messages.msgid: A blast of electricity from your Super Stun Gun bionic.
translations: 从你身上的超级电击枪里射出来的一束电流。

messages.msgid: You discharge energy from your Super Stun Gun.
translations: 你使用你的超级电击枪释放出一股强大的能量。

messages.msgid: A stimulator system has been surgically implanted alongside your adrenal glands, allowing you to trigger your body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.
translations: 在你肾上腺内经过手术被植入了一套刺激装置，消耗生化能量可以触发你的身体的肾上腺素反应。

messages.msgid: A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  Everything loses velocity when penetrating this field, which results in reduced amount of dealt damage at the cost of your bionic energy.  Bullets and stabbing attacks will lose more velocity than cutting attacks and those in turn more than bashing attacks.
translations: 一层围绕着你的身体的薄薄力场，不断地消耗着能量。任何东西在穿过这个力场时都会失去速度，造成更少的伤害，但同时也会造成额外的能量消耗。子弹和扎刺攻击会比切割攻击失去更多的速度，而这些攻击又会比钝击失去更多的速度。

messages.msgid: A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert you.  This is very useful during sleep, or if you suspect a cloaked pursuer.
translations: 一个运动侦测警报系统，可以侦测到半径15英尺（约4.6米）范围内的所有运动，并且为你提供无声的警报。在睡觉时很有用，或者当你怀疑自己被隐身怪物追踪时。

messages.msgid: In a cruel twist of fate, a poorly executed CBM surgery has given you a pair of useless bionics which make squeaking noises when you walk.
translations: 命运难料，你经历了一次失败的CBM安装手术，除CBM失效外，还让你在行走时发出吱吱的响声。

messages.msgid: Extremely thin lenses provide user with augmented reality overlay allowing the user to zoom, and it displays handy information about local topology.
translations: 为用户提供叠加增强显示的超薄镜头，可以缩放视野，展示一些有用的信息。

messages.msgid: An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your arms and hands, protecting them from physical trauma.
translations: 先进的防护网状合金已经编织进你手臂和双手的肌肉中，保护其免受物理创伤。

messages.msgid: Your eye sockets have been surgically sealed with highly protective mirrored lenses and your tear ducts have been re-routed to your mouth.  When you cry, you must spit out or swallow your tears.
translations: 你的眼眶经过手术被高防护的反光镜片封死了，你的泪管被重新导向你的口腔。当你哭泣的时候，如果不把眼泪吐出来，你就只能含泪吞下去了。

messages.msgid: An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your head and jaw region, protecting your skull from physical trauma.
translations: 先进的防护网状合金已经编织进你头部和嘴部的肌肉中，保护其免受物理创伤。

messages.msgid: An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your legs and feet, protecting them from physical trauma.
translations: 先进的防护网状合金已经编织进你腿部和双脚的肌肉中，保护其免受物理创伤。

messages.msgid: An advanced protective meshwork has been woven into the flesh on your torso, protecting it from physical trauma.
translations: 先进的防护网状合金已经编织进你躯干的肌肉中，保护其免受物理创伤。

messages.msgid: You have a battery draining attachment, and thus can make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.  Use bionic menu to drain charge from a battery.  Can be toggled on and off at will.
translations: 你体内装有一个电池系统，能够使用存储在普通电池内的电力。在生化插件菜单中开启来使用电池。可以自由开关。

messages.msgid: A deadly foot-long blade made of advanced material now resides inside your forearm, capable of being extended through the back of your wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent you from holding anything else while extended.
translations: 约30厘米长的单分子刀片隐藏在你的前臂内侧，通过手腕背部的电源驱动。异常锋利，伸展时会妨碍你抱拿握其他物品。

messages.msgid: Concealed in your left arm is a single shot 12 gauge shotgun.  Activate the bionic to fire and reload the shotgun.
translations: 你的左臂内隐藏着一把单发12号口径霰弹枪。激活这个生化插件以发射并装填该霰弹枪。

messages.msgid: A pair of lenses surgically installed over your eyes that can be tinted to block out incoming light.
translations: 你的眼睛经过手术安装上了能够变换颜色的镜片，可以遮挡光线。

messages.msgid: Small sensors have been surgically implanted in your heart, allowing you to analyze your blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.
translations: 你的心脏经过手术被植入了小型传感器，让你可以分析自身的血液情况。这将能够检测到各种疾病、毒瘾及其他身体情况。

messages.msgid: A filtration system near your heart allows you to actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs.  It will have limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in your system will be affected.
translations: 你的心脏旁被植入了一个过滤系统，让你能够主动过滤掉血液中的化学杂质，主要是药物和毒品。但该系统对病毒效果不佳。需要注意的是该系统并非定向过滤系统，你体内的所有药物和毒品都会受到影响。

messages.msgid: You have a complex port surgically mounted above your hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via jumper cable.
translations: 你的臀部上方通过手术安装了一个复杂的接口，启动后可以通过跨接电缆与电源连接并恢复生化能量。

messages.msgid: Lying just beneath your skin is a thin armor made of carbon nanotubes.  This has no impact on blunt trauma but will protect you against deep cuts.
translations: 一层薄薄的碳纳米管制成的装甲置于你的皮肤之下。它无法防御钝击伤害，但可以保护你免受过深的斩击伤害。

messages.msgid: Your body is equipped with a chain lightning generator, allowing you to emit a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake, jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.
translations: 你的身体被植入了一个连锁闪电发生器，可以释放一道闪电攻击周围的目标。闪电命中目标后会跳跃到目标附近4格内的其他目标身上。

messages.msgid: Vicious claws have been surgically installed inside your fingers, allowing you to extend and retract them at the cost of a small amount of power.  These do considerable cutting damage, but prevent you from holding anything else while extended.
translations: 你的手指经过手术安装上了伸缩式利爪，消耗少量生化能量可将其伸出或收回。爪子可造成斩击伤害，但是伸出爪子时无法手持任何物品。

messages.msgid: Throughout your body lies a network of thermal piping, which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures when activated.
translations: 在你的体内设有一个热气管网，启动后它可以轻易的影响周围环境温度的高低。

messages.msgid: This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make you blend into your background, rendering you fully invisible to normal vision.  However, you may be detected by infrared, sonar, etc.
translations: 一套高耗能的隐身系统，由无数的迷你摄像机和LED灯组成，让你能与周围环境融为一体，进入可见光隐身状态。但是，你仍旧可以被红外视觉发现，隐形系统也无法屏蔽声音和气味之类的信息。

messages.msgid: Bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs, are surgically integrated into your nervous system.  While active, the CQB module will improve your hand-to-hand combat skills, but prevents you from improving them through combat experience.
translations: 你的神经系统经过手术植入了一块存储有海量武术程序的数据库和处理器。开启时，它可以提升你的徒手格斗技能，但是将会使你无法从战斗中获得经验。

messages.msgid: A combination of poor surgical installation and unpleasant scarring has lead to the malfunctioning bionic catastrophe you call your face.  People who mind that you look like a dime-store Frankenstein will react poorly to your appearance.
translations: 你的脸部因为一次拙劣的生化手术留下了失效的生化插件以及恐怖的疤痕。那些外貌协会成员会因为你这张山寨弗兰肯斯坦的脸而反感你。

messages.msgid: Your reaction time has been greatly enhanced with bionic nerve stimulators, giving you a +2 bonus to dexterity.
translations: 你体内植入的生化神经电极大幅缩短了你的反应时间，敏捷+2。

messages.msgid: You have been outfitted with three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only can you extract much more nutrition from food, but you are highly resistant to foodborne illness, and can sometimes eat rotten food.
translations: 你的消化系统被改造成了拥有三个人造胃和工业级人造肠道的系统。你不仅可以从食物中吸收更多营养，还会对食物传染类疾病产生很高的抗性，另外偶尔也能吃下腐坏的食物。

messages.msgid: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges acid into your muscles, causing sharp pain and minor damage.
translations: 一个出故障的生化插件，会不时向你的肌肉里释放酸液，造成刺痛和微小的伤害。

messages.msgid: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges electricity through your body, causing pain and brief paralysis but no damage.
translations: 一个出故障的生化插件，时不时的漏电，这会造成疼痛和短暂全身麻痹瘫痪，不过不会产生伤害。

messages.msgid: A malfunctioning bionic.  It doesn't perform any useful function, but will occasionally draw power from your batteries.
translations: 一个出故障的生化插件。它没有任何益处，而且会不时的从你的储能系统中吸能。

messages.msgid: When this bionic is active, you can block hearing completely.
translations: 激活这个生化插件能完全隔绝声音。

messages.msgid: When this bionic is active, your hearing will be drastically improved, allowing you to hear ten times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage your hearing.
translations: 当这个生化插件启用时，你的听力将极大提高，使你能够达到相当于普通人10倍的听力。此外，高分贝的声音将在你听力受到损伤前自动减弱。

messages.msgid: Surgically implanted into your skull near the eardrums are two speakers, as well as a small port behind the left earlobe.  They can pick up local radio waves and play downloaded music in concert hall quality.  It came pre-installed with "Rubik's Mickse".
translations: 在你的头骨靠近耳膜的地方，通过手术植入了两个扬声器，左耳垂后面还有一个小端口。它们可以接收本地的无线电波，并以音乐厅级音质播放下载的音乐。它预装了“鲁比克的混音”。

messages.msgid: Hailing from a world choked with neon smog, and appreciated by Exodii artists, the AudioVox implant allows you to change, remodulate, and even autotune your voice.  It also causes vocalizations /(such as shouts and singing/) to be much louder.  It consists of an electronic voice box, synthetic larynx and multiple speakers implanted throughout your throat.
translations: 这款语音合成植入物来自一个被霓虹烟雾笼罩的世界，深受 流亡族艺术家的喜爱。它可以让你改变声音，为其变调甚至自动调音。它还能让发声（如喊叫和唱歌）更加响亮。它由电子声匣、人造喉头和多个植入你喉咙的扬声器组成。

messages.msgid: Surgically mounted in your left arm and the palm of your left hand are small parabolic EMP field generators.  You may use power to fire a wide but short-ranged blast that will disable electronics and robots.
translations: 你的左掌被手术植入了一只小型抛物式EMP发射器。你能够使用生化能量发射短距离的EMP冲击，瘫痪电子器械和机器人。

messages.msgid: A ranged EMP generator system is implanted in your right arm and the palm of your right hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets but mostly useless otherwise.
translations: 你的右臂和右掌被手术植入了一套远程电磁脉冲发生器系统。这套系统能发射精准的单目标脉冲，需要时间瞄准。对电子目标特别有效，但对其它目标没什么作用。

messages.msgid: You burn alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.
translations: 你通过一种极其高效的转换方式来燃烧酒精产生能量。

messages.msgid: Slowly generates bionic power out of kerosene or motor oil.
translations: 燃烧煤油或机油来缓慢恢复生化能量。

messages.msgid: This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into your blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.
translations: 这个插件可以从周围的空气中吸收水蒸气，逐渐将其直接注入血液之中。在非常干燥的地区，此仪器可能效果不佳。

messages.msgid: Your vision is greatly enhanced, giving you a +2 bonus to perception.
translations: 你的视觉被生化插件大幅强化了，感知+2。

messages.msgid: Much of the material in your inner eye has been surgically removed and replaced with an array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses.  They function as integrated binoculars, letting you see much farther than before, and any vision problems you might have had are now gone.
translations: 你眼球内的大部分组织已经被手术移除，取而代之的是一套高倍率的自动对焦透镜阵列。它们就像一个集成的双筒望远镜，让你比以前看得更远，以前的视力问题都消失了。

messages.msgid: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, you are capable of altering your facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.
translations: 通过生物化学控制的微型电机，你能够改变你的面部结构，从而巧妙地影响他人对你的反应。这将让你在和NPC交互时获得社交加成。

messages.msgid: Throughout your body lies a network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors which can be charged with bionic power to temporarily protect you from external electrical discharge.
translations: 在你整个身体内部建立一个绝缘电容网络，能够通过使用生化能量暂时保护你免受外部电击的伤害。

messages.msgid: One of your fingers has an electrohack surgically embedded in it; an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like (but not computers).  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.
translations: 你的一根手指经过手术被嵌入了电子黑客仪，允许你破解大部分控制面板以及类似的系统（但不包含电脑）。你的计算机学技能等级将影响成功率，而失败的尝试有可能损坏你体内的电路系统。

messages.msgid: A module implanted in your body measures your calorie intake and expenditure at all times.
translations: 一个植入你体内的模组/模块，可以随时测量你的卡路里摄入和消耗。

messages.msgid: Light emitting diodes surgically integrated into your skin can release a flash comparable to a flashbang grenade, blinding nearby enemies.  Speakers integrated into your body mimic the loud sound, deafening those nearby.
translations: 你的皮肤表面经过手术植入了许多发光二极管，能够释放出媲美闪光弹的强烈闪光，让附近的人失明。同时体内植入的扬声器也能够释放出巨大的响声，让附近的人失聪。

messages.msgid: Surgically mounted between your eyes is a small but powerful LED flashlight.
translations: 你的两眼之间经过手术安装了一个小巧强劲的LED闪光灯。

messages.msgid: You can greatly intensify the power of your bionic flashlight to be much brighter at a much higher power cost.
translations: 你可以大大增强仿生手电筒的功率，以更高的功率成本获得更大的亮度。

messages.msgid: A small LED display just beneath your dermal layer can be illuminated on command to show patterns of your choice at dim or bright luminosity.  It doesn't provide enough light to comfortably read or craft, but it can suffice if you have nothing else.
translations: 一个小型LED显示屏植入了你的皮肤层下面，可以根据指令照明，在昏暗或明亮的亮度显示你选择的图案。它不能提供足够的光来舒适地阅读或制造物品，但如果你没有其他光源，它也勉强够用。

messages.msgid: You don't think that capacitor is *meant* to glow, but it does, and usually at bad times.  A malfunctioning bionic randomly turns on and off, causing you to glow and making you visible in the dark without improving how much you can see in the slightest.
translations: 你没想过电容还能发光，但是它的确会，而且通常是在糟糕的时机下发光。这个失灵的仿生插件会随机开关，发出光芒，让你难以在黑暗中隐藏。然而，它的光芒不足以让你看清周围的事物。

messages.msgid: Small radiation sensors have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to analyze your level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert you whenever exposed to environmental radiation.
translations: 你的全身经过手术植入了许多小型辐射传感器，可以让你分析你吸收的辐射水平。当暴露于辐射环境时，该装置也会提醒你。

messages.msgid: A complex respiration augmentation system.  Improves respiration ability in air and allows breathing water.  Will automatically activate when drowning.  Turn on to recharge stamina faster, at moderate power cost.  Asthmatics may also use it to stop asthma attacks.
translations: 一个复杂的呼吸增强系统。可以强化在空气中的呼吸能力，并允许在水中呼吸，溺水后自动开启。开启后以中等能量消耗，快速恢复耐力。哮喘患者也可以用它来阻止哮喘发作。

messages.msgid: Your feet are equipped with precision sonar equipment, allowing you to detect the movements of creatures below the ground, buried traps, and unstable terrain.
translations: 你的脚掌上植入了精密的声纳设备，可以探测地下生物的移动、掩埋的陷阱和不稳定的地形。

messages.msgid: You sense some creature moving underground here.
translations: 你感到一些生物在地下活动。

messages.msgid: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage, and increasing your power reserves slightly.
translations: 当你徒手攻击恒温生物时，你有一定几率吸取目标体内的热能，造成少量的额外伤害并增加少量的生化能量。

messages.msgid: Powerful heatsinks and supermaterials are surgically woven into your flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect your internal temperature.
translations: 你的体表经过手术植入了强大的散热片和超级材料纤维，插件开启时可以防护低于2000华氏度（约1093摄氏度）的高温伤害。注意，这不会影响你体内的热量。

messages.msgid: While activated, your muscles will be greatly enhanced, increasing your strength by 20.
translations:
你的双臂肌肉发力被改造为液压动力，当该系统激活时，你的肌力会得到极大的强化，增加20点力量。
"下一个，来！"

messages.msgid: Your range of vision extends into the infrared, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark or through smoke.
translations: 你的视觉扩展到了红外波段，使你能在黑暗中或透过烟雾看见恒温生物。

messages.msgid: Your brain has been enhanced with bionic coprocessors, giving you a +2 bonus to intelligence.
translations: 你的大脑被植入了更强大的生物处理芯片，智力+2。

messages.msgid: A bionic of some sort, so badly installed that you cannot even tell what it was originally supposed to be.  Sometimes it itches horribly.
translations: 一个生化插件，它安装的太糟糕了，使它无法发挥原先的作用，但有了一个新效果：让你奇痒难忍。

messages.msgid: One of your fingers has a small high-powered laser surgically embedded in it.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.
translations: 你的一根手指经过手术被植入了一把小型高能激光枪。此远程武器虽然不会造成很高的伤害，但是命中率很高，并且可能点燃目标。

messages.msgid: This botched piece of bionic hardware slowly leaks electrolytic compounds, piezoelectric nanomaterials, and other high-tech contaminants into your bloodstream.  Needless to say, this is not good for your health.
translations: 你体内有一个安装失败的生化插件，该插件慢慢释放出电解化合物、压电纳米物质以及其他高科技污染物到你血液中。不必多说，肯定对你的健康不好。

messages.msgid: You are equipped with bionic stimulators which augment your haematopoiesis system, allowing you to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is supposed to run continuously and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.
translations: 你安装了刺激造血功能的生化系统，让你可以消耗储能来加速白细胞的生产。它应当保持持续运行，开启后再关闭可能会导致不愉快的副作用。

messages.msgid: The index finger of your left hand has a fire starter that can extend from the tip.
translations: 你的左手食指尖端被手术植入了火焰喷射器，可喷射出高温火焰。

messages.msgid: One of your fingers has an electronic lockpick surgically embedded in it.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.
translations: 你的一根手指经过手术被嵌入了电子开锁器，这个全自动开锁器可以打开除最先进的电子锁外的所有锁，并且不需要使用者掌握任何开锁技能。

messages.msgid: Surgically embedded in your left arm is a powerful electromagnet, allowing you to use your own strength to pull all nearby magnetic objects towards you.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.
translations: 你的左臂被手术植入了一个强力电磁铁，使你能够使用自身力量吸引周围所有磁性物品。不明真相的围观群众可能会被到处乱飞的物品击伤甚至击毙。

messages.msgid: Your eyes are equipped with thin membranes that cover your eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.
translations: 你的眼睛上覆盖着一侧透明的人工薄膜，让你在水下仍能清晰视物，不受视野惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your memory has been enhanced with small quantum storage drives.  While active, you learn - both through reading and practice - more quickly.  Additionally, you forget skills you've learned slower.
translations: 一组小型量子存储器增强了你的记忆。当开启时，你通过阅读和实践训练技能的速度都变快了。此外，你遗忘技能的速度会变慢。

messages.msgid: Your digestive system and power supply are interconnected; bionic energy is replenished by burning calories.  Can be toggled on and off at will.
translations: 你的消化系统和生化能量系统被连接到了一起，可以通过消耗卡路里来恢复生化能量。可以随意开关。

messages.msgid: A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collect environmental data.  The data is compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells you the local air temperature.
translations: 一堆科学装置和感应器的集合。用来收集周围环境的数据，这些数据随后将会被分析并汇总成为易于读取的天气情况报告。它还可随时显示周围的环境温度。

messages.msgid: Inside your body is a fleet of tiny dormant robots.  While activated they will flit about your body, repairing damage at 1 HP per minute and stopping bleeding at the cost of extra power and stored calories.  No power is consumed if there is nothing to heal.
translations: 你体内有一群微型纳米机器人。开启时会不断消耗能量，绕行你的周身，并通过消耗额外能量和卡路里来以每分钟 1 HP 的速度修复伤害以及止血。没有治疗需要时不会消耗能量。

messages.msgid: When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius through destructive interference.
translations: 开启时，这个生化插件会通过干扰光线消除附近 2 格内所有的光源。

messages.msgid: When active, this bionic will amplify existing light, allowing you to see in the dark.
translations: 这个生化插件启用时可以通过放大微弱光线来增强你的夜视能力。

messages.msgid: A malfunctioning bionic.  It will occasionally emit a loud burst of noise.
translations: 一个出现故障的生化插件。它偶尔会发出一阵滋滋滋的巨大噪音。

messages.msgid: You're really not sure how the CBM ended up in your nose, but no matter how it got there this badly misplaced bionic makes it difficult to breathe.  Increases mouth encumbrance by ten.
translations: 你真的不知道那个CBM是怎么到你鼻子你去的，但不管怎样它严重的干扰了你的呼吸，你不得不用嘴来呼吸。嘴部累赘+10。

messages.msgid: A thin forcefield surrounds your body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.
translations: 当该系统激活时，一层护盾会围绕你的身体并持续消耗能量。这层护盾不会格挡或偏移任何攻击，但是会电击徒手或使用金属武器攻击你的目标。

messages.msgid: Your nervous system is wired to allow you to inhibit the signals of pain, allowing you to dull your senses at will.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction time and drowsiness.
translations: 你的神经系统经过生化改造，可让你大幅度抑制疼痛及抑制各类感官输入。不过，使用该系统可能会导致反应迟钝和嗜睡等症状。

messages.msgid: Due to a badly misplaced dielectric stylette, you are now suffering from mild optic neuropathy.  Increases eye encumbrance by ten.
translations: 由于一次严重的生化插件安装失误，你现在患有轻度视神经病变。眼部累赘+10。

messages.msgid: A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 100 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.
translations: 储能模块CBM，可以为你增加 100kJ 的生化能量储备上限。你至少需要一个储能模块才能使用耗能型CBM，同时你还需要至少一种供能型CBM，为自己充能。

messages.msgid: A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 250 kJ.
translations: 小型生化电池插件，可以为你增加 250kJ 的生化能量储备上限。

messages.msgid: Damaged power circuits cause short-circuiting inside your muscles when your batteries are above 75% capacity, causing greatly reduced strength.  This has no effect if you have no internal batteries.
translations: 损坏的能量线路会在你储能超过75%时在你的肌肉内发生短路，使你的力量大幅下降。当然如果你没有内置储能系统，这玩意就不会对你产生任何影响。

messages.msgid: Increases your body's wavelength, allowing you to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Power drain in standby is minimal, but each tile tunneled through costs 250 bionic power.
translations: 让你的身体波长进行改变，使得你可以量子隧穿墙壁，出现在另一边。待机时功耗非常小，但每穿透一格墙壁时消耗250点能量。

messages.msgid: Surgically implanted in your trachea is an advanced filtration system.  If toxins or airborne diseases find their way into your windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.
translations: 你的气管经过手术被植入了一套先进的空气过滤系统。不管进入你气管的是毒气还是空气传播病菌，这个过滤器都会尝试将其过滤。

messages.msgid: A compact communications device has been built into your ears, enabling you to communicate over radio waves.
translations: 你的耳朵内置了一个紧凑的通信设备，使你能够通过无线电波进行通信。

messages.msgid: A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to purge yourself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.
translations: 你的身体经过手术被植入了一套先进的压电式血液透析装置，使你可以通过消耗生化能量来清除体内的辐射。

messages.msgid: You possess razor-sharp claws underneath your fingernails that do a small amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever your fingertips are uncovered.
translations: 在你的指甲之下有着锋利的爪子，可以在你的指尖没有被覆盖时造成轻微的斩击伤害。

messages.msgid: Your digestive system has been outfitted with a series of filters and processors, allowing you to reclaim waste liquid and, to a lesser degree, nutrients.  The net effect is a greatly reduced need to eat and drink.
translations: 你的消化系统被改造成了拥有一系列过滤器和处理器的装置，允许你回收体内废液并从中提取少量的营养物质。此生化插件可大幅度降低你的饮食需求。

messages.msgid: A small module connected to your brain allows you to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.
translations: 一个连接到你大脑的小模块，可以与附近有无线功能的设备联动。

messages.msgid: Your entire body may resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.
translations: 你的身体在极高的能量下产生共振，制造出一个短距离冲击波。虽然无法对生物造成多少伤害，但是会损坏坚硬的物体，例如墙和门。

messages.msgid: While this system is powered, your body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track you by scent.
translations: 当该系统激活时，你的身体只会产生很少的气味，使得其他生物几乎不可能通过气味来跟踪你。

messages.msgid: A poorly-wired bionic which fails to serve its intended purpose, this malfunctioning device periodically short-circuits, causing systemic muscle tremors.
translations: 一个安装失败的生化插件未能达到其预期目的，该设备周期性地短路，导致全身肌肉震颤。

messages.msgid: An electromagnetic stimulator has been surgically implanted on the back of your head and along your spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, you will not suffer from sleep deprivation, although you may still feel sleepy; and if you're sleep deprived already, it will gradually reduce the symptoms of lacking sleep.
translations: 一套电磁刺激装置被植入到你的后脑和脊柱上，不断地消耗着生化能量。当被激活时，你就不会受到睡眠不足的惩罚，尽管你仍会困倦；如果你已经睡眠不足了，它将逐渐减轻睡眠不足的症状。

messages.msgid: While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock your opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.
translations: 当你徒手搏斗或者使用可导电的武器时，你有一定几率消耗部分能量电击对手，造成额外伤害并暂时使目标失去行动能力。

messages.msgid: You generate a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knockback any creatures they collide with.
translations: 你产生一道强力的冲击波，击退所有附近的生物并造成短暂的眩晕，如果撞击在无法通行的地形上将造成额外的伤害和眩晕，被击退生物碰撞到的其他生物也会被一同击退。

messages.msgid: Through a combination of psychochemical manipulation and old fashioned electrical nerve stimulation, this malfunctioning bionic alters your brain chemistry in such a way as to cause sleepiness.  You will find yourself tiring a bit faster than before.
translations: 因为一些生化手术和过时的电神经刺激装置，这个故障的生化插件扰乱了你的内分泌，让你容易产生睡意。你会发现你比以前更容易犯困了。

messages.msgid: One piezoelectric solenoid surgically installed backwards, two crossed wires, and four burned-out capacitors later you started falling on your face and writhing around at the least convenient times.  This incorrectly-configured bionic periodically stuns you for a short duration.
translations: 手术时一个压电电磁阀装反了，两根线绕在了一起，四个电容烧坏了。这个错误安装的生化插件会周期性使你眩晕一小会。

messages.msgid: Your nervous system has been enhanced with bionic stimulators, giving you a 10% boost to your speed.
translations: 你神经系统突触经过了生化刺激装置强化，给你的速度带来10%的提升。

messages.msgid: Improperly installed wires cause a physical stiffness in most of your body, causing increased encumbrance.
translations: 错误安装的导线会导致你全身大部僵直，从而增加你的累赘度。

messages.msgid: Your muscular system has been surgically enhanced with myomer fibers, giving you a +2 bonus to strength.
translations: 你的肌肉组织经过手术被替换成为更为强劲的生化纤维，力量+2。

messages.msgid: A system of surgical grade scalpels is implanted in your forearms, extending from just above your wrists.  They allow you to make automated precise cuts and can also be used as a high-quality butchering tool.
translations: 你的前臂至手腕被手术植入了一组外科手术刀。这让你能够进行全自动的精确切割。它也可以作为高级屠宰工具使用。

messages.msgid: Your eyes have quick-reacting transition lenses surgically installed over them.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect you from bright flashes, and protect your eyes when welding.
translations: 你的眼睛经过手术被植入了一套反应灵敏的折射镜头，它能抵消眩光的惩罚，保护你的眼睛免受强光伤害。

messages.msgid: You have highly efficient artificial lungs which greatly increase your oxygen intake.  If they are not powered you will suffocate, and they weaken your immune system somewhat.
translations: 高效的人工肺，可以大大增加氧气摄入量。 如果它们失去供能，你就会窒息，而且它们会在一定程度上削弱你的免疫系统。

messages.msgid: Your eyes are surgically equipped with range finders, and their movement is synced with that of your arms, to a degree.  Shots you fire will be much more accurate, particularly at long range.
translations: 你的眼睛经过手术被植入了一套测距仪，并且能够与你的手臂在某种程度上保持同步移动。你的射击将更加精准，尤其是在远程射击时。

messages.msgid: While active, a tiny device in your inner ear periodically generates ultrasonic pulses which aid in navigation, provided you are underwater and able to hear.
translations: 一个植入内耳的小型装置。开启时，它会周期性地发出超声波脉冲，协助你导航，前提是你得在水下并且能听到声音。

messages.msgid: You have a powerful stun gun built into your hand.  Activate to zap an adjacent enemy.
translations: 你的手上装着一把强大的电击枪，激活以击杀附近的敌人。

messages.msgid: This highly experimental unit folds space over short distances, instantly transporting your body up to 25 feet at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.
translations: 这个高度实验性质的生化插件可将空间折叠，进行短距离传送。通过消耗大量能量，你可以迅速传送至25英尺（约7.6米）外的地方。需要注意的是长期或者频繁使用可能有危险的副作用。

messages.msgid: Self-locking thumbs hold tight (even when you really don't want them to) and don't let go (even when you'd rather they did).  Increases hand encumbrance by ten, while failing to improve your ability to hold objects whatsoever.
translations: 会自锁的手指紧紧抓住（尽管你不想这么做）并且坚决不松开（尽管你很想放手）。手部累赘+10，但是并不能让你能把手里的物品抓得更牢。

messages.msgid: At the cost of all stored bionic power, you may increase your body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  You are still delicate, however, and violent or rapid movements may damage you due to friction.
translations: 通过消耗体内所有储存的生化插件能量，你可以极大的提升自己的速度和反应能力，就好像把时间冻结了一样。要记住的是，超高速下运动产生的空气摩擦可能会导致你受伤。

messages.msgid: Surgically implanted in your hands and forearms is a set of compact tools and a welder that runs off your internal power banks.
translations: 你的手和前臂通过外科手术植入了一整套紧凑的工具和一台使用体内生化能量的焊机。

messages.msgid: Your fingers and arms have been implanted with retractable electrical probes connected to a multimeter embedded in your arm, allowing you to measure electrical voltage, resistance, and current by touch.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.
translations: 你的手指和手臂被植入了可伸缩的电子探针，探针与嵌入手臂的万用表相连，可以通过触摸测量电压、电阻和电流。这也为你的手部和手臂提供了少许电击防护。

messages.msgid: Your fingers and arms have been implanted a soldering iron, a multimeter, and a set of small screwdrivers, providing all the tools required for working with bench-scale electrical circuits.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.
translations: 你的手指和手臂被植入了一个烙铁、一个万用表和一套小螺丝刀，提供了制造小型电子电路所需的全套工具。这也为你的手部和手臂提供了少许电击防护。

messages.msgid: Your joints have been surgically equipped with torsion ratchets that slowly generate power when you move.  Whilst this is toggled, moving will require more effort, though more power will be generated.
translations: 你的关节处被植入了齿轮发电机，当你移动时可以缓慢的产生能量。当开启该模块时，能产生更多生化能量，但移动更加费力。

messages.msgid: Your leg joints have been equipped with servomotors that provide power-assisted movement.  Movement takes less effort when this bionic is online.  However, when it's offline it will hamper your movement, as you struggle against its moving parts.
translations: 你的腿关节配备了伺服电机，能为运动提供辅助动力。当该生化插件开启时，移动起来会变得更加轻松。然而，当它关闭时，未工作的移动部件会阻碍你的行动。

messages.msgid: A malfunctioning bionic which causes occasional visual distortion and pixelation.
translations: 一个出现故障的生化插件。导致你偶尔会出现视觉失真和像素化。

messages.msgid: Your nervous system has been augmented with bionic processors, allowing you to dodge attacks beyond normal human capability.
translations: 你的神经系统因为安装插件而得到了强化，获得超乎常人的回避技巧。

messages.msgid: You have a Unified Power System wired into your power banks.  Objects that run on a UPS can now draw directly from your bionic power supply.
translations: 你的能量槽嵌入了UPS系统。使用UPS的物品现在可以直接使用你的生化能源了。

messages.msgid: You will likely spend the rest of your days serving as a walking testament to why you don't opt for the Autodoc's 'Cyborg Identity Package'.  A remodulator unit jammed down your throat has given you a creepy robot voice.
translations: 你的余生将可能是一个为什么不选择全自动医疗仪的"改造人身份套餐"的活生生的反面教材了。一个安装失败又卡在你喉咙里的变声器，使你的声音变成了令人毛骨悚然的机械音。

messages.msgid: You have been equipped with an internal atomic clock, ensuring that you will always know the current time.  Additionally, it includes a silent alarm clock function.
translations: 你体内安装了一个小型原子钟，确保你永远知道当前的时间。另外它还有一个无声闹钟功能。

messages.msgid: Nanotubes surgically embedded in the palm of your hand will pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities and convert it into drinkable water.  You must, however, have a container to store the water in.
translations: 你的掌心经过手术被植入了纳米管，允许你从任何尸体中提取可用的液体，净化并转换为可饮用的净水。不过，你必须有个装水的容器。

messages.msgid: A small gasoline fuel cell fixed to your scapula.  Despite its limited energy output compared to other fuel cells, this device still produces a significant amount of heat dissipated through a heat exhaust protruding from your back.  A diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders has been meshed with your circulatory system and serves as a fuel tank.
translations: 一个装在肩胛骨上的小型汽油燃料电池。尽管它的能量输出相比其它燃料电池以及很少，它仍然会产生大量的热量，只能通过一个从你背部伸出的散热系统散热。一套生物塑胶制成的液囊扩散网络沿着你的循环系统放置，用于存放燃料。

messages.msgid: The flesh of the inside of your middle finger has been replaced with a tube leading into your arteries, with a retractable needle extending out of the tip of the finger when clenched.  This lets you pump intravenous drugs like morphine directly into your bloodstream without needing to carry a syringe.
translations: 你中指内的肌肉已经被一根通向你静脉的针管所取代，当你紧握拳头时，一根可伸缩的针管从中指指尖伸出。可将如吗啡这样的静脉注射药物直接注入你的血液中，而不需要额外携带注射器。

messages.msgid: Titanium bracing has been installed onto your elbows, knees, and spine, making them far better at handling strain.  Your carrying capacity is increased by 20 kilograms, or about 44 pounds, and you receive slightly less bashing damage to your arms, legs and torso.
translations: 钛合金骨架被植入了你的膝盖、肘部和脊椎内，让其能够更好的承受压力。你的负重提升了20千克，约44磅，同时你的手部、腿部与躯干受到更少的钝击伤害。

messages.msgid: A set of highly sensitive sensors is installed in your mouth, and a small yet sophisticated analyzer is installed in the cavity of your skull.  The active bionic will nullify the taste of all comestibles with negative enjoyment value at the cost of draining bionic power.
translations: 你的嘴里被安装了一套高度敏感的传感器，头骨腔中安装了一个小而精密的分析仪。开启后将消耗生化能量使所有难吃的食物不再具有负面心情效果。

messages.msgid: An electrode has been implanted into your brain's ventrolateral preoptic nucleus.  It turns on whenever you're trying to fall asleep, creating an artificial but effective sensation of sleepiness.
translations: 一个电极被植入你大脑的前额叶。每当你试图入睡时，它就会启动，产生一种人造但有效的睡意。

messages.msgid: A broken implant that sends electromagnetic impulses that reduce other implants capacity to store charge.
translations: 一个损坏的生化插件，它会不断发出电磁脉冲，降低其他储能生化插件的容量。

messages.msgid: A malfunctioning processor haphazardly interfaced with your taste receptors has given everything you consume a horrid bitter taste.  Food and drink will severely harm your morale.
translations: 一个不正常的处理器与你的味觉感受器连接失灵，让你吃下的每样东西都有种可怕的苦味。食物和饮料会极度损害你的心情。

messages.msgid: This damaged CBM occasionally leaks radiation.
translations: 这个损坏的CBM偶尔泄露出辐射。

messages.msgid: Reactive shock absorbers installed in your wrists and elbows which greatly reduce felt recoil.
translations: 你的手腕和肘部被植入了反应式减震器，这大大减少了后坐力。

messages.msgid: For better or worse, this CBM suppresses stimuli while asleep, preventing you from waking up until the end of your natural sleep cycle.
translations: 不知道是好是坏，这个CBM在你睡觉时会抑制刺激，阻止你在自然睡眠周期结束前醒来。

messages.msgid: Taken from a world that embraced cybernetics in their sports, this CBM links the eyes to a series of nerve stimulators along the arms and hands.  The result is a significant increase to throwing accuracy, and it turns out it works great with fragmentation grenades.
translations: 这种CBM来自于一个生化改造被体育竞技所接受的世界，它将眼睛与沿手臂和手部的一系列神经刺激器连接起来。能够大大增加投掷的准确性，而且事实证明，它用来扔破片手榴弹依然好用。

messages.msgid: You smash the %s with a powerful shoulder-check.
translations: 你用一记强力的撞肩猛击了 %s。

messages.msgid: You smash the %s with a firm headbutt.
translations: 你用一记强力的头槌猛击了 %s。

messages.msgid: You use your flippin' face to smash the %s.  EXTREME.
translations: 你用你坚硬的脸皮猛击了 %s。太疯狂了。
你用一记强力的肘击猛击了 %s。

messages.msgid: You smash the %s with your fist.
You bring your knee down on the %s, smashing it.
You kick down the %s, smashing it.
You recently finished a training session and need a mental break before teaching again.
translations: 你最近刚刚完成培训课程，需要在再次教学前休息一下。

messages.msgid: Your armor has been shattered by a heavy attack.
translations: 你的护甲被一次猛烈攻击击碎了。

messages.msgid: You've been knocked off-balance by an attack.
translations: 你被一次攻击弄得失去了平衡。
你受到的伤害让你失去了平衡。

messages.msgid: It's hard to pay attention to anything when you're in the middle of sneezing!
translations: 打喷嚏的时候很难集中注意力！

messages.msgid: You're knocked to the ground.  You have to get up before you can move.
translations: 你倒在了地板上，你必须爬起来才能继续移动。

messages.msgid: You're receiving assistance to practice a surgery.
translations: 你接受了外科手术的帮助。

messages.msgid: Your scent is masked by another one.
translations: 你的体味被其他气味所掩盖。

messages.msgid: Your received a complete check-up and are now aware of the state of your health.
translations: 你接受了一次完整的全身检查，现在已经了解自身健康的状况。

messages.msgid: At least one of your bionics is producing heat and warming you.
translations: 你的某个生化插件正在产生热量，使你的身体升温。

messages.msgid: You're short of breath.  Running and fighting will be difficult until you recover.
translations: 你气喘吁吁。跑步及打斗都将更困难，直到你回复。

messages.msgid: You're short of breath.  Your left leg has impaired function until you recover.
translations: 你气喘吁吁，在你恢复前左腿功能受损。

messages.msgid: You're short of breath.  Your right leg has impaired function until you recover.
translations: 你气喘吁吁，在你恢复前右腿功能受损。

messages.msgid: You're short of breath.  Your left arm has impaired function until you recover.
translations: 你气喘吁吁，在你恢复前左臂功能受损。

messages.msgid: You're short of breath.  Your right arm has impaired function until you recover.
translations: 你气喘吁吁，在你恢复前右臂功能受损。

messages.msgid: Your vision flickers and goes gray!
translations: 你眼前一团金星，东西开始失去色彩了！

messages.msgid: The world flickers back to normality.
translations: 闪烁的世界终于恢复正常。
你开始不自主的随意运动。

messages.msgid: Your artificial senses are scrambled and report false readings.
translations: 你的生化传感器被干扰，并输出错误读数。

messages.msgid: You're visibly shaken up, and are having a hard time focusing on what's going on around you.
translations: 你明显被震晕了，很难集中精神注意到发生在你身边的事情。

messages.msgid:
Loss of health - Entire Body
Your clothing and other equipment may be consumed by the flames.
translations:
损失生命 - 全身
你的衣服和其他装备可能被火焰破坏。

messages.msgid: You're on fire!  Wait in place to attempt to put out the fire.
translations: 你着火了！等在原地会尝试扑灭火焰。

messages.msgid: Your footing is unstable.  It's more difficult to fight while standing here.
translations: 你所站的地方不太稳固。站在这里战斗会更困难。

messages.msgid: You try to keep your balance.
Range of Sight: 0.  You cannot see anything.
translations: 视野降至0，你看不到任何东西。

messages.msgid: You are wearing earphones and can't hear much from outside world.
translations: 你戴着耳机，很难听到外界的声音。

messages.msgid: You can barely hear anything and your ears hurt.
translations: 你几乎什么也听不到了，耳朵好痛！

messages.msgid: You can't hear anything and your head aches from all the noise.  You can't converse with NPCs.
translations: 你听不见任何声音，噪音让你脑袋发疼，你无法与他人对话了。
你可以再次听到声音了！

messages.msgid: A bionic LED is glowing softly beneath your skin.
translations: 一个生化插件的LED在你的皮肤下柔和地发光。

messages.msgid: The pollen makes it hard to breathe!
The wound swells visibly and burns like hell.
translations: 伤口明显肿大，像地狱一样灼热。

messages.msgid: The burning pain subsides, but the damage is done.
translations: 灼热的疼痛减轻了，但伤害已经造成了。

messages.msgid: The sting itself barely hurt, but suddenly you feel exhausted.
translations: 刺伤本身几乎感觉不到痛，但你突然感到筋疲力尽。

messages.msgid: The weight on your chest lessens.
translations: 你胸口的重压感觉减轻了。

messages.msgid: You find it hard to concentrate on your surroundings properly.
translations: 你发现你很难集中注意力观察你周围的环境。

messages.msgid: You're not even listening, are you?
Everything will be fine.  Just ignore all you see, and everything will be fine.
translations: 一切都会好的。不管你看到什么，一切都会好起来的。

messages.msgid: It was right here, wasn't it?
Are you sure there's something there?
The wound throbs with sharp pain.
translations: 被咬到的伤口剧烈疼痛。

messages.msgid: A dull pain starts spreading from the wound!
translations: 一大片疼痛感开始从伤口蔓延开来！

messages.msgid: Your stomach is extremely upset, and you are quite nauseated.
translations: 你的胃中不停地翻滚，你感到非常的恶心。
你的胃不停地让你分心。

messages.msgid: You are being slowed by a paralyzing poison!
translations: 你被瘫痪性毒素减速了！

messages.msgid: You are nauseous and may lead to vomiting.
translations: 你感到很恶心，可能导致呕吐。

messages.msgid: Your sleep debt has been steadily increasing for a while.  You should get some rest.
translations: 你这一阵子一直缺乏足够的睡眠。你该歇会了。

messages.msgid: You feel weary, your body tired from lack of quality sleep.
translations: 你感到疲倦，你的身体因缺乏足够睡眠而疲惫不堪。

messages.msgid: You have finally caught up with your lost sleep, and you feel refreshed and awake for a change.
translations: 你终于补足了缺乏的睡眠，你感到自己变得精神饱满并且十分清醒。

messages.msgid: You took some melatonin supplements.  These will help with sleep deprivation.
translations: 你服用了一些褪黑素补充剂。这将帮助你改善睡眠不足的症状。

messages.msgid: You consumed mutagen.  It was probably a good idea.
translations: 你服用了诱变剂。这也许是个好主意。

messages.msgid: You can feel your insides shifting.  It feels… nice.
translations: 你能感觉到体内器官移动。感觉……很好。

messages.msgid: Your innards churn in an unnatural fashion - if you survive this, you'll be a changed… something.
translations: 你的内脏以一种不自然的方式不停扭动——如果你能活下来的话，你将变异成一只改变了的……某种生物。

messages.msgid: Your body is starting to feel normal again.
translations: 你的身体又感觉变得正常了。

messages.msgid: Your stomach feels like it's burning.  Hopefully that was a good idea…
translations: 你的胃感觉在燃烧。但愿喝下那种东西是个好主意……

messages.msgid: You're feeling a little better now.
You took a dose of chelator.  Any mutagenic drugs in your body are being purged.
translations: 你服用了一些诱变螯合剂。现在你身体里所有引起诱变的物质都在被清除。

messages.msgid: You feel better.  So much better.
translations: 你感觉好多了。好的多得多。

messages.msgid: The world needs you, surely this won't kill you.  It better not.
translations: 这个世界需要你，这肯定没法杀死你。最好不能。

messages.msgid: Now, to find a quiet pond and settle for the wait…
translations: 现在，只需要找到一个安静的池塘，安心等待……

messages.msgid: You feel like you're about to croak… if you don't keel over first.
translations: 你感觉自己快要顶呱呱了……如果你没先倒下的话。

messages.msgid: There must be prey around.  Stay alert.
translations: 附近一定有猎物。保持警惕。

messages.msgid: Primal instincts overwhelm your mind, and your saliva has turned to froth.
translations: 原始本能压倒了你的理智，你的唾液变成了一团泡沫。

messages.msgid: You feel the pull of the skies.
translations: 你能感受到天空的呼唤。

messages.msgid: Goosebumps stand across your entire body.  You keep feeling that you're falling.
translations: 你全身上下都起了鸡皮疙瘩。你一直感觉自己在朝下方坠落。

messages.msgid: This pasture will grow barren soon.  Keep moving.
translations: 这片牧场很快就会变得贫瘠。继续前行。

messages.msgid: Dull fog clouds your mind, and you feel close to vomiting.
translations: 浓雾笼罩着你的大脑，你感觉快要呕吐了。

messages.msgid: Your skin crawls and your extremities twitch and jerk.
translations: 你的皮肤毛骨悚然，四肢抽搐摆动。
你摄入了奇美拉引物。为什么？

messages.msgid: Your flesh is the clay of the new world.  You'll overcome all challenges.
translations: 你的血肉是新世界的泥土。你会克服所有的挑战。

messages.msgid: Your body heaving and changing is a rough time, but what doesn't kill you makes you stronger.
translations: 你的身体艰难地起伏和变化，但杀不死你的东西只会让你变得更强壮。

messages.msgid: You must look after this world, if no one else will.
translations: 你必须照料这个世界，若无他人能做到。

messages.msgid: You see stars.  You see so many stars.
translations: 你看到星星了。你看到无数的星星。

messages.msgid: Quiet steps and sharp claws.  They'll never see it coming.
translations: 轻柔的步伐和尖利的爪子。它们永远也无法觉察到。

messages.msgid: If this overdose kills you, you've got a few more lives… right?
translations: 如果过量服用会让你丧命，但你会多几条命……对吧？

messages.msgid: The waters call to you.  Leave this exposed wasteland.
translations: 大海在呼唤着你。离开这片裸露的废土。

messages.msgid: You feel clammy yet dry, absolutely parched no matter how much you drink.
translations: 你觉得既湿漉漉又干巴巴的，不管你喝下了多少，依然口渴难耐。

messages.msgid: Slow and steady wins the race.
You itch terribly, and your mouth feels salty and dry.
translations: 你浑身痒得厉害，嘴巴又咸又干。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of purifier.  Why does it feel so strange?
translations: 你喝下了大量的净化剂。为什么感觉这么奇怪？

messages.msgid: You consumed a huge amount of purifier, and you can tell that something isn't right.
translations: 你喝下了大量的净化剂，你可以感觉到有些东西不对劲。

messages.msgid: You can't wait for your change.  It can't be long now.
translations: 你等不及即将到来变化了。现在不会太久了。

messages.msgid: You can't stop shivering and twitching.  Life is so short.
translations: 你无法停止颤抖和抽搐。生命是如此的短暂。

messages.msgid: Your skin feels dry and too small.  You'll have to molt soon.
translations: 你的皮肤感觉又干又小。你很快就要蜕皮了。

messages.msgid: Your limbs slump, almost ready to tear right out of their sockets.
translations: 你的四肢萎靡不振，仿佛要从关节里扯出来一般。

messages.msgid: Where's your pack?  How will you survive without them?
translations: 你的狼群呢？没有它们你怎么活下去？

messages.msgid: You pant, unable to stop pacing and full of hunger.
translations: 你气喘吁吁，无法停止脚步，充满饥饿。

messages.msgid: You consumed medical primer.  You should do that again.
translations: 你摄入了医疗引物。你应该再来点。

messages.msgid: You're tearing yourself apart.  Need to get fixed back up.  Should put some stitches in you.
translations: 你正在撕裂自己。需要重新修好。应该再给你缝几针。

messages.msgid: Your heart pounds, knowing that predators could approach at any second!
translations: 你的心怦怦直跳，因为你知道捕食者随时都可能靠近你！

messages.msgid: Your heart hammers away with a rapid, irregular beat.
translations: 你的心脏不规则地快速跳动。

messages.msgid: All this running… why don't you just find a nice, fertile spot and bask in the sun?
translations: 一直逃个不停……你为什么不找块肥沃的好地方晒晒太阳呢。

messages.msgid: Your processes are slowing.  You would make great fertilizer.
translations: 你的动作正在放缓。你会成为很好的肥料。

messages.msgid: Sharpen your talons and clean your feathers.  Your prey won't give itself easily.
translations: 磨快你的爪子，打理你的羽毛。你的猎物不会轻易屈服。

messages.msgid: Delusions fill your head… is it true?  Did you die long ago?
translations: 你脑中充满了幻象……这是真的吗？你早就死了吗？

messages.msgid: So much to do!  Better hop to it!
translations: 有很多事要做！最好快点！

messages.msgid: Will you have a future?  Will any new generations be born… your pounding head is full of worry.
translations: 你会有未来吗？会有新一代出生吗……你的脑袋里满是忧虑。

messages.msgid: This place is too open.  Hide!
translations: 这地方太空旷了。快躲起来！

messages.msgid: Dull aches fill your stomach, and every smell seems offensive.
translations: 你的胃隐隐作痛，每一种气味似乎都令人厌恶。

messages.msgid: You taste iron, and you want more.
translations: 你尝到了铁锈的味道，你想要更多。

messages.msgid: Every sound is a painful screech in your ears.  It's all too much!
translations: 各种声音对你的耳朵来说都是痛苦的尖叫声。快受不了了！

messages.msgid: An anchor line there and there, connect with capture threads…
translations: 在这里喝这里拉上锚线，再用捕捉线连接……

messages.msgid: Perhaps you should curl up, just curl up and give in.
translations: 也许你应该蜷缩起来，蜷缩起来投降。

messages.msgid: Down in the dark corners of the new world.  That's where you belong.
translations: 在新世界的黑暗角落。那才是你的归宿。

messages.msgid: Deep and dark, your bones ache and twist.
translations: 深沉而黑暗，你的骨头疼痛而扭曲。
穴居生物突变引物污染

messages.msgid: Berries, brood, honey, or meat?  What will today bring?
translations: 浆果、鱼苗、蜂蜜还是肉？今天会是什么？

messages.msgid: Sleep sounds good.  Sleep forever, maybe.
translations: 睡上一觉听上去很不错。也许应该永远睡去。

messages.msgid: You consumed a large amount of crustacean mutagen.
translations: 你服用了大量甲壳诱变剂。

messages.msgid: You consumed a life-changing amount of crustacean mutagen.
translations: 你服用了能改变生命的甲壳诱变剂。

messages.msgid: You can't move until you get free!
translations: 在你从陷阱里挣脱出来之前，你无法移动。

messages.msgid: For such a tiny creature, you're in a very big pickle.
translations: 对于这么个小不点来说，你可真是个大块头。

messages.msgid: The sun is in your eyes.
The sunlight's glare makes it hard to see.
translations: 强烈的太阳光刺激导致了你双眼难以视物。

messages.msgid: The sunlight is reflecting off the snow.
The sunlight reflecting off the snow makes it hard to see.
translations: 雪地反射的太阳光让你双眼难以视物。

messages.msgid: A laser sight is targeting you!
Your eyes sting badly and tears stream from them continuously.
translations: 你的眼睛剧烈刺痛，泪水不停流淌。

messages.msgid: You can barely see anything due to your massive eye irritation and the flood of tears streaming from them.
translations: 由于剧烈的眼部刺激和不断涌出的泪水，你几乎看不到任何东西。

messages.msgid: Your eyes sting and tear from the irritation.
translations: 你的眼睛因刺激而刺痛和流泪。

messages.msgid: You draw in a faint whiff of smoke.
A noticeable volume of smoke fills your lungs.
A dense cloud of smoke enters your lungs.
translations: 你的肺中装下了整个烟云的盛宴。

messages.msgid: You inhale an overwhelming volume of smoke.
Your lungs burn from the smoke.
translations: 你的肺被浓烟呛得很难受。

messages.msgid: You've been exposed to tear gas!
translations: 你暴露在了催泪瓦斯中！

messages.msgid: You inhale a lungful of tear gas.
translations: 你吸入了大量催泪瓦斯。

messages.msgid: Your eyes burn from the tear gas.
translations: 你的眼睛被催泪瓦斯刺的火辣辣。

messages.msgid: Your vision is obscured by a disgusting splatter of bile.
translations: 你被胆汁喷了一身，视线模糊！

messages.msgid: You are covered in glowing goo!
translations: 你全身沾满了发光的黏液！

messages.msgid: You're covered in a glowing goo!
translations: 你全身沾满了发光的黏液！

messages.msgid: You're splattered with a greasy layer of liquified putrescence.
translations: 你身上溅满了油腻腻的腐败液体。

messages.msgid: You're covered in a foul smelling fluid!
translations: 你全身沾满了恶臭的液体！

messages.msgid: The rancid smell of corpse bile finally goes away.
translations: 丧尸胆汁的臭味终于消除了。

messages.msgid: Acidic boomer bile is irritating your skin.
translations: 酸性的爆汁丧尸胆汁正在刺激你的皮肤。
你皮肤上的刺激感消停了。

messages.msgid: You were sprayed by a skunk!
A solution that neutralizes skunk odors.
translations: 一种能够中和臭鼬恶臭味的液体。

messages.msgid: As you apply the solution, the skunk odor dissipates.
translations: 随着你喷洒溶液，臭鼬的恶臭味逐渐消散了。

messages.msgid: The chemical irritant damaged your eyes!
translations: 化学刺激物伤害了你的眼睛！

messages.msgid: It feels like there's sand in your eye.
translations: 你感觉似乎眼里进了沙子。

messages.msgid: The irritation in your eyes stops.
translations: 你眼睛中的刺激感消停了。

messages.msgid: You took a fast-acting sedative some time ago and you might still be under its influence.
translations: 不久前你服用了速效镇静剂，你可能仍然受它的影响。

messages.msgid: You took an antidepressant some time ago and you might still be under its influence.
translations: 不久前你服用了抗抑郁药，你可能仍然受它的影响。

messages.msgid: You're stuck in a pit.  Sight distance is limited and you have to climb out.
translations: 你被困在了坑里，看不见上面的东西，你必须爬出来。

messages.msgid: You took an antipsychotic some time ago and you might still be under its influence.
translations: 不久前你服用了抗精神病药，你可能仍然受它的影响。

messages.msgid: You can't see very far from this spot.
translations: 你从这个视角没法看到远处的东西。
轻度消炎止痛药（非甾体类）
轻度消炎止痛药（乙酰氨基酚类）

messages.msgid: You have a nasty bite wound.
translations: 你有个很严重的咬伤伤口。

messages.msgid: The bite wound feels really deep…
translations: 被咬伤的伤口似乎很深……
你有个已经感染的伤口。
你感觉自己的伤口被感染了。

messages.msgid: You are recovering from an infection.
translations: 你正在从感染中恢复过来。

messages.msgid: The wounds on your %s are bandaged.
translations: 你 %s 上的伤口已经包扎了。

messages.msgid: The wounds on your %s are disinfected.
translations: 你 %s 上的伤口已经消毒了。

messages.msgid: You can feel the tiny spores sinking directly into your flesh.
translations: 你可以感觉到小小的孢子沉入你的肉体中。

messages.msgid: You feel your skin prickle with an uncomfortable feeling, and as you try to rub away the specks of dust you realize they've started to embed themselves, sinking into your skin.
translations: 你感到皮肤刺痛，有一种不舒服的感觉，当你试图擦掉灰尘污点时，你意识到它们已经开始下沉并嵌入你的皮肤。

messages.msgid: The itching in your skin fades away.
translations: 你觉得皮肤下的瘙痒感逐渐消失了。
你感觉到身体很不舒服。

messages.msgid: You've been exposed to fungal acid fumes!
translations: 你受到了真菌酸雾的效果影响！

messages.msgid: You inhale a lungful of hallucinogenic acid fumes.
translations: 你呛入了一大口致幻酸雾。

messages.msgid: You've been exposed to thick fungal acid fumes!
translations: 你已受到浓厚的真菌酸雾影响！

messages.msgid: You inhale a lungful of thick hallucinogenic acid fumes.
translations: 你呛入了一大口浓厚的致幻酸雾。
你眼前的世界支离破碎。

messages.msgid: You are disoriented as strange visions flash through your mind.
translations: 当奇怪的幻觉闪过你的脑海时，你有点迷失了方向。

messages.msgid: You are overwhelmed by the disturbing imagery and concepts you're flooded with.
translations: 你的脑中充满了那些令人不安的图像和概念。

messages.msgid: You can't comprehend the things around you…
translations: 你无法理解你周围的事物……

messages.msgid: You don't know what is and isn't real anymore…
translations: 你无法分清真实和虚幻……
你对现实的感觉扭曲了！

messages.msgid: You can't trust everything that you see.
translations: 你不能相信你所看到的一切。
你感觉有点恶心，觉得自己变得像老鼠一样。

messages.msgid: Your hands just won't stop shaking.
translations: 你的手不受控制的颤抖。

messages.msgid: Your muscles have seized up, and you can't control them!
translations: 你的肌肉不停抽搐，而你无法控制它们！

messages.msgid: You regain control of your muscles!
translations: 你现在能重新控制你的肌肉了！
这不过是点小划伤而已。

messages.msgid: Blood is gushing from you like a fountain!
translations: 血像喷泉一样从你身上喷涌而出！
厚厚的黏液覆盖住了你！

messages.msgid: Your %s is exposed to the cold.
Your %s is very exposed to the cold.
translations: 你的%s长时间暴露在寒冷之中。

messages.msgid: Your %s is uncomfortable.  Wearing something soft under your hard armor would help.
translations: 你的 %s 很不舒服。在坚硬的护甲下方穿些柔软的衣物会有所改善。

messages.msgid: You struggle to move in this heat.
translations: 你的行动在炎热下变得非常困难。

messages.msgid: Your %s is frostnipped and has gone numb.
Your %s is frostbitten!  Its tissues are frozen from the cold!
translations: 你的%s被严重冻伤！组织已经结冰了！

messages.msgid: Your %s is starting to feel the damage cold has wrought.
translations: 你的%s开始受到寒冷造成的伤害。

messages.msgid: Your %s is blistering from the intense heat.
translations: 你的%s因高温开始起水泡。

messages.msgid: You can feel something wriggling beneath the skin…
translations: 你能感到皮肤下有东西在蠕动……

messages.msgid: There's a small lump under your skin, it shifts and writhes with a life of its own…
translations: 你的皮肤下有个小肿块，它正伴随着其中的生命抽搐扭动……

messages.msgid: An area of your flesh bulges unnaturally, stretched by the presence of something inside.  It feels like it's desperately trying to push its way out…
translations: 你身上的一块肉不自然地隆起，因内部的某种存在而舒张。 感觉就像它在拼命往外挤……

messages.msgid: You stop to scratch yourself frequently; high INT helps you resist the urge.
translations: 你时不时停下来抓挠自己，更高智力能让你抵挡这种冲动。
好痒！感觉身上就像有蚂蚁在爬！
你身上沾满了植物汁液！

messages.msgid: The sap's too sticky for you to fight effectively.
translations: 粘稠的汁液让你很难继续战斗。

messages.msgid: You are coming down with some kind of sickness.  It's too early to tell how bad it's going to be, but it might be a good idea to find a safe place to rest.
translations: 你得病了，不好说会不会变得很严重，所以你最好找个安全的地方好好休息。

messages.msgid: You feel a sickness coming on…
You have contracted the 'Common Cold'.  Symptoms can be alleviated by medication (cough syrup).
translations: 你得了感冒。可以吃些药（抗感冒药物）来缓解症状。

messages.msgid: You feel a cold coming on…
You're too stuffed up to fight effectively.
translations: 你严重的鼻塞让你很难继续战斗。

messages.msgid: You have contracted flu, or more technically speaking, the 'Influenza'.  Symptoms can be alleviated by medication (cough syrup).
translations: 你得了流感，可以吃些药（抗感冒药物）来缓解症状。

messages.msgid: You feel a flu coming on…
Common cold antibodies in your bloodstream prevent you from catching common cold.
translations: 普通的感冒抗体，分布在你的血液里，让你免于染上普通感冒。

messages.msgid: You have been vaccinated for the flu recently.
You are temporarily resistant to venoms.
translations: 你暂时对毒液有抵抗力。

messages.msgid: You have taken an antiasthmatic drug recently.
translations: 你最近服用了抗哮喘药物。

messages.msgid: You have taken an antihistamine drug recently.
translations: 你最近服用了抗组胺药物。

messages.msgid: You have used steroid eye drops recently.
translations: 你最近使用过了类固醇眼药水。

messages.msgid: You feel the rush of stimulants in your body!
You feel a rush as the chemicals flow through your body!
translations: 随着化学药剂在你体内奔流，你感到干劲十足！

messages.msgid: The jet injector's chemicals wear off.  You feel AWFUL!
translations: 注射的化学药剂药效开始消退了。你觉得好糟糕！
你感到迟钝，动作也变慢了。

messages.msgid: An intense surge of stimulants pulses through your body.
translations: 一种强烈的刺激像电流一样流遍你的全身。

messages.msgid: You feel an intense surge of stimulants pulse through your body!
translations: 你感到一种强烈的刺激像电流一样流遍你的全身！

messages.msgid: The stimulant combo is wearing off.  You feel sluggish.
translations: 兴奋剂的效果开始消退了。你感到迟钝。

messages.msgid: You feel the rush of adrenaline in your body!
translations: 肾上腺素在你体内奔流！

messages.msgid: You feel a surge of adrenaline!

translations: 你的状态不佳导致了你的失误。

messages.msgid: Your adrenaline rush wears off.  You feel AWFUL!
translations: 你的肾上腺素消退了，你觉得很糟糕！

messages.msgid: Our fibers are stretched near breaking.  Local power diverted to regenerate.
translations: 吾等之纤维已经接近断裂极限。本地生物能量转移至修复使用。

messages.msgid: Our enemies are near, and violent action is imminent.  We are turgid.
translations: 吾等之敌人就在附近，暴力行为已近在咫尺。吾等已变得更强壮了。

messages.msgid: Mycal wrath fills our fibers, and we grow turgid.
translations: 马卡斯的怒火充满了我们的纤维，我们已经变得更为强大。

messages.msgid: We require repose; our fibers are nearly spent…
translations: 吾等需要休息，吾等之纤维已经接近断裂极限……

messages.msgid: You had a reasonable amount of nicotine and are experiencing a pleasant buzz.
translations: 你摄入了适量的尼古丁，正享受着愉悦的兴奋感

messages.msgid: You had way too much nicotine and feel awful.
translations: 你摄入了过量的尼古丁，感觉糟透了

messages.msgid: You are high as a kite.
That critter's jumping around like a jitterbug!  It needs to mellow out.
translations: 那玩意像个精神病一样跳来跳去！它需要放松。

messages.msgid: You are wearing photochromic contact lenses that additionally protect you from the sunlight.
translations: 你正在佩戴的是变色隐形眼镜，保护你免受刺眼阳光的影响。

messages.msgid: You are wearing non-prescription photochromic contact lenses that protect you from the sunlight, but don't help with any sight issues.
translations: 你正在佩戴的是平光变色隐形眼镜，保护你免受刺眼阳光的影响，但不能解决视力问题。
你戴上了一副变色隐形眼镜。

messages.msgid: you pull off your photochromic contact lenses.
translations: 你摘下了变色隐形眼镜。

messages.msgid: You drank some alcohol.  You feel warm inside.
translations: 你喝了些酒，感觉身体有点暖和。
你喝了些酒。派对时间到！

messages.msgid: You drank lots of alcohol.  Are those white mice?
translations: 你喝了很多酒。那是些白老鼠吗？

messages.msgid: You drank unholy amounts of alcohol.  It's the end of the world, what do you care?
translations: 你喝太多酒了。已经是世界末日了。你还有什么好在乎的？

messages.msgid: You embalmed yourself alive with so much alcohol, that even zombies will leave your dead body alone.
translations: 你给自己灌了太多的酒，现在连丧尸都以为你已经死了。

messages.msgid: You can't look away from the faultline…
You have been paralyzed by the fear.
translations: 你因为恐惧而无法动弹。

messages.msgid:
You suffer from a respiratory disorder that makes breathing difficult.
An asthma attack can occur from time to time, so have your inhaler nearby.
translations:
你饱受呼吸功能障碍的困扰而感到呼吸困难。
你随时都有可能突发哮喘，所以你得把哮喘吸入器备在身边。
天花板掉落下来并砸在了你身上！

messages.msgid:
You took anticonvulsant drugs some time ago and you might still be under its influence.
Prescription note says its effect duration may vary, so your estimate may be inaccurate.
translations:
不久前你服用了抗惊厥药物，你可能仍然受它的影响。
处方说明它的效果持续时间可能会有所差异，因此你的估计可能不准确。

messages.msgid: You are thoroughly relaxed and don't feel like moving.  Fighting?  Too much effort.
translations: 你觉得浑身上下完全放松，毫无力气，再也不想动弹一下。战斗？太费劲了。
你吸入了大量甜味气体。

messages.msgid: You aren't sure what's wrong with you but you don't feel well.
translations: 你不确定自己出了什么问题，但感觉不舒服。

messages.msgid: Your muscles are binding up, you should probably find a sedative.
translations: 你的肌肉都绷紧了，你或许该找找镇静剂了。

messages.msgid: Your skin starts burning around some of your scratches.  Some aspirin might relieve the effects.
translations: 你被抓伤的伤口周边皮肤开始火辣辣的疼。服用一些阿司匹林可能会减轻症状。

messages.msgid: Buy the ticket, take the ride.  The datura has you now.
translations: 买票，上车，曼陀罗带你走。

messages.msgid:
You have been grabbed and held in place by an attack.  You're not able to move until breaking the grab, and depending on the strength of your opponent using this limb is difficult to impossible.
Wait in place or attempt to move without attacking to try and remove this effect.
translations: 你被攻击抓住并固定在原地。在打破抓斗之前，你无法移动，并且取决于对手的力量，使用这种肢体很难甚至不可能。原地等待或尝试移动而不攻击以尝试消除此效果。

messages.msgid: Grabbing another creature and holding them in place.
translations: 牢牢抓住了另一生物，使其无法动弹。

messages.msgid: Grabbing another creature and holding them in place with a second appendage.
translations: 抓住另一个生物，并用第二个附肢将它们固定在原地。

messages.msgid: You haven't slept in a while, and it shows.
translations: 你有段时间没睡觉了，后果正慢慢显现。

messages.msgid: You are too physically tired to function well.
translations: 你太累了，无法集中精力。

messages.msgid: You don't have energy to fight.
translations: 你缺少用来战斗的精力。

messages.msgid: You lie down to go to sleep…
translations: 你躺下来闭上眼试图睡觉……

messages.msgid: You are being operated on.  Try to stay still.
translations: 你正在接受手术，不要乱动！

messages.msgid:
You're playing an instrument.
Focusing on playing music distracts you, slowing you down.
translations:
你正在弹奏乐器。
专心弹奏乐器让你速度变慢。
你被腐蚀的酸液覆盖了！

messages.msgid: You've been zapped with electricity and are barely able to move!
translations: 你被电击了，只能够勉强移动！

messages.msgid: You're being shocked with electricity to the point of serious harm!
translations: 你被电击并造成了严重伤害！

messages.msgid: Your changing body did not cope well with your bionics.
translations: 你的变异中的身体无法适应你的生化插件。

messages.msgid: Your twisting flesh strains against the bionics invading your body.
translations: 你扭曲的血肉与植入的生化插件激烈反应。

messages.msgid: A lack of iron in your diet has hampered the efficiency and regeneration of your red blood cells.
translations: 你的饮食中铁的缺乏阻碍了红细胞的输氧效率和再生速度。

messages.msgid: Prolonged lack of iron in your diet has compromised the efficiency and regeneration of your red blood cells.
translations: 你的饮食中铁的长期缺乏损害了红细胞的输氧效率和再生速度。

messages.msgid: Severe lack of iron in your diet results in your red blood cells dying faster then they are regenerating.
translations: 你的饮食中铁的严重缺乏使得红细胞死亡速度比再生速度还快。

messages.msgid: You begin feeling increasingly tired and listless.
translations: 你开始感到越来越疲倦和无精打采。

messages.msgid: You are no longer in risk of becoming anemic.
translations: 你不再有缺铁贫血的风险。

messages.msgid: Your iron deficiency is nearly resolved.
translations: 你的缺铁症状快要解除了。

messages.msgid: Your feel stronger as your iron deficiency starts to improve.
translations: 随着你的缺铁症状开始改善，你感觉不那么虚弱了。

messages.msgid: Loss of red blood cells results in progressively worsening anemia.
translations: 你失去了大量红细胞，会导致日益严重的贫血。
你的贫血症快要痊愈了。

messages.msgid: Your feel stronger as your anemia starts to improve.
translations: 随着你的贫血症状开始改善，你感觉不那么虚弱了。

messages.msgid: A lack of vitamin C in your diet will result in progressively worse symptoms of scurvy.
translations: 你的饮食中缺乏维生素C，会使得你出现坏血病，并会持续恶化。

messages.msgid: You start to develop symptoms of scurvy.
translations: 你的坏血病的症状加重了。

messages.msgid: Your vitamin C deficiency is starting to resolve.
translations: 你的维生素C缺乏症状快要解除了。

messages.msgid: Your scurvy lessens as your Vitamin C deficiency improves.
translations: 随着你不再缺乏维生素C，你的坏血病症状开始好转。

messages.msgid: You are under the influence of a beta blocker.  This controls your heart rate, decreasing the influence of stressful events such as pain on it.  However, it also lowers blood pressure and induces sleepiness.
translations: 你受到了β受体阻滞药的影响，它可以控制你的心率，减少疼痛等压力事件对心率的影响。然而，它也会降低血压并且让人犯困。

messages.msgid: An excess of vitamins has badly affected your metabolism.
translations: 过量的维生素严重影响了你的新陈代谢。
你的新陈代谢变得不稳定。
你的新陈代谢稳定下来了。
你的肌肉一直在奇怪地抽搐。

messages.msgid: Your nervous system is malfunctioning, almost like it's being torn apart from the inside.
translations: 你的神经系统失灵了，就像从内部被撕裂了一样。

messages.msgid: Mild euphoric feelings from the Opiates you've taken.
translations: 因服用阿片类药物产生的轻微欣快感。
中等程度欣快感，可能伴随镇静效果。
显著欣快感，伴随强烈镇静作用。
一些失能、镇静、恶心、麻木感。

messages.msgid: Significant chance of death, incapable of many tasks, narcolepsy.
translations: 死亡的可能性很大，无法完成许多任务，产生嗜睡感。
样品含有阿片类止痛药。

messages.msgid: The food you eat is disgusting.
Eating nothing but disgusting rations is starting to get you down.
translations: 除了恶心的口粮什么都没有，这开始让你感到失望。

messages.msgid: Sure, you survived, but what kind of survival is this, eating these disgusting rations day in and day out?
translations: 是的，你活了下来，但这样活着还有什么意义，日复一日地吃着这些恶心的口粮？

messages.msgid: You've lost some blood and look somewhat pale.
translations: 你流了不少血，脸色有点苍白。

messages.msgid: You've lost a large amount of blood, and you're not feeling well.
translations: 你失血过多，感觉人不太舒服。

messages.msgid: You've lost an awful lot of blood, and your condition is severe.  Seek medical attention.
translations: 你失血过多，病情严重。需要立刻寻求医疗救治。

messages.msgid: You've lost tremendous amount of blood, and you're standing on death's door.  Saline infusion might save you.
translations: 你因失血过多，一只脚踏已经进了鬼门关。立即输生理盐水也许能救你一命，快！

messages.msgid: You have lost a lot of blood, and your condition worsens.
translations: 你失血过多，休克症状开始恶化。

messages.msgid: You are no longer in shock.
Your blood volume increases, and you feel better; but still, you look pale.
translations: 你的血液量回升，感觉休克的症状好多了，但仍然面色苍白。

messages.msgid: You feel stronger as your blood volume starts to improve.
translations: 随着你的血液量开始回升，你感觉不那么虚弱了。

messages.msgid: You're not dying from lack of blood, but you're not out of the woods yet.
translations: 你目前不会因为失血而死，但你还没有完全脱离危险。

messages.msgid: You are carrying a light and can't hide well.
translations: 你正携带着光源，因此无法很好地隐蔽。

messages.msgid: This damaged limb is slowly regaining its functions.
translations: 损坏的肢体正缓慢恢复其功能。

messages.msgid: This limb is damaged beyond use and may require a splint to recover.
translations: 该肢体过度损伤以至于失去功能，需要用夹板才能恢复。
折断的肢体已被治疗好。

messages.msgid: You are under the influence of analgesic substances to relieve pain, but they may numb you a bit.
translations: 镇痛剂正在缓解你的疼痛，但也同时也会麻痹你。

messages.msgid: Oh what a day!  What a lovely day!
I'm on top of the world, baby!
translations: 老子站在世界之巅呢，宝贝！

messages.msgid: You are not content with your life.
translations: 你对你的生活感到不满。

messages.msgid: This is not what you planned for your life.
translations: 这不是你所想要的生活。

messages.msgid: You wonder what's the point of fighting?
When will all your suffering end?
translations: 你的苦痛何时才能结束？

messages.msgid: You dejectedly consider the pointlessness of it all.
translations: 你沮丧地觉得一切都毫无意义。

messages.msgid: You're very jittery and pumped up, probably from some stimulants.
translations: 你感到自己精力旺盛并且紧张不安，大概是受到兴奋剂的影响。

messages.msgid: You are under the influence of depressants, and in a bit of a daze.
translations: 在镇静剂的作用下，你感到有点迷糊。

messages.msgid: You can't sit still as you feel your heart pounding out of your chest.  You probably overdosed on those stims.
translations: 你坐不稳，心脏狂跳不已。你很可能服用了过量的兴奋剂。

messages.msgid: You shake with the excess stimulation.
translations: 过度的刺激使你不由自主地颤抖。

messages.msgid:
You consumed mild antibiotic some time ago to fight off infection.
If you don't recover you may want to take another dose, but beware overdosage.
translations:
你不久前服用了一些弱效抗生素来抵抗感染。
如果你没有康复，你可能需要再服用一次，但要小心服用过量。

messages.msgid:
You consumed antibiotic some time ago to fight off infection.
If you don't recover you may want to take another dose, but beware overdosage.
translations:
你不久前服用了一些抗生素来抵抗感染。
如果你没有康复，你可能需要再服用一次，但要小心服用过量。

messages.msgid:
You consumed prescription-grade antibiotic some time ago to fight off infection.
If you don't recover you may want to take another dose, but beware overdosage.
translations:
你不久前服用了一些强效抗生素来抵抗感染。
如果你没有康复，你可能需要再服用一次，但要小心服用过量。

messages.msgid: You feel incredible!  You could take on the world!
translations: 你感到难以置信！你感觉自己随时准备好直面这个世界了。

messages.msgid: You are under the effects of a stomach soother.
translations: 你的胃部不适症状得到了缓解。

messages.msgid: You are under the effects of an antifungal medicine or chemicals.
translations: 你服用了有抗真菌效果的药物或化学品。

messages.msgid: You've been recently affected by an electromagnetic pulse.
translations: 你最近被EMP电磁脉冲击中过。

messages.msgid: You've been struck by lightning, and feel… different.
translations: 你最近被闪电击中过，感觉很……奇特。

messages.msgid: You feel as if your muscles are not quite there.
translations: 你觉得自己的肌肉仿佛不在了一般。

messages.msgid: You feel as if your muscles are not in your body.
translations: 你觉得自己的肌肉仿佛不在身体里一般。

messages.msgid: Your lack of strength stops you!
translations: 你的力量不足使你未能命中！

messages.msgid: You seem to have problems touching things.
translations: 你似乎无法触碰到物体。

messages.msgid: You feel as if your hands just pass through matter.
translations: 你觉得自己的手好像从物体中穿过。

messages.msgid: Your attacks don't seem to touch your enemies!
translations: 你的攻击似乎无法触及你的敌人！

messages.msgid: You have problems distinguishing shapes and colors.
translations: 你无法区分形状和颜色。

messages.msgid: You seem to see slightly different realities every time you blink.
translations: 你似乎在每次眨眼时看到的现实都略有不同。

messages.msgid: You can't distinguish up from down!
Your thoughts seem to wander around on their own.
translations: 你的思维似乎自己在四周徘徊。

messages.msgid: Foreign thoughts seem to invade your mind.
translations: 外来的思想似乎侵入了你的头脑。

messages.msgid: You suddenly think you shouldn't do that!
translations: 你突然觉得你不该那么做！

messages.msgid: Faint sparks surround your every move, your body aches more with every passing second.
translations: 你的一举一动都带着微弱的火花，你的身体每过一秒都会更加疼痛。

messages.msgid: Sparks swarm around you, your body hurts and even the air seems to reject your existence.
translations: 火花在你周围涌动，你的身体疼痛，甚至连空气都似乎排斥着你的存在。

messages.msgid: The world is no longer trying to eject you from this plane of existence, for now.
translations: 世界不再试图排斥你，至少暂时如此。

messages.msgid: The rejection you feel from all around you has become a little easier to bear.
translations: 你感到周围的世界对你的排斥减弱了。

messages.msgid: The world around you seems calmer with your presence and actions.
translations: 你周围的世界似乎因为你的存在和行为变得更加平静。

messages.msgid: The world around you seems to regard you as one of their own, your body is a little easier to move now.
translations: 周围的世界开始将你视为它的一部分，你的身体活动感觉变得更自如了。

messages.msgid: You can more easily exert your will around you, this dimension is, if not welcoming you, obeying you a little.  You have managed to secure a foothold in this reality.
translations: 你意志的运用在周围变得更容易了，即使这个维度不欢迎你，也多少向你表现出了服从。你已成功在这个维度中初步立足。

messages.msgid: The very fabric of reality is blending in with your body, your will is greatly easier to exert around you and your body is trying to permanently assimilate with this world, it just needs a little push…
translations: 现实的结构正与你的身体融为一体，你的意志更加容易操纵，你的身体正试图永久地同化到这个世界，现在只需要一点助力…

messages.msgid: Your eyes open to a whole new world!
translations: 你眼前看到一片完全崭新的世界！

messages.msgid: You start to feel rejected by the world again.
translations: 你又开始感到在被这个世界排挤。

messages.msgid: Did the world just oppose you?
For a moment you felt a great hostility all around you.
translations: 一瞬间，你感觉到周围充满了巨大的敌意。

messages.msgid: Did your enemy just vanish for a moment?
translations: 你的敌人是不是一下子就消失了？

messages.msgid: You felt weird for a moment.
Something just flashed in front of your eyes.
translations: 有什么东西刚刚从你眼前闪过。

messages.msgid: Why did the hit go that way?
translations: 为什么这一下打到那儿去了？

messages.msgid: You could swear that you hit it!
translations: 你可以发誓你击中它了！

messages.msgid: The world no longer embraces you as its child.  At least it still tolerates your presence.
translations: 世界不再像对待他的孩子般拥抱你。但它至少还容忍你的存在。

messages.msgid: You have lost your foothold and can no longer command the world around you, the world sees you now as only an unruly child.
translations: 你失去了立足点，再也无法掌控周遭的世界，此世界如今只将你视为一个不守规矩的孩子。

messages.msgid: You can no longer bend the world to your will.  You have failed in blending in with this reality and have now only a foothold left.
translations: 你再也无法让世界屈从你的意志。你未能融入这个现实，如今仅余一个立足之地。

messages.msgid: The air in here smells like vinegar and mold.
translations: 这里的空气闻起来酸臭发霉。

messages.msgid: The air in here smells like vinegar and mold.  It makes you feel soft-headed and confused.
translations: 这里的空气闻起来酸臭发霉。这让你感到晕眩和迷惑。

messages.msgid: The air in here smells like vinegar and mold.  It is closing in and smothering you, making it impossible to think clearly.
translations: 这里的空气闻起来酸臭发霉。它不断靠近并窒息你，让你无法清晰地思考。

messages.msgid: The air in here smells like vinegar and mold, and hurts your lungs a bit.
translations: 这里的空气闻起来酸臭发霉，这让你的肺部有点疼。

messages.msgid: You feel groggy in this sweltering, foul air.
translations: 在这闷热恶臭的空气中，你感到头昏眼花。

messages.msgid: The feeling of the goop slowly sliding on your skin revulses you and the smell makes you gag.
translations: 恶臭黏液在皮肤上缓慢滑落的感觉让你全身发抖，而它散发出的恶臭气味让你快要呕吐出来。
你被恶臭黏液恶心到了。

messages.msgid: You lack substance, as if you aren't quite fully here.
translations: 你缺乏实质形体，仿佛你并没有完全处于此处一般。

messages.msgid:
You've been pretty active for a while; operating at the highest levels of activity will be impaired.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 1.25x
translations:
你已经活动了一段时间，进行最高活动强度的活动将受到影响。
进行以下活动强度的活动时将被施加相应行动惩罚：
超剧烈：1.25倍

messages.msgid:
You've been quite active for a while; operating at higher levels of activity will be impaired.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 1.67x, Active: 1.33x
translations:
你已经活动了相当一段时间，进行更高活动强度的活动将受到影响。
进行以下活动强度的活动时将被施加相应行动惩罚：
超剧烈：1.67倍，剧烈：1.33倍

messages.msgid:
You've been very active for a while, and need to slow down for a bit.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 2.5x, Active: 2x, Brisk: 1.5x
translations:
你已经活动了非常长的一段时间，需要放缓一会了。
进行以下活动强度的活动时将被施加相应行动惩罚：
超剧烈：2.5倍，剧烈：2倍，重度：1.5倍

messages.msgid:
You've been extremely active for a while, and need to slow down.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 5x, Active: 4x, Brisk: 3x, Moderate: 2x
translations:
你已经活动了极长一段时间，需要好好休息一下了。
进行以下活动强度的活动时将被施加相应行动惩罚：
超剧烈：5倍，剧烈：4倍，重度：3倍，中度：2倍

messages.msgid:
You've been extremely active for a while, and can't take much more activity.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 10x, Active: 8x, Brisk: 6x, Moderate: 4x, Light: 2x
translations:
你已经活动了极长一段时间，不能继续动下去了。
进行以下活动强度的活动时将被施加相应行动惩罚：
超剧烈：10倍，剧烈：8倍，重度：6倍，中度：4倍，轻度：2倍

messages.msgid:
You've been extremely active for a while, and really need to get some rest.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 10x, Active: 8x, Brisk: 6x, Moderate: 4x, Light: 2x
translations:
你已经活动了极长一段时间，真的要停一会了。
进行以下活动强度的活动时将被施加相应行动惩罚：
超剧烈：10倍，剧烈：8倍，重度：6倍，中度：4倍，轻度：2倍

messages.msgid:
You've been extremely active for a while; it's time to stop.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 10x, Active: 8x, Brisk: 6x, Moderate: 4x, Light: 2x
translations:
你已经活动了极长一段时间，必须要停下来了。
进行以下活动强度的活动时将被施加相应行动惩罚：
超剧烈：10倍，剧烈：8倍，重度：6倍，中度：4倍，轻度：2倍

messages.msgid:
You've been extremely active for a while, and can no longer keep pushing.
The following move penalties are applied for the following activity levels:
Extreme: 10x, Active: 8x, Brisk: 6x, Moderate: 4x, Light: 2x
translations:
你已经活动了极长一段时间，不能再逼自己了。
进行以下活动强度的活动时将被施加相应行动惩罚：
超剧烈：10倍，剧烈：8倍，重度：6倍，中度：4倍，轻度：2倍

messages.msgid: You feel quite full, and a bit sluggish.
translations: 你感觉自己吃得太饱了，有些懒洋洋的。

messages.msgid: Your stomach is full to bursting.  This was a mistake.
translations: 你的胃快被撑得胀破了。这是个错误。

messages.msgid: Your body moves strangely easily, as if it weighted less.
translations: 你的身体移动起来异常容易，仿佛重量减轻了一般。

messages.msgid: Your inertia itself is damaged, but the outcome seems suspiciously beneficial.
translations: 你自身的惯性平衡被破坏了，但结果似乎是有益的。

messages.msgid: Reality reasserts itself and your inertia returns to normal.
translations: 现实重新出现，而你的惯性也恢复了正常。

messages.msgid: Your body is strangely difficult to move, as if it weighted more.
translations: 你的身体出奇的难以移动，好像它的重量更大了。

messages.msgid: Your inertia itself is damaged, but hopefully it's not permanent yet.
translations: 你自身的惯性已经受损，但希望它还不是永久性的。

messages.msgid: Space is warped around you such that you can see a wider arc and as if everything was closer.
translations: 空间在你的周围扭曲，以至于你可以看到更宽的弧度，好像一切都离你更近了。

messages.msgid: Space around you is damaged but in the process your can see more and more easily than before.
translations: 你周围的空间被破坏了，但在这个过程中，你可以比以前看的更多，更容易。

messages.msgid: Reality reasserts itself and your perspective returns to normal.
translations: 现实重现，你的视角恢复正常。

messages.msgid: Space is warped around you such that you can see less and as if everything was farther away.
translations: 你周围的空间被扭曲了，以至于你能看到的更少，而且好像一切都变远了。

messages.msgid: Space around you is damaged narrowing your perspective.
translations: 你周围的空间像镜子一样破碎，缩小了你的视野。

messages.msgid: Something is wrong with local spacetime and everything near you seems to weigh less.
translations: 本地的时空出现了问题，你附近的一切都变轻了。

messages.msgid: Space around you is damaged and everything near you seems to weigh less.
translations: 周围的空间碎成万片，你附近的一切似乎不再那么重了。

messages.msgid: Reality reasserts itself and your gravity returns to normal.
translations: 现实重新显现，你的重力恢复正常。

messages.msgid: Something is wrong with local spacetime and everything near you seems to weigh more.
translations: 本地的时空出现了问题，你周围的一切像是灌了铅水一样沉重。

messages.msgid: Space around you is damaged and everything near you seems to weigh more.
translations: 周围的空间碎成万千，你附近的一切都更重了。

messages.msgid: Something is wrong with local spacetime and everything around seems to move faster than you.
translations: 本地的时空出现了问题，你周围的一切似乎都变得更快了。

messages.msgid: Time around you is damaged and everything near you seems to move faster.
translations: 周围的时间遭到了破坏，你附近的一切似乎都变得更快了。

messages.msgid: Reality reasserts itself and your time returns to normal.
translations: 现实重新确定，你的时间恢复正常。

messages.msgid: Your night vision goggles give a green tint to the world.
translations: 你的夜视仪给世界涂上了一层绿色的色调。

messages.msgid: You've inhaled a lungful of glowing nether parasite spores.  Thankfully, they don't seem adapted to the human physiology.
translations: 你吸入了一肺发光的异界寄生孢子。 值得庆幸的是，它们似乎并不适应人类的生理学。

messages.msgid: You inhale a lungful of the glowing gas, and you have an urge to violently cough.
translations: 你吸入了一肺发光的气体，你有剧烈咳嗽的冲动。

messages.msgid: Your lungs burn from the glowing gas.
translations: 你的肺被发光气体呛得很难受。

messages.msgid: You are covered in glowing nether spores!
translations: 你全身沾满了发光的异界孢子！

messages.msgid: The glowing spores settle on you!
translations: 发光孢子掉落在你身上！

messages.msgid: You feel a strong urge to hide somewhere safe.
translations: 你有一种想躲在安全之处的强烈冲动。

messages.msgid: Your chitin plating itches against your body.
translations: 你的甲壳板开始摩擦着你的身体，让你发痒。

messages.msgid: Seek shelter, you will be helpless when it begins.
translations: 立刻寻找安全的地方，否则当它开始时，你将变得十分无助。

messages.msgid: You can hardly move in your tightening exoskeleton, and you feel a strong impulse to hunker down somewhere safe.
translations: 你在紧缩的外骨骼中几乎无法移动，而且有一种想要钻进安全角落的冲动。

messages.msgid: Your eyes are itchy and you've got a runny nose.
translations: 你的眼睛发痒，不断流着鼻涕。

messages.msgid: The star vampire has drunk blood and is now visible.
translations: 星之精已经喝下了血，现在你看得见祂了。

messages.msgid: The monster is drinking your blood, you vile feral!
translations: 怪物正在吸食你的血液，可恶的家伙！

messages.msgid: Your ink glands are empty.  Given some time and hydration they will recharge.
translations: 你的墨囊彻底空了。它正在消耗水分，随着时间的推移生产墨汁。

messages.msgid: Your ink glands are almost empty.  Given some time and hydration they will recharge.
translations: 你的墨囊几乎空了。它正在消耗水分，随着时间的推移生产墨汁。

messages.msgid: Your ink glands have some ink inside.  Given some time and hydration, more ink will be generated.
translations: 你的墨囊现在半满。它正在消耗水分，随着时间的推移生产墨汁。

messages.msgid: Your ink glands are bulged and full.  No more ink is being created.
translations: 你的墨囊已经完全充盈。不再产生新的墨水。

messages.msgid: Your movements are restricted by the surroundings.
translations: 周围的环境限制了你的行动。

messages.msgid: You are able to move freely again.
translations: 你能不受限制地活动了。

messages.msgid: You don't have any room to move!
translations: 你没有任何可移动的空间了！

messages.msgid: You are gliding through the air.
You are descending at a safe speed.
translations: 你正以安全的速度缓慢降落。

messages.msgid: It feels good to spend time around others.
translations: 和同伴共度了一段美好时光。

messages.msgid: You could really use a friend right now.
translations: 你现在真的需要一个朋友。

messages.msgid: What's the point of surviving if you're all alone?
translations: 如果孑然一身，那活着还有什么意义呢？

messages.msgid: Being on your own makes you feel good.
translations: 独自一人的感觉真不赖。

messages.msgid: Being around others has left you feeling drained.
translations: 和别人在一起让你精疲力尽。

messages.msgid: OK, that's enough social time.  You'd really rather be alone now.
translations: 好吧，社交到此为止。你现在真的想独处一会儿。

messages.msgid: Your nerves are frayed from all this socializing.  You need some alone time to recharge.
translations: 频繁社交让你的神经紧绷。你需要独处一会儿恢复些元气。

messages.msgid: You are positioned to take advantage of your mutated anatomy, and will receive no penalties for crouching in melee combat.  Wielding a weapon will cause you to lose this effect.
translations: 你的姿势可让你充分利用你的变异肢体，并且在近战中蹲着不会受到惩罚。手持武器会使你失去此效果。

messages.msgid: Every few seconds, an ultrasonic pulse is broadcast from your location.  If you're underwater and your hearing is good enough, you may be able to navigate by the pings that come back.
translations: 每隔几秒钟，你所在的位置就会发出一道超声波脉冲。如果你在水下，而且你的听力足够好，你就可以通过回声信号来导航。

messages.msgid: Your stomach constantly feels like it's full, even when you haven't eaten in awhile.
translations: 你的胃总是感觉很饱，即使你已经有一段时间没吃东西了。

messages.msgid: Your stomach starts to feel strange and bloated.
translations: 你的腹部开始感到奇怪和肿胀。
你的肠胃感觉不那么肿胀了。

messages.msgid: You feel the strain in your stomach lessen.
translations: 你感觉胃里的绞痛减轻了。

messages.msgid: You see a tiny figure radiating heat.
translations: 你看到一个散发着热量的细小影像。

messages.msgid: You see a small figure radiating heat.
translations: 你看到一个散发着热量的小型影像。
