messages.msgid: You see a medium figure radiating heat.
translations: 你看到一个散发着热量的中型影像。

messages.msgid: You see a large figure radiating heat.
translations: 你看到一个散发着热量的大型影像。

messages.msgid: You see a huge figure radiating heat.
translations: 你看到一个散发着热量的巨型影像。

messages.msgid: You sense a creature with your thermal nostrils.
translations: 你用你的热鼻孔感知到一个生物。

messages.msgid: You sense something emitting electricity here.
translations: 你感觉这里有东西在放电。

messages.msgid: You are wearing night vision goggles which allow you to see really well in the dark.
translations: 你正戴着夜视仪，在黑暗中也看得十分清楚。

messages.msgid: You are wearing night vision goggles which allow you to see quite well in the dark.
translations: 你正佩戴着夜视仪，在黑暗中可以看得相当清楚。

messages.msgid: You are wearing night vision goggles which allow you to see in the dark.
translations: 你正佩戴着夜视仪，在黑暗中也可以看得清楚。

messages.msgid: You are wearing night vision goggles which allow you to poorly see in the dark.
translations: 你正佩戴着夜视仪，在黑暗中可以稍微看清楚。

messages.msgid: You are wearing equipment that helps handle harsh climates.
You are wearing equipment that gives 10 strength.
Your armor's massive weight makes it nearly impossible to be knocked over or pushed back.
translations: 你极重的护甲使得你难以被击倒或击退。

messages.msgid: Your armor lets you detect otherworldly presence with ease.
translations: 你的护甲让你能够轻易感知到异界。

messages.msgid: You sense an otherworldy danger here.
translations: 你感觉到这里有一种异界的危险。

messages.msgid: You are wearing equipment that muffles your footsteps.
Your rapidly buzzing wings propel you with extra speed.
translations: 你不断振翅，为你提供额外的速度。

messages.msgid: The exoskeleton is inactive and makes moving in it difficult and exhausting.
translations: 外骨骼已经关闭了，穿着它移动变得既困难又费力。
作战外骨骼 MK I 型（开）

messages.msgid: Now powered, the exoskeleton provides <color_white>significant</color> improvements to your carry weight and movement exertion while the life support system shields you against harmful gas, cools you down, and dampens harmful sounds.
translations: 启动的外骨骼系统，<color_white>显著</color>提升你的负重与体能，同时生命维持系统使你免受气体侵害，调节温度并降低有害噪音。
作战外骨骼 MK II 型（开）

messages.msgid: Now powered, the exoskeleton provides <color_white>moderate</color> improvements to your carry weight and movement exertion while the life support system shields you against harmful gas, cools you down, and dampens harmful sounds.
translations: 启动的外骨骼系统，<color_white>适量</color>提升你的负重与体能，同时生命维持系统使你免受气体侵害，调节温度并降低有害噪音。
作战外骨骼 MK III 型（开）

messages.msgid: Now powered, the exoskeleton provides <color_white>slight</color> improvements to your carry weight and movement exertion while the life support system shields you against harmful gas, cools you down, and dampens harmful sounds.
translations: 启动的外骨骼系统，<color_white>稍微</color>提升你的负重与体能，同时生命维持系统使你免受气体侵害，调节温度并降低有害噪音。

messages.msgid: The sticky globs of light cover you, and begin to burn!
translations: 一大块粘稠的光团覆盖了你，然后它开始燃烧了起来！

messages.msgid: For an instant, every inch of this infinite space is itself infinite, slowing you drastically.
translations: 刹那间，这无限空间内的每一寸时空本身都包含无限空间，让你的行动极度缓慢。

messages.msgid: Space unfolds and extends around you!
translations: 你周围的空间不断解压延展！

messages.msgid: You cannot make any progress in all this vastness.
translations: 在这无尽的空间里，你什么也做不了。

messages.msgid: There is no longer an inside or outside of you.  It is all one side; flat, infinite, and everything you have ever been.  You wonder if you're having no trouble understanding it because your brain works better spread out like this.
translations: 你不再有内外之分。现在只有一个平面；平坦、无限，是你曾经的一切。你不禁想你之所以现在能轻松地理解这一切，是不是因为你的小脑瓜得像这样铺开才转得动。

messages.msgid: This is not intended to be visible during normal gameplay.  <bad>Please file a bug report</bad> unless you are seeing this in the debug menu.
translations: 这不是在正常游戏过程中应该显示的。如果不是调试菜单中看到，<bad>请提交错误报告</bad>。

messages.msgid: You can use this armor <info>with chainmail</info> without encumbrance penalty.
translations: 你可以使用<info>链甲</info>装备而不会有累赘惩罚。

messages.msgid: Item must be a chainmail compatible armor piece
translations: 物品必须是与链甲兼容的护甲部件

messages.msgid: This plate will fit in <info>large</info> armor pockets.
translations: 这块装甲板能放进<info>大型</info>装甲板口袋。

messages.msgid: Item must be a large ablative plate
translations: 物品必须为大型装甲板

messages.msgid: This will hook to a <info>Hub 01 proprietary</info> mantle connector.
translations: 这件物品可以挂在 <info>Hub 01 特制</info> 的外套挂带上。

messages.msgid: Item must be an armored mantle
This can be supported by the ryūsei battle kit.
translations: 这件物品是流星战甲的组件。
物品必须是流星胸甲板

messages.msgid: This plate will fit in <info>medium</info> armor pockets.
translations: 这块装甲板能放进<info>中型</info>装甲板口袋。

messages.msgid: Item must be a medium ablative plate
translations: 物品必须为中型装甲板

messages.msgid: This will hook to a <info>Hub 01 proprietary</info> skirt connector.
translations: 这件物品可以挂在 <info>Hub 01 特制</info> 的裙板挂带上。

messages.msgid: Item must be an armored skirt
This will hook to a <info>Hub 01 proprietary</info> helmet connector.
translations: 这件物品可以挂在 <info>Hub 01 特制</info> 的头盔挂带上。

messages.msgid: Item must be an armored helmet
This gear has <info>cloaking tech</info> that will <good>make you invisible</good> when active, at the cost of <info>power from a UPS</info>.
translations: 这件装备有 <info>隐形技术</info>，开启时能让你 <good>隐形</good>，但需要消耗 <info>UPS电量</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear has an <info>alarm clock</info> feature.
translations: 这件装备有 <info>闹钟</info> 功能。

messages.msgid: This item <info>won't prevent you from blocking with your body, such as arms or legs</info> when wielded as a weapon.
translations: 此物品作为武器使用时<info>不会阻止你用身体的一部分格挡，比如使用手臂或腿</info>。

messages.msgid: This clothing won't hinder special attacks that involve <info>mutated or cybernetic anatomy</info>.
translations: 这件装备不会妨碍你的<info>变异或生化肢体</info>进行特殊攻击。

messages.msgid: This item can be activated or reloaded from an adjacent tile without picking it up.
translations: 这个物品可在相邻的地上直接激活或重新装填，无须拾起。

messages.msgid: This item can use all of its features in darkness.
translations: 此物品在黑暗中能使用其所有功能。

messages.msgid: This gear is equipped with an accurate barometer (which is used to measure atmospheric pressure).
translations: 这件装备有 <info>精准气压计</info> 功能（可测气压）。

messages.msgid: This item can be <info>clipped onto a belt loop</info> of the appropriate size.
translations: 该物品可以别在/钩在大小合适的 <info>腰带环</info> 上。

messages.msgid: Item must clip onto a belt loop
translations: 物品必须可夹在腰带环上。
这件装备可以 <info>背系</info> 在身上。

messages.msgid: This item <info>provides</info> instructions and other required data for several bionics, allowing installation of them with <good>minimal failure chance</good>.
translations: 这件物品<info>提供了</info>生化插件的安装说明和其他所需数据，能够<good>最小化失败几率</good>。

messages.msgid: A <good>follower</good> could <info>make use of this CBM</info> if installed properly.
translations: 这个CBM可被 <good>同伴</good> <info>植入使用</info>。
这件装备会 <bad>阻挡视线</bad>，让你 <info>完全失明</info>。

messages.msgid: This item can be used to block attacks when worn.
translations: 这件装备穿戴后可以格挡攻击。

messages.msgid: This item enables you to keep track of calorie intake.
translations: 这件物品能够记录你的热量摄入情况。

messages.msgid: This item enables you to keep track of calorie consumption.  Includes CALORIES_INTAKE.
translations: 这件物品能够记录您的热量消耗情况。包括摄入的热量。

messages.msgid: Being caseless rounds, these <bad>cannot be disassembled or reloaded</bad>.
translations: 由于是无壳弹，因此 <bad>不能拆解/复装</bad>。

messages.msgid: This item is a Compact Bionic Module.  You'll need to <info>use specialized machinery</info> or <info>ask a surgeon</info> to install it into your body.
translations: 这件物品是生化插件，需通过 <info>专用医疗设备</info> 或者 <info>外科医生</info> 才能安全植入体内。

messages.msgid: This clothing has a <info>wide collar</info> that can keep your mouth warm if it is unencumbered.
translations: 这件装备有 <info>宽领子</info>，能在嘴部没有累赘时拉高领子，为嘴部保暖。

messages.msgid: Contents are hidden by default in inventory view.
translations: 默认在物品栏中隐藏内容物。

messages.msgid: This gear <bad>prevents</bad> you from <info>hearing any sounds</info>.
translations: 这件装备会 <bad>阻挡声音</bad>，让你 <info>完全失聪</info>。

messages.msgid: Continuously firing this weapon will cause it to <bad>overheat</bad> and <info>can potentially damage it</info>.
translations: 持续射击将会使武器 <bad>过热</bad>，并且可能使其 <info>受到损害</info>。

messages.msgid: This item has a <good>diamond coating</good> improving its <info>cutting or piercing damage</info>.
translations: 这件物品有着 <good>钻刃涂层</good>，增加了 <info>斩击及穿刺伤害</info>。

messages.msgid: This item is a precious gemstone, used for ornamentation.  This is mostly useless post-Cataclysm.
translations: 这是一种珍贵的宝石，常用于装饰，然而在大灾变后它基本上没什么大用。

messages.msgid: While wielded, this item allows you to mine through rocks and other hard obstacles by moving into tiles with them.  Note that automatic mining option should be set to true for this to work.
translations: 这件物品在手持时能够让你在朝坚岩等障碍物所在位置移动时自动破坏障碍物。需要在选项中开启自动挖矿功能。

messages.msgid: As a weapon, this item is <good>well-made</good> and will <info>withstand the punishment of combat</info>.
translations: 这件物品 <good>制作精良</good>，在战斗中作为武器使用时 <info>经久耐用</info>。

messages.msgid: This gun is made of <info>relatively simple parts</info> which makes powder fouling <good>easier to clean</good>.
translations: 这把枪械 <info>结构简单</info>，使得火药残渣 <good>更易清理</good>。

messages.msgid: You have marked this article to not display a sprite when worn.
translations: 你将这件衣物标记为穿戴时不显示图形。

messages.msgid: You could probably use this to get into a secure science facility.
translations: 这件物品可让你进入一处防护严密的科研设施。

messages.msgid: You could probably use this to get into a secure military facility.
translations: 这件物品可让你进入一处防护严密的军事设施。

messages.msgid: You could probably use this to get into a secure industrial facility.
translations: 这件物品可让你进入一处防护严密的工业设施。

messages.msgid: Gives you access to the artisans workshop.
translations: 让你能够进入匠人工坊。

messages.msgid: This med can't be used by everyone, it requires a special mutation.
translations: 这件药物需要你具有特殊变异才能使用。

messages.msgid: This armor can't be worn directly.
translations: 这件装甲无法直接穿戴。

messages.msgid: If exposed to the atmosphere, it will <bad>start to go bad</bad>.
translations: 如果接触外部空气，就会开始 <bad>腐坏</bad>。
这件食物 <color_light_cyan>冷藏</color> 后 <good>风味更佳</good>。
这件食物 <color_red>加热</color> 后 <good>风味更佳</good>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>electric discharges</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>免被电击</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>biological damage</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受生化伤害</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>bash damage</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受钝击伤害</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>EMP blasts</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受电磁脉冲影响</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>cut damage</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受斩击伤害</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>bullet damage</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受射击伤害</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>acid damage</info>.

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>stab damage</info>.

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>high temperatures</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受高温影响</info>。

messages.msgid: This item is attachable in the front of <info>hard hats and helmets</info> to protect your eyes or face.
translations: 这件物品可以安装在<info>安全帽或头盔</info>前方，保护眼睛和面部。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of face shield
This item is attachable in the front of <info>military helmets</info>.

translations: 物品必须为正面头盔挂件

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of ear attachment

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of nape protector
This item is attachable as a mandible guard in military <info>helmets</info> or headgear specifically adapted with rails for attachments.
translations: 这件物品可以安装在<info>军用头盔</info>或带滑轨的头部装备上，保护下颌。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of rail-mounted mandible guard
This item is attachable as a mandible guard in <info>hard hats and helmets</info>.
translations: 这件物品可以安装在<info>安全帽或头盔</info>上，保护下颌。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of strapped mandible guard
This item is attachable in the back of <info>hard hats and helmets</info> as a counterweight pouch.
translations: 这件物品可以安装在<info>安全帽或头盔</info>的背面，作为配重。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of back pouch
This item is attachable in <info>tactical helmets</info> as a flashlight.
translations: 这件物品可以作为手电筒安装在<info>战术头盔</info>上。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of flashlight
This item is attachable to metal cap helmets as a face and neck protective layer.
translations: 该物品能装在金属头盔上，作为脸部或颈部的保护层。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of chainmail veil
This item is attachable to commercial diving boots as fins.
translations: 该物品可安装在市售潜水靴上当作脚蹼。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of fins
This item is attachable to custom diving boots as fins.
translations: 该物品可安装在常规潜水靴上当作脚蹼。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of custom fins
This item is attachable to straps and mountings on some masks and hoods.
translations: 该物品可连接到某些面罩和兜帽的带子和支架上。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of item that can be attached to straps on masks and hoods
translations: 物品必须能安装于面罩/兜帽绑带挂点上

messages.msgid: This item is attachable to a proprietary wrist mount.
translations: 该物品可以连接专用的腕部挂点。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of item that can be attached to a proprietary wrist mount
translations: 物品必须能安装于专用腕部挂点上

messages.msgid: This item is wearable over some armors as an extra layer of plating.
translations: 这件物品可以镀在一些盔甲上作为额外的镀层。

messages.msgid: Item must be some kind of strapped additional plating
This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>low temperatures</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受低温影响</info>。

messages.msgid: <info>Only one</info> item can be worn on this clothing layer.
translations: 这件装备在同衣物层只能穿着 <info>一件</info>。

messages.msgid: This item counts as <color_red>fire</color> for crafting purposes.
translations: 这件物品可以作为 <color_red>火源</color> 制造物品。

messages.msgid: This item can serve as a firewood.
translations: 这件物品可以作为柴火使用。

messages.msgid: This clothing <info>prevents going underwater</info> including both <good>drowning</good> and <bad>diving</bad>.
translations: 这件装备<info>防止你沉入水中</info>，你将<good>不会溺水</good>但也<bad>无法潜水</bad>。

messages.msgid: This clothing has fins that <good>improve swimming speed</good>, but <bad>reduce movement speed</bad> on land.
translations: 这件衣服的鳍会<good>提高游泳速度</good>，但在陆地上会<bad>降低移动速度</bad>。

messages.msgid: This gear is <bad>fragile</bad> and <info>won't protect you for long</info>.
translations: 这件装备 <bad>十分脆弱</bad>，<info>无法长久保护</info> 你。

messages.msgid: As a weapon, this item is <bad>flimsy</bad> and <info>won't last long in combat</info> before breaking apart.
translations: 这件物品 <bad>工艺粗糙</bad>，在战斗中作为武器使用时 <info>十分脆弱</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>any gas</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受毒气影响</info>。

messages.msgid: This clothing has a <info>hood</info> to keep your head warm if your head is unencumbered.
translations: 这件装备有 <info>兜帽</info>，能在头部没有累赘时戴上兜帽，为头部保暖。

messages.msgid: This gear is equipped with an accurate hygrometer (which is used to measure humidity).
translations: 这件装备有 <info>精准湿度计</info> 功能（可测湿度）。

messages.msgid: This gun mod catches ejected casings.
translations: 这件枪械模组能够收集抛出的弹壳。

messages.msgid: This item is a component of the gun it is attached to.  It can't be removed without destroying it.
translations: 这件物品是所属枪械的内置模组。它无法在不被破坏的情况下移除。
这件装备<info>视同</info>普通层衣物。

messages.msgid: This item is impossible to clean.
This thing no longer spawns naturally and has been obsoleted.
translations: 这件物品不再生成，已经废弃了。

messages.msgid: This item can be put up on a wall, like a poster.
translations: 这件物品可以被张贴在墙上，像一张海报。

messages.msgid: This food <neutral>melts when not in a very cold climate</neutral>, and tastes much <good>better</good> when <color_light_cyan>frozen</color>.
translations: 这件食物在室温下会 <neutral>融化</neutral>，<color_light_cyan>冷冻</color> 后 <good>风味更佳</good>。

messages.msgid: This gear is generally <info>worn over</info> clothing.
translations: 这件装备一般套在 <info>衣物外边</info>。

messages.msgid: This clothing is large enough to accommodate <info>abnormally large mutated anatomy</info>.
translations: 这件装备尺码够大，能容纳 <info>大型变异肢体</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>reduces</good> the volume of <info>sounds</info> to a safe level.
translations: 这件装备会 <good>自动减弱</good> <info>声音强度</info> 至听力范围内。

messages.msgid: This clothing has <info>pockets</info> to warm your hands when you are wielding nothing.
translations: 这件装备有 <info>口袋</info>，能在你空手时把手放在口袋里，为手部保暖。

messages.msgid: As a weapon, this item needs considerable space to use properly and does 70% of its normal damage to adjacent enemies.
translations: 这件物品作为武器使用时需要很大空间挥舞，因此对临近敌人只能造成70%伤害。

messages.msgid: Can be used to <info>store data</info> for other devices.
translations: 可用来为其他设备 <info>存储数据</info>。

messages.msgid: Some of your data is <info>stored</info> here.
translations: 你的一些数据已经<info>存储</info>在了这。

messages.msgid: This food item has been irradiated, and will spoil 4 times slower.
translations: 该食物已被辐照消毒，腐坏速率降为原来的 25%。

messages.msgid: This item used to be legal tender before the Cataclysm.
translations: 这件物品在大灾变之前是法定货币。

messages.msgid: This item can be worn, but it <neutral>won't provide any effects</neutral>.
translations: 你可以戴上它，但是 <neutral>没有防护效果</neutral>。

messages.msgid: This item has notable padding and will be comfortable worn without clothing under it.
translations: 这件装备有内衬，在下方不穿柔软衣物也很舒适。

messages.msgid: This item will <good>attach directly</good> to <info>load bearing vests</info>, taking a <good>small amount of space</good>.
translations: 这件物品可<good>安装</good>在<info>承重背心</info>上，占用<good>一块空间</good>。

messages.msgid: This item will <good>attach directly</good> to <info>load bearing vests</info>, taking an average amount of space.
translations: 这件物品可<good>安装</good>在<info>承重背心</info>上，占用两块空间。

messages.msgid: This item will <good>attach directly</good> to <info>load bearing vests</info>, taking a <bad>large amount of space</bad>.
translations: 这件物品可<good>安装</good>在<info>承重背心</info>上，占用<bad>三块空间</bad>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>keeps out</good> the <info>mind control rays</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>部分保护</good> 你 <info>不受恐惧形象影响</info>。

messages.msgid: This item can <good>detect</good> dangerous levels of <info>radiation</info>.
translations: 这件物品可以 <good>检测</good> 危险等级的 <info>辐射水平</info>。
这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受辐射影响</info>。
这件装备能 <good>部分保护</good> 你 <info>不受辐射影响</info>。

messages.msgid: Sterilized using radiation, so it's <good>safe to eat</good>.
translations: 经过辐照消毒，可 <good>安全食用</good>。

messages.msgid: This gear requires careful balance to use.  Being hit while wearing it could make you <bad>fall down</bad>.
translations: 这件装备会让你难以稳定重心。穿着时被击中可能会让你 <bad>摔倒</bad>。

messages.msgid: This item can be used to communicate with radio waves.
translations: 这件物品可用于无线电交流。

messages.msgid: This item can be used to <info>pick locks</info> with <good>zero effort</good>.
translations: 这件物品可以 <good>无消耗</good> <info>开锁</info>。

messages.msgid: This clothing is designed to keep you <info>dry</info> in the rain.
translations: 这件装备能够让你在雨中保持 <info>干燥</info>。

messages.msgid: It seems <info>partially intangible</info>, and can occupy the same space as other things when worn.
translations: 这件物品处于 <info>近乎虚体</info> 的形态，可以与其它物品同层。

messages.msgid: This item can <info>fit in an axe sheath</info> of the appropriate size.
translations: 这件物品可以存入大小合适的 <info>斧鞘</info>中。

messages.msgid: Item must fit in an axe sheath
translations: 物品必须可存入斧鞘中。

messages.msgid: This item can <info>fit in a sheath</info> of the appropriate size.
translations: 这件物品可以存入大小合适的 <info>刀鞘</info> 中。

messages.msgid: Item must fit in a sheath
translations: 物品必须可存入刀鞘中。

messages.msgid: This item can <info>fit in a scabbard</info> of the appropriate size.
translations: 这件物品可以存入大小合适的 <info>剑鞘</info> 中。

messages.msgid: Item must fit in a scabbard
translations: 物品必须可存入剑鞘中。

messages.msgid: This item can <info>attach to a spear strap</info> of the appropriate size.
translations: 这件物品可以拴在大小合适的 <info>长矛背带</info> 上。

messages.msgid: Item must attach to a spear strap
translations: 物品必须可栓在长矛背带上。

messages.msgid: This item can <info>fit in a bow sling</info> of the appropriate size.
translations: 这件物品可以存入大小合适的 <info>弓背带</info> 中。

messages.msgid: Item must fit in a bow sling
translations: 物品必须可存入弓背带中。

messages.msgid: This clothing <info>lies close</info> to the skin.
This item provides comfort during sleep.
translations: 这件物品为你提供更舒适的睡眠条件。

messages.msgid: This clothing will <good>protect</good> you from harm and withstand <info>a lot of abuse</info>.
translations: 这件装备具有 <good>良好防护</good>，能使你免于受伤并 <info>承受大量伤害</info>。

messages.msgid: This clothing keeps the <info>glare</info> out of your eyes.
translations: 这件装备能 <info>遮挡刺眼阳光</info>。

messages.msgid: This clothing allows you to <good>see much further</good> <info>under water</info>.
translations: 这件装备能让你在 <info>水下</info> <good>看得更远</good>。

messages.msgid: This gear is equipped with an <info>accurate thermometer</info>.
translations: 这件装备有 <info>精准温度计</info> 功能。

messages.msgid: This gear is worn on or around your <info>waist</info>.
translations: 这件装备穿着在你的 <info>腰部</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear allows to see <info>actual time</info>.
translations: 这件装备有 <info>精准计时</info> 功能。

messages.msgid: This clothing <info>won't let water through</info>.  Even if you jump into a river.
translations: 这件装备 <info>不透水</info>，即使你跳进河里也能保持干燥。

messages.msgid: This clothing <good>performs well</good> even when <info>soaking wet</info>.  This can feel good.
translations: 这件装备 <info>湿透</info> 时 <good>性能良好</good>，不受心情值惩罚。

messages.msgid: This item was broken and <bad>won't activate anymore</bad>.
translations: 这件物品已损坏，<bad>无法激活</bad>。

messages.msgid: This item <bad>will get broken</bad> by water.
This item <bad>will get broken</bad> by water if it gets <info>submerged while active</info>.
translations: 这件物品激活后 <info>潜水</info> 时会 <bad>损坏</bad>。

messages.msgid: This item <bad>will get dissolved</bad> in water.
This item can be worn simultaneously with power armor.
translations: 这件装备可与动力装甲同时穿戴。

messages.msgid: This item can be used to <good>better</good> see <info>things far away</info>.
translations: 这件物品能让你 <good>更好</good> 地看清 <info>远处物体</info>。

messages.msgid: This clothing has a fur lining sewn into it to <good>increase</good> its overall <info>warmth</info>.
translations: 这件装备缝上了毛皮内衬，能够 <good>增加</good> <info>保暖度</info>。

messages.msgid: This gear has Kevlar inserted into strategic locations to <good>increase protection</good> with some <bad>increase to encumbrance</bad>.
translations: 这件装备镶嵌了凯夫拉片，能够 <good>增加防护</good> 但有点 <bad>累赘</bad>。

messages.msgid: This gear has certain parts padded with leather to <good>increase protection</good> with moderate <bad>increase to encumbrance</bad>.
translations: 这件装备垫上了一些皮革，能够 <good>增加防护</good> 但略为 <bad>累赘</bad>。

messages.msgid: This gear has certain parts padded with steel to <good>increase protection</good> with moderate <bad>increase to encumbrance</bad>.
translations: 这件装备垫上了一些钢板，能够 <good>增加防护</good> 但略为 <bad>累赘</bad>。

messages.msgid: This clothing has a wool lining sewn into it to <good>increase</good> its overall <info>warmth</info>.
translations: 这件装备缝上了羊毛内衬，能够 <good>增加</good> <info>保暖度</info>。

messages.msgid: This item has a holographic patch that reflects the light oddly.  It was constructed in a nanofabricator and can be <info>repaired in one</info>.
translations: 这件物品带有一片反光怪异的全息贴片。它由纳米制造机生产，也可以在其中<info>修复</info>。

messages.msgid: This item contains a nanofabricator recipe.
translations: 这件物品包含纳米制造配方。

messages.msgid: This template is copy protected and will be <bad>destroyed</bad> after a single use.
translations: 这个模板拥有复制保护，在使用过一次后便会<bad>销毁</bad>。
这个生化插件<bad>已经故障</bad>。
这个生化插件是个动力源。

messages.msgid: This bionic can provide power to powered armor.
translations: 这个生化插件能够为动力装甲供能。

messages.msgid: This food is <bad>unappetizing</bad> in a way that <bad>can't be covered up by most cooking</bad>.
translations: 这个食物让人 <bad>倒胃口</bad>，且大多数烹饪方式都<bad>无法改善其口味</bad>。

messages.msgid: This food is <info>raw</info>, and will be <good>more nutritious</good> if cooked.
translations: 这个食物是<info>生的</info>，烹饪后食用会<good>更有营养</good>。

messages.msgid: <bad>You must</bad> have two free hands to wield this item.
translations: 你必须使用<bad>双手</bad>来手持这个物品。

messages.msgid: This item has had its stock removed, it will be hard to shoot with.
translations: 这件物品的枪托已经移除，射击变得较困难。

messages.msgid: This items stock is folded it will be hard to shoot with.
translations: 这件物品的枪托已经折叠，射击变得较困难。

messages.msgid: This items stock is collapsed it will be hard to shoot with.
translations: 这件物品的枪托已经折叠，射击变得较困难。
这件物品是<info>身体</info>的一部分。

messages.msgid: This is <info>naturally sized to the body</info>.
This item provides power to <info>UPS compatible items</info>.
translations: 这件物品可以作为 <info>UPS电源</info>。

messages.msgid: This item is <bad>bulky</bad> and may not fit in all magazine pockets.
translations: 这个弹匣<bad>体积较大</bad>，不是所有类型的弹匣袋都能将其容纳。

messages.msgid: Item must be a bulky magazine
translations: 物品必须为大体积弹匣

messages.msgid: This weapon is <bad>too unwieldy</bad> to fire on its own and <info>must be mounted</info> on a vehicle or furniture (window, table, mound of dirt, etc.) before use.
translations: 该枪过于<bad>笨重</bad>，无法直接拿来射击，<info>必须安装/架设</info>在车辆或某些家具/地形上才能射击。

messages.msgid: This item is designed to have special effects
translations: 这件物品具有特殊效果。

messages.msgid: Used in the <neutral>creation of mutagenic drugs</neutral>.
Injecting it will <neutral>prime your body for mutation</neutral>.
translations: 注射后可 <neutral>让你的身体准备变异</neutral>。

messages.msgid: This item can quickly reload rounds into gun or magazine that <info>have enough space</info>.
translations: 这个物品可以快速将子弹重新装填入<info>有足够空间</info>的枪支或弹匣。

messages.msgid: This item can quickly reload rounds into gun or magazine that <info>don't have enough space</info>.
translations: 这个项目可以快速将子弹装填入<info>没有足够空间</info>的枪支或弹匣。
这件装备会<bad>阻碍声音</bad>，让你<info>无法说话</info>。

messages.msgid: This item will be activated when it is placed in mapgen.
translations: 这件物品在地图创建时将被自动激活。

messages.msgid: <bad>You must</bad> have two free hands to fire this item.
translations: 你必须使用<bad>双手</bad>来发射这个物品。

messages.msgid: This item has a small profile consistent with a compact magazine.
translations: 这件物品外形小巧，类似紧凑型弹匣。

messages.msgid: Item must be a compact magazine
translations: 物品必须为紧凑型弹匣

messages.msgid: You could probably use this to get into a science facility.
translations: 这件物品可让你进入一处科学设施。

messages.msgid: You could probably use this to get into a secured maintenance area.
translations: 这件物品可让你进入一处防护严密的维护区域。

messages.msgid: You could probably use this to get into a secured law enforcement area.
translations: 这件物品可让你进入一处防护严密的执法部门区域。

messages.msgid: You could probably use this to get into a secured  area.
translations: 这件物品可让你进入一处防护严密的区域。

messages.msgid: You could probably use this to access a secure zone of a facility.
translations: 这件物品可让你进入一处防护严密的设施中的区域。

messages.msgid: This item fits in items that use ultra-light batteries.
translations: 这件物品能放入使用超轻电池的电器。

messages.msgid: This item fits in items that use light batteries.
translations: 这件物品能放入使用轻型电池的电器。

messages.msgid: This item fits in items that use medium batteries.
translations: 这件物品能放入使用中型电池的电器。

messages.msgid: This item fits in items that use tool batteries.
translations: 这件物品能放入使用工具电池的电器。

messages.msgid: This item fits in items that use methanol fuel cells.
translations: 这件物品能放入使用甲醇燃料电池的电器。

messages.msgid: This item is meant to be toggled during combat.
translations: 这件物品需要在进入战斗前开启。

messages.msgid: Airtight tanks for propane, natural gas, etc.
translations: 存储丙烷、天然气等气体的密封罐。

messages.msgid: Laser sights are invalid when the target position is <bad>too far</bad> or <bad>too bright</bad>.
translations: 瞄准目标<bad>太远</bad>或<bad>太亮</bad>时，激光瞄具不可用。
这件物品属于喷气背包。
这件物品可以让你在空中悬停。

messages.msgid: Allows movement over rough and sharp terrain without penalty.
translations: 能在崎岖或危险地形以正常速度移动。

messages.msgid: This is meant for a small exosuit hardpoint.
translations: 这件物品可装入动力装甲的小型插槽。

messages.msgid: This is meant for a large exosuit hardpoint.
translations: 这件物品可装入动力装甲的大型插槽。

messages.msgid: This is meant for an exosuit PSU hardpoint.
translations: 这件物品可装入动力装甲的PSU插槽。

messages.msgid: This is meant for small exosuit gadgets, 1 L or less.
translations: 这件物品可插入动力装甲的小型储物插槽。（< 1升）

messages.msgid: This is meant for helmet-specific gadgets.
translations: 这件物品可插入动力装甲的头盔储物插槽。

messages.msgid: This is meant for medium exosuit gadgets, between 1 L and 5 L.
translations: 这件物品可插入动力装甲的中型储物插槽。（1~5升）

messages.msgid: This is meant for large exosuit gadgets, larger than 5 L.
translations: 这件物品可插入动力装甲的大型储物插槽。（> 5升）

messages.msgid: This is meant for exosuit underlayers.
translations: 这件物品是动力装甲的贴身服。

messages.msgid: This is meant for exoskeleton helmet plating.
translations: 这件物品可插入外骨骼的头盔护甲插槽。

messages.msgid: This is meant for exoskeleton torso plating.
translations: 这件物品可插入外骨骼的躯干护甲插槽。

messages.msgid: This is meant for exoskeleton arm plating.
translations: 这件物品可插入外骨骼的手臂护甲插槽。

messages.msgid: This is meant for exoskeleton leg plating.
translations: 这件物品可插入外骨骼的腿部护甲插槽。

messages.msgid: This is meant for exoskeleton foot plating.
translations: 这件物品可插入外骨骼的脚部护甲插槽。

messages.msgid: This piece of armor is an energy barrier and will break after absorbing a certain amount of damage.
translations: 这件盔甲是一道能量屏障，在吸收一定量的伤害后就会破碎。

messages.msgid: A medium drone sold by Hub 01.
translations: Hub 01出售的一架中型无人机。

messages.msgid: A small drone sold by Hub 01.
translations: Hub 01出售的一架小型无人机。

messages.msgid: This tool can test for voltage.
translations: 这件工具可以测量电压。
这是一块液体冻结后碎成的小片。

messages.msgid: This item is removed after use.
translations: 这个物品在使用后被移除。

messages.msgid: Contents of this item are used for fueling bionics.
translations: 这个物品的内容被用作生化燃料。

messages.msgid: ID card granting access to the crashing ship's locker room.
translations: 允许你进入失事船只更衣室的钥匙卡。

messages.msgid: ID card granting access to the crashing ship's armory.
translations: 允许你进入失事船只军械库的钥匙卡。

messages.msgid: ID card granting access to the crashing ship's exobay.
translations: 允许你进入失事船只外部甲板的钥匙卡。

messages.msgid: Item must be shaped like paper
Item must be shaped like a credit card
Item must be shaped like a bank note
Item must be shaped like a coin
Item must be shaped like a bank note strap
This item is meant to be externally attached to the eyepiece of a single-lens gas mask.
translations: 本产品用来从外部连接到一个单眼窗防毒面具的目镜。

messages.msgid: Item must be designed to clip onto the external Lenz brackets of a panoramic-view gas mask.
translations: 产品必须设计为能夹固到全景视野防毒面具的外部棱镜支架上。

messages.msgid: This item is intended to be inserted behind the visor of a single-lens gas mask.
translations: 本产品用于插入单眼窗防毒面具的遮阳板后方。

messages.msgid: Item must be able to clip into place within a gas mask that has a single, panoramic eyepiece.
translations: 产品必须能够固定到有一个全景单眼窗的防毒面具上。

messages.msgid: An old gun, WWII or earlier.
translations: 一把老古董的枪支，大概产自二战时期或者更早。
这件护甲<info>受击消耗能量</info>。

messages.msgid: You feel like you would keep all your items if you somehow became incorporeal.
translations: 你能在虚体形态下继续保留该物品。

messages.msgid: You can ascend straight up even with no physical surface to climb on.
translations: 你能够垂直向上移动，脚下无需踩着实体表面来支撑。

messages.msgid: You gain greatly enhanced effects from the Mycorrhizal Communion mutation
translations: 你从菌根交流突变中获得极大的增强效果

messages.msgid: The character has roots, which helps with the TREE_COMMUNION mutation.
translations: 角色有根，这有助于TREE_COMMUNION变异。

messages.msgid: The character has extensive roots, which helps with the TREE_COMMUNION mutation.
translations: 角色有大量的根，这有助于TREE_COMMUNION变异。

messages.msgid: The character can use vines to safely rappel down sheer drops.
translations: 角色可以利用藤蔓从悬崖峭壁上安全滑下。

messages.msgid: The character is disliked by natural animals.
translations: 自然动物不喜欢这个角色。

messages.msgid: The character is intensely disliked by natural animals.
translations: 自然动物极其不喜欢这个角色。

messages.msgid: The character is liked by natural animals.
translations: 自然动物喜欢这个角色。

messages.msgid: The character is intensely liked by natural animals.
translations: 自然动物极其喜欢这个角色。

messages.msgid: This clothing is able to <info>accommodate even mutated anatomy</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <info>容纳变异肢体</info>。

messages.msgid: The character bleeds slower than normal, losing blood at 2/3rds the normal rate.
translations: 角色的出血速度比正常情况慢，失血速度是正常情况的三分之二。

messages.msgid: The character bleeds even slower than normal, losing blood at 1/3rd the normal rate.
translations: 角色的出血速度比正常情况更慢，失血速度是正常情况的三分之一。

messages.msgid: This grants access to the LIXA facility.
translations: 这件物品使你能够进入LIXA研究所。

messages.msgid: This grants access to the experiment chamber of the LIXA facility.
translations: 这件物品使你能够进入LIXA研究所的实验舱。

messages.msgid: This grants access to the experiment chamber and PPE lockup for the LIXA facility.
translations: 这件物品使你能够进入LIXA研究所的实验舱及防护服储藏室。

messages.msgid: This grants access to locked-down areas of the LIXA facility.
translations: 这件物品使你能够进入LIXA研究所的禁止区域。

messages.msgid: This will eventually <bad>go bad</bad> if left in the open air too long.
translations: 这件物品在露天长时间放置会<bad>腐烂</bad>。

messages.msgid: This gear <good>completely protects</good> you from <info>skin irritants</info>.
translations: 这件装备能 <good>完全保护</good> 你 <info>不受皮肤刺激影响</info>。

messages.msgid: Something is preventing your worn and carried items from being effected by water.
translations: 你的物品和装备能够免受进水的侵害。

messages.msgid: You can walk across the surface of water.
You can craft at 100% speed in any level of light.
translations: 你在各种光照情况下，都能以100%的速度制造。

messages.msgid: Deal damage equal to 100% of monster's HP.
translations: 造成相当于怪物 100% 生命值的伤害。

messages.msgid: Not a martial art, this is just plain old punching and kicking.
translations: 并非武术流派，而是人类近乎本能的拳脚击打。

messages.msgid: You decide to not use any martial arts.
translations: 你决定不使用任何武术。

messages.msgid: Not a martial art, setting this style will prevent weapon attacks and force punches (with a free hand) or kicks.
translations: 并非一种真正的武术流派，选择该流派将不使用手持物品近战攻击，而是用拳头（如果你空手时）或脚。

messages.msgid: You force yourself to fight unarmed.
Aikido is a Japanese martial art focused on self-defense, while minimizing injury to the attacker.  It uses defensive throws and disarms but its techniques lack offensive power.
translations: 合气道是一种专注自卫的日本武术，以抓筋拿脉，分筋错骨为主要手段，尽量减少对对方的实际伤害。它使用防御投技并解除敌人的武装，但是招式缺乏进攻力。

messages.msgid:
By disregarding offense in favor of defense, you are better at protecting yourself.

Blocked damage reduced by 100% of Dexterity, +2 blocking effectiveness, +1.0 Dodging skill.
translations:
通过舍弃攻击力来换取防御力，你能够达到更好的自卫效果。

格挡值按敏捷的100%增加，格挡效率 +2。
闪避技能 +1。

messages.msgid:
An intermediate Aikido practitioner can protect themselves against multiple opponents.

Blocked damage reduced by 100% of Dexterity, +1 blocking effectiveness, +1 block attempt, +1 dodge attempt.
translations:
中级合气道武师能够同时抵御数个敌人的攻击。

格挡值按敏捷的100%增加，格挡效率 +1。
格挡次数 +1，闪避次数 +1。

messages.msgid:
An advanced Aikido practitioner can protect themselves against even more opponents than normal.

+1 blocking effectiveness, +1 block attempt, +1 dodge attempt.
translations:
高级合气道武师能够同时抵御大量敌人的攻击。

格挡效率 +1。
格挡次数 +1，闪避次数 +1。

messages.msgid:
After a smooth dodge, you prepare to counter your foe.

-10% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
在一次流畅闪避后，你准备好对抗你的敌人。

移动耗时 -10%。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid:
After a smooth block, you prepare to counter your foe.

-10% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
在一次流畅格挡后，你准备好对抗你的敌人。

行动点消耗 -10%。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: Bōjutsu, "The Way of the Staff", is the Japanese martial art of fighting with a staff.  Bōjutsu focuses on maintaining a good stance to effectively block and counterattack.
translations: 日本棍术，又称"棍之道"，是一种源自日本的使用棍棒作战的武术。日本棍术专注于保持良好的姿态，以有效格挡和反击敌人。

messages.msgid: You position yourself into an agile stance.
translations: 你摆出了一个灵活的姿态。
%s 摆出了一个灵活的姿态。

messages.msgid:
A agile stance that allows your blocks to reduce incoming damage.

Blocked damage reduced by 100% of Dexterity.
translations:
灵活的姿态能让你的格挡抵挡伤害。

格挡值按敏捷的100%增加。

messages.msgid:
As you get more skilled you're able to begin targeting striking points that allow more for damage.

Melee skill increases bash damage cap.
translations:
随着你的技能提高，你可以开始瞄准攻击点，从而造成更高伤害。

近战技能等级增加钝击武器伤害上限。

messages.msgid:
As you move you begin to rapidly and fluidly roll your staff between your hands.

+10% bash damage.
Enables "Rolling Strike" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
当你移动时，你快速而流畅地用双手舞棍。

钝击伤害 +10%。
解锁"旋棍打击"招式。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: Barbaran Montante originated in 16th century Spain and focuses on overcoming thick armor with heavy weaponry and sweeping blows, transferring kinetic energy through armor and into vulnerable organs and bones.
translations: 巴巴兰重剑术起源于16世纪的西班牙，专注于对抗厚重装甲，使用重型武器和横扫招式来将动能透过装甲转移到脆弱的器官和骨骼上。

messages.msgid: You heft your weapon, stretch your shoulders, and slide into the Represa.
translations: 你举起武器，伸展肩膀，然后转入蓄力姿态。

messages.msgid: %s rolls their shoulders and prepares to duel.
translations: %s 转了转肩膀准备好决斗。

messages.msgid:
Sliding footwork enhances the crushing continuity of your attacks.

Armor penetration increased by 75% of Strength.
translations:
滑动的步法增强了攻击的连续性。

护甲穿透按力量的75%增加。

messages.msgid:
You switch or sturdy your grip mid-step to aid your blocking.

Blocked damage reduced by 40% of Strength.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
你可以在移动中换手或紧握刃柄，以帮助你格挡。

格挡值按力量的40%增加。
持续 3 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid:
You prepare for the final crushing strike.

Accuracy increased by 15% of Strength, armor penetration increased by 225% of Strength.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
你为最后的毁灭一击做好准备。

命中按力量的15%增加，护甲穿透按力量的225%增加。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid:
Blocking a key strike will turn the battle around.

-5% move cost.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 2 times.
translations:
关键时刻格挡打击将扭转局面。

-5% 行动点消耗
持续 3 回合。可叠加 2 次。

messages.msgid:
Formal victory is attained, and your mind is cleared to focus on your next moves.

+1 block attempt.
Lasts 5 turns.
translations:
胜利已经正式确立，你的头脑已经清空，可以专注于下一步行动。

格挡次数 +1。
持续 5 回合。

messages.msgid: Sport of the true gentleman, modern boxing has evolved from the prizefights of the Victorian era.  Strength reduces blocked damage and moving increase Dodging skill.
translations: 真正绅士的运动，现代拳击由维多利亚时期的拳击赛发展而来。力量能够增加格挡值，移动能够增加闪避技能。

messages.msgid: You lower your chin and raise your fists to eye level.
translations: 你低下下巴，把拳头举到与眼睛同高。

messages.msgid: %s prepares to fight with raised fists.

A solid stance allows you block more damage than normal and deliver better punches.

+1 accuracy, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.
translations:
沉稳的站姿可以格挡更多伤害，打出更好的拳。

+1 命中，格挡值增加力量的 50%。

messages.msgid:
You make yourself harder to hit by bobbing and weaving as you move.

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 2 times.
translations:
你通过反复移动来变得更加难以击中。

闪避技能 +1。
持续 1 回合，可叠加 2 次。

messages.msgid:
You've seen your chance.  Now strike back!

+25% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
发现破绽！马上反击！

+25% 伤害。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: You're used to hand-to-creature fighting.  You know how to fight when unarmed or with any weapon to a certain extent.  It's not stylish or sporting, but it gets the job done.
translations: 你习惯于和各种生物打架，大概知道该如何徒手或使用武器攻击。你的招式看起来不是很美观，但是够用就行了。

messages.msgid: You grit your teeth and prepare for a good fight.
translations: 你咬紧牙关，准备好好干上一架。
%s 摆出一副要斗殴的姿势。

messages.msgid:
Combat experience has led to you being able to block multiple attacks at a time.

+1 block attempt.
translations:
战斗经验使你能够一次格挡多个敌人的攻击。

格挡次数+1。

messages.msgid:
You take a moment to prepare your stance before the enemy, allowing you to hit a little more accurately.

+1 accuracy.  Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 2 times.
translations:
你花了点时间准备好面对敌人的姿态，让你的攻击更准确一点。

+1 准确度。持续2回合。可叠加2次

messages.msgid: A dance-like style with its roots in Brazilian slavery, Capoeira is focused on fluid movement and sweeping kicks.  Moving briefly enables stronger techniques.  Missing an attack grants bonus damage for a short time.
translations: 巴西战舞是一种发源于巴西奴隶中的舞蹈般的武术，专注于流畅的动作和扫腿攻击。移动后的短时间内能使用更强力的招式，而没打中的时候能够在短时间内提高伤害。

messages.msgid: %s begins to rhythmically rock back and forth.
translations: %s 开始有节奏地前后踏步。

messages.msgid:
You never stop moving while performing the ginga.  This makes you very mobile while fighting.

+1.0 Dodging skill, +1 dodge attempt.
translations:
你的持续不停的舞步使你在战斗时异常灵巧。

闪避技能 +1，闪避次数 +1。

messages.msgid:
You can feel the rhythm as you move.  You are harder to hit, and your kicks are even more amazing!

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Enables "Spin Kick" and "Sweep Kick" techniques.
Lasts 3 turns.
translations:
你能感受到你移动的节奏。你不仅更加难以击中，你的脚法也变得更加炫酷！

闪避技能 +1。
解锁"回旋踢"和"扫堂腿"招式。
持续 3 回合。

messages.msgid:
Hit or miss, it's just part of the dance!  And the best part is about to start!

+5% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
不管成败，这只是舞蹈的一部分！而最棒的部分即将开始！

+5% 伤害。
持续 1 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Crane uses intricate hand techniques and jumping dodges.  Dexterity determines your damage, rather than Strength; you have a higher chance to dodge and dodging unlocks strong techniques for a limited time.
translations: 少林五形拳之一。鹤拳刚柔相济，拳意轻灵。敏捷将取代力量决定你的伤害，你有更高的闪避几率，闪避后可以在短时间内解锁威力强大的招式。

messages.msgid: You raise your leg slightly and balance like a crane.
translations: 你抬起一只脚，仿佛飞鹤一般。
%s 摆出了一个鹤一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
Your attacks strike at your opponents' weak spots with speed and precision instead of brute force.

Bash damage increased by 75% of Dexterity but decreased by 75% of Strength.
translations:
你通过速度和精度而不是蛮力来攻击敌人的弱点。

钝击伤害增加敏捷的 75%，同时减少力量的 75%。

messages.msgid:
Like the beautiful crane, you are very skilled at evading danger.

+2.0 Dodging skill.
translations:
就像美丽的仙鹤一样，你非常善于躲开危险。

闪避技能 +2。

messages.msgid:
Masters of the Crane style can evade multiple foes with ease.

+2 dodge attempts.
translations:
鹤拳大师可以轻松躲避多个敌人。

闪避次数 +2。

messages.msgid:
Much like the crane, you are quick to avoid danger and strike back.

+1 accuracy, +1.0 Dodging skill.
Enables "Crane Kick" and "Crane Strike" techniques.
Lasts 3 turns.
translations:
就像仙鹤一样，你可以快速躲开危险并反击。

命中 +1，闪避技能 +1。
解锁"鹤爪印沙"和"雄鹤刷翎"招式。
持续 3 回合。

messages.msgid: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Dragon uses fluid movements and hard strikes.  Intelligence improves your accuracy and damage instead of Dexterity and Strength.  Dodging and blocking increases your damage.  Pausing increases your defenses.  You can perform a powerful strike against a downed opponent.
translations: 少林五形拳之一。龙拳步法多变，攻击凶悍。智力将替代敏捷及力量提升你的命中和伤害。闪避和格挡也会增加你的伤害。原地等待会增加你的防御能力。你可以对被击倒的对手进行强力打击。

messages.msgid: You relax and patiently await conflict like the great dragon.
translations: 你放松身体，如同巨龙一般耐心等待风暴到来。
%s 摆出了一个龙一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
You plan your attacks far in advance, relying on your intuition instead of your speed to strike true.

Accuracy increased by 25% of Intelligence but decreased by 25% of Dexterity, bash damage increased by 75% of Intelligence but decreased by 75% of Strength.
translations:
你通过直觉而非速度提前计划好攻击以正中目标。

命中按智力的 25% 增加，同时按敏捷的 25% 减少。
钝击伤害按智力的 75% 增加，同时按力量的 75% 减少。

messages.msgid:
Life and combat are a circle.  An attack leads to a counter and to an attack once again.  Seek to complete this loop.

+10% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.
translations:
生活和战斗是一个循环。你可以循环进行攻击和反击。完成这个循环吧。

+10% 伤害。
持续 3 回合。

messages.msgid:
You take a moment to reflect on battles past and to come.  This insight will protect you from future harm.

+2 blocking effectiveness, blocked damage reduced by 100% of Intelligence, +1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
你静心反思过去和未来的战斗。从中领悟如何防止未来的伤害。

格挡效率 +2，格挡值按智力的 100% 增加。
闪避技能 +1。
持续 2 回合。

messages.msgid: Eskrima, also known as Kali, is a Filipino martial art.  It emphasizes rapid strikes with knife and baton weapons, along with a variety of improvised substitutes.
translations: 菲律宾剑棍术，同时以"卡力"一名闻名，是一种源自菲律宾的武术。它的招式侧重于使用匕首、短棍和各类自制武器快速连续的攻击，因手上武器不同，可以有各种变招。

messages.msgid: You enter an open guard stance and prepare to strike.
translations: 你摆出了一个开放式防御的姿态，随时准备出击。
%s 摆出了一个开放式防御姿态。

messages.msgid:
You are skilled at getting the most out of your weapons.  The term 'weapon' might be very subjective.

+2 accuracy.
translations:
你善于高效利用你的武器。什么是"武器"可以由你决定。

命中+2。

messages.msgid:
You can follow up a critical hit with a stronger attack if the opportunity presents itself.

+15% damage.
Enables "Combination Strike" technique.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
机会出现之时，你能在暴击之后连上一招更强的攻击。

+15% 所有伤害。
解锁"组合连击"招式。
持续 3 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid: The noble art of fencing is taught with flexible competition blades, but the techniques are derived from (and applicable to) more functional examples.  Skilled fencers can take advantage of blocks and feints to deliver accurate strikes.
translations: 击剑术，一种高雅的武艺，通过灵活的比赛用剑施展，但是这些招式是从多种不同的武器的使用中总结提取出来的，所以也适用于使用其他武器战斗。资深的击剑者能够在格挡和佯攻寻求精准突刺的机会。

messages.msgid: You move into the en-garde stance.
translations: 你摆出了剑术预备姿态。

messages.msgid:
Your side stance reduces the chance that you will be harmed in combat.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Dexterity.
translations:
你的侧身步法使你在战斗中更难被击中。

格挡值增加敏捷值的 50%。

messages.msgid:
You fake an attack and prepare yourself to unleash a Compound Attack.

+2 blocking effectiveness.
Enables "Compound Attack" technique.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
你佯攻之后，准备发动复杂进攻。

格挡效率 +2。
解锁"复杂进攻"招式。
持续 2 回合。

messages.msgid:
Your next strike will find its mark much easier after your parry.

+1 accuracy.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
由于你的招架，你的下一次攻击更容易命中敌人。

命中 +1。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid:
Your feint is the perfect setup for a devastating followup attack!

+1 accuracy.
Enables "Compound Attack" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
你的佯攻是下一次致命一击的完美准备！

命中 +1。
解锁"复杂进攻"招式。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: Medieval Europe's martial techniques for fighting with hooked weapons.  The "Flower of Battle" places great focus on countering one's opponent and knocking them down before landing a killing blow.
translations: 中世纪欧洲使用钩式武器战斗的武术招式。 "战斗之花"非常注重反击对手并在致命一击之前将其击倒。

messages.msgid: You hold your weapon in a firm grip, ready to block any attack.
translations: 你握紧武器，准备好格挡攻击。
%s 紧紧握住了自己的武器。

messages.msgid:
You are stalwart and will not budge against any threat.

+2 blocking effectiveness, +1 block attempt, -1.0 Dodging skill, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.
translations:
猛男在危险面前从不动摇。

格挡效率 +2，格挡次数 +1，闪避技能 -1，格挡值按力量的50%增加。

messages.msgid:
You moved and nullified the effects of Stand Your Ground!

-2 blocking effectiveness, -1 block attempt, +1.0 Dodging skill, blocked damage increased by 50% of Strength.
Prevents "High Round Strike" technique.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
你的移动使不动如山失效！

格挡效率 -2，格挡次数 -1，闪避技能 +1，格挡值按力量的50%减少。
禁用"高旋斩"及"移位勾"招式。
持续 2 回合。

messages.msgid:
Each successful block reveals an opening in your opponent's guard.

+1 accuracy.
Enables "Displace and Hook" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
每一次成功的格挡都会暴露出你对手防守的漏洞。

命中 +1。
解锁"移位勾"招式。
持续 1 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid:
They fell for your feint!

Enables "Hook and Drag" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
他们被你的佯攻给骗了！

解锁"勾拽"招式。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: Judo is a martial art that focuses on grabs and throws, both defensive and offensive.  You are resistant to most effects that can knock you down and can counter grab and takedown attacks with a strong judo throw.
translations: 柔道是一种侧重于抓取并抛出武术，兼具防守与进攻。大多数能让你摔倒的攻击都能被你抵挡下来，并且能用强大的柔道投掷术来打断那些想要抓住或者想要击倒你的攻击。

messages.msgid: You prepare yourself for a grapple.
translations: 你摆出了能够随时擒抱的姿势。
%s 摆出了能够随时擒抱的姿势。

messages.msgid: Your knowledge of grappling allows you to recover from knockdown effects instantly.  In addition, you can counter grabs and takedown attacks with a judo throw.
translations:
你的格斗知识的了解可以让你从被击倒的状态中立即恢复过来。
此外，你还可以用柔道投掷术来打断那些想要抓住或者想要击倒你的攻击。

messages.msgid:
You've moved into a perfect position to counter attack!

+30% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
你已经进入了反击的绝佳位置！

+30% 伤害。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: Karate is a popular martial art, originating from Japan.  It focuses on rapid, precise attacks, blocks, and fluid movement.  A successful hit allows you an extra dodge and an extra block on the following round.
translations: 空手道是一种广为流行的武术，起源于日本。它侧重于快速、精确的攻击、格挡和流畅的步法。成功命中会让你在下回合获得额外闪避和额外格挡。

messages.msgid: You adopt a classic karate stance.
translations: 你摆出了一个经典空手道姿势。
%s 摆出了一个经典空手道姿势。

messages.msgid:
Landing a hit allows you to perfectly position yourself for maximum defense against multiple opponents.

+1 block attempt, +1 dodge attempt, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength, -10% move cost.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
攻击命中可以让你在面对多个敌人时找到最佳的防御位置，最大限度的防御对手的攻击。

格挡次数+2，闪避次数+1，格挡值按力量的 50% 增加，行动点消耗 -10%。
持续2回合。

messages.msgid:
Your no-nonsense stance allows you hit more accurately.

+2 accuracy.
translations:
你干净利落的步法使你的攻击更加精准。

命中+2。

messages.msgid: A martial art that combines western boxing with elements of Karate, Taekwondo, Muay Thai, and Savate, particularly in the use of kicks.  American Kickboxing in particular focuses on high kicks without knee or elbow strikes.
translations: 一种将西方拳击与空手道、跆拳道、泰拳和法国踢腿术元素相结合的武术，侧重于踢腿的技巧。美式踢拳道去掉了膝顶和肘击，转而专注于高踢。

messages.msgid: You bring your fists up and stay light on your feet.
translations: 你举起拳头，使出凌波微步。

messages.msgid: %s brings their fists up and stays light on their feet.

You have adopted a stance which allows for greater mobility and stability.  Your hands are in a guard position with elbows forward to protect yourself.

Blocked damage reduced by 25% of Strength.
+1.0 Dodging skill.
translations:
你摆出了一种可以提供更多机动性和稳定性的姿势。你的手处于防守位置，肘部向前保护自己。

格挡值按力量的 25% 增加。
+1.0 闪避技能

messages.msgid: Originating in Israel, Krav Maga is based on taking down an enemy quickly and effectively.  It focuses on applicable attacks rather than showy or complex moves.  Popular among police and armed forces everywhere.
translations: 发源于以色列地区，马伽术基于迅速有效地打倒敌人的技巧发展而来。它的技术偏向于切实有效的攻击动作，摒弃展示用或者较为复杂的动作。在警察和各种武装部队人员之间流行。

messages.msgid: You assume a practical combat stance.

Your training makes it easier to land hits and fight multiple opponents.

+1 accuracy, +1 block attempt.
translations:
你良好的训练使你更容易确定击打的位置并进攻多个对手。

命中+1，格挡次数+1。

messages.msgid:
Like a fool, your opponent has left themselves wide open.

+5% critical hit chance.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
就像仇敌一样，你的对手已经暴露了自己。

暴击率 +5%。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Leopard focuses on rapid, strategically-planned strikes.  Dexterity determines your damage, rather than Strength and also increases your critical hit chance.
translations: 少林五形拳之一。豹拳出其不意，快速压制。敏捷将替代力量提升你的伤害，同时能提高暴击率。

messages.msgid: You prepare to pounce like a leopard.
translations: 你准备好随时像豹子一样扑向敌人。
%s 摆出了一个豹一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
You fight by overwhelming your opponents with speedy strikes that are much harder to defend against.

Bash damage increased by 75% of Dexterity but decreased by 75% of Strength.
translations:
你通过难以防御的快速打击来压倒对手。

钝击伤害按敏捷的 75% 增加，同时按力量的 75% 减少。

messages.msgid:
Go for the throat and take out your foes immediately!

Critical hit chance increased by 100% of Dexterity.
translations:
瞄准喉咙，瞬间干掉你的敌人！

暴击率按敏捷的100%增加。

messages.msgid:
Just like a cat, you are quick, agile, and hard to pin down.

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
你就像猫一样动作敏捷，难以被抓住。

闪避技能 +1。
持续 2 回合。

messages.msgid: The art of the longsword and sword & buckler, preceding the later development of fencing.  Designed for combat both unarmored and in armor, it includes grappling as well as defensive and offensive sword techniques.  This style is a combination of the Italian and German traditions.
translations: 使用长剑和剑与盾的技艺，这一技艺之后发展成了现代击剑。它既适用于无甲战斗，也适用于装甲战斗，包括擒拿以及防守和进攻剑法。这篇论文用详尽的分解插图比较了意大利和德国的中世纪战斗传统。

messages.msgid: You take on a knightly stance.
translations: 你摆出了和骑士一样的姿势。
%s 摆出了一个骑士一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
You maintain the momentum from your last strike to move more quickly.

-20% move cost.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
你借助上一次打击的力道，以更快地移动。

行动点消耗 -20%。
持续 2 回合。

messages.msgid:
Through chivalry and vigilance, your defense with a blade has increased.

+1 block attempt, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.
translations:
贯彻了骑士精神与警觉，你成功用刀锋防御的概率增加了。

格挡次数 +1，格挡值按力量的 50% 增加。

messages.msgid:
You grip the blade partway down for greater control.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength, -1 accuracy.
Enables "Grab" and "Lethal Strike" techniques.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
手握剑刃部分，以获得更好的控制。

格挡值按力量的 50% 增加，-1 命中，
解锁"擒拿"和"致命一击"招式。
持续 2 回合。

messages.msgid:
You parry and return the attack with greater vigor!

+10% damage, -10% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
你成功招架，并更有力的回击对手！

伤害 +10%，行动点消耗 -10%。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: Also referred to as the "Art of 8 Limbs," Muay Thai is a popular fighting technique from Thailand that uses powerful strikes.  Your Strength decreases blocked damage.  Blocking attacks or getting hit will increase your damage and blocked damage further.
translations: 也被称作"八臂武术"，泰拳是一种源自泰国的流行格斗技，采用双拳、双肘、双膝、双脚这八个部位给予对手强力一击。你的格挡值随着力量增加而增加。格挡成功或者受到伤害会增加你的攻击伤害并提升后续格挡值。

messages.msgid: You perform a short wai khru in honor of your teachers.
translations: 你跳了一小段拜师舞来感谢自己的师傅。

messages.msgid:
Strength is everything in Muay Thai and you know how to make the most of yours.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.
translations:
泰拳中力量就是一切，你知道如何充分利用你的力量。

格挡值按力量的 50% 增加。

messages.msgid:
Taking a hit will not slow you down.  You will outlast your opponent and win this fight.

Bash damage increased by 25% of Strength, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.
Lasts 5 turns.
translations:
受到攻击并不会减慢你的速度。你能比你的对手撑得更久，从而赢得这场比赛。

钝击伤害按力量的 25% 增加，格挡值按力量的 50% 增加。
持续 5 回合。

messages.msgid: Ninjutsu is a martial art and set of tactics used by ninja in feudal Japan.  It focuses on rapid, precise, silent strikes.  Ninjutsu is almost entirely silent and you have a higher chance to critically hit on your first attack.  It also provides small combat bonuses every time you move.
translations: 忍术是封建时代的日本忍者所使用的武学和战斗技巧。它专注于快速、精确、无声的突击。忍术招式几乎全是无声的，并且首次攻击时有暴击几率更高。它也会在你每次移动时提供少许战斗加成。

messages.msgid: You perform a kuji-in mantra with your hands.  Rin, Kai, Jin!
translations: 你用手结印。临兵斗者皆阵列前行！

messages.msgid: %s performs a series of intricate hand signs.
translations: %s 用手连续比划了几个错综复杂的手势。

messages.msgid:
Your training allows you to make no noise when attacking and less noise when moving around.

Melee and unarmed attacks generate 0 noise, moving generates 1/2 as much noise.
translations:
你的训练可以让你在攻击时完全不出声，而且降低移动时的声音。

近战攻击完全无声。移动声音减半。

messages.msgid:
To a true shinobi, the first strike and the last strike are one and the same.

+25% critical hit chance.
translations:
对一个真正的忍者来说，第一击就是最后一击。

+25% 暴击几率。

messages.msgid:
Ninja are trained to be extremely agile and mobile.

+1.0 Dodging skill, accuracy increased by 20% of Dexterity.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
忍者训练注重敏捷和灵活。

闪避技能 +1，命中按敏捷的 20% 提升。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid:
Your intentions are known!  It will take you a few moments to sneak attack again.

Disables "Sneak Attack" buff and "Assassinate" and "Ninjutsu Takedown" techniques.  Enables "Swift Strike (crit)" technique.
Lasts 3 turns, persists after switching styles.
translations:
你的意图已经被人发现了！你需要过一阵子才能再次偷袭。

禁用"偷袭"增益、"刺杀"和"忍术绊摔"招式。解锁"迅捷一击（暴击）"招式。
持续 3 回合，切换流派后仍旧持续。

messages.msgid:
Your target has perished.  It is time to leave and plan your next attack.

+2 dodge attempts, +10 movement speed.
Lasts 3 turns, persists after switching styles.
translations:
你的目标已经死了。是时候逃离并计划下一次攻击了。

闪避次数 +2，移动速度 +10。
持续 3 回合，切换流派后仍旧持续。

messages.msgid: Niten Ichi-Ryu is an ancient school of combat, transmitting a style of classical Japanese swordsmanship conceived by the warrior Miyamoto Musashi.  Perception increases damage and reduces blocked damage.  Moving and attacking reduces dodging and damage until you pause.  Pausing for a moment increases Dodging skill.
translations: 名为二天一流的二刀流流派，是一个由传奇的日本剑术名家宫本武藏所创立的流派。感知提升攻击伤害和格挡值。每次移动和攻击都会降低闪避和攻击伤害，除非你在每次攻击前停顿一下。原地不动时可以提升闪避技能。

messages.msgid: You clear your mind as you prepare yourself for combat.
translations: 你斩断一切思绪，准备好作战。

messages.msgid:
Cautious watchful eyes,
measure and display your skill.
Practice makes perfect.

Armor penetration increased by 50% of Perception, blocked damage reduced by 100% of Perception.
translations:
谨慎持重，眼观六路
权衡利弊，展现技巧
一言蔽之，熟能生巧

护甲穿透按感知的 50% 增加，格挡值按感知的 100% 增加。

messages.msgid:
Blackened like darkness,
nightmares approach from all sides.
Flee at any cost!

-5.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
暗如黑夜，
魑魅魍魉，四面袭来。
速速逃离！

闪避技能 -5。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid:
Luck be the light,
on a dark and cloudy night,
as the moon shines down.

Enables "In-One Timing" technique.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
幸有此光，
于此暗夜，
有如月洒清辉。

解锁"闪现突攻"招式。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid:
A sharp sword cuts true.
Although, all things fade with time.
Restraint hones your skills.

-1.0 Dodging skill, -5% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 5 times.
translations:
利刃已出鞘，
然万物随时间消逝。
唯忍得以精进此术。

闪避技能 -1，钝击伤害 -1，斩击伤害 -1。
持续 1 回合。可堆叠 5 次。

messages.msgid:
The eye of the storm,
a fleeting moment of peace,
gone without a trace.

+2 accuracy, Dodging skill increased by 50% of Perception.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
风暴之眼，
安宁须臾，
旋即消失无踪。

命中 +2，闪避技能按 感知 的 50% 增加。
持续2回合。

messages.msgid: An ancient Greek martial art once used by the Spartans.  It combines boxing and wrestling techniques to create a brutal sport, though the modern revival of the art is more restrained and rules-based.
translations: 一种曾经由斯巴达人使用过的古希腊武术，结合拳击和摔跤技巧，构筑成一个残酷的运动。而现代的版本就有着某些规范了。

messages.msgid: You crouch slightly and prepare to rush forward.
translations: 你半蹲下，准备好向前扑出。

messages.msgid: %s crouches slightly, ready to rush forward.
translations: %s 半蹲下，准备好向前扑出。

messages.msgid:
You have your opponent right where you want them!

+20% damage.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
你让你的对手正好处于你想要的位置！

+20% 伤害。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid:
The enemy has presented an opening in their defense.

+10% damage.
Enables "Close Combat" buff.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
敌人的防御出现了漏洞。

+10% 伤害。
解锁"近身作战"招式。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: Pencak Silat, of Indonesian origin, is a fighting style that covers the use of short blades and bludgeons.  Fighters stay low and mobile to avoid attacks, then unleash deadly critical hits.
translations: 班卡苏拉，这种武术发源于印尼，是一种使用短刀和棍棒来格斗的武术流派。武者弯腰游走来回避攻击，然后出其不意的发动致命的会心一击。

messages.msgid: You give a salute of respect as you prepare for combat.
translations: 你摆出了敬礼的姿势，准备好作战。

messages.msgid:
You try to stay as loose as possible when fighting to have more chances to dodge.

+1 dodge attempt.
translations:
你在战斗时尽量保持放松，使你有更多的机会躲闪。

闪避次数+1。

messages.msgid:
You stay low as you move, making it harder for enemies to defend against you.

+5% critical hit chance.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
你在移动时放低身体，使敌人更难防御你的攻击。

暴击率 +5%。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid:
Each time you dodge an attack, you learn a bit more about your opponent's fighting style.  This allows you to make more precise attacks against them.

Accuracy increased by 15% of Dexterity.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
每次你次闪避过攻击时，你就会对手的战斗方式有更多的了解。这使你能够更精确的攻击敌人。

命中按敏捷的 15% 增加。
持续 2 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Snake focuses on sinuous movement and precision strikes.  Perception determines your accuracy and damage, rather than Dexterity and Strength.  Standing still increases the accuracy and critical hit chance of your next few attacks.
translations: 少林五形拳之一。蛇拳以其若即若离的进攻动作与精准而致命的打击闻名于世。感知将取代敏捷和力量决定命中和伤害，且静止不动会提升下次攻击时的命中和暴击几率。

messages.msgid: You adopt a fluid stance, ready to strike like a snake.
translations: 你摆出了灵活的姿态，准备像蛇一样攻击。
%s 摆出了一个蛇一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
Each snake bite is more painful than the last.

Armor penetration increased by 25% of Perception.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 4 times.
translations:
每次被蛇咬都比上次更痛。

护甲穿透按感知值的25%增加。
持续 2 回合。可叠加 4 次。

messages.msgid:
You are patient and know where to hit your opponent for best results.

Accuracy increased by 25% of Perception but decreased by 25% of Dexterity, bash damage increased by 75% of Perception but decreased by 75% of Strength.
translations:
你很有耐心，知道打击对手那些部位能获得最好结果。

命中按感知的 25% 增加，同时按敏捷的 25% 减少。
钝击伤害按感知的 75% 增加，同时按力量的 75% 减少。

messages.msgid:
Every snake waits for the perfect moment to strike.  Aim as your opponents approach and attack their weak spots without mercy!

+1 accuracy, +1 blocking effectiveness, +5% critical hit chance.
Lasts 4 turns.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
每条蛇都会等待完美一击的时刻的到来。当你的对手分心时，毫无怜悯地攻击他们的弱点！

命中 +1，格挡效率 +1，暴击几率 +5%。
持续 4 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid:
You hit a weakpoint!  Your next attack will be extra painful.

Armor penetration increased by 100% of Perception.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
你击中了弱点！你的下次攻击会非常疼痛。

护甲穿透按感知的100%增加。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: Sōjutsu, "The Way of the Spear", is the Japanese martial art of fighting with a spear.  Sōjutsu focuses on keeping opponents at a distance in order to maintain the advantage in combat.  Standing still gives you an extra block attempt but moving will briefly increase your damage.
translations: 日本枪术是一种源自日本的使用长矛作战的武术。日本枪术专注于在战斗中保持同对手的距离，以便维持自身战斗优势。当你站立不动时，你会获得一次额外的格挡，而你移动时则会短暂地提高伤害。

messages.msgid: You prepare to defend against all that approach you.
translations: 你准备好抵抗任何胆敢靠近你的敌人。
%s 摆出了一个开脚防御的姿势。

messages.msgid:
Your training grants better defense while using a polearm.

+1 block attempt, +2 blocking effectiveness.
translations:
你接受的武术训练令你在使用长柄武器时能够更好的防御。

格挡次数 +1，格挡效率 +2。

messages.msgid:
You have given up your defenses for a moment to increase the damage of your attacks.

+10% damage, -1 block attempt.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
你放弃防御以便在短时间内提高自身伤害。

伤害 +10%，格挡次数 -1。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: Taekwondo is the national sport of Korea, and was used by the South Korean army in the 20th century.  Focused on kicks, it does not benefit from wielded weapons.  It also includes strength training; your blocks absorb extra damage and your attacks do more damage if you are not holding anything.
translations: 跆拳道是韩国的国民运动项目，也在20世纪时被韩国军队使用。由于这种武术流派专注于使用脚踢攻击对手，因此它不受你手中武器的加成。这项武术流派同时也包含了力量的训练；格挡将吸收更多伤害，并且未手持物品时你的伤害也会增加。

messages.msgid: You adopt a narrow fighting stance.
translations: 你摆出了一个近身格斗的姿态。
%s摆出了一个近身格斗的姿态。

messages.msgid:
Using your legs to attack keeps your hands free for better defense.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.
translations:
你使用腿部进行攻击，从而腾出双手用于更好地防御。

格挡值按力量的 50% 增加。

messages.msgid:
Your attacks are stronger if you are not holding anything in your hands.

+33% damage when not using a weapon.
translations:
你在空手攻击时伤害更高。

未手持武器时伤害 +33%。

messages.msgid: Though Tai Chi is often seen as a form of mental and physical exercise, it is a legitimate martial art, focused on self-defense.  Its ability to absorb the force of an attack makes your Perception decrease damage further on a block.  Pausing for a moment enables powerful palm strike techniques.
translations: 尽管太极通常被视为一种锻炼身心的运动，它同时也是一种专注于自卫的正规武术。太极能够吸收攻击的力量，使你在格挡时所受伤害随着感知的提高而进一步减小。原地不动时，你可以使出强力的掌击。

messages.msgid: You settle into a gentle stance and prepare to defend yourself.
translations: 你摆出了一个中正安舒的姿态，随时准备防御。
%s 摆出了一个中正安舒的姿态。

messages.msgid:
You are focused on defense and predicting your opponents' attacks.

+1 block attempt, blocked damage reduced by 100% Perception.
translations:
你专注于防御和预测对手的攻击。

格挡次数 +1，格挡值按感知的 100% 增加。

messages.msgid:
By taking a moment to prepare yourself, you are able to use your entire body fully for attacking and defending.

+2 blocking effectiveness, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Perception.
Enables "Palm Strike" and "Double Palm Strike" techniques.
Lasts 3 turns.
translations:
通过花点时间为自己下一步招式做准备，你可以充分利用全身来攻击和防守。

格挡效率 +2，格挡值按感知的50%增加。
解锁"拗步掌"和"双按掌"招式。
持续 3 回合。

messages.msgid:
By perfectly positioning yourself and your opponent, you have become more accurate and can bypass your opponent's defenses.

Accuracy increased by 20% of Perception, armor penetration increased by 50% of Perception.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
你仔细掌握你和目标的相对位置，动作更加精准而且能绕开对手的防御。

命中按感知的 20% 增加，护甲穿透按感知的 50% 增加。
持续 2 回合。

messages.msgid: One of the five Shaolin animal styles.  The Tiger focuses on relentless attacks above all else.  Your Strength determines your accuracy, and your attacks do increasing damage as you continue attacking.
translations: 少林五形拳之一。虎拳一气相贯，连绵不绝。力量将取代敏捷决定你的命中，且连续攻击将逐步增加伤害。

messages.msgid: You clench your hands into ferocious, tiger-like claws.
translations: 你把双手握紧成猛虎般的爪子。
%s 摆出了一个虎一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
You attack with an endless barrage of strikes.  The more you hit, the stronger you become.

+1 accuracy, +5% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
你的攻击无穷无尽。你的命中得越多，你就会越强。

+1 命中，+10% 伤害。
持续 3 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid:
You do not need defense.  You do not need a plan.  You need strength.  Strength will break your opponents' defenses and overwhelm them completely.

Accuracy increased by 25% of Strength but decreased by 25% of Dexterity.
translations:
你不需要防御。你不需要计划。你只需要力量。力量会击溃对手的防御，并完全压倒他们。

命中按力量的 25% 增加，同时按敏捷的 25% 减少。

messages.msgid: Wing Chun is a Chinese martial art that began by selecting the easiest-to-learn effective techniques from the various Shaolin animal forms.  It has a high stance, with one's weight resting entirely on the rear leg.  Wing Chun focuses on sensitivity to the opponent's direction of force, and flowing around it to create opportunities for attack.
translations: 咏春是一门中国武术，传说起源于南少林鹤拳，也有从蛇鹤相斗获得灵感的说法。它的站立姿势很高，重心完全放在后腿上。咏春专注于对对手发力方向的准确感知，并借此还击。

messages.msgid: You take your stance and prepare to receive the gift of violence.
translations: 你摆好架势，准备迎接暴力的洗礼。

messages.msgid: %s patiently assumes a curiously pigeon-toed stance.
translations: %s 摆出了一个内八字的姿势。

messages.msgid:
Your punches are properly timed to give your opponent no rest from your strikes.

-10% move cost.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
你每次出拳都恰到好处，不会给你的对手任何喘息机会。

行动点消耗 -10%。
持续 1 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid:
You have a greater understanding of balance and technique.  This gives you a better chance to avoid your opponent's attacks.

Dodging skill increased by 25% of Perception, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Perception.
translations:
你对平衡和技巧有更深的理解。这让你能更好地躲开你的对手的攻击。

闪避技能按感知的 25% 增加。格挡值按感知的50%增加。

messages.msgid:
Through the perfect application of the Thrusting Fingers form, you can strike your opponents' weak points, force them away, and follow!

Accuracy increased by 20% of Perception
Enables "Straight Punch (Knockback)" and "L-Hook (Knockback)" techniques.
Lasts 3 turns.
translations:
通过完美地应用插指的招式，你可以打击对手的弱点，迫使他们后退，然后跟进一击！

命中按感知的20%增加。
解锁"直拳（击退）"和"左勾拳（击退）"招式。
持续2回合。

messages.msgid: AKA "drunken boxing," Zui Quan imitates the movement of a drunk to confuse the enemy.  You gain a passive Dodging skill bonus based on Intelligence and dodge attempts.  Dodging increases your damage and accuracy based on Intelligence for a short time.  Moving gives you an additional dodging bonus.
translations: 醉拳模仿醉汉的动作来迷惑敌人。你获得基于智力的被动闪避加成及闪避次数加成。闪避成功会在短时间内让你获得基于智力的伤害和命中。移动会给你额外的闪避加成。

messages.msgid: You begin to sway to and fro with a confident swagger.
translations: 你摆开架势，充满自信地来回摇摆。

messages.msgid: %s stumbles as if pretending to be drunk.
translations: %s 仿佛喝醉酒般蹒跚而行。

messages.msgid:
Others might think you stumble about at random, but you know better.  Each movement is calculated to evade harm with ease.

+2 dodge attempts, Dodging skill increased by 20% of Intelligence.
translations:
其他人可能会认为你四处乱撞，但你自己更清楚。每一次移动都经过精心计算让你轻易避开伤害。

闪避次数 +2，闪避技能按智力的 20% 提升。

messages.msgid:
With a few quick steps, you can completely change your orientation and dodge attacks easier.

+1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 2 times.
translations:
只需少许碎步，你就可以完全改变方向，并轻松避开攻击。

闪避技能 +1。
持续 1 回合，可叠加 2 次。

messages.msgid:
Each time you dodge, your positional advantage increases against your opponents.  This makes your attacks hit harder with each successful dodge.

+20% damage, accuracy increase by 20% of Intelligence.
Lasts 1 turn.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
每次闪避后，你对你的对手的位置优势都会增加。每次成功的闪避都会使你的攻击更猛烈。

+10% 伤害，命中按智力的 20% 增加。
持续 1 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid: A secret martial art used only by developers and cheaters.
translations: 失传的绝世武学，仅由开发者和作弊者使用。

messages.msgid: You get ready pwn some zeds!
translations: 你准备好调试掉些丧尸！

messages.msgid: %s prepares to cheat at martial arts!

You are a walking tank!

Bash armor increased by 100% of Strength, cut armor increased by 100% of Dexterity, electric armor increased by 100% of Intelligence, and fire armor increased by 100% of Perception.
translations:
你是一辆步行坦克！

钝击防护按力量的100%增加，斩击防护按敏捷的100%增加，电击防护按智力的100%增加，火焰防护按感知的100%增加。

messages.msgid:
When I get my hands on you…

+2 bash damage.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 5 times.
translations:
别让我抓住你……

+2 钝击伤害。持续 2 回合。可叠加 5 次。

messages.msgid:
Lightning strikes twice.

Electric damage equal to 100% of Perception.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 2 times.
translations:
闪电能击中两次。

电击伤害按感知的100%增加。
持续 3 回合。可叠加 2 次。

messages.msgid:
YOU ARE ON FIRE!

+5 fire damage.
Lasts 5 turns.
translations:
你着火了！
+5 火焰伤害。
持续 5 回合。

messages.msgid: A modern combat style for the post-modern human.  Nicknamed "Biojutsu", Bionic Combatives combines integrated weaponry, armor, and augments into a consolidated fighting discipline.
translations: 一种为后现代人类设计的先进格斗术，简称"生化术"。生化格斗术将集成进体内的武器、护甲和其它生化插件融入进招式，并最终诞生了这一统一的武术流派。

messages.msgid: BEGINNING BIONIC COMBATIVES PROGRAM.  INITIATING COMBAT PROTOCOLS.
translations: 生化格斗程序已启动。启用作战协议。

messages.msgid: %s starts moving with swift robotic precision.
translations: %s 开始以机器人般精准敏捷地移动。

messages.msgid:
player@CDDA:/root$ sudo apt install improved-armor
player@CDDA:/root$ sudo apt update

+3 bash, cut, and stab armor.
Lasts 4 turns.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
player@CDDA:/root$ sudo apt install improved-armor
player@CDDA:/root$ sudo apt update

钝击/斩击/刺击防护 +3。
持续 4 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid:
>10 LOCATE TARGET
>20 EXECUTE TARGET
>30 GOTO 10

+1 accuracy, +15% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
>10 LOCATE TARGET
>20 EXECUTE TARGET
>30 GOTO 10

命中 +1，所有伤害 +2。
持续 3 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Zhang Yiaotian.  Centipede Style uses an onslaught of rapid strikes.  Each attack you land increases your attack speed.  Critical hits increase your damage further.
translations: 五毒教汤山魁使用的神功。蜈蚣功用暴雨般的高频攻击敌人。你的每次命中都会提高你的攻击速度。暴击将进一步提高你的伤害。

messages.msgid: You ready yourself to attack as fast as possible.
translations: 你准备好如暴风雨般地进攻敌人。
%s 摆出了一个蜈蚣一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
Your attacks are a blur of hands and legs that become faster as you strike your opponents without rest.

-4 move cost.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 4 times.
translations:
你不停击打敌人，越来越快，只能看到拳脚的残影！

行动点消耗 -4。
持续 3 回合。可叠加 4 次。

messages.msgid:
Your venom burns your opponents at the worst of times.

+15% damage.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
你的毒液是你的对手永远无法忘却的长久苦痛。

+15% 伤害。
持续 2 回合。

messages.msgid: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Meng Tianxia.  Lizard Style focuses on using walls to your advantage.  Standing near a wall enables stronger buffs and techniques.
translations: 五毒教何远新使用的神功。壁虎功善于利用墙壁攻击敌人。站在墙边可以获得更强的增益并解锁更强大的招式。

messages.msgid: You ready yourself to attack from any angle.
translations: 你准备好从任何角度进攻敌人。
%s 摆出了一个壁虎一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
Through patience and observation, you know how to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

+2 accuracy, +2 blocking effectiveness.
translations:
通过耐心观察，你知道如何扭转战局使其对你有利。

+2 命中，+2 格挡效率。

messages.msgid:
Staying near a wall further improves your chances to hit and avoid damage.

+2 accuracy, +2 blocking effectiveness when near a wall.
translations:
待在墙边会进一步提高你的命中率和格挡率。

紧邻墙壁时，+2 命中，+2 格挡率。

messages.msgid:
By briefly pushing off a nearby wall and leaping, you can make yourself more dangerous and evasive.

+2.0 Dodging skill, +10% critical hit chance.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
通过短暂地推开附近的墙并跳跃，你可以提升自己的威胁度和闪避能力。

+2 闪避技能，+10% 暴击率。
持续 2 回合。

messages.msgid:
From your high vantage point, you can strike downward and deal more damage.

+10% damage while near a wall.
Lasts 3 turns.
translations:
你栖身高处，随时能向下攻击敌人，造成更多的伤害。

紧邻墙壁时，+10% 伤害。
持续 4 回合。

messages.msgid:
Your venom is a long-lasting pain that your opponents will never forget.

+15% damage.
Lasts 5 turns.
translations:
你的毒液是你的对手永远无法忘却的长久苦痛。

+15% 伤害。
持续 5 回合。

messages.msgid: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Gao Ji.  Scorpion Style is a mysterious art which uses pincer-like hands and a stinger kick.  Moving enables a stunning pincer attack.  Critical hits do massive damage and knock your opponent back along with anyone your opponent comes in contact with.
translations: 五毒教马腾使用的神功。神秘的蝎子功主练"钳形散手"与"蝎尾踢"。保持移动可以解锁一招能击昏敌人的"巨螯击"，暴击时招式能造成更高伤害，并能够击飞对手和其它被撞到的人。

messages.msgid: You prepare to capture and sting your foes.
translations: 你准备好钳住并蜇刺你的敌人。
%s 摆出了一个蝎子一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
Your venom is a constant threat that nothing can escape from.

+15% damage.
translations:
你的毒液是你的对手永远无法逃避的持续威胁。

+15% 伤害。

messages.msgid:
Rush forward and catch your prey!

+10% damage.
Enables "Pincer Fist" technique.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 2 times.
translations:
向前冲，抓住你的猎物！

+10% 伤害。
解锁"巨螯击"招式。
持续 2 回合。可叠加 2 次。

messages.msgid:
Nothing is scarier than an angry scorpion.  Your attacks can keep others at bay.

+1 dodge attempt.
Lasts 1 turn.
translations:
没有什么比一只被激怒的蝎子更可怕的了。你的攻击可以威吓你的敌人。

闪避次数 +1。
持续 1 回合。

messages.msgid: One of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Liang Shen.  Masters of Toad Style can focus their Strength to protect against all attacks.  You have powerful armor against physical attacks, though you will lose focus when you move.  You can meditate by pausing, giving yourself more armor for a short time.
translations: 五毒教李豪使用的神功。蛤蟆功大师能专注于力量来抵御所有攻击。你有强大的物理防护，但当你移动时你会分心。你可以停下来冥想，在短时间内给自己提供更多的护甲。

messages.msgid: You pause for a moment and focus on your invincible body.
translations: 你静止不动，专注于你无敌的身体。
%s 摆出了一个蛤蟆一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
Your body is as strong as iron, but only if you don't move.

Bash, cut, and stab armor increased by 100% of Strength.
translations:
你的身体和铁一样强壮，但前提是你不动。

钝击/斩击/刺击防护按力量的100%增加。

messages.msgid:
Moving causes you to lose your iron skin.

Bash, cut, and stab armor reduced by 20% of Strength.
Lasts 5 turns.  Stacks 5 times.
translations:
移动会使你失去铁布衫。

钝击/斩击/刺击防护按力量的 20% 减少。
持续 5 回合。可叠加 5 次。

messages.msgid:
By concentrating for a moment, you can bolster the strength of your iron skin.

Bash, cut, and stab armor increased by 50% of Strength.
Lasts 2 turns.
translations:
通过集中注意力，你可以增强你的铁布衫的力量。

钝击/斩击/刺击防护按力量的50%增加。
持续 2 回合。

messages.msgid:
Your venom is a harsh lesson about the strength of your iron body.

+15% damage.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 3 times.
translations:
你的毒液只不过是你的铁布衫威力的又一课。

+15% 伤害。
持续 3 回合。可叠加 3 次。

messages.msgid: A legacy of the Five Deadly Venoms, used by Qi Dong.  Viper Style (originally called Snake Style) is punishing to stunned opponents.  Stunning a foe with a Viper Bite will allow you to finish them off with the legendary Viper Strike.
translations: 五毒教齐东使用的神功，毒蛇功专注于攻击被击昏的对手。先用"蛇嘴拳"击晕，然后就能够使用传说中的"蛇信掌"终结对手。

messages.msgid: You prepare to strike your foes' weaknesses.
translations: 你准备好打击敌人的弱点。
%s 摆出了一个毒蛇一样的姿势。

messages.msgid:
You are a terrifying monster on the battlefield!  Opponents will have a harder time fighting back.

+1 accuracy, +1.0 Dodging skill.
Lasts 3 turns.  Stacks 2 times.
translations:
你是战场上可怕的怪物！对手将更难反击。

命中 +1，闪避技能 +1。
持续 3 回合。可叠加 2 次。

messages.msgid:
Every snake waits for the perfect moment to strike.  Turn your opponents' mistakes into your opportunity to strike!

+1 dodge attempt, +1 accuracy, +5% critical hit chance.
translations:
每条蛇都在等待完美时刻的到来。把对手的错误转化为攻击的机会！

闪避次数 + 1，命中 +1，暴击几率 +5%。

messages.msgid:
Your venom is a harsh reminder to never tease a predator.

+15% damage.
Lasts 4 turns.
translations:
你的毒液是一次严厉的提醒，永远不要戏弄捕食者。

+15% 伤害。
持续 4 回合。

messages.msgid: You are a pupil of the Venom Clan.  You start with one of the five deadly venoms: Centipede, Viper, Scorpion, Lizard, or Toad.
translations: 你是五毒教的徒众。你在游戏开始时可以使用蜈蚣功，毒蛇功，蝎子功，壁虎功或蛤蟆功之一。请参考邵氏经典电影《五毒》。
充能纳米复合材料（钚电池）

messages.msgid: Your skill in speaking to other people.  Covers ability in boasting, flattery, threats, persuasion, lies, bartering, and other facets of interpersonal communication.  Works best in conjunction with a high level of intelligence.
translations: 与他人打交道的熟练度，包括但不限于吹嘘、奉承、威胁、说服、撒谎(谎言)、交易，以及其他涉及与人沟通的能力。在此之上若有较高的智力，则会有更好的表现。

messages.msgid: You probably don't care about talking to other people much.
You know effective communication methods and sales tactics.
translations: 你熟知有效的沟通方法和销售技巧。

messages.msgid: You're not used to talking to people.
You rarely offend people by accident.
translations: 你已经很少会在交流中无意地冒犯他人。

messages.msgid: You can communicate your ideas well.
translations: 你可以很好地传达自己的想法。

messages.msgid: You can make friends easily and drive a hard bargain.
translations: 你善于结交朋友，也精于讨价还价。

messages.msgid: You could sell ocean water to a hermit crab.
translations: 你能凭口才把海水卖给寄居蟹。

messages.msgid: Your skill in accessing and manipulating computers.  Higher levels can allow a user to navigate complex software systems and even bypass their security.
translations: 访问和操作计算机的熟练度。等级越高越能浏览更加复杂的软件系统，甚至找到其中的后门。

messages.msgid: You barely know the minimum of how to use a computer.
translations: 你对电脑的了解处于最低水准之下。

messages.msgid: You knew how to surf the web back when that was possible.
translations: 你在这个世界还存在互联网的时候有上过网。

messages.msgid: You're aware what a "command prompt" is.
translations: 你知道什么是“命令提示符”。

messages.msgid: You know how to write code in a few scripting languages.
translations: 你能写出几种脚本语言的代码。

messages.msgid: You have an in–depth knowledge of code and how computers function.
translations: 你对代码和计算机运作原理有着深入的理解。

messages.msgid: You have probably read the entire SICP.
translations: 你大概已经啃完了《计算机程序的构造和解释》全书。

messages.msgid: You can navigate to the "phone" app on your smartphone and likely "hunt and peck" to type.
translations: 你能够打开智能手机上的“电话”应用，然后盯着屏幕一个个按完电话号码。

messages.msgid: You can debug a mod conflict for a video game.
translations: 你有能力自己修游戏mod的bug。

messages.msgid: You can make your own mods for a video game.
translations: 你有能力自己做游戏的mod。

messages.msgid: You can code your own video game.
You could get paid to bounty-hunt vulnerabilities in government databases, if any government was still around.
translations: 如果政府还存在于世的话，他们大概会花钱请你找政府数据库的bug。

messages.msgid: Your skill in effecting medical treatment.  Higher levels allow better use of medicines and items like bandages and first aid kits, and reduce the failure and complication rates of medical procedures.
translations: 进行医疗行为的熟练度。等级越高，使用绷带及药品得到的效果也越好，使用过程中的失误与并发症的发生率也会减少。

messages.msgid: You barely have any idea how your own body works.
translations: 你对自身躯体的运作几乎一无所知。

messages.msgid: You're at least aware the blood should stay inside you.
translations: 你至少知道血应该留在体内。

messages.msgid: You have a decent idea of first aid.
translations: 你对急救有不错的了解。
你受过良好的急救训练。

messages.msgid: You know a lot about how the body works and how to deal with many injuries.
translations: 你对人体运作机制及多种伤势处理颇有心得。

messages.msgid: You may know how to do simple surgeries.
translations: 你已经有足够的知识执行一些简单的手术。

messages.msgid: You might be able to put a bandaid on a minor cut without passing out.
translations: 你或许能贴个创可贴处理小伤口而不至于晕过去。

messages.msgid: You can do basic first-aid techniques without panicking too much.
translations: 你可以冷静地实施基本的急救措施。

messages.msgid: You're used to using a first-aid kit.
translations: 你已经习惯使用急救箱了。

messages.msgid: Dealing with injuries is becoming routine for you.
translations: 处理伤势对你来说已是家常便饭。

messages.msgid: You could probably work in the ER.
translations: 你完全可以胜任急诊室的工作。

messages.msgid: You almost certainly can perform a simple surgery.
translations: 你也有执行简单的手术的信心。
