messages.msgid: Your skill in engineering, maintaining and repairing vehicles and other mechanical systems.  This skill covers the craft of items with complex parts, and plays a role in the installation of bionic equipment.
translations: 操作、维护和修理载具和其他机械系统的熟练度。制造包含复杂零件的装置，以及安装生化插件时都会用到它。

messages.msgid: You know that cars are supposed to be able to go forward.
translations: 你至少知道汽车应该是往前开的。

messages.msgid: You know how to check your oil.
translations: 你会看汽车的仪表盘上的油量表。

messages.msgid: You know the basic ideas of how a car works.
translations: 你了解汽车的基本工作原理。

messages.msgid: You know how to fix most issues a car could have.
translations: 你懂得如何修理汽车可能出现的大部分问题。

messages.msgid: You know how to build a car from scratch.
translations: 你懂得如何从零开始造一辆车。

messages.msgid: You can change a wheel.  Potentially.
translations: 把你、汽车、轮胎关一起，你迟早能把轮胎换上。

messages.msgid: You can do the basics of car maintenance.
translations: 你可以进行基础的车辆维护。

messages.msgid: You can fix most common issues your car could have.
translations: 你也有能力修理汽车可能出现的大部分问题。
你可以为汽车拆卸和安装引擎。

messages.msgid: You're a skilled enough mechanic you can install a second engine.
translations: 你的机械技术足够精湛，有能力为汽车安装第二台引擎。

messages.msgid: Your skill in manipulating fine devices like security systems, traps, locks and other precision tasks.  This skill does not affect the evasion of traps that are triggered.
translations: 操作精密装置（安保系统、陷阱、撬锁），以及其他精细任务的熟练度。该技能并不影响触发陷阱时的规避能力。

messages.msgid: You know keys go in locks and traps go off if you step on them.
translations: 你知道钥匙能开锁，踩到陷阱会触发。

messages.msgid: You know how to set basic traps.
translations: 你懂得如何布置基础陷阱。

messages.msgid: You know how to set most traps and how most locks function.
translations: 你懂得如何布置大多数陷阱以及大多数锁具的工作原理。

messages.msgid: You're a knowledgeable trapper and locksmith.
translations: 你是个经验丰富的陷阱专家兼锁匠。

messages.msgid: You have an intricate understanding of traps and locks.
translations: 你对陷阱和锁具有着深刻的理解。

messages.msgid: You shouldn't try disarming anything, you'll only hurt yourself.
translations: 每当你尝试拆除陷阱，都只会伤到自己。

messages.msgid: You might be able to pick the simplest locks and can disarm basic traps.
translations: 你或许能撬开最简单的锁，拆除最基础的陷阱。

messages.msgid: You can easily disarm most traps and pick some locks.
translations: 你能轻松拆除有大多数陷阱，并撬开部分类型的锁。

messages.msgid: Lockpicking shouldn't be a problem for you.
translations: 开锁对你来说已经不成问题。

messages.msgid: You can disarm a landmine.  It's still extremely unsafe.  But you can.  Probably.
translations: 你可以拆除地雷——虽然仍极度危险，但你可以。大概吧。

messages.msgid: Your skill in operating and steering a vehicle in motion, from cars and boats to helicopters and hot air balloons.  A higher level allows greater control over vehicles at higher speeds, and reduces the penalty of shooting while driving.
translations: 操作和掌控行驶载具的熟练度，从汽车和船只到直升机和热气球。等级越高，你越能控制住高速运动的载具，以及减少边驾驶边射击时的命中率惩罚。

messages.msgid: You know what a car looks like.
You know the basics of driving a car.
translations: 你了解开动汽车的基本知识。

messages.msgid: You know how to drive a car.
You probably know how to drive larger vehicles like a truck or bus.
translations: 你已经大致掌握驾驶卡车或公交车等大型车辆的技巧。

messages.msgid: You know how to drive even in difficult conditions.
translations: 你懂得如何在恶劣条件下驾驶车辆。

messages.msgid: You know tricks even racecar drivers use.
translations: 你掌握连赛车手都在用的技巧。

messages.msgid: You don't even have a driver's license.
You were good enough to get a driver's license.
translations: 你的驾驶水平够考驾照的了。

messages.msgid: You've driven a car enough for it to become routine.
translations: 你对开车已经是驾轻就熟。

messages.msgid: You're better than most drivers on the road.  Well, not that any are left.
translations: 你比路上大多数司机都强——好吧，虽然现在也没几个在路上的了。

messages.msgid: You can keep control of most vehicles even in awkward conditions.
translations: 即使在恶劣条件下，你也能掌控大多数载具的驾驶。

messages.msgid: You could compete on a race track.
translations: 你可以独立在赛道上疾驰。

messages.msgid: Your athletic ability, including swimming endurance and ability to swim with weight.  Athletic skill also improves your overall cardio fitness and stamina.
translations: 对运动相关行为的熟练度，也包括游泳耐力和游泳时的最大负重。运动技能还能提高你的心肺功能和耐力。

messages.msgid: You don't even let people tell you that you should be more active.
translations: 你甚至不希望别人提起你应该多动动。

messages.msgid: You're at least aware exercise is good and that you should do it more.
translations: 你至少知道锻炼有益，而你也应该多运动。

messages.msgid: You know proper form and stretches.
translations: 你知晓如何正确地健身和拉伸。

messages.msgid: You could be a personal trainer.
translations: 你可以成为一名私人教练。
你属于是在沙发上生根了。

messages.msgid: You might be able to doggy paddle.
You're reasonably active and a decent swimmer.
translations: 你比较活跃，游泳水平也还凑会。

messages.msgid: You're active and a good swimmer.
translations: 你非常活跃，游泳水平也不赖。

messages.msgid: You're very active and a great swimmer.
translations: 你相当活跃，还是个游泳好手。

messages.msgid: You could swim across the English Channel.
translations: 你可以横渡英吉利海峡。

messages.msgid: Your skill in working with raw materials and shaping them into useful objects.  This skill plays an important role in the crafting of many objects.
translations: 把材料加工塑造成有用物品的熟练度。这项技能在各项物品制造中起着重要的作用。

messages.msgid: You barely know which side of the hammer you should hold.
translations: 你连锤子该握哪头都搞不清楚。

messages.msgid: You know how to hold a hammer.
You're a decent DIYer and know how to craft a variety of wooden items or very basic metalworking.
translations: 你是个不错的 DIY 爱好者，懂得制作各种木制品或进行最基础的金属加工。

messages.msgid: You're a fairly skilled DIYer and know how to craft a variety of metal items.
translations: 你是个相当熟练的 DIY 达人，懂得如何打造各种金属制品。

messages.msgid: You're an exceptionally skilled DIYer and know how to smith basic tools and weapons.
translations: 你是一位技艺超群的 DIY 达人，熟知锻造基础工具与武器的技艺。

messages.msgid: You know the ins and outs of making almost anything you can think of.
translations: 你精通制造几乎所有能想到的物品。

messages.msgid: You can only craft the most basic things.
translations: 你只能制作出最最基础的物品。

messages.msgid: You can craft a few basic things.
translations: 你可以制作一些相对基础物品。

messages.msgid: You can craft a variety of useful stuff without much issue.
translations: 你可以轻松制作出各种实用的物品。

messages.msgid: You can easily craft useful, if junky weapons and armor, but nothing too complex.
translations: 你可以轻松制作出实用但粗糙的武器和护甲，不过复杂的东西就别想了。

messages.msgid: You can craft even complex objects without fail.
translations: 你能毫无差错地制作出复杂的物品。

messages.msgid: You have created many things with your hands and you should have little issue crafting anything.
translations: 你已亲手创造了许多物品，制作任何东西对你来说都不在话下。

messages.msgid: Your skill in combining food ingredients to make other, tastier food items.  Also includes food preservation and safety, brewing, butchery, and more.
translations: 将食物材料加工成更可口的食品的熟练度。这个技能也涉及食品存储、食品安全、酿制和屠宰等方面。

messages.msgid: You know the basics of how not to burn your house down.
translations: 你知道"不把房子烧掉"的基本常识。

messages.msgid: You know how to cook reasonably.
translations: 你懂得如何像模像样地烹饪。

messages.msgid: You know how to cook a wide variety of food.
translations: 你熟知多种多样的食物的烹饪方式。

messages.msgid: You know how to cook the most advanced and complex dishes.
translations: 你熟知最高端且复杂的菜肴的烹饪方式。
你连花生酱果酱三明治都能烤糊，真是绝了。

messages.msgid: You can cook a variety of recipes.
translations: 你可以烹饪多种多样的食谱。

messages.msgid: You can cook most recipes with ease.
translations: 你可以轻松烹饪大多数食谱。
你在社区烘焙大赛中能拔得头筹。

messages.msgid: You'd be an excellent chef, too bad all the zombies want to eat is you.
translations: 你会是个很棒的厨师，可惜丧尸们只想品尝你。

messages.msgid: Your skill in the craft and repair of clothing, bags, blankets and other textiles.  Affects knitting, sewing, stitching, weaving, and nearly anything else involving a needle and thread.
translations: 制造和修复衣物、背包、毛毯和其他纺织品的熟练度。影响针织、缝纫以及其他任何与针线有关的事儿。

messages.msgid: You know the very basics of how to sew a patch over a small hole.
translations: 你知道"在小破洞上缝补丁"这类基础知识。

messages.msgid: You know how to sew well.
You know how to sew with non-standard materials.
translations: 你了解怎么用特殊材料缝纫。
你是个知识渊博的裁缝。

messages.msgid: You can put a shirt on without ripping it, at least.
translations: 你光是把衬衫穿上不扯破就算是谢天谢地，更别提上手缝了。

messages.msgid: You've held a sewing needle once or twice.
You can repair or sew simple clothing.
translations: 你可以缝制或修补一些简单的衣物。

messages.msgid: You can repair or sew more complex clothing.
translations: 你能够缝制或修补更为复杂的衣物。

messages.msgid: You're skilled at working with non-standard materials like Kevlar.
translations: 你擅长使用像凯夫拉这样的特殊材料进行缝纫。

messages.msgid: You can sew anything you could dream of.
translations: 你可以缝制任何你能想象到的东西。

messages.msgid: Your skill in surviving the wilderness, and in crafting various basic survival items.  This also covers your ability to skin and butcher animals for meat and hides.
translations: 荒野生存、制造各种基础生存物资的熟练度。也影响你从尸体上获取皮毛和肉类的能力。

messages.msgid: You're aware the outdoors is gross.
You know the very basics of camping.
translations: 你了解露营的基本知识。

messages.msgid: You know how to craft a fire drill to start fires without lighters.
translations: 你知晓如何制作钻木取火装置来替代打火机。

messages.msgid: You probably memorized most of the Scouting handbook.
translations: 你可能已熟记童子军手册中的大部分内容。

messages.msgid: You're exceptionally knowledgeable in all things outdoorsy.
translations: 你在户外相关领域具备异常丰富的知识储备。
你至少是出门碰过草了。

messages.msgid: You might've been a cub scout as a kid.
translations: 你小时候可能是个童子军。

messages.msgid: You're a skilled scout and can pitch a tent with ease.
translations: 你是个熟练的童子军，可以很轻松地搭起帐篷。

messages.msgid: You could likely be dropped into a forest with nothing and thrive.
translations: 你有能力被丢到森林里荒野求生。

messages.msgid: Your skill in dealing with electrical systems, used in the craft and repair of objects with electrical components.  This skill is an important part of installing and managing bionic implants.
translations: 处理电路系统、制造与修复电子设备的熟练度。这项技能是安装和管理生化插件的重要指标。

messages.msgid: You don't know the first thing about how electricity works.  It might as well be magic to you.
translations: 你根本不知道电是如何工作的。大概是魔法罢。

messages.msgid: You have a very rudimentary knowledge on how electricity works.
translations: 你对电有着基础且浅显的了解。

messages.msgid: You have some idea of how electricity works.
translations: 你大体知晓电路是怎么运作的。

messages.msgid: You have a good understanding of how electricity works and were possibly an electrician.
translations: 你对电的运作原理有很好的了解，很可能曾经从事过电工的工作。

messages.msgid: You have an intricate understanding of electronics and how they function.
translations: 你对电子学及其运作原理有着深入透彻的理解。

messages.msgid: You can turn a light switch on or off.
You can craft extremely basic electronics like flashlights.
translations: 你能够制作如手电筒等非常基础的电子设备。

messages.msgid: You can craft some electrical gadgets and set up an at-home power grid without major fire hazards.
translations: 你具备组装简易电子装置并搭建家用电力系统的技术能力，且能有效规避重大火灾风险。

messages.msgid: You can craft a variety of useful electronics.
translations: 你具备制作多种实用电子设备的技术能力。

messages.msgid: You can craft any electrical device you can think of.
translations: 你能够制作任何你能想象到的电子设备。

messages.msgid: Your skill in using bow weapons, from hand-carved self bows to complex compound bows.  Quiet and effective, they require strength of body and sight to wield, and are not terribly accurate over a long distance.
translations: 从自制简易弓到结构复杂的复合弓，使用它们的熟练度。它们安静而有效，但也需要强壮的身体和敏锐的视线才能用好。此外在射击远攻击时，弓的命中率难以恭维。

messages.msgid: You know what a bow looks like.
You know how to nock an arrow.
You know the basics of archery.
translations: 你知道射箭的基础知识。
你对射箭拥有丰富的知识。

messages.msgid: You have a wealth of knowledge about archery.
translations: 你对射箭拥有海量的知识。

messages.msgid: You're lucky if the arrow doesn't spin sideways.
translations: 箭要是没像回旋镖那样横着转飞出去都得算是你运气好。

messages.msgid: You can usually get the arrow to fly straight-ish.
translations: 你通常可以让箭笔直射出。

messages.msgid: You can usually hit an archery target.
translations: 你可以做到射箭不脱靶。

messages.msgid: You're a skilled archer and might've done well in some competitions.
translations: 你是一个经验老道的射手，可能还在某些赛事中得过好成绩。

messages.msgid: You'd've been a terror at the Battle of Agincourt.
translations: 你在阿金库尔战役中是个可怕的存在。

messages.msgid: Your overall skill in using bows and firearms.  With higher levels, this general experience increases accuracy with any bows or firearms, but is secondary to practice with the type of ranged weapon in question.
translations: 使用弓弩及枪械的整体熟练度。等级提高会提升使用弓弩及枪械的命中率，但所持武器相对应技能的提升会更加明显。

messages.msgid: You don't even know how to aim a gun.
translations: 你甚至不知道如何用枪瞄准。

messages.msgid: You know where the iron sights on a gun are.
translations: 你至少知道枪上的准星在哪。

messages.msgid: You know the basics of aiming.
translations: 你知晓基础的瞄准技巧。

messages.msgid: You know how to aim most ranged weapons fairly well.
translations: 你在使用大多数远程武器时都能很好地瞄准。

messages.msgid: You know how to aim even at long distances taking into account bullet drop and wind speed.
translations: 你知道如何瞄准远距离目标——只要考虑子弹下落和风速。

messages.msgid: Your hands shake, your aim is shit, and you close your eyes before each shot.  You could aim at the ground and somehow miss.
translations: 你手抖成老太太，准头更是一坨，每次扣扳机前还都闭上眼睛。你哪怕瞄着地面都有可能射天上去。

messages.msgid: Holding a gun steady is difficult for you.
You've been to the range a few times and can usually hit the target.
translations: 你去过靶场几次，通常能击中目标。

messages.msgid: Your aim is pretty good even at medium ranges.
translations: 即使在中射程下你的瞄准也相当不错。

messages.msgid: You have good aim even at fairly long ranges.
translations: 你在相当远的距离下也能保持好的准头。
你是个名副其实的狙击手。

messages.msgid: Your skill in using heavy weapons like rocket, grenade or missile launchers.  These weapons have a variety of applications and may carry immense destructive power, but they are cumbersome and hard to manage.
translations: 对火箭、榴弹或导弹发射器之类的重型武器的熟练度。它们用途涵盖多样，威力巨大，但也很笨重和难以操作。

messages.msgid: You know nothing about launchers, cannons, or anything similar.
translations: 你对发射器、大炮或类似的东西一无所知。

messages.msgid: You've at least read about cannons or flamethrowers.
translations: 你至少在书上见过大炮或火焰喷射器。

messages.msgid: You probably built a spud launcher at some point.
translations: 你可能在过去的某个时间点建造过土豆发射器。

messages.msgid: You're skilled with various types of launchers.
translations: 你熟知多种类型的发射器。

messages.msgid: You're a rare expert in knowledge about various types of launchers.
translations: 你对各类发射器的知识几乎是专家级别。

messages.msgid: Rather understandably, you have never fired any kind of launcher before.
translations: 你以前从未发射过任何发射器——可以理解。

messages.msgid: You may have fired a spud cannon at some point.
translations: 你可能在过去的某个时间点使用过土豆发射器。

messages.msgid: You have experience firing launchers or flamethrowers, somehow.
translations: 你不知为何有不少使用发射器或火焰喷射器的经验。

messages.msgid: Your growing level of experience with rocket launchers, flamethrowers, or cannons is worrying.
translations: 你对火箭发射器、火焰喷射器或大炮的经验越来越丰富，这令人担忧。

messages.msgid: You just want to watch the world burn, and you're really damn good at making sure it will.
translations: 你只想看着世界燃烧，而你也真的很擅长让它燃烧这件事。

messages.msgid: Handguns have poor accuracy compared to rifles, but are usually quick to fire and reload faster than other guns.  They are very effective at close quarters, though unsuited for long range engagement.
translations: 相较于步枪，手枪精准度要差一些，但它们的举枪射击和装弹速度都比其他类型的枪械快。它们在近距离十分有效，但在远距离就比较颓废。

messages.msgid: You can't tell a revolver from a semiautomatic.
translations: 你分不清左轮手枪和半自动手枪的区别。

messages.msgid: You can tell a revolver from a semiautomatic.
translations: 你分得清左轮手枪和半自动手枪的区别了。

messages.msgid: You know the basics of handguns and their usage.
translations: 你对手枪和它们的使用方式有着基础的了解。

messages.msgid: You're knowledgeable about handguns and their uses.
translations: 你对手枪和它们的使用方式有着很多知识。

messages.msgid: You know every trick and technique for firing handguns accurately and effectively.
translations: 你知道准确有效地发射手枪的每一个技巧和技术。

messages.msgid: Hopefully it won't fly out of your hands when you fire one.
translations: 只要在击发时还能把枪握住不脱手就算胜利。

messages.msgid: Handguns feel awkward to use for you.
translations: 你觉得手枪用起来很尴尬。

messages.msgid: You're comfortable with the usage of handguns.
translations: 你觉得手枪用起来很顺手。

messages.msgid: You're quite skilled and accurate with handguns.
translations: 你可以熟练地用手枪进行精准射击。

messages.msgid: You could win a duel at high noon.
translations: 你可以在正午决斗时赢得胜利。

messages.msgid: You're a deadeye with pistols and can likely hit someone at 20 yards from the hip with ease.
translations: 你是一个拿着手枪的神枪手，哪怕是腰部射击也能轻松击中20码外的人。

messages.msgid: Classic rifles have terrific range and accuracy compared to other firearms, but may be slow to fire and reload, and can prove difficult to use in close combat.  Short-barreled rifles and carbines are more like SMGs and perform well in close combat.
translations: 与其他类型的枪械相比，传统步枪射程远、精度高，但射击和装填速度慢，在近距离作战中会略显弱势。短管步枪和卡宾枪则更像接近冲锋枪，在近距离作战中表现得比较优秀。

messages.msgid: Rifles are complicated weaponry and you don't know anything about them.
translations: 步枪是种复杂的武器，而你对此一窍不通。

messages.msgid: You at least have rudimentary knowledge of rifles.
translations: 你掌握步枪最最基础的知识。

messages.msgid: You can maintain your average standard-issue rifle.
translations: 你能够进行常见的制式步枪的维护。

messages.msgid: You have an intricate knowledge of all the parts of a rifle and their use.
translations: 你对步枪的各个部件及其功能有深入了解。

messages.msgid: You can probably disassemble and reassemble your rifle in the dark with your hands tied together.
translations: 即使在黑暗或双手受限的情况下，你也能完成步枪的拆解与组装。

messages.msgid: You've never fired a rifle before.
You can at least shoulder a rifle.
translations: 你至少能做到正确抵肩持枪。

messages.msgid: You're at least as competent as the average soldier straight out of boot camp.
translations: 你至少具备刚从新兵训练营出来的普通士兵的水准。

messages.msgid: Rifles feel familiar in your hands.
translations: 步枪在你手中显得得心应手。

messages.msgid: You could be a career sniper.
translations: 你完全有资格成为一名职业狙击手。

messages.msgid: Shotguns are easy to shoot and can inflict massive damage, but their effectiveness and accuracy decline rapidly with range.  Slugs can be loaded into shotguns to provide greater range, though they are somewhat inaccurate.
translations: 霰弹枪易于使用且能造成大量伤害，但随着距离增加，威力和命中率会迅速下降。独头弹可以补足普通霰弹的射程，但其精准度难以恭维。
“什么叫它既能打准也打不准？”

messages.msgid: You know what a shotgun is.
translations: 你了解霰弹枪的基本构造与功能。

messages.msgid: You know enough about shotguns to get mad about unrealistic pellet spread in video games.
translations: 你对霰弹枪的了解已经多到会对游戏里离谱的霰弹枪散布较真了。

messages.msgid: You're knowledgeable about the handling and maintenance of shotguns.
translations: 你很了解对于霰弹枪的操作和维护。

messages.msgid: You couldn't hit the broad side of a barn.
translations: 你哪怕是站谷仓面前射击都能射空。

messages.msgid: You can usually hit a clay pigeon if it's just sitting there.
translations: 你通常可以打中一只泥鸽，如果它只是不动的站在那。

messages.msgid: You probably have experience skeet shooting.
translations: 你多少有着泥鸽射击的经验。

messages.msgid: You're a very skilled skeet shooter.
translations: 你是一个熟练的泥鸽射击手。

messages.msgid: You could snipe with most shotguns if you weren't limited by the spread.
translations: 你可以用大多数霰弹枪狙击——不考虑散步限制的话。

messages.msgid: Comprised of an automatic rifle carbine designed to fire a pistol cartridge, submachine guns can reload and fire quickly, sometimes in bursts, but they are relatively inaccurate and may be prone to mechanical failures.
translations: 冲锋枪作为射击手枪弹的自动卡宾枪，可以在短时间内快速装弹并宣泄子弹，但命中率相对较低，且易于发生故障。

messages.msgid: You don't know the first thing about submachine guns.
You know very little about SMGs.
You know a decent bit about firing SMGs accurately.
translations: 你知道如何用冲锋枪进行精准射击。

messages.msgid: You're knowledgeable about the tactics used with SMGs.
translations: 你对冲锋枪相关的战术很了解。

messages.msgid: You've never held an SMG before.
translations: 你从来没拿起过冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: You have minimal experience with SMGs.
translations: 你有较少使用冲锋枪的经验。

messages.msgid: You have some experience with SMGs.
translations: 你有一些使用冲锋枪的经验。
你对冲锋枪的操作相对熟练。
你对冲锋枪的操作很有经验。

messages.msgid: You're a CQB expert with SMGs.
translations: 你是使用冲锋枪的CQB专家。

messages.msgid: Your skill in throwing objects over a distance.  Skill increases accuracy, and at higher levels, the range of a throw.
translations: 远距离投掷物品的熟练度。等级越高，投掷距离和精度越高。

messages.msgid: You've managed to avoid gym class your whole life and barely know how to throw a rock.  Impressive.
translations: 你翘了这辈子所有的体育课，导致还不知道怎么扔石头。令人佩服。

messages.msgid: You know how to throw things.  Which is good, since that's an inherent skill of being human.
translations: 你知道怎么扔东西——人类与生俱来的技能。不错。

messages.msgid: You know how to throw stuff with reasonable accuracy.
translations: 你知道怎么把东西扔得很准。

messages.msgid: You know proper form and methods for throwing accurately.
translations: 你知道能进一步提升精准度的投掷方式和方法。

messages.msgid: You could teach sports.  The ones that involve throwing stuff anyway.
translations: 你可以教体育——要教扔东西的那种。

messages.msgid: You're lucky if you don't drop the thing you're throwing at your feet.  Be extra careful with grenades.
translations: 你丢东西的过程中能不脱手就算是祖坟烧青烟了。手榴弹更是要特别小心。

messages.msgid: You can usually throw a rock at a person if they're not too far away, or moving.
translations: 如果一个人离你不远，且没有在移动，你通常可以用石头扔中他。

messages.msgid: You can accurately throw a dodgeball at someone.
translations: 你可以准确地向某人投掷躲避球。

messages.msgid: You can pitch a baseball across home plate into the strike zone reliably.
translations: 你可以可靠地把棒球投过本垒板进入好球区。

messages.msgid: You could've become a professional pitcher.  At least beaning zombies doesn't give them a free walk to first base.
translations: 你本可以成为职业棒球投手的，不过至少爆僵尸头时不用白送它们上一垒。

messages.msgid: Your skill and finesse in personal combat, both with and without a weapon.  Higher levels can significantly increase the accuracy and effectiveness of your physical attacks.
translations: 在个人战斗中的技能和技巧——不论是徒手还是持械。高等级可以显著增加物理攻击的命中率和威力。

messages.msgid: You have no idea how to do anything other than vaguely swing in their direction.
translations: 你只知道一味地朝着敌人的大致方向胡乱挥拳。
你可以进行理论上的战斗。

messages.msgid: You've learned enough to avoid overswinging and falling off balance if you miss.
translations: 你的知识已经足以帮助你避免在挥空时失去平衡摔倒。

messages.msgid: Whether self-taught or trained, you've learned quite a lot about fighting.
translations: 无论是自学还是训练，你掌握了大量的格斗知识。

messages.msgid: You could teach a platoon of medieval soldiers how to fight in a war.
translations: 你可以教一排中世纪的士兵如何在战争中作战。

messages.msgid: Any fighting you do is mostly just panicked flailing.
translations: 你做的任何打斗都只是惊慌失措的乱挥手臂。

messages.msgid: Your panicked flailing has become somewhat more determined flailing.
translations: 你惊慌失措的乱挥变成了更坚定的乱挥。

messages.msgid: Your fighting now actually resembles proper form and is far less clumsy.
translations: 你现在拥有正常的打斗方式，动作也不那么笨拙了。

messages.msgid: You're a proper fighter and can use most techniques.
translations: 你已是一名合格的战士了，并且掌握了大多数的战斗技巧。

messages.msgid: You're a skilled man-at-arms that wouldn't look out of place fighting on a medieval battlefield.
translations: 你是一位技艺娴熟的武士，就算把你放在中世纪的战场中，你也能临危不惧，迅速融入。

messages.msgid: In a world with guns you've dedicated yourself to mastering melee combat, and you're damn good at it too.
translations: 在一个枪械盛行的世界里，你却专注于成为一名近战大师，并且你现在确实技艺非凡。

messages.msgid: Your skill in fighting with blunt weaponry, from rocks and sticks to baseball bats and the butts of rifles.  Skill increases damage, and higher levels will improve the accuracy of an attack.
translations: 使用钝器战斗的熟练度，从路边的石头木棍，到棒球棍，再到步枪枪托都在此列。等级越高，伤害和命中率也越高。

messages.msgid: You don't even know how to swing a baseball bat properly.
translations: 你甚至都不知道如何正确地挥动棒球棍。

messages.msgid: You at least know how to swing a baseball bat.
translations: 你至少知道怎么挥舞棒球棒。

messages.msgid: You have a decent idea how to maneuver blunt weapons without falling off balance.
translations: 你大致知道如何在保持自身平衡的情况下，挥舞钝器进行战斗。

messages.msgid: You've learned how to leverage blunt weapons best to get powerful, accurate hits.
translations: 你已经学会了如何最高效的使用钝器，能在战斗中发出强力且精准的攻击。

messages.msgid: You could teach a class on fighting with maces and hammers.
translations: 你的钝击技巧娴熟到甚至可以开设一门关于使用战锤和钉头锤的战斗课程。

messages.msgid: You've somehow gone through life without even swinging a stick for fun.  How awful.
translations: 你活到现在，居然连根木棍都没挥着玩过，真是糟透了。

messages.msgid: You can swing a baseball bat.
translations: 你可以正确地挥舞棒球棍。

messages.msgid: You can reliably hit a pitch while at bat.
translations: 你能稳定的用棒球棍击中投来的球。

messages.msgid: You're a decently skilled batter and good at using all sorts of bludgeons, improvised or otherwise.
translations: 你是个训练有素的击球手，擅长使用各种钝器，无论是自制的棍棒还是专业的武器。

messages.msgid: You can hit zombies over the head even with random junk and still make it look good.
translations: 就算用随手捡到的垃圾，你也能轻松地给丧尸开瓢，甚至还能打得优雅而不失风采。

messages.msgid: You can swing a heavy, poorly-weighted sledgehammer with pinpoint accuracy even against a moving target.
translations: 你能挥舞一把沉重且平衡差的长柄大锤精确命中目标，即使是面对移动的目标也不成问题。

messages.msgid: Your skill in fighting with weaponry designed to cut, hack and slash an opponent.  Lower levels of skill increase accuracy and damage, while higher levels will help to bypass heavy armor and thick hides.
translations: 使用砍、劈类武器战斗的熟练度。低等级下仅提升命中率和伤害，而高等级则能帮助击穿厚重防护和重甲。

messages.msgid: You don't even know how to play-swordfight.
translations: 你甚至不会假装拿剑瞎比划。

messages.msgid: You at least know which part of the sword you're supposed to hold.
translations: 你至少知道应该握住剑的哪一部分。

messages.msgid: You've learned how to cut properly with draw cuts and similar techniques.
translations: 你已经学会了如何正确地进行拔刀斩以及类似的斩击技巧。

messages.msgid: You've learned how to fight with swords effectively.
translations: 你已经学会了如何有效地使用剑进行战斗。
你已经深入研习过剑术。

messages.msgid: You'd probably hit with the flat of the blade more than the edge.
translations: 绝大多数情况，你都是在用剑身当棍子打，而不是拿刃砍。

messages.msgid: You can usually get a decent cut when chopping.
translations: 至少在切菜时，产生的切口挺整齐。

messages.msgid: You can reliably keep good edge alignment when slicing.
translations: 你已经能稳定使用剑刃进行劈砍。
你已经是一名技艺娴熟的剑士了。

messages.msgid: With your skill, in another life you could duel a samurai.
translations: 凭借你的高超技艺，下一世的你甚至可以与武士一决高下。

messages.msgid: Your ability to dodge an oncoming threat, be it an enemy's attack, a triggered trap, or a falling rock.  This skill is also used in attempts to fall gracefully, and for other acrobatic feats.  The first number shown includes modifiers, and the second does not.
translations: 躲避迎面威胁的熟练度，无论是敌人的攻击、触发的陷阱，还是上方的落石。这项技能也将决定你是优雅的落地，还是一屁股砸在地板上，以及其他一些你心血来潮所做的杂技动作。前一个数值为加成后的数据，后一个数值则为基础值。

messages.msgid: For most people, jumping out of the way of danger is instinct, and you barely have that.
translations: 对于大多数人来说，躲避危险是本能。你几乎没有本能。

messages.msgid: You might know how to dodge.
You've learned how to minimize your movement with dodging to avoid overexerting yourself.
translations: 你学会了如何减小闪避的幅度，以免过度消耗你的体力。

messages.msgid: You have a good grasp on various dodging techniques and ways to avoid being grabbed.
translations: 你很好的掌握了各种闪避技巧，也知道那些避免被人抓住的方法。

messages.msgid: You know how to do a dodge, duck, dip, dive, and how to win every game of dodgeball.
translations: 你知道如何闪转腾挪，并赢下每一场躲避球比赛。

messages.msgid: Your reflexes are dull and you have two left feet.  Hope you don't trip.
translations: 你神经反射和肢体协调与你的身体无关，你走路不崴脚能被归类为生命的奇迹。

messages.msgid: You can at least dodge without tripping over your own feet.
translations: 至少你在躲避攻击时不会绊倒自己。

messages.msgid: You have decent reflexes and can dodge a dodgeball.
translations: 你的反应能力还不错，能够躲避飞来的躲避球。

messages.msgid: You're fairly squirrely, most enemies will have some difficulty hitting you.
translations: 你相当灵活，大多数敌人很难击中你。

messages.msgid: You have exceptional reflexes and are very slippery and hard to pin down.
translations: 你反应灵敏，动作娴熟，敌人很难将你抓住。

messages.msgid: Your skill in fighting with knives, spears and other such stabbing implements.  Skill increases attack accuracy as well as the chance of inflicting a deadly and critical blow.
translations: 用匕刃、矛等刺击武器战斗的熟练度。等级提升将提升命中，与造成暴击或致命打击的几率。

messages.msgid: You might not even be aware you're supposed to stab with a spear.
translations: 你可能都不知道长矛的头是拿来捅人的。

messages.msgid: You understand the gist of thrusting weapons.
translations: 你了解刺击武器的基本使用方法。

messages.msgid: You know some of the techniques involved with thrusting weapons.
translations: 你知道一些使用刺击武器的技巧。

messages.msgid: You're well-learned in fencing or spearmanship.
translations: 你在击剑或是长枪方面有很高的造诣。

messages.msgid: You could open a fencing school or start your own spear lessons.
translations: 你完全有能力开设一所击剑学校，或是进行长枪课程的教学。

messages.msgid: You have a hard time spearing steak with a fork.
translations: 哪怕用叉子叉牛排，对你来说也颇为棘手。

messages.msgid: Stabbing is an awkward motion for you.
translations: 你觉得戳捅是个很别扭的动作。

messages.msgid: You're a decent fencer or spearman.
translations: 你是一位像样的击剑家或长枪手。

messages.msgid: You're a skilled fencer or spearman.
translations: 你是一位技艺娴熟的击剑家或长枪手。

messages.msgid: You're a commando with a knife, a fencing expert, and an accomplished spearman.
translations: 你是一位手持军匕的突击队员，一位剑术专家，或是一名技艺高超的长枪手。

messages.msgid: Your skill in hand-to-hand fighting.  For the unskilled, it's a good way to get hurt, but those with enough practice can perform special blows and techniques to quickly dispatch enemies.
translations: 徒手战斗的熟练度。对于门外汉来说无异于自残，但只要多加练习，就能使用出特殊技法来快速干倒敌人。

messages.msgid: You've never had any interest in learning to fight.
translations: 你对空手搏斗从来没有一丁点儿兴趣。

messages.msgid: You can theoretically throw a punch.
translations: 理论上，你知道该怎么出拳。

messages.msgid: You know how to throw down.
translations: 你知道该怎么徒手打架。

messages.msgid: You really know how to throw down.
translations: 你非常熟悉该怎么徒手打架。

messages.msgid: You could probably teach your own martial art.
translations: 你大概都能自创一套武术流派了。

messages.msgid: Punching someone is more likely to hurt you than them.
translations: 你的拳脚功夫惊为天人，甚至能做到杀敌八百，自损一千。

messages.msgid: You can throw a punch.  Not well, but you can throw one.
translations: 你略懂拳脚——至少打一拳踢一脚的问题不大。

messages.msgid: You're enough of a scrapper to fight with your fists if you have to.
translations: 如果必须动手才能解决问题的话，你也能用双拳打一架。

messages.msgid: You could win most bar fights.
translations: 你能赢下大多数的酒吧斗殴。

messages.msgid: You'd have your black belt if any dojos were still open.
translations: 要是还有道馆开着，恐怕你现在早就拿到黑带了。

messages.msgid: You could have multiple black belts or box in the major leagues.
translations: 你的肉搏水平完全可以拿下好几条黑带，甚至去职业拳击赛场上搏一搏。

messages.msgid: Your skill in general 'bench science', applying any of a wide range of precision techniques based on your overall understanding of scientific principles.  This is not a research skill, but about using the results of others' research.
translations: 对“实验室科学”的熟练度，适用于需要基于你对科学原理的理解程度来执行的各类精密科学技术。并不代表你的科研能力，而是对他人的科研成果的使用能力。

messages.msgid: You're not even theoretically a physicist.
translations: 你甚至连物理都一知半解。

messages.msgid: You have the basic understanding of science on par with a high schooler.
translations: 你对科学有着基本的理解，相当于高中生的水平。

messages.msgid: You have a decent understanding of science on par with a college graduate.
translations: 你对科学有着进一步的理解，相当于大学生的水平。

messages.msgid: You have a deep understanding of the scientific method and possibly have a degree in a scientific field.
translations: 你对科学方法有着深刻的理解，可能在某个科学领域拥有学位。

messages.msgid: You likely have a PhD in a scientific field.
translations: 你很可能在某个科学领域拥有博士学位。

messages.msgid: You skipped all your science classes.
You've at least done high school chemistry classes.
translations: 你至少有参与过高中的化学实验课。

messages.msgid: You've worked with a few chemicals and can follow simple procedures.
translations: 你处理过一些化学品，有能力制备工序简单的化合物。

messages.msgid: You can follow some more complicated procedures and likely took advanced chemistry courses.
translations: 你能遵循一些更复杂的制备流程制作化工产物，你可能还修过高级化学课程。

messages.msgid: You can do some advanced chemistry, or just make drugs.
translations: 你可以进行一些高级化学实验，或是制作药物。

messages.msgid: Space twists and deforms around you.
translations: 你周围的空间扭曲变形。

messages.msgid: The world unravels into geometric shapes, and between the chaos you spot a horrid prowling beast.
translations: 你感到世界被分解成几何图形，在混乱中你看见了一只可怕的潜行野兽。

messages.msgid: An unnatural implosion sends objects flying.
translations: 一股反常的力量让物品飞了过来。

messages.msgid: The world loses coherence, with images of nearby places forming and disappearing around you.
translations: 你感到宇宙失去了连续性，附近地区的景象在你身边不断形成又消失。

messages.msgid: Slows you for a few turns.
The world shifts blue, and reality accelerates around you.
translations: 你感到世界仿佛蓝移了一般，现实在你身边加速流逝。

messages.msgid: Grants you a few turns of super speed.
Stale golden light floods the world, and reality stands still.
translations: 你感到世界被一道陈腐的金光淹没，现实停滞不前。

messages.msgid: Persistent shadows invade your field of view.
translations: 你感到持续不断的暗影涌入你的视野。

messages.msgid: Closes a tear in reality and transfers strange energy to the artifact user.
translations: 关闭时空裂隙，并将奇特的神秘能量传递给神器使用者。

messages.msgid:
It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
它在世界上是独一无二的。
它也许拥有未知的力量；激活它可以触发特殊效果。

messages.msgid:
An ornately decorated robe with an unfamiliar royal symbol on it.  The humanoid figure on the seal has two pairs of eyes.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一件装饰华丽的长袍，上面有一个陌生的皇家标志。海豹上的人形人物有两双眼睛。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A cloak of thin, faded cloth.  The faint silhouette of a long-dead humanoid is barely visible on it.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一件薄薄的、褪色的布披风。一个早已死去的人形生物的微弱轮廓在上面几乎看不见。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A heavy, finely crafted coat made of the fur of an unidentifiable creature.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一件厚重、制作精美的外套，由一种无法识别的生物的毛皮制成。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A sinister mask made of a smooth green stone.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
由光滑的绿色石头制成的阴险面具。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A helmet with an imposing face plate.  Though the corrosion has completely defaced the symbols written on the sides, it seems sturdy.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
带有气势磅礴的面板的头盔。虽然腐蚀已经完全污损了侧面写的符号，但它看起来很坚固。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A set of worn leather gloves embossed with gold.  The unidentifiable leather it is made from is oddly soft.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一套用金色压花的破旧皮手套。它由无法识别的皮革制成，非常柔软。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A pair of ancient leather boots.  Though the flaps of leather are crudely sewn together, the red hue it is dyed with is striking.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一双古老的皮靴。虽然皮革翻盖被粗略地缝合在一起，但它染成的红色色调却引人注目。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A band of gold with a smooth piece of amber set into it.  A strange worm is encased in the amber, making a perfect spiral with its sealed body.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一根金带，上面镶嵌着一块光滑的琥珀。琥珀中包裹着一条奇怪的蠕虫，用它密封的身体形成了一个完美的螺旋。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A well-balanced stick of treated wood with metal caps.  A red stone is embedded in the handle.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一根平衡良好的处理过的木棍，带有金属盖。手柄上嵌着一颗红色的石头。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A sword made out of a striking black metal.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一把由醒目的黑色金属制成的剑。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A harp made of black wood.  Faint hypnotic notes ring in the air each time you touch it.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
黑木制成的竖琴。每次触摸它时，空气中都会响起微弱的催眠音符。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A ritual knife used by some ancient civilization.  Unreadable runes are carved into the handle.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一些古代文明使用的仪式刀。不可读的符文被刻在手柄上。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A sturdy wooden pole with a sharp metal spike on the end.  The handle has the symbol of a blue sun on it.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一根坚固的木杆，末端有一个锋利的金属钉。手柄上有蓝太阳的象征。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A misshapen rod of gnarled, knotted wood.  The knots in the wood exhibit a strange fractal pattern.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一根畸形的棒子，由粗糙的打结的木头组成。木材中的结呈现出奇怪的分形图案。它是同类中唯一的一个。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A set of three rings linked together.  There's something about the way the rings connect to each other that gives you a headache.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一组三个相连的环。这些环彼此相扣的方式让你头痛不已。这是独一无二的物品。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A large triangle made out of three thick rectangles that connect to each other in an angle.  No matter how much you turn it around, you can't seem to comprehend how it links together.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一个由三个厚重矩形构成的大三角形，这些矩形成一个角度，相互连接。不管你怎么转动它，你都无法理解它是如何相连在一起的。这是独一无二的物品。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A large trident made entirely out of an indiscernible material.  The prong in the middle seems to fade away into nothingness when looked at from the top, but you can clearly see the shaft connecting the tip of the weapon from the bottom.  It's giving you a headache.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一个完全由不明材料制成的大三叉戟。从顶部看去，中间的叉齿似乎消失在虚无中，但从底部，你却能清楚地看到连接武器尖端的柄。它让你感到头痛。这是独一无二的物品。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A transparent flask with a neck that connects directly to its bottom without overlapping itself, even though it clearly does.  You can put things in it, but attempting to follow their path through the neck is impossible.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一个透明的瓶子，其瓶颈直接连接到底部，没有任何重叠，尽管它看起来明显是重叠的。你可以把东西放进去，但尝试沿着瓶颈追踪它们的路径是不可能的。这是独一无二的物品。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
It's a cube that constantly shrinks and grows in size.  It's two cubes linked by the vertices, with ever-shifting sides folding onto each other, over and over.  It's four cubes in the exact same position.  It's a cube fading to ash then reverting to pristine form repeatedly.  It's all of these at once, and none of them at all.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
这是一个不断收缩和扩大的立方体。它是两个顶点相连的立方体，变化无常的边不断折叠在一起。它是四个处于完全相同位置的立方体。它是一个不断化为灰烬又恢复原状的立方体。它是所有这些的集合，但又似乎什么都不是。这是独一无二的物品。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A large wire-frame cube.  The interior wires somehow appear to be over the exterior wires, no matter which angle you look at the cube from.  Trying to trace the lines with your finger is probably not a good idea.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一个大型的线框立方体。无论从哪个角度看，内部的线条总是出现在外部线条之上。尝试用手指追踪这些线条可能不是一个好主意。这是独一无二的物品。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid:
A chunky ring that folds onto itself continuously, preventing its use as an esoteric piece of jewelry.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.
translations:
一个厚重的戒指，持续地折叠在自身上，不能用作一种神秘的首饰。这是独一无二的物品。
它可能具有未知的力量；尝试激活它们。

messages.msgid: Causes a surge of adrenaline to flow throughout your body.
translations: 使一股肾上腺素流遍你的全身。

messages.msgid: You're filled with a roaring energy!
translations: 你感觉到自己体内爆发出强大的力量！

messages.msgid: Causes blood to leak from nearby terrain.
translations: 使得周围的地面渗出血液。

messages.msgid: Blood soaks out of the ground and walls.
translations: 鲜血从地面和墙壁中渗了出来。

messages.msgid: Will heal injuries all over your body.
translations: 能够治疗你全身的伤口。

messages.msgid: Causes nearby enemies to become confused.
translations: 使得周围的敌人陷入困惑。

messages.msgid: Randomly teleports you a short distance.
translations: 使你随机传送一段距离。

messages.msgid: You're not quite sure what you did, but something is watching you for it.
translations: 你不明白你做了什么，但是某种东西已经因此开始注视你。

messages.msgid: You feel like your action has attracted attention.
translations: 你感觉到你的行为吸引了异界的关注。

messages.msgid: DO YOU HEAR THE VOICES TOO?
translations: 你 也 听 见 了 吗？
你感觉到自己时空错乱。

messages.msgid: A wave of nausea passes through you!
translations: 你感觉到自己体内一阵恶心！
几个幽灵在你四周聚集成形。

messages.msgid: Does a variable amount of stamina damage.

translations: 你感觉自己如同被抽干的果冻。

messages.msgid: Hurts all monsters within your view distance.
translations: 对视野范围内的怪物造成伤害。
苍蝇在你身边嗡嗡作响。

messages.msgid: Makes a noise at your location.
You hear a deafening boom from your location!
translations: 你听见自己身上传出震耳欲聋的爆炸声。
天空开始渐渐暗淡下来。

messages.msgid: Creates some dimensional fatigue at a random point within range.
translations: 在距离内随机某处的造成一些维度疲劳

messages.msgid: Causes an explosion at the target.
Causes a flashbang at the target.
translations: 在指定地点引起闪光弹爆炸。

messages.msgid: Paralyzes you for a second or two.

translations: 你感觉到自己被麻痹了！

messages.msgid: Reveals an area around you on the overmap.
translations: 获得你附近的大地图视野。

messages.msgid: You have a vision of the surrounding area…
translations: 你感觉到自己看清了周边地区的地图……
在你四周施放火焰风暴。
你全身上下充满了欢快的感觉！

messages.msgid: One of the bolts thrown by Artifact Storm.
translations: 神器风暴所制造出的闪电。

messages.msgid: Calls down a storm near you.
translations: 在你四周施放闪电风暴。

messages.msgid: You debugged in this spell!  It makes you evil for 30 minutes.
translations: 你调试出了这个法术！施放后让你获得30分钟邪恶增益。

messages.msgid: This is a solid cube that is much heavier than its size suggests.  When you look at it, it pulls your gaze inward until you fall through the sky, showing you a top-down view of your position with the surroundings revealed.
translations: 这是一个实心立方体，重量比起它的尺寸所预估得要重得多。当你盯着它看时，你的目光会被它不断吸引，直到你仿佛从天而降般看见你和你周围环境的俯视图。

messages.msgid: A debug item to make sure that skills can be modified by enchantments.
translations: 一个调试物品，以确保技能可以被附魔修改。

messages.msgid: You just took a shot of some weird stuff.  You feel sleepy, nauseous, and generally weak, but your wounds are closing up at an unnatural pace.
translations: 你刚刚注射了一剂不明物质。随之感到困倦、恶心和全身虚弱，但你的伤口却以非自然的速度迅速愈合。

messages.msgid: Without hesitation, you draw the liquid from the ampule, smack it a bit to release any air, and inject it right into a vein, hoping it won't kill you.
translations: 你毫不犹豫地从安瓿瓶中吸取了液体，轻轻敲打以排出气泡，然后直接注入你的静脉中，希望这不会让你丧命。

messages.msgid: You feel your rapid regeneration fade away, but you still feel sick.
translations: 你感到你的快速再生正逐渐消退，但你仍然感觉不太舒服。

messages.msgid: Your body regeneration is not as fast as before, but you still feel some weakness.
translations: 你的身体恢复速度已不如之前那般迅速，但仍感体力虚弱。

messages.msgid: You jump at your target with your talons up front, attempting to deal devastating damage to your target.
translations: 你用爪子朝前跳向目标，试图对目标造成毁灭性伤害。

messages.msgid: This bionic needs to be reset to its factory state.
translations: 这个生化插件需要被恢复到出厂设置。

messages.msgid: Required for closing a protected electronic circuit.
translations: 受保险丝保护的电子电路。

messages.msgid: Required for storing charge in an electronic circuit.
An electronic circuit has been destroyed by overvoltage.
translations: 电子电路被过量电流损坏了。

messages.msgid: This device is rebooting after being shorted by an EMP.
translations: 这个设备在经受EMP短路之后被重新设置

messages.msgid: Firing blackpowder loads from a gun fouls it, which reduces reliability and, if left uncleaned, leads to rust.  It fouls the gun much faster than the use of modern smokeless powder cartridges.  Fouling is only a significant impact on reliability at high levels, but black powder fouling accumulates quickly.
translations: 枪械发射黑火药弹药会残留残渣，降低枪械可靠性并且若不及时清理会使得枪械生锈。黑火药会比现代无烟火药更快的污染枪膛。残渣只会在堆积过高时影响枪械可靠性，但使用黑火药会在枪管中迅速堆积残渣。

messages.msgid: Either this gun is brand new and came without lubrication or it was recently cleaned with a solvent without oiling afterwards.  Either way, it's not lubricated and will not cycle properly, and can even be damaged.
translations: 这把枪要么是全新没有润滑，要么是最近用溶剂清洗过后没有润滑。无论怎样，它都没有润滑，也无法正常上膛循环，甚至可能被损坏。

messages.msgid: Fouling is caused by firing gunpowder loads repeatedly, which reduces reliability and can eventually cause damage to the gun.  Fouling accumulates slowly (unless blackpowder is used) due to the design of modern smokeless powder found in the vast majority of retail cartridges and it is not a significant problem until high levels of fouling are reached due to firing thousands of rounds without cleaning your firearm.
translations: 反复发射弹药会留下残渣，降低枪械可靠性并且若不及时清理最终会损害枪械。由于现代大部分在售弹药都采用无烟火药因此残渣积累非常缓慢（除非使用黑火药），除非你发射数千发弹药还从不清理导致残渣过多，残渣堆积不是大问题。

messages.msgid: This weapon can uncontrollably vent coolant when overheated.
translations: 这种武器在过热时可以不受控制地排出冷却剂。

messages.msgid: Excessive heat has rendered this weapon inoperable.
translations: 这把武器因为过热而无法使用。

messages.msgid: This weapon will attempt to enter a cooling cycle when overheated.
translations: 这种武器在过热时会试图进入冷却循环。

messages.msgid: This gun did not load the round in the chamber properly.
This gun currently has an empty casing in the chamber.
translations: 这把枪的枪膛里卡着一颗空弹壳。

messages.msgid: The casing of the cartridge is stuck in the ejection port without being properly ejected, forming an exhaust pipe shape.
translations: 弹壳未能正确抛出，卡在了抛壳窗，形成类似烟囱的形状。

messages.msgid: Magazine of the gun tried to put two rounds in the chamber at once.
translations: 枪械弹匣试图将两发子弹一起装入枪膛。

messages.msgid: Edge of the blade got rolled, making it harder to cut.
translations: 刀口卷曲变形，更难使用。

messages.msgid: The small piece of blade edge was broken off, making it much duller.
translations: 一小块刃口缺损，以致锋利度锐减。

messages.msgid: The small part of this blade broke away.  You still can use it, but it's much less effective.
translations: 刀身的一小部分断掉了。仍可使用，但效果大打折扣。

messages.msgid: The blade shattered completely, making it just a stub.  The only way to repair such damage to make a new weapon.
translations: 刀身粉碎，仅剩残端。想修只能铸把新的了。

messages.msgid: The tip of the blade you could use to thrust is no more.
translations: 你可以用来戳刺的刀尖消失了。

messages.msgid: The tip of the blade you could use to thrust rolled into a spiral.
translations: 你可以用来戳砍的刀尖蜷曲了。

messages.msgid: The tip of %s snapped off, making the thrusts weaker.
translations: %s的尖锋折断了，使其戳砍能力减弱。

messages.msgid: The tip of %s started to warp, making the thrusts weaker.
translations: %s的尖锋扭曲了，使其戳砍能力减弱。

messages.msgid: Small pieces of %s started to chip off, making the thrusts less damaging.
translations: %s的尖锋崩落了小碎片，使其戳砍能力减弱。

messages.msgid: The %s's socket was bent off, making the tip not lined with a shaft, and making the weapon very hard to thrust properly.
translations: %s的刃座弯曲变形，导致尖锋与主体不对齐，使得武器难以合适地戳砍。

messages.msgid: The head of %s is completely broken.  The only way to repair such damage is to make a new one.
translations: %s的头段彻底破损了，想修只能铸把新的了。

messages.msgid: Small pieces of %s are chipping off.
translations: %s 的表面有小碎片正在崩落。

messages.msgid: There is a nasty crack on this %s.  Better to fix it before the entire thing snaps in half!
translations: 这个 %s 上出现了严重的裂缝。最好在它彻底断成两半之前修理一下！

messages.msgid: The entire %s just snapped, leaving only long splinters.
translations: 整个 %s 已经断裂，只剩下长长的碎片。

messages.msgid: There is a nasty crack on this %s.  Better to fix it before the entire shaft snaps in half!
translations: 这个 %s 上有一道严重的裂缝。最好在整根断成两半之前修好！

messages.msgid: This %s is snapped in half.  You still can use it, albeit much less effectively.
translations: 这个 %s 已经断成两半了，虽然还能用，但效果大打折扣。
这个 %s 已经完全损坏。

messages.msgid: Small pieces of the handle are chipping off.
translations: 握把有小碎片正在剥落。

messages.msgid: There is a nasty crack on a handle.  Better to fix it before the entire shaft snaps in half!
translations: 手柄上有一道难看的裂缝。最好在整根轴折断之前把它修好！

messages.msgid: Instead of a handle, there is just a small piece of wood that was left.
translations: 原先的手柄只留下一小块木头。

messages.msgid: The handle that was here before snapped away.
translations: 原先在这儿的把手断裂脱落了。

messages.msgid: The handle is snapped in half.  You still can use it, albeit less effectively.
translations: 手柄折断成两半了。不过你还是可以用，只是效果会差一些。

messages.msgid: The head of the tool completely separated off the shaft.
translations: 工具的头部完全从杆上脱落了。

messages.msgid: Required for operation of an attached alternator.
translations: 一个交流发电机保障正常运转的必需配件。

messages.msgid: Help when starting an engine in low ambient temperatures.
translations: 帮助你在低温环境下启动引擎。

messages.msgid: An immobilizer device prevents starting of the vehicle without the appropriate key.
translations: 一个防盗设备，防止有人不用钥匙就发动汽车。

messages.msgid: Required to pump and pressurize diesel from a vehicle's tank.
translations: 将柴油从油箱中泵出并加压的必要器件。

messages.msgid: An expired filter reduces fuel efficiency and increases smoke production.
translations: 老旧的过滤器会降低燃料的效率，并产生更多的烟雾。

messages.msgid: An expired filter reduces performance and increases the chance of backfires.
translations: 老旧的滤清器会降低性能并提高逆火的概率。

messages.msgid: Required to pump gasoline from a vehicle's tank.
translations: 将汽油从油箱中泵出的必要器件。

messages.msgid: Required to initially start the engine.
translations: 用于启动引擎的必需品。

messages.msgid: Item is too wet to use and has to be dried.
translations: 这件物品湿透了，需要烘干后使用。

messages.msgid: A standard electric convection-based oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  It's plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 一台标准的对流式电烤箱，通常用于加热及烹饪食物。它已经接入电缘并准备就绪

messages.msgid: This device effectively sterilizes water.  Activate it to clean all water in a connected tank, at the cost of some electricity.
translations: 该设备有效地对水进行消毒。 激活它以清洁连接水箱中的所有水，但需要一些电力。

messages.msgid: A bulky upright arcade cabinet, brightly painted and slightly worn with age.  Ready to be played.
translations: 一台笨重的立式街机游戏机，色彩鲜艳，因长年使用而略微磨损。可以用它玩一会游戏。

messages.msgid: An arc furnace designed to burn a powdery mix of coke and limestone to create calcium carbide.  Plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 一个用于煅烧粉末状焦炭石灰混合物来制取电石的电弧炉。已插上电源，随时可以使用。

messages.msgid: An electric forge, plugged in and ready to be used for metalworking.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs a forge, you will be given the option of selecting it as a tool.
translations: 一台电锻炉，已经插上电源随时可用于金属加工。如果你尝试制作需要锻炉的物品，你可以选择将其作为工具。

messages.msgid: An electric kiln for baking brick or clay.  When plugged in and powered you could use this to harden bricks or clay.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs a kiln, you will be given the option of selecting it as a tool.
translations: 一台可以烧制砖块和陶器的电力窑炉，当接通电源时，你可以用它来烧制砖块或陶器。砖块和陶器需要烧制变硬后才能使用。如果你在制造物品时需要使用到它的功能时，该部件会出现在可选项中。

messages.msgid: A powerful drill mounted on a slide that lets it drop precisely down.  Useful in all kinds of projects, from industrial fabrication to home woodworking.  Plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 一台安装在滑轨上的强力钻机，可以用它精确钻孔。可用于从工业制造到家庭木工的各种工作。已接通电源，可以使用了。

messages.msgid: A rotating sawblade set into a large, flat table.  Used for making straight, measured cuts, it's a key tool in any carpenter's arsenal.  Plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 一台安装在大平台上的圆锯，能够笔直切割出精确的直线，各类木工设备中的关键利器之一。已接通电源，可以使用了。

messages.msgid: A circular sawblade on an arm that can slide and rotate in several directions, this is a staple tool for nearly any carpentry.  Plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 一台安装在机械臂上的圆锯，可以在多个方向上滑动旋转，是木匠的标配工具。已接通电源，可以使用了。

messages.msgid: A ribbonlike sawblade runs in a single direction in this tool, allowing precise cuts at almost any angle.  Plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 一台带型链锯，上面的带状锯片可朝一个方向运行。它可以从几乎任意角度进行精确切割。接通电源来使用。

messages.msgid: This table has an inset router, a rotating motor with an exchangeable blade head for cutting specific profiles and grooves.  Plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 这张桌子有一个嵌入式刳刨机、一个旋转电机和一个可更换的刀头，用于切割特定的轮廓、凹槽和材料。已接通电源，可以使用了。

messages.msgid: A hefty tool that will take in a board and cut it smooth and flat to a specific width, particularly great if working with raw lumber stock, but also good just for shaving wood down to size.  Plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 一台笨重机器，能把木板切割成特定厚度并抛光。特别适合用来处理原木，但也能用来把木块切削加工成合适的尺寸。已接通电源，可以使用了。

messages.msgid: A table-shaped tool with a rotating blade that will cut down, smooth out, and square off a board to make it nice and smooth.  Plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 一张安装有旋转刀刃工具的桌子，它可以把一块木板切割成形、磨平，使之变得非常光滑、美观。已接通电源，可以使用了。

messages.msgid: A makeshift extraction system, or as makeshift as you can consider something that was purpose-built in a laboratory by a group of experts.
translations: 一套临时的催化裂解系统，或者说是那种实验室的研究人员建造的临时制取装置。

messages.msgid: If you really want to squash something a lot, this is exactly the right industrial tool for you.  Plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 如果你真的很想挤压一些东西，这对你来说就是一个很好的工业工具。你懂的，它的力量非常大。已接通电源，可以使用了。

messages.msgid: This durable tank is topped with a motor that will cram as much air into the tank as possible.  Plugged in and ready to go.
translations: 这个坚固的气罐顶部安装着一台压缩机，能将尽可能多的空气抽进罐中。已接通电源，可以使用了。

messages.msgid: A makeshift appliance which decomposes water into oxygen and hydrogen via electrolysis of sodium hydroxide solution, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.
translations: 一台自制的通过碱性溶液电解将水分解成氧气和氢气的设备，带有连接到电网的电源线。

messages.msgid: A huge appliance built from salvaged industrial equipment, which produces ammonia via the Haber-Bosch process from hydrogen and nitrogen.  It has a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.
translations: 一台巨大的设备，由回收来的工业设备制成，通过哈伯-博施法将氢气和氮气反应合成氨，带有连接到电网的电源线。

messages.msgid: A rather complicated system of thick-walled pipes, powerful compressors, and wiring, meant to interface with a reactor producing ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen via the Haber-Bosch process, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.
translations: 一个相当复杂的系统，由厚壁管道、强大的压缩机和电线组成，用于连接氨反应器，通过哈伯-博施法将氢气和氮气合成氨，带有连接到电网的电源线。

messages.msgid: A large makeshift appliance which captures nitrogen from the air for use in chemistry projects, with a power cord to connect it to an electric grid.
translations: 一台自制的从空气中收集氮气用于化学反应的大型设备，带有连接到电网的电源线。

messages.msgid: A power cord sticking out of an appliance.  You need to plug it into a powered grid for the appliance to work properly.
translations: 一条从电器中伸出的电源线。你需要将其插入电网，电器才能正常工作。

messages.msgid: A wall-mounted lamp that provides illumination when turned on.
translations: 壁挂式灯，打开时提供照明。

messages.msgid: A tall floor lamp that provides illumination when turned on.
translations: 高大的落地灯，打开时提供照明。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy light that illuminates a wide area around it when switched on.
translations: 一种大而重的灯，打开后能照亮周围的大片区域。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy light that illuminates a wide semicircle around it when switched on.
translations: 一种大而重的灯，打开后能照亮周围的半圆形区域。

messages.msgid: Electric wires embedded in the wall.
translations: 安装在墙上用来供电的电线。

messages.msgid: This folding solar panel has been unfolded, and it is ready to charge connected devices, if the sun is out.
translations: 展开的折叠式太阳能板，在有太阳的日子，可以给接入的设备充电。

messages.msgid: This solar suitcase has been unpacked and is ready to supply power.
translations: 展开的提箱式太阳能板，可正常供电。

messages.msgid: A small solar panel, mounted on a frame and ready to power other appliances.
translations: 一块安装在框架上的小型太阳能板，能够为其他电器供电。

messages.msgid: A solar panel, mounted on a frame and ready to power other appliances.
translations: 一块安装在框架上的太阳能板，能够为其他电器供电。

messages.msgid: A reinforced solar panel, mounted on a frame and ready to power other appliances.
translations: 一块安装在框架上的强化太阳能板，能够为其他电器供电。

messages.msgid: A  small, high-performance solar panel, mounted on a frame and ready to power other appliances.
translations: 一块安装在车架上的高性能小型太阳能板，能够为其他设备供电。

messages.msgid: A high-performance reinforced solar panel, mounted on a frame and ready to power other appliances.
translations: 一块安装在车架上的高性能强化太阳能板，能够为其他设备供电。

messages.msgid: A mounted wind turbine, ready to power other appliances.
translations: 一个安装好的风力发电机，准备好给其他家电供电了。

messages.msgid: A large mounted wind turbine, ready to power other appliances.
translations: 一个安装好的风力发电机，准备好给其他家电供电了。

messages.msgid: A mounted water wheel, ready to power other appliances.
translations: 一个安装好的水轮机，准备好给其他家电供电了。

messages.msgid: A mounted large water wheel, ready to power other appliances.
translations: 一个安装好的大型水轮机，准备好给其他家电供电了。

messages.msgid: A small battery to store electrical power in a static power grid.
translations: 一块能够储存电能来为电网供电的小型蓄电池。

messages.msgid: A medium battery to store electrical power in a static power grid.
translations: 一块能够储存电能来为电网供电的中型蓄电池。

messages.msgid: A large battery to store electrical power in a static power grid.
translations: 一块能够储存电能来为电网供电的大型蓄电池。

messages.msgid: A very large battery to store electrical power in a static power grid.
translations: 一块能够储存电能来为电网供电的超大型蓄电池。

messages.msgid: A car battery wired into a static power grid.
translations: 连接到供电网的汽车电池。

messages.msgid: A motorbike battery wired into a static power grid.
translations: 一块连接到电网的摩托车电池

messages.msgid: A small motorbike battery wired into a static power grid.
translations: 一块连接到电网的小型摩托车电池

messages.msgid: An appliance used to clean laundry, plugged into a power supply and using internal water tanks.
translations: 一台用来洗衣服的家电，已经插入电源并使用内部水箱。

messages.msgid: An appliance used to clean dishes, plugged into a power supply and using internal tanks.
translations: 一台用来洗碗的家电，已经插入电源并使用内部水箱。

messages.msgid: An autoclave that can steam its contents at high enough temperatures to completely sterilize them, killing any possible contaminants.  This one is plugged into a power grid and running off internal water tanks.
translations: 一个车载高压灭菌釜，能以高温蒸汽彻底消毒内容物，清除可能的污染。已经接入到电网并使用内部水箱

messages.msgid: A universal recharging station integrated into a steel storage compartment.  When turned on, it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.
translations: 集成了钢制储物柜的通用充电站。开启后会对直接放置在其内部存储空间中的任何可充电电池（蓄电池、铅酸电池等）持续充电。

messages.msgid: A small device for recharging batteries integrated into a small wooden storage compartment.  When turned on, it will slowly charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.
translations: 集成了一个小型木制储物箱的小型通用充电器。开启后会对直接放置在其内部存储空间中的任何可充电电池（蓄电池、铅酸电池等）持续缓慢地充电。
先进斯特林放射性同位素发电机

messages.msgid: A rather heavy brick of metal housing an ASRG, formerly designed by NASA and repurposed for terrestrial use.  Will provide about 130 W, basically forever as far as you're concerned.  Even though the alpha radiation these run off of isn't very dangerous in case of a breach, this unit appears to be armored to take a beating and is a good deal heavier owing to its composite plating.
translations: 一个装有先进斯特林放射性同位素发电机（ASRG）的笨重金属块，最初由NASA设计，后改进为于地面使用。它能在你有生之年内稳定输出130W的电量。尽管同位素放出的α射线在发生泄漏时也不是很危险，但装置仍作了用以应对冲击的装甲保护，其也因所使用的复合装甲板而变重了许多。

messages.msgid: A microwave connected to a power grid, ready to cook some food.
translations: 连接到电网的微波炉，准备好用于处理食物了。

messages.msgid: A machine capable of generating pure oxygen from the air.  It has been plugged into a power grid.
translations: 一种能吸入空气产生纯氧的机器。它已经接入了电网。

messages.msgid: A machine designed to compress an input gas to a very high pressure.  It has been plugged into a power grid.
translations: 一种能把输入气体压缩至超高压的机器。它已经接入了电网。

messages.msgid: An electric crucible, powered by your electric grid.  Designed for melting large quantities of glass for batch crafting and production of large items, it needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 电坩埚，由你的电网供电。 专为熔化大量玻璃而设计，用于批量制作和生产大型物品。需要放置并插入电源。

messages.msgid: A small, portable generator, one that people buy for a camp.  It just needs to be fueled up, and then turned on.
translations: 一种小型便携式发电机，通常用于露营。只需添加燃料，然后启动即可。

messages.msgid: Big and powerful generator, used for street works.  It just needs to be plugged in, fueled up, and then turned on.
translations: 一种功率强大的大型发电机，主要用于街道施工。只需接入电网，加入燃料，然后启动即可。

messages.msgid: Big and powerful generator, painted in camo.  It just needs to be plugged in, fueled up, and then turned on.
translations: 一种功率强大的大型发电机，外壳涂有迷彩。只需接入电网，加入燃料，然后启动即可。

messages.msgid: Still reasonably portable, this 12000 W gasoline generator can power up an entire house.  It just needs to be plugged in, fueled up, and then turned on.
translations: 一台12000瓦的汽油发电机，依然保持了相对的便携性，能够为整栋房屋提供电力。只需接入电网，加入燃料，然后启动即可。

messages.msgid: A standard household refrigerator.  When turned on, it will cool the food inside, extending the time until the food spoils.
translations: 一台普通的家用冰箱。开启时，它可以冷藏食物，延缓腐烂。

messages.msgid: A small fridge.  When turned on, it will cool the food inside, extending the time until the food spoils.
translations: 一台小型车载冰箱。开启时，它可以冷藏食物，延缓腐烂。

messages.msgid: A heavy, portable fridge.  When turned on, it will cool the food inside, extending the time until the food spoils.
translations: 一台沉重的车载冰箱。开启时，它可以冷藏食物，延缓腐烂。

messages.msgid: A commercial refrigerator with a glass door.  When turned on, it will cool the food inside, extending the time until the food spoils.
translations: 一台带玻璃门的商用冰箱。开启时，它可以冷藏食物，延缓腐烂。

messages.msgid: A commercial refrigerator with two glass doors.  When turned on, it will cool the food inside, extending the time until the food spoils.
translations: 一台带双玻璃门的商用冰箱。开启时，它可以冷藏食物，延缓腐烂。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty refrigerator.  When turned on, it will cool the food inside, extending the time until the food spoils.
translations: 一台结实耐用的重型冰箱。开启时，它可以冷藏食物，延缓腐烂。

messages.msgid: A display fridge.  When turned on, it will cool the food inside, extending the time until the food spoils.
translations: 一台展柜形状的冰箱。开启时，它可以冷藏食物，延缓腐烂。

messages.msgid: A common upright freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.
translations: 常见的立式冰柜。打开后，它会冷冻里面的食物，防止任何物品进一步的过期。

messages.msgid: A small freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.
translations: 一台小型冰柜。通电后，它能将内部的食物冷冻起来，防止食物进一步变质。

messages.msgid: A small chest freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.
translations: 这是一台小型立式冰柜。一旦接通电源，它便能将里面的食物冷冻保存，从而有效阻止食物继续变质。

messages.msgid: A heavy, portable freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.
translations: 一款沉重但可移动的冰柜。一旦开启，它能迅速将内部存放的食物冻结，有效阻止食品继续腐坏变质。

messages.msgid: A big chest freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.  Don't fall in!
translations: 一个大型的卧式冰柜。一旦通电运行，它就能使内部的食物保持冷冻状态，有效阻止食品过期变质。千万小心，别掉进去了！

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.
translations: 一款重型冰柜。一旦开启，它就能迅速冷冻内部食物，有效阻止食物继续变质。

messages.msgid: A glass door freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.
translations: 一款带玻璃门的冰柜。接通电源后，它能够冷冻存储在内的食物，从而避免食品继续变质。

messages.msgid: A display freezer.  When turned on, it will freeze the food inside, preventing any further expiration.
translations: 这是一款展示冰柜。一旦开启电源，它就能冷冻保存内部的食物，有效阻止食品过期变质。

messages.msgid: An elegant piano, capable of producing beautiful music if used by a skilled player.  A set of off-white and black keys are linked to a set of hammers, which strike their corresponding tightly-coiled wire to produce sound.
translations: 一台优雅的钢琴，在熟练的演奏者手中能演奏出优美的音乐。一组黑白相间的琴键与一组击锤相连，击锤敲击对应被缠紧的金属丝发出声音。

messages.msgid: A simple upholstered chair with armrests.  Soft and fairly warm, it definitely beats the ground for sleeping on, though not by much.
translations: 一把样式简单带有扶手的软垫椅。十分柔软且相当温暖，绝对比睡在地上要好，虽然好得不多。

messages.msgid: A large cushion filled with beads often used as a seat.
translations: 一种装满珠子的大垫子，通常用作座位。

messages.msgid: A steel storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has a small lock.
translations: 一个钢制的存储箱，可以放下很多东西。盖子上有把小锁。

messages.msgid: An aluminum storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has a small lock.
translations: 一个铝制的存储箱，可以放很多东西。盖子上有把小锁。

messages.msgid: A massive bench-mounted device with a short guillotine blade mounted to a long lever.  Designed for making straight or curved cuts through sheet metal up to 3 millimeters thick.
translations: 一台巨大的安装在长凳上的机器，较短的旋转铡刀安装在一根长杠杆上。设计用来对最高厚度达3毫米的金属板进行直线或曲线切割。

messages.msgid: Some free-floating battery charge.  It can be reloaded into rechargeable battery cells, but can never be unloaded.
translations: 一些自由流动的电能。它可以被重新装入可充电的电池单元，但不能被卸载。

messages.msgid: A common flammable liquid, used in lighters.
translations: 一种用于打火机的常见的易燃液体。

messages.msgid: A notch used with a fire drill to create an ember.
translations: 火种凹槽，对准凹槽使用钻木取火器就可以生火了。

messages.msgid: Paint that comes in a sealed, pressurized container and is released in an aerosol spray when a valve button is depressed.
translations: 装在密封加压容器中的油漆，当按下阀门按钮时，会在气溶胶喷雾中释放出来。

messages.msgid: Ink comprised of a main carrier solvent, a glyceride, a pyrrolidone, a resin, and a colorant, making it water resistant.
translations: 一种防水油墨，主要成分有主载体溶剂、甘油、吡咯烷酮、树脂和着色剂。

messages.msgid: A solid flammable substance, used to make candles.
translations: 一种用于制作蜡烛的固体易燃物质。

messages.msgid: A pyrotechnic chemical used in flares.
translations: 照明弹中使用的燃烧时产生强烈发光效应的烟火药剂。

messages.msgid: A small stick with a red part at the end.  Strike it against a matchbook to light it.
translations: 一根红头小木棍。在火柴盒上划一下可以点燃它。

messages.msgid: Harness the power of radiation in your own home!  It looks similar to a D-cell battery, but actually contains folded layers of radioactive material inside.  It can produce electricity for several years at a steady voltage… but it's barely enough to power a small LED, and these batteries were worth hundreds of dollars.  Mostly they're a good way to brag to your neighbors that you have a nuclear power source in your house.
translations: 在家中就能轻易使用的核能辐射电池！它看起来像一个一号电池，但实际上包含了很多层放射性物质，能在稳定的电压下使用很多年。问题在于，它最多只能驱动一个小型LED，而它的价格高达数百美元。因此大多数情况下，拥有这种电池的唯一好处就是可以向邻居炫耀你家里有核能。
放射性同位素热能发电机

messages.msgid: Did your neighbors brag about their cool beta-decay-powered nightlights?  Do them one better!  The CuppaTech 4 radioisotope thermoelectric generator is a three kilogram chunk of metal - mostly lead - with a slug of cerium-244 encased within.  It is capable of generating somewhere between 100-150 Watts of thermal energy, although its electrical generation capacity is minimal at only 2 Watts.  Careful!  Curium is great at making heat, and also releases deadly gamma radiation.  Keep away from cellular life forms.
translations: 你的邻居有没有向你吹嘘他们那炫酷的贝塔衰变原子灯？我们能做得更好！CuppaTech 4型放射性同位素热能发电机是一块三千克重的金属，大部分是铅，内部包裹着一段锔-244。它能够产生100-150瓦的热能，但发电功率只有2瓦。小心！锔除了会释放出大量热量，也会释放致命的伽马射线，把它放置在远离生物的地方。

messages.msgid: A sheet of thin foil made of aluminum.  Sometimes called 'tin foil' due to being made of tin in the past.
translations: 一片由铝制成的箔纸。由于过去是用锡做的，有时被人称为"锡箔"。

messages.msgid: A unit of currency equivalent to 0.01 US dollars.
translations: 等效于0.01美元的货币单位。

messages.msgid: A small quantity of thread that could be used for sewing.
translations: 一小团可用于缝纫的细线。

messages.msgid: A tough sinew cut from a corpse, usable as thread.
translations: 一小段从尸体上截下来的筋腱，可作为缝衣线使用。

messages.msgid: Tough, thin fiber taken from a plant.  Can be used as thread.
translations: 从植物中提取的坚韧的细纤维。可作为缝衣线使用。

messages.msgid: A length of wool yarn that could be used to knit wool clothing.
translations: 一团可用于编织羊毛衣物的羊毛纱线。

messages.msgid: A cleansing agent shaped into a bar.
translations: 一种被制成块状的清洁剂。

messages.msgid: A cosmetic preparation used for protecting, moisturizing, and lubricating the skin.
translations: 一种用于保护、保湿和润滑皮肤的化妆品。

messages.msgid: A moisturizer that works for all skin types and is really affordable!
translations: 一款适用于所有皮肤类型的保湿霜，而且价格实惠！

messages.msgid: A moisturizer that's smooth like milk, just like your skin will be after applying this wonderful product.
translations: 一款像牛奶一样光滑的保湿霜，就像你涂完这个奇妙产品后的皮肤一样。

messages.msgid: A simple moisturizer with all-organic ingredients.
translations: 一款含有全有机成分的简单保湿霜。

messages.msgid: A favorite among customers with sensitive skin.
translations: 一款敏感肌客户最喜欢的产品。

messages.msgid: If you have oily skin, this moisturizer is for you!
translations: 如果你是油性皮肤，那这款保湿霜适合你！

messages.msgid: After applying this moisturizer, your skin will feel hydrated and smooth.
translations: 使用这款保湿霜后，你的皮肤会感到水润光滑。

messages.msgid: Using various plants as ingredients, this moisturizer will give your skin all the vitamins it needs for the day.
translations: 使用各种植物成分，这款保湿霜将为你的皮肤提供一天所需的各种维生素。

messages.msgid: A moisturizer containing mushroom extract to help improve the wellbeing of your skin.
translations: 一款含有蘑菇提取物的保湿霜，有助于改善皮肤健康。

messages.msgid: A favorite among mature customers, this moisturizer will smooth out the wrinkles on your face and make you appear younger.
translations: 年老客户的最爱。这种保湿霜会抚平你脸上的皱纹，让你看起来更年轻。

messages.msgid: A moisturizer that works all day and night.  A perfect fit for those that decide their own sleep schedule.
translations: 一款昼夜都能起效的保湿霜。非常适合那些自己决定睡眠时间表的人。

messages.msgid: A roll of incredibly strong tape.  Its uses are innumerable.
translations: 一卷十分牢固的强力胶带。用途非常广泛。

messages.msgid: A thin paper strip intended for the rolling of cigarettes.
translations: 一张用于卷烟的细纸带。

messages.msgid: A length of plastic-jacketed copper cable, of the type used in small electronics.
translations: 一段包裹着塑料外皮的铜芯电线，常用于小型电子设备中。

messages.msgid: A length of copper wire ready to be covered with plastic.
translations: 一段准备好被用塑料胶皮覆盖的裸铜线。

messages.msgid: This is neither a fuel cell, nor nuclear, but the name stuck.  It uses plutonium-244 as a catalyst to stabilize a complicated nanocompound that can store enormous amounts of power.  Unfortunately, it cannot be recharged by conventional means: expended cells had to be sent to a central reprocessing facility that almost certainly doesn't exist anymore.
translations: 它其实既不是燃料电池，其中也没有任何核反应，但名字就这么被定下来了。它内部采用钚-244催化剂来稳定某种特殊的纳米复合材料，这种材料能够储存海量电能。不幸的是，你无法使用常规手段为它充电，已耗尽电能的电池需要被送至一处中央回收处理设施处理，几乎可以肯定它再也不存在了。

messages.msgid: The uranium dioxide (UO2) powder is fired in a high-temperature, sintering furnace to create hard, ceramic pellets of enriched uranium dioxide.
translations: 二氧化铀(UO2)粉末在高温烧结炉中烧制，形成的坚硬浓缩二氧化铀陶瓷颗粒。

messages.msgid: Highly-radioactive slurry.  It is probably best to get far away from this.
translations: 具有高度放射性的钚浆。也许你该离它远一些。

messages.msgid: A rock the size of a baseball.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is also good for throwing at enemies.
translations: 一个棒球大小的岩石。可以当一个凑合的近战武器，也可以当作投掷武器。

messages.msgid: A small rock, useful as ammunition for a slingshot.
translations: 一块小石头，很适合当弹弓的弹药。

messages.msgid: A round projectile made of clay, useful as ammunition for a slingshot.
translations: 一颗由黏土制成的圆形弹丸，很适合当弹弓的弹药。

messages.msgid: A glass marble, useful as ammunition for a slingshot.
translations: 一颗玻璃弹珠，很适合当弹弓的弹药。

messages.msgid: A steel ball bearing, useful as ammunition for a slingshot.
translations: 一颗钢制的滚珠轴承，很适合当弹弓的弹药。

messages.msgid: A small steel ball that can be fired from a BB gun.  Deals virtually no damage.
translations: 一颗BB枪用的小钢球。没什么杀伤力。

messages.msgid: A feather from a bird.  Useful for fletching arrows.
translations: 一根禽类的羽毛，可以用来制作箭矢。

messages.msgid: A fluffy down feather from a bird.  Useful for making cozy bedclothes.
translations: 一根禽类的羽绒，可用于制作舒适的床上用品。

messages.msgid: A 120mm high-explosive anti-tank round.  It could ruin anyone's whole day.
translations: 一发 120 毫米高爆反坦克弹。它足以让任何人“一整天都过得很糟”。

messages.msgid: A canister of pressurized hydrogen so heavily compressed it has turned solid.  With proper equipment, it could be heated into plasma.
translations: 一罐被加压成固态的氢气。用合适的设备可以将其加热成等离子态发射出去。

messages.msgid: Firearm-quality gunpowder, mixed without concern for composition, burn rate, or shape, making it thoroughly useless for reloading ammunition.  It has been slightly ground to make its properties more uniform.
translations: 火器级品质的火药，制造者在完全不考虑组分、燃烧速率和形状的前提下将它混合起来，并稍稍碾碎以使其性质更加统一。这种火药无法用于弹药复装。

messages.msgid: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in shotgun shells.
translations: 火器级品质的火药，可以用于制造霰弹。

messages.msgid: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in pistol ammunition.
translations: 火器级品质的火药，可以用于制造手枪弹药。

messages.msgid: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in magnum pistol ammunition.
translations: 火器级品质的火药，可以用于制造马格南手枪弹药。

messages.msgid: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in rifle ammunition.
translations: 火器级品质的火药，可以用于制造步枪弹药。
无烟型大口径步枪弹火药

messages.msgid: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in large rifle ammunition.
translations: 火器级品质的火药，可以用于制造大口径步枪弹药。

messages.msgid: Single base smokeless gunpowder intended for use in artillery propelling charges.
translations: 纯净的无烟火药，可以用于制造炮弹发射药。
粉末状的不稳定化学氧化剂。

messages.msgid: Powdered caustic soda, also known as sodium hydroxide.
translations: 粉末状的腐蚀性纯碱，也称为氢氧化钠。

messages.msgid: A primer from a shotgun shell.
translations: 一些霰弹所使用的子弹底火。

messages.msgid: A primer from a small-caliber pistol round.
translations: 一些小口径手枪子弹使用的底火。

messages.msgid: A primer from a large-caliber pistol round.
translations: 一些大口径手枪子弹使用的底火。

messages.msgid: A primer from a small-caliber rifle round.
translations: 一些小口径步枪子弹使用的底火。

messages.msgid: A primer from a large-caliber rifle round.
translations: 一些大口径步枪子弹使用的底火。

messages.msgid: A primer from a shotgun shell.  It has been fired, and must be cleaned and reloaded to use again.
translations: 霰弹枪弹壳上的底火。它已被激发过，必须清洁并复装后才能再次使用。
小口径手枪子弹底火（已使用）

messages.msgid: A primer from a small-caliber pistol round.  It has been fired, and must be cleaned and reloaded to use again.
translations: 小口径手枪子弹上的底火。它已被激发过，必须清洁并复装后才能再次使用。
大口径手枪子弹底火（已使用）

messages.msgid: A primer from a large-caliber pistol round.  It has been fired, and must be cleaned and reloaded to use again.
translations: 大口径手枪子弹上的底火。它已被激发过，必须清洁并复装后才能再次使用。
小口径步枪子弹底火（已使用）

messages.msgid: A primer from a small-caliber rifle round.  It has been fired, and must be cleaned and reloaded to use again.
translations: 小口径步枪子弹上的底火。它已被激发过，必须清洁并复装后才能再次使用。
大口径步枪子弹底火（已使用）

messages.msgid: A primer from a large-caliber rifle round.  It has been fired, and must be cleaned and reloaded to use again.
translations: 大口径步枪子弹上的底火。它已被激发过，必须清洁并复装后才能再次使用。

messages.msgid: A rubber slug from a shotgun beanbag round.  You could use it to make a new beanbag round.
translations: 来自霰弹枪沙包弹的一枚橡胶弹头，可用于再装填制成新的沙包弹。

messages.msgid: A chunk of useful rubber that can be molded easily.
translations: 一块用途广泛的易塑型橡胶。

messages.msgid: Some scrap bits of copper.  Could be used to craft things, such as makeshift ammunition.
translations: 一些铜废料。可以用于制造，比如自制弹药。

messages.msgid: A roll of semi-opaque medical tape, intended to hold bandages in place.  Not as versatile as duct tape.
translations: 一卷半透明的医用胶带，用于固定绷带。不如强力胶带万能。

messages.msgid: A flammable carbon-based material produced by slowly burning wood.  Utilized in recipes requiring a pure, hot flame.  Can also be used in filters to remove contaminants from air and water.
translations: 一种易燃的碳基材料，由缓慢燃烧的木材产生。可以在制造中提供纯净的高温火焰，也可用于过滤空气和水中的污染物。

messages.msgid: This carbon electrode is basically made from wood and sugar, and it actually works.
translations: 这根碳电极棒基本上是由木头和糖制成的，而且它确实有效。

messages.msgid: Flammable black chunks of carbon-based material, commonly used for cooking and heating.
translations: 可燃的黑色碳基块状物质，常用于烹饪和取暖。

messages.msgid: A bronchodilator that relaxes muscles in the airways and increases air flow to the lungs.
translations: 学名为沙丁胺醇，属于支气管扩张剂，能使呼吸道的肌肉放松并增加流入肺部的空气量。

messages.msgid: A tiny glass vial filled with advanced fast-healing chemicals which can only be activated by a Rivtech jet injector device.  The packaged instructions describe its efficacy in dealing with infections, wounds, intoxications, envenomations, and general tiredness in enthusiastic detail.  A short safety section at the end warns - in much smaller typeface - against using more than two doses per hour.
translations: 一个装满了帮助伤口快速愈合的先进化合物的小玻璃瓶，必须和Rivtech公司专用的注射器配合使用。包装说明详细介绍了它在处理感染、伤口、中毒、毒液螫入和一般疲劳等方面的功效。最后的安全警告部分用更小的字体简短的写着"不要每小时使用超过两剂"。

messages.msgid: A pressurized multi-chamber glass vial filled with powerful chemical stimulants which can only be activated by a Rivtech stimulant delivery system.
translations: 一个具有数个单独内腔、装满了强力兴奋剂的加压玻璃瓶。里面的兴奋剂只能用Rivtech公司专用的注射器来激活使用。

messages.msgid: A polymer dissolved in solvent, with antiseptic added, for topical treatment of minor cuts and scrapes.
translations: 一种溶解在溶剂中并添加了防腐剂的聚合物，用于局部治疗轻微割伤和擦伤。

messages.msgid: Granulated mixture of slaked lime, potassium hydroxide and/or sodium hydroxide that is used as CO2 scrubbing agent in rebreathers.
translations: 由熟石灰、氢氧化钾和/或氢氧化钠混合而成的颗粒物，用于在呼吸器中吸收CO2。

messages.msgid: Potassium superoxide powder, used as oxygen regenerating agent in rebreathers.  Keep away from water.
translations: 超氧化钾粉末，用于在呼吸器中再生氧气，请勿让其靠近任何水体。

messages.msgid: A small, replaceable filter cartridge for an air filtration mask.
translations: 一个过滤面罩使用的小型滤芯。

messages.msgid: A small amount of coal-derived carbon material with many small pores, used for the adsorption of harmful chemicals.  Most commonly employed within respirator filters, it traps and retains chemical gases and vapor contaminants while allowing filtered air to pass unhindered.  Once all the carbon has been bonded to intruding chemicals, the filter is expired and must be replaced.
translations: 一种源自煤炭的多孔碳材料，用于吸附有害化学物质。它最常用于呼吸器滤芯中，能够捕获并滞留化学气体和蒸汽污染物，同时让过滤后的空气畅通无阻地通过。一旦所有碳都与吸附的化学物质结合，滤芯就失效了，必须更上新的。

messages.msgid: Liquid made up of propylene glycol, vegetable glycerin, flavorings, and nicotine.  Intended for use in an advanced electronic cigarette.
translations: 由丙二醇、植物甘油、香料和尼古丁组成的液体。用于高级电子烟。

messages.msgid: A handful of bait, used in traps to lure fish.
translations: 一把诱饵，用于在陷阱中吸引鱼类上钩。

messages.msgid: A hand-built rocket, consisting of a spike welded onto a pipe filled with improvised rocket fuel.  Horribly inaccurate, as can be expected of this grade of weapon, but packs a fierce punch… if it hits.
translations: 一支手工火箭，将一根钉刺焊在填满自制火箭燃料的钢管上。鉴于这种武器的质量，它的精度低得可怕，但能打出相当猛的一击……如果打中。

messages.msgid: A hand-built rocket, consisting of a simple explosive warhead attached onto a pipe, filled with improvised rocket fuel.  Not very powerful, but can be made from scratch.
translations: 一枚手工自制火箭，由连接在金属管上的简易爆炸战斗部和填充于管内的简易火箭燃料构成。威力并不强，但可以从零开始自行制作。

messages.msgid: A hand-built rocket, consisting of a container of flammable gel attached onto a pipe, filled with improvised rocket fuel.  A short-range incendiary - handle with care!
translations: 一枚手工自制火箭，由连接在金属管上的可燃凝胶容器和填充于管内的简易火箭燃料构成。属于短程燃烧性武器 — 请谨慎操作。

messages.msgid: The result of an interrupted charcoal-making process.  Useless, except as fuel in a charcoal kiln.
translations: 一次中断的制炭过程所产生的产物，除可作为木炭窑中的燃料外毫无用途。

messages.msgid: A pile of small 3 cm by 6 cm steel rectangles with a pattern of holes drilled into it.  For use in creating or repairing lamellar armor.
translations: 一堆 3x6 平方厘米的小长方形钢片，上面有规则的钻孔，用于制造或修复鳞甲。

messages.msgid: A pile of small 3 cm by 6 cm steel rectangles with a pattern of holes drilled into it, then hardened.  For use in creating or repairing hardened lamellar armor.
translations: 一堆 3x6 平方厘米的小长方形钢片，上面有规则的钻孔，并且经过硬化处理，用于制造或修复硬化碳钢鳞甲。

messages.msgid: A set of small metal rings, suitable for constructing chainmail.
translations: 一串小型金属锁链，可以用来制造锁环甲。

messages.msgid: A mixture of oxygen and nitrogen in proportions suitable for sustaining divers.
translations: 一种氧气和氮气的混合物，其比例适合潜水员维持生命。

messages.msgid: A dry chemical solution effective at extinguishing fires.
translations: 一种能够有效灭火的干粉状化学溶剂。

messages.msgid: A noxious aerosolized irritant used to fend off attackers both human and bear alike.
translations: 雾化的有毒刺激性液体，用来驱赶像人和熊这样的大体型入侵者。

messages.msgid: Flammable material, finely divided for easy combustion.
translations: 易燃材料，经过研磨之后，更加易于燃烧。

messages.msgid: A plastic die used to play various role-playing games.
translations: 一个用来玩各类桌游的塑料骰子。

messages.msgid: A metal die used to play various role-playing games.
translations: 一个用来玩各类桌游的金属骰子。

messages.msgid: Some decent-sized chunks of scrap bronze, for fashioning some old-school items.
translations: 一些尺寸适中的青铜废料，用于制造一些旧时代的物品。
