messages.msgid: A mix of blue dye, base catalyst, and diphenyl oxalate used in glowsticks.
translations: 一种由蓝色染料、碱性催化剂和草酸二苯酯组成的混合物，用于荧光棒。

messages.msgid: Graphite powder mixed with a clay binder.  Produces gray or black marks that are easily erased, but otherwise resistant to moisture, most chemicals, ultraviolet radiation, and natural aging.
translations: 混合有黏土粘结剂的石墨粉，能够产生灰色或黑色痕迹，易于擦除，但又能抵御湿气、大多数化学物质、紫外线辐射和自然老化。

messages.msgid: Ink made from a variety of sources for use in quill style pens.
translations: 用多种原料制成的墨水，适用于羽毛笔书写。

messages.msgid: Carbon black pigment infused with polymers, stabilizers, and water to help the ink flow properly.
translations: 一些碳黑颜料，加入了聚合物、稳定剂和水以帮助油墨正常流动。

messages.msgid: Prussian blue, crystal violet, and phthalocyanine blue pigments infused with polymers, stabilizers, and water to help the ink flow properly.
translations: 一些普鲁士蓝、结晶紫和酞菁蓝颜料，加入了聚合物、稳定剂和水以帮助油墨正常流动。

messages.msgid: Chlorophyll pigment infused with polymers, stabilizers, and water to help the ink flow properly.
translations: 一些绿色颜料，加入了聚合物、稳定剂和水以帮助油墨正常流动。

messages.msgid: Eosin dye infused with polymers, stabilizers, and water to help the ink flow properly.
translations: 一些曙红颜料，加入了聚合物、稳定剂和水以帮助油墨正常流动。

messages.msgid: A tin of small cone-shaped pellets meant to be used in an air rifle.  Suitable for plinking.
translations: 一罐用于气步枪的圆锥形小弹丸，一般用于娱乐射击。

messages.msgid: A tin of small cone-shaped pellets meant to be used in an air rifle.  Suitable for hunting small game.
translations: 一罐用于气步枪的圆锥形小弹丸，一般用于狩猎小型动物。
呼吸器二氧化碳吸收物
锟厄焚军械炮燃烧载荷
锟厄焚军械炮腐蚀载荷
锟厄焚军械炮黏着载荷

messages.msgid: A disconnected electric convection-based oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  Plug it into a vehicle or power grid to get cooking.
translations: 一台未通电的对流式电烤箱，通常用于加热及烹饪食物。把它接入汽车电源或连接电网就可以做饭了。

messages.msgid: A device that effectively sterilizes water, but it doesn't take batteries.  You'll need to connect it to a power source.
translations: 一种有效消毒水的设备，但它不使用电池。 你需要将其连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A bulky upright arcade cabinet, brightly painted and slightly worn with age.  Ready to be plugged in and played.
translations: 一台笨重的立式街机游戏机，色彩鲜艳，因长年使用而略微磨损。可以接入电源后用它玩一会游戏。

messages.msgid: An arc furnace designed to burn a powdery mix of coke and limestone to create calcium carbide.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 一个用于煅烧粉末状焦炭石灰混合物来制取电石的电弧炉。已插上电源，需要被放置并接入电源来使用。

messages.msgid: A powerful drill mounted on a slide that lets it drop precisely down.  Useful in all kinds of projects, from industrial fabrication to home woodworking.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 一台安装在滑轨上的大功率钻机，可以用它精确钻孔。可用于从工业制造到家庭木工的各种工作。需要放置后接入电源使用。

messages.msgid: A rotating sawblade set into a large, flat table.  Used for making straight, measured cuts, it's a key tool in any carpenter's arsenal.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 一台旋转锯片，嵌装在宽敞又平整的工作台上。它能够笔直地切割出精准的直线，是各类木工设备中的关键工具之一。需要放置后接入电源使用。

messages.msgid: A circular sawblade on an arm that can slide and rotate in several directions, this is a staple tool for nearly any carpentry.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 一台安装在机械臂上的圆锯，可以在多个维度上滑动旋转，近乎是木匠的标配工具。需要放置后接入电源使用。

messages.msgid: A ribbonlike sawblade runs in a single direction in this tool, allowing precise cuts at almost any angle.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 一台装在一条线性导轨上运行的带型链锯。可按任意角度进行精确切割。需要放置后接入电源使用。

messages.msgid: This table has an inset router, a rotating motor with an exchangeable blade head for cutting specific profiles and grooves.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 这张桌子上安装着一台嵌入式刳刨机、一台旋转电机和一套可更换的刀头，能够将材料切割出特殊轮廓、凹槽和其他形状。需要放置后接入电源使用。

messages.msgid: A hefty tool that will take in a board and cut it smooth and flat to a specific width, particularly great if working with raw lumber stock, but also good just for shaving wood down to size.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 一台笨重机器，能丝滑地把木板平整切割成特定厚度。特别适合用来处理原木，但也能很好地用来把木块切削加工成合适的尺寸。需要放置后接入电源使用。

messages.msgid: A table-shaped tool with a rotating blade that will cut down, smooth out, and square off a board to make it nice and smooth.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 一张安装有旋转刀刃工具的工作台，能把木板切割成形、抛光，使之变得非常光滑、美观。需要放置后接入电源使用。

messages.msgid: If you really want to squash something a lot, this is exactly the right industrial tool for you.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 如果你真的很想冲压一些东西，那你就确实选对了工业工具。需要放置后接入电源使用。

messages.msgid: This durable tank is topped with a motor that will cram as much air into the tank as possible.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 这个坚固的气罐顶部安装着一台压缩机，能将尽可能多的空气抽进罐中。需要放置后接入电源才能使用。

messages.msgid: An autoclave, used to sterilize equipment with pressurized steam.  It requires a massive amount of power, so it will need to be plugged into a power grid.
translations: 一台高压灭菌釜，用于对 CBM 之类的装置进行加压灭菌。启动它需要巨多电力，因此需要接入电网使用。

messages.msgid: A wall light that provides illumination when plugged into a grid.
translations: 一个可以挂起来的落地灯，在接入电网后可以提供照明。

messages.msgid: A tall standing lamp that provides illumination when plugged into a power outlet.
translations: 一盏高高的立灯，插到电源插座上时提供照明。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy light designed to illuminate wide areas when plugged into a power outlet.
translations: 一盏又大又重的灯，插到电源插座上时可用来照亮大片半圆形区域。
立式定向泛光灯（未连接）

messages.msgid: A large, heavy light designed to illuminate a wide semicircle in a chosen direction when plugged into a power outlet.
translations: 一盏又大又重的灯，插到电源插座上时可用来照亮选择的大片半圆形区域。

messages.msgid: Electric wires used to run power through walls.
translations: 安装在在墙上用来供电的电线。

messages.msgid: A universal recharging station integrated into a steel storage compartment.  When plugged in and powered, it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.
translations: 集成了钢制储物柜的通用充电站。接通电源并开启后会对直接放置在其内部存储空间中的任何可充电电池（蓄电池、铅酸电池等）持续充电。

messages.msgid: A small device for recharging batteries integrated into a small wooden storage compartment.  When plugged in and powered, it will slowly charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.
translations: 集成了一个小型木制储物箱的小型通用充电器。接通电源并开启后会对直接放置在其内部存储空间中的任何可充电电池（蓄电池、铅酸电池等）持续缓慢地充电。
先进斯特林放射性同位素发电机（未连接）

messages.msgid: A machine capable of generating pure oxygen from the air.  Can be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 一种能吸入空气产生纯氧的机器。可以放置后接入电源使用。

messages.msgid: A machine designed to compress an input gas to a very high pressure.  Can be placed and plugged into a power source.
translations: 一种能吸入空气产生纯氧的机器。可以放置后接入电源使用。

messages.msgid: A light, coin-like battery cell designed for small size over everything else.  Used for watches, calculators, toys or similar low-power electronics.
translations: 一款轻薄的硬币状电池，设计上力求将体积微型化，常用于手表、计算器、玩具等低功耗电子产品。

messages.msgid: A light, coin-like battery cell designed for small size over everything else.  Used for watches, calculators, toys or similar low-power electronics.  This one can't be recharged.
translations: 一种轻型纽扣电池，体积小，重量轻。 用于手表、计算器、玩具或类似的低功耗电子产品。 此款电池不能充电。

messages.msgid: A light battery cell, popular for any consumer-grade electronic: from remotes to mouses, from clocks to thermometers.  This one can't be recharged.
translations: 一种轻型电池，适用于任何消费级电子产品：从遥控器到鼠标，从钟表到温度计。 此款电池不能充电。

messages.msgid: A light battery cell, popular for any consumer-grade electronic: from remotes to mouses, from clocks to thermometers.
translations: 一款轻型电池，广泛应用于各种消费级电子产品：从遥控器到鼠标，从时钟到温度计。

messages.msgid: A medium battery cell, wildly used in modern tools: heavy flashlights, two-way radios, security cameras, multiple of them make a tool battery, and some older generation of EV use thousands of this as the power storage.
translations: 一块中型电池，广泛用于耐用手电筒、双向无线电、安保摄像头等现代工具中。一块工具电池由数块这样的电池组成，此外也有些老式电动汽车用数千块这样的电池供能。

messages.msgid: A light battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and portable tools - drills, angle grinders, chainsaws.
translations: 一块轻型电池，与电钻、角磨机、链锯等各种工业级设备和便携电动工具普遍兼容。

messages.msgid: A heavy battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and portable tools - drills, angle grinders, chainsaws.
translations: 一块重型电池，与电钻、角磨机、链锯等各种工业级设备和便携电动工具普遍兼容。

messages.msgid: A battery that uses a thin plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound.  It is universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.  Although it stores a huge amount of power, it cannot be recharged.
translations: 这种电池使用一根钚-244棒来稳定一种奇特的纳米复合材料，兼容各种工业级设备和大型电动工具。虽然它储存了大量的能量，但它不能被再次充电。

messages.msgid: A battery that uses a huge plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound.  It was used in military mech-suits, was highly experimental, and had no civilian applications.  Although it stores a stupendous amount of power, it cannot be recharged.
translations: 这种电池使用一根巨大的钚-244棒来稳定一种奇特的纳米复合材料。供军用机甲使用，实验性质较高，尚未进入民用领域。虽然它储存了大量的能量，但它不能被再次充电。

messages.msgid: A CBM that is broken beyond repair; you can't do anything with it.
translations: 一个彻底损坏的CBM，你不能用它做任何事。

messages.msgid: A stimulator system that is implanted alongside the adrenal glands, allowing the user to trigger their body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.
translations: 一套刺激器系统植入到了受体的肾上腺附近，使其能够使用生化能量触发身体的肾上腺素反应。

messages.msgid: A bionic that projects a thin forcefield around the user's body.  Everything loses velocity when penetrating this field, which results in a reduced amount of dealt damage at the cost of user's bionic energy.  Bullets and stabbing attacks will lose more velocity than cutting attacks, and those in turn more than bashing attacks.
translations: 一个能在受体周围投射出一层薄薄的力场屏障的生化插件。任何穿透这个力场的东西都会失去速度，降低造成的伤害，但同时也会造成额外的能量消耗。子弹和刺击会比斩击失去更多的速度，而这些攻击又会比钝击失去更多的速度。

messages.msgid: A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert the user.  This is very useful during sleep, or if the user suspects a cloaked pursuer.
translations: 一个运动侦测警报系统，可以侦测到半径15英尺（约4.6米）范围内的所有运动，并且为使用者提供无声的警报。在睡觉时很有用，或者当使用者怀疑自己被隐身怪物追踪时。

messages.msgid: This bionic module integrates augmented reality interface into user's eyes.
translations: 该生化插件将增强现实（AR）界面集成到使用者的眼部。

messages.msgid: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh.  Provides passive protection at the cost of mild encumbrance, and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.
translations: 先进的网状防护合金，被织入使用者的肌肤。以少许累赘为代价提供被动保护，可结合生化格斗术使用。

messages.msgid: A bionic package that seals the user's eye sockets with highly-protective mirrored lenses and re-routes their tear ducts to their mouth.  When the user cries, they must spit out or swallow their tears.
translations: 这个生化插件将用高防护性的镜状晶体封闭受体的眼眶，并将泪管重新导向口腔。当使用者哭泣的时候，如果不选择把眼泪吐出来，就只能选择自食其泪了。

messages.msgid: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh, protecting both their head and jaw regions at the cost of mild encumbrance.
translations: 先进的防护网状合金，被织入使用者的肌肤。以少许累赘为代价，保护了头部和嘴部区域。

messages.msgid: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh, protecting it from physical trauma at the cost of mild encumbrance.
translations: 先进的防护网状合金，被织入使用者的肌肤。以少许累赘为代价，保护躯干不受创伤。

messages.msgid: A battery draining attachment to make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.
translations: 这套电池系统可以利用普通电池来恢复生化能量。

messages.msgid: A deadly foot-long blade made of advanced material that is installed inside the forearm, capable of being extended through the back of the user's wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.
translations: 约30厘米长的先进材料刀片隐藏在受体的前臂内部，使用少量能量可以从手腕背部伸出。异常锋利，伸展时会妨碍使用者拿取其他物品。

messages.msgid: A concealed, single shot 12 gauge shotgun that is implanted inside the left forearm.  Perfect in a pinch.
translations: 一把单发12号口径霰弹枪被隐蔽地植入到左臂内部，以备不时之需。

messages.msgid: Small sensors that are implanted in the user's heart, allowing them to analyze their blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.
translations: 受体的心脏被植入了小型传感器，使其可以分析自身的血液情况。这套系统能够检测各种疾病、药物以及其它状况。

messages.msgid: A filtration system that is installed in the heart and can actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs, with limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in the system will be affected.
translations: 受体的心脏植入了一个过滤系统，使其能够主动过滤掉血液中的化学杂质，主要包括药物和毒品。但该系统对病毒效果不佳。需要注意的是该系统并非定向过滤系统，受体体内的所有药物和毒品都会受到影响。

messages.msgid: A complex port that is mounted above the hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a battery via jumper cable.
translations: 受体臀部上方安装了一个复杂的接口，启动后可以通过跨接电缆与电池连接并恢复生化能量。

messages.msgid: Thin armor made of carbon nanotubes, implanted just beneath the skin.  It reduces cutting, stabbing and ballistic damage.
translations: 被植入到皮肤下方的薄层碳纳米管装甲。削弱收到的斩击，刺击和子弹伤害。

messages.msgid: A chain lightning generator that emits a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake and jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.
translations: 这套连锁闪电发生器可以释放一道闪电攻击目标，并留下一道带电尾迹。闪电命中目标后会跳跃到目标附近4格内的其它目标身上。

messages.msgid: A set of vicious, retractable claws that are implanted inside the user's fingers.  They do considerable cutting damage, but prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.
translations: 受体的手指中植入了可伸缩利爪，伸出时能够造成可观的斩击伤害，但使用者将无法手持任何物品。

messages.msgid: A network of thermal piping which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures once activated.
translations: 这套导热管网在启动后能够缓解环境温度对体温的影响。

messages.msgid: A high-power system that uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make the user blend into their surroundings, rendering them fully invisible to eyes and optical sensors.  However, this doesn't prevent detection from other means such as infrared, sonar, etc.
translations: 一套高耗能的隐身系统，由无数的迷你摄像机和LED灯组成，让使用者能与周围环境融为一体，进入可见光隐身状态。但是，隐形系统也无法屏蔽红外视觉或声呐之类的探测。

messages.msgid: A set of bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs.  While active, the CQB module will improve the user's hand-to-hand combat skills, but prevents them from improving them through combat experience.
translations: 一套存有海量武术程序的数据库和处理器。开启时，它的近战模块会提升使用者的徒手格斗技能，但是使用者将无法从战斗中获得经验。

messages.msgid: A set of bionic nerve stimulators that greatly enhance reaction times, granting a +2 bonus to dexterity.
translations: 这套生化神经电极能够极大地缩短反应时间。敏捷+2。

messages.msgid: This module contains three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines which replace the user's corresponding organs.  Not only will these extract much more nutrition from food, but also increase the user's resistance to foodborne illness, and occasionally allow the digestion of rotten food.  Installing this CBM will correct any abnormalities in the user's digestive system.
translations: 这个生化插件包含三个人造胃囊和工业级人造肠道，用来替换使用者所对应的器官。这套系统不仅可以从食物中吸收更多营养，还能提高使用者对食源性疾病的抵抗力，偶尔也能消化腐坏食物。安装此CBM将纠正患者消化系统的任何异常。

messages.msgid: While this bionic is active, the user's hearing will be drastically improved, allowing them to hear ten times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage the user's hearing.
translations: 当这个生化插件启用时，使用者的听力将极大提高，使其能够达到相当于普通人10倍的听力。此外，高分贝的声音将在使用者听力受到损伤前自动减弱。

messages.msgid: An implanted set of vocal cords and speakers allowing the user to remodulate and project their voice at will.
translations: 一套植入式声带和扬声器，允许使用者随意调整和投射自己的声音。

messages.msgid: A set of speakers implanted into the skull, able to pick up local radiowaves and play downloaded music.
translations: 一组植入到你头骨中的扬声器，能够接收本地无线电波，并播放下载的音乐。

messages.msgid: A tiny device implanted in the inner ear.  When active, it will periodically generate ultrasonic pulses which aid in navigation, provided the user is underwater and able to hear.
translations: 一个植入内耳的小型装置。开启时，它会周期性地发出超声波脉冲，协助你导航，前提是你得在水下并且能听到声音。

messages.msgid: A set of small parabolic EMP field generators that are mounted in the palm of the user's right hand.  They can be used to instantly fire a wide, but short-ranged blast which will disable electronics and robots.
translations: 一套小型电磁脉冲抛射器，被植入受体的右手掌心，可以用于瞬时发射一道大范围近程EMP冲击来瘫痪掉电子器械和机器人。

messages.msgid: A ranged EMP generator system that is implanted in the user's right arm and hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets, but mostly useless otherwise.
translations: 一套远程电磁脉冲发射器系统，被植入在受体右臂和右手下。这套系统能发射精准的单目标脉冲，需要时间瞄准。对电子目标特别有效，但对其它目标没什么作用。

messages.msgid: A reactor that burns alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.  It can store up to 500 mL and accepts ethanol, methanol and denatured alcohol as fuel.
translations: 一个生化酒精反应炉，燃烧效率极高。可以储存 500 毫升乙醇、甲醇或者改性酒精作为燃料。

messages.msgid: This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into the user's blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.
translations: 这个插件可以从周围的空气中吸收水蒸气，并将其直接低速注入血液之中。在非常干燥的地区，此仪器可能效果不佳。

messages.msgid: A set of diamond corneas which greatly enhance the user's vision, granting a +2 bonus to perception.
translations: 一对钻石角膜，能够极大提高用户的视力。感知+2。

messages.msgid: An array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses that replaces much of the material in the user's inner eye.  This fixes any vision problems and allows for an increased vision range akin to binoculars.
translations: 一组高功耗自动对焦镜头，用于替代眼内的大部分组织。可以消除受体的任何视力缺陷，并且能够达到如同望远镜一般的视力范围。

messages.msgid: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, this bionic module lets the user alter their facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.
translations: 通过控制电化学脉冲，这套生化插件能使受体改变其面部结构，从而悄无声息地影响他人的反应。这将使你在各类社交互动上获得少许加成。

messages.msgid: A network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors, implanted throughout the user's body to protect from external electrical discharge.
translations: 一套微型压电电容网络，植入到全身用于防御外部电击的伤害。

messages.msgid: A miniature electrohack, surgically embedded in a finger of the user's right hand.  This is an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like, but not computers.  Computer proficiency is important, and a failed use may cause damage.
translations: 一台微型电子黑客仪，通过手术植入到右手的一根手指中。这种通用黑客单元可以用于覆写控制面板及类似的系统，但是不能用于电脑。使用者的计算机专长对成功至关重要，每次失败的尝试都有可能造成身体损伤。

messages.msgid: A small medical implant that passively tracks your calorie expenditure and consumption.
translations: 一种小型医疗植入物，可以被动跟踪你的卡路里消耗。

messages.msgid: A combination of LEDs and speakers that create a flash and sound comparable to a flashbang grenade, deafening and blinding nearby enemies.
translations: 这套LED灯和扩音器组成的系统能够产生如同闪光弹一样的闪光和巨响，对周围的敌人产生致盲致聋的效果。

messages.msgid: A small, but powerful LED flashlight that is mounted between the user's eyes.
translations: 一颗小型高功率LED灯，植入于两眼之间。

messages.msgid: An LED display implanted beneath the epidermis that can display patterns or pictures through the skin.  When active it glows dimly, providing a very small amount of light.
translations: 一块植入表皮下的LED显示屏，可以透过皮肤显示花纹或图案。当激活时，它会发出昏暗的光，提供微弱的照明。

messages.msgid: A set of small radiation sensors that are implanted throughout the body, allowing the user to analyze their level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert the user whenever exposed to environmental radiation.
translations: 一套小型辐射传感器已经植入使用者的身体，可以让使用者分析其辐射吸收量级。该装置也会提醒使用者是否暴露于辐射环境。

messages.msgid: A complex respiration augmentation system that increases the user's maximal oxygen uptake and allows for underwater breathing akin to gills.  Will automatically activate if the user is drowning.
translations: 一整套复杂的呼吸增强系统。可以强化受体对氧气的利用，并允许受体在水中呼吸，溺水后自动开启。

messages.msgid: A set of precision sonar equipment, implanted in the user's feet to allow the detection of below-ground movement, buried traps, and unstable terrain.
translations: 一套植入在脚掌上的精密声纳设备，可以探测地下生物的移动、掩埋的陷阱和不稳定的地形。

messages.msgid: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage and recharging the user's bionic power reserves slightly.
translations: 当使用者成功徒手攻击恒温生物一次，你有一定几率吸取目标体内的热能，造成少量的额外伤害并增加少量的生化能量。

messages.msgid: A set of powerful heatsinks and supermaterials woven into the user's flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent external heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect the internal body temperature.
translations: 一套强力散热片和超织物被植入了受体体内，供电时可以防护低于2000华氏度（约1093摄氏度）的外部高温伤害。注意，这不会影响受体的内部体温。

messages.msgid: A hydraulic muscle support system that when active, increases the user's strength by 20.
translations: 一套液压肌肉支持系统，启用时力量+20。

messages.msgid: A bionic module that extends the user's range of vision into the infrared, allowing them to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark and through smoke.
translations: 这个生化插件将受体的视觉扩展到红外波段，使其能够在黑暗中或透过烟雾看见恒温动物。

messages.msgid: A set of bionic coprocessors that are implanted in the user's brain, granting a +2 bonus to intelligence.  It takes over and replaces numerous cognitive functions once installed and cannot be removed.
translations: 一套生物处理芯片，植入使用者的脑中，提供 +2 智力。它一经安装就接管替代了许多的认知功能，并且不能够移除。

messages.msgid: A small, high-powered laser that is embedded in the user's fingertip.  This long-range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.
translations: 一个小型大功率激光发射器嵌在指尖上。这种远程武器伤害不高，但是异常精准，还有可能点燃目标。

messages.msgid: A set of bionic stimulators which augment the user's haematopoiesis system, allowing them to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is designed for continuous use and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.
translations: 这个生化激励系统增强了受体的造血系统，使其能够消耗生化能量加速白细胞的生成。它应当保持持续运行，开启后再关闭可能造成不良影响。

messages.msgid: A pair of powerful fire starters which extend from the tip of both hands' index fingers.
translations: 一对强大的喷火器，植入到了受体双手的食指中。

messages.msgid: An electronic lockpick that is embedded in a fingertip.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.
translations: 植入指尖的电子开锁器。这个全自动开锁器可以迅速打开除了最先进以外的所有钥匙锁，不需要使用者掌握任何开锁技能。

messages.msgid: A powerful electromagnet that is implanted into the user's right hand, allowing them to indiscriminately pull all nearby magnetic objects towards them.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.
translations: 一个强力电磁铁，植入到了受体的右手当中，使受体能够无差别地吸引周围所有磁性物品。不明真相的围观群众可能会被到处乱飞的物品击伤甚至击毙。

messages.msgid: Thin membranes that cover the user's eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.
translations: 在水下会自动覆盖受体眼球的人造瞬膜，能消除所有水下视觉惩罚。

messages.msgid: A set of highly-advanced quantum storage drives used to enhance memory.  While active, they increase the rate that the user learns skills.  Once it is installed, it will partially replace the functionality of the hippocampus, and thus cannot be removed without risk of severe permanent amnesia and difficulty forming new memories.
translations: 一组用于增强内存的高度先进的量子存储驱动器。激活时，加快使用者学习技能的速度。一旦安装完毕，它将取代部分海马体的功能，将其移除会造成严重的永久性失忆并且难以形成新的记忆。

messages.msgid: This module interconnects the user's digestive system and power supply, letting them replenish bionic energy by burning calories.
translations: 这个模组将受体的消化系统和电源连接起来，使其能够通过消耗卡路里恢复生化能量。

messages.msgid: A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collects environmental data.  The data are compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells the user their external temperature.
translations: 一堆科学装置和感应器的整合系统。用来收集周围环境的数据，这些数据随后将会被分析并汇总成为易于读取的目前天气的情况报告。它还可被动显示使用者的外部温度。

messages.msgid: A fleet of tiny, dormant robots.  While activated, they will flit about the user's body, repairing damage and stopping bleeding at the cost of power.
translations: 一群微型纳米机器人。开启时会不断消耗能量，绕行使用者的周身，修复伤害以及止血。

messages.msgid: When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius of the user through destructive interference.
translations: 开启时，这个生化插件会通过干扰光线来消除附近2格内所有的光源。

messages.msgid: This bionic module modifies the user's eyes to amplify existing light, allowing them to see in the dark.
translations: 这个生化插件通过放大微弱光线的方式改造使用者的眼球，增强夜视能力。

messages.msgid: A thin forcefield gets projected around the user's body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.
translations: 当该系统激活时，一层护盾会投影在使用者身体周围，并持续消耗能量。这层护盾不会格挡或偏移任何攻击，但是会电击徒手或使用导电武器攻击使用者的敌人。

messages.msgid: This module lets the user's nervous system inhibit pain signals, allowing them to dull their senses at will.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction times and drowsiness.
translations: 这个模组通过使受体的神经系统抑制疼痛信号，使受体能够随意抑制感官输入。不过，使用该系统可能会导致反应迟钝和嗜睡等症状。

messages.msgid: A Compact Bionics Module that upgrades the user's power capacity by 100 units.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  The user will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.
translations: 储能模块CBM，可以为受体增加100点生化能量储备上限。受体至少需要一个储能模块才能使用耗能型生化插件，同时还需要至少一种供能型生化插件为其充能。

messages.msgid: A Compact Bionics Module developed at DoubleTech Industries as a replacement for the highly successful Power Storage CBM.  Increases the user's power capacity by 250 units.
translations: DoubleTech公司研发的新一代生化插件，旨在取代大受欢迎的第一代储能模块。能够为受体增加250点能量储备上限。

messages.msgid: Increases the body's wavelength, allowing the user to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Power drain in standby is minimal, but each tile tunneled through costs 250 bionic power.
translations: 这套生化插件可以改变受体的身体波长，使其能够量子隧穿墙壁，出现在另一边。待机时功耗非常小，但每穿透一格墙壁时消耗250点能量。

messages.msgid: An advanced filtration system that is implanted in the user's trachea.  If toxins or airborne diseases find their way into the windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.
translations: 一套先进的空气过滤系统，被植入进受体气管中。不管进入气管的是有毒气体还是通过空气传播的病菌，这个过滤器都会试图去过滤它们。

messages.msgid: A wireless communications device that integrates with the ear canal to enable hands-free communication over radio waves.
translations: 一个无线通信装置，整合到使用者的耳道，使其拥有无线电交流的能力。"在发号施令时解放你的双手"

messages.msgid: A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters that are implanted throughout the body, allowing the user to purge themself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.
translations: 一种先进的压电式血液透析装置，植入了受体的体内，使之可以通过消耗生化能量来清除体内的辐射。

messages.msgid: A set of ten double-edged, four centimeter long razor-sharp claws that are implanted underneath the fingernails.  They deal a small amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever the user's fingertips are uncovered.
translations: 一套由十个四厘米长的利刃组成的，剃刀般锋利的爪子，植入进受体的指甲之下。当受体的指尖没有被盖住时，徒手攻击时可以用它们造成少量额外的斩击伤害。

messages.msgid: A small gasoline fuel cell able to convert gasoline to bionic power.  It's connected to a diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders able to hold up to 500 mL of gasoline.
translations: 这是一个小型汽油燃料电池，可以将汽油转化为生化能量。一套生物塑胶制成的液囊扩散网络与其连接，能够存放最多 500 毫升的汽油。

messages.msgid: A series of filters and processors that is implanted in the user's digestive system, allowing them to reclaim waste liquid and, to a lesser degree, nutrients.  The net effect is a greatly reduced need to eat and drink.
translations: 一系列的过滤器和处理器被植入到受体的消化系统中，使其能够重新吸收废弃液体和少量营养物质，最终大幅度降低受体的饮食需求。

messages.msgid: A small module that connects to the user's brain and allows them to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.
translations: 一个连接至受体大脑的小模块，可以与附近有无线功能的设备联动。

messages.msgid: A bionic module that allows the user's entire body to resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.
translations: 这个生化插件能使使用者的全身在极高的能量下产生共振，产生一道短距冲击波。虽然这道冲击波无法对生物造成多少伤害，但其能够损坏坚硬的物体，比如说墙壁或者门。

messages.msgid: While this system is powered, the user's body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track them by scent.
translations: 当该系统激活时，使用者的身体只会产生很少的气味，使得其他生物几乎不可能通过气味来跟踪他们。

messages.msgid: While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock the user's opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.
translations: 当使用者徒手搏斗或者使用可导电的武器时，有一定几率消耗部分能量电击对手，造成额外伤害并暂时使目标失去行动能力。

messages.msgid: A bionic module that generates a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knock back any creatures they collide with.
translations: 生化插件可以产生一道强力的冲击波，击退所有附近的生物并造成短暂的眩晕，如果撞击在无法通行的地形上将造成额外的伤害和眩晕，被击退生物碰撞到的其他生物也会被一同击退。

messages.msgid: A set of bionic stimulators that enhance the user's nervous system, granting a 10% boost to speed.
translations: 这套生化神经电极能增强神经系统，为行动速度带来10%的提升。

messages.msgid: A set of myomer fibers that enhance the user's muscular system, granting a +2 bonus to strength.
translations: 一套能够增强使用者肌肉系统的生化纤维，力量+2。

messages.msgid: A system of surgical-grade scalpels that is implanted in the user's fingers.  They allow for automated precise cuts and can be used as a high-quality butchering tool.
translations: 一套外科级别的手术刀植入在用户的手指上。能够自动进行精确切割。也可以用作高级屠宰工具。

messages.msgid: A set of quick-reacting transition lenses that are installed over the user's eyes.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect from bright flashes, and protect the eyes when welding.
translations: 使用者的眼睛上安装了快速反应折射镜头，它能抵消眩光的惩罚，在遭受闪光以及焊接时保护使用者的眼睛。

messages.msgid: Highly efficient synthetic lungs which replace the user's own.  After installation the user's cardio fitness will be greatly increased and will not need regular exercise to maintain but the user will need continuous power to remain breathing.  Further, they will weaken the user's immune system somewhat.
translations: 我们先进的合成肺已经全面超越了用户老式的肺，安装后，用户的有氧健身能力将大大提高，而且不需要定期锻炼来维持，但用户需要持续的动力来保持呼吸。此外，它们会在一定程度上削弱用户的免疫系统。

messages.msgid: A bionic module that contains rangefinders and synchronizes the movement of the user's eyes with their arms, to a degree.  Shots they fire will be much more accurate, particularly at long ranges.
translations: 这个生化插件内含测距仪，并且能在一定程度上使使用者的眼睛与手臂保持同步。使用者的枪击将会更精准，特别是在长距离上。

messages.msgid: A bionic stun gun which implants into the hand.  It is highly powerful, able to easily cause electrical burns and cardiac arrest in targets.  The electricity it generates arcs through the air over short distances, making it nearly impossible to miss, but it still requires the user to be nearly adjacent to their target.
translations: 一种植入手部的仿生电击枪。它非常强大，很容易就能对目标造成电烧伤，并令其心脏骤停。虽然它在短距离的空气中产生的电弧百发百中，但用户依然得靠近目标使用。

messages.msgid: A highly experimental unit that folds space over short distances, instantly transporting the user's body up to 25 feet in a random direction at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.
translations: 这个高度实验性质的生化插件可将空间折叠，进行短距离传送。通过消耗大量能量，使用者可以传送至25英尺（约7.6米）外随机方向的一个地方。需要注意的是长期或者频繁使用可能有危险的副作用。

messages.msgid: At the cost of all stored bionic power, the user may increase their body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  Violent or rapid movements may cause damage due to friction.
translations: 通过消耗体内所有储存的生化插件能量，使用者可以极大的提升自己的速度和反应能力，就好像把时间冻结了一样。但是，剧烈或高速下运动产生的空气摩擦可能会导致受伤。

messages.msgid: A surgically-implanted set of compact tools and a welder which runs off the user's power banks.  Includes screwdriving heads, a multi-purpose knife, a low-power impact wrench and a nail prying tool.
translations: 一套小型工具和一台焊机通过外科手术植入了你的体内，并使用体内的生化能量供能。这套工具包括螺丝刀、多功能刀、低功耗冲击扳手和撬钉工具。

messages.msgid: A set of electrical leads to be embedded in the user's fingers, connected to a multimeter unit in their hand.  Allows the user to measure voltage, resistance, and current using their fingertips, and provides slight protection against electric shocks.
translations: 一组电线被植入了使用者的手指中，并连接到手臂里的万用表上。可以让使用者用指尖测量电压、电阻和电流，并提供少许电击防护。

messages.msgid: A soldering iron, multimeter, and set of fine screwdrivers implanted in the user's hands.  Contains all the tools required for manipulating bench-scale electrical circuits, and provides slight protection against electric shocks.
translations: 烙铁、万用表和一套精细的螺丝刀被植入了使用者的手中。包含制造小型电子电路所需的全套工具，并提供少许电击防护。

messages.msgid: A set of torsion ratchets that replace the user's joints to slowly generate power when they move.  These can be toggled to generate more power, but movement will require more effort.
translations: 一套会替换使用者的关节的动力齿轮，能在其移动时缓慢恢复生化能量。启动即可开始产生能量，但是移动会更加费力。

messages.msgid: A set of servomotors installed on the leg joints to provide power-assisted movement.  They are optimized for running, but walking also requires less effort while this bionic is active.  However, when it's offline it will hamper the user's movement.
translations: 一套安装在腿部关节上的伺服电机，能为运动提供辅助动力。它们能提高跑步速度，同时当该生化插件开启时，步行也会更加轻松。然而，当它关闭时，未工作的移动部件会阻碍行动。

messages.msgid: A set of bionic processors that augment the user's nervous system, allowing them to dodge attacks beyond normal human capability.
translations: 一套生化处理器，能够增强使用者的神经系统，使其能够以远超常人的水平回避攻击。

messages.msgid: A Unified Power System that is wired into the user's bionic power banks.  Objects that run on a UPS can now directly draw power from the bionic power supply.
translations: 一套UPS系统，连接到了使用者的生化能量槽上。使用UPS的物品现在可以直接使用生化能量了。

messages.msgid: A bionic module containing an atomic clock, complete with a silent alarm clock function.
translations: 一个包含了一个原子钟的生化插件，具有无声闹钟功能。

messages.msgid: A module containing nanotubes that are embedded in the palm of the user's hand to pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities, and convert it into potable water.  Water container not included.
translations: 这个模块包含了一套纳米管，能够植入到掌心，用于从尸体中提取可用的液体，净化并转换为可饮用的净水。不过，你必须有个装水的容器。

messages.msgid: A small tube with a retractable needle that terminates in a net of tiny hoses instead of a plunger.  When installed, it allows the user to draw substances directly into their bloodstream akin to a regular syringe.
translations: 一个带有可伸缩针头的小型注射管，但针管末端是网状细管而非柱状活塞。安装后，使用者可以通过注射管将针剂直接引入血液之中，达成类似注射针筒的功能。

messages.msgid: A set of hinges, springs, and other synthetic augments for the skeletal structure.  These artificial enhancers strengthen the knees and elbows, allowing the user to carry more weight.  The reinforcement also provides 2 bashing armor to the torso, legs and arms.
translations: 一副由各种铰链，弹簧，和其他合成材料增强过的骨架被植入了使用者的体内。这些生化强化装置加强了膝盖和肘部关节，让使用者能够携带更多的重量。它同时也为躯干、手部、及腿部提供2点钝击防护。

messages.msgid: A set of highly-sensitive sensors implanted in the user's mouth, combined with a sophisticated analyzer.  While active, it will block all unpleasant taste and texture at the cost of bionic energy.
translations: 一套极其敏感的传感器被植入到了使用者的口腔，附有一个复杂的分析装置。开启时，它可以通过消耗生化能量来屏蔽不佳的味道和质感。

messages.msgid: A microscopic electrode designed to gently stimulate a particular cluster of neurons in the hypothalamus, helping the user to fall asleep.
translations: 一种微小的电极，设计用来轻轻地刺激使用者下丘脑的一组神经元，帮助其入睡。

messages.msgid: A pair of defective bionics that make squeaking noises.
translations: 一对发出吱吱噪音的故障生化插件。

messages.msgid: A jumble of broken metal pieces that were removed during reconstructive surgery.
translations: 从手术中取出的一堆金属碎片。

messages.msgid: A CBM that has been breached in several places.  Some acid is leaking from it.
translations: 一个有几处已经破损、正在泄露酸液的CBM。

messages.msgid: A formerly-functional CBM that is now a mess of naked wires and burnt resistors.
translations: 一个已经变成了一堆乱七八糟的裸露电线和烧毁电阻的CBM。

messages.msgid: This CBM was wired incorrectly and would drain power from any system connected to it.
translations: 该CBM因为接线错误，会不断消耗所连接系统内的生化能量。

messages.msgid: You can't recognize what this is supposed to be, but you imagine it'd be a very awkward thing to have in one's body.
translations: 你不知道这是什么，但是你可以想象到它在你的身体里时会令你非常不舒服。

messages.msgid: It's a… thing?  And it glows, at least it did when it was installed.
translations: 这是……某种东西，至少安装在身上后会发光的东西。

messages.msgid: A mess of pierced pipes and broken seals, something unpleasant is leaking from it.
translations: 一堆穿孔的管子和破裂的密封件，一些令人不快的东西从里面漏了出来。

messages.msgid: A malfunctioning bionic.  When installed, it occasionally emits a loud burst of noise.
translations: 一个出现故障的生化插件。当安装在身上时，它偶尔会发出一阵巨大的噪声。

messages.msgid: This thing was up someone's nose, they're probably glad to be rid of it.
translations: 这东西曾经在某人的鼻子里，他们可能很高兴摆脱它。

messages.msgid: A defective bionic that impairs vision.
translations: 这个故障的生化插件减弱了受体的视力。

messages.msgid: A bunch of defective power circuits that are prone to short-circuiting.
translations: 一堆故障的功率电路，随时会短路。

messages.msgid: This bionic is poorly wired and occasionally short-circuits.
translations: 这个生化插件的接线很乱，偶尔会短路。

messages.msgid: A malfunctioning bionic that causes sleepiness by altering the unfortunate user's brain chemistry.
translations: 这个故障的生化插件改变了它倒霉受体的脑部化学过程，使得受体容易犯困。

messages.msgid: An electromagnetic stimulator surgically implanted on the back of the head and along the spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, the user will not suffer from sleep deprivation, although they may still feel sleepy; if activated by a user that is already sleep-deprived, it will gradually reduce the symptoms of lacking sleep.
translations: 一套电磁刺激装置被植入到你的后脑和脊柱上，不断地消耗着生化能量。当被激活时，你就不会受到睡眠不足的惩罚，尽管你仍会困倦；如果开启时你已经睡眠不足了，它将逐渐减轻睡眠不足的症状。

messages.msgid: The result of poor configuration, this bionic module frequently causes debilitating muscle spasms.
translations: 作为胡乱安装的后果，这个生化插件经常造成肌肉痉挛，使人虚弱。

messages.msgid: A length of poorly installed wiring that would cause stiffness.
translations: 一根错误安装的电线，会造成身体的僵直。

messages.msgid: A pair of faulty, self-locking thumb bionics.
translations: 一对故障的自锁大拇指生化插件。

messages.msgid: A pair of defective ocular bionics that cause visual distortion and pixelation.
translations: 一对故障的眼部生化插件，会造成视觉失真和像素化。

messages.msgid: Part of the Autodoc's 'Cyborg Identity Package', this bionic gives the user a creepy robot voice.
translations: 这个生化插件是全自动医疗仪的"改造人身份套餐"的一部分，使受体的声音变成令人毛骨悚然的机械音。

messages.msgid: A broken implant that sends electromagnetic impulses that reduce other implants' capacity to store charge.
translations: 一个会不断发出电磁脉冲，降低其他储能生化插件容量的损坏生化插件。

messages.msgid: A CBM that generates power out of kerosene or motor oil.  It is fairly efficient and can store up to 750 mL of fuel, but works somewhat slowly.
translations: 燃烧煤油或机油的供能 CBM。它的转换率相当高，可以储存最多 750 毫升的燃油，但能量恢复速度较慢。

messages.msgid: A broken and mis-wired module that would cause food and drink to taste terrible if installed.
translations: 一个坏掉的、接线错误的生化插件，会让食物和饮料的味道变得糟糕。

messages.msgid: A broken CBM that has been leaking radiation into its user.  The danger seems to have been sealed off during the removal process, but you definitely shouldn't put it back.
translations: 一个持续泄漏辐射的破损的CBM。大部分辐射泄漏似乎在移除时已被封存，但把它装回体内绝对是个坏主意。

messages.msgid: A CBM that contains shock absorbers and kinetic braces which greatly reduce the recoil of guns.
translations: 一个包含减震器和动力支架的CBM，可大大减少枪械后坐力。

messages.msgid: A CBM that completely shuts down all communication between the user's brain and the rest of their body when they fall asleep, preventing them from waking up under any circumstance until their natural sleep cycle completes.  An inability to trigger its effects manually makes it useless as an anesthesia substitute.
translations: 这个CBM完全关闭使用者入睡时大脑与身体其他部位之间的所有通信，防止他们在任何情况下醒来，直到他们的自然睡眠周期结束。由于无法手动触发其效果，因此无法作为麻醉替代品使用。

messages.msgid: The culmination of decades of research into hominid palaeoanthropology and biomechanical modeling, the throwing assist CBM was brought to market to revolutionize Beqball tournaments, soon becoming exhibitions of cybernetic human effort and engineering.  A network of neurostimulators and sensors, mostly in the arms and hands, work in tandem with the eyes for a significant increase in throwing accuracy and precision.  When the Exodii came upon this cybernetic enhancement suite, they found it to be an economical way to ensure precise grenade placement in partial cyborgs.
translations: 作为数十年来人科考古人类学与生物力学建模研究的巅峰成果，投掷辅助CBM彻底改变了贝球锦标赛的格局，使其迅速演变为展示人体机能与机械工程融合的科技盛典。该模块由主要分布在手臂与手掌的神经刺激器和传感器网络构成，通过与视觉系统协同运作，大幅提升投掷的准确度与精密度。当流亡族发现这套改造增强系统时，他们意识到这是确保改造人士兵精确投掷手雷的经济高效方案。

messages.msgid: Bird droppings, feathers, and soiled bits of rubbish.
translations: 一堆鸟粪、羽毛和肮脏的垃圾混合物。

messages.msgid: A fresh cow pie; this could probably be used to make some great fertilizer.
translations: 一滩新鲜的牛粪，可以用来制造不错的肥料。

messages.msgid: Common manure, could probably be used to make some great fertilizer.
translations: 普通的粪便，可以用来制造不错的肥料。

messages.msgid: Large black pellets of rotting material.
translations: 一堆巨大的黑色球体，里面是各种早已腐烂的材料。

messages.msgid: A foul-smelling goop.  It has a disgusting texture and a powerful smell that overwhelms every other smell around it.
translations: 一团散发着恶臭的黏液。它有一种令人作呕的质感和强烈刺激的臭味，这臭味能够盖过四周所有其他气味。

messages.msgid: The dust left over by winged insects such as butterflies or moths.  It's mostly chitin but may also contain dirt and other gross materials.
translations: 蝴蝶或飞蛾等有翅膀的昆虫留下的粉尘。其主要成分为甲壳素，但也可能含有泥土和其他恶心的材料。

messages.msgid: A small length of shed snakeskin.  It's thin and translucent but still bears the distinct pattern of scales.
translations: 一小块脱落的蛇皮。它薄而半透明，但仍然带有明显的蛇鳞图案。

messages.msgid: The molted dermis of an adult snake.  This one is in one piece.  You can even see the individual eyes.
translations: 成年蛇蜕下来的蛇皮。这个是一体的。你甚至可以看到每只眼睛。

messages.msgid: A very large shed snakeskin.  This didn't come from anything native, or natural, to New England.
translations: 一大块蜕下的蛇皮。看起来不像是来自新英格兰本地，或是说自然里会产生的东西。

messages.msgid: A complete shed snakeskin of tremendous size.  Whatever left it must be getting even bigger.  You should not be, or return to, wherever you found this.
translations: 一块巨大的完整的蛇皮。不管来自何处，它一定越来越大了。你不应该去找，或是回到你发现它的地方。

messages.msgid: A handful of greatly oversized scales from a snake.  This is a troubling find for a few reasons.  There's the size, obviously, but also the unusual hardness in spite of the obvious decay, and the fact that snakes don't shed individual scales like this.
translations: 一把超大的蛇鳞片。这是一个令人不安的发现，原因有几个。首先显而易见，当然是蛇的大小，其次尽管有明显的腐烂迹象，但仍然表现出不同寻常的硬度，最后蛇不会像这样脱落单个鳞片。

messages.msgid: A variety of powerful hypnotic, analgesic, and stimulative drugs.  It's intended for use in specialized medical equipment, and can't be administered manually.  You can reload an anesthesia kit with it.
translations: 各式各样的强力催眠药、安眠药和兴奋剂。用于专业医疗设备使用，无法直接使用。你可以用它重新装填麻醉套件。

messages.msgid: A pill for those looking to have children.  It is of no use to you.
translations: 为那些希望有孩子的人准备的药丸。它对你没有任何用处。

messages.msgid: A handful of pure sulfur.  Primarily used to make battery acid, sulfur is sometimes used as fuel for explosives.  Can be burned to produce acidic smoke that is deadly to bacteria and humans alike, or oxidized to make paper-bleaching agents.  It also serves as a basis for many kinds of fungicide.
translations: 一小把纯硫磺。主要用于制造电池液，也能用用作爆炸物的燃料。可以点燃制造酸性烟雾，对细菌和人都是致命的，或者用于氧化漂白纸张，它也是多种杀菌剂的原料。

messages.msgid: A chunk of pure sulfur.  Break it up to use it.
translations: 一块硫磺结晶，可以被拆解成碎块来使用。

messages.msgid: Portland is most likely long gone, but its memory persists in cement.  This ubiquitous binder can be used for all kinds of advanced masonry.  Just add water.
translations: 一堆粉状水硬性无机粘合材料，加水搅拌后成浆体，可用于建筑。

messages.msgid: A handful of gravel, smaller than pebbles but larger than sand.
translations: 一把碎石，比石子略小，但又比沙子略大。

messages.msgid: A handful of shredded rubber, usable as a mulch now.
translations: 一大把碎橡胶，现在可以用来制造橡胶地板。

messages.msgid: A handful of small chunks of limestone.  Useful for experiments at science fairs, but pretty useless as ammo.  Maybe something could be crafted from this stuff…
translations: 一把石灰石碎块。可用于科学实验，无法当作弹药使用。也许可以用来制造点什么……

messages.msgid: The product of burning limestone, this white powder is a crucial ingredient in making cement.  That said, it is also extremely caustic and will cause severe burns to any tissue it comes in contact with.  This property could probably be exploited.
translations: 这种白色粉末是石灰石燃烧的产物，是制造水泥的关键成分。不过，它也是极具腐蚀性的，会对它接触到的任何组织造成严重烧伤。这一特性可能可以被利用。

messages.msgid: A handful of slaked lime, a white odorless powder with many uses.  Also known as calcium hydroxide.
translations: 一份熟石灰，特征为白色无气味粉末，有许多用途。也被称为氢氧化钙。

messages.msgid: A handful of New England sand.  If you had a stoked furnace, you could turn it into glass.  Otherwise, it's only good for making cement.
translations: 一大把原产自新英格兰的沙子。如果有焦炉的话可以烧玻璃，否则只能用来制造水泥。

messages.msgid: A pile of loosely-packed, slightly damp loamy soil.  This mixture of sand, silt and clay is ideal for growing plants.
translations: 一堆松软的，略微潮湿的肥沃土壤。这种由沙子、淤泥和黏土的混合物是种植植物的理想材料。

messages.msgid: A small shard of limestone.  Pretty flimsy and not much of a weapon, but its alkaline properties may yet find some use.
translations: 一小片石灰岩。非常脆弱，无法作为武器，但是它的碱性化学属性也许能有点用处。

messages.msgid: A handful of rock salt crystals.  Could be refined into table salt.
translations: 一大把岩盐结晶。可以被提炼为食盐。

messages.msgid: A chunk of rhodonite.  It has manganese dioxide covering and going through it in veins, which can be obtained using a chisel.
translations: 一大块蔷薇辉石。二氧化锰纹路覆盖和贯通其中，可以用凿子采集。

messages.msgid: A chunk of zincite.  Could be refined into zinc oxide, then into zinc by reduction with a source of carbon.
translations: 一大块红锌矿，可以被提炼成氧化锌，再用碳来还原成锌。

messages.msgid: Sodium hypochlorite, a common household cleaning agent.
translations: 次氯酸钠，一种常见的家用清洁剂。

messages.msgid: Anhydrous ammonia, a useful chemical compound.  It must be stored under pressure or refrigerated.  Don't even think about drinking it.
translations: 无水液氨，一种十分有用的化合物。必须加压或冷藏储存。别想着喝了。

messages.msgid: Ammonium hydroxide, a common household cleaning agent.
translations: 氨水，一种常见的家用清洁剂。
一些流体肥料，俗称液肥，内含多种对作物有益的微量营养元素，对作物有着明显的增产作用。

messages.msgid: A mixture of various organic wastes and water.  Wait about two months for them to be fermented in a tank.  Also, biogas production will start after one month.
translations: 各种有机废物和水的混合物。液体在罐中发酵需要大约两个月时间。此外，装罐一个月后，罐内开始产生沼气。

messages.msgid: A mixture of fish, sugars, and water.  Wait about two months for them to be fermented in an open tank.
translations: 鱼，糖和水的混合液体。装进开放的发酵容器中并等待两个月可以将其发酵。

messages.msgid: The overpowering smell of the fermenting fish liquid makes it clear that it is not ready for use.
translations: 发酵的鱼类混合液散发出的强烈气味表明它还不能被使用。

messages.msgid: A mixture of fermented biomass, will become liquid fertilizer after simple treatment.
translations: 各种发酵生物质的混合物，经过简单处理即可变为液体肥料。
富含营养的颗粒状植物肥料。

messages.msgid: Agricultural-grade chemical anti-fungal powder designed to destroy infections in plants.
translations: 农业用的化学抗真菌粉末，用来消除植物的真菌感染。

messages.msgid: Agricultural-grade chemical insecticide powder designed to eradicate insect pests.
translations: 农业用化学杀虫剂，用于消灭害虫。

messages.msgid: Water with salt added.  Not good for drinking.
translations: 加了盐的水。不适合饮用。

messages.msgid: Water with soap added.  Not good for drinking.
translations: 一些加了肥皂的水，最好别喝。

messages.msgid: A sample of sewage from a treatment plant.  Gross.
translations: 一份污水处理厂的污水样本，看上去闻上去都非常糟糕。

messages.msgid: A handful of finely-ground aluminum powder.  This strong reducing agent was used in combination with various oxidants for chemical welding and explosives alike.  Just before the Cataclysm, however, it was the basis of virtually all commercial metallic-hued paints and anti-corrosive coatings.
translations: 一小撮细磨铝粉。这种强还原剂可用于各种氧化剂的化学焊接和炸药制造之中。然而，就在大灾变之前，它被用于几乎所有的商业金属涂料和抗腐蚀涂料。

messages.msgid: A handful of silvery-white metallic powder composed of nickel.  Common industrial uses include production of stainless steel as well as other alloys.
translations: 一份由镍制成的银白色金属粉末。常见的工业用途包括生产不锈钢及其他合金。

messages.msgid: A handful of zinc powder.  While commercially used mostly in cosmetics and for paints, hobbyists used to mix it with sulfur to make basic rocket fuel or a smokescreen.  When treated with a strong acid, it will produce hydrogen.
translations: 一小撮锌粉。商业上主要用于化妆品及染料中，业余化学爱好者们将其和硫磺混合制造基础火箭燃料或烟雾发生器。和强酸混合时会生成氢气。

messages.msgid: A handful of zinc oxide.  It can be reduced into zinc, or used for some other reactions of its own.
translations: 一小撮氧化锌粉末。可以被还原成锌，或者将其用于其他的化学反应。

messages.msgid: A handful of manganese dioxide powder.  Occurring naturally in the mineral pyrolusite, it is used commercially in the production of alkaline and zinc-carbon batteries.
translations: 一小撮二氧化锰粉末。在自然状况下一般存在于软锰矿中，在商业上常被用来生产碱和碳锌电池。

messages.msgid: A moisturized mixture of zinc chloride and manganese dioxide, slightly acidic.  It can be used in the production of zinc-carbon batteries.
translations: 一团氯化锌和二氧化锰的湿润混合物，呈弱酸性。可用于制造锌碳电池。

messages.msgid: A handful of dark green crystalline powder, with a weak pungent smell similar to that of hydrochloric acid.  Commonly used as a Lewis acid for catalyzing various chemical reactions.
translations: 一份深绿色结晶粉末，具有类似盐酸的微弱刺鼻气味。常用作路易斯酸，用于催化各种化学反应。

messages.msgid: A handful of soft, colorless powder with a sharp pungent odor, also known as butter of antimony.  It's a catalyst for polymerization, hydrocracking, and chlorination reactions, and has some other niche uses.
translations: 一份柔软无色的粉末，有刺鼻的气味，也称为黄油锑。它是聚合反应、加氢裂化反应和氯化反应的催化剂，还有其他一些特殊用途。

messages.msgid: A handful of potassium chloride.  Although it occurs naturally in the mineral sylvite, it can be produced as a byproduct of the reaction of saltpeter and hydrochloric acid.  It can be used for making fertilizer, or potassium hydroxide by way of electrolysis.
translations: 一小撮氯化钾粉末。尽管它在自然状况下存在于钾盐矿中，但它又会在硝石和盐酸反应中作为副产品产生。它本身可以用来制造化肥，或用电解法制造氢氧化钾。

messages.msgid: A handful of potassium hydroxide.  Commonly called caustic potash, it was mainly used industrially for its caustic nature.  It can be used as an electrolyte in alkaline batteries, among other applications.
translations: 一小撮氢氧化钾粉末。俗称苛性钾，由于其腐蚀性很强，在工业上用途很多。除其他应用外，它还可以用作碱性电池的电解液。

messages.msgid: Sulfuric acid: viscous, foul-smelling and extremely corrosive, particularly to organic matter and evil clowns.  Although used to prepare a number of chemicals, it is mostly known as battery acid, due to its widest commercial application.
translations: 硫酸，很粘、刺鼻且极具腐蚀性，尤其是对有机物而言，虽然能用于制备很多种化学物质，但它主要是被作为蓄电池酸液而广为人知，因为它主要的商业用途就是制造电池。

messages.msgid: Hydrochloric acid, also known as muriatic acid.  It is a strong acid that has a distinctive smell, important and frequently used ever since its discovery.  It still has a vast multitude of uses.
translations: 氢氯酸，又称盐酸。它是一种强酸，具有独特的气味，自从被发现以来就被广泛使用。迄今为止它仍有大量用途。

messages.msgid: Acetone, best known as the primary constituent of most nail polish removers.  Flammable, and can be easily used for potent homemade explosives, as demonstrated by the terrorist attacks of 2016.
translations: 丙酮，最广为人知的用途是作为大多数洗甲水的主要成分。易燃，可以轻易地被用于强力的自制炸药，正如2016年的恐怖袭击那时一样。

messages.msgid: Nitric acid, a strong oxidant and an extremely corrosive material.  Mainly used in the production of synthetic fertilizers, for the etching of circuit boards, and in woodworking.  Remains quite useful both for making a vast array of pyrotechnic and explosive agents and as a direct weapon: not many beings enjoy being doused in nitric acid.
translations: 硝酸是一种强氧化剂，亦为极强腐蚀性的物质。主要用于合成肥料的生产、电路板的蚀刻以及木工加工。在制造各类烟火和爆炸药剂方面依然十分有用，同时也可以直接作为武器使用 — 很少有生物会乐于被硝酸浇身。

messages.msgid: A handful of chromium oxide.  This substance, typically known as the only stable green pigment for paints, is also a mild oxidizer, which can be mixed with aluminum powder to make thermite for welding.  If one had access to a CVD machine and a laboratory worth of reagents, they might be able to produce very durable ceramic layers.
translations: 一小把氧化铬。这种物质是通常情况下唯一稳定的绿色颜料，也是一种温和的氧化剂。它可以与铝粉混合来制备铝热剂。

messages.msgid: A powdered mixture of coke and lime ready to be smelted into usable calcium carbide in an arc furnace.
translations: 一堆焦炭粉和石灰粉的混合物，随时可以在电弧炉中熔炼成可用的电石。

messages.msgid: A handful of calcium carbide, giving off a faint, garlic-like smell.  Commercially, calcium carbide was used for on-the-spot manufacture of acetylene and historically to power acetylene lamps.  If mixed with water and sealed, it will explode with little strength, but with a relatively loud noise that might be useful as a distraction.
translations: 一份电石块，散发出微弱的大蒜味。在商业上，电石被用于乙炔的现场生产，在历史上还被用来驱动乙炔灯。如果它与水混合密封，会引起杀伤力不大的爆炸，但噪音较大，可以作为诱饵使用。

messages.msgid: A handful of calcium carbonate powder, typically derived from lime or shells.  Useful for a number of roles, such as sugar production, fracking, construction, paint additives and antacid medicine.
translations: 一把碳酸钙粉末，通常来源于石灰或贝壳。有用于多种用途，如制糖、水力压裂、建筑、涂料添加剂和抗酸药。

messages.msgid: A handful of waxy hexamine tablets which could be broken up into smaller crumbs if needed.  This ubiquitous fuel was used to start up almost every garden grill, and no 'real' camping trip could do its cooking without it, until the Cataclysm.  Nowadays, it is even more valuable than before, being the key component in the preparation of several military-grade explosives.
translations: 一小把蜡状乌洛托品片，可以根据需要被分解成更小的碎片。，这种普遍的燃料几乎被用于每一个花园烤架，直到大灾变为止，任何"真正的"露营之旅都离不开它。现在，作为军用级炸药制备的关键成分，它甚至比以前还要金贵了。

messages.msgid: Concentrated hydrogen peroxide is a powerful oxidant, violently decomposing in contact with most reducing agents.  Can be used as rocket fuel or to make high explosives.  Causes severe burns to any organic matter and may ignite it on contact.
translations: 浓缩过氧化氢溶液是一种强大的氧化剂，与大部分还原剂接触都会剧烈分解。可以用作火箭燃料或烈性炸药。与任何有机物接触都有可能点燃它们并导致剧烈燃烧。

messages.msgid: A chunk of unshielded plutonium.  You should probably get very far away from this, if you enjoy not being irradiated.
translations: 一块开封的钚。如果你不是想被辐照的水果的话，你应该远离它。

messages.msgid: Some uranium.  You should probably get very far away from this, if you enjoy not being irradiated.
translations: 一些固态铀块。如果你不想被辐射的话，你应该远离它。

messages.msgid: A handful of ammonium nitrate.  This white, crystalline powder is commonly used as a component of fertilizers and explosives.  Could also be dissolved in water to sharply lower its temperature, but is there any use for this quality in this new world?
translations: 一把硝酸铵。这种白色晶状粉末常被用作化肥与炸药的组成成分。它也可以溶于水以显著降低水温，然而在这个崩坏的新世界里，这一特性是否还有用武之地？

messages.msgid: A handful of ammonium nitrate pellets.  These pellets are commonly used as a component of fertilizers and explosives.  Could also be dissolved in water to sharply lower its temperature, but is there any use for this quality in this new world?
translations: 一把硝酸铵颗粒。这些颗粒常被用作化肥与炸药的组成成分。它们也可以溶于水以显著降低水温，然而在这个崩坏的新世界里，这一特性是否还有用武之地？

messages.msgid: A handful of saltpeter.  Sometimes used as a fertilizer, this ubiquitous nitrate is the principal constituent of black gunpowder and simple rocket propellants, such as rocket candy.
translations: 一小撮硝石。有时用于肥料制造，但这无所不在的硝酸盐是黑火药和基础火箭推进剂的主要组分。

messages.msgid: A large crystal of niter, the mineral form of potassium nitrate.  It can be processed into saltpeter.
translations: 一大块结晶硝石矿石，以矿物形式存在的硝酸钾。它可以被处理成为硝石。

messages.msgid: Several crystals of aluminum sulfate.  Historically, an agent for purifying water and as molluscicide, due to the fact that it degenerates their slime.  Just before the Cataclysm, its main uses were for adjusting the acidity of soil and as an additive to baking powder.  If mixed with a strong acid, it could be used to saturate soil with aluminum, causing all but the most resistant of plants to wither and die.
translations: 一份硫酸铝结晶。在历史上，由于其吸附黏液的特性，它被当作净水剂和灭螺剂使用。在大灾变之前，它主要被用作土壤酸碱度调节剂及发酵粉添加剂使用。当它与强酸混合时，可使土壤中的铝离子饱和，除了少数几种抵抗力强的植物，其他植物都会枯萎死亡。

messages.msgid: Concentrated acetic acid, typically used as a chemical reagent and antifungal agent.  Despite its horrid smell, it was used to prepare several types of perfumes, but would making perfume not be too fancy for post-apocalyptic New England?
translations: 浓缩的醋酸，常用作化学试剂和抗真菌剂。尽管它气味难闻，却被用来调制好几种香水，但在灾变之后的新英格兰，制造香水会不会太潮了？

messages.msgid: Formaldehyde, here dissolved in water, was widely used before the Cataclysm as a precursor to production of many chemicals and materials and as an embalming agent.  Easily identifiable by its pungent odor.  Terribly toxic, carcinogenic, and volatile.
translations: 少量甲醛水溶液，又被称为福尔马林，在大灾变之前被广泛用作生产许多化学品和材料的前体，并作为一种防腐剂被广泛使用。它刺鼻的气味很容易辨认。甲醛含有剧毒，致癌，易挥发。

messages.msgid: A handful of silvery-greenish powder, produced by mixing aluminum and chromium oxide.  This mixture, burning at a constant pace and at extremely high temperature, was once used for on-the-spot welding.  Can be used as an incendiary material in a pinch.
translations: 少量银绿色的粉末，由铝粉和氧化铬混合而成。这种混合物能稳定燃烧并产生极高的温度，曾经被用于即时焊接。必要时可以作为燃烧弹的材料。

messages.msgid: A handful of brownish pellets, made by allowing ammonium nitrate to absorb an organic fuel.  This ammonium nitrate/fuel oil mixture, or ANFO, is a common industrial explosive due to its stability and low price.  Burns fast, but needs an explosive primer to detonate.
translations: 一份用硝酸铵吸收有机燃料制成的褐色小球。这种硝酸铵与燃料油的混合物，即ANFO（铵油炸药）因其稳定性好、价格低廉，是一种常见的工业炸药。它燃烧很快，但需要一个爆炸引信来引爆。

messages.msgid: A handful of black gunpowder, a mix of saltpeter, charcoal, and sulfur.  Pretty useless for making modern cartridges, as the soot produced when it burns will quickly clog any firearm, but it could be used to make some vicious bombs.
translations: 一份黑火药，硝石、木炭和硫磺的混合物。无法用于制造现代弹药，因为在燃烧时会留下残渣堵塞枪械的枪膛，但还是可以用于制造一些凶猛的炸弹。

messages.msgid: Several off-white crystals of RDX, or hexogen: a military-grade, shelf-stable high explosive.  Can be cast into shaped charges, or mixed with scrap to pepper the blast area with high-velocity shrapnel.
translations: 几种灰白色的环三亚甲基三硝胺晶体，被称为黑索金：一种军用级的，性质稳定的烈性炸药。可以用于锥形装药或混合废料来使高速飞行的弹片覆盖爆炸区域。

messages.msgid: Composition B is an explosive consisting of castable mixtures of RDX and TNT.  It is used as the main explosive filling in artillery projectiles, rockets, land mines, hand grenades, and various other munitions.
translations: B型炸药是由RDX和TNT按比例浇筑混合而成的炸药。它被广泛用作装填炮弹、火箭、地雷、手榴弹和其他各种弹药的主要炸药。

messages.msgid: Hexamine peroxide: this fine, yellowish powder is a powerful primary explosive, used to initiate detonation of more stable explosives, such as RDX.  Relatively stable, but best not store it for too long.
translations: 六亚甲基过氧化物：这种细腻的淡黄色粉末是一种强力起爆药，用于引发更稳定炸药（如 RDX）的爆轰。相对稳定，但最好不要长期存放。

messages.msgid: Acetone peroxide: this fine, white crystalline powder is a powerful primary explosive, used to initiate detonation of more stable explosives, such as RDX.  Relatively stable, with a fruit-like smell when pure.
translations: 三过氧化三丙酮：这种细小的白色结晶粉末是一种强大的起爆药，用于引爆更稳定的炸药，如RDX。纯净的三过氧化三丙酮相对稳定，闻起来有水果味。

messages.msgid: A chunk of a zinc powder-and-sulfur mixture, bound together by superglue, that can be used as an impromptu rocket fuel.
translations: 一堆锌粉和硫磺的混合物，由强力胶粘合胶结，可以用作临时爆炸箭燃料。

messages.msgid: Intended for the clarification and disinfection of unsafe drinking water while camping or traveling, this sodium dichloroisocyanurate-based purification tablet removes dangerous contaminants using powerful chemicals.  The label says to use one tablet per liter (4 units of water).
translations: 这种基于二氯异氰尿酸钠的净水片剂可在露营或旅行时对不安全的饮用水进行澄清和消毒，利用强力化学物质去除危险的污染物。 标签上标明每公升（4 单位水）使用一片。

messages.msgid: A root from a hickory tree.  It has an earthy smell.
translations: 山核桃树的根，尚带着泥土的芬芳。

messages.msgid: A handful of hard nuts from a hickory tree, still in their shells.
translations: 一把从山核桃树上摘下来的坚果，还没去壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of hard nuts from a pecan tree, still in their shells.
translations: 一把从碧根果树上摘下来的坚果，还没去壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of hard nuts from a pistachio tree, still in their shells.
translations: 一把从开心果树上摘下来的坚果，还没去壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of hard nuts from an almond tree, still in their shells.
translations: 一把来自杏仁树的坚硬果实，仍带着外壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of hard nuts from a peanut bush, still in their shells.
translations: 一把从花生丛上摘下来的坚果，还没去壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of hard nuts from a hazelnut tree, still in their shells.
translations: 一把从榛树上摘下来的坚果，还没去壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of hard nuts from a chestnut tree, still in their shells.
translations: 一把从栗树上摘下来的坚果，还没去壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of hard nuts from a walnut tree, still in their shells.
translations: 一把从核桃树上摘下来的坚果，还没去壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of nuts from a butternut tree, still in their shell.
translations: 一把从白胡桃木上摘下来的坚果，还没去壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of husks from a butternuts, emptied of their meat.
translations: 一把掏空了果肉的灰胡桃壳。

messages.msgid: Turbid liquid from the sewers with an awful stench.
translations: 一些下水道里恶臭而浑浊的液体。
一种在大灾变前流行的用于清洗肮脏物品的粉末。

messages.msgid: A handful of flakes shaved off a bar of soap, suitable for use in a washing machine.
translations: 一把从肥皂上刮下来的薄片，适合在洗衣机里使用。

messages.msgid: A liquid form of sodium hydroxide.  It is highly corrosive; handle with care.
translations: 一份氢氧化钠溶液，具有高度腐蚀性，小心轻放。

messages.msgid: A liquid form of potassium hydroxide.  It is highly corrosive; handle with care.
translations: 一份氢氧化钾溶液，具有高度腐蚀性，小心轻放。

messages.msgid: A steel canister containing carbon, iron, titanium, copper, and other elements in specifically engineered atomic-scale configurations.  A nanofabricator can assemble them into usable items.
translations: 一个装着经过特殊设计的原子级结构的碳，铁，钛，铜和其他元素的钢罐。使用一台纳米制造机可以将其组装成可用的物品。

messages.msgid: A handful of almost-weightless residue left after the burning of some substance.
translations: 一份木材经过燃烧后剩下的残渣，几乎没有什么重量。

messages.msgid: The burnt remains of a person or animal.
translations: 人或动物遗体燃烧后的残留物。

messages.msgid: A useful industrial solvent, and the first inhalative anesthetic in widespread use.  Its uncomfortable side effects and tendency to explode caused it to fall out of favor decades ago in the developed world.  If you can't get the good stuff, however, it might make a passable substitute.
translations: 一种工业溶剂，也是第一种广泛使用的吸入式麻醉剂。由于其不良反应及爆炸倾向让它在几十年前被发达国家禁止用于临床。但当你买不到合适的麻醉剂时，它还算是款勉强可以接受的替代品。

messages.msgid: Dimethyl sulfoxide, or DMSO, is a common and important aprotic solvent, capable of dissolving a huge range of things.  It has the unusual property of being absorbed very quickly through the skin, causing a garlic flavor in the mouth, even if it touched your arm.
translations: 二甲基亚砜(DMSO)是一种常见而重要的非质子溶剂，能溶解大量物质。它有一种不同寻常的特性——它能很快被皮肤吸收，即使只是手臂碰到，嘴里也会有大蒜味。

messages.msgid: Famous for its properties as an illicit sedative, this substance is also a very good solvent.  In particular, it's used a lot in nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy.
translations:
这种物质因为常用于非法麻醉他人而闻名，是一种很好的化学溶剂。尤其是，它在核磁共振波谱学中被大量使用。
"和乙醚一样强劲。"

messages.msgid: A useful and potent solvent with a wide range of reactive applications.  It can be used to make a huge number of plastics and polymers, it can be an antiseptic, it can strip paint and break down epoxy, and it can burn your skin away like tissue paper under a heat gun.  Wear gloves.
translations: 一种用途广泛且效力强大的溶剂，适用于多种反应性应用。可用于合成大量塑料与高分子材料，可作为防腐消毒剂，可用于除漆和分解环氧树脂，同时也足以将你的皮肤灼蚀得如同热风枪下的薄纸一般。操作时请务必佩戴手套。

messages.msgid: A colorless, highly flammable liquid with a sweet odor, one of the elementary petrochemicals.  Being used primarily as a precursor to the manufacture of chemicals with more complex structure, it's a major industrial chemical, but finds limited use in consumer items because of its toxicity.
translations: 一种闻起来具有甜味的无色高度易燃液体，初级石化产品之一。它主要作为前体用于制造结构更复杂的化学品，是重要的工业化学品，但由于其毒性，在消费品中的用途有限。

messages.msgid: A colorless, toxic, and highly flammable liquid which smells like paint thinner.  It's predominantly used as an industrial feedstock and a solvent, and is also used as an intoxicative inhalant in a manner unintended by manufacturers.
translations: 一种无色、有毒且高度易燃的液体，闻起来像油漆稀释剂。它主要用作工业原料和溶剂，也能以制造商未曾设想的方式用作麻醉吸入剂。

messages.msgid: Also called glycerin, this clear, odorless liquid is both a handy skin moisturizer and an ingredient necessary to make dynamite.
translations: 这种透明无味的液体也被称作丙三醇，既是常用的皮肤保湿剂，也是制作炸药的必备成分。

messages.msgid: A pre-mixed salty solution of protein and sugar meant for bacteria to eat.
translations: 一种预先混合好的蛋白质和糖的盐溶液，供细菌繁殖。

messages.msgid: Clear flakes of processed seaweed that can be dissolved in boiling water to create a very sturdy, temperature-resistant gel.  Not only is it good for making gels to separate molecules by size, but it's a great cheat ingredient to make sure your jellies set properly.
translations: 这些清澈的海藻薄片可以溶解在沸水中，形成一种非常坚固、耐高温的凝胶。这种凝胶既可以用来当作电泳分离设备的溶剂基质，也还是保证你的果冻制造成功的秘密配方。

messages.msgid: A handful of highly carcinogenic white powder that can be readily polymerized into a whole bunch of useful water-soluble gels.
translations: 一份高度致癌的白色粉末，很容易聚合成一块有用的水溶性凝胶。

messages.msgid: A metal grille.  It can be used as a framework for making a chemical catalyst.
translations: 一个金属格栅。它可以用作制造化学催化剂的支撑框架。

messages.msgid: A piece of unshielded radioactive material that used to be a part of some nuclear industry equipment.  You have yet to find some use for it, and you probably shouldn't stand near it.
translations: 一份开封的放射性物质，曾经是核工业设备的一部分。不过你还没有找到这玩意儿的用途，并且最好别站在它附近。

messages.msgid: A wooden bead.  It can be used to craft inscribable jewelry or create a beaded curtain door.
translations: 一颗木珠。可以用来制造可刻字的珠宝或制造珠帘门。

messages.msgid: A chunk of yellowish rosin, usable as a flux for soldering.
translations: 一块淡黄色的松香，可作为助焊剂用于焊接。

messages.msgid: A flammable gas that explodes under pressure.  Combined with oxygen, acetylene makes a great welding gas.
translations: 可燃性气体，在高压下会爆炸。与氧气混合后可以作为优良的焊接气。

messages.msgid: Common in nature as an insect venom, this substance has a number of industrial uses such as preservation and manufacturing.
translations: 一种自然界中常见的昆虫毒素，在工业上被用作防腐剂或制造其他化学物质的化工原料。

messages.msgid: A liquid precursor to rubber found in some plants.
translations: 一种由某些植物分泌出的含有天然橡胶的液态预聚体。

messages.msgid: A manufactured form of citric acid that is commonly used as an additive in food, cleaning agents, and nutritional supplements.
translations: 一份人工合成出来的柠檬酸，通常用作食品添加剂、清洁剂和营养补充剂。

messages.msgid: A fragile, slightly quivering organ for the production and storage of wasp venom.  You could extract some very useful chemicals from it with the right know-how, but only if you hurry.
translations: 黄蜂毒腺是一种脆弱的器官，用于产生和储存黄蜂毒液。你可以用特殊的技术从中提取一些非常有用的化学物质，前提是要快。

messages.msgid: A fragile, slightly quivering organ for the production and storage of honeybee venom.  You could extract some very useful chemicals from it with the right know-how, but only if you hurry.
translations: 蜜蜂毒腺是一种脆弱的器官，用于产生和储存蜜蜂毒液。你可以用特殊的技术从中提取一些非常有用的化学物质，前提是要快。

messages.msgid: A grayish, flexible vesicle filled to the brim with the potent paralytic agent the triffids use to subdue still-moving fertilizer such as yourself.  If you know your way around poisons you might be able to find a use for it.
translations: 一颗灰色的，有弹性的小球，充满了强效麻痹毒素。三尖树用它来对付像你这样还在移动的肥料。如果你知道提取毒素的方法，你也许能找到它的用途。

messages.msgid: A triffid sac filled with what appears to be a triffid-produced antifungal agent.  It will likely already work as an antifungal compound for more offensive applications, but requires further refining before it can be used as a medical drug.
translations: 一个三尖树液囊，里面装的似乎是三尖树生产的抗真菌剂。它可能已经能够被直接当作抗真菌物质用于攻击作战之中，但需要进一步提炼才能当作药物使用。

messages.msgid: A transparent, lightly greenish liquid, refined from the venom of bees and wasps.  Active ingredients include (nor-)adrenaline, dopamine, histamine, and protein toxins.  It is now relatively stable, but will require further separation to be useful for anything other than killing you.
translations: 一份透明的浅绿色液体，由蜜蜂和黄蜂的毒液提炼而来。活性成分包括去甲肾上腺素、多巴胺、组织胺和蛋白质毒素。它现在化合态较为稳定，但需要进行分离才能用在除自杀以外的事情上。

messages.msgid: A concentrated paralytic agent, originally from a triffid.  Given your experience with its effects (chiefly gathered while sourcing this batch) and their striking similarity to earthly flora, you figure it's related to curarines.  Might come in handy in crafting more useful things.
translations: 一份来源于三尖树的浓缩麻痹剂。考虑到你对其效果的（主要是在采集原料时）初步观察总结以及它们与地球某类植物惊人的相似之处，你认为它的作用机理可能与箭毒碱类似。可能会在制作其它东西上派上用场。

messages.msgid: Rocuronium bromide, a fast-acting muscle relaxant.  Used primarily in emergency medicine because of its relative stability, it can serve as a component of a balanced anesthesia in a pinch.
translations: 罗库溴铵，一款速效肌肉松弛剂，由于其特性相对稳定，主要在急诊时用作全身麻醉剂。

messages.msgid: An allotrope of the element phosphorous.  It's what you use to light matches, but can also be used in the synthesis of methamphetamine.  You could use it to make bombs, and if you were truly desperate you might even be able to use it in small portions as a propellant for bullets.
translations: 磷元素的同素异形体。它可以用来点燃火柴，但也可以用于合成甲基苯丙胺（冰毒）。你可以用它制造炸弹，不过如果你真的走投无路，也可以把它小剂量的用作子弹的推进药。

messages.msgid: An allotrope of the element phosphorous.  It's what you use to light matches, but can also be used in the synthesis of methamphetamine.  You could use it to make bombs, and if you were truly desperate you might even be able to use it as a propellant for bullets.
translations: 磷元素的同素异形体。它可以用来点燃火柴，但也可以用于合成甲基苯丙胺（冰毒）。你可以用它制造炸弹，不过如果你真的无路可走了，也可以把它用作子弹的推进药。

messages.msgid: An allotrope of the element phosphorous.  Extremely flammable, produces toxic smoke, you can use it to make smoke bombs.
translations: 磷元素的同素异形体。极度易燃，燃烧时会产生有毒烟雾，可以用来制造烟雾弹。

messages.msgid: A colorless liquid that smells strongly of vinegar.  If you have enough chemical knowledge, you could use it to easily convert morphine into heroin.
translations: 一种带有强烈醋味的无色液体。如果你有足够的化学知识，你可以利用它轻易地将吗啡转化为海洛因。

messages.msgid: A handful of resublimed crystals of the element iodine, they can be used as an antiseptic, but are also used in the making of methamphetamine.
translations: 一小撮经过再升华处理的碘元素晶体，它们可作为消毒剂使用，但也常用于甲基苯丙胺的制造。

messages.msgid: Standard skin-safe liquid soap, the type you might see on a kitchen sink, shower shelf, or bathroom soap dispenser, but it should work reasonably well for cleaning anything that's filthy.
translations: 符合标准的不伤手液体肥皂，在厨房水池、淋浴置物架或是卫生间都能找到它的身影。虽然常见，但它应该能相当好地清除任何污渍。

messages.msgid: A sticky, sludgy mass of sap harvested from a pine tree.
translations: 一些从松树上采集的粘稠、淤泥状的松树树液。

messages.msgid: A thick gray paste used as a sealant in many construction projects.
translations: 一种厚灰色的糊状物，在许多建筑项目中用作密封剂。

messages.msgid: Blood mixed with acidic compounds, extremely corrosive, a means of refining this could net some useful chemicals.
translations: 混合着酸性化合物的血液，腐蚀性极强，能用来通过某种方法提取出一些有用的化学物质。

messages.msgid: Blood mixed with acidic compounds, smells putrid, a means of refining this could net some useful chemicals.
translations: 混合着酸性化合物的血液，带有腐臭气味，能用来通过某种方法提取出一些有用的化学物质。

messages.msgid: Blood mixed with acidic compounds, foul-smelling and extremely corrosive, a means of refining this could net some useful chemicals.
translations: 混合着酸性化合物的血液，臭气熏天且腐蚀性极强，能用来通过某种方法提取出一些有用的化学物质。

messages.msgid: A patch kit produced by the Exodii for repairing their nanotube-infused ceramics.  Requires a kiln.
translations: 由流亡族生产的用于修复其纳米管陶瓷的修补套件。使用它需要一个窑炉。

messages.msgid: Commonly used in electronics prototyping, this solderless breadboard is a small brick of plastic filled with hundreds of holes connected by internal electrical busses.  With a few components and scraps of wire, you could quickly build a circuit on this, if you know what you're doing.
translations: 这个不带焊锡的试验板通常用于电子产品的原型制作，它是一块有数百个小孔的塑料砖块，这些小孔通过内部铜线连接。如果你知道自己在做什么的话，用一些元件和电线，你就可以很快在上面搭出一个电路。

messages.msgid: An electrical component designed to produce microwaves, for use in a microwave oven.
translations: 一个能够产生微波的电子元件，主要用于微波炉中。

messages.msgid: A large device consisting mainly of a tube of copper wire surrounding a large copper tube filled with high explosives.  When detonated properly, the explosives allow the device to produce large amounts of electrical energy in a very short time.
translations: 一个大型爆炸装置，其中主要部分是一根内部装满高能炸药且外部缠满电线的大型铜管。当正确引爆时，爆炸装置能在极短的时间内产生巨大的电磁脉冲。

messages.msgid: A hefty and expensive-looking golden dish engraved with concentric circuitry.  You felt the urge to rip it from a supercomputer.
translations: 一个看起来又重又贵的金制碟状物，上面刻着一圈圈的电路。 你感到有种冲动，想把它从超算上扯下来。

messages.msgid: A set of speakers implanted into your skull, that can receive local radiowaves and play downloaded music at a concert hall quality.  It is currently playing "Rubik's Mickse".
translations: 一组植入到你头骨中的扬声器，能够接收本地无线电波，并以音乐厅级音质播放下载的音乐。它正在播放“鲁比克的混音”。

messages.msgid: A set of speakers implanted into your skull, that can receive local radiowaves and play downloaded music at a concert hall quality.  It is currently listening to the radio.
translations: 一组植入到你头骨中的扬声器，能够接收本地无线电波，并以音乐厅级音质播放下载的音乐。它现在正在收听广播。

messages.msgid: Extremely thin lenses provides user with augmented reality overlay allowing the user to zoom, and it displays handy information about local topology.
translations: 为用户提供叠加增强显示的超薄镜头，可以缩放视野，展示一些有用的信息。

messages.msgid: A system of surgical-grade scalpels.  They allow you to make precise cuts on corpses.
translations: 一组外科手术刀。这让你能够对尸体进行精细的解剖。

messages.msgid: A paste of half-finished milled grains, not yet flour.
translations: 一种由碾碎的谷物制成的糊状物，还不是面粉。

messages.msgid: A handful of smoldering embers emitting smoke.  They are fading away before your eyes.
translations: 一份熏烤后留下的余烬，仍有余烟。它渐渐消失在你的眼前，随风而去。

messages.msgid: A fortune-telling device from the 1950s.  The kind of moral support you didn't know you needed.
translations: 一个源自20世纪50年代的占卜工具。提供你不知道你其实很需要的精神支撑。
一副含有52张扑克牌的扑克。

messages.msgid: A fairly new, glossy deck of 52 playing cards.
translations: 一副光滑的扑克牌，共52张，相当新。

messages.msgid: A deck of 52 playing cards.  Judging by the bent, frayed edges and faded prints, it saw its share of games.
translations: 一副老旧的扑克牌，共计52张。从它弯曲的，磨损的边缘和褪色的印花来看，想必它见识过无数次刺激游戏。

messages.msgid: A set of Uno cards meant to play a game of Uno with your companions.  Just don't yell Uno too loud to avoid attracting the undead.
translations: 一套UNO牌，用来和你的同伴玩UNO。不过现在喊UNO也可能会受到来自某些不死生物的“惩罚”。

messages.msgid: A set of cards used in the solo or two-player cooperative card game called Shadowcaser.  The deck consists of 76 unique cards.  Shadowcaser is a immersive card game set in a dream world where players find themselves trapped in a mysterious labyrinthine dream.  The objective of the game is for players to escape this dream world by unlocking eight doors before they run out of time or succumb to the nightmares haunting them.
translations: 一个用于单人或两人合作的卡牌游戏Shadowcaser中使用的卡牌套装。这副牌包含76张独特的卡牌。Shadowcaser是一个沉浸式的卡牌游戏，设定在一个梦境世界中，玩家们发现自己被困在一个神秘的迷宫梦境中。游戏的目标是让玩家在时间耗尽或被困扰的噩梦击倒之前，通过解锁八扇门来逃离这个梦境世界。

messages.msgid: A set of cards meant to play the game "Sorcery."  Each card has a fun picture of a different monster.
translations: 一整套用来玩著名"巫术"桌游的卡牌。每张卡牌上都画着一张不同怪物的有趣插画。

messages.msgid: A deck of tarot cards.  Commonly used for the practice of divination.  Each card has a unique and highly symbolic picture.
translations: 一盒塔罗牌，常用来进行塔罗占卜。每张牌上都印有独特的具有隐喻含义的图像。

messages.msgid: A deck of 52 makeshift cards, made out of cardboard rectangles with simple designs drawn on them.
translations: 一副52张自制的简易扑克，由长方形的卡纸制成，上面画着简单的图案。

messages.msgid: A photo of a smiling family on a camping trip.  One of the parents looks like a cleaner, happier version of a zombie you've seen.
translations: 一张照片，展示了一个露营的家庭，家人笑容洋溢。 其中一位家长看起来像是你曾遇见的一只丧尸——在它还干净而快乐的时候。

messages.msgid: A pair of red and silver pom poms with plastic handles.  Using them will make you start a cheerleading routine.
translations: 一对红色银色相间的带塑料手柄的啦啦队花球。使用它会让你开始啦啦队训练。

messages.msgid: A poorly-taken polaroid photo of a young man wearing bell-bottoms and a fedora.  It's pretty blurry.
translations: 一张拍得很差的拍立得照片，上面有个穿着喇叭裤、戴着软呢帽的年轻人。这张照片拍的很模糊。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a image of something, somewhere.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成某种东西的图像。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the main view of the White House in Washington, DC.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成白宫的主视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the main view of the St. Basil's Cathedral at the Red Square in Moscow, Russia.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成圣巴西尔大教堂的主视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the front view of the Big Ben in London, United Kingdom.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成大本钟的前视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the front view of the Curitiba's Botanical Garden in Curitiba, Brazil.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成库里奇巴植物园的前视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the backside view of Christ Redeemer, the Copacabana Beach, and the Pao de Acucar in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成基督像的后视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the background view of the ancient village of Machu Picchu in Machu Picchu, Peru.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成马丘比丘的背景视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the front view of the Pyramids of Giza in Al Haram, Egypt.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成吉萨金字塔的前视图。

messages.msgid: Great Wall of China jigsaw puzzle
messages.plural: Great Wall of China jigsaw puzzles

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a beautiful horizontal view of the Great Wall of China in Northern China.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成长城的平视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the front view of the Roman Colosseum in Roma, Italy.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成罗马斗兽场的前视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the background view of the Taj Mahal mausoleum in Agra, India.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成泰姬陵的背景视图。

messages.msgid: Hanging Gardens of Babylon jigsaw puzzle
messages.plural: Hanging Gardens of Babylon jigsaw puzzles

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a possible accurate representation of the Hanging Gardens of Babylon.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成巴比伦空中花园的假想图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a theoretical representation of the Statue of Zeus, a wonder that used to be at Olympia, Greece.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成宙斯象的假想图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a historical representation of the Temple of Artemis, possibly located in present-day, pre-Cataclysm Turkey.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成阿尔特弥斯神庙的假想图。
哈利卡纳苏斯陵墓拼图

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a possibly historically-accurate representation of the Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, probably located in present-day, pre-Cataclysm Turkey.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成哈利卡纳苏斯陵墓的假想图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a representation of the Colossus of Rhodes in the island of same name, Greece, that may or may not be accurate.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成罗德岛巨像的假想图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a historical representation of the Lighthouse of Alexandria, that was built in the ancient city of Alexandria, Egypt.
