translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成亚历山大灯塔的假想图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the front view of the ancient Stonehenge in Salisbury, United Kingdom.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成巨石阵的前视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the underwater view of the Great Barrier Reef in the coast of Queensland, Australia.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成大堡礁的水下视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the forms the horizontal view of the Mount Everest, located at the Himalayan Mountain Range.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成珠穆朗玛峰的平视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the horizontal view of Mount Fuji, at the Japanese island of Honshu.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当全部拼放放正确时，会形水平图画，展现出处于日本本州岛的富士山。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a magnificent upper view of the Victoria Falls at the border between Zambia and Zimbabwe.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成维多利亚瀑布的顶视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the natural view of the Paricutín Volcano, located in the Michoacán State, Mexico.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成帕里库廷火山的视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a interior view of the Angkor Wat temple complex in Cambodia.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成吴哥窟的内部视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the natural view of the Guanabara Bay in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成瓜纳巴拉湾的视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the rocky view of the Grand Canyon, at the State of Arizona.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成科罗拉多大峡谷的视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the otherworldly beautiful view of the Northern Lights (Aurora Borealis) which occur most often in the Arctic Circle and polar regions.
translations: 一个装有 1000 块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会构成壮观的北极光图案。
阿卡迪亚国家公园拼图

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the natural view of the entrance of the Acadia National Park, located in Maine.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成阿卡迪亚国家公园的视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the front view of the Mark Twain House in Connecticut.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成马克吐温故居的前视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the front view of the Mount Rushmore National Memorial in South Dakota.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成拉什莫尔山的前视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the beautiful front view of the Portland Head Light in Maine.  Its picturesque setting overlooking the Atlantic Ocean is outstanding!
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成波特兰灯塔的前视图。

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the beautiful front view of the Eiffel Tower in Paris, France.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成埃菲尔铁塔的前视图。

messages.msgid: The Statue of Liberty jigsaw puzzle
messages.plural: The Statue of Liberty jigsaw puzzles

messages.msgid: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms the unique, beautiful front view of the Statue of Liberty, in New York.
translations: 一个装有1000块拼图的纸箱，当它们都被摆放正确时，会形成自由女神像的前视图。

messages.msgid: Not really a set, just a sheet of paper with a big '#' drawn at the center, alongside three buttons of a specific color, three others from a different color and a proper container for storing it properly.  You can play tic tac toe indefinitely with that!
translations: 一张画着井字的纸，可以用来玩井字棋。

messages.msgid: Twenty eight rectangular pieces of cardboard, with dots on them so you can use it to play dominoes.  It has also a proper container for storing them all in place.
translations: 装在一个容器里的28块带点的长方形纸板，可以用它来玩多米诺骨牌。

messages.msgid: A pair of smaller checkered wooden boards that together form a compact checkerboard.  Useful as timber or for crafting a smaller chess or checkers board.
translations: 一对较小的棋盘格木板，合在一起形成一个紧凑式棋盘，可用作木材或作为较小的国际象棋或跳棋棋盘使用。

messages.msgid: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of chess.
translations: 一个里面装着玩一盘国际象棋所需的整套棋子的木箱。

messages.msgid: A smaller and compact counterpart of the standard chess set, perfect for casual play and travel.  It contains all the pieces needed to play a game of chess.
translations: 与标准国际象棋相比，体积更小、更紧凑，非常适合在旅行途中游玩。它包含了下棋所需的所有棋子。

messages.msgid: A wooden box containing a set of round tokens used to play checkers.
translations: 一个木箱，里面装着玩一盘国际跳棋所需的整套圆形棋子。

messages.msgid: A modest wooden box containing a square base, two small triangles, two large triangles, a parallelogram, and a rhombus, all painted in different colors to play the traditional Chinese puzzle of tangram.  At the box, there are several figures that you can make with the pieces.
translations: 一个朴素的木盒，正方形底座由两个小三角形、两个大三角形、一个平行四边形和一个菱形拼成，都涂上了不同的颜色，用来玩中国传统的七巧板游戏。里面还标注着你能拼成的其他形状。

messages.msgid: A wooden box containing a wooden board with a star-shaped pattern, ten holes in each of its six arms, and a set of round pegs used to play Chinese checkers.  In the box, there's a comprehensible explanation of how to play the game.
translations: 木盒里面有一个带有星形图案的木板，六个边各有十个洞，还有一组用来玩中国跳棋的圆栓。里面还有一个份游戏说明书。

messages.msgid: A somewhat large wooden box containing a rectangular wooden board with a series of small pits, as well as a number of game pieces that look like different colored beads.  The board features two rows of pits, with each player controlling the row of pits closest to them.  The game pieces are distributed evenly among the pits at the beginning of the game, and players take turns picking up and redistributing the pieces according to the rules.  In the box, there's a comprehensible step-by-step guide on how to play.
translations: 一个有点大的木盒，内含一块长方形的木板，木板上面挖出了许多小坑，还有一副不同颜色的游戏棋子。棋盘上有两排坑，每个玩家控制最靠近他们的一排坑。游戏开始时，棋子均匀地分布在各个坑中，玩家根据规则轮流拾取和重新分配棋子。游戏盒中自带一份简单易懂的游戏说明书。

messages.msgid: A cardboard box containing a plastic grid with seven columns and six rows, and 42 colored discs, alongside a small booklet explaining how to play Four in a Row.
translations: 一个纸板箱，里面装着一个七列六排的塑料棋盘，以及42枚彩色棋子，旁边还有一本小册子，详细说明了如何玩四子棋。

messages.msgid: A cardboard box containing a grid, and various tiles akin to a classic deck of cards, alongside a booklet explaining how to play Rummy-o.
translations: 一个纸箱，里面有一个格子和类似扑克牌的瓷牌，旁边还有一本解释如何玩拉密牌的小册子。

messages.msgid: A cardboard box containing a grid, and various round black and white pieces, alongside a booklet explaining how to play Reversi.
translations: 一个纸盒，里面有一个网格和各种圆形的黑白棋子，旁边还有一本解释如何玩黑白棋的小册子。

messages.msgid: A board game cardboard box containing a proper board, and various letter tiles, meant to play Scrabble Letters alone or with friends.
translations: 一种叫拼字游戏的棋盘游戏，里面有适当的棋盘和各种字母卡片，用来独自或与朋友玩拼字游戏。

messages.msgid: A small and compact wooden box containing a set of round tokens used to play checkers.  Perfect for casual play and travel.
translations: 一个小巧的木盒，里面装有一组用于玩跳棋的圆形代币。非常适合休闲娱乐和旅行。

messages.msgid: A piece of paper scribbled with a pattern identical to the checkerboard on a, well, checkerboard, along with all the necessary pieces and a container to store everything properly inside.
translations: 一张纸上潦草涂画了棋盘格的图案，与所有必要的棋子及其他物件恰好地装在一个容器里。

messages.msgid: A game where one player draws an image, and the others attempt to guess what it is.
translations: 一种游戏，一个人画图，另一个试着猜所画的是什么。

messages.msgid: A game where players traverse around the board, buying property and swindling their friends.
translations: 一种桌面游戏，玩家在棋盘上周游、购买地产、敲诈其他玩家。

messages.msgid: A wooden board with the alphabet and numbers on its face.  Commonly used for communing with spirits of the dead.  A planchette is included in the set.
translations: 一块带有字母和数字的木板，常用来与灵体接触交流。还附带有一个通灵占写板。

messages.msgid: A roleplaying game set in the post-apocalypse, so you can pretend to survive the apocalypse while surviving the apocalypse.
translations: 一个以末日为背景的角色扮演游戏，你可以在大灾变中求生之余假装自己在末日之后求生。

messages.msgid: A roleplaying game set in the a fantasy medieval world with goblins and orcs.  You can be a mage, a warrior, or a barbarian and go on epic adventures.
translations: 一套角色扮演桌面游戏，背景设置在一个充满哥布林和兽人的中世纪幻想世界。你可以扮演一个法师，一个战士，或一个野蛮人，来一场史诗般的冒险。

messages.msgid: A roleplaying game set in the Stone Age.  There, you can choose different places in the world to start, select many different classes, and different species of hominids to survive the primitive world.
translations: 一款以石器时代为背景的角色扮演游戏。在这里，你可以选择在世界上不同地区开始，并选择数个不同职业和不同物种的古人类在原始世界中求生。

messages.msgid: A strategy game featuring a set of tiny figurines of fantasy creatures.
translations:
一个战略游戏，附带了各种奇幻生物和角色的小模型。
“我不可能告诉你任何事情饿啊啊啊啊啊！”

messages.msgid: A strategy game featuring a set of tiny figurines of space aliens and grotesque space marines.
translations:
一个战略游戏，附带了各种太空外星怪兽和奇异太空军人的小模型。
“我不可能告诉你任何事情饿啊啊啊啊啊！”

messages.plural: sets of Settlers of the Ranch

messages.msgid: A strategy game where players build settlements and trade for supplies.
translations: 一个战略游戏，玩家扮演拓荒者建设营地并交易各种补给。

messages.msgid: A fun strategy board game where players (or just a player, since you can play this alone as a solitaire board game) attempt to improve their farms by plowing fields, sowing crops, raising livestock, and expanding their families.  The game is set in the European farming community during the 17th century.
translations: 一款有趣的战略棋盘游戏，玩家们（或者你自己，因为你可以独自游玩这款棋盘游戏）通过耕田、播种、饲养牲畜和扩大家庭来改善农场。游戏背景设定在17世纪的欧洲农业社区。

messages.msgid: A interesting strategy board game where players (or just a player, since you can play this alone as a solitaire board game) take roles of farmers in Ancient China, attempting to sell their crops at the market.  The game revolves around managing resources, fulfilling orders, and expanding the farm to become the most successful farmer.
translations: 一套有趣的棋盘策略游戏，玩家们（或是单人游玩）扮演古代中国的农场主，尝试在市场上销售他们的农作物。管理资源、履行订单，扩展农场成为最成功的农民吧。

messages.msgid: A fun solo deck-building board game where a player takes on the role of Robinson Crusoe's mentor, trying to help him survive and escape from a deserted island.  This game is played in rounds, with the player using their deck-building skills to improve Robinson's abilities and combat various challenges that arise during his time on the island.
translations: 一款有趣的单人卡牌建造游戏，玩家将扮演鲁滨逊·克鲁索的顾问，帮助他从荒岛上生存下来并逃离。游戏分回合进行，玩家使用他们的卡牌技能来提高鲁滨逊的能力，并应对他在岛上时出现的各种挑战。

messages.msgid: A thematic adventure board game designed for solo play.  It is based on Jules Verne's classic novel '20,000 Leagues Under the Sea' and allows players to step into the role of Captain Nemo as they navigate the oceans, encounter various challenges, and make critical decisions that impact their journey.
translations: 一款为单人设计的主题冒险桌游。游戏基于儒勒·凡尔纳的经典小说《海底两万里》，让玩家扮演尼莫船长的角色，在海洋中航行，遇到各种挑战，并做出影响他们旅程的关键决定。

messages.msgid: A highly strategic board game that combines elements of role-playing games with deck-building and traditional board game mechanics.  Players (or a solo player) take on the roles of powerful Knights Mages who explore the land, conquer cities, and engage in epic battles against various enemies.  The game features an intricate leveling system where players can enhance their characters' abilities and acquire new skills as they progress through the game.
translations: 这款高度战略性的桌游结合了角色扮演游戏、卡牌构建和传统桌游机制的元素。玩家将扮演强大的骑士法师的角色，探索土地、征服城市，并与各种敌人进行史诗般的战斗。游戏具有复杂的升级系统，玩家可以在游戏中提升角色的能力并获得新技能。

messages.msgid: A intriguing and critically acclaimed cooperative board game where players (or just the player, as it can be played alone as a solitaire board game) take on different roles with unique abilities as members of a disease control team.  Their objective is to prevent global outbreaks and find cures for four deadly diseases before they escalate out of control.
translations: 一个有趣且广受好评的合作棋盘游戏，玩家们（也可单人游玩）扮演疾病防控团队成员的不同角色，具有独特的能力。他们的目标是在四种致命疾病升级失控之前，防止全球爆发并找到治疗方法。

messages.msgid: A strategy board game set in an alternate history, steampunk-themed world, where players assume the roles of workers, engineers, and factory owners in a fictional 1920's Eastern European country.  This game focuses on area control, engine building, and resource management, as players aim to achieve victory through various paths, such as military conquest, building up their factories, or completing secret objectives.  The best part?  You can play it alone too.
translations: 这款策略棋盘游戏设定在一个蒸汽朋克主题的架空历史世界中，玩家在虚构的 20 世纪 20 年代的东欧国家扮演工人、工程师和工厂主的角色。这款游戏侧重于区域控制、引擎建造和资源管理，玩家通过各种途径，如军事征服、建造工厂或完成秘密目标，以取得胜利。最棒的是，你也可以独自玩。

messages.msgid: A cooperative board game designed for 1-4 players, where each player takes on the role of a powerful deity defending an island from colonizing invaders.  Before the Cataclysm, inside the board gaming community, it was known for its deep strategic gameplay, thematic richness, and intricate mechanics.
translations: 这款合作桌面游戏是为1-4名玩家设计的，每个玩家扮演一个强大的神明，保卫岛屿免受殖民侵略者的侵扰。在大灾变发生之前，在桌面游戏社区内部，它以其深刻的战略游戏玩法、丰富的主题和复杂的机制而闻名。

messages.msgid: This board game is set in the 4300s, where corporations are working together to terraform the planet Mercury, the smallest and innermost planet in our solar system.  Each player (or just the player) will have unique abilities and resources at their disposal, and they will need to strategize and cooperate with one another to achieve their goals.
translations: 这个桌游背景设定在公元4300年，各大公司正在合作进行对水星的改造，水星是我们太阳系中最小、最靠近太阳的行星。每个玩家（或者只有一个玩家）都拥有独特的能力和资源，他们需要制定策略并合作以实现自己的目标。

messages.msgid: This board game is set in the 2400s, where corporations are working together to terraform the planet Mars and make it habitable for human life.  Players (or just a single player) take on the roles of these corporations and compete to contribute to the terraforming process by raising temperature, creating oceans, and cultivating greenery on the Martian surface.
translations: 这个桌游背景设定在公元2400年，各大公司共同努力，将火星进行改造，使其适合人类居住。玩家们（或者只有一个玩家）扮演竞争公司，通过提高温度、创造海洋和在火星表面培育绿色植物来改造火星。

messages.msgid: Another epic edition of the Terraforming board game series, it is set in the 2700s.  The player OR the players take on the role of corporations competing to transform Venus into a habitable planet by increasing its temperature, oxygen levels, and increasing the number of oceans.  The game progresses through several rounds, with each round consisting of various phases.
translations: 系列桌游星际拓荒的又一个版本，背景设定在公元2700年。玩家或玩家们扮演竞争公司，通过提高温度、氧气水平和增加海洋数量来将金星转变为适宜居住的行星。游戏将会持续几个回合，每个回合包括各种各样的阶段。

messages.msgid: The largest edition of Terraforming, this epic board game is set in the 5000s, where players (or just the player) take on the role of corporations competing to terraform and colonize the gas giant Jupiter and its moons (the Jovian System).  This game combines elements of strategy, resource management, and exploration as players work to transform the hostile environment of the Jovian System into a habitable zone for human civilization.
translations: 系列桌游星际拓荒最为宏大的一个版本，背景设定在公元5000年，玩家们（或单个玩家）扮演竞争公司进行气体巨星木星及其卫星（木卫系统）改造和殖民。这个游戏结合了战略、资源管理和探索元素，玩家们努力将木卫系统的恶劣环境转变为适合人类文明居住的区域。

messages.msgid: This board game is set in the 4600s, and there, the player or the players take on the role of corporations competing to terraform and/or colonize Saturn's moons, rings and Saturn itself, to make them habitable for human life.  The game combines elements of strategy, resource management, and area control, offering an immersive experience for players.
translations: 这款桌游的背景设定在公元4600年，单名或多名玩家扮演多家企业，竞相改造并殖民土星的卫星、星环以及土星本身，将它们改造变得适宜人类居住。游戏结合了策略、资源管理和区域控制等要素，为玩家提供了沉浸式体验。

messages.msgid: Another edition of the acclaimed board game Terraforming, this time set in the 3000s, where players or the player (again) take on the role of corporations working together to terraform the planet Uranus though various ways, such as increasing temperature, developing a proper atmosphere and development of oxygen.
translations: 备受赞誉的系列桌游星际拓荒的又一个版本，背景设定在公元3000年，玩家们或玩家（再次）扮演竞争公司，通过各种方式来对天王星进行开拓，例如提高温度、创造适宜的大气层和氧气等。

messages.msgid: This board game is set in the 2800s, and just like it's prequels, either a single player or players take on the roles of terraforming corporations, competing to transform the planet Neptune into a habitable environment for human life.
translations: 这个桌游的背景设定在公元2800年，像系列作品一样，由一个或多个玩家扮演竞争公司，将海王星改造变成适合人类居住的环境。

messages.msgid: The smallest set of the Terraforming series, this board game is set in the 2700s in the outer reaches of our solar system.  In this game, players take on the roles of corporations competing to terraform and colonize the dwarf planet Pluto, utilizing resources, technology, and strategic decision-making to transform the icy world into a habitable environment.
translations: 系列桌游星际拓荒中最轻量的一个版本，设定在公元2700年的太阳系边缘。在游戏中，玩家扮演竞争公司，对冥王星进行开拓和殖民，利用资源、技术和战略决策，将这个冰冷的世界转变为适宜居住的环境。

messages.msgid: This board game is set in the 5000s, a distant future where Earth has become uninhabitable due to climate change, resource depletion, and overpopulation.  The player or players must work together to restore the planet's ecosystems, atmosphere, and climate while also competing for resources and prestige.
translations: 这款桌游背景设定在公元5000年，在遥远的未来，地球因气候变化、资源枯竭和人口过剩而变得不再宜居。玩家必须共同努力，恢复行星的生态系统、大气和气候，同时竞争资源和声望。

messages.msgid: A fun strategy board game that simulates the experience of running a vineyard in Tuscany, Italy.  Players take on the roles of vineyard owners who must plant vines, harvest grapes, produce wine, and fulfill orders to earn victory points.  The game is played over several seasons, with players making strategic decisions about which actions to take each season to maximize their vineyard's productivity and efficiency.
translations: 一款有趣的策略桌游，模拟在意大利托斯卡纳经营葡萄园的体验。玩家扮演葡萄园主，种植葡萄藤，收获葡萄，酿造葡萄酒，履行订单以赢取胜利点。游戏分为几个季节进行，玩家需要在每个季节做出战略决策，以最大化他们葡萄园的生产力和效率。

messages.msgid: In this great strategy board game, players (or the player) assume the role of a Viking chieftain, aiming to expand their territory, amass wealth, and gain favor with the Norse gods.  Players take turns performing actions, such as exploring new territories, constructing buildings, raiding settlements, and trading goods.
translations: 在这个绝妙的策略棋盘游戏中，玩家（或玩家）扮演维京酋长的角色，扩展领土，积累财富，并获得北欧神灵的青睐。玩家轮流行动，探索新领土，建造建筑物，袭击定居点和交易商品。

messages.msgid: A great strategy board game set in the 18th century in the East Frisia region of Germany, where players (or the player) take on the roles of farmers who are developing their farms and expanding their resources.
translations: 一个绝妙的策略棋盘游戏，设定在德国东弗里斯兰地区的18世纪，玩家们（或玩家）扮演农场主，发展他们的农场并扩大资源。

messages.msgid: A great cooperation-focused fantasy board game set in a dark and evolving fantasy world where players take on the roles of mercenaries seeking fortune and glory in the city of Emporium and its surrounding areas.  This game is characterized by its legacy-style gameplay, which means that decisions made during one play session can have lasting effects on future sessions.  Players must work together to explore dungeons, battle monsters, complete quests, and make choices that shape the narrative and outcome of their campaign.
translations: 一个着重于多人协作的奇幻桌游，背景设定在一个不断进化的黑暗幻想世界，玩家扮演寻求财富和荣耀的雇佣兵，在艾普琳城及其周边地区展开冒险。这款游戏以传承式的玩法为特色，这意味着在一次游戏会话中做出的决策可能会对未来的游戏会话产生持久的影响。玩家必须共同努力，探索地下城，与怪物战斗，完成任务，并做出决定故事发展和战役结果的选择。

messages.plural: sets of Le Pourt: The Inland Port

messages.msgid: A strategy board game where players (or the player) aim to amass wealth and construct buildings to expand their harbors while carefully managing their resources in the fictitious French region of Le Pourt.  This game involves strategic decision-making as players must balance their investments in buildings, ships, and resources to maximize their profits.
translations: 一款策略桌游，玩家们（或玩家）通过积累财富并建造设施来扩展自己的港口，在虚构的法国勒普尔特地区协调手中的资源。这个游戏着重于战略决策，因为玩家必须平衡他们在建筑物、船只和资源上的投资，以最大化他们的利润。

messages.msgid: A cooperative horror board game set in the Lovecraftian Universe.  It offers an immersive gameplay experience where players work together to solve mysteries and confront otherworldly horrors.  This game is scenario-based, with each scenario presenting a unique narrative and set of challenges for the players to overcome.  Players must explore the game board, gather clues, solve puzzles, and engage in combat encounters while uncovering the secrets hidden within the mansion or other eerie locations.
translations: 一个设定在洛夫克拉夫特宇宙中的恐怖协作桌游。它提供沉浸式的游戏体验，玩家们共同努力解决谜团并面对异界恐怖。这款游戏着重于剧情，每个情节都呈现出独特的叙事并提供一系列挑战供玩家克服。玩家必须进行探索，收集线索，解决谜题，并在探索庄园或其他可怕地点隐藏的秘密时进行遭遇战。

messages.msgid: A strategic board game that simulates the rise and fall of nations.  A great civilization-building game designed for 1-4 players.  Each player takes on the role of leading an ancient civilization, making strategic decisions to develop their nation over the course of several ages.  This game involves managing resources, constructing buildings, and competing with other players to achieve dominance in various aspects such as military strength, culture, and economy.
translations: 一个模拟国家兴衰的战略桌游。专为1-4名玩家设计的绝妙文明模拟游戏。每个玩家扮演领导古代文明的角色，在数个时代中做出战略决策来发展自己的国家。这个游戏涉及资源管理、建筑构建，并与其他玩家竞争，以在军事实力、文化和经济等各个方面取得优势。

messages.msgid: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of senet, along with a rule booklet.  A board game from ancient Egypt, Senet plays like modern chess with a 3x10 grid and a smaller amount of pieces.
translations: 一个木盒，内含一整套赛内特棋，以及一本玩法小指南。来自古埃及的棋盘类游戏，它像现代国际象棋一样用3x10棋盘格玩，棋子则较少。

messages.msgid: A very beautiful, and really huge plastic box, containing all the pieces needed to play a game of mahjong, along with a poorly-translated but comprehensible rule booklet.  Mahjong is a tile-based game where you need to match pieces into winning hands to earn points.
translations: 一个非常漂亮的巨大塑料盒子，里面装着一整套麻将牌，还有一本极其小，翻译得很糟糕，但简明易懂的打麻将指南。麻将是一种棋牌游戏，你需要在牌组中找到成对的麻将牌，并获得最大的分数。

messages.msgid: A polished wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of chaturanga chess, along with a rule booklet.  Chaturanga is an ancient Indian strategy game, the ancestor of many other chess variations - European, Chinese, Japanese, and other regional variants of chess owe it their origin.
translations: 一个抛光的木盒，内含一整套古印度象棋，以及一份玩法小指南。古印度象棋(Chaturanga)是一种古老的印度战略游戏，是许多其他象棋变体——欧洲象棋、中国象棋、日本象棋等的祖先。

messages.msgid: A very nice dark wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of backgammon, along with a handwritten set of rules.  The objective of the game is to be the first to remove all fifteen of your own pieces from the board.
translations: 一个非常漂亮的深色木盒，里面有玩双陆棋（又叫十五子棋）所需的所有棋子，还有一套手写的规则。 游戏的目的是第一个把自己的15个棋子从棋盘上移走。

messages.msgid: A small wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of latrunculi, along with a rule booklet.  Latrunculi was played throughout the Roman Empire, and requires a lot of tactics and strategy.
translations: 一个小木盒，里面有玩强盗游戏（latrunculi，意为"来自latrunculus的士兵游戏"或"强盗的游戏"）所需的所有棋子，还有一份玩法小指南。这是一种双人战略棋盘游戏，曾经整个罗马帝国都在玩，它需要大量的战术和策略。

messages.msgid: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of go, along with a bilingual English/Mandarin rule booklet.  Go is a two-player game where each player tries to grab more territory than their opponent.
translations: 一个木盒，内含下围棋所需的所有棋子，以及一本英文/普通话双语规则手册。 围棋是一种双人游戏，每个玩家都试图比他们的对手抢夺更多的领土。

messages.msgid: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of shogi, along with a bilingual English/Japanese rule booklet.  Also known as Japanese chess, shogi was one of the most popular board games in Japan before the Cataclysm.  The main objective is to tsumi (checkmate) the opponent's osho (king).
translations: 一个木盒，里面装着一整套将棋，还有一份极小的玩法指南，其中有一些日文字符。它也被称为日本象棋，是一种供两人玩的战略棋盘游戏。在大灾变之前，它曾经是日本最流行的棋类游戏之一，主要目标是通过战略，tsumi（将军）掉对方的osho（王）。

messages.msgid: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of hnefatafl, along with a rule booklet that features heavy use of Norse runes.  Also called 'Viking Chess', it was a popular game in medieval Scandinavia.  The player controlling the attackers (located on the sides of the board), wins by capturing the defender's king, while the defender wins by getting the king to one of the four corners of the board.
translations: 一个木盒，里面装着整套板棋，还有一份极小的玩法指南，上面写着一些北欧的规则。它也被称为"维京棋"，是中世纪斯堪的纳维亚半岛的一种流行游戏，有进攻方和防守方，进攻方（位于棋盘的边缘）必须抓住防守方的国王，同时防守方要把国王送到棋盘四角的其中一个上。

messages.msgid: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of alquerque, along with a rule booklet.  Alquerque is of Middle Eastern origin, and is an ancestor to checkers and Fanorona.
translations: 一个木盒里装有玩中东跳棋所需的所有棋子，还有一本规则手册。 中东跳棋起源于中东，是跳棋和迂棋的祖先。

messages.msgid: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of dominoes.  The pieces of this one are perfectly handmade in light wood.
translations: 一个木盒，里面装着一整套多米诺骨牌，每一块都由浅色木材手工制成，工艺非常完美。

messages.msgid: A cardboard tube containing 60 pieces in various colors for playing a casual pick-up sticks game alone or with friends.  The rules and different values of each color are printed on the tube.
translations: 一个包含60个不同颜色棋子的纸板管，可用于单独或与朋友一起玩休闲的捡棍子游戏。 规则和每种颜色的不同价值都印在管子上。

messages.msgid: A board game for two or more players, regarded before the Cataclysm as a worldwide classic.  The objective of the game is to navigate one's game piece to the goal on the board, helped by climbing ladders but hindered by sliding down snakes.
translations: 一款供两个或更多玩家使用的棋盘游戏，在大灾变之前被认为是全球经典。 游戏的目的是将自己的棋子引向棋盘上的目标，可以通过爬梯子来帮助自己，但也会受到从蛇身上滑下的阻碍。

messages.msgid: A strategy board game for two to four players, in which the players race their four tokens from start to finish according to the rolls of a single die.
translations: 英国十字戏是一种供2至4人游玩的策略棋盘游戏，玩家们要根据一颗骰子的掷出结果，抢先让自己的4颗棋子全部从起点移动到终点。(注 : 传入中国后被改造成为了"飞行棋")

messages.msgid: A game of chance featuring a silly-looking pirate inside a spring-loaded barrel.  Players take turns inserting plastic swords into slots in the barrel, hoping to avoid the trigger slot that causes the pirate to be launched out of the barrel.
translations: 这是一个概率游戏，其特点是在一个已经复位的弹簧桶内有个看起来傻不啦叽的海盗。 玩家轮流将塑料剑插入桶壁上的插槽，希望避开触发槽，使海盗被推出桶外。

messages.msgid: A board wargame that can be played alone or with friends.  When playing alone, the opponent's actions are chosen via tables, charts, and a 'paragraph book'.
translations: 这是一款可以一个人或与朋友一起玩的棋盘战争游戏。 当独自游戏时，对手的行动是通过表格、图表和 "段落书 "决定的。（ "段落书 "是指一个小笔记本，存着游戏的提示和任务。玩家可通过翻阅"段落书 "来了解游戏的情节和需完成的任务。）

messages.msgid: A tactical solitaire board game.  The player is put in the role of a patrol leader in different modern battlefield scenarios, performing missions, capturing or killing enemies, protecting their teammates, and advancing on the map.
translations: 巡逻队长是一种战术单人棋牌游戏。在这个游戏中，玩家要在不同的现代战场场景中扮演一个巡逻队长的角色，执行任务，捕捉或杀死敌人，保护队友，并在地图中前进。非常准确和逼真，如果你喜欢棋盘游戏，保证会很有趣。

messages.msgid: A tactical solitaire board game.  The player controls a platoon of tanks in six different scenarios with various victory conditions.  The player travels across the map, entering combat when an 'event marker' comes into their line of sight.
translations: 一个战术性的单人棋盘桌游。玩家在六个不同的场景中控制一个排的坦克，有各种胜利条件。玩家在地图上旅行，当"事件标记"进入他们的视线时就进入战斗。

messages.msgid: A game where players try to guess where the opponent placed their ships on the board.
translations: 一种双人游戏，玩家猜测对手放置战舰的位置并试图击毁所有敌方战舰的游戏。

messages.msgid: A game where players try to figure out who murdered the butler.
translations: 一个玩家试图找出杀害管家的凶手的游戏。

messages.msgid: An old, nondescript North American Cylinder key.  Lord knows what lock it goes to; best not to bother with it.
translations: 一把北美西林德公司生产的锁具钥匙，老旧而普通。天知道它是开什么锁的，最好不要去管它。

messages.msgid: A set of small blades that pinch together to cut the end off of a cigar.
translations: 一套刀片，夹在一起能剪断雪茄的末端。

messages.msgid: A small tube meant to cut a hole in the end of a cigar.
translations: 一根用来在雪茄末端开洞的小管子。

messages.msgid:
A sturdy steel briefcase, containing what appears to be an old-fashioned drum seismograph.  The stenciled acronyms of its outer case imply it was used by XEDRA as some sort of recording device.

Thin parallel lines cover both ends of the drum, but as they approach the middle their vibrations intensify, until the ink fuses into a thick red stain.
translations:
一个坚固的钢质公文包，里面装着一个看起来像老式鼓形地震仪的设备。从箱子上的缩写字母可以推断出它曾被XEDRA用作某种记录设备。 

记录鼓的两端有着细小的平行线，当它们靠近中心时，振动强度逐渐加大，直至墨水融成厚厚的红色印痕。

messages.msgid: A squat tripod supports what appears to be a rather long microphone encased within a glass ampoule.  You can't tell whether it's meant to record audio, or something else entirely.
translations: 一个矮三脚架上安装着一个很长的麦克风，它被包裹在一个玻璃罩子里。你不知道它是用来录音的，还是用来干别的什么的。

messages.msgid: A small rod giving off a nice smell.
translations: 一根散发出香味的小棍子。

messages.msgid: A short writ featuring the signed agreement of establishing a trade route.
translations: 一份签署有同意建立贸易路线的法律文书。

messages.msgid: A plastic ruler used to measure lengths of smaller objects.  This one measures 15 cm.
translations: 一把用于测量较小物体长度的塑料尺，尺寸为 15 厘米。

messages.msgid: A small eraser used to clear up unwanted pencil handwriting.
translations: 用于清除不需要的铅笔笔迹的小橡皮擦。

messages.msgid: A small sharpener used to keep pencils in working order.
translations: 一种用来保持铅笔正常工作的小卷笔刀。

messages.msgid: A non-slip mat with a welcoming message.  Once used to keep a house clean and inviting.
translations: 一块印着"欢迎"的防滑地垫。曾用于保持住宅整洁，并营造友好的氛围。

messages.msgid: A brief with the word LIXA on the official letterhead, for distribution to the onsite staff.
translations: 一份使用LIXA作为正式抬头字样的简报，分发给现场员工。

messages.msgid: A sheaf of papers containing a truly dizzying assortment of graphs, diagrams, and equations, on LIXA letterhead.
translations: 一捆使用LIXA抬头的记录纸，里面记录了各种各样令人眼花缭乱的图表和方程式。

messages.msgid: A signed and serialed notice distributed to LIXA's onsite military police.
translations: 一份署名且编号的通知，分发给LIXA现场宪兵。

messages.msgid: A black glass model of an old, tattered little book with a broken spine.  To your surprise, it can be opened to a place in the middle.  Inside, the pages are blank and perfectly reflective.
translations: 一本破旧、书脊断裂的黑色玻璃书。 让你惊讶的是，这本书有一页是可以打开的，然而，除了反光，你什么都看不见。

messages.msgid: A glass model of an apple that has begun to rot.  In places, it sags away from the core.  Inside, the seeds are still pristine.
translations: 一个腐烂的玻璃苹果，它的一些果肉已经变得蔫耷了，但里面的种子依然完好无损。

messages.msgid: A black glass model of an old sailing ship, with a gaping hole smashed in the side of the hull.  It's certainly no longer suited for long voyages.
translations: 一艘老旧的黑色玻璃帆船，船体侧面被砸出一个大洞。 它再也无法远航了。

messages.msgid: A shard of black glass that is almost impossible to touch without cutting yourself.  It doesn't reflect anything, but sometimes you think you catch a glimpse of something in it anyway.
translations: 一块黑色的玻璃碎片，如果你不想割伤自己就别去碰它。 它的表面反射不了任何光线，但有时你会觉得你从中瞥见了一些东西。

messages.msgid: A piece of graphite-based artwork someone has drawn on a spare sheet of paper.
translations: 一件铅笔艺术作品，某人在空白纸张上画出来的。

messages.msgid: This one is a collection of assorted doodles of goofy cartoon characters in varying styles.
translations: 这幅作品汇集了各种风格的搞笑卡通人物的涂鸦。

messages.msgid: This one is a collection of assorted doodles, many have dark imagery and shadowy figures.  It's kind of disturbing.
translations: 这幅作品汇集了各种风格的涂鸦，其中许多都有黑暗的图像和人影。令人不安。

messages.msgid: This one is a <sketch_concept_description> <random_character_pose_dark>.  <artist_identifying_info>.  It gives off a sense of unease.
translations: 这幅画上画着一个<random_character_pose_dark>的<sketch_concept_description>。<artist_identifying_info>。十分令人不安。

messages.msgid: This one is a <sketch_concept_description> <random_character_pose>.  <artist_identifying_info>.  It would appear that this is some sort of concept art.
translations: 这幅素描画着一个<random_character_pose>的<sketch_concept_description>。<artist_identifying_info>。这似乎是某种概念艺术。

messages.msgid: A painting that someone has made.
This painting depicts a <sketch_concept_description> <random_character_pose>.  It seems to have been <painting_type_with_style>.  <artist_identifying_info>.
translations: 这幅人像画了一个<random_character_pose>的<sketch_concept_description>。画似乎<painting_type_with_style>。<artist_identifying_info>。

messages.msgid: This painting depicts a <landscape_description>.  It seems to have been <painting_type_with_style>.  <artist_identifying_info>.
This painting depicts <abstract_art_type>.  It seems to have been <painting_type>.  <artist_identifying_info>.
A piece of canvas on a collapsible aluminum frame.  Used to catch bugs or fish, but might not be as useful for the mutated ones.  It must be extended to use.
translations: 一块帆布挂在可折叠的铝制框架上。它被用于捕捉昆虫或鱼，但对变异昆虫可能不是很有用。它必须被展开才能使用。

messages.msgid: You snap open your butterfly net.
translations: 你啪嗒一下展开了你的蝴蝶网。

messages.msgid: A piece of canvas on a collapsible aluminum frame.  Used to catch bugs or fish, but might not be as useful for the mutated ones.
translations: 一块帆布挂在可折叠的铝制框架上。它被用于捕捉昆虫或鱼，但对变异昆虫可能不是很有用。

messages.msgid: A piece of canvas stretched over a stick.  Used to catch bugs or fish, but might not be as useful for the mutated ones.
translations: 一块伸张的帆布挂在一根棍子上。它被用于捕捉昆虫或鱼，但对变异昆虫可能不是很有用。

messages.msgid: A set with a key and a small lock, resembling a padlock if the shackle was replaced by a steel cable.  This design allows the cable to fit into the chamber of a firearm and lock, preventing the firearm from functioning.  An import part of gun safety, it is required by law to be sold with any firearm.
translations: 一套带钥匙的小锁具，看起来像是把挂锁的U形扣换成了一根钢缆。这种设计让钢缆能穿入枪膛并锁住，使枪支无法击发。作为枪支安全的重要部件，法律要求它必须随任何枪支一同出售。

messages.msgid: Extremely pure alcohol suitable for use as a component in chemical reactions.  You could also water it down and drink it, or use it as fuel in an alcohol-burning stove.
translations: 一些高纯度酒精，可用于进行化学反应。稀释后可以饮用，或者用来做酒精炉的燃料。

messages.msgid: A high-strength ethanol solution mixed with methanol to make it toxic to drink, so as to avoid pre-apocalyptic regulations on ethanol.  Intended for use in alcohol-burning stoves and as a solvent.
translations: 一种高浓度酒精溶液，为了使其具有毒性无法饮用而掺有甲醇，以此来规避大灾变前的酒类管制制度。可用作酒精炉燃料或化学溶剂。

messages.msgid: A high-strength ethanol solution mixed with denatonium benzoate to make it impossibly bitter to drink, so as to avoid pre-apocalyptic regulations on ethanol.  Intended for use in alcohol-burning stoves and as a solvent.
translations: 一种高纯度酒精溶液，混入了俗称苦精的苯甲地那铵，使其苦得无法饮用，以此来规避大灾变前的相关酒类法规。可用于酒精炉燃料或化学溶剂。

messages.msgid: High-purity methanol suitable for use in chemical reactions.  Could also be used as fuel in an alcohol-burning stove.  Very toxic.
translations: 一种高纯度甲醇溶液，可用于某些化学反应。也可供酒精炉燃烧。有剧毒。

messages.msgid: A petroleum-based fuel made from a byproduct of the gasoline making process.
translations: 一种从加工汽油的副产品中提炼出来的石化燃料。

messages.msgid: A kerosene-based fuel used mainly by US military vehicles as a replacement for diesel and jet fuel, to simplify logistics.
translations: 一种基于煤油制成的特种燃料，主要被美国军用载具当作柴油和航空燃油的替代品，以简化后勤需求。

messages.msgid: A specialized type of petroleum-based fuel used to power aircraft.
translations: 一种特殊的石油燃料，用于为飞机提供动力。

messages.msgid: Vegetable oil- or animal fat-based diesel fuel consisting of long-chain alkyl (methyl, ethyl, or propyl) esters.
translations: 由植物油或动物脂肪为原料制成的柴油，主要成分是长链烷基（甲基、乙基或丙基）酯。

messages.msgid: A highly flammable liquid fuel.  When under pressure, it has the potential for violent explosion.
translations: 一种高度易燃的液体燃料。当受压时，有可能发生剧烈爆炸。

messages.msgid: A thin and clean-burning oil made for use in oil lamps.
translations: 一份轻型无烟煤油，在油灯中使用。

messages.msgid: An oil made for use in car engines.
translations: 一款供汽车引擎使用的机油。

messages.msgid: A thick black slurry that can be refined to produce usable products including gasoline or diesel.
translations: 一种黑色粘稠液体，可以通过精炼产生汽油和柴油等有用产品。

messages.msgid: Gasoline mixed with some other components to make it stick to surfaces and increase burning temperature, meant to be used as flamethrower fuel.
translations: 一种混合了一些特殊成分的汽油，使得其可以粘附在物体表面并增加燃烧时的温度。可以用作火焰喷射器的燃料。

messages.msgid: A flammable gel composed of gasoline and dissolved shavings of polystyrene, roughly similar in properties to napalm B.  It's meant to be used as flamethrower fuel.
translations: 由汽油和溶解的聚苯乙烯屑制成的可燃胶体，性质类似凝固汽油。可以用作火焰喷射器的燃料。

messages.msgid: A mixture of gasoline and diesel oil in equal parts.  Its combustion properties make it unfit for applications where you would use any of them separately, but it can be used to feed a flamethrower.
translations: 由等量的汽油和柴油混合而成。特殊的燃烧性质使其无法再像汽油或柴油一样使用，但是可以用作火焰喷射器的燃料。

messages.msgid: Propane gas, useful for everything from torches to barbeque grills to metalworking.
translations: 气态丙烷，可用于从焊炬到烧烤架到金属加工的一切用途。

messages.msgid: Biogas gathered from anaerobic digester system, can be used in biogas cooker.
translations: 从厌氧发酵系统收集的生物燃气，可用于生物燃气炉。

messages.msgid: Oil of turpentine, distilled from pine resin or crude oil.
translations: 松节油，由松脂或原油蒸馏而成。

messages.msgid: A blend of turpentine and ethanol, historically used as the successor to whale oil for lamps before kerosene.
translations: 一种松节油和乙醇的混合物，历史上在煤油出现之前作为鲸油的替代品使用。

messages.msgid: A crude, natural oil made for use in pre-modern oil lamps.
translations: 一种粗制的，用于前现代油灯的天然油脂。

messages.msgid: A fluffy white seed.  While it looks like the common cotton, it is too weak and short to be turned into clothing.
translations: 蓬松的白色种子。虽然它看起来像普通的棉花球，但纤维太弱太短，不能做成衣服。

messages.msgid: a smoking device and a source of flame
messages.plural: a smoking device and a source of flame

messages.msgid: Several documents containing all kinds of information, customer data, and charts, kept together in a manila folder.  Pretty useless now.
translations: 几份文件资料，包括客户信息、市场分析图表及很多其他东西，收捡于文件袋内。

messages.msgid: A white piece of paper, with the logo of XEDRA printed on its upper left corner.  It seems to be an internal report of some kind.
translations: 一张白纸，左上角印有 XEDRA 的标志，看起来像是一份内部报告。
高角环形暗场成像：T-基质

messages.msgid: A small scrap of paper with two long character sequences scribbled on it.
translations: 一段2厘米长的碎纸，上面有潦草的字迹。

messages.msgid: A sequence of overlapping numbers plotted in thermal paper, at times so densely-packed that they disappear into thick blots of oxide-colored ink.  A few number sequences repeat in an almost orderly fashion, but you can't tell whether that means anything.
translations: 在热敏纸上绘制的一系列重叠的数字，有时非常密集，以至于它们淹没在一团厚厚的氧化彩色油墨污点中。一些数字序列以几乎有序的方式重复，但你并不清楚它是否意味着什么。

messages.msgid: A long sequence of overlapping numbers plotted in thermal paper, at times so densely-packed that they disappear into thick blots of oxide-colored ink.  The blots and numbers are arranged in a strangely pleasing pattern.
translations: 在一条长长的热敏纸上绘制的一系列重叠的数字，有时非常密集，以至于它们淹没在一团厚厚的氧化彩色油墨污点中。污点和数字似乎以一种奇怪的令人满足的方式排列。

messages.msgid: A very, very long sequence of overlapping numbers plotted in thermal paper.  It is almost 15 feet long.
translations: 在热敏纸上绘制的一个非常非常长的重叠数字序列。它快有15英尺（约4.6米）长。

messages.msgid: A long sequence of overlapping numbers plotted in thermal paper, at times so densely-packed that they disappear into thick blots of oxide-colored ink.  The printed values increased along rhythmical waves, but the number 5 is always skipped.
translations: 在一条长长的热敏纸上绘制的一系列重叠的数字，有时非常密集，以至于它们淹没在一团厚厚的氧化彩色油墨污点中。数值按某种规律序列增长着，但数字5总是会被略过。

messages.msgid: A bright pink loyalty card, all the points are stamped.  This would definitely prove your fidelity to Foodplace, if that still meant anything…
translations: 一张亮粉色的会员积分卡，所有的积分都加盖了印戳。这肯定能证明你对美食广场™的忠诚，如果这还有意义的话……

messages.msgid: A small, slender branch.  Makes passable firewood but is not useful for much else.
translations: 5厘米长的小树枝。很细，除了当柴火，没什么别的用处。

messages.msgid: Some ordinary, mostly dry leaves.  They have very few uses and are thus (almost) only good for burning.
translations: 一些普通的树叶，大部分都干了。用途很少，因此（几乎）只适合当燃料。

messages.msgid: A dead plant.  Good for starting fires or making crude tailoring crafts.
translations: 一株枯萎的植物。适合生火或制成裁缝制品。

messages.msgid: A bit of dried seaweed.  It's tough, inedible, and possibly poisonous, but it could be burned or used for crafts.
translations: 一小块干海藻。它质地坚韧，不可食用，可能含有毒素，但适合用作燃料或制作材料。

messages.msgid: A big heap of dried seaweed.  It's tough, inedible, and possibly poisonous, but it could be burned or used for crafts.
translations: 一大堆干海藻。它质地坚硬，无法食用，可能含有毒素，但适合用作燃料或制作材料。

messages.msgid: Cyanoacrylate, more commonly known as superglue, is a strong, quick curing glue with many applications.  It was a favorite of many post-Cataclysm hobbyists, but has become a sought-after trade good due to its wide applications, and the fact it has become essentially impossible to manufacture.
translations: 氰基丙烯酸酯通常被称为超级胶水，是一种强力快速固化胶水，用途广泛。 它曾是许多大灾变爱好者的最爱，但由于应用广泛，且基本上已无法制造，因此已成为一种抢手的商品。

messages.msgid: A tin of adhesive typically used to glue rubber together.  It forms a less rigid bond than typical superglue, making it ideal for projects requiring flexibility.  Typically smelly and toxic.
translations: 一罐通常用来粘橡胶的胶水。它能够形成比常见的万能胶更软的胶体，这使它非常适合用于需要弹性的场合。多带有刺激气味且有毒。

messages.msgid: Glue made from boiling animal bones.  The adhesive isn't strong enough for heavy-duty usages, but it can be used as a varnish or holding together small items.
translations: 用动物骨头熬制而成的胶。这种粘合剂粘着性并不太强，但是粘粘一些小手工还是可以的。

messages.msgid: A token representing fertilization of a plant.
translations: 一个标记，植物已经使用过肥料。

messages.msgid: A heavy steel chain.  Useful as a weapon, or for crafting.  It has a chance to wrap around your target, allowing for a bonus unarmed attack.
translations: 一条沉重的钢链。可用作武器，也可用于制作。它有一定几率缠住目标，从而让你获得一次额外的徒手攻击。

messages.msgid: A piece of an insect's exoskeleton.  It is light and very durable.
translations: 一块昆虫的坚硬躯壳，它不仅轻巧，而且很耐用。

messages.msgid: A piece of an insect's endoskeleton.
A cluster of membranous bubbles, each about the size of a grape, retrieved from inside a mutant insect.  They float like tiny helium balloons - perhaps they are full of a lighter-than-air gas.
translations: 一团薄膜状气泡，每一个都有葡萄大小，是从某种变异的巨型昆虫体内屠宰而来的。它们像微小的氦气球一样在空中漂浮，可能内部充满了比空气还轻的气体。

messages.msgid: A cluster of hydrostatic organs, each about the size of a baseball, retrieved from inside a kraken mutant.  Some of them seem to be lighter than air, and some seem to weigh as much as air.
translations: 一团静压流体器官，每个都有棒球那么大，是从一只海怪变种怪物体内割下来的。有些似乎比空气还轻，而有些似乎和空气一样重。

messages.msgid: A lump of exoskeleton that has undergone biosilicification.  It is acid-resistant but rather brittle.
translations: 一块经过生物硅化反应的昆虫外壳。防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: A hundred cotton patches, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.
translations: 100片棉布条，系紧打包以便存放。可拆解。

messages.msgid: Twenty-five cotton sheets, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.
translations: 25张棉布面料，系紧打包以便存放。可拆解。

messages.msgid: Fifty leather patches, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.
translations: 50片皮革片，系紧打包以便存放。可拆解。

messages.msgid: A hundred felt patches, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.
translations: 100片毛毡片，系紧打包以便存放。可拆解。

messages.msgid: Fifty synthetic fabric patches, bundled tightly together for storage.  Disassemble to unpack.
translations: 50片化纤布片，系紧打包以便存放。可拆解。

messages.msgid: Ten construction planks securely tied together for easier transport.  Disassemble to untie them.
translations: 十片被紧紧地捆在一起以存放的木板，可拆解。

messages.msgid: Ten rods of rebar securely tied together for easier transport.  Disassemble to untie them.
translations: 十根被紧紧地捆在一起以存放的钢筋，可拆解。

messages.msgid: Ten pipes securely tied together for easier transport.  Disassemble to untie them.
translations: 十根被紧紧地捆在一起以存放的钢管，可拆解。

messages.msgid: Ten copper pipes securely tied together for easier transport.  Disassemble to untie them.
translations: 十根被紧紧地捆在一起以存放的铜管，可拆解。

messages.msgid: Ten sticks securely tied together for easier transport.  Disassemble to untie them.
translations: 十根被紧紧地捆在一起以存放的粗木棍，可拆解。

messages.msgid: Five long sticks securely tied together for easier transport.  Disassemble to untie them.
translations: 五根被紧紧地捆在一起以存放的长木棍，可拆解。

messages.msgid: Five wooden javelins securely tied together for easier transport.  Disassemble to untie them.
translations: 五根被紧紧地捆在一起以存放的木标枪，可拆解。

messages.msgid: An acrylic cube cast around a small black crystal.  It's tepid to the touch.
translations: 一小块密封在亚克力玻璃内的黑色晶体，有着微热的触感。

messages.msgid: An unopened biollante flower, brilliant purple in color.  It may still have its sap-producing organ intact.
translations: 这是一株还未开花的异形花的花苞，呈现出绚丽的紫色，其中可能还原封不动地保存了一些植物的汁液。

messages.msgid: An empty canister, which may have once held tear gas or other substances.
translations: 一个空罐子，里面可能装过催泪弹什么的，有股气味散发出来。

messages.msgid: A fist-sized eyeball with a cross-shaped pupil.  It seems to be made of stone, but doesn't look like it was carved.
translations: 这颗拳头大小的眼球有个十字形的瞳孔，虽然看起来好像是石头做的，但完全看不出雕刻的痕迹。

messages.msgid: A rock the size of your fist.  It is covered with intricate spirals; it is impossible to tell whether they are carved, naturally formed, or some kind of fossil.
translations: 拳头般大小的岩石。有着复杂的螺旋图形，你也不知道它是雕刻的，还是自然形成的，亦或是某种化石。

messages.msgid: A USB thumb drive.  Useful for holding software.  This one seems like it could get run over by a truck and be fine.
translations: 一个U盘，用于存储电脑软件与数据。这个型号很坚固，能被卡车碾过而毫发无伤。

messages.msgid: Some type of advanced data storage device, filled with logistical data on subterranean train routes and schedules.
translations: 某种先进的数据存储设备，里面全是各种地下火车线路和时刻表的后勤数据。

messages.msgid: A secured USB thumb drive, containing a copy of the LIXA facility's research archives.
translations: 一个加密USB，里面存储了LIXA的研究档案。

messages.msgid: A heavy and very durable protective case made of steel and thick plastic, locked with a six-dial combination.  A sticker with the logo of DARPA is attached to the front, but looking at the surface, you can see that another marking - formerly stenciled into the material - was recently and hastily destroyed.
translations: 一个十分坚固耐用的保险箱，由钢和厚塑料制成，被一个密码盘锁紧。正面贴着一张带有DARPA标志的贴纸，但观察它的表面，你可以勉强分辨出另一个标志——曾被蜡印在箱体上——最近刚被匆匆销毁。

messages.msgid: Evacuation plans, disaster risk projections, personnel lists, and last-minute communications from just before the end, all scrubbed from FEMA servers and stored in an external HDD.
translations: 从 FEMA 服务器下载的各种大灾变发生前不久的疏散方案、灾害预测、人员名单和通信记录，存储在一个外置机械硬盘上。

messages.msgid: A stack of various forms and papers with credits and debits listed all over them, detailing transactions and purchases.  Reading over them, all of the balances are mismatched, and a significant amount of money is missing.
translations: 一堆各种表格和文件，上面列出了贷项和借项，详细说明了交易和购买情况。仔细阅读之后，你发现它们完全无法匹配，大量资金直接消失了。

messages.msgid: A stack of various forms and papers with credits and debits listed all over them, detailing transactions and purchases.  Reading over them, everything is in good order, whoever did these is skilled at their job.
translations: 一堆各种表格和文件，上面列出了贷项和借项，详细说明了交易和购买情况。仔细阅读之后，里面的一切都十分精确而正常，仿佛出自一位熟练的会计之手。

messages.msgid: A brass candlestick with a gold finish.
translations: 一个有着闪亮金饰面的黄铜烛台。

messages.msgid: A large, relatively sharp blade.  Could be used to make bladed weaponry, or attached to a car.
translations: 一个锋利的大刀片，用于装在车上对目标造成物理伤害，也经过可简易的加工成为一把砍刀。

messages.msgid: A large, curved blade.  Could be used to assemble a scythe, or make an improvised polearm.
translations: 一块又大又弯的刀片。可以组装成镰刀，或者制作成一把简易的长柄武器。

messages.msgid: An 8" circular sawblade.  You could make a saw with it, or throw it.  Wielding it without sturdy gloves is a bad idea.
translations: 8吋圆锯刃片。可以拿它做把圆锯，扔出去也可以。边缘锋利，请先戴手套再扔它。

messages.msgid: A hollow metal cylinder which is inserted in a tree crust in order to slowly harvest its sap.  Can be used on a maple tree between late winter and early spring to harvest maple sap.
translations: 一根食指大小的中空金属管，把它深深地插进树皮里就可以从中缓慢的获得树汁。可以在晚冬早春时节从枫树里收集枫树树汁。

messages.msgid: A carved piece of wood which is inserted in a tree crust in order to slowly harvest its sap.  Can be used on a maple tree in between late winter and early spring to harvest maple sap.
translations: 一截木头插管，手工雕刻制成，把它深深地插进树皮里就可以从中缓慢的获得树汁。可以在晚冬早春时节从枫树里收集枫树树汁。

messages.msgid: Strange lights perpetually glimmer within the sharpened internals of this glass globule.
translations: 一个玻璃珠，内部发出暗淡却持久的奇异微光。

messages.msgid: Time and the elements have reduced them to a mound of filthy ribbons.
translations: 时间和自然因素把它们变成了一堆肮脏的布带。

messages.msgid: A length of thin, relatively stiff steel wire.  Like the sort you find in chain link fences.
translations: 一段相对较硬的细钢丝，就像常见的铁丝网上的钢丝一样。

messages.msgid: A length of thin, relatively stretchy coiled steel wire.  Used to produce musical notes in instruments.
translations: 一种细长的、有一定弹性的盘绕钢丝。用于在乐器中产生音符。

messages.msgid: A length of thin, relatively stiff wire made of mild steel.  Ubiquitously found in everyday applications such as chain link fences.
translations: 一段用低碳钢制成的细长且较硬的金属丝。在日常生活中十分常见，例如制作铁丝网围栏。

messages.msgid: A length of thin, stiff wire made of medium steel.  Its balance between strength and flexibility makes it suitable for steel ropes and cables.
translations: 一段用中碳钢制成的细长且坚硬的金属丝。其强度和韧性之间的平衡使其适用于钢丝绳和缆线。

messages.msgid: A length of strong wire made of high carbon steel.  Often used in industrial machinery and springs.
translations: 一段高碳钢制成的坚固金属丝，常用于制造工业机械和弹簧。

messages.msgid: A length of thin, relatively stiff steel wire, made of hardened steel.
translations: 一段用硬化碳钢制成的细长且硬的钢丝。

messages.msgid: A length of flexible and durable steel wire, made of tempered spring steel.  Often used in industrial and automotive springs, and the wire in musical instruments.
translations: 一段用回火碳钢制成的柔韧耐用的钢丝。常用于工业和制造汽车弹簧，或是作为乐器中的琴弦。

messages.msgid: A length of stiff wire, covered in sharp barbs.
translations: 一条有着锋利的倒钩的长线。

messages.msgid: A 6-inch square piece of finely-woven steel wire, useful for dryer lint traps and reusable coffee filter baskets.  You could put this on a window to keep mosquitoes and other bugs out if it was larger, but chain link fencing will do these days.
translations: 一张6英寸（约15厘米）见方的细钢丝网，可以用作烘干机滤网或者用来滤咖啡。如果它再大点，你就可以把它做成纱窗用来遮挡蚊虫了，但是如今的蚊虫只需要勾花围栏就能挡住了。

messages.msgid: A rod of rebar, makes a nice melee weapon, and could be handy in constructing tougher walls and such.
translations: 钢筋，很好的近战武器，也可以用来建造更坚固的建筑，比如墙壁什么的。

messages.msgid: A length of track, made from some planks and rails.
translations: 一段窄轨铁路轨道，由一些木板和铁轨制成。

messages.msgid: Some mixed cement, sand and aggregates, precombined and ready to be used in a construction project.
translations: 一些混合起来的水泥，沙子和骨料，可以用于建筑。

messages.msgid: The tanned hide of an animal repurposed to become the head on a percussion drum.
translations: 经过鞣制处理的动物皮革，可以用来制作鼓。

messages.msgid: A torch that has consumed all its fuel; it can be recrafted into another torch.
translations: 燃尽了的火炬，加上燃料或就能当新的用了。

messages.msgid: A spent magnesium flare.  It is essentially trash.
translations: 一个已经燃烧完毕的照明弹。本质上是垃圾，且不可回收。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy-duty spring.  Expands with significant force when compressed.
translations: 一根巨大的弹簧。可以承受不少力，且弹性十足。

messages.msgid: A motorized pushmower that seems to be broken.  You could take it apart if you had a wrench.
translations: 一台已损坏的电动手推式割草机，可以使用扳手进行拆解以获得其中的零件。

messages.msgid: A small tent, just big enough to fit one person comfortably.  This tent is broken and cannot be deployed.
translations: 一顶小帐篷，足够一个人舒舒服服地钻进去睡大觉。但这个帐篷已经坏了，无法撑开。

messages.msgid: A family-sized tent, very bulky but with plenty of space.  This tent is broken and cannot be deployed.
translations: 一顶供家庭使用的帐篷，很大，空间充裕。可惜它的龙骨已经断裂，不能再次撑开使用。

messages.msgid: A heating element, like the ones used in hotplates or kettles.  Consists of nichrome wire surrounded by electrical insulator and placed inside a steel casing.
translations: 加热元件，通常用在电炉或电水壶等中。由镍铬合金电热丝组成，由绝缘体包裹，置于钢壳内。

messages.msgid: A primitive heating element made from thin coiled steel wire.  It will degrade much quicker with use than normal heating elements, but it'll do for some applications.
translations: 一款造型简陋的加热元件，由细钢丝盘绕制成。与普通的加热元件相比，它的热效比大大降低，但在某些场合中会起作用。

messages.msgid: A simple thermostat controlled by thermal expansion of a bimetal strip.
translations: 由双金属片的热膨胀控制的简单恒温器。

messages.msgid: A large metal tank with a water faucet attached to it, primarily used to store and heat water.
translations: 一个大金属罐，上面有个水龙头，主要用来储存和加热水。

messages.msgid: A large metal tank with a water faucet attached to it, primarily used to store and heat water.  Large enough for a whole family.
translations: 一个大金属罐，上面有个水龙头，主要用来储存和加热水。它足够大，可以满足一家人的用水需求。

messages.msgid: A large LCD television, full of delicious electronics.
translations: 一台大屏幕液晶电视，接收不到信号无法观看电视节目，可以使用工具拆解以获得其中零件。

messages.msgid: An appliance used to wash laundry, not of much use without power and water.  Can be placed as an appliance.
translations: 一台用来洗衣的家电，没水没电就没多大用。可以作为家电放置。

messages.msgid: An appliance used to clean dishes, not of much use without power and water.  Can be placed as an appliance.
translations: 一台用来洗碗的家电，没水没电就没多大用。可以作为家电放置。

messages.msgid: A pilot light from a gas-burning device, this particular one is a simple piezoelectric igniter.
translations: 从燃气装置上拆下来的辅助燃烧辅助点火器，这个是压电性的。

messages.msgid: A complex mechanical fuze.  It seems it can be used to detonate stable explosives after a short time by triggering it.
translations: 一个结构复杂的机械引信。它似乎可以在触发后经过一小段特定时间后引爆稳定炸药。

messages.msgid: A complex mechanical fuze.  It seems it can be used to detonate stable explosives upon a solid impact.
translations: 一个结构复杂的机械引信。它似乎可以在受到强烈撞击后引爆稳定炸药。

messages.msgid: A special forces Russian rifle chambered in 5.45 that someone has taken a plasma cutter to, cutting it in three places to comply with import restrictions.  This thing would have been hard to source, and thankfully its unique complex recoil balance system remains intact, unlike the receiver and barrel.  The telltale rainbow patterns of torch cuts mar the otherwise beautiful receiver.  A well-equipped gunsmith with time and materials could probably build a new one out of this…
translations: 有人用等离子切割机切掉了一支5.45口径的俄罗斯特种部队步枪，为了遵守进口限制，把它切成了三处。这个东西很难找到来源，谢天谢地，它独特的复杂的后坐力平衡系统仍然完好无损，不像机匣和枪管。火炬切割的彩虹图案破坏了原本很棒的机匣。一个装备精良，有时间和材料的枪匠可能会用这个造一把新的……

messages.msgid: A broken camspy.  It probably won't spy on anything ever again.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的侦察无人机。它可能再也无法监视任何东西了。可以拆解以获取零件。

messages.msgid: A broken skitterbot.  Much less threatening now that it lies limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的掠行无人机。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken Hub 01 exterminatron.  Much less threatening now that it lies limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个坏掉的Hub 01灭绝机器人。行动不便让它的威胁变小了许多。可以拆解得到部件。
实验室原型无人机（损坏）

messages.msgid: A broken lab defense bot, with its casing broken and fluid drained.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的实验室原型无人机，它的外壳破损，有液体从中流出。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken nurse bot.  Its smooth face stares vacantly into empty space.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的护士机器人。它光滑的脸茫然地凝视着空气。可以拆解回收部件。

messages.msgid: A broken grocery bot.  Its smiling face stares vacantly into empty space.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的食杂店机器人。它微笑的脸茫然地凝视着空气。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: The body of a busted grocery bot.  Its tarnished face is still smiling.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台残缺损坏的食杂店机器人，面容黯淡却仍然带着微笑。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken prototype robot--well, more broken than before.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台破损的原型机器人，至少是比之前更破。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken miner bot.  Much less threatening now that it's no longer capable of drilling anything.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的排爆机器人。没有威胁，因为它再也钻不动了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken mech exoskeleton suit, it looks beyond repair.
translations: 一套损坏的外骨骼装甲，看起来已经没法修了。

messages.msgid: A broken riot dispatch, with its mesh midsection filled with fried manhacks and its motor limp and still.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的防暴派遣者，它的腹部密集的舱位停满了烧焦的飞锯无人机，它的引擎已经完全失去了动力。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A piece of paper.  Can be used to start fires.
A book binder.  With a pen and some paper you could copy some recipes from books into it.
translations: 一个活页夹。有了笔和纸你可以从书上抄写下一些配方装入其中。

messages.msgid: A broken military dispatch.  Though the scratched manhacks visible in its belly are disarmed, their destructive potential still inspires a spark of fear in you, even now.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的军用派遣者。透过腹部裂痕，可以看到内部的飞锯无人机，它们闪烁着令人恐惧的火花，仍然隐藏着恐怖的破坏力。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken manhack.  Much less threatening now that it lies limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的飞锯无人机。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken grenade hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的榴弹无人机。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken tear gas hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的催泪弹无人机。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken EMP hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的EMP无人机。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken flashbang hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的闪光弹无人机。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken C-4 hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的C4炸弹无人机。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken loudspeaker.  It's so unusually quiet now…  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的音乐扩音器。现在安静的呆在那里。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A central processor unit, useful in advanced electronics crafting.
translations: 一个中央处理器，简称CPU。用于制造高级电子设备。

messages.msgid: A stick of memory.  Useful in advanced electronics crafting.
translations: 一根内存条。用于制造高级电子设备。

messages.msgid: A power supply unit.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.
translations: 一个供电模块。用于制造许多电子设备。

messages.msgid: A circuit designed to amplify the strength of a signal.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.
translations: 一个用于放大信号的电路。用于制造许多电子设备。

messages.msgid: A circuit designed to repeat a signal.  Useful for crafting communications equipment.
translations: 一段用于重复某段信号的电路。用于制造通讯设备。

messages.msgid: A module designed to receive many forms of signals.  Useful for crafting communications equipment.
translations: 一个用来接收多种形式信号的模块。用于制造通讯设备。

messages.msgid: A large backlit screen, used for displaying images.  Useful in some electronics recipes.
translations: 一个大型背光式屏幕，用于显示图像。用于制造某些电子设备。

messages.msgid: A small backlit screen, used for displaying images.  Useful in some electronics recipes.
translations: 一个小型背光式屏幕，用于显示图像。用于制造某些电子设备。

messages.msgid: A high-quality glass lens, useful for focusing or diffusing light.  Might be useful for starting a fire.
translations: 一个高品质的玻璃镜头，可以用来聚光或散光。或许还可以用来生火。

messages.msgid: A small, high-quality glass lens, useful for focusing or diffusing light.  Might be useful for crafting.
translations: 一个小型高品质的玻璃镜头，可以用来聚光或散光。可用于制成其他物品。

messages.msgid: A pair of small, darkened glass lenses, like the ones used in sunglasses.
translations: 一对被染黑的小型玻璃镜片，就和用于制造太阳镜的玻璃镜片一样。

messages.msgid: Once a valuable bionic implant, it has not held up well under repeated use.  It has been destroyed by excessive electric current and is now useless.
translations: 这曾经是块珍贵的生化插件，高强度的使用下它的状态不是很好。而超负荷的电流更是彻底摧毁了它，现在已经不能用了。

messages.msgid: A state-of-the-art optical storage system.  This small slate of transparent glass holds, inscribed as a miniature pattern, the instructions required to create an item through a nanofabricator.
translations: 一套最先进的光学存储系统。这一小块透明玻璃板上，刻着一个微缩图案，集成了纳米制造机制造物品时所需要的指令。

messages.msgid: A state-of-the-art optical storage system.  This small slate of transparent glass holds, inscribed as a miniature pattern, the instructions required to create an item through a nanofabricator.  A small text at the bottom indicates that this one is specifically used to create combat exoskeletons.
translations: 一套最先进的光学存储系统。这一小块透明玻璃板上，刻着一个微缩图案，集成了纳米制造机制造物品时所需要的指令。底部的一行文字表明这块模板是专用于制造战斗外骨骼的。

messages.msgid: A state-of-the-art optical storage system, containing the instruction set to replicate itself.
translations: 一种最先进的光学存储系统，包含全套用于复制自身的操作手册。
纳米制造模板（硅光子电路）

messages.msgid: A state-of-the-art optical storage system, containing the instruction set required for the fabrication of complex silicon photonic circuitry.  The data within was once clearly worth millions, but now, you are not sure if it's anything more than a fancy, high-tech paperweight.
translations: 一套最先进的光学存储系统，包含了制造复杂硅光子电路所必须的指令。里面的数据显然曾经价值千万，但是事到如今，你不知道它除了拿来当个花哨的高科技镇纸之外还能用来做什么。

messages.msgid: A state-of-the-art optical storage system, containing the instruction set required for the fabrication of advanced armor materials.  This seems to just be routines for working with the materials, not actual armor schematics.
translations: 一套最先进的光学存储系统，存有制造高级护甲所需的指令集。看来只是处理材料的通用程序，而非实际的护甲制造设计图。

messages.msgid: A simple thin copper shaft.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.
translations: 一个简单的细铜轴。用于制造许多电子设备。

messages.msgid: A very small electric motor like those used in RC cars or electric hair trimmers.
translations: 一种非常小的电动马达，就是用在电动遥控车中的那种。可用于制造各种电子设备。

messages.msgid: A printed card that supports and electrically connects electronic components on a non-conductive substrate.
translations: 一块印刷好的电路板，能将安装在不导电的衬底上的各个电子部件通过金属连线连接起来。

messages.msgid: A random collection of resistors, capacitors, and diodes which have been stripped from printed circuits.
translations: 一堆从印刷电路板上拆下来的各种电阻、电容和二极管。

messages.msgid: A system designed to convert a radio station into an autonomous repeater.
translations: 一个被设计用来将普通的无线电站转换为自动中继器的装置。

messages.msgid: A small fan, used to propel air around a room.
translations: 一台小型风扇，可以用来使房间的空气流动。

messages.msgid: A ceramic armor plate, specifically engineered for use as armor.  Not suitable for human use.
translations: 一块陶瓷装甲板，专门设计用于护甲。不适合直接穿戴。

messages.msgid: A filled fishbowl, the tag says 'to Ed' and the fish's name, 'Hoss'.  The fish appears to have tiny antlers.
translations: 一个充满水的鱼缸，标签上写着"送给艾德"和里面的鱼的名字"霍斯"，看起来鱼已经变异出微小的鹿角。

messages.msgid: A tool designed to clean the interior surface of pipes, bottles, and similar objects.  This one is thin enough to be used for cleaning firearm barrels from dirt and fouling.
translations: 一个用于清洁管道、瓶子和类似物体内部表面的工具。这个足够细，可以用来清洗枪管内的灰尘和污垢。

messages.msgid: A small mechanical clock, it's stopped at 10:10.
translations:
"10:10"
一个小机械钟，已经停止运作。

messages.msgid: A small assortment of gears and other clockwork gubbins.
translations: 一堆各式各样的小型齿轮和发条装置。
一块手持小镜子，也可以作为反光镜安装在载具上。

messages.msgid: A heavy iron disc that typically covers a ladder into the sewers.  Lifting it from the manhole is impossible without a crowbar.
translations: 一块铁制的大圆盘，通常用来盖在下水道的入口处。如果没有撬棍是几乎不可能将它移出井口的。

messages.msgid: A branch from a pine tree, oozing sticky sap and bristling with prickly needles.
translations: 一根从松树上折下的树枝，断口出渗出粘糊糊的松脂，树枝上还带着一些绿色的松针。

messages.msgid: A spiny pod from a pine tree.
translations: 一颗松树所结出多刺松果。

messages.msgid: Some cooked rice mixed with yeast and koji mold fragments, set aside to let koji mold grow on it so that it can make a passable sake base.
translations: 将一些煮熟的米饭与酵母和曲霉菌混合，静置使得曲霉菌在上面生长，这样就可以做成一个合格的清酒酒曲。

messages.msgid: The koji mold seems to have overtaken all the rice; this batch is usable now.
translations: 曲霉菌似乎已经完全覆盖了大米；这批酒曲现在可以用了。

messages.msgid: The koji mold is still growing.
Some rice covered in koji mold, mixed in with yeast.  Useful for making sake, but not really tasty on its own.  Smells vaguely of chestnuts.
translations: 将一些煮熟的米饭与酵母和曲霉菌混合制成的酒曲。可以用来酿制清酒，但本身并不美味。隐约有栗子的味道。

messages.msgid: Some cooked rice sprinkled with ash and wrapped into a corn husk.  If left alone for a while, it will most likely grow koji mold.
translations: 将一些煮熟的米饭撒上炉灰，并裹在玉米壳之中。静置一段时间，它很可能会长出曲霉菌。

messages.msgid: Patches of koji mold have grown on the rice; you can now extract it.
translations: 米饭上长出了曲霉菌；你现在可以取出它了。

messages.msgid: The koji mold hasn't grown yet.
Some cooked rice sprinkled with ash and wrapped into a corn husk.  It has grown patches of koji mold inside; disassemble this item to extract it.
translations: 将一些煮熟的米饭撒上炉灰，并裹在玉米壳之中。它外表长出了一片片的曲霉菌；拆解这个物品将其取出。

messages.msgid: Dough made from cooked and mashed soybeans and wheat flour, wrapped in wet paper.  If left to dry for some time, it'll grow koji mold, as necessary for making soy sauce.
translations: 煮熟并捣碎的大豆混合小麦粉制成的面团，用湿纸包裹。风干一段时间后会长出曲霉菌，这是制作酱油所必需的。

messages.msgid: The koji mold seems to have overtaken all the dough; this batch is usable now.
translations: 曲霉菌似乎已经完全覆盖了面团；这批酱醅现在可以用了。

messages.msgid: soy and wheat dough with koji
messages.plural: soy and wheat dough with koji

messages.msgid: A block of dried dough made from cooked and mashed soybeans and wheat flour, covered with koji mold.  Usable for making soy sauce.
translations: 一块煮熟并捣碎的大豆和小麦粉制成的干面团，上面覆盖着曲霉菌。可用于制作酱油。

messages.msgid: A poppy bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a mutated poppy flower.
translations: 罂粟花的花蕾，包含了一些变异罂粟花特有的成分。

messages.msgid: The top of a sunflower, with yellow petals and some seeds that have yet to be eaten by animals.
translations: 向日葵的花蕾，有黄色的花瓣和一些尚未被动物吃掉的种子。

messages.msgid: A handful of white chamomile flowers, used as an herbal remedy since ancient times.
translations: 一把白洋甘菊，自古以来用作草药。

messages.msgid: A lovely flower that grows on the surface of bodies of fresh water.  Traditionally connected with many Eastern cultures.
translations: 一种生长在淡水表面的可爱的花。传统上与许多东方文化相联系。

messages.msgid: A handful of yellow-green flowers.  Can be brewed into a tea that prevents asthma attacks.
translations: 一种黄绿色的花。花朵可以制成预防哮喘发作的茶。

messages.msgid: A mixed collection of flowers.  Unfortunately, they have all withered with time.
translations: 一整束混合品种的花，可惜它们都随着时间枯萎了。

messages.msgid: An identification tag for a pet, engraved with their name and their owner's address and phone number.  It says "<dog_name>".
translations: 一块宠物识别标签，上面刻有宠物的姓名、主人的地址和电话号码。上面写着：“<dog_name>”。

messages.msgid: A fresh piece of clay.  Useful for some crafting recipes.
translations: 一块新鲜的黏土，用来制造许多东西。

messages.msgid: A fire-hardened building block used in masonry construction.
translations: 一块经过火烤硬化后的建筑材料，用在各种砖石结构中。

messages.msgid: Some mortar, ready to be used in building projects.
translations: 一堆灰泥，已经准备好，随时可以用到工程建设项目中。

messages.msgid: Some lime mortar, made from quicklime and aggregate and ready for building.
translations: 一些石灰砂浆，由生石灰和骨料制成，可用于建筑。

messages.msgid: A compacted mass of soil and natural fibers, still too wet to build with.  Load it onto a pallet and leave it to dry.
translations: 一块压实的土壤和天然纤维，仍然太湿，无法用它建造。把它装到托盘上，让它晾干。

messages.msgid: You test the brick, and it seems solid enough to use.
translations: 你试了试，这块砖似乎已足够结实可以使用。

messages.msgid: The brick is still too damp to bear weight.
translations: 这块砖还太湿，承受不了重量。

messages.msgid: A compacted mass of soil and natural fibers, baked dry enough to harden into a brick.
translations: 一块压实的土壤和天然纤维，烘焙得足够干燥，可以硬化成砖块。

messages.msgid: A thick, pasty mud, low in sand content to reduce crumbling once dry.  Used to glue larger, heavier pieces of mud and clay together.
translations: 一团厚厚的泥巴糊，含沙量低，一旦干了就能减少碎裂。用来粘合更大更重的泥块和黏土。

messages.msgid: A sheet of tannin-rich bark from a tree, useful for tanning leather.
translations: 一大块富含单宁的树皮，用于鞣制皮革。

messages.msgid: A sheet of tough, water-resistant bark taken from a birch tree.
translations: 一片既坚硬又防水的树皮，从桦树上取得。

messages.msgid: A sheet of bark taken from a willow tree.  Used in the production of aspirin.
translations: 一片从柳树上取得的树皮，可用于制造阿司匹林。

messages.msgid: A root taken from a sassafras tree.  Used in the production of certain sweet beverages.
translations: 从黄樟树上取下的根。 用于生产某些甜味饮料。
一颗闪闪发光的石榴石。
一颗闪闪发光的紫水晶。
一颗闪闪发光的海蓝宝石。
一颗闪闪发光的祖母绿。
一颗闪闪发光的紫翠玉。
一颗闪闪发光的孔雀石。
一颗闪闪发光的红宝石。
一颗闪闪发光的橄榄石。
一颗闪闪发光的蓝宝石。
一颗光滑圆润的蛋白石。
一颗闪闪发光的电气石。
一颗闪闪发光的黄水晶。
一颗闪闪发光的蓝黄玉。

messages.msgid: A pile of dry grass.  Can be used to craft a straw bed if there is nothing else to sleep on.
translations: 一堆干草。实在没什么地方可以躺了，就用它来做张稻草床吧。

messages.msgid: An old straw doll, made to look like a woman in a dress.
translations: 一个老旧的稻草娃娃。看上去是个穿裙子的女性。

messages.msgid: A pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个枕头，供你睡觉时放松你的头部。它被卷起来，以便于紧凑的存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A pillowcase with straw and other dead plants as filling.  It's better than nothing…  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个枕套，里面填充着稻草或是其他的枯萎植物。尽管用起来不算理想，但总比没有强。它被卷起来，以便于紧凑的存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of an anime character on the front and their scantily-clad version on the back.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的，印有动漫角色图案的等身抱枕，正面是普通形象，背面则是裸露款。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of an aircraft carrier drawn on both sides.  The one on the back is stripped of its armor plating, how naughty.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正反两面印有某位航母舰娘的图案。背面是去除了其“装甲”的版本，看上去很是调皮。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a fully-modded tacticool M4 SOPMOD II on both sides.  The rifle firing a grenade somehow looks suggestive.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正反两面印有一把完全改装过的战术M4 SOPMOD II的图案。这位能发射榴弹的枪娘看起来有些挑逗。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a blue-haired Boston-Chan, the mascot of Boston AnimeCon, on both sides.  This seems to be official merch, and the art on both sides is quite tame.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正反两面印有蓝发的波士顿酱——波士顿动漫展的吉祥物。这似乎是官方商品，抱枕两面的图案都相当的全年龄。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a blue-haired Boston-Chan, the mascot of Boston AnimeCon, on both sides.  It's highly unlikely the convention would officially endorse such a lewd depiction of her.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正反两面印有蓝发的波士顿酱——波士顿动漫展的吉祥物。显然，动漫展不太可能正式认可这种色情的形象。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with an anime-style print of Bear Grillings, Ultimate Survivor on both sides.  On one side he's holding a pneumatic air rifle, and on the other he is clad in nothing but duct tape.  The pillow is stylized to look like Kevlar.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，两侧印有动漫画风的终极生存者——贝尔·格里尔斯。一面上画着他拿着一支气动步枪，另一面上他只用胶带裹身。枕头的纹理似乎特地做出了凯夫拉的质感。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of an anthropomorphic fox on the front and a scantily-clad version on the back.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正面印有拟人化的狐狸图案，背面是其穿着较少衣物的版本。它被卷起来便于紧凑存储和运输。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a popular blue-twintailed virtual musician on the front and her scantily-clad version on the back.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正面印有一位受欢迎的蓝色双马尾虚拟歌手图案，背面则是其穿着较少的版本。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of an anime character dressed in all black on the front and their scantily-clad version on the back.  They're surrounded by red candles and laying atop a demonic pentagram.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正面印着一个身着全黑服装的动漫角色，背面则是裸露款。她们周身被红色蜡烛所环绕，正上方有一个恶魔样式的五角星。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a cute maid on the front and the same maid - covered in blood and holding a knife - on the back.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正面印有一个可爱的女仆图案，背面则是同一位女仆，然而她手持一把刀，身上沾满血迹。它被卷起来便于紧凑存储和运输。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a masculine woman on the front and her scantily-clad version on the back.  It's captioned with 'TOMBOY SUPREMACY' on both sides.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正面印有一位具有男性气质的女性图案，背面则是她穿着较少衣物的版本。两面都标有“假小子至上”的字样。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a feminine man on the front and his scantily-clad version on the back.  It's captioned with 'FEMBOY SUPREMACY' on both sides.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正面印有一位女性化男性的图案，背面则是他穿着较少衣物的版本。两面都标有“男娘至上”的字样。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a pouting anime character on the front and their scantily-clad version on the back.  They don't actually like you or anything, they swear!  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的、等身大小的抱枕，正面印有一位嘟嘴的动漫角色图案，背面则是她穿着较少衣物的版本。哼，她才不会喜欢你呢，真的，发誓不喜欢你！它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a popular anime VTuber on the front and their scantily-clad version on the back.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的，印有动漫虚拟主播图案的等身抱枕，正面是普通形象，背面则是裸露款。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A big, body-sized pillow.  Someone drew a vaguely humanoid figure on it.  Its heartwarming smile fills you with joy.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个大号的等身抱枕，上面画着一个模糊的人形图案，它温暖的笑容会让你感到喜悦。它被卷起来，以便于存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A fluffy pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.
translations: 一个毛绒绒的枕头，供你睡觉时放松你的头部。它被卷起来，以便于紧凑的存储和运输。当你把它放在那儿并准备入睡时，它会自动展开。

messages.msgid: A medical device that bears the approval of the FDA (Food and Drug Administration).  If used properly, this pouch can keep things sterile indefinitely.
translations: 一个通过了美国国家食品药品监督管理局认证的医疗用品。如果使用恰当，这种袋子可以使其他物品保持永久无菌状态。

messages.msgid: The smoke billowing from this cigar has a sweet, musty odor.
translations: 烟从这支雪茄翻滚而出，香甜和霉变的味道混合其中。

messages.msgid: A true gentleman always finishes his cigars.
translations: 真汉子从来都是抽到烟屁股的好哇！

messages.msgid: Smoke swirls from the lit end of this cigarette, filling the air with the thrilling smell of burning chemicals.
translations: 烟从这支香烟点燃的末端盘旋而上，让空气中充满了令人陶醉的化学物燃烧的味道。

messages.msgid:
What was once a wonderfully addictive tube of dried tobacco leaf is now just a smelly piece of trash.  What a tragedy!
The leftover tobacco in a few of these could probably be used to roll another cigarette.  If you're willing to go that far…
translations: 曾经令人着迷的烟叶卷现在只剩下了一小片有味道的垃圾。如果你烟瘾实在无法解决，可以尝试用多个这东西里边剩下的烟草，应该可以卷成一个新的香烟。

messages.msgid: The smell of skunk permeates the air as a thin trail of smoke floats off of this joint.
translations: 随着一缕缕青烟从这支大麻烟上飘出，空气中弥漫着大麻的臭味。

messages.msgid:
The smoked-down butt of a joint, a reminder of some good times.  Pretty much trash now.  Bummer, man.
A few of these could probably be used to roll another joint.
translations:
抽剩下的的大麻烟卷烟蒂，让人想起一些愉快的时光。现在基本就是垃圾了，真可惜。
攒上几个或许还能再卷一支。

messages.msgid: A psychoactive plant indigenous to Central Asia and the Indian subcontinent traditionally cultivated for its fiber, oil, for medicinal purposes, and for use as a recreational drug.  It requires further processing to be useful.
translations: 一种致幻植物，源自中亚及印度次大陆。传统用途包括获取其纤维、油料、医用、及用作消遣毒品。需要进一步加工来使用。

messages.msgid: Various parts of a tobacco plant, full of nicotine.  They need to be dried to become smokable.
translations: 烟草的各个部分，富含尼古丁。需要先弄干后才能抽。

messages.msgid: A yellow plastic card used to electronically store money.  It holds up to 2 million dollars.
translations: 一张黄色的塑料卡，用于存储电子货币。它最多可容纳200万美元。

messages.msgid: A small, transparent card that was attached to the prototype robot's CPU.  It might contain the data the intercom spoke of.
translations: 这张小小的透明卡连接到了原型机器人的CPU上。它可能包含对讲机提到的数据。

messages.msgid: A memory bank containing the information collected by the meteorologist drone.
translations: 包含气象学无人机收集信息的记忆库。

messages.msgid: This card gives you a little discount on the purchase of gasoline.
translations: 购买汽油的时候可以便宜一点的优惠卡。

messages.msgid: This card gives you a good discount on the purchase of gasoline.
translations: 购买汽油的时候可以便宜一些的优惠卡。

messages.msgid: This card gives you a splendid discount on the purchase of gasoline.
translations: 购买汽油的时候可以便宜不少的优惠卡。

messages.msgid: A small neoprene patch.  Can be used to repair neoprene clothing.
translations: 一小块氯丁橡胶片。可用于修补氯丁橡胶材质的衣物。

messages.msgid: A rather outdated light bulb used in all sorts of lighting equipment.
translations: 一个较为过时的电灯泡，用于各种发光设备中。

messages.msgid: A twisted shard of jagged metal.
translations: 一块扭曲而凹凸不平的金属碎片。

messages.msgid: A nice-looking clay pot used for planting.
translations: 一个漂亮的陶花盆，可以用来种植。

messages.msgid: A cheap plastic pot used for planting.
translations: 一个便宜的塑料花盆，可以用来种植。

messages.msgid: This 3 L jar contains a human brain preserved in a formaldehyde solution.
translations: 一个容量为3L的玻璃罐子，里面有一个保存在福尔马林中的人脑。

messages.msgid: A set of long, snakelike tubes for evaporating refrigerant.
translations: 一套用来蒸发制冷剂的细长蛇形管。

messages.msgid: A compressor and fan that work together to cool down refrigerant.
translations: 一套用来冷凝制冷剂的压缩机和风扇。

messages.msgid: A small tank containing some sort of refrigerant often used in devices such as freezers.  Hermetically sealed to prevent evaporation - cannot be opened without prior connection to a compatible valve.
translations: 一种装有某种制冷剂的小型金属罐，常用于制冷设备中，为防止蒸发已被完全密封。需要连接到特制的阀门上才能打开。

messages.msgid: An armor plate made of very thick steel, specifically engineered for use in a bullet-resistant vest.
translations: 一块加厚钢制装甲板，专为防弹背心而设计。

messages.msgid: A steel armor plate, specifically engineered for use in a bullet-resistant vest.
translations: 一块钢制装甲板，专为防弹背心而设计。

messages.msgid: A small lock, with its key still inserted.
translations: 一把小锁，上面插着钥匙。
这是一个正在制造中的物品。
这是一个正在拆解中的物品。
