messages.msgid: A bumper-mounted rig for attaching and storing a spare tire on the back of a vehicle.  Combine it with a wheel to get a mountable piece.
translations: 可以存放备胎的托架，用于将备胎固定在车辆后面。将它与车轮组合可得到待安装的载具部件。

messages.msgid: An amplifier head.  Typically paired with a speaker cabinet for amplifying musical instruments.  Basically only good for spare parts now.
translations: 头戴式扩音器，通常与扬声器柜配对，用于放大乐器的声音。现在基本上只能拆掉获得零件。

messages.msgid: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的炮塔。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken riot control turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的防暴炮塔。现在安静的散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。
M249 CROWS II 自动机枪塔（损坏）
messages.plural: broken M249 autonomous CROWS II turrets

translations: M240 CROWS II 自动机枪塔（损坏）
messages.plural: broken M240 autonomous CROWS II turrets

translations: M2HB CROWS II 自动机枪塔（损坏）
messages.plural: broken M2 autonomous CROWS II turrets

messages.msgid: A broken secubot, with its casing broken and fluid drained.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的安保无人机，它的外壳破损，有液体从中流出。可以拆解得到部件。
M202A1 鹰爪型无人车（损坏）

messages.msgid: A broken TALON UGV, with its casing broken and fluid drained.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一架损坏的鹰爪型无人车，它的外壳破损，有液体从中流出。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A reinforced brick designed to withstand intense heat.
translations: 一块经过强化能够承受高温的砖块。

messages.msgid: A heavy cube-shaped block of salt for livestock.  Don't lick it, it's gross.
translations: 一大块沉重的立方体食盐块，供牲畜食用。别舔它，太恶心了。

messages.msgid: A strip of bark pulled from an alder tree.  Used in the production of topical hemostatics.
translations: 一片从桤木上取得的树皮，可用于制造局部止血药。

messages.msgid: A small, flat case used to carry items such as currency, identification documents, and laminated cards.
translations: 一个小而扁平的袋子，用于携带货币、身份证件和塑料卡片等物品。

messages.msgid: A wallet made entirely out of duct tape.
translations: 一个完全由强力胶带制成的钱包。
一个由皮革制成的钱包。

messages.msgid: A flat case used to carry items such as currency, identification documents, laminated cards, and other small items.
translations: 一个扁平的袋子，用于携带货币、身份证件、塑料卡片，以及其他小型物品。

messages.msgid: A stylish flat case used to carry items such as currency, identification documents, laminated cards, and other small items.
translations: 一个款式时髦的扁平袋子，用于携带货币、身份证件、塑料卡片，以及其他小型物品。

messages.msgid: A flat case with a neck strap, used to carry items such as currency, identification documents, laminated cards, and other small items.
translations: 一个能够挂在脖子上的扁平袋子，用于携带货币、身份证件、塑料卡片，以及其他小型物品。

messages.msgid: A flat, clear plastic sleeve for identification documents, laminated cards, and other small items.  It has a neck strap attached.
translations: 一个扁平的透明塑料套，能够用来装身份证、多层卡片和其他小物件。它有一条颈带。

messages.msgid: A broken taser hack, with its propellers still and taser inert.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的电击枪无人机。现在安静地散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken security drone, with its propellers still and camera inert.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一个损坏的安防无人机。现在安静地散在地上构不成威胁了。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: This is a big, bulky military-level parachute, designed to slow the fall of up to a thousand kilograms of cargo dropped from an aircraft.  You have no clue how to put all the straps back in their place.
translations: 这是个大型的军用降落伞，可使1吨重的货物从飞行器上缓降。你不知道该如何收好上面的绑带放到它们原先的位置。

messages.msgid: This is a heavy and bulky 40x48 inch pallet.
translations: 这是一个笨重的40x48英寸托盘。

messages.msgid: A hand-made humanoid figure, useful for training in close quarters combat.  This one is made from wood and has some duct tape to mark the striking points.  Use the construction menu (* by default) to embed it into the ground for training.
translations: 一个手工制作的人形靶，用于近身格斗训练。这个是用木头做的，并用胶带标记了打击点。使用建造菜单（默认为*键）将其嵌入地面进行训练。

messages.msgid: A hand-made humanoid figure, useful for training in close quarters combat.  This one is covered in scrap armor and looks on guard.  Use the construction menu (* by default) to embed it into the ground for training.
translations: 一个手工制作的人形靶，用于近身格斗训练。这个覆盖着废弃护甲，呈防守姿态。使用建造菜单（默认为*键）将其嵌入地面进行训练。

messages.msgid: A soft target for archery, consisting of tightly-packed cloth stuffed into a cardboard box, with a bullseye marked on the front.  Must be set up in the construction menu (* by default) to use.
translations: 一个射箭用的软靶，由紧密塞满布条的硬纸盒制成，正面画着一个靶心。使用建造菜单（默认为*键）将其嵌入地面进行训练。

messages.msgid: An electronic device for registering and calculating sales transactions.  It doesn't seem to be working.
translations: 一台用来记录和计算销售交易的电子设备。它似乎没法工作了。

messages.msgid: A prepared blunderbuss shot comprised of a large hunk of metal.  Better for distance than scattershot.
translations: 一颗装好的火铳弹，装着一大块金属弹丸。相较霰射弹种，更适合远距离射击。

messages.msgid: A prepared blunderbuss shot comprised of miscellaneous metal or stone bits.
translations: 一颗装好的火铳弹，装着许多小块金属或小石子。

messages.msgid: A prepared blunderbuss shot comprised of lead pellets.
translations: 一颗装好的火铳弹，装着许多铅弹丸。

messages.msgid: A prepared blunderbuss shot comprised of flechettes or nails.
translations: 一颗装好的火铳弹，装着许多镖形弹丸或钉子。

messages.msgid: An ID card that once belonged to a scientist.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.
translations: 这张钥匙卡曾经属于某位科学家。它的背面描述了使用规定，如果你能找到一个控制面板，它可以让你获得一次访问授权。

messages.msgid: An ID card that once belonged to a military officer.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.
translations: 这张钥匙卡曾经属于某位军官。它的背面描述了使用规定，如果你能找到一个控制面板，它可以让你获得一次访问授权。

messages.msgid: An ID card that once belonged to a high-level technician.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.
translations: 这张钥匙卡曾经属于某位高级工程师。它的背面描述了使用规定，如果你能找到一个控制面板，它可以让你获得一次访问授权。

messages.msgid: A manually-encoded badge giving you access to the artisans' workshop.  It even has your name written on the back.
translations: 一张手动编码的钥匙卡，让你能够进入匠人工坊。它的背面甚至写着你的名字。

messages.msgid: A visitor's pass to some sort of facility.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at a card reader, if you can find one.  It also lists the addresses of nearby facilities; activate it to add their locations to your map.
translations: 某种设施的访客通行证。背面描述了使用它的协议；如果你能找到读卡器，这可以授予访问权限。它还列出了附近设施的地址；使用它以将设施位置添加到地图中。

messages.msgid: You add the facilities to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了这个地点。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a maintenance worker.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at green zone card readers.
translations: 一张维护工的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得绿区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a maintenance worker.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at ocher zone card readers.
translations: 一张维护工的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得赭区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a maintenance worker.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at blue zone card readers.
translations: 一张维护工的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得蓝区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a freight hauler.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at transport freight card readers.  It also lists the addresses of nearby facilities; activate it to add their locations to your map.
translations: 一张货运工的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得货运区读卡器的访问授权。它还列出了附近设施的地址，激活它可以将其位置添加到你的地图上。

messages.msgid: You add the facilities to your map
translations: 你在地图上标记了这个地点。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a security officer.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at yellow zone card readers.
translations: 一张保安的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得黄区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a security officer.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at magenta zone card readers.
translations: 一张保安的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得洋红区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a security officer.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at black zone card readers.
translations: 一张保安的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得黑区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a research scientist.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at light green zone card readers.
translations: 一张研究员的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得浅绿区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a research scientist.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at pink zone card readers.
translations: 一张研究员的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得粉区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a research scientist.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at cyan zone card readers.
translations: 一张研究员的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得青区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a medical doctor.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at red zone card readers.
translations: 一张医生的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得红区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An employee badge for a system's supervisor.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access through white zone card readers.
translations: 一张系统主管的钥匙卡。它的背面描述了使用规定，可以让你获得白区读卡器的访问授权。

messages.msgid: An ID badge for the LIXA facility, with a photo of an awkwardly smiling scientist on the front.  Instructions on the back explain that this will grant you access to the LIXA experiment floor.
translations: 一张 LIXA 设施的身份钥匙卡，正面有一位的科学家尴尬微笑的照片。背面附有说明，允许持有者进入 LIXA 实验楼层。
磨损的 LIXA 身份钥匙卡

messages.msgid: An ID badge for the LIXA facility, with a photo of an awkwardly smiling scientist on the front.  It is heavily scratched, and there is a line on the back in black marker.
translations: 一张 LIXA 设施的身份钥匙卡，正面有一位的科学家尴尬微笑的照片。表面刮花得很严重，背面还有黑色记号笔涂了一根横线。

messages.msgid: LIXA ID badge: Dr. Najma Saed
translations: LIXA 身份卡：纳吉马 萨艾德
messages.plural: LIXA ID badges: Dr. Najma Saed

messages.msgid: An ID badge for the LIXA facility.  The photo is of a pleasantly smiling woman in a hijab.
translations: 一张 LIXA 设施的身份钥匙卡。照片中是一个微笑的女性，戴着伊斯兰头巾。

messages.msgid: LIXA ID badge: Dr. Jason Mitchell
translations: LIXA 身份卡：杰森 米歇尔
messages.plural: LIXA ID badges: Dr. Jason Mitchell

messages.msgid: An ID badge for the LIXA facility.  The photo is of a confidently smiling young man.
translations: 一张 LIXA 设施的身份钥匙卡。照片中是一个自信笑着的年轻男子。

messages.msgid: LIXA ID badge: Dr. Kai-Mei Luo
messages.plural: LIXA ID badges: Dr. Kai-Mei Luo

messages.msgid: An ID badge for the LIXA facility.  The photo is of an awkwardly smiling woman, who blinked during the picture.
translations: 一张 LIXA 设施的身份钥匙卡。照片中是一个尴尬笑着的女子，拍照时正好在眨眼睛。

messages.msgid: LIXA ID badge: Dr. Richard Raimes
translations: LIXA 身份卡：理查德 瑞姆斯
messages.plural: LIXA ID badges: Dr. Richard Raimes

messages.msgid: An ID badge for the LIXA facility.  The photo is of a gently smiling older man, with kind eyes.
translations: 一张 LIXA 设施的身份钥匙卡。照片中是一个神情祥和的老人，正对着镜头绅士地笑着。

messages.msgid: An id card bearing the name, rank, and serial number of a soldier stationed at LIXA.
translations: 一张 LIXA 设施的身份钥匙卡，记录有驻守LIXA士兵的名字、军衔和编号。

messages.msgid: A small rectangular device that Rubik gave you.  It is meant to be plugged in a locator antenna to reactivate it.
translations: 鲁比克给你的一个矩形装置，它可以插入并重新激活定位天线。

messages.msgid: A plastic lantern that is painted to look like a pumpkin with a face.  It has a tiny LED light inside, which is currently off.  It's mostly for seasonal decoration and doesn't provide very much light.
translations: 一个塑料灯笼，涂成了带鬼脸的南瓜的形状。它的内部有一只关闭的LED灯。它主要用作节日装饰，不会太亮。

messages.msgid: You flip the switch in the jack-o'-lantern.
translations: 你打开了万圣节南瓜灯的开关。

messages.msgid: A plastic lantern that is painted to look like a pumpkin with a face.  It has a tiny LED light inside which is currently on, to delightfully spooky effect.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can stay lit for a very long time.
translations: 一个塑料灯笼，涂成了带鬼脸的南瓜的形状。它的内部有一只点亮的LED灯，不是很亮，但能维持相当久。

messages.msgid: The LED winks out inside the lantern.
A carved pumpkin with a candle inside it.  You could light it to really set the spooky mood.
translations: 一个雕刻着鬼脸的南瓜，里面有支蜡烛。你可以点亮它来制造恐怖的氛围。

messages.msgid: A carved pumpkin with a lit candle inside.  Spooky and festive!
translations: 一个雕刻着鬼脸的南瓜，里面有支蜡烛。诡异又喜庆！

messages.msgid: A decorative wreath that can be deployed as furniture to celebrate the winter holidays.
translations: 这种装饰花环可以作为家具摆放，用于圣诞节的装饰。

messages.msgid: A battery-powered inflatable dragon from the Halloween before the end.  It might be fun to display it somewhere.
translations: 一头电池驱动的充气龙，来自大灾变之前的万圣夜。将其摆在某个地方可能很有趣。

messages.msgid: A battery-powered inflatable ghost from the Halloween before the end.  It might be fun to display it somewhere.
translations: 一只电池驱动的充气幽灵，来自大灾变之前的万圣夜。将其摆在某个地方可能很有趣。

messages.msgid: A battery-powered fog machine.  It would be great for setting ambience.
translations: 电池供电的喷雾机，烘托氛围的效果非常好。

messages.msgid: This defies easy description, it feels solid but the surface is yielding.  Looking at it you have a strange desire to call it a shelter.
translations: 这个东西很难描述，它感觉很坚固，但表面却在扭曲。看着它，你有一种奇怪的想法：这是一个庇护所。

messages.msgid: Seems like a targeted spatial distortion.
translations: 似乎是指向某处的空间扭曲。

messages.msgid: This defies easy description, it feels solid but the surface is yielding.  Looking at it you have a strange desire to call it a door.
translations: 这个东西很难描述，它感觉很坚固，但表面却在扭曲。看着它，你有一种奇怪的想法：这是一扇门。

messages.msgid: Seems like a random spatial distortion.
translations: 似乎是随机的空间扭曲。

messages.msgid: This defies easy description, it feels solid but the surface is yielding.  Looking at it you are reminded of the calm at the end of a portal storm.
translations: 这个东西很难描述，它感觉很坚固，但表面却在扭曲。看着它，你会想起空间风暴结束那一瞬间的宁静。

messages.msgid: Seems like it could calm local conditions.
translations: 它似乎可以平息这里的混乱。

messages.msgid: A creased holiday card.  It appears to be a Valentine's Day card from before the Cataclysm.
translations: 一张皱折的节日贺卡。这似乎是大灾变前的情人节贺卡。

messages.msgid: A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.
translations: 一张废纸，上面写了些字，但是太潦草了。

messages.msgid: A piece of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in simple, messy handwriting.
translations: 一张废纸，上面写了些字，但是太潦草了。

messages.msgid: A scrap of paper with a faded drawing on it.
translations: 一张纸，上面画着已经略显褪色的涂鸦。

messages.msgid: This grimy note seems out of place, as if someone lost it.
translations: 这张脏兮兮的字条显得格格不入，好像有人把它弄丢了。

messages.msgid: A sheet of paper adorned with an atom-and-flask symbol, detailing some questionable biological research.
translations: 一张印着原子和烧瓶符号标记的纸，详细描述了一些可疑的生物学研究。

messages.msgid: A sheet of paper bearing an atom-and-cross symbol, pertaining to the mental wellbeing of science staff.
translations: 一张印着原子和十字符号标记的纸，内容似乎与科研人员的精神健康有关。

messages.msgid: A sheet of paper bearing an atom-and-flask symbol, filled with incoherent ramblings about alien geometries and how to get to them.
translations: 一张印着原子和烧瓶符号标记的纸，上面写满了各种奇怪的几何结构以及如何到达它们的杂乱无章的文字。

messages.msgid: A collection of documents attesting to the purity of this batch, the performance of instrumentation during its production, and a list of materials used during its production and analysis.  It includes a Certificate of Analysis, each line listing a test method, result, and reviewer's signature, all in service of… something.  On one distinctive page a series of checkmarks slowly appear and fade around <color_yellow>"500 units of mutagen per 500 units of primer"</color> ratio.
translations: 一套文件记录，描述了某个批次的产品的纯度、生产时的仪器性能和生产检测中用到的材料的列表。里面包括了一张检测证书，每一行都列出了一种测试方式、相应的测试结果以及审阅人的签名，全部都是为了……某种目标。其中一张与众不同的文件上打着一系列时隐时现的勾，勾的附近写着<color_yellow>"500 单位诱变剂结合 500 单位诱变引物"</color>。

messages.msgid: Accompanying document, that describes tests performed on different subjects.
translations: 一套关于在不同实验对象身上进行的测试的附件。

messages.msgid: A sheet of paper bearing an atom-and-rifle symbol, detailing some very particular security protocols.
translations: 一张印着原子和步枪符号标记的纸，详细说明了一些非常特殊的安保流程。

messages.msgid: A manila folder containing top-secret test data.  Most of it is unintelligible without knowing the jargon, and the contents have obviously suffered from the chaos in this place, but there are some intact pages you can make sense of.
translations: 一个包含某些绝密测试数据的纸制文件夹。大部分内容在你不知道术语时是完全无法理解的，而且内容显然被这里的混乱所影响，但是有一些完整的页面可供你学习。

messages.msgid: A folder full of what appear to be transcripts of confidential psychotherapy sessions.  Most of it is rather trivial, but certain passages catch your eye…
translations: 一个满是秘密心理治疗记录的文件夹。大部分内容都很琐碎，但某些段落吸引了你的眼球……

messages.msgid: A manila folder bearing an atom-and-rifle insignia.  Most of it is concerned with shipping logs and personnel rotations, but there is a single page that feels out of place.
translations: 一个印着原子和步枪标记的马尼拉文件夹。大部分内容都与运输记录和人员轮换有关，但其中一张似乎有些异常。
一张彩色印刷的记分卡。

messages.msgid: A snippet from a newspaper, celebrating the achievements of the one enshrined.
translations: 报纸上的一段片段，是庆祝某个人的成就，他似乎被奉为圣人对待。

messages.msgid: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It is possibly one of the last issues printed before New England was overwhelmed.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.
translations: 一份报纸中的某页。可能来自新英格兰被丧尸占领前印刷的最后几期。大多是些琐碎或者过时的信息，但某件事还是能短暂吸引你的目光。

messages.msgid: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It seems to date from several years ago, and you have NO idea how it lasted this long.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.
translations: 一份报纸中的某页，来自好几年前，你很奇怪它是如何保存至今的。大多是些琐碎或者过时的信息，但某件事还是能短暂吸引你的目光。

messages.msgid: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It seems to date from a few years ago--amazing it has lasted this long.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.
translations: 一张报纸大张。 它似乎可以追溯到几年前 - 令人惊讶的是它持续了这么长时间。 大多数信息都非常琐碎或过时，但有一件事会短暂地吸引你的眼球。

messages.msgid: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed more than a year ago.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.
translations: 一张报纸大张。 它是一年多前印刷的。 大多数信息都非常琐碎或过时，但有一件事会短暂地吸引你的眼球。

messages.msgid: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed in the months leading up to the Cataclysm.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.
translations: 一张报纸大张。 它是在大灾变前的几个月里印刷的。 大多数信息都非常琐碎或过时，但有一件事会短暂地吸引你的眼球。

messages.msgid: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed in the weeks leading up to the Cataclysm.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.
translations: 一张报纸大张。 它是在大灾变前几周印刷的。 大多数信息都非常琐碎或过时，但有一件事会短暂地吸引你的眼球。

messages.msgid:
Welcome to your Emergency Survival Shelter.  We hope your stay here will be short and comfortable.  Provided are an emergency blanket, high-visibility jacket, gas mask, and food and water rations for one day, as well as an emergency lighter and flashlight.  There are further supplies in the communal cabinets should the facility be over its intended capacity.  These resources are checked and updated by FEMA on a regular basis, but if you find some items missing, please contact a FEMA supervisor at your earliest convenience.

Please wait in the shelter until an official evacuation transport arrives to take you to your homes or, in the event of a major disaster, to the nearest evacuation gathering point.

In the event that you have been evacuated under violent circumstances, FEMA recommends taking cover in the shelter's basement until help arrives.  Remember: if you leave the shelter, we cannot find you to take you to safety.
translations:
欢迎来到你的紧急生存庇护所。我们希望你在这里停留的时间短暂而舒适。提供应急毯、高能见度夹克、防毒面具、一天的食物和水配给，以及应急打火机和手电筒。 如果设施超出其预期容量，公共柜中还有更多供应品。FEMA 会定期检查和更新这些资源，但如果你发现某些物品缺失，请尽早联系 FEMA 主管。

请在避难所等候，直到官方疏散运输工具到达，将你送回家，或在重大灾难发生时，转移至最近的疏散集合点。

如果你在暴力情况下被疏散，FEMA 建议你在避难所的地下室躲避，直到救援到达。 请记住：如果你离开避难所，我们无法找到你并将你送至安全地带。

messages.msgid: An official poster notifying the public of a missing person, and requesting that anyone with information contact the listed phone number.
translations: 通知公众失踪人员的官方海报，并要求任何有信息的人联系列出的电话号码。

messages.msgid: An official poster notifying the public of a missing child, and requesting that anyone with information contact the listed phone number.
translations: 一张官方海报，通知公众失踪儿童，并要求任何有信息的人联系列出的电话号码。

messages.msgid: A handmade poster notifying passersby about someone's missing dog, and requesting that anyone with information contact the listed phone number.
translations: 一张手工制作的海报，通知路人某人失踪的狗，并要求任何有信息的人联系列出的电话号码。

messages.msgid: A handmade poster notifying passersby about someone's missing cat, and requesting that anyone with information contact the listed phone number.
translations: 一张手工海报，内容大意是某人遗失了他的猫，希望任何有线索的路人联系主人的号码。

messages.msgid: Posters promoting movies that were in theaters when the Cataclysm hit.
translations: 大灾变发生时，正在上映的电影宣传海报.

messages.msgid: Last Stand 2: Still Standing movie poster
translations: 《背水一战2：依然屹立》电影海报
messages.plural: Last Stand 2: Still Standing movie posters

messages.msgid: This a poster for the highly anticipated sequel "Last Stand 2: Still Standing".  Ashton Murphy reprises his role as Det. Harvey Baxter, a retired private eye who delivers pain to those who flee from justice.
translations: 这是备受期待的续集电影《背水一战2：依然屹立》的海报。阿什顿-墨菲(Ashton Murphy)再次扮演哈维-巴克斯特（Det. Harvey Baxter），他是一名退休的私家侦探，为那些逃离正义的人带来痛苦。

messages.msgid: A poster promoting the animated movie "The Black Freighter", an adaptation of the novel of the same name.  The print is in the same style as the source material.
translations: 一张宣传动画电影《黑船》的海报，改编自同名小说。这张传单的美术画风和其衍生漫画相同。

messages.msgid: A white movie poster displaying a balding man in a stained hoodie waving lackadaisically.  He appears to be the title character.
translations: 一张白色的电影海报，展示了一个身穿脏兮兮连帽衫的秃头男子，无精打采地挥手。他似乎就是标题角色。

messages.msgid: Fyreguard: A Tale as Old as Time movie poster
translations: 《菲尔护卫队：与时间一样古老的故事》电影海报
messages.plural: Fyreguard: A Tale as Old as Time movie posters

messages.msgid: A vibrant poster displaying an astonishing landscape full of magical creatures.  Above the illustration is the title of the movie in a medieval font.
translations: 一张富有冲击力的海报，描绘着充满神奇生物的惊人景观。插图上方是中世纪字体的电影标题。

messages.msgid: A poster for "Hunted III", the third entry of the "Hunted" slasher franchise.  Its tagline reads: "You can't outrun it forever".
translations: 《猎杀III》的海报，《猎杀》系列的第三部作品。 标语写着：“你不可能永远甩掉它”。

messages.msgid: A poster for "Cybercop 3D", a sci-fi movie about a policeman tasked to take down a group of dangerous hackers inside a simulated reality.
translations: "Cybercop 3D"的海报，这是一部科幻电影，讲述了一名警察的任务是在模拟现实中击败一群危险的黑客。

messages.msgid: A small picture of something or somebody important to the owner, designed to be safely tucked into a wallet.
translations: 一张对主人来说很重要的东西或某人的小照片，能安全地放进钱包里。

messages.msgid: A medium picture of something that the owner wished to decorate their house with.
translations: 中等大小的装饰图片，用来装点屋主的家。

messages.msgid: A module that integrates visual and proprioceptive information from peripheric sensors and outputs information necessary for accurate aiming.
translations: 该模块通过将来自外围传感器的视觉和本体感知信息集成运算，输出精确瞄准所需要的信息。

messages.msgid: A module that continuously runs image recognition algorithms to differentiate friend from foe.
translations: 该模块不断运行图像识别算法，以识别敌友。

messages.msgid: A module that uses a combination of vector integration and egocentric mapping to find the best path available.
translations: 该模块使用向量集成和以自我为中心的映射相结合来找到最佳可用路径。

messages.msgid: A module that allows for the storage and recovery of information.
translations: 该模块能够储存和恢复信息。

messages.msgid: A wide range of sensors meant to give the ability to perceive the surrounding world.
translations: 各种各样用于感知周围的世界情况的传感器。

messages.msgid: An array of sensors and diagnostic modules allowing a robot to perceive itself.
translations: 一系列传感器和诊断模块，允许机器人感知自己。

messages.msgid: A module that is responsible for decision-making, it basically runs the AI of a robot.
translations: 该模块负责决策，机器人的 AI 基本上靠它运行。

messages.msgid: A very basic AI core with minimal cognitive abilities.
translations: 只拥有最小认知能力的基础人工智能核心。

messages.msgid: An advanced AI core with impressive cognitive abilities.
translations: 拥有令人印象深刻的认知能力的高级人工智能核心。

messages.msgid: A system that can operate most conventional weapons.
translations: 可以操作大多数常规武器的系统。

messages.msgid: A set of tiny, pointy legs, like the ones found under a skitterbot.
translations: 一对细小而尖的腿，就像在滑稽机器人下发现的那些。

messages.msgid: A set of omni wheels, like the ones found under a police bot.
translations: 一组全向车轮组，就像在警用机器人用的那种。

messages.msgid: A set of rotors able to lift a small drone.
translations: 一组能够驱动小型无人机的转子。

messages.msgid: A set of small tank treads, like the ones used by the "Beagle" mini-tank.
translations: 一组小型坦克履带，就像"猎兔犬"型无人坦克用的那种。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton of a turret.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备后剩下的构成炮塔的骨架。

messages.msgid: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of a police bot.
translations: 移除所有可动部件和电子设备时剩下的，是警用机器人的骨架和装甲。

messages.msgid: A set of big pointy legs, like the ones found under a tripod.
translations: 一组大而尖的腿，就像在三足机器人用的那种。

messages.msgid: What's left when you strip an android body from its components.
translations: 将仿生人躯体剥离部件后剩下的东西。

messages.msgid: A miscellaneous piece of hobby software.  Probably useless.
translations: 一堆有趣的小型软件打包，没什么用处。

messages.msgid: Research archives from a government laboratory.
translations: 一份来自政府实验室的实验数据。

messages.msgid: There are numerous security keys with dates for potential future access to encrypted archived data.
translations: 许多带有日期的安全密钥，可以用来访问加密的存档数据。

messages.msgid: Extremely compressed research data, observation and experiment statistics.  The only pattern you manage to recognize is an increase in the amount of report closer to the Cataclysm, but also a reduction in the number of facilities still submitting reports.
translations: 高度压缩的研究数据、观察和实验统计数据。你唯一认出来的特征是，越接近大灾变发生的那一天，报告的数量越多，但仍旧在提交报告的设施数量也逐渐减少了。

messages.msgid: Huge archives of numerous IC circuit datasheets from several major manufacturers.  Probably valuable to the right person, as it would be hard to salvage and reuse these components without them.
translations: 一套包含了多个大型制造商的集成电路参数表的档案库。缺少这些数据将很难回收使用相应的集成电路元件，因此这套档案对某些人来说可能很有价值。

messages.msgid: A useless piece of electronic data.
translations: 一些毫无用处的电子数据。

messages.msgid: You kept this file on the off-chance that it might be interesting, but you need to take a more thorough look to find out what's inside.
translations: 你保留这份文件的初衷是觉得它可能会很有趣，但你需要更深入地查看其中的内容，才能知道里面到底有什么。

messages.msgid: Information about nearby locations stored from previous use.
translations: 存储那些以前使用过的附近位置信息。

messages.msgid: This is a filtered collection of PDFs, images, and texts that contains instructions for making useful items.  Any electronic recipe catalogs will be added to this one.
translations: 这是一个经过筛选的PDF、图像和文本集合，其中包含制作有用物品的说明。任何电子配方目录都将添加到此目录中。

messages.msgid: A varied collection of detailed photos.  Any collections of this kind will be added to this one.
translations: 各种各样的细节详尽的照片集。任何此类文件都将添加到其中。

messages.msgid: A tool to help set arm bones and hold them in place.
translations: 一个用于固定和矫正手臂骨骼以帮助骨折恢复的工具。

messages.msgid: A tool to help set arm bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Huge survivors.
translations: 一个用于固定和矫正手臂骨骼以帮助骨折恢复的工具。专门设计用于体型较大的幸存者。

messages.msgid: A tool to help set arm bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Tiny survivors.
translations: 一个用于固定和矫正手臂骨骼以帮助骨折恢复的工具。专门设计用于体型较小的幸存者。

messages.msgid: A first aid device used to apply pressure to a limb or extremity in order to limit blood flow.  Should be employed only to manage heavy bleeding, because prolonged use will harm the limb.  It can be adjusted in size to fit different limbs.
translations: 一款能够对四肢或手足施加压力以限制血液流动的急救装置。应当仅用于非常严重的出血症状的急救，因为长期使用会对四肢造成伤害。它可以调节尺寸，以适应不同大小的肢体。
你调节了止血带的尺寸。

messages.msgid: A crude eye covering woven from blades of grass with string attached to fasten it.  Useful for sleeping in bright areas.  Use to raise it.
translations: 这是一种用草叶编织而成的简易眼罩，上面有附带的绳子可以固定。在光照明亮的场所睡觉时会很有用。你可以把它拉上去。
你不再遮住自己的双眼。

messages.msgid: A crude eye covering woven from blades of grass with string attached to fasten it.  It's currently raised, letting you see.  Use to lower it.
translations: 这是一种用草叶编织而成的简易眼罩，上面有附带的绳子可以固定。眼罩目前处于抬起状态，允许你保持视觉。你可以把它拉下来。

messages.msgid: A simple fabric covering tied over the eyes to block sight.  Useful for sleeping in bright areas.  Use to raise it.
translations: 一块系在眼部以遮挡视觉的简易织物，在光照明亮的场所睡觉时会很有用。你可以把它拉上去。

messages.msgid: A simple fabric covering tied over the eyes to block sight.  It's currently raised, letting you see.  Use to lower it.
translations: 一块系在眼部以遮挡视觉的简易织物。眼罩目前处于抬起状态，允许你保持视觉。你可以把它拉下来。

messages.msgid: A simple covering tied over the eyes to block sight, made out of duct tape.  Useful for sleeping in bright areas.  Use to raise it.
translations: 一件由强力胶带制成的简易眼罩，用于遮挡视觉。在光照明亮的场所睡觉时会很有用。你可以把它拉上去。

messages.msgid: A simple covering tied over the eyes to block sight, made out of duct tape.  It's currently raised, letting you see.  Use to lower it.
translations: 一件由强力胶带制成的简易眼罩，用于遮挡视觉。眼罩目前处于抬起状态，允许你保持视觉。你可以把它拉上去。

messages.msgid: Industrial-grade ear plugs.  They fit inside the ears.
translations: 工业级耳塞。 它们适合耳朵内。

messages.msgid: A huge duffel bag with a backpack attached, both packed to the gills.  Judging by the feel, a National Guardsman could have packed this to be ready for deployment.  Activate to unpack and enjoy.
translations: 一个配有背包的超大行李袋，被绑得严严实实。从外形和材质上看，这应该是国民警卫队的标配。使用可拆开包装。

messages.msgid: A huge duffel bag with a backpack attached, both packed to the gills.  You packed this to be ready for deployment.  Activate to unpack and enjoy.
translations: 一个配有背包的超大行李袋，被绑得严严实实。使用可拆开包装。

messages.msgid: A tool to help set leg bones and hold them in place.
translations: 一个用于固定和矫正腿部骨骼以帮助骨折恢复的工具。

messages.msgid: A tool to help set leg bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Huge people.
translations: 一个用于固定和矫正腿部骨骼以帮助骨折恢复的工具。专门设计用于体型较大的幸存者。

messages.msgid: A tool to help set leg bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Tiny people.
translations: 一个用于固定和矫正腿部骨骼以帮助骨折恢复的工具。专门设计用于体型较小的幸存者。

messages.msgid: A plastic mask with a very dark visor, meant to protect the entire face while welding.  It also serves as somewhat good armor, but makes it hard to see.  Activate it to push it up your head.
translations: 一种带有深黑色视窗的塑料面罩，用来在焊接时保护整个面部。也可以当作一个不错的头部护甲来穿戴，但会严重遮蔽你的视线。激活以将面罩推到头顶。

messages.msgid: You push your %s up your head.
A crude welding mask made from shaped steel.  It will keep your face safe while welding, but it's a bit less comfortable than the real deal.  Activate it to push it up your head.
translations: 一个用钢材手动锻造成型的简易焊接面罩。它可以在焊接时防护你的面部，但穿起来仍然不如真正的焊接面罩舒服。激活以将面罩推到头顶。

messages.msgid: A crude welding mask made from shaped steel.  It's less dark than a proper welding mask, and therefore less difficult to see in, but also less protective when welding.  Activate it to lower it over your face.
translations: 一种用成形钢制成的简易焊接面罩。比真正的焊接面罩颜色稍浅，因此在便于视物的同时也牺牲了部分焊接时的保护能力。激活以将面罩降下至覆盖全脸。

messages.msgid: You lower your crude welding mask over your face.
translations: 你将你的简易焊接面罩降下，覆盖住面部。

messages.msgid: A plastic mask with a very dark visor, meant to protect the entire face while welding.  It also serves as somewhat good armor, but makes it hard to see.  Activate it to lower it over your face.
translations: 一种带有深黑色视窗的塑料面罩，用来在焊接时保护整个面部。也可以当作一个不错的头部护甲来穿戴，但会严重遮蔽你的视线。激活以将面罩降下至覆盖全脸。

messages.msgid: You lower your welding mask over your face.
translations: 你将你的焊接面罩降下，覆盖住面部。

messages.msgid: A waterproof digital watch with a built-in electronic game system, powered by standard batteries.  Activate to play.
translations: 一块防水电子表，内置电子游戏系统，使用标准电池供电。激活即可游玩。

messages.msgid: A touchscreen watch that comes with many uses, such as a calendar, alarm, and even a fitness app, for when you want to check your health on the go!
translations: 一款具有多种用途的触摸屏手表，例如日历、闹钟，甚至是健身应用程序，当你想在旅途中检查健康状况时！

messages.msgid: A touchscreen watch that comes with many uses, such as a calendar, alarm, and even a fitness app, for when you want to check your health on the go!  This is more expensive model, featuring shock-resistant and waterproof case and a bunch of additional sensors.
translations: 一款具有多种用途的触摸屏手表，例如日历、闹钟，甚至是健身应用程序，当你想在旅途中检查健康状况时！ 这是更昂贵的型号，具有防震防水外壳和一堆额外的传感器。

messages.msgid: A fitness band that can track your heartbeat, exercise level, and calories, and also has a clock.  Activate to see your metrics.
translations: 一个健身手环，可以记录你的心跳、运动水平和热量摄入，内置一个时钟。激活以查看自身的健康运动指标。

messages.msgid: A proprietary wrist mount for a flashlight.  Not very useful on its own.
translations: 一款手电筒专用腕部支架。单独使用并没什么用。

messages.msgid: Proprietary mount for a diving flashlight.
A cloak woven with metallic fibers and covered with hexagonal sheets of reflective carbide.  When activated, it will create a holographic decoy of its wearer.
translations: 一件由金属纤维制成的披风，表面覆盖着许多能反射光线的六边形的碳化物。开启后，会生成一个和穿戴者一模一样的全息投影。

messages.msgid: A high-crowned, wide-brimmed, sable-colored fedora.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.  The perfect hat for treasure hunting.
translations: 一只宽边高顶的黑貂色软呢帽。它的宽边能够为你的眼睛遮挡阳光。这帽子特别适合探宝行动。

messages.msgid: A pair of socks with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一双有着内部电池供电加热元件的袜子。激活来开启它。

messages.msgid: A pair of socks with internal battery-powered heating elements.  They are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.
translations: 一双有着内部电池供电加热元件的袜子。它已经被开启，不断耗电来产生热量。激活来关闭它。

messages.msgid: A full-body suit of thin thermal underwear equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一件配有内部电池供电的加热元件体的保暖内衣套装。激活来开启它。

messages.msgid: A full-body suit of thin thermal underwear equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一件配有内部电池供电的加热元件体的保暖内衣套装。激活来关闭它。

messages.msgid: A pair of gloves with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一双有着内部电池供电加热元件的手套。激活来开启它。

messages.msgid: A pair of gloves with internal battery-powered heating elements.  They are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.
translations: 一双有着内部电池供电加热元件的手套。它已经被开启，不断耗电来产生热量。激活来关闭它。

messages.msgid: A snug cloth mask with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一件有着内部电池供电加热元件的贴身舒适的布头罩。激活来开启它。

messages.msgid: A snug cloth mask with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一件有着内部电池供电加热元件的贴身舒适的布头罩。它已经被开启，不断耗电来产生热量。激活来关闭它。

messages.msgid: A pair of optics with a neck strap attached.  Useful for seeing long distances.  Wearing this item or carrying it in your inventory will double the distance around you that is mapped during your travels.  You could also use them to focus the sunlight.
translations: 望远镜，有了它，你就能望向很远的地方。穿戴或将其放在物品栏内可以使得大地图视野翻倍。你同样可以使用它来聚焦阳光。

messages.msgid: An LED headlamp with an adjustable strap so as to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一个系在可调整的带子上的LED手电筒，可以把它穿在头上或者系在头盔上。激活来开启它。

messages.msgid: A point-and-shoot digital camera with a digital viewfinder, a backup 'iron-sight', and flash.  You can look at your photos on the digital screen, or transfer them with a memory card.  This one can be worn over your neck.
translations: 傻瓜式数码相机，配有数码取景器、备用“瞄具”和闪光灯。 您可以在数码屏幕上查看照片，也可以用存储卡传输照片。 这款相机可以戴在脖子上。

messages.msgid: A 35 mm digital SLR (single-lens reflex) camera with optical and digital viewfinders, a zoom lens with auto-focus and stabilizer, and flash.  You can view your photos on it or transfer them with a memory card.  Before the Cataclysm, you could have taken professional-grade photos using this.  This one can be worn over your neck.
translations: 一台35毫米数码单反相机，配有光学和电子取景器、带自动对焦与防抖功能的变焦镜头，以及闪光灯。你可以直接在相机上浏览照片，或通过存储卡导出。在灾变降临前，用它拍出的可是专业级作品。这款相机可以挂在脖子上随身携带。

messages.msgid: An LED headlamp with an adjustable strap so as to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一个系在可调整的带子上的LED手电筒，可以把它穿在头上或者系在头盔上。它已经被开启，不断耗电来产生光亮。激活来关闭它。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty LED headlamp with a durable polymer housing.  It's impact-resistant, chemical-resistant, waterproof and certified for use in hazardous environments.  Designed for firefighters, rescue personnel and miners.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 重型 LED 头灯，采用耐用的聚合材料外壳。 它耐冲击、耐化学腐蚀、防水，并通过了危险环境使用认证。 专为消防员、救援人员和矿工设计。 激活它以关闭。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty LED headlamp with a durable polymer housing.  It's impact-resistant, chemical-resistant, waterproof and certified for use in hazardous environments.  Designed for firefighters, rescue personnel and miners.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 重型 LED 头灯，采用耐用的聚合材料外壳。 它耐冲击、耐化学腐蚀、防水，并通过了危险环境使用认证。 专为消防员、救援人员和矿工设计。 激活它以开启。

messages.msgid: A custom-made, reinforced headlamp powered by the magic of nuclear decay, focused for more usable brightness.  The adjustable strap allows it to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.
translations: 一个自制的强化头灯，使用原子能衰变放出的能量照明，光线经过聚焦以达到能用的亮度。头灯上的带子可以调整，让你可以把它穿在头上或者系在头盔上。激活它来关上灯罩。

messages.msgid: A custom-made, reinforced headlamp powered by the magic of nuclear decay, focused for more usable brightness.  The adjustable strap allows it to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.
translations: 一个自制的强化头灯，使用原子能衰变放出的能量照明，光线经过聚焦以达到能用的亮度。头灯上的带子可以调整，让你可以把它穿在头上或者系在头盔上。激活它来打开灯罩。

messages.msgid: A pair of compact augmented reality glasses with some basic functionality.  There is a camera on the rim, and it has an alarm clock feature.
translations: 一副小巧的增强现实眼镜，具有一些基本功能。镜框上有个摄像头，还有闹钟功能。

messages.msgid: An expensive model of augmented reality glasses, with adaptive light correction and some gadgets, designed to be compatible with corrective glasses.  An augmented reality overlay allows the user to zoom their view, and it displays handy information about local topology.
translations: 一款昂贵的增强现实眼镜，带有自适应光线校正功能和一些小工具，能够和矫正视力的眼镜兼容。增强现实叠加层可以让用户缩放，并显示有关本地路网的有用信息。

messages.msgid: An armored, electronically-shielded helmet containing a camera, a two-way radio, and a headlamp, all of which can be voice-activated for redundancy.  It is designed to protect against overpressure, fragmentation, impact, and heat.
translations: 一顶装甲电子防护头盔，包含一个摄像机、一个双向无线电和一个头灯，所有设备都有语音激活系统作为备份。它们被设计得能够防护超压、破片、冲击和高温。

messages.msgid: A full-body suit of sleek black military armor that represents the pinnacle of Rivtech's powered armor technology.  It has a proprietary internal battery recharged by UPS.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一套光滑的黑色军用全身装甲，代表着Rivtech动力装甲技术的巅峰。它有一个由UPS充电的专用内置电池。激活以启动。

messages.msgid:
You activate your RM13 combat armor.
Rivtech Model 13 RivOS v2.19:   ONLINE.
CBRN defense system:            ONLINE.
Acoustic dampening system:      ONLINE.
Thermal regulation system:      ONLINE.
Vision enhancement system:      ONLINE.
Electro-reactive armor system:  ONLINE.
All systems nominal.
translations:
你激活了你的RM13战斗装甲。
Rivtech Model 13 RivOS v2.19: 系统启动
CBRN 防御系统: 在线
声学减震系统: 在线
热调节系统: 在线
视觉增强系统: 在线
电反应装甲系统: 在线
系统全部正常。

messages.msgid: The RM13 combat armor's battery is dead.
translations: RM XIII 战斗装甲的燃料电池耗尽了。

messages.msgid: A full-body suit of sleek black military armor that represents the pinnacle of Rivtech's powered armor technology.  As you move your fingers over the surface, the armor tenses, almost as though it were alive.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一套光滑的黑色军用全身装甲，代表着Rivtech动力装甲技术的巅峰。当你的手指在它表面上划过时，盔甲的弹力让你感觉它似乎是活物一般。激活以关闭。

messages.msgid:
You deactivate your RM13 combat armor.
RivOS v2.19 shutdown sequence initiated.
Shutting down.
Your RM13 combat armor turns off.
translations:
你关闭你的RM13战斗装甲。
RivOS v2.19 正在执行关闭程序：
正在关闭。
你的战斗装甲关闭了。

messages.msgid: A featureless, disc-shaped device mounted on a harness.  The words "X.E.D.R.A" and "5-point anchor" are inscribed on its front and back.
translations: 一个装在背带上的无特征碟状装置。在它的正反两面分别刻着"X.E.D.R.A"和"五点式空间锚"两词。

messages.msgid: An LED light in the %s flickers on.
It seems like this device needs power.
translations: 看起来这个设备需要有某种能源才能使用。

messages.msgid: The harness' shoulder-mounted LED glows with a soft green hue.  There's no further indication of anything happening.
translations: 空间锚肩部的LED发出柔和的绿光。除此之外，似乎没有任何其它事情发生。

messages.msgid: A battered, disc-shaped device mounted on a harness.  The inscriptions "X.E.D.R.A" and "5-point anchor" are barely legible on its radiation-stained front and back.
translations: 一件固定在背带上的破旧碟形装置。其被辐射污染的正反两面勉强可辨"X.E.D.R.A"与"五点式空间锚"字样。

messages.msgid: The %s emits a low-pitched clicking alarm as its mounted LED light flashes yellow.
translations: %s发出低沉的咔嗒警报声，上面LED灯闪着黄光。

messages.msgid: Covered in interlocking plates of reflective metal, this advanced suit resembles both plate armor and an astronaut's spacesuit.  Designed to protect its wearer during extradimensional excursions, it offers unparalleled environmental protection, both in this Earth and beyond.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 这套高级防护服覆盖着交错的反射性金属装甲板，看上去又像板甲又像宇航服。它的设计能够在使用者进行超维度移动时提供保护，因此有着无与伦比的环境防护能力，无论是在地球还是在其它地方。使用以启动。

messages.msgid:
Initiating
Running suit integrity diagnostics…
All systems operational.
translations:
正在初始化
进行防护服完整性诊断……
所有系统工作正常。

messages.msgid: Warning: Operating on minimal power.  Protection compromised.
translations: 警告：正以最低功率运行。防护已失效。

messages.msgid: Covered in interlocking plates of reflective metal, this advanced suit resembles both plate armor and an astronaut's spacesuit.  It is turned on, and continually draining power.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 这套高级防护服覆盖着交错的反射性金属装甲板，看上去又像板甲又像宇航服。它已经启动，正在持续消耗能量。使用以关闭。

messages.msgid: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一个罩住嘴的面罩，当放入合适的滤芯时，可以让你在水下循环利用呼出的废气。激活它来开启。

messages.msgid: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一个罩住嘴的面罩，当放入合适的滤芯时，可以让你在水下循环利用呼出的废气。它目前已开启并持续消耗滤芯，激活它来关闭。

messages.msgid: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been expanded substantially and can accommodate exotic anatomy.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一个罩住嘴的面罩，当放入合适的滤芯时，可以让你在水下循环利用呼出的废气。这一型号经过扩容可以容纳任何骨骼惊奇的家伙。激活它来开启。

messages.msgid: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been expanded substantially and can accommodate exotic anatomy.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一个罩住嘴的面罩，当放入合适的滤芯时，可以让你在水下循环利用呼出的废气。这一型号经过扩容可以容纳任何骨骼惊奇的家伙。它目前已开启并持续消耗滤芯，激活它来关闭。

messages.msgid: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been shrunk dramatically to fit a smaller face.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一个罩住嘴的面罩，当放入合适的滤芯时，可以让你在水下循环利用呼出的废气。这一型号经过缩小适合更小的脸。激活它来开启。

messages.msgid: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been shrunk dramatically to fit a smaller face.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一个罩住嘴的面罩，当放入合适的滤芯时，可以让你在水下循环利用呼出的废气。这一型号经过缩小适合更小的脸。它目前已开启并持续消耗滤芯，激活它来关闭。

messages.msgid: A mask that straps over your mouth and nose and filters air.  Protects from smoke, dust, and other contaminants quite well.  It must be prepared before use.
translations: 一个罩在嘴巴和鼻子上并过滤空气的口罩。可以很好地阻挡烟雾、灰尘和其他污染物。需要先使用才能起效。

messages.msgid: A full-face, industrial-grade respirator made from a solid black silicon and butyl rubber blend, providing decent user comfort in addition to a clear field of view and a secure fit thanks to the mask's single-element visor and 6-point head harness.  Provided that a filter canister's been screwed into the right-side filter port and the respirator's been prepared, it'll do an admirable job at preventing smoke, gas, and contaminants derived from chemical and lab work from taking up residence in your organs.
translations: 一款全脸式、工业级的防毒面具，由坚固的黑色硅胶和丁基橡胶混合材料制成，除了提供良好的佩戴舒适度之外，还因面具的单片式面罩和六点头部固定带确保了清晰的视野和稳固的贴合。只要在右侧过滤端口安装了滤毒罐，并且防毒面具已经戴好，它就能出色地防止烟雾、有毒气体及实验室工作中产生的化学污染物侵入你的器官。

messages.msgid: A number of external brackets arranged around the eyepiece to retain an outer attachment.
translations: 一些眼罩周围配置的多点式外置支架，用于稳固附加配件。

messages.msgid: A space behind the visor designed to accommodate the installation of inserts.
translations: 一块面罩后预留的空间，专门为插入配件而设计。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, form-fitting mask that straps over your mouth and nose, providing full protection from the inhalation of smoke, tear gas, and chemical contaminants - though safety goggles are advised!  It must be prepared before use.
translations: 一副轻巧的贴身面罩，绑在你的嘴和鼻子上，提供全面保护，防止你吸入烟雾、催泪瓦斯和化学污染物——不过建议戴上安全护目镜！需要先使用才能起效。

messages.msgid: A custom-made leather gasmask faced with Nomex.  It must be prepared before use.
translations: 一个自制的皮革防毒面具，表面覆有芳纶面料。需要先使用才能起效。

messages.msgid: A full-face mask commonly used by firefighters.  The protective breathing apparatus provides excellent protection from smoke, flame, and other dangers.  It must be prepared before use.
translations: 一种消防员常用的全脸面罩。其防护呼吸装置能对烟雾、火焰及其他危险提供出色的防护。使用前必须先进行提前准备。

messages.msgid: A gas mask handcrafted from treated leather with a steel faceplate overtop.  It must be prepared before use.
translations: 使用防水皮革手工制成的防毒面具，上面有一个钢制的面板。需要先使用才能起效。

messages.msgid: A half-face gasmask handcrafted from treated leather.  It provides no protection for the eyes, and must be activated before use.
translations: 使用防水皮革手工制成的半脸防毒面罩，没有对眼部的保护，需要先使用才能起效。

messages.msgid: A gas mask handcrafted from treated leather.  It must be prepared before use.
translations: 使用防水皮革手工制成的防毒面具，需要先使用才能起效。

messages.msgid: A pair of battery-powered goggles that use a infrared LED in conjunction with a IR camera, allowing you to see in the dark.  Use it to turn them on.
translations: 一副电池供电的夜视仪，使用红外LED和红外相机，使佩戴者在黑暗之中能看到东西。激活来开启。

messages.msgid: A pair of battery-powered goggles that use a infrared LED in conjunction with a IR camera, allowing you to see in the dark.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.
translations: 一副电池供电的夜视仪，使用红外LED和红外相机，使佩戴者在黑暗之中能看到东西。它已经开启并不断消耗电池，激活来关闭。

messages.msgid: A pair of battery-powered goggles that grant infrared vision, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark.  Use it to turn them on.
translations: 一幅电池驱动的红外护目镜，让你能在黑暗中看到恒温生物。激活来开启。

messages.msgid: A pair of battery-powered goggles that grant infrared vision, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark.  Use it to turn them off.
translations: 一幅电池驱动的红外护目镜，让你能在黑暗中看到恒温生物。激活来关闭。

messages.msgid: A modified RX12 jet injector which can be worn on the body.  A label on the side warns against using more than two doses per hour.
translations: 一个改造过的RX12压力注射器，可以穿在身上。上面有一个标签，提醒使用者不要在1小时内使用超过2次。

messages.msgid: A Rivtech RX11 stimulant delivery system, a jet autoinjector system worn on the user's body.  A simple press of its activator injects powerful chemical stimulants into the bloodstream without using a needle.
translations: 一个RX11兴奋剂注射器，一种穿戴式的无针自助注射设备。仅仅需要简单地按一按启动按钮，不需要扎入针头，强力兴奋剂就能进入你的血液。

messages.msgid: A custom-built, armored rebreather mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from harm as well providing breathing gas while underwater.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一个自制的带甲呼吸面罩，覆盖了脸和眼睛，提供良好防护的同时还供你在水下呼吸。激活它来开启。

messages.msgid: A custom-built, armored rebreather mask that covers the face and eyes.  Provides excellent protection from harm as well providing breathing gas while underwater.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一个自制的带甲呼吸面罩，覆盖了脸和眼睛，提供良好防护的同时还供你在水下呼吸。它已经启动，正持续使用滤芯。激活它来关闭。

messages.msgid: A custom-built, armored rebreather mask that covers the face and eyes regardless of your state of mutation.  Provides excellent protection from harm as well providing breathing gas while underwater.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一个自制的带甲呼吸面罩，覆盖了脸和眼睛，适用于各种脸部变异，提供良好防护的同时还供你在水下呼吸。它已经启动，正持续使用滤芯。激活它来关闭。

messages.msgid: A small, battery-powered biometric safety device worn on the wrist.  Activate to check your current level of radiation exposure.
translations: 一个电池供电的小型生物安全监测设备，能带在手腕上。激活它来检测当前辐射水平。

messages.msgid: A plain hairpin to keep your hair in place.
translations: 一个平平无奇的发夹，可以固定住头发。

messages.msgid: A pink hairpin with cute flower textures.
translations: 一个粉红色的发夹，上面印着可爱的花朵图案。

messages.msgid: A large, fluffy towel.  It could be used to dry yourself.  Any person that can travel the length and breadth of the apocalypse, rough it, slum it, struggle against terrible odds, win through, and still know where their towel is, is clearly a force to be reckoned with.
translations: 一条蓬松柔软的大毛巾，使用它可以擦干你自己。任何能在宽阔广大的末日世界旅行，在艰苦生存、穷困潦倒、进行毫无胜算的拼搏、却最终胜出之后、还能知道自己的毛巾在哪的人，无疑是一股不可忽视的力量。

messages.msgid: A large, sopping wet towel.  If you wait a little bit, it should dry out.  Don't panic.
translations: 一条湿答答的大毛巾，如果你再等一会儿，它应该就会变干。不要恐慌。

messages.msgid: A straw fedora hat, comfortable and stylish.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.
translations: 一顶浅顶草帽，既舒适又新潮。帽檐还能帮你的眼睛挡阳光。

messages.msgid: A suit of thin thermal underwear that covers you from head to toe and is equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一件配有内部电池供电的加热元件体的保暖内衣套装，从头覆盖到脚。激活来开启。

messages.msgid: A suit of thin thermal underwear that covers you from head to toe and is equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一件配有内部电池供电的加热元件体的保暖内衣套装，从头覆盖到脚。它已经被开启，不断耗电来产生热量。激活来关闭。

messages.msgid: A tasteful wool turtleneck, modeled after cashmere.  Unencumbering and warm, but lacking storage.
translations: 一件雅致的羊毛高领毛衣，仿羊绒款。不太累赘而且非常保暖，但缺乏存储空间。

messages.msgid: You adjust the neck and collar of the turtleneck.
translations: 你调整了高领毛衣的领口高度。

messages.msgid: This wool turtleneck's neck is rolled out of the way of the mouth.
translations: 这件羊毛高领毛衣的领口放下，露出了嘴。

messages.msgid: A tasteful cotton turtleneck shirt, thick for a shirt, thin for a sweater, and completely lacking storage.
translations: 一件雅致的棉质高领衬衫，比衬衫厚一些，比毛衣薄一些，完全没有存储空间。

messages.msgid: You adjust the neck and collar of the turtleneck shirt.
translations: 你调整了高领衫的领口高度。

messages.msgid: This turtleneck shirt's neck is rolled out of the way of the mouth.
translations: 这件高领衫的领口卷起，露出了嘴。

messages.msgid: A warm wool mask that protects the head and face from the cold.  It covers most of your head and mouth, and can be adjusted to hang around your throat instead.
translations: 一个温暖的羊毛面罩，保护你的头和脸远离寒冷。它覆盖了你的大部分头部和嘴部，可以拉下调整挂在脖子上。

messages.msgid: You adjust your ski mask for less warmth.
translations: 你调整你的滑雪面罩来透透气儿。

messages.msgid: A warm wool mask that protects the head and face from the cold.  It is wrapped around your throat, and can be adjusted to cover your mouth and more of your head.
translations: 一个温暖的羊毛面罩，保护你的头和脸远离寒冷。它包裹在你的脖子上，可以拉上调整以覆盖嘴部和头部。

messages.msgid: You adjust your ski mask for more warmth.
translations: 你调整你的滑雪面罩来保暖。

messages.msgid: A simple metal whistle, with a cord to wear it around your neck.
translations: 一个简单的金属口哨，有着一根绳子相连，可以把它戴在你的脖子上。

messages.msgid: A pair of earmuffs favored by shooters.  Without batteries or when turned off, they function like normal earmuffs and block all sound.  They will only block sounds over a certain decibel amount when turned on, to protect your ears from injury while otherwise allowing you to hear normally.  The earmuffs are currently off.
translations: 一副战术耳机，射手的心头宝。没有电池或关闭时，它们就像普通耳塞，一视同仁地阻隔声音。开启后能阻挡超过一定分贝的声音，保护你的听力，而让其他声音正常通过。耳机现在处于关闭状态。

messages.msgid: A pair of earmuffs favored by shooters.  The earmuffs are turned on, and will block sounds over a certain decibel amount while otherwise allowing you to hear normally.
translations: 一对备由射手青睐的护耳。现在处于启动状态，阻挡超过一定分贝的声音，同时让你正常听到。

messages.msgid: A pair of in-ear drivers designed to dampen loud sounds and amplify quiet sounds.  Without batteries or when turned off, they function like normal earplugs and block most sound.  They will only block sounds over a certain decibel amount when turned on, to protect your ears from injury while otherwise allowing you to hear normally.  The earplugs are currently off.
translations: 一对入耳耳塞，能够抵消抑制过大的声音，同时放大微弱的声音。没有电池或关闭时，它们就像普通耳塞，阻挡大部分声音。开启后能阻挡超过一定分贝的声音。现在处于关闭状态。

messages.msgid: A pair of in-ear drivers designed to dampen loud sounds and amplify quiet sounds.  The earplugs are turned on, and will block sounds over a certain decibel amount while otherwise allowing you to hear normally.
translations: 一对入耳式耳塞，能够抑制过大的声音并放大微弱的声音。 耳塞已打开，会阻挡超过一定分贝的声音，同时让你听到正常的声音。

messages.msgid: A medical listening tool.  Use it to listen to things.  Closely.
translations: 一个医用听诊工具。只能用来听身边的东西。靠近物体并使用。

messages.msgid: A relatively cumbersome DIY child's medical listening toy.  Use it to listen to things.  Closely.
translations: 一个相对笨重的自制儿童听诊玩具。只能用来听身边的东西。靠近物体并使用。

messages.msgid: A personal portable charging system consisting of an array of solar panels neatly folded into the form of a large backpack.  It can be worn like a normal backpack, and has an integrated cable to plug it into a cable charger system CBM.
translations: 一套个人便携式充能系统，由一系列太阳能电池板组成，都被整齐地折叠并装入一个大背包。它可以像普通背包一样穿着在身上，并且集成了一条可插入电缆充电器CBM的电缆。

messages.msgid: An unfolded array of portable solar panels, ready to push some power into an active cable charger system CBM.
translations: 一套已经展开的便携式太阳能电池板阵列，准备好为电缆充电器CBM提供能量。

messages.msgid: A riot helmet with a plastic face shield that covers your entire face.  Activate to raise the face shield.
translations: 一个带有塑料面罩的防暴头盔，可以覆盖你的整个面部。

messages.msgid: A riot helmet with a plastic face shield, which is raised up.  Activate to lower the shield.
translations: 一顶带塑料面罩的防暴头盔，目前面罩处于抬起状态。激活即可放下面罩。

messages.msgid: A popular German helmet of the late medieval era, the sallet covers the head and eyes.  Activate it to toggle the visor.
translations:
夏雷尔盔，激活它以调节面甲。
一款中世纪晚期流行的德式头盔，覆盖了头部和眼睛。

messages.msgid: You lower the sallet visor over your eyes.
translations: 你把面甲放低，遮住眼睛。

messages.msgid: An iconic knightly helm of the late Middle Ages.  When you think of a knight's helmet, it looks something like this.  Activate it to toggle the visor.
translations: 中世纪晚期骑士的标志头盔。当你想象骑士头盔时，它看起来就应该像这个样子。激活它以切换面罩。

messages.msgid: A high-pressure 232 bar diving tank that can contain up to 12 L of a compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  It is equipped with an on-demand regulator and a mouthpiece designed mostly for underwater use.
translations: 这是一个高压232巴的潜水罐，可以容纳多达12L的压缩氧氮混合物。它配有一个呼吸气阀和一个主要为水下使用而设计的咬嘴。

messages.msgid: A small, high-pressure 200 bar backup diving tank that can contain 4 L of a compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  It is equipped with an on-demand regulator and a mouthpiece designed mostly for underwater use.
translations: 一个小型的高压200巴备用潜水罐，可以容纳4L的压缩氧氮混合物。它配有一个呼吸气阀和一个主要为水下使用而设计的咬嘴。

messages.msgid: A heated blanket made of polyester.  The most comfortable thing on Earth.  Its power drain is usually negligible, but without being able to plug it into a wall, it chews through batteries insanely quickly.
translations: 由聚酯纤维制成的加热毯，地球上最舒适的东西。过去人们常常忽视它的耗电，但如今它可是个电老虎！

messages.msgid: You turn the blanket's heating elements on.
translations: 你打开了电热毯的加热元件。

messages.msgid: A heated blanket made of polyester.  It's turned on, making it nice and toasty while it lasts.
translations: 由聚酯纤维制成的加热毯。它被打开了，现在它的里面就是天堂。

messages.msgid: You turn the blanket's heating elements off.
translations: 你关闭了电热毯的加热元件。

messages.msgid: Foodperson, the mascot your stomach deserves!
translations: 美食侠™，你的胃配的起这样的吉祥物！

messages.msgid: Your HUD lights-up: "Greetings Foodperson, your shift begins now.  Good luck!"
translations: 你的平视显示器点亮了：你好美食侠™，你的轮班现在开始。祝你好运。

messages.msgid: A pair of industrial-grade ear plugs attached together by some string.  They are inside your ears, activate them to take them out.
translations: 一对用线连接的工业级防噪耳塞。你现在正戴着它，激活以取出。

messages.msgid: You take the ear plugs out.
A pair of industrial-grade ear plugs, they are attached together by some string.  They hang around your neck, use them to plug them in.
translations: 一对用线连接的工业级防噪耳塞，现在正挂在你的脖子上。激活以戴上它。

messages.msgid: A pair of makeshift ear plugs made from lumps of wax on the ends of a piece of string.  They are inside your ears, activate them to take them out.
translations: 一对简易耳塞，由一根绳子和两端的蜡块制成。已经塞进了你的耳朵里，激活来取出。

messages.msgid: A pair of makeshift ear plugs made from lumps of wax on the ends of a piece of string.  They hang around your neck, use them to plug them in.
translations: 一对简易耳塞，由一根绳子和两端的蜡块制成。只是挂在你的脖子上，激活可以塞进耳中。

messages.msgid: A military flight helmet.  Equipped with a visor, microphone, and noise dampening system.  The helmet is also fitted with plastic rail for a night-vision attachment.
translations: 一顶军用飞行头盔。配有面罩、麦克风和消音系统。头盔还装有塑料导轨来安装夜视附件。

messages.msgid: You turn the flight helmet on.
Pocket for a front night vision attachment.
A military officer's combo cover, or peaked cap.  It conveys an air of authority, while keeping the sun out of your eyes.
translations: 一顶军官的鸭舌帽，或尖顶帽。它散发出一种权威感，同时能避免阳光直射你的眼睛。

messages.msgid: You bring your hand to your cover and issue a salute.
translations: 你把手并拢，微接帽檐，敬礼。

messages.msgid: A skeletal frame of sturdy metal with attached motors to allow the user to move heavier loads with less strain on the body.
translations: 一台坚固的金属外骨骼框架，安装了辅助马达，让使用者在能搬运更重负载的同时减少对身体的压力。
电池动力工业外骨骼（开）

messages.msgid: A skeletal frame of sturdy metal with attached motors to allow the user to move heavier loads with less strain on the body.  It is turned on and continually drawing power.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一台坚固的金属外骨骼框架，安装了辅助马达，让使用者在能搬运更重负载的同时减少对身体的压力。它已经开启，不断地消耗能量。激活来关闭。

messages.msgid: A skeletal frame of sturdy metal with attached motors to allow the user to move heavier loads with less strain on the body.  This model uses a compact internal combustion engine for power.
translations: 一台坚固的金属外骨骼框架，安装了辅助马达，让使用者在能搬运更重负载的同时减少对身体的压力。这个型号使用小型内燃机作为动力。

messages.msgid: A skeletal frame of sturdy metal with attached motors to allow the user to move heavier loads with less strain on the body.  This model uses a compact internal combustion engine for power.  It is turned on and continually draining gasoline.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一台坚固的金属外骨骼框架，安装了辅助马达，让使用者在能搬运更重负载的同时减少对身体的压力。这个型号使用小型内燃机作为动力。它已经开启，不断地消耗汽油。激活来关闭。

messages.msgid: A device that replaces conventional battery connections with a connector port that can plug into a UPS.  Any device modified with this can be used without a battery as long as you have a charged UPS with you.
translations: 这个改装模组将工具由普通电池接口改装为UPS接口。任何进行此改装的设备都可以不用电池，只要你有一个有电的UPS。

messages.msgid: A kit that replaces conventional battery connections with the circuitry and cables required to draw power from a Standard Neurobionics Interface (SNI).  Any device modified with this is powered by your own bionic power storage instead of conventional batteries.
translations: 一套改装套件，用于替换设备上的传统电池接口。它内置了所需的电路与线缆，可以直接从“标准神经仿生接口”(SNI)中获取能源。任何经此改造的设备，其能量将由你自身的义体能源储备直接供应，无需再使用传统电池。
电池仓模组（小型蓄电池）

messages.msgid: A battery compartment mod that allows using vehicle batteries and small storage batteries in regular tools.
translations: 一个电池仓改装模组，允许将普通工具改装成使用汽车电池及小型蓄电池供电。

messages.msgid: A battery compartment mod that allows the use of light and ultra-light batteries in tools that otherwise could not.
translations: 一种电池仓改装模组，允许将普通工具改装成使用轻型及超轻电池供电。

messages.msgid: A battery compartment mod that allows the use of medium batteries in tools that otherwise could not.
translations: 一种电池仓改装模组，允许将普通工具改装成使用中型电池供电。

messages.msgid: A battery compartment mod that allows the use of tool batteries in tools that otherwise could not.
translations: 一种电池仓改装模组，允许将普通工具改装成使用工具电池供电。

messages.msgid: A manufactured plush toy.  This is the default variant, if you see it something went wrong.
translations: 一只人造毛绒玩具。这是基础样式，如果你看到它说明出错了。

messages.msgid: A mass-produced plush teddy bear.  It is wearing a little red t-shirt but no pants.
translations: 一只量产的毛绒泰迪熊。它穿着一件小小的红色T恤，但没有裤子。

messages.msgid: A mass-produced plush black teddy bear with a mark in its face that looks like a pair of white glasses or a white bandit mask.  It is wearing a little white t-shirt and a pajama hat, but no pants.
translations: 一只量产的黑色毛发的熊玩偶，脸上有着类似眼罩的白色花纹。它穿着一件小小的白色T恤和一顶睡帽，但没有裤子。

messages.msgid: A mass-produced plush panda teddy bear.  It is wearing a little gray t-shirt, but no pants.
translations: 一只量产的熊猫玩偶。它穿着一件小小的灰色T恤，但没有裤子。

messages.msgid: A large plush ferret with cute beady eyes.
translations: 一只长着可爱小眼睛的大型毛绒雪貂。

messages.msgid: A large, round, cuddly dinosaur plushie with soft horns and a sturdy build.
translations: 一只又大又圆的可爱的恐龙毛绒玩偶，有着柔软的角和结实的身体。

messages.msgid: A large stegosaurus plushie with a spiky back and soft, huggable body.  Don't worry, it is completely docile!
translations: 一只背部长着尖刺的大号的剑龙玩偶，身体柔软，可以随便拥抱。别担心，它很温顺的！

messages.msgid: A silly, oversized and soft brontosaurus plushie with a long tail, a long neck and a small head with a friendly smile.
translations: 一个愚蠢的、超大号的、柔软的雷龙玩偶，它长着一条长尾巴、一条长脖子和一个带着友好微笑的小脑袋。

messages.msgid: A velvety-soft plush penguin.  It makes a funny noise when you hug it.
translations: 一只天鹅绒般柔软的毛绒企鹅。当你拥抱它时，它会发出一种滑稽的声音。

messages.msgid: A large plush fox.  It isn't realistic enough to trick a zombie into going after it, but it's very cute and makes a comforting bedtime companion.
translations: 一个大型毛绒狐狸玩偶。它不够逼真，无法骗僵尸去追它，但非常可爱，作为睡前的陪伴也很让人安心。

messages.msgid: A cuddly plushie of the mighty moose, with soft brown fur, floppy ears, and big antlers.  It has a special huggability feature that makes it delightfully squishy, perfect for comforting cuddles.
translations: 一只毛茸茸的可爱驼鹿，有着柔软的棕色皮毛、耷拉的耳朵和巨大的鹿角。它有一个特殊的可拥抱功能，非常适合安慰拥抱。

messages.msgid: A soft, cute bobcat plushie with a cute, tufted pair of ears, a fluffy tail and soft brown fur.  It has embroidered both soft whiskers and claws that add a touch of realism to its cute and playful design.
translations: 一只柔软可爱的山猫毛绒玩具，有一对可爱的簇绒耳朵，一条蓬松的尾巴和柔软的棕色皮毛。它有刺绣的柔软胡须和爪子，为其可爱俏皮的设计增添了一丝真实感。

messages.msgid: A cuddly and majestic bald eagle plushie with soft, brown and white cotton faux feathers, a hooked, soft beak, and a patriotic expression.  It has a pair of special eyes that glow as brightly as the stars and stripes of Old Glory, the perfect partner to fend off your enemies in the Cataclysm.
translations: 一个可爱而雄伟的秃鹰毛绒玩具，有着柔软的棕色和白色的人造棉羽毛，一个弯曲的软喙，和一种爱国的表情。它有一双特别的眼睛，能像美国国旗的星星和条纹一样闪亮，是在大灾变中抵御敌人的完美伙伴。

messages.msgid: A cuddly seal plushie with soft, grayish fur and big, soulful eyes.  It features a realistic texture that mimics the soft and textural quality of real seals' fur.
translations: 可爱的海豹毛绒玩具，有着柔软的灰色皮毛和深情的大眼睛。其以逼真的纹理来模拟真正的海豹毛皮的柔软感。

messages.msgid: A playful and fuzzy northern river otter plushie with brown fur and a curious expression.  It has a special, state-of-the-art semi-waterproof finish that makes it the perfect bathtub companion for those who love to play with their toys while they get clean.
translations: 一个毛茸茸的北河水獭毛绒玩偶，动作生动活泼，有着棕色的毛皮和好奇的表情。表面有先进半防水涂层，是习惯在洗澡时玩玩具的人们的完美浴缸伴侣。

messages.msgid: A cuddly peregrine falcon plushie with soft, brown and white cotton faux feathers, a soft hooked beak, and an alert expression.  With a speedy and sleek plushie design, this toy plushie is sure to take imaginative people on make-believe high-flying chase scenes!
translations: 一只可爱的游隼毛绒玩具，采用柔软的棕色和白色棉质人造毛绒，拥有柔软的钩状鸟嘴和机警的神色。这款毛绒玩具的设计既迅捷又时尚，定能带领富有想象力的人们展开想象高空中的追逐场景！

messages.msgid: A cute, adorable eastern chipmunk plushie with soft, reddish-brown fur and big eyes.  It features a harmless, special crinkly texture that mimics the sound of chipmunks rustling in the leaves.
translations: 一只可爱的东方花栗鼠，有柔软的红棕色皮毛和大眼睛。它有一种无害的、特殊的褶皱纹理，模仿花栗鼠在树叶中沙沙作响的声音。

messages.msgid: A very huggable white-tailed deer plushie with soft, brown fur and a cute expression with adorable antlers.
translations: 一只非常可爱的白尾鹿毛绒玩具，拥有柔软的棕色皮毛，可爱的表情和讨人喜爱的鹿角。

messages.msgid: A cute striped skunk plushie with soft, black-and-white fur and a playful expression.  Ironically, it has a weak, pleasant pine scent.
translations: 一只可爱的条纹臭鼬毛绒玩具，有着柔软的黑白毛皮和顽皮的表情。具有讽刺意味的是，它散发出微弱而宜人的松木香味。

messages.msgid: A plushie with soft, black-gray-and-white fur and a curious expression with its iconic bandit mask.  It has a special feature that makes its tails emerge from its hiding spot in the toy, reminiscent of one of the raccoon's greatest attributes.
translations: 一个拥有柔软的黑色、灰色和白色毛皮的浣熊毛绒玩具，带有标志性的小偷面具和好奇的表情。它有一个特殊的设计，让它的尾巴从玩具的遮掩处露出，让人想起浣熊最大的特征之一。

messages.msgid: A cuddly and wise-looking owl plushie with fluffy white cotton faux feathers, orange eyes, and a cute expression.
translations: 一只可爱且看起来很聪明的猫头鹰毛绒玩偶，有着毛茸茸的白色棉质人造羽毛，橙色的眼睛与可爱的表情。

messages.msgid: A cuddly and big wild turkey plushie with brown cotton faux feathers, a prominent, soft beak, and expressive, soulful eyes.  It has a special feature of making gobbling sounds when squeezed, almost perfectly mimicking the turkey's unique calls.
translations: 一只可爱的火鸡毛绒玩具。它长长的深褐色的棉制羽毛乱蓬蓬的，喙部柔软但有形。那双富有表现力且深情的眼睛更是突出。这只玩偶的特别之处在于，当你捏它时，会发出特别的咯咯声（不要联想到那种常见市售的黄色尖叫鸡），几乎完美地模仿了火鸡独特的叫声。

messages.msgid: A soft and cuddly crocodile plushie with soft green scales, a big smile, and a long snout.  When squeezed or touched, this plushie produces authentic hissing and growling sounds, just like a real crocodile.  Or is it an alligator?  It's hard to tell.
translations: 这只绿色毛绒鳄鱼的表面较为光滑，显然做过处理。它长长的口吻两侧，缝有整齐的棉制牙齿。它的嘴巴无法完全闭合，再加上圆滚滚的眼睛，看起来一点也不凶猛，反而有点呆萌。如果你捏它，它会发出逼真的咆哮声混杂着尖细的嘶嘶声，就像只真的长吻鳄……或许是短吻鳄？难说。

messages.msgid: A cuddly iguana plushie with soft green scales, big eyes, and a friendly, curious expression.  It possess a special ribbed texture to mimic the skin of a real iguana.
translations: 一个可爱的鬣蜥毛绒玩具，长着柔软的绿色鳞片和大大的眼睛，露出亲切又好奇的表情。它的皮肤采用了特殊的肋状纹理，模仿真正的鬣蜥的皮肤。

messages.msgid: A cute and colorful gecko plushie with soft, vibrant skin and big, playful eyes.  This plushie has a special cotton-based internal mechanism that makes its tail wiggle and move playfully when squeezed enough, just like a real lizard's tail.
translations: 一个可爱又多彩的壁虎毛绒玩具，有着柔软而富有弹力的皮肤和大而顽皮的眼睛。这个毛绒玩具内部有个特殊的棉花机关，当用力挤压时，它的尾巴就会像真正的壁虎尾巴一样来回摆动。

messages.msgid: A cuddly and soft chameleon plushie that can change colors, complete with big, round eyes and a cute expression.  This plushie's soft body has a simple color-changing mechanism on its fabric, that changes from green to brown if you pet it properly, enabling people, especially children, to explore and learn about the biology of this fascinating reptile.
translations: 一只可爱又柔软的变色龙毛绒玩具，它会变色，还有大大的圆眼睛和可爱的表情。这只毛绒玩具柔软的身体上有一个简单的变色机制，如果你顺着特定方向抚摸它，它会从绿色变成棕色，让人们，尤其是孩子们，探索和了解这种迷人的爬行动物的生物特性。

messages.msgid: A precious soft and cuddly chicken plushie with soft, warm brown cotton faux feathers and a gentle expression.
translations: 一个珍贵的柔软又可爱的小鸡毛绒玩具，采用柔软且温暖的棕色棉花制成的人造羽毛，露出温柔的表情。

messages.msgid: A goose plushie with soft, white cotton faux feathers, a cute and soft orange beak, and big, playful eyes.  This plushie produces realistic honking sounds when hugged!
translations: 一只鹅毛绒玩具，长着柔软的白色人造羽毛，可爱而柔软的橙色喙，还有一双顽皮的大眼睛。这个毛绒玩具在被拥抱时会发出逼真的鹅叫声！

messages.msgid: A cuddly duck plushie with soft, yellow cotton faux feathers, cute orange feet, and a lovable quack.  This plushie has special water-repellent properties to make it float in water, just like a real duck!
translations: 一个可爱的鸭子玩具，采用柔软人造棉制羽毛，长着橘色的蹼和可爱的鸭嘴。这个毛绒玩具还特意使用了防水材料，能够像真正的鸭子一样浮在水面上！

messages.msgid: A fluffy and cuddly plushie of a mutt puppy with soft, fuzzy fur, big, round eyes, and a playful expression.
translations: 一只毛茸茸的可爱玩具小狗，有着微卷的软毛，又大又圆的眼睛，展现出顽皮的表情。

messages.msgid: A cute and lovable domestic kitty plushie with soft, plush fur, big, round eyes, and a gentle expression.  You can't tell if it is a short-haired one or a long-haired one.
translations: 一只可爱的家猫玩偶。它的毛发很软，看起来也很温顺。你难以分辨这是短毛猫还是长猫猫。

messages.msgid: A big, soft and cuddly walrus plushie with fluffy brown fur, cute, soft tusks, and big, wise soulful eyes.
translations: 一个可爱的大号海象毛绒玩具，有着棕色的毛皮，柔软的长牙，以及智慧而深情的大眼睛。

messages.msgid: A plushie with black fluffy cotton faux feathers, big curious eyes, and an inquisitive expression.
translations: 一个毛绒乌鸦玩具，采用柔软的黑色人造棉制羽毛，长着大大的眼睛，露出充满好奇的表情。

messages.msgid: A frog plushie with soft, green, and bumpy skin, big, playful eyes, and typical frog legs.  This plushie produces realistic croaking sounds when squeezed and a special texture that makes it fun to squeeze and manipulate.  Or is it a frog?  You can't really tell.
translations: 一只青蛙毛绒玩偶，长着柔软且凹凸不平的绿色皮肤，以及大而顽皮的眼睛和标志性的蛙腿。这个毛绒玩具在挤压时会发出逼真的蛙鸣声，还有特殊质感使得挤压玩耍变得十分有趣。或者它是一只青蛙？你觉得这些很难分辨。

messages.msgid: A precious bat plushie with soft, black fur, big ears, and somewhat small, curious eyes.  It produces a special squeaker sound effect when squeezed.
translations: 一个被人珍藏的蝙蝠毛绒玩具，长着柔软的黑色皮毛，大耳朵和相比较小但又带着好奇的眼睛。挤压时会发出一种特殊的吱吱声。

messages.msgid: A cuddly and adorable gorilla plushie with soft, black fur, big eyes, and a friendly expression.
translations: 一个可爱的大猩猩毛绒玩具，长着柔软的黑色皮毛，大大的眼睛露出和善的表情。

messages.msgid: A lovable and huggable orangutan plushie with soft, orange-brown fur and big, friendly eyes in a big, wise-looking face.  This plushie makes playful and cuddly jungle sounds when squeezed and hugged.
translations: 一只可爱的红毛猩猩毛绒玩具，长着柔软的橙棕色皮毛，在一张睿智的大脸上有着一双友好的大眼睛。这个毛绒玩具在挤压和拥抱时发出有趣又可爱的丛林声音。

messages.msgid: A cute and cuddly chimpanzee plushie with soft, brown fur, big, curious eyes, and a playful expression.
translations: 一个可爱的黑猩猩毛绒玩具，长着柔软的棕色皮毛，大大而好奇的眼睛，带着顽皮的表情。

messages.msgid: This bright, extremely cute lion plushie features long, soft, and golden-colored fur and a extremely playful demeanor.  On the label it says that it is an ambassador of its species, and that the amounts collected in the sales of the plushies were donated to help the conservation of the species.  Surely now, without many humans, maybe these animals don't have to worry so much about their habitat being destroyed.
translations: 这个闪亮且极其可爱的狮子毛绒玩偶有着长长的、柔软的、黄金色的毛皮和极其俏皮的性格。在标签上写着它是其物种的大使，其销售收入都将被捐赠出去，用来帮助保护这个物种。现在，没有了人类，也许这些动物不必再那么担心它们的栖息地被破坏了。

messages.msgid: A somewhat scary, but cuddly tarantula plushie with soft, fuzzy brown fur and big, curious eyes.
translations: 一只有点可怕，但同时很可爱的狼蛛毛绒玩具，有柔软、模糊的棕色毛皮和大而好奇的眼睛。

messages.msgid: A ant plushie with a sturdy, hard yet soft shell mimic, and big, inquisitive eyes.
translations: 一只具有坚固、硬但同时又柔软的外壳模仿的蚂蚁毛绒玩具，以及大而好奇的眼睛。

messages.msgid: A cute and lovable ladybug plushie with soft, red and black polkadotted wings and big, friendly eyes.  This plushie features a special retractable spotted soft wing mechanic sewed directly into the body that gives it the authentic appearance of a ladybug about to fly.
translations: 这是一个可爱又讨人喜欢的瓢虫毛绒玩具，它有着柔软的红色和黑色的波点翅膀，以及大大的友好的眼睛。这个毛绒玩具的特点是它有一个特殊的可收缩的斑点软翅膀，这使得它看起来就像一只真正的、即将起飞的瓢虫。

messages.msgid: An amazing crab plushie with soft, textured blue and red bumpy shell and big, curious eyes.
translations: 这是一个令人惊叹的螃蟹毛绒玩具，它有着柔软的、充满质感的蓝色和红色的凹凸不平的壳和大大而好奇的眼睛。

messages.msgid: A large, funny, cuddly whale plushie with soft, blue-gray fur, big, friendly eyes, and a playful expression.
translations: 这是一个巨大、有趣、可爱的鲸毛绒玩具，它有着柔软的蓝灰色的毛皮，大大而友好的眼睛，和一个可爱的表情。

messages.msgid: A cuddly and sweet camel plushie with two soft humps, tan fur and big, soulful eyes.
translations: 一个可爱又甜美的骆驼毛绒玩具，有两个柔软的驼峰，棕黄色的毛皮和大大的，充满灵魂的眼睛。

messages.msgid: A cute and loving alpaca plushie featuring soft, curly fur in shades of white and brown, shiny black eyes, and slightly short legs.
translations: 一个可爱而亲切的羊驼毛绒玩具，特点是柔软的，卷曲的白色和棕色的毛皮，闪亮的黑色眼睛，和一对小短腿腿。

messages.msgid: This very well-made cow plushie features soft, velvety fur in black and white patches, with endearing floppy ears and bright eyes, together with a pair of soft horns and the typical cow udder.
translations: 这个做工非常好的牛毛绒玩具，特点是柔软的，天鹅绒般的黑色和白色斑纹的毛皮，有可爱的下垂的耳朵和明亮的眼睛，还有一对柔软的角和大乳头。

messages.msgid: This loving and fluffy sheep plushie features soft, woolly fur in white, with cute floppy ears and expressive eyes.
translations: 一只可爱而蓬松的绵羊毛绒玩具，有着柔软的，羊毛般的白色毛皮，长着可爱下垂的耳朵和富有表情的眼睛。

messages.msgid: This loving, precious pig plushie has a soft pink fur, with endearing floppy ears and bright eyes.  It also has a plush snout with brown fur on its legs and paws.  Its nose is somewhat long and black, and its eyes are large and expressive.
translations: 这只可爱珍贵的猪毛绒玩偶拥有柔软的粉色毛皮，带有可爱的耷拉耳朵和明亮的眼睛。它的鼻子柔软，腿和爪上的毛皮是棕色的。它有着又长又黑的鼻子，和一对富有表情的大眼睛。

messages.msgid: This majestic unicorn plushie features a soft white body and horn, with tufts of white hair on its neck and tail.  Its black eyes are adorably large and round.
translations: 这只华丽的独角兽毛绒玩偶拥有柔软的白色身体和角，颈部和尾巴上有一缕白色的毛发。它的黑色眼睛又大又圆，十分可爱。

messages.msgid: A somewhat large, mass produced shark plushie.  Meant to provide comfort to people of all ages.
translations: 一种较大的、批量生产的鲨鱼毛绒玩具。 旨在为所有年龄段的人提供舒适感。

messages.msgid: A large manufactured figurine.  This is the default variant, if you see it something went wrong.
translations: 一个大型的手办。这是基础样式，如果你看到它说明出错了。

messages.msgid: A relatively large plastic figurine of a T-rex.
translations: 一个相对较大的霸王龙塑料手办。

messages.msgid: A large figurine of a humanoid robot, armed with a rifle, with a smaller figure sitting inside the head.
translations: 一个机器人手办，手持步枪，头部还坐着一个小人。

messages.msgid: A large figurine of a knight in shining armor standing watch, with its sword planted at the ground at its feet.
translations: 一个大型的骑士手办，身穿闪亮的盔甲，正在站岗，一把大剑插在它身前的地面中。

messages.msgid: A very intricate looking model of a robotic skeleton with red eyes and a futuristic weapon in its hand.
translations: 一个精巧的骨架机器人模型，有着红色的眼睛，手里拿着一把未来风格的武器。

messages.msgid: An expensive figurine of a buff man in streetwear with a lizard head, holding a pair of knives in his hands.
translations: 一个昂贵的蒙眼男手办，穿着街头服饰，留着蜥蜴头，手持一对锋利的匕首。

messages.msgid: An expensive figurine of a cartoon woman in flashy clothing.
translations: 一个穿着华丽服装的卡通女性的昂贵手办。

messages.msgid: A large figurine of a video game character, holding a massive Gatling gun in his giant arms.
translations: 一个大型的电子游戏角色手办，它巨大的手臂抱着一挺同样巨大的加特林机枪。

messages.msgid: A nasty looking figurine of a mutant zombie, with a large tongue sprouting from its face.  You thankfully haven't encountered something like that yet.
translations: 一个看起来很恶心的变种丧尸手办，一条大舌头从脸上长出。谢天谢地，你还没有遇到这种玩意。

messages.msgid: An expensive looking figurine of a gnarly, jet-black alien covered in menacing looking spines.
translations: 一个看起来很昂贵的外星人手办，它身上粗糙不平，乌黑发亮，还长满了看起来很危险的尖刺。

messages.msgid: A normal-sized manufactured figurine.  This is the default variant, if you see it something went wrong.
translations: 一个正常大小的人造雕像。这是基础样式，如果你看到它说明出错了。

messages.msgid: A figurine of some unnamed swordsman, covered with scars and equipped with sturdy leather armor.  Seems to be ready to fight.
translations: 一个无名剑客的手办，满身伤痕，穿着结实的皮甲，似乎已经准备好战斗。

messages.msgid: A plastic figurine of a young woman.  She's meant to be dressed up and accessorized with a wide variety of clothing, sold separately.
translations: 一位年轻女性的塑料模型，可以用各种服装首饰打扮，不过服饰需要单独购买。

messages.msgid: A plastic figurine with a nightmarish, scarred face.  He wears a hat and has three long blades extending from a glove on the back of his hand.
translations: 一个有长着梦魇般满是伤痕脸庞的塑料手办。它带着一顶帽子，手背上有三片从手套延伸出来的长刀。

messages.msgid: A figurine of a blue unicorn.  It is in a sitting position, shyly covering both eyes with its front hooves.
translations: 一只蓝色独角兽的手办。它坐在地上，害羞地用两只前蹄遮起眼睛。

messages.msgid: A figurine of a scaly green swamp monster emerging from some fetid lagoon.
translations: 一个有鳞片的绿色沼泽怪物的手办，正从一个腥臭的泻湖中浮起。

messages.msgid: Your heart leaps to your throat as you see the face of Death itself staring back at you, scythe raised for the harvest!  You relax significantly once you realize it's only a few inches tall and made of plastic.
translations: 当你看到死神的面孔盯着你，举起镰刀准备收割时，你的心一下子跳到了嗓子眼！然后你意识到它只有十几厘米高，而且是塑料做的……

messages.msgid: A figurine of a redheaded mermaid sitting on a rock.  Like in the film this toy is based on, she gazes longingly out to a world she wants to be a part of - or she would be, but the face isn't drawn very well and doesn't express much emotion at all.
translations: 一个坐在岩石上的红发美人鱼的手办。就像这个玩具所依据的电影一样，她渴望地凝视着一个她想加入的世界——或者说她本来该这样，但是脸画崩了，根本没有表达什么情感。

messages.msgid: A plastic figurine of an anthropomorphic avocado, holding a salt shaker and a spoon.  Makes a great gift for the guacamole lover in your life, or as a decoration for your kitchen.
translations: 一个拟人化的牛油果塑料手办，手持盐罐和勺子。这是给鳄梨酱爱好者的好礼物，也可以作为你厨房的装饰。

messages.msgid: A superhero action figure.  Its limbs can be adjusted for different poses, and it is designed to do battle against a wide variety of crooks and supervillains, sold separately.
translations: 一个超级英雄玩具人偶。它的四肢可以调整为不同姿势，用来与各种各样的骗子和超级恶棍做斗争（反派需单独购买）。

messages.msgid: A simple yoyo on a string.  Now you can be bored with style.
translations: 一个朴素的带绳悠悠球。现在你可能厌倦了款式。

messages.msgid: A fidget spinner.  An artifact from when the times were simpler.
translations: 一个指尖陀螺。纯真年代时的神器。

messages.msgid: Its legs are mismatched, its arms misshapen, its eyes more crooked than its smile.  Everywhere, it sparkles with the golden thread that has put it back together.  It's beautiful.
translations: 它长着极不协调的腿和畸形的手臂，带着一股扭曲的眼神和微笑。闪闪发光的金线让它不至于破碎。它很漂亮。

messages.msgid: They're different colors and different lengths.  It would be hard to run away with these.
translations: 它们颜色各异，长短不一，带着这些东西会让你难以逃跑。

messages.msgid: The spun cloth fingers are fraying away.  There's nothing that they could hold on to.
translations: 磨破了的布质手指，什么都抓不住。

messages.msgid: A pair of mismatched buttons and some dull yellow thread, to put on a brave face with.
translations: 一对不相配的纽扣和一些暗黄色的线，用来缝出勇敢的面孔。

messages.msgid: Jacketed 10mm Auto ammunition with a 180gr bullet.  The 10mm Auto cartridge is a rather powerful handgun round and the progenitor to the more popular .40 S&W.
translations: 使用180格令全金属被甲弹头的 10mm Auto 弹。10mm Auto 弹不光威力强大，还是更加流行的 .40 S&W 弹的前身。

messages.msgid: Jacketed 10mm Auto ammunition with a 180gr hollow point bullet, intended for use in self-defense, or perhaps hunting.  The 10mm Auto cartridge is a rather powerful handgun round and the progenitor to the more popular .40 S&W.
translations: 使用180格令被甲空尖弹头的 10mm Auto 弹，多用于个人防卫以及狩猎。10mm Auto 弹不光威力强大，还是更加流行的 .40 S&W 弹的前身。

messages.msgid: 'Full House' 10mm Auto ammunition with a 140gr solid copper penetrator projectile, for hunting or self-defense from dangerous game.  The 10mm Auto cartridge is a rather powerful handgun round and the progenitor to the more popular .40 S&W.
translations: 强装药、使用140格令全金属被甲弹头的 10mm Auto 弹，多用于危险环境下的个人防卫以及狩猎。10mm Auto 弹不光威力强大，还是更加流行的 .40 S&W 弹的前身。

messages.msgid: A Heckler & Koch 12mm projectile, to be used in H&K railguns.  It's made of ferromagnetic metal, probably cobalt.
translations: H&K公司出品的 12mm 弹，专用于 H&K 磁轨步枪。弹头由磁性金属制成，大概率是钴。
