messages.msgid: .22 Conical Ball, a variety of .22 ammunition that propels its bullet using a primer instead of gunpowder.  The end result is a subsonic round that is so weak as to be nearly useless given your predicament.
translations: .22 锥形弹丸，一种 .22 口径弹药，依靠底火而非火药推动弹头。最终得到的是一种亚音速弹，威力弱得几乎毫无用处，尤其是在你眼下的处境里。

messages.msgid: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with a 30gr FMJ bullet.  The .22LR round is extremely weak, with short range and negligible recoil.  This type is marginally better at piercing through targets, but deals even less damage as a result.
translations: 使用30格令全金属被甲弹头的 .22 LR（长步枪） 弹。威力极小，射程不长，但后坐力可忽略不计。该型号的弹头有着可堪一用的穿透性能，但造成的伤害也因此更小。

messages.msgid: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with a 40gr unjacketed bullet.  The .22LR round is extremely weak, with short range and negligible recoil.  It is most useful for target practice and hunting small animals.
translations: 使用40格令无被甲铅制弹头的 .22 LR（长步枪） 弹。威力极小，射程不长，但后坐力可忽略不计。该型号的最大用途是训练枪法以及猎杀小型动物。

messages.msgid: A .22 caliber cartridge loaded with very small pieces of shot contained within a fragmenting plastic capsule.  It has an extremely short range and poor penetration ability, but the spread of shot can hit targets with greater ease.
translations: 装满小颗粒弹丸的塑料弹壳 .22 霰弹。射程极短，穿透力微弱，但霰射的弹丸也更容易命中目标。

messages.msgid: .223 Remington ammunition with a 55gr FMJ-BT bullet, patterned after the M193 loading.  The .223 round has been very popular with civilian shooters for almost a century, finding use in a wide variety of weapons.  The combination of high velocity with a thinly-jacketed, cannelured projectile led to unexpected yaw and fragmentation in soft tissue, increasing this round's performance.
translations: 使用55格令全金属被甲艇尾弹头的 .223 雷明顿弹，其弹头样式源于 M193 弹。在过去近一个世纪以来，.223 口径在民用射击领域都极受欢迎，该口径的枪械也种样繁多。薄被甲且包含弹壳槽线的弹头，在高速击中软组织时会产生无法预测的翻滚及破片，提升最终的停止力效果。

messages.msgid: 5.56x45mm ammunition, loaded for precision from the Mk 12 SPR rifles, and later used by other SF units looking for more effective loadings for their M4A1 and Mk 18 carbines.  The Mk 262 Mod 1 is loaded with a 77 grain Open Tip Match bullet, enhancing lethality even at longer ranges when compared to older M855 loadings.
translations: 5.56x45mm 弹，起初作为精确射击型号供 Mk 12 SPR 步枪使用，后因其出众效能而被其他特种部队吸纳，用于部队所使用的 M4A1 步枪和 Mk18 卡宾枪之中。Mk262 Mod 1 弹使用77格令开尖弹头，相较更早的 M855 弹，在杀伤力与杀伤距离上都有所提升。

messages.msgid: 5.56x45mm ammunition, developed due to SOF dissatisfaction with the M855 cartridge.  The Mk318 Mod 1 is loaded with a 62 grain Open Tip Match Rear Penetrator bullet, a copper slug enclosed inside an open-tipped brass projectile, providing for consistent loading, enhanced lethality and increased penetration.  When compared to M855, the Mk318 fragments consistently, even out of short-barreled carbines.
translations: 5.56x45mm 弹，基于特殊作战部队对 M855 弹的不满而研发。Mk318 Mod 1 弹使用62格令开尖穿甲弹头——铜制弹芯被包裹在开尖黄铜外壳内，提升了量产时的出品一致性，同时也提升了杀伤力和穿透力。与 M855 弹相比，即使是使用短管卡宾枪发射，Mk318 弹也能更稳定地产生破片。

messages.msgid: 5.56x45mm ammunition with a 62gr FMJ bullet containing a steel penetrator.  Originally designed for the M249 FN Minimi, M855 was designed to penetrate steel helmets and light cover at range, sacrificing terminal performance and accuracy in the process.  The limited yaw and fragmentation is worsened with shorter-barreled carbines shooting this round, and optimization of barrel twist for stabilization of the tracer variant of M855 has resulted in lackluster accuracy overall.
translations: 使用62格令全金属被甲钢芯弹头的 5.56x45mm 弹。起初为 M249 FN "米尼米" 轻机枪而设计，M855 弹旨在远距离穿透钢制头盔和轻度掩体，但也因此牺牲了弹道性能及精度。其弹头翻转及破碎性能有限，由短管卡宾枪发射时则更差，膛线缠距为曳光弹变体的稳定性而优化，也使得整体精度不高。

messages.msgid: An updated loading of M855 5.56x45mm ammunition, featuring a 62 grain projectile containing an exposed steel penetrator and copper slug.  Designed as a mostly lead-free projectile, the opportunity was further taken to improve upon M855's penetration and lethality characteristics through penetrator design and increased pressure.  Its improved accuracy, penetration and lethality over M855 are appreciated by users of shorter-barreled AR variants.
translations: M855 5.56x45mm弹的改进型号，采用外露钢质穿甲弹芯与铜质弹体的62格令弹头设计。作为基本实现无铅化的弹头，该设计通过优化穿甲结构并增加膛压，显著提升了原M855弹药的穿透力与杀伤效能。其较M855更优异的精度、穿透力和杀伤效果，尤其受到使用短管AR枪型使用者的青睐。

messages.msgid: An M856 tracer round.  Traditional practice is to load one tracer per every four normal rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.  They have the potential to ignite flammable surfaces at their point of impact.
translations: M856 曳光弹。传统做法是每隔四发普通子弹加入一发曳光弹，以便于射手追踪射击目标。这类弹药在命中目标时能点燃易燃表面。

messages.msgid: An armor piercing 5.56x45mm M995 round using a 52gr projectile, featuring a black-tipped, tungsten carbide penetrator over an aluminum slug.  Increased penetration over standard ball rounds at the cost of worse wounding potential in soft tissue.
translations: 5.56x45mm M995 穿甲弹，使用52格令复合弹头，前段使用碳化钨穿甲弹芯，后段使用铝芯，特征是弹头尖呈黑色。相较常见的球状弹芯拥有更强的穿透力，代价是对软组织伤害力不足。

messages.msgid: .270 Winchester ammunition with a 130gr full metal jacket bullet.  It is a powerful round capable of taking down large targets with ease.
translations: 使用130格令全金属被甲弹头的 .270 温彻斯特弹。作为大威力弹种，能轻松击倒大型目标。

messages.msgid: .270 Winchester ammunition with a 130gr soft point bullet.  The .270 round was not initially successful, but over a few decades it became one of the most popular rifle cartridges for hunting and silhouette shooting.  It is a powerful round capable of taking down large targets with ease.
translations: 使用130格令软尖弹头的 .270 温切斯特弹。.270 弹最初并不成功，但在经历几十年的时间后，它现在已经成为最受欢迎的猎枪子弹之一——作为大威力弹种，能轻松击倒大型目标。
.270 温彻斯特 软尖弹（黑火药）
.270 温彻斯特 软尖弹（复装）
.270 温彻斯特 被甲弹（复装）
.270 温彻斯特 被甲弹（黑火药）

messages.msgid: .300 Winchester Magnum ammunition with a 220gr JHP bullet.  The 300WM round is an extremely powerful and accurate rifle round introduced in 1963.  It has proven popular with hunters and snipers, although it is not as common as .308 or .30-06.
translations: 使用220格令空尖弹头的 .300 温彻斯特马格南弹。.300 温彻斯特马格南弹是1963年投入使用的一种极具威力和精准度的步枪子弹，在猎人和狙击手中很流行，只是名气上比不过 .308 或者 .30-06 弹。
.300 温彻斯特马格南弹（黑火药）
.300 温彻斯特马格南弹（复装）

messages.msgid: Jacketed .30-06 Springfield M2 Ball ammunition with a 150gr spitzer bullet.  The .30-06 cartridge was adopted in 1906 by the US military, where it served for some 50 years, and it remains popular today among collectors and hunters for its range, versatility, and power.
translations: 使用150格令被甲尖头弹头的 .30-06 春田 M2 弹。.30-06 口径弹药于1906年被美国军方采用，此后服役了大约50年。如今它仍然因为射程、泛用性和威力而在收藏家和猎手中大受欢迎。

messages.msgid: .30-06 Springfield ammunition with a 165gr soft point bullet.  The .30-06 cartridge was adopted in 1906 by the US military, where it served for some 50 years, and it remains popular today among collectors and hunters for its range, versatility, and power.
translations: 使用165格令软尖弹头的 .30-06 春田弹。.30-06 口径弹药于1906年被美国军方采用，此后服役了大约50年。如今它仍然因为射程、泛用性和威力而在收藏家和猎手中大受欢迎。

messages.msgid: .30-06 M14A1 tracer ammunition to help keep the weapon it is fired from on target.
translations: .30-06 M14A1 曳光型弹药，在连续射击时便于追踪射击目标。

messages.msgid: Armor piercing .30-06 M2 ammunition with a 166gr hardened steel core bullet.  The .30-06 cartridge was adopted in 1906 by the US military, where it served for some 50 years, and it remains popular today among collectors and hunters for its range, versatility, and power.
translations: 使用166格令硬化钢芯穿甲弹头的 .30-06 M2 弹。.30-06 口径弹药于1906年被美国军方采用，此后服役了大约50年。如今它仍然因为射程、泛用性和威力而在收藏家和猎手中大受欢迎。

messages.msgid: A .300 AAC Blackout round with a 125gr open tip match bullet.  .300 BLK is an intermediate cartridge necked up from 5.56x45mm, designed to achieve similar ballistics to 7.62x39mm.  It is compatible with standard AR-15 lower receivers and will feed from STANAG magazines.
translations: 使用125格令空尖竞赛弹头的 .300 BLK 弹。.300 BLK 弹是一种中间型弹药，基于 5.56x45mm 口径拓宽而来，从而达到类似于 7.62x39mm 口径子弹的弹道性能。该子弹兼容标准 AR-15 下机匣，可使用 STANAG 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: A subsonic .300 AAC Blackout round with a 220gr open tip match bullet.  When fired with a suppressor, it only emits low noise, making it ideal for silently eliminating your enemies.  It is compatible with standard AR-15 lower receivers and will feed from STANAG magazines.
translations: 使用220格令空尖竞赛弹头的 .300 BLK 亚音速弹。搭配消音器进行射击时，会发出极小的噪音，适合悄无声息地干掉目标。该子弹兼容标准 AR-15 下机匣，可使用 STANAG 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: Jacketed .303 British ammunition loaded with a 174gr spitzer bullet, similar to the MK VII pattern.  The British Empire's standard combat cartridge from 1888 until the 1950s.
translations: 使用174格令被甲尖头弹头的 .303 英式弹——造型与MK VII型 .303 英制弹相似。该口径为大英帝国于1888年至1950年代的制式弹药口径。

messages.msgid: Jacketed .303 British ammunition loaded with a 180gr soft point bullet, for hunting medium game.  .303 British was the standard caliber for military rifles in the British Empire from 1888 until the 1950s.  This loading allows the round to undergo greater expansion upon striking targets, leading to larger wound channels.
translations: 使用180格令软尖弹头的 .303 英式弹，常用于狩猎中型猎物。该口径为大英帝国于1888年至1950年代的制式弹药口径。软尖弹头在命中目标时会产生更大的空腔，从而对肉体造成更大的伤害。

messages.msgid: Jacketed .303 British ammunition loaded with a 174gr open tip match bullet, for precision shooting.  .303 British was the standard caliber for military rifles in the British Empire from 1888 until the 1950s.  The projectile's open tip construction offers greater manufacturing precision and a marginal amount of increased expansion over regular full metal jacket bullets.
translations: 使用174格令开尖竞技弹头的 .303 英式弹。该口径为大英帝国于1888年至1950年代的制式弹药口径。开尖弹头不光使其拥有更高的生产精度，其弹头扩展性相较全金属被甲弹也更为优秀。
.303 英式 开尖竞赛弹（黑火药）
.303 英式 软尖弹（黑火药）
.303 英式 被甲弹（黑火药）
.303 英式 开尖竞赛弹（复装）

messages.msgid: A 7.62x51mm NATO round with a 147gr FMJ bullet.  It is a powerful rifle cartridge commonly used by hunters and military snipers because of its high accuracy and long range.
translations: 使用147格令全金属被甲弹头的 7.62x51mm NATO 弹。高威力的步枪弹药，因其高精准度和长射程，被猎人和军方的狙击手们广泛使用。

messages.msgid: .308 Winchester ammunition with a 168gr hollow point bullet.  The .308 cartridge is one of the most popular hunting cartridges in the world due to its accuracy and power.
translations: 使用168格令空尖弹头的 .308 温彻斯特弹。.308 口径弹药因其威力与精准度，成为世界上最受欢迎的狩猎弹药之一。

messages.msgid: An M62 tracer round.  Traditional practice is to load one of these for every four normal rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.  They have the potential to ignite flammable surfaces on impact.
translations: M62 曳光弹。传统做法是每隔四发普通子弹加入一发曳光弹，以便于射手追踪射击目标。这类弹药在命中目标时能点燃易燃表面。

messages.msgid: An armor piercing 7.62x51mm round with a 126gr, tungsten carbide core projectile.  It offers significantly better armor penetration than standard ball rounds at the cost of worse wounding potential in soft tissue.
translations: 7.62x51mm M993 穿甲弹，使用126格令碳化钨核心弹头。相较常见的球状弹芯拥有更强的穿透力，代价是对软组织伤害力不足。

messages.msgid: .30 Carbine ammunition with a 110gr full metal jacket bullet.  A light rifle round developed during the Second World War for use in the M1 carbine; it remains a popular sporting round today.
translations: 使用110格令全金属被甲弹头的 .30 卡宾枪弹。第二次世界大战期间，为 M1 卡宾枪研发的轻型步枪子弹，在如今仍作为竞赛用弹而流行。

messages.msgid: .30 Carbine ammunition with a 110gr jacketed soft point bullet, which will perform better as a hunting round than FMJ.  A light rifle round developed during the Second World War for use in the M1 carbine; it remains a popular sporting round today.
translations: 使用110格令被甲软尖弹头的 .30 卡宾枪弹，比全金属被甲弹更适合作为狩猎用弹。第二次世界大战期间，为 M1 卡宾枪研发的轻型步枪子弹，在如今仍作为竞赛用弹而流行。
.30 卡宾枪 软尖弹（黑火药）
.30 卡宾枪 软尖弹（复装）
.30 卡宾枪 软尖弹（红磷火药）
.30 卡宾枪被甲弹（红磷火药）

messages.msgid: A jacketed .32 ACP cartridge loaded with a 71 grain bullet.  .32 ACP was once a popular handgun cartridge in the 20th century.  It lacks power compared to .380 Auto and 9x19mm.
translations: 使用72格令全金属被甲弹头的 .32 ACP 弹。.32 ACP 弹是于20世纪流行的手枪弹，但威力相比于 .38 弹或者 9x19mm 弹要更小。

messages.msgid: Jacketed .32 ACP ammunition with a 71gr hollow point bullet, intended for use in self-defense.  This caliber was once a popular handgun cartridge in the 20th century, though it lacks power compared to .380 Auto and 9x19mm.
translations: 使用71格令被甲空尖弹头的 .32 ACP 弹，主要用于自卫。.32 ACP 弹是于20世纪流行的手枪弹，但威力相比于 .38 弹或者 9x19mm 弹要更小。
.338 拉普阿 艇尾空尖弹

messages.msgid: .338 Lapua ammunition, loaded with a 300-grain hollow-point boat-tailed bullet.  Developed as a joint venture between Accuracy International, SAKO, and Lapua, the .338 round is a long-range sniping cartridge that boasts impressive accuracy and devastating terminal ballistics.  With burgeoning interest among military, law enforcement, and civilian circles before the Cataclysm, the .338 cartridge filled the gap between lighter infantry munitions and anti-material rounds, although its potential utility as a hunting cartridge was somewhat diminished due to its high cost.
translations: 300格令的 .338 拉普阿艇尾空尖弹。由精密国际、芬兰萨科防务公司和芬兰拉普阿公司合作研发。这种.338子弹是一种远程狙击子弹，拥有令人印象深刻的准确性和毁灭性的终端弹道。在大灾变之前，军方、执法部门和民间都对.338子弹产生了浓厚的兴趣，它填补了轻型步兵弹药和反器材子弹之间的空白，但由于其成本较高，其作为狩猎子弹的潜在效用被削弱了一些。

messages.msgid: .338 Lapua ammunition, loaded with a 248-grain armor-piercing bullet.  Developed as a joint venture between Accuracy International, SAKO, and Lapua, the .338 round is a long-range sniping cartridge that boasts impressive accuracy and devastating terminal ballistics.  This specialized loading of .338 Lapua features a highly penetrative full-metal jacketed bullet, which comes at the cost of negligible expansion once the round thunders into, and likely straight through, the target.
translations: 使用248格令穿甲弹头的 .338 拉普阿弹。该弹种为长距离狙击弹药，由精密国际公司、萨科公司，以及拉普阿公司联合研发，因其卓越的精准度和强大的终端弹道效能而闻名。该特殊弹使用高穿甲的全金属被甲弹头，但代价是子弹命中目标后几乎不存在扩张，甚至大概率还会直接穿透目标。
.338 拉普阿 穿甲燃烧弹

messages.msgid: .338 Lapua ammunition, loaded with a 256-grain armor-piercing incendiary bullet.  Developed as a joint venture between Accuracy International, SAKO, and Lapua, the .338 round is a long-range sniping cartridge that boasts impressive accuracy and devastating terminal ballistics.  This specialized loading of .338 Lapua features a tungsten carbide penetrator as well as an extra dose of nastiness in the form of an incendiary loading, which serves to highlight the point of impact and possibly set flammable materials alight.
translations: 使用256格令穿甲燃烧弹头的 .338 拉普阿弹。该弹种为长距离狙击弹药，由精密国际公司、萨科公司，以及拉普阿公司联合研发，因其卓越的精准度和强大的终端弹道效能而闻名。该特殊弹使用穿甲碳化钨弹头，以及用作燃烧剂的额外装药，用以照亮射击点并潜在地点燃易燃目标。
.338 拉普阿 艇尾空尖弹（黑火药）
.338 拉普阿 穿甲弹（黑火药）
.338 拉普阿 穿甲燃烧弹（黑火药）
.338 拉普阿 艇尾空尖弹（复装）
.338 拉普阿 穿甲弹（复装）
.338 拉普阿 穿甲燃烧弹（复装）

messages.msgid: Jacketed .357 Magnum ammunition.  The .357 Magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 Special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.
translations: 使用被甲弹头的 .357 马格南弹。.357 马格南弹基于早先的 .38 特制弹完善而来，有着更长的弹壳和更高的膛压。

messages.msgid: Jacketed hollow point .357 Magnum ammunition.  The .357 Magnum round is derived from the earlier .38 Special, with a marginally longer case and generating greater pressure.
translations: 使用被甲空尖弹头的 .357 马格南弹。.357 马格南弹基于早先的 .38 特制弹完善而来，有着更长的弹壳和更高的膛压。
.357 马格南 被甲弹（黑火药）
.357 马格南 空尖弹（黑火药）
.357 马格南 被甲弹（复装）
.357 马格南 空尖弹（复装）
.357 马格南 被甲弹（红磷火药）
.357 马格南 空尖弹（红磷火药）

messages.msgid: Jacketed .357 SIG ammunition.  Based on a 10mm Auto case necked down to a .355 inch bullet, the .357 SIG round is a high velocity pistol cartridge, giving it a flatter trajectory than many handgun rounds.
translations: 使用全金属被甲弹头的 .357 西格弹。由 10mm AUTO 弹壳缩口装入 .355 弹头制成，.357 西格弹是一种高初速手枪弹，相较于普通手枪弹拥有更加平直的弹道。

messages.msgid: Jacketed hollow point .357 SIG ammunition.  Based on a 10mm Auto case necked down to a .355 inch bullet, the .357 SIG round is a high velocity pistol cartridge, giving it a flatter trajectory than many handgun rounds.
translations: 使用被甲空尖弹头的 .357 西格弹。由 10mm AUTO 弹壳缩口装入 .355 弹头制成，.357 西格弹是一种高初速手枪弹，相较于普通手枪弹拥有更加平直的弹道。
.357 西格 被甲弹（黑火药）
.357 西格 空尖弹（黑火药）
.357 西格 被甲弹（红磷火药）
.357 西格 空尖弹（红磷火药）

messages.msgid: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and a .36 projectile.  Used by the Colt M1861 Navy.
translations: 一颗纸卷弹，里面填充有预先称量好的黑火药和一颗 .36 口径弹头，用于柯尔特 M1861 海军型 左轮手枪。

messages.msgid: .38 Special ammunition with a 130gr FMJ bullet.  From its inception, the .38 Special round has been known for its accuracy and low recoil.  Because it was initially a black powder cartridge, .38 Special is very low pressure.
translations: 使用130格令黄铜被甲弹头的 .38 特制弹。从诞生之日起，.38 特制弹就以其高精度和低后座的特性而见称。由于最初采用黑火药作为发射药，.38 特制弹的膛压非常低。

messages.msgid: Jacketed .38 Special ammunition with a 130gr hollowpoint bullet.  From its inception, the .38 Special round has been known for its accuracy and low recoil.  Because it was initially a black powder cartridge, .38 Special is very low pressure.
translations: 使用130格令被甲空尖弹头的 .38 特制弹。从诞生之日起，.38 特制弹就以其高精度和低后座的特性而见称。由于最初采用黑火药作为发射药，.38 特制弹的膛压非常低。

messages.msgid: Overpressure .38 Special ammunition with a jacketed 135gr hollowpoint bullet.  The round's increased velocity results in superior penetration and stopping power at the cost of higher recoil.
translations: 强装药、使用130格令被甲空尖弹头的 .38 特制弹。得益于更高的初速度，弹头的精度和停止力皆有明显提升，缺点则是产生更强的后座力。
.38 特制 被甲弹（黑火药）
.38 特制 空尖弹（黑火药）
.38 特制 被甲弹（红磷火药）
.38 特制 空尖弹（红磷火药）

messages.msgid: .380 ACP ammunition with a brass jacketed 95gr bullet.  Popular in pocket pistols for over a century, it is often considered the weakest caliber to consider for self-defense.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.
translations: 使用95格令黄铜被甲弹头的 .380 ACP 弹。作为袖珍手枪用子弹流行了一个多世纪，通常被认为是自卫用口径中威力最弱的。注意别把它装入使用 9x18mm 马卡洛夫弹或 9x19mm 弹的枪里。

messages.msgid: .380 ACP ammunition with a 95gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  It is a popular round for small concealable backup pistols, and often the weakest recommended defensive caliber.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.
translations: 使用95格令被甲空尖弹弹头的 .380 ACP 弹。作为袖珍手枪用子弹流行了一个多世纪，通常被认为是自卫用口径中威力最弱的。注意别把它装入使用 9x18mm 马卡洛夫弹或 9x19mm 弹的枪里。

messages.msgid: Overpressure .380 ACP ammunition with a 90gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  This defensive loading is designed to maximize performance and tends to be more accurate than practice ammo.  One should be careful not to chamber it in 9x18mm Makarov or 9x19mm firearms.
translations: 强装药、使用90格令被甲空尖弹弹头的 .380 ACP 弹。作为袖珍手枪用子弹流行了一个多世纪，通常被认为是自卫用口径中威力最弱的。注意别把它装入使用 9x18mm 马卡洛夫弹或 9x19mm 弹的枪里。

messages.msgid: .38 Super ammunition with a 124gr FMJ bullet.  The .38 Super round was developed from .38 ACP in 1929 to penetrate body armor of the era.  The caliber saw some resurgence in popularity among competition shooters in the 1980's prior to the proliferation of double stack 9mm pistols.
translations: 使用124格令全金属被甲弹头的 .38 超级弹。.38 超级弹于1929年，在 .38 ACP 弹的基础上研发而来，用于击穿同时期的防弹衣。而在双排 9mm 手枪普及前的80年代，该口径又复兴于竞技射击领域。

messages.msgid: .38 Super ammunition with a 115gr JHP bullet.  The .38 Super round was developed from .38 ACP in 1929 to penetrate body armor of the era.  The caliber saw some resurgence in popularity among competition shooters in the 1980's prior to the proliferation of double stack 9mm pistols.
translations: 使用115格令被甲空尖弹头的 .38 超级弹。.38 超级弹于1929年，在 .38 ACP 弹的基础上研发而来，用于击穿同时期的防弹衣。而在双排 9mm 手枪普及前的80年代，该口径又复兴于竞技射击领域。
.38 超级 被甲弹（黑火药）
.38 超级 空尖弹（黑火药）
.38 超级 空尖弹（红磷火药）
.38 超级 被甲弹（红磷火药）

messages.msgid: .40 S&W ammunition with a 180gr FMJ bullet.  The .40 S&W round is descended from the 10mm Auto cartridge and maintains most of its predecessor's strengths while reducing recoil.  It was popular among law enforcement before the FBI switched to 9mm.
translations: 使用180格令全金属被甲弹头的.40 S&W 弹。.40 S&W 继承了 10mm Auto 弹的大多数优点，同时降低了后坐力。在联邦调查局改用 9mm 弹之前，它曾在一度在执法部门中十分流行。

messages.msgid: .40 S&W ammunition with a 135gr JHP bullet.  The .40 S&W round is descended from the 10mm Auto cartridge and maintains most of its predecessor's strengths while reducing recoil.  It was popular among law enforcement before the FBI switched to 9mm.
translations: 使用135格令被甲空尖弹头的.40 S&W 弹。.40 S&W 继承了 10mm Auto 弹的大多数优点，同时降低了后坐力。在联邦调查局改用 9mm 弹之前，它曾在一度在执法部门中十分流行。

messages.msgid: A low velocity less-lethal 40x46mm round with a foam and plastic projectile intended to cause pain and disorientation to the target.  May still injure or kill.
translations: 一个低初速、低杀伤的 40x46mm 榴弹，装载一颗泡沫海绵和塑料制成的复合材料弹丸，目的是使目标疼痛并迷失方向感知能力。“低杀伤”不代表不会杀伤，目标仍有可能瘀伤甚至致死。

messages.msgid: A low velocity 40x46mm high explosive dual-purpose grenade.  It can penetrate 2 inches of steel armor, and the fragmentation of the projectile body also makes it suitable for use against infantry.
translations: 一个低初速的 40x46mm 高爆两用榴弹。它能够击穿2英寸厚的载具装甲，而其产生的大量破片也使它在反载具外，能够作为反步兵弹药使用。

messages.msgid: A 40x46mm buckshot load, designed for use in thick vegetation or room clearing.  Due to the limitations of weapons built to fire 40x46mm grenades, it's much less powerful than you'd expect.
translations: 一个 40x66mm 猎鹿弹，主要用于丛林茂密地形或是室内作战。受限于用于发射 40x46mm 榴弹的武器的设计局限性，它的实际威力比你想象的要小得多。

messages.msgid: A low velocity 40x46mm tear gas canister.  It is effective for riot control and driving infantry from entrenched positions, and is able to penetrate thin wood.
translations: 一个低初速的 40x46mm 催泪瓦斯榴弹。在防暴行动中人群控制，或将敌方步兵逼出防御阵地时十分有效，而且能穿透较薄的木板。

messages.msgid: A set of ten .22 LR bullets compressed into a 40mm adapter.  Fires all ten rounds simultaneously.
translations: 一个装有十发 .22 LR 弹的 40mm 榴弹适配器，能够将十发子弹同时击发。

messages.msgid: A set of four .410 000 shotshells and a large pistol primer loaded into a 40mm adapter.  Fires all four rounds at once with an internal firing assembly, which is set off by the primer.
translations: 一个装有四发 .410 口径 000 霰弹和大型手枪底火的 40mm 榴弹适配器，击发底火后，内部的组件能够将四发霰弹同时击发。

messages.msgid: A set of four .410 slug shells and a large pistol primer loaded into a 40mm adapter.  Fires all four rounds at once with an internal firing assembly, which is set off by the primer.
translations: 一个装有四发 .410 口径独头弹和大型手枪底火的 40mm 榴弹适配器，击发底火后，内部的组件能够将四发霰弹同时击发。

messages.msgid: A set of four .410 birdshot shells and a large pistol primer loaded into a 40mm adapter.  Fires all four rounds at once with an internal firing assembly, which is set off by the primer.
translations: 一个装有四发 .410 口径猎鸟弹和大型手枪底火的 40mm 榴弹适配器，击发底火后，内部的组件能够将四发霰弹同时击发。

messages.msgid: A set of four .410 'scrap-shot' shells and a large pistol primer loaded into a 40mm adapter.  Fires all four rounds at once with an internal firing assembly, which is set off by the primer.
translations: 一个装有四发 .410 口径废料弹和大型手枪底火的 40mm 榴弹适配器，击发底火后，内部的组件能够将四发霰弹同时击发。

messages.msgid: A 40x53mm canister shot load, with 113 17-grain flechettes.
translations: 一个 40x53mm 镖形弹，内装有113支17格令重的镖箭。

messages.msgid: A high velocity 40x53mm high explosive dual-purpose grenade.  It can penetrate 3 inches of steel armor, and the fragmentation of the projectile body also makes it suitable for use against infantry.
translations: 一个高初速的 40x53mm 高爆两用榴弹。它能够击穿3英寸厚的载具装甲，而其产生的大量破片也使它在反载具外，能够作为反步兵弹药使用。

messages.msgid: An improvised 40x53mm buckshot load somewhat resembling M576.
translations: 一个自制的 40x53mm 猎鹿弹，大体与 M576 榴弹相仿。

messages.msgid: An improvised 40x53mm load resembling an oversized shotgun slug.
translations: 一个自制的 40x53mm 独头弹，大体与（尺寸大过头的）独头霰弹相仿。

messages.msgid: An improvised 40x53mm flechette load containing 115 steel darts, similar to a M1001 flechette load.
translations: 一个自制的 40x53mm 镖形弹，内装有115支钢镖，大体与 M1001 镖形弹相仿。

messages.msgid: A .410 shotshell loaded with a 110gr slug.  Decent for hunting medium game or possibly self-defense.
translations: 装载110格令独头弹头的 .410 霰弹。适合狩猎中型猎物或者自卫。

messages.msgid: A .410 shotshell loaded with five 000 pellets.  Good for a hunting or combat load.
translations: 装载5颗000号弹丸的 .410 霰弹。适合狩猎或战斗使用。

messages.msgid: A .410 shotshell loaded with 3/8th of an ounce of #4 brass-plated steel birdshot.  Designed for hunting birds and other small game, its applications in combat are very limited.
translations: 装载3/8盎司的4号镀铜钢弹的 .410 霰弹。设计用于狩猎鸟类或小型猎物，在战斗中的效果较为有限。

messages.msgid: A .410 shotshell filled with whatever scrap metal was lying around.  More damaging than birdshot, but fairly inaccurate.
translations: 装载各种金属废料的 .410 霰弹，弹丸材料完全因地制宜。威力比猎鸟弹强，就是不太准。

messages.msgid: Jacketed .44 Magnum ammunition with a 240gr bullet.  The .44 Magnum round is one of the most powerful handgun cartridges available.  It has excellent stopping power but suffers from extremely high recoil for a handgun round.
translations: 使用240格令全金属被甲弹头的 .44 马格南弹。.44 马格南弹是当今市面上的手枪弹中威力最大的弹种之一。它有着优异的停止力，但同时作为手枪弹来说后坐力也非常高。

messages.msgid: Jacketed .44 Magnum ammunition with a 240gr hollowpoint bullet.  The .44 Magnum round is one of the most powerful handgun cartridges available.  It has excellent stopping power but suffers from extremely high recoil for a handgun round.
translations: 使用240格令被甲空尖弹头的 .44 马格南弹。.44 马格南弹是当今市面上的手枪弹中威力最大的弹种之一。它有着优异的停止力，但同时作为手枪弹来说后坐力也非常高。
.44 马格南 被甲弹（复装）
.44 马格南 被甲弹（黑火药）

messages.msgid: A paper cartridge containing a premeasured amount of black powder and a .44 projectile.  Used by the Colt M1860 Army.
translations: 一颗纸卷弹，里面填充有预先称量好的黑火药和一颗 .44 口径弹头，用于柯尔特 M1860 陆军型 左轮手枪。

messages.msgid: .45 ACP ammunition with a 230gr FMJ bullet.  Due to a reputation for effectiveness, the .45 ACP round has been common for over a century.
translations: 装有 230 格令全金属被甲弹头的 .45 ACP 弹药。.45 ACP 因其良好的杀伤效果而享有声誉，已流行并被广泛使用逾一个世纪。

messages.msgid: .45 ACP ammunition with a 185gr JHP bullet.  The .45 ACP round was developed to replace the .38 Long Colt cartridge in the early 20th century, but has since lost some of its popularity to more modern handgun ammo.
translations: 装有185格令被甲空尖弹头的 .45 ACP 弹。.45 ACP 弹于20世纪早期设计研发，用以代替 .38 长柯尔特弹，但随着现代手枪弹药的逐渐发展，使用频率也逐渐下滑。

messages.msgid: Overpressure .45 ACP ammunition with a 185gr JHP bullet.  This cartridge has higher muzzle energy than typical loads, leading to greater damage, accuracy and recoil.
translations: 强装药、使用185格令被甲空尖弹头的 .45 ACP 弹。该增压弹拥有更高的枪口动能，相比同口径普通弹有着更高伤害、精准度，和更大的后坐力。

messages.msgid: .450 Bushmaster ammunition, loaded with a plastic-capped 250-grain Flex Tip bullet.  Born from discontent with the .223 Remington's weak stopping potential, the .450 Bushmaster round was crafted in line with the so-called 'Thumper' concept: an envisioned need for a large-bore, semi-automatic sporting cartridge capable of downing game in one shot.  Along with its elder sibling, the .50-caliber Beowulf cartridge, the .450 Bushmaster is one of a number of such high-caliber rounds and is compatible with appropriately converted AR-15-platform rifles.  This particular cartridge possesses a plastic-tipped projectile, which acts as an improved hollow point bullet with uniform and devastating expansion within wound cavities.
translations: 250格令的.450 大毒蛇软尖弹，使用塑料制软尖弹头。出于对.223雷明顿较弱停止力的不满，.450大毒蛇弹按照所谓的"出重拳"概念制作：设想一种大口径、半自动的运动子弹，能够在一枪之内结束游戏。与它的老兄弟，.50口径的贝奥武夫弹一样，.450大毒蛇弹也属于能与适当改装的AR-15平台步枪兼容的大口径弹药。这种特殊的子弹拥有一个塑料弹头，作为一种改进的空尖弹，在伤腔内的膨胀是均匀且破坏性的。

messages.msgid: .450 Bushmaster ammunition, loaded with a solid-copper 220-grain penetrator bullet.  Born from discontent with the .223 Remington's weak stopping potential, the .450 Bushmaster round was crafted in line with the so-called 'Thumper' concept: an envisioned need for a large-bore, semi-automatic sporting cartridge capable of downing game in one shot.  Along with its elder sibling, the .50-caliber Beowulf cartridge, the .450 Bushmaster is one of a number of such high-caliber rounds and is compatible with appropriately converted AR-15-platform rifles.  This particular cartridge is loaded with a solid-copper projectile: excellent at punching through thick barriers and delivering massive amounts of energy to anything unfortunate enough to be hit.
translations: 220格令的.450 大毒蛇穿甲弹弹，使用实心铜制穿甲弹头。出于对.223雷明顿较弱停止力的不满，.450大毒蛇弹按照所谓的"出重拳"概念制作：设想一种大口径、半自动的运动子弹，能够在一枪之内结束游戏。与它的老兄弟，.50口径的贝奥武夫弹一样，.450大毒蛇弹也属于能与适当改装的AR-15平台步枪兼容的大口径弹药。这种特殊的子弹装载的是实心铜弹头，非常擅长击穿厚厚的障碍物，并向任何不幸被击中的物体送去大量动能。
.450 大毒蛇终极狩猎弹（黑火药）
.450 大毒蛇终极狩猎弹（复装）

messages.msgid: .454 Casull ammunition with a 300gr jacketed soft point bullet.  The .454 Casull round is derived from .45 Long Colt with a stronger, lengthened case.  It is an exceptionally powerful cartridge with higher stopping power than many rifle rounds, although its extreme recoil makes it unsuitable for most purposes.
translations: 300格令的.454口径卡苏尔被甲软尖弹。.454口径卡苏尔弹是.45口径长柯尔特弹（.45 LC）的弹壳拉伸加厚版，它有着令人惊异的高能量装药，能打出比许多步枪子弹都要好的停止作用，但同时它击发时极高的后坐力使得它不适用于大多数环境。

messages.msgid: .45-70 Government ammunition loaded with a 305 grain soft point bullet.  One of the oldest cartridges still in use, it is still a favorite for large game hunting at short ranges.
translations: 305格令的 .45-70 软尖政府弹。它是目前仍在使用的最古老的弹药之一，依然是近距离狩猎大型猎物的首选弹药。

messages.msgid: .45-70 Government overpressure ammunition loaded with a 305 grain solid copper penetrator projectile.  Designed for maximum penetration through thick hide and bone while maintaining ideal wounding characteristics.
translations: 305格令的 .45-70 铜芯穿甲政府弹，超压型号。设计在最大限度地保证穿透厚皮和骨头的同时，保持了理想的弹道伤害特性。

messages.msgid: .45-70 Government ammunition loaded with a 405 grain lead flat nose bullet to original specifications for safe use in antique firearms.  Quite a bit less powerful than modern ammo, but still packs a punch.
translations: 使用 405 格令铅芯平头弹弹头的 .45-70政府弹，符合最初的设计规格，可安全用于古董枪械。虽然比现代弹药的威力要弱一些，但仍然有一战之力。
.458 温彻斯特马格南软尖弹

messages.msgid: Jacketed .458 Winchester Magnum loaded with a 350gr soft point bullet.  Compared to other cartridges of this size, the straight walls of the case and the 'belt' near the base of the case give the cartridge a strange appearance.  .458 Winchester Magnum is a modern Big Five game rifle cartridge, intended for taking any of Africa's large and dangerous game, which quickly supplanted other cartridges in use by hunters, guides and wardens.
translations: 350格令的.458温彻斯特马格南软尖弹。与其他尺寸相似的弹药相比，笔直的外壳壁和靠近外壳底部的"弹带"使这款弹药具有独特的外观。.458 温彻斯特马格南弹是一款现代狩猎非洲五霸的步枪弹，旨在针对非洲各种危险的大型猎物，它很快取代了猎人、向导和狱警们所使用的其他型号弹药。
.458 温彻斯特马格南弹（复装）
.458 温彻斯特马格南弹（黑火药）

messages.msgid: .45 Long Colt ammunition with a 250gr lead flat nose bullet.  Originally designed for the Colt Single Action Army, and still used for modern reproduction revolvers.  This ammunition is loaded to be safer in antiques and for cowboy action shooting, and is thus less powerful than other, hotter loads.
translations: 250格令的.45 长柯尔特弹药，采用铅制平头弹头。原本为柯尔特单发陆军型左轮手枪设计，但仍然被用于现代复制的左轮手枪中。这款型号的装药为了保证古典和牛仔动作射击比赛时的安全性，因此相比其他型号威力更小。
.45 柯尔特牛仔弹（红磷火药）

messages.msgid: Jacketed .45 Colt ammunition with a 225gr hollow point bullet, loaded much hotter than regular loads for this cartridge.  Hollowpoints in this venerable caliber were issued by the occasional police department looking for extra lethality before the '97 North Hollywood shootout.  Since then they were mostly used for home defense, and now by the post-apocalyptic cowboy.
translations: 225格令的 .45 口径柯尔特披甲空尖弹。装药比常规子弹更多。在97年北好莱坞抢劫案之前，这种古老口径的空尖弹由警局发行，以追求额外的杀伤力。之前它们常用于家庭自卫保护，现在则是被末世后牛仔使用。

messages.msgid: Jacketed .45 Colt ammunition with a 225gr hollow point bullet, loaded much hotter than regular loads for this cartridge.  The resource scarcity of the Cataclysm inspired someone to hand-reload this one with black powder, bringing the round closer to its original incarnation.  It's kind of poetic, when you think about it.
translations: 225 格令的.45 柯尔特被甲空尖弹，其装药量比常规弹药更多。大灾变的资源匮乏激发了某人用黑火药手工复装这枚弹药，这让它更接近其最初原型。当你细想这件事时，竟还带点诗意。
.45 柯尔特空尖弹（红磷火药）

messages.msgid: Jacketed .45 Long Colt ammunition with a 225gr bullet.  Originally designed for the Colt Single Action Army, and still used for modern reproduction revolvers.
translations: 225 格令的. .45 长柯尔特子弹。最初为柯尔特单动式陆军左轮手枪(M1873)设计，时至今日，这种弹药仍应用于其现代复刻版左轮手枪。

messages.msgid: Jacketed .45 Long Colt ammunition with a 225gr bullet.  Originally designed for the Colt Single Action Army, and still used for modern reproduction revolvers.  The resource scarcity of the Cataclysm inspired someone to hand-reload this one with black powder, bringing the round closer to its original incarnation.  It's kind of poetic, when you think about it.
translations: 225格令的.45口径长柯尔特弹药。原本是为柯尔特单动式陆军左轮手枪设计的弹药，但仍然被用于现代重制版的左轮手枪中。大灾变的资源匮乏激发了某人用黑火药手工重新装填这枚弹药，这让它更接近其最初原型。当你细想这件事时，竟还带点诗意。
.45 柯尔特被甲弹（红磷火药）

messages.msgid: 4.6x30mm ammunition with a 31gr copper plated steel bullet.  The 4.6x30mm round was developed by H&K to compete with FN Herstal's 5.7x28mm cartridge.  It has low recoil and excellent armor penetration.
translations: 31格令的4.6x30mm口径镀铜钢芯弹，4.6x30mm口径子弹是由H&K公司研制，用来与 FN 赫斯塔尔公司的5.7x28mm口径弹药竞争的弹种。该弹有着较低后坐力，和优秀的穿甲性能。

messages.msgid: 4.6x30mm ammunition with a 31gr copper plated lead bullets.  The 4.6x30mm round was developed by H&K to compete with FN Herstal's 5.7x28mm cartridge.  It has low recoil, but lacks its usual armor penetration due to using a simple lead bullet rather than a proper factory-made penetrator projectile.
translations: 31格令的4.6x30mm口径镀铜铅芯弹，4.6x30mm口径子弹是由H&K公司研制，用来与 FN 赫斯塔尔公司的5.7x28mm口径弹药竞争的弹种。该弹有着较低后坐力，但由于使用的是简单的铅芯而不是正规的工厂制造的穿甲弹芯，因此没有常规枪弹的对于装甲的穿透力。

messages.msgid: .460 S&W Magnum ammo, with a 200 grain FTX projectile.  Its purpose serves mainly as a hunting handgun, or to deter wildlife in dangerous areas, though you have no doubt about its effectiveness against the undead.
translations: .460 S&W 马格南弹药，配有200格令FTX弹丸。它的用途主要是作为狩猎手枪，或在危险地区威慑野生动物，尽管你毫不怀疑它对丧尸的有效性。
.460 S&W 马格南 FTX 弹（复装）
.460 S&W 马格南 空尖弹

messages.msgid: .460 S&W Magnum ammo, with a 300 grain JHP projectile.  Its purpose serves mainly as a hunting handgun, or to deter wildlife in dangerous areas, though you have no doubt about its effectiveness against the undead.
translations: .460 S&W 马格南弹药，配有300格令空尖弹弹丸。它的用途主要是作为狩猎手枪，或在危险地区威慑野生动物，尽管你毫不怀疑它对丧尸的有效性。
.460 S&W 马格南 空尖弹（复装）

messages.msgid: A tracer variant of the powerful .50 BMG round.  Tracer rounds help to keep the weapon they are fired from on target at the risk of igniting flammable substances.
translations: .50 BMG的曳光弹型号。曳光弹种可帮助保持对射击目标的瞄准，但同时也有引燃可燃物的风险。

messages.msgid: .50 BMG ammunition with a mild steel cored 661gr FMJ bullet.  The .50 BMG is a very powerful rifle round designed for anti-aircraft use, later adapted to anti-vehicular and anti-personnel roles.  Its stupendous energy and armor piercing capabilities make it one of the most deadly rounds available, offset only by its drastic recoil and noise.
translations: 661 格令的 .50 BMG M33 弹药，使用软钢芯全金属被甲弹弹头。.50 口径弹药是非常强悍的步枪弹，原本设计用于防空，但后来也被改用于反载具和反步兵等多种用途。它所拥有的惊人威力和穿甲力使它成为有史以来最致命的弹药之一，但缺点是其击发后震撼的后坐力以及发射时所带来的巨大噪声。

messages.msgid: .50 BMG ammunition with a lead-cored FMJ bullet.  The .50 BMG is a very powerful rifle round designed for anti-aircraft use, later adapted to anti-vehicular and anti-personnel roles.  Its stupendous energy and armor piercing capabilities make it one of the most deadly rounds available, offset only by its drastic recoil and noise.
translations: .50 BMG 弹，采用铅芯全金属被甲弹弹头。.50 口径弹药是非常强悍的步枪弹，原本设计用于防空，但后来也被改用于反载具和反步兵等多种用途。它所拥有的惊人威力和穿甲力使它成为有史以来最致命的弹药之一，但缺点是其震撼的后坐力以及发射时所带来的巨大噪声。这是手工复装的型号。

messages.msgid: A variant of the .50 BMG round that uses a core of very dense, hardened tungsten steel.  Penetration is increased, but damage is reduced.
translations: .50 BMG 穿甲弹，采用密度非常高、极为坚硬的钨钢穿甲弹芯。提升了穿甲能力，但伤害降低。
.50 BMG 诺霍斯 Mk 211 弹

messages.msgid: This variant of the .50 BMG round makes the most of the caliber's potential payload delivery: The tip is loaded with an incendiary mix, which ignites on impact, detonating the RDX or PETN charge.  This also ignites a secondary zirconium powder incendiary charge that surrounds a tungsten carbide penetrator, both encased by a mild steel cup.  Fragments from the cup and burning metallic powder follow the penetrator through armored targets, increasing lethality.  This rare, complicated, and expensive round is not likely to be manufactured again; use it wisely.
translations: 这款.50 BMG 弹型充分利用了自身口径的潜在载荷发射能力：弹尖内填充了燃烧剂，会在击中目标的同时瞬间点燃，并引爆内置的RDX或PETN装药。此外还会点燃环绕在碳化钨穿甲弹头周围的辅助燃烧剂，两者被同时密封在脆性钢制弹壳中。钢壳碎片和燃烧的金属粉末随着穿甲弹头穿透装甲目标打击内部，以增加杀伤力。缺点莫过于巨大的后坐力和噪声，这种罕见复杂且昂贵的弹药几乎不可能再次被制造出来；谨慎使用。

messages.msgid: .500 S&W Magnum ammunition with a 500gr bullet.  The .500 S&W Magnum round is a colossally powerful handgun cartridge capable of killing almost any target with one hit.  It has extremely high damage, and recoil to match.
translations: 500格令的.500 S&W 马格南弹，这款子弹的威力无比巨大，足以一枪击杀大多数目标，还能让你像西部牛仔那样吹吹枪口冒出来的白烟。但与其恐怖威力为之相对的后坐力也是十分巨大。

messages.msgid: .50-caliber Beowulf ammunition, loaded with a copper-jacketed 350-grain eXtreme Terminal Performance bullet.  Developed in 2001 as a powerful short- to medium-range chambering for AR-15 style rifles, this stout cartridge had gained some popularity as a hunting round before the Cataclysm.  This particular version of the cartridge is coated in a layer of polymer, encouraging commendable terminal ballistics, penetrative capabilities, and overall expansion from its 12.7x42mm projectile.
translations: .50口径贝奥武夫弹，装载350格令"极致终端性能"铜甲弹头。这种坚固的子弹在2001年被研发用于中短程膛室的AR-15型步枪，在大灾变之前作为狩猎子弹小有名气。这种特殊版本的子弹涂有一层聚合物，给它的12.7x42mm弹头带来了值得称赞的终端弹道、穿透能力和整体膨胀表现。

messages.msgid: .50-caliber Beowulf ammunition, loaded with a solid-copper 420-grain Xtreme Penetrator bullet.  Developed in 2001 as a powerful short- to medium-range chambering for AR-15 style rifles, this stout cartridge had gained some popularity as a hunting round before the Cataclysm.  With a blunt nose construction for better initial energy transfer, this 12.7mm-wide bullet's solid copper design allows it to punch through entry barriers while resulting in a larger wound column.
translations: .50口径贝奥武夫弹，装载420格令的"极限穿甲"实心铜弹头。这种坚固的子弹在2001年被研发用于中短程膛室的AR-15型步枪，在大灾变之前作为狩猎子弹小有名气。这种12.7毫米宽的子弹采用实心铜设计，钝头结构能实现更好的初始能量传递，使其能够穿透入口障碍，同时产生更大的伤口柱。
.50 贝奥武夫终极穿甲弹（黑火药）
.50 贝奥武夫终极穿甲弹（复装）

messages.msgid: .50 Action Express ammunition loaded with a 325-grain jacketed flat-nose bullet, primarily for use in the Desert Eagle pistol.
translations: 使用325格令的被甲平头弹头的 .50 AE 弹，主要用于沙漠之鹰手枪。

messages.msgid: .50 Action Express ammunition loaded with a 300-grain jacketed hollowpoint bullet, primarily for use in the Desert Eagle pistol.
translations: 使用300格令的被甲空尖弹头的 .50 AE 弹，主要用于沙漠之鹰手枪。

messages.msgid: Domestically produced 5.45x39mm ammunition with a 56gr FMJ bullet.  The 5.45x39mm round was introduced along with the AK-74 in 1974.  It has superior wounding potential to the older 7.62x39mm round and quickly replaced it in Soviet military use.
translations: 56格令的5.45x39mm 7N10 全金属被甲弹。5.45x39mm口径弹药在1974年随着AK-74的流行而广泛流行开来，因其较7.62x39mm口径的老式型号有着更优异的破坏力，因此该种弹药在发布后就迅速地取代了老式子弹。

messages.msgid: 5.45x39mm ammunition with a 57gr bullet containing a mild steel penetrator, which penetrates armor marginally better than lead core projectiles.  Developed in 1974 by the Russian military, and banned from import into the US in 2014.
translations: 57格令碳钢穿甲弹头的5.45x39mm口径子弹，比起铅芯弹头穿甲性能更好。1974年由俄罗斯陆军研发，在2014年被禁止进口到美国。

messages.msgid: 5.7x28mm ammunition with a 31gr AP FMJ bullet.  The 5.7x28mm cartridge was designed by FN Herstal to replace the 9x19mm round in NATO use.  Although the project to replace 9x19mm Parabellum was effectively canceled, the 5.7x28mm round has seen action in many conflicts and has proven to be reliable.  It has very low recoil and its armor penetration is a defining feature.
translations: 31格令的 5.7x28mm SS190 全金属被甲穿甲弹。5.7x28mm口径子弹是由 FN 赫斯塔尔公司设计，计划用来在北约中取代9x19mm帕拉贝鲁姆弹的弹种。尽管弹种取代计划被最终取消了，5.7x28mm口径子弹也已经在许多地区冲突中得到了使用，并证明了它的可靠性能。该种弹药的后坐力很低，并且穿甲性能不俗。

messages.msgid: A subsonic cartridge derived from the 5.7x28mm, designed for silenced firearms.  It offers good armor penetration at the cost of slightly less damage.
translations: 5.7x28mm 手枪弹的亚音速衍生版本，供微声武器使用。这种子弹通过稍稍降低威力的改进来获得良好的装甲穿彻性能。

messages.msgid: A commercially available cartridge derived from the 5.7x28mm round.  It features a copper-jacketed bullet with an aluminum core, which significantly reduces its armor-piercing capabilities compared to its lead-core counterpart.  However, the hollow-point design enhances terminal performance against unarmored targets.  In all other respects, it remains largely identical to the military version.
translations: 一种由5.7x28mm弹药改进而来的商业弹种。该弹头采用铜被甲包裹铝芯结构，与铅芯弹相比其穿甲性能大幅削弱，但空尖弹设计显著提升了其对无防护目标的杀伤效果。其余性能参数则与军用版本基本保持一致。

messages.msgid: 5.7x28mm ammunition with a 31gr AP FMJ bullet.  The 5.7x28mm cartridge was designed by FN Herstal to replace the 9x19mm round in NATO use.  Although the project to replace 9x19mm Parabellum was effectively canceled, the 5.7x28mm round has seen action in many conflicts and has proven to be reliable.  It has very low recoil but lacks its usual armor penetration due to using a simple lead bullet rather than a proper factory-made penetrator projectile.
translations: 31格令的 5.7x28mm SS190 全金属被甲穿甲弹。5.7x28mm口径子弹是由 FN 赫斯塔尔公司设计，计划用来在北约中取代9x19mm帕拉贝鲁姆弹的弹种。尽管弹种取代计划被最终取消了，5.7x28mm口径子弹也已经在许多地区冲突中得到了使用，并证明了它的可靠性能。该种弹药的后坐力很低，但由于使用的是简单的铅芯而不是正规的工厂制造的穿甲弹芯，因此没有常规枪弹的对于装甲的穿透力。

messages.msgid: High-explosive mortar cartridge, designed to be used against troops, light vehicles, light bunkers or similar targets.
translations: 高爆迫击炮弹，被设计用于对付士兵、轻型车辆、轻型掩体或类似目标。

messages.msgid: High-explosive mortar cartridge, designed to be used against troops, light vehicles, light bunkers or similar targets.  This one is more modern version, both more safe and more powerful.
translations: 高爆迫击炮弹，设计用于对付士兵、轻型车辆、轻型掩体或类似目标。这个版本更现代，更安全，更强大。

messages.msgid: High-explosive mortar cartridge, designed to be used against troops, light vehicles, light bunkers or similar targets.  This one is more modern version, more safe and more powerful, but uses more simple impact fuze.
translations: 高爆迫击炮弹，设计用于对付士兵、轻型车辆、轻型掩体或类似目标。这是一个更现代的版本，更安全，更强大，但使用更简单的冲击引信。

messages.msgid: A 66mm incendiary rocket, used in the M202 FLASH rocket launcher.  Its warhead is filled with a thickened pyrophoric agent, which burns at 2200 degrees Fahrenheit.
translations: M202 FLASH 火箭筒使用的66mm 燃烧弹。弹头中装填了TPA（经过聚异丁烯增稠的三乙基铝），燃烧温度达到1200°C。

messages.msgid: A 66mm high-explosive anti-tank round.  It could blow through up to two feet of concrete.
translations: 一枚66mm破甲火箭弹，它能击穿厚达2英尺（约61厘米）的混凝土等材质掩体。

messages.msgid: Imported 7.62x39mm M67-style ammunition with a 124gr jacketed, lead core bullet.  Thankfully this loading has non-corrosive primers, and also features a reloadable brass case.
translations: 进口的7.62x39mm M67型弹药，有着124格令重的铅芯弹头。好消息是这枚子弹使用不带腐蚀性的底火，和可复装的黄铜外壳。

messages.msgid: 7.62x39mm ammunition with a 123gr jacketed, hollowpoint bullet.  Made for hunting medium game, cartridges such as these were once popular for those using cheap military surplus rifles, as 7.62x39's ballistics are somewhat similar to that of 30-30 Winchester.  The combination of sanctions against exporting nations and drying up of formerly plentiful surplus has made these loadings of 7.62x39 less popular.
translations: 123格令 被帽空尖弹头的7.62x39mm口径子弹。用于狩猎中型猎物，这样的弹药曾被过剩的廉价军用枪支大量使用，因为7.62x39口径与30-30温切斯特口径极为相似。一系列关于出口的规定和存量枪支的消耗让这种口径的子弹不再炙手可热。

messages.msgid: 7.62x54mmR ammunition with a 150gr FMJ bullet.  The 7.62x54mmR round is one of the oldest still in common use, primarily due to the popularity of the Mosin-Nagant rifle.  It is a powerful cartridge capable of killing most targets with one shot.
translations: 150格令的7.62x54mmR 全金属被甲弹。7.62x54mmR口径子弹是至今仍被广泛使用的最老式子弹之一，主要是因为它所配套的莫辛纳甘步枪的流行使得它经久不衰，尽管在军用领域它在几十年前就已经撤装，但是在民用射击领域至今仍有它的身影。这种弹药是一种能够一击杀死大部分猎物的大威力弹药。

messages.msgid: A commercial version of the 7.62x25mm cartridge created for the armed forces of Soviet Russia.  It was derived from the 7.63x25mm cartridge used by the C96 pistol.
translations: 为苏俄军方制造的 7.62x25mm 弹药的民用版本，它衍生自 C96 手枪所使用的 7.63x25mm 弹药。

messages.msgid: A high-pressure commercial version of the 7.62x25mm cartridge, loaded with an 85 gr. FMJ bullet.  It is more powerful than the original.
translations: 85格令的7.62x25mm 全金属被甲增压弹的民用版本。相比原版威力更加强大。

messages.msgid: A subsonic cartridge derived from the 7.62x25mm, designed for silenced firearms.  It offers good armor penetration at the cost of slightly less damage.
translations: 7.62x25mm 托卡列夫手枪弹的亚音速衍生版本，供微声武器使用。这种子弹通过稍稍降低威力的改进来获得良好的装甲穿彻性能。

messages.msgid: This is a 7.7x58mm Arisaka cartridge loaded with a 174 gr soft point bullet, excellent against larger game and, now, zombies.  Adopted as the Japanese empire's standard service cartridge in 1939 (though chambered in machine guns before then) to replace the less potent 6.5x50mm Arisaka round, the 7.7mm bullet was, while more deadly, never quite able to supplant the older munitions.  Having acquired a following as a hunting cartridge before the Cataclysm, mainly due to the prevalence of captured or surrendered Japanese rifles, the round was more common than its older 6.5x50mm counterpart.
translations: 174格令软尖弹头的7.7x58mm口径Arisaka子弹，非常适合对付大型猎物和僵尸。1939年被用作日本帝国的标准子弹（之前曾用作机枪弹药），以取代威力较小的6.5x50mm Arisaka子弹。尽管更致命，但并未完全取代旧弹药。在大在变前，这种子弹大量用作狩猎弹药，因为受降或缴获了大量日军武器，它比旧的6.5x50mm口径更常见。

messages.msgid: An 84x245mm High Explosive anti-personnel cartridge for the Carl Gustaf M3 and other 84mm recoilless rifles.  Designed to be highly effective against personnel.
translations: 一发84x246mm口径的高爆弹，用于卡尔古斯塔夫 M3 无后坐力炮或其他84mm口径武器。高爆设计能有效杀伤人员。

messages.msgid: An 84x245mm High Explosive Dual Purpose anti-materiel cartridge for the Carl Gustaf M3 and other 84mm recoilless rifles.  Designed to be highly effective against vehicles and structures.
translations: 一枚 84x245mm 高爆两用反器材炮弹，用于卡尔古斯塔夫 M3 无后坐力炮和其他84mm口径炮，能有效打击车辆和建筑。

messages.msgid: An 84x245mm smoke marker cartridge for the Carl Gustaf M3 and other 84mm recoilless rifles.  Commonly used for signaling, target designation, and for screening troop movements.
translations: 一枚 84x245mm 烟雾弹，用于卡尔古斯塔夫 M3 无后坐力炮和其他84mm口径炮，常用于发信号、指示目标和掩护部队。

messages.msgid: An 8x40mm caseless cartridge with a rectangular shape, consisting of a jacketed 127gr bullet housed inside of an advanced propellant body.  Upon firing, the body will be consumed, leaving nothing behind in the chamber.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech 8x40 caseless guns.
translations: 使用方形的先进装药制弹体，包裹127格令被甲弹头的 8x40mm 无壳弹。子弹被击发后，作为弹体的装药将直接被消耗殆尽，因此也不会留下弹壳。为Rivtech 8x40mm 无壳弹枪械的专属弹药。

messages.msgid: An 8x40mm caseless cartridge with a rectangular shape, consisting of a licensed 127gr solid copper expanding bullet housed inside of an advanced propellant body.  Upon firing, the body will be consumed, leaving nothing behind in the chamber.  The monometal construction of the bullet lends itself to greater manufacturing precision, while also offering excellent expansion and penetration.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech 8x40 caseless guns.
translations: 使用方形的先进装药制弹体，包裹127格令空尖弹头的 8x40mm 无壳弹。子弹被击发后，作为弹体的装药将直接被消耗殆尽，因此也不会留下弹壳。一体式的弹头使其拥有更高的生产精度，但其相应地也能表现出优秀的弹头扩展性和穿透性。为Rivtech 8x40mm 无壳弹枪械的专属弹药。

messages.msgid: 9x19mm ammunition with a 116gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  JHP rounds have inferior penetration to FMJ rounds, but their expansion slightly increases stopping power against unarmored targets and reduces overpenetration.
translations: 使用116格令被甲空尖弹头的 9x19mm 弹。被甲空尖弹的穿甲力比全金属被甲弹差一些，但弹头的扩张性略微提升了其命中没有护甲防护的目标时的停止力，弹头也更容易留在目标体内。

messages.msgid: 9x19mm ammunition with a brass jacketed 115gr bullet.  It has been a popular round for military, law enforcement, and civilian use for over a century.
translations: 使用115格令黄铜制全金属被甲弹头的 9x19mm 弹。其作为军警和民用领域的常用弹种，已有百年有余。

messages.msgid: Overpressure 9x19mm ammunition.  The round's increased velocity results in superior accuracy and stopping power at the cost of higher recoil.
translations: 强装药的 9x19mm 增压弹。得益于更高的初速度，弹头的精度和停止力皆有明显提升，缺点则是产生更强的后座力。

messages.msgid: A step beyond the high-pressure 9x19mm +P round, the +P+ has even higher internal pressure offering superior damage, accuracy, and penetration.
translations: 在强装药 9x19mm +P 弹的基础上更进一步，+P+ 弹更加高的膛压使弹头产生更高的伤害、精度，和穿甲。

messages.msgid: 9x18mm Makarov ammunition with a 93gr steel core FMJ bullet.  The 9x18mm round was very common in the Eastern Bloc during the 20th century and remained in Russian military service into the 21st.
translations: 93格令的 9x18mm 马卡洛夫全金属被甲钢芯弹。类似欧洲的 9x19mm 弹，9x18mm 弹在20世纪被东欧社会主义国家广泛使用，在21世纪依然服务于俄罗斯军队。

messages.msgid: 9x18mm Makarov SP-7 ammunition.  The 9x18mm round was very common in the Eastern Bloc during the 20th century and remained in Russian military service into the 21st.
translations: 9x18mm 马卡洛夫 SP-7弹，类似欧洲的9x19mm弹，9x18mm弹在20世纪被东欧社会主义国家广泛使用，在21世纪依然服务于俄罗斯军队。

messages.msgid: 9x18mm Makarov RG028 ammunition.  The RG028 round uses a bullet with a hardened steel core to improve armor penetration.
translations: 9x18mm 马卡洛夫 RG028 弹。RG028 弹头中含有硬化钢芯，具有更好的护甲穿透能力。

messages.msgid: 9x18 millimeter Makarov, an old Soviet pistol cartridge used mainly by the Makarov PM.  This one has been hand-reloaded to generate higher internal pressure, boosting flight stability and damage.
translations: 9x18mm 马卡洛夫手枪弹，主要用于马卡洛夫PM手枪的前苏联制式子弹。这种弹药被重新装填，增加了内压，提供更高飞行稳定性及伤害。这是手工复装的型号。

messages.msgid: A tube-launched, optically tracked, wire-guided missile contained in a steel tube.  Designed to be highly effective against vehicles and structures.
translations: 一件由发射管发射，具有光学制导的线导的导弹。对车辆及建筑物非常有效。

messages.msgid: Tiny droplets of venom trickle out of the sponge-like tissue of this sharp barb.
translations: 小滴的毒液从这根毒刺海绵般的组织中渗出。

messages.msgid: Tiny droplets of cyan venom trickle out of the sponge-like tissue of this sharp barb.
translations: 这根毒刺的海绵状组织中渗出小滴的青色毒液。

messages.msgid: A powder load .22 blank used for powder-actuated tools.
translations: 一个装满火药粉末的 .22 空包弹，用于火药发射工具。

messages.msgid: A bundle of wadding, black gunpowder, and a cannonball, ready to be loaded into a cannon.
translations: 一捆棉絮、黑色火药和球形炮弹，准备装进大炮里。

messages.msgid: A hazardous mixture made from household cleaning chemicals, improvised for use in a chemical thrower.  Best used with some kind of mask or mouth protection.
translations:
一些由家用清洁剂制成的危险喷雾，须填充于药剂喷罐喷洒。
"最好戴上面罩或嘴部防护使用。"

messages.msgid: Fungicide enhanced with sulfur to create sprayable anti-fungal ammo for the chemical thrower.  Best used with some kind of mask or mouth protection.
translations:
一些抗真菌剂加硫磺制成的强化式抗真菌喷雾，须填充于药剂喷罐喷洒。
"最好戴上面罩或嘴部防护使用。"

messages.msgid: Strong sprayable insecticide ammo for the chemical thrower.  Best used with some kind of mask or mouth protection.
translations:
一些强化式杀虫剂，需填充于药剂喷罐喷洒。
"最好戴上面罩或嘴部防护使用。"

messages.msgid: In some alternate universe, the 12.3ln cartridge was introduced in Romania in the wake of the second Carpathian conflict.  The PA md. 71 rifle, using this ammunition, rapidly gained popularity in the Eastern Union, and from there, the world.  Due to this, the 12.3ln rapidly became the standard combat round in the Eurasian sphere, making it easy for the Exodii to stockpile it in large quantities when they visited that version of Earth.  It looks vaguely like a rimless, .303 British cartridge loaded with a larger, non-spitzer bullet.
translations:
一枚12.3ln口径弹药，类似于.303口径英制弹药，只是弹头更大更圆。
在某个平行世界中，罗马尼亚在第二次喀尔巴阡山冲突后引进了 12.3ln 弹。使用这种弹药的 PA md.71 步枪迅速在东欧联盟以及世界各地流行起来。正因为如此，12.3ln 弹迅速成为欧亚大陆的标准弹药口径。因此流亡族在到达这个世界的地球时轻易储存了大量弹药。

messages.msgid: 27.3x110 Diyua light slug loads were employed by colonists on some alternate Earth to take dangerous game, and later, fend off commonwealth forces from atop palisade walls.
translations: 27.3x110 蒂约轻型独头弹，某个平行世界中殖民者为狩猎危险猎物研发。后来用于从防御工事击退联邦军队。

messages.msgid: 27.3x110 Diyua medium slug loads were employed by colonists on some alternate Earth to take extremely dangerous game, and later, fend off commonwealth forces from atop palisade walls.  Most users of the Brogyaga guns considered these shells too punishing to withstand.
translations: 27.3x110 蒂约中型独头弹，某个平行世界中殖民者为狩猎高危猎物研发。后来用于从防御工事击退联邦军队。大多数使用博雅格枪械的人常抱怨子弹威力太大，难以应对。

messages.msgid: 27.3x110 Diyua slug loads similar to these were employed by colonists on some alternate Earth to take extremely dangerous game.  This heavy slug load, however, was used almost entirely by recoil enthusiasts and braggarts, until the Exodii came upon them.
translations: 27.3x110 蒂约独头弹，某个平行世界中殖民者为狩猎高危猎物研发的加重版本。在流亡族出现前，这种重型独头弹几乎只有对后坐力有特殊嗜好或是喜欢吹牛的人才用。

messages.msgid: On some alien Earth, scores of flocks were decimated by loads such as this 27.3x110 Diyua shell, loaded with a ludicrous number of tiny pellets.  Though it would still be devastating against more humanoid targets, flockshot like this is more typically employed by the Exodii by the occasional hunting party.
translations: 在某个异界，27.3x110 蒂约猎鸟弹消灭了大量鸟群。尽管对于类人的目标来说，这种弹药仍能造成严重破坏，但像这种子弹通常仅由流亡族的临时狩猎队使用。

messages.msgid: On some alien Earth, these mini-canister loads mimicked much larger artillery shot, and were employed for anti-personnel usage against advancing waves from atop a palisade.  The Exodii would load these in their Brogyeki sidearms for backup usage.
translations: 在某个异界，这种27.3x110 口径霰弹模仿大型的霰弹式炮弹，用于对从防御工事顶部对人群造成大规模杀伤。流亡族会在他们的副武器博杰奇中填装这种子弹备用。

messages.msgid: These flare cartridges are for use in 27.3x44 Diyua guns, or perhaps in 27.3x110 Diyua guns.  They are employed by the Exodii for emergency signaling when their usual communications systems are suffering interference, breakdown, or are being jammed.
translations: 用于27.3x44 口径，或是27.3x110口径蒂约枪械的照明弹。流亡族的常规通信受到干扰、阻塞、破坏时，用以传递紧急信号。

messages.msgid: A 27.3x44 Diyua cartridge loaded with a large hollow aluminum projectile, painted blue at the tip, for practicing shooting.  If interdimensional total replacement cyborgs have to practice, maybe you should too.
translations: 一枚装有大号空心铝制弹头的 27.3x44口径 蒂约弹药，尖端涂成了蓝色，用于射击训练。嗯，如果说全身都是义肢的改造人都需要训练的话，你或许也该练练了。

messages.msgid: A 27.3x44 Diyua cartridge with a minute amount of liquid fuel encasing a fuel dispersing explosive charge, and a secondary ignition charge.  On impact the fuel is dispersed, creating a fuel air mixture which is ignited a few milliseconds later.  In a cartridge like 27.3x44 Diyua, the pressure wave produced is rather diminutive, yet it makes the most of what little payload is available.
translations: 一枚封装有液态燃料和爆破性弹头的27.3x44口径蒂约弹药，弹头有二级点火设计。击中时燃料扩散至空气中，几毫秒后随之点火，造成温压爆炸。27.3x44口径能产生的压力波不大，但这种设计已经尽可能地利用载荷产生更大的杀伤力了。

messages.msgid: A 27.3x44 Diyua cartridge loaded with a high explosive charge and a point-detonating fuze.  Primarily useful for assaulting soft targets, and, in their universe of origin, dispersing crowds.
translations: 一枚装有高爆弹头及起爆引信的 27.3x44口径蒂约弹药。主要用于对付软体目标，或是在他们原来的世界中驱散人群。

messages.msgid: A long 27.3 Diyua cartridge loaded with a propelling charge, attached to a large high explosive shaped charge grenade several times larger in diameter.  It was designed to be muzzle loaded into 27.3x44 Diyua guns.  Though the grenade's penetration and fragmentation were ultimately deemed insufficient, this was of no matter to the Exodii who saw value in the explosive potential the grenade added to the Brogyeki '23.
translations: 一枚带有推进弹头的27.3口径加长蒂约子弹，连接着一枚直径几倍的的高爆穿甲榴弹。它设计从27.3x44 蒂约枪的枪口填装。尽管最终发现这枚榴弹的穿透力和碎片效果不足，但对于流亡族来说，这并不重要，因为他们看到了这枚榴弹为Brogyeki '23增添的爆炸潜力的价值。

messages.msgid: This is a small metallic cube of inscrutable construction.  A single groove etched into one side of the object presumably allows it to be mounted into other things, and a small red arrow has been helpfully painted besides it.
translations: 这是一个构造难以理解的小型金属立方体。物体一侧刻有一条凹槽，大概是为了将其安装到其他物体上，旁边还贴心地画了一个红色箭头。

messages.msgid: Pressurized chemical payload for the Khuunäöfaai.  Highly reactive to oxygen, removing it from the tank would be a bad idea.
translations: 锟厄焚军械炮的加压化学有效载荷。对氧气有强烈反应，从罐中将其取出是个坏主意。

messages.msgid: Pressurized chemical payload for the Khuunäöfaai.  Highly flammable and reactive to oxygen, removing it from the tank would be a bad idea.
translations: 锟厄焚军械炮的加压化学有效载荷。高度易燃且对氧气有反应，将其从罐中取出将是一个坏主意。

messages.msgid: Pressurized chemical payload for the Khuunäöfaai.  Essentially a juiced up version of pirahna solution, removing it from the tank would be a bad idea.
translations: 锟厄焚军械炮的加压化学有效载荷。本质上是食人鱼溶液（浓硫酸和过氧化氢溶液）的浓缩版本，将其从罐中取出是一个坏主意。
锟厄焚军械炮发泡胶载荷

messages.msgid: Pressurized chemical payload for the Khuunäöfaai.  An incredibly powerful binding agent and sealant, removing it from the tank would be a bad idea.
translations: 锟厄焚军械炮的加压化学有效载荷。一种非常强大的粘合剂和密封剂，将其从罐中取出是一个坏主意。

messages.msgid: Initially made for marine combat, this hefty projectile is a go-to round for late-stage Exodii fights.
translations: 最初为海军陆战队战斗而设计，这种沉重的弹药是流亡族后期战斗中的首选弹药。

messages.msgid: A paper cartridge containing black powder and a metallic projectile.  Historically used to reload muzzleloaders in a more reasonable time.
translations: 装有黑火药与金属弹丸的纸制弹药筒。历史上用于以更合理的速度为前装枪重新装填。

messages.msgid: A paper cartridge containing black powder and metallic shot.  Historically used to reload muzzleloaders in a more reasonable time.
translations: 一个装满了黑火药和许多金属弹丸的纸药卷，历史上用来加快老式燧发枪的装填速度至可让人接受的范围内。

messages.msgid: A tiny steel dart.  Can be fired from a nail gun or similar weapon, or used for crafting ammunition.
translations: 微型钢镖，可以被射钉枪或者其他类似武器发射，或用来制造弹药。

messages.msgid: A pin-shaped piece of bronze.  It can be used to construct various things with a hammer.
translations: 一颗钉子形状的青铜，配合锤子可以打造各种各样的东西。

messages.msgid: A pin-shaped piece of steel.  It can be used to construct various things with a hammer.
translations: 一颗钉子形状的钢铁，配合锤子可以打造各种各样的东西。

messages.msgid: A matching nut and bolt.  Useful for securing objects together.
translations: 一对匹配的螺母和螺栓。用于将物品固定在一起。

messages.msgid: A small paintball for recreational shooting.  Getting shot with one stings a little, but you'd be hard-pressed to kill anything with it.
translations: 娱乐休闲射击时所使用的小彩弹。被打中时有点刺痛，但你很难用它杀死任何东西。

messages.msgid: A shotgun shell filled with magnesium pellets or shards, used mostly as a distress flare or pyrotechnics tool.  When the round is fired, high-temperature sparks and flames shoot out of the barrel.  While looking very impressive, they present more of a fire hazard than an effective tool for lighting up hostiles.  This one was made in somebody's garage.  Are you sure you want to shoot this?
translations: 一种填充镁颗粒或碎片的霰弹枪弹，主要用作紧急求救信号弹或者起火工具。当该弹药发射时，枪管会射出高温火花和火焰。但它们更像是一种火灾隐患而不是一种点燃敌人的有效工具。这个某个人手工复装弹型号。你确定要用这个吗？

messages.msgid: A 12 gauge shotgun shell, filled with 9 pellets of 00 buck.  A very common and versatile round, they're useful for both self defense and for hunting.  The spread of the shot doesn't just increase your chances to have a projectile hit, it also causes a much larger wound, greatly increasing lethality.  It does struggle with range, and against body armor.
translations: 12号口径霰弹枪弹，内装9枚00号鹿弹。这种弹药极为常见且用途广泛，既可用于自卫也能狩猎。弹丸散布不仅能提高命中几率，还会造成更大面积的创伤，显著增强杀伤效果。但其射程有限，对防弹衣效果欠佳。

messages.msgid: A beanbag round for shotguns.  Designated 'less-lethal' and intended to disable, but remember that 'less-lethal' does not mean 'non-lethal'.
translations: 一枚霰弹枪使用的防暴霰弹。宣称"低致命性"并旨在使目标瘫痪，但请记住，"低致命性"并不意味着"非致命性"。

messages.msgid: Weak shotgun ammunition, filled with tiny pellets and a low powder charge.  Used often for shooting clays or birds, they're a very common commercial round.  Their effectiveness against human targets are quite limited outside of very close ranges, serving more to hurt than kill.
translations: 12号口径猎鸟霰弹，弹丸细小且装药量较低。这种商用弹药常用于飞靶射击或猎鸟，极为常见。但除非在极近距离，否则对人类目标的杀伤效果相当有限，更多是造成伤害而非致命。

messages.msgid: A shotgun shell filled with magnesium pellets or shards, used mostly as a distress flare or pyrotechnics tool.  When the round is fired, high-temperature sparks and flames shoot out of the barrel.  While looking very impressive, they present more of a fire hazard than an effective tool for lighting up hostiles.
translations: 一种填充镁粒或镁片的霰弹枪弹，主要用于求救信号弹或起火工具。击发时，枪管会喷出高温火花与烈焰。虽然视觉效果惊人，但这玩意儿点燃敌人的效率远不如引发火灾的效率高。

messages.msgid: A shotgun shell filled with tiny steel darts.  While looking quite dangerous, their actual effectiveness is questionable.  Despite being finned, they have a tendency to tumble mid-air, leading to greater spread and reduced damage.
translations: 装填细小钢镖的霰弹枪弹。虽然看起来相当致命，但实际杀伤效果存疑。尽管钢镖带有尾翼，仍容易在空中翻滚，导致弹道扩散加剧，杀伤力下降。

messages.msgid: A shotgun shell shooting a small explosive.  Banned in several states.  While an explosive from a shotgun sounds impressive, its practical applications are limited at best.  The loss in mass in order to accommodate an explosive give it much less impact force compared to traditional ammunition.  The relatively small size of the slug can only accommodate a limited amount of explosives, resulting in a fairly underwhelming explosion.  These traits make it a utility tool for damaging barriers and disrupting other explosive devices, rather than something for anti-personnel use.
translations: 一种发射小型爆炸弹头的霰弹。在数个州被禁用。虽然能爆炸的霰弹听起来很强，但其实际应用场景十分有限。与传统霰弹相比，为了容纳炸药而损失的弹头质量使其产生的冲击力要小得多，而弹头相对较小的尺寸只能容纳十分有限的炸药，导致爆炸强度相当低。这些特点使其成为破障和干扰其他爆炸装置的实用工具，而非用于杀伤人员。

messages.msgid: A shotgun shell filled with whatever scrap metal was lying around.  More damaging than birdshot, but fairly inaccurate.
translations: 一种塞进了各种金属废料的霰弹，弹丸材料完全因地制宜。威力比猎鸟弹稍微强点，就是不太准。

messages.msgid: A shotgun shell filled with black gunpowder and whatever scrap metal was lying around.  The logical conclusion of ammunition bootlegging.  It'll kill zombies just fine, but your gun will suffer for it.
translations: 一种塞进了各种金属废料的霰弹，弹丸材料完全因地制宜。自然是某人自制的弹药。它可以很好地杀死丧尸，但你的枪肯定也不好受。

messages.msgid: A 12 gauge slug.  Unlike birdshot or buckshot, slugs are a single large projectile fired from a shotgun.  They're mostly used for hunting bigger game, or for longer range shots where typical buck may spread out more.  Not as lethal as buckshot in certain ranges, but much more accurate and with a longer range, and is more effective against armor.
translations: 12号口径独头弹。与鸟弹或鹿弹不同，独头弹是从霰弹枪发射的单一大型弹头。主要用于狩猎大型猎物，或在较远距离射击时使用——普通鹿弹在这种距离下弹道会过于分散。虽然某些射程内杀伤力不及鹿弹，但精准度更高、有效射程更远，对护甲的穿透效果也更好。

messages.msgid: A round of 12 gauge birdshot that has had the crimp opened, and wax poured into the shot to mimic the performance of a proper slug.
translations: 一种经过加工的12号口径鸟弹。通过割开霰弹壳顶部的收口，再将融化的蜡灌入霰弹中，使其凝固成一个整体，从而达到类似常规独头弹的效果。

messages.msgid: A heavy plastic cartridge made for use in flare guns.  It appears to be a modified 12 gauge shotgun shell.
translations: 一个沉重的塑料信号弹弹药。似乎是改造自霰弹枪弹药。

messages.msgid: A bottle of flammable liquid with a long fuse inserted, ready to be used in a staff sling with a modified cradle.  To throw this item without a sling, use it light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  After lighting it, throw it to cause fires.
translations: 一瓶塞着一块长长引线的易燃液体，随时可以使用带有改进托架的弹弓发射。没有弹弓时，使用该物品将点燃它，当然你需要口袋里有打火机或火柴来点燃它。点燃后投掷会引发大火。

messages.msgid: A military-grade fragmentary hand grenade, modified with a retaining fuse for use in a staff sling with a modified cradle.  To throw this item without a sling, use it to snap the fuse and activate the grenade.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.
translations: 一个军用破片手雷，随时可以使用带有改进托架的弹弓发射。没有弹弓时，使用此物品以拔掉插销，之后你有五秒钟的时间将它投掷出去。

messages.msgid: You snap the retaining fuse on the grenade.

An improvised explosive device cobbled together from spare parts and modified with a retaining fuse for use in a staff sling.  To throw this item without a sling, use it to snap the fuse and activate the grenade.  You will then have 5 seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.
translations: 一个用各种零件拼凑成的自制手雷，用延时引信改装，随时可以使用弹弓发射。没有弹弓时，使用此物品以点燃引信，之后你有五秒钟的时间将它投掷出去。

messages.msgid: You light the retaining fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows in your face!
translations: 你点燃了自制手雷的引信。赶紧在你的脸被炸掉之前扔出去！

messages.msgid: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from spare parts and modified with a retaining fuse for use in a staff sling with a modified cradle.  To throw this item without a sling, use it to snap the fuse and activate the grenade.  You will then have 5 seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.
translations: 一个用各种零件拼凑成的自制手雷，用延时引信改装，随时可以使用带有改进托架的弹弓发射。没有弹弓时，使用此物品以点燃引信，之后你有五秒钟的时间将它投掷出去。

messages.msgid: sling-ready military explosive small homemade grenade
translations: 投射用军用炸药小型自制手雷
messages.plural: sling-ready military explosive small homemade grenades

messages.msgid: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from parts and modified with a retaining fuse for use in a staff sling.  To throw this item without a sling, use it to snap the fuse and activate the grenade.  You will then have some amount of time before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.
translations: 一个用各种零件拼凑成的自制手雷，用延时引信改装，随时可以使用弹弓发射。没有弹弓时，使用此物品以点燃引信，之后你有一小段的时间将它投掷出去。
投射用军用炸药自制手雷

messages.msgid: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from parts and modified with a retaining fuse for use in a staff sling with a modified cradle.  To throw this item without a sling, use it to snap the fuse and activate the grenade.  You will then have some amount of time before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.
translations: 一个用各种零件拼凑成的自制手雷，用延时引信改装，随时可以使用带有改进托架的弹弓发射。没有弹弓时，使用此物品以点燃引信，之后你有一小段的时间将它投掷出去。

messages.msgid: Pressurized, dangerous acetylene gas.  Can be used for welding or cutting with a torch.
translations: 危险的加压乙炔气，可以用于焊接或焊柜切割。

messages.msgid: A length of coated welding electrode - a 3 mm thick steel rod coated in a special flux.  During the welding process, the hot metal of the electrode fills the seam, jointing parts together while the flux protects the surface of the seam from atmospheric gases and rapid cooling.  Required for arc welding.
translations: 一截3mm粗的涂层钢焊条，焊芯表面涂有特殊的助焊剂药皮。在焊接过程中，焊芯熔化的钢水会填充焊缝，将零件连接在一起，此时助焊剂保护焊缝表面，使其免受空气与骤冷的影响。用于电弧焊。

messages.msgid: A length of coated welding electrode - a 3.2 mm thick aluminum rod coated in a special protective flux.  Required for arc welding aluminum alloys.
translations: 一截3mm粗的涂层铝焊条，表面涂有特殊的保护剂药皮。用于铝合金电弧焊。

messages.msgid: A length of 0.8 mm steel wire for MAG welding.
translations: 一截0.8mm粗的钢焊丝，用于金属活性气体焊接。

messages.msgid: A length of 0.9 mm aluminum wire for MIG welding.
translations: 一截0.9mm粗的铝焊丝，用于金属惰性气体焊接。

messages.msgid: A length of 3.2 mm flux-coated bronze rod, for brazing steel.
translations: 一截3.2mm粗的涂层青铜焊条，用于金属钎焊。

messages.msgid: A length of 3.2 mm aluminum rod, for brazing aluminum alloys.  Also suitable for TIG welding.
translations: 一截3.2mm粗的铝焊条，用于铝合金钎焊，也可以用于气体钨弧焊接。

messages.msgid: Small, portable generator, one that people buy for a camp.  It just needs to be plugged in, fueled up, and then turned on.
translations: 一种小型便携式发电机，通常用于露营。只需接入电网，添加燃料，然后启动即可。

messages.msgid: Big and powerful generator, used for street works.  It just needs to be plugged in, fueled up, and then turned on.  Has little wheels to make it easier to move.
translations: 一台功率强大的大型发电机，主要用于街道施工。只需接入电网，加入燃料，然后启动即可。这台配有小轮子，方便搬运。

messages.msgid: A disconnected household refrigerator.  General choice to store some perishables for an average family.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台断电的家用冰箱。普通家庭储存易腐物品的通用选择。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A disconnected minifridge, similar to ones in some luxury limousines.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台断电的迷你冰箱，类似于某些豪华轿车内置的那种。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A heavy and bulky fridge with little wheels for easier transportation.  Has a bunch of sections and separators, which allow it to be installed in a vehicle with relative assurance that any items inside will stay put.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台笨重而庞大的冰箱，配有小轮以便于搬运。内置多格分区，确保在载具中安装时，柜内物品能稳固存放。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A disconnected commercial refrigerator with a transparent glass door, designed to show off any cold drinks and similar goods in a grocery store while still keeping them cool.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台断电的商用展示冰箱，配有透明玻璃门，专为杂货店设计，既能展示冷饮及其他冷藏商品，又能保证冷藏效果。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A disconnected commercial refrigerator with two transparent glass doors, designed to show off any cold drinks and similar goods in a grocery store while still keeping them cool.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台断电的双门透明玻璃商用展示冰箱。专为杂货店设计，既能展示冷饮及其他冷藏商品，又能保证冷藏效果。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A disconnected commercial refrigerator, used in many professional kitchens.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台断电的商用冰箱，常见于众多专业厨房。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A big glass chamber, designed to display different food in a multiple rows, while cooling it at the same time.  While you might not need to actually display any of your food, it cools the food as good as any another fridge.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台大型玻璃展示柜，设计用于多排展示各式食物的同时进行冷藏保鲜。即便你无需展示食物，它也能像其他冰箱一样出色地保持食物新鲜。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A disconnected household freezer.  Great choice if you need to freeze some discount meat.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台断电的家庭用冰柜。如果你需要冷冻一些打折的肉类，这会是个不错的选择。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A compact version of an upright freezer, designed as a mobile solution for freezing food.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台紧凑的立式冰柜，设计为冷冻食品的移动解决方案。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A compact version of a chest freezer, designed as a mobile solution for freezing food, but it's pretty tricky to pull anything out from the bottom.  Perfect choice to put in your closet and forget for a year.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台紧凑的卧式冰柜，设计为冷冻食物的移动解决方案，但从底部取出东西相当费劲。最好将它丢到储藏室里直至遗忘。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A heavy and bulky freezer with little wheels for easier transportation.  Has a bunch of sections and separators, which allow it to be installed in a vehicle with relative assurance that any items inside will stay put.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台笨重且庞大的冰柜，配有小轮以便于搬运。内置多格分区，确保在载具中安装时，柜内物品能稳固存放。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A hefty chest freezer, designed to store plenty of perishables for a minuscule amount of power.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台敦实的卧式大冰柜，旨在以极低的耗电量储存大量易腐食品。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty upright freezer.  Big as a closet, heavy as a tank, can probably fit enough meat to feed a little colony for a week, but consumes power like no other.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台重型立式冰柜，大如衣橱，重似坦克，大概能装下足够一个小聚落一周所需食用的肉量，但耗电量也是非同一般。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A disconnected commercial freezer with a glass door, used to present different frozen goods.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台断电的带透明玻璃门的商用冰柜，曾经用来展示不同的冷冻商品。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: A disconnected commercial chest freezer with a glass lid.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.
translations: 一台断电的带透明玻璃门的商用卧式冰柜。激活以放置并连接到电网。

messages.msgid: You feel a strange force pressing you inwards and inside-out
translations: 你感到一股莫名的力量将你向内挤压翻卷。

messages.msgid: A slight temporal distortion appears to be centered around you
translations: 你周围的时空似乎略微扭曲了。

messages.msgid: A small pouch that can be used to store most types of small ammunition; rockets, however, will not fit.  Use insert to store ammunition.
translations: 一个小袋子，可以用来存储大多数的小型弹药，但是装不下火箭弹。使用它来存储弹药。

messages.msgid: A fabric ammo bag worn at the waist.  It is capable of holding a single large magazine close at hand.
translations: 一个绑在腰上的弹匣包。可装一个大型弹匣，保证能随手取用。

messages.msgid: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your chest and hold a single magazine close at hand.
translations: 一个绑在胸口上的弹匣包。可装一个弹匣，保证能随手取用。

messages.msgid: Popularized during the Vietnam War, chest rigs like these are typically plain, barebones affairs consisting of three or more pouches in a row, with straps to secure them on your chest.  This one can hold four magazines in its pouches.
translations: 这是一种在越南战争期间开始流行的携行具。这种携行具都很朴素，通常是由三个或以上的袋子组成的简单装备，用带子固定在你的胸前。这个携行具能容纳四个弹匣。

messages.msgid: An American flag is proudly embroidered across the front of each pouch, with a tiny, eagle-winged .50-caliber bullet crowning each banner.
translations: 这件弹挂的每个口袋前都自豪地绣有美国国旗，每面旗帜上都有一颗小巧的鹰翼.50口径子弹。

messages.msgid: An open medieval-looking bag, designed to store javelins within easy reach.
translations: 一个开口的中世纪款式标枪包，易于存取标枪。

messages.msgid: A small fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your ankle and hold a single small magazine close at hand.
translations: 一个绑在脚踝上的弹匣包。可装一个小型弹匣，保证能随手取用。

messages.msgid: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your leg and hold two magazines close at hand.
translations: 一个绑在腿上的弹匣包，能够装下两个弹匣，保证弹药随手取用。

messages.msgid: A leather quiver worn at the waist that can hold 20 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.
translations: 一个可佩戴在腰部、可容纳20支箭的皮革箭筒。使用它以存储箭支或弩矢。

messages.msgid: A lighter and more durable quiver made of nylon, with straps to attach to a MOLLE system.
translations: 由尼龙制成的更轻、更耐用的箭筒，可安装到MOLLE系统上。

messages.msgid: A quiver woven from strips of birch bark, worn at the waist, that can hold 20 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.
translations: 一个可佩戴在腰部、可容纳20支箭的桦树皮箭筒。使用它以存储箭支或弩矢。

messages.msgid: A makeshift quiver fashioned from a pipe, worn at the waist.  Heavier and thinner than a typical quiver, it can only hold 10 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.
translations: 由钢管制成的临时箭筒，佩戴在腰间。比典型的箭筒更重更薄，只能容纳10支箭或弩矢。使用插入动作来储存箭或弩矢。

messages.msgid: A large leather quiver trimmed with metal, worn on the back, that can hold 60 arrows or bolts.  Historically used by horse archers, rather than foot archers, but neither of THEM had to fight zombies.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.
translations: 一个佩戴在后背、可容纳60支箭的皮革大箭筒，有着金属镶边。使用它以存储箭矢或弩矢。

messages.msgid: A large quiver woven from strips of birchbark, worn on the back, that can hold 60 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.
translations: 一个佩带在后背、可容纳60支箭的桦树皮大箭筒。使用它以存储箭支或弩矢。

messages.msgid: A large makeshift quiver fashioned from 3 pipes, worn on the back.  Heavier and thinner than a typical large quiver, it can only hold 30 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.
translations: 一个由3根钢管制成的大型临时箭筒，背在背上。比普通的大型箭筒更重更薄，只能容纳30支箭或弩矢。使用插入动作来储存箭或弩矢。

messages.msgid: A simple quiver made out of cloth that can be adjusted to hold various types of arrows, bolts, and spears of different lengths.  Takes slightly longer to pull ammunition from than a regular quiver.  Use insert to store arrows, bolts, fishing spears, or atlatl spears.
translations: 由布料制成的简易箭袋，可以调节大小以容纳不同长度的箭矢、弩箭和矛。取箭速度比普通箭袋稍慢。使用以存储箭矢、弩箭、捕鱼矛或投矛。

messages.msgid: A large cotton quiver capable of easily storing 16 arrows.  It includes a bag and straps to store a takedown bow, as well as a small pouch for archery accessories.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts and activate to holster/draw your bow.
translations: 一个可以轻易存放16支箭的大号棉制箭筒。它有个口袋和绑带，可以装下一把可拆卸的弓，还有个用来装弓箭配件的小口袋。使用它来存储弓箭或弩矢，激活它来收拔弓。

messages.msgid: This light vest is meant to carry your magazines, shells and pistols.  They are popular among law enforcement, but less so than combination tactical vests incorporating Kevlar.
translations: 这款轻便的背心可以让你携带弹匣，霰弹及手枪。它们很受执法部门的欢迎，但不如加入了凯夫拉纤维的战术背心。

messages.msgid: This lightweight harness covered in MOLLE webbing is designed to attach a few pouches, holsters and other PALS compatible accessories.  Preferred by some soldiers over directly attaching accessories to a ballistic vest as they can then be easily separated.
translations: 这款轻型背心通体覆盖MOLLE织带，专为搭载弹匣包、枪套及其他符合PALS系统的配件而设计。由于相较防弹背心更便于拆取配件，受到不少士兵的青睐。

messages.msgid: This vest covered in MOLLE webbing is designed to attach pouches, holsters and other PALS compatible accessories.  Preferred by some soldiers over directly attaching accessories to a ballistic vest as they can then be easily separated.
translations: 这款背心通体覆盖MOLLE织带，专为搭载弹匣包、枪套及其他符合PALS系统的配件而设计。由于相较防弹背心更便于拆取配件，受到不少士兵的青睐。

messages.msgid: This vest covered in MOLLE webbing is designed to attach pouches, holsters and other PALS compatible accessories.  Preferred by some soldiers over directly attaching accessories to a ballistic vest as they can then be easily separated.  This one has a single point sling wrapped around the shoulders using a system to keep your weapon extra secure.
translations: 这款背心通体覆盖MOLLE织带，专为搭载弹匣包、枪套及其他符合PALS系统的配件而设计。由于相较防弹背心更便于拆取配件，受到不少士兵的青睐。这个型号有环绕肩部的单点式枪带系统，能稳固挂载武器。

messages.msgid: This massive vest covered in MOLLE webbing is designed to attach a large number of pouches, holsters and other PALS compatible accessories.  Preferred by some soldiers over directly attaching accessories to a ballistic vest as they can then be easily separated.
translations: 这款大型背心通体覆盖MOLLE织带，专为搭载大量弹匣包、枪套及其他符合PALS系统的配件而设计。由于相较防弹背心更便于拆取配件，受到不少士兵的青睐。

messages.msgid: heavy load bearing vest with sling
messages.plural: heavy load bearing vests with slings

messages.msgid: This massive vest covered in MOLLE webbing is designed to attach a large number of pouches, holsters and other PALS compatible accessories.  Preferred by some soldiers over directly attaching accessories to a ballistic vest as they can then be easily separated.  This one has a single point sling wrapped around the shoulders using a system to keep your weapon extra secure.
translations: 这款大型背心通体覆盖MOLLE织带，专为搭载大量弹匣包、枪套及其他符合PALS系统的配件而设计。由于相较防弹背心更便于拆取配件，受到不少士兵的青睐。这个型号有环绕肩部的单点式枪带系统，能稳固挂载武器。

messages.msgid: This massive vest covered in MOLLE webbing is designed to attach a large number of pouches, holsters and other PALS compatible accessories.  This one has a single point sling wrapped around the shoulders using a system to keep your weapon extra secure, as well as a set of strong magnets attached to the torso and waist to hold a breaching shotgun.
translations: 一个表面覆盖了MOLLE连接织带的重型背带，设计用来安装大量口袋、枪套和其他兼容PALS的附件。这个型号有个穿在肩上的单点背带，附带系统能够保证挂在上面的武器更加稳固，以及一套安装在躯干和腰部的强力磁铁，可以吸住一把破门霰弹枪。

messages.msgid: A pouch designed to keep your radio accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.
translations: 一个专为无线电的可及性和安全性而设计的口袋。有可以用来安在腰带或背心上的MOLLE连接织带。

messages.msgid: A pouch designed to keep gadgets and small items accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.
translations: 一个专为小型物品的可及性和安全性而设计的口袋。有可以用来安在腰带或背心上的MOLLE连接织带。

messages.msgid: A pouch designed to hold a water bottle with an additional front tactical pocket.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.
translations: 一个设计用来装水瓶的口袋，前面还有个战术口袋。有可以用来安在腰带或背心上的MOLLE连接织带。

messages.msgid: A pouch designed to keep your canteen accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.
translations: 一个专为水壶的可及性和安全性而设计的口袋。有可以用来安在腰带或背心上的MOLLE连接织带。

messages.msgid: A low profile pouch designed to keep your tools accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a vest or can be strapped directly to your chest.
translations: 一个专为工具而设计的小口袋，保证其可及性和安全性。有可以用来安在腰带或背心上的MOLLE连接织带。

messages.msgid: A tiny pouch designed to keep your flashlight accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.
translations: 一个专为手电筒而设计的小口袋，保证其可及性和安全性。有可以用来安在腰带或背心上的MOLLE连接织带。

messages.msgid: A sturdy holster designed to be worn vertically, to keep a small profile on a tactical vest.  This makes it a little more awkward to draw from than a normal holster.
translations: 一个结实的枪套，设计成垂直佩戴以便在战术背心上占据较小空间。这使得它比普通枪套更难拔出。

messages.msgid: A large pouch capable of holding a gas mask and an additional filter, keeping both accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.
translations: 一个专为防毒面具和额外的过滤器而设计的大口袋，保证其可及性和安全性。有可以用来安在背带或背心上的MOLLE连接织带。

messages.msgid: The main compartment for a respirator.
A side pocket for a single spare filter.
translations: 侧面的小口袋，用于放置一个备用滤芯。

messages.msgid: An internal divider pocket for some small accessories.
translations: 一个内部隔层小口袋，用于收纳一些小配件。

messages.msgid: A pouch designed to hold one military grenade, keeping it both accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.
translations: 一个专为军用手榴弹而设计的口袋，保证其可及性和安全性。有可以用来安在背带或背心上的MOLLE连接织带。

messages.msgid: A collection of 6 pockets, 3 wide and 2 deep, designed to hold rifle magazines and keep them accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a vest or can be strapped directly to your chest.
translations: 一个六联弹药袋，宽三列深两排，用来保证步枪弹匣的可及性和安全性。有可以用来安在背带或背心上的MOLLE连接织带。

messages.msgid: A pouch designed to hold shotgun shells or .308 rounds, keeping them accessible and secure.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt or vest.
translations: 一个专为霰弹和.308弹而设计的口袋，保证其可及性和安全性。有可以用来安在背带或背心上的MOLLE连接织带。

messages.msgid: A massive handmade imitation of a proper ballistic vest for abnormally large folks.  Large and heavy, but will still fit under an abnormally large coat.
translations: 一件巨大的自制凯夫拉防弹背心，根据正品仿制，供体型异常大的人使用。又大又重，但仍然适合放在异常大的外套下面。

messages.msgid: A sturdy leather ammo bag worn at the waist.  It is capable of holding a single large magazine close at hand.
translations: 一个绑在腰上的皮革弹匣包。可装一个大型弹匣，保证能随手取用。

messages.msgid: A leather ammo pouch that can be strapped to your chest and hold a single magazine close at hand.
translations: 一个绑在胸口上的皮革弹匣包。可装一个弹匣，保证能随手取用。
