messages.msgid: A MOLLE-compatible loop for attaching small tools to a load-bearing vest.
translations: 一个 MOLLE 兼容的环，用于将小工具连接到承重背心上。

messages.msgid: A MOLLE-compatible loop for attaching tools and some weapons to a load-bearing vest.
translations: 一个 MOLLE 兼容的环，用于将工具和一些武器连接到承重背心上。

messages.msgid: A MOLLE-compatible loop for attaching large tools and weapons to a load-bearing vest.
translations: 一个 MOLLE 兼容的环，用于将大型工具和武器连接到承重背心上。

messages.msgid: A large, drawstring & buckle pouch originally designed to hold 3 MREs, and part of the official MOLLE II rucksack system.  Has MOLLE straps for attaching to a belt, vest, or rucksack.
translations: 一个大型抽绳扣带包，原设计用于装三份军用即食口粮，属于MOLLE II标准背包系统的组成部分。配有MOLLE织带，可固定在腰带、战术背心或背包上。

messages.msgid: A pair of improvised arm guards made from broken pieces of a plank that are tied to your arms with rags and string.  They offer good protection, but are really uncomfortable to wear.
translations:
一对用布条绑上了木板的强化双臂护手，能够提供良好的防护，但穿起来很累赘。
"看起来和骨折用的夹板没什么区别，但是请遵医嘱。"

messages.msgid: Small squares of carpet rolled around your upper and lower arms.  Armor of the truly desperate or crafty.
translations: 裹住上臂和手肘的小张地毯。身处绝望时灵光乍现制作的防具。

messages.msgid: Small squares of carpet rolled around your lower arms.  The bare minimum to hopefully stop a bite or two.
translations: 可以包裹住你下臂的小块地毯。希望它至少能抗上丧尸们的一两口咬伤吧。

messages.msgid: A pair of arm guards made from the exoskeletons of insects.  Light and durable.
translations: 一对由昆虫甲壳制成的护臂，轻便耐用。

messages.msgid: pair of biosilicified chitin arm guards
messages.plural: pairs of biosilicified chitin arm guards

messages.msgid: A pair of arm guards crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Acid-resistant but brittle.
translations: 一对由经过精心清理并裁剪过的酸蚁硅化甲壳制成的护臂，防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: The sleeves of a thick cotton shirt, with a bunch of cloth sewn in to act as extra padding.  They're quite lonely, no longer being attached to each other by the rest of the shirt.
translations: 一对厚棉衬衫袖子，缝上了一束布料提供额外保护。只有袖套，没有和衬衫连在一起。

messages.msgid: A pair of neoprene arm sleeves covered with molded plastic sheaths.
translations: 一双氯丁橡胶护臂，外面套了一个模具成形的塑料外壳，能承受更多伤害。

messages.msgid: A pair of tough leather arm guards.  Light and comfortable.
translations: 一对轻便而舒适的硬皮护臂。

messages.msgid: A full assembly of medieval arm protection.  Rerebraces, couters, and vambraces, with leather straps to secure each piece and connect it as part of a set.
translations: 一套完美复刻的中世纪式手臂防具。用皮革条把上臂甲片，肘弯甲片，前臂甲片连结成一体，一双完美坚实的战争工艺品。

messages.msgid: pair of sheet metal arm guards
messages.plural: pairs of sheet metal arm guards

messages.msgid: A pair of arm guards hammered out from metal, avoiding joints.  Perfect for the Post-Apocalyptic Warrior look.
translations: 一对用钢板锤打而成的护臂，避开了关节部位。完美搭配末日战士造型。

messages.msgid: pair of hardened steel sheet metal arm guards
messages.plural: pairs of hardened steel sheet metal arm guards

messages.msgid: A pair of arm guards hammered out from sheet metal, hardened for extra protection.  Still manages that Post-Apocalyptic Warrior look.
translations: 一对用钢板捶打而成的护臂，经过了表面硬化以提供额外防护。依然引领着末日战士造型的潮流。

messages.msgid: pair of mild steel sheet metal bracers
messages.plural: pairs of mild steel sheet metal bracers

messages.msgid: A pair of arm guards hammered out from metal, only covering your forearms.
translations: 一对由金属捶打而成的护臂，只覆盖你的前臂。

messages.msgid: pair of hardened steel sheet metal bracers
messages.plural: pairs of hardened steel sheet metal bracers

messages.msgid: A pair of forearm guards hammered out from sheet metal, hardened for extra protection.
translations: 一对用钢板捶打而成的护臂，只覆盖前臂，经过了表面硬化以提供额外防护。

messages.msgid: pair of mild steel sheet metal pauldrons
messages.plural: pairs of mild steel sheet metal pauldrons

messages.msgid: Two half-cylinders of sheet metal jutting out over your shoulders and two more underneath.  They make it impossible to raise your arms fully, but they'll keep your arms attached to you.
translations: 从你肩膀上伸出来的两片半圆柱形金属板，下面还有两个。穿上这东西让你无法完全举起手臂，但起码可以保证你的手臂还连接在你身上。

messages.msgid: pair of hardened sheet metal pauldrons
messages.plural: pairs of hardened sheet metal pauldrons

messages.msgid: A pair of crude pauldrons made out of sheet metal and hardened for reinforcement.
translations: 一对由金属板粗制而成的肩甲，经过表面硬化处理加固。

messages.msgid: pair of mild steel sheet metal elbow guards
messages.plural: pairs of mild steel sheet metal elbow guards

messages.msgid: Two small half-cylinders of sheet metal cut down and hammered to fit over your elbows.  Very brutal, just needs spikes.
translations: 两个小的半圆柱体金属板被切割下来，经过捶打以适应你的肘部，十分狂野，再来点钉子就更好了。

messages.msgid: pair of hardened sheet metal elbow guards
messages.plural: pairs of hardened sheet metal elbow guards

messages.msgid: Elbow guards of sheet metal, hardened to make sure you never bang your funny bone on the table again.
translations: 一对由金属板制成的护肘，经过表面硬化处理加固，你再也不用担心撞到麻筋了。

messages.msgid: Arm guards made of stacked paper sheets held together with duct tape.
translations: 一对将许多纸张叠在一起，然后用胶带粘牢的纸护臂。

messages.msgid: pair of improvised tire arm guards
messages.plural: pairs of improvised tire arm guards

messages.msgid: Arm guards made of thick chunks of tire held together with duct tape.
translations: 一对将许多块轮胎片叠在一起，然后用胶带粘牢的护臂。

messages.msgid: A pair of arm guards made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings.
translations: 一对用金属碎片做成的护臂，碎片之间用小绳子固定。

messages.msgid: A pair of arm guards made from thick chunks of tire secured by simple strings; the loose collection of rubber plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.
translations: 一套用轮胎片做成的护臂，碎片之间用小绳子固定。这些松垮的橡胶小片片能提供不错的防护，但是还不够完美。

messages.msgid: A pair of soft neoprene arm sleeves.  Often used in contact sports.
translations: 一对柔软的橡胶护臂，身体接触较多的运动员经常穿戴它以防止运动损伤。

messages.msgid: A pair of arm sleeves made from heavy quilted fabric.
translations: 一对由厚重绗缝织物制成的袖子。

messages.msgid: A pair arm sleeves made from aramid, with strips of soft body armor sewn on top to simulate quilting.
translations: 一件由多层凯夫拉制成的绗缝厚护臂。

messages.msgid: Customized chainmail arm protection.  Both sleeves have straps to connect them with each other.  They don't cover the hands, making them less cumbersome and allowing them to be worn with gloves.
translations: 自制的链甲甲臂防护。两个袖子都有带子将它们相互连接。它们不覆盖手部，使其不那么笨重，并允许与手套一起穿戴。

messages.msgid: You can wear some armor over chainmail without penalty.
translations: 你可以在链甲上安装合适的装甲板而不产生累赘惩罚。

messages.msgid: Customized chainmail arm protection.  The metal shows signs of rust and corrosion.  Both sleeves have straps to connect them with each other.  They don't cover the hands, making them less cumbersome and allowing them to be worn with gloves.
translations: 一对自制的锁环甲护臂，金属有生锈和腐蚀的迹象。套筒间有带子连接，无指的设计使它们不那么笨重，并留下了戴手套的空间。

messages.msgid: pair of mild steel chainmail sleeves
messages.plural: pairs of mild steel chainmail sleeves

messages.msgid: pair of medium steel chainmail sleeves
messages.plural: pairs of medium steel chainmail sleeves

messages.msgid: pair of high steel chainmail sleeves
messages.plural: pairs of high steel chainmail sleeves

messages.msgid: pair of hardened steel chainmail sleeves
messages.plural: pairs of hardened steel chainmail sleeves

messages.msgid: pair of tempered steel chainmail sleeves
messages.plural: pairs of tempered steel chainmail sleeves

messages.msgid: A pair of elbow pads made of stout plastic and cloth.
translations: 一对用结实的塑料和布条制成的护肘。

messages.msgid: A pair of bronze arm guards with a simple leather lining.
translations: 一对有着简易皮内衬的青铜护臂。

messages.msgid: A pair of light leather arm guards, made for archery.
translations: 一对轻皮革护臂，用于射箭。

messages.msgid: A long pair of cut-resistant Kevlar sleeves with thumbholes.  Useful for chainsaw protection.
translations: 一对长长的凯夫拉材质防切割护臂，袖口开了个能露出拇指的洞。用于使用链锯时的防护。

messages.msgid: A light armguard, 1.25 mm at the thickest.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件厚1.25毫米的轻型护臂。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A light armguard, 1.25 mm at the thickest.  Made with tougher medium steel, this offers solid protection.
translations: 一件厚1.25毫米的轻型护臂。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A light armguard, 1.25 mm at the thickest.  Made with high steel offering excellent protection.
translations: 一个轻型护臂，最厚处为1.25毫米。由高碳钢制成，提供出色的防护。

messages.msgid: A light armguard, 1.25 mm at the thickest.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一个轻型护臂，最厚处为1.25毫米。低碳钢经过硬化处理，提供卓越的防护性能。

messages.msgid: A light armguard, 1.25 mm at the thickest.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top of the line protection.
translations: 一件厚1.25毫米的轻型护臂。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: An armguard, 1.75 mm at the thickest.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件厚1.75毫米的护臂。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: An armguard, 1.75 mm at the thickest.  Made with tougher medium steel, this offers solid protection.
translations: 一件厚1.75毫米的护臂。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: An armguard, 1.75 mm at the thickest.  Made with high steel offering excellent protection.
translations: 一个护臂，最厚处为1.75毫米。由高碳钢制成，提供出色的防护。

messages.msgid: An armguard, 1.75 mm at the thickest.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一个护臂，最厚处为1.75毫米。低碳钢经过硬化处理，提供卓越的防护性能。

messages.msgid: An armguard, 1.75 mm at the thickest.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top of the line protection.
translations: 一件厚1.75毫米的护臂。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy armguard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件厚2.25毫米的重型护臂。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A heavy armguard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  Made with tougher medium steel, this offers solid protection.
translations: 一件厚2.25毫米的重型护臂。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy armguard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  Made with high steel offering excellent protection.
translations: 一个重型护臂，最厚处为2.25毫米。由高碳钢制成，提供出色的防护。

messages.msgid: A heavy armguard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一个重型护臂，最厚处为2.25毫米。低碳钢经过硬化处理，提供卓越的防护性能。

messages.msgid: A heavy armguard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top of the line protection.
translations: 一件厚2.25毫米的重型护臂。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: Armor made of combined pre-Cataclysm clothing.  Sections from leather clothing are tightened and affixed to the sleeves of a thick cotton shirt, excluding the joints.
translations: 一套将大灾变前的服装拼接而成的护甲。从其它衣物上裁下来的皮革片被紧固到了一对厚衬衫袖子上，避开了关节处。

messages.msgid: Hard arm guards used by riot police.
translations: 防暴警察使用的硬质护臂。

messages.msgid: A ballistic vest with specialized pockets on the front, back, and sides to hold armor plates.  While this plate carrier is still protective even without inserts, it's too soft to effectively stop high-energy projectiles on its own.
translations: 一件胸前、背后及身侧有专门装甲板口袋的防弹背心。虽然口袋不插入装甲板依旧能够提供少许防护，但它太软，无法阻挡高速子弹。

messages.msgid: This version is patterned in multi-environment camouflage, and was standard-issue for the US Army.
translations: 这个型号采用多环境迷彩，是美国陆军使用的制式版本。

messages.msgid: This version is colored black, and was once used by specialized police forces.  "SWAT" is emblazoned on the back.
translations: 这个型号是纯黑色版本，曾经由特种警察部队使用。背面印着SWAT字样。

messages.msgid: Pocket for a large armor plate.
Pocket for a medium armor plate.

A thick armored jacket constructed from Kevlar, Nomex, and foam padding, for use by explosive ordnance disposal technicians.  It features a central pocket for a large plate, and near complete coverage in fragmentation resistant materials.  Aside from the plate, it offers insufficient protection from ballistic threats.
translations: 一件由凯夫拉、芳纶和泡沫衬垫构成的厚重防护夹克，供排爆技术员使用。它具有一个用于插入大型防护板的口袋，并几乎完全覆盖防破片材料。除了防护板之外，它对子弹的防护不足。

messages.msgid: Pocket for a huge armor plate.

An armored jacket constructed from Kevlar, Nomex, and foam padding, for use by explosive ordnance disposal technicians in 'non-permissive environments'.  It is lighter than normal EOD armor to allow for wearing a plate carrier beneath it.  It features two pockets in the arms covering the deltoids for additional optional protection.
translations: 一件由凯夫拉、芳纶和泡沫衬垫构成的防护夹克，供排爆技术员在“非许可环境”中使用。与普通EOD拆弹部队盔甲防护服相比，它更轻便，可以在里面穿防弹衣。它在袖子上覆盖三角肌的位置有两个口袋，用于提供额外的可选保护。

messages.msgid: A polygonal fragmentation plate with a slightly concave profile, made of thin layers of steel, UHMW polyethylene, foam, and Kevlar.  Though certified to provide protection from fragmentation, it will not provide much protection from firearms.  This is intended to be inserted into an EOD suit, and can't be worn on its own.
translations: 一块具有轻微凹面轮廓的多边形破片防护板，由薄层钢板、超高分子量聚乙烯、泡沫和凯夫拉制成。尽管经认证可提供破片防护，但对枪械的防护不足。这是为了插入EOD拆弹部队防护服而设计的，不能单独穿戴。

messages.msgid: A polygonal ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile, made of ceramic.  Its inner surface is coated with UHMW polyethylene and is labeled "TOP", while the outer surface is labeled "STRIKE FACE".  This is intended to be worn in a ballistic vest, and can withstand several high-energy rifle rounds before breaking.
translations: 一块有轻微凹面的多边形防弹装甲板，由陶瓷制成。其内表面涂有超高分子量聚乙烯，并印着"顶部"的字样，而在外表面印着着"打击面"的字样。它需要放进防弹背心后穿着使用，在完全破碎之前可以承受几次高能步枪子弹打击。

messages.msgid: A soft armor insert designed to protect against stab wounds.  While it's not great protection, it incurs no additional encumbrance.  This is intended to be inserted into a ballistic vest, and can't be worn on its own.
translations: 一个柔软的防弹背心插板，用来防刺伤。虽然防护称不上优秀，但同时也不会增加多少累赘。它需要放进防弹背心后穿着使用，无法直接穿着。

messages.msgid: A concave ballistic plate made of hard steel, designed to stop small-caliber rounds.  "NIJ III A PROTECTION" is etched into the back of the plate.  This is intended to be inserted into a ballistic vest, and can't be worn on its own.
translations: 一块带凹面的硬质钢防弹板，用来阻挡小口径子弹。插板背面蚀刻着"NIJ III A级防护"的字样。它需要放进防弹背心后穿着使用，无法直接穿着。

messages.msgid: A heavy concave ballistic plate made of tempered steel, designed to stop small-caliber rounds.  "NIJ III PROTECTION" is etched into the back of the plate.  This is intended to be inserted into a ballistic vest, and can't be worn on its own.
translations: 一块沉重的带凹面的回火碳钢防弹板，用来阻挡小口径子弹。插板背面蚀刻着"NIJ III 级防护"的字样。它需要放进防弹背心后穿着使用，无法直接穿着。

messages.msgid: A flat piece of salvaged steel, crudely cut and bent into the shape of an ESAPI ballistic plate.  It's wrapped in rags to cover the sharp edges.  Better than nothing, but it's heavier than the real thing, and not very strong.  This is intended to be inserted into a ballistic vest, and can't be worn on its own.
translations: 一块由废料制成的扁平钢板，经过粗糙的切割弯曲成 ESAPI 防弹板的形状。它被布条包了起来，以盖住锋利的边缘。总比什么都没有好，但它比真正的防弹钢板更重，而且并不结实。它需要放进防弹背心后穿着使用，无法直接穿着。

messages.msgid: Mild steel forged into a ballistic plate.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.
translations: 用低碳钢锻造的防弹插板，比废料防弹板的做工更加专业，但仍保留着大量临场发挥的痕迹。

messages.msgid: Medium steel forged into a ballistic plate.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.
translations: 用中碳钢锻造的防弹插板，比废料防弹板的做工更加专业，但仍保留着大量临场发挥的痕迹。

messages.msgid: High steel forged into a ballistic plate.  While it is more professionally done than most scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.
translations: 用高碳钢锻造的防弹插板，比废料防弹板的做工更加专业，但仍保留着大量临场发挥的痕迹。

messages.msgid: Hardened steel forged into a ballistic plate.  While it is more professionally done than most scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.
translations: 用硬化碳钢锻造的防弹插板，比废料防弹板的做工更加专业，但仍保留着大量临场发挥的痕迹。

messages.msgid: Tempered steel forged into a ballistic plate.  While it is more professionally done than most scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.
translations: 用回火碳钢锻造的防弹插板，比废料防弹板的做工更加专业，但仍保留着大量临场发挥的痕迹。

messages.msgid: A pair of NIJ Level III ballistic plates with a concave profile, made of UHMW polyethylene.  "STRIKE FACE" is printed on its outer surface.  These plates are designed to be worn in the shoulder pockets of suitable plate carriers or combat shirts, and can resist several high-energy rifle rounds before breaking.  Deltoid plates such as these are very infrequently worn due to their marginal utility in improving survivability.
translations: 一对NIJ III级防弹板，具有凹面轮廓，由超高分子量聚乙烯制成。外表面印有"STRIKE FACE"字样。这些防弹板设计用于在适合的防弹衣或战斗衬衫的肩部口袋中插入，可以在破裂之前抵抗多发步枪子弹。由于在提高生存能力方面的实用性有限，这种防弹板很少被使用。

messages.msgid: A polygonal ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile, made of ceramic.  "STRIKE FACE" is printed on its outer surface.  This is designed to be worn in the sides of a plate carrier, and can withstand several high-energy rifle rounds before breaking.
translations: 一块有轻微凹面的多边形陶瓷防弹板。外表面标记着"打击面"的字样。它需要放进防弹背心后穿着使用，在完全破碎之前可以承受几次高能步枪子弹打击。

messages.msgid: A flat piece of salvaged steel, crudely cut and bent into the shape of an ESBI ballistic plate.  It's wrapped in rags to cover the sharp edges.  Better than nothing, but it's heavy, and not very strong.  This is intended to be inserted into a ballistic vest, and can't be worn on its own.
translations: 一块由废料制成的扁平钢板，经过粗糙的切割弯曲成 ESBI 防弹板的形状。它被布条包了起来，以盖住锋利的边缘。总比什么都没有好，但它很重，而且并不结实。它需要放进防弹背心后穿着使用，无法直接穿着。

messages.msgid: A hexagonal piece of mild steel forged into a side plate and padded with synthetic fabric.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.
translations: 一块低碳钢锻造的六边形侧方防弹插板，带有人造纤维衬垫。比废料防弹板的做工更加专业，但仍保留着大量临场发挥的痕迹。

messages.msgid: A hexagonal piece of medium steel forged into a side plate and padded with synthetic fabric.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.
translations: 一块中碳钢锻造的六边形侧方防弹插板，带有人造纤维衬垫。比废料防弹板的做工更加专业，但仍保留着大量临场发挥的痕迹。

messages.msgid: A hexagonal piece of high steel forged into a side plate and padded with synthetic fabric.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.
translations: 一块高碳钢锻造的六边形侧方防弹插板，带有人造纤维衬垫。比废料防弹板的做工更加专业，但仍保留着大量临场发挥的痕迹。

messages.msgid: A hexagonal piece of hardened steel forged into a side plate and padded with synthetic fabric.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.
translations: 一块硬化碳钢锻造的六边形侧方防弹插板，带有人造纤维衬垫。比废料防弹板的做工更加专业，但仍保留着大量临场发挥的痕迹。

messages.msgid: A hexagonal piece of tempered steel forged into a side plate and padded with synthetic fabric.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.
translations: 一块回火碳钢锻造的六边形侧方防弹插板，带有人造纤维衬垫。比废料防弹板的做工更加专业，但仍保留着大量临场发挥的痕迹。

messages.msgid: A large ballistic plate that has been cracked by damage.  It no longer provides reliable protection, but it's still just as heavy.
translations: 一块损坏破裂的大型防弹装甲板。它不再提供可靠的保护，但仍然很重。

messages.msgid: A medium-sized ballistic plate that has been cracked by damage.  It no longer provides reliable protection, but it's still just as heavy.
translations: 一块损坏破裂的中型防弹装甲板。它不再提供可靠的保护，但仍然很重。

messages.msgid: Heavier ballistic armor used by the US Army, known as the IOTV.  It has pockets on the front, back, and sides for armor plates; additional protection for the lower back; and attachment points for optional shoulder, groin, and neck protection.
translations: 美国陆军所使用的更重的防弹背心，也被称为IOTV。它的正面、背面和侧面都有用于放置装甲板的口袋；为后背部提供额外保护；以及可额外安装护肩、护裆和护颈的插口。

messages.msgid: It's black with IR reflective markings and a large XE on the right shoulder.
translations: 它是黑色的，有个在红外波段高反射率的标志，右肩上写着大大的"XE"。

messages.msgid: A simple plate carrier covering the thorax, with front and back pockets for armor plates.  Designed to keep your organs from being perforated by small-arms fire.  This version has a MOLLE cummerbund that you can tuck a few magazines into.
translations: 一件简单的防弹背心，仅覆盖胸部，前后的装甲板袋能插入装甲插板。用来防止你的器官被小口径枪械穿孔。这个型号带了一个有MOLLE织带的宽腰带，你可以在其中插入几个弹匣。
轻型防弹背心（橄榄色）（弹匣袋）

messages.msgid: It's styled in a dark olive color.

translations: 轻型防弹背心（棕褐色）（弹匣袋）

messages.msgid: It's styled in a tan color.

translations: 轻型防弹背心（黑色）（弹匣袋）

messages.msgid: It's colored dark gray, like something a contractor might wear.
translations: 它的款式是深灰色的，就像军事承包商雇员会穿的一样。
轻型防弹背心（六角迷彩）（弹匣袋）

messages.msgid: It's decorated in a pattern of spiraling hexagons that screams style over substance.
translations: 它上面布满了螺旋六角形的图案装饰，时髦风范简直就要从其中溢出来了。
轻型防弹背心（骷髅）（弹匣袋）

messages.msgid: Someone has spray-painted a large white skull on the front.
translations: 有人在正面面喷上了一个大大的白色骷髅头骨。
轻型防弹背心（花哨）（弹匣袋）

messages.msgid: The original owner has decorated this thing with an excessive number of patches; inane slogans, political punch lines, and cartoon characters making bedroom eyes are plastered all over the front.
translations: 它曾经的主人在它上面画满了各类装饰：正面画满了空虚愚蠢的标语，政治短笑话，以及带着诱惑眼神的卡通人物。

messages.msgid: A simple plate carrier covering the thorax, with front and back pockets for armor plates.  Designed to keep your organs from being perforated by small-arms fire.  This version has a small pouch on the front to store stuff.
translations: 一件简单的防弹背心，仅覆盖胸部，前后的装甲板袋能插入装甲插板。用来防止你的器官被小口径枪械穿孔。这个型号的正面有一个用来存放东西的小口袋。
轻型防弹背心（橄榄色）（储物袋）
轻型防弹背心（棕褐色）（储物袋）
轻型防弹背心（黑色）（储物袋）
轻型防弹背心（六角迷彩）（储物袋）
轻型防弹背心（骷髅）（储物袋）
轻型防弹背心（花哨）（储物袋）

messages.msgid: A simple plate carrier covering the thorax, with front and back pockets for armor plates.  Designed to keep your organs from being perforated by small-arms fire.  This version has a shoulder-mounted pouch for a radio and a hook on the front for a glowstick.
translations: 一件简单的防弹背心，仅覆盖胸部，前后的装甲板袋能插入装甲插板。用来防止你的器官被小口径枪械穿孔。这个型号的肩上有个无线电袋，正面有一个用来挂荧光棒的挂钩。
轻型防弹背心（橄榄色）（肩袋）
轻型防弹背心（棕褐色）（肩袋）
轻型防弹背心（黑色）（肩袋）
轻型防弹背心（六角迷彩）（肩袋）
轻型防弹背心（骷髅）（肩袋）
轻型防弹背心（花哨）（肩袋）

messages.msgid: A simple Level II protection vest.
translations: 一件简单的二级防护背心。

messages.msgid: A slim security vest used by mall cops.  Its protection is mostly meant to extend to knives and not actual bullets, but at least it kept insurance costs down.  It has "SECURITY" written on the front lapel and across the back, and features a pocket for a notebook and pen.
translations: 一件商场保安使用的轻便黑色背心。它最多能够挡一挡刀刺，而非真正的子弹，但至少降低了保险开销。前翻领和后翻领上都印着"保安"字样，还有一个放笔记本和笔的口袋。

messages.msgid: A low-cost tactical vest styled in black camouflage, used in cosplay and airsoft.  It'll let you shrug off airsoft pellets like a badass, but its protection is mediocre against anything that's actually dangerous.  It sports several small pouches, and includes touch fasteners to attach identifying patches.
translations: 一件廉价的黑色迷彩战术背心，通常由COS和软弹枪玩家使用。穿上它会让你像个大佬一样轻松抖落气枪软弹。但对任何真正危险的东西都没有啥防护。前翻领上印着一个动漫美少女的士气章，还有几个小口袋，而且包含了用来安装识别标志的魔术贴。

messages.msgid: A simple soft armor ballistic vest.
translations: 一件简单的软甲防弹背心。

messages.msgid: A lightweight black vest used by private security, covering the chest and most of the abdomen.  Soft armor plates sealed inside the fabric provide solid defense against shrapnel and small-caliber rounds.  "SECURITY" is emblazoned on the front lapel and across the back, and it features a pocket for a notebook and pen.
translations: 一件轻便的黑色背心，由私人保安使用，覆盖了胸部和大部分腹部。密封在织物中的内部软装甲板让这件背心能够抵挡弹片和小口径枪支的射击。前翻领和后翻领上都印着"保安"字样，还有一个放笔记本和笔的口袋。

messages.msgid: Colored a distinctive navy blue and with a flared collar extending up to the chin, this soft body armor was once used by news crews reporting from combat zones.  It provides good protection from shrapnel, and to a lesser degree, low-caliber bullets.  "PRESS" is emblazoned prominently on the front lapel and across the back, and it features a pocket for a notebook and pen.
translations: 一件颜色独特的海军蓝防弹背心，柔软的领口一直向上延伸到下巴，通常被战地记者使用。它能很好地防止弹片，并在较小程度上防止低口径子弹。前翻领和后翻领上都印着"记者"字样，还有一个放笔记本和笔的口袋。

messages.msgid: A ranger green soft ballistic vest with MOLLE rigging used by federal law enforcement agencies.  Soft armor plates inside the vest provide solid defense against shrapnel and small-caliber rounds.  "FBI" is emblazoned across the front and back in large, yellow lettering, and it includes a pocket for storing evidence.  Use it to attach or detach pouches.
translations: 一件游骑兵绿的软质防弹背心，带有MOLLE织带，由联邦执法机构使用。背心内部的软质装甲板可有效防御弹片和小口径枪弹。“FBI”字样以醒目的大号黄色字体印在正面和背面。背心上还带有一个用于存放证物的口袋。使用MOLLE织带可以附加或拆卸各种口袋。

messages.msgid: Armored panels give this vest solid defense against small caliber firearms, and front and back pockets for hard armor panels give protection from higher calibers.
translations: 装甲板让这件防弹背心能够抵挡对小口径枪械射击，可以装入硬质装甲板的前后口袋能防护更大口径武器的射击。

messages.msgid: Bright blue in color, this slim armor vest was used by volunteers and officials from humanitarian groups during the first days of the Cataclysm before order broke down completely.  "FEMA" is written on the front lapel and across the back.
translations: 一件轻薄的亮蓝色防弹背心，在秩序完全失控的大灾变发生前，曾被志愿者和人道救援组织的官员使用。前翻领和后翻领上都印着"FEMA"字样。

messages.msgid: This charcoal-colored body armor was once a common sight on police officers, and it provides adequate protection against small-caliber firearms in addition to featuring pouches to hold armor inserts.  "POLICE" is written on the front lapel and across the back.
translations: 一件炭黑色的防弹衣，样式就是警官们曾经常穿的那种，它除了自身能提供足够的保护，防止小口径枪支的袭击之外，还有可以插入装甲插板的口袋。前翻领和后翻领上都印着"警察"字样。

messages.msgid: Styled in urban camo, this ballistic vest was issued to soldiers, and as things got worse, to volunteers as well.  It was designed to stand out after the chaos of the riots; "US ARMY" is emblazoned on the front lapel next to a patch of the United States flag, and "NATIONAL GUARD" is written across the back.
translations: 一件城市迷彩样式的防弹背心，配发给士兵的款式，随着局势不断恶化，也配发给志愿者。它的作用在骚乱混乱之中脱颖而出；前翻领上印着一块美国国旗，旁边印着"美国陆军"的字样，背面印着"国民警卫队"的字样。

messages.msgid: An enormous handmade ballistic vest built with of lots of salvaged ballistic Kevlar panels.  It's bulkier than a factory made US Army vest, but it is customized for the benefit of an abnormally large mutant who couldn't wear such armors otherwise.  Coated in MOLLE webbing to support modular loadouts for the tacticool mutant.  It could be outfitted with steel plates for further protection.
translations: 一件巨大的自制防弹背心，由大量回收的防弹凯夫拉板制成。它比工厂制造的美国陆军防弹背心更笨重，但这件防弹背心专为大号变种人定制，让他们可以穿上它。背心上有 MOLLE 织带，可以支持战术工具的模块化装载。它还可以安装钢板，以提供进一步保护。

messages.msgid: An enormous handmade ballistic vest built with lots of salvaged ballistic Kevlar panels and homemade "ballistic inserts" made of mild steel.  The thin metal isn't the most protective, but it's probably better than just plain Kevlar.
translations: 一件巨大的自制防弹背心，由大量回收的防弹凯夫拉板和自制低碳钢“防弹插板”制成。这些薄金属片的防护效果未必是最好的，但总比凯夫拉纤维好。

messages.msgid: An enormous handmade ballistic vest made of lots of salvaged ballistic Kevlar panels and ten NIJ IIIA plates inserted into custom-made pockets - four each for your front and back and one each for your sides.  Monstrously heavy but extremely protective.
translations: 一件巨大的自制防弹背心，由大量回收的防弹凯夫拉板和前后各四个、两侧各一个共十块插入定制口袋的NIJ IIIA防护级别钢板制成。重量惊人，但防护性能极强。

messages.msgid: Nylon armor with soft armor inserts protecting the deltoid and upper arm.  Designed to be attached to heavy military body armor.
translations: 一件尼龙盔甲，插入了能防护三角肌和上臂的软装甲片。设计用于与重型防弹衣同时穿着。

messages.msgid: Front and back nylon armor with soft armor inserts for groin and butt protection.  Designed to be attached to heavy military body armor.
translations: 一件覆盖了正面和背面的尼龙盔甲，插入了能防护腹股沟和臀部的软装甲片。设计用于与重型防弹衣同时穿着。

messages.msgid: Front and back nylon collar assemblies with soft armor inserts for neck protection.  Designed to be attached to heavy military body armor.
translations: 一件覆盖了正面和背面的尼龙盔甲，插入了能防护颈部的软装甲片。设计用于与重型防弹衣同时穿着。

messages.msgid: An embroidered leather bandolier for keeping pistol cartridges close to hand.  If this doesn't make you feel like a cowboy, nothing will.
translations: 一条刺绣的皮革子弹带，保证手枪子弹随手可得。西部牛仔的标配之一。

messages.msgid: A leather bandolier for keeping rifle cartridges close to hand.
translations: 一个皮革子弹带，保证步枪子弹随手可得。

messages.msgid: A leather bandolier worn around the waist for keeping shotgun shells close to hand.
translations: 一条缠在腰间的皮革子弹带，保证霰弹枪子弹随手可得。

messages.msgid: A leather bandolier strapped around the torso for keeping 40mm grenades close to hand.  For some reason, wearing this makes you feel Austrian.
translations: 一条系在躯干上的皮革榴弹带，保证40mm榴弹随手可得。不知为何，戴上这个让你有一种奥地利人的感觉。

messages.msgid: A leather bandolier strapped around the torso for keeping shotgun shells close to hand.
translations: 一条系在躯干上的皮革子弹带，保证霰弹枪子弹随手可得。

messages.msgid: A covered leather pouch, worn at the waist to store and protect prepared blackpowder cartridges.
translations: 一个带盖的皮革腰袋，穿戴在腰部，方便存储与保护已经预包卷好的黑火药纸卷弹。

messages.msgid: A small fabric bandolier for rifle cartridges, designed to be worn around the wrist.
translations: 一个小型子弹带，保证步枪子弹随手可得。设计穿在手腕上。

messages.msgid: A small pouch for storing cartridge grenades, with straps for attaching it to your belt or other webbing.
translations: 一个小口袋，用来存储榴弹弹药。自带一条带子，可以附加到腰带或者其他带子上。

messages.msgid: A medium-sized pouch for storing rocks, with straps for attaching it to your belt or other webbing.
translations: 一个小口袋，用来存储石子。自带一条带子，可以附加到腰带或者其他带子上。

messages.msgid: A medium-sized pouch for storing rocks, made of heavy leather, with straps for attaching it to your belt or other webbing.
translations: 一个用厚皮革制成的小口袋，用来存储石子。自带一条带子，可以附加到腰带或者其他带子上。

messages.msgid: A pouch for holding up to four full-sized grenades of various types, with straps for attaching it to your belt or other webbing.
translations: 一个小袋子，最多能装四枚各种型号的全尺寸手雷。它有带子，可以固定在你的皮带或其它网格上。

messages.msgid: A simple bag on a strap, partitioned into pouches for four STANAG 30-round magazines or twelve 10-round 5.56x45mm stripper clips.  When full, this bandolier is more encumbering than proper kit and slower to reload from, but it at least offers a quick and cheap means of resupplying ammunition.
translations: 入门级的弹挂，分为4个口袋，总共可以装下4个30发 STANAG 弹匣或是12个10发5.56x45mm弹夹。装满时比专用装备更累赘且不易取用。但它至少能为你提供便捷廉价的弹药供应。

messages.msgid: A large cotton pouch, designed to store a spare ammo belt for the M249 SAW.
translations: 一个大型棉布袋，用于存放M249 SAW机枪的备用弹药带。

messages.msgid: A large cotton pouch, designed to store a spare ammo belt for the M240 or M60 machine guns.
translations: 一个大型棉布袋，用于存放 M240 机枪或 M60 机枪的备用弹药带。

messages.msgid: A stout firefighter's belt.  Useful for keeping your bunker gear up, it also doubles as an equipment belt with a reinforced loop for holding a large tool.
translations: 一条结实的、能把工具牢牢地绑在身上的消防腰带，有一个强化腰带环用于挂大型工具。

messages.msgid: Clipped directly to side of the belt.
A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a master.
translations: 武术练习者佩戴的腰带，用于宣传某位师傅。

messages.msgid: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a strong intermediate.
translations: 一条跆拳道武者的腰带，新晋高级选手的级别。

messages.msgid: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a near-master.
translations: 一条跆拳道武者的腰带，次级大师的级别。

messages.msgid: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising an intermediate.
translations: 一条跆拳道武者的腰带，中级选手级别。

messages.msgid: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a fresh intermediate.
translations: 一条跆拳道武者的腰带，新晋中级选手的级别。

messages.msgid: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a novice.
translations: 一条跆拳道武者的腰带，新手级别。

messages.msgid: A belt worn by martial arts practitioners, advertising a moderate novice.
translations: 一条跆拳道武者的腰带，次新手级别。

messages.msgid: A leather belt.  Designed to look good and hold up a pair of pants, but you should be able to attach a small tool or weapon to one of the belt loops.
translations: 一条皮革腰带。款式好看，可以兜起一条裤子，但你应该能将一个小型工具或武器安装在腰带环上。
你将 %s 放进你的 %s 里
选择要挂在腰带上的物品

messages.msgid: Clipped directly to back of the belt.

translations: 一条黑色的日本和服宽腰带。

messages.msgid: A black leather belt used by police officers.  It has several pouches and a holder for a baton.
translations: 一条警察佩戴的黑色皮带。它上面有几个袋子和一个警棍的插销。

messages.msgid: A broad, buckled leather belt, commonly used by bearded men on Christmas.  Usually worn over a red jacket.
translations: 一根带扣的宽皮带，常被那个在圣诞节出现的长胡子男人使用。通常穿在一件红色夹克外面。

messages.msgid: A common belt with pockets, loops and sheaths to store up to seven tools or blades.  Widely used by handymen and electricians.
translations: 一条常见的工具腰带，带有口袋，腰带环和刀套，最多能够收纳七件工具或者刀具。手工业者和电工们经常穿着。
可储存多种物品的小袋。

messages.msgid: A 2-inch nylon webbing belt commonly used by military forces.  MOLLE-compatible pouches can be attached to the webbing for extra storage.
translations: 一条2英寸（约5厘米）宽的尼龙编织腰带，常被军队使用。MOLLE兼容的口袋可以安装在腰带上，以增加存储空间。

messages.msgid: Clipped directly to the back of the belt.
A pair of black suspenders, which reach over the wearer's shoulders and hook to their waist.  Gives a wonderful western feel!
translations: 一条黑色吊带，可以绕过穿戴者的肩膀，扣在腰上。给人一种美妙的西部片感觉！

messages.msgid: A pair of leather suspenders, which reach over the wearer's shoulders and hook to their waist.  Gives a wonderful western feel!
translations: 一条皮革吊带，可以绕过穿戴者的肩膀，扣在腰上。给人一种美妙的西部片感觉！

messages.msgid: A pair of leather suspenders with a holster placed near the stomach.
translations: 一条皮革吊带，在腹部附近有个皮枪套。

messages.msgid: Lightweight sandals made from wound cord.  They offer little in the way of protection, but keep you cool during warmer months.
translations: 一双用线编成的轻飘飘的凉鞋。几乎无法提供有效防护，但在最热的日子里可以为你提供一点慰藉。

messages.msgid: Tough leather boots, for tough everyday work.
translations: 一双坚固耐用的皮靴，供日常干粗活时使用。

messages.msgid: Leather boots covered with tiny, finely-carved bones.  With each step, the bones collide with each other and produce a melodic clicking.
translations: 一双布满了细小且雕刻精美的骨头的皮靴。每走一步，骨头就会互相碰撞，咔嗒声听起来像是有旋律一般。

messages.msgid: A pair of steel-toed rubber boots, the sort worn by firefighters.
translations: 一双消防员经常穿的钢头橡胶靴。

messages.msgid: Boots made from the exoskeletons of insects.
translations: 一双由昆虫甲壳制成的靴子。

messages.msgid: Boots crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Acid-resistant but brittle.
translations: 一对由经过精心清理并裁剪过的酸蚁硅化甲壳制成的长靴，防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: Modern reinforced tactical combat boots.  Very durable.
translations: 现代加固的战术作战靴。非常耐用。

messages.msgid: A pair of boots extending towards your lower leg, completely lined with denim.  Looks cool and has above average protection.
translations: 一对延伸到小腿的靴子，内衬完全由牛仔布制成。看起来很酷，提供了较高的防护。

messages.msgid: Armored foot protectors constructed from steel and Nomex for use by explosive ordnance disposal technicians.
translations: 一双用钢材和芳纶纤维制成的装甲防护靴，供排爆技术员使用。

messages.msgid: Rubbery overshoes that cover your toes with sturdy, OSHA compliant steel toes.
translations: 一双橡胶套鞋，前端有个坚固且符合OSHA标准的钢制靴头包裹着你的脚趾。

messages.msgid: Boots lined with fur for warmth.
translations: 一双毛皮内衬的靴子，十分暖和。

messages.msgid: Tough yet light leather boots, intended for outdoor activity.
translations: 一双专门为户外运动设计的坚韧而轻便的皮靴。

messages.msgid: Thick leather boots made specifically to protect the feet.  Light yet tough.
translations: 一双专门为保护脚部而设计的厚皮靴。轻巧而坚韧。

messages.msgid: An extremely heavy set of armor plated boots.
translations: 一双十分沉重的重型金属靴。

messages.msgid: A pair of rubber boots, often used while cleaning with caustic materials.
translations: 一双橡胶靴，在清理腐蚀性物质时经常使用。

messages.msgid: Boots made of random metal scraps attached to simple cloth wraps.  They're uncomfortable, but provide decent protection.
translations: 一双把各类废旧金属固定在简单的衬布制成的靴子。穿起来很不舒服，但防护还可以。

messages.msgid: Some sheets of metal hammered to fit over the top of your foot and around your ankles, meant to be worn over boots.  They make walking a fair bit more awkward, but they'll keep your toes from being stomped on.
translations: 一些被捶打成能够贴合脚板和脚踝的金属板，用来穿在靴子外面。这东西让你走路更加别扭，但是可以防止你的脚趾被踩扁。

messages.msgid: Sabatons made of sheet metal, hardened to protect your feet if you drop something heavy on them.  No relation to the band, aside from being very metal.
translations: 由金属板制成的靴子，经过表面硬化处理，可以保护你的脚不被砸伤之类的。除了真的非常"金属"以外，与乐队没有任何关系。

messages.msgid: Leather boots with a steel toe, intended for use by workers.
translations: 一双钢头皮靴，供工人使用。

messages.msgid: A descendant of the classic steeltoed boot, this modern footwear has become popular among working class people over the last couple of decades.
translations: 作为经典钢头靴的后代产物，过去几十年中，这种现代运动鞋在工人大众中广受欢迎。

messages.msgid: Stiff leather boots with intricate embroidery and one-inch heels.  They look good, but these boots are made for walking, not running for your life.  Each boot is large enough to conceal a small holdout pistol.
translations: 一对带着精巧刺绣的硬邦邦皮靴，有着较宽的高鞋跟。虽然样式时髦，但跑步时容易崴脚。每只靴子都足够大，能够装下一把小型自卫手枪。
一双为保暖而设计的羊毛内衬靴子。

messages.msgid: Sport shoes with hard undersides and studs on the bottom designed to dig into grass.
translations: 一双硬底的运动鞋，底部设计有鞋钉，可以让你稳稳地走在草地上。

messages.msgid: Snug sport shoes with hard ridges on the bottom.
translations: 一双舒适的运动鞋，鞋底有些坚硬的鞋钉增加抓地力。

messages.msgid: Known as klompen in the Netherlands and sabots in France, these wooden shoes have endured through the ages due to their simple design and durability.
translations: 在荷兰被称为“klompen”、在法国被称为“sabots”的这种木鞋，凭借其简洁的设计与耐用性，历经时代仍被沿用。

messages.msgid: Gigantic shoes fit for a clown.  Incredibly difficult to walk in.
translations: 小丑们穿着的超大的鞋子。穿上就别想走路了。

messages.msgid: Expensive black dance shoes with large heels.
translations: 一双昂贵的黑色高跟舞鞋。

messages.msgid: Fancy patent leather shoes.  Not designed for running.
translations: 一双样式时髦的皮鞋。但它并不是为跑步而设计的。

messages.msgid: Simple sandals.  Somewhat difficult to run in.
translations: 一双样式简单的拖鞋。穿着它很难跑步。

messages.msgid: These are upmarket "luxury" flip-flops.  Very difficult to run in.
translations: 一双高档的"豪华版"拖鞋。穿着它很难跑步。

messages.msgid: Rags tied around your feet.  Not much of an improvement over being barefoot, but still better than nothing.
translations: 裹在脚上的布条，比光脚好不了多少，但也总比光着要好。

messages.msgid: Fur pelts tied around your feet.  Not much of an improvement over being barefoot, but still better than nothing.
translations: 裹在脚上的毛皮，比光脚好不了多少，但也总比光着要好。

messages.msgid: Faux fur patches tied around your feet.  Not much of an improvement over being barefoot, but still better than nothing.
translations: 裹在脚上的人造皮，比光脚好不了多少，但也总比光着要好。

messages.msgid: Leather patches tied around your feet.  Not much of an improvement over being barefoot, but still better than nothing.
translations: 裹在脚上的皮革，比光脚好不了多少，但也总比光着要好。

messages.msgid: Felt patches tied around your feet.  Not much of an improvement over being barefoot, but still better than nothing.
translations: 裹在脚上的羊毛，比光脚好不了多少，但也总比光着要好。

messages.msgid: A simple pair of geta.  Traditional wooden Japanese sandals with a fabric thong similar to flip flops.
translations: 一双简单的木屐。传统的日式木制凉鞋，鞋带类似人字拖。

messages.msgid: A pair of high heels.  Difficult to even walk in.
translations: 一双高跟鞋。穿着它走路都有点困难。

messages.msgid: A traditional pair of tall, high-heeled shoes with a tapered, slender heel, which makes strutting fashionable, walking a challenge, and running an impossibility.  These days, they'd probably be more useful to stab a zombie's eyes out than as footwear.
translations: 一双普通高跟鞋，鞋跟又细又尖，使走路成为一种时尚，跑步则是不可能的。如今，它们可能更适合戳瞎丧尸的眼睛，而不是作为鞋子穿着。

messages.msgid: These are a pair of chunky, broad-based shoes with a sturdy block-like heel, and while they don't do you any favors in the mobility department, they're at least more comfortable to trudge about in than their peers and won't likely cause irreversible damage to your feet.
translations: 这是一双厚实、宽底的鞋子，带有一个坚固的方块状鞋跟，虽然在移动方面对你没有任何好处，但至少比同类鞋子穿着起来更舒适，而且不太可能对你的脚造成不可逆转的伤害。

messages.msgid: A pair of tall, high-heeled, open-toed shoes with thick wedges running the length of the shoe, serving as its heels.
translations: 一双露趾高跟鞋，鞋底是一块厚厚的楔形，垫起作为厚高跟。

messages.msgid: A pair of heavy, thick-soled high-heeled shoes with a ridiculously tall heel supported by an ankle strap and chunky soles.  A great choice for when you've given up on basic biomechanical function and decided that you're more than willing to risk long-term damage to your feet for the sake of a ridiculous fashion statement in the ruins of America.
translations: 一双沉重的厚底高跟鞋，鞋跟高得离谱，由脚踝带和厚底固定。 如果你想放弃基本的生物力学运动，冒着足部长期损伤的风险，只为在废墟上发表可笑的时尚声明的话，这无疑是一个很棒的选择。

messages.msgid: The shoes of patriotic ladies around the nation, these open-toed heels glitter with small golden stars embroidered along their sides, with a pair of decorative flaps styled with the image of a miniature American flag unfurling from each ankle, like wings.  The footwear's heels consist of an adorably tiny reproduction of the Statue of Liberty situated beneath each sole, with their arms razed and supporting the shoe's heels.  Each of the statues' dresses is inscribed with the legend, "America Gives You Wings!"
translations: 作为全国各地爱国女士的鞋子，这些露趾高跟鞋的两侧闪耀着金色的小星星，一对装饰性的挡板上有一个微型美国国旗的形象，像翅膀一样从每个脚踝处展开。 鞋跟由缩小的自由女神像组成，十分漂亮，其手臂抬起，支撑着鞋跟。 每个女神像的衣服上都刻着这样的字样："美国给你翅膀！"

messages.msgid: Very long leather boots that cover the lower legs, they are cumbersome to wear.
translations: 一双长度及膝的长皮靴。穿起来很费力。

messages.msgid: A pair of sturdy, over-the-knee, laceless boots fitted with a rubberized sole: these imposing combat boots provide good traction despite their encumbering nature.  Most commonly associated with totalitarian regimes due to their use by Nazi soldiers, this style of boot is warm, protective, and produces a deeply satisfying sound while marching.
translations: 一双用料扎实的橡胶鞋底过膝长筒靴，没有鞋带。这种大号战斗靴虽然比较累赘，但抓地力好不易打滑。因为纳粹士兵曾有这样的穿着，它通常让人联想到中央集权的政体。这种靴子很暖和，防护也不错，还能在列队行进时发出迷人的踏地声。

messages.msgid: A pair of knee-length, laceless boots formed from calfskin with an elastic side panel that's designed to stretch away to facilitate simple donning and doffing, these stylish stompers are a time-old gift from Victorian-age England.  Intended for you to fashionably saunter down roadways rather than sprint for your life, this style of boot became a style staple within London during the 1960s, where they were synonymous with the mod crowd.
translations: 这是一双由小牛皮制成长及膝盖的靴子，没有鞋带，侧面有一个可伸展的弹性板，以方便简单的穿脱。这双时尚的散步靴是维多利亚时代英国的古老礼物。 这种靴子是为了让你时尚地在公路上漫步，而不是为生活而冲刺，这种风格的靴子在20世纪60年代成为伦敦的时尚主力，是时尚人群的代名词。

messages.msgid: Custom-made knee-high leather boots issued to motor officers.  Warm, durable and quite tough.
translations: 为摩托警官定制的及膝皮靴。温暖、耐用、相当坚韧。

messages.msgid: Sturdy leather hiking sandals with a heel strap.  Offers little in the way of protection, but keeps you cool during warmer months.
translations: 结实的皮制登山凉鞋，有着一根脚踝带。几乎无法提供有效防护，但透气性堪称一流，夏日首选。

messages.msgid: Lightweight shoes made of cloth and rubber.
translations: 重量很轻的鞋，由布和橡胶制成。

messages.msgid: A type of traditional Native American footwear sewn out of prepared leather or pelts.
translations: 一种美洲特色的皮鞋，后跟很矮，通常由皮革或毛皮制成。

messages.msgid: A pair of durable boots used by dirt bikers and motorcyclists.
translations: 一套为摩托车手和越野自行车手所使用的靴子。

messages.msgid: A pair of inline skates.  Very fast on flat floors, but they make it hard to move on rough terrain, take hits, or dodge effectively.
translations: 一双直排轮滑鞋。在平地上移动速度很快，但是在崎岖地形上会让你举步维艰，难以攻击并且更难躲闪。

messages.msgid: An old-fashioned pair of leather rollerskates with steel frames.  While quite fast on flat floors, they make it difficult to take hits or to move on rough terrain.
translations: 一双老样式钢架皮制滚轴溜冰鞋。在平地上移动速度很快，但是在崎岖地形上会让你举步维艰，难以攻击并且更难躲闪。

messages.msgid: Simple shoes woven from strips of birch bark.  Not very comfortable, but better than going barefoot.
translations: 由桦树皮条编织而成的简单鞋子。不太舒服，但总比赤脚来得好。

messages.msgid: A pair of flat-soled shoes designed to give you a grip on slippery surfaces.
translations: 一双设计用于增加湿滑地面抓地力的平底鞋。

messages.msgid: A pair of denim shoes.  They are cool and that's about it.
translations: 一双牛仔鞋。 他们很酷，仅此而已。

messages.msgid: Soft shoes that keep your feet warm.  Not suitable for running.
translations: 柔软的鞋子，可保持双脚温暖。不适合跑步。

messages.msgid: Guaranteed to make you run faster and jump higher!
translations: 一双质量不错的鞋子，保证让你跑得更快，跳得更高！

messages.msgid: Sandals made from straw rope.  Not very comfortable, but can keep your feet safe.
translations: 用稻草绳编成的凉鞋。不太舒适，但能保护双脚。

messages.msgid: Very long leather boots that reach past the knees, they are cumbersome to wear.
translations: 一双长度过膝的长皮靴。穿起来很费力。

messages.msgid: A pair of sneakers with integrated wheels.  Currently the wheels are retracted, making these essentially normal lace-up athletic shoes.
translations: 一双自带滑轮的运动鞋。目前滑轮被收起来，使它和普通的系带运动鞋一样。

messages.msgid: A pair of sneakers with integrated wheels, currently the wheels are out, allowing you to swiftly roll around on flat terrain.  You should probably pop them back in before you try fighting or going off-road.
translations: 一双自带滑轮的运动鞋。目前滑轮在外面，让你在平坦的地形上快速滑行。在你准备打架或越野前，你可能应该把滑轮收回去。

messages.msgid: You pop the wheels back in.
Customized chainmail chausses that cover the feet, like booties made of chainmail.  The metal shows signs of rust and corrosion.
translations: 经过特别定制的锁环镫靴，覆盖了整个脚部。金属有生锈和腐蚀的迹象。

messages.msgid: Customized chainmail chausses that cover the feet, like booties made of chainmail.
translations: 经过特别定制的锁环镫靴，覆盖了整个脚部。

messages.msgid: A snug-fitting pair of stockings made from thin and lightweight Nomex fabric.
translations: 一双由轻薄的芳纶织物制成的防火袜子。
一双穿在脚上的棉制袜子。

messages.msgid: Short socks, commonly used for sports.  These are designed to protect your feet from friction, not temperature.
translations: 一双运动型短袜。为了保护你的脚不被擦伤而设计，保暖性很差。

messages.msgid: A pair of disposable plastic bags, adapted to be used as socks.
translations: 一对用可回收塑料袋稍加修改制成的袜子。

messages.msgid: Cheap socks designed to be worn once and then thrown away.  They keep your feet clean, but are too thin to give any protection.
translations: 一双廉价的一次性袜子。只能让脚不弄脏，但是太薄了，没法提供任何防护。
一双羊毛制成的袜子，非常暖和。

messages.msgid: Long cotton socks that reach above the knees to help protect from the cold.
translations: 一双长度及膝的棉袜，保暖效果很棒。

messages.msgid: This one is black, with white stripes.  Or is it white with black stripes?
translations: 它是黑底白条纹的还是白底黑条纹的？

messages.msgid: This one is colored red with a polka dot pattern.
translations: 它上面有红色的波尔卡圆点图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored in various shades of red with a floral pattern.
translations: 它上面有不同深浅色的红色图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored orange with a striped pattern.
translations: 它上面有橙色的条纹图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored blue and white with a striped pattern.
translations: 它上面有蓝色和白色的条纹图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored in various shades of blue with a floral pattern.
translations: 它上面有不同深浅色的蓝色图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored blue and black with a checkered pattern.
translations: 它上面有蓝色和黑色的格子图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored purple and white with a striped pattern.
translations: 它上面有紫色和白色的格子图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored purple with a polka dot pattern.
translations: 它上面有紫色的波尔卡圆点图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored in various shades of purple with a floral pattern.
translations: 它上面有不同深浅色的紫色图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored pink and white with a striped pattern.
translations: 它上面有粉色和白色的条纹图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored pink with a polka dot pattern.
translations: 它上面有粉色的波尔卡圆点图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored green and white with a striped pattern.
translations: 它上面有绿色和白色的条纹图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored gray and white with a striped pattern.
translations: 它上面有灰色和白色的条纹图案。

messages.msgid: This one is colored brown with a polka dot pattern.
translations: 它上面有棕色的波尔卡圆点图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the pride flag.
translations: 它上面有着同性恋骄傲旗图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the lesbian flag.
translations: 它上面有着拉拉旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the bisexual flag.
translations: 它上面有着双性恋旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the transgender flag.
translations: 它上面有着跨性别者旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the asexual flag.
translations: 它上面有着无性恋者旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the aromantic flag.
translations: 它上面有着浪漫主义旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the pansexual flag.
translations: 它上面有着泛性恋的旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the genderqueer flag.
translations: 它上面有着性别酷儿的旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the genderfluid flag.
translations: 它上面有着性别流动者的旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the agender flag.
translations: 它上面有着无性别者旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the non-binary flag.
translations: 它上面有着非二元性别旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the intersex flag.
translations: 它上面有着间性人旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: This one has patterns akin to the polysexual flag.
translations: 它上面有着代表多性恋的旗帜图案。

messages.msgid: Six long cotton tubes sized to fit over tentacles and help protect them from the cold.
translations: 六根大小足以容下任何触肢的长棉袜，保暖效果很棒。

messages.msgid: A pair of split toe black tabi socks.  Usually worn as a part of traditional Japanese clothing.  The big toe is separated from the others by the fabric to be comfortably worn with thonged footwear.
translations: 一双黑色分趾袜，通常作为日本传统服饰的穿着搭配。特点是布料把拇趾与其他脚趾分隔开来，以便舒适地搭配鞋履。

messages.msgid: A pair of split toe white tabi socks, as used by martial arts practitioners.  Usually worn as a part of traditional Japanese clothing.  The big toe is separated from the others by the fabric to be comfortably worn with thonged footwear.
translations: 一双白色分趾袜（足袋），常为武术练习者穿着。通常也作为日本传统服饰的一部分。布料将大脚趾与其他脚趾分隔开，以便舒适地搭配鞋履。

messages.msgid: A flexible set of jointed lames that can be worn over footwear for additional protection, traditionally worn by mounted knights.
translations: 一套灵活的带有关节的板腿甲，可以穿在鞋外以提供额外的保护，传统由骑士穿着。

messages.msgid: Originating from the Pyrenees and made from a rope sole and cloth, these shoes are perfect for the hot weather, sipping Sangria and dodging tourists.
translations: 这种鞋子源自比利牛斯山脉，鞋底由绳子和布料制成，非常适合在炎热的天气下一边喝着桑格利亚汽酒一边躲避游客。

messages.msgid: A pair of thin traditional Japanese split toed boots sewn out of leather.
translations: 一双用皮革缝制的薄底日式分趾靴。

messages.msgid: A pair of comfortable modern split toed jika-tabi shoes with a rubber base.  Also known as ninja shoes.  Though originally developed for laborers in Japan, in the west they are usually found being used in outdoor martial arts practice.
translations: 一双舒适的现代分趾地下足袋，带有橡胶鞋底，也被称为忍者鞋。虽然最初是为日本劳工所开发的，但在西方通常用于户外武术练习。

messages.msgid: A vest made from tough fabric with steel plates riveted on the inside.  Can be comfortably worn over chainmail for extra protection.
translations: 一件由坚韧织物制成的背心，内侧铆接着钢板。可以舒适地穿在链甲外面，以获得额外防护。

messages.msgid: Attachment for additional plating placed on top.
translations: 顶部镀层外部的附加口袋

messages.msgid: A cardboard helmet shaped to look like a medieval great helm.  Very unencumbering in comparison to actual helmets, with rather obvious drawbacks in exchange.  The interior is lined with aluminum, apparently to 'divert the zombie beta rays'.  It sure doesn't help with comfort.
translations: 一种形状像中世纪巨盔的硬纸板头盔。与实际的头盔相比，它累赘很低，但有相当明显的缺点。内部内衬是铝箔，显然是为了“阻挡丧尸贝塔射线”。这对舒适度毫无帮助。

messages.msgid: A set of cardboard armor that's been duct taped and superglued into place, with paper padding the interior in an unsuccessful attempt to increase comfort.  Despite the triple-layering, tensile and shear strength diagrams, and careful design considerations, there's just no way this is going to hold up to a single attack.
translations: 一套硬纸板盔甲，用胶带和强力胶粘在一起，用纸填充内部，试图增加舒适度，但没有成功。尽管有三层结构，拉伸和剪切强度图，以及仔细的设计考虑，但这根本无法抵挡一次攻击。

messages.msgid: While this isn't quite the 'heavy ballistic vest' the blueprints pretend it is, the layering makes it almost passable as a form of extremely rudimentary armor.  It's still nowhere near as good as basically any other choice, while still being hard to move around in.
translations: 虽然这并不是蓝图中所描绘的那种“重型防弹背心”，但这种分层结构使它勉强可以作为一种极其简陋的护甲。它仍然远远比不上任何其他护具，同时穿着它很难活动。

messages.msgid: A piece of cardboard crudely bent into shape and cut to look like a crown.
translations: 一块硬纸板，粗糙地弯曲成形状，然后切成王冠的样子。
你松开了你的硬纸板王冠。

messages.msgid: A piece of cardboard crudely bent into shape and cut to look like a crown.  This one's been loosened up somewhat, allowing it to be worn over some headgear comfortably.
translations: 一块硬纸板，粗糙地弯曲成形状，然后切成皇冠的样子。这件有点松了，可以舒适地戴在一些头饰上。
你稍稍系紧你的硬纸板王冠。

messages.msgid: An honorable badge identifying the owner as a "Knight Errant" of "House Da".  The large letters slowly dwindle in size as the badge runs out of space, leaving out the last two letters of Dino Dave's name.
translations: 一个荣誉徽章，表明主人是“戴家族”的“游侠骑士”。随着徽章空间的耗尽，大写字母的大小慢慢缩小，没能写下迪诺·戴夫名字的最后两个字母。

messages.msgid: A large American flag, made to fly in even the worst conditions.
translations: 一面巨大的美国国旗，即使在最糟的情况下也能飘扬。

messages.msgid: A weak energy shield that protects against ballistic damage.
translations: 一种抵御弹道穿透伤的弱能量盾。

messages.msgid: A large rainbow flag, The colors reflect the diversity of the LGBT community and the spectrum of human sexuality and gender.
translations: 一面大彩虹旗，颜色反映了LGBT群体的多样性以及人类性行为和性别的光谱。
进步同性恋骄傲日旗帜

messages.msgid: A large rainbow flag, The colors reflect the diversity of the LGBT community and the spectrum of human sexuality and gender.  On the left side you can see a chevron that features black, brown, light blue, pink, and white stripes to bring those communities to the forefront; "the arrow points to the right to show forward movement, while being along the left edge shows that progress still needs to be made".
translations: 一面巨大的彩虹旗，颜色反映了LGBT社区的多样性以及人类性行为和性别的光谱。在左边，你可以看到一个以黑色、棕色、浅蓝色、粉红色和白色条纹组成的大V字，带领社区走到了最前沿；"箭头向右表示向前发展，箭头靠左表示仍需努力"。

messages.msgid: A large green gray and black agender flag.  The black and white stripes represent complete absence of gender, gray represents being semi-genderless, and green represents non-binary gender.
translations: 一面巨大的由绿色、灰色、和黑白组成的无性别旗帜。黑白条纹表示没有性别，灰色表示半无性别，而绿色则表示非二元性别。

messages.msgid: A large pink and blue bisexual flag.  The pink stripe represents homosexuality, while the blue stripe represents heterosexuality.  The purple stripe, the "overlap" of the blue and pink stripes, purple represents attraction regardless of sex or gender a.k.a bisexuality.
translations: 一面巨大的由粉色和蓝色组成的双性恋旗帜。粉色条纹表示同性恋，而蓝色条纹表示异性恋。紫色的条纹，是粉色和蓝色的"重叠"，紫色表示不分性别，也就是双性恋。

messages.msgid: A large pink, blue and yellow pansexual flag.  The pan-pride flag uses pink for people on the female-spectrum, blue for people on the male-spectrum, and yellow for non-binary or genderqueer people.
translations: 一面巨大的由粉色、蓝色和黄色组成的泛性恋旗帜。泛性恋骄傲旗帜用粉色表示喜欢女性的人，蓝色表示喜欢男性的人，黄色则表示喜欢非二元性别的人。

messages.msgid: A large black and purple labrys lesbian flag.  On the flag you can see a labrys, a type of double-headed axe, superimposed on a downward-pointing black triangle, set against a violet background.
translations:
一面巨大的由黑色和紫色组成的女同性恋双头斧旗帜。在旗帜上你可以看到一把双头斧（神话中亚马逊女战士常用武器）叠加在一个黑色倒三角形上，以紫色作为背景。

—— 百合无限好，只是生不了。虽然生不了，还是无限好。

messages.msgid: A large pink, white and orange lesbian flag.  The dark orange representing "gender non-conformity", orange for "independence", light orange for "community", white for "unique relationships to womanhood", pink for "serenity and peace", dusty pink for "love and sex", and dark rose for "femininity".
translations: 一面巨大的由粉红色、白色和橙色组成的女同性恋旗帜。深橙色代表"性别不一致"，橙色代表"独立"，浅橙色代表"社区"，白色代表"与女性的独特关系"，粉红色代表"宁静与和平"，灰粉色代表"爱与自由"，暗玫瑰色代表"女性气质"。

messages.msgid: A large purple, white, gray and black asexual flag.  Black for asexuality (feeling no sexual attraction), gray for gray-asexuality and demisexuality (feeling sexual attraction only sometimes), white for non-asexual partners and allies, and purple for community.
translations: 一面巨大的由紫、白、灰和黑色组成的无性恋旗帜。黑色代表无性恋（没有那种世俗的欲望.jpg）灰色代表半无性恋（只是有时有那种世俗的欲望），白色代表非无性恋朋友或盟友，紫色代表社区。

messages.msgid: A large black, gray, white and green aromantic flag.  The green and light green stripes cover everyone under the aromantic spectrum, while represents nonromantic forms of love and attraction, and the gray and black represent all sexualities under the aromantic spectrum.
translations: 一面巨大的由黑色、灰色、白色和绿色组成的芳香旗帜，绿色和浅绿色条纹涵盖了芳香族光谱下的每个人，同时代表非芳香族形式的爱和吸引，而灰色和黑色代表芳香族光谱下的所有性取向。

messages.msgid: A large white, pink, and blue transgender flag.  The stripes at the top and bottom are light blue, the traditional color for baby boys.  The stripes next to them are pink, the traditional color for baby girls.  The white stripe is for people that are nonbinary, feel that they don't have a gender.  The pattern is such that no matter which way you fly it, it is always correct, signifying finding correctness in one's life.
translations: 一面巨大的白色，粉色和蓝色组成的跨性别旗帜。顶部和底部的条纹是浅蓝色代表男婴，旁边的粉红色代表女婴。白色的是为非二元者准备的，他们觉得自己没有性别。这个图案代表了这样一种含义，无论你想要怎样生活，都是正确的。代表了一个人在生活中找到了何为正确。

messages.msgid: A large green, white, and purple genderqueer flag.  Lavender, a mixture of blue and pink to represent androgynes and androgyny, white to represent agender identity, and green, the inverse of lavender, to represent all those who fall outside of the gender binary.
translations: 一面巨大的由绿色，白色和紫色组成的性别酷儿旗帜。薰衣草色，蓝色和粉红色的混合物，代表着双性恋和雌雄同体，白色代表无性别认同，绿色作为薰衣草色的反面，代表所有不属于性别二元论的人。

messages.msgid: A large yellow, and purple intersex flag.  It displays a purple circle on a yellow field.  Yellow and purple were chosen as colors as they were viewed as free from gender associations and were historically used to represent intersex people.  The circle is described as "unbroken and unornamented, symbolizing wholeness and completeness, and our potentialities".
translations: 一面巨大的由黄色和紫色组成的间性人旗帜。黄色背景上印着一个紫色圆圈。之所以选择了黄色和紫色，因为这两个颜色被视为没有性别关联，并且在历史上被用来表示双性人。这个圆圈被描述为"完美无瑕，象征了整体性和完整性，以及我们的潜力"。

messages.msgid: A large blue, black, purple, white and pink genderfluid flag.  The genderfluid flag has a pink stripe for femininity, a blue stripe for masculinity, a purple stripe for both masculinity and femininity, a black stripe for lack of gender, and a white stripe for all genders.
translations:
一面巨大的由蓝、黑、紫、白、粉组成的性别流动旗帜。性别流动旗上的粉色条纹代表女性，蓝色条纹代表男性，紫色条纹代表男性和女性，黑色条纹表示没有性别，白色条纹表示所有性别。
注：性别流动是指在不断改变自己性别认同的群体

messages.msgid: A large green, white, gray and black agender flag.  The black and white stripes represent complete absence of gender, gray represents being semi-genderless, and green represents non-binary gender.  The symmetry of the pattern makes it so that it's correct no matter how it flies.
translations: 一面巨大的由绿色，白色，灰色和黑色组成的无性别旗帜。黑白条纹表示没有性别，灰色表示半无性别，而绿色表示非二元性别。图案的对称性代表了无论怎样飞翔都是正确的。

messages.msgid: A large black, purple, white, and yellow non-binary flag.  Yellow for those whose gender exists outside of and without reference to the binary, white for those who have many or all genders, purple for those who feel their gender is between or a mix of female and male, and black for those who feel they are without gender.
translations: 一面巨大的由黑色，紫色，白色和黄色组成的非二元性别旗帜。黄色代表性别存在于二元以外的人，白色代表那些性别多种或所有性别的人，紫色代表那些觉得自己的性别介于男性和女性之间或混合的人，黑色代表那些认为自己没有性别的人。

messages.msgid: A large blue, green, and pink polysexual flag.  Pink for people on the female-spectrum, blue for people on the male-spectrum, and green for non-binary or genderqueer people.
translations: 一面巨大的由蓝色，绿色和粉色组成的多性恋旗帜，粉色代表女性，蓝色代表男性，绿色代表非二元和变性的人。

messages.msgid: A horizontally striped black and blue leather flag with a white band in the middle and red heart in a corner.  The black represents leather; the blue represents devotion, loyalty, and community; the white represents purity and innocence; and the red heart represents love for the community.
translations: 一面巨大的由黑色和蓝色组成的抖SM自豪旗帜。一面水平条纹的黑蓝旗，中间有一条白带，一角有红心。黑色代表捆绑，蓝色代表奉献，忠诚和社区；白色代表纯洁和天真；而红心代表对社区的爱。

messages.msgid: A large black and orange international bear brotherhood flag.  The flag displays seven horizontal stripes of colors ranging from black to brown representing the colors of different bear species, you can see a black bear paw in the upper right corner.
translations: 一面巨大的由黑色和橙色组成的国际熊熊兄弟会大旗。旗子上显示了七条横条纹，颜色从黑色到棕色不等，代表了不同熊种的颜色，你可以在右上角看到一只黑熊的爪子。

messages.msgid: A large flag, made to fly in even the worst conditions.
translations: 一面巨大的国旗，即使在最糟的情况下也能飘扬。

messages.msgid: It has three vertical boxes of black, red, and green placed behind the royal seal of Afghanistan.
translations: 它由黑、红、绿三色垂直的方格组成，中心是阿富汗国徽。

messages.msgid: It's a solid red, overlaid with the crest of Albania.
translations: 它的旗面整体为红色，中央是黑色雄鹰标记。

messages.msgid: It's divided by green and white halves, overlaid with a crescent moon and a star in red.
translations: 一面阿尔及利亚国旗，左绿右白，中间叠有红色的新月与星星图案。

messages.msgid: It has three vertical lines navy blue, yellow, and red, overlaid with the crest of Andorra.
translations: 这面旗帜由蓝黄红三色的竖条组成，中间是安道尔公国的纹章。

messages.msgid: It's divided by red and black rectangles, overlaid by a gold machete, star, and half of a gear.
translations: 这面旗帜上红下黑，中间交叉着砍刀、金星与半只齿轮。

messages.msgid: It has three horizontal lines of baby blue and white, with a gold star in the middle.
translations: 这面旗帜由竖直排列的蓝白蓝组成，中间有一颗金星。

messages.msgid: It has three stripes of red, navy blue, and orange.
translations: 这面旗帜由红蓝橘三条色带组成。

messages.msgid: It's solid navy blue, with various white stars.  In the top left corner is a miniature Union Jack.
translations: 旗帜主体为海军蓝，缀有样式各异的白星。左上有小型的英联邦旗帜。

messages.msgid: It has three stripes of red and white.
translations: 是一面竖向排列的红白红三色旗。

messages.msgid: It has three stripes of light blue, red, and green.  In the middle is a white crescent moon and star.
translations: 它具有浅蓝、红、绿三色横纹。中间是白色的新月与星星。

messages.msgid: It has a black V-shape surrounded by red.  The bottom of the V is blue, with a rising sun immediately above.
translations: 旗帜主体是红色包裹着黑色V型图案，V的下部分为蓝色，上部分是一轮旭日。

messages.msgid: It has three stripes of light blue and yellow, with a black triangle on the far-left side.
translations: 旗帜由蓝黄蓝组成，左端有一个黑色三角形。

messages.msgid: It has a red background with a series of white spikes on the left.
translations: 旗帜主体为红色，左侧有一列白色锯齿状图案。

messages.msgid: It's solid dark green, with a red circle in the middle.
translations: 旗帜主体暗绿，中心偏左有个红圈。

messages.msgid: It has three vertical lines of navy blue and yellow, with a black trident in the center.
translations: 旗帜由蓝黄蓝三道竖条组成，中间有一柄黑色的三叉戟。

messages.msgid: It has a red and green background, with a checker pattern on the left.
translations: 旗帜主体上红下绿，最左侧部分有棋盘型图案。

messages.msgid: It has three vertical stripes of black, yellow, and red.
translations: 一面黑黄红三色竖纹旗。

messages.msgid: It has two small stripes of red, separated by a square of blue, with the emblem of Belize in the center.
translations: 主体为蓝色，上下各有一条红，中间有个伯利兹纹章。

messages.msgid: It is divided into squares of yellow, red, and light green.
translations: 一面旗帜，上黄下红，左侧为绿。

messages.msgid: It is divided into triangles of red and dark yellow, with a dragon in the center.
translations: 旗帜按黄与红分为左上和右下两个三角形，中间有一条龙。

messages.msgid: It has three stripes of red, yellow, and green, with the crest of Bolivia in the center.
translations: 旗帜由红黄绿三条色带组成，中间是玻利维亚的纹章。

messages.msgid: It has a yellow triangle over a navy blue background, with white stars running along one side.
translations: 旗帜主体海蓝，右上有个黄色的三角型，再右侧并排有一列白星。

messages.msgid: It has a yellow diamond on a light green base.  In the center of the diamond sits a blue orb with a curved, white line.
translations: 浅绿色的旗面上有一颗黄色的菱形。菱形中心有一个蓝色的球体，球体上面有一条弯曲的白线。

messages.msgid: It has a black and white line running through a baby blue background.
translations: 旗帜整体浅蓝，白黑白的细长条带横向穿过中间。

messages.msgid: It has a diagonal black-and-white line through a yellow background, with a red lamp in the center.
translations: 倾斜的黑白条带从左上至右下穿过黄色的旗帜，中心出有个红色灯笼图案。

messages.msgid: It has three stripes of white, green, and yellow.
It's divided into red and green, with a yellow star at the center.
translations: 旗帜一分为二，上红下绿，中间有颗黄色的星星。

messages.msgid: It is divided into red and green triangles, with three stars at the center.
translations: 旗帜被分隔成了上下左右四个三角形，上下为红，左右为绿。中部有三颗星星。

messages.msgid: It has three vertical beige, white, and green stripes.
translations: 一面橘、白、绿三色竖纹旗。

messages.msgid: It has a thin red line in the center, surrounded by white and blue.  To the left lies an oval of gold stars.
translations: 白红白三色细条穿过蓝色的旗帜主体，靠左的地方有一圈金星围成了椭圆的形状。

messages.msgid: It has three horizontal lines on navy blue and red, with a palace at the center.
translations: 旗帜由蓝红蓝条带竖向排列组成，主体的红色部分内有一个宫殿图样。

messages.msgid: It's divided into three green, red, and yellow stripes, with a golden star in the center.
translations: 旗帜分为绿、红、黄三条色带，中间有一颗金星。

messages.msgid: It has three red and white stripes, with the iconic maple leaf in red.
translations: 旗帜红白相间，中间有一片标志性的枫叶。

messages.msgid: It has three stripes of navy blue, yellow, and red.
translations: 旗面由海军蓝、黄、红三个条纹组成。

messages.msgid: It has a red and white backing, with a white star on blue in the upper left corner.
translations: 旗面由红、白组成，左上方为蓝色正方形，其中央绘有一颗白色五角星。

messages.msgid: It has a solid red back, with five yellow stars in the top left.
translations: 旗面为红色，左上方缀黄色五角星五颗。

messages.msgid: It has a yellow, navy blue, and red stripe running horizontally.
translations: 旗帜由黄、蓝、红三条水平色带组成。

messages.msgid: Four horizontal stripes of yellow, white, red, and blue serve as a backdrop for a sideways green triangle on the far left, with a white crescent moon and four stars in the center.
translations: 旗帜主体由黄、白、红、蓝四条色带组成，左侧有一个绿色的三角，三角内部为白色的新月与四颗星。

messages.msgid: It has a diagonal tricolor of green, yellow and red radiating from the lower hoist side corner.
translations: 这面旗帜上的绿黄红三色条带从左下到右上沿对角线延伸。

messages.msgid: Five horizontal stripes of white, blue, and red run across it, with the coat of arms lying off-center.
translations: 蓝、白、红、白、蓝五道横条组成了这面旗帜，中间的红色条纹较宽，在靠近左侧处有一个纹章。

messages.msgid: A flag of three horizontal stripes of red, white, and blue and a checkered red and white coat of arms shield, above which stands a crown of a dark and light blue pattern.
translations: 有红白蓝水平条纹的旗帜，中间有个盾辉图案，上面有红白棋盘花纹，盾辉上方有深蓝与浅蓝交错的冠状图样。

messages.msgid: Blue and white stripes run horizontally across the flag, a red triangle forms over the left side with a white star in its center.
translations: 蓝色与白色交错横向贯穿整个旗帜，左侧有一个红色三角形，内有一颗白色的星星。

messages.msgid: A white flag with a yellow emblem of the island stands in the center, two green olive branches stand below it.
translations: 一面白色的旗帜，中间有一个黄色的小岛图案，两根橄榄枝交于下方。

messages.msgid: A flag with horizontal stripes of blue, white, green and yellow coloration and one vertical red stripe down the middle with a star in the upper left corner.
translations: 一面旗帜，有蓝色、白色、绿色和黄色的水平条纹，中间被一条垂直的红色条纹隔开，左上角有一颗黄色的星星。

messages.msgid: A flag with a blue triangle at the hoist and a horizontal white and red color on it.
translations: 一面旗帜，由白红两色水平构成，左侧有个大大的蓝色三角。

messages.msgid: A sky blue flag with a yellow star in the upper left canton, diagonally running across the flag is a red strip and yellow fimbriation.
translations: 一面天蓝色的旗帜，左上方有颗黄色的星星，红色与黄色条纹沿对角线穿过国旗。

messages.msgid: A flag of a red field with a white Nordic cross over it.
translations: 一面红色的国旗，中间有个白色的天主十字。

messages.msgid: A flag that has a white triangle in the left portion with light blue and green color running horizontally.
translations: 一面旗帜，水平方向浅蓝与绿色，左侧部分有个白色的三角形。

messages.msgid: A green flag with a running tricolor cross of yellow, black, and white, in the center stands a red circle with a parrot in the middle surrounded by green stars.
translations: 一面绿色的旗帜，黄黑白三色细带组成的十字盖在上面。中心是一个红色的园，里面有一只鹦鹉，围绕着一圈绿色的星星。

messages.msgid: A flag with a white cross and a coat of arms in the center with a pattern of blue and red on the outside of the cross.
translations: 一面旗帜，上面有白色十字，中间有个盾形纹章，十字外面是蓝红两色。

messages.msgid: A horizontal tricolor flag of yellow, blue, and red with its coat of arms in the center.
translations: 一面旗帜，黄蓝红三色水平排列，中间有个盾牌形印章。

messages.msgid: A horizontal tricolor flag of red, white, and black with a yellow eagle in the center.
translations: 一面旗帜，红白黑三色水平排列，中间有一只黄色的鹰。

messages.msgid: It is a horizontal pattern flag of blue, white, and blue with a coat of arms in the center.
translations: 一面蓝白色水平图案的旗帜，中间有个盾牌形印章。

messages.msgid: A horizontal tricolor flag, with green, white and red stripes and a blue triangle at the hoist with a coat of arms in the center.
translations: 一面水平方向的绿白红三色旗，左侧有一个蓝色三角形，旗帜中间有一个盾形印章。

messages.msgid: A tricolor flag of green, red, and blue with a golden wreath surrounding an olive branch near the hoist.
translations: 一面绿红蓝三色旗，边缘有一个黄金花环环绕着橄榄枝。

messages.msgid: A horizontal tricolor flag of blue, black, and white.
translations: 一面蓝黑白水平三色旗帜。

messages.msgid: A triband flag of blue with a yellow outline and red in the middle, in the center is a Nguni shield and two spears.
translations: 一面蓝黄红三色旗帜，黄色在边缘，红色在中间。在正中是一个恩古尼盾牌和两根矛。

messages.msgid: A horizontally running tricolor flag of green, yellow, and red, in the center is a blue circle and a yellow star.
translations: 一面绿黄红水平三色旗帜，中间是一个蓝色圆环和一颗黄色星星。

messages.msgid: A sky blue flag with a Union Jack in the hoist and a shield centered in the outer half of it with the cross of Saint George within it.
translations: 一面天蓝色的旗帜，边缘有个英国国旗，外侧有个盾牌徽章，里面有个圣乔治十字架。

messages.msgid: A white flag with a blue Nordic cross over it.
translations: 一面白色旗帜，上边有个蓝色的北欧十字架。

messages.msgid: A tricolor flag of blue, white, and red.
A horizontal tricolor flag of green, yellow, and blue.
translations: 一面绿黄蓝三色水平旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag consisting of horizontal red, blue, and green stripes separated by two thin stripes of white.
translations: 一面红蓝绿水平组成的旗帜，由两条白色细条分隔开。

messages.msgid: It is a white field flag with a red cross of Saint George and four equilateral crosses.
translations: 一面白色旗帜，有一个红色圣乔治十字架和另外四个等大的十字。

messages.msgid: A horizontal tricolor flag of black, red, and gold.
translations: 一面黑红金三色水平旗帜。

messages.msgid: A horizontal tricolor flag of red, gold, and green, a black star standing in its center.
translations: 一面红金绿水平三色旗帜，中间有颗黑色的星星。

messages.msgid: A striped colored flag of four white and five blue alternating horizontal stripes, with a white cross on the upper left corner.
translations: 一面由四条白色五条蓝色交替组成的条纹旗帜，左上部有个白色的十字架。

messages.msgid: A flag that is diagonally divided field of yellow, green, yellow, green with a red border, in addition to the six yellow stars in the border, there is a central star in a red disk and, at the hoist, a nutmeg symbol.
translations: 一面对角分为黄绿色的旗帜，边缘为红色条带，其中还有六颗黄色星星星，中间的红色区域内还有一颗星，边缘是一个肉豆蔻图案。

messages.msgid: A vertical triband flag that features a central band of white that holds the nation's coat of arms nestled between two bands of light blue.
translations: 一面浅蓝夹白色的三色竖条旗帜，白色中间有个国徽。

messages.msgid: A vertical triband flag of red, gold, and green.
translations: 一面红金绿竖直三色旗。

messages.msgid: A flag that features two horizontal bands of gold and green with a red vertical band charged with a black star on the hoist side.
translations: 一面由金绿两色组成的水平旗帜，左侧一边有红色竖条，内有有颗黑色的星星。

messages.msgid: A flag of a green field with the black edged red isosceles triangle based on the hoist side superimposed on the larger white edged golden triangle, also based on the hoist side, pointed toward the fly-side.
translations: 一面以绿色基调的旗帜，靠近旗杆一侧有个白边金色三角形，其内部有个黑边红色等腰三角形。

messages.msgid: A bicolor horizontal flag of blue and red, with a white rectangle in the center featuring a coat of arms.
translations: 一面蓝红双色水平旗帜，中间有个白色矩形盾徽。

messages.msgid: A flag with a bicolor of gold and white with the crossed keys of Saint Peter and the Papal Tiara centered in the white band.
translations: 一面金白双色旗帜，在白色部分有圣彼得的交叉钥匙和教皇皇冠图案。

messages.msgid: A flag with a horizontal triband of turquoise and white with five turquoise five pointed stars arranged in an x pattern centered on the white band.
translations: 一面浅蓝与白色水平三条纹旗帜，中间有按X型排列的五颗浅蓝色星星。

messages.msgid: A tricolor flag consisting of horizontal red, white and green.
translations: 一面红白绿水平三色旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag of a blue field with the white edged red Nordic cross that extends to the edges, the vertical part of the cross is shifted to the hoist side.
translations: 一面蓝底旗帜，白边红色北欧十字延伸到旗帜边缘，十字的竖直部分靠向旗杆一侧。

messages.msgid: A flag that has a horizontal triband of saffron, white, and green with a navy blue wheel with twenty four spokes in the center.
translations: 一面橘黄，白，绿组成的水平三条旗帜，中间有个有着二十四根辐条的海蓝色轮状图案。

messages.msgid: A flag with a horizontal bicolor of red and white.
translations: 一面红白双色水平旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag that has a horizontal tricolor of green, white and red with the national emblem in red centered on the white band.
translations: 一面绿白红水平三色旗帜，白色中间有一个红色国徽图案。

messages.msgid: A tricolor flag of horizontal stripes in red, white, and black with the inscription in Kufic script in the center white band.
translations: 一面红白黑水平三色旗帜，在白色条纹中间有一个古阿拉伯字符。

messages.msgid: A tricolor flag featuring vertical stripes of green, white, and orange.
translations: 一面绿白橙三色竖纹旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag that has a white field bearing two horizontal blue stripes and a blue central Shield of David.
translations: 一面旗帜，白色领域带有两条水平的蓝色条纹和一个蓝色的中央大卫盾牌。

messages.msgid: A flag that has a tricolor vertical stripes of green, white, and red.
translations: 具有绿色、白色和红色三色垂直条纹的旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag that has a gold diagonal cross which divides the field into four triangles of green and black.
translations: 一面旗帜，带有金色对角线十字架，将场地分为绿色和黑色四个三角形。

messages.msgid: A flag of a white field with a red circle in the center piece.
translations: 白色领域的旗帜，中间有一个红色圆圈。

messages.msgid: A flag of a horizontal triband of black, white and green; with a red chevron based on the hoist side containing a white seven-pointed star.
translations: 黑色、白色和绿色水平三带的旗帜；葫芦侧面有一个红色的人字形，上面有一个白色的七角星。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a gold sun above a soaring golden steppe eagle, both centered on a turquoise field.
translations: 一面旗帜，上面有一个金色的太阳，上面是一只翱翔的金色草原鹰，两者都以绿松石原为中心。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal tricolor of black, white-edged red, and green with two crossed white spears behind a red, white, and black Maasai shield.
translations: 一面旗帜，具有黑色、白边红绿三色旗，红白黑马赛盾牌后面有两根交叉的白色长矛。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal bicolor of red and blue with the yellow frigate bird flying over the rising sun with seventeen rays centered on the upper half and three white wavy horizontal stripes on the lower half.
translations: 一面红蓝双色水平条纹的旗帜，上半部有一轮发射17到光线的升起的太阳，一只金色的鸟飞于其上。旗帜下半部有三条白色的波浪状条纹。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of green, white and red; with a black trapezium based on the hoist side.
translations: 一面绿白红三色水平旗帜，靠近旗杆一侧有一个黑色的梯形。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a red field charged with a yellow sun with forty uniformly spaced rays, the sun is crossed by two sets of three lines.
translations: 一面红底旗帜，上有一个黄色的太阳，发射四十束整齐的光线，被两组三道线十字交叉穿过。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of red, blue and red, charged in the center a white circle.
translations: 一面红蓝红水平三色旗帜，中间有一个白色的圆。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a carmine red field bisected by a narrow white stripe.
translations: 一面洋红色为主体的旗帜，中间有白色的窄条带。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of red, white, and red, charged in the center is a green cedar tree.
translations: 一面红白红水平条带旗帜，中间有绿色雪松树图案。

messages.msgid: A horizontal triband of blue, white and green charged with a black mokorotlo centered on the white band.
translations: 一面蓝白绿水平三色条纹旗，白色中间有顶莫克罗托帽的标志。

messages.msgid: A flag that features eleven horizontal stripes alternating red and white, in the canton is a white star on a blue field.
translations: 一面十一条红白条纹水平交错的旗帜，左上角的蓝色方形小区域内有一颗白色的星星。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of red, black, and green charged with a white crescent and five pointed star centered on the black stripe.
translations: 一面红黑绿三色水平旗帜，中间的黑色条带中有白色的新月和五颗星星的图案。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal bicolor of blue and red, charged with a gold crown in the canton.
translations: 一面蓝红双色水平旗帜，左上角有一个金色的皇冠。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of yellow, green and red.
translations: 一面黄绿红水平三色条带旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of red, white and light blue.
translations: 一面红白浅蓝的水平三色旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag that features two horizontal bands of red and green with a white vertical band on the hoist side.
translations: 一面红绿水平条纹旗帜，靠旗杆一侧有竖直白色条。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of black, red, and green; charged with a red rising sun with rays centered on the black stripe.
translations: 一面黑红绿三色旗帜，在黑色条带中有发光的红日。

messages.msgid: A flag that features fourteen horizontal stripes alternating red and white, a yellow crescent and fourteen-point star on a blue field in on the canton.
translations: 一面由十四红白条纹交错组成的旗帜，在靠旗杆上侧的蓝色区域中有黄色新月和十四角星星。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a green rectangle centered on a red field; charged with a white crescent.
translations: 一面红色基基底上有着绿色矩形的旗帜，还有一轮白色的新月在上边。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a vertical tricolor of green, gold and red.
translations: 一面绿金红三色竖直条纹组成的旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a vertical bicolor of white and red with the representation of the George Cross edged in red on the upper hoist-side corner of the white band.
translations: 一面白红双色竖直条纹旗帜，在靠旗杆一侧白色条带底边有一个乔治十字架。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a blue field with two diagonal stripes of orange and white radiating from the lower hoist side corner to the upper fly side corner and the large white star with four large rays and twenty small rays on the upper hoist side corner above the stripes.
translations: 一面有橘白两色条带从旗杆侧左下到右上的蓝底旗帜，旗杆侧上方有一颗白色星星，发出四条较大光线和二十条较小的光线。

messages.msgid: A flag that features two red stripes flanking a green field with a golden upward-pointed crescent and star charged in the center.
translations: 一面两根红色条带分部飘于绿色基底上下边缘的旗帜，中间有向上的星星和新月图案。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a vertical tricolor of green, white and red, with the national coat of arms centered on the white band.
translations: 一面绿白红竖直三色旗帜，中间有个国家盾徽标志。

messages.msgid: A flag with a light blue field with four white five-pointed stars arranged in the diamond pattern in the center.
translations: 一面浅蓝基底上有四颗白色五角星的旗帜，五角星的中间围着钻石的图案。

messages.msgid: A vertical tricolor of blue, yellow and red charged with the coat of arms centered on the yellow band.
translations: 一面蓝黄红竖直三色旗帜，中间有盾徽图案。

messages.msgid: A horizontal bicolor flag of red and white.
translations: 一面红白水平双色旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a vertical triband of red and blue with a Soyombo symbol centered on the hoist-side of the red band.
translations: 一面红蓝红竖直三色条旗帜，靠旗杆侧红色条带中有一个索永布图案。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a red field surrounded by a golden border charged with the coat of arms at the center of a two headed eagle.
translations: 一面红色基底旗帜，边缘包裹金色边，中间有只双头鹰，体内有个盾徽图案。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a red field with a green pentagram, a five-pointed linear star.
translations: 一面中间有五角星的红底旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of yellow, green and red charged with a large white five pointed star at the center.
translations: 一面黄绿红水平三色条带旗帜，中间有一个白色五星。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a white edged red diagonal band radiating from the lower hoist side corner.  The upper triangle is blue, charged with a gold sun with rays and the lower triangle is green.
translations: 一面旗帜，白色包边的红色条带从旗杆侧底部沿对角线延伸到另一侧。上部分的三角是蓝色的，有散发光芒的金色太阳。下部分三角是绿色的。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a blue field with the thin yellow narrow horizontal stripe across in the center and the large white twelve pointed star on the bottom of the stripe and near the hoist side.
translations: 一面蓝底旗帜，有一个窄的黄色水平箭头穿过中心，旗杆侧底部靠近条带的地方有一颗十二角星。

messages.msgid: A unique looking flag of two juxtaposed triangular figures with a blue colored base and deep blue borders, there being a white emblem of the crescent moon with eight rays visible out of sixteen in the upper part and a white emblem of a twelve rayed sun in the lower part.
translations: 一面独特的旗帜，两个并列的三角形图形，底部是蓝色，边缘是深蓝色，上半部分是月牙形的白色标志，十六道光芒中有八道可见，下半部分是十二道太阳光芒的白色标志。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of red, white, and cobalt blue.
translations: 一面红白钴蓝三色水平条带旗帜。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a blue ensign with a Union Jack in the first quarter and four five-pointed red stars with white borders on the fly.
translations: 一面蓝色国旗，旗杆侧上部是英国国旗，右侧是四颗有白边的红色五角星。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of azure and white with the coat of arms centered on the white band.
translations: 一面海蓝与白色交错的三色旗，中间有一个国徽。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a horizontal triband of orange, white and green; charged with an orange circle in the center.
translations: 一面橙白绿三色水平条带旗帜，中间有一个橘色的圆。

messages.msgid: A flag that features a vertical bicolor triband of green, white and green.
translations: 一面绿白绿双色三道旗。
