messages.msgid: A pair of white beekeeping gloves made out of smooth leather.
translations: 一副由光滑皮革制成的白色养蜂手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of big, red, 8 oz. boxing gloves made from thick leather.
translations: 一对又红又大的8盎司拳击手套。它们是用厚皮革制成的。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized chainmail gloves that fully enclose the hands.  The metal shows signs of rust and corrosion.
translations: 一副经过特别定制的完全覆盖了双手的锁环手套。金属有生锈和腐蚀的迹象。

messages.msgid: pair of mild steel chainmail gloves
messages.plural: pairs of mild steel chainmail gloves

messages.msgid: A pair of customized steel chainmail gloves that fully enclose the hands.
translations: 一双自制的完全覆盖双手的钢链甲手套。

messages.msgid: pair of medium steel chainmail gloves
messages.plural: pairs of medium steel chainmail gloves

messages.msgid: pair of high steel chainmail gloves
messages.plural: pairs of high steel chainmail gloves

messages.msgid: pair of hardened steel chainmail gloves
translations: 锁环手套（硬化碳钢碳钢）
messages.plural: pairs of hardened steel chainmail gloves

messages.msgid: pair of tempered steel chainmail gloves
messages.plural: pairs of tempered steel chainmail gloves

messages.msgid: A heavy pair of gloves, used by firefighters and metalworkers for heat protection.
translations: 一副沉重的、供消防员与锻工使用的隔热手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of gauntlets made from the exoskeletons of insects.
translations: 一对由昆虫甲壳制成的护手。

messages.msgid: A pair of gauntlets crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Acid-resistant but brittle.
translations: 一对由经过精心清理并裁剪过的酸蚁硅化甲壳制成的护手，防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: A pair of well-made black stretch vinyl gloves, with black steel claws connected to the fingers.  Used in BDSM performances or as part of a costume.
translations: 一副制作精良的黑色弹性塑料手套，手指上安装着黑色的钢爪。通常用于BDSM表演或作为COS服装的一部分。

messages.msgid: A single suede glove with a sturdy cotton wrist, padded back, and well-fitting fingers.
translations: 一只单面绒面手套，有着结实的棉制手腕，带衬垫的手背和合身的指套。

messages.msgid: A single suede glove with a sturdy cotton wrist, padded back, and well-fitting fingers.  This one is left-handed.
translations: 一只单面绒面手套，有着结实的棉制手腕，带衬垫的手背和合身的指套。这只是左手用的。

messages.msgid: A pair of heavy fingerless leather gloves.
translations: 一对沉重的无指皮革手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of disposable plastic bags, adapted to be used as gloves.
translations: 一副用可回收塑料袋稍加修改制成的手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of leather gloves without fingers.
pair of armored fingerless leather gloves
messages.plural: pairs of armored fingerless leather gloves

messages.msgid: A pair of leather gloves without fingers.  These have been crudely reinforced with steel guards across the back.
translations: 一对无指皮革手套。手背部位用钢片加强了防护。

messages.msgid: A pair of small sheets of metal, one attached to the back of the hand, and one tied to the back of your fingers, leaving the index finger untied for trigger pulling.  Your handwriting will suffer, but they'll keep your fingers attached.
translations: 两组小金属片，每组有一片贴在手背上，一片绑在手指背上，为了能扣动扳机，食指没有绑住。穿上它会让你的字迹歪歪扭扭，但起码可以让手指还连接在你身上。

messages.msgid: pair of hardened steel sheet metal gauntlets
messages.plural: pairs of hardened steel sheet metal gauntlets

messages.msgid: These crude mitten gauntlets have been hardened to keep the zombie dogs from biting your fingers off.
translations: 这副粗制的护手已经过表面硬化处理，可以防止丧尸狗狗咬掉你的手指。

messages.msgid: A pair of warm fur gloves.
translations: 一对十分保暖的毛皮手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of warm faux fur gloves.
A single white glove covered with hundreds of rhinestones.
translations: 一双镶满数百颗莱茵石的白色手套。

messages.msgid: A thin pair of black leather gloves.
translations: 一双轻薄的黑色皮手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of denim gloves.  Not very comfortable but slightly warmer and more sturdier than ones that would be made from cotton.
translations: 一双牛仔布手套。虽然不是很舒适，但比棉质手套稍微暖和，也更加坚固一些。

messages.msgid: A pair of fingerless denim gloves.  Much less cumbersome this way, but not as protective or warm.
translations: 一双无指牛仔布手套。这种设计更加方便手指活动，但保护和保暖效果欠佳。
一双棉手套，提供基础的手部保暖与防护。

messages.msgid: A pair of thin cotton gloves.  Often used as a liner beneath other gloves.
translations: 一双薄的棉手套，通常作为内衬穿戴在其他手部装备里。

messages.msgid: A pair of thin latex gloves, designed to limit the spread of disease.  Too fragile to protect you from much else.
translations: 一双轻薄的橡胶手套，能够隔绝病原体，降低疾病传染几率。除此之外，它过于脆弱，完全无法保护你免受其它伤害。

messages.msgid: A pair of black cotton gloves.
An extremely heavy set of armor-plated leather gloves.
translations: 一副十分沉重并加装了多块装甲片的皮革手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of rubber gloves, often used while cleaning with caustic materials.
translations: 一双橡胶手套，常用在需要接触腐蚀性物质的场合。

messages.msgid: A pair of flame- and cut-resistant aramid fabric gloves.  Commonly used by police and military units.
translations: 一双凯夫拉防割战术手套。通常供警察或军人使用。

messages.msgid: A pair of padded cotton gloves.  Toasty!
translations: 一双加了棉布内衬的手套。暖烘烘的！

messages.msgid: A warm pair of wool gloves.
translations: 一双十分保暖的羊毛手套。

messages.msgid: A warm pair of wool gloves without fingers.  Less encumbering, but provides significantly less warmth.
translations: 一双温暖的羊毛无指手套，有着更少的累赘度，但是提供的温暖也显著减少。

messages.msgid: A tough pair of gloves, for tough everyday work.
translations: 一双坚固耐用的手套，供日常干粗活时使用。

messages.msgid: A pair of cut-resistant gloves, useful for butchery or routine work with bladed objects.
translations: 一双防切割的手套，用于屠宰以及使用锋利物品时的防护。

messages.msgid: Long pieces of cloth that are meant to be wrapped around your hands.  They provide small amounts of protection while punching and performing other general mischief.
translations: 一条长长的绑在手部、提供稍许防护与其他用途的棉布条。

messages.msgid: Pieces of animal pelt that are meant to be wrapped around your hands.  They provide small amounts of protection while punching and performing other general mischief.
translations: 一条长长的绑在手部的毛皮条，在进行拳击或其他用途时提供些许防护。

messages.msgid: Pieces of leather that are meant to be wrapped around your hands.  They provide small amounts of protection while punching and performing other general mischief.
translations: 一条长长的绑在手部的皮革条，在进行拳击或其他用途时提供些许防护。

messages.msgid: Long pieces of wool that are meant to be wrapped around your hands.  They provide small amounts of protection while punching and performing other general mischief.
translations: 一条长长的绑在手部的羊毛条，在进行拳击或其他用途时提供些许防护。

messages.msgid: pair of extra long white gloves
messages.plural: pairs of extra long white gloves

translations: 一双长长的白色戏剧手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of warm but cumbersome mittens.
translations: 一双相当保暖的但十分累赘的连指手套。

messages.msgid: A snug-fitting pair of gloves made from thin and lightweight Nomex fabric.
translations: 一双由轻薄的芳纶织物制成的贴身手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of red gloves with white faux fur trim.  Keeps your hands warm and your holiday spirit bright.
translations: 一双装饰着白色人造毛皮的红色手套。让你的手更暖，节日气氛更热烈。

messages.msgid: A pair of improvised gloves made from socks with holes poked through them.
translations: 一双自制的简易手套，袜子前端开了个洞让手指能够露出来。

messages.msgid: A pair of improvised gloves made from wool socks with holes poked through them.
translations: 一双自制的简易手套，羊毛袜子前端开了个洞让手指能够露出来。

messages.msgid: A pair of improvised gloves made from Nomex socks with holes poked through them.
translations: 一双自制的简易手套，芳纶袜子前端开了个洞让手指能够露出来。

messages.msgid: Long cotton tubes sized to fit over tentacles and help protect them from the cold.
translations: 一双大小足以容下任何触手的管状长袖套，保暖效果很棒。

messages.msgid: A pair of padded gloves.  Favored by the military.
translations: 一对有衬垫的手套，深受军队欢迎。

messages.msgid: A pair of white costume gloves made out of cotton.
translations: 一副由棉花制成的白色手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of black costume gloves with a skeletal hand pattern printed on them.
translations: 一双印着骷髅手图案的黑色COS服装手套。

messages.msgid: A thin pair of black leather golfing gloves.
translations: 一双轻薄的黑色皮制高尔夫球手套。

messages.msgid: A pair of fragmentation resistant pads for wearing over the backs of one's hands, providing protection from shrapnel in case things go wrong.  Sold as an accessory for explosive ordnance disposal suits, but not often used due to the difficulty in armoring the entire hand and retaining dexterity.
translations: 一对防爆衬垫，戴在手背上，提供弹片防护。作为爆炸物处理服的配件出售，但由于对整只手的防护性与灵活性不能兼顾，较少被人使用。

messages.msgid: A pair of leather gloves with chainmail protecting the fingers and palm, and plating over the back of the hand and wrist.
translations: 一对皮革手套，用锁环保护手指和手掌，用板甲保护手背和手腕。

messages.msgid: pair of mild steel mitten gauntlets
messages.plural: pairs of mild steel mitten gauntlets

messages.msgid: A pair of leather mittens with chainmail protecting the fingers and palm, and steel plating over the back of the hand, fingers, and wrist for additional protection.
translations: 一对皮革手套，用锁环保护手指和手掌，用板甲保护手部，指背和手腕。

messages.msgid: pair of medium steel mitten gauntlets
messages.plural: pairs of medium steel mitten gauntlets

messages.msgid: pair of high steel mitten gauntlets
messages.plural: pairs of high steel mitten gauntlets

messages.msgid: pair of hardened steel mitten gauntlets
messages.plural: pairs of hardened steel mitten gauntlets

messages.msgid: pair of tempered steel mitten gauntlets
messages.plural: pairs of tempered steel mitten gauntlets

messages.msgid: A pair of fingerless gloves with hard plastic reinforcing the backs of the hands to protect against BB pellets and other light projectiles.
translations: 一对无指手套，手背上有硬塑料加固，可以防止BB弹和其他轻型弹丸的伤害。

messages.msgid: These may not be the Great Plains, but you can still be the Boss with this high-crowned, wide-brimmed hat.
translations: 一顶宽边高顶的大檐牛仔帽。虽然这里不是北美大平原，但戴上它仍看起来像个Boss。

messages.msgid: A cotton bandana, worn over the head.
translations: 一条可以覆盖住头部的棉制方巾。

messages.msgid: You adjust the %s to cover your mouth.
translations: 你调整 %s 来覆盖嘴部。

messages.msgid: A soft cotton hat.  Commonly worn by armed forces and existentialists.
translations: 一顶柔软的棉制无檐军帽。通常被由各类武装部队或意大利存在主义者穿戴。

messages.msgid: A soft wool hat.  Commonly worn by armed forces and existentialists.
translations: 一顶柔软的羊毛无檐军帽。通常被由各类武装部队或意大利存在主义者穿戴。

messages.msgid: The only hat for a made man.  Look like a real good fella while laughing in the face of your foes!
translations: 帮派成员才配戴的帽子。戴上它，面对敌人也能从容大笑，活像个地道的狠角色。

messages.msgid: A wreath headdress made from plant material woven into a ring.
translations: 一种由植物材料制成的环状头饰。

messages.msgid: Whether yer hunting varmints, fixing up the ranch, or heading into the sunset, this is the hat for the job.
translations: 不管你是去打猎、打理农场，还是踏上远行，这顶帽子都很合适。

messages.msgid: This hat has traded its original classic looks for a red, white, and blue pattern with a band of golden stars embossed about its lip; suitable headwear for only the most serious of patriots.
translations: 这顶帽子有着最经典的红白蓝图案样式，上部嵌着一颗闪闪发亮的金星。"很适合刻板印象的美国红脖子佩戴"

messages.msgid: An improvised harness that can be worn over other headgear or by itself, made from two small liquid containers, a rubber hose, a bundle of steel wire, and some cordage.  A convenient and simple device for hands-free drinking, though it's not watertight and would spill if you put it into your backpack.
translations: 这套简单的自制装置由两个小型容器、一根塑胶管、一捆铁线和一些绳索制成，戴在头上之后不需要用手就可以方便地喝水。不过，如果你把它放进背包，里面的水就会洒掉。

messages.msgid: A high, black cap with a very narrow top.  Traditionally worn by Shinto priests.
translations: 一顶通常由神道教的祭司穿戴的黑色尖顶高帽。

messages.msgid: Also known as a utility cover or utility cap, this is an eight pointed hat with a baseball-style visor at the front.  Commonly worn by Marines and sailors, this hat is the standard headwear of both the United States Marine Corps and Navy.
translations: 也被称为工作帽或作训帽，这是一顶八角帽，前面有棒球风格的帽舌。这顶帽子常见于海军陆战队和水手，是美国海军陆战队和海军的标准头饰。

messages.msgid: A simple round cap in a camouflage pattern.  Often used by the military when helmets aren't needed.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.
translations: 一种有迷彩图案的简单圆帽。经常在军中用于不需要头盔的场合。它的边沿可以为你的眼睛遮阳。

messages.msgid: Also called a "bucket hat." Often used in the military.  Its wide brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.
translations: 也叫“渔夫帽”。常用于军队。宽大的帽檐有助于遮挡阳光，避免刺眼。

messages.msgid: A cotton cap with a rounded crown, an adjustable strap, and a long visor.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.  Traditionally worn by baseball players.
translations: 一顶圆顶棉帽，有条可调节的带子和长长的帽舌。它能保护你的眼睛不受阳光直射，而且也能稍微保暖。通常由棒球运动员穿戴。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the logo of a local baseball team.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶印着当地棒球队队标的按扣棒球帽。它能保护你的眼睛不受阳光直射，而且也能稍微保暖。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the logo of a local football team.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶印着当地橄榄球队队标的按扣棒球帽。它能保护你的眼睛不受阳光直射，而且也能稍微保暖。

messages.msgid: A snapback golden-colored baseball cap displaying a golden dollar sign symbol at the front.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.  Makes you fell like a rapper.
translations: 一顶金色的按扣式棒球帽，前面有一个金色的美元符号图案。它能保护你的眼睛避免阳光直射，同时提供一点点保暖效果，更让你感觉自己像是一名说唱歌手。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the shape of a single pine tree at the front.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶按扣式棒球帽，前面有一棵孤零零的松树图案。它能保护你的眼睛避免阳光直射，同时提供一点点保暖效果。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the phrase 'Got Sorcery?', colored white in a cosmos black background.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶按扣式棒球帽，上面印有“Got Sorcery？”的字样，字体为白色，背景为宇宙黑色。它能保护你的眼睛避免阳光直射，同时提供一点点保暖效果。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the white-colored shape of a diamond in the front.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶按扣式棒球帽，前面展示着白色的钻石形状。它能保护你的眼睛避免阳光直射，同时提供一点点保暖效果。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the image of bloodpack connected to a drop of blood in the front, and under that image, a text that reads: 'Donating Blood', in white, and 'Save Lives' in red.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶按扣式棒球帽，正面画着一个血袋连接到一滴血的图案，图案下方写着：白色的“献血”和红色的“拯救生命”字样。它能保护你的眼睛不受阳光直射，而且也能稍微保暖。

messages.msgid: A beige colored snapback baseball cap displaying the FEMA acronym, which denotes for the Federal Emergency Management Agency, in the front, and the official seal of the Federal Emergency Management Agency in the right side.  Commonly used by the government organization employees and volunteers.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶米色的按扣式棒球帽，在前面印有FEMA（联邦紧急事务管理局）的首字母缩略词，棒球帽右侧展示着联邦紧急事务管理局的官方印章。这款帽子通常由政府机构的员工和志愿者使用。它能保护你的眼睛避免阳光直射，同时提供一点点保暖效果。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the detailed image of a round Planet Earth right at the front.  The whole cap is black, with some white dots around, making the background looks like outer space.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶按扣式棒球帽，前面印有一个细致的地球图像。整个帽子是黑色的，周围有一些白色点，使背景看起来像外太空。它能保护你的眼睛避免阳光直射，同时提供一点点保暖效果

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the image of a flat, disk-like Earth, with the dome right above it, showing the sun illuminating one half of Flat Earth, and the moon, illuminating the night with moonlight (which is reflected light from the sun) on the other half, and besides it, a text that reads: 'Earth is Flat!'.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶反扣式棒球帽，展示了一个扁平、圆盘状的地球图像，正上方是穹顶，太阳照亮了扁平地球的一半，另一半是月亮，月光（就是来自太阳的反射光）照亮了夜晚，除此之外，还有一段文字：“地球是平的！”。它为你的眼睛遮挡阳光，并提供一丝温暖。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the green icon of a leaf in the front, and a text on the top of it reading 'Go Vegan!'.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶按扣式的棒球帽，正面有一片叶子状的绿色圣像，顶部写着“去吃素食！” 它可以保护你的眼睛免受阳光照射，并提供一点点保暖效果。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the pinkish icon of a slice of bacon in the front, and a text on the top of it reading 'Bacon is Life!'.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶按扣式的棒球帽，前面显有一片浅粉色的培根状圣像。图案顶上的文本写着“培根就是生活！”它可以保护你的眼睛免受阳光直射，并提供一点点保暖效果。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the green icon of the well known symbol of biohazard and biological danger in the front, and a text reading 'Warning: Biohazard'.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶按扣式的棒球帽，前面绘制有广为人知的绿色生物学危害和危险标识章，其上文本为“警告：生物危害”。它可以保护你的眼睛免受阳光直射，并提供一点点保暖效果。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap embossed with the pattern of the flag of the United States of America.  It shields your eyes from the sun, provides a little bit of warmth and also makes you feel like a real patriot.
translations: 一顶按扣棒球帽，上面用拷花做出了美国国旗的图案。它能保护你的眼睛不受阳光直射，而且也能稍微保暖。戴上它会让人感觉是个爱国者。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the logo of a popular soccer team.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶印着知名足球队队标的按扣棒球帽。它能保护你的眼睛不受阳光直射，而且也能稍微保暖。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the logo of a popular basketball team.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶印着知名篮球队队标的按扣棒球帽。它能保护你的眼睛不受阳光直射，而且也能稍微保暖。

messages.msgid: A snapback baseball cap displaying the logo of a popular hockey team.  It shields your eyes from the sun and provides a little bit of warmth.
translations: 一顶印着知名曲棍球队队标的按扣棒球帽。它能保护你的眼睛不受阳光直射，而且也能稍微保暖。

messages.msgid: A cotton cap with a broad front and a plastic mesh at the back, allowing better air circulation.  The trucker hat came about in it's true form in the early 1970's as a promotional give-away from US feed or farming supply companies to farmers, truck drivers (hence the name) and other rural workers.  It is perfect for keeping your head cool and the sun out of your eyes.
translations: 一个正面有宽大的帽檐、背面有塑料透气网的棉制帽子。司机帽出现于 1970 年代，由美国饲料和农用物资公司作为宣传礼物送给农民、货车司机和其它农村工人，这也是司机帽名称的来由。是保持头部凉爽和防止阳光刺眼的不二之选。

messages.msgid: A deep blue snapback baseball cap with "FBI" embroidered across the front in blocky, yet imposing yellow lettering.  Although very much illegal to impersonate a government official, most zombies tend to let it slide.  It shades your eyes from the sun, provides a little warmth, and makes you feel like an operator.
translations: 一顶深蓝色按扣式棒球帽，正面用粗犷而醒目的黄色字体绣着“FBI”字样。虽然冒充政府官员是严重的违法行为，但大多数丧尸并不在意。它可以遮挡阳光，提供少量保暖，并让你感觉像个特工。

messages.msgid: A traditional chef's hat, standing tall and proud against the vulgarities of the world.
translations: 一定传统的厨师帽，高耸而骄傲地对抗着尘世的凡俗。

messages.msgid: A snug-fitting cotton hat.  Quite warm.
translations: 一顶贴身的棉帽。保暖效果比较好。

messages.msgid: A hat made from the pelts of animals.  Extremely warm.
translations: 一顶由动物毛皮制成的帽子。保暖效果非常好。

messages.msgid: A stylish hat made of faux fur.  Like real fur, but without the suffering, if the tag is to be believed.  Very warm.
translations: 一顶用人造毛皮制成的时髦帽子。像真正的毛皮，如果真如标签所说的话，制造过程不会杀害野生动物。十分保暖。

messages.msgid: A hard plastic hat worn at construction and industrial sites.  Provides excellent protection from cuts and percussion.
translations: 一顶供工地或工厂的工人穿戴的硬塑料帽，能有效提供头部对斩击与钝击的保护。

messages.msgid: It's colored yellow, commonly used by general, unspecialized workers like laborers and operators of heavy machinery.
translations: 它是黄色的，通常由一般的，非特定专业的工人使用，例如普通劳工和重型机械操作员。

messages.msgid: It's colored orange, commonly used by road construction workers, new hires, and site visitors.
translations: 它是橙色的，通常由筑路工人、新进员工或现场访客使用。

messages.msgid: It's colored white, commonly used by anyone in a supervisory position, including managers, architects, engineers, and foremen.
translations: 它是白色的，通常由管理人员使用，包括经理、建筑师、工程师和工头。

messages.msgid: It's colored brown, commonly used by workers using applications involving high heat such as welders.
translations: 它是棕色的，通常由涉及高温操作的工人使用，例如焊工。

messages.msgid: It's colored blue, commonly used by medical workers and electricians, as well as employees in a technical advisory role.
translations: 它是蓝色的，通常由医务人员、电工以及担任技术顾问的员工使用。

messages.msgid: It's colored green, commonly used by safety officers and inspectors.
translations: 它是绿色的，通常由安保或监察人员使用。

messages.msgid: It's colored red, commonly used by emergency workers and firefighters.
translations: 它是红色的，通常由急救工人和消防人员使用。

messages.msgid: It's colored pink, commonly issued as a punishment to workers that forgot or lost their hard hat.  Or maybe the previous owner just liked pink.
translations: 它是粉红色的，通常用作对忘记或丢失安全帽的普通工人的惩罚。或者它上一个主人就喜欢粉色。

messages.msgid: It's colored gray, commonly used by visitors to any worksite.
translations: 它是灰色的，通常被工地上的访客使用。

messages.msgid: It's colored black, like the first real hard hats in history.
translations: 它是黑色的，跟历史上第一顶真正的安全帽一个颜色。

messages.msgid: It has cartoon character stickers all over it.
translations: 它贴满了卡通人物贴纸。

messages.msgid: It's colored white and has skull decorations.
translations: 它是白色的，印着骷髅装饰。

messages.msgid: It's decorated with an American flag pattern.  Protects your head with the power of freedom.
translations: 上面印着星条旗的图样。靠自由的力量保护你的脑袋。

messages.msgid: It's colored black, with industrial gear decorations and a steampunk design.
translations: 它是黑色的，带有工业齿轮装饰和蒸汽朋克设计。

messages.msgid: Pocket for a face shield or a shield visor.
Pocket for a strapped mandible guard.

A hard plastic hat worn at construction and industrial sites, with a sun shield tucked on top to keep the glare out of your eyes.  Protects your eyes from the harsh sun, although it makes ear muffs unattachable to the hard hat itself.
translations: 一顶在建筑工地与工业现场佩戴的硬塑料安全帽，顶部附有遮阳板，以防强光刺眼。虽能有效防护烈日对双眼的伤害，却使得耳罩无法直接固定于安全帽上。

messages.msgid: It's colored pink, commonly issued as a punishment to regular workers that forgot or lost their hard hat.  Or maybe the previous owner just liked pink.
translations: 它是粉红色的，通常用作对忘记或丢失安全帽的普通工人的惩罚。或者它上一个主人就喜欢粉色。

messages.msgid: A red plaid hunting cap with ear flaps.  Notably warm.
translations: 一顶扁扁的、两侧有御寒耳罩的毛毡制猎帽，非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A snug-fitting wool hat.  Very warm.
translations: 一顶贴身的羊毛帽。保暖效果非常好。

messages.msgid: A slouching wool cap with a short front brim, traditionally associated with newspaper delivery boys.  Quite warm.
translations: 一顶松垮的羊毛帽，前方有短帽檐，传统上常与送报童联系在一起。相当保暖。

messages.msgid: Padding over your ears, kept in place by some string.  Blocks incoming sounds.
translations: 一个用来隔绝外界噪音的头戴式耳罩。

messages.msgid: An orange felt sombrero with traditional white and yellow hand stitching.  The wide brim keeps the sun out of your eyes, and a thin strap hooks around your chin.
translations: 一顶橙色的墨西哥毛毡宽边帽，装饰着传统白黄相间的手工刺绣图案。宽大的帽檐能够保护你的眼睛不受阳光直射，同时还有一条细细的绑带钩住你的下巴。

messages.msgid: A thin, rounded skullcap.  A traditional headdress in Judaism.
translations: 一顶轻薄的圆形无边便帽，是犹太教教徒的传统服饰。

messages.msgid: A small, crimson skullcap.  Traditionally worn by Catholic priests.
translations: 一顶较小的深红色无檐帽。一般是天主教神父常戴着它。

messages.msgid: A brimless, short and rounded cap.
translations: 一个短短的圆圆的无沿小帽子，是流行于西北非、中东等地的男性用帽，也同时在非洲裔男性中被广泛使用。
一个有着白色镶边的头饰。

messages.msgid: A flat-topped hat with circular indent and a narrow brim.  Most popular in the 40s and 50s, still common among those in the mod scene, hipsters, and people named Heisenberg.
translations: 一顶有着圆形凹槽和狭窄帽檐的平顶帽。在上世纪四五十年代很流行，现在仍然常在摩德文化客，嬉皮士以及被叫做"海森堡"的那家伙头上见到。（注：《绝命毒师》）

messages.msgid: A traditional mail carrier's cap, with the US postal service logo embroidered on the front above the plastic brim.  A symbol of a bygone world.
translations: 一顶塑料帽檐上方印着美国邮政服务标志、传统样式的邮差帽。

messages.msgid: A red hat with white faux fur trim, commonly used by bearded men on Christmas.
translations: 一顶装饰着白色人造毛皮的红色帽子，常被那个在圣诞节出现的长胡子男人使用。

messages.msgid: A hat woven out of straw.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.
translations: 一顶由麦秸或其他坚韧植物编织而成的帽子，宽大的帽檐能够保护你的眼睛不受太阳直射。

messages.msgid: A sheet of aluminum foil that has been molded into a form-fitting hat.  Perfect for protecting yourself from the government, Illuminati, aliens, and THEM.
translations: 用一块铝箔纸折叠而成的一顶合身的帽子。保护你免受来自政府、神棍、外星人，还有"他们"对你的伤害。

messages.msgid: The only hat for a gentleman.  Look exquisite while laughing in the face of danger!
translations: 绅士的唯一选择。戴上它，直面危险也能从容大笑，显得格外考究。

messages.msgid: A classic design, the "tricorne", or three-cornered hat, simply pins a large and floppy brim out of the way, though this example adds well-embroidered designs and is oiled against water.  Whether you're the "guvnah" of a settlement, or the captain of a post-apocalyptic crew, this is the hat for you.
translations: 一顶经典设计的三角帽。帽檐做了防水设计，是以前加勒比一带海盗船长的标准装备。无论你是聚居地的“头儿”，还是一支灾变后队伍的船长，这顶帽子都很适合你。

messages.msgid: Cloth wound around the head, worn by people of many cultures worldwide.  Some historical examples could be huge and ostentatious, but this one is a very simple design.
translations: 一条缠在头上的布，世界各地各种文化的人都会穿着。历史上某些范例能弄得十分巨大或华丽，但这条款式非常简单。

messages.msgid: You're not actually sure if this is called a golf cap, but it's the stereotypical cap golfers wear.
translations: 你不确定这顶帽子是不是该被叫做高尔夫球帽，但这是高尔夫球手们经常戴着的球帽。

messages.msgid: A blue pointed hat with stars stitched into it.  Wearing it makes you feel like a powerful wizard.
translations: 一顶镶有许多星星的蓝色尖顶帽。戴上它会让你感觉自己像个强大的法师。

messages.msgid: A pointed hat suitable for a witch.
translations: 一顶适合女巫戴的尖顶帽。

messages.msgid: A headscarf worn by Muslim women which covers most of the head, leaving the face visible.
translations: 穆斯林妇女戴的一种头巾，能遮住头部的大部分，只露出脸。

messages.msgid: A veil worn by Muslim women which covers the face, leaving the eyes visible.
translations: 穆斯林妇女戴的一种面纱，遮住面部，只露出眼睛。

messages.msgid: A pair of ear muffs attachable to a hard hat or helmet to reduce noise exposures to safe levels.  Activate to put ear muffs into a working position, blocking most sounds.
translations: 一对可安装在硬帽或头盔上的耳罩，可将噪声暴露降低到安全水平。激活它来使耳罩进入工作状态，阻挡大部分声音。

messages.msgid: You put the ear muffs tightly to your ears.
translations: 你将耳罩紧紧地压在了耳朵上。

messages.msgid: A pair of ear muffs attachable to a hard hat or helmet to reduce noise exposures to safe levels.  Activate to put ear muffs into a standby position, letting you clearly hear again.
translations: 一对可附加在安全帽或头盔上的耳罩，可将噪声暴露降低到安全水平。激活它来移开耳罩，让你再次清晰地听到声音。

messages.msgid: You put the ear muffs away from your ears.
A ballistic jaw guard designed to be attached on a military helmet, but easily adjustable to helmets with any kind of rail system installed.
translations: 一个下颌防护装置，原本设计用于安装在军用头盔上，但可轻松调节以适配各种带滑轨的头盔。

messages.msgid: A plastic jaw guard designed to be strapped to any common hard hat or helmet, it was probably part of some costume before the world ended.
translations: 一个塑料护颌，可以绑在任何常见的安全帽或头盔上，它可能是世界末日之前某些服装的一部分。

messages.msgid: A common plastic chin guard designed to be attached to the straps of any common hard hat or helmet.
translations: 一个普通的塑料下巴护具，可以安装在任何常见安全帽或头盔的带子上。

messages.msgid: A counterweight pouch attachable to the back of a hard hat or helmet to balance the weight on your head.  You can store batteries or some other very small items in it.
translations: 一个配重袋，可安装在安全帽或头盔的后部，以平衡头部的重量。你也可以在其中存放电池，或其他一些非常小的物品。

messages.msgid: A common sun shield intended to be put over a hard hat to protect the user from the sun.
translations: 一种常见的防晒面罩，用于戴在安全帽上，以保护用户免受阳光照射。

messages.msgid: A common shield visor intended to be attached on a hard hat or helmet.
translations: 一个普通的防护面罩，可以安装在安全帽或头盔上。

messages.msgid: A thermoplastic face shield with a mounting bracket intended to be attached over a hard hat or helmet.
translations: 一个带有安装支架的热塑性面罩，可以安装在安全帽或头盔上。

messages.msgid: A thick polycarbonate and plexiglass face shield with a mounting bracket intended to be attached to a ballistic helmet for protection from blast and fragmentation in 'non-permissive environments'.
translations: 一个带安装支架的厚聚碳酸酯和有机玻璃面罩，用于安装在防弹头盔上，在“非许可环境”中提供对爆炸和碎片的防护。

messages.msgid: A plastic face shield with a mounting bracket intended to be attached over a hard hat or helmet.  It doesn't protects you as much as one made from thermoplastic, but it's cheaper and more common.
translations: 一个带有安装支架的塑料面罩，可以安装在安全帽或头盔上。它的保护效果不如热塑面罩，但更便宜而且更常见。

messages.msgid: Last generation double-tube night vision device, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  Currently raised up and out of the way.
translations: 最新款的双筒夜视仪，设计用于安装在兼容的头盔上。现在已经抬起，不会阻挡视线。

messages.msgid: Last generation single-tube night vision device, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  Limited field of view while activated.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 最新款的单筒夜视仪，设计用于安装在兼容的头盔上。激活时视野受限。当前已经开启，并持续消耗电量。激活它以关闭。

messages.msgid: Advanced GPNVG with four image intensifier tubes, allowing for a large field of view at night, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  Currently raised up and out of the way.
translations: 先进的四筒(GPNVG)夜视仪，配备四个图像增强管，能在夜间提供更多的视野，设计用于安装在兼容的头盔上。现在已经抬起，不会阻挡视线。

messages.msgid: Advanced GPNVG with four image intensifier tubes, allowing for a large field of view at night, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 先进的四筒(GPNVG)夜视仪，配备四个图像增强管，能在夜间提供更多的视野，设计用于安装在兼容的头盔上。当前已经开启，并持续消耗电量。激活它以关闭。

messages.msgid: New and rare high-resolution thermal NVG device, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  Lets you see in the dark, and detects heat signatures emitted by (un)living organisms.  Currently raised up and out of the way.
translations: 全新罕见的高分辨率热成像夜视设备，设计用于安装在兼容的头盔上。让你在黑暗中也能看见，并能检测到（非）生物体发出的热信号。现在已经抬起，不会阻挡视线。

messages.msgid: New and rare high-resolution thermal NVG device, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  Lets you see in the dark, and detects heat signatures emitted by (un)living organisms.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 全新罕见的高分辨率热成像夜视设备，设计用于安装在兼容的头盔上。让你在黑暗中也能看见，并能检测到（非）生物体发出的热信号。当前已经开启，并持续消耗电量。激活它以关闭。

messages.msgid: A common nape protector intended to be attached on a hard hat or helmet to protect against the sun and dust.
translations: 一种常见的颈背保护装置，用于安装在安全帽或头盔上，以防止阳光和灰尘。

messages.msgid: A common mesh nape protector intended to be attached on a hard hat or helmet to protect against the sun while letting the cold wind refresh your nape.
translations: 一种常见的颈背保护装置，用于安装在安全帽或头盔上，在遮蔽阳光的同时让凉风能吹到你的后颈。

messages.msgid: A custom-made Kevlar strengthened nape protector intended to be attached on a hard hat or helmet to protect your nape against cuts and slashing attacks.
translations: 一种定制的凯夫拉加强型颈背保护装置，用于安装在安全帽或头盔上，以保护颈背免受割伤和砍伤。

messages.msgid: A wide chainmail ring designed to attach to a cap helmet, hanging down to extend protection to the face and neck.
translations: 一件宽大的链甲，被设计为可以在其上连接头盔，两侧可以垂下来保护头颈。

messages.msgid: A wide chainmail draping designed to attach to a cap helmet, hanging down to extend protection to the face, neck and shoulders.
translations: 一件宽大的锁环垂甲，设计使上面可以连接头盔，两侧链甲部分可以垂下来保护头部、颈部以及肩部。

messages.msgid: A metal face mask designed to attach to a cap helmet to protect the lower half.  This is a crude, dull facsimile of the original masterpieces made of mild steel.
translations: 一种金属面罩，设计用于固定在有帽头盔上以保护脸的下半部分。这个面罩是由低碳钢制成的粗糙、哑光的复制品。

messages.msgid: A metal face mask designed to attach to a cap helmet to protect the lower half.  This one is made of medium steel, and at least has some ornamentation, but not much.
translations: 一种金属面罩，设计用于固定在有帽头盔上以保护脸的下半部分。这个面罩是由中碳钢制成的，有一些装饰，但不多。

messages.msgid: A metal face mask designed to attach to a cap helmet to protect the lower half.  This one is made of high steel, and you've got it with a fancy mustache and everything.
translations: 一种金属面罩，设计用于固定在有帽头盔上以保护脸的下半部分。这个面罩是由高碳钢制成的，拥有一个漂亮的胡子样花纹和其他装饰。

messages.msgid: A metal face mask designed to attach to a cap helmet to protect the lower half.  This one is made of tempered steel with gold inlays and a setting for a gemstone.  This isn't just surviving the apocalypse, this is about living truly apocalypse fancy.
translations: 一种金属面罩，设计用于固定在有帽头盔上以保护脸的下半部分。这个面罩是由回火碳钢制成的，上面有镶有黄金和宝石。仅仅在世界末日中幸存下来是不够的，而是要活出真正的幻想中的末日。

messages.msgid: A metal face mask designed to attach to a cap helmet to protect the lower half.  This one is made of hardened steel with fancy gold inlays, who says armor can't be stylish!
translations: 一种金属面罩，设计用于固定在有帽头盔上以保护脸的下半部分。这个面罩是由硬化碳钢制成的，上面镶嵌有精美的黄金，谁说盔甲不能时尚！

messages.msgid: A simple and flexible transparent lens of plastic that clips into place over a panoramic gas mask's solitary eyepiece, providing extra protection from scratches, abrasions, and ballistic threats.
translations: 一个简单灵活的塑料透明镜片，可夹紧固定于全景防毒面具的单眼观察窗上，为防毒面具额外提供划伤、磨损及弹道威胁的保护。

messages.msgid: A tinted and flexible plastic outsert intended to be mounted over the eyepiece of a panoramic-view gas mask to protect the wearer from high-level UV light, sudden flashes, and overly bright flares.
translations: 一种有色的柔性塑料外罩，用于安装在全景防毒面具的目镜上，以保护佩戴者免受高强度紫外线、突发闪光和照明弹的过亮伤害

messages.msgid: A specialized lens designed to clip into place over the solitary eyepiece of a panoramic gas mask, providing eye protection to users deploying a cutting torch while also improving impact resistance.
translations: 一款特制镜片，用于安装在全景防毒面具的单眼窗目镜上，为使用切割焊枪的人员提供强光防护，同时提供抗冲击保护。

messages.msgid: A detachable frame of prescription lenses intended for installation behind a panoramic gas mask's visor, providing an alternative vision-correcting solution to users with inherent eye issues rather than contact lenses.
translations: 一副可拆卸的处方镜片框，用于安装在全景防毒面具的面罩后，为有先天性眼部问题的佩戴者提供除隐形眼镜之外的另一种视力矫正方案。

messages.msgid: A helmet made from a soup pot.  It's not very good protection, but it's better than nothing.
translations: 用汤锅做成的头盔。防护效果不佳，但总比没有强。

messages.msgid: An enclosed helmet made from a stock pot with a 'T' crudely carved into the front and a blanket stuffed inside to cushion it.  There are strings tied to the handles to help fasten it to your body, but it's extremely limiting and smothering.
translations: 一个由汤锅制成的封闭式头盔，前面被粗略地刻出一个了"T"字，里面塞了一条毯子来做衬垫。锅把上系着绳子，以便能够绑在你身上，但穿起来十分受限，令人窒息。

messages.msgid: Lightweight sports headgear designed to protect the head while sparring.
translations: 一顶轻型格斗头盔，用来在拳击对练时保护选手头部。

messages.msgid: A heavy helmet that provides excellent protection from all sorts of damage.  It is labeled as the advanced combat helmet.
translations: 一顶沉重的头盔，能很好地保护你免受各种伤害。上面有个标记写着"先进作战头盔"。

messages.msgid: Pocket for a face shield, or a front night vision attachment.
A simple helmet meant to protect the head from fragmentation and impacts.  Its simple steel construction renders it outdated by modern military standards.
translations: 一种旨在保护头部免受碎片和冲击伤害的简单头盔。其简单的钢结构对于现代的军事标准来说已经过时了。

messages.msgid: A M1 combat helmet, famously worn by American soldiers in the Second World War as well as the Korean and Vietnam wars.  Inferior to modern helmets, but it still remains popular among guerrilla fighters, collectors and war re-enactors.
translations: M1战斗头盔，美国士兵在第二次世界大战以及朝鲜战争和越南战争中所佩戴的头盔。虽然不如现代头盔，但它在游击队战士、收藏家和战争爱好者中仍然很受欢迎。

messages.msgid: An old SSh-68 combat helmet from the Soviet Union, likely brought to The States by a collector or migrant.  It is designed to protect against shrapnel and some small arms and will do little to stop a rifle round.
translations: 来自苏联的一顶老旧的SSh-68战斗头盔，可能是由收藏家或移民带到美国的。它的设计是用来防护弹片和一些小口径武器，对步枪的子弹几乎没有作用。

messages.msgid: A Soviet era tanker helmet.  It's distinctive foam pads are meant to protect a tank driver from bumps against the cramped interior.
translations: 一顶苏联时代的坦克手头盔。其独特的泡沫垫设计旨在保护坦克驾驶员免受狭小车内碰撞带来的冲击。

messages.msgid: An all-encompassing black helmet that covers your entire face and neck, providing excellent protection from all sorts of damage.
translations: 一顶全覆盖式的黑色头盔，覆盖面部和颈部，保护你免受各种伤害。

messages.msgid: A lightweight black helmet that provides excellent protection from all sorts of damage.  It has a military rail system for attachments.
translations: 一顶轻型黑色头盔，能很好地保护你免受各种伤害。它有一套用于安装附件的军用导轨系统。

messages.msgid: Pocket for a rail-mounted mandible guard.
A distinctive helmet worn by firefighters.  More than just a piece of firefighting equipment, it serves as a badge of honor and respect.
translations: 消防员佩戴的标志性头盔。它不仅是消防装备的一部分，也象征着荣誉与敬意。

messages.msgid: A hard plastic helmet that covers the head and ears.  Designed to protect against a baseball to the head.
translations: 一顶坚硬的塑料头盔，覆盖了头部和耳朵。用来保护选手不被棒球直接命中头部。

messages.msgid: A hardwood Mesoamerican helmet that resembles the head of an eagle.  It was worn by the renowned eagle warriors of the Aztec, both ceremonially and for protection.  Its inside is lined with cotton, and it is ornamented with many feathers, carvings and colors.
translations: 一种形似鹰头的中美洲硬木头盔。由阿兹特克著名的鹰战士穿戴，用于仪式，也用于实战。盔内有棉花内衬，盔上有许多羽毛、雕刻和涂色。

messages.msgid: A medieval helmet that provides excellent protection for the head, with a Y shaped opening for the face.
translations: 一种中世纪头盔，能为头部提供出色的防护，面部开口呈 Y 字形。

messages.msgid: A thick foam helmet.  Designed to protect against concussion.
translations: 一顶厚实的泡沫塑料头盔。设计用来防止佩戴者摔出脑震荡。

messages.msgid: A helmet made from the exoskeletons of insects.  Covers the entire head; very light and durable.
translations: 一顶由昆虫甲壳制成的头盔，覆盖了整个头部。轻巧又耐用。

messages.msgid: A helmet made from the exoskeletons of insects.  Covers most of the head but leaves some space around the eyes and mouth open for breathability.  Very light and durable.
translations: 一顶由昆虫甲壳制成的头盔，覆盖了头部的大部分区域，在眼睛和嘴部周围留有空隙来方便透气。轻巧又耐用。

messages.msgid: A conical iron helm with additional protection for the neck, associated with the Mongol Empire.
translations: 一件锥形的铁制头盔，在颈部有额外的保护，源自蒙古帝国。

messages.msgid: A helmet crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Covers the whole head.  Acid-resistant but brittle.
translations: 一对由经过精心清理并裁剪过的酸蚁硅化甲壳制成的头盔，能覆盖你的整个头部，防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: A helmet crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Covers most of the head but leaves some space around the eyes and mouth open for breathability.  Acid-resistant but brittle.
translations: 一对由经过精心清理并裁剪过的酸蚁硅化甲壳制成的头盔，覆盖了头部的大部分区域，在眼睛和嘴部周围留有空隙来方便透气。防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: A heavy polycarbonate helmet normally worn by football players.  It comes with a visor to protect the eyes.
translations: 一个沉重的聚碳酸酯头盔，通常由足球运动员佩戴，有一个护目板来保护眼睛。

messages.msgid: An Imperial Roman helmet, with distinct projections protecting the sides of the head.
translations: 一顶罗马帝国头盔，有其独特的突出部以保护头部两侧。

messages.msgid: A medieval Japanese helmet with a scowling face mask that provides excellent protection to the entire head and face.
translations: 一顶日本武士中将领级别所装备的兜冑，可以为头部与面部提供出色的防御能力。

messages.msgid: A thick leather helmet that provides excellent protection for the head.
translations: 一顶厚实的皮头盔，提供了优秀的头部防护。

messages.msgid: The top part of a large wolf skull, equipped with leather straps to secure it on your head.  Every inch of the skull has been carved with a maze of fine, intertwined symbols that make your eyes water.
translations: 一个非常大的狼头骨的上半部分，装上了皮带，能够被戴在头上。头骨上面每寸空间都被雕刻得如同迷宫一般，里面交织着刺眼得让你流泪的奇怪符号。

messages.msgid: A cloth liner worn inside a helmet to help keep your head warm in cold climates.
translations: 一个垫在头盔里的保暖内衬。

messages.msgid: A helmet that covers the entire head along with glareproof visors, offering the best protection for when you ride around on your motorcycle.  Activate to raise the visor.
translations: 一个带有防眩光面罩的全包式头盔，为你的摩托骑行提供最好的防护。激活它以升起面罩。
全包式摩托头盔（面罩升起）

messages.msgid: A helmet that covers the entire head along with glareproof visors, offering the best protection when you ride around on your motorcycle.  The visor is raised.  Activate to put down the visor.
translations: 一个带有防眩光面罩的全包式头盔，为你的摩托骑行提供最好的防护。面罩已经升起。激活它以放下面罩。

messages.msgid: A helmet designed to protect from falls and kicks involving horses, has a small peak to protect from glare.
translations: 一顶设计来防护马匹踢击或是从马匹摔落伤害的头盔，有一个防止太阳眩光的顶罩。

messages.msgid: A helmet designed to protect from falls and kicks involving horses.
translations: 一顶设计来防护马匹踢击或是从马匹摔落伤害的头盔。

messages.msgid: An early medieval helmet with a projection guarding the nose, to better protect the face without obstructing vision.  Proper Viking gear, unlike the stereotypical horned helm.
translations: 一顶中世纪早期的头盔，有保护鼻子的突起，防护良好的同时又不遮挡视线。可能是更适用的维京人装备，而不是刻板印象中的带角头盔。

messages.msgid: attachment for a partial or full aventail.

An early medieval helmet with a projection guarding the nose, to better protect the face without obstructing vision.  Proper Viking gear, unlike the stereotypical horned helm.  This one is made in modern times out of steel.
translations: 一顶中世纪早期的头盔，鼻子前有一条挡板，提供防护的同时减少对视野的遮挡。对维京人来说是实际上更适用的装备，而不是刻板印象中的角盔。这一顶是在现代用钢铁制成的。

messages.msgid: A medieval helmet that provides excellent protection to the entire head, at the cost of great encumbrance.
translations: 一种中世纪头盔，能为整个头部提供出色的防护，但代价是很高的累赘度。

messages.msgid: A wide-brimmed helmet that looks somewhat like a metal cowboy hat.  Sadly, it won't help protect your eyes from the sun.
translations: 一顶宽边头盔，看起来有点像一顶金属牛仔帽。可惜的是，这并无助于保护你的眼睛免受刺眼阳光的惩罚。

messages.msgid: The tall crested helmet of a Spanish conquistador.  Heavy rusting implies it might be that many years old.
translations: 一顶铁盔，帽檐翘起，曾经的西班牙征服者很喜欢戴着它。上面已经锈迹斑斑，应该有些年头了。

messages.msgid: A helmet made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings; the loose collection of plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.
translations: 一套用金属碎片做成的头盔，碎片之间用小绳子固定。这些松垮的小片片能提供不错的防护，但是还不够完美。

messages.msgid: Massively heavy, extremely uncomfortable, very crude, and looks like a bucket with a slit cut out the front, but it'll keep zombie claws off your face.  Comes with a bevor to help spread the weight out onto your shoulders and protect your neck, and some cloth padding to keep your bell from being rung.
translations: 这个头盔非常重，非常不舒服，非常粗糙，看起来像一个前面有切口的水桶，但它能让丧尸的爪子碰不到你的脸。它还附带有一个帮助将重量分散到肩膀上并保护脖子的软垫，还有一些布垫，以免被敲击的时候变成一口大钟嗡嗡响。

messages.msgid: It still looks like a bucket, but this crude great helm has at least been hardened for extra protection.
translations: 虽然看起来仍然像一个水桶，但是这顶简易的头盔至少经过硬化处理，防护效果相当不错。

messages.msgid: A helmet that looks like a crude bucket with the face cut out.  It comes with a bevor to distribute some of the weight to your shoulders, as well as cloth padding to keep your bell from being rung.
translations: 一个头盔，看起来像一个粗糙的铁桶，面前有开口。带有将一些重量分配到肩膀上，同时防止你被像大钟一样敲得嗡嗡响的布垫。

messages.msgid: While the design is crude, this helmet has been hardened for added protection, while still leaving your face open so you can see properly.
translations: 虽然设计很粗糙，但这个头盔已经过硬化处理，防护效果还不错，脸上依然有开口，这样你就能正常看到东西了。

messages.msgid: A small metal helmet that covers the head and protects against cuts and percussion.
translations: 一顶轻巧的金属头盔，为头部提供防护，让你在滑板时避免割伤或者脑震荡。

messages.msgid: A spiked helmet once worn by German military officers.  The spike is ornamental.
translations: 一个在十九世纪和二十世纪广泛被德国的军队、 消防队员、警察配备的标志性尖顶头盔，亦被普鲁士与其他军队使用。

messages.msgid: An ancient Greek bronze helmet that provides excellent protection for the head, with slits for the eyes and mouth.
translations: 一顶古希腊青铜头盔，为头部提供了极好的保护，在眼部及嘴部留有缝隙。

messages.msgid: A solid, single piece closed bronze helmet with a slit for the eyes.
translations: 一顶坚固的整体成型的封闭式青铜头盔，在眼部有个开口。

messages.msgid: A huge makeshift helmet made from a canning pot.  For the truly desperate man-bear-pig.
translations: 一个使用水浴锅制成的还凑合的超大号头盔。为了那些真正走投无路的人型猪头熊。（注：南方公园S10E6）

messages.msgid: A type of helmet that was developed in the late 15th century.  Evolving from the sallet and armet, it includes a bevor to protect the neck.  Activate it to raise the visor.
translations: 一顶在15世纪末发明的板甲头盔。它由夏雷尔盔和武装盔演变而来，包括保护颈部的颈甲。激活以升起面罩。
封闭式轻盔（低碳钢）（面罩升起）

messages.msgid: A type of helmet that was developed in the late 15th century.  Evolving from the sallet and armet, it includes a bevor to protect the neck.  Activate it to lower the visor.
translations: 一顶在15世纪末发明的板甲头盔。它由夏雷尔盔和武装盔演变而来，包括保护颈部的颈甲。激活以降下面罩。
封闭式轻盔（中碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式轻盔（高碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式轻盔（硬化碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式轻盔（回火碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式头盔（低碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式头盔（中碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式头盔（高碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式头盔（硬化碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式头盔（回火碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式重盔（低碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式重盔（中碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式重盔（高碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式重盔（硬化碳钢）（面罩升起）
封闭式重盔（回火碳钢）（面罩升起）

messages.msgid: A lightweight helmet that is fashioned to look like a real military helmet, but is made of plastic and only protects against BB's and other light threats.  It has a military rail system for attachments.
translations: 一顶轻便的头盔，外形仿照真正的军用头盔，但是由塑料制成，只能防止BB弹和其他轻微的威胁。它有一套用于安装附件的军用导轨系统。

messages.msgid: A middle eastern helmet, cylindrical on the top with protection for the nose and ears but nothing lower.  This one is made in modern times out of steel.
translations: 一种中东头盔，顶部呈圆柱形，有为鼻部与耳朵的防护，但下部分什么都没有。这一顶是在现代由钢铁制成的。

messages.msgid: A leather holster, big enough for a rifle or other large gun.  Designed to be strapped to the back.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 一个皮革枪套，大的能装下步枪或其他大型枪械，正确用法是用带子跨在背部.激活来放入/取出枪支。

messages.msgid: A leather harness which can hold up to six pistol-sized guns in total, available for quick drawing.  Historically, similar harnesses were used by pirates to carry multiple loaded flintlock pistols at once, as reloading them is a lengthy process.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 一根斜挎的皮枪套，可同时容纳最多六支手枪尺寸的枪械，枪械可快速拔出。历史上海盗们使用类似的皮枪套来同时携带多把燧发手枪，因为重新装弹耗时漫长。激活它来收拔枪械。

messages.msgid: A small concealed holster worn on the ankle.  It is awkward to use without practice.  Activate to holster/draw a small pistol.
translations: 一个穿在脚踝上的枪套。不经过练习用起来很笨拙。激活它来收拔枪械。

messages.msgid: A somewhat complicated set of straps and fabric to keep your bow close to hand and (mostly) out of harm's way.  Activate to holster/draw your bow.
translations: 一套较为复杂的由带子和布料组成的装备。让你随手取用弓，同时保护（大部分）弓身。激活它来收拔弓。

messages.msgid: A harness going over your shoulder and across your chest.  Designed to connect to a rifle at a single point with the rifle hanging off your front.  Great for fighting, not great for travel.  Activate to holster/draw your weapon.
translations: 一条背在肩上斜跨过胸口的背带。设计用于和步枪单点连接，将其悬挂在胸前。利于战斗，但不便携行。激活它来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A leather strap worn on the hip for holding pistol-sized guns.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 一个挂在臀部的皮枪套，可以放一把手枪尺寸的枪械。激活它来收拔枪械。

messages.msgid: Holster made from nylon, rather than leather.  A bit stronger and lighter, but not as fashionable.  Activate to draw/holster a gun.
translations: 尼龙制成的枪套，而不是皮革。稍微更坚固且更轻，但也没那么时尚了。激活以拔出/放入枪械。

messages.msgid: A Western-style gun belt as worn by cowboys and gunfighters in the movies and on TV. Has loops across the back to hold spare ammo.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 一条西部风格的枪背带，就是电影电视中牛仔和枪手穿的那种。在背部有绳圈，可以放下备用子弹。激活以收拔枪械。

messages.msgid: A comfortable quick-draw holster for small guns.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 一个设计舒适的快拔枪套，用于小型枪械。激活它来收拔枪械。

messages.msgid: A comfortable quick-draw holster for larger pistols.  One side holsters a gun, and the other side holds two magazines.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 一对设计舒适的快拔枪套，用于大型手枪。一侧用来装枪，另一侧用来装两个弹匣。激活它来收拔枪械。

messages.msgid: An elastic band with numerous provisions for concealing a very small pistol close to the body.  It is awkward to use without practice.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 一条弹性皮带，可以在紧贴身体的地方隐藏一把非常小的手枪，只有专业人士才能使用自如。激活它来收拔枪械。

messages.msgid: A wide elastic belly belt with a built-in holster for a pistol and a spare magazine.  It is very awkward to use without practice.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 一种宽而有弹性的腹部腰带，带有内置手枪套和弹匣袋。不经练习就使用它的话会感到非常不方便。激活它来收拔枪械。

messages.msgid: Two holsters attached together by a strap, right next to each other.  The placement means that drawing guns out of either one is slower than a regular holster.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 两个枪套，由条带并排连接在一起。这也意味着从任何一个枪套中拿取，都会比普通枪套更慢。激活以放入/取出枪械。

messages.msgid: Two holsters attached together by a strap, one in front of the other.  The placement means that drawing a gun out of the front holster is slower than the other holster.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 两个枪套，一个重叠在另一个前面。这也意味着从任何一个枪套中拿取，都会比普通枪套更慢。激活以放入/取出枪械。

messages.msgid: Two nylon holsters attached together by a strap, right next to each other.  The placement means that drawing guns out of either one is slower than a regular holster.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 两个尼龙枪套，由条带并排连接在一起。这也意味着从任何一个枪套中拿取，都会比普通枪套更慢。激活以放入/取出枪械。

messages.msgid: Two nylon holsters attached together by a strap, one in front of the other.  The placement means that drawing a gun out of the front holster is slower than the other holster.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 两个尼龙枪套，一个重叠在另一个前面。这也意味着从任何一个枪套中拿取，都会比普通枪套更慢。激活以放入/取出枪械。

messages.msgid: A belt holster consisting of a loop and strap intended for use with larger firearms.  Slightly more cumbersome than a standard holster due to the straps that hold it flat against your leg.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 一个挂在臀部的皮枪套，包含用于大型枪械的皮带及锁扣。由于枪械被皮带平放在腿旁，使得它比标准枪套要更加累赘。激活它来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A belt holster consisting of a loop and strap intended for use with larger firearms, but made with nylon instead of leather.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.
translations: 由尼龙材质制成的枪套，带有固定环和绑带，专为大型枪械设计。激活可快速收放武器。

messages.msgid: A beekeeping hood.  Keeps the bees out, but lets fresh air in.
translations: 一顶防蜂兜帽，阻止蜜蜂进入的同时能通风透气。

messages.msgid: A customized chainmail hood.  Can be worn comfortably under helmets.
translations: 一条能舒适地戴在头盔之下的定制链甲头巾。

messages.msgid: A waterproof hood made to be worn in bad weather.
translations: 一件天气不好时穿戴的防水兜帽。

messages.msgid: A snug fitting garment that protects your head and neck, made from lightweight Nomex fire-resistant fabric.  Tough yet breathable, it is light and comfortable to wear under clothing.
translations: 一件能保护你头部和颈部的贴身服装，由很轻的芳纶防火织物制成。结实又透气，穿在其他衣服下既轻便又舒适。

messages.msgid: A hood sewn from treated and split intestines, the perfect companion for a gutskin parka.
translations: 一件用处理过的割开的动物肠衣制成的兜帽，是爱斯基摩肠制大衣的完美伴侣。

messages.msgid: A black hood commonly used by ninja.
translations: 一条忍者常用的黑色兜帽。

messages.msgid: A pliable but hefty layer of living plant matter.
translations: 一层柔软而厚重的活植物物质。

messages.msgid: A powerful layer of bark, thicker in parts.
translations: 一层强大的树皮，局部比较厚。

messages.msgid: Your bark is spread evenly across your body.
translations: 你的树皮均匀地散布在全身。

messages.msgid: Your bark is pulled together to protect your torso.
translations: 你的树皮被固结在一起以保护你的躯干。

messages.msgid: Your bark is latticed into a larger frame.
translations: 你的树皮连接成网格形成一个更大的框架。

messages.msgid: Iridescent feathers covering your entire body.  Provides some warmth and protection from the elements, but could be thicker.
translations: 彩虹般的羽毛覆盖了你的全身。提供了一些温暖并且为你遮风挡雨，但是可能需要更厚一些。

messages.msgid: Thin, patchy fur that clearly needs to grow more.
translations: 薄而斑驳的毛皮，显然仍然需要更多得生长。

messages.msgid: Though it's quite warm, your fur is also quite protective.
translations: 虽然很保暖，但毛皮同样具有保护作用。

messages.msgid: A heavy shag carpet of fur, somewhere between a ballistic vest and attic insulation.
translations: 一层厚厚的毛绒地毯，强度介于防弹背心和阁楼保温棉之间。

messages.msgid: While still formidable, this furry hide has lost a lot of its bulk to better endure the summer months.
translations: 虽然仍大得可怕，这张毛皮已经去除了绝大多数的体积，可以更好地适应夏季。

messages.msgid: The fur of a strong, wild creature.
translations: 一种强壮的野生动物的毛皮。

messages.msgid: A covering of fur that has thinned out for the summer.
translations: 在夏季变薄了的一层毛皮。

messages.msgid: The fur of a proud, wise creature.
translations: 一种骄傲的智慧动物的毛皮。

messages.msgid: A pile of fur around the neck, protecting from foes that go for the throat.
translations: 脖子周围围着一圈毛皮，用来保护喉部免受敌人的攻击。

messages.msgid: Skin like a spilled tub of paints, splattered in abstract shapes of chitin, fur, and hide.
translations: 皮肤就像一桶被泼洒出的油漆，溅成一滩滩甲壳、毛皮和兽皮的抽象形状。

messages.msgid: Beauty is only skin deep, but with this skin, a knife might find itself broken in the beauty layer.
translations: 说它美貌过于肤浅，但有了这层皮肤，一把刀可能在美貌层就已经被折断。

messages.msgid: Folks that can't catch bullets with their skin insist that it's what's on the inside that counts.  Those folks don't know anything.
translations: 那些不能用皮肤挡住子弹的人坚持认为，重要的是内在美。那些人什么都不懂。

messages.msgid: These are much better than puny human mouthparts.
translations: 这些比人类的小口器要强得多。

messages.msgid: Your fangs have properly developed, and are prepared for the kill.
translations: 毒牙已经伸出，做好了杀戮的准备。

messages.msgid: Your chitinous skin doesn't sweat so well and it's a bit stiffer than before, but it's far more durable than your old human skin.
translations: 你现在拥有几丁质皮肤，你再也不会出一身臭汗了，代价是它会有点僵硬。但不管怎么说，比你从前的人类皮肤耐用多了。

messages.msgid: The skin hardens, develops.  Good, it will be needed.
translations: 皮肤变硬、发育。很好，这能派上用场。

messages.msgid: The exoskeleton is soft and vulnerable.  It would be best to hide until it hardens.
translations: 柔软且脆弱的几丁质甲壳。你最好先让它避避风头，等它完全硬化。

messages.msgid: When the time comes to prey, this platemail will be ready for any resistance.
translations: 等到了捕猎的时候，这个骨甲将做好面对任何抵抗的准备。

messages.msgid: The exoskeleton is weak, it will require more time to harden.
translations: 骨质甲板还很脆弱，你需要一些时间等它变硬。

messages.msgid: Useful for the hunt, suitable for maximum efficiency.
When the time comes to prey, this unwavering carapace will keep you safe from everything that could harm you.
translations: 狩猎时间到了，这坚硬的甲壳使你免于承受几乎任何伤害。

messages.msgid: This recently-molted carapace is still soft, and will need time to harden before it provides proper protection.
translations: 刚蜕皮成型的骨质厚甲，还是软的。还需要一些时间来硬化才能提供防护能力。

messages.msgid: A powerful tool for snatching fish or breaking open shells.
translations: 一只强力的蟹螯。这个大钳子无论是抓鱼还是开蚌壳都很好用。

messages.msgid: You have a large, protective shell on your back, but unfortunately, it doesn't have enough space to fit inside or store anything, makes wearing anything on your torso impossible, and makes backpacks encumbering.
translations: 你的背上有一个巨大的保护壳，但不幸的是，它没有足够的空间容纳或存放物品，而且它让你无法在躯干上穿任何东西，并使得背包变得更累赘了。

messages.msgid: Your shell has grown larger and thicker.  You can hide yourself in it, as well as use it as a backpack, but torso armor is still off limits.
translations: 你的壳变得更大更厚。你可以将自己隐藏在其中，也可以将其用作背包，但显然没法带着这东西穿上躯干护甲。

messages.msgid: Your shell has grown larger and even thicker, and has a pearly sheen to it.  You can hide yourself in it, as well as use it as a backpack, but torso armor is still off limits.
translations: 你的贝壳变得甚至比先前更大，更厚，并且有珍珠般的光泽。你可以将自己隐藏在其中，也可以将其用作背包，但还是没法带着这东西穿上躯干护甲。

messages.msgid: Your dermis has toughened and started to grow scales in places.
translations: 你的真皮层已经变硬，并开始在一些地方长出鳞片。

messages.msgid: Your scales have grown thicker and cover most of your body, providing solid armor.
translations: 你的鳞片紧密生长，覆盖了大部分的体表，就像一层轻甲。

messages.msgid: Your skin has become a smooth and elegant mesh of interlocking scales.
translations: 你的皮肤已经变成了一层光滑而优雅，网状交错着的鳞片。

messages.msgid: Leathery and heavily armored, your lamellar skin has toughened for the fiercest battles ahead.
translations: 鳞片覆盖了你像革一样坚韧的皮肤，并为将来最激烈的战斗变得又厚又硬。

messages.msgid: Highly protective lenses which seal off your eyes from danger, routing your tear ducts to your mouth.
translations: 高性能的防护镜片，可保护你的眼睛免受伤害，并且将你的泪管引导至口中。

messages.msgid: You have long, sharp claws at the tips of your fingers.
translations: 你的指甲从指尖长出，形成了又尖又利的爪。

messages.msgid: Your fingernails have become gnarled, twisted claws.
translations: 你的指甲变成了利爪，表面粗糙，微微弯曲。

messages.msgid: Your claws have toughened to become something akin to miniature butcher knives.
translations: 你的利爪更硬了，现在它们就如同一把把锋利的屠刀！

messages.msgid: Your index fingers have become talons.  They make for wicked natural daggers.  Unfortunately, they get in the way of everything including gloves.
translations: 你的指头变长，类似鸟爪，仿佛天然的匕首。不幸的是，有了他们你就不能带手套了。

messages.msgid: A pair of fangs sharp and sturdy enough to use in combat.
translations: 一对锋利而坚固的尖牙，足以在战斗中使用。

messages.msgid: A wicked pair of fangs, pointed and surgically sharp.
translations: 一对可怕的毒牙，如外科手术刀般尖利。

messages.msgid: A simple bracelet of string and wooden beads.  Also doubles as a set of prayer beads, if you're so inclined.
translations: 一根由线和木头珠子制成的简单手链。也可当做念珠使用，如果你想的话。

messages.msgid: A simple pair of earrings made of string and wooden beads.
translations: 一对由线和木头珠子制成的简单耳环。

messages.msgid: A simple necklace made of string and wooden beads.  Also doubles as a set of prayer beads, if you're so inclined.
translations: 一根由线和木头珠子制成的简单项链。也可以当做念珠使用，如果你想的话。

messages.msgid: A homemade bracelet crafted from colorful knickknacks.  It's not very expensive, but it's the effort that makes it special.
translations: 一根用五颜六色的小装饰品制成的自制手链。不是很值钱，但是礼轻情义重。

messages.msgid: A medal awarded for achieving third place in some event.  It might be worth something if it was made of bronze; this one is made from brass.
translations: 在某项赛事中获得第三名而颁发的奖牌。 如果它是青铜制成的，它可能会值一些钱； 这个是黄铜制成的。

messages.msgid: A bracelet made of cowrie shells, valued in many African cultures such as the Yoruba.  If you want, you could meditate with this.
translations: 一只由”子安贝“贝壳做成的手镯，在许多非洲文化例如”约鲁巴“文化中备受重视。如果你想，你可以用它来冥想。

messages.msgid: An assortment of cowrie shells used to decorate locs or braids.
translations: 过去常被用来装饰发辫或发髻的一套”子安贝“贝壳。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of cowrie shells, valued in many African cultures such as the Yoruba.  If you want, you could meditate with this.
translations: 一只由”子安贝“贝壳做成的项链，在许多非洲文化例如”约鲁巴“文化中备受重视。如果你想，你可以用它来冥想。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with diamonds, worn over the teeth.  Fits horribly, but looks very shiny.  For that high-class gangsta rap look.
translations: 镶有钻石的假牙套，戴在牙齿外面。贴合度很差，但看起来非常闪亮。适合那种“高端匪帮说唱”风格。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with garnets, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗石榴石假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with amethysts, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗紫水晶假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with aquamarines, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗海蓝宝石假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with emeralds, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗祖母绿假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with alexandrites, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗紫翠玉假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with rubies, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗红宝石假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with peridots, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗橄榄石假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with sapphires, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗蓝宝石假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with tourmaline, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗电气石假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with citrines, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗黄水晶假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: A barrette with lots of ornaments.
translations: 一个有很多装饰的条形发夹。

messages.msgid: Fake teeth inlaid with blue topaz, worn over the teeth.  It looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗蓝黄玉假牙，套在牙齿上。看上去异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: A gold ring with a sparkling diamond mounted on top of it.  Back in the old days, this could have been worth a fortune.
translations: 一个金戒指，顶部有一颗闪光的钻石，在大灾变之前可以值很大一笔钱。

messages.msgid: A waterproof, self-winding watch on a stainless steel watchband.  Tells the time and current temperature.  Activate to check the digital thermometer.
translations: 一块防水的自动发条手表，不锈钢表带。在水中也可以查看时间和温度。使用它来查看数字温度计。

messages.msgid: A staple accessory for gentlemen.  Keeps your shirt collar in place and provides a more aesthetically pleasing arc to your necktie.
translations: 一件绅士的小配件。用于固定领带在衬衫上的位置，使你的领带有更优雅的弧线。
一个样式过时的铜制手镯。

messages.msgid: A pair of copper earrings.  They're pretty heavy.
A circular copper locket.  It's been tarnished with use, and has gained some dull green spots.
translations: 一条圆形铜质的盒式小吊坠。长期的使用已让它失去光泽，上面出现了许多暗绿的锈点。

messages.msgid: A simple chain of copper, with a clasp in the middle to create a necklace.
translations: 一串简单的铜链，中间有个刚好能戴在脖子上的卡扣。

messages.msgid: A plain, copper ring.  Not very shiny, and not very popular.
translations: 一个朴素的铜戒指，既不闪闪发光，款式也不怎么流行。

messages.msgid: An unmarked pair of silver cufflinks.  Cufflinks are used to secure the cuffs of dress shirts - a must-have for men in formal wear.
translations: 一对没有标志的银制袖扣，用于扣紧衬衫的袖口，正装必备。

messages.msgid: An expensive pair of silver cufflinks, stylized with detailed overlays of gold gears and fractal patterns.
translations: 一对昂贵的银制袖扣，上面刻着齿轮和分形的精细艺术图案。

messages.msgid: A pair of cufflinks with inset garnets.
A pair of cufflinks with inset diamonds.
A pair of cufflinks with inset amethysts.
A pair of cufflinks with inset aquamarines.
A pair of cufflinks with inset emeralds.
A pair of cufflinks with inset alexandrites.
A pair of cufflinks with inset rubies.
A pair of cufflinks with inset peridots.
A pair of cufflinks with inset sapphires.
A pair of cufflinks with inset tourmaline.
A pair of cufflinks with inset citrines.
A pair of cufflinks with inset blue topaz.
A pair of cufflinks with inset opals.
A pair of cufflinks with inset pearls.
A pair of cufflinks with inset onyx.
A pair of cufflinks with inset blood-red rubies in the shape of a drop of blood.
translations: 镶嵌血红色红宝石的袖扣，形状像血滴。

messages.msgid: A pair of cufflinks with inset onyx and a couple of dark silver cat decorations.
translations: 镶嵌玛瑙的袖扣，四周有银色的黑猫装饰。

messages.msgid: One of those round things people plug into their earlobes as earrings, also called an "ear plug" or "ear spool."
translations:
一对插入耳垂中当做装饰的圆形耳饰。
"即便没有耳洞也可以戴上的神奇耳钉。"

messages.msgid: Fake golden teeth, worn over the teeth.  Fits horribly, but looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗金色假牙，套在牙齿上。带上很不舒服，但是异常的闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: A pair of shiny gold earrings.
A gold hairpin, designed by the rich, for the rich.
translations: 一根纯金发夹，专为富人设计的奢侈品。

messages.msgid: A heart-shaped gold locket with a frame inside to store photographs or small objects.
translations: 一条心形的金质盒式小吊坠，有一个可以存放照片或其他小物件的夹层。

messages.msgid: A medal awarded for achieving first place in some event.  Before everything fell apart, this was likely a source of great pride for its owner.  Now it's just another shiny bauble.
translations: 一块某个活动的冠军奖章。在过去的一切分崩离析之前，它是它主人自傲的本钱，然而现在它只是一个闪闪发光的小玩意。

messages.msgid: A medal awarded to military personnel for heroism, wounds suffered in combat, or distinguished service.
translations: 授予英雄主义、战中负伤或功绩杰出军人的勋章。

messages.msgid: A gold-plated steel self-winding wristwatch, suitable for a retirement present.  Tells the time and looks good.
translations: 一块镀金的自动发条手表，适合作为退休礼物送人。能够看时间并且很美观。

messages.msgid: A fancy silver tie clip, a great match for a necktie.
translations: 一枚样式时髦的银色领带夹，看上去和你的窄领带很配。

messages.msgid: An elegant silver watch, crafted from silver-plated stainless steel.  It's much cheaper than other metal watches, but more classy than an ordinary wristwatch.
translations: 一只优美的银表，由镀银的不锈钢制成。比其它金属表便宜，但是比普通腕表更有逼格。

messages.msgid: A pair of beautiful silver earrings.

A rather large and expensively-made wristwatch.  Tells the time in elegantly wrought gold with silver detailing.  It's really the only timepiece suitable for someone of your exquisitely discerning tastes.
translations: 一块相当大、且制作考究昂贵的腕表。它以工艺精美的金色配以银色细节来显示时间。对于拥有极其挑剔品味的你来说，这才是真正唯一配得上的计时器。

messages.msgid: A small relic from a forgotten saint.  As extraordinary as the world has become, it may have some power yet.
translations: 一件发掘自被遗忘的某圣地的小巧圣物。既然世界已经发生了如此巨变，也许它也蕴藏着某种不同寻常的力量。

messages.msgid: An assortment of wooden beads used to decorate locs or braids.
translations: 过去常被用来装饰发辫或发髻的一套木制发珠。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of fine gold chain, bearing the symbol of a forgotten faith.
translations: 一条用细密金链打造的金项链，有着一个被遗忘的信仰的徽记。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with a plain cross symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of Christian faith, no matter the denomination.
translations: 一条由细金链制成的项链，吊坠是一个普通的十字架符号。它是基督教信仰的象征，不管是什么教派。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Star of David symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of the Jewish faith.  The Star of David became officially associated with Judaism when it was chosen as the symbol to appear on a flag at the First Zionist Congress in 1897.  At that time, it became the symbol of the Jewish people, Zionism, and the Jewish communities throughout the world.
translations: 一根由细金链制成的项链，吊坠为大卫之星的符号。它是犹太教信仰的一个象征。当大卫之星在1897年第一次犹太复国主义大会上被选为旗帜上的标志时，它就正式与犹太教联系起来。那时，它就成为了犹太民族、犹太复国主义和全世界犹太社区的象征。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Crescent Moon and Star symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of both the Sunni and Shia Islam faith.  The crescent of the new moon signifies the beginning and end of fasting during Ramadan.
translations: 一条由细密金链制成的项链，吊坠是新月和星星的标志，是逊尼派和什叶派伊斯兰教信仰的象征。弯曲的新月标志着斋月期间斋戒的开始和结束。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Dharmachakra symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of the Hindu, Jain and Buddhist faiths.  Also known as Dharma Wheel, the circle, the round shape of the wheel, represents the perfection of the Dharma, the Buddha's teaching.  The rim of the wheel represents meditative concentration and mindfulness, which hold practice together.  The hub represents moral discipline.
translations: 由细金链制成的项链，带有法轮金刚符号作为吊坠。它是印度教，耆那教和佛教信仰的象征。法轮，圆圈，车轮的圆形代表着佛法的完美，佛陀的教诲。轮毂代表冥想专注和正念，将实践集中到一起。而中心则代表道德纪律。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Horn of Odin symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of the Asatru faith.  The Horn of Odin is one of the most recognizable Norse symbols, consisting of three interlocking drinking horns and symbolizing poetic inspiration and wisdom.  It is also a nod to Viking drinking customs and the camaraderie derived from them.
translations: 一条由细金链制成的项链，吊坠是奥丁之角的标志。它是阿萨特鲁信仰的一个象征。奥丁之角是最容易识别的北欧符号之一，由三个交错的牛角酒杯组成，象征着诗意的灵感和智慧。它也是对维京人饮酒习俗和由此产生的友情的一种认可。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Faravahar symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of the Zoroastrianism faith.  While there is no total understanding of the meanings of that ancient symbol, it depicts a bearded man with one hand reaching forward.  He stands above a pair of wings that are outstretched from a circle which are believed to represent eternity.
translations: 一条由细金链制成的项链，吊坠是法拉瓦哈的符号。它是琐罗亚斯德教信仰的象征。虽然对这个古老符号的含义没有完全的理解，但它描绘了一个大胡子男人，一只手向前伸。他站在一对翅膀上面，这对翅膀从一个圆圈中伸出来，被认为代表着永恒。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Khanda symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of the Sikh faith.  The Khanda symbol depicts the Sikh doctrine of Deg Tegh Fateh in emblematic form.  It is also part of the design of the 'Sikh national flag', the Nishan Sahib.  A double edged sword (also called Khanda) is placed at the top of a Nishan Sahib flag as an ornament or finial.
translations: 一条由细金链制成的项链，吊坠为汗达符号，锡克教信仰的一个象征。汗达符号以符号语言描述了"善业与佩剑得胜"的锡克教义。它也是锡克教三角黄底国旗设计的一部分。一把双刃剑（也叫Khanda，汗达）被放在国旗的顶部，作为装饰品或顶边。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Baha'i Star symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of the Baha'i faith.  The Baha'i nine-pointed star reflects the importance of the number for the Faith.  The number nine is the highest single digit number, which symbolizes wholeness and the fulfillment of the expectations of all prior religions.
translations: 一根由细金链制成的项链，吊坠为巴哈伊之星标志，是巴哈伊信仰的象征。巴哈伊的九芒星反映了数字对信仰的重要性。数字九是最高的个位数，它象征着整体性和实现所有先前宗教的期望。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Torii symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of Shinto faith, where the Torii denotes the entrance to Shinto Shrines and the respect towards the Shinto beliefs and culture.
translations: 一条由细金链制成的项链，吊坠是鸟居的标志，是神道教信仰的象征。鸟居表示神道教神社的入口以及对神道教信仰和文化的尊重。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Ying Yang symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of both Confucian and Taoist faiths and philosophical systems.  Yin is a symbol of earth, femininity, darkness, passivity, and absorption.  It is present in even numbers, in valleys and streams, and is represented by the tiger, the color orange, and a broken line.  Yang is conceived of as heaven, maleness, light, activity, and penetration, and together, they represent balance between opposites.
translations: 一条由细金链制成的项链，有阴阳符饰作为吊坠，是道家信仰和哲学体系的象征。阴是大地、女性、黑暗、被动和吸收，它存在于偶数、山谷和溪流中，并由老虎、橙色和一条断线代表。 而阳象征高天、男性、光明、活动和渗透。它们一起代表着对立面之间的平衡。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Cao Dai symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of Caodaism faith.  In Vietnamese, 'Cao' literally means 'high', while 'Dai' means 'tower', 'palace' or 'abode'. The combined verbal image is used to represent both a heavenly place and a Supreme Being envisioned as creating all religions and beings on the earth.  The visual symbol used by Caodaism followers for this Supreme Being is an all-seeing eye, the Cao Dai.
translations: 一条由细金链制成的项链，吊坠是高台教的标志，是高台教信仰的象征。在越南，"Cao"字面意思是"高"，而"Dai"意思是"塔"、"宫殿"或"居所"。这个组合的语言形象既用来代表一种天国，也代表一个被设想为创造地球上所有宗教和生命的最高存在。高台教的信徒对这个最高存在的视觉符号是一只能看清一切的眼睛，即Cao Dai。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Zia Sun symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of the strength and union of the Zia Native Americans.  The Zia Sun symbol represent the four cardinal directions, the four seasons of the year, the four period of each day (morning, noon, evening, and night), and the four seasons of life (childhood, youth, middle age, and old age).
translations: 一根由细金链制成的项链，以齐亚太阳符号为吊坠。它象征着齐亚美洲原住民的力量和联合。齐亚太阳符号代表四个基本方向，一年中的四个季节，每天的四个时段（早上、中午、晚上和夜晚），以及生命的四个季节（童年、青年、中年和老年）。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Hand of Ahimsa symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of the Jainist faith and philosophical system.  The hand with a wheel on the palm symbolizes Ahimsa in Jainism.  The word in the middle is 'ahimsa' (non-injury).  The wheel represents the dharmachakra, which stands for the resolve to halt the samsara through the relentless pursuit of Ahimsa.
translations: 一条由细金链制成的项链，吊坠是不害之手的标志，是耆那教信仰和哲学体系的一个象征。手掌上有一个轮子的手便是耆那教的"不害"。中间的字是"ahimsa"（不伤害），轮子代表达摩法轮。它代表通过对"不杀生"的不懈追求来停止轮回的决心。

messages.msgid: A necklace made of a fine gold chain with the Om symbol as a pendant.  It is a symbol of the Hindu faith, as Om is a sacred sound, syllable, mantra, or an invocation in Hinduism.  Om is the prime symbol of Hinduism, variously said to be the essence of the supreme Absolute, consciousness, Atman, Brahman, or the Cosmic world.  In Indian traditions, Om serves as a sonic representation of the divine, a standard of Vedic authority and a central aspect of soteriological doctrines and practices.
translations: 一根由细密金链制成的项链，有一个"唵"符号作为吊坠，是印度教信仰的标志，因为唵在印度教中是神圣的声音、音节、真言或祷告。唵是印度教最主要的符号，被不同地称为至高的绝对，意识，我，梵天，或是宇宙的核心精髓。在印度传统中，唵作为神圣之声的代表，吠陀权威的标准，也是救赎教义和实践的核心。

messages.msgid: A simple necklace representing a religious faith.
translations: 一个简单朴素的木制项链，有着一个被遗忘的信仰的徽记。

messages.msgid: A hand-crafted jade brooch of Oriental origin.
translations: 一个手工制作的远东风格的翡翠胸针。

messages.msgid: A collar made from round and lustrous pearls; its former owner must have been a wealthy individual.
translations: 一条由光彩迷人的浑圆珍珠制成的项链，它的前主人一定是个有钱人吧。

messages.msgid: Flex on those gold-watch wearers with this rare, expensive, and superior platinum watch.  This one is made from solid platinum.
translations: 戴上这只昂贵罕见的铂金手表，那些戴金表的人只会相形见绌。这可是纯铂金的！
一只完美无瑕的铂金手镯。

messages.msgid: Fake platinum-and-silver teeth.  They may be cheaper than fake gold teeth, but they're much more rare.  Fits horribly, but looks very shiny.
translations: 一颗铂金假牙。比金牙便宜，但是更加罕有。戴上很不舒服，但是非常闪亮耀眼。

messages.msgid: A pair of plain platinum earrings - if gold is getting boring, just use another rare metal.
translations: 一对纯铂金耳环——如果纯金的看起来太俗，就换一种贵重金属。

messages.msgid: The ultimate in esoteric, metal hair accessories, this hairpin is made from pure platinum.
translations: 一根由纯铂金制成的发夹，金属头饰中常人难懂的品味极致。

messages.msgid: A small, platinum locket for storing photographs or other small objects.
translations: 一条铂金的盒式小吊坠，用于存放照片或其它小物件。

messages.msgid: A platinum necklace, with a small, empty heart-shaped frame hanging from a chain.
translations: 一串铂金项链，上面用一根链条挂着一个心形的小盒子。

messages.msgid: A platinum ring, engraved with all manner of swirls and spirals.
translations: 一只铂金戒指，上面刻着各种漩涡和螺旋花纹。

messages.msgid: This ring is an intricate gold band with a small cluster of diamonds set in the center.  Before the world broke down, this ring would've cost a small fortune.
translations: 这枚戒指由一条复杂的金带扭成，中间镶嵌了一小簇钻石。在旧世界坍塌之前，你要花上不小的一笔财富才能买到它。

messages.msgid: Also known as a promise ring, this ring is worn as a sign of chastity.  This one bears the inscription, "Love is patient."
translations:
也被称作承诺戒指或恋爱戒指，情侣通常戴上它来表明自己的洁身自好。
这枚戒指上镌刻着铭文："爱是恒久忍耐。（注：《新约圣经》林前 13:4--8）"

messages.msgid: A gold and silver ring with a wide stamp attached to the band.  A long time ago, the stamp was legible, but now the pattern is too worn to discern its former use.
translations: 一枚金银制成的戒指，上面连接着一个宽大的印章。印章很久以前曾经清晰可辨，但是现在已经磨损严重，看不出过去的用途了。

messages.msgid: A flawless ring, ensnaring a diamond with twists of pure gold.  It's a constant reminder that the wearer is married.
translations: 一枚无瑕的戒指，中间用缠结的纯金线嵌住一颗钻石。这是它的佩戴者已经结婚成家的长久证明。

messages.msgid: A shiny silver hairpin with a tiny bee engraved onto it.
translations: 一只闪耀的银发夹，上面刻着一只小蜜蜂。

messages.msgid: A small silver locket with a frame inside to store photographs or small objects.
translations: 一条银质的盒式小吊坠，有一个可以存放照片或其他小物件的夹层。

messages.msgid: A medal awarded for achieving second place in some event.  Before everything fell apart, this was likely a source of pride for its owner.  Now it's just another shiny bauble.
translations: 一块授予某个赛事第二名的奖牌。在世界末日前这会是它主人的骄傲，事到如今它只是一个闪光的装饰品。

messages.msgid: A black leather 'collar' with a bell dangling from the front.  Don't worry, the bell is silent.
translations: 一个黑色皮革“项圈”，正面垂着一枚铃铛。别担心，这个铃铛是无声的。

messages.msgid: A simple wristwatch on a plastic band.  Tells the time and has an alarm clock feature.
translations: 一块配有塑料表带的简易腕表。可以显示时间，并带有闹钟功能。

messages.msgid: A plastic badge with an embedded filmstrip.  The text on the badge says the filmstrip changes color as it is exposed to radiation, and never goes back to how it initially looked.  Wear on your lapel so you can notice if it changes.
translations: 一块佩戴在胸前、嵌入了检测辐射剂量的色条的徽章。徽章上的文字说明如果有辐射就会通过变色来提醒你，且无法变回原来的颜色。将它穿在身上就能看到它的颜色是否变化。

messages.msgid: A tarnished silver star gives an air of authority to the wearer.
translations: 一只失去光泽的银色星形徽章，标志着佩戴者是名维护法律与治安的警员。

messages.msgid: A tarnished golden shield gives an air of authority to the wearer.
translations: 一只失去光泽的金色盾形徽章，标志着佩戴者是名刑侦警探。

messages.msgid: A bright silver star strikes fear into the eyes of ne'er-do-wells.
translations: 一枚明亮的银色星徽，足以令不法之徒心生畏惧。

messages.msgid: A matte-finish silver shield identifies the wearer as an authority who goes in when the cops just aren't enough.
translations: 一个亚光处理的银制盾牌状徽记，标志着佩戴者是一名在情况恶化到警察都无法应对时出现的S.W.A.T单位成员。

messages.msgid: A gold-filled brass shield with an eagle perched atop it and Lady Justice emblazoned on its center.  In large, engraved lettering it reads, "FEDERAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION-US DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE".  It identifies the wearer as an agent with federal authority throughout all the United States and her territories; that is, whatever is left of them.
translations: 一枚镀金黄铜盾牌，顶部是一只栖息的雄鹰，中央镌刻着正义女神的形象。盾牌上大字镌刻着“联邦调查局 - 美国司法部”。它表明佩戴者是联邦特工，拥有在全美及其领土（如果还有剩的话）的联邦执法权。

messages.msgid: A plastic name tag marking the wearer as a real doctor of the medical kind.
translations: 一种塑料名牌，标明佩戴者是真正的医生。

messages.msgid: A star-shaped plastic badge.  "Foodkid" is printed on it in bold letters.  This badge marks its wearer as Foodperson's trusty sidekick, and comes included with every kid's meal at Foodplace.
translations: 一个星形的塑料徽章，上面用粗体字写着"美食小子™"。这是深受美食侠™信赖的模范助手所佩戴的徽章，并且包含在每份美食广场™的儿童套餐之中。

messages.msgid: A simple, if rather crude, piece of post-Cataclysm jewelry: a solitary bullet casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition strung upon a length of string, cord, or twine to form a makeshift pendant.
translations: 一件造型简约但做工相当粗糙的大灾变后的首饰：用手枪弹或其他类似弹药中取出的完整弹壳，串在一段绳子、草绳或麻绳上，组成了一个自制吊坠。

messages.msgid: A simple, if rather crude, piece of post-Cataclysm jewelry: a solitary bullet casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition strung upon a length of string, cord, or twine to form a makeshift pendant.  The shell's neck has been daintily drilled through with two tiny holes on opposite sides, through which the cord has been fed and tied off to form a poor man's excuse for a chain, and from where the cartridge hangs, dimpled primer-down.
translations: 一件造型简约但做工相当粗糙的大灾变后的首饰：用手枪弹或其他类似弹药中取出的完整弹壳，串在一段绳子、草绳或麻绳上，组成了一个自制吊坠。在弹壳颈部相对的两侧被精巧地钻了两个小洞，绳子从孔中穿过后绑紧，作为丐版项链，挂着的弹壳底部，有个击发过的子弹底火。

messages.msgid: A simple, if rather crude, piece of post-Cataclysm jewelry: a solitary bullet casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition strung upon a length of string, cord, or twine to form a makeshift pendant.  The dimpled section of the shell's primer has been punched out, and a second hole has been drilled through the casing's side just shy of the base, with the ballistic accoutrement hanging from a section of tied-off cord that has been threaded through both entry points.
translations: 一件造型简约但做工相当粗糙的大灾变后的首饰：用手枪弹或其他类似弹药中取出的完整弹壳，串在一段绳子、草绳或麻绳上，组成了一个自制吊坠。弹壳底火的凹陷部分已经被打通，第二个孔钻在弹壳侧面，紧挨着基座，弹壳整体挂在一段绑住的绳子上，绳子穿过了两个孔。

messages.msgid: A simple, if rather crude, piece of post-Cataclysm jewelry: a solitary bullet casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition strung upon a length of string, cord, or twine to form a makeshift pendant.  The shell's throat has been twisted closed by a set of pliers, creating a spiraled taper where the neck would be, while a hole has been drilled on opposite hemispheres of the pendant's sides, through which a length of string has been threaded.  The cord's loose ends have been wrapped several times around the casing before being tied off, forming a sort of little bullet cocoon.
translations: 一件造型简约但做工相当粗糙的大灾变后的首饰：用手枪弹或其他类似弹药中取出的完整弹壳，串在一段绳子、草绳或麻绳上，组成了一个自制吊坠。弹壳喉部被钳子拧紧，在颈部形成一个螺旋锥，而在吊坠两侧的相反半球上各钻了一个洞，一段绳子从中穿过。绳子在外壳上缠了好几圈之后才被系紧，像个小小的子弹茧壳。

messages.msgid: Rather crude and clearly put together on a budget, this is a piece of post-Cataclysmic—so-called—jewelry—little more than an unpolished, solitary rifle casing threaded on a length of cord, string, or twine to form a pendent necklace.
translations: 这款首饰相当粗陋，显然在预算有限的情况下拼凑而成，是所谓的后灾变时代的“珠宝”——实际上不过是一枚未经打磨的步枪弹壳，被穿在一条绳索、细线或麻线上，形成了一条吊坠项链。

messages.msgid: Rather crude and clearly put together on a budget, this is a piece of post-Cataclysmic—so-called—jewelry—little more than an unpolished, solitary rifle casing threaded on a length of cord, string, or twine to form a pendent necklace.  The cartridge's neck has been carefully drilled through, leaving behind a tiny hole on either side of the shell's throat through which the cord has been fed and tied off, forming a pedestrian facsimile of a chain from where the round hangs, primer-down.
translations: 这款首饰相当粗陋，显然在预算有限的情况下拼凑而成，是所谓的后灾变时代的“珠宝”——实际上不过是一枚未经打磨的步枪弹壳，被穿在一条绳索、细线或麻线上，形成了一条吊坠项链。弹壳颈部经过精心钻孔，子弹壳口两侧各留下一个小洞，绳索从中穿过并系紧，形成了一个简陋的链条状结构，使弹丸得以悬挂，底火朝下。

messages.msgid: Rather crude and clearly put together on a budget, this is a piece of post-Cataclysmic—so-called—jewelry—little more than an unpolished, solitary rifle casing threaded on a length of cord, string, or twine to form a pendent necklace.  The primer's indented portion has been drilled away, with a second hole situated in the casing's side just shy of the base and a length of tied-off cordage looping through both entry points to form a makeshift chain for the apparel.
translations: 这款首饰相当粗陋，显然在预算有限的情况下拼凑而成，是所谓的后灾变时代的“珠宝”——实际上不过是一枚未经打磨的步枪弹壳，被穿在一条绳索、细线或麻线上，形成了一条吊坠项链。底火凹陷部分已被钻掉，弹壳侧壁接近底部处另开一小孔，一段绳结穿过两个入口形成临时链环，用于挂载这件饰品。

messages.msgid: Rather crude and clearly put together on a budget, this is a piece of post-Cataclysmic—so-called—jewelry—little more than an unpolished, solitary rifle casing threaded on a length of cord, string, or twine to form a pendent necklace.  The jaws of a set of pliers have twisted closed the cartridge's throat with a spiral flourish, while a hole has been drilled through opposite sides of the pendant's shoulder, through which a loop of cord has been threaded.  The string's loose ends have been wrapped several times around the casing in a vague X-pattern before being tied off, creating a form of mini-bullet cocoon.
