translations: 这款首饰相当粗陋，显然在预算有限的情况下拼凑而成，是所谓的后灾变时代的“珠宝”——实际上不过是一枚未经打磨的单独步枪弹壳，被穿在一条绳索、细线或麻线上，形成了一条吊坠项链。钳子的钳口以螺旋状紧紧扭闭了弹壳口，同时在挂坠的肩部相对两侧各钻了一个孔，一根绳圈从中穿过。绳子两端在弹壳上松散地绕成大致的X形后被系紧，形成了一个微型子弹茧状结构。

messages.msgid: An expedient means of flaunting one's gunnery prowess, or a crude attempt at overcompensating for matters best left undescribed, this article of craft-produced jewelry is, essentially, one part cordage and three parts mammoth bullet casing: the giant cartridge, either from a grenade round or some other form of heavy munitions, strung to hang upon the chest as a pendent.
translations: 这种手工艺品首饰是一种权宜之计，用来炫耀某人的射击技能，或者是一种粗俗的尝试，用来过度补偿那些最好不提的事情。本质上，这件首饰是由一部分绳索和三部分巨大的子弹壳组成的：这个巨大的弹壳，要么来自一种榴弹，要么是其他某种重型弹药，被串起来挂在胸前作为吊坠。

messages.msgid: An expedient means of flaunting one's gunnery prowess, or a crude attempt at overcompensating for matters best left undescribed, this article of craft-produced jewelry is, essentially, one part cordage and three parts mammoth bullet casing: the giant cartridge, either from a grenade round or some other form of heavy munitions, strung to hang upon the chest as a pendent.  The shell's neck has been carefully tapped, leaving a hole on either side of the casing's throat through which the makeshift neck chain has been fed and tied off.
translations: 这种手工艺品首饰是一种权宜之计，用来炫耀某人的射击技能，或者是一种粗俗的尝试，用来过度补偿那些最好不提的事情。本质上，这件首饰是由一部分绳索和三部分巨大的子弹壳组成的：这个巨大的弹壳，要么来自一种榴弹，要么是其他某种重型弹药，被串起来挂在胸前作为吊坠。弹壳的颈部两侧被小心地凿开，留下了孔，绳子穿过这些孔并打结固定，形成了这件自制的项链。

messages.msgid: An expedient means of flaunting one's gunnery prowess, or a crude attempt at overcompensating for matters best left undescribed, this article of craft-produced jewelry is, essentially, one part cordage and three parts mammoth bullet casing: the giant cartridge, either from a grenade round or some other form of heavy munitions, strung to hang upon the chest as a pendent.  The center of the shell's struck primer has been punched out, and a second hole has been drilled shy of the rim, with a section of tied-off cordage stringing through both entry points to form a makeshift neck chain.
translations: 这件工艺饰品既是一种炫耀射击技术的高明手段，又是一种笨拙地试图弥补那些最好避而不谈的事情的尝试。其本质上，是由一部分绳索和三部分巨型子弹壳组成：巨大的弹壳，可能是来自榴弹或其他形式的重型弹药，被串起来挂在胸前作为吊坠。弹壳中央的撞击底火已被冲出，同时在边缘附近钻了一个孔，通过这两个入口点穿入一段打结的绳索，形成这件自制的项链。

messages.msgid: An expedient means of flaunting one's gunnery prowess, or a crude attempt at overcompensating for matters best left undescribed, this article of craft-produced jewelry is, essentially, one part cordage and three parts mammoth bullet casing: the giant cartridge, either from a grenade round or some other form of heavy munitions, strung to hang upon the chest as a pendent.  The jaws of a set of pliers have been laid to work, with the shell's neck twisted closed in a tapered spiral, while a hole has been bored through opposite sides of the cartridge's base, through which a loop of cord has been tugged.  The string's loose ends have been wrapped around the casing in a serpentine pattern before being tied off, creating a manner of bullet cocoon.
translations: 这件手工制作的饰品，本质上既是一种炫耀射击技术的高明手段，又是一种笨拙地试图弥补那些最好避而不谈的事情的尝试。它主要由一部分绳索和三部分巨型子弹壳组成：这个巨大的弹壳，可能来自榴弹或其他形式的重型弹药，被串起来挂在胸前作为吊坠。用钳子的钳口将弹壳的颈部以锥形螺旋状扭曲闭合，同时在弹壳底座的对面两侧钻出一个孔，穿过一根绳索的环。绳索的松散末端以蛇形图案缠绕在弹壳上，然后系紧，形成了一个子弹茧的样式。

messages.msgid: The product of a gun nut and a fashionista proverbially shaking one another's hand, this plain, though elegant, necklace has been strung with a solitary, sparklingly polished casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition.
translations: 象征着枪械迷与时尚达人的交汇融合，这条简单而优雅的项链由一枚闪亮的，经过抛光的手枪弹药或其他种类的弹药制成。

messages.msgid: The product of a gun nut and a fashionista proverbially shaking one another's hand, this plain, though elegant, necklace has been strung with a solitary, sparklingly polished casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition.  The shell's primer and rim have been neatly sawed away, and in place of the projectile, a little gemstone has been wrapped with a length of fine-gauge wire and bedded into the casing's throat.  The rest of the wire's length trails back through the cartridge's body, feeding out the base and entwining with a link in the chain.
translations: 象征着枪械迷与时尚达人的交汇融合，这条简单而优雅的项链由一枚闪亮的，经过抛光的手枪弹药或其他种类的弹药制成。弹壳的底火和边缘已经被整齐地锯掉，在弹壳的内部，一根细钢丝缠绕着一颗小宝石，并嵌入到弹壳的口部。其余的钢丝穿过子弹的主体，从底部拉出并与链条中的一个环相交织在一起。

messages.msgid: The product of a gun nut and a fashionista proverbially shaking one another's hand, this plain, though elegant, necklace has been strung with a solitary, sparklingly polished casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition.  The teeth of a saw have been put to work upon this shell, whose base and primer have been neatly cut away, and in the throat of which has been seated a small, shining gem.  A length of fine wire has been tightly wrapped around both the cartridge and gemstone in a top-down pattern, with the cord's loose ends eventually tugged through a small drill hole at the cartridge's base and finally wrapped among the neck chain's links.
translations: 这款项链是枪械爱好者和时尚达人相结合的产物，虽简约却又不失优雅。它串着一颗熠熠生辉、打磨得闪闪发光的手枪弹药壳或其他弹药形式的弹壳。这个弹壳经过锯子的精心处理，其底部和底火被整齐地切去，并在其喉部镶嵌了一颗小巧闪亮的宝石。一段细线紧密地自上而下地缠绕在弹壳和宝石上，而线的松散末端则最终被拉过弹壳底部的一个小钻孔，并最终缠绕在项链的链环中。

messages.msgid: A gentlemanly article of craft-produced jewelry for the most spiffy ladies and gentlemen of the post-apocalypse, this plain chain of precious metal has been retrofitted with a fired rifle cartridge that hangs from it as a pendant.
translations: 这件很有派头的手工首饰是为后启示录时代最时髦的女士和先生们制作的，一条纯贵金属链，装上一枚发射过的步枪弹药作为坠子。

messages.msgid: A gentlemanly article of craft-produced jewelry for the most spiffy ladies and gentlemen of the post-apocalypse, this plain chain of precious metal has been retrofitted with a fired rifle cartridge that hangs from it as a pendant.  With its brass polished to a mirror-like sheen, the shell's primer and rim have been neatly extricated at the edge of a saw, with a little gemstone peeking out the casing's throat.  The gem's wrapped within the embrace of a length of fine-gauge wire, whose remaining length has been tugged back through the cartridge's body, fed out the base, and entwined with a link in the chain.
translations: 这件很有派头的手工首饰是为后启示录时代最时髦的女士和先生们制作的，一条纯贵金属链，装上一枚发射过的步枪弹药作为坠子。它的黄铜部分被打磨得像镜子一样光泽，弹壳的底火和底缘被整齐地锯下，一小颗宝石从壳颈中伸出。宝石被一段裁得正好的线仔细包缠，多出的线经过弹壳后部，从底座穿出，缠在项链的环上。

messages.msgid: A gentlemanly article of craft-produced jewelry for the most spiffy ladies and gentlemen of the post-apocalypse, this plain chain of precious metal has been retrofitted with a fired rifle cartridge that hangs from it as a pendant.  With its brass polished to a mirror-like sheen, the shell has grown shorter by virtue of its base having been sawed away, and a glittering jewel has been seated comfortably within the throat.  A length of wire is tightly wrapped around both cartridge and gemstone in a top-down pattern, forming an X-grid as it wines, with the cord's loose ends trailing through a small drill hole at the cartridge's base and tied to the chain's links.
translations: 这件很有派头的手工首饰是为后启示录时代最时髦的女士和先生们制作的，一条纯贵金属链，装上一枚发射过的步枪弹药作为坠子。它的黄铜部分被打磨得像镜子一样光泽，底部锯掉后弹壳更短了，一块闪闪发光的珠宝完美地嵌在壳颈中。一段线自上而下紧紧缠在弹壳与宝石上，形成一个x形网格，绳子松散的末端穿过弹药底部的一个小孔，系在项链的环上。

messages.msgid: An article of hand-produced apparel that George Washington himself could look down upon with an approving smile, the daintiness of this necklace's precious metal chain looks rather comical when compared against the gargantuan pendant that hangs from it: an expended casing from a grenade round, shotgun cartridge, or some other form of sizable munition.
translations: 这款手工制作的饰品，乔治·华盛顿本人若是看到，想必也会带着赞许的微笑低头审视。与这条项链的精致金属链条相比，挂在其上的巨型吊坠显得颇为滑稽：它是一个来自榴弹、霰弹枪弹药筒或其他大型弹药形式的弹壳。

messages.msgid: An article of hand-produced apparel that George Washington himself could look down upon with an approving smile, the daintiness of this necklace's precious metal chain looks rather comical when compared against the gargantuan pendant that hangs from it: an expended casing from a grenade round, shotgun cartridge, or some other form of sizable munition.  With its brass polished to a mirror-like sheen and its rim cleanly extricated by the saw, a well-sized gemstone peers at the world from out of this shell's throat.  The jewel's wrapped within a length of fine-gauge wire, whose remaining length has been tugged through the cartridge's body, fed out the base, and entwined with a link in the chain.
translations: 这款手工制作的饰品，即便是乔治·华盛顿本人也会带着赞许的微笑低头审视。与其精致的金属链条相比，挂在其上的巨型吊坠显得颇为滑稽：它是一个巨大的弹壳，可能来自榴弹、霰弹枪弹药筒或其他大型弹药。弹壳的黄铜被打磨得如同镜子般光亮，边缘被锯子整齐地切去，一颗大小适中的宝石从弹壳的喉部探出，注视着这个世界。宝石被一段细线包裹着，细线的剩余部分被拉过弹壳的主体，从底部穿出，并与链条上的一个环扣缠绕在一起。

messages.msgid: An article of hand-produced apparel that George Washington himself could look down upon with an approving smile, the daintiness of this necklace's precious metal chain looks rather comical when compared against the gargantuan pendant that hangs from it: an expended casing from a grenade round, shotgun cartridge, or some other form of sizable munition.  The shell has, essentially, been rendered into a tiny brass pipe: its base and primer are neatly sawed off, and its head is capped by a large, glittering gemstone that regards the Cataclysm from its seat within the throat.  A length of wire is tightly wrapped around both the cartridge and jewel, with the cord's loose ends trailing through a small drill hole at the shell's base and linked to the neck chain.
translations: 这款手工制作的饰品，即便是乔治·华盛顿本人看到也会带着赞许的微笑。与其精致的金属链条相比，挂在其上的巨型吊坠显得颇为滑稽：这是一个巨大的弹壳，可能来自榴弹、霰弹枪弹药筒或其他大型弹药。这个弹壳基本上被制成了一个小小的黄铜管：其底部和底火被整齐地锯去，其顶部镶嵌着一颗硕大、闪闪发光的宝石，它坐在弹壳的喉部，凝视着大灾变。一段细线紧紧地缠绕在弹壳和宝石上，细线的松散末端穿过弹壳底部的一个小钻孔，并与项链链环相连。

messages.msgid: An assortment of shiny silver beads used to decorate locs or braids.
translations: 过去常被用来装饰发辫或发髻的一套闪闪发光的银制发珠。

messages.msgid: A simple teeth necklace, this is sure to add some bite to an outfit.
translations: 一条简单的牙齿项链，能让衣服更添几分张牙舞爪的气势。

messages.msgid: The teeth hanging from this one look alien, with a hypnotizing, iridescent shine.
translations: 这条项链上的牙齿看起来像是外星生物的，闪耀着引人入迷，五彩斑斓的光芒。

messages.msgid: A red plastic headband adorned with a pair of cartoonish devil horns.  Delightfully devillish.
translations: 一条红色塑料头带，上面装饰着一对卡通恶魔角。愉悦而邪门。

messages.msgid: A plastic headband adorned with a fluffy halo.
translations: 一种装饰着蓬松光环的塑料头带。

messages.msgid: A slick and long red tail that ends in a pointy spade.
translations: 一条光滑的红色长尾巴，末端有一个尖铲。

messages.msgid: A rather impressive pair of white wings.  While they may not give you the ability to fly, they make you look angelic.
translations: 令人印象深刻的一对白色翅膀。虽然它们可能无法让你飞行，但它使你看起来像是天使。

messages.msgid: It's a detached collar with a bow tie, too.  It's usually worn with a sexy one-piece bunny suit and bunny ears headband.
translations: 它是一个独立的领带和蝴蝶结，通常与性感的一体式兔女郎服装和兔子耳朵头带搭配。

messages.msgid: A fuzzy pair of black bunny ears on a headband.  It does nothing, but there's no reason not to look good even if no one's looking.
translations: 一对软绒的黑色兔耳朵头带，没什么用，但即使没有人在看着也应该打扮的好看点。

messages.msgid: A fluffy bunny tail ball, usually worn with a sexy one-piece bunny suit and bunny ears headband.
translations: 一根绒毛兔尾巴球，通常与性感的一体式兔女郎服装和兔耳朵头带搭配。

messages.msgid: A pair of improvised shin guards made from broken pieces of a plank that are tied to your shins with rags and string.
translations: 一对用碎布和绳子将木板碎片绑在小腿上做成的简易护腿。

messages.msgid: Small squares of carpet rolled around your shins and thighs.  Perfect for wading through the local furniture store.
translations: 裹住大腿与小腿的小张地毯，挺适合在逛本地家具店时候穿的。

messages.msgid: Small squares of carpet rolled around your shins.  These might protect you from the corner of a table.
translations: 裹住胫部的小块地毯。没什么防御力，看起来只能避免你被桌角磕伤。

messages.msgid: A pair of leg guards made from the exoskeletons of insects.
translations: 一对由昆虫甲壳制成的护腿。

messages.msgid: pair of biosilicified chitin leg guards
messages.plural: pairs of biosilicified chitin leg guards

messages.msgid: A pair of leg guards crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Acid-resistant but brittle.
translations: 一对由经过精心清理并裁剪过的酸蚁硅化甲壳制成的护腿，防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: A heavy pair of protective overalls worn by firefighters as protection against heat.
translations: 一件消防员经常穿的重型防护裤。能防护高温和火焰。

messages.msgid: Customized chainmail leggings.  Their straps keep everything in place, and the lack of toes and heels allows them to work perfectly well with footwear.
translations: 一套自制的链甲腿甲，各个部件之间采用带子连接固定在一起，脚趾与后跟处留空，方便你穿上各种鞋具。

messages.msgid: Customized partial chainmail leggings only covering the front and sides of the legs.  The zigzagging lace at the back keeps everything in place, and the lack of toes and heels allows them to work perfectly well with footwear.
translations: 一套自制的链甲腿甲部件，仅覆盖腿的前侧及两侧。背部的锯齿形系带起到固定作用。脚趾与后跟处留空，方便你穿上各种鞋具。

messages.msgid: Customized chainmail leggings.  Their straps keep everything in place, and the lack of toes and heels allows them to work perfectly well with footwear.  The metal shows signs of rust and corrosion, and some chain links have fallen away.
translations: 一套自制的锁链腿甲，各个部件之间采用带子连接固定在一起，脚趾和脚跟处的空缺使它们能够与鞋类很好地兼容。金属有生锈和腐蚀的迹象。

messages.plural: pairs of mild steel chainmail leggings
pairs of medium steel chainmail leggings
pairs of high steel chainmail leggings
pairs of hardened steel chainmail leggings
pairs of tempered steel chainmail leggings
pairs of mild steel chainmail half-leggings
pairs of medium steel chainmail half-leggings
pairs of high steel chainmail half-leggings
pairs of hardened steel chainmail half-leggings
pairs of tempered steel chainmail half-leggings

messages.msgid: This leg armor, made of interlocking plates of burnished bronze, appears to be either a high-quality recreation or a genuine artifact.  Despite having an ancient design, it is in mint condition aside from some battle damage.  It covers from the upper thigh to the lower shin, and is of extremely high quality.
translations: 这件青铜甲胄由相互连接的抛光青铜板制成，看起来要么是高质量的现代重制品，要么是真正的古代遗物。尽管样式十分古老，除了表面的一些战斗损伤，它仍旧完好无缺。它覆盖的部位从头部到腰部，品质极高。

messages.msgid: A pair of black leather chaps.  Very tough and light, but doesn't offer any storage.
translations: 一条黑色的皮护腿。非常坚韧又轻盈，但是不提供任何存储空间。

messages.msgid: A pair of tough chaps made of Kevlar.  Chainsaw kickbacks are potentially fatal; personal protective equipment like these chaps help protect your femoral arteries.  The layered Kevlar is designed to fray on contact with the chain and bind up the tool.
translations: 一条由凯夫拉纤维制成的坚固耐用的裹腿。链锯失控能够致命；诸如此类的个人防护设备能保护你的股动脉。分层的凯夫拉纤维在与链条接触时会磨损，并缠住链条。

messages.msgid: A pair of reinforced pants used by fencers to prevent injuries.  They don't cover the lower leg.
translations: 一条用于避免击剑时发生意外的防护裤，没有覆盖到小腿。

messages.msgid: A pair of knee pads made of stout plastic and cloth.
translations: 一对用结实的塑料和布条制成的护膝。

messages.msgid: A pair of bronze leg guards with a simple leather lining.
translations: 一对有着简易皮内衬的青铜护胫。

messages.msgid: A pair of polyurethane leg guards with neoprene backing.
translations: 一对氯丁橡胶护腿，外面套了一个模具成形的塑料外壳，能够承受更多伤害。

messages.msgid: A full assembly of medieval leg protection.  Cuisses, poleyns, and greaves, with leather straps to secure each piece and connect it as part of a set.
translations: 一套完美复刻的中世纪式腿部防具，用皮革条把护腿甲片，护膝甲片，护胫甲片连结成一体，一双完美坚实的战争工艺品。

messages.msgid: A pair of iron leg guards with a simple leather lining.
translations: 一对有着简易皮内衬的铁制护胫。

messages.msgid: pair of sheet metal leg guards
messages.plural: pairs of sheet metal leg guards

messages.msgid: A pair of leg guards hammered out of metal and shaped to tie on to the upper and lower leg, avoiding joints.  Perfect for the Post-Apocalyptic Warrior look.
translations: 一对用金属锤打而成的护腿，能绑在大腿和小腿上，避开了关节部位。完美搭配末日战士造型。

messages.msgid: pair of hardened sheet metal leg guards
messages.plural: pairs of hardened sheet metal leg guards

messages.msgid: These crude leg guards have been hardened to further protect your legs from the mighty coffee table, destroyer of shins.
translations: 这副粗制的护腿经过硬化处理，可进一步保护你的腿免受"强大的小腿破坏者——咖啡桌"的伤害。

messages.msgid: A pair of shin guards hammered out of metal and shaped to tie on to the lower leg.
translations: 一对用金属锤打成型的护胫，可以系在小腿上。

messages.msgid: pair of hardened sheet metal greaves
messages.plural: pairs of hardened sheet metal greaves

messages.msgid: These crude greaves have been hardened to further protect your shins.
translations: 这对简陋的护胫经过硬化处理，可以进一步保护小腿。

messages.msgid: Four cut-down sheets of metal hanging off your waist to keep your hip and groin safe.  They're held in place rather loosely, but still get in the way a lot when running.
translations: 四块切割好的金属板，挂在你的腰上，以保护你的臀部和腹股沟。虽然这些金属板比较松散，但在跑步时仍会有不少不便。

messages.msgid: This loose skirt made from several cut-down sheets of metal has been hardened to provide maximum protection for your most vulnerable area.
translations: 这条宽松的裙子由几块金属片切割制成，经过硬化处理，为你最脆弱的区域提供最大程度的保护。

messages.msgid: pair of sheet metal knee guards
messages.plural: pairs of sheet metal knee guards

messages.msgid: Two small half-cylinders of sheet metal cut down and hammered to fit over the front of your knees.  They make kneeling painful, but don't impede running much.
translations: 两块被切割并捶打成半圆柱形，以贴合膝盖前部的小金属板。这东西让你跪在地上时非常痛苦，但不太会妨碍跑步。

messages.msgid: pair of hardened sheet metal knee guards
messages.plural: pairs of hardened sheet metal knee guards

messages.msgid: Knee guards of sheet metal, hardened to protect your kneecaps from any feral with a bat.
translations: 薄钢板制成的护膝，经过硬化处理，可以保护你的膝盖免受那些拿着棒球棍的疯子所伤。

messages.msgid: Leg guards made of stacked paper sheets held together with duct tape.
translations: 一对将许多纸张叠在一起，然后用胶带粘牢的纸护腿。

messages.msgid: pair of improvised tire leg guards
messages.plural: pairs of improvised tire leg guards

messages.msgid: Leg guards made of thick chunks of tire held together with duct tape.
translations: 一对将许多块轮胎片叠在一起，然后用胶带粘牢的护腿。

messages.msgid: A pair of leg guards made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings.
translations: 一对用金属碎片做成的护腿，碎片之间用小绳子固定。

messages.msgid: A pair of leg guards made from thick chunks of tire secured by simple strings; the loose collection of rubber plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.
translations: 一套用厚橡胶块做成的护腿，碎片之间用小绳子固定。这些松垮的小片片能提供不错的防护，但是还不够完美。

messages.msgid: A pair of thick jeans interwoven with Kevlar for added durability and sporting integrated kneepads and flank protection, typically worn by motorcyclists to protect from road rash.
translations: 一条嵌入了凯夫拉纤维以增加耐久度，并提供了一体化的护膝和侧腹保护的厚牛仔裤，摩托车手通常会穿这条牛仔裤，以防出车祸时受伤。

messages.msgid: A pair of jeans reinforced with hard plastic knee pads and metal sheets.  The end product is not very sturdy and somewhat cumbersome, but protective.
translations: 一条用硬塑料护膝和金属片加固的牛仔裤。 虽然不是很坚固还有点笨重，但至少能保护你。

messages.msgid: A pair of jeans reinforced with hard plastic knee pads and hardened steel sheets.  Although its high protection outweighs its encumbrance, it's not really sturdy.
translations: 一条用硬塑料护膝和硬化碳钢加固的牛仔裤。 虽然较高的防护能力超过了累赘程度，但它并不是很耐用。

messages.msgid: This is a heavy pair of trousers armored in Kevlar, Nomex, and foam padding, for use by explosive ordnance disposal technicians.  While it offers near complete coverage in fragmentation resistant materials, it still offers insufficient protection from ballistic threats.
translations: 这是一条由凯夫拉纤维、芳纶和泡沫衬垫制成的厚重长裤，供排爆技术员使用。 虽然它几乎完全被防破片材料覆盖了，但仍不足以抵御子弹的威胁。

messages.msgid: This is a heavy pair of trousers armored in Kevlar, Nomex, and foam padding, for use by explosive ordnance disposal technicians in 'non-permissive environments'.  While it offers near complete coverage in fragmentation resistant materials, it still offers insufficient protection from ballistic threats.  These trousers are lighter than normal EOD armor to provide more maneuverability.
translations: 这是一条由凯夫拉、芳纶和泡沫衬垫制成的厚重长裤，供排爆技术员在“非许可环境”中使用。 虽然它几乎完全覆盖了抗碎裂材料，但它仍然无法提供足够的防弹威胁保护。为了提供更强大的机动性，这条裤子比普通的拆弹护甲更轻。

messages.msgid: A light leg guard, 1.25 mm at the thickest.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件厚1.25毫米的轻型护腿。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A light leg guard, 1.25 mm at the thickest.  Made with tougher medium steel, this offers solid protection.
translations: 一件厚1.25毫米的轻型护腿。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A light leg guard, 1.25 mm at the thickest.  Made with high steel offering excellent protection.
translations: 一件厚1.25毫米的轻型护腿。这件是用更坚硬的高碳钢制成，提供出色的保护。

messages.msgid: A light leg guard, 1.25 mm at the thickest.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一件厚1.25毫米的轻型护腿。低碳钢经过硬化处理，提供更好的保护。

messages.msgid: A light leg guard, 1.25 mm at the thickest.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top of the line protection.
translations: 一件厚1.25毫米的轻型护腿。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: A leg guard, 1.75 mm at the thickest.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件厚1.75毫米的护腿。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A leg guard, 1.75 mm at the thickest.  Made with tougher medium steel, this offers solid protection.
translations: 一件厚1.75毫米的护腿。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A leg guard, 1.75 mm at the thickest.  Made with high steel offering excellent protection.
translations: 一件厚1.75毫米的护腿。这件是用更坚硬的高碳钢制成，提供出色的保护。

messages.msgid: A leg guard, 1.75 mm at the thickest.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一件厚1.75毫米的护腿。低碳钢经过硬化处理，提供更好的保护。

messages.msgid: A leg guard, 1.75 mm at the thickest.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top of the line protection.
translations: 一件厚1.75毫米的护腿。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy leg guard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件厚2.25毫米的重型护腿。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A heavy leg guard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  Made with tougher medium steel, this offers solid protection.
translations: 一件厚2.25毫米的重型护腿。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy leg guard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  Made with high steel offering excellent protection.
translations: 一件厚2.25毫米的重型护腿。这件是用更坚硬的高碳钢制成，提供出色的保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy leg guard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一件厚2.25毫米的重型护腿。低碳钢经过硬化处理，提供更好的保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy leg guard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top of the line protection.
translations: 一件厚2.25毫米的重型护腿。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: A pair of tough canvas pants with sections from leather pants affixed, excluding the joints.  Offers mild protection without compromising mobility too much, but a lot of the pockets have been removed to make room for the leather.
translations: 一条坚韧的帆布裤，上面贴有皮裤上裁下来的补丁，避开了关节处。可以提供少量防护，不会过多影响机动性，但许多口袋为了给皮革片腾出空间，已经被移除。

messages.msgid: A pair of tough canvas pants with sections of cotton sewn onto it in a crossing pattern, clearly done by an amateur.
translations: 一条坚韧的帆布裤子，上面缝有棉质的交叉图案，显然是出自业余制作者之手。

messages.msgid: Hard leg guards used by riot police.
translations: 防暴警察使用的硬质护腿。

messages.msgid: A pair of tough leather leg guards.  Light and comfortable.
translations: 一对轻便舒适的硬质皮革护臂。

messages.msgid: A traditional, ankle-length Buddhist skirt.  The bottom protrudes, and appears in the rough shape of a triangle.
translations: 安陀会是一种传统佛教的长至脚踝的裙子。其底部向外突出，大致成三角形。

messages.msgid: A pair of basketball shorts.  Comfortable and light.
translations: 一条棒球短裤，多为棒球运动员比赛或训练时所穿。舒适且轻便。

messages.msgid: A well-made pair of old-fashioned pants, made of stiff yet baggy material.  Comfortable, but lacks pockets.
translations: 一条精心制造的老款式裤子，使用的布料没什么弹性，所以制成较为宽松的尺寸。穿着舒适，但没有口袋。

messages.msgid: A breezy red cheerleader skirt.  Easy to move in, and of an acceptable length for most real cheerleading.
translations: 一条清凉的红色啦啦队短裙。穿进去很容易，而且长度符合大多数真正的啦啦队的要求。

messages.msgid: A very short and breezy red cheerleader skirt.  Easy to move in, but you will probably need shorts underneath to safely practice cheerleading in this.
translations: 一条非常短的清凉的红色啦啦队短裙。穿进去很容易，但你可能需要在下面穿条短裤来练习啦啦队舞。

messages.msgid: Waterproof plastic fishing waders with a single large front pocket.
translations: 一件由防水橡胶制成的，有着一个前置大口袋的渔夫装。

messages.msgid: A simple pair of short shorts.
A simple pair of fur short shorts.
A simple pair of leather short shorts.
A pair of jeans with two deep pockets.
translations: 一条有两个深口袋的牛仔裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of blue jeans with two deep pockets.
translations: 一条带有两个深口袋的蓝色牛仔裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of black jeans with two deep pockets.
translations: 一条有两个口袋的黑色牛仔裤。

messages.msgid: A stylish pair of bleached denim jeans.
translations: 一条时髦的漂白牛仔裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of old baggy jeans.  The heels are all ripped up.
translations: 一条破旧的布袋牛仔裤。裤脚都被撕裂了。

messages.msgid: A pair of jeans that has been ripped over the knees.  It may have been fashionable before Cataclysm, but it's just a pair of sub-par jeans now.
translations: 一条膝盖处有破洞的牛仔裤。 在大灾变之前它可能很流行，但现在它只是一条劣质的牛仔裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of vintage jeans that has started to lose its color.  It appears to be slightly heavier and thicker; but hey, don't let that stop you from wearing the fashion of the olden days!
translations: 一条已经开始褪色的复古牛仔裤。 看起来稍微重一点，厚一点；不要因此拒绝这复古的时尚！

messages.msgid: A pair of vintage jeans that has been around for so long that very little remains of its once vibrant blue color.  Otherwise it's surprisingly well preserved though.
translations: 这是一条非常旧的复古牛仔裤，曾经的鲜亮蓝色已所剩无几。然而令人惊讶的是，它保存得相当完好。

messages.msgid: A very old pair of black vintage jeans.  From paint marks here and there you assume this belonged to a painter.
translations: 这是一条很旧的黑色复古牛仔裤。上面随处可见的颜料痕迹让人猜测，它曾经属于一位画家。

messages.msgid: A groovy pair of stone washed denim jeans from the 80s.  It gets baggy around the ankles.  Perfect for pretending as if Cataclysm never happened and you are on your way to dance floor.
translations: 这是一条来自80年代的时髦水洗牛仔裤，裤腿在脚踝处略显宽松。穿上它，仿佛可以假装大灾变从未发生，你正迈向舞池。

messages.msgid: A pair of vintage blue jeans that has been preserved perfectly.  You can see the leather brand on its behind of company that hasn't been around for a long while, even before the Cataclysm.  This would have made a fortune if; well, you know, it wasn't apocalypse.
translations: 这是一条保存完好的复古蓝色牛仔裤。你可以看到其臀部的一个皮革品牌标签，那个品牌已经消失很久了，甚至在大灾变发生之前就已不存在。如果现在不是末世的话，这条裤子一定能卖出个好价钱。

messages.msgid: A pair of skinny jeans with two pockets.
translations: 一条有两个口袋的窄脚裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of blue skinny jeans with two pockets.
translations: 一条有两个口袋的蓝色窄脚裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of black skinny jeans with two pockets.
translations: 一条有两个口袋的黑色窄脚裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of red skinny jeans with two pockets.
translations: 一条有两个口袋的红色窄脚裤。

messages.msgid: No true Scotsman would leave home without his kilt.  Kilts lack pockets and thus a belt and sporran are necessary accessories.
translations: 苏格兰短裙是苏格兰人居家旅行必备衣物。这种短裙没有口袋，因此腰带和毛皮袋是必要的配件。

messages.msgid: Common in America, the utility kilt takes the traditional woolen kilt and constructs it out of cotton canvas and then adds a pocket that would never be on a traditional kilt.
translations: 这种实用短裙在美国很常见，其与传统苏格兰短裙不同，由棉帆布而非羊毛织成，并且还多了个口袋。

messages.msgid: No true Scotsman would leave home without his kilt.
translations:
一条苏格兰男性短裙，这是一种从腰部到膝盖的短裙，用花呢制造而成，布面有连续的大方格。
"没有任何真正的苏格兰人会不穿他的苏格兰短裙就出门"

messages.msgid: Skin-tight nylon leggings, sometimes used when exercising, that keep your legs nice and warm.
translations: 一条贴身的紧身尼龙裤，通常在锻炼时候穿着。保暖效果很好。

messages.msgid: This pair is a vibrant purple.
This pair is a muted olive green.
This pair has a printed flame pattern.
translations: 这件上面印着火焰图案。

messages.msgid: This pair has a zebra stripe pattern.
translations: 这件上面印着斑马条纹。

messages.msgid: This pair has a leopard print pattern.
This pair has a tiger stripe pattern.
This pair has a simple geometric pattern.
translations: 这件上面印着简单几何图案。

messages.msgid: Rags stitched together and tied into a makeshift loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.
translations: 把碎布缝在一起并系成的临时兜裆布。能遮羞，但也仅此而已。

messages.msgid: A fur pelt tied into a loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.  Now you are a true barbarian warrior.
translations: 把碎毛皮缝在一起并系成的临时兜裆布。能遮羞，但也仅此而已。

messages.msgid: Leather patches stitched together and tied into a makeshift loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.
translations: 把几片皮革缝在一起并系成的临时兜裆布。能遮羞，但也仅此而已。

messages.msgid: Bits of wool stitched together and tied into a makeshift loincloth.  Covers your modesty, but not much else.
translations: 把几片羊毛毡片缝在一起并系成的临时兜裆布。能遮羞，但也仅此而已。

messages.msgid: Apparently the microskirt wasn't short enough.
translations: 一件比超短裙还要更加暴露的纳米短裙。显然对于某些人，超短裙仍然不够短。

messages.msgid: A pair of khaki pants.  Slightly warmer than jeans.
translations: 一条卡其色的长裤，比牛仔裤稍微保暖些。

messages.msgid: A comfortable set of navy blue pants with large pockets, slightly thicker and warmer than regular jeans.
translations: 一条舒适的海蓝色长裤，带有深口袋，比一般的牛仔裤更厚也更暖和。

messages.msgid: A snappy set of black, neatly pressed trousers, perfect for formal events or looking professional.
translations: 一条干练舒适，烫熨齐整的长裤，非常适合正式的活动以及面试时穿着。

messages.msgid: A set of storm gray pants speckled with dark stains so deeply assimilated into the fabric that they're nigh-irremovable.  You vehemently hope that they're just the mortal remains of some spilled beverage.
translations: 这是一条风暴灰色的裤子，上面布满了深色的污渍，这些污渍已经深深地渗透到布料中，几乎无法去除。你强烈希望这些污渍只是某种泼洒饮料的残留物。

messages.msgid: A pair of soft, comfortable burgundy trousers with a button-up fly and spacious pockets.
translations: 一条柔软舒适的酒红色长裤，有着纽扣式开口和宽大的口袋。

messages.msgid: A set of rugged and comfortable trousers dyed a soft shade of violet, these pants come equipped with an adjustable waistband.
translations: 一条粗糙但舒适的长裤，染成浅浅的紫罗兰色，并配有一条可以调节的腰带。

messages.msgid: Boredom personified, this pair of corduroy pants is a dull hue of brown.
translations: 无趣的化身，这条灯芯绒长裤呈现乏味的棕色。

messages.msgid: A pair of milky, off-white pants dyed a shade of soft cream.  They're slightly warmer than jeans.
translations: 一条乳白色的长裤，染成了柔和的奶白色。它比牛仔裤稍稍暖和一些。

messages.msgid: A business-like set of stone-gray trousers for business-like people, these pants are the same hue as concrete and are relatively warm.
translations: 一条浅灰色的商务长裤，为职场人设计，色调类似于水泥，相对比较暖和。

messages.msgid: While these pants might not be English, their color certainly is.  More specifically, these comfortable trousers are a shade of British-khaki, a type of brownish-yellow hue developed by the empire's military for use in service uniforms.
translations: 虽然这些裤子可能不是英国的，但它们的颜色肯定是。 更具体地说，这些舒适的裤子是一种浅卡其色（British-khaki），一种由帝国军队开发的用于服务制服的棕黄色色调。

messages.msgid: A pair of casual, tan-hued pants with a slight yellowish overtone, intended to contrast with one's skin color.
translations: 一条休闲的、棕褐色的裤子，略带黄色，旨在与人的肤色形成对比。

messages.msgid: Flaunting an almost aggressively vibrant shade of bright pink, this pair of soft, plush pants is slightly warmer than far duller jeans and makes a bold statement to any onlookers: human, zombie, or otherwise.  Though, perhaps dressing up like an anthropomorphic Easter egg isn't, in retrospect, the wisest way to prolong your time on this earth.
translations: 这条柔软的、毛绒绒的裤子炫耀着几乎是咄咄逼人的鲜艳的粉红色，比起暗淡无光的牛仔裤，它略显温暖，并向任何旁观者发出了大胆的声明：人类、丧尸，或其他。 虽然，也许穿得像一个拟人化的复活节彩蛋并不是延长你在地球上存活时间的最明智的方法。

messages.msgid: A visually appealing and subtle blend of browns and deep reds characterizes this pair of pants, which come equipped with a drawstring at the waist, elastic cuffs, and zip-up pockets.  An energetic and sporting set of pants for high-energy situations.
translations: 这条裤子采用了深棕色和深红色的巧妙搭配，视觉效果出色。裤子配有腰间抽绳、弹性裤口和拉链口袋。这是一款充满活力、适合高强度运动的裤子。

messages.msgid: While these aren't US-issued military trousers or even civilian tactical pants, this article of clothing possesses a blend of dark greens, browns, and blacks identical to the camouflage pattern of Vietnam-era army uniforms.  Slightly warmer than regular jeans, it's a decent piece of faux-military kit for those unwilling to shill out on a pair of actual BDU pants.
translations: 虽然这不是美国发放的军裤，甚至不是民用战术裤，但这种衣服拥有与越南时代军队制服的迷彩图案相同的深绿色、棕色和黑色的混合色。 它比普通牛仔裤略微保暖，对于那些不愿意花钱买一条真正的战术裤的人来说，这是一件体面的仿军事装备。

messages.msgid: Not too dissimilar from the pattern adopted by older US Marine uniforms, this pair of otherwise conventional civilian pants is printed with a green, brown, and black woodland camouflage pattern.
translations: 这条裤子与美国海军陆战队的老式制服所采用的图案不太一样，这条原本传统的民用裤子印有绿色、棕色和黑色的林地迷彩图案。

messages.msgid: Similar in color to the old frog skin uniforms issued to Marine Raiders during the Second World War, this pair of warm, comfortable trousers is dyed a greenish gray hue.  Completely conventional in every other respect, the patterning would be incredibly helpful if you were planning to take a trip down to the Amazon any time soon.
translations: 与第二次世界大战期间发放给海军陆战队突击队员的旧蛙皮制服的颜色相似，这条温暖舒适的裤子被染成了青灰色。 在其他方面完全是传统的，如果你打算不久后去亚马逊旅行，这种图案会有很大的帮助。

messages.msgid: Possessing reinforced knees and a hardy construction, this set of trousers is resplendent in a camouflage pattern of mixed light greens, browns, and beige tones.  With a set of deep pockets and an insulated design, it's an ideal piece of legwear for outdoor ventures.
translations: 这套长裤拥有加固的膝盖和坚硬的结构，在浅绿色、棕色和米色混合的迷彩图案中显得格外耀眼。 它有一组深口袋和保温设计，是户外活动的理想裤装。

messages.msgid: The faithful friend of waterfowl hunters, this pair of pants is printed with a brown, gray, tan, and green camouflage pattern designed to blend in with the vegetation and reeds present in swamps and marshlands.
translations: 作为沼泽猎人的忠实朋友，这条裤子印有棕色、灰色、棕褐色和绿色的迷彩图案，旨在与沼泽地的植物和芦苇融为一体。

messages.msgid: Dyed a mix of brown, tan, and yellowish beige hues, this pair of hardy trousers is designed to seamlessly blend into arid environments.  That being said, the fact that New England is famously devoid of deserts means that the pattern's only utility is in looking cool.
translations: 这条长裤混合了棕色、褐色和米黄色的色调，旨在无缝地融入干旱的环境。 也就是说，新英格兰没有沙漠这一事实意味着该图案的唯一效用是看起来很酷。

messages.msgid: The companion of aspiring mountaineers and alpine hunters, these brown, gray, and white dyed pants possess a network of jagged shapes and mottled lines, designed to break up the wearer's profile and better conceal them against the background landscape of mountains.
translations: 作为有抱负的登山者和高山猎人的伴侣，这条被染成棕色、灰色和白色的裤子拥有锯齿状的网络和斑驳的线条，这样设计的目的是打破穿着者的轮廓，并在山峦的背景色中更好地隐蔽。

messages.msgid: A set of rugged yet comfortable pants dyed in various scales of gray, black, and dirty white, possessing a set of sizable pockets, and printed with squares and irregular polygons to disrupt a wearer's silhouette within man-made environments.  You would honestly not be surprised if you learned that this singular pair of trousers contains 50 shades of gray.
translations: 一套粗犷，结实且舒适的裤子，染成了不同比例的灰色、黑色和脏白色，拥有一组可观的口袋，并印有正方形和不规则的多边形以在人造环境中模糊穿着者的轮廓。 老实说，如果你知道这条奇特的裤子包含50种灰色，你一定不会感到惊讶。

messages.msgid: Featuring a camouflage pattern consisting of white, shades of gray, and a slight tinge of brown, this pair of rugged pants is fit for snowy tundra and polar regions—or it would be, had the garment not been only moderately warmer than jeans.  You have yet to grasp their point for existing.
translations: 这条裤子采用了由白色、灰色和棕色组成的迷彩图案，适合在雪地苔原和极地地区穿着，或者说，如果这件衣服不比牛仔裤暖和的话，它就会是这样。 你还没有把握住他们存在的意义。

messages.msgid: Dyed a deep hue of urban black, this pair of hardwearing pants is designed to assist a wearer in concealing themselves within nighttime environments and low-light conditions.  While they're simple civilian trousers given a stealth-black paint job and don't hold a candle to their more marshal brothers, they still look cool and are great at making you feel like you're Spetsnaz.
translations: 这条耐穿的裤子被染成了深色调的城市黑色，旨在帮助穿着者在夜间环境和低光照条件下隐藏自己。 虽然它们是简单的民用长裤，被涂上了隐身黑漆，尽管不能与它们数量更多的制式版本兄弟相提并论，但它们看起来仍然很酷，并能让你觉得自己是特种部队。

messages.msgid: Notorious for either looking fabulous or disastrous with little in between, this stylish pair of boot-cut white trousers will almost certainly gain a plethora of irremovable stains as soon as you set foot beyond the threshold of your abode.
translations: 这条时尚的靴筒式白色长裤要么看起来很好，要么看起来很糟糕，两者之间几乎没有什么区别，几乎可以肯定的是，只要你一踏出住所的门槛，就会有大量的不可去除的污渍。

messages.msgid: Reminiscent of the color of flames, this pair of cotton trackpants is, perhaps optimistically, dyed a muted shade of burned orange.
translations: 这条棉质长裤让人联想到火焰的颜色，也许是乐观的，它被染成了一种柔和的烧焦的橙色。

messages.msgid: These pair of sky blue pants are resplendent with a pair of stitched American flags, their flag poles running down each leg, and a standard flanking the trousers' front and rear.  "Freedom" is boldly stitched across the fly and enclosed by a ring of golden stars, while the back bears the legend, "Liberbooty!"
translations: 这条天蓝色长裤光彩夺目，两侧腿部各缝有一面美国国旗，旗杆沿裤腿延伸而下，前后裤腰处还装饰有标准旗帜。裤门襟上大胆地绣着“Freedom（自由）”字样，被一圈金色星星环绕，而后部则赫然印着“Liberbooty!（自由万岁！）”的标语。

messages.msgid: A tough pair of pants lined with pockets.  Favored by the military.
translations: 一条结实的长裤，外面有许多口袋。深受军人喜爱。

messages.msgid: A tough pair of pants.  Favored by the military.  This pair sports the US Army's gray, green and tan Universal Camouflage Pattern.  The pattern is notable for its lack of black.
translations: 一条结实的军用长裤。这条上面印着灰色、绿色和棕褐色的迷彩。这种迷彩图案的特点是没有黑色。

messages.msgid: A tough pair of military pants patterned in desert camouflage.  They are lined with deep pockets.
translations: 一条结实的军用长裤。这条是沙漠迷彩款式。上面缝着结实的口袋。

messages.msgid: A tough pair of military pants with a black, green and tan pixel camouflage pattern.  Commonly seen worn by US Marines.
translations: 一条结实的军用长裤。这条上面印着黑色、绿色和棕褐色的像素迷彩。通常是由美国海军陆战队使用。

messages.msgid: A tough pair of military pants with the black, brown, green and tan Battle Dress camouflage pattern.  They look old.
translations: 一条结实的军用长裤。这条上面印着黑色、棕色、绿色和褐色的迷彩。看上去已经很旧了。

messages.msgid: A tough and breathable pair of military pants in Operational Camouflage Pattern.
translations: 一条绘有作战迷彩图案的军用长裤，坚韧耐磨，透气舒适。

messages.msgid: A tough pair of military pants with a predominantly dark blue camouflage.  Favored by the US Navy.
translations: 一条结实的军用长裤。这条上面印着深蓝色的迷彩。看上去已经很旧了。通常是由美国海军使用。

messages.msgid: A pair of pants lined with pockets, offering lots of storage.
translations: 带多口袋设计的裤子，提供很大的携带容量。

messages.msgid: In a pinch, these pants can be used for an impromptu game of checkers.
translations: 一条嬉皮士们喜欢穿的花格喇叭裤。也许能够当作应急的国际象棋棋盘使用。

messages.msgid: A hefty pair of fur-lined pants.
translations: 一条带有毛皮内衬的厚实裤子。非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A pair of long cotton pants lined with warm imitation fur.
translations: 一条棉质长裤，内衬着十分保暖的人造毛皮。

messages.msgid: A pair of black trousers with calf and waistband ties.  Comfortable to use but lacks pockets.
translations: 一条黑色裤子，在小腿和腰部有系带。穿着舒适，但没有口袋。

messages.msgid: A pair of black leather pants.  Very tough, but cumbersome and without much storage.
translations: 一条黑色皮革长裤。非常结实耐用，但有点累赘，而且没有多少存储空间。

messages.msgid: A pair of pants meant for alpine skiing.
translations: 一条适合高山滑雪时使用的保暖长裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of tight-fitting police breeches.  Offers lots of mobility for motorized officers.
translations: 一条紧身的警用马裤。能让摩托警官行动自如。

messages.msgid: A pair of dark blue shorts, the kind used by postal service workers.
translations: 一条深蓝色短裤，通常是邮政人员的工作服。

messages.msgid: A pair of red shorts with white trim.  For when Santa is on summer vacation.
translations: 一条白色镶边的红色短裤。也许是圣诞老人放暑假时穿的。

messages.msgid: A pair of red pants with white faux fur trim, commonly used by bearded men on Christmas.  Somewhat warm and has two deep pockets.
translations: 一条装饰着白色人造毛皮的红色长裤，常被那个在圣诞节出现的长胡子男人使用。有些保暖而且还有两个深口袋。

messages.msgid: A pair of shorts lined with pockets, offering decent storage.
translations: 带多口袋设计的短裤，提供不错的携带容量。

messages.msgid: A pair of stone wash denim shorts.
translations: 一条石磨水洗的牛仔短裤。

messages.msgid: An old pair of denim jeans that have been cut down into shorts.
translations: 一条被裁成短裤的旧牛仔裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of brand-name black denim shorts.
translations: 一条名牌黑色牛仔短裤。

messages.msgid: A blue skirt made from denim.
translations: 一件由牛仔布制成的蓝色裙子。

messages.msgid: A short, breezy cotton skirt.  Easy to move in, but only has a single small pocket.
translations: 一条青春又清凉的棉短裙。穿进去很容易，但它只有一个小口袋。

messages.msgid: A long skirt with no pockets.  Slightly more cumbersome but warmer than a normal skirt.
translations: 没有口袋的长裙。稍微厚重一些，但比普通的裙子暖和一点。

messages.msgid: A primitive skirt made from grass.  Not actually useful for much other than looking like a tribal person.
translations: 一条自制的草裙。除了让你看起来像个原始人外，其实没什么用。

messages.msgid: A very short leather skirt, clearly designed to look good, not be practical.
translations: 一条非常短的皮短裙，明显是为了外观好看的设计，并不是很实用。

messages.msgid: A pair of pants with horizontal black and white stripes.
translations: 一条带有水平黑白相间条纹的裤子。

messages.msgid: A pair of gray canvas work pants.
translations: 一条灰色的帆布工装长裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of blue canvas work pants.
translations: 一条蓝色的帆布工装长裤。

messages.msgid: A pair of light-blue canvas work pants.
translations: 一条浅蓝色的帆布工装长裤。

messages.msgid: A tough pair of pants lined with pockets, thickly padded for warmth.  Favored by the military.
translations: 一条厚实的长裤，上面缝着不少口袋，有防寒衬里。军队指定用品。

messages.msgid: Plain white zubon for use in martial arts.
translations: 一件白色的日式短裤，一般为习武者穿戴。

messages.msgid: A water-resistant pair of lightweight, flexible hiking pants with a good number of pockets.
translations: 一条防水的轻便灵活的登山裤，口袋数量不少。

messages.msgid: Coated in more pockets than is probably either necessary or healthy and looking like they belong within a SWAT locker, these rugged combat pants possess a water-repellent coating, tough double-stitched seams, reinforced belt loops, and articulated knees.
translations: 这种坚固的战斗裤拥有比必要或舒适更多的口袋，看起来就像属于特警的储物柜，具有防水涂层、坚韧的双缝接缝、加固皮带环和铰接式膝盖。

messages.msgid: This particular pair is dyed a muted, beige-like shade of wolf gray.
translations: 这条裤子被染成了一种柔和的、类似米色的狼灰色。

messages.msgid: This pair is predominantly an earthy shade of coyote brown.
translations: 这条裤子主要是土黄色的郊狼棕色。

messages.msgid: This pair sports a warm, yellowish beige desert tan hue—a bold choice, considering New England's notable lack of deserts.
translations: 这款采用温暖的黄褐色沙漠色调——鉴于新英格兰地区显著缺乏沙漠，这是一个大胆的选择。

messages.msgid: This worn and smoke-hued pair is completely dyed black.
translations: 这条破旧的烟色裤子是完全染成黑色的。

messages.msgid: This remarkably drab, traditional camouflage pair is dyed a muted shade of OD green, much like old US Army battle dress.
translations: 这条非常单调的传统迷彩裤被染成了暗淡的军绿色，很像老美军的作战服。

messages.msgid: A short skirt for the Boston-Chan costume.
translations: 波士顿酱cosplay套装中的短裙。

messages.msgid: A warm covering that protects the head and face from the cold.
translations: 一个只露出眼睛，非常暖和的棉制头部面罩。

messages.msgid: A skull-print balaclava covering the head and face, commonly used by motorcycle riders and as part of a costume.
translations: 一条覆盖头部和面部的骷髅头骨图案的面罩，通常用于摩托车骑手，或是COS服装的一部分。

messages.msgid: A face covering that helps protect from slashes and cuts, in addition to the cold.
translations: 一个把脸盖得严实的面罩，有助于防止脸部被割伤，而且很保暖。

messages.msgid: A cotton bandana, worn over the mouth for warmth and minor protection from dust and other contaminants.
translations: 一条可以覆盖在嘴上的棉制方巾，可以保暖并减少吸入尘土和有害物质。

messages.msgid: You adjust the %s to cover your head.
translations: 你调整 %s 来覆盖头部。

messages.msgid: A tight mask made of black leather.  The eyes and mouth can be closed using zippers.
translations: 一个黑色皮革做的紧身面具，眼部和嘴部有拉链。

messages.msgid: You zip the eyes and mouth of the bondage mask closed.
translations: 你将面罩眼部和嘴部的拉链拉上。

messages.msgid: A tight mask made of black leather.  The eyes and mouth have been zipped closed.
translations: 一个黑色皮革做的紧身面具，眼部和嘴部的拉链已经被拉上。

messages.msgid: You unzip the eyes and mouth of the bondage mask.
translations: 你将面罩眼部和嘴部的拉链拉开。

messages.msgid: A tough hood made of steel mesh used by fencers.
translations: 一个面部以钢丝网制成、防止击剑等运动时发生意外的击剑防护面罩。

messages.msgid: A protective reinforced Kevlar mask that covers the face.  Provides excellent protection from ballistic threats.
translations: 一个凯夫拉加固的防护面具，提供出色的防护并减少子弹的威胁。

messages.msgid: A simple piece of cotton that straps over the mouth.  Provides a small amount of protection from airborne illness and dust.
translations: 一个能抵挡灰尘与病原体入侵的简单口罩。

messages.msgid: It's a clean white color, like the ones doctors use.
translations: 它是干净的白色，就像医生用的那种。

messages.msgid: It's yellow and decorated with a flower pattern.
translations: 它是黄色的，上面印着花朵图案。

messages.msgid: It's printed with a camouflage pattern.
It has a large mustache printed on it.
translations: 它上面印着一个大大的八字胡。

messages.msgid: It's black, with a skull mouth design.
translations: 它是黑色的，上面印着骷髅嘴图案。

messages.msgid: It has cartoon characters printed on it.
translations: 它上面印着一个卡通角色。

messages.msgid: It's colored black, with a steampunk design.  Very fashionable.
translations: 它是黑色的，带有蒸汽朋克设计。非常时髦。

messages.msgid: It's printed with an American flag pattern.  Perfect for a real patriot.
translations: 它上面印着星条旗图案。非常适合真正的爱国者。

messages.msgid: Remember, remember, the fifth of November.
translations:
一个有着戏谑的狰笑与阴邪的黑色胡子白色塑料面具。
"记住，记住11月5日。"

messages.msgid: A protective face mask made of thick plastic.  Commonly worn by hockey goalies.
translations: 一个曲棍球守门用的厚塑料防护面具。

messages.msgid: A t-shirt with the sleeves tied behind the back of one's head.  These are usually worn by rioters to hide their identity.
translations: 一个将头套进T恤的领口，然后把袖子从后面扎住裹在头上而成的简易面罩，通常由制造骚乱的暴徒们隐藏身份使用。

messages.msgid: A plastic mask that covers the face.
translations: 一张戴在脸上的塑料面具。
这是张骷髅面具。好吓人。

messages.msgid: It's modeled after a green goblin.
translations: 这张是以绿色哥布林为原型设计的。

messages.msgid: It's a mask of a unicorn with a plastic piece sticking out as a horn.
translations: 这是张独角兽面具，上面有一块塑料作为角。

messages.msgid: It's modeled after an American black bear.
translations: 这张是以美洲黑熊为原型设计的。

messages.msgid: It's a cheesy plastic zombie mask.  You miss when they were just fiction.
translations: 这张丧尸面具与你平时遇见的那些一比可太廉价了。你怀念它们还只是虚构的时候。

messages.msgid: It's a plastic mask of a certain heister who heists the loud way.
translations: 这是一个塑料面具，上面画着某位大张旗鼓的劫匪。

messages.msgid: It's a plastic mask of a lonely spirit.
translations: 这是一张孤独幽灵塑料面具。

messages.msgid: A fake white beard that straps over the mouth.  Perfect for your Santa costume!
translations: 一条戴在嘴上的假白胡子。和你的圣诞老人套装很配！

messages.msgid: A simple piece of cotton that covers your face.
translations: 一块盖住你的脸的简单棉布。

messages.msgid: It's colored black with a rather fancy looking golden trim.
translations: 它的纯黑色的，四周有道十分漂亮的金色镶边。

messages.msgid: A flimsy plastic pumpkin mask to wear over your head.
translations: 一个可以带在头上南瓜面具，看起来很廉价，只由一层薄塑料制成。

messages.msgid: A flimsy leather zombie mask.  When zombies were still works of fiction.
translations: 一个单薄的皮制丧尸面具，当然，是大灾变前虚构作品中的丧尸形象。

messages.msgid: A chicken mask that looks like a killer in Miami would wear.
translations: 一个看起来像迈阿密杀手的鸡面具。

messages.msgid: A green skinned full-face mask, much like the one from The Mask.
translations: 一个绿色皮肤的全脸面具，很像《面具》里的那个。

messages.msgid: A white mask with a screaming face on it, much like the mask Ghostface worn in Scream, black hood included.
translations: 一个白色的面具，上面有一张尖叫的脸，还带有一个黑色的兜帽，很像《呐喊》中的幽灵面具。

messages.msgid: A full-head mask with hair, much like the one worn by Michael Myers in Halloween.
translations: 一个覆盖全头的假发面具，酷似《月光光心慌慌》中迈克尔·麦尔斯所戴的那款。

messages.msgid: A full-head mask that looks like the head of Frankenstein's monster.
translations: 一个全包面具，可能让你看起来像弗兰肯斯坦的怪物。

messages.msgid: A beaked leather mask used by plague doctors.
translations: 瘟疫医生使用的皮革鸟喙面具。

messages.msgid: A colorful and ridiculous wig fit for a clown.
translations: 一顶五颜六色的滑稽搞笑的小丑假发。

messages.msgid: A red latex nose often worn by clowns.  Squeezing the nose makes it honk.
translations: 一个小丑常戴的红色乳胶鼻子。按压鼻子就会发出响声。

messages.msgid: A delicate golden crown featuring flowering trees.
translations: 一顶缀满花树纹饰的精致金冠。

messages.msgid: A golden crown for the monarch of survivors.
translations: 一顶幸存者之王的金冠。

messages.msgid: A protective piece of equipment commonly used by athletes, worn inside the mouth to protect your teeth.
translations: 一个拳击运动员常用的保护性装备。戴在嘴里以保护牙齿。

messages.msgid: A skinny black and white checkered necktie.
translations: 一条细长的黑白相间的格子领带。

messages.msgid: A large sleeping bag that covers you head to toe, with a strap for carrying it on your back when not in use.  This one is medium weight.  Activate it to unroll it so you can use it for warmth.
translations: 一个可以把你从头到脚包住的大睡袋，不用时可以用带子扎起来背在背上。这个是中等重量的型号。它现在绑好了；使用它来取暖。

messages.msgid: A large sleeping bag lined with fur, with a strap for carrying it on your back when not in use.  Who needs a tent?  It is currently unrolled; activate it roll it up for easy storage.
translations: 一个可以把你从头到脚包住的内衬毛皮的大睡袋，不用时可以用袋子扎起来背在背上。谁还需要帐篷呢。当前已展开；使用它把它绑好，便于存放。

messages.msgid: You roll up the fur sleeping bag, preparing it for transport.
translations: 你把毛皮睡袋卷起来，便于携带。

messages.msgid: A large sleeping bag lined with fur, with a strap for carrying it on your back when not in use.  Who needs a tent?  Activate it to unroll it so you can use it for warmth.
translations: 一个可以把你从头到脚包住的内衬毛皮的大睡袋，不用时可以用袋子扎起来背在背上。谁还需要帐篷呢。它现在绑好了；使用它来取暖。

messages.msgid: You unroll the fur sleeping bag.
A simple black bow tie.  Best worn with a suit.
translations: 一个简单的领结，搭配西装更佳。

messages.msgid: A clip-on necktie with blue and silver stripes.  It's quick and easy to put on, and really, who's going to know the difference?
translations: 一根有着蓝色和银色条纹的夹式领带。夹式领带便于穿戴，而且说真的，谁会知道它们的差别呢？

messages.msgid: An ordinary green necktie.  Knowing how to properly tie it takes some practice, but it's an important skill to learn.  Clip-ons are for children.
translations: 一根普通的绿色领带，知道如何正确地打领带需要一些练习，但这是一项需要学习的重要技能。夹式领带是给孩子们戴的。

messages.msgid: A pair of white vampire fangs made of plastic.
translations: 一对白色的塑料吸血鬼尖牙。
一个带有花边的结婚面纱。

messages.msgid: A plastic sheet with several grommets for securing it with rope or cord.  Useful for improvised rain protection.
translations: 用绳子或线固定的塑料片，还算有效的临时防雨措施。

messages.msgid: A set of leather straps attached to a wooden box, to fulfill the commandment written in Deuteronomy that states "And you shall set these words of Mine upon your heart and upon your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand and they shall be for ornaments between your eyes."  This one is for the left arm.
translations: 一套皮带系在一个木盒子上，以履行在申命记写下的戒律: “你们要把我的这些话放在你们的心上和灵魂上，绑在你们的手上作记号，在你们的眼睛之间作装饰品。” 这个是给左臂用的。

messages.msgid: A set of leather straps attached to a wooden box, to fulfill the commandment written in Deuteronomy that states "And you shall set these words of Mine upon your heart and upon your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand and they shall be for ornaments between your eyes."  This one is for the right arm.
translations: 一套皮带系在一个木盒子上，以履行在申命记写下的戒律: “你们要把我的这些话放在你们的心上和灵魂上，绑在你们的手上作记号，在你们的眼睛之间作装饰品。” 这个是给右臂用的。

messages.msgid: A set of leather straps attached to a wooden box, to fulfill the commandment written in Deuteronomy that states "And you shall set these words of Mine upon your heart and upon your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand and they shall be for ornaments between your eyes."  This one is for the forehead.
translations: 一套皮带系在一个木盒子上，以履行在申命记写下的戒律: “你们要把我的这些话放在你们的心上和灵魂上，绑在你们的手上作记号，在你们的眼睛之间作装饰品。” 这个是头部使用的。

messages.msgid: A long blue hair wig for the Boston-Chan costume.
translations: 波士顿酱cosplay套装中的蓝色长假发。

messages.msgid: Two oval disks attached to a chain, worn by military personnel for identification.
translations: 挂在链条上的两个椭圆盘，由军事人员佩戴用于识别身份。

messages.msgid: A heavy, mattress-like armor of cloth, leather and thick linings of Kevlar, originally used as protection in bullfighting.  You could put this on a friendly cow.
translations: 一套由棉布、皮革和厚厚的凯夫拉内衬制成的沉重的床垫状盔甲，最初用于斗牛时的保护。你可以将这套牛铠穿在一头友好的牛身上。

messages.msgid: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from biosilicified chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly cow.  Acid-resistant but brittle.
translations: 一套使用硅化甲壳块自制的动物铠甲，包含鸡颈，当胸和搭后，贴合在一层细网外。你可以把这套牛铠套在一头友好的牛身上。这个版本防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly cow.
translations: 一套使用甲壳块自制的动物铠甲，包含鸡颈，当胸和搭后，贴合在一层细网外。你可以把这套牛铠套在一头友好的牛身上。

messages.msgid: A heavy covering of chainmail, suitably made for cows as protection.  You could put this on a friendly cow.
translations: 一套厚厚的铁环链甲，专门为保护牛打造。你可以将这套牛铠穿在一头友好的牛身上。

messages.msgid: boiled leather cow barding with caparison
messages.plural: boiled leather cow bardings with caparison

messages.msgid: A full barding for cows consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison depicts a battle between a monstrous dragon and regal griffin.  You could put this on a friendly cow.
translations: 一套全身牛铠，由鞣制皮革和布制内衬构成。马铠上的装饰描述了一只恶龙与一匹皇家狮鹫之间的战斗。你可以将这套牛铠套在一头友好的牛身上。

messages.msgid: boiled leather cow barding with bones
messages.plural: boiled leather cow bardings with bones

messages.msgid: Decorative bones affixed to leather cow barding to invoke fear in bandits and raiders and traders all!  You could put this on a friendly cow.
translations: 一套鞣制皮革制成的牛铠，上面附加了许多装饰性的骨钉，足以使强盗、掠夺者和商人们感到恐惧！你可以将这套牛铠套在一头友好的牛身上。

messages.msgid: A thin plastic covering designed to keep a cow dry in the rain.  You could put this on a friendly cow.
translations: 一层薄薄的能覆盖一头牛全身的塑料布，使牛在雨中保持干燥。你可以将这套雨衣套一头友好的牛身上。

messages.msgid: A heavy covering of strategically-placed iron plates and leather, suitably made for cows as protection.  You could put this on a friendly cow.
translations: 一套厚厚的皮甲，关键部位有精心放置的铁板，专门为保护牛而打造。你可以将这套牛铠穿在一头友好的牛身上。

messages.msgid: A heavy covering of steel plate and leather, suitably made for cows as protection.  You could put this on a friendly cow.
translations: 一套厚厚的皮甲，关键部位有精心放置的钢板，专门为保护牛而打造。你可以将这套牛铠穿在一头友好的牛身上。

messages.msgid: A heavy covering of strategically-placed bronze plates and leather, suitably made for cows as protection.  You could put this on a friendly cow.
translations: 一套厚厚的皮甲，关键部位有精心放置的青铜板，专门为保护牛而打造。你可以将这套牛铠穿在一头友好的牛身上。

messages.msgid: A blue bulletproof harness, designed to be worn by canines in the service of local law enforcement, that protects from the shoulders to the abdomen.  You could put this on a friendly dog.
translations: 一套蓝色的防弹犬具，为当地执法机构的巡逻警犬而设计，覆盖肩部到腹部。你可以将这套犬具穿在一匹友好的狗身上。

messages.msgid: A makeshift canine harness of biosilicified chitin fitted to a thin mesh, protecting from the neck to the flank.  You could put this on a friendly dog.  Acid-resistant but brittle.
translations: 一套自制的犬具，上面的生物硅化甲壳片和薄薄的网状织物贴合在一起，保护狗的侧面和颈部。你可以将这套犬具穿在一匹友好的狗身上。防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: A makeshift canine harness of chitin fitted to a thin mesh, protecting from the neck to the flank.  You could put this on a friendly dog.
translations: 一套自制的犬具，上面的生物甲壳片和薄薄的网状织物贴合在一起，保护狗的侧面和颈部。你可以将这套犬具穿在一匹友好的狗身上。

messages.msgid: Protecteth yon hund fram ful daemons!  You could put this on a friendly dog.
translations: 为你的狗提供可怕的防御力。你可以将这套犬具穿在一匹友好的狗身上。

messages.msgid: A neck to hip harness made from leather that can be attached to a canine for protection.  You could put this on a friendly dog.
translations: 一套皮革制成的犬具，从脖子一直覆盖到臀部，可以穿在狗身上进行保护。你可以将这套犬具穿在一匹友好的狗身上。

messages.msgid: Decorative bones affixed to a leather dog harness for that true post-apocalyptic style, including a skull bone headpiece!  You could put this on a friendly dog.
translations: 一套皮革制成的犬具，上面附加了许多装饰性的骨钉，甚至还用头骨做了个头饰，满满的大灾变风格！你可以将这套犬具穿在一匹友好的狗身上。

messages.msgid: A thin plastic covering designed to keep a dog dry in the rain.  You could put this on a friendly dog.
translations: 一层薄薄的能覆盖犬只全身的塑料布，能使狗在雨中保持干燥。你可以将这套犬具穿在一匹友好的狗身上。

messages.msgid: A heavy, mattress-like armor of cloth, leather and thick linings of Kevlar, originally used as protection in bullfighting.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套由棉布、皮革和厚厚的凯夫拉内衬制成的沉重的床垫状盔甲，最初用于斗牛时的保护。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from biosilicified chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly horse.  Acid-resistant but brittle.
translations: 一套使用硅化甲壳块自制的动物铠甲，包含鸡颈，当胸和搭后，贴合在一层细网外。你可以把这套马铠套在一匹友好的马身上。这个版本防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: A makeshift assembly of criniere, peytral and croupiere made from chitin fitted to a thin mesh.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套使用甲壳块自制的动物铠甲，包含鸡颈，当胸和搭后，贴合在一层细网外。你可以把这套马铠套在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A heavy covering of chainmail, suitably made for horses as protection.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套厚厚的铁环链甲，专门为保护马匹打造。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: boiled leather horse barding with caparison
messages.plural: boiled leather horse bardings with caparison

messages.msgid: A full barding for horses consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison depicts a battle between a monstrous dragon and regal griffin.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套全身马铠，由鞣制皮革和布制内衬构成。马铠上的装饰描述了一只恶龙与一匹皇家狮鹫之间的战斗。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A full barding for horses consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison depicts a red dragon breathing fire on cities.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套全身马铠，由鞣制皮革和布制内衬构成。马铠上的装饰描述了一只红龙向城市喷吐烈火。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A full barding for horses consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison depicts a bear standing on its hind legs, forelegs outstretched in a menacing manner.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套全身马铠，由鞣制皮革和布制内衬构成。马铠上的装饰描述了一只熊用后腿直立起来，并威胁性地伸展它的前腿，准备扑击。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A full barding for horses consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison depicts an assortment of fruits and vegetables with a very large orange featured in the foreground.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套全身马铠，由鞣制皮革和布制内衬构成。马铠上的装饰描绘了一个巨大的橘子，背景中还有各种水果蔬菜。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A full barding for horses consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison depicts a massive vulture perched on a mountain.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套全身马铠，由鞣制皮革和布制内衬构成。马铠上的装饰描绘了一只栖息在高山上的秃鹫。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A full barding for horses consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison depicts the mythical Erymanthian boar in various artistic forms.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套全身马铠，由鞣制皮革和布制内衬构成。马铠上的装饰以多种艺术形式描绘了希腊神话中凶恶的厄律曼托斯野猪。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A full barding for horses consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison seems to be sponsored by Rycon Construction, with a tag line of "From down under to your home, we play all the roles from start to finish!".  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套全身马铠，由鞣制皮革和布制内衬构成。马铠上的装饰看起来由瑞康建筑公司赞助，包含公司的广告词："从澳大利亚到你的家中，从动土到封顶，我们什么活都接！"。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A full barding for horses consisting of boiled leather and cloth undercovering.  This caparison seems to be sponsored by Core Generator Tech, with a tag line of "Providing power solutions from culinary to graphic design, we have the magic touch for your problems!".  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套全身马铠，由鞣制皮革和布制内衬构成。马铠上的装饰看起来由核心发电科技公司赞助，包含公司的广告词："提供从烹饪到平面设计的电源解决方案，有难题找我们！"。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: boiled leather horse barding with bones
messages.plural: boiled leather horse bardings with bones

messages.msgid: Decorative bones affixed to leather horse barding to invoke fear in bandits and raiders and traders all!  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套鞣制皮革制成的马铠，上面附加了许多装饰性的骨钉，足以使强盗、掠夺者和商人们感到恐惧！你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A thin plastic covering designed to keep a horse dry in the rain.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一层薄薄的能覆盖马匹全身的塑料布，能使马在雨中保持干燥。你可以将这套犬具穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A heavy covering of strategically-placed iron plates and leather, suitably made for horses as protection.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套厚厚的皮甲，关键部位有精心放置的铁甲，专门为保护马匹打造。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A heavy covering of steel plate and leather, suitably made for horses as protection.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套厚厚的皮甲，关键部位有精心放置的钢板，专门为保护马匹打造。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A heavy covering of strategically-placed bronze plates and leather, suitably made for horses as protection.  You could put this on a friendly horse.
translations: 一套厚厚的皮甲，关键部位有精心放置的青铜甲，专门为保护马匹打造。你可以将这套马铠穿在一匹友好的马身上。

messages.msgid: A pair of covered pouches laid across the back of a horse behind the saddle.
translations: 一对有盖的袋子横放在马鞍后面的马背上。

messages.msgid: A custom-designed poncho for the true frontier explorer, made with aramid fibers and robust ripstop nylon.  Striped in brown and blue, the white seal of Hub 01 is emblazoned proudly on the front.  It features several quick access pouches attached to a waist drawstring, and two waterproof dry bags for carrying liquids.  It also features several tight clamps and velcro strips around the waist and shoulders; perhaps something attaches to them.
translations: 一条为真正的边疆探险家定制设计的披风，由凯夫拉纤维和极厚的防裂布制成。上面使用棕蓝相间的条纹，Hub 01的标志被自豪地印在了披风的正面。自带了挂在腰部拉绳上的几个快速存取口袋和两个防水干袋，用于盛装液体。此外在腰部和肩部也有几个夹具和尼龙搭扣；也许能在上面安装些其他挂件。
Hub 01 模块化防护空间锚

messages.msgid: A custom-designed poncho for the true frontier explorer, made with aramid fibers and robust ripstop nylon.  This one features a hardened skeleton of ceramic plates running up and over the shoulders, and a portion of the front has been raised upwards from the rest.  Lifting the fabric reveals a large disc-shaped device installed into the garment, featureless except for a prominent switch and Hub 01's logo in LED.  In addition to the poncho's usual complement of storage, a battery compartment has been added that wires into this device, featuring very specialized connectors and, perhaps a little disconcertingly, radiation shielding.
translations: 一条为真正的边疆探险家定制设计的披风，由凯夫拉纤维和极厚的防裂布制成。这款型号上装满了一直向上覆盖到肩部的陶瓷护甲板，在正面的一部分向前凸出。提起织物，可以看到下方一个巨大的圆盘状装置安装在装甲上，除了一个突出的开关和Hub 01的LED标志外，没有其他特征。除了原版披风所带的储物空间外，还额外增加了一个电池箱，可以连接到设备上，具有非常独特的连接器，可能还有一个令人不安的辐射屏蔽层。

messages.msgid: You activate the anchor, and the Hub 01 logo on your front begins to glow white.
translations: 你开启了空间锚，正面的Hub 01标志开始发光。
Hub 01 模块化防护空间锚（开）

messages.msgid: A custom-designed poncho for the true frontier explorer, made with aramid fibers and robust ripstop nylon.  The logo of Hub 01 emblazoned on the chest is glowing white.
translations: 一条为真正的边疆探险家定制设计的披风，由凯夫拉纤维和极厚的防裂布制成。这款型号上装满了一直向上覆盖到肩部的陶瓷护甲板，在正面的一部分向前凸出。胸前印着Hub 01的标志，正在发出白光。

messages.msgid: The Hub logo on your front stops glowing.

Heavy duty hooded headwear for the true frontier explorer, made with robust Nylon sheeting reinforced with Kevlar fibers.  The top consists of a series of plastic plates with hooks and velcro strips, perhaps for attaching additional parts.  On the forehead of the assembly is a bulky box visor on a mechanism to quickly pull it down over your eyes, with a cover on the side to insert standard batteries.  Activate to lower the visor and use the light amplification functions.
translations: 为真正的先驱探险家设计的带兜帽重型头盔，由坚固的化纤织物与凯夫拉纤维加固而成。头盔顶部装有一系列塑料板，上面附有挂钩和尼龙搭扣带，推测是用来安装附加模块的。头盔前额处装有一个厚重的盒状护目镜，通过目镜支架可以迅速将其拉下覆盖眼部，侧边有一个电池仓盖，可用于放入标准电池供电。激活以降下护目镜并启用微光增强功能。

messages.msgid: You lower the visor and flick the control dial to light amplification mode.
translations: 你放下护目镜，拨动控制盘，进入微光增强模式。

messages.msgid: Hooks for an armored helm plate.

translations: Hub 01 模块化侦察头盔（夜视+红外）

messages.msgid: Heavy duty hooded headwear for the true frontier explorer.  The visor has been lowered over the eyes, and is drawing low power to provide light amplification by way of an infrared illuminator and detector.  Lets you see in the dark, and detects heat signatures emitted by (un)living organisms.  Activate again to turn off and stow the visor.
translations: 为真正的先驱探险家设计的带兜帽重型头盔，护目镜已降下，正在缓慢消耗电量，通过红外照明器和探测装置实现微光增强效果。能让你在黑暗中视物，并侦测活体或非活体生物发出的热信号。激活以关闭功能并将护目镜抬起。

messages.msgid: You flick the visor off, and push it off your face.
translations: 你关闭了护目镜，并把它从脸上抬起。

messages.msgid: A modified army harness, repurposed to carry several small and a single medium sized drone alongside the tools to maintain them.
translations: 改进的军用背带，用于携带几架小型和一架中型无人机以及维护它们的工具。

messages.msgid: A series of connectors meant to hold a medium sized drone on your back.
translations: 一条用于将中型无人机固定在背上的背带。

messages.msgid: A series of connectors meant to store a small drone.
translations: 一条用于将小型无人机固定在背上的背带。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the upper body, made of thick and pliable polymer with metallic fibers for reinforcement.  Several buckles and straps allow it to be adjusted to fit you comfortably.  Despite its rough finish, it's clear that a lot of thought has gone into the ergonomics and weight.  Designed to clip to the chest and shoulders, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".
translations: 一套3D打印的上半身盔甲，由一层厚而柔韧的含有加固金属纤维的塑料制成。几条扣环和背带可以调整适合你的体型，穿着合身舒适。尽管表面粗糙，但很明显设计者在人体工程学和装备重量方面考虑了很多。设计了胸部和肩部的夹具，内侧印着"此面安装于模块化防御系统"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the upper body, made of thick and pliable polymer with metallic fibers for reinforcement.  This model incorporates a rubber coating that diffuses impacts and provides excellent protection from blunt trauma, even if it does feel a bit like a rain coat.  Designed to clip to the chest and shoulders, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".
translations: 一套3D打印的上半身盔甲，由一层厚而柔韧的含有加固金属纤维的塑料制成。这款型号采用了橡胶涂层，可以扩散冲击，并提供极好的保护，免受钝击创伤，即使这使它看起来有点像雨衣。设计了胸部和肩部的夹具，内侧印着"此面安装于模块化防御系统"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the upper body, made of thick and pliable polymer with metallic fibers for reinforcement.  This model features heat-resistant materials in the construction, providing protection from extreme heat without sacrificing its overall performance.  Designed to clip to the chest and shoulders, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".
translations: 一套3D打印的上半身盔甲，由一层厚而柔韧的含有加固金属纤维的塑料制成。这款型号采用了耐热材料，在不牺牲其整体性能的情况下能够防护极端高温。设计了胸部和肩部的夹具，内侧印着"此面安装于模块化防御系统"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the upper body, made of thick and pliable polymer with metallic fibers for reinforcement.  Thanks to a slim under-layer of synthetic fibers, it provides fantastic defense from small-arms fire, and could take the edge off of a rifle bullet, too.  Designed to clip to the chest and shoulders, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".
translations: 一套3D打印的上半身盔甲，由一层厚而柔韧的含有加固金属纤维的塑料制成。多亏内含的一层合成纤维薄层，它能轻松挡下小口径武器的射击，还可以降低步枪子弹所造成的伤害。设计了胸部和肩部的夹具，内侧印着"此面安装于模块化防御系统"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the upper body, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  Made of extremely tough UHMW polyethylene combined with treated aramid fabric, it provides military-grade defense against zombies, bullets, zombies with bullets, and plenty of other things that the Cataclysm can throw at you.  Designed to clip to the chest and shoulders, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".
translations: 一套3D打印的上半身盔甲，由一层厚而柔韧的含有加固金属纤维的塑料制成。它由极为坚硬的超高分子量聚乙烯和经过处理的凯夫拉纤维制成，可提供军用级的防御，抵御丧尸、子弹、带子弹的丧尸，以及大灾变所能丢到你头上的其他大部分东西。设计了胸部和肩部的夹具，内侧印着"此面安装于模块化防御系统"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the thighs and knees, consisting of a skirt made of segmented armor plates.  It features a simple integrated belt to let it fit any waist size.  Despite its rough finish, it's clear that a lot of thought has gone into the ergonomics and weight.  Designed to clip to the waist, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".
translations: 一套3D打印的下半身盔甲，由多块分段装甲组成裙板。它内置一条简单的腰带，适合所有的腰围。尽管表面粗糙，但很明显设计者在人体工程学和装备重量方面考虑了很多。设计了腰部的夹具，内侧印着"此面安装于模块化防御系统"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the thighs and knees, consisting of a skirt made of segmented armor plates.  This model resembles scale armor, and provides excellent protection from blunt trauma.  Designed to clip to the waist, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".
translations: 一套3D打印的下半身盔甲，由多块分段装甲组成裙板。这个型号类似于鳞甲，并提供了极好的保护，免受钝击创伤。设计了腰部的夹具，内侧印着"此面安装于模块化防御系统"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the thighs and knees, consisting of a skirt made of segmented armor plates.  This version incorporates tight-fitting leggings that provide some protection from extreme heat.  Designed to clip to the waist, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".
translations: 一套3D打印的下半身盔甲，由多块分段装甲组成裙板。这个型号采用紧身护腿，可以防护极端高温。设计了腰部的夹具，内侧印着"此面安装于模块化防御系统"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the thighs and knees, consisting of a skirt made of segmented armor plates.  It includes a reinforcing layer of aramid fabric in addition to leg sleeves made of high-strength material, protecting your sensitive bits from small-arms fire.  Designed to clip to the waist, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".
translations: 一套3D打印的下半身盔甲，由多块分段装甲组成裙板。除了高强度材料制成的腿套，它还包括一层凯夫拉纤维加固层，保护你的敏感部位免受小口径武器的攻击。设计了腰部的夹具，内侧印着"此面安装于模块化防御系统"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the thighs and knees, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  Composed of segmented polyethylene armor plates featuring a dense metal core sandwiched between layers of composite-grade aramid fabric, it provides excellent protection for the upper legs to ensure that you'll stay on your feet when it really matters.  Designed to clip to the waist, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".
translations: 一套3D打印的下半身盔甲，拥有专业的外观和一流的人体工程学。它由分段聚乙烯装甲板组成，沉重的金属核心被夹在复合凯夫拉纤维层之间，为腿部提供极好的保护，确保你在真正重要的时候依然能够稳如泰山。设计了腰部的夹具，内侧印着"此面安装于模块化防御系统"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed arm guards, made of large and flexible polymer sheets wrapped around the forearm.  The end of each sheet features a clip and drawstring, to fit the armor to any size.  Despite the rough finish, it fits securely, and feels quite comfortable.
translations: 一对3D打印的护臂，由包裹在前臂上的大块柔性聚合物装甲板组成。每块装甲板末端都有一个夹具和一根拉绳，以适合任何尺寸的盔甲。尽管表面粗糙，但它牢固贴合，感觉非常舒适。

messages.msgid: 3D printed arm guards, made of large and flexible polymer sheets wrapped around the forearm.  These ones are built in an overlapping pattern that diffuses impacts and provides excellent protection from blunt trauma.
translations: 一对3D打印的护臂，由包裹在前臂上的大块柔性聚合物装甲板组成。每块装甲板都排成相互重叠的样式，可以传递冲击，并提供良好的保护，免受钝击创伤。

messages.msgid: 3D printed arm guards, made of large and flexible polymer sheets wrapped around the forearm.  These ones include Nomex sleeves to protect your arms from extreme heat.
translations: 一对3D打印的护臂，由包裹在前臂上的大块柔性聚合物装甲板组成。这个型号采用芳纶制成袖子，可以为手臂提供极端高温防护。

messages.msgid: 3D printed arm guards, made of large and flexible polymer sheets wrapped around the forearm.  These ones include aramid arm sleeves that do a great job of slowing down bullets and preventing them from shredding your arms.
translations: 一对3D打印的护臂，由包裹在前臂上的大块柔性聚合物装甲板组成。这个型号采用凯夫拉纤维制成袖子，可以很好地减缓子弹的速度，防止它们撕碎你的手臂。

messages.msgid: 3D printed arm guards, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  With thick bullet-resistant arm sleeves, flexible but extremely tough thermoplastic plates, and special attention given to areas reflexively used to protect the face from attacks, it provides first-rate protection against all the horrors that the apocalypse has brought to bear.
translations: 一对3D打印的护臂，由包裹在前臂上的大块柔性聚合物装甲板组成。这个型号有着厚厚的防弹袖子，柔韧但极为结实的热塑性塑料装甲板，并特别注意利用人的本能来保护面部免受攻击，它提供了一流的保护，以抵御大灾变所带来的各种恐怖。

messages.msgid: 3D printed leg guards, consisting of thick knee pads and a pair of large, flexible polymer plates for securing around the calves to protect the tibias of each leg.  Two straps on each plate can be tightened or loosened to fit different leg sizes.  Despite the rough finish, it doesn't impede your movement, and fits comfortably against your body.
translations: 一对3D打印的护腿，由一个厚护膝和一对大块柔性聚合物装甲板组成，用来固定在小腿周围，以保护双腿的胫骨部位。每块装甲板上的两条带子可以拉紧或松开，以适应不同的腿部尺寸。尽管表面粗糙，但它不会妨碍你的运动，并且舒适地贴合你的身体。

messages.msgid: 3D printed leg guards, consisting of thick knee pads and a pair of large, flexible polymer plates for securing around the calves to protect the tibias of each leg.  Thick padding and rubber lining provide excellent protection from blunt trauma.
translations: 一对3D打印的护腿，由一个厚护膝和一对大块柔性聚合物装甲板组成，用来固定在小腿周围，以保护双腿的胫骨部位。厚厚的衬垫和橡胶衬里提供极好的保护，免受钝击创伤。

messages.msgid: 3D printed leg guards, consisting of thick knee pads and a pair of large, flexible polymer plates for securing around the calves to protect the tibias of each leg.  Heat-resistant leg sleeves and a breathable design provide adequate protection from extreme heat without sacrificing your mobility or core protection.
translations: 一对3D打印的护腿，由一个厚护膝和一对大块柔性聚合物装甲板组成，用来固定在小腿周围，以保护双腿的胫骨部位。耐热裤管和透气设计在不牺牲灵活性或核心保护的前提下，为你的腿部提供充分的极端高温防护。

messages.msgid: 3D printed leg guards, consisting of thick knee pads and a pair of large, flexible polymer plates for securing around the calves to protect the tibias of each leg.  This model features leggings made of durable aramid and a reinforced plate design; combined, they do a good job of mitigating damage from small-arms fire.
translations: 一对3D打印的护腿，由一个厚护膝和一对大块柔性聚合物装甲板组成，用来固定在小腿周围，以保护双腿的胫骨部位。这个型号采用结实耐用的凯夫拉纤维制成，并采用强化装甲板设计；综合起来，它能够有效抵御小口径武器射击所造成的伤害。

messages.msgid: 3D printed leg guards, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  Layered UHMW thermoplastic plates and bullet-resistant aramid padding combine to keep your lower leg bones protected and unbroken, even when knee-deep in the dead.
translations: 一对3D打印的护腿，由一个厚护膝和一对大块柔性聚合物装甲板组成，用来固定在小腿周围，以保护双腿的胫骨部位。多层超高分子量热塑性塑料板和防弹凯夫拉衬垫相结合，让你的小腿骨不受损伤，即使身陷死人堆之中。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the head, made of thick polymer plates woven with metallic fibers.  Despite its rough finish, it's clear that a lot of thought has gone into the ergonomics and weight.  Designed to clip to some kind of attachment point, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR HEADGEAR".
translations: 3D打印的头部装甲，由厚厚的聚合材料板与金属纤维编织而成。尽管它看起来很粗糙，但很明显在人体工程学和重量上花了很多心思。它被设计成可以扣在某种连接点上，内侧写着"此面安装到模块化头盔"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the head, made of thick polymer plates woven with metallic fibers.  This model is covered in countless rubber hexagons, and offers superior protection against blunt trauma.  Designed to clip to some kind of attachment point, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR HEADGEAR".
translations: 3D打印的头部装甲，由厚厚的聚合材料板与金属纤维编织而成。这种型号覆盖有无数的橡胶六边形，对钝击提供了卓越防护。它被设计成可以扣在某种连接点上，内侧写着"此面安装到模块化头盔"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the head, made of thick polymer plates woven with metallic fibers.  This version incorporates a tight fitting Nomex layer for some protection against heat.  Designed to clip to some kind of attachment point, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR HEADGEAR".
translations: 3D打印的头部装甲，由厚厚的聚合材料板与金属纤维编织而成。这种型号在内测加入了一层紧贴的芳纶，以提供一些防热效果。它被设计成可以扣在某种连接点上，内侧写着"此面安装到模块化头盔"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the head, made of thick polymer plates woven with metallic fibers.  This one has extra Kevlar and steel layering, to provide superior protection against small arms.  Designed to clip to some kind of attachment point, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR HEADGEAR".
translations: 3D打印的头部装甲，由厚厚的聚合材料板与金属纤维编织而成。这种型号有额外的凯夫拉和钢板层，以提供对小型枪械的卓越保护。它被设计成可以扣在某种连接点上，内侧写着"此面安装到模块化头盔"。

messages.msgid: 3D printed armor for the head, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  Composed of a dense metal shell sandwiched between layers of composite-grade aramid fabric, it provides excellent protection, ensuring you'll keep your head against whatever the Cataclysm throws at you.  Designed to clip to some kind of attachment point, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR HEADGEAR".
translations: 3D打印的头部盔甲，拥有专业的外观和一流的人体工程学。它由一个致密金属外壳和多层复合凯夫拉纤维组成，提供了出色的保护，能让你的头部在大灾变中保持完好。它被设计成可以扣在某种连接点上，内侧写着"此面安装到模块化头盔"。

messages.msgid: A snuggly woolen cowl.  It's one of those stylish and bulky cowls you see in fashion magazines.
translations: 一件松软的针织羊毛兜帽。这件款式和你在时尚杂志上看到那种时髦而笨重的款式一样。

messages.msgid: A loose cloth worn over the head and around the neck.
translations: 戴在头上和脖子上的一块宽松的布。

messages.msgid: A type of headdress traditionally used in the Middle East.  It can be used in different ways to protect the head and mouth from the elements.
translations: 一条阿拉伯国家男子普遍穿戴的头巾，沙漠坏境产物，夏季遮阳防晒，冬天御寒保暖，有着多种戴法。

messages.msgid: A simple and light cloth scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.
translations: 简单轻便的布围巾，围住头颈以保持温暖。根据你的喜好围在脸上或者包裹头部。

messages.msgid: A simple and light cloth scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your head if you get too cold.
translations: 简单轻便的布制围巾，包裹你的颈部。 如果觉得太冷，可以把它裹在头上。

messages.msgid: You wrap your %s around your head.
A simple and light cloth scarf, worn over the head and mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your head.
translations: 简单轻便的布制围巾，包裹你的头部和嘴。 如果觉得太热，可以把它围在颈部。

messages.msgid: A very long light cloth scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.
translations: 一条非常长且质地轻巧的围巾，围住头颈以保持温暖。因为特别加长的缘故，足以同时保暖脸部以及双手。根据你的喜好围在脸上或者包裹头部。

messages.msgid: A very long light cloth scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to wear it around your head if you get too cold.
translations: 一条非常长且质地轻巧的围巾，包裹你的颈部。因为特别加长的缘故，足以同时保暖脸部以及双手。如果觉得太冷，可以把它裹在头上。

messages.msgid: A very long light cloth scarf, worn over the head and mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your mouth.
translations: 简单轻便的布制围巾，包裹头部和嘴来保暖。 如果觉得太热，可以把它围在颈部。

messages.msgid: A long knitted cotton scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.
translations: 一条长款棉质针织围巾，可拉到口鼻处保暖。若觉得太热，可使用物品将其调松一些

messages.msgid: A long knitted cotton scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your head if you get too cold.
translations: 一条长长的针织棉制围巾，包裹你的颈部。如果觉得太冷，可以把它裹在头上。

messages.msgid: A long knitted cotton scarf, worn over the head and mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your mouth.
translations: 一条长长的针织棉制围巾，包裹头部和嘴来保暖。 如果觉得太热，可以把它围在颈部。

messages.msgid: A really long knitted cotton scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.
translations: 一条特别长的棉质针织围巾，可拉到口鼻处保暖。由于长度更长，它也足以适应不寻常的面部特征，并能让你把手也缩进去。若觉得太热，可使用物品将其调松一些。

messages.msgid: A really long knitted cotton scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to wear it tighter if you get too cold.
translations: 一条非常长的针织棉制围巾，可穿戴以覆盖嘴部保持温暖。因为特别加长的缘故，足以同时保暖脸部以及双手。如果太冷了，使用它来围紧些吧。

messages.msgid: A really long knitted cotton scarf, worn over the head and mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your mouth.
translations: 一条加长的针织棉制围巾，包裹头部和嘴来保暖。 如果觉得太热，可以把它围在颈部。

messages.msgid: A long wool scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.
translations: 一条长款羊毛围巾，可拉到口鼻处保暖。若觉得太热，可使用物品将其调松一些。

messages.msgid: A long wool scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your mouth.
translations: 一条长长的羊毛围巾，包裹你的颈部。 如果觉得太冷，可以把它围紧些。

messages.msgid: A long wool scarf, worn over the head and mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your mouth.
translations: 一条长款羊毛围巾，可拉到头部与口鼻处保暖。若要将其围在口鼻处，可使用物品进行调整。

messages.msgid: A really long wool scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.
translations: 一条特别长的羊毛围巾，可拉到口鼻处保暖。由于长度更长，它也足以适应不寻常的面部特征，并能让你把手也缩进去。若觉得太热，可使用物品将其调松一些。

messages.msgid: A really long wool scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to wear it around your head if you get too cold.
translations: 一条真的非常长的羊毛围巾，围在嘴上提供保暖。它真的非常长，足够照顾到你特殊的大脸以及双手。如果觉得太冷，可以把它裹在头上。

messages.msgid: A really long wool scarf, worn over the head and mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to wear it around your mouth.
translations: 一条真的非常长的羊毛围巾，包裹头部和嘴来保暖。它真的非常长，足够照顾到你特殊的大脸以及双手。如果觉得太热，可以把它脱下围在颈部。

messages.msgid: A long fur scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.
translations: 一条长款毛皮围巾，可拉到口鼻处保暖。若觉得太热，可使用物品将其调松一些。

messages.msgid: A long fur scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your head if you get too cold.
