translations: 一条长长的毛皮围巾，围在嘴上提供保暖。如果觉得太冷，可以把它裹在头上。

messages.msgid: A long fur scarf, worn over the head and mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your mouth.
translations: 一条长长的毛皮围巾，包裹头部与颈部来保暖。如果觉得太热，可以把它围在颈部。

messages.msgid: A really long fur scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.
translations: 一条特别长的毛皮围巾，可拉到口鼻处保暖。由于长度更长，它也足以适应不寻常的面部特征，并能让你把手也缩进去。若觉得太热，可使用物品将其调松一些。

messages.msgid: A really long fur scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to wear it around your head if you get too cold.
translations: 一条真的非常长的毛皮围巾，围在嘴上提供保暖。它真的非常长，足够照顾到你特殊的大脸以及双手。如果觉得太冷，可以把它裹在头上。

messages.msgid: A really long fur scarf, worn over the head and mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to wear it around your mouth.
translations: 一条真的非常长的毛皮围巾，包裹头部和嘴来保暖。它真的非常长，足够照顾到你特殊的大脸以及双手。如果觉得太热，可以把它脱下围在颈部。

messages.msgid: A long faux fur scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.
translations: 一条长款仿毛皮围巾，可拉到口鼻处保暖。若觉得太热，可使用物品将其调松一些。

messages.msgid: A long faux fur scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your head if you get too cold.
translations: 一条长长的人造毛皮围巾，围在嘴上提供保暖。如果觉得太冷，可以把它裹在头上。

messages.msgid: A long faux fur scarf, worn over the head and mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your mouth.
translations: 一条长长的人造毛皮围巾，包裹头部与颈部来保暖。如果觉得太热，可以把它围在颈部。

messages.msgid: A really long faux fur scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to loosen it if you get too warm.
translations: 一条特别长的仿毛皮围巾，可拉到口鼻处保暖。由于长度更长，它也足以适应不寻常的面部特征，并能让你把手也缩进去。若觉得太热，可使用物品将其调松一些。

messages.msgid: A really long faux fur scarf, worn over the mouth for warmth.  With the extra length, it's enough to handle nonstandard facial features and accommodate your hands too.  Use it to wear it around your head if you get too cold.
translations: 一条真的非常长的人造毛皮围巾，围在嘴上提供保暖。它真的非常长，足够照顾到你特殊的大脸以及双手。如果觉得太冷，可以把它裹在头上。

messages.msgid: A really long faux fur scarf, worn over the head and mouth for warmth.  Use it to wear it around your mouth.
translations: 一条真的非常长的人造毛皮围巾，包裹头部与颈部来保暖。如果觉得太热，可以把它围在颈部。

messages.msgid: A simple cloth scarf worn by Marloss Voices.  Wherever the Voices go, long-sought peace soon follows, for better or for worse.
translations: 一条马洛斯之声成员佩戴的造型朴素的青色领巾。据说只要是马洛斯之声所到之处，人们期盼已久的和平总会到来。

messages.msgid: A grass sheet with cords to wear it like a Middle Eastern headdress.  It's a bit itchy, but can keep your head and mouth a bit warmer if there's nothing in the way.
translations: 一条带绳索的草席，可以像中东头巾一样戴在头上。戴起来有点痒，但如果实在没有其他衣物，它能让你的头和嘴稍微暖和一点。

messages.msgid: A loose cloth headwrap and veil.  Typically worn by Christian nuns.
translations: 一件宽松的布制头巾和面纱。通常由基督教修女穿着。

messages.msgid: A large prayer shawl worn by observant Jews during morning prayers and certain other occasions.
translations: 一种大型的祈祷披肩，是虔诚的犹太教徒在晨祷或其他某些场合穿戴的。

messages.msgid: A common nylon throat guard commonly used for neck protection when playing sports.
translations: 一种常见的尼龙护颈，通常用于在体育运动中保护颈部。

messages.msgid: A common canvas throat guard commonly used for neck protection when playing sports like hockey.
translations: 一种常见的帆布护颈，通常用于在冰球（或曲棍球）这类体育运动中保护颈部。

messages.msgid: A rare variety of throat guard originally known as a gorget and used for neck protection in HEMA.  It's made from thick rubber covered by nylon.  It offers good protection for the throat, but it only covers a small portion of the nape.
translations: 一种罕见的护喉护具，最初被称为“颈甲”，用于在欧洲历史武术(HEMA)中保护颈部。它由厚实的橡胶制成，覆盖尼龙外层。这款护具能为喉部提供良好保护，，不过脖子后面只能盖住一小块地方。

messages.msgid: A cut-resistant Kevlar throat guard, commonly used by welders, security forces and in some sports.
translations: 一种凯夫拉纤维制成的防割喉部护具，普遍为焊工、安防部队及一些体育运动所采用。

messages.msgid: A ballistic collar modified to wear it as a standalone armor, carefully combined with a regular nylon throat guard for extra protection.
translations: 一个防弹护颈，经过改造可以单独穿着，细致地和常规尼龙面料结合以提供额外防护。

messages.msgid: A combination of leather and a metal ring to hold an axe on your waist.
translations: 一条带着金属环的皮带，可以在你的腰间收纳一把斧头。

messages.msgid: A leather scabbard, big enough for anything up to a longsword, or even a bit larger than that.  Designed to be worn at the waist, secured to the sturdy leather belt.  Activate to sheath/draw a sword.
translations: 一个皮革剑鞘，大小足够容纳一把长剑，或是比它稍大的武器。剑鞘穿在腰间，加以结实的皮带系稳。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A nylon strap knife sheath worn on the thigh, made to hold 6 very thin knives, such as throwing knives, close at hand.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一个能绑在大腿上的尼龙刀鞘，能装下6把小刀随手取用。通常用来存放飞刀。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A small concealed garter knife sheath worn on the thigh.  Commonly used by assassins under a skirt or dress.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一个隐蔽的小型吊袜刀鞘。通常被刺客穿在裙子或连衣裙下面。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A small concealed garter double knife sheath worn on the thigh.  Commonly used by overly cautious assassins under a skirt or dress.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一个隐蔽的小型双开吊袜刀鞘。通常被特别小心的刺客穿在裙子或连衣裙下面。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A small concealed knife sheath worn on the ankle.  It is awkward to use without practice.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一个穿在脚踝上的小型刀鞘。不经过练习用起来很笨拙。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A handcrafted small concealed knife sheath worn on the ankle, made from birch bark.  It is awkward to use without practice.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一个用桦树皮制成的穿在脚踝上的自制小型刀鞘。不经过练习用起来很笨拙。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A leather scabbard, big enough for almost any sword.  Designed to be strapped to the back, it's very difficult to draw from without considerable practice.  Activate to sheath/draw a sword.
translations: 一个皮制的剑鞘，足够容纳大部分剑类武器，剑鞘通过肩带系在后背，不经过一定练习很难将武器快速拔出。使用它来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A large, adjustable sheath for holding swords and other large blades.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一个巨大的可调节剑鞘，大小足够容纳大型刀剑类武器。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A large, adjustable sheath for holding swords and other large blades, made with nylon.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一个巨大的可调节剑鞘，由尼龙制成，大小足够容纳大型刀剑类武器。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A leather sheath for holding knives and other small blades.  It is easy to use without much practice.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一个皮革刀鞘，大小足够容纳匕首，或是类似的小型刀具。它很容易使用，不需要太多练习。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A handcrafted sheath made from birch bark, for holding knives and other small blades, with a strap attached.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一个用桦树皮制成的自制刀鞘，大小足够容纳匕首，或是类似的小型刀具，自带一条背带。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A leather strap tied around the torso for toting spears while keeping your hands free.  You have to duck to get through doors while one's in it, though.  Activate to holster/draw a weapon.
translations: 一根系在身上的皮带子，可以拴住长矛，解放双手。小心别卡在门框上。激活它来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A small backpack.  Good storage for a little encumbrance.
translations: 一个小型布制背包，用一点点累赘换取可观的存储空间。

messages.msgid: Small pocket for a water bottle.
Tucked between your back and the backpack.
Attached with a carabiner or strap.
A large hiking backpack with plenty of storage space.
translations: 一个大容量的登山背包，提供了很大的存储空间。

messages.msgid: Pouch sized for a hydration pack.
translations: 一个大小适合储水背袋的口袋。

messages.msgid: Secured under compression straps or with a tool loop.
translations: 捆在压缩带/工具扣环下

messages.msgid: A large hunting backpack with plenty of storage space and additional external space possible for large camping items or game bags.
translations: 一个大型狩猎背包，具有充足的存储空间和额外的外部空间，可以装大型露营物品或作为游戏包。

messages.msgid: The pack has been slid away from the frame leaving room to store large items.
translations: 从背包主体额外展开的口袋，可以存很多东西，但很麻烦。

messages.msgid: A huge fabric backpack made mostly as a joke before the Cataclysm.  Now, it's still rather silly, but it can store a lot of stuff.
translations: 一个体积巨大的纤维织物背包，在大灾变前看上去很可笑。现在虽然看着还是很蠢，但是能储存许多物品。

messages.msgid: A small leather backpack.  Good storage for a little encumbrance.
translations: 一个小型皮制背包，用一点点累赘换取可观的存储空间，相比普通背包更加耐用。

messages.msgid: A denim backpack.  Solid storage for few encumbrance.  The texture feels nice.
translations: 牛仔布背包。用少量的累赘换取存储空间。质感很好。

messages.msgid: A large tactical multi-compartment backpack that has great lower back support.
translations: 一个大型战术背包，内设多个隔间，对背部下方的支撑性能优异。

messages.msgid: Also known as a "bigpack", this rucksack is prized by pack rats but may lead to a bad back.
translations: 一个旅行背包，特点就是大。它巨大的容量受到松鼠党的一致好评，但是这也可能让太多的重物压断你的腰。

messages.msgid: You're ready for a trip down some train tracks.  Also known as a hobo stick.
translations:
一根用来把包袱绑在末端、扛在肩上携带的木棍，也叫“流浪汉棍”。
"准备好沿着铁路流浪。"

messages.msgid: A makeshift backpack comprised of a wooden box and a pair of ropes.
translations: 一个简易背包，由一个木箱和一对绳索组成。

messages.msgid: Useful for carrying money, documents, or smuggled goods.
translations: 一个配有提手的箱子，内部可存放纸币、文档、或者是走私物品。

messages.msgid: Useful to carry your precious musical instrument around protected from any harm.
translations: 用于随身携带并且保护你珍贵的乐器。

messages.msgid: An ultralight nylon backpack intended for one-day hiking trips.  Waterproof, slim, and spacious.
translations: 一种超轻的尼龙背包，常用于单日的徒步旅行。这个防水背包在轻便的外表下还拥有很大的存储空间。

messages.msgid: A durable nylon bag marketed towards military personnel.  It has clips on the top and back, making it easy to attach a strap and wear it comfortably as a fanny pack.  MOLLE webbing on the back lets you affix it to body armor or a backpack.
translations: 一个耐用尼龙小包，受众主要是军人。顶部和背面都有夹子，便于固定在带子上，可当作一个舒适的腰包穿戴。背面的MOLLE织带可以让你将其固定在防弹衣或背包上。

messages.msgid: A lightweight mesh backpack, commonly worn by swimmers and divers.
translations: 一款轻量网眼背包，常见于游泳者和潜水员使用。

messages.msgid: A lightweight watertight backpack, commonly worn by swimmers and divers.
translations: 一个轻便的防水背包，常常用于游泳或潜水运动。

messages.msgid: A huge watertight duffel bag.  Capable of floating.  Provides plenty of storage, but is severely encumbering.
translations: 一个很大的防水行李袋，放在水里都不会沉下去。提供大量的存储空间，但特别的累赘。

messages.msgid: An expandable pouch secured with straps.  Provides a bit of extra storage with minimal encumbrance.
translations: 一个可以张开的战术横腰袋，提供额外的存储空间。

messages.msgid: A small fabric bag worn on the waist, with the pouch in front for easy access.  Once used as a visual shorthand for unstylish geeks and silly tourists, it was making a decent comeback before the apocalypse.
translations: 一个穿在腰上的小布袋，正前方有个便于取用的小口袋。它曾被当作没品位极客和愚蠢游客的视觉标志，但在世界末日到来之前，就已经某种程度上重新流行起来。

messages.msgid: A tall canvas and plastic bag with fold-out legs used for golfing.  It even has straps to be worn on the back and a slot for an umbrella.
translations: 一个细长的带有可折叠支架的高尔夫球背包，采用帆布和塑料制成。它甚至还配有一条背带和雨伞挂钩。
你笨拙地将 %s 收入球包中

messages.msgid: The raw skin of an animal, quickly turned into a makeshift bag for storage.  It will still rot, and needs to be cured and tanned.
translations: 一个由动物生皮匆忙制成的简易储存袋，如果不加工与鞣制它就会腐烂。

messages.msgid: The raw skin of a monster, quickly turned into a makeshift bag for storage.  It will still rot, and needs to be cured and tanned.
translations: 一个由怪物生皮匆忙制成的简易储存袋，如果不加工与鞣制它就会腐烂。

messages.msgid: This is a plain, hard-sided black briefcase with a trigger in the handle and a concealed hole in the side.  Squeezing the trigger would currently do nothing, as it is empty.  Don't forget to put a suitable MP5 back inside before you try to pay any ransom fees with lead.
translations: 这是一个乍一看平平无奇的硬壳黑色公文包，但实际上它的把手上藏有一个扳机，而箱子一侧开有一个隐秘的枪孔。现在箱子是空的，扳动扳机没什么作用。在你准备赴鸿门宴之前不要忘了放一把合适的 MP5 冲锋枪进去！

messages.msgid: A jerrycan modified to be worn in a similar manner to a backpack.
translations: 一个五加仑装的油桶绑上带子，剪个大口，然后背到背上，成为了一个背包。

messages.msgid: A bag stitched together from leather scraps.  Doesn't hold an awful lot but is easy to wear.
translations: 这是一个由皮革简单缝制成的耐用小袋子，提供少量储存空间。

messages.msgid: A pouch that can be worn on the thighs using buckled straps.  This variety is favored by the military.
translations: 一个用扣带绑在大腿上的战术口袋，深受军队人员喜爱。

messages.msgid: A set of pouches that can be worn on the thighs using buckled neoprene rig.  This variety is favored by the divers.
translations: 一对用氯丁橡胶腿环固定在大腿上的口袋，深受潜水者的喜爱。

messages.msgid: A bag that can be worn on the thighs and hips using adjustable buckled straps.  Provides some extra storage for outdoor activities.
translations: 一个可以绑在大腿和臀部上的绑腿包，有着可调节的扣带。为户外运动提供一些额外的存储空间。

messages.msgid: A black bag that can be worn on the thighs and hips using adjustable buckled straps.  Commonly used by motorcycle riders.
translations: 一个可以绑在大腿和臀部上的黑色绑腿包，有着可调节的扣带。通常由摩托车手使用。

messages.msgid: A khaki bag that can be worn on the thighs and hips using adjustable buckled straps.  Works nicely with a pair of khaki pants.
translations: 一个可以绑在大腿和臀部上的卡其色绑腿包，有着可调节的扣带。和卡其色的裤子很配。

messages.msgid: A purple bag that can be worn on the thighs and hips using adjustable buckled straps.  Perfect for the ladies that want a cooler way of carrying their personal items.
translations: 一个可以绑在大腿和臀部上的紫色绑腿包，有着可调节的扣带。非常适合那些想以更酷的方式携带个人物品的女士。

messages.msgid: A green bag with camouflage print that can be worn on the thighs and hips using adjustable buckled straps.  For those that have a military heart.
translations: 一个可以绑在大腿和臀部上的军绿色迷彩绑腿包，有着可调节的扣带。适合那些心怀军旅梦的人。

messages.msgid: A black and dark gold bag that can be worn on the thighs and hips using adjustable buckled straps, with a steampunk design and chains all over it.  Perfect for a wide variety of costumes.
translations: 一个可以绑在大腿和臀部上的黑色和深金色绑腿包，有着可调节的扣带。采用蒸汽朋克设计，周围许多铁链装饰。适合搭配各类COS服装。

messages.msgid: A jet-black bag that can be worn on the thighs and hips using adjustable buckled straps, with skulls and spikes all over it.  Perfect for a rider of the apocalypse.
translations: 一个可以绑在大腿和臀部上的深黑色绑腿包，有着可调节的扣带，四周点缀着骷髅和尖刺装饰。非常适合末日之后的骑手们。

messages.msgid: A garishly colored red, white, and blue bag that can be worn on the thighs and hips using adjustable buckled straps, with the stylized depiction of George Washington's face gazing sternly from the side.  Perfect for carrying the dreams of the founding fathers wherever you go.
translations: 这款色彩艳丽的红、白、蓝三色包袋可通过调节搭扣腰带佩戴在大腿和臀部，侧面饰有乔治·华盛顿严肃面孔的个性图案。无论走到哪里，都能将国父们的梦想随身携带。

messages.msgid: A small purse that can be worn on the upper leg using buckled straps, easier to use than on the arm.  For those who want to wear a dress without pockets while carrying their phone and money.  Use it to adjust it to fit your arm.
translations: 一个小钱包，可以用扣带绑在大腿上，比绑在手臂上时更容易使用。适合那些想穿着没有口袋的连衣裙，但又需要携带手机和零钱的人。使用它将其调成能绑在手臂上的大小。

messages.msgid: You adjust your %s to wear it on your arm.
translations: 你把 %s 调成绑在手臂上。

messages.msgid: A small pouch that can be worn on the upper arm using buckled straps.  This is a favored item among sports & camping enthusiasts.  Use it to adjust it to fit your leg.
translations: 一个可以用系带扣在上臂的小袋子。这是一件深受运动和野营爱好者喜爱的装备。使用它将其调成能绑在大腿上的大小。

messages.msgid: You adjust your %s to wear it on your leg.
translations: 你把 %s 调成绑在大腿上。

messages.msgid: A small concealed wallet pouch worn on the ankle.  If you strap it under your clothes, it can help you keep your wallet hidden and safe.
translations: 一个能够绑在脚踝上的隐蔽小钱包。如果你把它穿在其他衣物下方，它能把你的钱藏好不被发现。

messages.msgid: A pair of pants with the bottom ends tied with string, and then passed through the belt loops so the knapsack can be carried on the back.
translations: 一条底部被绳索绑起来的裤子，绳索接着穿过皮带扣，使得整条裤子能够像背包背在背上。

messages.msgid: A large sheet tied into a crude, over-the-shoulder sling.
translations: 把一大块床单打结做成的粗糙斜挎布带。

messages.msgid: Light and easy to wear, but doesn't offer much storage.
translations: 轻便易穿，但提供的收纳空间不多。

messages.msgid: You slide the bag to your side.
You move the bag to your back.

The Modular Lightweight Load-carrying Equipment is an advanced military backpack.  Covered with pockets and straps, it strikes a fine balance between storage space and encumbrance.  Can attach accessory pockets to the outside rigging.
translations: 一件新一代模块化的改进型军用背包，相比普通背包它更加轻便舒适，且提供更可观的存储空间，取得了存储空间与累赘度之间的完美平衡。可以将附件口袋安装在外部携行具上。

messages.msgid: The Modular Lightweight Load-carrying Equipment is an advanced military medium rucksack.  Covered with straps for modularity, it strikes a fine balance between storage space and encumbrance.  Can attach accessory pockets to the outside rigging.
translations: 一件新一代模块化的改进型军用背包，相比普通背包它更加轻便舒适，且提供更可观的存储空间，取得了存储空间与累赘度之间的完美平衡。可以将附件口袋安装在外部携行具上。

messages.msgid: The Modular Lightweight Load-carrying Equipment is an advanced military large rucksack.  Covered with straps for modularity, it strikes a fine balance between storage space and encumbrance.  Can attach accessory pockets to the outside rigging.
translations: 一件新一代模块化的改进型军用背包，相比普通背包它更加轻便舒适，且提供更可观的存储空间，取得了存储空间与累赘度之间的完美平衡。可以将附件口袋安装在外部携行具上。

messages.msgid: A bag woven together from strings, with straps to wear it on back.  Lighter than a standard backpack, but more awkward to carry when loaded and unable to hold small or heavy items.
translations: 一个用绳子编织成的包，有条能让你背在身上的带子。比标准背包轻，但在装满时更显累赘，而且无法携带过小或过重的物品。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm this would allow your four-legged friend to see the world, now it's used to shield them from the world.
translations: 在大灾变来临前，这个背包可以让你带着你四条腿的朋友见识这个世界，但现在它也可以用来保护他们免遭世界的伤害。

messages.msgid: A bag used to carry groceries home.
translations: 一个能携带各类杂货的购物袋。

messages.msgid: A fancy leather purse from a well-known designer.  A bit cumbersome to wear, but provides some storage.
translations: 一位著名设计师设计的精美皮包。穿戴略显累赘，但能提供一些存储空间。

messages.msgid: A makeshift bag, cobbled together from rags.  Really gets in the way, but provides a decent amount of storage.
translations: 一个用布条拼凑而成的简易袋子。用起来很碍事，但提供了一定的存储空间。

messages.msgid: A huge military rucksack, provides a lot of storage.
translations: 一个广泛用于士兵行军、远足者旅行的结实耐用的大背包，提供非常可观的存储空间。

messages.msgid: The obvious choice for outdoor athletes, this ergonomic backpack is light and easy to wear, ensuring comfort when carrying heavy and bulky items.
translations: 一个设计严格符合人体工程学的轻便舒适小背包，提供少量的储存空间。

messages.msgid: A simple single-sling backpack.  Easier to access than a normal backpack, but can't comfortably hold as much.
translations: 一款简单的单肩斜挎背包。比普通背包更便于取用，但舒适携带的容量不如普通背包大。

messages.msgid: A handmade straw basket.  Carry it with you for extra storage.
translations: 一个手工编织的干草篮。随身携带可以让你获得额外的存储空间。

messages.msgid: A huge wheeled suitcase used mainly for transporting clothes and other possessions during trips, provides a decent amount of storage but hauling it around is neither fast nor comfortable.
translations: 一个主要用于旅行期间存放衣物和杂物的巨大轮式旅行箱，提供充足的存储空间，但拉起来很累赘。

messages.msgid: A mid-sized wheeled suitcase used mainly for transporting clothes and other possessions during trips, provides a decent amount of storage but hauling it around is not exactly comfortable.
translations: 一个带滚轮的中型旅行箱，主要用于旅行时存放衣物和杂物，提供了充足的存储空间，但拉起来很累赘。

messages.msgid: A large canvas sack, re-purposed for makeshift storage.  Goes well with a striped shirt and a domino mask.
translations:
一个大型帆布袋，进过重新改造用于临时存储。
"和黑白条纹衫及小偷面具配合很搭。"

messages.msgid: A hiking pack used for short trips.
translations: 用于短途旅行的登山包。

messages.msgid: A light vest covered in pockets and straps for storage.
translations: 一件有着可以存东西的口袋及肩带的轻型背心。

messages.msgid: A large handmade straw basket with a lid and shoulder straps to wear it like a backpack.  Less comfortable than a proper backpack, but will do the job.
translations: 一个大的手工草编篮子，有盖子和肩带，可以像背包一样穿。不如一个合适的背包舒服，但一样能用。

messages.msgid: A pocket universe.  Can store approximately 384 * 10^6 bugs.
translations: 一个调试用的口袋宇宙。可以储存大约 384 * 10^6 个bug。

messages.msgid: A long duffel bag.  Provides storage for long arms and rifles.  Quite cumbersome.
translations: 一个长长的无纺布编织袋，提供了能放进长柄武器和步枪的存储空间，但相当的累赘。

messages.msgid: A long soft rifle case.  Provides storage for long arms and rifles.  Includes a small pocket, strap and handle.
translations: 一个长长的步枪枪袋，提供了能放进长柄武器和步枪的存储空间。自带一个小口袋，一根背带和一个提柄。

messages.msgid: A long soft leather rifle case.  Provides storage for long arms and rifles.  Includes a small pocket, strap and handle.
translations: 一个长长的皮制步枪枪袋，提供了能放进长柄武器和步枪的存储空间。自带一个小口袋，一根背带和一个提柄。

messages.msgid: A long soft rifle case.  Provides storage for 2 long arms and rifles.  Includes 3 accessory pockets and a strap.
translations: 一个长长的步枪枪袋，提供了能放进两把长柄武器和步枪的存储空间。自带三个附件袋和一根背带。

messages.msgid: A long soft leather rifle case.  Provides storage for 2 long arms and rifles.  Includes 3 accessory pockets and a strap.
translations: 一个长长的皮制步枪枪袋，提供了能放进两把长柄武器和步枪的存储空间。自带三个附件袋和一根背带。

messages.msgid: An extra long soft leather rifle case.  Provides storage for long arms and rifles.  Includes a small pocket, strap and handle.
translations: 一个特别加长的皮制步枪枪袋，提供了能放进长柄武器和步枪的存储空间。自带一个小口袋，一根背带和一个提柄。

messages.msgid: A simple bag used to hold a camera, with a small pocket on the side for accessories.  Comes with a carry strap.
translations: 一个能用来装照相机的简单袋子，侧面有一个小口袋用来装相机配件。自带一根背带。

messages.msgid: An old-fashioned book strap carrier.  Guaranteed to make you feel like a proper scholar.
translations: 一条老式书包带。保证让你觉得自己是一个真正的学者。

messages.msgid: A length of rope tied with a sliding knot into a loop.  You can slip all sorts of large objects in and carry them as a bundle; if you want to tie a single item more securely you'd have to disassemble this loop.  It takes a while to untie it and get things out, and attackers might pull the whole thing undone if you're not careful.
translations: 一段用滑结系成圈的绳子。你可以把各种各样的大件物品塞进去，把它们捆扎携带；如果你想更牢固地系上单件物品，你就必须拆解这个绳圈。解开它并把东西拿出来需要一段时间，而如果你不注意的话，受到攻击可能会把整捆东西都解开。

messages.msgid: A wooden frame with waterproofed cloth stretched around it, and a drawstring at the top to hold things in.  It has straps to wear it on your back.
translations: 一个木制框架，四周铺着防水布，顶部有根拉绳，可以装下不少东西。它有一对背带可以背在你的背上。

messages.msgid: An L-shaped wooden frame with a waterproofed cloth sack attached to it.  There's a drawstring to hold things in and straps to carry it on your back.
translations: 一个L形木制框架，上面有个防水布袋。顶部有根拉绳，可以装下不少东西，还有一对背带可以背在背上。

messages.msgid: An L-shaped wooden frame with straps to secure a large item to it.
translations: 一个 L 形木制框架，带有绑带，可将大型物品固定在上面。

messages.msgid: A sturdy L-shaped wooden frame with leather straps to secure an oversized item to it. It has straps to wear it on your back.
translations:
一个更加坚固的L型木制框架，有皮革带可以固定住一件更大的物品。
"可以背点更大的猎物，虽然你不一定能背得动"

messages.msgid: A little bag for carrying items to the gym.  Basically an extremely small duffel bag.
translations: 用来携带物品去健身房的小袋子。基本上就是一个非常小的行李袋。
网格口袋，适合存放小物品。

messages.msgid: A light bag for carrying items to the gym.  Basically a very small duffel bag.
translations: 一种用于携带物品去健身房的轻便提包。基本上就是一个小号的驮袋。

messages.msgid: A bag for carrying items to the gym.  Basically a small duffel bag.
translations: 用于携带物品去健身房的包。本质上是个小行李袋。

messages.msgid: Mesh pocket for a water bottle.
A bag for carrying items to the gym.  Basically a duffel bag.
translations: 用于携带物品去健身房的包。本质上是个行李袋。

messages.msgid: A bag for carrying items to the gym.  Basically a large duffel bag.
translations: 用于携带物品去健身房的包。本质上是个大行李袋。

messages.msgid: A very spacious bag for carrying things to the gym.  Basically a very large duffel bag.
translations: 用于携带物品去健身房的超宽敞包袋。本质上是个超大行李袋。

messages.msgid: A large duffel bag.  Provides lots of storage, but is severely encumbering.
translations: 一个超大尼龙行李袋。储物空间极大，但会造成极大的行动阻碍。
背带的环状设计很别扭。

messages.msgid: A big nylon duffel bag.  Provides tons of storage, but is extremely encumbering.
translations: 一个超大尼龙行李袋。储物空间极大，但会造成极大的行动阻碍。

messages.msgid: Awkwardly looped through the carry handles.
translations: 提手的环状设计很别扭。

messages.msgid: A small simple backpack, probably sized for a kid.
translations: 一个小巧简单的背包，大概是儿童尺寸。

messages.msgid: A little <color> backpack, probably sized for a kid.
translations: 一个小巧的<color>背包，大概是儿童尺寸。

messages.msgid: A zipper pocket, meant for pens and pencils.
translations: 一个专门放笔的拉链口袋。

messages.msgid: A suit of snug black leather.  Has no pockets, but does feature an abundance of unusually located zippers.
translations: 一套黑色皮革做的紧身衣。没有口袋，但在奇怪位置安装了许多拉链。

messages.msgid: A tight-fitting bodysuit made of Lycra.  Covers the whole body from neck to toe.
translations: 一件氨纶制成的紧身连体衣。从脖子到脚趾覆盖了全身。

messages.msgid: It's colored neon blue and has a bright pink symbol on the back.  Perfect for hunting space pirates and parasitic aliens.
translations: 它是霓虹蓝色的，背面有个亮粉色的符号。非常适合穿着它去追杀太空海盗和外星寄生虫们。

messages.msgid: It's colored neon red and has a bright orange symbol on the back.  Perfect for hunting space pirates and parasitic aliens.
translations: 它是霓虹红色的，背面有个亮橙色的符号。非常适合穿着它去追杀太空海盗和外星寄生虫们。

messages.msgid: It's colored black and has a bright blue symbol on the back.  Perfect for hunting space pirates and parasitic aliens.
translations: 它是霓虹黑色的，背面有个亮蓝色的符号。非常适合穿着它去追杀太空海盗和外星寄生虫们。

messages.msgid: It's colored black and seems to fade into the background.  Commonly used by special agents when on a mission.
translations: 它是黑色的，似乎随时会消失在背景之中。通常被执行特别任务的特工使用。

messages.msgid: It's colored blue and has a big "S" symbol on the front.  It would combine nicely with a red cape.
translations: 它是蓝色的，前面有一个大大的"S"符号。它能和红色披风完美结合。

messages.msgid: It's colored black and has a symbol in the shape of a bat on the front.  It would combine nicely with a black cape and mask.
translations: 它是黑色的，前面有一个蝙蝠形状的符号。它能和黑色披风和面具完美结合。

messages.msgid: It's colored red and blue and has web-like lines all over it, as well as a big spider symbol on the front and back.  It makes you want to climb buildings and shoot webs.
translations: 它是红蓝相间的，上面有网状的线条，前后都有一个巨大的蜘蛛符号。它让你想爬上建筑，射出蛛网。

messages.msgid: It's primarily colored green and has a superhero design.
translations: 它主体是绿色的，像是某个超级英雄的设计。

messages.msgid: It's primarily colored purple and has a superhero design.
translations: 它主体是紫色的，像是某个超级英雄的设计。

messages.msgid: It's primarily colored pink and has a superhero design.
translations: 它主体是粉色的，像是某个超级英雄的设计。

messages.msgid: It's colored black and looks pretty kinky.  A great alternative to the leather version.
translations: 它是黑色的，穿上去挺变态的。皮革版的绝佳替代品。

messages.msgid: It's colored jet-black and has a skeleton design printed on it.  Maybe the zombies would ignore you in this.
translations: 它是深黑色的，全身都画满了骨头。希望这能让丧尸忽略你吧。

messages.msgid: It's printed with an American flag pattern.
translations: 上面印有美国国旗图案。

messages.msgid: A colorful and ridiculous costume fit for a clown.  Provides decent storage.
translations: 一套色彩鲜艳、夸张滑稽的小丑服装。提供不错的携带容量。

messages.msgid: The basic denim overalls that is the symbol of the Proletariat (and some hipsters).  It covers the legs and a large portion of the torso, secured around the shoulders with straps.  It has many pockets and is relatively protective.
translations: 基本款牛仔工装裤，是无产阶级（以及一些潮人）的象征。它覆盖双腿及躯干部位大部分，肩部用带子固定。设有多个口袋，具有一定的防护性。

messages.msgid: A jumpsuit embroidered with a pattern of the American flag.  Provides decent storage and is not very encumbering.
translations: 一件印着星条旗花纹的连身衣。可以提供一些存储空间，而且也不太累赘。

messages.msgid: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit without pockets, similar to those worn by prisoners.  Not very encumbering.
translations: 一件轻薄的短袖连身衣，没有口袋，类似囚犯穿的那种。活动起来不算碍事。

messages.msgid: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit similar to those worn by prisoners.  Provides decent storage and is not very encumbering.
translations: 一件轻薄的短袖连身衣。可以提供一些存储空间，而且也不太累赘。

messages.msgid: A brown jumpsuit worn by the staff of Hub 01.
translations: 一件棕色的连身衣，是Hub 01的工作服。

messages.msgid: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit updated for the trans-human who needs full-body clothing.  Provides some storage and is adjustable to minimize encumbrance.
translations: 一件轻薄的短袖连身衣，为某些需要全身着装的超人类所设计。可以提供一些存储空间，能够调整已使得累赘最低。

messages.msgid: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit; similar to those worn by prisoners.  Provides decent storage and is not very encumbering.
translations: 一件轻薄的短袖连身衣。可以提供一些存储空间，而且也不太累赘。

messages.msgid: A black jumpsuit with a skeleton pattern printed on it.  It can be zipped all the way up to cover your head and face in a skull pattern too.  Use it to zip the head portion closed.
translations: 一件印着骨架图案的黑色连身衣。它可以一直往上拉到你的头和脸，变成骷髅形状。使用它把拉链往上拉到头部。

messages.msgid: You now have a skull as head.
A black jumpsuit with a skeleton pattern printed on it.  It covers all the way up to your head and displays a skull pattern over your face.  Use it to unzip the head portion.
translations: 一件印着骨架图案的黑色连身衣。它一直往上覆盖了你的头和脸，变成骷髅形状。使用它把拉链往下拉到颈部。

messages.msgid: You facial skin is now visible.
An off-white jumpsuit printed to look like the tattered wrappings of an ancient mummy.  Very easy to move in, but it doesn't offer any type of protection.
translations: 一套看起来像古代木乃伊的白色破烂衣服。穿着很方便，但它不提供任何防护。

messages.msgid: A fully covering jumpsuit made of waterproof canvas.  Offers solid protection from everyday dangers on the job and plenty of storage pockets.
translations: 由防水帆布制成的全套连体裤。提供坚固的保护，避免工作中的日常危险，还有许多的存储口袋。

messages.msgid: A thick, fully covering jumpsuit made of waterproof canvas lined with extra fabric for warmth in brisk weather.  Offers solid protection from everyday dangers on the job and plenty of storage pockets.
translations: 一款厚实全覆盖的连身裤，由防水帆布制成，内衬额外面料，在寒冷天气下保暖。提供坚固的保护，避免工作中的日常危险，还有许多的存储口袋。

messages.msgid: A one-piece suit of full-body long underwear that helps to maintain body temperature.  It laces closed in the front.
translations: 一件连身内衣，能维持体温。正面有拉链可以拉上。

messages.msgid: A full-body fursuit in the form of an anthropomorphic animal.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套完整的兽人装，呈现拟人化动物的形态。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A cartoonish full-body fursuit made to resemble an anthropomorphic wolf.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套卡通风格的完整兽人装，设计成拟人化的狼形态。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A fuzzy full-body fursuit made to resemble an anthropomorphic domestic canine of unknown breed.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套毛茸茸的完整兽人装，设计成拟人化的家犬形态，品种不明。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常保暖。

messages.msgid: An intricately designed full-body fursuit made to resemble an anthropomorphic bengal tiger, you can't imagine how long it took for it's maker to sew all those stripes onto it.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套精心设计的完整兽人装，呈现拟人化的孟加拉虎形态，你无法想象制作者花了多长时间才能将这些条纹缝制到上面。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A fluffy full-body fursuit made to resemble an anthropomorphic feline of indistinguishable breed.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套毛茸茸的完整兽人装，设计成拟人化的猫形态，品种难以辨别。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A dopey-looking full-body fursuit made to resemble an anthropomorphic otter.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套看起来蠢萌的完整兽人装，设计成拟人化的水獺形态。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A full-body fursuit made to resemble a nervous-looking anthropomorphic beaver.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套完整的兽人装，设计成拟人化的神经质海狸形态。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A detailed full-body fursuit made to resemble a western dragon, complete with a set of small stubby wings on its back.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套精细设计的完整兽人装，呈现拟人化的西方龙形态，其背部有一对小巧的短翼。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A sleek full-body fursuit made to resemble an anthropomorphic lizard.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套流线型的完整兽人装，设计成拟人化的蜥蜴形态。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A gnarly looking full-body costume in the form of an anthropomorphic bull shark.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一件覆盖全身的仿公牛鲨套装。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常温暖。

messages.msgid: A sleek looking full-body costume in the form of an anthropomorphic orca whale.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套外观流线型的完整服装，呈现拟人化的杀人鲸形态。它非常累赘且几乎没有存储空间，但非常保暖。

messages.msgid: A full-body costume in the form of an anthropomorphic dinosaur.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.
translations: 一套全身恐龙外形的服装。十分累赘，而且没多少存储空间，但是非常暖和。

messages.msgid: An encumbering wool suit covered in nice patterns.  It looks like full body armor but it only protects against cold, sadly.
translations: 一套穿着有点累赘的羊毛套装，它看起来就像一套完整的防弹衣，可惜，它只能抵御寒冷。

messages.msgid: An encumbering red wool suit with a hood adorned with cartoonish devil horns and a devil's tail on the back.  It's for those who want to feel devilishly warm in their sleep.
translations: 一套非常累赘的红色羊毛连身衣，帽子上装饰着卡通风格的恶魔角，背部有一条恶魔尾巴。适合那些想在睡觉时感受恶魔般温暖的人。

messages.msgid: An encumbering and fluffy bunny onesie with a hood and adorned with a pair of bunny ears.  Very fluffy.
translations: 一套非常累赘且毛茸茸的兔子连身衣，帽子上有一对装饰用的兔耳朵。非常柔软蓬松。

messages.msgid: Short for 'zenshin taitsu', a zentai is a form-fitting full-body nylon and spandex garment.  Though it covers your face, you can see through the thin fabric.  With a couple of these and some friends, you could put on some kabuki or harass a rival sports team.
translations: 又被称为"全身タイツ"，全包紧身衣是一种由尼龙和氨纶制成的包裹全身的连体服。虽然它遮住了你的脸，但你可以通过其集成的兜帽看到外界。有几件这样的衣服，再找来一些朋友，你就可以办一场歌舞伎表演了，或用来骚扰对手的运动队。

messages.msgid: Thick leather body armor that has been hardened via chemical treatment.  Light and strong.
translations: 一件经过化学鞣制硬化的厚实皮甲。轻巧而耐用。

messages.msgid: Leg and body armor made from the exoskeletons of insects.
translations: 一件由昆虫甲壳制成的护甲。

messages.msgid: Leg and body armor crafted from the carefully cleaned and pruned biosilicified exoskeletons of acidic ants.  Acid-resistant but brittle.
translations: 一副由经过精心清理并裁剪过的酸蚁硅化甲壳制成的全身护甲，防酸但很脆弱。

messages.msgid: Thick body armor made from furs.
translations: 一件由毛皮制成的厚重护甲。

messages.msgid: Thick body armor made from faux furs.
translations: 一件由人造毛皮制成的厚重护甲。

messages.msgid: A full suit of thick leather body armor.  Light and comfortable.
translations: 全套厚实的皮革护甲，轻便又舒适。

messages.msgid: A suit of Gothic plate armor.  The metal shows signs of rust and corrosion, and the leather straps are tattered.
translations: 一套哥特式板甲。金属已经有生锈和腐蚀的迹象，皮带也破旧不堪。

messages.msgid: A full set of armor hammered out from sheet metal and tied in place with leather straps and belts.  It's crude, heavy, and uncomfortable, but damn protective.  Now, you're a true Post-Apocalyptic Warrior.
translations: 一整套用金属板捶打出来的护甲，并用皮带系在适当的位置。又粗糙、又沉重、还不舒服，但最可恶的是防护效果还那么好。现在，你是一个真正的后世界末日战士了。

messages.msgid: A full set of armor hammered out from sheet metal and hardened for added protection.  Perfect for keeping all your fleshy bits safe from zombie teeth.
translations: 一整套用金属板捶打出来的护甲，并经过表面硬化处理提升防护能力。这样丧尸的牙齿就咬不到你身上的肉了，完美！

messages.msgid: A full set of armor hammered out from sheet metal and tied in place with leather straps and belts, with a doubly-thick chest guard to keep all your important organs safe.  You might be as mobile as a refrigerator wearing all this, but that's the price to pay to keep your flesh attached.
translations: 一整套由金属板捶打出来的护甲，并用皮带系在适当的位置，胸甲部分有两层钢板厚，能确保你所有重要器官的安全。穿上这堆东西，哇哦，你居然比冰箱还要灵活！这是保持你身体完整的必要代价。
重型钢板护甲（硬化碳钢）

messages.msgid: A full set of armor hammered out from sheet metal and hardened for extra protection, with a doubly-thick chest guard.  The Ned Kelly gang would be proud.
translations: 一整套用金属板捶打出来的护甲，并经过表面硬化处理提升防护能力，并带有双倍厚的胸甲。奈德·凯利帮用了都说好。

messages.msgid: A full set of steel armor made from sheet metal hammered into shape and attached with chainmail covering the gaps.  For the modern knight on a budget.
translations: 一整套钢制铠甲，由钣金锤打成型，并在连接处用锁子甲覆盖缝隙。适合预算有限的现代骑士。

messages.msgid: A full set of steel armor made from sheet metal hammered into shape and attached with chainmail covering the gaps, with an extra-thick chestpiece.  About as heavy as a car but nowhere near as mobile, this suit is nonetheless quite protective.
translations: 一整套钢制铠甲，由钣金锤打成型，并在连接处用锁子甲覆盖缝隙，胸甲部分还额外加厚。它几乎像汽车一样沉重，却远不如汽车灵活，但防护性能依然相当出色。

messages.msgid: A full set of steel armor made from sheet metal hammered into shape, attached with chainmail, and case-hardened for extra strength.  It might be crude and uncomfortably heavy, but it was clearly made by a skilled metalworker and offers excellent protection.
translations: 一整套钢制铠甲，由钣金锤打成型，并以锁子甲连接，且经过表面渗碳硬化以增强强度。它也许做工粗犷、重量沉得不太舒适，但显然出自熟练的金工之手，能提供出色的防护。
重型废土板甲（硬化碳钢）

messages.msgid: A full set of steel armor made from sheet metal hammered into shape, attached with chainmail, with a double-thick chestpiece, and case-hardened for extra strength.  Top-of-the-line in armor that looks like it was made from banged-up lockers, for the skilled metalworker that values protection over being able to move.
translations: 一整套钢制铠甲，由钣金锤打成型，并以锁子甲连接，胸甲为双层加厚，且经过表面渗碳硬化以增强强度。在这种“看起来像用被砸坏的储物柜拼出来”的铠甲里，它属于顶级之选，适合重视防护胜过机动性的熟练金工。

messages.msgid: A light suit of plate armor with a 2 mm thick chestpiece.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件胸甲厚2毫米的轻型板甲套装。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A light suit of plate armor with a 2 mm thick chestpiece.  Made with tougher medium steel, this suit offers solid protection.
translations: 一件胸甲厚2毫米的轻型板甲套装。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A light suit of plate armor with a 2 mm thick chestpiece.  Made with high steel, offering excellent protection.
translations: 一件胸甲厚 2 毫米的轻型板甲套装。这件是用更坚硬的高碳钢制成，提供出色的保护。

messages.msgid: A light suit of plate armor with a 2 mm thick chestpiece.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一套轻型板甲，胸甲厚度为2毫米。低碳钢经过表面硬化处理，提供更好的保护。

messages.msgid: A light suit of plate armor with a 2 mm thick chestpiece.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top-of-the-line protection.
translations: 一套轻型板甲，胸甲厚度为2毫米。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: A suit of plate armor with a 4 mm thick chestpiece.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件胸甲厚4毫米的板甲套装。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A suit of plate armor with a 4 mm thick chestpiece.  Made with tougher medium steel, this suit offers solid protection.
translations: 一件胸甲厚4毫米的板甲套装。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A suit of plate armor with a 4 mm thick chestpiece.  Made with high steel, offering excellent protection.
translations: 一套板甲，胸甲厚度为4毫米。采用更坚硬的高碳钢制成，提供了出色的保护。

messages.msgid: A suit of plate armor with a 4 mm thick chestpiece.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一套板甲，胸甲厚度为4毫米。低碳钢经过表面硬化处理，提供更好的保护。

messages.msgid: A suit of plate armor with a 4 mm thick chestpiece.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top-of-the-line protection.
translations: 一套板甲，胸甲厚度为4毫米。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy suit of plate armor with a 6 mm thick chestpiece.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件胸甲厚6毫米的重型板甲套装。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A heavy suit of plate armor with a 6 mm thick chestpiece.  Made with tougher medium steel, this suit offers solid protection.
translations: 一件胸甲厚6毫米的重型板甲套装。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy suit of plate armor with a 6 mm thick chestpiece.  Made with high steel, offering excellent protection.
translations: 一套重型板甲，胸甲厚度为6毫米。采用更坚硬的高碳钢制成，提供出色的保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy suit of plate armor with a 6 mm thick chestpiece.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一套重型板甲，胸甲厚度为6毫米。低碳钢经过表面硬化处理，提供更好的保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy suit of plate armor with a 6 mm thick chestpiece.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top-of-the-line protection.
translations: 一套重型板甲，胸甲厚度为6毫米。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: Thick leather body armor that has been reinforced with strategically-placed metal plates.
translations: 一件在重要位置用金属板加固的厚皮甲。

messages.msgid: An extremely heavy suit of ornamental armor.  The metal shows signs of rust and corrosion, and the leather straps are tattered.
translations: 一套极其厚重的装饰用盔甲。金属已经有生锈和腐蚀的迹象，皮带也破旧不堪。

messages.msgid: A full suit of black plastic body armor plates used by riot police.  Cleverly placed velcro straps secure each piece, resulting in slightly less encumbrance than its constituent parts.  MOLLE webbing is attached to the torso and the word POLICE is emblazoned across the front.
translations: 一套完整的黑色塑料防暴警察全身护甲。尼龙搭扣巧妙地将带子固定在每一块上，使之比每件单独穿着时的累赘略少。躯干装有MOLLE织带，正面印有"警察"字样。

messages.msgid: An ornamental suit of Japanese samurai armor.
translations: 一套装饰性的日本武士铠甲。

messages.msgid: A suit of armor made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings to cloth wraps; the loose collection of plates provides decent but uncomfortable protection.
translations: 一套用金属碎片做成的装甲，碎片之间用小绳子固定在衬布上。松垮的甲片虽然防护还行，但是穿着很不舒服。

messages.msgid: A suit of armor made from thick chunks of rubber tire secured by simple strings; the loose collection of rubber plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.
translations: 一套用轮胎片做成的装甲，碎片之间用小绳子固定。这些松垮的小片片能提供不错的防护，但是还不够完美。

messages.msgid: A white suit commonly worn by professional beekeepers with straps on your ankles and wrists to prevent bees from flying in.  It's not a very tough fabric, but it's lightweight and has plenty of storage thanks to a chest pocket.
translations: 一套白色套装，通常是职业养蜂人穿戴，在袖口和脚踝处有系带防止蜜蜂飞入蛰伤。这件衣服使用的织物并不坚固，但很轻便，此外胸口的大袋子提供了不少的存储空间。

messages.msgid: A fully customized chainmail outfit, covering torso and arms.  Combine with a aketon or other padded layer for optimal protection.
translations: 一件自制的锁环服，覆盖了躯干和手臂。与衬铠或其他内衬一同穿着时能提供更好的保护效果。
无袖连体锁环衣（低碳钢）
无袖连体锁环衣（中碳钢）
无袖连体锁环衣（高碳钢）
无袖连体锁环衣（硬化碳钢）
无袖连体锁环衣（回火碳钢）

messages.msgid: A fully customized chainmail outfit, leaving the head uncovered.  Combine with a gambeson or other padded layer for optimal protection.
translations: 一件自制的锁环服，没有覆盖头部，衣服下摆也只延伸到大腿中段。与软铠或其他内衬一同穿着时能提供更好的保护效果。

messages.msgid: A fully customized chainmail suit.  Combine with a gambeson or other padded layer for optimal protection.
translations: 一套自制的完整链甲套装。与软铠或其他内衬一同穿着，能够提供最佳保护。

messages.msgid: A fully customized chainmail suit.  The metal shows signs of rust and corrosion.  Combine with a gambeson or other padded layer for optimal protection.
translations: 一套自制的锁环甲套装，金属有生锈和腐蚀的迹象。与软铠或其他内衬一同穿着时能提供更好的保护效果。

messages.msgid: A fully customized chainmail suit that can be worn over your normal clothing.  The suit is conductively interconnected with a cage covering the face, protecting against electricity.
translations: 一套自制的锁环甲套装，可以穿在你正常的衣服上。衣服内各个部件是导电连接，形成了一个法拉第笼，能有效防护电击。

messages.msgid: A simple hazardous materials handling suit.  Though somewhat restrictive and fragile, wearing it will provide excellent protection against ambient radiation.
translations: 一套简单的危险物处理防护服。虽然穿着有些累赘而且容易损坏，但是能够很好防护环境中的辐射。

messages.msgid: A flame-resistant whole-body garment worn by firefighters as protection against extreme heat.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection against smoke.
translations: 一件消防员经常穿的重型防护服，能防护高温和火焰。需要额外配套的防化面具才能完全防护烟雾。

messages.msgid: Designed to stop the injuries of dog bites, this thick, one piece suit is often used in the rehabilitation of abused animals and in training dogs by the police and military.  A base layer of aramid fabric has had strips of soft body armor sewn into it to mimic quilting, and to soften the blunt of animals jumping, slashing, or pouncing on the wearer.
translations: 设计来防止犬类咬伤的的厚实一体式防护服，常用于警察或军队收容受虐动物或训练犬只。基层是凯夫拉材质，上面层叠缝有防护甲条从而卸掉动物飞扑、猛抓或撞击时的力道。

messages.msgid: An impermeable whole-body garment worn as protection against hazardous materials.  Restrictive and fragile, wearing it will provide complete protection against ambient radiation.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.
translations: 一套不透气的、十分累赘而且容易损坏的危险物处理全身防护服。穿上它能够完全防护环境中的辐射。只需要再戴一个防毒面具就能够给你全方位的防护。

messages.msgid: A snug body suit made from thin and lightweight Nomex fire-resistant fabric.  Tough yet breathable, it is light and comfortable to wear under clothing.
translations: 一套由轻薄的芳纶防火织物制成的紧身服。结实但透气，穿在其他衣服下既轻便又舒适。

messages.msgid: A lightweight environmental suit incorporating Kevlar-lined boots and gloves, worn by Hub personnel in their rare forays aboveground.  Colored brown and blue, the white seal of Hub 01 is embroidered on both of its upper arms.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.
translations: 一套轻便的环境防护服，包括凯夫拉内衬的靴子和手套，仅供 Hub 01 工作人员在执行少有的地面任务时穿着。主色调是棕色和蓝色，两侧上臂印着带有 Hub 01 白色标志的臂章。只需要再戴一个防毒面具就能够给你全方位的防护。

messages.msgid: You slip out of the top of the suit and tie the sleeves around your waist.
translations: 你脱下上衣，把袖子系在腰间。

messages.msgid: A lightweight environmental suit incorporating Kevlar-lined boots, worn by Hub personnel in their rare forays aboveground.  Colored brown and blue, the upper portion has been tied around the waist casually.
translations: 一套轻便的环境防护服，包括凯夫拉内衬的靴子和手套，仅供 Hub 01 工作人员在执行少有的地面任务时穿着。主色调是棕色和蓝色，两侧上臂印着带有 Hub 01 白色标志的臂章。上半部分被随意地系在腰间。

messages.msgid: You untie the sleeves and put back on the top of the suit.
translations: 你解开袖子，重新穿好衣服。

messages.msgid: A single-piece brown and orange environmental suit, tailored in a way that slightly recalls a military flight suit.  The letters "X.E.D.R.A" are inscribed on its back, and a white shoulder patch on the right arm shows an arrow reaching within rings of concentric circles.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.
translations: 一件棕色和橙色的环境防护服，其剪裁方式略微让人想起军用飞行服。背部刻有"X.E.D.R.A"字样，右臂上的白色肩章显示一个箭头伸向同心圆环内。只需要再戴一个防毒面具就能够给你全方位的防护。

messages.msgid: A single-piece brown and orange environmental suit, tailored in a way that slightly recalls a military flight suit.  The upper portion has been tied around the waist casually.
translations: 一件棕色和橙色的环境防护服，裁剪样式让人想起一件军用飞行服。它的背面印着"X.E.D.R.A"的字母，右臂上的白色肩章画着一个箭头射进一环套一环的同心圆内。上半部分被随意地系在腰间。

messages.msgid: A full-body cotton suit.  Makes the apocalypse a truly gentlemanly experience.
translations: 一套全身式的棉质套装。让末日也显得格外绅士。

messages.msgid: A leather bodysuit with padding in high-impact areas, meant for motorcyclists out on the track.  The leather is stiff but makes the armor much sturdier and more protective than lighter counterparts.
translations: 一种皮革连体衣，在高冲击区域有衬垫，专为巡回赛赛道上的摩托车手设计。皮革很硬，但使它比其他轻型护甲更坚固，更具防护。

messages.msgid: A military officer's dress uniform from before the Cataclysm, complete with rank and ribbons.  Just looking at it gives you an air of authority.  Perhaps not the most practical military wear, but a very stylish option.
translations: 大灾变前的军官制式礼服，配有军衔和缎带。只要看看它，你就会有一种权威感。也许不是最实用的军装，但却是非常时尚的选择。

messages.msgid: A sage-green US military flight suit.  It has various insignia embroidered onto it.
translations: 一件深绿色的美军飞行服。上面绣着各种徽章。

messages.msgid: A full body multilayered suit of plate armor with a 4 mm thick chest piece.  The medium steel has been quenched, tempered and affixed over a full-body layered suit of weight-distributing straps.  The armor has an integrated breathable Lycra jumpsuit and the torso has a spall liner of aramid panels.  Electronics run below the surface and circulate cool air to the skin, drawing power from your internal CBM reservoir.
translations: 一件胸甲厚4毫米的板甲套装。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，并安在全身多层配重系带上。盔甲内有一件一体式透气氨纶连体衣，躯干处有一层由凯夫拉纤维板制成的防弹内衬。盔甲下有电子设备运行，使用你身上CBM携带的生化能量将冷气带到体表。

messages.msgid: You turn the climate control on.

A full body multilayered light suit of plate armor with a 2 mm thick chest piece.  The medium steel has been quenched, tempered and affixed over a full-body layered suit of weight-distributing straps.  The armor has an integrated breathable Lycra jumpsuit and the torso has a spall liner of aramid panels.  Electronics run below the surface and circulate cool air to the skin, drawing power from your internal CBM reservoir.
translations: 一件胸甲厚2毫米的轻型板甲套装。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，并安在全身多层配重系带上。盔甲内有一件一体式透气氨纶连体衣，躯干处有一层由凯夫拉纤维板制成的防弹内衬。盔甲下有电子设备运行，使用你身上CBM携带的生化能量将冷气带到体表。

messages.msgid: A full body multilayered heavy suit of plate armor with a 6 mm thick chest piece.  The medium steel has been quenched, tempered and affixed over a full-body layered suit of weight-distributing straps.  The armor has an integrated breathable Lycra jumpsuit and the torso has a spall liner of aramid panels.  Electronics run below the surface and circulate cool air to the skin, drawing power from your internal CBM reservoir.
translations: 一件胸甲厚6毫米的重型板甲套装。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，并安在全身多层配重系带上。盔甲内有一件一体式透气氨纶连体衣，躯干处有一层由凯夫拉纤维板制成的防弹内衬。盔甲下有电子设备运行，使用你身上CBM携带的生化能量将冷气带到体表。

messages.msgid: A full body multilayered chainmail outfit.  The medium steel has been quenched, tempered and affixed over a full-body layered suit of weight-distributing straps.  The armor has an integrated breathable Lycra jumpsuit and the torso has a spall liner of aramid panels.  Electronics run below the surface and circulate cool air to the skin, drawing power from your internal CBM reservoir.
translations: 一件覆盖全身的多层链甲。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，并安在全身多层配重系带上。盔甲内有一件一体式透气氨纶连体衣，躯干处有一层由凯夫拉纤维板制成的防弹内衬。盔甲下有电子设备运行，使用你身上CBM携带的将冷气带到体表。
一件简单的比基尼内裤。

messages.msgid: They're printed with an American flag pattern.
translations: 上面印有美国国旗图案。

messages.msgid: They're colored neon pink.  Pretty flashy.
translations: 它是霓虹粉的。十分招摇。

messages.msgid: They're green and has a tropical design.
translations: 它是绿色的，带点热带风情的设计。

messages.msgid: They're colored yellow and has a floral design.
translations: 它是黄色的，上面有花朵图案。

messages.msgid: They're has a camouflage pattern, perfect for a soldier on beach leave.
translations: 它上面印着迷彩图案，非常适合那些想在海边度假的士兵。

messages.msgid: They're colored black and printed with a skull pattern.  Works wonders to communicate your happiness on the beach.
translations: 它是它是黑色的，带着骷髅图案。对于你在海滩上传播快乐的事业有奇效。

messages.msgid: They're colored black with white frilly decorations.  You are not sure that this is common attire for the beach.
translations: 它是黑色的，带着白色褶边装饰。你不确定这是海滩上常用的服装。

messages.msgid: A very short pair of bikini bottoms, commonly called a thong.
translations: 一条非常短的比基尼内裤，通常也被称为丁字裤。
一件简单的比基尼上衣。

messages.msgid: It's colored neon pink.  Pretty flashy.
translations: 它是霓虹粉的。十分招摇。

messages.msgid: It's green and has a tropical design.
translations: 它是绿色的，带点热带风情的设计。

messages.msgid: It's colored yellow and has a floral design.
translations: 它是黄色的，上面有印花图案。

messages.msgid: It has a camouflage pattern, perfect for a soldier on beach leave.
translations: 它上面印着迷彩图案，非常适合那些想在海边度假的士兵。

messages.msgid: It's colored black and printed with a skull pattern.  Works wonders to communicate your happiness on the beach.
translations: 它是它是黑色的，带着骷髅图案。对于你在海滩上传播快乐的事业有奇效。

messages.msgid: It's colored black with white frilly decorations.  You are not sure that this is common attire for the beach.
translations: 它是白色的，带着黑色褶边装饰。你不确定这是海滩上常见的服装。

messages.msgid: A very short bikini top.  It doesn't cover much, but was in fashion before the world ended.
translations: 一条非常短的比基尼文胸。它盖不住多少地方，但在世界末日前很流行。

messages.msgid: It has horizontal black and white stripes.
translations: 它印着水平黑白相间的条纹。

messages.msgid: It's bright red and has a white cross with the word "Lifeguard" on the front.
translations: 它是鲜红色的，正面有一个白色十字，上面写着"救生员"。

messages.msgid: A long-sleeved rashguard shirt.  Commonly used to protect against rashes from abrasion or sun exposure.
translations: 一件长袖防晒衬衫。通常用来防止摩擦或日晒引起的皮疹。

messages.msgid: It's printed with an American flag pattern.  You feel as if the flag itself protects your skin.
translations: 它上面印着星条旗花纹。你感觉仿佛国旗本身保护着你的皮肤。

messages.msgid: It has jungle decorations and motifs of animals fighting among themselves.
translations: 它上面印着丛林装饰，以及与各类动物战斗的图案。

messages.msgid: It has a camouflage pattern and outlines your muscles.
translations: 它上面印着迷彩图案，勾勒出你的肌肉。

messages.msgid: It's colored black and has a big skull on the front and back.  It makes you look tough.
translations: 它是黑色的，前后都印着一个大骷髅头。这让你看上去很强。

messages.msgid: It has a jet-black color with dark red decorations.  Looks creepy.
translations: 它是深黑色的，带有深红色的装饰图案。看起来很恐怖。

messages.msgid: A pair of very short black swim briefs.  Commonly used by male competitive swimmers and bodybuilders.
translations: 一条黑色超短泳裤。通常用于男子游泳和健美运动员。

messages.msgid: A pair of blue swim briefs.  Commonly used by male competitive swimmers.
translations: 一条蓝色泳裤。通常用于男子游泳运动员。

messages.msgid: A tightly fitted, skin-tight head garment made of Lycra.  Commonly used by recreational and competitive swimmers.
translations: 一顶用氨纶制成的紧身头巾。通常是水中娱乐时或是竞技游泳运动员使用。

messages.msgid: A pair of swimming trunks, with netting.
translations: 一件男性平角泳裤，有绳子可以绑。

messages.msgid: A pair of 3 mm split-toe neoprene diving socks with thin rubber soles.
translations: 一双3毫米厚的氯丁橡胶分趾潜水袜，底部有一层薄橡胶。

messages.msgid: A pair of 5 mm thick neoprene diving boots with thick soles.
translations: 一双5毫米厚的氯丁橡胶潜水靴，鞋底较厚。

messages.msgid: mounting for a pair of fins.
A pair of rubber flippers worn on the feet, which improve swimming speed while greatly impeding the wearer's ability to walk.
translations: 一双穿在脚上的橡胶脚蹼，可以提高游泳速度，但走起路来非常困难。

messages.msgid: A full-body 3 mm thick neoprene wetsuit with nylon lining.
translations: 一件 3 毫米厚的全身氯丁橡胶尼龙内衬潜水服。

messages.msgid: A full-body 5 mm thick neoprene wetsuit with nylon lining.
translations: 一件 5 毫米厚的全身氯丁橡胶尼龙内衬潜水服。

messages.msgid: A 3 mm neoprene hood, commonly worn by divers.
translations: 一个 3 毫米厚的氯丁橡胶头套，通常是潜水员穿的。

messages.msgid: A 5 mm thick neoprene hood, commonly worn by divers in cold weather.
translations: 一件 5 毫米厚的氯丁橡胶头套，通常由潜水员在寒冷天气下佩戴。

messages.msgid: A long-sleeved neoprene jacket.  Keeps you warm and protected from the elements.
translations: 一件长袖氯丁橡胶夹克。让你保持温暖，抵御恶劣天气。

messages.msgid: A short-sleeved neoprene shirt.  Good for use on the beach.
translations: 一件短袖氯丁橡胶衬衫。适合在海滩上使用。

messages.msgid: A thin long-sleeved neoprene shirt.  Good for surfing and other water sports.
translations: 一件薄制长袖氯丁橡胶衬衫。适合冲浪和其他水上运动。

messages.msgid: A long-sleeved neoprene shirt.  Good for surfing and other water sports.
translations: 一件长袖氯丁橡胶衬衫。适合冲浪和其他水上运动。

messages.msgid: A pair of light and stretchy thin neoprene pants.  Good for surfing and other water sports.
translations: 一条轻便有弹力的薄制氯丁橡胶长裤。适合冲浪和其他水上运动。

messages.msgid: A pair of light and stretchy neoprene pants.  Good for surfing and other water sports.
translations: 一条轻便有弹力的氯丁橡胶长裤。适合冲浪和其他水上运动。

messages.msgid: A pair of light and stretchy neoprene shorts.  Good for use on the beach.
translations: 一条轻便有弹力的氯丁橡胶短裤。适合在海滩上使用。

messages.msgid: A pair of stretchy neoprene shorts with large pockets.  Can be worn alone or adjusted to be worn over a wetsuit.
translations: 一条带有大口袋的弹性氯丁橡胶短裤。 可单独穿着，也可调整后穿在潜水衣外面。

messages.msgid: A pair of stretchy neoprene shorts with large pockets.  Can be worn over a wetsuit or adjusted to be worn alone.
translations: 一条带有大口袋的弹性氯丁橡胶短裤。 可穿在潜水衣外面，也可调整为单独穿着。

messages.msgid: A long-sleeved spring wetsuit with pink color details and cleavage-enhancing, hip-accentuating construction.  Not as protective as a full-body suit, but also less restrictive.
translations: 一件长袖的保暖潜水衣，上面有着粉红色的点缀。流线型的贴身设计充分彰显出你前凸后翘的傲人身材。虽然这件衣服安全性上没有全身潜水服好，但是其胜在轻便不勒身。

messages.msgid: A sleeveless spring wetsuit with an ocean blue color and cleavage-enhancing, hip-accentuating construction.  Not as protective as a full-body suit, but also less restrictive.
translations: 一件无袖的保暖潜水衣，上面有着海蓝色的点缀。流线型的贴身设计充分彰显出你前凸后翘的傲人身材。虽然这件衣服安全性上没有全身潜水服好，但是其胜在轻便不勒身。

messages.msgid: A one-piece chainmail suit used by SCUBA divers for protection against shark bites.  It has been conductively interconnected, protecting against electricity.
translations: 一件潜水员用来防止被鲨鱼咬伤、覆及全身的一体链甲套装。内部有电传导系统，有效防护电击。

messages.msgid: A-one piece chainmail suit used by SCUBA divers for protection against shark bites.
translations: 一件潜水员用来防止被鲨鱼咬伤的一体链甲套装。

messages.msgid: A small pair of goggles made for swimming.
translations: 一副符合光学和医用标准，水下视物清晰、视野宽阔的游泳镜。

messages.msgid: A pair of flexible neoprene-silicone rubber gloves, suitable for underwater use.
translations: 一双富有弹性的氯丁橡胶手套，适合水下使用。

messages.msgid: A pair of thick neoprene-silicone rubber gloves, suitable for underwater use.
translations: 一双厚厚的高延展性的氯丁橡胶手套，适合水下使用。

messages.msgid: A full-face diving mask that covers the face and eyes.  Can be equipped with any common scuba regulator to protect from drowning and other dangers, though the process needs some time and knowledge.
translations: 一种完全包裹面部和眼睛的潜水面罩。可以配备任何常见的水肺调节器，以防止溺水和其他危险，尽管这个过程需要一些时间和知识。

messages.msgid: A high-end modular full-face diving mask that covers the face and eyes.  Can be equipped with proprietary adapters for scuba tanks or rebreather cartridges to protect from drowning and other dangers.
translations: 一个高端模块化的全包式潜水面罩，覆盖面部和眼睛。可以配备专有的水肺罐或再呼吸器墨盒适配器，以防止溺水和其他危险。

messages.msgid: An ancient Greek breastplate made of bronze.
translations: 一件古希腊的胸甲，由青铜制成。

messages.msgid: A solid, single-piece cuirass made from bronze.  It isn't particularly well designed, but it does its job.
translations: 一件坚固的整体成型的青铜胸甲。它的设计不是特别好，但依旧管用。

messages.msgid: A cuirass made of multiple pieces of tough leather, laced together for durable yet flexible protection.
translations: 由多片坚韧皮革制成并用系带串连的胸甲，提供耐用而又相对灵活的防护。

messages.msgid: A cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  It's less Mad Max and more Garage Mongolian, but the classics are classic for a reason.
translations: 一件由金属薄片拼接而成的胸甲，介于锁子甲和板甲之间。它不像《疯狂的麦克斯》里的那种，而更像是《车库里的蒙古人》，但经典之所以经典是有原因的。

messages.msgid: A cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  The perfect size for an orc or bipedal grizzly bear.
translations: 一件由金属薄片拼接而成的胸甲，介于锁子甲和板甲之间。它不像《疯狂的麦克斯》里的那种，而更像是《车库里的蒙古人》，但经典之所以经典是有原因的。这个尺寸适合兽人或者恐怖两脚熊。

messages.msgid: A cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  Perfectly sized for a particularly angry rat-person, yes-yes.
translations: 一件由金属薄片拼接而成的胸甲，介于锁子甲和板甲之间。它不像《疯狂的麦克斯》里的那种，而更像是《车库里的蒙古人》，但经典之所以经典是有原因的。非常适合那种特别生气的鼠人，没错。

messages.msgid: A cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  This one has been hardened for extra protection.
translations: 一件由金属薄片拼接而成的胸甲，介于锁子甲和板甲之间。它不像《疯狂的麦克斯》里的那种，而更像是《车库里的蒙古人》，但经典之所以经典是有原因的。这件经过硬化处理，防护效果更好。

messages.msgid: A hardened cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  Built larger for a minotaur guarding their labyrinth.
translations: 一件由表面硬化碳钢金属薄片拼接而成的胸甲，介于锁子甲和板甲之间。它不像《疯狂的麦克斯》里的那种，而更像是《车库里的蒙古人》，但经典之所以经典是有原因的。这件似乎是给守卫迷宫的牛头怪穿的大号版本。

messages.msgid: A hardened cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  Just the right size for a fantasy dwarf.
translations: 一件由表面硬化碳钢金属薄片拼接而成的胸甲，介于锁子甲和板甲之间。它不像《疯狂的麦克斯》里的那种，而更像是《车库里的蒙古人》，但经典之所以经典是有原因的。尺寸正好适合那种神话中的矮人。

messages.msgid: A rectangular length of tough carpet with a hole cut out for your head and tied around the waist.  It's decently protective for its weight and quite the fashion statement.
translations: 一张长方形的粗糙地毯，上面开了个洞让你套在头上，拴住腰部固定。相对于它的重量来说，防护力就有点不够看了。

messages.msgid: A Mesoamerican armor of Nahuatl origin, somewhat similar to a European gambeson.  It is made of unspun cotton between two layers of quilted cotton crystalized by brine, edged with leather around its holes.  It is extremely thick and offers superb protection, but is also heavy.  This bad boy once stopped Spanish bullets and Aztec missiles alike, now its time has come to stop zombie bites.
translations: 源自中美洲纳瓦特尔人的盔甲，类似欧洲的软铠。纳瓦特尔布甲由两层由盐水硬化的未纺棉花制成的，甲上有孔，孔边镶有皮革。这种布甲很厚，保护性能优秀，但重量拖了后腿。这种布甲曾经挡下西班牙的子弹和阿兹特克的投石，现在我们的好小子该挡僵尸了。

messages.msgid: An ancient Roman laminar armor, made of overlapping metal strips connected to internal leather straps.
translations: 一件古罗马片甲，由互相重叠的金属片连接而成，内部由皮带联结。

messages.msgid: This armor, made of interlocking plates of burnished bronze, appears to be either a high-quality recreation or a genuine artifact.  Despite having an ancient design, it is in mint condition aside from some battle damage.  It covers from the shoulders to the hips and is of extremely high quality.
translations: 这件青铜甲胄由相互连接的抛光青铜板制成，看起来要么是高质量的现代重制品，要么是真正的古代遗物。尽管样式十分古老，除了表面的一些战斗损伤，它仍旧完好无缺。它覆盖的部位从头部到腰部，品质极高。

messages.msgid: Two sheets of metal hammered to fit your torso and riveted to leather belts to act as straps.  Heavy, uncomfortable, and difficult to move in, but it should help keep your blood inside your body.
translations: 两块金属板，经过敲打以贴合你的躯干，并铆接在皮带上作为肩带。沉重、不舒服且很难穿上，但它应该有助于保持你的血还在你的身体里。

messages.msgid: A chest guard made of hammered sheet metal, hardened for added protection.  It's not any easier to move in, but it is much sturdier now.
translations: 由金属板捶打出来的胸甲，经过硬化处理提升防护能力。穿上这东西本来就不容易，但起码这个在变得更坚固的同时没有变得更难穿。

messages.msgid: A double-decker chest guard made from two sheets of metal layered over each other and hammered to fit your torso.  Monstrously heavy, but it's quite protective and the thicker material makes it sturdier.
translations: 双层厚的钢板胸甲，由两层金属板叠在一起，并照着躯干形状捶打制成。非常重，但防护能力也很棒，更厚的材料使它更加坚固。

messages.msgid: hardened heavy sheet metal chest guard
translations: 重型钢板胸甲（硬化碳钢）
messages.plural: hardened heavy sheet metal chest guards

messages.msgid: Double-thick, hardened sheet metal hammered to fit your torso.  Offers the best protection a junkyard knight could ask for.
translations: 双层金属板锤打而成，并经过硬化处理的胸甲。对于垃圾场骑士而言，这件装备的防护能力已经是顶级的了。

messages.msgid: One sheet of metal, cut in half to only cover your upper torso and back and riveted to leather belts to act as straps.  It's heavy and uncomfortable, but at least you can bend at the waist.
translations: 一块金属板，切成两半，只覆盖你的上半身和背部，并铆接到皮带上作为肩带。很重，很不舒服，但至少穿着时可以弯腰。

messages.msgid: hardened light sheet metal chest guard
translations: 轻型钢板胸甲（硬化碳钢）
messages.plural: hardened light sheet metal chest guards

messages.msgid: Sheet metal cut to only cover your upper torso and hardened for extra protection.  Provides a decent compromise between protection and being able to move.
translations: 由金属板捶打而成的胸甲，仅覆盖上半躯干，经过硬化处理以提供额外保护。在防护和移动能力之间提供了一个不错的折中方案。

messages.msgid: A crude form of armor made from thickly-stacked paper and rolls of duct tape.
translations: 一件由一叠叠厚纸和胶带制成的简易护甲。

messages.msgid: Armor fashioned from overlapping chunks of tire and rolls of duct tape, covering the shoulders and torso.
translations: 一套将许多块轮胎片叠在一起，然后用强力胶带粘牢的胸甲，覆盖了双肩和躯干。

messages.msgid: A customized mild steel chainmail vest.  It's a sleeveless piece of chainmail with small straps designed to better distribute the weight.
translations: 一件自制的低碳钢锁环胸甲，这件无袖胸甲由多条带子连结，均匀地分散装甲的重量。

messages.msgid: A customized chainmail vest.  The metal shows signs of rust and corrosion.  It's a sleeveless piece of chainmail with small straps designed to better distribute the weight.
translations: 一件自制锁环胸甲，金属有生锈和腐蚀的迹象。这件无袖胸甲由多条带子连结，均匀地分散装甲的重量。

messages.msgid: A thick cotton sweatshirt that an amateur tailor sewed ever-increasing amounts of cloth onto, providing noticeable, if haphazard padding.
translations: 一件厚厚的棉质运动衫，由某个业余裁缝在上面缝制了一大堆布料。很随意，但是十分引人注目，也有一些防护效果。

messages.msgid: A thick cotton shirt with the sleeves cut off and large amounts of cloth sewn in to make a padded vest.  It would be fashionable, if not for all the disparate colors from the patchwork cotton cannibalized from other random clothes.
translations: 一件厚厚的棉质衬衫，袖子被剪掉，大量的布料被缝在里面，最终变成了一件超级厚的背心。如果不是因为各种从其它衣服上裁下来的花花绿绿布料混合起来太辣眼睛，这一定能引领新的时尚潮流。

messages.msgid: A solid vest of plastic padding protecting your torso.
translations: 一件结实的塑料内衬的护胸，用来保护你的躯干。

messages.msgid: A steel breastplate, and a vital part of plate armor.  Even as full armor went into decline, cuirasses remained in use among cavalry in Europe.
translations: 一件钢制的胸腹部护甲，一套盔甲的核心部位。就算在全身覆甲的潮流被时代所淘汰之后，钢制胸甲仍然在欧洲的骑兵部队中有被装备。

messages.msgid: A cuirass made from scraps of metal secured by simple strings.
translations: 一件用金属碎片做成的护甲，碎片之间用小绳子固定。

messages.msgid: A cuirass made from thick chunks of tire secured by simple strings; the loose collection of rubber plates provides decent but not the most convenient protection.
translations: 一套用厚橡胶块做成的胸甲，碎片之间用小绳子固定。这些松垮的小片片能提供不错的防护，但是还不够完美。

messages.msgid: A padded jacket with a zipper on the back, used by fencers to prevent accidents.
translations: 一件拉链在背后、防止击剑时发生意外的厚夹克。

messages.msgid: A thick motorcycle jacket with metal plates drilled onto various areas for increased protection.
translations: 一件厚厚的摩托车夹克，各处钻有金属板，以加强防护能力。

messages.msgid: A denim jacket reinforced with metal plates.  Adequately protective, but not very sturdy.
translations: 一件加固了金属板的牛仔夹克。防护性还行，但还不够结实。

messages.msgid: A denim vest reinforced with metal plates.  Adequately protective, but not very sturdy.
translations: 一件加固了金属板的牛仔背心。防护性还行，但还不够结实。

messages.msgid: A thick motorcycle jacket with hardened metal plates drilled onto various areas for highly increased protection.
translations: 一件厚重的摩托车夹克，其上用螺栓固定了硬化金属板，大幅增强了防护性能。

messages.msgid: A denim jacket reinforced with hardened steel plates.  Highly protective, but not very sturdy.
translations: 一件加固了硬化碳钢的牛仔夹克。防护性极高，但不够坚固。

messages.msgid: A denim vest reinforced with hardened steel plates.  Highly protective, but not very sturdy.
translations: 一件加固了硬化碳钢的牛仔背心。防护性极高，但不够坚固。

messages.msgid: A black jacket made from thick leather and covered with intricately carved bones.  You've never seen patterns like those before, each time you look at them you spot a new one as if they were changing on their own.
translations: 一件由厚皮制成的黑色夹克，上面布满了雕刻复杂的骨头。你以前从来没有见过上面这种花纹，每当你再次细细查看，你就会发现一个新的花纹，好像它们会自己改变一样。

messages.msgid: A motorcycle jacket reinforced with chunks of thick rubber tire.  Thick and highly resistant to blunt force.
translations: 一件用厚实橡胶轮胎碎片加固的摩托车夹克。很厚，对钝击有很好防护性能。

messages.msgid: A thin, lightweight conductive vest with the zipper on the back used by fencers for electronic scoring.  Its outer layer is a woven mix of sturdy cotton and stainless steel strands.
translations: 一件轻薄的导电背心，背部有拉链，用于在击剑时电子计分。它的最外层是由结实的棉布和不锈钢丝交织而成的。

messages.msgid: A thin, lightweight conductive jacket used by fencers for electronic scoring.  Its outer layer is a woven mix of sturdy cotton and stainless steel strands.
translations: 一件轻薄的导电夹克，用于在击剑时电子计分。它的最外层是由结实的棉布和不锈钢丝交织而成的。

messages.msgid: Heavy polycarbonate armor for your upper torso.  Normally worn by football players.
translations: 一件沉重的聚碳酸酯护甲，通常由橄榄球球员穿着。

messages.msgid: A lightweight level II ballistic vest, suitable for wearing under a coat or other outer wear.
translations: 轻便的二级防弹背心，适合穿在外套或其他外衣下。

messages.msgid: A light jacket made of a stretch mesh covered in plastic pads meant for motorcyclists.  Made to be much more comfortable to wear than leather alternatives, but the underlying Lycra isn't protective at all.
translations: 一种由弹性织网制成的轻便夹克，上面覆盖着塑料衬垫，供摩托车手穿着。与皮革版相比，它的穿着更加舒适，但其底层的氨纶面料根本没有防护力。

messages.msgid: A sturdy cotton plastron that protects much of the torso, the dominant shoulder, and underarm while fencing.
translations: 一件结实的棉质胸甲，能在击剑时保护大部分躯干、肩膀主要部分和腋下。

messages.msgid: A rigid plastic plastron with molded cups to be worn by female fencers for protection while fencing.
translations: 一件坚硬的塑料胸甲，带有用模具成型的胸罩，可供女子击剑运动员佩带，以在击剑时提供保护。

messages.msgid: An armored vest made from thick leather and metal plates.
translations: 一件由厚皮革和金属板制成的护甲背心。

messages.msgid: An armored vest made from thick leather and metal plates which have been hardened for superb protection.
translations: 一件带护甲的皮背心，由厚皮革和经硬化处理的金属板制成，提供不俗的防御。

messages.msgid: A light chestplate, 2 mm thick.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件厚2毫米的轻型护胸。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A light chestplate, 2 mm thick.  Made with tougher medium steel, offering solid protection.
translations: 一款轻型胸甲，厚度为2毫米。采用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A light chestplate, 2 mm thick.  Made with high steel, offering excellent protection.
translations: 一款轻型胸甲，厚度为2毫米。采用更坚硬的高碳钢制成，提供出色的保护。

messages.msgid: A light chestplate, 2 mm thick.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一款轻型胸甲，厚度为2毫米。采用低碳钢制成，提供了优越的防护性能。

messages.msgid: A light chestplate, 2 mm thick.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top-of-the-line protection.
translations: 一款轻型胸甲，厚度为2毫米。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供了顶级防护性能。

messages.msgid: A chestplate, 4 mm thick.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件厚4毫米的护胸。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A chestplate, 4 mm thick.  Made with tougher medium steel, offering solid protection.
translations: 一件厚4毫米的护胸。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A chestplate, 4 mm thick.  Made with high steel, offering excellent protection.
translations: 一件厚4毫米的护胸。这件是用更坚硬的高碳钢制成，提供出色的保护。

messages.msgid: A chestplate, 4 mm thick.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一件厚4毫米的护胸。低碳钢经过硬化处理，提供更好的保护。

messages.msgid: A chestplate, 4 mm thick.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top-of-the-line protection.
translations: 一件厚4毫米的护胸。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy chestplate, 6 mm thick.  This one has been made with mild steel.
translations: 一件厚6毫米的重型护胸。这件是用低碳钢做的。

messages.msgid: A heavy chestplate, 6 mm thick.  Made with tougher medium steel, offering solid protection.
translations: 一件厚6毫米的重型护胸。这件是用更坚硬的中碳钢制成，提供坚固的保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy chestplate, 6 mm thick.  Made with high steel, offering excellent protection.
translations: 一件厚6毫米的重型护胸。这件是用更坚硬的高碳钢制成，提供出色的保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy chestplate, 6 mm thick.  The mild steel has been hardened, offering superior protection.
translations: 一件厚6毫米的重型护胸。低碳钢经过硬化处理，提供更好的保护。

messages.msgid: A heavy chestplate, 6 mm thick.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top-of-the-line protection.
translations: 一件厚6毫米的重型护胸。中碳钢经过淬火和回火处理，提供顶级保护。

messages.msgid: Armor made of combined pre-Cataclysm clothing.  Sections from leather clothing are tightened and affixed to a thick cotton shirt, excluding the joints.
translations: 一套将大灾变前的服装拼接而成的护甲。从其它衣物上裁下来的皮革片被紧固到了一件厚棉衬衫上，避开了关节处。

messages.msgid: Armor made of combined pre-Cataclysm clothing.  Sections from leather clothing are tightened and affixed to a thick cotton shirt.  The sleeves have been cut off.
translations: 一套将大灾变前的服装拼接而成的护甲。从其它衣物上裁下来的皮革片被紧固到了一件厚棉衬衫上。这件的袖子已经被剪下来了。

messages.msgid: A hard chest protector, attached to thigh and upper arm guards.  Used by riot police officers.  MOLLE webbing is attached to the torso and the word POLICE is emblazoned across the front.
translations: 由防暴警察使用的坚硬胸部护甲，可以与护腿和护臂相连。大腿上系有MOLLE织带，前面印有"警察"字样。

messages.msgid: A leather chest plate with attached shoulder guards.
translations: 附带护肩的革质胸板甲。

messages.plural: sets of mild steel mirror armor

messages.msgid: Mirror armor earns its name from its distinct shape and polished sheen.  Round and rectangular steel plates are fastened together to protect all four sides of the torso.  It can be worn on top of other armor like chainmail and brigandines.  This set is crudely put together with square plates of mild steel.
translations: 镜铠因其独特的形状和抛光的光泽而得名，由圆形和矩形的钢板固定在一起组成，以保护躯干的前后左右。镜铠可以穿在其他盔甲上，如锁子甲和布面甲等。这套镜铠用几块低碳钢简单组装而成。

messages.plural: sets of medium steel mirror armor

messages.msgid: Mirror armor earns its name from its distinct shape and polished sheen.  Round and rectangular steel plates are fastened together to protect all four sides of the torso.  It can be worn on top of other armor like chainmail and brigandines.  This set is made with rectangular plates of medium steel.
translations: 镜铠因其独特的形状和抛光的光泽而得名，由圆形和矩形的钢板固定在一起组成，以保护躯干的前后左右。镜铠可以穿在其他盔甲上，如锁子甲和布面甲等。这套镜铠由几块方形中碳钢组装而成。

messages.plural: sets of high steel mirror armor

messages.msgid: Mirror armor earns its name from its distinct shape and polished sheen.  Round and rectangular steel plates are fastened together to protect all four sides of the torso.  It can be worn on top of other armor like chainmail and brigandines.  Made of high steel plates, this set is well-formed and lightly polished for a neat finish.
translations: 镜铠因其独特的形状和抛光的光泽而得名，由圆形和矩形的钢板固定在一起组成，以保护躯干的前后左右。镜铠可以穿在其他盔甲上，如锁子甲和布面甲等。这套镜铠由高碳钢制成，样式精巧，微微反光。

messages.plural: sets of hardened steel mirror armor

messages.msgid: Mirror armor earns its name from its distinct shape and polished sheen.  Round and rectangular steel plates are fastened together to protect all four sides of the torso.  It can be worn on top of other armor like chainmail and brigandines.  Made of hardened steel, this set was created with an array of rectangular and circular plates, polished and lightly decorated.  Tough, durable, and made to protect.
translations: 镜铠因其独特的形状和抛光的光泽而得名，由圆形和矩形的钢板固定在一起组成，以保护躯干的前后左右。镜铠可以穿在其他盔甲上，如锁子甲和布面甲等。这套镜铠由一组圆形和方形的高碳钢制成，样式精巧，稍带装饰，微微反光，坚固耐用，堪称一套好甲。

messages.plural: sets of tempered steel mirror armor

messages.msgid: Mirror armor earns its name from its distinct shape and polished sheen.  Round and rectangular steel plates are fastened together to protect all four sides of the torso.  It can be worn on top of other armor like chainmail and brigandines.  Masterfully crafted with tempered steel, this set features a prominent circular plate on the front that has been polished to a mirror-like sheen, flanked with supporting plates intricately joined to fit  the body, all meticulously decorated.  Will protect you from serious harm, as well as the evil gazes of the undead.
translations: 镜铠因其独特的形状和抛光的光泽而得名，由圆形和矩形的钢板固定在一起组成，以保护躯干的前后左右。镜铠可以穿在其他盔甲上，如锁子甲和布面甲等。这套镜铠由回火碳钢精制而成，其正面有一块突出的圆形护板，护板已抛光完毕，闪耀如镜。护板两侧链接精妙贴身，且所有的装饰都是精心设计的。这套铠甲能保护你免受重伤和不死族的恶意。

messages.msgid: A long waist apron made of cotton.
translations: 一件由棉布制成的半腰长围裙。

messages.msgid: It's colored white, like the ones commonly used by chefs, professional or otherwise.
translations: 它是白色的，通常由厨师、专家或其他人使用。

messages.msgid: It's a royal blue color, commonly used by supermarket workers around the world.
translations: 它是藏蓝色的，通常由世界各地的超市工作人员使用。

messages.msgid: It's colored neon pink, commonly used by women or men who like pink.
translations: 它是霓虹粉的，通常由女性或喜欢粉红色的男性使用。

messages.msgid: It has a floral design and colored yellow, perfect for cooking outdoors.
translations: 它是黄色的，带着印花图案，适合户外烹饪。

messages.msgid: It has a camouflage pattern, perfect for chefs who want to hide in the wild.
translations: 它印有迷彩图案，非常适合那些想躲在野外的厨师。

messages.msgid: It's colored black with a skull and roses pattern.  Makes you feel more fashionable just by wearing it.
translations: 它是黑色的，带着骷髅和玫瑰图案。穿上它会让你感觉更时尚。

messages.msgid: It's colored white with black frilly decorations, commonly used with a maid dress or alone for nighttime activities.
translations: 它是白色的，带着黑色褶边装饰，通常与女仆服搭配使用，或在夜间活动时单独穿着。

messages.msgid: It has a jet-black color with dark red decorations, perfect for cosplay or an adventurous gourmet.
translations: 它是深黑的，带着深红色的装饰，非常适合COS玩家或爱猎奇的美食家。

messages.msgid: A short waist apron made of cotton.
translations: 一件由棉布制成的半腰短围裙。
一件由棉布制成的围裙。
一件由皮革制成的围裙。

messages.msgid: An apron made of plastic, provides good protection against accidental chemical splashes.
translations: 一条塑料围裙，能很好地防护飞溅的化学试剂。

messages.msgid: An apron made of Kevlar fabric.
translations: 一件由凯夫拉织物制成的围裙。

messages.msgid: A short black and yellow dress, reminiscent of a bee.  It includes bee wings, a hood, and a pair of antennae.
translations: 一条黑色黄色条纹相间的连衣裙，看着像蜜蜂。它包括蜜蜂的翅膀、一个兜帽和一对触角。
一件羊毛制的专业运动夹克。

messages.msgid: This one is bright blue and styled to cosplay Boston-Chan.
translations: 一件亮蓝色的西装外套，用来cos成“波士顿酱”。

messages.msgid: A light and breezy cheerleader dress.  It's blue and white with the word "Cheers" printed at the top.
translations: 一条轻便而清凉的啦啦队连衣裙。它是蓝色和白色的，胸部印着"加油"的字样。

messages.msgid: A short red cheerleader tank top.  It has the word "Cheers" printed at the top.
translations: 一条红色啦啦队短背心。胸部印着"加油"的字样。

messages.msgid: An oddly balanced long-sleeved shirt with a thin, breathable torso and thicker arms more appropriate for a jacket.  The arms are covered in a camouflage pattern and have two shoulder pockets.  It has a pocket for your pen!
translations: 一种奇怪匀称的长袖衬衫，躯干部分薄而透气，手臂部分更厚，更像是夹克。手臂部分覆盖着迷彩图案，肩部有两个口袋。它还有一个口袋能用来放你的钢笔！

messages.msgid: A luxurious evening gown.  It accentuates your curves, or lack thereof.
translations: 一件奢华的晚礼服。它会凸显你的曲线 — 或者凸显你没有曲线这一点。

messages.msgid: A long sleeved button-down shirt made from denim.
translations: 一件纽扣领的牛仔布长袖衬衫。

messages.msgid: A long sleeved button-down blue shirt made from denim.
translations: 一件蓝色纽扣领的牛仔布长袖衬衫。

messages.msgid: A long sleeved button-down shirt made from denim, dyed black.
translations: 一件染成黑色的纽扣领牛仔布长袖衬衫。

messages.msgid: A long sleeved button-down cowboy wash shirt made from denim.
translations: 一件纽扣领的水洗牛仔布长袖衬衫。

messages.msgid: A button-down shirt with long sleeves.  Looks professional!
translations: 一件纽扣领的长袖衬衫。"穿着像个专业人士！"

messages.msgid: A white button-down shirt with long sleeves and a pocket on the front.  Looks professional!
translations: 一件白色长袖前扣衬衫，胸前有一个口袋。看起来很专业！

messages.msgid: A beautiful white wedding dress.  What good will it be now?
translations: 一件美丽的白色婚纱。现在还适合穿吗？

messages.msgid: A brightly-colored vest designed to keep you upright and floating in water.
translations: 一件有着醒目颜色的，能让你在水上保持垂直漂浮的背心。

messages.msgid: A flotation vest made of inflated animal skins.
translations: 一件用充满气的动物毛皮制造而成的救生衣。

messages.msgid: A short top made from cotton.
A sweatshirt with a hood and a "kangaroo pocket" in the front for storage.
translations: 一件带兜帽的运动衫，正面有一个“袋鼠口袋”用于收纳。

messages.msgid: This one is made to look like a cute shark.
translations: 它被做得看起来像一条可爱的鲨鱼。

messages.msgid: This one is made to look like a cute bear.
translations: 它被做得看起来像一只可爱的熊。

messages.msgid: This one is made to look like a cute cat.
translations: 它被做得看起来像一只可爱的猫猫。

messages.msgid: This one is made to look like a cute bunny.
translations: 这件设计成可爱的兔子造型。

messages.msgid: This one is made to look like a cute wolf.
translations: 这件设计成可爱的狼造型。

messages.msgid: This one is made to look like a cute lizard.
translations: 这件设计成可爱的蜥蜴造型。

messages.msgid: This one is made to look like a cute dog.
translations: 这件设计成可爱的狗狗造型。

messages.msgid: This one is made to look like a cute panda.
translations: 这件设计成可爱的熊猫造型。

messages.msgid: This one is made to look like a cute frog.
translations: 这件被设计成可爱的青蛙造型。

messages.msgid: A sweatshirt with a hood, cropped to expose the stomach.
translations: 一件带有兜帽的卫衣，裁剪露出了腹部。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, breathable shirt made from synthetic fabric, designed for athletic performance and team identification.
translations: 一件轻便透气的人造纤维衬衫，专为运动表现与队伍识别而设计。

messages.msgid: This one is printed with the name and logo of the <sports_team>
translations: 这件衣服印有 <sports_team> 的名称和队徽。

messages.msgid: A skin-tight spandex garment, covering the body from the groin to the shoulders.  With its deep scoop-cut back and high waist cuts, this garment is perfect for showcasing your physique on the stage.
translations: 一件紧身的氨纶连体服，覆盖了从腹股沟到肩膀的身体。它背后的圆低领和底部高腰的剪裁，能够在舞台上完美的展示出你的体型。

messages.msgid: The French maid dress, blue with a frilly white apron.
translations: 法式女仆装，蓝色款，配有带褶边的白色围裙。

messages.msgid: The French maid dress, black with a frilly white apron.  This version is much lighter and shorter than normal.
translations: 一套法式女仆装，主色调为黑色，搭配有一个镶褶边的白色围裙。这件短装比普通款更短也更轻便。

messages.msgid: A short off-white dress printed to look like the tattered wrappings of an ancient mummy.  Very easy to move in, but it doesn't offer any type of protection.
translations: 一套看起来像古代木乃伊的白色破烂短衣。穿着很方便，但它不提供任何防护。

messages.msgid: A short black and red sleeved dress with oriental dragon motifs printed on it.  Perfect for the kunoichi that wants a little more style.
translations: 一条印有东方龙图案的黑色和红色短袖连衣裙。非常适合那些想要更时尚一点的忍者。

messages.msgid: A short black and red dress with oriental dragon motifs printed on it.  Perfect for the kunoichi that wants a little more style.
translations: 一条印有东方龙图案的黑色和红色无袖连衣裙。非常适合那些想要更时尚一点的忍者。

messages.msgid: A short-sleeved cotton shirt, slightly thicker than a t-shirt.
translations: 一件短袖棉衬衫，比 T 恤略厚。

messages.msgid: A light blue button down shirt with a couple of pockets in front and the US postal service logo embroidered on it.
translations: 一件浅蓝色纽扣衬衫，前面有两个口袋，并绣有美国邮政署的标志。

messages.msgid: A tan button-down shirt with long sleeves.
translations: 一件常见于郡县治安官们的棕褐色长袖纽扣衬衫，上面印有当地治安部门的标志。

messages.msgid: A charcoal button-down shirt with long sleeves.  Has a patch with the word "SWAT" affixed on one shoulder.
translations: 一件炭黑色长袖纽扣领衬衫。肩上贴着一块补丁，上面写着"SWAT"。
