messages.msgid: A sleeved red dress with white faux fur trim.  For when you want to be Mrs. Claus on Christmas, or perhaps Santa going clubbing.
translations: 一条装饰着白色人造毛皮的红袖连衣裙。适合圣诞夫人在圣诞夜时穿着，或者圣诞老人去夜总会时穿着。

messages.msgid: A long red dress with full sleeves and white faux fur trim.  A dress for a queen of the north pole.
translations: 一条装饰着白色人造毛皮的红色长袖连衣裙。这是条属于北极女王的裙子。

messages.msgid: A short red dress with white faux fur trim.  Looks like something Mrs. Claus might wear on Christmas night.
translations: 一件装饰着白色人造毛皮的红色短裙。看起来像是圣诞夫人会在圣诞夜穿的衣服。

messages.msgid: A crude and bulky short-sleeved shirt woven from grass.  Definitely not the most comfortable thing to wear.
translations: 一件粗糙而笨重的短袖衬衫，由草编织而成。绝对不是最舒服的衣服。

messages.msgid: A long black and red dress with full sleeves, a collar, and embroidery reminiscent of a vampire duchess.
translations: 一件黑色和红色长袖连衣裙，领子和刺绣图案让人想起吸血鬼公爵夫人。

messages.msgid: A short red dress made in gothic lolita fashion.
translations: 一件哥特洛丽塔风格的红色短连衣裙。

messages.msgid: A red and black gown with full sleeves.  It has a gothic style and looks pretty luxurious.
translations: 一件红黑色长袖礼服。哥特风，看起来很奢华。

messages.msgid: A light and breezy cotton dress.
translations: 一件轻便清凉的棉质吊带裙。
一件十分保暖的羊毛衫。

messages.msgid: A gray work t-shirt with a small front pocket.
translations: 一件灰色的工作T恤，前面还有个小口袋。

messages.msgid: A blue work t-shirt with a small front pocket.
translations: 一件蓝色的工作T恤，前面还有个小口袋。

messages.msgid: A light-blue work t-shirt with a small front pocket.
translations: 一件浅蓝色的工作T恤，前面还有个小口袋。

messages.msgid: A short-sleeved cotton shirt with the logo of a local baseball team printed on its front and back.
translations: 一件棉制的短袖衬衫，正反面都印着当地棒球队的队标。

messages.msgid: A short-sleeved cotton shirt with the logo of a local football team printed on its front and back.
translations: 一件棉制的短袖衬衫，正反面都印着当地橄榄球队的队标。

messages.msgid: This one has a picture on it, <clothing_picture>
translations: 这件衣服上有一个图案，<clothing_picture>

messages.msgid: This one has some text on it, it says "<clothing_text>".
translations: 这件衣服上印有一些文本，上写“<clothing_text>”。

messages.msgid: A t-shirt embroidered with an American flag pattern.
translations: 一件印着星条旗花纹的T恤。

messages.msgid: This one has a joke in the form of <linux_joke>.
translations: 这件衣服上印有一个linux笑话：<linux_joke>。

messages.msgid: This one is merch for a music band and has <music_band_graphic>
translations: 这件衣服是为一个乐队定制的，并印有<music_band_graphic>

messages.msgid: A short-sleeved cotton shirt, cropped to expose the stomach.
translations: 一件短袖棉衬衫，裁剪露出了腹部。

messages.msgid: A shirt with four tassels worn by observant Jews in deference to Deuteronomy 22:12, which commands the wearing of fringes on the corner of one's garments.
translations: 一种有四条流苏的衬衫，虔诚的犹太教徒遵守《申命记》22:12戒律而穿着，该条律要求衣角上要有流苏。

messages.msgid: A traditional Buddhist shirt, covering most of the upper body, but not the arms.
translations: 郁多罗僧是一种传统佛教的上衣，覆盖除了手臂的整个上半身。

messages.msgid: A vest made from thick leather.
translations: 一件厚皮革制成的背心。

messages.msgid: A dress with full sleeves and pointed cuts at the edges.  Perfect for Halloween.
translations: 一件具有长袖和尖形剪裁边缘的连衣裙。非常适合万圣节之夜。

messages.msgid: A long dress with sleeves, typical of a witch.  It includes a pouch for storing potions and other magical items.
translations: 一条女巫常穿的长袖连衣裙。它包括一个用来存放药剂和其他魔法物品的袋子。

messages.msgid: A short dress typically used by witches.
translations: 一条通常由女巫穿着的连衣短裙。

messages.msgid: A hooded wool shirt with a kangaroo pocket in the front.
translations: 一件带有兜帽和前置口袋的卫衣。

messages.msgid: A bunny suit, still shiny despite the time it's likely spent in storage, or worse, on a corpse.  While not resembling a bunny without its accompanying tail and ears, it was a recognizable piece of clothing often found in clubs or in playboy magazines.
translations: 一套兔女郎服装，尽管可能已经存放了一段时间，或者更糟，被那些行尸走肉所穿着，但它依然保持光泽。尽管在没有尾巴和耳朵时看起来并不像一只兔子，但它是一个在俱乐部或《花花公子》杂志中常见的标志性服饰。

messages.msgid: Snug, soft cloth sleeves to keep your arms warm.
translations: 一对舒适合身柔软的布套，可以保持你的手臂温暖。

messages.msgid: A piece of clothing designed to be worn around the belly, called Haramaki in Japan.  This one is made from wool, comfortable and warm.
translations: 一件设计用于围着腰腹部穿着的衣物，在日本被称为腹卷。这件是羊毛做的，舒适而温暖。

messages.msgid: Rags wrapped around the belly.  Usually worn in combination with a chestwrap.  Provides negligible protection against punches to your stomach.
translations: 一根裹在肚子上的布条。通常与裹胸一同穿着。能为你的腹部提供些微不足道的保护。

messages.msgid: Fur pelts wrapped around the belly.  Usually worn in combination with a chestwrap.  Provides negligible protection against punches to your stomach.
translations: 一根裹在肚子上的毛皮。通常与裹胸一同穿着。能为你的腹部提供些微不足道的保护。

messages.msgid: Leather patches wrapped around the belly.  Usually worn in combination with a chestwrap.  Provides weak protection against punches to your stomach.
translations: 一根裹在肚子上的皮革。通常与裹胸一同穿着。能为你的腹部提供些微弱的保护。

messages.msgid: Felt patches wrapped around the belly.  Usually worn in combination with a chestwrap.  Provides negligible protection against punches to your stomach.
translations: 一根裹在肚子上的羊毛条。通常与裹胸一同穿着。能为你的腹部提供些微不足道的保护。
一件简单的毛皮比基尼上衣。
一件皮比基尼胸罩，相比普通比基尼泳装，这款更加耐用但不防水。

messages.msgid: A binder, meant to bind the chest close to the body to keep a persons chest flat.
translations: 一条束胸带，用于束住胸部，让胸部保持平坦。

messages.msgid: This one is painted with the star spangled banner, the red white and blue, old glory, the American flag.
translations: 这条束胸带上画着代表着美国旧日辉煌的红白蓝相间的星条旗。

messages.msgid: This one is black, with white rib bones.
translations: 这条黑色束胸带上画着白色的肋骨。

messages.msgid: This one has a row of mushrooms on it.
translations: 这条束胸带上有一排蘑菇。

messages.msgid: This one has a floral pattern.
translations: 这条束胸带上有花朵的图案。

messages.msgid: This one has a cartoon rendition of a stegosaurus on it.
translations: 这条束胸带上画着一只卡通化的剑龙。

messages.msgid: This one is painted after the trans pride flag.
translations: 这条束胸带上画着跨性别骄傲旗。

messages.msgid: This one is painted after the non-binary pride flag.
translations: 这条束胸带上画着非二元性别骄傲旗。

messages.msgid: This one has an image of a stuffed rat chef, looking up with arms spread to the heavens, with text above reading "I don't want to cook anymore", and the bottom text reading "I want to DIE" all in a comic sans font.
translations: 这条束胸带上有一个毛绒老鼠厨师的形象，他张开双臂仰望天空，他上面的文字写着“我不想再做饭了”，而下面的文字写的是“我想死”。

messages.msgid: The age-old question, boxers or briefs?  Your answer?  Yes.
translations: 老问题：选平角还是三角内裤？你的回答：都行。

messages.msgid: A pair of homemade boxer briefs, a marvel of basic sewing skills.
translations: 一条自制的四角内裤，展现缝纫基本功的杰作。

messages.msgid: A pair of boxer briefs, these are a solid <color> color.
translations: 一条四角内裤，这条是纯<color>的。

messages.msgid: A pair of boxer briefs, adorned with little <color> hearts.
translations: 一条四角内裤，这条装饰着<color>心形图案。

messages.msgid: A pair of boxer briefs.  Printed across the bottom, in bubble letters, is the word "<day>."
translations: 一条四角内裤，这条底部用气泡艺术字母印着“<day>”。

messages.msgid: Men's boxer shorts.  More fashionable than briefs and just as comfortable.
translations: 一件和三角内裤同样舒适但更加流行的男式平角短裤。
印有星条旗的搏击短裤

messages.msgid: This pair has been printed with the pattern of an American flag, with stars and miniature eagles embroidered at strategic positions.
translations: 这条短裤印有美国国旗图案，在重要的地方绣有星星和微缩老鹰。

messages.msgid: A pair of homemade boxer shorts, a marvel of basic sewing skills.
translations: 一条自制的四角短裤，展现缝纫基本功的杰作。

messages.msgid: A pair of boxer shorts, these are a solid <color> color.
translations: 一条四角短裤，这条是纯<color>的。

messages.msgid: A pair of boxer shorts, adorned with little <color> hearts.
translations: 一条四角短裤，这条装饰着<color>心形图案。

messages.msgid: A pair of boxer shorts.  Printed across the bottom, in bubble letters, is the word "<day>."
translations: 一条四角短裤，这条底部用气泡艺术字母印着“<day>”。

messages.msgid: A pair of boxer shorts adorned with images of hundred dollar bills.
translations: 一条四角短裤，这条装饰着百元美金图案。

messages.msgid: A pair of boxer shorts, these are adorned with little <animals> in a pattern across the entire garment.
translations: 一条四角短裤，这条装饰着许多<animals>图案。

messages.msgid: A pair of boxer shorts, merchandise for a famous cartoon.  It features <cartoon_blanket>.
translations: 一条四角短裤，是某部著名动画的周边。上面画着<cartoon_blanket>。

messages.msgid: Female underwear similar to men's boxer shorts, but much more close-fitting.
translations: 一件类似男用版但更弹性、轻薄、贴身的女式平角内裤。
印有星条旗的童装短裤

messages.msgid: A simple bra.  For protecting those bits you don't want zombies to look at.
translations: 一件简单的胸罩。用来遮护那些你不想让丧尸盯着看的部位。

messages.msgid: A pair of briefs.  Comfortable underwear worn by men.
translations: 一条男性普遍穿着的舒适三角内裤。

messages.msgid: A small camisole made from silk.  Typically used as an undergarment, it is light and easy to wear.
translations: 一件丝质吊带小背心。通常作为内衣穿着，轻便舒适，穿着方便。

messages.msgid: Rags wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.
translations: 裹在胸前的布条。能遮掩身体，也能束住胸前以免影响行动，但除此之外用处不大。

messages.msgid: Fur pelts wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.
translations: 裹在胸前的毛皮。能遮掩身体，也能束住胸前以免影响行动，但除此之外用处不大。

messages.msgid: Leather patches wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.
translations: 裹在胸前的皮革片。能遮掩身体，也能束住胸前以免影响行动，但除此之外用处不大。

messages.msgid: Felt patches wrapped around the chest.  Preserves your modesty and keeps things out of the way, but not good for much else.
translations: 裹在胸前的毛毡片。能遮掩身体，也能束住胸前以免影响行动，但除此之外用处不大。

messages.msgid: A snug, black leather corset.  Has no pockets, but its thick material provides good protection from harm.  Use it to loosen it if you want to wear it over normal clothing.
translations: 一件紧身的黑色皮衣，无袖、无口袋，但是非常结实耐用。使用它可以放松些，以便穿着在其他衣物上。

messages.msgid: A somewhat loose black leather corset.  Has no pockets, but its thick material provides good protection from harm.  Use it to wear it tighter and close to the skin.
translations: 一件略为放松的黑色皮衣，无袖、无口袋，但是非常结实耐用。使用它可以裹紧些，以便贴身穿着。

messages.msgid: A snug, black leather waist corset.  Works as a stylish solution for back pain.  Use it to loosen it if you want to wear it over normal clothing.
translations: 一件紧身的黑色束腰，可作为解决背痛的时髦方案。使用它可以放松些，以便穿着在其他衣物上。

messages.msgid: A somewhat loose black leather waist corset.  Works as a stylish solution for back pain.  Use it to wear it tighter and close to the skin.
translations: 一件略为放松的黑色束腰，可作为解决背痛的时髦方案。使用它可以裹紧些，以便贴身穿着。

messages.msgid: You wrap your waist corset tighter.
A simple, decorated undergarment commonly used in combination with stockings.  They don't cover much, but they do help you feel sexy.
translations: 一件简单的装饰内衣，通常与长筒袜配合穿着。它可没有覆盖多少，但确实能让你变得更性感。

messages.msgid: Snug, soft cloth sleeves to keep your legs warm.
translations: 一对舒适合身柔软、可以保持你的腿部温暖布套。

messages.msgid: Snug fur sleeves to keep your legs warm.  Simple yet effective since prehistoric times.
translations: 一对可以为你腿部保暖的舒适皮草套子。始于史前时代，简单有效。

messages.msgid: Snug fur sleeves to keep your fetlocks warm.
translations: 一对可以为你的蹄子保暖的舒适毛皮套筒。

messages.msgid: Large, soft, snug cloth sleeves to keep your exotic anatomy warm.
translations: 宽大、柔软且贴合的布制护套，即便你的肢体已经发生变异也可以保暖。

messages.msgid: A pair of long underwear that help to maintain body temperature.
translations: 一条长的、用来保持体温的贴身内衣长裤。

messages.msgid: A long underwear top that helps to maintain body temperature.
translations: 一条长的、用来保持体温的贴身内衣上衣。

messages.msgid: A sleeveless underwear top that helps to maintain body temperature.
translations: 一件无袖保暖衬衣，可以用来维持体温。

messages.msgid: Underwear designed to be worn by women.  Preserves your modesty in desperate times.
translations: 一件为女士设计的贴身内裤。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, form-fitting long-sleeved spandex undershirt that helps maintains body temperature.
translations: 一件轻便而合身的长袖氨纶底衫，有助于保持体温。

messages.msgid: A sturdy nylon bra to provide additional support during physical movement.  Typically worn when exercising, it clings to the skin and is easy to wear.
translations: 结实的尼龙胸罩，运动型。通常在锻炼时穿着，贴合肌肤而且穿着简单。

messages.msgid: A sleeveless cotton shirt.  Very easy to move in.
translations: 一件无袖棉衬衫。穿着很方便。

messages.msgid: A sleeveless cotton shirt with a camouflage pattern.  Very easy to move in.
translations: 一件无袖迷彩棉制背心，多为士兵夏季训练时所穿。穿着很方便。

messages.msgid: A red cheerleader tank top.  It has the word "Cheers" printed at the top.
translations: 一条红色啦啦队背心。胸部印着"加油"的字样。

messages.msgid: A snug cloth garment which clings tightly to the legs and feet to protect them from the cold.
translations: 一件贴身的布质衣物，紧贴腿部和脚部，用于抵御寒冷。

messages.msgid: These are adorned with dozens of <color> polka dots.
translations: 这条紧身裤上面装饰着许多<color>圆点。

messages.msgid: A pair of snug cotton tights, featuring a classic <animal_print> pattern.
translations: 一条贴身的紧身裤，上面装饰着经典的<animal_print>图案。

messages.msgid: A pair of cotton tights, these are a solid <color> color.
translations: 一条贴身的紧身裤，这条是纯<color>的。

messages.msgid: Nylon sportswear that clings to your chest and wicks away sweat.
translations: 紧贴胸部的尼龙运动服，能快速吸汗排湿。

messages.msgid: Nylon sportswear that clings to your upper legs, aiding muscle tone and wicking away sweat.
translations: 贴合大腿的尼龙运动服，有助于展现肌肉线条并有效吸汗排湿。

messages.msgid: A simple white undershirt.  Worn beneath your regular clothes, it provides a little extra warmth.
translations: 一件简单的白色汗衫。穿在其他衣物下，能够起到一点点保暖作用。

messages.msgid: A skin-tight spandex garment resembling a crew-necked leotard combined with leggings.  Commonly used by gymnasts, dancers and equestrian vaulters, the unitard provides overall coverage with great flexibility.
translations: 一件紧身的氨纶全身服，看上去像是由水手领的紧身连衣裤和长裤合体而成。通常由体操运动员，舞者和马戏演员穿着，全身紧身衣提供全面覆盖而又不影响灵活性。

messages.msgid: A reinforced but airy jumpsuit designed to survive the long-term wear and tear of exploring the apocalyptic wasteland.  Rather than advanced polymer fabrics which may not be available in many worlds, it is made of breathable twill fabric with leather reinforcements ensuring it can be produced easily regardless of technology level.  Its clever construction adds additional core support, helping you to carry more equipment.
translations: 一件坚固但透气的连身衣，能够经受探索世界末日的荒原时磨损的洗礼。它并不是许多世界上可能没有的先进聚合物织物制成的，而是由透气的牛仔布和皮革制成，无论技术水平如何，都能轻松生产。其巧妙的结构增加了额外的核心支撑，帮助你携带更多设备。

messages.msgid: A reinforced but airy jumpsuit designed to survive the long-term wear and tear of exploring the apocalyptic wasteland.  Rather than advanced polymer fabrics which may not be available in many worlds, it is made of breathable twill fabric with leather reinforcements ensuring it can be produced easily regardless of technology level.  Its clever construction adds additional core support, helping you to carry more equipment.  A set of cooling tubes run throughout the clothing as well.
translations: 一件坚固但透气的连身衣，能够经受探索世界末日的荒原时磨损的洗礼。它并不是许多世界上可能没有的先进聚合物织物制成的，而是由透气的牛仔布和皮革制成，无论技术水平如何，都能轻松生产。其巧妙的结构增加了额外的核心支撑，帮助你携带更多设备。还有一套冷却管贯穿了整件衣服。

messages.msgid: A reinforced but airy jumpsuit designed to survive the long-term wear and tear of exploring the apocalyptic wasteland.  Rather than advanced polymer fabrics which may not be available in many worlds, it is made of breathable twill fabric with leather reinforcements ensuring it can be produced easily regardless of technology level.  Its clever construction adds additional core support, helping you to carry more equipment.  The internal cooling tubes are active and humming.
translations: 一件坚固但透气的连身衣，能够经受探索世界末日的荒原时磨损的洗礼。它并不是许多世界上可能没有的先进聚合物织物制成的，而是由透气的牛仔布和皮革制成，无论技术水平如何，都能轻松生产。其巧妙的结构增加了额外的核心支撑，帮助你携带更多设备。内置的冷却管处于活动状态并发出嗡嗡声。

messages.msgid: A light, airy jumpsuit designed to survive the long-term wear and tear of exploring the apocalyptic wasteland.  Rather than advanced polymer fabrics which may not be available in many worlds, it is made of breathable twill fabric with leather reinforcements ensuring it can be produced easily regardless of technology level.  Its clever construction adds additional core support, helping you to carry more equipment.
translations: 一件轻而透气的连身衣，能够经受探索世界末日的荒原时磨损的洗礼。它并不是许多世界上可能没有的先进聚合物织物制成的，而是由透气的牛仔布和皮革制成，无论技术水平如何，都能轻松生产。其巧妙的结构增加了额外的核心支撑，帮助你携带更多设备。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, hand-built combination armor made of Kevlar with a moisture-wicking core and additional padding in many places.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件轻便的自制复合护甲，由凯夫拉纤维制成，核心是件能够吸湿的连身衣，在许多地方打上了补丁。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A hand-built combination armor made of thick Kevlar with a moisture-wicking core and substantial padding in many places.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件自制复合护甲，由多层凯夫拉制成，核心是件能够吸湿的连身衣，在许多地方打上了补丁。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A hand-built combination armor made of thick Kevlar with a moisture-wicking core and thin steel plating in many places.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件自制复合护甲，由多层凯夫拉制成，核心是件能够吸湿的连身衣，在许多地方安上了钢甲。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A warm and heavy hand-built combination armor made from a moisture-wicking core padded with layers of Kevlar and fur.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件温暖且厚重的自制复合护甲，核心是件能够吸湿的连身衣，填充了毛皮和多层凯夫拉。可以提供环境和伤害防护。
人造毛皮凯夫拉连身衣

messages.msgid: A warm and heavy hand-built combination armor made from a moisture-wicking core padded with layers of Kevlar and faux fur.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件温暖且厚重的自制复合护甲，核心是件能够吸湿的连身衣，填充了人造毛皮和多层凯夫拉。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A hand-built combination armor made from a wetsuit padded with layers of Kevlar.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件自制复合护甲，由填充了多层凯夫拉的潜水服制成。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A hand-built light combination armor made from an expanded and lightened wetsuit padded with layers of Kevlar.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 手工制造的轻型组合盔甲，由膨化和轻量化的潜水衣与多层凯夫拉纤维填充而成。 既能抵御风雨，又能防止受伤。

messages.msgid: A hand-built combination armor made from a thick wetsuit padded with layers of Kevlar.  While uncomfortably warm and hard to move in it provides substantial protection from harm and from the elements.
translations: 一件手工制作的组合式护甲，由厚厚的潜水服和多层凯夫拉纤维填充而成。虽然可能暖和到不舒服，而且穿着时难以移动，但它对伤害和环境因素提供了有效防护。

messages.msgid: A heavy, hand-built combination armor made from flame-resistant Nomex padded with layers of Kevlar.  Protects from fire as well as from harm.
translations: 一件重型自制复合护甲，由填充了多层凯夫拉的防火服制成。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A pair of custom-made Kevlar-armored boots with a chemical-resistant layer and rubber toes.  Will keep you highly mobile without the worry of zombie acid dissolving your feet.
translations: 一双定制的凯夫拉靴子，带有耐化学物质层和橡胶鞋尖。让你可以在不用担心丧尸酸液会溶解你的脚的情况下快速移动。

messages.msgid: A pair of custom-made boots constructed of thick Kevlar and a chemical resistant layer, featuring steel toes for extra protection.  Keeps your feet safe from the myriad dangers of the apocalypse.
translations: 一双由厚凯夫拉和耐化学层制成的定制靴子，鞋尖使用了钢来提供额外的保护。保护你的脚免受世界末日的无数危险。

messages.msgid: pair of faux fur winter survivor boots
translations: 幸存者人造毛皮长靴（防寒）
messages.plural: pairs of faux fur winter survivor boots

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored boots with a chemical-resistant layer and steel toes.  Warm thanks to the faux-fur lining, and quite protective due to the thick materials, though perhaps a little hard to move in.
translations: 一双定制的凯夫拉靴子，具有耐化学物质层和钢制鞋尖。它的人造毛皮保暖里衬，材料厚，保护性强，尽管可能让人有点难以移动。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored boots with a chemical-resistant layer and steel toes.  Warm thanks to the real fur lining, and quite protective due to the thick materials, though perhaps a little hard to move in.
translations: 一双定制的凯夫拉靴子，具有耐化学物质层和钢制鞋尖。它的真皮保暖里衬，材料厚，保护性强，尽管可能让人有点难以移动。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored neoprene boots.  These will keep you dry and alive, come hell or high water.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉-氯丁橡胶长靴，能有效保护你身体干爽，即使身陷汪洋之中。

messages.msgid: mounting for a pair of custom fins.
pair of light Kevlar diving overboots
messages.plural: pairs of light Kevlar diving overboots

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored light neoprene boots.  These will keep you dry and alive, come hell or high water.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉-氯丁橡胶轻质长靴，能有效保护你身体干爽，即使身陷汪洋之中。

messages.msgid: pair of thick Kevlar diving boots
messages.plural: pairs of thick Kevlar diving boots

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored thick neoprene boots.  These will keep you dry and alive, come hell or high water.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉-氯丁橡胶加厚长靴，能有效保护你身体干爽，即使身陷汪洋之中。

messages.msgid: A pair of rubber flippers worn on the feet, which improve swimming speed while greatly impeding the wearer's ability to walk.  This pair was reduced in volume and weight and has to be attached to diving boots with necessary attachment points.
translations: 一双穿在脚上的橡胶脚蹼，可以提高游泳速度，但会大大阻碍穿着者的行走能力。这对定制脚蹼经过优化，大小和重量都有所减轻，必须通过特定的连接点与潜水靴相连。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored cloth gloves.  These are designed for comfort first.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉强化布手套。侧重于舒适度。

messages.msgid: pair of fingerless light survivor gloves
messages.plural: pairs of fingerless light survivor gloves

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored cloth gloves without fingers.  These are designed for comfort first.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉强化无指布手套。侧重于舒适度。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored leather gloves without fingers.  These strike a balance between comfort and protection.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉强化无指皮革手套。同时注重舒适度与防护性能。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored leather gloves.  These strike a balance between comfort and protection.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉强化皮革手套。同时注重舒适度与防护性能。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored gloves.  These are lined with real fur.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉强化手套。内部有毛皮内衬。

messages.msgid: pair of faux fur winter survivor gloves
translations: 幸存者人造毛皮手套（防寒）
messages.plural: pairs of faux fur winter survivor gloves

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored gloves.  These are lined with faux-fur.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉强化手套。内部有人造毛皮内衬。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored neoprene gloves, modified to be easy to wear while providing maximum protection under extreme conditions.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉-氯丁橡胶复合手套，更易于穿戴，即使在极端情况下也能提供最大防护。

messages.msgid: pair of light Kevlar wetsuit overgloves
messages.plural: pairs of light Kevlar wetsuit overgloves

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored light neoprene gloves, modified to be easy to wear while providing significant protection under extreme conditions.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉-氯丁橡胶轻质复合手套，更易于穿戴，即使在极端情况下也能提供可观的防护。

messages.msgid: pair of thick Kevlar wetsuit gloves
messages.plural: pairs of thick Kevlar wetsuit gloves

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored neoprene gloves, modified to provide maximum protection under extreme conditions.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉-氯丁橡胶复合手套，经过改造以在极端情况下提供最大防护。

messages.msgid: A denim cowl with additional leather padding stitched onto the head with integrated protection from a plastic visor, sun brim, and filter cartridge intake, designed for long travels.  The design includes some clever shaping that allows it to offer a lot of coverage without interfering too much with vision and breathing.
translations: 一顶牛仔布头罩，头部缝有额外的皮革衬垫，配有塑料面罩、遮阳帽檐以及滤芯进气口，专为长途旅行设计。其设计之巧妙，既能在提供大量的防护的同时，还不太干扰视线和妨碍呼吸。

messages.msgid: A customized armored leather and Kevlar hood, designed to balance comfort and protection.
translations: 一件自制的凯夫拉-皮革兜帽，同时注重舒适度与防护性能。

messages.msgid: A customized armored Kevlar hood.  Warm thanks to the real fur lining.
translations: 一件自制的凯夫拉-布兜帽。内部有保暖用的毛皮内衬。

messages.msgid: A customized armored cloth and Kevlar hood, light yet durable.
translations: 一件自制的凯夫拉-布兜帽，轻巧又耐用。
幸存者人造毛皮兜帽（防寒）

messages.msgid: A customized armored Kevlar hood.  Warm thanks to the faux-fur lining.
translations: 一件自制的凯夫拉-布兜帽。内部有保暖用的人造毛皮内衬。

messages.msgid: A customized armored neoprene and Kevlar hood, very strong and durable.
translations: 一件自制的凯夫拉-氯丁橡胶复合兜帽，非常结实、耐用。

messages.msgid: A customized light armored neoprene and Kevlar overhood, very strong and durable.
translations: 一件自制的凯夫拉-氯丁橡胶复合轻质兜帽，非常结实、耐用。

messages.msgid: A customized thick armored neoprene and Kevlar hood, very strong and durable.
translations: 一件自制的凯夫拉-氯丁橡胶复合加厚兜帽，非常结实、耐用。

messages.msgid: A sturdy canvas hat and cowl extending down to the neck, fitted with a shade brim, plastic eye visor and integrated filter cartridge intake built into the mouth section.  Provides smoke protection, and is cleverly designed to be relatively unencumbering and protective.
translations: 由一顶坚固的帆布帽和覆盖至颈部的头罩组成，配有遮阳檐、塑料护目镜和位于口部的集成滤芯进气口。它能提供烟雾防护，其设计之巧妙，能在提供保护的同时又相对不太累赘。

messages.msgid: Lightweight, Kevlar armored cargo pants designed to hold as much as possible.  Strong and mostly waterproof.
translations: 一件轻巧的工作裤，使用了凯夫拉装甲加以补强。可以容纳大量物品，耐用且有一定防水能力。

messages.msgid: A pair of Kevlar armored pants covered with pouches and pockets.  Custom-built to be durable, comfortable, and easy to wear.
translations: 一件镶嵌有凯夫拉片的长裤，有许多的口袋，非常舒适、耐用、易于穿戴。

messages.msgid: A sturdy pair of pants fit for a soldier of fortune.  Made from work pants padded with Kevlar panels.  It gives good protection and decent storage, but the added thickness makes it uncomfortable to wear any armor over it.
translations: 一条为雇佣兵量身定制的结实裤子。由工装长裤填充了凯夫拉片制成。它提供不错的防护，也提供一定的存储空间，但增加的厚度使得再穿上任何其他盔甲都不舒服。

messages.msgid: A Kevlar armored custom full-length duster, covered with pouches and pockets.  Comfortable, durable, and great for storage.
translations: 一件凯夫拉强化的自制全身长防尘风衣，有许多的口袋，舒适、耐用，提供比较可观的存储空间。

messages.msgid: A custom Kevlar armored full-length duster without sleeves, covered with pouches and pockets.  Comfortable, durable, and great for storage.
translations: 一件凯夫拉强化的自制全身长无袖防尘风衣，上面布满了各种大小口袋。舒适、耐用，还很能装。

messages.msgid: A sturdy coat fit for a soldier of fortune.  Made from a ballistic vest combined with a military jacket reinforced with soft armor panels.  Has pockets for armor inserts and MOLLE webbing to attach accessories.
translations: 一件为雇佣兵量身定制的结实大衣。由一件防弹背心和一件用软甲片加固过的军装夹克制成。有个用来插入防弹板的口袋和用于安装附件的MOLLE织带。

messages.msgid: A Kevlar armored custom trenchcoat, covered with pouches and pockets.  Comfortable, durable, and great for storage.
translations: 一件有镶嵌了凯夫拉片的自制风衣，有许多的口袋，舒适、耐用，可以装很多东西。

messages.msgid: A custom Kevlar armored trenchcoat without sleeves, covered with pouches and pockets.  Comfortable, durable, and great for storage.
translations: 一件有镶嵌了凯夫拉片的自制无袖风衣，有许多的口袋，舒适、耐用，可以装很多东西。

messages.msgid: A custom-built heavy duffel bag.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.
translations: 量身打造的沉重的编织袋，额外缝了很多口袋上去。值得信赖的手工技术将它打造得至为舒适耐用。

messages.msgid: A modified large watertight duffel bag.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.  Capable of floating.  Provides plenty of storage, but is severely encumbering.
translations: 经过改造的大号筒状防水行李袋。精心制作所以耐用且能装很多东西。能浮在水面上。提供大量的存储空间，但特别的累赘。

messages.msgid: A custom-built backpack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.
translations: 一件自制的背包，经久耐用并且被经过精心制造，使得它能够装下尽可能多的物品。

messages.msgid: A custom-built heavy backpack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.
translations: 一件自制的重型背包，经久耐用并且被经过精心制造，使得它能够装下尽可能多的物品。

messages.msgid: A custom-built lightweight runner pack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.
translations: 一个自制的轻便的慢跑背包。经久耐用，细心的做工使得它能够装下尽可能多的物品。

messages.msgid: A modified lightweight watertight backpack.  Durable and carefully crafted to hold as much stuff as possible.
translations: 经过改造的轻便防水背包。精心制造所以经久耐用，能装下许多东西。

messages.msgid: A custom-built lightweight set of weight distributing pouches on the thighs and stomach.  This configuration is designed to be worn with a military harness or tactical vest.
translations: 一套自制的轻便配重口袋，穿在大腿和腹部上。设计用于搭配军用背带或战术背心穿着。

messages.msgid: A custom-built lightweight set of weight distributing pouches over your entire body.  Its cunningly placed and stabilized pockets can store a remarkable amount of useful stuff without getting in the way or sacrificing balance.  Has a flashlight mounted on the shoulder and an internal reservoir for water purification in the field, both exclusively powered by your internal bionic energy.
translations: 一套自制的轻便的重量分配装置，许多口袋覆盖全身。其巧妙放置且固定的口袋可以储存大量有用的东西，而不会显得累赘或是牺牲平衡。肩上安装了一个由身体供电的手电筒，还有一个用于野外储存净水的集成蓄水袋。两者都完全由你的生化插件能量供能。

messages.msgid: You turn the shoulder mounted flashlight on.
translations: 你打开了肩部的手电筒。

messages.msgid: You turn the shoulder mounted flashlight off.
translations: 你关闭了肩部的手电筒。

messages.msgid: A simple, thin, skintight layer of breathable fabric that protects your skin.  It has integrated feet and precisely placed rubberized pads to protect critical points from impact and abrasion.
translations: 一套十分简单但薄而透气的贴身面料制成的紧身衣，保护你的皮肤。它内置脚套和精确放置的橡胶垫，以保护要害免受伤害和电击。

messages.msgid: A simple, thin, skintight layer of breathable fabric that protects your skin.  It has integrated feet and precisely placed rubberized pads to protect critical points from impact and abrasion, and has been reinforced with a loose mesh of advanced polymer threads.
translations: 一套十分简单但薄而透气的贴身面料制成的紧身衣，保护你的皮肤。它内置脚套和精确放置的橡胶垫，以保护要害免受伤害和电击，并且用一层松散的高级聚合物纤维网加固过了。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored Nomex boots.  These will keep you alive, even when knee-deep in the flames.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉-芳纶长靴，能有效保护你，即使身陷火海之中。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized Kevlar boots that are heavily armored with steel.  Favoring protection over comfort, these will keep you alive, especially when knee-deep in the dead.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉-钢片强化型长靴，偏重防护性能而非舒适度，能提供最大的伤害防护，即使身陷死人堆之中。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, steel-backed Kevlar gloves.  These are designed for protection first.
translations: 一双自制的凯夫拉-钢片强化手套。为双手提供最大的伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A pair of customized, Kevlar-armored Nomex gloves.  These are a post-apocalyptic extension of what firefighters wore pre-Cataclysm.
translations: 一双自制的的凯夫拉强化芳纶纤维防火手套，是大灾变前消防员所穿装备在世界末日后的改造品。

messages.msgid: A customized armored Nomex and Kevlar hood, strong and durable.
translations: 一件自制的凯夫拉-芳纶纤维防火兜帽，结实又耐用。

messages.msgid: Heavy, hand-built combination armor made from a cut-down bulletproof vest and a reinforced flame-resistant Nomex jumpsuit.  Protects the wearer from fire and the elements.
translations: 沉重的自制复合护甲，由裁剪过的防弹背心和强化防火芳纶连身衣组合而成，可以提供火焰和环境防护。

messages.msgid: A heavy, hand-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and a metal-plated leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件沉重的自制复合护甲，由强化防弹背心和加了金属板的皮革连身衣制成。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: Custom-made armor that combines a level II vest with a combat shirt and adds extra padding to the arms for safety.  Fairly lightweight and ergonomic and has numerous pockets for storage.
translations: 一套自制护甲，将2级护甲结合在作战T恤内，额外加了一块来防护手臂。设计符合人体工程学，比较轻便，还有几个装东西的小口袋。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, hand-built combination armor made from a cut-down bulletproof vest and a reinforced fabric jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件轻便的自制复合护甲，由裁剪过的防弹背心和强化织物连身衣制成。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A hand-built combination armor made from a bulletproof vest and a reinforced leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件自制复合护甲，由防弹背心和强化皮革连身衣制成。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A massive hand-built combination armor made from a bulletproof vest and a reinforced leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件大号的自制复合护甲，由防弹背心和强化皮革连身衣制成。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A warm and heavy hand-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and an insulated leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件保暖、沉重的自制复合护甲，由强化防弹背心和隔热皮革连身衣制成。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A warm and heavy hand-built combination armor made from a reinforced bulletproof vest and a faux fur insulated leather jumpsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件保暖、沉重的自制复合护甲，由强化防弹背心和人造毛皮隔热皮革连身衣制成。可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, hand-built combination armor made from a cut-down bulletproof vest and a reinforced neoprene wetsuit.  Protects from the elements as well as from harm.
translations: 一件自制的轻型复合防护服，由防弹背心和强化橡胶潜水服组合而成，可以提供环境和伤害防护。

messages.msgid: A custom-built leather belt covered with pouches, with a sheath to carry a smaller blade, a holster to carry a pistol and a loop for holding larger tools.  Durable and carefully crafted to be comfortable to wear.  Activate to sheathe/draw a weapon.
translations: 一条自制的皮带，上边有满满的皮带和口袋，同时集成着一个小型刀鞘、一个手枪枪套和一个工具挂钩。精细的做工让它又耐用穿起来又舒服。使用来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: A custom-built pair of armored goggles with tinted lenses.  Comfortable and built to last, they provide excellent protection from environmental dangers.
translations: 一个自制的带深色镜片的强化眼镜。舒适且耐用，保护你不会受到环境伤害的影响。

messages.msgid: A custom-built light harness covered with pouches and including an integral tactical sling for a small rifle or other such weapon.  Durable and carefully crafted to be comfortable to wear.  Activate to holster/draw your weapon.
translations: 一个自制的轻型背带，缝了不少口袋的同时还有一个集成战术吊索用于小型步枪及此类武器。值得信赖的手工技术将它打造得至为舒适耐用。激活它来收拔武器。

messages.msgid: The Museum of All Things Awesome and That Go Boom
translations: 顶呱呱的能轰轰的百科博物馆
messages.plural: copies of The Museum of All Things Awesome and That Go Boom

messages.msgid: The Museum of All Things Awesome and That Go Boom is an anthology of science fiction featuring blunt force trauma, explosions, adventure, derring-do, tigers, Martians, zombies, fanged monsters, dinosaurs (alien and domestic), ray guns, rocket ships, and anthropomorphized marshmallows.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.
translations: 《顶呱呱的能轰轰的百科博物馆》是一本科幻小说选集，包含了钝器创伤，爆炸，冒险，英勇行为，老虎，火星人，丧尸，尖牙怪物，恐龙（外星和家养），激光枪，火箭船，和人型棉花糖。本书由上层胶靴书社出版。

messages.msgid: Sunvault is the first English-language anthology to broadly collect solarpunk short fiction, artwork, and poetry.  A new genre for the 21st Century, solarpunk is a revolution against despair.  Focusing on solutions to environmental disasters, solarpunk envisions a future of green, sustainable energy used by societies that value inclusiveness, cooperation, and personal freedom.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.
translations: 《太阳金库》是第一本广泛收集涉及太阳能朋克的小说、插画和诗歌的全英文选集。作为21世纪新出现的一种流派，太阳能朋克是一场反对绝望的革命。以解决环境灾难为中心，太阳能朋克设想了一个绿色、可持续能源被重视包容、合作和个人自由的社会所广泛使用的未来。本书由上层胶靴书社出版。

messages.msgid: Sharp & Sugar Tooth: Women Up To No Good is a horror anthology of dark fiction and darker appetites, edited by Octavia Cade.  Containing 22 stories of "bad" women, and "good" women who just haven't been caught yet, it features 22 fearless writers who identify as female, non-binary, or a marginalized sex or gender identity.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.
translations: 《利嘴糖牙：不怀好意的女人》是由奥克塔维亚·凯德为主编的一部恐怖小说选集，集黑暗小说和黑暗欲望于一身。全书包含了22个关于"坏"女人和"好"女人的故事，而"好"女人不过是还没有被抓到把柄而已，全书共有22名不畏世俗的作家，他们的身份认同或为女性、或是非二元性别、或是边缘化的性别及性别认同。本书由上层胶靴书社出版。

messages.msgid: Broad Knowledge: 35 Women Up To No Good is a feminist anthology of dark fiction and darker knowledge, edited by Joanne Merriam.  Containing 35 stories of "bad" women, and "good" women who just haven't been caught yet.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.
translations: 《学识广博：35个不怀好意的女人》是由乔安妮·梅里亚姆为主编的一部女性向的黑暗小说和黑暗故事集。全书包含了35个关于"坏"女人和"好"女人的故事，而"好"女人不过是还没有被抓到把柄而已。本书由上层胶靴书社出版。

messages.msgid: Choose Wisely: 35 Women Up To No Good is a feminist anthology of dark fiction, co-edited by H. L. Nelson and Joanne Merriam.  Containing 35 stories of "bad" women, and "good" women who just haven't been caught yet, it features Joyce Carol Oates, Aimee Bender, Diane Cook, and 33 other fearless women writers.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.
translations: 《明智之选：35个不怀好意的女人》是由H·L·尼尔森和乔安妮·梅里亚姆共同主编的一部女性向的黑暗小说集。全书包含了35个关于"坏"女人和"好"女人的故事，而"好"女人不过是还没有被抓到把柄而已。全书收集了包括乔伊斯·卡罗尔·奥茨、艾美·本德、黛安·库克和其他33位不畏世俗的女作家的作品。本书由上层胶靴书社出版。

messages.msgid: Every society and every generation has its version of the apocalypse: swine flu, genetic mutation, global warming, nuclear fallout, the second coming, peak oil, mass extinction, giant irradiated ants, zombies… Apocalypse Now: Poems and Prose from the End of Days is the first anthology of its kind to bring together the poetry and prose of some of America's finest (though not always most well-known) literary voices with an eye for the literary and the popular, for story and lyric, for the past and the future, for the psychological and the physical, for the real and the fantastic.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.
translations: 每一个社会和每一代人都有自己版本的世界末日：猪流感，基因突变，全球变暖，核辐射，二次降临，石油峰值，大灭绝，巨型辐射蚂蚁，丧尸……《现代启示录：末日诗歌散文》是此类别中的第一部选集，汇集了美国一些最优秀（虽然并不总是最知名）的文学作家的诗歌和散文，着眼于文学与大众，着眼于故事与抒情，着眼于过去和未来，着眼于心理和生理，着眼于真实和奇幻。本书由上层胶靴书社出版。

messages.msgid: How to Live on Other Planets: A Handbook for Aspiring Aliens
messages.plural: copies of How to Live on Other Planets

messages.msgid: How to Live on Other Planets: A Handbook for Aspiring Aliens explores the immigrant experience in a science fiction setting, with exciting fiction and poetry from some of the genre's best writers.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.
translations: 《如何在异星生存：一本供有抱负外星人的手册》探索了科幻小说背景下的异星殖民经历，其中有一些来自本类型的最佳作家的精彩小说和诗歌。本书由上层胶靴书社出版。

messages.msgid: The Poetic Edda is a collection of Old Norse narrative poems in alliterative verse recounting some of the stories of Norse mythology.
translations: 《诗体埃达》是一本古挪威叙事诗的合集，用头韵诗讲述了一些挪威神话故事。

messages.plural: copies of Lessons for the Novice Bowhunter

messages.msgid: This hefty paperback book contains all the information needed for novice archers to get started hunting with a variety of bows and crossbows.
translations: 这本厚重的平装书包含了新手利用各种弓弩进行狩猎所需要掌握的一切信息。

messages.msgid: A book that highlights archery techniques from the point of view of the relationship between the anatomy of the human body and the anatomy of the bow.
translations: 一本从人体解剖学和弓的解剖学之间的关系着重介绍射箭技术的书。

messages.msgid: Way of Archery: A 1637 Chinese Military Training Manual
translations: 射箭之道：1637年的中国军队训练手册
messages.plural: copies of Way of Archery: A 1637 Chinese Military Training Manual

messages.msgid: The Way of Archery provides a detailed introduction to practicing archery in the traditional Chinese military style.  It explains the basics of how to shoot using the Asian thumb ring, proper posture, training regimen, equipment, and avoiding pitfalls in shooting.
translations: 《射箭之道》详细介绍了中国传统军事射箭的练习方法。 它解释了如何使用亚洲拇指环进行射击的正确姿势、训练方案、设备以及避免射击陷阱的基础知识。

messages.msgid: Zen and the Art of Archery
messages.plural: copies of Zen and the Art of Archery

messages.msgid: This massive book contains a wealth of vital information for the novice archer.
translations: 这本厚重的书包含了大量对于弓箭初学者来说至关重要的信息。

messages.plural: copies of Beginner's Guide to Traditional Archery

messages.msgid: An easy-to-understand instruction manual for traditional archery.  Covers both target shooting and bow hunting.
translations: 传统射箭的简单易懂的说明， 涵盖目标射击和弓箭狩猎。

messages.msgid: The Theory And Practice Of Archery
messages.plural: copies of The Theory And Practice Of Archery

messages.msgid: Authored by Horace Ford, the champion archer of England for the years 1850 to 1859 and 1867, and known as one of the greatest archers of all time, this book holds all of his experience in archery, which is still relevant by modern standards.
translations: 霍勒斯·福特是 1850 年至 1859 年和 1867 年的英格兰冠军弓箭手，被誉为有史以来最伟大的弓箭手之一，这本书包含了他在射箭方面的所有经验，对于现代标准来说，仍然很高。

messages.msgid: Will you be able to place the arrow right into the bullseye?  It is not that easy, but once you know how it's done, you will have a lot of fun with archery.
translations: 你能把箭射入靶心么？听起来不那么容易，不过一旦你掌握了要领，你会对弓箭欲罢不能。

messages.msgid: "Become a more consistent and accurate archer!", The Archery Drill Book covers all aspects of the sport, with 130 of the best drills for developing superior technique, skill, physical stamina, and the focused mindset needed to shoot under pressure.
translations: "成为一名更稳定和准确的射手！"，弓术训练手册涵盖了这项运动的各个方面，提供了130个最佳的训练方法，帮助你培养出色的技术、技能、耐力和在压力下射击所需的专注心态。

messages.plural: copies of Archery from A to Z

messages.msgid: A beginner's guide to the equipment and shooting fundamentals that new shooters of all ages will benefit from.
translations: 所有年龄段的新射手都将从中受益的设备和射击基础初学者指南。

messages.msgid: "Anecdotes of Archery - From the Earliest Ages to the Year 1791" - This vintage book contains a comprehensive guide to archery, with historical details, information on archery in different cultures throughout the ages, anecdotes of notable events and battles, a glossary of archery terms, and much more.
translations: "射箭轶事——从最早的时代到 1791 年"，这本古老的书包含射箭的综合指南，包括历史细节，不同国家射箭的信息、各个时代的文化、著名事件和战斗的轶事、射箭术语表等等。

messages.msgid: Normally this glossy, ad-filled magazine about cars would be pointless, but it has a series of articles on haggling techniques.
translations: 一本充满广告的毫无意义的杂志，但是里边竟然蕴藏了讨价还价的技巧。

messages.plural: copies of How to Succeed in Business

messages.msgid: Useful if you want to get a good deal when purchasing goods.
translations: 一本实用的经商类书本，可以提高你的交易能力。

messages.msgid: How To Day Trade For A Living
messages.plural: copies of How To Day Trade For A Living

messages.msgid: The fundamentals of day trading, and how it differs from other styles of trading and investment, with elaboration on important trading strategies that many traders use every day.
translations: 日间交易的基本概念，以及它与其他交易和投资风格的区别。详细阐述了许多交易员每天都在使用的交易策略。

messages.plural: copies of Trading Psychology For Dummies

messages.msgid: A guide to help you develop a mindset to trade on a rapidly changing stock market.  Not very useful in current moment, when the main stock you have is a stock of ammo, or maybe just soup.
translations: 一本指南，帮助你建立在瞬息万变的股市交易的思维模式。现在并不十分有用，当你的主要资产是一大批子弹，或者可能只是一些浓汤的时候。
一本关于经济学的大学课本。

messages.plural: copies of Peer to Peer Bartering

messages.msgid: In this work, David Cabanillas adopts bartering incentive pattern as an attractive foundation in the age of the internet for a simple and robust form of exchange to reallocate resources.
translations: 在这项工作中，大卫·卡瓦尼利亚斯采用易货激励模式作为互联网时代的一个有吸引力的基础，以一种简单而强大的交换形式来重新分配资源。

messages.msgid: Comprehensive coverage of most major stock trading styles.
translations: 几乎涵盖了大多数主要的股市交易风格。

messages.msgid: A baseball magazine that focuses on batting tips.  There are lots of colorful, full-page photos of skilled athletes demonstrating proper form and technique.
translations: 一本棒球杂志，附带一些击球技巧和丰富的演示照片，可以提高你对武器的熟练度。

messages.msgid: Bludgeons and Broken Bones: A Reference Guide
messages.plural: copies of Bludgeons and Broken Bones: A Reference Guide

messages.msgid: Written with hard prison slang, this book says a lot about how to use maximum power from your muscles and weight of your weapon.
translations: 这本书使用了很多监狱俚语，讲了很多关于如何利用你的肌肉和武器重量造成最大的威力。

messages.msgid: Bash Weapons for Self-Defense: A Practical Guide
translations: 自卫钝击武器：实用指南
messages.plural: copies of Bash Weapons for Self-Defense: A Practical Guide

messages.msgid: A small brochure from an unknown self-defense shop, focused on using bash weapons for self-defense in real-world situations.  It covers topics like assessing threats, using verbal commands and body language to de-escalate situations, and legal considerations for using force in self-defense.  It also includes techniques for using bash weapons to defend against attackers armed with knives, guns, and other weapons.
translations: 一本来自一个不知名的自卫用品店的小册子，专注于介绍如何在现实情况下使用钝击武器进行自卫。它涵盖了诸如评估威胁、使用口头命令和肢体语言缓和局势、以及在自卫中使用暴力的法律考虑等主题。它还包括了使用钝击武器防御持刀、枪支和其他武器的攻击者的技巧。

messages.msgid: Ultra Tactics: The Ways of the Modern Warrior
translations: 终极战术：现代战士之道
messages.plural: copies of Ultra Tactics: the Ways of the Modern Warrior

messages.msgid: This book researches the long, international story of ultras - fanatical football fans ready to defend the prestige of their football team in any possible way, including with brutal violence and heavy bats.
translations: 这本书研究了一个漫长的国际故事，超级狂热的球迷准备以任何可能的方式捍卫他们的足球队的声望，包括暴力和沉重的棒球棍。

messages.plural: copies of tactical baton defense manual

messages.msgid: An informative guide to self-defense using clubs and batons.  Aimed at the law enforcement and military market, it is packed with time tested, no-nonsense information and written to be understandable for beginners.
translations: 一个经验丰富的作者所写的如何使用军用制式武器的技巧，针对警棍枪械等，经受了时间的考验，严肃的信息和难以理解的内容对初学者很不友好。

messages.msgid: The Art and Science of Stick Fighting
messages.plural: copies of The Art and Science of Stick Fighting

messages.msgid: A non-style specific guide to fighting with the short stick, with a few levels of instructions from easy to master, and a lot of photos showing movements with motion arrows.
translations: 一本非风格化的短棍格斗攻略，带有易于理解的说明，以及大量带有指引箭头的图例。

messages.msgid: A comprehensive guide on how to do demolition on your own piece of land - from replacing the pavement to total house deconstruction - using only common instruments.  Surprisingly not so hard, as you just need to know how and when hit the thing.
translations: 一本关于如何在你自己的土地上进行拆除的综合指南——从更换路面到彻底拆除房屋——仅使用常用工具。这本书意外地好理解，因为你只需要知道如何以及何时敲打什么东西就好。

messages.msgid: "The Authoritative Guide to Using the Cane or Walking Stick for Self-Defense", this book provides plenty of ways to use an everyday tool as a sturdy weapon.
translations: 《使用拐杖或手杖自卫的权威指南》，书中提供了很多方法来使用日常工具作为可靠的武器。

messages.msgid: A university-level textbook on advanced principles of physical chemistry and all its branches: thermochemistry, electrochemistry, solid-state chemistry, photochemistry, quantum chemistry et cetera.
translations: 一本大学教材，内容涉及了物理化学的先进理论及其所有分支科学：热化学、电化学、固态化学、光化学、量子化学等。

messages.plural: copies of Physical Chemistry: Principles and Applications

messages.msgid: Fifth Edition of a best-selling book about using physical chemistry in various branches, with real examples.
translations: 一本畅销书，关于如何在生活的细枝末节中使用物理化学，第五版，还带有各种实例。

messages.plural: copies of Physical Chemistry: A Molecular Approach

messages.msgid: A textbook that covers more specialized topics in physical chemistry, including quantum chemistry, statistical mechanics, and surface science.
translations: 一本教科书，涵盖物理化学的更多专业主题，包括量子化学、统计力学和表面科学。

messages.msgid: Physical Chemistry: From Quantum Mechanics to Statistical Thermodynamics
translations: 物理化学：从量子力学到统计热力学
messages.plural: copies of Physical Chemistry: From Quantum Mechanics to Statistical Thermodynamics

messages.msgid: This book provides a comprehensive introduction to the principles of physical chemistry, covering topics such as quantum mechanics, thermodynamics, and statistical mechanics.
translations: 本书全面介绍了物理化学原理，涵盖了量子力学、热力学和统计力学等主题。

messages.msgid: Physical Chemistry for Scientists and Engineers
translations: 科学家和工程师的物理化学
messages.plural: copies of Physical Chemistry for Scientists and Engineers

messages.msgid: This book is designed for students in engineering and the physical sciences who are interested in applying physical chemistry concepts to real-world problems.  It covers topics such as thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, and transport phenomena, and includes examples and problems drawn from engineering and scientific applications.
translations: 本书专为有兴趣将物理化学概念应用于实际问题的工程和物理科学专业的学生而设计。 它涵盖了热力学、统计力学和传输现象等主题，并包括来自工程和科学应用的示例和问题。

messages.msgid: An in-depth and easy to read guide that details a very modern take on the ancient art of leather tanning.
translations: 一本关于鞣制的指南，详细介绍了从古至今的皮革鞣制技术，内容深入但通俗易懂。

messages.msgid: Leathercraft: Traditional Handcrafted Leatherwork Skills and Projects
translations: 皮革工艺：传统手工皮革技能和项目
messages.plural: copies of Leathercraft: Traditional Handcrafted Leatherwork Skills and Projects

messages.msgid: A guide by Nigel Armitage offering traditional leatherworking techniques with modern applications, creating durable goods able to last generations.
translations: 奈杰尔·阿米蒂奇的指南介绍了传统皮革加工技术与现代应用的结合，创造出经久不衰的耐用品。

messages.msgid: A leatherworking book for amateurs by a top professional, with some key techniques and various projects.
translations: 顶级专业人士为业余爱好者准备的皮革加工书籍，包含一些关键技术和各种项目。

messages.msgid: The Leather Manufacture in the United States
messages.plural: copies of The Leather Manufacture in the United States

messages.msgid: This vintage book contains a detailed treatise on the leather industry in late-nineteenth century America, being a dissertation on the methods employed in and the economics of tanning.
translations: 这本古书包含一篇关于 19 世纪后期美国皮革工业的详细论文，是一篇关于鞣制方法和鞣制经济学的论文。

messages.msgid: This sheaf of papers--dated two weeks before all this started--describes some new chemical formula, and its effects on human subjects.  It's stamped "APPROVED"…
translations: 这叠文件上的日期是距大灾变发生两周前，详细分析了很多化学配方以及这些反应对于人体的影响。上面盖了一个鲜红的图章"同意"……

messages.msgid: This team logbook details several varieties of mutagenic experiments, focusing on those derived from various Earth fauna.  The team seems quite enthusiastic--if not eager--about their results.
translations: 这本团队日志详尽记录了几类变异实验，重点是各种地球生物种群。看起来，研究团队对研究结果满腔热忱——甚至有些，"渴求"。

messages.msgid: This sheaf of papers describes a new chemical formula in detail and supplies instructions for its use as some sort of… crowd-control catalyst?  That can't be right…
translations: 这篇文献对一种新的化学公式作了详细的描述，并称其可以用作……"群体事件控制催化剂"？看起来不太妙……

messages.msgid: This team logbook details several varieties of mutagenic experiments, focusing on those derived from flesh contaminated with XE037.  The results look promising but the procurement methods seem awfully vague…
translations: 这本团队日志详尽记录了几类变异实验，重点是那些被XE037感染的活体组织。研究结果看起来很有希望，但测试对象的获取方式却语焉不详……

messages.msgid: This binder details the scheduled maintenance for several plumbing systems throughout the facility.  However, some of the log sheets seem to be filled with… a chemical formula?
translations: 这个日志内详细列出了机构内的数套管道系统的维护计划。不过，有几页记录表上似乎写着一道……化学式？

messages.msgid: This somewhat technical binder has several intimidating security warnings on the cover, yet guarantees unauthorized readers "permanent employment, for life".  It contains useful information on "basic" chemical projects like methamphetamine and heroin, along with briefing on things called "XE037" and "PE012".
translations: 这本活页夹的封面上有着多个看上去挺吓人的安全警告，却声称研究所会"终身雇佣"任何越权的读者。里面记载了关于冰毒和海洛因之类"基础化学品"的制造要点，还简略地提到了"XE037"和"PE012"这两种意义不明的制剂。

messages.msgid: This damaged team logbook lacks (deliberately?) any identifying information, but still contains useful information on several types of mutagen and their development.
translations: 这本污损的研究日志缺少（可能是故意的）可供辩别身份的信息，不过依然保留了几种诱变剂的配方和研发材料。

messages.plural: copies of PE023 "Medical": Application and Findings

messages.msgid: This binder of highly technical papers describes some new chemical formula, and its effects on human subjects.  It's stamped "APPROVED"…
translations: 这些尖端技术论文描述了一些全新的化学配方以及他们在人类实验者身上的效果。上面盖着"通过"的印章……

messages.msgid: This sheaf of papers is a highly speculative proposal for focusing "PE065".  Scribbled notes throughout seem to think that it might work, but that there's no time.
translations: 这捆文件是关于一个代号为"PE065"的高风险方案。各处的潦草笔记暗示着方案可能会如预期般有效，但是却没时间实施了。
化合药物体内传递实例操作
messages.plural: copies of Best Practices for Compound Delivery

messages.msgid: This internal manual details several varieties of mutagenic experiments, as well as describing the protocols used to concentrate mutagens for quicker results.  The authors recommend that researchers ensure that their subjects are well-fed and in good health, as the concentrated serums draw heavily on subjects' bodies.
translations: 这本内部读物详细地记录了几种变异实验，还有诱变剂的浓缩方案。作者要求操作者保证试验品处于"营养充足且健壮"的状态，因为"高度浓缩的诱变血清对受试者身体会造成沉重负担"。
CRC化学和物理手册（附默克索引，第四版）

messages.msgid: This huge hardbound book is a collection of reference data and formulae pertinent to many technical disciplines.  If poring over tables of chemical and physical data is your thing, this is the book for you.
translations: 这本大部头的硬皮书塞满了各种技术学科的参考数据和相关公式。如果你对盯着满桌子的化学和物理数据感兴趣的话，这本书会很适合你的需求。
一本关于化学的大学课本。

messages.plural: copies of Chemistry Essentials For Dummies

messages.msgid: Invaluable quick reference guide to the fundamentals of chemistry for students.
translations: 学生化学基础知识的宝贵快速参考指南。

messages.msgid: The revised third edition of a classic first-year text by Nobel laureate.  Covers atomic and molecular structure, quantum mechanics, statistical mechanics, and thermodynamics correlated with descriptive chemistry problems.
translations: 由诺贝尔奖获得者修订的经典第一学年教科书，第三版。涵盖与描述性化学问题相关的原子和分子结构、量子力学、统计力学和热力学。

messages.plural: copies of Modern Chemistry: Student Edition

messages.msgid: A giant, almost 1000 page book that covers anything a student may want (and may not want) to know about chemistry, from foundations to an intermediate level.
translations: 一本将近1000页的大作，涵盖了学生可能想（也可能不想）了解的化学知识，从基础到中级。

messages.plural: copies of The Essential Oil Enthusiasts Handbook

messages.msgid: A heavy hardback book explaining the process of essential oil making, with schematics for the equipment to do it.  Good luck, and don't blow yourself up!
translations: 一本沉重的精装书，详细描述了精油的制作过程，并附有设备原理图。祝你好运，别把自己炸了！

messages.msgid: Handbook of Essential Oils: Science, Technology, and Applications
translations: 精油手册：科学、技术和应用
messages.plural: copies of Handbook of Essential Oils: Science, Technology, and Applications

messages.msgid: This book presents the development, use and marketing of essential oils, with a wide range of topics, sources, as well as production and analysis techniques.
translations: 这本书介绍了精油的开发、使用和营销，涵盖了广泛的主题：来源、生产和分析技术。

messages.msgid: This book provides a detailed guide to the process of distilling essential oils, including information on equipment and processes for extracting them from plant materials.  It also includes tips for selecting and storing essential oils, as well as using the byproducts of manufacturing.
translations: 这本书提供了蒸馏精油过程的详细指南，包括设备信息和从植物材料中提取精油的过程。它还包括选择和储存精油的技巧，以及重新利用副产品的技巧。

messages.msgid: Art and Science of Chemical Warfare
translations: 化学战中的艺术与科学
messages.plural: copies of Art and Science of Chemical Warfare

messages.msgid: This in-depth and technical text covers the design, development, dissemination of, and defenses against various chemical weapons throughout the centuries.  The photographs the author chose make it a difficult read at times, though the information is top-notch.
translations: 一本深入而专业地描述了一个世纪以来化学武器的设计、发展、传播以及防护的书。因为作者着意使用顶尖的一手资料，某些图片可能不大适合心灵脆弱的读者观看。

messages.msgid: Chemistry for Kids: Awesome Science Experiments that Really Work
translations: 少儿化学：真正管用的有趣科学实验
messages.plural: copies of Chemistry for Kids: Awesome Science Experiments that Really Work

messages.msgid: A book with comprehensive and accurate step-by-step illustrated instructions for many scientific experiments, for young researchers and anyone else who wants to delve into the amazing world of chemistry.
translations: 一本带有全面而准确的逐步操作图示说明的科学实验书，供青少年研究员或者任何想钻研化学这个神奇世界的人使用。

messages.msgid: The Chemistry Book: Big Ideas Simply Explained
translations: 化学书：大思想简单解释
messages.plural: copies of The Chemistry Book: Big Ideas Simply Explained

messages.msgid: Short, pithy explanations of some of the most historic moments in science, from the birth of alchemy to modern chemistry state.  Simple graphics, such as flowcharts and mind maps, support the text and make the explanation of key concepts easy to follow.
translations: 从炼金术的诞生到现代化学状态，对科学中一些最具历史意义的时刻进行了简短而精辟的解释。 简单的图形，如流程图和思维导图，支持文本并使关键概念的解释易于理解。

messages.msgid: The fifth edition of a textbook to help students master math and problem solving they will use in their future chemistry classes.
translations: 第五版教科书，帮助学生掌握在未来化学课上会用到的数学问题和解决方法。

messages.plural: copies of Basic Chemistry Concepts and Exercises

messages.msgid: This book communicates the fundamentals of chemistry in a practical, down-to-earth manner, with simple language and detailed images.
translations: 这本书用简单的语言和详细的图像，以实用、脚踏实地的方式传达了化学的基础知识。

messages.msgid: Everything You Need to Ace Chemistry in One Big Fat Notebook
translations: 在一本大胖笔记本中获得成为化学高手所需的一切
messages.plural: copies of Everything You Need to Ace Chemistry in One Big Fat Notebook

messages.msgid: This book provides plenty of info about high school-level chemistry, with lot of additional tables and formulas, though lacking many additional pictures.
translations: 这本书提供了大量关于学校化学的信息，还有很多额外的表格和公式，但缺少了很多额外的配图。

messages.msgid: Catalytic Cracking at Home for Solarpunks
translations: 太阳朋克家用催化裂解手册
messages.plural: copies of Catalytic Cracking at Home for Solarpunks

messages.msgid: A colorful textbook that proclaims to teach one how to bootstrap kerosene and diesel production from waste products.  Despite the hip title, the information contained within is highly advanced and technical.
translations: 一本色彩缤纷的教科书，宣称要教会人们如何利用各种油脂废料，来进行煤油和柴油生产。尽管标题很时髦，但其中包含的信息是非常先进和高科技的。

messages.msgid: Modeling and Simulation of Fluid Catalytic Cracking Riser
translations: 流化催化裂化提升管的建模与仿真
messages.plural: copies of Modeling and Simulation of Fluid Catalytic Cracking Riser

messages.msgid: Describing the problems that may occur while refining oil, this book is an excellent reference and teaching material for students and researchers in chemical engineering and chemistry.
translations: 本书描述了炼油过程可能出现的问题，是化学工程科研人员和学生的极佳参考和教材。

messages.plural: copies of Fluid Catalytic Cracking Handbook

messages.msgid: This handbook provides practical information and tools that engineers can use to maximize the profitability and reliability of their fluid catalytic cracking operations.
translations: 本手册提供实用信息和工具，工程师可以使用这些信息和工具最大限度地提高流化催化裂化操作的盈利能力和可靠性。

messages.msgid: A Literature Review on Cold Cracking of Petroleum Crude Oil
translations: 石油原油冷裂化的文献综述
messages.plural: copies of A Literature Review on Cold Cracking of Petroleum Crude Oil

messages.msgid: This book describes cold petroleum cracking - a type of process that occurs below the freezing point, compared the common process that occurs at nearly 400 centigrade.  You can't really use this type of process without a lot of additional equipment, but the book provides plenty of information about common methods that you can do by hand.
translations: 这本书描述了石油冷裂解的方法——比起需要在近400摄氏度水平上进行的过程，这种反应要在冰点下才能发生。如果没有很多额外设备，你就无法真正使用这种方法，不过这本书提供了大量常用方法相关的信息，可以让你手工完成，前提是你要先搞到类似的设备。
生物柴油：可再生燃料资源
messages.plural: copies of Biodiesel: Renewable Fuel Resource

messages.msgid: A large textbook for college students about biodiesel.
translations: 一本有关生物柴油的大部头大学教科书。

messages.msgid: Biodiesel Production: Technologies, Challenges, and Future Prospects
translations: 生物柴油生产：技术、挑战和未来前景
messages.plural: copies of Biodiesel Production: Technologies, Challenges, and Future Prospects

messages.msgid: Sponsored by the American Society of Civil Engineers, this book presents approaches, technologies, and source materials for biodiesel production, as well as socioeconomic and political impacts of its applications.  You surely don't need the second part anymore.
translations: 这本书由美国土木工程师协会赞助，介绍了生物柴油生产的方法、技术和原材料，以及其应用的社会经济和政治影响。 你肯定不再需要第二部分了。

messages.msgid: A big, 500-page book that provides plenty of info about the history of different fuels, methods to apply them, and properties required for each.  It's mainly centered on biodiesel and another biofuels.
translations: 一本500页的大书，提供了不同燃料的历史、应用方法以及每种燃料所需特性的大量信息，主要集中在生物柴油和其他生物燃料上。

messages.msgid: Biodiesel: a Realistic Fuel Alternative for Diesel Engines
translations: 生物柴油简史：可行的柴油替换方案
messages.plural: copies of Biodiesel: a Realistic Fuel Alternative for Diesel Engines

messages.msgid: A small book offering insights into plant-based fuels, with detailed analyses of biodiesel types, and possible scenarios for their implementation.  Sadly most of the book just repeats itself, writing the same text over and over again, which makes you feel you stuck in a constant loop.
translations: 一本提供对植物燃料的见解的小册，详细分析生物柴油及其实施的可能方案。可悲的是，这本书的大部分内容只是重复自己，一遍又一遍地写同样的文字，这让你觉得自己陷入了一个不断循环的循环中。

messages.msgid: Biodiesel Science and Technology: From Soil to Oil
translations: 生物柴油科技：从土壤到石油
messages.plural: copies of Biodiesel Science and Technology: From Soil to Oil

messages.msgid: This book contains different techniques for producing biofuels in different scales - from home-made work in your backyard to large manufacturing - with different issues you may meet in the process, and ways to resolve them.
translations: 这本书包含了不同规模的生物燃料生产技术——从在家后院自制到大批量生产——还有过程中你可能会遇到不同的问题，以及解决这些问题的方法。

messages.msgid: Biodiesel Basics and Beyond: A Comprehensive Guide to Production and Use for the Home and Farm
translations: 生物柴油基础知识及扩展：家庭和农场生产和使用综合指南
messages.plural: copies of Biodiesel Basics and Beyond: A Comprehensive Guide to Production and Use for the Home and Farm

messages.msgid: A comprehensive guide by William Kemp to produce biodiesel at small scale while avoiding common failures of fuel quality and byproduct waste management, with accuracies of data and process backed by government or university verification.
translations: 威廉·坎普 (William Kemp) 的综合指南，旨在小规模生产生物柴油，有效避免燃料质量和副产品废物管理方面的常见问题，数据和流程的准确性得到政府或大学验证的支持。

messages.msgid: Handbook of Biofuels Production: Process and Technologies
translations: 生物燃料生产手册：过程和技术
messages.plural: copies of Handbook of Biofuels Production: Process and Technologies

messages.msgid: A book about different types of biofuels, issues in their production and application, and different processes and technologies that are used in their manufacturing.
translations: 一本关于不同类型的生物燃料、其生产和应用中的问题、以及在其生产中使用的各种过程和技术的书。

messages.msgid: The original cover of this book was replaced with a white sheet of paper with a hand-made "Bean Diesel" label and simplified image of Vin Diesel, drawn in pen.  Excluding this, it is a pretty mundane handbook about biofuel production.
translations: 这本书原来的封面被替换成了一张白纸，上面有一个手工制作的"豆类柴油"标签，以及用钢笔绘制有文·迪塞尔（Vin Diesel）的涂鸦。除此以外，它只是一本关于生物燃料生产的手册，平平无奇。
计算机程序的构造和解释

messages.msgid: A classic text, "The Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs." Written with examples in LISP, but applicable to any language.
translations: 《计算机程序的构造和解释（第2版）》1984年出版，成型于美国麻省理工学院(MIT)多年使用的一本教材，1996年修订为第2版。在过去的二十多年里，《计算机程序的构造和解释》对于计算机科学的教育计划产生了深刻的影响。第2版中大部分重要程序设计系统都重新修改并做过测试，包括各种解释器和编译器。作者根据其后十余年的教学实践，还对其他许多细节做了相应的修改。

messages.msgid: Also known as CLRS - a letter for the last names of each author - this book contains deep explanations for a range of algorithms divided across several self-contained chapters, with pseudocode presentation.
translations: 本书也被称为CLRS——四位作者姓氏首字母的组合——包含了对一系列算法的深入解释，分为几个自成一体的章节，并有伪代码演示。

messages.msgid: The Art of Computer Programming, Vol. 1
translations: 计算机编程艺术（第一卷）
messages.plural: copies of The Art of Computer Programming, Vol. 1

messages.msgid: A huge reference manual about fundamental algorithms, with a lot of examples and math.
translations: 一本关于基本算法的厚重参考手册，有大量的例子和数学知识。

messages.msgid: The Art of Computer Programming, Vol. 3
translations: 计算机编程艺术（第三卷）
messages.plural: copies of The Art of Computer Programming, Vol. 3

messages.msgid: A huge reference manual about sorting and searching algorithms, with a lot of examples and math.
translations: 一本关于排序和搜索算法的厚重参考手册，有大量的例子和数学知识。

messages.msgid: A college textbook on computer science.
translations: 一本关于计算机学的大学课本。

messages.plural: copies of Computer Science: An Overview

messages.msgid: The 13th edition, this book gives a bottom-up, concrete-to-abstract foundation in the subject, and encourages a practical and realistic understanding of computer science.
translations: 第13版，这本书给出了一个自下而上、从具体到抽象的学科基础，并鼓励人们对计算机科学有一个具体和现实的理解。

messages.msgid: Everything You Need to Ace Computer Science and Coding in One Big Fat Notebook
translations: 在一本大部头笔记中获得成为计算机高手所需的一切
messages.plural: copies of Everything You Need to Ace Computer Science and Coding in One Big Fat Notebook

messages.msgid: Not as big as the back cover suggests, this book still contains lots of information for the reader about key concepts, definitions, diagrams, and doodles about computer science.
translations: 这本书不像封面上宣传的那么大，但仍然为读者提供了大量关于计算机科学的各种信息：关键概念、定义、图表和涂鸦。
自学成才的计算机科学家
messages.plural: copies of The Self-Taught Computer Scientist

messages.msgid: A nice workbook that contains information about computer science beyond the common college program, with lots of practical examples and additional tools.
translations: 一本不错的工作手册，包含了普通大学课程之外的计算机科学信息，有很多实用的例子和附加工具。

messages.plural: copies of How to Browse the Web

translations: 一本非常基础的计算机入门书籍。

messages.plural: copies of Computer Basics For The Over 50s

messages.msgid: A colorful book with lots of images detailing how to perform simple tasks in a computer system.
translations: 一本有大量图片的彩色书籍，详细介绍了如何在计算机系统中执行简单任务。

messages.plural: copies of Hand Book On Computer Basics

messages.msgid: A small book that describes the very foundations of how computers and the internet work, with relevant examples.
translations: 一本描述计算机和互联网工作原理的小册，并附有相关示例。
为老年人准备的傻瓜电脑指南
messages.plural: copies of Computers For Seniors For Dummies

messages.msgid: A simple guide to computers that'll show you what all the fuss is about.
translations: 一本简单的计算机指南，从头向你介绍那些不值得大惊小怪的事情。

messages.msgid: Check Your English Vocabulary for Computers and Information Technology
translations: 检查你的计算机和信息技术英语词汇
messages.plural: copies of Check Your English Vocabulary for Computers and Information Technology

messages.msgid: This workbook is designed to help non-native English speakers improve their knowledge and understanding of core computing and IT terminology, with definitions and some examples.
translations: 这本工作手册旨在帮助非英语母语者提高对核心计算机和IT术语的认识和理解，并附有定义和一些例子。

messages.msgid: An informative magazine all about computers, both hardware and software.
translations: 一本包含了各类硬件软件知识的计算机学杂志。

messages.msgid: An old, shabby magazine about hardware and software.  The last page says this is the last printed issue, as they are going all digital.
translations: 一本关于硬件和软件的破旧杂志。最后一页说这是最后一期印刷版了，因为他们要全数字化了。

messages.msgid: A shiny scientific journal that reviews fresh literature in the computer science field.
translations: 一本闪亮的科学期刊，评论计算机科学领域的最新文献。

messages.msgid: Journal that cover lot of aspects of software engineering, processes, and practices.
translations: 涵盖软件工程、过程和实践的许多方面的期刊。

messages.msgid: A practitioner-oriented magazine issued to all members of the society, containing articles and columns about different computing-related issues.
translations: 一本面向所有社会成员的从业者杂志，包含有关不同计算相关问题的文章和专栏。
一本计算机的初级教材，内容面向初学者，简单易懂。

messages.plural: copies of An Introduction to Computer Science

messages.msgid: An introduction into computer world, based on simple computer language.  It guides the reader toward deep computer world.
translations: 一本计算机概论，以通俗易懂的计算机用语，引导读者深入计算机世界。

messages.msgid: Printouts, held together by a staple, that explain work in different applications, multimedia, the web, and basic work with hardware.
translations: 一堆用书钉固定在一起的打印件，解释了不同应用程序、多媒体和网络的运行方式，还有基本的硬件原理。

messages.plural: copies of Teaching Computing in Secondary Schools

messages.msgid: A practical book for teachers about how to plan lessons and what they need to teach scholars about computer science.
translations: 一本供教师使用的实用书籍，介绍了如何备课，以及向学生传授什么计算机科学知识。

messages.plural: copies of The Elements of Computing Systems

messages.msgid: A book that describes how computers works, how they break big tasks into smaller and simpler tasks, and teaches how you can do the same.
translations: 一本书，描述了计算机的工作原理，它们如何将大任务分解为更小、更简单的任务，并教你如何做同样的事情。

messages.plural: copies of Principles of Advanced Programming

messages.msgid: A heavy textbook dedicated to advanced-level software design, written for several different programming languages.
translations: 一本沉重的教科书，内容为高级软件编程设计。含有许多不同编程语言教学。

messages.msgid: This book illuminates durable principles at the heart of effective software development, with historic examples and personal experience.
translations: 本书通过历史实例和个人经验，阐明了高效持续软件开发的核心原则。

messages.plural: copies of Fundamentals of Software Architecture

messages.msgid: This book examines different architecture patterns and components of good application.
translations: 本书研究了不同的架构模式和优秀应用应有的组成部分。

messages.msgid: Advanced Game Design: A Systems Approach
messages.plural: copies of Advanced Game Design: A Systems Approach

messages.msgid: Author research how computer game works, how they build, and how to make proper gameplay parts and prototypes, with examples of real code.
translations: 作者研究了计算机游戏的工作原理、它们的构建方式以及如何制作适当的游戏部分和原型，并提供了真实代码示例。

messages.msgid: This book describes the key features of popular computer languages with features you can use to enhance your working environment and experience, as well as your code.
translations: 本书描述了流行计算机语言的主要特征，侧重于提升你的工作环境和经验，以及你的代码质量。

messages.msgid: This book shows the most common pitfalls inexperienced programmers may meet in their work, and different solutions one can use to resolve or avoid them.
translations: 本书展示了新手程序员在工作中可能遇到的最常见陷阱，以及用来解决或避免这些陷阱的不同方案。

messages.plural: copies of Data-Driven Science and Engineering

messages.msgid: A guide for scientists and engineers describing how to use modern computer systems and methods in their work.
translations: 一本写给科学家和工程师的指南，描述了如何在工作中利用现代计算机系统和方法。

messages.msgid: A thick glossy paperback instructional manual for aspiring web designers that includes a teaching guide for young students.
translations: 一本厚而光滑的平装本教科书，面向有抱负的网页设计师，其中包括针对年轻学生的教程。

messages.msgid: A comics-like manual explaining how to perform simple code tasks, targeted at kids.
translations: 一本类似漫画的手册，解释了如何执行简单的代码任务，面向儿童。

messages.msgid: Computer Programming: Fundamentals for Absolute Beginners
translations: 计算机编程：绝对初学者的基础知识
messages.plural: copies of Computer Programming: Fundamentals for Absolute Beginners

messages.msgid: A book that tries to teach the reader the most common programming activities - planning the work, making comfortable workarounds, designing the code schemes, and writing them in the right way.
translations: 一本试图教会读者最常见编程活动的书——计划工作、制定舒适的变通方案、设计代码计划，并以正确的方式编写它们。

messages.msgid: This handbook describes the very basics of coding - creating and using variables, loops, decisions, objects - and examples of how and where to use them.
translations: 这本手册介绍了编程的最基本知识——创建和使用变量、循环、决策、对象——并举例说明了如何以及在何处使用它们。
初学者计算机编程：基础知识
messages.plural: copies of Computer Programming for Beginners: Fundamentals

messages.msgid: A small book that explains different skills a programmer needs to be able to code, in simple terms and with samples.
translations: 一本小手册，用简单的语言和例子解释了程序员编程所需的技能。

messages.msgid: A beginner's guide to coding, with step-by-step instructions how to get started and write a simple program.
translations: 初学者编码指南，包含如何开始和编写简单程序的分步说明。

messages.msgid: A thinly veiled attempt at teaching kids coding skills.  Not nearly as exciting as the authors might have hoped, but there's some real knowledge in here.
translations: 一次教会孩子们编程的浅薄尝试。内容或许并没有作者希望的那么能让孩子兴奋，但确实有一些真正知识。

messages.msgid: First Steps in Coding: What's Decomposition?
translations: 编程第一步：什么是分解？
messages.plural: copies of First Steps in Coding: What's Decomposition?

messages.msgid: A tiny book with childish images of a robot, that explains what functional decomposition is, and how to use it properly.
translations: 一本带有幼稚机器人画像的小书，解释了什么是功能分解，以及如何正确使用它。

messages.msgid: A shiny book with lot of useful information about using code for different tasks inside the computer.  Sadly some big chunks of information are hidden behind QR code links, which you can't open.
translations: 一本亮闪闪的书，里面有很多关于在计算机内使用代码完成不同任务的有用信息。遗憾的是，一些大块头的知识点被藏在二维码链接里，而你再也打不开了。

messages.msgid: A fully illustrated, friendly guide describing how different algorithms are used to solve practical problems - both in real life and in programming.
translations: 一本图文并茂的友好指南，描述了不同的算法是如何用于解决实际问题的——无论是在现实生活还是编程中。

messages.msgid: A tiny book that describe how games are created, alongside simple projects to make your own simple games, with lot of illustrations and funny facts.
translations: 一本描述游戏是如何创作的小书，以及如何制作自己的简单游戏项目，有很多插图和有趣的小知识。

messages.msgid: A book full of easy-to-follow recipes and useful advice on homebrewing, malting, and fermenting.  It even smells faintly of booze.
translations: 一本写满了易学配方的家庭酿造指南，从出芽，发酵，酿造工艺的每一过程都有详细文章与配图。

messages.plural: copies of Cooking on a Budget

messages.msgid: A nice cookbook that goes beyond recipes and into the chemistry of food.
translations: 一本细致的烹饪书，不仅仅局限于菜谱本身，还深入探讨了食物的化学成分，甚至还包含有一些炊事用具的配方。

messages.msgid: This cookbook is written in Italian, but handily illustrated with step-by-step photo instructions.
translations: 这是一本意大利语烹饪书，内含多款意式美食的制造方法，每个步骤都有详细的配图，即便不识意大利语也可以看懂配方。

messages.msgid: La Vida Deliciosa: Definitive Mexican Cuisine
messages.plural: copies of La Vida Deliciosa: Definitive Mexican Cuisine

messages.msgid: This cookbook has lots of colorful pictures of finished dishes and features personal tips from the author/chef on nearly every recipe.  On the back cover are two joyful photos of the author in the kitchen with their parents: one as a child and one as an adult.
translations: 这本食谱有许多成品菜肴的彩色图片，并附有作者/厨师对几乎每份食谱的个人提示。封底是作者和父母在厨房里的两张欢乐照片：一张是小时候，一张是成年时。

messages.msgid: A simple text for the aspiring sushi lover, this easy-to-read guide is filled with lots of helpful illustrations for everything from basic rice preparation to setting a proper Japanese table.
translations: 一本为"志向远大"的寿司爱好者准备的小手册，这本易于阅读的指南为寿司制作的一切都配上了许多有用的插图，从基本的米饭准备，到设置合适的日本餐桌。

messages.msgid: A big binder full of somebody's family recipes.  The well-turned pages and creased corners speak volumes of the culinary knowledge contained within.  You could probably learn a lot about cooking from studying this domestic artifact.
translations: 一本某人家传的烹饪食谱合集，家庭主妇亲自为你解说各种烹饪技巧，内含很多食物加工知识。

messages.msgid: Exciting recipes and restaurant reviews.  Full of handy tips about cooking.
translations: 一本餐饮杂志，内容包含令人兴奋的食谱以及一些饭店的评论，以及一些关于烹饪的小心得。

messages.msgid: A full-size glossy women's magazine.  There are a few unoriginal recipes and some simple cooking tips somewhere in between the fashion photos and the sex advice columns.
translations: 一本光鲜亮丽的大开本女性杂志。在时尚先锋和两性关系栏目的之间夹着一些缺乏创意的食谱和一些基础烹饪心得。

messages.plural: copies of Ye Scots Beuk o Cuikery

messages.msgid: A semi-translated Gaelic cookbook from sixteenth century Scotland.  While a bit difficult to read, as there are a disquieting number of illustrations of people stabbing each other mixed with rants about 'True Scotsmen', it provides insights into medieval Scottish cuisine and culture.
translations: 一部翻译得半通不通的盖尔语烹饪书，描述了十六世纪的苏格兰菜肴。虽然书中夹杂的大量士兵打斗插图，以及作者对"真正的苏格兰人"的抱怨让这本书读起来有些难懂，但它能提供对中世纪苏格兰饮食和文化的深入解析。

messages.msgid: This book describes in detail all the ways that one can make vinegar.  You would have thought that there wasn't much to making vinegar, but the girth of this book tells you otherwise.
translations: 这本书详细描述了酿醋的所有方法。你可能认为酿醋没什么大不了的，但这本书的厚度告诉你并非如此。

messages.msgid: Canning foods doesn't have to stop with jam and pickles.  This book provides a plethora of juices that can be preserved.
translations: 罐装食品不必再局限于果酱和腌菜。这本书提供了超多种适于保存的果汁配方。

messages.msgid: Offal Holiday Cooking, by Evelyn Turncoat, is a book of holiday recipes that utilize organ meats from various animals.  For the true nose-to-tail cook.
translations: 《内脏节日料理》是一本关于节日料理食谱的书，伊芙琳·腾考特著。该食谱使用了来自各种动物的内脏，献给真正的从鼻子用到尾巴的厨师。

messages.plural: copies of Things to Do with Milk

messages.msgid: Whatever you want to do with milk, you will probably find it in this book.
translations: 无论你想用奶做什么菜，你都能在这本书里找到配方。

messages.msgid: Liver-Licious Recipes Your Kids Will Love
This cookbook is written by liver enthusiast Tamsyn Beckerleg.  Inside you'll find a great deal of anecdotes about the near-certain ruination of children who refuse to eat their liver.
translations: 这本食谱是由肝脏料理狂热分子塔姆辛·贝克雷格编著，内含大量有关不吃肝脏会如何毁掉孩子的轶事。

messages.plural: copies of Blood for the Greater Good

messages.msgid: A recipe book compiled by blood-as-food advocate Alžbeta Bátoriová.  The consumption of blood is a taboo among members of many Abrahamic religions, but they aren't going to stop you now.  This book has bonus material for those with particular tastes.
translations: 一本由血液食物倡导者巴托里·伊丽莎白编撰的食谱。食用血液是许多亚伯拉罕宗教成员的禁忌，但他们现在不打算阻止你。这本书为那些有特殊口味的人提供了些特别的素材。

messages.msgid: Dainty Dishes Fit for a King

This cookbook contains many fanciful recipes.  Some of them are even worth the trouble to actually prepare.  Lovely pen and ink illustrations of overweight knights and gluttonous monks line the pages.
translations: 这本书列举了许多花哨的菜谱，书页上用钢笔风格绘制着肥胖的骑士和修道士的精美图案。其中有几道菜还是值得花费心思一试的。

messages.msgid: Eat Your Way to a Fit Physique
This self-help book, by "acclaimed nutrition and health guru Amar de Freitas," is as dubious as its title.  Worse, it is boring.  It does, however, contain a few basic cooking instructions.
translations: 这本由"著名营养与健康大师阿马尔·德·弗雷塔斯"编写的参考书的内容和它的标题一样可疑，而更糟糕的是它还非常无趣。尽管如此，它还是包含了一些基础的烹饪教程。

messages.msgid: A cookbook professing itself to be for those seeking "daring and sophisticated flavors."  The book exhorts the reader to defy convention and break the rules, and then presents a number of useful rules and conventions for preparing food.
translations: 一本自称是为追求"大胆且复杂的味觉体验"的人所编著的食谱。这本书告诫读者要挑战传统、打破常规，然后就列出了一系列烹饪的传统技巧和常规方法。

messages.msgid: Winemaking is an art form.  This book teaches you how to crayon within the lines.
translations: 酿酒，是一种艺术。这本书教你如何像在横线上涂蜡笔一样，循规蹈矩地酿酒。

messages.plural: copies of You Can Can at Home

messages.msgid: This entry-level guide to home canning talks about the importance of acidity and food contents in preservation, and how to avoid contaminants in your canning batches.
translations: 这本入门级家庭罐装指南讨论了不同酸度和原料含量在罐装保存过程中的重要性，以及如何避免罐装批次被污染。

messages.msgid: This dry guide to a home-use tin can sealer goes into clear detail on everything you can seal with the device and how to do it safely, and includes some basic recipes.
translations: 这份内容枯燥的家用罐头密封机的说明书清楚描述了此封罐机所有能够密封的物品，以及安全密封的步骤，并包含了一些简单的食谱。

messages.msgid: This dry guide to a home-use vacuum sealer goes into clear detail on everything you can seal with the device and how to do it safely, and includes some basic recipes.
translations: 这份内容枯燥的家用真空封口机说明书清楚描述了此封口机所有能够密封的物品，以及安全密封的步骤，并包含了一些简单的食谱。

messages.msgid: This book promises to teach you the ways of baking, from cakes to souffles.
translations: 这本书宣称能够教会你制作各式烘培配方，从蛋糕到舒芙蕾。

messages.msgid: Fermenting as a cooking practice only recently came back into vogue before the Cataclysm.  Here is a book with dozens of recipes, many of which you are unlikely to ever see the ingredients for again.
translations: 发酵作为一种烹饪方法，直到最近才在大灾变之前重新流行起来。这本书中包含了几十种食谱，但你不太可能再看到其中大部分食谱所需的原材料了。

messages.msgid: Out of the Holler and into the Home: A guide to home distillation
messages.plural: copies of Out of the Holler

messages.msgid: A book describing the history of at-home distillation.  Each chapter is named after a different type of liquor, and contains a complete recipe for its namesake.
translations: 一本描述家庭蒸馏历史的书。每章都以不同类型的酒命名，并包含与其同名的完整配方。

messages.msgid: Sweets for your Sweet Child is a best-selling cookbook marketed to the parents of young children.  Every recipe uses oversized text, easy words and diagram instructions for children learning to cook with their parents.
translations: 《给甜心的甜品》是一本在有小孩的父母中最畅销的烹饪书。每个菜谱都用超大文字、简单词汇和示例图片详细描述，让孩子们可以与父母一起学习烹饪。

messages.msgid: A thick hardcover book as much about Indian culture as it is a cookbook, clearly written with adoration.
translations: 一本厚厚的精装书，它既是一本烹饪书，又是一本介绍印度文化的书，书中行文富含着对其文化的热爱。

messages.msgid: A thick hardcover book about the history and future of Native American cuisine.  As much recipe collection as manifesto.
translations: 一本关于美国原住民美食的历史和未来的厚重精装书。既是食谱集，又是宣言。

messages.msgid: The definitive cookbook of hearty, healthy Turkish cuisine.
translations: 以丰盛、健康为特点的土耳其美食权威烹饪书。

messages.msgid: An interesting magazine that contains information about swords and sword fighting techniques from all across the world.
translations: 一本十分有趣的杂志，包含来自世界各地的剑的种类和剑术知识。

messages.msgid: Swordfighting, for Writers, Game Designers, and Martial Artists
translations: 剑术：为作家、游戏设计师和武术家而写
messages.plural: copies of Swordfighting, for Writers, Game Designers, and Martial Artists

messages.msgid: Answers for questions you may have if you've never held a sword in your hands.
translations: 一本解答你可能有的关于剑的问题的书，如果你从未握过剑的话。

messages.msgid: The Beginner's Guide to the Long Sword
messages.plural: copies of The Beginner's Guide to the Long Sword

messages.msgid: Based on different Europeans' martial arts, this book describes the main principles of swordsmanship.
