translations: 这本书根据不同欧洲武术介绍了剑术的主要原理。

messages.plural: copies of Basics Of Stage Combat

messages.msgid: Foundation of using single handed sword on stage and on screen, with different tricks how to make a good show of it.
translations: 在舞台上和银幕上使用单手剑的基础知识，包含了如何使其更具观赏性的不同技巧。

messages.plural: copies of Medieval Combat in Colour

messages.msgid: An ancient fencing manual with updated illustrations of techniques.  Sometimes it just looks silly, describing how to fight if you have sword in one hand and a spear in another.
translations: 一本古老的击剑手册，有近现代新增的技巧图示。有的看起来很傻，描述了如果你一手拿剑一手拿矛该如何战斗。

messages.msgid: It seems to be a guide to edged weapon combat, poorly photocopied and released on spiral-bound paper.  Still, there are lots of useful tips for beginners.
translations: 一本印刷质量很差，用弹簧草草装订后就发行的指南，里面的内容都是教人如何用刀、匕首等武器战斗。不过对初学者来说确实有许多有用的小提示。

messages.msgid: Principles and guides to Italian dagger combat, with useful drills and advice for novices.
translations: 意大利匕首战斗的原则和指南，并为新手提供有用的演习方法和建议。

messages.msgid: Knife Fighting Techniques for the Street
messages.plural: copies of Knife Fighting Techniques for the Street

messages.msgid: A small book that contain pretty simple and easy to follow movements to use against your enemy or enemies.
translations: 一本小手册，包含相当简单和容易遵循的动作，可以用来对付你的敌人或敌人们。

messages.msgid: Complete methodology for using knives in a real fight, with tips and tricks.
translations: 一本小册子，写满了用匕首实战的方法论。也列出了许多注意事项和有用的小技巧。

messages.msgid: This book combines some different blade methodologies from European, Asian, and American martial arts into a unique style.
translations: 这本书参考了一些来自欧洲、亚洲和美洲的武术的不同刀法，融合形成了独特的风格。

messages.msgid: Lots of knife training methods and techniques for experienced martial artists.
translations: 许多关于匕首的训练方法和技巧，适合经验丰富的武术家。

messages.plural: copies of USMC Sword Manual Procedure

messages.msgid: A text on stationary sword drills in US Marine Corps.
translations: 一本美国海军陆战队关于站立剑术操练的教学手册。

messages.msgid: A text on stationary sword drills in US Marine Corps.  Contains lots of information about how to draw and pose with a sword, but nothing about using it.
translations: 一篇关于美国海军陆战队固定式剑术训练的文章。 包含很多关于如何用剑挥舞和架势的技巧，但没有关于如何使用它的讲解。

messages.msgid: An old Japanese treatise about swordsmanship, translated and polished, with additional illustrations and detailed explanations.
translations: 日本古剑术论，译文润色，图文并茂，解释详尽。

messages.plural: copies of Records of the Medieval Sword

messages.msgid: Original research about straight two-edged knightly swords of the European middle ages.
translations: 书中包含了对欧洲中世纪直双刃骑士剑的独创性研究。

messages.msgid: An ancient Japanese book of advice about building the proper skills and mind for sword fighting.  Talks too much about Zen, but the sword techniques are worth noting.
translations: 一本日本古籍，经过翻译润色。讲解如何培养剑术战斗时的技巧和思路。关于禅道的内容过多，剑术技巧只是个添头。

messages.plural: copies of The Art of Longsword Fighting

messages.msgid: A grounded work about the history of swordsmanship, ways to teach it, and how to enhance students' experience.
translations: 一本内容充实的书，记载了剑术历史、如何教授剑术，以及怎样增强学习者的剑术体验。

messages.plural: copies of Art of Sword Combat

messages.msgid: Translation of an old German treatise about using a few different cutting weapons in a real fight, with modern comments and clarification.
translations: 一篇古老德国论文译文，附有现代评论和说明，讲解如何在实战中使用不同的带刃武器。

messages.msgid: Learn the moves of the trendiest dances right now.
translations: 一本舞蹈入门教程，封面上印着："现在，跟我学最炫最酷的舞蹈吧！"

messages.msgid: In this book, zoologist Sir James Gray explores the development of different kinds of animal movement, from swimming to crawling to jumping, and then examines the mechanics of the variety of possible movements made by different creatures, illustrated with both sketches and photographs.
translations: 在这本书中，动物学家詹姆斯·格雷爵士探索了不同种类的动物运动的发展，从游泳到爬行再到跳跃，然后研究了不同生物可能做出的各种运动的机制，并通过插图和照片进行了说明。

messages.plural: copies of The Art of Movement

messages.msgid: A collection of photos of different dance movements of the world.  The images are inspiring, and the movements of the dancers are deep.
translations: 世界各地舞蹈的照片集。 画面鼓舞人心，舞者的动作到位。

messages.plural: copies of Self-Defense for Gentlemen and Ladies

messages.msgid: An old treatise about self defense, with style.
translations: 关于自卫的古老专著，风格独特。

messages.msgid: Self-Defence for Non-Experts: A Book for People Who Can't Fight
translations: 非专业自卫：一本给不会打架的人的书
messages.plural: copies of Self-Defence for Non-Experts: A Book for People Who Can't Fight

messages.msgid: A small guide on self defense for an untrained person - mostly simple tricks and advice like having a knife and how to threaten an enemy into backing down, but contains some more advanced and detailed descriptions of movement techniques.
translations: 针对未受过训练的人的自卫指南 - 只有简单的技巧和建议，例如拿刀威胁敌人让步，但也包含一些进阶移动技巧的描述。

messages.plural: copies of The Book of Dances

messages.msgid: This massive antique book documents dances from all around the world in great detail.  A perceptive reader could learn a lot about defensive footwork from some of the war dances.
translations: 一本厚重的古董书，里面详尽地记载了世界各地的舞蹈，包括一些有关防御的战斗舞步。

messages.plural: copies of The Complete Book about Dodgeball

messages.msgid: A small book from a Physical Education and Health teacher about the simple game of dodgeball, its rules and variations, tricks, and what it can teach students.  Sadly, the book contains surprisingly poor grammar, and the informal conversational tone makes it difficult to follow at times.
translations: 一本由教授体育与健康的老师撰写的书，内容涉及简单的躲避球游戏及其规则、变体和技巧，以及学生可以从中学到什么。 遗憾的是，这本书的语法出奇地糟糕，不规范的说法时常让人难以理解。

messages.msgid: A comprehensive guide on what to do in dangerous situations on the street and beyond - ways to improve your awareness skills, de-escalate the situation or, if it is not possible, defend yourself and your family in every possible manner, violent or not.
translations: 一本全面的指南，关于在大街上陷入危险时该怎么做，关于如何提高关注力，化解危险。如果威胁实在难以避免，则尽可能地保护你自己与家人-以暴力或非暴力的方式。

messages.msgid: This book explores the mechanics, mysteries, and methods of upright walking - why, how, and when.  Includes a big chapter on how different martial arts exploit this mode of movement.
translations: 这本书研究直立行走的机制、奥秘和方法 - 以及为何，如何，何时使用技巧。其中有一大章是关于不同的武术如何运用这种移动方法的。

messages.msgid: The Kids' Guide to Acting and Stagecraft.

"The Kids' Guide to Acting and Stagecraft".  This book is packed with engaging outdoor games, complete with rules, strategies, and tips for mastering each activity, along with some simple drills to train skills in an easy way.
translations: "扮演与编剧指南儿童版"。这本书里全是户外游戏及其规则、策略，以及熟练掌握各个项目的小提示。它还教授轻松训练对应技能的练习。
为孩子准备的自卫手册
messages.plural: copies of Self-defense for Your Child

messages.msgid: A fully-illustrated practical course of simple techniques to defend your child from bullies or predators.  You doubt it will help much for a real child, but you found some interesting info here.
translations: 一个完整的图解实用课程，包含简单的技巧，可以保护你的孩子免受欺凌或掠夺者的侵害。 你怀疑它对真正的孩子有多大帮助，但你在这里发现了一些有趣的信息。

messages.plural: copies of Protective Measures: A Graphic Novel

messages.msgid: Modern comics about an unnamed Hero that protects people without any superpowers, using only his body and different martial arts.  The artwork is well-illustrated and shows the movement and strategy of each character, but the plot is fairly simple.
translations: 一本现代漫画书，讲述一位无名英雄靠自己的身体和武功保护普通人的故事。画得很精致，每个角色的动作都栩栩如生，可惜情节有些乏味。

messages.msgid: Treasury of Legends about Western Dancing
messages.plural: copies of Treasury of Legends about Western Dancing

messages.msgid: Written by Emanuel Nogueira, a constabulario and historian of Nuevo Laredo, this massive book details the movements and cultural legacies of a variety of North American folk dances.
translations: 由墨西哥新拉雷多的历史学家、警察伊曼纽尔·诺盖拉撰写，这本厚书详细描述了北美西部各种民俗舞蹈的发展演变和流传下来的文化遗产。

messages.msgid: A Guide To Making Yourself A Hard Target
messages.plural: copies of A Guide To Making Yourself A Hard Target

messages.msgid: Written by self-defense instructor Neal Martin, this book describe techniques and movesets you need to train to avoid being a victim, as well as avoid trouble with the law in the aftermath.
translations: 这本书由防御技巧大师尼尔·马丁所著，记载的技巧和步伐可以让你免于受到伤害…或是在惹事后逃之夭夭。

messages.msgid: The Ultimate Guide to Unarmed Self Defense
messages.plural: copies of The Ultimate Guide to Unarmed Self Defense

messages.msgid: This book contains a lot of info about awareness, prevention, and defense in unarmed fights.
translations: 这本书提供了很多信息，囊括了徒手搏击中的意识、闪避和防御。

messages.plural: copies of Knife Self-Defense for Combat

messages.msgid: A small manual about skills you need to defend yourself in armed street fights.
translations: 一本小册子，介绍了在街头武装打斗中自卫所需技能。

messages.msgid: A dark book with a barbarian on the cover, this guide talks about how to obtain skills for the streets, battlefields and… playing fields?
translations: 一本黑色的书，封面上有个野蛮人，探讨如何习得让你在街头、战场上驰骋的技艺。貌似在游乐场也挺有用？
战争机器是如何养成的

messages.msgid: "How to Transform Yourself Into A Vicious And Deadly Street Fighter".  This book, despite having a gladiator on the cover, describes pretty practical ways to obtain the psychology, physiology, and combat potential of a real warrior, ancient or modern.
translations: "如何将你自己变成一个凶狠的、致命的街头战士"。尽管封面画了个古代角斗士，这本书关于锻炼身体与心灵、激发潜能方面的建议都非常实用。让你成为一个真正的战士，无论古代还是现代。

messages.plural: copies of Understanding the Human Foot

messages.msgid: A full color, updated overview of the structure of the feet, with essential info about its functions, demonstrating how the foot relates to and interacts with the rest of the body during movement.
translations: 一本全彩书籍，从最新的研究展现了人脚的结构，提供了必要的解释信息，举例说明了它是如何在运动中与人体的其它部位关联和互动的。

messages.msgid: A tourist-centric guide to points of interest throughout the country.  Though it focuses on the north-central US, the driving sections contain some practical tips on proper driving techniques.
translations: 一个记载了全国各个地点的手册，它专注于介绍美国中北部，其中一些内容也与驾驶技术有关。

messages.msgid: A travelogue about a group of teenagers in the late nineties.
translations: 90年代末关于一群青少年到处旅行的游记。

messages.msgid: A notebook about living off-the-grid, with a wide collection of stories, examples, tips, and advice.
translations: 一本笔记本，记录了大量有关离群索居的故事、例子、技巧和建议。

messages.msgid: Traffic: Why We Drive the Way We Do
translations: 交通： 为什么我们可以这样开车
messages.plural: copies of Traffic: Why We Drive the Way We Do

messages.msgid: A big research book that talks about how roads are built, why they're built in such a manner, and what we can do to improve it.
translations: 一本硕大的研究书籍，讲述了道路是如何建造的，为什么会以这样的方式建造，以及我们可以做什么来改善它。

messages.msgid: Lots of articles about cars and driving techniques.
translations: 一本面向车迷的杂志，包含许多关于汽车和驾驶的事情的文章。

messages.msgid: A nice-looking magazine about the automobile industry, with shiny images and long articles.  Dated 2019.
translations: 有关汽车工业的漂亮杂志，图片闪亮，文章漫长。日期是2019年。

messages.msgid: A monthly report about recent changes in the transport industry.
A shabby magazine about new and old cars, automobile reviews, general motorsports, and DIY.
translations: 一本破旧杂志，内容包括新旧汽车、汽车点评、赛车运动、和汽车DIY。

messages.msgid: An absolutely generic monthly magazine about the automotive industry.
translations: 一本汽车工业的权威通用月刊。

messages.msgid: Flashy journal about cars, racing, and mechanics.
translations: 有关汽车、赛车和机械的华丽期刊。

messages.msgid: An automotive magazine, focused on heavily modifying trucks, SUVs, and cars powered by diesel.
translations: 汽车杂志，专注于重载改装卡车、SUV和柴油动力车。

messages.msgid: A really old issue about classic car maintenance and restoration.
translations: 古董杂志，内容是保养和修复老爷车。

messages.msgid: Monthly magazine about hot rodding, drag racing, and muscle cars.
translations: 有关改装车、飙车、肌肉车的月刊。

messages.msgid: Boring automobile magazine with a big shiny label.
translations: 无聊的汽车杂志，附带一个大标签。

messages.msgid: It seems to be a car magazine, but you can only understand the images, as the text is written in another language.
translations: 看上去是一本汽车杂志，但你只能看懂上面的图片，因为文字是另一种语言。

messages.plural: copies of The Rules of the Road

messages.msgid: A thick textbook for beginning drivers.  It contains chapters on laws, safe vehicle operation, and defensive driving concepts.
translations: 一本专用于教导新司机的厚重教科书。包含了法律，安全的车辆操作，和防御型驾驶理念的章节。

messages.msgid: Guide to Passing the Driving Test
messages.plural: copies of Guide to Passing the Driving Test

messages.msgid: A thick, heavy book about every thing you may be asked in your driving exam.  The biggest part of the book contains a 'theory test' with detailed answers, and many how-to's related to driving overall.
translations: 一本厚重的书，讲述了驾驶考试中可能出现的每一个问题。书中最大的部分是"理论考试"，有详细的答案，还有许多与驾驶有关的方法。

messages.msgid: The official DVSA guide to driving
messages.plural: copies of The official DVSA guide to driving

messages.msgid: This book is packed with comprehensive information about driving, how to do it properly, and take joy in it.  You wonder how this manual made it here, as DVSA is a British organization, and the book contains information about specific British driving rules.
translations: 这本书包含了关于驾驶的全面信息，如何正确、快乐地开车。但这本手册为什么会出现在这里呢，明明DVSA是一个英国组织，内容也都是以英国交规为准。

messages.msgid: Automated Driving and Driver Assistance Systems
translations: 自动驾驶与驾驶员辅助系统
messages.plural: copies of Automated Driving and Driver Assistance Systems

messages.msgid: This book explains the technologies and approaches of advanced driving systems, how they are designed, and why it is hard to get a good result.  It is difficult to understand sometimes, but it shows driving from a perspective an average driver wouldn't think about.
translations: 这本书解释了先进驾驶系统的技术和手段，从它们是如何设计的，到为什么很难取得好的效果。这本书有时很难理解，但它从一个普通司机不会想到的角度展示了驾驶。

messages.plural: copies of The Driving Instructor's Handbook

messages.msgid: Detailed textbook about how to provide driving lessons, what may be discussed, and how to prevent dangerous situations and collisions.
translations: 关于如何提供驾驶课程、应该讨论的内容以及如何防止危险情况和碰撞的详细教科书。

messages.msgid: A tourist-centric guide to points of interest throughout the country.  This particular copy is apparently the Anonymous Anarchist's Annual: the cover conceals a wealth of ways to help stick it to The Man, along with plenty of advice for avoiding police.
translations: 一本以观光客为对象的全国名胜游览指导书册。这本特制的合订本显然是年度的匿名游客点评汇总大全。封面之下包括了丰富技巧以及大量避免被交通警察找上麻烦的建议。

messages.msgid: Classic illegal manual about making weapons and explosives.  The first page contains a quote from its author William Powell, that describes it as "a youthful indiscretion or mistake that can haunt someone during their early years or even longer".
translations: 关于制造武器和爆炸物的经典非法手册。第一页包含其作者威廉·鲍威尔的一段话，写道："年轻时的轻率行为或错误，可能困扰某人的前半生或者更久"。

messages.plural: copies of Science of Revolutionary Warfare

messages.msgid: A small, shabby book about making explosives, poisons, and weapons with resources you may find in your backyard.
translations: 一本破旧的迷你书，内容是关于如何利用你可能在后院找到的资源制作炸药、毒药和武器。

messages.plural: copies of The Poor Man's James Bond

messages.msgid: A collection of American paramilitary knowledge throughout history, containing a lot of information about how to make dangerous weapons and explosives in pretty dry language.
translations: 美国历史上的准军事知识集锦，包含大量制造危险武器和爆炸物的信息，但行文十分枯燥。

messages.msgid: A college textbook on circuit design.
translations: 一本关于电子电路设计的大学课本。

messages.msgid: A textbook-sized book of electronics and robotics experiments.
translations: 一本教科书大小的关于电子学和机器人的实验用书。

messages.msgid: An amusing magazine about ham radio, with lots of diagrams and illustrations for making your own electronic devices.
translations: 一本有趣的无线电杂志，收录大量教你如何自行制造电子设备的插图和图表。

messages.msgid: A basic manual of electronics and circuit design.
translations: 一本基础的电子学和电路设计手册。

messages.msgid: This reference manual contains datasheets and pinout diagrams for 101 of the most popular IC chips, including the 555 timer, LM358 op-amp, and LM317 voltage regulator, along with logic chips from the 74xx family, and even the 6502 8-bit processor.  If you want to do anything useful with integrated circuits, a reference like this would be indispensable.
translations: 这本本参考手册包含101种最流行IC芯片的数据手册和引脚图，包括555定时器、LM358运放器和LM317稳压器，以及74xx系列的逻辑芯片，甚至6502 8位处理器的电路。如果你想用这些芯片做些有用的事情，像这样的参考资料是必不可少的。

messages.plural: copies of Amateur Home Radio for Enthusiasts

messages.msgid: A book about ham radio and citizen's band radio.  It contains numerous diagrams and illustrations explaining the science behind the electronics.
translations: 一本关于业余级无线电和民用无线电台的书。包含了大量的图册以及漂亮的插图解释背后的科学原理。

messages.msgid: One side of this sheet is printed with a meaningless jumble of characters, but the other side shows a complicated, hand-drawn circuit diagram.
translations: 一份全是些无意义的杂乱字符的打印稿，但另一面却手绘着一副非常复杂的电路设计图。

messages.msgid: The Role of Robotics in Modern Day Manufacturing
translations: 机器人在现代制造业中扮演的角色
messages.plural: copies of The Role of Robotics in Modern Day Manufacturing

messages.msgid: A hefty book containing a whole bunch of technical info on industrial robotics.  While constructing these robots are no doubt outside any realm of feasibility, the information provided still has a fair bit to teach about complex electronics.
translations: 一本厚重的书籍，塞满了关于工业机器人的技术细节。虽然在灾变后的世界重建这些机器人像天方夜谭，但书中知识仍能教会你不少精密构造的门道。

messages.msgid: This hefty binder contains a multitude of diagrams and technical specifications for various electronic materials.  Some of the diagrams use symbols you've not seen before…
translations: 这个沉重的活页夹里装满了各种图表，以及许多电子仪器的技术要点。有些图表上的符号你还是第一次见到……

messages.msgid: This DoubleTech Industries binder has several intimidating security warnings on the cover.  Probably because it contains complete design specs, technical drawings, and test results for their military-grade bionic implants.
translations: 这本 DoubleTech 工业的技术档案的封面上有许多吓人的安全警告，或许是因为里面记载了他们军用级生化插件的完整设计参数、设计图与测试结果。

messages.msgid: plans for a radio repeater mod
messages.plural: plans for a radio repeater mod

messages.msgid: Instructions on how to create a mod for a radio station terminal which converts the entire system into a repeater.
translations: 这本书教会你制造一个简单的插件，该插件可以将整个无线电终端转换为一个无线电中继器。

messages.msgid: An advanced college textbook on circuit theory, design, and organization.
translations: 一本先进的大学级教科书，教你如何电路理论和设计与制造。

messages.plural: copies of Robots for Fun & Profit

messages.msgid: A rare book on the design of robots, with lots of helpful step-by-step guides.
translations: 一本少见的关于机器人制造的书，内容包含各种有用的循序渐进的教程。

messages.msgid: A heavy and disparate binder detailing the deactivation, storage and transport procedures for a so called "Trifacet" UGV.  The pages and schematics within have been compiled from the internal reports of a vast array of governmental agencies, many of which you had never heard of before.
translations: 一叠沉重且夹杂着各种纸张的手册，用活页夹固定，详细说明了如何关闭、储存及运输所谓的"三琢面"无人车的步骤。其中的书页和原理图是根据大量政府机构的内部报告汇编而成，许多机构名称你以前从未听说过。

messages.msgid: A printed technical reference for the Exodii's CBM interface wire kit using numerous alien symbols along with Anglic terminology.  Thankfully someone's hand-written a legend for those symbols and terms along the margins, but it'll still take significant electronics knowledge to decipher this document.
translations: 一本印刷的流亡族的 CBM 接口布线组参考资料，使用了许多未知符号和英吉利语术语。谢天谢地，有人在页边空白处为这些符号和术语手写了一个图例，但仍然需要大量的电子知识来破译这份文件。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Uncanny, these are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the nurse bot.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有非凡公司标志的护士机器人组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Uncanny, these are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the grocery bot.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有非凡公司标志的食杂店机器人组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the security bot.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 安防无人机的组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the skitterbot.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 掠行无人机的组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the cleaner bot.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 清洁机器人的组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the miner bot.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 排爆机器人的组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。
实验室原型无人机原理图

messages.msgid: Assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the lab defense bot.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 实验室原型无人机的组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Northrop, these are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the dispatch.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有诺斯洛普标志的派遣者装配施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据装配施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Bearing the logo of Northrop, these are assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the military dispatch.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 印有诺斯洛普标志的军用派遣者装配施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据装配施工图回收零部件重新组装机器人。

messages.msgid: Assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the anti-materiel turret.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 反器材炮塔的组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装炮塔。

messages.msgid: Assembly plans, design specs, and technical drawings for the milspec searchlight.  Most of this is useless to you, but you could use the assembly plans to re-assemble the robot from salvaged parts.
translations: 军用探照灯的组合施工图、设计规范以及技术图纸。其中大部分没什么用了，但是可以根据组合施工图回收零部件重新组装使用。

messages.plural: copies of The Art of Glassblowing

messages.msgid: A textbook that illustrates the science and technique of the ancient art of glassblowing.
translations: 一本传授古代玻璃吹制工艺的教科书。

messages.msgid: Plastics & Polymers: Projects for the Classroom
translations: 塑料与聚合物：课堂项目
messages.plural: copies of Plastics & Polymers: Projects for the Classroom

messages.msgid: A textbook that goes through types and material properties of various common plastics, and how to use them in several common projects.
translations: 一本介绍了各种常见塑料的类型和材料特性的教科书，以及如何在几个课堂合作项目中使用它们。

messages.msgid: A textbook with information about casting various types of metals.
translations: 一本介绍各种金属铸造的教科书。

messages.msgid: A textbook with information about alloying various types of metals.
translations: 一本介绍各种金属合金化的教科书。

messages.plural: copies of The Bronze Age Encyclopedia

messages.msgid: A huge textbook with information about the historic use of bronze around the world, with well illustrated instructions of the manufacturing process of armor, weapons and bronze tools.
translations: 一本厚重的教科书，对世界各地使用青铜的历史进行了详细记载，也有带插图的指导步骤，说明如何制造盔甲、武器以及各种青铜工具。

messages.plural: copies of Historic Warfare: The Bronze Age

messages.msgid: An in-depth magazine about the use of bronze weapons in warfare.  There are some images about their fabrication process.
translations: 一本十分有深度的期刊，讲述战争中青铜器的使用。其中配有一些青铜器制造过程的图片。

messages.msgid: The Prop Builder's Molding and Casting Handbook
translations: 道具制造商的成型和铸造手册
messages.plural: copies of The Prop Builder's Molding and Casting Handbook

messages.msgid: The first book to contain, in one comprehensive volume, every molding and casting procedure of use to the theater props builder of any skill level.  The author demonstrates the techniques involved in over thirty materials from papier-mache to breakaway glass.
translations: 首部仅用一卷文字就全方位介绍及展示了剧院道具制造过程中每个成型和铸造步骤所使用的所有技艺的百科全书。作者展示了从纸浆模型到易碎玻璃工艺等30多种不同材料道具的制作工艺。

messages.msgid: A comprehensive and illustrated history of the techniques used to make crowns, bracelets, necklaces, and other types of jewelry.
translations: 一本全面且附有插图的历史书，包含了很多用于制造皇冠、手镯、项链以及其他珠宝饰品的技术。

messages.msgid: A fun quarterly magazine all about macaroni art and things you can make by supergluing found objects together.
translations: 一本很有趣的季刊杂志，主要介绍了如何通过将各种手头杂物用强力胶随意拼凑成各式各样的手工艺品。

messages.msgid: A large, paperback book detailing a hundred and one beginner's projects in fabrication.
translations: 一本大块头的平装书，包含了制造初学者所需上百种制造配方。

messages.msgid: This hefty book is devoted to folks looking to handcraft their own arrows.  It starts with a hip and snappy disclaimer about the risks, both physical and legal, of using explosives and flammable materials.  Look for its companion, "The Bowyer's Buddy"!
translations: 这本大厚书为那些想手工造箭的朋友们编写。开头用不太靠谱的轻佻语气提了两句制造过程中可能出现的危险（生理上的和法律上的）——"不对爆炸或灼伤引起的生命或财产损失负任何责任"。去找找它的姊妹篇吧——《弓师之朋》！

messages.msgid: This hefty book is dedicated to craftsfolk and outdoors-y types looking to make their own bows.  It recommends its companion volume "The Fletcher's Friend" for instructions on producing their ammunition.
translations: 这本大厚书为那些想要打造名弓的DIY狂和户外运动狂热者们提供所有他们想要的信息。结尾处它大力推荐它的姊妹篇——《箭客之友》，那里面记录了所有配套的"弹药"制法。

messages.msgid: Everything you could ever want to know about handloading ammunition, sealed with a… childproof cover.  Apparently a liability thing, because the chapter on explosive rounds covers them in excellent detail too.
translations: 这本书介绍了关于手工复装弹药的一切知识，而且封面上还有个……儿童锁，显然是为了让发行商免责而设置的，因为关于爆炸弹的章节描写的也太过于详细了。

messages.msgid: This Rivtech binder warns that "Unauthorized readers are our best test subjects." With good reason: it contains complete design specs and technical drawings for their entire line of products.
translations: 这是一本Rivtech武器设计书，扉页上印着："未经授权而阅读本书的读者是我们最好的实验对象！"这本书详尽地记录了全套Rivtech无壳弹系列枪械的设计原理和工程图。
研究日志（古斯塔夫博士）

messages.msgid: This paper notebook is mostly full of boring logs, experimental observations and notes.  Mixed in, however, are musings on how to use the lab's vapor deposition machine to deposit amorphous carbon in a diamond-like form onto common metals.  The author's intended goal was a better non-stick frying pan, but you can think of a couple of better uses for it.
translations: 这本笔记里写满了无趣的记录、实验的观察与注释。其中混杂着如何用实验室的气相沉积机将无定形碳以类钻石结构蒸镀到普通金属表面的知识。虽然作者的本意只是想要一个更好的不粘锅，但你一定能想到更好的用途。

messages.msgid: A sizable how-to guide for making hand-to-hand combat weapons.  Though the processes are thoroughly detailed and several illustrations are provided, they rely heavily on technical jargon.  More for machinists-turned-weaponsmiths than streetfighters, really.
translations: 一本关于徒手武器制造的合订本。虽然过程描述很详细，还附上了几幅插图，但由于书中包含不少专业术语，需要有机械系的专业知识才能读懂。

messages.plural: copies of The Art of Japanese Armormaking

messages.msgid: This in-depth and technical text details various forms of ancient Japanese armor crafting, and is well illustrated with lots of photos.
translations: 这本书深入而专业地描述了各种形式的古代日本盔甲制造，并且配以照片。

messages.msgid: Arms and Armor of Imperial China
translations: 古代中国的武器和护甲
messages.plural: copies of Arms and Armor of Imperial China

messages.msgid: This textbook details the military history of ancient China, with a particular focus on the nature of historical arms and armor.  It also details some of the equipment used by other cultures that came into conflict with the empire over various dynasties.
translations: 这本教科书详细介绍了古代中国的历史，特别侧重于历史上的武器及护甲。它还详细介绍了一些在过去朝代中与帝国发生冲突的蛮夷们所使用的装备。

messages.msgid: Tools of Warfare in the Arabic World
translations: 阿拉伯世界的战争工具
messages.plural: copies of Tools of Warfare in the Arabic World

messages.msgid: This exhaustive book details various forms of medieval period Middle Eastern and South Asian weapons and armor.  It is incredibly detailed with diagrams and pictures, but quite dry.
translations: 这本内容详实的书事无巨细介绍了中世纪中东和南亚时期各种形式的武器和盔甲。它及其详尽，有图表和图片，但也相当枯燥。

messages.plural: copies of Studies in Historic Armorsmithing

messages.msgid: This in-depth and technical text details various forms of ancient European armor crafting, and is well illustrated with lots of photos.
translations: 这本书深入而专业地描述了各种形式的古代欧洲盔甲制造，并且配以照片。

messages.msgid: The Art of Warfare in Precolumbian Mesoamericas
translations: 前哥伦比亚时代中美洲战争艺术
messages.plural: copies of The Art of Warfare in Precolumbian Mesoamericas

messages.msgid: This intricate history book details the history of Mesoamerican warfare from the sources of the native codices, Spanish records and contemporary historians.  It contains descriptive diagrams and information on few of the weapons and armor used, mainly of the Nahuatl speaking peoples.  You reckon you could craft a few of these weapons with steel instead of obsidian.
translations: 这本复杂的历史书详细介绍了中美洲战争的历史，这些史料来自当地的抄本、西班牙的记录和当代历史学家。它载有关于主要由纳瓦特尔语民族所使用的少数武器和护甲的描述图表和资料。你估计你可以用钢铁而不是黑曜石来制作这类武器。

messages.msgid: A thick, hardbound book detailing countless projects for inventions that claim to improve all aspects of life.
translations: 一本厚重的硬壳精装书，里面介绍了无数声称能够提升方方面面生活品质的各类小发明小案例。

messages.plural: copies of A History of Firefighting

messages.msgid: This in-depth and technical text details the history of firefighting from ancient times into the modern era, with a focus on the technology used to save lives.
translations: 一本深入而专业地描述了从古至今的消防历史的工具书，并专注于描述各种用于救死扶伤的技术手段。

messages.plural: copies of The Swords of the Samurai

messages.msgid: This in-depth and technical text details various forms of ancient Japanese sword smithing, and is well illustrated with step by step photo instructions.
translations: 这本书深入而专业地描述了各种形式的古代日本武器制造，并且配以全程照片。

messages.msgid: This in-depth and technical text details various forms of ancient European weapon smithing, and is well illustrated with step by step photo instructions.
translations: 这本书深入而专业地描述了各种形式的古代欧洲武器制造，并且配以全程照片。

messages.msgid: A rather technical textbook that illustrates the science and technique of becoming a better welder.
translations: 一个相当有实力的技术教材，科学与技术可以让你的焊接机更完美。

messages.msgid: A paperback book detailing 101 home repair projects for the novice carpenter.
translations: 一本平装书，为新手木匠详细提供了进行家居修缮的入门教程。

messages.plural: copies of The Complete Home Repair Guide

messages.msgid: A massive book that details virtually every aspect of remodeling and repairing a home, with concise terminology aimed at experienced carpenters.
translations: 一本厚重的书，详细讲述了如何进行居家修缮，内容运用了资深老手才看的懂得简洁术语。

messages.msgid: A riveting periodical all about birdhouses and their construction.
translations: 一本关于各式鸟笼和对应建造方法的期刊。

messages.msgid: A large, paperback book detailing several beginner's projects in construction.
translations: 一本大的平装书，详细描述着初学者的建筑学入门知识。

messages.msgid: A textbook on civil engineering and construction.
translations: 一本关于土木工程和建筑知识的书。

messages.msgid: This classic reference work contains extensive, dense chapters and tables on materials, metrology, toolmaking, gears, threading and more.  This recent edition includes extensive data on the latest techniques in additive manufacturing.  If you need to know how best complete a certain machining operation, the answer lies somewhere in these pages.
translations: 这本经典的参考书目包含了大量密集的章节和表格，内容涉及材料学、度量学、工具制造、传动装置、螺纹车工等各个方面。而这本最新的修订版，还包含了很多关于三维打印技术的数据。如果你急于知道如何最优地完成某项加工作业，答案就藏在这本书的某一页里。

messages.msgid: A collection of notable uses of concrete.  Contains detailed directions on how to mix and use cement to form useful aggregates.
translations: 这本书介绍了混凝土的各类主要用途。同时详细说明了混合水泥及骨料制成混凝土的过程。

messages.plural: copies of WX010 Living Armor Observations

messages.msgid: This sheaf of papers seems to describe maintenance on a new form of ballistic armor.  "the regenerative plates though promising for field use do require maintenance or combat to stop from becoming overgrown".
translations: 这份文件似乎描述了如何维护一种新型防弹装甲板。"再生装甲板虽然有望投入实际使用，但确实需要日常维护或参与实战，以防止生长过度"。

messages.plural: copies of Artillery of the Ancients

messages.msgid: This is a history book detailing the siege machines and field artillery of some ancient civilizations.  It contains detailed diagrams that explain how such devices were assembled and maintained.
translations: 这是一本历史书，详细介绍了一些古代文明的攻城器械和野战火炮。书中包含详细的图表，解释了这些设备是如何组装和维护的。
迪诺-戴夫的纸板笔记本
messages.plural: copies of Dino Dave's cardboard notebook

messages.msgid: This school notebook contains an astounding amount of "recipes" of various cardboard utilities, ranging from the wholly impractical to completely impossible.  Despite that, they're illustrated in a surprisingly thorough manner, to the point where you could possibly learn something from studying the chicken scratch and schematics in detail.  The last page thanks a number of names, some of which you recognize from the refugee center.  Your name covers half the page.  At the bottom, it warns you not to let "the sandman" read it.
translations: 这本学校笔记本包含了数量惊人的各种纸板工具的配方，从完全不实用到完全不可能。尽管如此，它们的图解却出人意料地详尽，以至于你可以通过详细研究这些鸡毛蒜皮和示意图学到一些东西。最后一页是一些名字，其中一些你在难民中心见过。你的名字占了半页。 底部警告你不要让"沙人 "看到这本笔记。

messages.plural: copies of Guide to Advanced Emergency Care

messages.msgid: A thick textbook for paramedics describing advanced lifesaving procedures and field-expedient care methods.
translations: 一本厚厚的教科书，描述了高级救生程序和现场急救处理方法。
一本有关急救知识讲解的杂志，每期的封面都是一个惹火的护士女郎。

messages.msgid: The Big Book of First Aid
messages.plural: copies of The Big Book of First Aid

messages.msgid: It's big and heavy, but full of great information about first aid.
translations: 一本又大又重的书，但是记载着大量的急救知识。

messages.plural: copies of Pocket Guide to First Aid

messages.msgid: This pocket-sized leather-bound guide to first aid combines a wealth of concise information with simple to follow instructions and easy to read illustrations.
translations: 这本袖珍急救指南集合看起来很袖珍，但是里边蕴含大量简洁的信息，以及简单容易阅读的插图。

messages.msgid: A hardbound book detailing advanced first aid techniques and field-expedient medical care.
translations: 一本详细记载了高级急救技巧和现场急救处理方法的硬皮书。

messages.plural: copies of First Aid Kit Instruction Booklet

messages.msgid: Illustrated how-to guide for your first aid kit.
translations: 一本图文并茂的急救包使用手册。
内科医生案头参考资料

messages.msgid: This hefty volume contains all the legally mandated information relevant to physicians for writing prescriptions, generously supported by the efforts and contributions of major pharmaceutical companies.  For the most part, it provides information identical to what is available on that of medication packaging inserts, and cannot match the completeness of digital pharmaceutical references like MediSoft.  At least it doesn't need power to be used.
translations: 这本大部头参考书包含了所有法律规定的内科医生开具处方所需的信息，其编纂和出版离不开各大制药公司的大力支持与贡献。这本书绝大多数部分的内容和药物包装里的说明书完全一致，完整性也比不上 Medisoft 等数字化药物参考数据库，但至少它不需要插电就能阅读。

messages.msgid: This expansive text covers 'all domestic species and diseases in veterinary medicine worldwide'.  Should you need information regarding zoonotic diseases, off-label use of medication for animals, common dysfunctions and diseases of animals, or any other veterinary reference info, this is your book.  There are some interesting new chapters on animal cloning in this edition.
translations: 这本博大精深的书目号称收录了"全世界兽医学已知的、所有家养物种的所有疾病"。如果你需要了解有关动物传染病、未被写入说明书的动物药物用法、常见的动物机能失调或动物疾病、以及其他兽医学相关的参考信息，这本书会很适合你，而且这个新版本还增加了一些关于动物克隆的有趣新章节。

messages.plural: copies of Textbook of Advanced Toxicology

messages.msgid: This unassuming volume details the broad spectrum of chemical and biological toxins known to modern medicine.  While the obvious focus of the book is the therapy of such poisonings, there are lengthy sections describing the structure and synthesis of some compounds of interest.
translations: 这个大部头详细讲解了各类现代医学已知的化学物质和生物毒素。虽然这本书的重点在于中毒的治疗，但还是用很多篇幅描述了一些有趣的化合物的结构和合成。

messages.msgid: Reviews of firearms, and various useful tips about their use.
translations: 一本有关枪械的杂志，让你了解枪械用法，并给一些初学者的小提醒。

messages.msgid: Annual magazine about firearms, weapon collections, self-defense, same as some practical and legal advices.
translations: 关于枪支、武器收藏和自卫的年度杂志，以及一些实用的法律建议。

messages.msgid: A modern magazine about handguns, tactical weapons, knives, and shooting activities.  It says there is a fold-out target, but someone took it off.
translations: 一本关于手枪、战术武器、刀具和射击活动的现代杂志。上面说印有一页折叠式靶子，但有人把它拿掉了。

messages.msgid: "Special Weapons And Tactics for the prepared American", this magazine contains info about firearms, law enforcement, and related interests, with a focus on SWAT police officers.
translations: 这本杂志是"为有准备的美国人准备的特殊武器和战术"，包含枪支、执法等信息，重点关注特警。

messages.msgid: Small magazine about ammo and firearms, and how to choose, use, and maintain them properly.
translations: 关于如何选择、使用和正确维护强制与弹药的小杂志。

messages.msgid: Modern magazine for young people about firearms, self-defense, different competitions, and reviews.
translations: 面向年轻人的现代杂志，介绍枪支、自卫、各种竞赛以及评论。

messages.plural: copies of The Gun Owner's Handbook

messages.msgid: A thick soft-cover book that claims to be a complete guide to safely operating, maintaining, and repairing firearms.
translations: 一本厚重的软皮书，里面详细介绍了安全使用，养护和修理枪械的注意事项。

messages.plural: copies of FM 3-90-1: Offense And Defense

messages.msgid: Official U.S. Army manual about basics and tactics of moving and attacking a target - how to shoot, how to hide, how to retreat, and how to defend.
translations: 美国陆军官方手册，讲述了移动和攻击目标的基本知识和战术——如何射击、如何隐藏、如何撤退，以及如何防守。

messages.msgid: A journal about modern and old firearms, their style, manufacturing, and usage.
translations: 一本关于现代和旧式枪枪械型号、制造和使用的杂志。

messages.plural: copies of Owning a Modern Firearm

messages.msgid: Essential handbook detailing how to own, use, and properly maintain a modern-day firearm.
translations: 详细介绍如何拥有、使用和正确维护现代枪械的基本手册。

messages.msgid: Step-by-step instructions on how to use a gun, with lot of drills for each level.
translations: 由浅到深的枪械使用指南，每个级别都有大量的演习。

messages.plural: copies of The Illustrated History of Firearms

messages.msgid: A reference book that contains hundreds of images of firearms inside, with lot of comments from professionals and information about each model.
translations: 一本包含数百张枪械图片的参考书，里面有很多专业人士的评论和关于每种型号的信息。

messages.plural: copies of Long Range Shooting Handbook

messages.msgid: "The Complete Beginner's Guide to Precision Rifle Shooting", this book contains information about shooting equipment, terminology, principles, and covers the theory of long-range shooting.  It has a lot practical advices about marksmanship.
translations: "精确步枪射击的完全入门指南"，这本书包含了有关射击设备、术语、原则的信息，并涵盖了远程射击的理论，还有很多关于枪法的实用建议。

messages.msgid: "A Practical Treatise on the Enfield-Pritchett Rifle, Recently Adopted in the British Service".  This is a practical guide to using the newly adopted P-1853 Enfield Rifle-Musket.  Despite being written in 1854, it still has lot of useful information about shooting, as well as information about how to maintain this antique rifle.
translations: "关于最近在英国军队中采用的恩菲尔德-普里切特步枪的实用论述"。这是一本关于新采用的P-1853恩菲尔德膛线火枪的实用指南。尽管写于1854年，它仍然有很多关于射击，以及维护这种古董步枪的信息。

messages.plural: copies of Pocket Guide to Firearm Safety

messages.msgid: This pocket-sized leather-bound guide to firearm safety combines a wealth of concise information with simple to follow instructions and easy to read illustrations.
translations: 一本外观轻薄的袖珍指南书，里边蕴含大量简洁的信息，以及简单容易阅读的插图。
弹道学：理论、设计及应用
messages.plural: copies of Ballistics: Theory, Design, and Application

messages.msgid: This hefty, hardbound textbook is written in obtuse, complex language.  If you already knew a bit about engineering and fabrication, it might be a useful reference on gunsmithing and design, but without that knowledge it'd be better used to prop up a table.
translations: 这本大部头精装教材以艰深复杂的语言写成。如果你了解一些工程学和制造的相关知识，那它在枪械制造和设计方面是本有用的参考书；如果一点也不懂的话，那就只能用来垫桌脚了。

messages.plural: copies of The Complete Guide to Gunsmithing

messages.msgid: This fairly old book is a highly detailed and essential reference for any gun enthusiast, and covers everything from the use of proper tools to how to get a gunsmithing job.
translations: 这本年代久远的书对于任何枪械爱好者来说都是非常详细和必备的参考资料，涵盖了从合适工具的使用到如何获得枪械制造工作的一切。

messages.msgid: A guide for gun shop owners, this book contains lots of information about weapons and weapon maintenance.
translations: 写给枪械店老板的指南，包含了很多关于武器及其维护的信息。

messages.msgid: The book contains step-by-step instructions to repair and maintain all major rifle types, from the AR-15 and AK-47 to the M1 Garand.  It also details many different projects and enhancements for gun owners.
translations: 该书包含了从 AR-15、AK-47 到 M1 加兰德等所有主要步枪类型的维修和保养的逐步说明。里面还有枪主可能感兴趣的各种改装升级项目的详解。

messages.msgid: Gunsmithing: A Manual of Firearm Design, Construction, Alteration and Remodeling
translations: 枪械设计、制造、维修和改装手册
messages.plural: copies of Gunsmithing: A Manual of Firearm Design, Construction, Alteration and Remodeling

messages.msgid: This book contains extremely precise instructions for fixing different issues with your gun.  Having lots of modern photos is a huge advantage, though the fact that it's a reprint of a book from the 1950s is not.
translations: 这本书包含修复各种枪械故障的相当详细的步骤讲解。这本书的优点是里面有许多清晰的现代图片，但缺点是这本书只是 1950 年代的一本书籍的重印版。

messages.msgid: The Guns of John Moses Browning
translations: 约翰·摩西·勃朗宁与他的枪
messages.plural: copies of The Guns of John Moses Browning

messages.msgid: A major biography of John Moses Browning, "the Thomas Edison of guns", this book describes his story, and the inventions he made, as well as decisions behind their development, processes, manufacturing, and usage.
translations: 一本关于约翰·摩西·勃朗宁——"枪械界的托马斯·爱迪生"——的大型传记，讲述了勃朗宁的故事、他所发明的枪支以及这些枪支的研发、生产、组装、投入使用等环节背后的种种细节。

messages.msgid: DIY Guns: Easy DIY Gunsmithing Projects
messages.plural: issues of DIY Guns: Easy DIY Gunsmithing Projects

messages.msgid: A big magazine about different gunsmithing projects, from tuning your gun to making a brand new one using common techniques.
translations: 一本厚厚的杂志，记载了各种改枪的案例，从如何校准你的枪支到如何造一支全新的都有记载。

messages.plural: copies of The Book of the Crossbow

messages.msgid: This book details the long story of crossbows - a devastating weapon which improved medieval distance warfare drastically - with lot of illustrations and information about additional weapons, like ballistae and catapults.
translations: 这本书详细梳理了十字弩——一种彻底改变了中世纪近距离作战的强力武器——的历史，配有许多插图，还顺带介绍了弩炮和投石车等武器。

messages.msgid: An interesting quarterly report about rocket launchers and recoilless rifles.  There are lots of large, exciting photos of explosions and weaponry.
translations: 一本有趣的关于火箭发射器和无后座力炮的季刊。有很多篇幅巨大且让人兴奋的爆炸和武器插图。

messages.plural: copies of Launchers, Lobbers and Rockets Engineer

messages.msgid: DIY guide about different ballistic launchers, how they work, and how to build one.
translations: 关于各种弹道发射器的DIY指南书，讲述它们的工作原理与实现方法。

messages.msgid: This book shows the history of Soviet Multiple Rocket Launcher systems, developed in a late 1930s, the reasons to use it, problems solved while designing them, and tactics for using them.
translations: 这本书介绍了苏联于1930年代末期研发的多重火箭弹发射器系统的发展历史，还讲了选择它的理由，设计时的困难和具体使用方法。

messages.plural: copies of The Rocket Propelled Grenade

messages.msgid: Part of a big series about different small arms, this book details RPGs - how they were created, how they were used, and how they are used now in modern times.
translations: 这本书是关于不同小型武器的系列丛书的一部分，详细介绍了RPG——它们是如何被创造出来的，它们是曾经如何被使用的，以及它们在现代是如何使用的。

messages.msgid: A professional magazine about artillery, published by the US Field Artillery Corps.  Lots of articles analyze using modern artillery in different wars, modern and future technologies, and the most recent discoveries in ballistics and field engineering.
translations: 一本关于炮兵的专业杂志，由美国野战炮兵出版。里面许多文章分析了现代火炮在不同战争中的使用，现代和未来的技术，以及弹道学和野战工程的最新发现。

messages.plural: copies of Jane's Mortars and Rocket Launchers

messages.msgid: An incredibly detailed guide to modern rockets, mortars, grenade launchers, and recoilless weaponry.  Lavishly illustrated with color photographs, it contains a wealth of information.
translations: 一本详细指导现代火箭、迫击炮、榴弹发射器，枪械武器的杂志。包括插图与彩色照片，蕴含大量丰富的信息。

messages.msgid: Part of a big series about different small arms, this book tells about the M79.  Created to fill the gap between hand grenade and light mortar, this weapon became an iconic symbol of the Vietnam War, and still serves its role perfectly.
translations: 作为关于不同小型武器的大型系列的一部分，这本书讲述了 M79。这种武器旨在填补手榴弹和轻型迫击炮之间的空白，成为越南战争的标志性象征，并且仍然完美地发挥其作用。

messages.msgid: Catalogue of Standard Ordnance Items: Volume 3 & 4
translations: 标准军械目录：第3卷和第4卷
messages.plural: copies of Catalogue of Standard Ordnance Items: Volume 3 & 4

messages.msgid: A giant, comprehensive list of every U.S. Army weapon, munition, and piece of equipment that was used during World War II, with small, but detailed information about each of them.  Volume 3 describes light weapons like grenade launchers, recoilless rifles, man-portable anti-tank and air-defense missiles and mortars, and Volume 4 describes different heavy ammunition from 20mm to 16 inch hand and rifle grenades.
translations: 一份巨大而全面的清单，列出了第二次世界大战期间使用的每件美国陆军武器、弹药和装备，并附有关于每一种的小而详细的信息。第3卷描述了榴弹发射器、无后坐力步枪、便携式反坦克和防空导弹和迫击炮等轻武器，第4卷描述了从20毫米到16英寸（约41厘米）的各种重型弹药。

messages.msgid: FM 3-09: Fire Support and Field Artillery Operations
translations: 野战手册3-09：野战炮兵火力支援
messages.plural: copies of FM 3-09: Fire Support and Field Artillery Operations

messages.msgid: Official U.S. Army manual about principles and functions for fire support elements and field artillery.  Most of it is about the functions and operations of artillery, alongside some ballistic calculations.
translations: 关于火力支援部队和野战炮兵的原理和功能的美国陆军官方手册。其中大部分是关于火炮的功能和操作，也一些弹道计算。
野战手册3-22.3：装甲车炮击学

messages.msgid: Official U.S. Army manual about using different light weapons - M203, ITAS M41, TOW and Javelins.
translations: 美国陆军的官方手册，讲述如何使用Stryker装甲车车载武器，如M203、M41陶氏反坦克导弹和标枪反坦克导弹等。

messages.plural: copies of FM 23-11: 90mm Recoilless Rifle, M67

messages.msgid: Official U.S. Army manual for using the M67 anti-tank rifle - theory, practice, and essential information.
translations: 美国陆军的官方手册，讲述如何使用M67反坦克炮，包括理论、练习方法和相关信息。
简氏：火焰喷射器和燃烧武器
messages.plural: copies of Jane's Flamethrowers and Firestarters

messages.msgid: A detailed, full-colored guide to flamethrowers, incendiary weapons, and napalm.  It builds off of information provided in its sister book, Jane's Mortars and Rocket Launchers, and so it's mostly incomprehensible to anyone without prior knowledge.
translations: 一本全彩的，关于喷火器、燃烧武器和凝固汽油弹的详细指南。它以姊妹篇《简氏：迫击炮和火箭筒》为基础，因此对于没有相关知识的读者来说，很难读懂它。
麻省理工学院开锁指南
messages.plural: copies of MIT Guide to Lock Picking

messages.msgid: A home-made booklet with large black-and-white pictures of several types of modern locks and general information on how to crack them open.
translations: 一本自制的小册子，上面有着一些巨大的现代锁结构的黑白图示，以及如何打开它们的基本资料。

messages.plural: copies of The CIA Lockpicking Manual

messages.msgid: It says it is a reproduction of the United States Central Intelligence Agency's Field Operative Training Manual that describes how to lockpick.  For such a big name it has a surprisingly small amount of information, only covering the topic on a very basic level.
translations: 这本书自称来自美国中央情报局(CIA)关于撬锁的行动训练手册。盛名之下却难符其实，只讲了很基础的撬锁内容。

messages.plural: copies of Keys To The Kingdom

messages.msgid: This book contain lots of information for experienced lockpickers, like possible tools that can be used, different types of locks that were produced, and even some tips to avoid lockpicking - sometimes it's easier to break a lock, door, or even wall itself.
translations: 这本书包含了撬锁匠的经验，包括工具的选用、锁具的结构，甚至有避免被撬锁的技巧。"有些时候撬锁很难，与其撬开它还不如暴力拆锁，甚至是暴力拆墙"。

messages.msgid: The combined experience of a few different locksmiths of how to do it properly, what skillset is required, and where it is legal to use it.  It says it comes with a DVD, but you can't find it anywhere nearby.
translations: 综合了几个不同锁匠的经验，讲解如何正确地撬锁，需要哪些技巧，以及在何处使用才合法的。书上说附赠有DVD，但书页里没有，估计已经找不到了。

messages.msgid: A small, meticulously folded piece of paper, filled with tiny handwriting and some surprisingly precise diagrams of subway tunnels, ventilation shafts, and… guard shifts?  You have the feeling they weren't supposed to write any of this stuff down.
translations: 一张精心折叠的小纸条，上面写满了细小的笔迹和一张令人惊讶的精确地铁隧道图，通风井，还有……警卫值班表？你觉得他们不应该把这些东西就这样随意的记录下来。

messages.msgid: You add the hidden stations to your map
translations: 你在地图上标记了一些隐秘的站点。

messages.msgid: A printed topographical map of the local area.  Originally of military origin, it details the locations of evacuation centers and military facilities.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.
translations: 一份本地区的打印地形图。地图资料来自军方，详细记录了疏散中心和军事设施的位置。使用这份地图后会往你的地图上添加几个目标地点。

messages.msgid: You add roads and facilities to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了道路和重要设施。

messages.msgid: A hand-drawn map of the local area.  Whoever created it has marked down the locations of nearby supply sources including gun stores and gas stations.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.
translations: 一份当地的手绘地图。绘制这份地图的人标记了附近的物资补给点，包括枪店和加油站。使用它会在你的地图上将这些地方标注出来。

messages.msgid: You add roads and possible supply points to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了道路和可能的补给点。

messages.msgid: A road map for the local area.  Listing information on civic sites like hospitals and police stations, it can be used to add points of interest to your map.
translations: 一张本地行车路线图。主要标记了公共服务场所，如医院、警察局等等。使用后会在你的地图上将这些地方标注出来。

messages.msgid: You add roads and points of interest to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了道路和重要地点。

messages.msgid: A map of subway tunnels formerly used by public maintenance workers.  Using it will add subway lines and underground stations to your map.
translations: 一张曾经由维修人员使用的地铁线路图。使用后会在你的地图上将这些地方标注出来。

messages.msgid: You add subway lines and underground stations to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了地铁线路和地铁站。

messages.msgid: A schematic diagram of local subway networks, too stylized to garter much useful information.  Using it will add subway stations to your map.
translations: 当地地铁网络的示意图，然而太过花里胡哨，无法提供太多有用的信息。使用它可以将地铁站添加到地图中。

messages.msgid: You add subway stations to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了地铁站。

messages.msgid: A map of sewers formerly used by public maintenance workers.  Using it will add sewer systems and facilities to your map.
translations: 一张曾经由维修人员使用的排水系统线路图。使用后会在你的地图上将下水道系统和设施标注出来。

messages.msgid: You add sewer systems and facilities to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了下水道系统和设施。

messages.msgid: A printed guide to the best local trails.  It has general details about the trails, trailhead amenities, suggestions for the best thru-hikes, and advice on interacting with local wildlife in a responsible and respectful manner.
translations: 一本当地林间小径的向导手册印刷版。它提供了关于林间小径、小径起点设施、最佳徒步旅行路径建议，以及如何以负责且尊重的方式与当地野生动物互动的指导。

messages.msgid: You add trails and trailheads to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了林间小径和林间小径起点。

messages.msgid: This is glossy printed pamphlet for tourists that details local hotels and attractions.
translations: 一本铜版纸小册子，详尽介绍了本地旅店与旅游胜地。使用它将在你的地图添加兴趣点。

messages.msgid: You add roads and tourist attractions to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了道路和旅游景点。

messages.msgid: This is glossy printed pamphlet that details dining establishments in the local area.  Printed by the Chamber of Commerce, it lists the addresses of all the best diners and bars.  Using it will add points of interest to your map.
translations: 一本铜版纸小册子，由本地商会出版。上面标注了附近所有餐厅和酒吧的详细地址。使用它将在你的地图添加兴趣点。

messages.msgid: You add roads and restaurants to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了道路和餐厅。

messages.msgid: A printed satellite map of the local area.  Due to it's low quality and lack of map legend, you are unable to recognize most buildings.  Using it will add terrain and roads to your map.
translations: 这是当地的卫星地图。由于质量不高而且缺乏图例，你无法认出大多数建筑物。使用后会在你的地图上将地形和道路标注出来。

messages.msgid: You add terrain and roads to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了地形和道路。

messages.msgid: A printout of a local road map, with several buildings circled in red.  Using it will add roads and abandoned buildings to your map.
translations: 一份当地路线图的打印件，其中有几座建筑物以红色圈出。使用它将在你的地图上添加道路和废弃建筑。

messages.msgid: You add roads and abandoned buildings to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了道路和废弃建筑。

messages.msgid: A small brochure advertising for local restaurants with an address below each entry.  Using it will add roads an local restaurants, diners and bars to your map.
translations: 一本为当地餐厅做广告的小册子，每个条目下面都有对应的地址。使用它来在地图上标注出当地的道路、餐厅、饭馆和酒吧。

messages.msgid: You add roads and local restaurants, diners and bars to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、餐厅、饭馆和酒吧。

messages.msgid: A small brochure advertising for local food shopping possibilities with an address below each entry.  Using it will add roads, local grocery, convenience stores and bakeries to your map.
translations: 一本为当地副食店做广告的小册子，每个条目下面都有对应的地址。使用它来在地图上标注出当地的道路、杂货店、便利店以及面包店。

messages.msgid: You add roads, local grocery and convenience stores as well as bakeries to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、杂货店、便利店以及面包店。

messages.msgid: A small pamphlet advertising local goods and produce and places to purchase them.  Using it will add roads, markets, butchers, bakers and craft shops to your map.
translations: 一本小册子，用于宣传当地商品和农产品以及购物地点。使用它可以在地图上添加道路、市场、肉铺、面包房和工艺品商店。

messages.msgid: You add roads, markets, butchers, bakers and craft shops to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、市场、肉铺、面包房和工艺品商店。

messages.msgid: A small pamphlet advertising various local businesses encouraging you to get fit.  Using it will add roads, gyms and pools along with shops where you can buy sporting gear to your map.
translations: 一本小册子，用于当地各种建筑做广告，鼓励你健身。使用它可以在地图上添加道路、健身房、游泳池和可以购买运动器材的商店。

messages.msgid: You add roads, gyms and pools along with shops where you can buy sporting gear to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、健身房、游泳池和可以购买运动器材的商店。

messages.msgid: A small pamphlet advertising the benefits of different pets and local pet related facilities and shops.  Using it will add roads, pet shops, animal shelters, parks, trailheads and vets to your map.
translations: 一本小册子，用于宣传不同宠物和当地宠物相关设施和商店的好处。使用它可以在地图上添加道路、宠物店、动物收容所、公园、步道和兽医院。

messages.msgid: You add roads, pet shops, animal shelters, parks, trailheads and vets to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、宠物店、动物收容所、公园、步道和兽医院。

messages.msgid: A small pamphlet advertising local nightlife options.  Using it will add roads, bars, music venues, movie theaters and gambling halls to your map.
translations: 一本小册子，用于宣传当地夜生活建筑。使用它可以在地图上添加道路、酒吧、音乐场所、电影院和赌场。

messages.msgid: You add roads, bars, music venues, movie theaters and gambling halls to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、酒吧、音乐场所、电影院和赌场。

messages.msgid: A small pamphlet advertising current shooting related events and giving directions to local shooting facilities and gun stores funded by Remington.  Using it will add roads, gun stores, shooting ranges, outdoorsman stores and any shows to your map.
translations: 一本小册子，用于宣传当前与枪械有关的地点，比如由雷明顿资助的当地射击场所和枪支商店。使用它可以在地图上添加道路、枪支商店、射击靶场、户外用品商店和其他相关地点。

messages.msgid: You add roads, gun stores, shooting ranges, outdoorsman stores and any shows to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、枪支商店、射击靶场、户外用品商店和其他相关地点。

messages.msgid: A small brochure advertising for local museums, libraries and antique stores with an address below each entry.  Using it will add roads an local museums, libraries and antique stores to your map.
translations: 一本为当地博物馆、图书馆和古董店做广告的小册子，每个条目下面都有对应的地址。使用它来在地图上标注出当地的道路、博物馆、图书馆和古董店。

messages.msgid: You add roads and local museums, libraries and antique stores to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、博物馆、图书馆和古董店。

messages.msgid: A small brochure advertising for local malls with an address below each entry.  Using it will add roads an local malls and strip malls to your map.
translations: 一本为当地购物商场做广告的小册子，每个条目下面都有对应的地址。使用它来在地图上标注出当地的道路、商场和购物中心。

messages.msgid: You add roads and local malls and strip malls to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、商场和购物中心。

messages.msgid: A small brochure advertising for local home improvement stores and with an address below each entry.  Using it will add roads an local furniture, home improvement and gardening stores to your map.
translations: 一本为当地家装商店做广告的小册子，每个条目下面都有对应的地址。使用它来在地图上标注出当地的道路、家具店、家装店和园艺商店。

messages.msgid: You add roads and local furniture, home improvement and gardening stores to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、家具店、家装店和园艺商店。

messages.msgid: A small brochure advertising for local electronic and hardware stores as well as arcades and internet cafes with an address below each entry.  Using it will add roads and local electronic and hardware stores as well as arcades and internet cafes to your map.
translations: 一本为当地电器店、五金店、街机房和网吧做广告的小册子，每个条目下面都有对应的地址。使用它来在地图上标注出当地的道路、电器店、五金店、街机房以及网吧。

messages.msgid: You add roads and local electronic and hardware stores as well as arcades and internet cafes to your map.
translations: 你在地图上标记了当地的道路、电器店、五金店、街机房以及网吧。

messages.plural: copies of The Spirit of Aikido

translations: 一本完整的合气道指南。

messages.msgid: Las Nueve Reglas de la Montante
translations: Las Nueve Reglas de la Montante
messages.plural: copies of Las Nueve Reglas de la Montante

messages.msgid: Thankfully, someone has scrawled translations in the margins of this guide to Barbaran Montante.  Judging by the notation, this greatsword and war hammer training manual is also a form of poem.
translations: 你根本看不懂这些西班牙语的内容，但谢天谢地，有人在页边的空白处潦草地写下了译文，这是一本巴巴兰重剑术的指南。从注释来看，这本大剑和战锤武术的训练手册，同时还是一本诗集。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to boxing.  Let's get ready to rough-up some ruffians!
translations: 一本完整的拳击指南。让我们准备好暴揍一些地痞吧！
一本完整的巴西战舞指南。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Crane Kung Fu.
translations: 一本完整的鹤形拳拳法秘籍。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Dragon Kung Fu.
translations: 一本完整的龙形拳拳法秘籍。
菲律宾剑棍术实用教程
一本完整的菲律宾剑棍术指南。
一本完整的西洋击剑术指南。

messages.plural: copies of The Shōtōkan Karate Handbook

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Shōtōkan Karate.
translations: 一本完整的松涛馆空手道手册。

messages.plural: copies of Bōjutsu The Matsumoto System

translations: 一部完整的日本棍术指南。

messages.plural: copies of Ultimate Guide to Kickboxing

messages.msgid: The ultimate guide to learning and mastering kickboxing, from beginner to black belt.
translations: 学习和掌握踢拳的终极指南，包含了从初学者到黑带的所有知识。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Krav Maga.
translations: 一本完整的马伽术（以色列搏击防身术）指南。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Leopard Kung Fu.
translations: 一本完整的豹形拳拳法秘籍。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Muay Thai.

messages.plural: copies of The Book of Five Rings

messages.msgid: A primer on Miyamoto Musashi's style of combat and philosophy, Niten Ichi-Ryu.
translations: 讲述宫本武藏的二天一流的理念与技巧的书。
一本完整的古希腊搏击的指南。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Pencak Silat.
translations: 一本完整的班卡苏拉刀术指南。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Snake Kung Fu.
translations: 一本完整的蛇形拳拳法秘籍。

messages.plural: copies of Official Taekwondo Training Manual

translations: 一部完整的跆拳道指南。

messages.plural: copies of Becoming One with the Tao

messages.msgid: A complete guide to T'ai Chi Ch'uan.
translations: 一本完整的太极拳拳法秘籍。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Tiger Kung Fu.
translations: 一本完整的虎形拳拳法秘籍。

messages.plural: copies of Zui Quan and You

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Zui Quan.
translations: 一本完整的醉拳拳法秘籍。

messages.plural: copies of The Way of the Spear

translations: 一部完整的日本枪术指南。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to Wing Chun Kung-fu.
A completely translated medieval guide teaching various techniques with polearms.  There is a chapter about the many variations of common polearms… there are even pictures!
translations: 一本翻译完全的中世纪长柄武器作战指南，其中一章详解了常见长柄武器的技巧差异，甚至附有图片。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to medieval swordsmanship.  Compares the German and Italian traditions for a multitude of swords, in and out of armor, with and without shield.
translations: 中世纪剑术的完整指南。比较了德国和意大利传统剑术中所使用的各类长剑，是否穿着盔甲及是否使用盾牌时的剑术差异。

messages.msgid: A college-level textbook that details the operation, maintenance, and repair of internal combustion engines.
translations: 一本大学水平的教材，详细介绍了如何操作维护和修理内燃机。

messages.msgid: A whimsical guide to the world of building and designing compressed air and pneumatic devices, loaded with puns and dry technical diagrams.  It is unclear who the audience for a book like this would be.
translations: 一本充满了奇思妙想的指南书，介绍了各类压缩空气的气动设备的制造和设计，里面充满了双关语和枯燥的技术图表。目前尚不清楚这样一本书的读者是谁。

messages.msgid: A compact manual with faded print detailing a number of improvised field repairs that can be made to vehicles.
translations: 一个带有褪色印刷的小型手册，详细介绍了一些对车辆进行临时野战修理的方法。

messages.msgid: A magazine about mechanical innovations.  Full of entertaining articles and advertisements for esoteric gadgets.
translations: 一本关于机械创新的杂志。充满各种关于科技小玩意的有趣的文章和广告。
创客空间学习套件说明书

messages.msgid: Instructions and blueprints for dozens of projects of increasing complexity for anyone new to the maker community.
translations: 数十个项目的说明书和蓝图，复杂度逐渐提升，适合任何新加入创客社区的人学习。
机器人玩具套装说明书

messages.msgid: Instructions and blueprints for dozens of projects of increasing complexity.  An introduction to toy robots.
translations: 数十个项目的说明书和蓝图，复杂度逐渐提升，适合任何想要搭建玩具机器人的人学习。

messages.msgid: Instructions and blueprints for building toy Stirling engines.  An introduction to engine principles.
translations: 制造玩具斯特林发动机的说明书和蓝图。适合发动机原理入门。

messages.msgid: An advanced mechanics manual, covering all sorts of topics.
translations: 一本机械学进阶手册，涵盖了各方面的主题。

messages.msgid: This lab notebook is filled with the collective discoveries and refinements of a research team dedicated to nuclear energy.  You don't think you're ready to start a second Cataclysm, but the general information provided might be useful…
translations: 这本团队日志记满了一个核能研究团队对核能技术的发现和改良内容。你并不想用核平带来另一个大灾变，但是上面一些通用的技术信息也许会派上用场……

messages.msgid: By learning the fundamentals of chassis building and suspension design you will gain the critical knowledge needed to hot rod properly.
translations: 这本书包含了汽车底盘制造和悬挂设计的基本原理，你可以从中获得正确改装车辆所需的关键知识。

messages.msgid: An advanced guide on mechanics and welding, covering topics like "Grinding off rust" and "Making cursive E's".
translations: 一本关于机械与焊接的高级指南，内容涵盖诸如“磨掉锈迹”和“写花体的 E”之类的主题。

messages.msgid: An in-depth look at various styles of close quarters fighting.  There's an amusing essay about dirty tricks in the front section.
translations: 一本深入讲解各种不同风格的室内近距离战斗的教科书，里面有一篇有趣的文章，讲的是近战中的"肮脏的把戏"。

messages.msgid: A barbaric guide detailing how to win a fight in the worst possible scenarios - mostly about how to retreat from such a fight, but it still has some information in case you have no another way.
translations: 一本粗犷的指南书，告诉你如何在各种最差的街头斗殴场景中获胜 - 大多数是在教你如何全身而退，但也给了你一些退无可退时的格斗建议。

messages.msgid: This book teaches how to predict enemy attacks, with a nice explanation of how to react to each of them - both defense and counterattacks.
translations: 这本书教授如何预测敌人的攻击，也从解释了如何攻击到对方，都包括了防御与还击。

messages.plural: copies of Out of the Cage

messages.msgid: This book shows lot of techniques to defeat an experienced martial artist - brutal and dirty.
translations: 这本书展示了许多为击败熟练武术家的技巧 - 招招毒辣且下作。

messages.msgid: An illustrated handbook about the human body, how it works, and how to destroy it with fairly easy steps.
translations: 一本关于人体的插图手册，说明了人体是如何行动的，以及如何以简单的步骤破坏行动能力。

messages.plural: copies of Close Quarter Fighting Manual

messages.msgid: A well-thumbed hardbound book which illustrates simple strategies and techniques for close quarters combat encounters.
translations: 一个被翻旧了的精装书，里面有插画来说明简单的近身格斗策略和技巧。

messages.msgid: "Will You Be The Last One Standing?", asks the author on the first page.  You don't know the answer, but this book contains plenty of info to reach this target.
translations: "你能活到最后吗？"，作者在扉页上这样问道。你没有答案，但这本书的内容确实可以帮你靠近这个目标。

messages.msgid: Different techniques to end the fight fast, easy, and without going to prison.  Luckily no one can imprison you anymore!
translations: 各种各样解决战斗的技巧，讲究快速，实用，还不会被送进监狱。好消息是现在已经没人抓你进监狱了！
应对突发威胁的训练准备
messages.plural: copies of Training for Sudden Violence

messages.msgid: This book contains professional instructions to prepare and prevail in dangerous situations, both physically and psychologically.
translations: 这本书包含了让你做好准备迎接威胁的专业指导 - 同时让身体与心理都做好准备。

messages.msgid: While this seems like it would be very useful in this situation, the sheer amount of misinformation present makes it practically useless.
translations: 一本看起来似乎很实用，但是里面巨大数量的错误信息使它实际上毫无用处的娱乐书。

messages.msgid: A full flight log for a military aircraft.  Nothing of interest stands out.
translations: 一个军用飞机的完整飞行日志，没什么特别的。

messages.msgid: A short paper of the economic viability of constructing an agricultural outpost.
translations: 一本薄薄的企划书，里面列举了如何盘活一间大型农场基地的各种企划方案。

messages.msgid: This binder details the scheduled maintenance for several plumbing systems throughout the facility.
translations: 这个日志内详细列出了机构内的数套管道系统的维护计划。

messages.msgid: A collection of essays by various authors from around the world, including works by Churchill, Mailer, Eco, and Voltaire.
translations: 一本由著名作家撰写的优美华丽的散文集。包括丘吉尔、梅勒、艾柯、伏尔泰的作品。

messages.msgid: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Cataclysm
messages.plural: copies of The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Cataclysm

messages.msgid: Inscribed on the cover in large, friendly letters, is the message "Don't Panic".
translations: 一本奇怪的书，封面上镌刻了巨大、友好的文字，"不要恐慌"。（注：《银河系漫游指南》）

messages.msgid: Reviews of recently released computer games and previews of upcoming titles.
translations:
一本刊载最新发布游戏的评测以及未发售游戏介绍的游戏杂志，内含CDDA最新开发进度。
1. 修改了若干物品描述，更严格的区分标点符号，同时让许多旧翻译失效。
2. 增加了许多毫无用途但更能模拟现实的计算函数。
3. 重写了部分代码，让我们能够发现之前隐藏的bug。
4. bug修复工作尚未开始，不过放心，0.H版本马上就要来了！

messages.msgid: Current events concerning a bunch of people who're all (un)dead now.
translations: 关于一群如今都已（不）再活着的人的时事新闻。

messages.msgid: This news magazine has been described as "a kind of Reader's Digest for America's corporate elite."  These concerns are, of course, behind us now.
translations: 这本新闻杂志被称为"美国企业精英的读者文摘"，当然，这里面所关心的东西现在早已是过去时了。

messages.msgid: You can read it for the articles.  Or not.
translations:
一本知名度极高的老牌杂志，有着五十余年历史的成人杂志，是目前世界上卖得最好的男性杂志。
"只看看图片即可。"

messages.msgid: A newsweekly covering regional events.  There is an article on the winter's snowstorms and several letters to the editor concerning the community response.
translations: 一本报道了本地事件的新闻周刊，上面有一篇有关冬季的暴风雪的文章，还有几封涉及社区反应的读者来信。

messages.msgid: The stirring tale of a race against time, in search of a lost city located in the heart of the African continent.
translations: 一本讲述和时间赛跑的激动人心的故事书，讲述了一个搜寻位于非洲大陆中心的失落城市的故事。

messages.msgid: A gripping tale of two friends struggling to survive on the streets of New York City.
translations: 一本讲述了两个朋友如何在纽约街头挣扎生存的小说。

messages.msgid: After their diamond heist goes wrong, the surviving criminals begin to suspect that one of them is a police informant.
translations: 一本犯罪小说，在钻石抢劫计划失败后，幸存的罪犯开始怀疑，他们之中出了一名警察线人，充满着经典的桥段。

messages.msgid: A story about three people in the fictional city of Los Santos: a gangster, an upper-class man, and a psychopath.  They eventually band together to pull off the biggest heist in the city's history.
translations: 虚构都市洛圣都的三重奏：一个街头混混、上流精英与疯子的命运交织。他们最终联手策划了这座城市史上最疯狂的惊天劫案。

messages.plural: copies of Murdered by the Grapevine

messages.msgid: This cheap paperback tells the story of a mob boss done in by mere suspicion.  She never breaks a confidence, never rats out an accomplice, and never turns her back on a friend.  Nonetheless her grip on the reigns of the underworld is eroded by rumor and paranoia.
translations: 这本廉价的平装书讲述了一个黑帮老大被怀疑的故事。她从不失信，从不供出同伙，也从不背弃朋友。尽管如此，她对地下社会的统治和控制不断被谣言和偏执所侵蚀。

messages.msgid: In this bare-knuckled potboiler, a ruthless police detective schemes to shut down local crime lords by pitting them against each other.  When long-simmering resentments finally flare the city learns why they call it "the dead of night."
translations: 一部赤裸裸的圈钱作品，讲述了一名冷酷无情的警探如何通过密谋，以挑唆本地帮派内斗的方式除掉一个又一个帮派首领。当酝酿已久的仇恨最终点亮整座城市的夜空时，人们才明白谁才是真正的"午夜死神"。

messages.msgid: A real book for real adults.
translations: 一本货真价实的书，适合真正的成年人阅读。

messages.msgid: A hackneyed fictional narrative concealing low-grade literary smut.
translations: 这是一本陈词滥调，文字低劣的书，有着流水账一般的文笔，充满了大量下流的情色描写。

messages.msgid: A bizarre play about the philosophy of existential absurdity.  Or maybe it's about two guys waiting for their friend to show up.  It's confusing.
translations: 一本关于存在及其荒谬性的哲学的奇怪的戏剧，或者也许是两人在等待他们的朋友来。真让人困惑不已。（注：《等待戈多》）
一本内容基本上都是各种剑术和巫术的书。

messages.msgid: Maybe not the best reading material considering the situation.
translations:
一本有着惊悚描写与鬼怪异闻的恐怖小说。
"最恐怖的桥段也比不上如今身处地狱的现实。"

messages.msgid: A detective investigates an unusual murder in a secluded location.
translations: 描述了一个侦探在偏僻地点调查变态杀人狂的凶杀案线索的故事。

messages.msgid: A tale about a group of friends who wander the USA in the 1960s against a backdrop of jazz, poetry and drug use.
translations: 一个讲述一群铁哥们在19世纪60年代的美国四处漂泊的故事，故事背景里充满了各种爵士乐、诗歌和毒品滥用的描写。

messages.msgid: Award-winning author Cornac McCaffordy weaves a chilling tale of horror and strife, following the compellingly lucrative, seductively dangerous bounty hunting and scalping trade across the western frontier.
translations: 一部由获奖作家科纳克·麦肯迪所编撰的充满恐怖和冲突的毛骨悚然的小说，讲述了在西部拓荒边境进行的利润丰厚、危险诱人的赏金狩猎和倒卖交易。
一本剧情跌宕起伏、还带有一些情色描写的小说。

messages.msgid: The passionate saga of two Boston politicians fiercely battling each other for the mayor's office, and for Lydia's hand in marriage.
translations: 一段跌宕起伏的传奇故事，讲述了两位波士顿政客为争夺市长职位，以及成为莉迪亚的老公而展开激烈竞争的故事。

messages.msgid: When the devil falls in love with a warlock, his proposal must be infernally wicked.  Will hooves, horns, and the scent of sulfur condemn love's flames to hellfire?
translations: 当魔鬼与一个男巫坠入爱河时，他们的求婚仪式一定邪恶至极。蹄子、尖角和硫磺的气味会把爱情之焰变为地狱之火吗？

messages.msgid: Sweet Providence Books is delighted to offer you this romantic tale of delicious dalliances and daring delights.
translations: 甜蜜的天意出版社很荣幸能为你呈现这份充满了美味调情和大胆欢愉的浪漫小说。

messages.msgid: His love songs were only for me, but I preferred the banjo over bagpipes.  How could I ever love a kilted yankee of foreign breeding?
translations: 他的情歌只为我而作，但我更喜欢班卓琴而不是风笛。我怎么会喜欢外国血统的北方佬呢？

messages.msgid: He is an automaton, she is a reformed vampire, can love find a way?  In this edgy romance by acclaimed author Kea Dekker, heartbreak is just the beginning.
translations: 他是个机器人，她是个改过自新的吸血鬼，他们之间的爱情能找到出路吗？在这部由著名作家凯亚·德克尔创作的前卫浪漫小说中，心碎不过是刚刚开始。

messages.msgid: When her fiancee names a star for her Wanda begins to wonder if an astronomer's wife can ever compete with the allure of the cosmos.
translations: 当她的未婚夫用她的名字命名一颗星星时，万达开始怀疑作为一位天文学家的妻子的自己能否与宇宙的魅力相媲美。

messages.plural: copies of Tall, Dark, and Gruesome

messages.msgid: Fatima's obsession with the dead threatens to consume her when she falls in love with a restless ghost.  In this provocative romp celebrated author Kea Dekker gently lifts the thin veil separating cold bodies from warm.
translations: 法蒂玛对死者的痴迷可能将她吞噬，她爱上了一个不愿安息的鬼魂。在这部挑逗的浪漫小说中，著名作家凯亚·德克尔轻轻地掀开分隔在冰冷尸体和温暖人体之间的薄纱。

messages.plural: copies of Along Came a Rider

messages.msgid: When Beth's career as a pro steeplechase jockey threatens to divide her from her lover, Beth has to act fast.  Will she ever find a man that can keep up with her racing heart?
translations: 贝丝作为职业障碍赛马师的生涯开始有把她与她的情人分隔开的危险，她必须迅速采取行动。她能否找到一个能跟得上她的奔腾脉搏的男人呢？

messages.msgid: Can Victoria reform the fugitive from justice who wooed her with false pretenses and true passion?
translations: 维多利亚能成功让那个用虚假借口和真实激情追求她的逃犯浪子回头吗？

messages.msgid: The Death of My Secret Life
messages.plural: copies of The Death of My Secret Life

messages.msgid: Makeda comes out to her family, but she's still got plenty of skeletons in her closet.  Best selling authoress Kea Dekker breaks all the rules in this macabre story of love and lies.
translations: 马克达终于向她的家人坦白出柜了，但她仍有许多秘密没有揭晓。畅销女作家凯亚·德克尔在这个充满了爱情和谎言的恐怖故事中打破了所有的写作规则。

messages.msgid: The classic tale of a wandering swordsman who comes to a small settlement and is hired to help the townsfolk defend themselves from a band of marauding outlaws.  This hardback is quite hefty.
translations: 一本经典小说，主要描写了日本战国时代，贫穷家村百姓为保卫家园，与雇来的七位武士联手击退强盗的故事。这本精装本还有点重。

messages.msgid: A political satire of the pre-apocalypse world.  Looking back on it from this side of Armageddon makes it seem all the more ridiculous.
translations:
一片对大灾变之前的政治讽刺小说。
"大灾变后讽刺加倍。"

messages.plural: copies of The House of God

messages.msgid: Set in a lightly disguised Boston hospital of high repute, Samuel Shem's novel dives deep into the agony of absurdity.
translations: 这部以塞缪尔·闪姆笔名出品的小说以一家名声显赫的波士顿医院为背景，稍作修改掩饰，深入探索了其中种种荒谬所带来的痛苦。

messages.msgid: There is a short informational forward in this paperback edition of Catch-22.  Apparently the original title for Joseph Heller's excruciatingly brilliant war satire was "Catch-11."
translations: 这本《第二十二条军规》平装版有份简短介绍背景的前言。显然，约瑟夫·海勒这部极其精彩的战争讽刺小说的初版标题是《第十一条军规》。

messages.msgid: Featuring a cast that includes Satan, Pontius Pilate, Jesus Christ, vampires, a talking cat, and the literary elite of Moscow, this novel by Mikhail Bulgakov explores philosophical issues on the nature of good and evil.
translations: 一部由米哈伊尔·布尔加科夫创作的探讨了善恶本质的哲学问题的政治讽刺小说，书中角色包括了撒旦、本丢·彼拉多、耶稣基督、吸血鬼、一只会说话的猫和莫斯科的文艺精英们。

messages.plural: copies of A Handful of Dust

messages.msgid: Laced with cynicism, Evelyn Waugh's "A Handful of Dust" satirizes a stratum of characters who have wealth, but lack any other credentials.
translations: 伊夫林·沃的《一掬尘土》带有愤世嫉俗的色彩，讽刺了整个上流社会，他们空有财富，却缺乏其他资历。

messages.msgid: A paperback edition of Kurt Vonnegut's fourth novel, in which the threat of nuclear destruction isn't much of an influence on human nature.
translations: 库尔特·冯内古特第四本小说的平装本，书中核毁灭对人性并没有太大的影响。（注：书中核弹的制造者在核弹被扔向人类时正在玩"猫的摇篮"，一种翻花绳游戏）

messages.msgid: A tale of intrigue and espionage among Nazis, no, Commies, no, Iraqis!
translations:
一本充满了阴谋和谍战的故事，对手的阵营扑朔迷离，剧情紧张刺激。
"对手是纳粹……不，是共党，不，是伊拉克人！"

messages.plural: copies of Come Fly the Treacherous Skies

messages.msgid: This tale of intrigue betrays the story of a debonair mechanic driven by a lust for revenge.  As she uncovers a sophisticated network of amateur pilots turned smugglers, the good guys and the bad guys begin to all look the same.
translations: 这个充斥了各类阴谋的故事揭露了一个温文尔雅的机械师被复仇欲望驱使的故事。当她发现一个由业余飞行员变成的走私犯们构成的复杂地下网络时，好人和坏人的分界开始变得越来越模糊。

messages.msgid: Lies, Damn Lies, and Rocket Science
translations: 谎言，该死的谎言，以及火箭科学
messages.plural: copies of Lies, Damn Lies, and Rocket Science

messages.msgid: This spy novel tells the story of a jaded rocket scientist looking for redemption in all the wrong places.  As selling state secrets becomes her career, she learns there isn't much of difference between a double-agent and a triple-agent.
translations: 这部间谍小说讲述了一个疲惫的火箭科学家在各种错误的地方寻找自我救赎的故事。随着出卖国家机密成为她的职业，她意识到双重间谍和三重间谍之间没有太大区别。

messages.msgid: An exciting seventeenth century tale of how an enslaved Irish doctor and his comrades-in-chains escape and become heroic pirates of the Robin Hood variety.
translations: 一个发生在17世纪的激动人心的故事，讲述了一个被奴役的爱尔兰医生和他的被困同伴如何逃脱并成为如同罗宾汉一样著名的海盗。

messages.msgid: Who watches the watchmen?  Pirate Jenny, that's who!  This swashbuckling adventure novel will make you feel swell.
translations: 守望者受谁人监管？海盗珍妮，就是她！这部充满了传奇历险的冒险小说会让你感到海浪的涌动。

messages.msgid: Captain Gosnold and the Sea Rovers of Buzzards Bay
translations: 戈斯诺德船长和秃鹫湾的海盗们

messages.msgid: This lengthy paperback novel describes the ocean exploits of Captain Gosnold.  The British consider him an outlaw, but in America he is a patriot.
translations: 这部长篇平装小说描述了戈斯诺德船长的海上冒险之旅。英国人认为他是个亡命之徒，但美国人认为他是个爱国英雄。

messages.msgid: The cover of this paperback pirate story shows a shirtless man and a near shirtless woman.  Clearly it is not a dress code.
translations: 这本平装海盗小说的封面画着一个赤膊上阵的男海盗和一个近乎赤膊上阵的女海盗。显然这本书不是着装守则。

messages.msgid: A suspenseful tale of betrayal and revenge.
translations: 一个关于背叛和复仇的悬疑故事。

messages.msgid: The story of two young lovers whose feuding families threaten to keep them apart.
translations: 令人伤感的年轻恋人的故事，家庭的不和使他们难以相处。

messages.msgid: A thrilling narrative of survival in a prisoner of war camp during the Second World War, filled with riveting subplots about rat farming and dysentery.
translations: 讲述了一个惊心动魄的在二战战俘营中挣扎求生的故事，包含了如何饲养老鼠和痢疾等各种吸引人的情节。

messages.msgid: A story about a Bosnian citizen who goes through many hardships and near death during the breakup of Yugoslavia.
translations: 关于一个波斯尼亚公民在南斯拉夫解体过程中历尽艰难命悬一发的故事。

messages.msgid: The classic tale of a gunfighting stranger who comes to a small settlement and is hired to help the townsfolk defend themselves from a band of marauding outlaws.
translations: 这是小说描写了一个家喻户晓的故事，讲的是一个枪术高超的异乡枪手来到一个偏远城镇，同时受雇于村民以保护他们免受邻近的一伙不法匪徒威胁的故事。

messages.plural: copies of Atwixt a Brace of Cacti

messages.msgid: A grizzled clodhopper interviews a mess of rangehands, flummoxing longhorns and tenderfoot alike in a flusteration of jawing.
translations: 一个缠人的乡巴佬的对一帮海盗们的访谈记录，充满了让长角牛和旱鸭子们焦躁不安张嘴困惑不已的各种海盗术语。

messages.plural: copies of Stinky Bart Puts on Starch

messages.msgid: A local bandit, driven by sadistic impulses, begins offering unlicensed dentistry to brave frontiersmen with few options and fewer teeth.
translations: 一个当地强盗，在自虐冲动驱使下，开始向勇敢的开拓者们提供无证牙医服务，选项很少而牙齿更少的服务。

messages.plural: copies of Six Beans in the Wheel

messages.msgid: The safety is off in this gun slinging tale of revenge and redemption by acclaimed author El Amor.
translations: 在这部由著名作家艾尔·阿莫尔撰写的复仇与救赎的西部枪战小说中，保险已经完全打开了。

messages.plural: copies of Irons at Calico Queen Annex

messages.msgid: The establishment of a telegraph line into the recently named town of Calico Queen threatens to bring with it the long arm of the law.  A trio of enterprising gunfighters hatches a plan to keep Calico Queen wild by looting the supply wagons.
translations: 刚被命名的印花女王镇上建起了一条新电报线，它所带来联邦法律的长臂可能威胁小镇的自由。三名富有进取心的枪手策划了一桩抢劫计划，通过打劫补给车队来保持印花女王镇的狂野本性。

messages.plural: copies of Riot on the Range

messages.msgid: Best selling author El Amor paints a visceral study in red with his latest western saga: Riot on the Range.
translations: 畅销书作家艾尔·阿莫尔用他最新的西部传奇小说《牧场暴乱》深入肺腑地描绘出鲜红的西部风土人情。

messages.msgid: Western author El Amor relates the story of a dispossessed young man inspired by a heat stroke delusion to pursue justice against an evil land baron.
translations: 西部小说作家艾尔·阿莫尔讲述了一个被剥夺了权利的年轻人在一次中暑引发的幻觉的鼓舞下向邪恶的地主讨回正义的故事。

messages.msgid: A wild young man, fast on the draw, who thinks he has nothing to lose, falls in with a group of gun runners.
translations: 一个狂野的年轻人，拔枪很快，认为自己一无所有，和一群同样的持枪骑手一起行动的故事。

messages.msgid: This hefty volume contains the telephone numbers of individuals, businesses, and utilities.  Pretty useless during the apocalypse and all.
translations: 这本厚厚的书包含了许多个人、企业和公共事业单位的电话号码。在大灾变中已经完全没有用了。

messages.msgid: A leather album full of photos of somebody's family.  You don't know any of the people in them, but seeing these pictures still makes you think of happier times.
translations:
一本皮革封面的相册，装满了某个陌生人的家族照片，充满着往日美好时光的记忆。
"看到这些照片感到很温馨。"

messages.msgid: A collection of plays by various authors from around the world, including scripts by Wilde, Beckett, Checkov, and Shakespeare.
translations: 一本收纳了诸多名家的经典戏剧的书，包括王尔德、贝克特、契科夫和莎士比亚。

messages.msgid: A collection of poetry by various authors from around the world, including writings by Dickinson, Goethe, Thoreau, and Yeats.
translations: 一本收罗了来自世界各地不同作者的作品的诗集，包括狄金森、歌德、梭罗和叶芝的著作。

messages.msgid: A small book filled with journal entries in Latin.  You can read Latin, right?
translations: 一本写满了拉丁语的日记小册子。你会拉丁语的，对吧？

messages.msgid: If you knew what to look for, something might stand out…
translations: 一册账本，如果你看懂的话，某笔交易显得尤为突出……

messages.msgid: A massive stack of medical records that contain every gory detail.
translations: 一大叠病例记录，包含了许多血淋淋的治疗过程。

messages.msgid: Old weather records that are about as interesting as a rock.
translations:
过去的天气记录读起来如同石头一样，毫无趣味。
"数据爱好者可能会读的津津有味。"

messages.msgid: This humongous volume contains a vast collection of short stories by different authors, spanning a wide variety of topics and genres.
translations: 一本超大的收集了来自不同作者的短文的书，包含了各种风格的故事和主题。

messages.msgid: An entertaining collection of early American folklore, featuring tales of larger than life individuals and their amazing adventures.
translations: 一本有趣的故事书，收录了各种美国民间传说，讲述那些勇往无前之人的冒险传奇。

messages.msgid: A small book detailing 'visions' a prisoner had on death row.
translations: 这是本描述了一位死刑犯在监狱中的"梦想"的书。
