messages.msgid: A book of classic literature, timeless and enjoyable but a bit dense to read.
translations: 一本关于经典文学的书，永不过时。但读起来有些难懂。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Dickens' "Bleak House".
translations: 查尔斯·狄更斯所著的《荒凉山庄》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Great Expectations" by Charles Dickens.
translations: 查尔斯·狄更斯所著的《远大前程》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of William Shinderling's "Under the Beech Trees".
translations: 威廉·辛德林所著的《山毛榉树下》。

messages.msgid: This is a collection of three Jane Austen novels: "Pride and Prejudice", "Sense and Sensibility", and "Emma".
translations: 这是简·奥斯汀的三部小说合集：《傲慢与偏见》、《理智与情感》、《爱玛》。

messages.msgid: This is a well-worn paperback copy of "Lord of the Flies".
translations: 一本旧了的平装本《蝇王》，威廉·戈尔丁著。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "To Kill a Mockingbird" by Harper Lee.
translations: 哈珀·李著所著的《杀死一只知更鸟》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of F. Scott Fitzgerald's "The Great Gatsby."
translations: 弗·司各特·菲茨杰拉德所著的《了不起的盖茨比》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Michael Abanaderly's lesser-known work, "He Walks".
translations: 迈克尔·阿巴纳德利所著的《他走路》，一部鲜为人知的作品。

messages.msgid: This is a collection of several vintage science fiction stories by Ray Bradbury.
translations: 几部经典科幻小说集，雷·道格拉斯·布莱伯利著。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer" by Mark Twain.
translations: 马克·吐温所著的《汤姆·索亚历险记》。

messages.msgid: This is an illustrated copy of "Innocents Abroad" by Mark Twain.
translations: 马克·吐温所著的《傻子出国记》的插图本。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Bram Stoker's "Dracula", with scholarly commentary in the margins.
translations: 布拉姆·斯托克著所著的《德古拉伯爵》，页边空白处有专业的批注。

messages.msgid: This is a large print copy of Tolstoy's "War and Peace".  It might make a decent improvised weapon.
translations: 这是一本大部头的《战争与和平》，列夫·尼古拉耶维奇·托尔斯泰著。它可能是一件很好的临时武器。

messages.msgid: This is a paperback copy of the well-known classic "Dark Days Ahead", by K. G. Ranade.  There are scrawled margin notes all over it, apparently the workings of a confused and feverish mind.
translations:
平装本《浩劫余生》，一部著名的经典著作，K·G·拉纳德著。上面到处都是潦草的笔记，显然是一个头脑狂热的疯子留下的。
（注：Kevin Granade，本游戏核心贡献者及项目领导人）

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Jane Eyre".  The cover art is quite out of place, making it look more like a dime-store romance novel.
translations: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特所著的《简·爱》。封面图案很不合适，让它看起来更像一本廉价的浪漫小说。

messages.msgid: This is a perfectly preserved hardcover copy of "The Gunslinger" by Stephen King, autographed by the author.  It contains a certificate of authenticity pronouncing it to be a first edition.
translations: 一本保存完好的史蒂芬·金的精装本《枪手》，上面有作者的亲笔签名。它包含了一份防伪证书，证明这是第一版。

messages.msgid: This paperback copy of "Wuthering Heights" has a large coffee stain on the first page.
translations: 艾米莉·勃朗特所著《呼啸山庄》的平装本。第一页上有一大块咖啡渍。

messages.msgid: This is a hardbound copy of "Lady Chatterly's Lover", by D. H. Lawrence.  It has some very explicit illustrations.
translations: 精装本《查泰莱夫人的情人》，D·H·劳伦斯著。它里面的一些插图相当"刺激"。

messages.msgid: This is a hardbound copy of "The Catcher in the Rye.".  It has some very nicely done illustrations.
translations: 精装本《麦田里的守望者》，杰罗姆·大卫·塞林格著。里面有些非常精美的插图。

messages.msgid: This is a collection of classic renaissance era stories, headlined by "Don Quixote".
translations: 这是一本文艺复兴时期的经典故事集，标题是《堂吉诃德》。

messages.msgid: This is a paperback copy of "The Fellowship of the Ring" by Tolkien.
translations: 约翰·罗纳德·瑞尔·托尔金所著《护戒使者》的平装本，是《指环王》三部曲的第一部。

messages.msgid: This is a paperback copy of "The Two Towers" by Tolkien.
translations: 约翰·罗纳德·瑞尔·托尔金所著《双塔奇兵》的平装本，是《指环王》三部曲的第二部。

messages.msgid: This is a paperback copy of "The Return of the King" by Tolkien.
translations: 约翰·罗纳德·瑞尔·托尔金所著《王者归来》的平装本，是《指环王》三部曲的第三部。

messages.msgid: This is a hardbound collection of George Orwell's works, including "1984" and "Animal Farm" as well as many of his less infamous titles.
translations: 这是乔治·奥威尔作品的精装珍藏合集，包括《1984》和《动物农场》，以及其他许多不那么出名的作品。

messages.msgid: This is a paperback copy of "Little Women" by Louisa May Alcott.  It appears to have been read a great many times.
translations: 路易莎·梅·奥尔科特所著《小妇人》的平装本。它似乎被翻阅了很多次。

messages.msgid: This is a paperback copy of "Of Mice and Men" by Steinbeck.
translations: 约翰·斯坦贝克所著《人鼠之间》的平装本。

messages.msgid: This is a hefty hardcover copy of "Run and Run Again" by Finn Calpay.  There is a lengthy forward about the controversy around the book's release.
translations: 芬·卡尔费所著《再次起跑》的大部头精装本。关于这本书出版的争议存在过很长一段时间。

messages.msgid: This is a hardcover copy of "The Gates Have Opened" by Arianna Methusalah.  You feel like you've read this before, but can't remember where.  Something about the book fills you with unease.
translations: 阿利安娜·玛图莎拉所著《门已经打开》的精装本。你好像读过这本书，但记不清在哪里读过了。书上的一些内容使你感到不适。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Count of Monte Cristo" by Dumas.
translations: 大仲马所著的《基督山伯爵》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Secret Garden" by Frances Burnett.
translations: 弗朗西丝·霍奇森·伯内特所著的《秘密花园》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Lieutenant Hornblower" by C.S. Forester.
translations: 英国作家西索·史考特·佛瑞斯特所著的《海军上尉霍恩布洛尔》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Master and Commander" by Patrick O'Brian.
translations: 一本《怒海争锋》，英国作家帕特里克·奥布赖恩所著。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Warden" by Anthony Trollope.
translations: 这是一本英国作家安东尼·特罗洛普的代表作《巴塞特郡养老院》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Far Side of the World" by Patrick O'Brian.
translations: 一本《极地远征》，英国作家帕特里克·奥布赖恩所著。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "HMS Surprise" by Patrick O'Brian.
translations: 一本《惊奇号》，英国作家帕特里克·奥布赖恩所著。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Barchester Towers" by Anthony Trollope.
translations: 这是一本英国作家安东尼·特罗洛普的代表作《巴彻斯特教堂尖塔》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Land Ironclads" by H.G. Wells.
translations: 这是一本由世界知名小说家、政治家H·G·威尔斯所创作的科幻著作《陆上铁甲》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Great Boer War" by Arthur Conan Doyle.
translations: 这是一本由著名推理小说家、福尔摩斯之父阿瑟·柯南·道尔所著的《伟大的布尔战争》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Crime of the Congo" by Arthur Conan Doyle.
translations: 这是一本由著名推理小说家、福尔摩斯之父阿瑟·柯南·道尔所著的纪实文学《在刚果的罪行》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Parasite" by Arthur Conan Doyle.
translations: 这是一本由著名推理小说家、福尔摩斯之父阿瑟·柯南·道尔所著的《寄生虫》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "By Stroke of Sword" by Andrew Balfour.
translations: 一本《一剑之下》，英国作家安德鲁·贝尔福所著。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Secret Agent" by Joseph Conrad.
translations: 约瑟夫·康拉德所著的《密探》，书中预言了20世纪恐怖主义、无政府主义以及英国军情五处这样的秘密机构的兴起。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Lord Jim" by Joseph Conrad.
translations: 约瑟夫·康拉德所著长篇小说《吉姆爷》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Vanity Fair" by William Makepeace Thackeray.
translations: 维多利亚时代的英国小说家威廉·梅克比斯·萨克雷所著的讽刺小说《名利场》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Luck of Barry Lyndon" by William Makepeace Thackeray.
translations: 维多利亚时代的英国小说家威廉·梅克比斯·萨克雷所著的《巴里·林登的遭遇》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "North and South" by Elizabeth Gaskell.
translations: 这是一本由伊丽莎白·盖斯凯尔创作的《南方与北方》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Mayor of Casterbridge" by Thomas Hardy.
translations: 这是一本由英国小说家、诗人托马斯·哈代创作的长篇小说《卡斯特桥市长》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Wessex Tales" by Thomas Hardy.
translations: 这是一本由英国小说家、诗人托马斯·哈代创作的故事集《韦塞克斯故事集》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Far from the Madding Crowd" by Thomas Hardy.
translations: 这是一本由英国小说家、诗人托马斯·哈代最早成书的长篇小说《远离尘嚣》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Captains Courageous" by Rudyard Kipling.
translations: 至今为止最年轻的诺贝尔文学奖得主鲁德亚德·吉卜林所著的《怒海余生》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Canterbury Tales" by Geoffrey Chaucer.
translations: 英国中世纪最杰出的诗人杰弗里·乔叟所创作的一部诗体短篇小说集《坎特伯雷故事集》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Harold, the Last of the Saxons" by Edward Bulwer-Lytton.
translations: 一本《哈罗德：最后的撒克逊王》，爱德华·布尔沃·利顿所著。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Mr Midshipman Easy" by Frederick Marryat.
translations: 弗雷德里克·马里亚特所著的《海军候补生伊齐先生》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Peter Simple" by Frederick Marryat.
translations: 弗雷德里克·马里亚特所著的《彼得·辛普》。

messages.msgid: A unique, valuable book that has been kept as a collector's item.
translations: 被作为收藏品保存的，一本独特且有价值的书。

messages.msgid: This is a high-quality leather bound copy of Charles Dickens' "A Tale of Two Cities".
translations: 豪华皮革装订本《双城记》，查尔斯·狄更斯著。

messages.msgid: This is a very old but well-preserved copy of Charles Dickens' "Oliver Twist".
translations: 查尔斯·狄更斯所著的《雾都孤儿》，年代久远但保存完好。

messages.msgid: This high-quality copy of Jane Austen's "Pride and Prejudice" is dog-eared and looks to have been read many times.
translations: 精订本《傲慢与偏见》，简·奥斯汀著。这本书已经有些卷边了，看起来被翻阅了许多次。

messages.msgid: This is a hefty, hardcover print of William Shinderling's "Vanity before Justice" with beautiful illustrations.
translations: 精装印刷本《正义前的虚荣心》，威廉·辛德林著。里面的插图十分精美。

messages.msgid: This copy of Jane Austen's "Sense and Sensibility" has a certificate of authenticity declaring it to be an early edition.  It would have been worth an enormous amount of money, not long ago.
translations: 这本简·奥斯汀的《理智与情感》包含一份防伪证书，证明它是早期版本。如果是在不久前，它值相当大一笔钱。

messages.msgid: This is an excellent quality copy of "To Kill a Mockingbird" by Harper Lee.
translations: 哈珀·李所著的《杀死一只知更鸟》，印刷质量很高。

messages.msgid: This is a high-quality leather bound copy of F. Scott Fitzgerald's "The Great Gatsby."
translations: 豪华皮革装订本《了不起的盖茨比》，弗·司各特·菲茨杰拉德著。

messages.msgid: This is a hefty, hardcover print of Michael Abanaderly's opus, "Lady Wanderlust".  It is over a hundred years old, but doesn't look it.
translations: 一本厚重的《漫游女士》精装本，迈克尔·阿巴那德勒利著。它已出版一百多年了，但这本看起来不像。

messages.msgid: This copy of Ray Bradbury's "Fahrenheit 451" has a certificate of authenticity declaring it to be an early edition.  It would have been worth an enormous amount of money, not long ago.
translations: 这本雷·布拉德伯雷的《华氏451度》包含一份防伪证书，证明它是早期版本。如果是在不久前，大灾变还没爆发的时候，它得值相当大一笔钱。

messages.msgid: This high-quality copy of "Pride and Prejudice and Zombies" has been autographed by the author.
translations: 这本精装的《傲慢与偏见与丧尸》已由作者亲笔签名。

messages.msgid: This is a high-quality leather bound copy of "The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn" by Mark Twain.  It contains some margin notes which themselves are quite old, and look to have been done by a scholar of some sort.
translations: 豪华皮革装订本《哈克贝利·费恩历险记》，马克·吐温著。它里面的空白处有一些批注，历史相当久远，看起来是某位学者留下的。

messages.msgid: This is a very nice print of Bram Stoker's "Dracula".  It has a certificate of authenticity with it that declares it a genuine early edition.
translations: 这是一本保存完好的布拉姆·斯托克的《德古拉伯爵》，品相不错。它有一份防伪证书，证明它是货真价实的早期版本。

messages.msgid: This copy of Douglas Adams' "The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy" has a certificate of authenticity declaring it to be a first edition, and is autographed by the author himself.
translations: 这本道格拉斯·亚当斯的《银河系漫游指南》包含一份防伪证书，声明它是第一版，并由作者亲笔签名。

messages.msgid: This is a high-quality leather bound copy of the well-known classic "Dark Days Ahead", by K. G. Ranade.
translations:
豪华皮革装订本《浩劫余生》，一本经典名著。K·G·拉纳德著。
（注：Kevin Granade，本游戏核心贡献者及项目领导人）

messages.msgid: This is a well-kept leather bound copy of "Oryx and Crake" by Margaret Atwood.  Inscribed in the inner cover is a faded note wishing the owner a happy birthday.
translations: 这是玛格丽特·阿特伍德的一本保存完好的皮革装订本《羚羊与秧鸡》。封皮内刻着一条模糊的信息："祝这本书的主人生日快乐。"

messages.msgid: This bright orange hardcover copy of "1984" by George Orwell has been carefully preserved, and appears to be a first or second edition judging from the publisher's information.
translations: 这本乔治·奥威尔的鲜橙色精装本《1984》被精心保存着，从出版商的信息来看，它似乎是第一版或第二版。

messages.msgid: This is a very nice copy of "Lady Chatterly's Lover", probably quite expensive in the days before the apocalypse.
translations: 一本非常精美的《查泰莱夫人的情人》，D·H·劳伦斯著。在大灾变前应该价值不菲。

messages.msgid: This is a high quality early edition hardcover copy of "The Handmaid's Tale" by Margaret Atwood, signed by the author.
translations: 玛格丽特·阿特伍德所著《使女的故事》的早期精装本，印刷质量很高，上面有作者的签名。

messages.msgid: This ancient and worn book looks to be an 18th or early 19th century handwritten copy of "Don Quixote".  In the days of book traders it would have been worth an absolute fortune.  Now it's either a priceless piece of history, some light reading before bed, or excellent kindling.
translations: 这本古老的书看起来是18或19世纪早期的手抄本《堂吉诃德》。在书商的时代，这绝对相当值钱。但现在，它可以被看成一段"无价"的历史，可以用来睡前阅读放松，还可以用来生火。

messages.msgid: This is a first edition copy of Terry Pratchett's "The Colour of Magic".  In the inner cover is a handwritten note that reads "To Chris, thanks for believing I could do it.  Best regards, Terry."
translations: 这是特里·普拉切特的《魔法的颜色》的第一版。内封面有一张手写的便条，上面写着："感谢克里斯相信我能做到。谨致问候，特里。"

messages.msgid: These are the prescriptures Pile 18 Disk sg30 File 14.  "Look, small brain of pink earth inside my null-grasping, and she/he receives Logos; and it lay with the Wor."
translations: 以下条例引自第18堆栈第30磁盘阵列第14文件："看，在我零值抓取中的粉色地球上的小脑瓜子们，而他/她将被赐予罗格斯（理性/图标）；而它将与吾同行。"

messages.msgid: The back cover of this cheaply published paperback reads: "These newly-released SubGenius revelations will SHOCK those who think they know Bob!  Unpredictables are not alone and possess amazing hidden powers of their own!  In a world without slack, a yeti lust revival saunters about.  WARNING: Do not fail to pay full price for this book; JHVH-1's wrath knows some bounds."
translations: 这本廉价出版的平装本的封底写着："这些最新发布的对非天才人群的揭秘将会让那些自以为了解鲍勃的人震惊！不可预测的事物并非孤立存在，而且它们自身就拥有着惊人的隐藏力量！在一个没有懈怠的世界里，野人般的欲望重新在世间游荡。警告：不要忘记为这本书付全价；JHVH-1的愤怒上有边界。"

messages.msgid: This paperback is titled "Glimpses of Solomon in Yellow; The Initiation Rites of the Starry Wisdom Covenant, by Dr. Enoch Craven."  It describes not just the investiture of new adherents, but the history and beliefs of the Church of Starry Wisdom.  Someone has defaced the sparse citations section by scrawling "PUPPETS OF ROME!" over its few pages.  The book does not provide any biography for Dr. Craven, let alone academic credentials.
translations: 这本平装书的标题是《瞥见黄衣所罗门：星慧之约的入会仪式，伊诺·克雷文著》它不仅描述了新信徒的授职仪式，还描述了星之智慧教堂的历史和信仰。有人在其中几页稀疏的引文部分潦草地涂写上了"罗马的木偶！"。这本书没有提供任何关于克雷文博士的人物介绍，更不用说学位证书了。

messages.msgid: A hefty book with a thick leather cover and metal clasps.  Both covers are completely empty, though on the first page there is an author's name written in English: "Abdul Alhazred"; below it the book title is written in Arabian: "العزيف", and below it in Greek: "Νεκρονομικόν".  The book looks very old and sinister.
translations: 一本有厚皮革封面和金属扣的厚书。两侧封面都是空白的，不过扉页上书写着作者的英文名字："阿卜杜·阿尔哈兹莱德"；在其下方用阿拉伯语写着书名："العزيف"，然后下方又用希腊语写着："Νεκρονομικόν"。这本书看起来既古老又邪恶。

messages.msgid: A Siddur, or prayerbook, contains the set order of prayers for Jewish religious services.  This one is comprehensive, divided into morning, afternoon, and evening prayers for both weekdays and Shabbat, along with separate sections for minor and major holidays.
translations: 一本西杜尔(Siddur)祈祷书，包含了犹太教宗教仪式的固定祈祷顺序。这本书很全面，分为平日和安息日的早晨、下午和晚上的祈祷，以及小节日和大节日的单独部分。

messages.msgid: This is a book of Judaica.  You're a real mensch if you managed to find this one.
translations: 这是一本犹太教典籍。如果你专门来找这个，你真是个虔诚信徒。
犹太教义中的地狱描写
messages.plural: copies of Hell in Jewish Literature

messages.msgid: A analysis of rabbinic discussions of Gehinnom, the Jewish afterlife for the cleansing of sins, including how big it is, how hot it is, who goes there, how long they stay there, whether there is any relief from their punishments in the meantime, and exactly what shape Gehinnom is.
translations: 分析拉比们对地狱Gehinnom的讨论，这是犹太人用来清洗罪恶的死后，包括它有多大，有多热，谁会去那里，在那里呆多久，在此期间他们的惩罚是否得到了缓解，以及Gehinnor到底是什么形状。在犹太教中，Gehinnom指的是不悔改的灵魂在死后去往的一个地方，在那里他们会被净化，去除精神上的污秽，然后才能回到上帝的面前。

messages.msgid: Mimekor Yisrael, Book One: The National Tales
translations: 米哥·以色列（卷一：民族故事）
messages.plural: copies of Mimekor Yisrael, Book One: The National Tales

messages.msgid: A collection of Jewish folktales, from Ashmedai king of demons to golem-making rabbis, from the Torah scholar who showed Aristotle the futility of philosophy to how Satan refused to bow to Adam because Adam was created from the dust of the earth, from martyrs murdered by Christian persecutors to General Joab single-handedly killing two thousand Amalekites so that when the blood ran out like a river through the city gates his troops knew to stop besieging the city and assault it, and dozens more besides.
translations: 犹太民间故事集，从恶魔之王阿什梅代到制作傀儡的拉比，从向亚里士多德展示哲学徒劳的托拉学者，到撒旦拒绝向亚当鞠躬，因为亚当是从地球的尘埃中创造出来的，从被迫害基督教的人杀害的烈士，到约押将军单枪匹马杀死了两千名亚玛力人，以至于当血像河流一样从城门流出来时，他的部队知道要停止围攻城市并攻击它，此外还有几十个其他民间故事。

messages.msgid: On the Doorposts of Your House
messages.plural: copies of On the Doorposts of Your House

messages.msgid: A list of prayers, meditations, and rituals for use at home, from lighting the Shabbat candles to welcoming a new child into the household.
translations: 一份在家里使用的祈祷、冥想和仪式清单，从点燃安息日蜡烛到欢迎新孩子进入家庭。

messages.msgid: The Observant Life: The Wisdom of Contemporary Judaism for Contemporary Jews
translations: 遵守戒律的生活：当代犹太人的当代犹太教智慧
messages.plural: copies of The Observant Life: The Wisdom of Contemporary Judaism for Contemporary Jews

messages.msgid: A long discussion of the ways in which Judaism's ancient rituals, traditions, and ethical practices are still relevant and meaningful in the modern world.  Unfortunately, there's no discussion of post-apocalyptic Judaism.
translations: 关于犹太教古老的仪式、传统和伦理实践在现代世界中的相关性和意义的长篇讨论。 遗憾的是，书中没有讨论末世后的犹太教。

messages.msgid: A prayerbook for Tisha b'Av, the most solemn day in the Jewish year.  This one also contains the full text of the book of Lamentations and selected commentaries.
translations: 提沙节的祈祷书，这是犹太一年中最庄严的一天。这本书还包含了《哀歌集》的全文和精选的评论。

messages.msgid: Coming to Terms with America: Essays on Jewish History, Religion, and Culture
translations: 与美国和解：犹太历史、宗教和文化随笔
messages.plural: copies of Coming to Terms with America: Essays on Jewish History, Religion, and Culture

messages.msgid: A series of fifteen essays by Jonathan Sarna on Jews' attempt to be both distinctively Jewish but also definitely American, covering the American Revolution through to contemporary times.
translations: 这是乔纳森·萨尔纳的十五篇系列文章，关于犹太人试图既成为犹太人又成为美国人，从美国革命到当代。

messages.msgid: An English translation of works written by Rabbi Abraham Joshua Heschel during the Nazi rule of Germany and Rabbi Heschel's exile in England, concerning historic and current persecution and his vision for Jewish education.
translations: 亚伯拉罕·约书亚·赫舍尔拉比在纳粹德国统治期间和赫舍尔拉比流亡英国期间所写的作品的英文译本，涉及历史和当前的迫害以及他对犹太教育的愿景。

messages.msgid: Jewish Literacy: The Most Important Things to Know About the Jewish Religion, Its People and Its History
translations: 犹太文学：关于犹太宗教、其人民及其历史的最重要的事情
messages.plural: copies of Jewish Literacy: The Most Important Things to Know About the Jewish Religion, Its People and Its History

messages.msgid: Rabbi Joseph Telushkin's encyclopedic tome of Jewish life, running to hundreds of chapters and answering questions about the Hebrew bible, the Talmud, the holidays and rituals, the Holocaust, Israel and the diaspora, and everything in between.
translations: 约瑟夫·特鲁什金拉比的犹太生活百科全书，包含数百个章节，解答了关于希伯来圣经、《塔木德》、节日和仪式、大屠杀、以色列及其散居历史等方方面面的问题。

messages.msgid: Biblical Literacy: The Most Important People, Events and Ideas of the Hebrew Bible
translations: 圣经文学：希伯来圣经中最重要的人物、事件和思想
messages.plural: copies of Biblical Literacy: The Most Important People, Events and Ideas of the Hebrew Bible

messages.msgid: Rabbi Joseph Telushkin's exploration and analysis of the Hebrew Bible, containing a myriad of commentary and analysis, including on famous stories like the Binding of Isaac or the Exodus, a discussion of the weekly Torah readings that form part of the Jewish liturgical calendar, and a list of all 613 mitzvot.
translations: 约瑟夫·特鲁什金拉比关于希伯来圣经的探索和分析，包含了大量的评注和分析，包括对诸如以撒的献祭或出埃及记等著名故事的解读、对构成犹太礼拜日历一部分的每周妥拉阅读的讨论，以及 613 条戒律的所有列表。

messages.msgid: This Is Real and You Are Completely Unprepared
translations: 这是真的，而你毫无防备
messages.plural: copies of This Is Real and You Are Completely Unprepared

messages.msgid: An in-depth discussion of the High Holy Days, starting with the Three Weeks and Nine Days before Tisha b'Av and continuing all the way through Sukkot, as a single period of rising and falling emotion, wherein each individual prepares themselves to stand before God.  A very well-known book that some people read every year and others mean to get around to finally reading this year.
translations: 这本书深入讨论了至高圣日，从提沙节前的三周和九天开始，一直到住棚节，情绪起起落落，每个人都准备面对上帝的审判。这是一本非常著名的书，有些人每年都会读，而另一些人则打算在今年抽出时间最终读一回。

messages.msgid: OU Manual for Checking Fruits and Vegetables
messages.plural: copies of the OU Manual for Checking Fruits and Vegetables

messages.msgid: A comprehensive guide to checking produce for insect infestation and how to prepare produce according to Jewish dietary law.
translations: 一份全面的指南，用于检查农产品是否受到虫害，以及如何根据犹太教法准备食材。

messages.msgid: Rabbi Shalom Rosner's commentary on the weekly Torah portion, covering the books of Genesis and Exodus.
translations: 拉比沙洛姆·罗斯纳对每周《托拉》部分的评论，涵盖了《创世记》和《出埃及记》。

messages.msgid: Rabbi Shalom Rosner's commentary on the weekly Torah portion, covering the books of Leviticus, Numbers, and Deuteronomy.
translations: 拉比沙洛姆·罗斯纳对每周《托拉》部分的评论，涵盖了《利未记》、《民数记》和《申命记》。

messages.msgid: The Origins of Judaism: An Archaeological-Historical Reappraisal
translations: 犹太教的起源：考古历史的再评价
messages.plural: copies of The Origins of Judaism: An Archaeological-Historical Reappraisal

messages.msgid: An examination of the archaeological evidence behind the beginning of many Jewish traditions, including eschewing pork, adopting tefillin and placing mezuzot on doorposts, and circumcision.
translations: 一项考察许多犹太传统文化和宗教习俗起源的考古学研究，包括禁食猪肉的习俗、佩戴经文匣的要求、在门柱上放置门柱圣卷的传统以及割礼仪式的起源。

messages.plural: copies of the Guide for the Perplexed

messages.msgid: An English translation of the great sage Rabbi Moses ben Maimon's work finding common points between natural philosophy and Talmudic scholarship.  Contains the famous Thirteen Principles of Faith, accepted by many Jews as a summary of the fundamental beliefs of Judaism.
translations: 伟大的圣人拉比摩西·本·迈蒙作品的英译本，寻找自然哲学和塔木德学术之间的共同点。包含著名的信仰十三原则，被许多犹太人接受为犹太教基本信仰的总结。

messages.msgid: Jewish Publication Society Torah Commentary: Genesis
translations: 犹太出版协会摩西五经评注：创世记
messages.plural: copies of the Jewish Publication Society Torah Commentary: Genesis

messages.msgid: A series of Torah commentaries written by scholars and academics, containing the traditional Hebrew text, a translation, and various notes.  This volume is for the book of Genesis.
translations: 由学者和学者撰写的一系列律法注释，包括传统的希伯来语文本、翻译和各种注释。这卷书是为《创世记》而编撰的。

messages.msgid: Jewish Publication Society Torah Commentary: Exodus
translations: 犹太出版协会摩西五经评注：出埃及记
messages.plural: copies of the Jewish Publication Society Torah Commentary: Exodus

messages.msgid: A series of Torah commentaries written by scholars and academics, containing the traditional Hebrew text, a translation, and various notes.  This volume is for the book of Exodus.
translations: 由学者和学者撰写的一系列律法注释，包括传统的希伯来语文本、翻译和各种注释。这卷书是为《出埃及记》而编撰的。

messages.msgid: Jewish Publication Society Torah Commentary: Leviticus
translations: 犹太出版协会摩西五经评注：利未记
messages.plural: copies of the Jewish Publication Society Torah Commentary: Leviticus

messages.msgid: A series of Torah commentaries written by scholars and academics, containing the traditional Hebrew text, a translation, and various notes.  This volume is for the book of Leviticus.
translations: 由学者和学者撰写的一系列律法注释，包括传统的希伯来语文本、翻译和各种注释。这卷书是为《利未记》而编撰的。

messages.msgid: Jewish Publication Society Torah Commentary: Numbers
translations: 犹太出版协会摩西五经评注：民数记
messages.plural: copies of the Jewish Publication Society Torah Commentary: Numbers

messages.msgid: A series of Torah commentaries written by scholars and academics, containing the traditional Hebrew text, a translation, and various notes.  This volume is for the book of Numbers.
translations: 由学者和学者撰写的一系列律法注释，包括传统的希伯来语文本、翻译和各种注释。这卷书是为《民数记》而编撰的。

messages.msgid: Jewish Publication Society Torah Commentary: Deuteronomy
translations: 犹太出版协会摩西五经评注：申命记
messages.plural: copies of the Jewish Publication Society Torah Commentary: Deuteronomy

messages.msgid: A series of Torah commentaries written by scholars and academics, containing the traditional Hebrew text, a translation, and various notes.  This volume is for the book of Deuteronomy.
translations: 由学者和学者撰写的一系列律法注释，包括传统的希伯来语文本、翻译和各种注释。这卷书是为《申命记》而编撰的。

messages.msgid: Compiled by Rabbi Yosef Karo in the 16th century, the Shuchan Arukh is the most widely-consulted and authoritative compilation of Jewish law lasting into the present day.  If you need to convene a post-Cataclysmic Beit Din, keep this with you and you'll be set.
translations: 《犹太法典：Shulchan Arukh》编纂于16世纪，由拉比约瑟夫·卡罗（Rabbi Yosef Karo）完成，是迄今为止最广泛、权威的犹太法律汇编。如果你需要召集一个后灾变时代的犹太法庭，请随身准备这本书。

messages.msgid: A Short History of the Jewish People: From Legendary Times to Modern Statehood
translations: 犹太人简史：从传奇时代到现代国家
messages.plural: copies of A Short History of the Jewish People: From Legendary Times to Modern Statehood

messages.msgid: A survey-level study of Jewish history, from Biblical times through to the 1990s.  At only 250 pages long, it is by necessity very brief on any individual topic.
translations: 从圣经时代到20世纪90年代犹太历史的调查研究。这本书只有250页，对任何一个主题都必须非常简短。

messages.msgid: An English translation of Martin Buber's philosophical work on the relationships of human beings to each other and to God.
translations: 马丁 · 布伯哲学著作《人与人、人与上帝之间的关系》的英译本。

messages.plural: copies of Living a Jewish Life

messages.msgid: Anita Diamant's survey-level discussion of the daily practices and rituals of Jewish life.  Originally mostly superseded by the free availability of information on the internet, it's much more useful now for everyone who feels bad that they didn't attend their synagogue often enough before it was overrun.
translations: 安妮塔 · 迪亚曼对犹太人日常生活习惯和仪式的调查级讨论。最初，互联网上的免费信息大部分都被取代了，现在，对于那些在犹太教堂被占用之前没有经常去犹太教堂的人来说，这种方式更加有用。

messages.plural: copies of What Is a Jew

messages.msgid: Rabbi Morris Kertzer's introductory text about Judaism and Jewish beliefs, written as a series of questions and then answers, primarily from a Reform viewpoint but with explicit mention of where Conservative or Orthodox Jews would disagree.
translations: 这本介绍犹太教和犹太信仰的书由犹太拉比Morris Kertzer以问答形式所写，内容主要从改革派观点出发，但明确指出保守派或正统派犹太人可能持不同观点。

messages.msgid: The Way of Humanity: According to Chasidic Teachings
translations: 人性之道：遵循查西德教义
messages.plural: copies of The Way of Humanity: According to Chasidic Teachings

messages.msgid: An English translation of lectures given by Martin Buber on six traditional Chasidic stories from the 18th and 19th centuries.
translations: Martin Buber关于十八至十九世纪六个有关犹太哈西德派传统故事讲座，这本为英文翻译本。

messages.msgid: Megillat Esther: The Book of Esther
messages.plural: copies of Megillat Esther: The Book of Esther

messages.msgid: A comprehensive work for celebrating Purim, this book contains the complete Book of Esther in Hebrew, multiple English translations, commentary on each of its chapters, and commentary on certain verses by a group of Conservative rabbis.  Cursed be Haman (booo)!
translations: 这本书全面介绍了普珥节的由来，其中包括希伯来语版《以斯帖记》、多个英文翻译版、对每一章节的评论，以及一群保守派拉比对特定经文进行的评论。诅咒哈曼（啧啧）！

messages.msgid: Rabbi Joseph Soloveitchik's argument on the proper path to moral virtue through Torah scholarship and observance to the law, through the intellect and not through mystical experience or surrender to God.
translations: 犹太拉比Joseph Soloveitchik的著作阐述了这样一个论点：实现道德美德的正确途径是对圣经的学研和对法律的遵守，是理性而非神秘主义或对上帝的顺从。
麦斯威尔版犹太教逾越节家宴祈祷仪式书
messages.plural: copies of the Maxwell House Haggadah

messages.msgid: Just like bubbe used to have at the Seder.  A true classic of the Jewish people despite its origin as a marketing tactic to sell coffee, the Maxwell House Haggadah has sold millions of copies and graced the Passover tables of millions of families.
translations: 这本和你犹太祖母在逾越节晚餐所用的那本一模一样。尽管这本书最初是为了销售咖啡而作为营销策略所推出的，但如今它已成为犹太人民真正的经典之作，数百万的销售量让它出现在数百万家庭的逾越节餐桌上。

messages.msgid: Reviving Synagogue Communities Using Smart Tech
translations: 使用智能技术复兴犹太社区
messages.plural: copies of Reviving Synagogue Communities Using Smart Tech

messages.msgid: A discussion of ways to use modern technology to alleviate the administrative burden on clergy and synagogue staff but without losing the human touch that leads to a proper religious community.
translations: 这本书讨论了如何利用现代技术减轻教士和犹太教堂工作人员的行政负担，但又不失人文关怀，从而形成一个符合传统的宗教社区。

messages.msgid: On Repentance And Repair: Making Amends in an Unapologetic World
translations: 论忏悔与修复：修补这个不知悔改的世界
messages.plural: copies of On Repentance And Repair: Making Amends in an Unapologetic World

messages.msgid: Rabbi Danya Ruttenberg's commentary on the great Jewish philosopher Maimonides ideas about "Tikkun Olam", often translated as "Repairing the World," and how while popular ideas of forgiveness often involve moving on after the apology, the Hebrew word "teshuvah" means something closer to "return."  True repentance, then, involves making restitution for error and harm and attempting to return the world to the way it was before the damage was done.
translations: 一本拉比丹娅·鲁滕伯格对著名犹太哲学家迈蒙尼德关于“Tikkun Olam”（通常译作“修复世界”）思想的评论集。她指出，尽管通常人们对宽恕的观点是在道歉后继续向前，但希伯来语中的“teshuvah”一词更接近于“返回”。因此，真正的悔改包括对犯下的错误和伤害进行弥补，并尝试将世界恢复到造成损害之前的状态。

messages.msgid: Beyond Breaking the Glass: A Spiritual Guide to Your Jewish Wedding, Revised Edition
translations: 不只是踩碎玻璃杯：犹太婚礼的精神指南（修订版）
messages.plural: copies of Beyond Breaking the Glass: A Spiritual Guide to Your Jewish Wedding, Revised Edition

messages.msgid: A practical guide to throwing a Jewish wedding, including checklists, a timeline, and ways to make traditional rituals resonate with modern wedding guests.
translations: 一份实用的指南，教你如何举办一场犹太婚礼，包括清单、时间安排，以及一些如何让习惯现代婚礼的宾客与这些传统仪式产生共鸣的方法。

messages.msgid: People Love Dead Jews: Reports from a Haunted Present
translations: 死掉的犹太人才是好犹太人：令人不安的现状报导
messages.plural: copies of People Love Dead Jews: Reports from a Haunted Present

messages.msgid: Dara Horn's exploration of the modern rise of antisemitism, why there is so much interest in Jewish tragedy and comparatively little interest in Jewish culture, and why non-Jews feature so often and so prominently in popular stories of the Holocaust.  It would probably have been riveting and insightful before the Cataclysm made such concerns mostly irrelevant.
translations: 达拉·霍恩探讨了现代反犹主义的兴起，人们为什么对犹太悲剧如此感兴趣，而对犹太文化的兴趣相对较少，以及非犹太人在有关大屠杀的流行故事中为何经常且显著地出现。在大灾变之前，这样的讨论可能很有洞察力且引人入胜，但现在，这些问题大多已经变得不那么重要了。

messages.msgid: God in Search of Man : A Philosophy of Judaism
translations: 寻找人的上帝：犹太教哲学
messages.plural: copies of God in Search of Man : A Philosophy of Judaism

messages.msgid: Rabbi Abraham Joshua Heschel's philosophical work on religious thought, on revelation and the problem of evil, and on the nature of a God who seeks a partner in humanity.
translations: 拉比亚伯拉罕·约书亚·赫舍尔关于宗教思想、启示、恶的问题以及一位寻求与人类合作的上帝的性质的哲学著作。

messages.msgid: Not in God's Name: Confronting Religious Violence
translations: 不以上帝的名义：直面宗教暴力
messages.plural: copies of Not in God's Name: Confronting Religious Violence

messages.msgid: Rabbi Abraham Joshua Heschel's answer to the claim that religion is fundamentally divisive and encourages conflict.  His main argument is that religiously-motivated violence stems from misreadings of sacred texts.
translations: 拉比亚伯拉罕-约书亚-赫舍尔(Abraham Joshua Heschel)对 "宗教从根本上具有分裂性并助长冲突 "这一说法的回答。 他的主要论点是，出于宗教动机的暴力源于对圣典的误读。

messages.msgid: When Bad Things Happen to Good People
translations: 当坏事发生在好人身上
messages.plural: copies of When Bad Things Happen to Good People

messages.msgid: A meditation on meaningless tragedy and why the disaster and sorrow in the world is unevenly distributed.  Written decades before the Cataclysm, but the author was obviously on to something.
translations: 一篇关于毫无意义的悲剧以及为什么世界上的灾难和悲伤分布不均的空想文章。这篇文章是在大灾变之前写的，但作者显然知道点什么。

messages.plural: copies of The Jewish War: Revised Edition

messages.msgid: An account of the Roman conquest of Judea and the destruction of the Temple written by Josephus, the first century Judean rebel turned Roman negotiator.
translations: 这是由约瑟夫斯写的一篇关于罗马征服犹太以及圣殿被毁的记述。约瑟夫斯是一位一世纪的犹太叛军，后来成为了罗马的谈判代表。

messages.msgid: Standing Again at Sinai: Judaism from a Feminist Perspective
translations: 再次站在西奈半岛：女性主义视角下的犹太教
messages.plural: copies of Standing Again at Sinai: Judaism from a Feminist Perspective

messages.msgid: A critique of Jewish practice by a Jewish feminist theologian.
translations: 犹太女权主义神学家写的犹太习俗批判。

messages.msgid: Zohar: The Book of Splendor: Basic Readings from the Kabbalah
translations: 佐哈尔（辉煌之书）：卡巴拉的基础读物
messages.plural: copies of Zohar: The Book of Splendor: Basic Readings from the Kabbalah

messages.msgid: A book of Jewish mysticism often attributed to the great rabbi Shimon bar Yochai, the Zohar is the central work of Kabbalah.  This is an abridged version containing selected passages from the full text.
translations: 一本有关犹太神秘主义的一本书，通常认为是伟大的拉比西门·巴尔·尤查伊所著，《光明篇》是卡巴拉思想的核心著作。这是一本精简版，包含了全文的选段。

messages.msgid: Miriam's Tambourine: Jewish Folktales from Around the World
translations: 米里亚姆的手鼓：来自世界各地的犹太民间故事
messages.plural: copies of Miriam's Tambourine: Jewish Folktales from Around the World

messages.msgid: A collection of over fifty Jewish folktales, from classics like the story of Miriam's well or Rabbi Loew and the golem or the life of the Baal Shem Tov, to Jewish versions of modern cultural classics like Snow White or Sinbad.
translations: 这是一个收集了50多个犹太民间故事的合集，其中包括了如米利暗之井、拉比罗伊与泥人，巴尔·舍姆·托夫的生平等经典故事，以及犹太版的现代文化经典，譬如白雪公主或辛巴达。

messages.msgid: From the Maccabees to the Mishnah
messages.plural: copies of From the Maccabees to the Mishnah

messages.msgid: A history of the development of Rabbinic Judaism, from the Jewish Revolt in the first century to the writing of the Mishnah, and how Judaism and Christianity fully separated.
translations: 这是一部关于拉比犹太教发展历史的著作，从一世纪的犹太起义到《米什纳》的撰写，以及犹太教和基督教如何完全分离的过程。

messages.msgid: A ruined book.  Someone has thoroughly ruined this book by ripping pages out and covering the remainder in… is that paint?
translations: 一本被毁坏的书。有人彻底毁了这本书，撕掉了书页，用……那是颜料吗？

messages.msgid: Scraps of paper that used to be part of a book.  Completely useless now.
translations: 曾经是书籍一部分的纸片。现在完全没用了。

messages.msgid: A booklet full of a bunch of information about a firearm, including how one is operated, how to take apart and clean the gun, and myriad of safety precautions.
translations: 一本小册子，里面有很多关于枪械的信息，包括如何操作枪支、如何拆卸和清洁枪支，以及无数的安全预防措施。

messages.msgid: A mishmash of self-contradictory advice on spirits, auras, chakras, crystals, and psychic powers.
translations: 一堆自相矛盾的关于精神、光环、查克拉、水晶和灵能的建议。

messages.msgid: Could you secretly have psychic powers?  Learn to see auras, attune to your chakras, and get down and dirty with your astral self.
translations: 你体内有隐藏的灵能吗？学会观察光环，调谐你体内的查克拉，让自己躺下，释放出星体自我。

messages.plural: copies of The Healing Power of Crystals

messages.msgid: Why waste time with 'doctors' or 'medicine'?  This guide will teach you to harness the innate healing power of crystals and nurture your soul.
translations: 为什么要把时间浪费在"医生"或"药物"上？本指南将教你如何利用水晶天生的治疗能力，滋养你的灵魂。

messages.msgid: The secret to happiness is simple: aromatherapy.  Surround yourself with products from our line of essential oils, using the discount code HAPPY for 10 percent off your first purchase, and you too can have it all.
translations: 幸福的秘诀很简单：芳香疗法。用我们的精油系列产品包围你自己，使用折扣码HAPPY，首次购买就可以享受10%的折扣，你也可以拥有这一切。

messages.msgid: This book starts with a spell for self-confidence (hang some lavender above your bathroom mirror), and works its way up to a hex for an ex (slash their tires).
translations: 这本书从一个提高自信的法术开始（在你浴室的镜子上挂一些薰衣草），然后一直将前女友变形的法术（割破她们的轮胎）。

messages.msgid: This book apparently contains instructions for summoning and battling powerful spirits from other realms.  It doesn't say anything about zombies, though.
translations: 这本书显然包含了从其他位面召唤并打败强大精灵的方法。不过，它没有提到丧尸。

messages.msgid: What happens beyond death might be a mystery to the unlearned, but with careful use of a crystal ball, available for purchase on our website, you too can see beyond the veil.
translations: 死后会发生什么对未学的人来说可能是个谜，但是仔细使用我们网站上提供的水晶球，你也可以看到纱幕之外的东西。

messages.msgid: While this book claims crystals can be used to cast offensive spells, you suspect it might be more effective to just throw them.
translations: 虽然这本书声称水晶可以用来施放攻击性法术，但你怀疑直接把它们丢出去可能更有效。

messages.msgid: Who made the Bermuda Triangle?  How did they build Stonehenge?  What did the alien king whisper in Cleopatra's ear that passionate night in the dunes?  These answers and more in the Alien Theorists' latest exposé.
translations: 谁创造了百慕大三角？他们是怎么建造巨石阵的？在沙丘边那个充满激情的夜晚，外星人国王在埃及艳后耳边低语了什么？这些答案和更多外星人理论成果的首次曝光。

messages.plural: copies of Your Year in Horoscopes

messages.msgid: A long, thorough list of horoscopes, sorted by date and by zodiac sign.  Today, you should "take a minute to relax - It's not the end of the world."
translations: 一长串完整的星座万年历，按日期和星座排序。今天，你应该"花点时间放松一下——这不是世界末日。"

messages.msgid: A deep discussion of morality with an emphasis on epistemology and logic.
translations: 一本对道德准则进行深入讨论的书，侧重于认识论和逻辑学。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Nietzsche's "Beyond Good and Evil".  Its cover is dog-eared and creased.
translations: 尼采所著的《善恶的彼岸》。它的封面已经折角变皱。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Unique and Its Property" by Max Stirner.  A modern translation by Wolfi Landstreicher.
translations: 麦克斯·施蒂纳所著的《唯一者及其所有物》。这本是Wolfi Landstreicher的现代译本。

messages.msgid: A large, extended version of "Madness and Civilization" by Michel Foucault.  The cover features a striking image of a Panopticonic Prison.
translations: 米歇尔·福柯所著的《疯癫与文明》的大部头增订版。封面上印着一幅极具视觉冲击力的圆形监狱的图像。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Postmodern Condition: A Report on Knowledge" by Lyotard.
translations: 让-弗朗索瓦·利奥塔所著的《后现代状况》。

messages.msgid: A collection of texts and essays by Jacques Derrida.  Its pages are loose and yellowed - you should probably handle it with care.
translations: 雅克·德里达的散文集。这本书的书页已经松散发黄，需要小心存放。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Society of the Spectacle" by Guy Debord.  Its cover shows rows of adults staring placidly into a screen.
translations: 居伊·德波所著的《景观社会》。这本书的封面上展示着数排成年人满足地盯着一块屏幕的图像。

messages.msgid: This is a split copy of both "An Ethic of Sexual Difference" and "This Sex Which Is Not One" by Luce Irigaray.
translations: 路思·伊瑞葛来所著的《An Ethic of Sexual Difference（性别差异的伦理）》和《This Sex Which Is Not One（此性非一）》的合订版。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Baudrillard's "Simulation and Simulacra".  The cover contains an image of a man holding a colored pill in each hand, with the caption "Welcome to the Desert of the Real.".  You think you've seen this movie.
translations: 让·鲍德里亚所著的《拟像和模拟》。这本书的封面上印着一名男性，两手拿着不同颜色的药丸，图题为"欢迎来到真实的荒漠"。你觉得你好像看过一部这样的电影。

messages.msgid: This is a small, pocket version of Sartre's "Existentialism and Humanism".  It looks to have been used as a coaster in a past life.
translations: 让-保罗·萨特所著的《存在主义是一种人道主义》的口袋版。这本书看起来曾经被当作杯托用过。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Practical Ethics" by Peter Singer.  From the local university press.
translations: 彼得·辛格所著的《Practical Ethics（实用伦理学）》，由本地大学的出版社出版。

messages.msgid: This is a photocopied spiral-bound copy of "Industrial Society and Its Future" by 'Freedom Club'.  The original looks to have been written on a typewriter before being copied.
translations: 一本"Freedom Club（自由俱乐部）"所著的《论工业社会及其未来》的活页影印本。影印前的原书似乎是用打字机撰写的。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Industrial Society and Its Future" by Ted Kaczynski.  Its cover is an image of a hand-crafted wooden box filled with wiring and an ominous looking metal tube.  Provocative.
translations: 泰德·卡辛斯基所著的《论工业社会及其未来》。这本的封面上印着一个手工制的木盒，里面装有电线和金属管，给人一种不好的预感。极具煽动性。

messages.msgid: This is a small reader on Hegel's Dialectics.
translations: 这是一本有关黑格尔的辩证法的简短读物。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The State and Revolution" by Vladimir Lenin.  In English, thankfully.
translations: 列宁所著的《国家与革命》。幸好是英文版译本。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "In Defense of Marxism" by Leon Trotsky.
translations: 列夫·达维多维奇·托洛茨基所著的《保卫马克思主义》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Steal This Book" by Abbie Hoffman.  There is a security tag on the back cover.  It appears to still be active.
translations: 艾比·霍夫曼所著的《Steal This Book（偷走这本书）》。书背上有一个防盗标签，看起来仍处于工作状态。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Walden: Or Life In The Woods" by Henry David Thoreau.  It contains a dried and pressed leaf as a bookmark.
translations: 亨利·大卫·梭罗所著的《湖滨散记》，里面夹着一张干燥压扁的树叶书签。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Female Eunuch" by Germaine Greer.  A child has scribbled over the contents page in red crayon.
translations: 杰梅茵·格里尔所著的《女太监》。目录上面不知道是哪个熊孩子用红蜡笔乱涂一气。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "An Introduction to Metaphysics" by Bergson.
translations: 亨利·柏格森所著的《形而上学导论》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Four Fundamental Concepts of Psychoanalysis" by Jacques Lacan.
translations: 雅各·拉冈所著的《The Four Fundamental Concepts of Psychoanalysis（精神分析的四个基本概念）》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Machiavelli's "The Prince".  With intro by Q. Skinner.
translations: 尼科洛·迪贝尔纳多·代·马基雅维利所著的《君主论》，由昆廷·斯金纳作序。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Revolution of Everyday Life" by Raoul Vaneigem.
translations: 劳尔·范内格姆所著《日常生活的革命》(1967)。

messages.msgid: This is a pocket copy of "An Essay on Liberation" by Herbert Marcuse.  The cover contains an image of a pelican.
translations: 赫伯特·马尔库塞所著《论解放》的口袋版。封面上画着一只鹈鹕。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Either-Or" by Søren Kierkegaard.
translations: 索伦·奥贝·克尔凯郭尔所著的《非此即彼》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Allegory of the Cave" by Plato.
translations: 柏拉图所著的《地穴寓言》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Leviathan" by Thomas Hobbes.
translations: 托马斯·霍布斯所著的《利维坦》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Critique Of Pure Reason" by Immanuel Kant.
translations: 伊曼努尔·康德所著的《纯粹理性批判》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Principles of Philosophy" by René Descartes.
translations: 勒内·笛卡尔所著的《哲学原理》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of both "On the Genealogy of Morality" and "The Gay Science" by Friederich Nietzsche.
translations: 弗里德里希·尼采所著《道德谱系学》和《快乐的科学》的合订本。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Myth of Sisyphus", and other essays, by Albert Camus.  The cover depicts a bare-chested man and a large boulder.
translations: 阿尔贝·加缪所著的《西绪弗斯神话》，以及其它散文。封面上画着一个光着膀子的男人和一块巨石。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Sickness Unto Death" by Søren Kierkegaard.  The pages are dotted with post-it notes.
translations: 索伦·奥贝·克尔凯郭尔所著的《致死的疾病》。书页上贴着许多便利贴。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Defence of Terrorism" by Leon Trotsky.  Despite the title, it does not actually appear to be defending terrorism.
translations: 列夫·达维多维奇·托洛茨基所著的《The Defence of Terrorism（对恐怖主义的辩护）》。虽然标题如此，但是其内容似乎并不是在辩护恐怖主义。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Enquiry Concerning Political Justice" by William Godwin.  This thick book is filled with antiquated phrases.
translations: 威廉·戈德温所著的《政治正义论》。这本厚书里面充满了陈旧的用词。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Abolition of Work and Other Essays" by Bob Black.  It is likely that "The Abolition of Work" is the most famous essay in this book.
translations: 鲍勃·布莱克所著的《废除工作与其他文章》。《废除工作》很可能是这本书里面最有名的一篇文章。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "What is Property?" by Pierre-Joseph Proudhon.  It looks like this book has a surprisingly long track record of owners.
translations: 皮埃尔-约瑟夫·普鲁东所著的《什么是所有权》。看起来这本的所有权改换过不少次。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Conquest of Bread" by Peter Kropotkin.  There is a picture of an old philosopher with magnificent beard, instead of bread, on the cover.
translations: 彼得·阿列克谢耶维奇·克鲁泡特金亲王所著的《夺取面包》。封面上只印着一个大胡子老哲学家的照片，并没有什么面包。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Trouble with Being Born" by Emil Cioran.  This book might have been printed decades before the Cataclysm since the cover is quite weathered.
translations: 萧沆所著的《诞生之不便》。这本书应该是大灾变前几十年出版的，封面已经饱经风雨。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The World as Will and Representation" by Arthur Schopenhauer.  It contains a few undecipherable notes and scribbles.
translations: 阿图尔·叔本华所著的《作为意志和表象的世界》。书上有着一些潦草难解的笔记和涂画。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Up-Wingers: A Futurist Manifesto" by FM-2030.  It seems that the author's real name is Fereidoun M. Esfandiary.
translations: FM-2030所著的《UpWingers: A Futurist Manifesto（上翼：未来主义宣言）》。看上去作者的真名好像是Fereidoun M. Esfandiary（费雷登·伊斯凡迪亚里）

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Bastiat Collection", a large collection of essays by Frederic Bastiat.
translations: 一本《巴斯夏文集》，19世纪法国的古典自由主义理论家弗雷德里克·巴斯夏的大型文集。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Anarchy, State, and Utopia" by Robert Nozick, one of the most influential books of modern libertarianism.
translations: 一本《无政府、国家和乌托邦》，罗伯特·诺齐克著，这是现代自由主义最具影响力的著作之一。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Socialism" by Ludwig von Mises, a critical examination of socialism.
translations: 一本《社会主义》，路德维希·冯·米塞斯著，一部对社会主义的批判性分析著作。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The ABC of Communism" by Nikolai Bukharin, one of the most influential books of early Marxism-Leninism.
translations: 一本《共产主义ABC》，尼古拉·布哈林著，这是马列主义早期最具影响力的著作之一。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Anti-Capitalist Mentality" by Ludwig von Mises.
translations: 路德维希·冯·米塞斯所著的《反资本主义的心态》。
作为形而上学的模态逻辑

messages.msgid: A treatise on applying logical tools to questions about that nature of reality, this book contains detailed discussion of metaphysical issues.
translations: 这本书详细讨论了形而上学的问题，是一部运用了各类逻辑工具来解决现实本质问题的论著。

messages.msgid: This hardbound anthology presents a collection of readings, scholarly works, and critical analyses on the subject of beauty.
translations: 这本精装的论文集提供了一系列美学方面的阅读资料，学术研究和批判分析。

messages.plural: copies of The Philosophy of Information

messages.msgid: This university text details a critical investigation of the conceptual nature and basic principles of information.  The student will gain a thorough appreciation of the conceptual frameworks commonly used to describe and advance semantic investigations.
translations: 这部大学教材对信息的概念性质和基本原理进行了深入地批判性研究。学生将全面了解常用的用于描述和推进语义分析的概念框架。

messages.msgid: This paperback is a copy of Jean-Paul Sartre's "Being and Nothingness".  A key work in the existentialist tradition.
translations: 一本平装版的《存在与虚无》，让-保罗·萨特著，存在主义的重要著作。

messages.msgid: A hardboiled detective tale filled with hard hitting action and intrigue.
translations: 一本冷硬派的侦探小说，充满着硬派动作与阴谋，由"文森特和马沙的妻子"、"金表"、"邦妮的处境"三个故事组成。
来自火星的黑色女武神
messages.plural: copies of Black Valkyries From Venus

messages.msgid: You hold in your hands a weather-beaten novel written by someone named "Lee Racket."
translations: 你手里拿着一本饱经风霜的小说，这本小说是由一个名叫"李·勒克"的人写的。

messages.msgid: You hold in your hands a cheap drugstore paperback written by someone named "Lee Racket."
translations: 你手里拿着一本廉价的药店平装小说，这本小说是由一个名叫"李·勒克"的人写的。

messages.plural: copies of No God From a Corpse

messages.msgid: A weatherworn paperback written by some skirt named "Lee Racket."  It tells how rage and jealousy can turn a man, or a woman, into a monster.  This story is hard-boiled enough to break a spoon.
translations: 由名为"李·勒克"的女作者写的粗糙平装小说，讲述了愤怒和嫉妒是如何将一个人变成怪物的，故事生硬老掉牙。

messages.msgid: This dimestore short story about space travel is written by a broad named "Lee Racket."
translations: 一部关于太空旅行的短篇小说，这本小说是由一个名叫"李·勒克"的人写的。

messages.msgid: Planet of the Murderous Squids that Time Forgot!
translations: 被时间遗忘的杀人乌贼星球
messages.plural: copies of Planet of the Murderous Squids that Time Forgot!

messages.msgid: In this psychedelic adventure novel of cosmic exploration, an elderly assassin discovers a planet too good to be true.  Only once it is too late does she discover the harrowing truth at the center of "The Planet of the Murderous Squids that Time Forgot!"
translations: 一部关于宇宙探索的迷幻冒险小说，讲述了一位年长的刺客发现了一颗好得难以置信的行星。当她发现位于"那颗被时间遗忘的杀人乌贼星球"中心那万分恐怖的真相时，一切都太迟了。
大都市中的斗篷英雄们
messages.plural: copies of The Great Capes of Metropolis

messages.msgid: In this classic pulp paperback of superheroic exploits, a group of masked vigilantes with diverse superpowers learn to work together to defeat the ultimate villain.
translations: 一本经典的平装超级英雄故事书，描述了一群拥有不同超能力的平民蒙面英雄学习如何齐心战胜终极大反派的故事。

messages.msgid: In this fast paced pulp noir, a hard-drinking detective with nerves of steel has one last shot at vengeance.
translations: 这本快节奏的平装小说讲述了一位拥有好酒量的侦探如何用他钢铁般的意志抓住了最后一次复仇机会。

messages.msgid: Flashgun Condor and the Crimson Criminal
messages.plural: copies of Flashgun Condor and the Crimson Criminal

messages.msgid: A hot-blooded photographer who fights crime with film, footage, and fists, Condor is more than a mere shutterbug on the crime beat.  But will she be able to unravel a devious deception and bring the "Crimson Criminal" to justice?
translations: 秃鹰不仅仅是一个普通的摄影迷，她是一位用电影、镜头和拳头打击犯罪的热血摄影师。但这次，她能解开这个狡猾的骗局，将"腥红狂徒"绳之以法吗？

messages.msgid: Aliens, ray guns, and space ships.
translations: 一本充斥着各类外星人、激光枪以及太空飞船描写的小说。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Gibson's "Neuromancer".  Written in the eighties, it was surprisingly accurate in predicting much of modern society… until recently.
translations: 这是一本威廉·吉布森的《神经漫游者》。虽然成书于上世纪80年代，但这本科幻经典令人惊奇地精准预测了许多现代社会的情形……但并不包括如今的情况。

messages.msgid:
This is a copy of "The Stars My Destination" by Alfred Bester.

Tyger, Tyger, Burning bright,
In the forests of the night:
What immortal hand or eye,
Dare frame thy fearful symmetry?
translations:
这是一本DC著名编剧、科幻作家阿尔弗雷德·贝斯特 所著的《群星，我的归宿》（又名《虎，虎》），书名源于威廉·布莱克的名诗《老虎》。

"虎，虎，光焰灼灼
燃烧在黑夜之林，
怎样的神手和神眼
构造出你可畏的美健？"

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Lathe of Heaven" by Ursula Le Guin.  Dirty finger-stains have smudged the occasional word.
translations: 这是一本厄休拉·勒奎恩所著的《天钧》。这本书被人用脏手拿过，所以有些词被污迹覆盖了。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Dispossessed" by Ursula Le Guin.
translations: 这是一本著名科幻作家厄休拉·勒奎恩所著的雨果奖、星云奖获奖作品《一无所有》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Hyperion" by Dan Simmons.
translations: 这是一本天才科幻作家丹·西蒙斯的雨果奖获奖作品、著名的"海伯利安四部曲"中的第一部《海伯利安》。

messages.msgid:
This is a copy of "Endymion" by Dan Simmons.  It opens with a poem by D.H. Lawrence:

Give us gods.  Oh give them us!
Give us gods.
We are so tired of men
And motor-power.
translations:
这是一本天才科幻作家丹·西蒙斯的获奖作品、著名的"海伯利安四部曲"的第三部《安迪密恩》。它以一段戴维·赫伯特·劳伦斯的诗作开篇：

"赐予我们神灵吧，
哦，请把他们赐予我们吧！
赐予我们神灵吧。
我们是如此地厌倦，
凡人和发动机。"

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Philip K. Dick's "Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?".
translations: 这是一本由著名科幻作家菲利普·K·迪克所著的科幻名篇《仿生人会梦见电子羊吗？》。

messages.msgid: This is a dog-eared copy of "Nova Express" by William Burroughs.
translations: 一本被翻旧了的《新星快递》，由威廉·巴勒斯所著。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Foundation" by Isaac Asimov.  The back cover has been ripped off.
translations: 这是一本由全球知名科幻作家艾萨克·阿西莫夫所著的、享誉全球的"基地系列"第一部《基地》。它的封底已经被撕掉了。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Trial" by Franz Kafka.  This book is rather worn.
translations: 这是一本弗兰兹·卡夫卡的经典文学著作《审判》。这本书已经被翻得破旧不堪了。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Handmaid's Tale" by Margaret Atwood.
translations: 这是一本加拿大小说家玛格丽特·阿特伍德的文学著作《使女的故事》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Windup Girl" by Paolo Bacigalupi.  The blurb makes you wonder how Thailand fared the end of the world.
translations: 这是一本科幻作家保罗·巴奇加卢皮所著的科幻大奖作品《发条女孩》。这本书的简介使你不禁思索遥远的泰国是如何度过这个末日的。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Islands in the Net" by Bruce Sterling.
translations: 这是一本赛博朋克背景的科幻小说《网上的孤岛》，由赛博朋克之父、著名科幻作家布鲁斯·斯特林所著。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Foundation and Empire" by Isaac Asimov.  The back page contains a hand-written grocery list.
translations: 这是一本由全球知名科幻作家艾萨克·阿西莫夫所著的、享誉全球的"基地系列"第二部《基地与帝国》。它的封底上被人写了一页超市购物单。

messages.msgid: This is an almost new copy of  "A Scanner Darkly" by Philip K. Dick.  It still has the smell of new books within its pages.
translations: 这是一本几乎全新的《遮蔽的眼睛》（又译《黑暗扫描仪》《心机扫描》《盲区行者》），由著名科幻作家菲利普·K·迪克所著。翻开它的时候，你仍然能闻到新书特有的油墨香气。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Mirrorshades: A Cyberpunk Anthology" compiled by Bruce Sterling.  The cover has rings of coffee stains over it.
translations: 这是一本由赛博朋克之父布鲁斯·斯特林编撰的《镜影：赛博朋克文集》。它的封面上残留着晕开的咖啡渍。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The World of Null-A" by A. E. van Vogt.  This copy looks to have been used to press flowers.
translations: 这是一本由著名科幻作家范·沃克特所著的科幻著作《非A世界》。这本书看起来好像被原主人用来做过压花。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Altered Carbon" by Richard Morgan.
translations: 这是一本科幻作家理查德·摩根所著的科幻作品《副本》（同名网剧在Netflix上映）。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Mary Shelley's "Frankenstein".  Wasn't that the name of the monster?
translations: 这是一本由世界上第一位科幻作家玛丽·雪莱所著的世界上第一本科幻作品《弗兰肯斯坦》。这不就是那种怪物的名字吗？

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Wasp" by Eric Frank Russel.  The futuristic terrorist's handbook.
translations: 这是一本英国早期科幻作家埃里克·弗兰克·拉塞尔所著的科幻作品《黄蜂》(1957)。这简直就是一本为未来主义恐怖分子量身打造的手册。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "I Am Legend" by Richard Matheson.  The sleeve is covered in dried blood.
translations: 这是一本由著名编剧、科幻小说家理查德·麦瑟森所著的《我是传奇》（同名电影由弗朗西斯·劳伦斯导演、威尔·史密斯主演）。这本书的封套上沾染了干掉的血渍。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Forever War" by Joe Haldeman.  This copy looks as if it's been slightly chewed by a dog or other large animal.
translations: 这是一本由著名科幻作家乔`霍尔德曼所著的《永世之战》(1974)。这本书看起来破烂得就像被狗或者别的大型动物嚼过一小会。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Moon Is a Harsh Mistress" by Robert A. Heinlein.
translations: 这是一本由硬科幻大师罗伯特·A·海因莱因所著的《严厉的月亮》（又译《月亮是冷傲的情人》）。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Samuel R. Delany's "Nova".  The cover reads "Review Copy.  Not for re-sale."
translations: 这是一本著名后现代科幻作家萨缪尔·R·德兰尼的科幻著作《新星》。这本书的封面上写着"赠阅本，非卖品"。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Vonnegut's "The Sirens of Titan".
translations: 这是一本由著名黑色幽默作家库尔特·冯古内特所著的科幻小说《泰坦族的海妖》(1959)。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Grass" by Sheri S. Tepper.  A child has scribbled over the first pages in crayon.
translations: 这是一本由美国女性主义奇幻科幻作家雪莉.泰珀所著的科幻奇幻作品《草》。有个孩子曾在封面上用蜡笔涂鸦。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of William Gibson's "Count Zero".  The spine is stamped with 'Library Copy'.  And a sticker reading 'Science Fiction'.
translations: 这是一本由著名科幻作家威廉·吉布森所著的著名科幻小说《零伯爵》。书脊上盖着"图书馆藏书"的章，还贴了一个"科幻小说"的分类贴纸。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Weapon Makers" by A. E. van Vogt.
translations: 这是一本由著名科幻作家A.E.范·沃克特所著的科幻作品《武器制造商》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Record of a Spaceborn Few" by Becky Chambers.  It looks almost brand new.
translations: 这是一本由2019年雨果奖入围作家贝基·钱伯斯创作的长篇科幻小说《太空出生者的少数派报告》。它看起来几乎是全新的。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Use of Weapons" by Iain M. Banks.  The spine is cracked and worn, some pages appear to be loose.
translations: 这是一本由著名科幻小说作家伊恩·班克斯所著的太空歌剧《武器制造商》（又译《武器浮生录》）。这本书的书脊被扯破了，有些书页看起来已经变得松动。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Jean-Baptiste Cousin de Grainville's "Le Dernier Homme".
translations: 这是一本由法国作家让-巴普提斯特·库辛·德·格兰维尔所著的《最后一个人类》。这是世界上第一部描述世界末日的现代推想小说。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Orwell's "Nineteen Eighty-Four".  The pages are loose and thin.  You should probably be careful with this copy.
translations: 这是一本乔治·奥威尔的著名反乌托邦小说《一九八四》。这本书的书页又松又薄，你得小心别把它弄坏了。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Heinlein's "Stranger in a Strange Land".  The cover is dog-eared and worn.
translations: 这是一本著名硬科幻大师罗伯特·安森·海因莱因所著的科幻文学作品《异乡异客》。它的封面已经卷边破损了。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Orson Scott Card's "Ender's Game".
translations: 这是一本著名科幻作家奥森·斯科特·卡德创作的雨果奖、星云奖获奖作品《安德的游戏》(1986)。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Lost World" by Arthur Conan Doyle.
translations: 这是一本由著名推理小说家、福尔摩斯之父阿瑟·柯南·道尔所著的著名科幻小说《迷失的世界》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Islands in the Sky" by Arthur C. Clarke.
translations: 这是一本由世界知名科幻小说家阿瑟·C·克拉克所创作的科幻作品《空中列岛》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of H. G. Wells' "The Island of Doctor Moreau".
translations: 这是一本由世界知名小说家、政治家H·G·威尔斯所创作的科幻著作《莫洛博士岛》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Stanisław Lem's "His Masters Voice".
translations: 这是一本由波兰著名天才科幻作家、哲学家斯坦尼斯拉夫·莱姆所创作的科幻小说《其主之声》(1968)。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Fred Hoyle's "The Black Cloud".
translations: 这是一本由英国著名天文学家弗雷德·霍伊尔所创作的科幻小说《黑云压境》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Last and First Men" by Olaf Stapeldon.
translations: 这是一本由英国哲学家、科幻作家奥拉夫·斯塔普雷创作的科幻著作《最后和最先的人》(1930)。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Stanisław Lem's "Solaris".
translations: 这是一本由波兰著名天才科幻作家、哲学家斯坦尼斯拉夫·莱姆所创作的著名克苏鲁风格科幻小说《索拉里斯星》（同名电影被翻拍多次）。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Theodore Sturgeon's "More Than Human".
translations: 这是一本由著名科幻小说作家西奥多·斯特金所著的国际幻想文学奖获奖作品《超人类》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Vurt" by Jeff Noon.
translations: 这是一本由著名赛博朋克作家杰夫·努恩所创作的科幻小说《瓦尔特》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "A Canticle for Leibowitz" by Walter M. Miller Jr.
translations: 这是一本由美国科幻小说家小沃尔特·M·米勒所创作的科幻著作《莱伯维茨的赞歌》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The War of The Worlds" by H. G. Wells.
translations: 这是一本由世界知名小说家、政治家H·G·威尔斯所创作的科幻著作《星际战争》（又译《世界之战》、《世界大战》、《强战世界》）。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Iron Sunrise" by Charles Stross.
translations: 这是一本由英国科幻小说家查尔斯·斯特罗斯创作的科幻小说《末日奇点：钢铁朝阳》（《奇点天空》续作）。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Hunger Games" by Suzanne Collins.  Reading the blurb reminds you of a Japanese movie you think you once caught on the television late at night.
translations: 这是一本由全美著名畅销小说作家苏珊妮·科林斯所创作的《饥饿游戏》。看到封面上的宣传语，你不禁想起一部曾在深夜里偶然在电视上瞥见的日本电影。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Day of the Triffids" by John Wyndham.
translations: 这是一本由著名短篇科幻小说家约翰·温德汉姆创作的著名科幻小说《三尖树之日》。（注：这本书就是游戏中三尖树怪物的出处）

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "A Clockwork Orange" by Anthony Burges.
translations: 这是一本由著名作家安东尼·伯吉斯所著的青春幻想小说《发条橙》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Man Who Fell to Earth" by Walter Tevis.
translations: 这是一本由科幻作家沃尔特·特维斯创作的科幻小说《天外来客》（翻拍为同名电影(1976)、电视剧(1987)）。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Simulacron-3" by Daniel F. Galouye.
translations: 这是一本由著名科幻小说家丹尼尔·弗朗西斯·伽洛耶所著的赛博朋克经典著作《三重模拟》（又译《十三层空间》，不知道多了的十层是哪里来的）。这是科幻文学史上第一部描写虚拟现实技术的小说。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "The Glass Bees" by Ernst Jünger.
translations: 这是一本由德国著名作家恩斯特·荣格创作的科幻小说《玻璃蜜蜂》，其中探讨了纳米机器人的未来。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of "Journey to The Center of the Earth" by Jules Verne.
translations: 这是一本由全球知名的法国科幻小说大师儒勒·凡尔纳创作的知名科幻巨著《地心游记》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Larry Niven's "Ringworld".  There are a couple of pages missing from the end of the book.  Luckily only mail-order advertisements.
translations: 这是一本由著名科幻小说作家拉里·尼文所创作的星云奖、雨果奖、轨迹奖获奖作品、世界公认硬科幻大师之作《环形世界》。这本书最后几页不幸遗失了，但幸好那只是一些邮购广告。

messages.msgid: This is a well-worn copy of "The Hitchhikers Guide to the Galaxy" by Douglas Adams.
translations: 这是一本被翻旧的科幻著作《银河系漫游指南》，由著名科幻作家道格拉斯·亚当斯所著。

messages.msgid: This is a dog-eared copy of "Dune" by Frank Herbert.  It has sand between some of its pages.  Weird.
translations: 这是一本折了角的《沙丘》，由著名科幻作家弗兰克·赫伯特所著。这本《沙丘》的一些书页之间夹了些沙子，真奇怪。

messages.msgid: This is a sturdy copy of "Dune" by Frank Herbert.  It is a fairly new reprint with the words "SOON TO BE A MAJOR MOTION PICTURE" splashed across its dust jacket.
translations: 一本结实的弗兰克·赫伯特所著的《沙丘》的复刻本。它是最近才出版的重印本，在它附带的防尘套上面喷印着"剧场版即将上映"的文字。

messages.plural: copies of Parable of the Talents

messages.msgid: This is a sturdy copy of "Parable of the Talents.".  It is Octavia Butler's sequel to her book "Parable of the Sower."
translations: 一本结实的《天才寓言》。此书是奥克塔维亚·巴特勒所著《播种者寓言》的续集。

messages.msgid: This is a signed hardcover copy of the Hugo award winning "The Fifth Season" by N. K. Jemisin.  It smells faintly of dirt.
translations: 这是一本由科幻作家N·K·杰米辛所著的2016年雨果奖获奖作品《第五季》的作者签名精装版。它闻起来有一股微弱的泥土味。

messages.msgid:
This hardback book is titled "The Annotated We: A New Translation of Yevgeny Zamyatin's Novel."

It is Vladimir Wozniuk's 2015 translation of "We," originally published in 1924 and generally seen as the first modern dystopian novel.  The commentary examines the profusive allusions and highlights the poetic nature of Zamyatin's language.
translations:
这本精装书的标题是《注释〈我们〉：叶夫根尼·扎米亚金小说的新译本》。

此书是由弗拉基米尔·沃兹尼克于2015年重新翻译的《我们》，原版最初出版于1924年，被普遍视为第一部现代反乌托邦小说。新书中注释详细介绍了丰富的历史典故并突出了扎米亚金小说语言中所富有的诗意。

messages.msgid:
A seminal work of dystopian fiction, Yevgeny Zamyatin's "We" was first published in 1924 but suppressed by the Soviet Union until 1988.

This mass-market 1993 edition you've found was translated from the Russian by Clarence Brown and includes a short introduction.  The slightly worn cover features a surrealist photo of a person gazing backward suspiciously.
translations:
作为反乌托邦小说的开创性作品，叶夫根尼·扎米亚金的《我们》于1924年首次出版，但苏联一直到1988年才将其解禁。

你手中这本书是1993年批量出版翻译自俄文的版本，由克拉伦斯·布朗翻译，包括一个简短的前言介绍。略显破旧的封面上有一张超现实主义的照片，照片中一个人怀疑地向身后凝视着。

messages.msgid: This 350 page paperback presents the exploits and robotic rivalries of Trurl and Klapaucius.  Originally written in Polish by Stanisław Lem, it has been masterfully translated into English by Michael Kandel.
translations: 这本350页的平装书介绍了造物者图尔和克莱鲍修斯的功绩和它们之间的机器人竞争。此书最初是由斯坦尼斯拉夫·莱姆用波兰语写成的，后来被迈克尔·坎德尔熟练地翻译成英译本。

messages.msgid: This is weather worn copy of "Brave New World" by Aldous Huxley looks like it has been left out in rain.  The novel begins in a bleak building where fetuses are grown in bottles on an assembly line.
translations: 一本奥尔德斯·赫胥黎所著的经典小说《美丽新世界》，看起来像是被雨淋过一般饱经风霜。这部小说的故事开始于一座凄惨建筑之中，在那里，胎儿是在流水线上的瓶子中长大的。

messages.msgid: This is a paperback copy of "Roadside Picnic" by Arkady and Boris Strugatsky.  It has been translated into over 20 languages, occasionally under the name "Stalker."  This copy, fortunately for you, just happens to be in your native tongue.
translations: 一本阿卡迪和鲍里斯·斯特鲁伽茨基兄弟所著《路边野餐》的平装本。这本书已经被翻译成20多种语言，偶尔还被冠以《潜行者》的名字。幸运的是，这本书正好是你母语的译本。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Ray Bradbury's "Fahrenheit 451."
translations: 这是一本著名科幻作家雷·布雷德伯里所著的反乌托邦小说《华氏451度》。

messages.msgid: Some joker has gently burnt the exterior edge of this paperback dystopia.  It's still perfectly readable.
translations: 一些爱开玩笑的人轻轻地烧焦了这边平装本反乌托邦小说的外部边缘。书仍然是完整可读的。

messages.msgid: "It was a pleasure to burn.  It was a special pleasure to see things eaten, to see things blackened and changed."
translations: 这本书的引言写道："焚烧是一种乐趣。看着事物被吞噬、烧焦、变形，有一种别样的快感。"

messages.msgid: This 1979 softcover edition of Ray Bradbury's "Fahrenheit 451" was once a library book.  It still has a light blue checkout card pocketed on the torn back cover.  One "Suzanne Collins" borrowed it in 1981.
translations: 这部1979年出版的雷·布雷德伯里所著的《华氏451度》的软封面版曾经是一本图书馆的书。在它被撕破的后封面上仍然插着一张浅蓝色的借阅卡。最后记录显示在1981年被一个叫做"苏珊娜·柯林斯"的人借走了它。

messages.msgid: The red and black paperback novel you hold in your hands is a modern reprint of Ray Bradbury's "Fahrenheit 451."
translations: 你手中拿着的这本红黑色封面的平装小说是雷·布雷德伯里所著的《华氏451度》的现代重印本。

messages.msgid: This sci-fi novel is divided into three parts: "The Hearth and the Salamander," "The Sieve and the Sand,", and "Burning Bright."
translations: 这部科幻小说分为三个章节：《壁炉与火蜥蜴》、《筛子与沙砾》、《火光熊熊》。

messages.msgid: This is a copy of Felicity Powell's All Things Weird.  It tells the story of a survivor following The Reckoning, interjected with comedy and dramatic twists.
translations: 这是一本《古怪的一切》，费利西蒂·鲍威尔著。它讲述了一个幸存者在清算之日后的故事，其中穿插了一些喜剧和戏剧性的转折。

messages.msgid: The dramatic tale of a small-time boxer who gets a rare chance to fight the heavy-weight champion, and seize his one chance to make a better life for himself while impressing the cute girl who works in the pet store.
translations: 一个小拳击手得到一次与重量级拳击冠军同场竞技的难得机会，并抓住这次机会让自己过上了更好的生活的同时，还让宠物店里的可爱女孩爱上自己的故事。

messages.plural: copies of The Art of Bunting

messages.msgid: While you might be forgiven for expecting instructions for party decorating, it is in fact a novel about baseball.  In the final climactic game a young star proves to himself that he is ready for the big leagues.
translations: 你会把这本书误以为是关于派对装饰也情有可原，其实它是一部关于棒球的小说。在最终故事发展到高潮的一场比赛之中，一名年轻球星终于证明了自己有加入联赛的实力。（注：Bunting双关）

messages.msgid: In this absorbing novel of football fandom, a pizza delivery driver makes a desperate gamble on the Monday night game.
translations: 关于橄榄球球迷的精彩小说，一位披萨外卖司机在周一晚上的比赛中孤注一掷。

messages.msgid: This paperback tells the story of a tennis prodigy who begins to regret her own success.
translations: 这本平装书讲述了一名网球天才开始后悔自己的成功的故事。

messages.msgid: This novel follows the humorous adventures of a professional athlete turned amateur reporter.
translations: 这部小说讲述了一名职业运动员变成业余记者的滑稽有趣的冒险故事。

messages.msgid: This hardback book is a collection of short stories in which love and golf are the only two constants.
translations: 这本精装书是一本短篇小说集，爱情和高尔夫是各个故事中两个经久不衰的常客。

messages.msgid: This hardback book about an equipment manager for a minor league team explores themes of loyalty and resentment.
translations: 这本精装书中讲述了一个联盟小球队的设备管理员如何探索忠诚和怨恨的主题。
点球成金：赢得被潜规则的比赛
messages.plural: copies of Budgetball: Winning a Rigged Game

messages.msgid: Budgetball tells the true story of the curious case of Benny Bobbin and his quixotic quest to defeat the deep-pocketed Orlando O's.
translations: 《便宜球》讲述了本尼·鲍宾的有趣经历以及他如何不切实际地试图击败财大气粗的奥兰多·奥的真实故事。

messages.plural: copies of The Lads of Summer

messages.msgid: This well worn paperback details the early baseball careers of one of the greatest teams professional sports has ever known.
translations: 这本破旧的平装书详细介绍了这只职业体育史上最伟大球队之一的早年棒球生涯。

messages.msgid: Volleyball: Get Ready to Get Ready
translations: 排球：为做好准备做好准备
messages.plural: copies of Volleyball: Get Ready to Get Ready

messages.msgid: "Volleyball: Get Ready to Get Ready" is YOUR illustrated guide to level up your game.  With full-color photos and diagrams, you will learn the drills and techniques you need to dominate the competition.
translations: 《排球：准备准备好》是一本能够迅速提高你的比赛水平的图解指南书。用全彩照片和图表，你将学习到一切用来主导比赛所需要的训练和技术。

messages.msgid: William G. Morgan, the Godfather of Volleyball
messages.plural: copies of The Godfather of Volleyball

messages.msgid: This odd little hardbound book is only 98 pages long, and a dozen of those are comprised of grainy black and white photos.  If you read this book, you learn that volleyball was originally called "Mintonette" and also some biographic details about its inventor.
translations: 这本奇怪的精装书只有98页，其中有十几页还是由颗粒密布的黑白照片组成的。如果你读了这本书，你会了解到排球最初被称为"Mintonette"，还有一些关于它的发明者的传记细节。

messages.msgid: This unwieldy coffee table book is titled "LEGENDARY Bike Rides Around the WORLD."  It provides a wealth of detail about paved bike trails in every part of the globe except New England.  But if you make it to Patagonia on bike, you're all set.
translations: 这部笨重的适合摆在咖啡桌上做装饰的书名为《环绕世界的传奇自行车骑行》。它还提供了大量世界各地的自行车道的细节，除了新英格兰地区。但如果你想现在骑自行车去巴塔哥尼亚，有这本书就够了。

messages.msgid: The poorly translated title is supposed to be Latin for "I Swim, Therefore I Am."  This short hardback presents "A Philosophy of Swimming" and then playfully attributes a variety of famous philosophical expressions into endorsements for the sport of swimming.  It's not a bad book, just a bit odd.
translations: 这本翻译得很糟糕的书的标题应该是拉丁语的"我游泳，故我存在。"这本短小的精装本中提出了"游泳的哲学"，然后有趣地将各种著名的哲学表达纳入游泳运动范畴之中。这本书其实写的不是太糟糕，只是有点奇怪。

messages.plural: copies of Stratosphere: The Rise of Hoops

messages.msgid: "Stratosphere: The Rise of Hoops" chronicles four decades of professional basketball against a backdrop of sustained social change.
translations: 《同温层：篮球的崛起》记录了在社会持续变革的背景下，职业篮球40年的发展历史。

messages.plural: copies of Anything Can Be Beautiful

messages.msgid: Stylist, designer, and glitter goddess Tiffynie Blust looks at the world with one mantra in mind: anything can be beautiful.
translations: 蒂芬妮·布洛思，著名造型师，设计师，"闪耀的女神"，她对待世间万物都基于心中的一个准则：万物皆可美丽。

messages.msgid: The Greatest Rooms of the Century
messages.plural: copies of The Greatest Rooms of the Century

messages.msgid: A stunning collection of the best living spaces created and commissioned by the most influential people in interior design.
translations: 一份由室内设计界最具影响的名师们设计并装修的最佳房间的图片集，房间都美得惊人。

messages.msgid: An ecologically-minded take on modern homemaking, a practical guide to maximizing your time in the kitchen and beyond.
translations: 这是一本注重生态的现代家政书，是一本可以让你最大限度地利用厨房内外的时间的实用指南书。

messages.msgid: A guide on how to affordably decorate rooms to suit your personality.  In the book, we visit rooms inspired by the needs of each homeowner and will see how they transformed their rooms.
translations: 这是一本教你如何省钱地装饰出符合自身品味的房间的书籍。在这本书中，我们参观了基于各位房主自身需求所创造出的房间，并将看到他们是如何逐步改造出自己的小屋的。

messages.msgid: Visit the homes of savvy tastemakers from the worlds of fashion, finance, and design, with this book of lavish photography.
translations: 用这本这本奢华的摄影照片集，你能参观来自时尚界、金融界和设计界的潮流名家们的家。

messages.plural: copies of Best Signature Outdoor Kitchens

messages.msgid: Outdoor space is one of the hottest amenities being considered by new and existing homeowners.  This book will show you how to turn any deck, patio, or other outside area into a great place to cook.
translations: 户外厨房空间是新户主和现有户主们所考虑首选的最热门的配套设施之一。这本书将教你如何把任意户外平台，露台，或其他户外区域转变成一处很棒的烹饪场所。

messages.msgid: The Art of Using Plants to Transform Your Home
messages.plural: copies of The Art of Using Plants to Transform Your Home

messages.msgid: Bring gorgeous greenery into your life with this delightful guide to decorating your living space with a wide variety of plants.  Illustrated examples enable you to easily transform every corner of your interior space.
translations: 这本令人愉悦的指南书将美丽动人的绿意带入你的生活之中，用各类植物装饰你的生活空间。各种示例图片让你可以轻松改变室内每个角落。

messages.msgid: A collection of essays and advice on style, beauty, and motherhood.  Part memoir, part lifestyle guide, this book reflects the author's experience growing up as a woman of color in Brooklyn.
translations: 一本关于风格、美貌和母性的散文和建议集。一部分是回忆录，一部分是生活指南，这本书反映了作者作为一位有色人种女性在布鲁克林区成长的经历。

messages.msgid: 10 Cool Things About Being A Ring Bearer
messages.plural: copies of 10 Cool Things About Being A Ring Bearer

messages.msgid: This book is for the delightful little ring bearer in your wedding.  The author depicts the responsibility and honor in being a ring bearer.  Your little angel will cherish this book as he or she learns how to behave on your perfect day.
translations: 这本书是为你婚礼上可爱的捧戒小孩准备的。作者描述了作为捧戒者的责任和荣誉，希望你的小天使能珍惜它，因为他或她需要学会如何在你最美好的一天上表现得体。

messages.msgid: How to Raise a Gentleman: A Civilized Guide to Parenting
translations: 绅士养成：文明育儿指南
messages.plural: copies of How to Raise a Gentleman: A Civilized Guide to Parenting

messages.msgid: A revised edition for parents who hope their little boy children will grow up to be the kind of men who know which fork to use, how to treat others, and generally make their parents proud.
translations: 这是一本育儿指南书的修订版，为那些希望自家小男孩长大后成为那种知道用哪把叉子、如何待人接物、并经常让父母感到自豪的人的父母们准备的。

messages.msgid: International Approaches to Securing Radioactive Sources Against Terrorism
translations: 制止核恐怖行为国际公约
messages.plural: copies of International Approaches to Securing Radioactive Sources Against Terrorism

messages.msgid: This book presents how to enhance cooperation and assistance between countries in support of International Atomic Energy Agency efforts to secure radioactive sources against the threat of terrorism.
translations: 这本书介绍了如何加强各国之间的合作和援助，以支持国际原子能机构加强对核原料的防护，使其免受恐怖主义威胁。

messages.plural: copies of Principles of Forensic Psychiatry

messages.msgid: This text addresses standards in the assessment and treatment of aggression and violence as well as psychological and neuroimaging assessments.
translations: 本文阐述了对攻击性和暴力的评估标准和治疗手段，以及心理学和神经影像学诊断流程。

messages.msgid: The Guide to Reflective Conflict Resolution
translations: 冲突解决中的反思性实践指南
messages.plural: copies of The Guide to Reflective Conflict Resolution

messages.msgid: The back cover of this hardbound book reads: "Why should professionals care about reflective practice?  How do its principles and methods increase competence?  What characteristics distinguish reflective practitioners?"
translations: 这本精装书的封底写道："为什么专业人士应该关心反思性实践？它的原则和方法如何提高能力？反思性实践者有哪些特点？"

messages.msgid: The Oxbridge Handbook of Mood Ailments
translations: 情绪疾病牛津剑桥手册
messages.plural: copies of The Oxbridge Handbook of Mood Ailments

messages.msgid: The Oxbridge Handbook of Mood Ailments provides detailed coverage of the characterization, understanding, and treatment of affective disorders.  It provides coverage of unipolar depression, bipolar disorder, and known variants of these illnesses.
translations: 情绪疾病牛津剑桥手册详细介绍了情感障碍的病情特征、机理研究和治疗方法。书中内容覆盖了单相抑郁症，双相情感障碍，以及这些疾病的已知变种。

messages.plural: copies of Phonological Acquisition and Disorders

messages.msgid: Studying the phonologies of children with non-organic speech disorders, this volume details the latest findings in optimality theory, phonological acquisition and disorders.  It is intended for linguists and psychologists.
translations: 这本书通过研究非器质性语言障碍儿童的语音，详细介绍了优选学领域关于语音习得和障碍的最新发现。它的读者主要是语言学家和心理学家。

messages.plural: copies of Therapeutic Gardens and Healing Spaces

messages.msgid: This book addresses how to design therapeutic gardens.  It illustrates a variety of landscape designs appropriate for public spaces that promote mental health.
translations: 这本书教你如何设计心理治疗花园。它介绍了各种适合公共空间的能促进心理健康的景观设计。

messages.plural: copies of Advances in Drug Delivery Systems

messages.msgid: This softcover reprint covers an array of topics in pharmacology.  The physicochemical concepts of the refinement of bioresponsive drug delivery are presented in detail alongside a variety of current approaches employed in the development of zero order release systems.
translations: 这本软皮再印版书籍涵盖了一系列药理学主题。详细介绍了用生物响应材料改进药物释放系统的物理化学概念，以及目前开发零级释放系统时所采用的各种方法。

messages.msgid: Using Art to Treat Eating Disorders
messages.plural: copies of Using Art to Treat Eating Disorders

messages.msgid: An introductory guide for those wanting to explore the use of art to address eating disorders.  Art therapy is a particularly effective therapeutic intervention, as it allows people to express uncomfortable thoughts and feelings nonverbally.
translations: 这是一本为那些想探索使用艺术来治疗饮食失调的人准备的介绍性指南。艺术治疗是一种特别有效的心理干预疗法，因为它让人以非语言的方式表达不舒服的想法和感觉。

messages.msgid: A Clinical Guide to Video Gamers
translations: 电子游戏玩家临床诊断指南
messages.plural: copies of A Clinical Guide to Video Gamers

messages.msgid: This scholarly work considers the role that games play in psychological experiences and mental health.  Chapters examine the factors that compel individual gamers to select and identify with particular games and characters, as well as the different play styles, genres, and archetypes common in video games.
translations: 这本学术书研究了电子游戏在心理体验和心理健康中的作用。各章分析了引导玩家选择及依赖特定游戏和角色的心理因素，以及电子游戏中常见的游戏风格、类型和原型。

messages.msgid: Paranoia and the History of Madness
messages.plural: copies of Paranoia and the History of Madness

messages.msgid: This book is an analysis of the use and misuse of paranoia throughout history and in contemporary society.  The impact of paranoia on societies is explored in detail.
translations: 这本书分析了历史和当代社会对偏执狂这一词汇的使用和滥用。同时也对偏执狂对社会的影响进行了详细的探讨。

messages.msgid: Freud referred to women's sexuality as a "dark continent" for psychoanalysis, drawing on colonial use of the same phrase to refer to Africa.  This book details how the problematic universalism of psychoanalysis led theorists to reject its relevance for postcolonial critique.
translations: 弗洛伊德曾将女性性欲称为精神分析的“黑暗大陆”，这一说法借用了殖民语境中对非洲的同名称呼。本书阐述了：精神分析中存在问题的普遍主义倾向，如何使一些理论家否认精神分析对后殖民批评的相关性与适用性。

messages.plural: copies of The Psychology of Stalking

messages.msgid: This book explores stalking from social, psychiatric, psychological and behavioral perspectives.  Topics include psychiatric diagnoses, offender-victim typologies, cyberstalking, false victimization syndrome, erotomania, domestic violence, the stalking of public figures, and many other aspects of stalking.
translations: 这本书从社会，精神，心理和行为的角度探讨尾行行为。主题包括精神病学诊断、罪犯-受害者类型分析、网络尾行、伪装受害者症、色情狂、家庭暴力、尾行公众人物以及尾行行为的许多其他方面。

messages.msgid: A glossy magazine all about handguns and shooting.  There is a good article about proper sighting near the middle.
translations: 一本关于手枪和射击的时尚武器杂志。里面有一篇教导初学者如何正确中距离瞄准的好文章。

messages.msgid: Simple beginner's guide to shooting handguns safely and effectively; simple and effective rules with some key information about handguns themselves.
translations: 为初学者所著的，关于如何安全高效射击的简单指南。规则简单实用，同时包含一些有关手枪的知识。

messages.msgid: The Practical Guide to Guns and Shooting, Handgun Edition
translations: 枪支与射击实用手册：手枪篇
messages.plural: copies of The Practical Guide to Guns and Shooting, Handgun Edition

messages.msgid: A practical guide for one who want to buy a gun - how they differ, how to choose the right ammo, shooting techniques, and lot of another info.
translations: 一本实用手册，帮助想买枪的人。内容有关如何选择合适的枪支，如何选择对应的弹药，恰当的设计技巧，以及其他的许多信息。

messages.msgid: Defensive Handgun for the Armed Citizen
messages.plural: copies of Defensive Handgun for the Armed Citizen

messages.msgid: This book takes carrying handguns seriously, and delivers lots of information a user may need to know, including self defense concepts, using deadly force, analyzing confrontation, as well as handgun tactics and techniques.
translations: 一本正经讲述手枪自卫的书，记载了许多有用的信息，包括自卫的概念，使用武器，分析对手等。还有许多手枪的战术动作和技巧。

messages.msgid: The Gun Digest Book of the Revolver
messages.plural: copies of The Gun Digest Book of the Revolver

messages.msgid: This book covers all aspects of the double-action revolver: shooting, handling, carrying, maintaining, and accessorizing - everything you need to know to operate the quintessential American handgun.
translations: 这本书包括了双动式左轮手枪的各个方面：设计，持枪，携带，保养以及配件装配等等 - 基本包含了关于操作这种美国经典手枪你所需要知道的一切。

messages.msgid: A shiny magazine about handguns and activities around them - handgun hunting, competition shooting, reloading, new brands and gear, ammo, and other similar things.
translations: 一本关于手枪和手枪运动的崭新杂志，包括了打猎，竞技设计，换弹，新兴品牌于装备的介绍，以及其他类似的事情。

messages.plural: copies of The Tao of the Handgun

messages.msgid: This introspective volume covers proper usage of handguns, from safety and stance, to maintenance and proper sighting technique.
translations: 一本充满内省哲理的书，讲述了如何正确使用手枪的方方面面，从安全使用和站姿，到合适的保养、瞄准技巧。

messages.msgid: Practical Guide to the Operational Use of the TT-33 Tokarev Pistol
translations: 拖卡列夫TT手枪行动练习手册
messages.plural: copies of Practical Guide to the Operational Use of the TT-33 Tokarev Pistol

messages.msgid: The most current, up to date, full color manual anywhere on the TT-33 Tokarev pistol, from former Special Forces instructor.  Surprisingly easy to follow.
translations: 这可能是关于TT-33托卡列夫手枪最新的全彩手册了，来自前特战指挥。出人意料是阅读起来门槛很低。

messages.msgid: Gun Safety: For Home Defense And Concealed Carry
translations: 安全用枪：家庭防卫与隐蔽携带
messages.plural: copies of Gun Safety: For Home Defense And Concealed Carry

messages.msgid: A book for a responsible gun owner, it highlights using weapons in the civil world, with lot of rules and legal recommendations, alongside  how to avoid harm for the gun user and their environment.
translations: 一本为负责枪手而写的书，主要讲解如何在城市中合理地使用枪械。记载了很多法律规定和建议，以及如何避免对枪手和附件的环境造成伤害。

messages.msgid: Pistols & Revolvers: From 1400 to the Present Day
messages.plural: copies of Pistols & Revolvers: From 1400 to the Present Day

messages.msgid: The book contains a long, detailed history of handguns - from the very first hand cannons to the latest automatics and machine pistols, with photos, technical specifications, and some artwork.
translations: 这本书记载了关于手枪的漫长详细的历史，从最开始的手炮到现代的自动手枪，并注以照片，技术标准，以及一些艺术画。

messages.msgid: A complete guide to maintaining handguns - lots of information about components, reloading, bullet types, and ballistics.
translations: 一本保养手枪的完全指南，记载了许多关于组件、装填、子弹类型和弹道学的信息。

messages.msgid: Gun Digest Book of Automatic Pistols Assembly/Disassembly
messages.plural: copies of Gun Digest Book of Automatic Pistols Assembly/Disassembly

messages.msgid: A giant, 1000-page manual of with step-by-step instructions for the disassembly of automatic pistols.  Over 100 models are covered, with clear photos and procedure tips.
translations: 一本足足1000页厚度夸张的手册，讲解如何一步步拆卸自动手枪。包含了超过100种手枪的拆装方法，并配有清晰的图片和步骤重点提示。

messages.plural: copies of Book of Revolvers Assembly/Disassembly

messages.msgid: A 700-page instructional manual of different revolver disassembly processes, with photos, detailed steps, and additional info.
translations: 一本关于各种左轮手枪拆解过程的厚达700页的指导手册，配有照片、详细步骤以及其他信息。

messages.msgid: FM 3-23.35: Combat Training With Pistols, M9 And M11
translations: 野战手册3-23.35：M9与M11手枪作战训练
messages.plural: copies of FM 3-23.35: Combat Training With Pistols, M9 And M11

messages.msgid: Official U.S. Army manual detailing how M9 and M11 handguns work, and how to use them safely and effectively.
translations: 美军陆军作战手册，详细讲解了M9与M11手枪的工作原理，以及如何安全高效地使用它们。

messages.plural: copies of Black Powder to Berettas

messages.msgid: This hardcover book, aimed at the gun nut, provides an illustrated, concise history of the handgun throughout history, including technical specifications and use techniques.  It's difficult to follow without a passing knowledge in pistols, but an experienced handgun user could glean much from it.
translations:
这本精装书面向枪械发烧友，里面描述了手枪的发展历史，还有许多技术规格和使用技术。没有手枪方面的相关知识很难读懂，但一个有经验的手枪使用者可以从中学到很多东西。
（注：Fabrica d'Armi Pietro Beretta，伯莱塔军火制造厂商，一家在多个国家运营的私营意大利枪支制造公司）

messages.msgid: An informative magazine all about rifles and shooting.  There is an excellent article about proper maintenance in this issue.
