translations: 一本杂志，包含有大量关于步枪和射击的信息。里面还有关于适当保养枪械的一篇优秀的文章。

messages.msgid: A monthly shooting and firearms publication, with a lot of articles and comments.
translations: 一本关于射击与火器的月刊出版物，刊登有许多文章和评论。

messages.msgid: An annual magazine for marksmen, with lots of articles and papers, as well as reviews of new rifles, optics, and mods.
translations: 一本狙击手年刊，收录了很多文章、论文，以及关于新步枪、瞄具、配件等的评论。

messages.msgid: A dedicated journal about various firearms, their usage, and news about them.  Different articles review new firearm models, old models, new attachments, hunting, maintenance, and a lot of other topics.
translations: 一本关于各种武器的专业期刊，讲解它们的使用与相关的新闻。其中有许多评论新出产、旧出产的武器型号，新的附件的文章，也讨论许多关于打猎、保养和许多其他话题。

messages.plural: copies of FM 23-16 Army marksmanship manual

messages.msgid: A hefty military field manual about automatic rifle usage and techniques which improve marksmanship and proper weapons-handling.
translations: 一本包含大量信息的军用野战手册，讲述了自动步枪的使用方法和技巧，能提高射击水平和武器使用水平。

messages.msgid: SAS and Elite Forces Guide Sniper
translations: SAS和精英部队指南：狙击手
messages.plural: copies of SAS and Elite Forces Guide Sniper

messages.msgid: An unofficial guide about the work and skills of British and NATO snipers.  There are a lot of photos of weapons and equipment, but it has a huge lack of details - the most important information is just mentioned or described without any value.
translations: 这是一本关于英国和北约狙击手的工作和技能的非官方指南。书中有很多武器和装备的照片，但缺乏细节——最重要的信息只是提到或描述，没有任何价值。
精确步枪射击：基本原理
messages.plural: copies of Precision Rifle Marksmanship: The Fundamentals

messages.msgid: A small book about the use of a rifle as a marksman's tool.  There is plenty of information, but it is too general, and the author talks more about his experience as a sniper than sniping itself.
translations: 这是一本关于如何使用步枪作为神射手工具的小书。书中有很多信息，但太过笼统，作者更多地谈论他作为狙击手的经历，而不是狙击本身。

messages.msgid: Precision Long Range Shooting And Hunting
messages.plural: copies of Precision Long Range Shooting And Hunting

messages.msgid: A book about the basics of long-range shooting, written in fairly simple language.
translations: 一本关于远距离射击的书，使用的语言相当简单。
海军陆战队狙击手手册
messages.plural: copies of The Marine Sniping Handbook

messages.msgid: The Official (or at least so it says) marksmanship guide for scout snipers.  With lots of essential info, it gives a pretty good foundation to anyone who knows how to use a rifle.
translations: 这是一本介绍侦察狙击手在进攻作战和防御力量保护中的正确和有效方法的手册。它还涵盖了选择、训练、使用、装备选择和保养等方面。

messages.msgid: A reprint of a 1917 book about rifle shooting and maintenance.  It is surprisingly detailed, and contains lots of information, even if the language is fairly old-fashioned.
translations: 一本与1917年出版的关于步枪设计与保养的书籍的重印版本。令人感到意外的是，尽管它的用语非常有年代感，但它的内容非常详尽，信息量很大。

messages.plural: copies of Rifle Shooting for Beginners

messages.msgid: A guide to shooting sports that explains the basics of equipment usage, judging distance, aiming, breathing, movement, and trigger discipline alongside a lot of other essential info.
translations: 一本射击运动指南书，解释了基础的装备使用，距离判断，瞄准，呼吸，移动和扳机守则，以及许多其他的有用信息。

messages.msgid: Great Hunting Rifles: Victorian to the Present
translations: 伟大的猎枪：从维多利亚至今
messages.plural: copies of Great Hunting Rifles: Victorian to the Present

messages.msgid: A history of some of the most exquisite rifles made in the twentieth century, written with a lot of love and attention to detail.
translations: 这本由热爱和对细节的专注写成的书籍，记载了二十世纪最精致的一些步枪的发展历史。

messages.plural: copies of FM 3-22.9: Rifle Marksmanship M16-/M4- Series

messages.msgid: An official U.S. Army manual that provides guidance for the planning and execution of training with the 5.56mm M16-series rifle and M4 carbine.
translations: 一本美国陆军官方手册，指导使用5.56mm的M16系列步枪与M4卡宾枪进行计划行动任务。
野战手册3-22.68：协同轻重机枪操作
messages.plural: copies of FM 3-22.68: Crew-Served Machine Guns 5.56-mm And 7.62-mm

messages.msgid: An official U.S. Army manual which is a comprehensive guide about using the M240 and M249 crew-served machine guns, with excellent examples and a lot of theory.
translations: 一本美军陆军手册指南，全面讲解了如何使用M240和M249班组机枪，也有良好演示案例和许多理论知识。

messages.msgid: A book containing different training methods for carbine users from world champion shooters, aimed toward civilians, law enforcement, and military shooters.
translations: 一本记录有来自世界射击冠军训练方法的指导书，为民兵，执法部队和军队射手的卡宾枪使用这所著。

messages.plural: copies of The Art of the Rifle

messages.msgid: This book covers the fundamentals of rifle shooting, including stance, grip, sight alignment, and trigger control.
translations: 一本介绍步枪射击基础的书，包括姿势、握法、瞄准和扳机控制。

messages.msgid: Shooter's Bible Guide to Rifle Ballistics
translations: 射手圣经：步枪弹道学指南
messages.plural: copies of Shooter's Bible Guide to Rifle Ballistics

messages.msgid: A comprehensive guide to the principles of rifle ballistics, including information on bullet types, trajectory, and wind drift.
translations: 一本关于步枪弹道学原理的全面指南，包含了子弹类型、弹道和风偏的信息。

messages.msgid: A giant, 500-page history about the AK-47—the most popular firearm in the world—and the information around it: the mechanics of the weapon, its usage, maintenance, modifications, and its impact on global conflicts.
translations: 一本厚达500页的书，讨论最广泛使用的枪 - AK47的历史和相关信息，囊括了武器的机械结构，使用方法，保养，改装，以及它在全球冲突中的影响。

messages.msgid: A history book penned by an anonymous author.  Starting from its design by John Garand and ending with the Vietnam War, it provides a detailed run-down of the M1 Garand rifle's use throughout history as well as its design and quirks with the weapon.
translations: 一本关于美国枪械的历史书，作者不详。它描述了M1加兰德步枪的使用史，从其设计者约翰·加兰德开始，到越南战争结束，还有与它的设计和历史相关的趣事。

messages.msgid: This is a small booklet, containing several diagrams and clearly worded instructions for assisting one in assembling, installing, and using their newly purchased weapon conversion kit.  The flyer's rear is covered in neatly printed rows of advertisements, displaying other products by the same manufacturer.  All in all, it, strangely enough, brings to mind nostalgic images of the instructions for assembling Legos—a very angry, explosive Lego construct that goes boom.
translations: 这是一本小册子，包含几张图表和措辞清晰的说明，可帮助人们组装、安装和使用他们新购买的武器改装套件。 传单的背面整齐地印着一排排广告，展示着同一制造商的其他产品。这让人回想起对照说明书拼乐高积木时的感受——某种意义上你拼的这玩意儿跟乐高差不多，都令人血压飙升。"再拼一点多一点就会爆炸"

messages.msgid: An in-depth magazine all about shotguns and shooting.  There is an informative article about proper shooting stance in the back pages.
translations: 一本深度研究霰弹枪和设计的杂志。在杂志封底处有一篇信息丰富的讲解正确射击姿势的文章。

messages.msgid: Gun Digest Shooter's Guide to Shotguns
messages.plural: copies of Gun Digest Shooter's Guide to Shotguns

messages.msgid: A training guide for anyone who never used a shotgun, with simple explanations and drills.
translations: 一本为从未接触过霰弹枪的读者所编写的训练手册，有简单的解释和具体训练计划。

messages.msgid: A modern magazine, published in South Africa, it contains various information about hunting and shooting.  This particular issue has a lot of information about shotguns and drills with them.
translations: 一本现代杂志，出版南非南非，常常包含许多关于狩猎和射击的信息。这本杂志关于霰弹枪和具体练习方法的内容特别多。
德克萨斯公园与野生动物
messages.plural: issues of Texas Parks and Wildlife

messages.msgid: Published by Texas Parks and Wildlife Department, this book contains lots of information and photos about nature and recreation in Texas's fields.  This exact issue is about hunting and gun safety.
translations: 由德克萨斯公园与野生动物部门出版，这本书包含许多关于信息、照片以及德州娱乐。这一期主要讲解狩猎和枪械安全。

messages.msgid: An annual magazine about bird hunting, including species identification, hunting techniques, and equipment recommendations.
translations: 一本关于用枪打鸟的年刊，包括鸟类鉴别，狩猎技巧和装备推荐。

messages.plural: copies of The Skeet Shooter's Logbook

messages.msgid: A small guide to skeet shooting, including rules, equipment, tips, and techniques for improving accuracy and performance.
translations: 一本关于飞盘射击的指南书，包括规则、装备、建议以及提高精度和射击表现的技巧。

messages.msgid: If It Ain't Broke, Fix It!
messages.plural: copies of If It Ain't Broke, Fix It!

messages.msgid: The beginner's guide to clay shooting, with lots of advice, instructions, and drills.
translations: 一本给黏土飞盘射击初学者的指南书，有许多的建议、指导何具体训练。

messages.msgid: A bird and clay shooting manual, this book contains lots of information about proper shotgun shooting like stances, aim, and ballistics.
translations: 一本手册，讲述打鸟与飞盘。包含了很多如何进行恰当的霰弹枪射击需要的知识，比如射击姿势，瞄准方法和弹道原理。

messages.plural: copies of Shotguns: The Art and Science

messages.msgid: This book claims to address every problem the shotgunner is likely to face, and offers solutions to ensure that shooters can make every shot count.
translations: 一本声称能够解决读者在使用霰弹枪时会遇到的所有问题，以及让霰弹枪弹无虚发的方法的书。

messages.msgid: This book shows the history, science and art of the most beautiful shotguns in the world - single and double barrel, combination, hammer shotguns, paired shotguns, special-use guns, and small-bore shotguns from around the world, with detailed information about each of them, and their usage.
translations: 这边书记载了世上最漂亮的霰弹枪们的历史、科学、与艺术设计。包括来自世界各地的单管、双管、组合式、击锤式、组合式、特种用途及小口径霰弹枪，并附有它们的详细信息和用法。

messages.plural: copies of Shotguns: A Comprehensive Guide

messages.msgid: Detailed manual about buying, owning, and shooting a shotgun, with additional information like cleaning, safety, and training.
translations: 关于购买，持有，射击霰弹枪的详细手册，还有关于清洁，安全，训练的附加信息。

messages.msgid: An illustrated chronicle of every model designed and produced under the Winchester name, with a wealth of facts, figures, and historically relevant information.
translations: 关于温彻斯特名下设计制作的各型号霰弹枪带插图的编年史，包含丰富的史实图表知识。

messages.plural: copies of Ordnance Maintenance Shotguns, All Types

messages.msgid: Part of a 1942 army manual, this book contains lots of information about the proper usage and maintenance of all shotguns that were adopted by the U.S. military, including the Winchester M97 and M12, Stevens M620, M620A and M520, the Ithaca M37, the Remington M31, M11, and Browning Automatic 5.
translations: 1942年版陆军手册的节选，包含了许多关于美军列装霰弹枪的信息，包括正确使用方法和保养方法。这些霰弹枪包括温彻斯特M97和M12，史蒂文M620、M620A和M520，雷明顿M31和M11，以及勃朗宁5号自动步枪。

messages.msgid: A comprehensive book about combat shotguns, covering single- and double-barreled, slide-action, semi-auto and rotary-cylinder shotguns, their usage, service, and tactics.
translations: 一本关于战斗霰弹枪的全面书籍，包括了单管、双管、泵动式、半自动和滚筒型霰弹枪的使用，列装和战术。

messages.msgid: This book has lot of fundamental information about shotguns, their workmanship, engineering, and art, along with lot of practical trainings for them.
translations: 这本书由许多关于霰弹枪的基本详细，包括了工作原理，机械制作，设计美学，以及许多实际的练习方法。

messages.plural: copies of Shotguns - Their History and Development

messages.msgid: An old magazine about shotguns: their history, models, cartridges, ballistics, accessories, and shooting, along with an appendix on shotgun data and tables.
translations: 一本关于霰弹枪的旧杂志，讲述霰弹枪的历史、型号、弹药、弹道、配件以及具体射击。后面还有一张附录表，列举有霰弹枪数据和表格。

messages.msgid: A good guide for both sportsmen and gun collectors, this book contains information about classic shotguns and their usage.
translations: 一本无论是对射击运动员还是收藏家来说，都十分有价值的好书，包含了很多关于经典霰弹枪及其使用方法的信息。

messages.msgid: A pocket-sized book printed in 2000 by the United States Marine Corps for official use.  It describes the operation, repair, and cleaning of the Benelli M1014 shotgun.  Though specific to the M4, it can provide a wealth of information to the trained eye.
translations: 美国海军陆战队于2000年出版的一本袖珍书，军用版本。介绍了贝尼利M1014霰弹枪的操作、维修和清洁。虽然是针对M1014的，但有经验的读者可以从中获得丰富的信息。

messages.msgid: An in-depth magazine about submachine guns and shooting.  There is an exhaustive article about close quarter combat techniques in the front.
translations: 一本深度研究冲锋枪以及其设计技巧的杂志。前面有一篇详细讲述近身枪械格斗技巧(CQC)的文章。

messages.plural: copies of The MP5 Submachine Gun

messages.msgid: A small, shiny journal about the most famous machine gun in the world, H&K MP5, and how it is used currently.
translations: 一本有关世界上最出名的冲锋枪，H&K MP5的崭新的小刊物。讲解它在当代是用在了哪些地方。

messages.plural: issues of Guns & Weapons for Law Enforcement

messages.msgid: A relatively old magazine about modern automatic firearms police may use.  This issue talks about submachine guns and the brand new KRISS Super V .45 ACP specifically.
translations: 一本较旧的杂志，内容是警方可能使用的现代自动枪械。本期主要介绍冲锋枪，并特别讨论了全新的 KRISS Super V .45 ACP。

messages.plural: copies of The Submachine Gun Handbook

messages.msgid: This concise guide details the proper care and operation of most forms of machine pistols and submachine guns currently used by regular armed and reserve forces, as well as several obsolete weapons.
translations: 一本冲锋枪手册，详尽列举了大多数款式的冲锋枪的维护和使用技巧，不仅介绍了了现役部队和预备役部队适用的机枪和冲锋枪，也介绍了一些老式的枪械。

messages.msgid: The full story of Gordon Ingram and his revolutionary machine gun designs: the Model 6, MAC-10, MAC-11, and SWD.
translations: 讲述了戈登·英格拉姆以及他改进的冲锋枪Model 6、MAC-10、MAC-11和SWD的完整故事。

messages.msgid: The Development of Sub-Machine Guns and their Ammunition from World War 1 to the Present Day
translations: 一战以来的冲锋枪及其弹药演变史
messages.plural: copies of The Development of Sub-Machine Guns and their Ammunition from World War 1 to the Present Day

messages.msgid: A comprehensive study of the development and use of the sub-machine gun since World War I, including a country-by-country survey of equipment used, with lots of illustrations and precise information.
translations: 一战至今关于冲锋枪的发展使用的一本全面研究书籍，包括各各国的装备情况，附有许多插图和精确信息。

messages.msgid: A fully illustrated book about famous submachine guns, their design, construction, and testing, as well as their accessories such as magazines, ammunition, webbing, and cleaning kits.
translations: 一本配有插图的图书，关于著名冲锋枪的设计，建造，测试，以及它们的配件如弹匣，弹药，背带及清洁套件。

messages.msgid: Part of a big series about weapons and their complexity, this issue describes the long history of the M1A1 Thompson Submachine gun - when it was created, why, and why it is iconic now.
translations: 关于武器与其复杂性系列丛书的其中一部，它记载了M1A1汤普森冲锋枪的漫长历史 - 于何时制造，为何制造以及如今为什么这么标志性。

messages.msgid: An Amateur's Guide for the Colt's Thompson Submachine Gun
translations: 柯尔特汤普森冲锋枪爱好者指南
messages.plural: copies of An Amateur's Guide for the Colt's Thompson Submachine Gun

messages.msgid: A 200-page collector's manual advising how to buy a real, old Tommy Gun, with detailed info on each model, info about maintenance and shooting, and stories about its usage in the St. Louis Police Department.
translations: 一本200页的手册，指导如何买一把老式汤米冲锋枪，对每种型号都有详细的介绍信息，教你如何保养和射击。还讲述了这些枪在圣路易斯警察部门的故事。

messages.msgid: Part of an old army field manual, this book explains the usage and maintenance of the M3 and M3A1, and how it was adopted into U.S. Army service in 1942.
translations: 旧陆军野战手册的节选，这本书主要讲解了M3和M3A1冲锋枪的使用与维护，以及它如何在1942年被美国陆军所采用。

messages.msgid: Maintenance on the MP40, PPSH41, M3A1, and Sten MKII Submachine Guns
translations: 冲锋枪保养：MP40、PPSH41、M3A1 和 斯登 Mk II
messages.plural: copies of Maintenance on the MP40, PPSH41, M3A1, and Sten MKII Submachine Guns

messages.msgid: A short manual about the disassembly, reassembly, maintenance, operation, and repair of some old machine guns.  Seems it has lack of some info, but better than nothing.
translations: 一本关于老式冲锋枪拆装、保养、维修、操作的简短手册。缺少某些信息，但比没有好。

messages.msgid: Weekly news about a bunch of famous people who're all (un)dead now.
translations:
一些关于一群名人的周刊报道。
"称为（不）死者报道更为贴切。"

messages.msgid: Full of useful tips for showing confidence in your speech.
translations: 一本有很多关于如何自信的进行演讲和谈判的小技巧的书。

messages.plural: copies of Principles of Effective Communication

messages.msgid: A hardbound book devoted to being an effective and persuasive speaker.
translations: 一本精装书，教导你如何成为一名高效且有说服力的演讲者。

messages.plural: copies of Dungeon Master's Guide: 6th Edition

messages.msgid: A thick, hardcover volume with everything needed to weave legendary stories.  It's full of information, but finding the things you're looking for can be a chore.
translations: 一本厚厚的精装书，里面记载了一堆编造传奇故事的技巧。这书信息量很大，在里面找到你想要的内容可不容易。

messages.plural: copies of Nail Your Law Firm Interview

messages.msgid: This lightweight book proclaims itself to be "the ONLY gold star interview guide for lawyers interviewing in any type of job interview."  It was supposed to help new lawyers find work.
translations: 这本薄薄的书宣称自己是"在任何工作面试类书籍中，律师的*唯一*一本面试指导宝典"。这本书适用于正在求职的新律师。

messages.msgid: A vellum book containing the hymns central to the Marloss faith.  As the verses lead into each other, the text sings of unity and promised paradise.
translations: 一本羊皮纸书，包含了以马洛斯信仰为中心的赞美诗。这些诗句彼此相通，经文歌颂统一和信仰的天堂。

messages.plural: copies of the King James Bible

messages.msgid: An English translation of the Christian Bible, which originated in England in the early 1600s.
translations: 基督教圣经的英文译本之一，最早于十七世纪初由英国国王詹姆斯一世下令翻译出版而成。

messages.plural: copies of the Eastern Orthodox Bible

messages.msgid: An English copy of the Eastern Orthodox translation of the Christian Bible.
translations: 一本东正教的圣经英译本，和天主教圣经有很大不同。

messages.msgid: An English translation of the Christian Bible, distributed free of charge by Gideons International.
translations: 基督教圣经的英文译本之一，由基甸国际基金会免费发行。

messages.plural: copies of the New American Bible

messages.msgid: An English translation of the Bible, first published in 1970.  It is accepted by the Catholic dioceses of the United States of America and the Philippines.
translations: 圣经的英文翻译版，首次出版于 1970 年，被美国和菲律宾天主教区批准。

messages.msgid: The New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures
messages.plural: copies of the New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures

messages.msgid: An English translation of the Bible published by the Watch Tower Bible and Tract Society, used and distributed by Jehovah's Witnesses.
translations: 守望台圣经书社出版的英文版圣经，由耶和华见证人使用和分发。
霍尔曼基督教圣经复印本
messages.plural: copies of the Holman Christian Bible

messages.msgid: An English translation of the Christian Bible by Holman Bible Publishers, developed by the Southern Baptist Convention.  It is primarily used within Baptist circles.
translations: 霍尔曼圣经出版社译制的基督教圣经的英文译本，由美南浸信会出版。 它主要在浸信会圈子内使用。
杜埃-兰斯圣经的复印本

messages.msgid: An uncommon English translation of the Christian Bible, completed in 1609.  It is based on the Latin Vulgate, and remained popular among traditionalist Catholics.
translations: 一种罕见的基督教圣经英文译本，完成于1609年。它基于拉丁版圣经译制，仍然受到传统天主教徒的欢迎。
台瓦西多圣经的复印本
messages.plural: copies of the Orthodox Tewahedo Biblical Canon

messages.msgid: This is very rare English translation of the Orthodox Tewahedo Biblical Canon, a collection of religious texts that form the basis of the Ethiopian Orthodox Church's faith and doctrine, probably acquired by a immigrant, collector or theologist.  This canon is distinct from the Protestant and Catholic biblical canons, as it contains additional books that are not part of the Hebrew Bible or the Old Testament.
translations: 这是一种非常罕见的正教经典的台瓦西多的英文译本圣经，这些宗教文字构成了埃塞俄比亚正教教会的信仰和教义基础，可能是从移民、收藏家或神学家那里获得的。这一经典与新教和天主教的圣经不同，因为它额外包含了希伯来圣经或旧约中没有的书籍。

messages.msgid: A compilation of texts and interpretations of the Christian Bible that focus on the history, culture, and religious beliefs of the Rastafarian community.  It aims to provide an alternative perspective on the origins of the world and its people, emphasizing the African roots of the Rastafarian faith.
translations: 一本汇编了基督教圣经文本和解释的书籍，侧重于拉斯塔法里社区的历史、文化和宗教信仰。它旨在提供一个关于世界及其人民起源的不同观点，同时强调了拉斯塔法里信仰的非洲渊源。

messages.plural: copies of a Children's Catholic Bibles

messages.msgid: A small, lightweight Catholic Bible intended for children, containing a extremely easy to understand English writing and many illustrations.
translations: 一本专为儿童设计的小巧轻便的天主教圣经，包含极易理解的英文语言和许多插图。

messages.plural: copies of a Children's Protestant Bibles

messages.msgid: A small, lightweight Protestant Bible intended for children, containing a extremely easy to understand English writing and many illustrations.
translations: 一本专为儿童设计的小巧轻便的新教圣经，包含极易理解的英文语言和许多插图。

messages.msgid: A hardcover edition of 'The Common Catechism: A Book of Christian Faith', an ecumenical Christian catechism that is the result of Roman Catholic-Protestant dialogue and work.
translations: 《共同教义问答：基督教信仰之书》的精装版，是罗马天主教和新教之间对话和合作的结果，这是一部普世基督教教义问答书。

messages.plural: copies of the Catechism of The Catholic Church

messages.msgid: A hardcover, updated edition of the 'Catechism of The Catholic Church', a compendium of Catholic doctrine, teachings, beliefs, and moral guidance.  This book serves as a guide for Catholics to understand and deepen their faith, providing a systematic presentation of the essential teachings of the Catholic Church.
translations: 一本精装的，新版的《天主教教义问答》，是天主教信仰、教导、信条和道德指导的概要。这本书作为天主教徒理解和加深信仰的指南，系统地呈现了天主教教会的基本教义。
威斯敏斯德信条及大小教理问答

messages.msgid: The Westminster Shorter Catechism and the Westminster Larger Catechism into one single large, hardcover book.  It serves as the doctrinal standard in the Reformed tradition of Protestant Christianity, a concise and systematic summary of Christian beliefs, intended to be used for teaching and instruction (and also one of the Four Forms of Unity, depending on the denomination).  This catechism is also divided into a series of questions and answers, covering various aspects of theology, morality, and Christian living.
translations:
由《威斯敏斯特短篇信仰问答》与《威斯敏斯特大教理问答》整合而成的大型精装书。书中阐释了基督教改革宗系统神学教义的最基本框架，对基督教信仰的简明而系统的总结，旨在用于教学和指导()
这本教义通过一系列的问答，呈现了神学、道德和基督徒生活的各个方面。

messages.msgid: The Luther's Small Catechism and the Luther's Large Catechism into one single large, hardcover book.  It contains a summary of Christian doctrine and was intended to be used as a teaching tool for laypeople, particularly parents and pastors, to instruct them in the basic principles of the Christian faith.
translations: 《路德小教理问答》和《路德大教理问答》合订的为一本大型精装书。它包含了基督教教义的总结，旨在作为非信徒（特别是父母和牧师）的教学工具，指导他们了解基督教信仰的基本原则。

messages.msgid: A paperback book written by Henry Steel Olcott and Published in 1881.  It serves as an introductory guide to Buddhism, providing a concise overview of its principles, practices, and history.  The book presents a series of questions and answers that cover various aspects of Buddhism, including the life of the Buddha, the Four Noble Truths, the Eightfold Path, karma, rebirth, meditation, and ethics.
translations: 亨利·斯太尔·奥尔科特创作的一本平装书，出版于1881年。它是佛教的入门指南，简要介绍了佛教的原理、实践和历史。这本书提出了一系列的问题和答案，涵盖了佛教各个方面的理论，包括佛的一生、四谛、八正道、十二缘起支、轮回、冥想和伦理思想。

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Safinatun Najah, a renowned manual of Islamic jurisprudence, specifically focusing on the Shafi'i school of thought.  It serves as a comprehensive guide for Muslims seeking knowledge and understanding of the principles and practices of Islam.
translations: 著名的伊斯兰法学手册《法源论纲》的精装英译本，专门关注沙斐仪学派。它是穆斯林寻求知识和理解伊斯兰教原则和实践的全面指南。

messages.msgid: A hardcover, updated edition of the 'Heidelberg Catechism', a Protestant confession of faith and also a guide for religious instruction, written in 1563 (and also one of the Three Forms of Unity, or Four Forms of Unity, depending on the denomination).  The contents consists of 129 questions and answers, divided into three main sections: guilt, grace, and gratitude.  Each section addresses a different aspect of the Christian faith and is intended to be memorized and understood by believers.
translations: 《海德堡要理问答》是一本硬封面、更新版的书，是1563年编写的基督教新教信仰告白，也是宗教教育的指南（也视教派而定，是《信仰统一三形态》或《信仰统一四形态》中的一部分）。其内容包含129个问答，分为三大主要部分：罪、恩典和感恩。每个部分都涉及基督教信仰的不同方面，旨在让信徒熟记并理解。

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Philaret Catechism, written by the Metropolitan Philaret of Moscow in the 19th century.  This book serves as a comprehensive guide to the teachings and beliefs of the Eastern Orthodox Church, structured in a question-and-answer format and covers various aspects of Christian doctrine, including theology, morality, sacraments, prayer, and the Ten Commandments.
translations: 《菲拉列特教理问答》的精装英译本，由莫斯科都主教菲拉列特于19世纪撰写。该书是一本全面介绍东正教教义和信仰的指南，采用问答形式，涵盖基督教教义的各个方面，从神学、道德、圣礼、祈祷到十诫。

messages.msgid: A hardcover edition of the Keach's Catechism, a Reformed Baptist catechism consisting of a set of basic questions and answers from scripture teaching readers the basics of the Baptist faith.
translations: 《基赤要理》的精装版，这是一部改革浸信会要理，由一系列基于圣经的基本问答组成，教导读者浸信会信仰的基础知识。

messages.msgid: A hardcover edition of the Pentecostal Catechism, a comprehensive guide to the beliefs, practices, and teachings of the Pentecostal movement within Christianity.
translations: 《五旬节派要理》的精装版，这是一本全面指导基督教内五旬节运动信仰、实践和教义的指南。

messages.plural: copies of the Canons of Dort

messages.msgid: A rare English translation of the Canons of Dort, a significant theological document within the Reformed tradition.  It consists of five main points: The Corruption of Human Nature, Unconditional Election, Limited Atonement, Irresistible Grace and Perseverance of the Saints.  It is also one of the Three Forms of Unity, or Four Forms of Unity, depending on the denomination.
translations: 《多特信经》（改革宗传承中的重要神学文献）的罕见英译本。包括五个要点：人性的败坏、无条件的拣选、有限的赎罪、不可抗拒的恩典和圣徒的坚忍不拔。在不同教派中，它还是三项联合信条或者四项联合信条中的一项。

messages.plural: copies of the Confession of Faith

messages.msgid: A rare English translation of the Confession of Faith, also known as the Belgic Confession.  It is a collection of documents in Christian theology and written statements of belief or doctrines.  These confessions aim to summarize and articulate the core beliefs of particular Christian denominations and traditions.  It also serve as a guide for the members of the church to understand and uphold the essential teachings of their faith.  It is also one of the Three Forms of Unity, or Four Forms of Unity, depending on the denomination.
translations: 《信条》的罕见英译本，又名《比利时信条》。它是基督教神学和信仰或教义书面声明的文档合集。这些信条旨在总结和阐明特定基督教教派及其传承的核心信仰。它也成为了教会成员理解和维护信仰的基本教义的指南。在不同教派中，它还是三项联合信条或者四项联合信条中的一项。

messages.msgid: A paperback edition of 'The Orthodox Church: An Introduction to Eastern Christianity', written by Timothy Ware.  This book provides a comprehensive overview of the history, theology, and practices of the Eastern Orthodox Church, and an introduction to the Orthodox faith for those unfamiliar with it, as well as a deeper exploration for those seeking to deepen their understanding.
translations: 平装版《正教会：东方基督教导论》，提摩太·瓦雷著。这本书全面概述了东正教的历史、理念和作风，向不熟悉的人介绍东正教的信仰，也能为想要详细了解的人提供更深层次的内容。

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of the Didascalia Apostolorum, an ancient Christian text that provides instructions and guidelines for the organization and governance of the early Christian Church.  The Didascalia Apostolorum is attributed to the Twelve Apostles, and is believed to have been written in the third century AD.
translations: 《宗徒训诲录》的平装英文译本，一本古老的基督教典籍，是早期基督教会组织和管理的说明与指导书。《宗徒训诲录》来自十二宗徒，被认为著成于三世纪。

messages.plural: copies of The Ladder of Divine Ascent

messages.msgid: A commercial-grade, hardcover English edition of The Ladder of Divine Ascent, a well-known spiritual guidebook written in the 6th century by John Climacus, an Orthodox Christian monk.  This book is composed of many chapters, each representing a rung on the ladder, symbolizing the spiritual journey towards union with God.
translations: 著名书籍《神圣攀登的天梯 》的精装英文版，为读者提供灵魂的指引，由6世纪的东正教僧侣所著。此书包括许多章节，每一章都代表着一级阶梯，象征着与上帝联系同一的更进一步。

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of the Jaiva Dharma, a significant philosophical and devotional book written by Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakura, a prominent spiritual leader and philosopher in the Gaudiya Vaishnava Hindu tradition.  This book delves into the essential teachings of the Bhagavad-gita and the Srimad-Bhagavatam, providing deep insights into the nature of the soul, its relationship with God, and the process of spiritual realization.
translations: 《微灵天职》的平装英译本，Gaudiya Vaishnava派印度教中杰出的精神领袖和哲学家Srila Bhaktivinoda Thakura所著，充满了哲理与虔诚。这本书深入研究了《博伽梵歌》和《圣典博伽梵歌》的基本教义，提供了对灵魂本质的深刻见解，灵魂与神的关系，以及悟道的步骤。

messages.msgid: Book of the Counsels of Zoroaster
messages.plural: copies of the Book of the Counsels of Zoroaster

messages.msgid: This is a rare English translation of the 'Book of the Counsels of Zoroaster', also known as 'Pand-namag i Zardust', a post-Sasanian compendium of apothegms intended to instruct every Zoroastrian male, upon his attaining the age of fifteen years, in fundamental religious and ethical principles, as well as in the daily duties incumbent upon him.
translations: 《琐罗亚斯德箴言录》的罕见英译本，又名《Pand-namag i Zardust》，后萨珊王朝时期的一本箴言合集，旨在指导年满15岁的拜火教男信徒学习基本的宗教和伦理原则，以及日常义务。

messages.plural: copies of the Anglican Book of Common Prayer

messages.msgid: A hardcover edition of the Anglican Book of Common Prayer.  It once held great significance in the Anglican Church, but still contain a collection of liturgical prayers, rites, catechisms and instructions that provide a standardized format for various religious services and ceremonies.
translations: 《圣公宗公祷书》的精装版。它曾在圣公宗中占有重要地位，但现在其中包含的礼仪祷文、仪式、教义和说明依然为各种宗教仪式和典礼提供了标准化格式。

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Kebra Negast, also known as the Glory of the Kings.  It is an ancient Ethiopian text that holds significant religious and historical value for the Ethiopian Orthodox Church and the Rastafarian movement.  It is a compilation of sacred stories and legends that revolve around the life of King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba, as well as the birth and early life of King Menelik I, the founder of the Ethiopian Empire.
translations: 《列王荣耀记》的精装英译本，也被称为《王之荣耀》。这是一部古埃塞俄比亚的文书，对埃塞俄比亚东正教和拉斯特法里运动具有重要的宗教和历史价值。这是一部神圣故事和传说的合集，围绕所罗门王和示巴女王的生活，以及埃塞俄比亚帝国的创始人孟尼利克王一世的出生和早期生活。

messages.plural: copies of The Guru Granth Sahib

messages.msgid: A single-volume copy of the central religious texts of Sikhism.
translations: 锡克教的核心宗教典籍的单行本。

messages.msgid: A Muslim religious text containing an account of the sayings and actions of the prophet Muhammad.
translations: 穆斯林的经文，记载了先知穆罕默德的言行。

messages.msgid: A book that embodies the main beliefs of Discordianism.  It seems to primarily concern chaos, and features a card in the back which informs you that you are now a 'genuine and authorized Pope of Discordia'.
translations: 收录了混沌教派主要宗教论述的宗教典籍。从头到尾都在说关于混沌的伟大，书背后画着一张卡片，提醒读完书的你已经是一位"名副其实的官方指定混沌教教皇"。

messages.msgid: The oldest extant chronicle of Japan's myths and history, the stories contained in the Kojiki are part of the inspiration behind Shinto practices.
translations: 记录日本神话和历史的、现存最古老的编年史书籍，其中包含了古事记故事背后、神道的做法灵感的一部分。

messages.msgid: Also known as 'Chronicles of Japan', it is considered one of the two most important and oldest chronicles of ancient Japan, the other being the Kojiki.  The Nihon Shoki covers the history of Japan with a compilation of myths, legends, religious practices, rituals and historical events.
translations: 一本日本编年史，是古代日本最重要且久远的纪年史书，另一本是古事记。《日本书纪》从神话、传说、宗教、仪式和历史事件等多个方面记录了日本历史。

messages.msgid: A somewhat large paperback book containing a extensive compilation of historical records and chronicles that originated in ancient Japan (probably during the Nara and Heian periods).  It covers local legends, folklore, religious beliefs, agricultural practices, dialects, historical events, quantity and quality of resources, boundaries, topography, climate, flora, fauna, and cultural practices of several Japanese provinces at that time.
translations: 一本稍大的平装书，包含了许多关于古代日本（奈良与平安时期）的历史记录和编年记载。内容覆盖了本土神话、民俗传说、宗教信仰、地方方言、农业实践、历史事件、资源分布、地界、地形、气候、植被、物种，以及一些文化现象和日本当时的行省设置。

messages.msgid: A large English translation of the most significant of the three scriptures within the Tenrikyo religious tradition (the other two being the Mikagura-uta and Osashizu).  It serves as an essential text that provides a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental beliefs and doctrines of Tenrikyo.
translations: 《御书》是天理教(Tenrikyo)宗教传统中三部最重要经文之一的大部头英文译本（其余两部为《御歌》和《御笔之旨》）。它作为一部必读的经文，为人们全面理解天理教的基本信仰和教义提供了深刻见解。

messages.msgid: A English translation of the Mikagura-uta, one of the most significant books within the Tenrikyo Religious Tradition.  It is a collection of hymns and prayers that serve as a guide for the followers of the Tenrikyo.
translations: 《御歌》是天理教宗教传统中最重要的书籍之一的英文译本。它是一系列赞美诗和祈祷文的集合，为天理教的信徒们提供了行为指南。

messages.msgid: A English translation of the Osashizu, one of the most significant books within the Tenrikyo Religious Tradition.  It serves as a guide for followers of the religion or people wishing to learn about it, providing spiritual teachings, ethical principles, and practical advice on various aspects of life.
translations: 《御笔之旨》是天理教宗教传统中最重要的书籍之一的英文译本。它既是信徒们的宗教指南，也是希望了解天理教的人们的学习资料。它提供了精神教诲、道德原则以及关于生活各个方面的实用建议。

messages.plural: copies of the Doctrines of Tenrikyo

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of Tenrikyo's official doctrine.  This book explains the basic teachings of the Tenrikyo Religious Tradition.
translations: 一本天理教官方教义，英文平装本。这本书阐释了天理教的基本教义。

messages.msgid: The Life of Oyasama, Foundress of Tenrikyo
translations: 天理教创始人中山美伎的一生
messages.plural: copies of The Life of Oyasama, Foundress of Tenrikyo

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of Tenrikyo's hagiography of Miki Nakayama, foundress of the Tenrikyo Religious Tradition.
translations: 一本天理教对其创始人中山美伎的传记，英文平装本。

messages.msgid: The Anecdotes of Oyasama, Foundress of Tenrikyo
translations: 天理教创始人中山美伎轶事
messages.plural: copies of The Anecdotes of Oyasama, Foundress of Tenrikyo

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of an anthology of anecdotes about Oyasama that were passed down orally by her first followers and later written down and verified.
translations: 一本英文平装本，收录了中山美伎的趣闻轶事。这些趣闻最初由她的首批追随者口口相传，后来得以文字记录和查证。

messages.msgid: This is very rare English translation of the Buluotuo, a sacred epic in Moism, the religion of most Zhuang people, the largest ethnic minority of China.  This book addresses the creation of the Universe and life as well as how to live a religiously meritorious life inside Moism.  This book also contains information on entities, deities, gods, goddesses, prayers, practices and rituals of Moism.
translations: 一本《布洛陀经诗》稀有的的英译本，《布洛陀经诗》是中国最大的少数民族的主要信仰——摩教的宗教经典。这本书讲述了人类的起源和生命的诞生，以及如何遵循摩教的思想做功德。这本书还介绍了摩教的神明，祈祷经文和各类宗教仪式。

messages.msgid: A rare and extensive study and translation of all the manuscripts of The Guodian Chu Slips by Scott Cook.  The original slip-texts include both Taoist and Confucian works that offered fresh information for scholars studying the history of philosophical thought in ancient China.
translations: 斯科特·库克（Scott Cook）对《郭店楚简》的所有手稿进行了罕见且详尽的研究与翻译。原简文中的内容既有道家作品，也有儒家作品，为学者研究中国古代哲学思想史提供了全新的资料。

messages.msgid: A English edition of the Popol Vuh, a sacred book of the K'iche' Maya people, a native group from the Guatemalan highlands.  It is a combination of creation myths, historical narratives, and heroic legends that revolve around the K'iche' people's origins, culture, and the deities that govern their universe.
translations: 《波波尔·乌》的英文版，这是基切玛雅人——一个来自危地马拉高地的土著群体的神圣之书。它融合了创世神话、历史叙述和英雄传奇，围绕着基切人的起源、文化以及掌管他们宇宙的神灵展开。

messages.msgid: A extremely rare English edition of the Codex Borbonicus, an ancient pre-Columbian Mesoamerican manuscript that provides valuable insights into the religious and ritual practices of the Aztecs.  It contains original pictures, illustrations, detailed information about the tonalpohualli (the sacred 260-day calendar), the xiuhpohualli (the agricultural year), deities, rituals, and ceremonies.  This codex also includes depictions and information of various gods and goddesses, sacrificial rites, and astronomical phenomena.
translations: 《波旁尼克手抄本》的英文版极为罕见，这是一部古老的前哥伦布时期中美洲手稿，为我们深入了解阿兹特克人的宗教和仪式习俗提供了宝贵线索。它包含原始图片、插图，以及关于托纳波胡亚利（神圣的260天历法）、修波胡亚利（农业年历）、神明、仪式和庆典的详细信息。此外，这部法典还描绘了众多神祇、女神的形象，介绍了祭祀仪式和天文现象。

messages.msgid: A uncommon English edition of the Huarochirí Manuscript, a collection of Quechua narratives that provides valuable insights into the religious beliefs, rituals, and cosmology of the Inca people.
translations: 一份不常见的英文版《瓦洛奇里手稿》，这部手稿汇集了克丘亚语叙事作品，为我们深入了解印加人的宗教信仰、仪式和宇宙观提供了宝贵资料。

messages.msgid: A pretty rare English translation of the Ugaritic Texts, a collection of ancient mythological, religious and literature texts regarding the Canaanites.  It contains religious epics such as the Baal Cycle, which recounts the myths surrounding the storm god Baal, as well as hymns, prayers, and rituals that shed light on the religious worldview of the ancient Canaanites and their practices.
translations: 一份相当罕见的英文版《乌加里特文献》，这是一系列关于迦南人的古代神话、宗教和文学文本的集合。其中包含宗教史诗，如《巴力周期》，它讲述了围绕风暴之神巴力的神话；还有赞美诗、祈祷文和仪式，它们揭示了古代迦南人的宗教世界观和实践。

messages.plural: copies of the Book of Kells

messages.msgid: A extremely rare English translation of the Book of Kells, a highly decorated and illuminated Celtic manuscript, primarily containing the four Gospels of the New Testament.  This translation mimics perfectly the art and style of the original manuscript, including its elaborate calligraphy, with each letter meticulously designed and adorned with various motifs, including animals, humans, and knotwork patterns.
translations: 及其稀有的《凯尔斯书》英文精译本，一本看起来装饰精美、光芒四射的凯尔特手稿，主要包含四部新约福音书，这版译本完美地模仿了原始手稿的艺术风格，包括其精心设计的书法，每一个字母都经过精心设计，并装饰成动物，人，绳结的图案。

messages.plural: copies of the Book of Leister

messages.msgid: A incredibly rare English translation of the Book of Leinster, a significant and ancient compilation of Irish literature and history, dating back to the 12th century.  It contains annals, genealogies, historical texts, legal tracts, secular and religious poetry and stories from Irish mythology, such as the epic tale "Táin Bó Cúailnge", which tells the story of the legendary warrior Cú Chulainn and the cattle raid of Cooley.
translations: 一本极为罕见的《莱恩斯特之书》英文译本，这是一部重要的古老爱尔兰文学与历史汇编，可追溯至12世纪。它收录了编年史、家谱、历史文本、法律条文、世俗与宗教诗歌，以及爱尔兰神话中的故事，如史诗般的“塔因·博·库阿林格”，讲述了传奇战士库丘林与库利牧场的牛群劫掠事件。

messages.msgid: A rare English translation of the Mabinogion, a collection of twelve medieval Welsh tales, dating back to the 11th and 12th centuries.  It provide a valuable insight into the mythology, history, religion and culture of medieval Wales.
translations: 一本稀有的《马比诺吉昂》英文译本，这是一部包含十二篇中世纪威尔士传说的作品集，可追溯至11至12世纪。它为我们提供了了解中世纪威尔士神话、历史、宗教和文化的宝贵视角。

messages.msgid: A rare English translation of the Mesopotamian Epic Atra-Hasis.  Named for its protagonist, Atrahasis ('exceedingly wise'), the Atra-Hasis include both a creation myth and one of three surviving Babylonian flood myths.
translations: 一本稀有的英译版美索不达米亚史诗《阿特拉-哈西斯》，这部作品以其主角“阿特拉哈西斯”（意为“极度睿智者”）命名，其中包含了美索不达米亚创世神话以及现存三部巴比伦洪水神话之一的故事内容。
恩基和宁胡尔萨格的传说
messages.plural: copies of the Enki and Ninhursag Myth

messages.msgid: A pretty uncommon English translation of the Enki and Ninhursag Myth, a Sumerian creation myth that explains the origins of the world, humanity, and the gods.
translations: 一部颇为罕见的英译版《恩基与宁胡尔萨格神话》，该神话源自苏美尔文明，阐释了世界起源、人类诞生以及诸神创生的故事。

messages.plural: copies of The Descent of Inanna

messages.msgid: A very rare English translation of the Descent of Inanna, an ancient Sumerian myth that recounts the journey of the goddess Inanna into the underworld, where she seeks to confront her sister Ereshkigal, the Queen of the Underworld.
translations: 一部极为稀有的英译版《伊南娜下冥界》，这是一部古苏美尔神话，讲述了女神伊南娜深入冥界，意图挑战其姐姐——冥界女王埃列什基伽尔的历险过程。

messages.msgid: A English translation of the Heliand, an Old Saxon epic poem that narrates the life and passion of Jesus Christ.  It begins with the Annunciation to the Virgin Mary and continues with the birth of Jesus.  It then narrates the story of Jesus' childhood, his baptism by John the Baptist, and his public ministry.  This poem also includes various miracles performed by Jesus, such as healing the sick, raising the dead, and calming the storm.
translations: 一份英译版《海尔兰德》，这是一部古老的撒克逊史诗，讲述了耶稣基督的生活与受难事迹。诗歌自天使向圣母玛利亚宣告受胎开始叙述，继而展开耶稣诞生的故事。接着描绘了耶稣童年时期的情景，他的洗礼由施洗者约翰主持，并进一步讲述了他的公开传道生涯。在这首诗中，还记录了耶稣所行的各种奇迹，如治愈病人、复活死者以及平息风暴等。

messages.plural: copies of the Alphabet of Sirach

messages.msgid: A rare English translation of the Alphabet of Sirach, a compilation of two lists of proverbs, 22 in Jewish Babylonian Aramaic and 22 in Medieval Hebrew (all translated to English), both arranged as alphabetic acrostics, with each proverb followed by an aggadic commentary.
translations: 一部罕见的英译版《便西拉智训字母篇》，该书汇编了两组共44条箴言，其中22条采用犹太巴比伦阿拉米语编写，另外22条则以中世纪希伯来语写成（所有内容均翻译成了英文）。这些箴言特别地按照字母顺序排列成首尾相连的串句形式，每条箴言后均附有一段aggadic（阿加达）注释性质的评论。

messages.plural: copies of The Buddha and His Dhamma

messages.msgid: A English translation of The Buddha and His Dhamma by B. R. Ambedkar.  It is a interpretation of the Buddhist path and the scripture for those who follow Navayana Buddhism.
translations: 一本《佛陀及其法》英文译本，是B.R. 阿姆贝卡对佛教道路和经文的阐释，它是那些追随新佛教(Navayana Buddhism)之人的教义。

messages.msgid: A extremely rare English translation of the Panaturan, the Holy Scripture of the Kaharingan religion.  It is a guide for its adherents and followers, providing them with spiritual teachings, moral lessons, and principles to live by.
translations: 一本极其罕见的《帕纳图兰》英译本，这是卡哈林甘宗教的圣典。它为信徒们提供精神指引、道德教诲与生活准则。

messages.msgid: A extremely rare English translation of the Zhivotnaya Kniga (Book of Life).  It is a collection of written and translated Doukhobor oral holy hymns, but this book also has the Russian version alongside the English translations.
translations: 一本极为罕见的《生命之书》英文译本。它汇集了书面记录并翻译的道库霍伯尔圣洁赞美诗，且书中同时包含了俄文原文与对应的英文译文。

messages.plural: copies of The Book of Mormon

messages.msgid: The sacred text of the Latter Day Saint movement of Christianity, originally published in 1830 by Joseph Smith.
translations: 摩门教（耶稣基督后期圣徒教会）的教义文本，该书最早于1830年由约瑟夫史密斯出版发行。

messages.plural: copies of the Holy Books of the East

messages.msgid: It is a monumental 50-volume set of English translations of Asian religious texts.  It incorporates the essential sacred texts of Hinduism, Buddhism, Taoism, Confucianism, Zoroastrianism, Jainism, and Islam.
translations: 这是一本包含亚洲宗教文本英译的鸿篇巨作，共50卷。其中汇编了印度教、佛教、道教、儒家、琐罗亚斯德教、耆那教以及伊斯兰教等各大宗教的核心圣典。

messages.msgid: Sacred Book of the East Vol. 1
messages.plural: copies of the first volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Upanishads, part 1/2: Khândogya Upanishad, Talavakâra (or Kena-Upanishad), Aitareya-Âranyaka, Kaushîtaki-Brâhmana and Vâjasaneyi-Sâmhita Upanishad.
translations: 这本书包含《奥义书》第1/2部分的《乔达磨奥义书》（Khândogya Upanishad）、《凯那奥义书》（Talavakâra）、《爱达瑞亚森林书》（Aitareya-Âranyaka）、《考希塔基奥义书》（Kaushîtaki-Brâhmana）以及《伐遮斯内义奥义书》（Vâjasaneyi-Sâmhita Upanishad）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 2
messages.plural: copies of the second volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Sacred Laws of the Aryas (Dharmasastra), part 1/2: Âpastamba, Gautama, Vâsishtha and Baudhâyana.
translations: 这本书包含《雅利安人法经》(Dharmasastra)第1/2部分中的《阿帕斯檀跋法经》（AÂpastamba）、《乔达磨法经》(Gautama)、《婆私咤法经》（Vâsishtha）以及《包德哈亚那法经》（Baudhâyana）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 3
messages.plural: copies of the third volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Sacred Books of China, part 1/6, the texts of Confucianism: The Shû King (Classic of History), Book of Thang, Books of Yu, Books of Hsiâ, Books of Shang, Books of Kâu, Shih King, the Book of Odes (Classic of Poetry, I - Odes of the Temple and the Altar, II - Minor Odes of the Kingdom, III - Major Odes of the Kingdom, IV - Lessons from the States) and The Hsiâo King (Classic of Filial Piety).
translations: 这本书包含了《中国圣书》第1/6部分中的儒家经典，《尚书》（包含《尧典》、《虞书》、《夏书》、《商书》、《周书》）、《诗经》（包含《颂》、《小雅》、《大雅》、《风》）以及《孝经》。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 4
messages.plural: copies of the fourth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Zend-Avesta, part 1/3: Vendîdâd.
translations: 这本书包含了《赞德-阿维斯塔》的第1/2部分——《旺迪达德》

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 5
messages.plural: copies of the fifth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Pahlavi Texts, part 1/5: Bundahis, selections of Zâd-sparam, Bahman Yast, Shâyast lâ-Shâyast.
translations: 这本书包含了《帕赫拉维文本》第1/5部分的内容，包括《邦达希斯》(Bundahis)、《扎德·斯帕拉姆选集》（Zâd-sparam selections）、《巴赫曼雅斯特》(Bahman Yast)以及《沙耶斯特·拉·沙耶斯特》（Shâyast lâ-Shâyast）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 6
messages.plural: copies of the sixth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Holy Qur'an part 1/2, from chapters I to XVI.
translations: 这本书包含了《古兰经》的第一部分，涵盖了从第一章到第十六章的内容。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 7
messages.plural: copies of the seventh volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Institutes of Vishnu.
translations: 这本书包含了《毗湿奴法典》。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 8
messages.plural: copies of the eighth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Bhagavadgitâ: Sanatsugâtîya and Anugitâ.
translations: 这本书包含了《博伽梵歌》中的两个篇章：“圣者寿天篇”（Sanatsugâtîya）与“后歌篇”（Anugitâ）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 9
messages.plural: copies of the ninth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Holy Qur'an, part 2/2, from chapters XVII to CXIV.
translations: 这本书包含了《古兰经》的第2/2部分，记载了从第十七章至第一百一十四章的内容。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 10
messages.plural: copies of the tenth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Dhammapada: a collection of verses, and the Sutta-Nipâta: a collection of discourses, being one of the canonical books of the Buddhists.
translations: 这本书包含了《法句经》：一系列精炼的偈语集，以及《经集》：一系列佛教教义的对话与论述，它们都是佛教典籍中的核心经典。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 11
messages.plural: copies of the eleventh volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Buddhist Suttas: Mahā-parinibbāna Suttanta, Dhamma-kakka-ppavattana Sutta, Tevigga Sutta'anta, Âkankheyya Sutta'a, Ketokhila Sutta'a, Mahâ-Sudassana Sutta'anta and Sabbâsava Sutta'a.
translations: 这本书包含了多部佛教经文，即佛教《经藏》中的精华篇章：Mahā-parinibbāna Suttanta：《大般涅槃经》，Dhamma-kakka-ppavattana Sutta：《转法轮经》，Tevigga Sutta'anta：可能是指《谛相应》中的某篇经文，Âkankheyya Sutta'a：愿望经，Ketokhila Sutta'a，Mahâ-Sudassana Sutta'anta：《大苏达沙那经》，Sabbâsava Sutta'a：《一切漏经》。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 12
messages.plural: copies of the twelfth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Satapatha Brahmana, part 1/5: Mâdhyandina Shakha from I to II.
translations: 这本书包含了《百道梵书》第1/5部分——《玛德扬迪纳支派》（Mâdhyandina Shakha）的第一卷至第二卷。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 13
messages.plural: copies of the thirteenth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Vinaya Texts, part 1/3: Pātimokkha and Mahâvagga, from I to IV.
translations: 这本书包含了《律藏》文本的第1/3部分内容，即《巴帝摩卡》（Pātimokkha）和《大品》（Mahāvagga）的第一卷至第四卷。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 14
messages.plural: copies of the fourteenth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Sacred Laws of the Aryas, part 2/2: Vâsishtha, Baudhâyana and Parisishta.
translations: 这本书包含了《雅利安人的神圣法典》第2/2部分，涉及到了三个部分：《瓦西斯托法典》（Vâsishtha）、《包达雅那法典》（Baudhâyana）以及《附录篇》(Parisishta)。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 15
messages.plural: copies of the fifteenth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Upanishads, part 2/2: Katha Upanishad, Mundaka Upanishad, Taittiriya Upanishad, Brhadaranyaka Upanishad, Svetasvatara Upanishad, Prasna Upanishad and Maitrayani Upanishad.
translations: 这本书包含了《奥义书》第2/2部分中的多个篇章，包括《卡塔奥义书》(Katha Upanishad)、《蒙达卡奥义书》（Mundaka Upanishad）、《泰迪里亚奥义书》(Taittiriya Upanishad)、《广林奥义书》（Brhadaranyaka Upanishad）、《白净识者奥义书》(Svetasvatara Upanishad)、《疑问奥义书》（Prasna Upanishad），以及《梅特拉亚尼奥义书》(Maitrayani Upanishad)。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 16
messages.plural: copies of the sixteenth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Sacred Books of China, part 2/6, the texts of Confucianism: Yi King (I Ching).
translations: 这本书包含了《中国神圣经典》第2/6部分，有关于儒家经典：《易经》（亦称Yi King为I Ching）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 17
messages.plural: copies of the seventeenth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Vinaya Texts, part 2/3: Mahavagga, from V to X, and Kullavagga, from I to II.
translations: 这本书包含了《律藏》文本的第2/3部分内容，涵盖了《大品》（Mahāvagga）的第五卷至第十卷，以及《全品》(Kullavagga)的第一卷至第二卷。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 18
messages.plural: copies of the eighteenth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Pahlavi Texts, part 2/5: Dâdistân-i Dinik and the Epistles of Mânûskihar.
translations: 这本书包含了《帕赫拉维文本》第2/5部分，包括《达迪斯坦-伊-迪尼克》（Dâdistân-i Dinik）与《曼努斯基哈尔书信》（Epistles of Mânûskihar）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 19
messages.plural: copies of the nineteenth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Fo-sho-hing-tsan-king: a life of Buddha, by Ashvaghosha, and the Bodhisattva.
translations: 其中包括《佛所行赞》：由马鸣菩萨所著的佛陀生平，以及关于菩萨的内容。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 20
messages.plural: copies of the twenty volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Vinaya Texts, part 3/3: Kullavagga, from IV to XII.
translations: 这本书包含了《律藏》文本的第2/3部分内容，涵盖了《全品》(Kullavagga)的第四卷至第十二卷。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 21
messages.plural: copies of the twentieth-first volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Saddharma-Pundarika (or The Lotus of the True Law).
translations: 这本书包含了《妙法莲华经》(Saddharma-Pundarika)。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 22
messages.plural: copies of the twenty-second volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Jaina Sutras, part 1/2: Âkârânga sutra and Kalpa sutra.
translations: 这本书包含了《耆那教圣典》文本的第1/2部分内容：《阿含经》（Âkârânga sutra）与《劫波经》(Kalpa sutra)。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 23
messages.plural: copies of the twenty-third volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Zend-Avesta, part 2/3: Sîrôzahs, Yasts and Nyâyis.
translations: 这本书包含《阿维斯陀经注解》的第2/3部分: 《Sîrôzahs》、《Yasts》和《Nyâyis》。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 24
messages.plural: copies of the twenty-fourth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Pahlavi Texts, part 3/5: Dinai Mainog-i khirad, Sikand-Gümanik Vigar and Sad Dar.
translations: 这本书包含了《帕赫拉维文本》第3/5部分，包括《迪耐伊-麦诺格-伊-希兰得》(Dinai Mainog-i khirad)、《斯堪德-古曼尼克-维嘉》（ Sikand-Gümanik Vigar）和《萨德达尔》(Sad Dar)。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 25
messages.plural: copies of the twenty-fifth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Laws of Manu, with extracts from seven commentaries.
translations: 其中包含了《摩奴法典》的内容，并节选自七部注释。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 26
messages.plural: copies of the twenty-sixth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Satapatha Brahmana, part 2/5: Mâdhyandina Shakha from III to IV.
translations: 这本书包含了《萨塔帕塔婆罗门》(Satapatha Brahmana)第2/5部分，包括：《马迪亚迪娜·沙卡》（Mâdhyandina Shakha）的第三卷到第四卷。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 27
messages.plural: copies of the twenty-seventh volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Sacred Books of China, part 3/6, the texts of Confucianism: The Li Ki I (Book of Rites).
translations: 这本书包含了《中国圣典》3/6的内容，即儒家经典：《礼记》第一部分。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 28
messages.plural: copies of the twenty-eight volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Sacred Books of China, part 4/6, the texts of Confucianism: The Li Ki II (Book of Rites).
translations: 这本书包含了《中国圣典》4/6的内容，即儒家文献：《礼记》第二部分。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 29
messages.plural: copies of the twenty-ninth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Grihya-sutras, part 1/2, rules of Vedic domestic ceremonies: Sankhyayana-Grihya-sutra, Āsvalāyana-Grihya-sutra, Paraskara-Grihya-sutra and Khadia-Grihya-sutra.
translations: 这本书包含了《格里希亚经》(Grihya-sutras)的上半部分，讲述了吠陀家庭仪式规则，包括：《桑克亚亚纳家庭经》（Sankhyayana-Grihya-sutra）、《阿斯瓦拉亚那家庭经》（Āsvalāyana-Grihya-sutra）、《帕拉斯卡拉家庭经》（Paraskara-Grihya-sutra）以及《卡迪亚家庭经》(Khadia-Grihya-sutra)。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 30
messages.plural: copies of the thirtieth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Grihya-sutras, part 2/2, rules of Vedic domestic ceremonies: Gobhila, Hiranyakesin, Apastamba and Yajna Paribhashasutras.
translations: 这本书包含了《格里希亚经》（Grihya-sutras）的下半部分，讲述了吠陀家庭仪式规则，包括：《戈比拉》(Gobhila)、《希拉亚克辛》(Hiranyakesin)、《阿帕斯坦巴》(Apastamba)以及《亚伊尼亚·帕里巴塔经》（Yajña Paribhāṣa Sūtras）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 31
messages.plural: copies of the thirty-first volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Zend-Avesta, part 3/3: Yasna, Visparad, Afrinagân, Gâhs and miscellaneous fragments.
translations: 这本书包含了《阿维斯陀经注解》（Zend-Avesta）第三部分也是最后一部分，包括《雅斯纳》(Yasna)、《维斯帕拉德》(Visparad)、《阿夫林纳甘》（Afrinagân）、伽斯（Gâhs）以及各类零散片段。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 32
messages.plural: copies of the thirty-second volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Vedic Hymns, part 1/2: Hymns to the Maruts, Hymns to Rudra, Hymns to Vâyu, Hymns to Vâta and a bibliographical list of the more important publications on the Rigveda.
translations: 这本书包含了《吠陀赞美诗》的第 1/2 部分：对风暴神马鲁特(Maruts)的赞美诗、对暴恶神楼陀罗(Rudra)的赞美诗、对风神伐由（Vâyu）的赞美诗、对风神伐他（Vâta）的赞美诗以及关于梨俱吠陀的更重要出版物的书目列表。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 33
messages.plural: copies of the thirty-third volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Minor Law-Books: Brihaspati.
translations: 这本书包含了《小律法书：祭主仙人》。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 34
messages.plural: copies of the thirty-fourth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Vedanta-Sutras, part 1/3: Commentary by Sankaracharya, part 1 of 2, and the Adhyâya I–II (Pâda I–II).
translations: 这本书包含了《吠檀多经》的一部分（占三分之一），其中收录了商羯罗的评注，为两部分中的第一部分，并涵盖了第一章和第二章的（第一节和第二节）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 35
messages.plural: copies of the thirty-fifth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Questions of King Milinda, part 1/2.
translations: 这本书还收录了《弥兰王问经》的节选（前半部分）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 36
messages.plural: copies of the thirty-sixth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains The Questions of King Milinda, part 2/2.
translations: 这本书还收录了《弥兰王问经》的节选（后半部分）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 37
messages.plural: copies of the thirty-seventh volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Pahlavi Texts, part 4/5: Contents of the Nasks.
translations: 此书收录了《波斯语文献集》的第四部分（共五部分），其中包含《纳斯克》的内容。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 38
messages.plural: copies of the thirty-eight volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Vedanta-Sutras, part 2/3: Commentary by Sankaracharya, part 2 of 2, and Adhyâya II to IV (Pâda III to IV).
translations: 本书收录了《吠檀多经》的第二部分（占三分之一），其中包含商羯罗的评注，为两部分中的第二部分，并涵盖了第二章到第四章（第三节和第四节）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 39
messages.plural: copies of the thirty-ninth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Texts of Taoism, part 1/2: The Tao Te Ching of Lao Dze (Lao Tsu) and The Writings of Chuang-tse, from I to XVII.
translations: 它包含了《道教经典》的第一部分：老子的《道德经》和庄子的第一至第十七篇著作，

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 40
messages.plural: copies of the fourtieth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Texts of Taoism, part 2/2: The Writings of Chuang-tse, from XVII to XXXIII, The Thai-shang tractate of actions and their retributions, other Taoist texts and the Index to volumes 39 and 40.
translations: 这本书收录了道教典籍的后半部分（共2部）：《庄子》的第十七篇至第三十三篇，《太上感应篇》，其他道教文献，以及第39卷和第40卷的索引。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 41
messages.plural: copies of the forty-first volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Satapatha Brahmana, part 3/5: Mâdhyandina Shakha from V to VII.
translations: 这本书收录了《百道梵书》的第3/5部分，包括了《玛德扬迪纳支派》（Mâdhyandina Shakha）第五卷到第七卷的内容。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 42
messages.plural: copies of the forty-second volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Hymns of the Atharvaveda, together With Extracts From the Ritual Books and the Commentaries.
translations: 这本书收录了《阿闼婆吠陀》的赞歌，仪式书和评注的节选。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 43
messages.plural: copies of the forty-third volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Satapatha Brahmana, part 4/5: the Mâdhyandina Shakha VII, IX and X.
translations: 这本书包含了《百道梵书》第4/5部分——《玛德扬迪纳支派》（Mâdhyandina Shakha）的的第七、九和十卷。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 44
messages.plural: copies of the forty-fourth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Satapatha Brahmana, part 5/5: the Mâdhyandina Shakha from XI to XIV.
translations: 这本书包含了《百道梵书》第5/5部分——《玛德扬迪纳支派》（Mâdhyandina Shakha）的的第十一到第十四卷。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 45
messages.plural: copies of the forty-fifth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Jaina Sutras, part 2 of 2: Uttaradhyayana Sutra and Sutrakritânga Sutra.
translations: 这本书收录了《耆那教经》的第2/2部分，内容有《优陀罗衍那经》和《苏多罗吉当伽经》。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 46
messages.plural: copies of the forty-sixth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Vedic Hymns, part 2/2: Hymns to Agni (Mandalas I to V).
translations: 这本书收录了《吠陀赞歌》的第2/2部分，内容为献给阿耆尼的赞歌（第一至第五曼荼罗）。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 47
messages.plural: copies of the forty-seventh volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Pahlavi Texts, part 5/5: The Marvels of Zoroastrianism.
translations: 此书收录了《波斯语文献集》第5/5部分，其中收录了《琐罗亚斯德教的奇观》。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 48
messages.plural: copies of the forty-eighth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Vedanta-Sutras, part 3/3, with the commentary of Râmânuja.
translations: 这本书收录了完整的《吠檀多经》的第3/3部分，并附有罗摩奴阇的评注。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 49
messages.plural: copies of the forty-ninth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains the Buddhist Mahayana Texts, part 1/2: Buddha-karita of Aśvaghosa, the Buddhist Mahayana Texts, part 2/2: Longer Sukhâvati-vyuha and Shorter Sukhâvati-vyuha, Vagrakkhedika, the longer Pragnâ-pâramitâ-hridaya-sutra, the shorter Pragnâ-pâramitâ-hridaya-sutra and the Amitâyur dhyâna-sutra.
translations: 它包含了佛教大乘经典，第一部分：阿育王的《佛陀传》；第二部分：较长的《阿弥陀经》和较短的《阿弥陀经》、 《金刚经》、较长的《般若波罗蜜多心经》、较短的《般若波罗蜜多心经》和《阿弥陀三昧经》。

messages.msgid: Sacred Books of the East Vol. 50
messages.plural: copies of the fiftieth volume of the Sacred Books of the East

messages.msgid: It contains a nice general index to the names and subject-matter of the Sacred Books of the East.
translations: 这本书包含了一份针对《东方圣书》精心编制的名称和主题内容的通用索引。

messages.msgid: A translation of some of the gnostic texts and early biblical apocrypha recovered from the Nag Hammadi library in Egypt.  Obviously heretical, but the zombies aren't the type to discriminate.
translations: 从埃及纳格·哈马迪图书馆发现的一些诺斯替文本和早期圣经伪经的翻译。 显然是异端，但僵尸不是那种可以歧视的类型。

messages.plural: copies of the first Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains the Prayer of the Apostle Paul, the Apocryphon of James, the Gospel of Truth, the Treatise on the Resurrection, and the Tripartite Tractate.
translations: 它包含使徒保罗的祈祷文、雅各的伪经、真理福音、复活论和三方小册子。

messages.plural: copies of the second Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains the Apocryphon of John (version 1), the Gospel of Thomas, the Gospel of Phillip, the Hypostasis of the Archons, On the Origin of the World, the Exegesis of the Soul, and the Book of Thomas the Contender.
translations: 它包含了《约翰异文录》（第一版）、《多马福音》、《腓力福音》、《执政官的本质》、《世界的起源》、《灵魂的阐释》以及《竞争者托马斯之书》。

messages.plural: copies of the third Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains the Apocryphon of John (version 2), Holy Book of the Great Invisible Spirit, Eugnostos the Blessed, The Sophia of Jesus Christ, and the Dialogue of the Savior.
translations: 它包含约翰福音的伪经（第 2 版）、伟大的无形之灵的圣书、有福的欧格诺斯托斯、耶稣基督的索菲亚和救主的对话。

messages.plural: copies of the fourth Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains the Apocryphon of John (version 1) and Holy Book of the Great Invisible Spirit.
translations: 它包含约翰福音的伪经（版本1）和伟大的无形之灵的圣书。

messages.plural: copies of the fifth Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains Eugnostos the Blessed, the Apocalypse of Paul, the First Apocalypse of James, the Second Apocalypse of James, and the Apocalypse of Adam.
translations: 这本书收录了《蒙福者尤格诺斯托斯》、《保罗启示录》、《雅各布第一启示录》、《雅各布第二启示录》和《亚当启示录》。

messages.plural: copies of the sixth Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains the Acts of Peter and the Twelve Apostles, The Thunder/Perfect Mind, Authoritative Teaching, the Context of Our Great Power, fragments of Plato's Republic, The Discourse of the Eight and Ninth, the Prayer of Thanksgiving, and Asclepius.
translations: 它包含彼得和十二使徒行传、雷霆/完美心灵、权威教义、我们伟大力量的背景、柏拉图共和国的片段、八和第九的论述、感恩的祈祷和阿斯克勒庇俄斯。

messages.plural: copies of the seventh Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains the Paraphrase of Shem, the Second Treatise of the Great Seth, Gnostic Apocalypse of Peter, the Teachings of Sylvanus, and the Three Steles of Seth.
translations: 它包含闪的释义、大塞特的第二篇论文、彼得的诺斯底启示录、西尔瓦努斯的教义和塞特的三块石碑。

messages.plural: copies of the eighth Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains Zostrianos and the Letter of Peter to Philip.
translations: 它包含佐斯特里亚诺斯和彼得写给菲利普的信。

messages.plural: copies of the ninth Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains Melchizedek, the Thought of Norea, and the Testimony of Truth.
translations: 它包含麦基洗德、诺里亚的思想和真理的见证。

messages.plural: copies of the tenth Nag Hammadi Codex

translations: 它包含马萨内斯（诺斯替学派的一篇论文）。
拿哈玛地文库抄本十一
messages.plural: copies of the eleventh Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains the Interpretation of Knowledge, a Valentinian Exposition, Allogenes, and Hypsiphrone.
translations: 它包含知识的解释、瓦伦丁式的阐述、同种异体和 Hypsiphrone。
拿哈玛地文库抄本十二
messages.plural: copies of the twelfth Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains the Sentences of Sextus, the Gospel of Truth, and various fragmented texts.
translations: 它包含塞克斯图斯的句子、真理福音和各种支离破碎的文本。
拿哈玛地文库抄本十三
messages.plural: copies of the thirteenth Nag Hammadi Codex

messages.msgid: It contains Trimorphic Protennoia, On the Origin of the World, and various fragmented texts.
translations: 它包含 Trimorphic Protennoia、On the Origin of the World 和各种碎片文本。

messages.msgid: The Gospel of the Flying Spaghetti Monster
messages.plural: copies of The Gospel of the Flying Spaghetti Monster

messages.msgid: A book that embodies the main beliefs of the Church of the Flying Spaghetti Monster.  It seems to involve a lot of pirates and some sort of invisible drunken monster made of pasta.
translations: 一本描写了飞天意面神教的主要信仰的书籍。这本书里面似乎包含了大量有关海盗和某种酗酒的隐身意面怪物的描写。RAmen！

messages.msgid: An English translation of the Muslim book of holy scriptures, with explanatory notes and commentaries to aid in understanding.
translations: 《古兰经》（或译《可兰经》；意思是"诵读"，英语：Quran；Koran），是伊斯兰教的最高经典，共有30卷114章6236节。一本穆斯林神圣经典的英文译本，并附有释义注记与评注，以帮助理解。

messages.msgid: A collection of essays, observations, and rituals published by Anton LaVey in 1969.
translations: 安东·拉维1969年出版的一部论文集、评论集和仪式集。

messages.plural: copies of The Book of Shadows

messages.msgid: A dark hardcover copy of The Book of Shadows.  It serves as a personal journal and reference book for individual witches or covens.  Each practitioner may have their own unique version of The Book of Shadows, which contains their personal rituals, spells, invocations, herbal lore, divination methods, and other magical knowledge.  This one, apart from having a wide range of information directly printed on the pages, also has blank pages for you to write on.
translations: 一本深色硬壳封面的《影之书》。它充当着女巫个人或巫群的私人日记与参考书籍。每位修行者可能都拥有自己独一无二版本的《影之书》，内含他们的个人仪式、咒语、召唤文、草药知识、占卜方法以及其他魔法学识。这一本除了一系列广泛的信息直接印制于页面上之外，还备有空白页供你书写记录。

messages.msgid: A hardcover book, written by Gerald Gardner and published in 1954.  It was once considered one of the foundational texts of modern Wicca and played a significant role in popularizing contemporary witchcraft.
translations: 杰拉尔德·加德纳 (Gerald Gardner) 撰写并于 1954 年出版的精装书。 它曾经被认为是现代巫术的基础文本之一，并在普及当代巫术方面发挥了重要作用。

messages.msgid: A hardcover copy of the Spiral Dance, written by Starhawk, a prominent author, and activist in the fields of feminism, spirituality, and environmentalism.  First published in 1979, this book explores the beliefs, practices, and history of the Goddess movement, which is a spiritual and feminist response to patriarchal religions.  The Goddess movement seeks to reclaim and revive the worship of the divine feminine in various forms.
translations: 一本《螺旋之舞》精装本。这本书的作者斯塔霍克是一位杰出的作家，也是一位女权主义、灵性和环保主义领域的活动家。该书于1979年首次出版，探讨了女神运动的信仰、实践和历史，作为对父权宗教的女权主义的灵性回应。女神运动寻求以各种形式复兴对神圣女性的崇拜。

messages.msgid: This book is the canonical text of Scientology.  Written by a science fiction author, it contains self-improvement techniques and musings on psychology called Dianetics.
translations: 这是一本山达基教（又称科学教、科学神教）的教典，其中介绍了一种被称作"戴尼提"的、自我提升和心灵冥想的技巧。不巧的是，它是由一位科幻作家创作的。

messages.plural: copies of The Book of the SubGenius

messages.msgid: A book about the Church of the SubGenius.  It seems to involve a salesman named J. R. "Bob" Dobbs and a concept called 'slack'.
translations: 亚圣教会的宗教典籍，这个教会的教义是自由散漫，有点奇怪是吧？如果你知道创立这个宗教的教主是个失败的销售员，你就会明白了。

messages.plural: copies of The Book of Mozilla

messages.msgid: A mysterious deep-red book with the title 'The Book of Mozilla' at the front.  The contents of this book are written in some sort of easy-to-understand computer language and are a collection of prophetic and apocryphal verses of unknown origin.
translations: 一本绯红色的神秘书籍，封面写着“Mozilla之书”。这本书用某种易于理解的计算机语言编写，涉及预言和对圣经的拙劣模仿，而这些内容的源头则不为人知。

messages.msgid: The Blue Book of the Blue Frog
messages.plural: copies of the Blue Book of the Blue Frog

messages.msgid: A curious handwritten blue book of unknown origin.  The contents of this book are complex, regarding stories of the 'Blue Frog', a strange cult called 'The Blue Frog Cult', its prophecies, the rules that the cult's followers must adhere to and also the practices, religious and political hierarchy of this cult.  Not much for a scavenger.
translations: 一本来历不明的手写蓝色小书，引人好奇。书中内容错综复杂，讲述了一个名为“蓝蛙”的奇异传说，以及与其相关的“蓝蛙教”——一个诡异的信仰团体，包括其预言、信徒必须遵循的戒律，以及该教派的宗教与政治等级制度等。对拾荒者来说，这似乎不太实用。

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Mahayana Sutras, a collection of scriptures that form the foundation of Mahayana Buddhism.  Those cover a wide range of topics and teachings, including, but not limited to, discourses on meditation, ethics, philosophy, cosmology, and the nature of reality.
translations: 《大乘佛经》的精装英文译本，是构成大乘佛教基础的经文集。 这些涵盖了广泛的主题和教义，包括但不限于关于冥想、伦理学、哲学、宇宙学和现实本质的论述。

messages.plural: copies of the Tibetan Buddhist Canon

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Tibetan Buddhist Canon, also known as the Kangyur and Tengyur, or Vajrayana Canon.  It contains a vast collection of sacred texts that form the basis of the Buddhist teachings in Tibetan Buddhism.  It consists of two main parts: the Kangyur, which contains the translated words of the Buddha, and the Tengyur, which comprises commentaries by Indian and Tibetan scholars.
translations: 一本英文精装版《藏传佛教大藏经》，亦称为《甘珠尔》与《丹珠尔》，或《金刚乘藏经》。这部藏经汇集了构成藏传佛教教义基础的大量神圣文献。它分为两大主要部分：《甘珠尔》收录佛陀的译文，而《丹珠尔》则包含印度与西藏学者的注释作品。

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of The Bhagavad Gita, a 700-verse Hindu scripture.  It is written in the form of a dialogue between Prince Arjuna and the god Krishna, who serves as his charioteer.  The conversation takes place on the battlefield of Kurukshetra just before the start of a great war between two factions of a royal family.
translations: 一本英文精装版《薄伽梵歌》。这是一部深具灵性的印度教圣典，包含700个诗节。本书以对话形式展开，讲述了在库鲁克谢特拉战场上，王子阿周那在战前紧张时刻与其战车御者神克里希纳之间的深刻对话。这场对话发生在一场因王室内部纷争而引发的即将爆发的宏伟战役之前。

messages.msgid: A large and complete hardcover English translation of The Mahabharata, the most revered and significant ancient texts in Indian literature and Hindu mythology.  It is an epic narrative that has been passed down through generations and has been a source of inspiration and guidance for millions of people before and possibly during and after the Cataclysm.  The epic is divided into 18 books or parvas, each focusing on different aspects of the story, such as the genealogy of the Pandavas, the education of the Pandavas, and the great war of Kurukshetra.
translations: 《摩诃婆罗多》的大型完整精装英文译本，是印度文学和印度教神话中最受尊敬和最重要的古代文本。这是一个史诗般的叙事，代代相传，在大灾难之前、期间和之后，它一直是数百万人的灵感和指导来源。这部史诗分为18本书，每本书都聚焦于故事的不同方面，如潘达瓦人的家谱、潘达瓦的教育和库鲁克谢特拉的伟大战争。

messages.msgid: A complete hardcover English translation of The Ramayana, an ancient Indian epic that holds great religious and cultural significance in Hinduism.  It is considered one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient Indian literature and tells the story of Prince Rama, an incarnation of Lord Vishnu, who embarks on a journey to rescue his wife Sita from the demon king Ravana.  The epic is divided into seven books, known as Kandas, and presents a narrative that encompasses themes of devotion, righteousness, duty, honor, love, and the triumph of good over evil.
translations: 《罗摩衍那》是印度古代的一部史诗，在印度教中具有重要的宗教和文化意义。它被认为是古代印度文学的两大梵文史诗之一，讲述了毗湿奴神的化身、王子罗摩在拯救被恶魔罗波那掳走的妻子悉多的旅途中的故事。这部史诗分为七卷，称为“卡拉达”，讲述了关于忠诚、正义、责任、荣誉、爱情以及善战胜恶的故事。

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of The Puranas, a collection of ancient Indian texts that form an integral part of Hindu literature.  They are considered to be among the oldest and most authoritative scriptures in Hinduism, alongside the Vedas.  It consist of a vast collection of narratives, legends, genealogies, cosmology, theology, philosophy, and rituals related to Hinduism, and are classified into two main categories: Mahapuranas (major Puranas) and Upapuranas (minor Puranas).
translations: 一本精装版的《往世书》的英文译本，这是古代印度文本的合集，是印度教文学的重要组成部分。它们与《吠陀》一起被认为是印度教中最古老和最权威的经典之一。该书包含了大量的叙事、传说、家谱、宇宙学、神学、哲学和与印度教相关的仪式，被分为两大类：大往世书(Mahapuranas)和小往世书(Upapuranas)。

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of The Agamas, a collection of scriptures in Hinduism that provide detailed guidelines for rituals, temple construction, worship practices, and philosophical teachings, and are considered authoritative texts by several Hindu sects, particularly those that follow the Shaiva and Shakta traditions.
translations: 一本平装版的《阿迦摩经》的英文译本，这部印度教的经典文集提供了对宗教仪式、寺庙建筑、礼拜活动和哲学教义的详细指导，并被多个印度教教派，特别是湿婆派和夏克提派，视为权威文本。

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of the Jain Agamas, the most authoritative and sacred scriptures in Jainism.  The Jain Agamas consist of two main categories: the Angas and the Upangas.  The Angas are considered the primary scriptures, while the Upangas are supplementary texts that provide further explanations and commentaries on various aspects of Jain philosophy and practice.
translations: 这本英文平装版的《耆那教圣典》是耆那教中最权威和神圣的经典文献。《耆那教圣典》主要分为两个类别：主经(Angas)和附经(Upangas)。主经被认为是主要的经典，而附经是补充文本，提供了关于耆那教哲学和实践各个方面的进一步解释和评论。

messages.plural: copies of The Sutras of the Buddha

messages.msgid: A collection of discourses attributed to the Buddha and his close disciples.
translations: 一本佛陀诸弟子与佛陀间的对话合集。

messages.msgid: A rare hardcover English translation of the Zara Avesta, a collection of sacred hymns, prayers, and liturgies, which are believed to have been revealed by Zoroaster himself.  It is considered an essential guide to living a righteous life in Zoroastrianism, as it provides moral teachings, ethical principles, and spiritual insights.
translations: 一本珍稀的《阿维斯陀经》英译精装本，这是一部神圣的赞美诗、祈祷词和礼仪的合集，被认为是由查拉图斯特拉本人亲自揭示的。因其提供了道德教义、伦理原则和精神洞察，因此被它被视为拜火教的教义生活的基本指南。

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of the Theogony, a Greek epic poem attributed to the ancient poet Hesiod.  It is one of the oldest surviving works of Greek literature and provides a comprehensive account of the origins and genealogies of the Greek gods, as well as the creation of the universe and the establishment of divine order.
translations: 一本《神谱》的平装英译本。这是一部古希腊诗人赫西俄德所著的史诗，是现存最古老的希腊文学作品之一。 这部作品详细讲述了希腊众神的起源、谱系，以及宇宙的诞生和神界的秩序建立。

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of The Orphic Hymns, a collection of ancient Greek hymns attributed to the legendary poet Orpheus.  These hymns are a significant source of information about Greek religion, philosophy, and literature.  It is divided in a set of 88 hymns, divided into 10 sections, and the hymns are dedicated to various gods and goddesses in the Greek pantheon, as well as to heroes and abstract concepts.
translations: 一本《俄耳甫斯祷歌》的平装英译本。这是一部古希腊时期归功于传奇诗人奥菲斯的古老赞歌集，是了解希腊宗教、哲学和文学的重要资料。全书分为十个章节，共88首颂歌，献给希腊神话中的众神、女神、英雄以及抽象的概念。

messages.plural: copies of The Orphic Gold Tablets

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of the many texts, hymns and inscriptions found in the Orphic Gold Tablets, a series of ancient Greek texts found on gold leaves, dating back to the 4th century BCE.  This book contain Orphic teachings and rituals, which are believed to have been used by initiates in Orphic mystery cults, offering guidance on purification, initiation, and the afterlife, as well as instructions for living a virtuous life in accordance with the Greek gods' will.
translations: 一本翻译了《奥尔菲克金板》中的众多文本、赞美诗和铭文的平装英译本。《奥尔菲克金板》是刻写在金叶上一系列古希腊文献，其历史可以追溯到公元前4世纪。该书包含了奥尔菲斯教的教义和仪式，据说这些教义和仪式曾被奥尔菲斯这一神秘教派的入教者使用，这本书提供了关于净化、入教和来世的指导，以及如何根据希腊神祇的旨意，去过高尚生活的指示。

messages.plural: copies of the Res Gestae Divi Augusti

messages.msgid: A rare, paperback English translation of the Res Gestae Divi Augusti, or 'Deeds of the Divine Augustus', a inscription commissioned by the Roman Emperor Augustus himself.  It is a list of his accomplishments and claims to divine status, emphasizing his role in the Roman Imperial Cult.  This inscription provides insight into the religious beliefs and practices surrounding the emperor during these stages of the Roman Imperial Cult.
translations: 一本稀有的英文平装版译本，内容是《神圣奥古斯都的事迹》（Res Gestae Divi Augusti），由罗马皇帝奥古斯都亲自委托制作的铭文，铭文列举了他的功绩和对神权的宣称，突出了他在罗马帝国崇拜中的作用。这份铭文为了解罗马帝国崇拜早期阶段围绕皇帝的宗教信仰和实践提供了深入视角。

messages.msgid: A large, rare hardcover English translation of the Historia Augusta, a collection of biographies of Roman emperors.  It also contains information about the Imperial Roman Cult, including its rituals, symbols, and the role of such emperors in the cult.
translations: 这是一本大型且稀有的精装《罗马帝国史》英文译本，收录了罗马皇帝的传记。书中还介绍了罗马帝国崇拜，包括其仪式、象征以及皇帝在其中的地位。

messages.msgid: A rare, paperback English translation of The Corpus Hermeticum, a collection of ancient philosophical and religious texts that are attributed to Hermes Trismegistus, a legendary figure in ancient Egyptian and Greek mythology.  The contents of this book consists of a series of dialogues or discourses that explore various philosophical and theological concepts.  These texts cover a wide range of topics, including cosmology, theology, metaphysics, ethics, and spirituality at the time.  The overarching theme throughout the Corpus Hermeticum is the pursuit of spiritual knowledge and the attainment of divine wisdom.
translations: 一本罕见的《赫耳墨斯文集》（Corpus Hermeticum）英文译本平装书，该书收录了古代哲学和宗教文本，这些文本被认为是出自古埃及和希腊神话中的传奇人物——赫耳墨斯·特里斯墨吉斯忒斯之手。本书的内容包括一系列探索哲学和神学概念的对话或论述，覆盖了当时的宇宙学、神学、形而上学、伦理学和灵性等诸多领域。《赫耳墨斯文集》贯穿始终的主题是追求灵性知识，并最终获得神圣的智慧。

messages.msgid: A commercial-grade, paperback English edition of The Mithraic Inscriptions, a book that explains the ancient Mithraic religion and its various inscriptions, artifacts, characteristics and rituals.  The book, written by a team of scholars and experts in the field, aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the Mithraism and its significance in the ancient world.
translations: 一本《密特拉教铭文》（The Mithraic Inscriptions）的商业平装英文版。书中详细阐述了古代密特拉教的宗教信仰，并对相关的铭文、文物、特点和仪式进行了分析。该书由该领域的学者和专家团队共同编写，旨在为读者提供关于密特拉教和其在古代世界重要性的全面认知。

messages.msgid: Tengriism: The Religion of Ancient Mongolia
translations: 腾格里教:古代蒙古的信仰
messages.plural: copies of Tengriism: The Religion of Ancient Mongolia

messages.msgid: A paperback English edition of the Tengriism: The Religion of Ancient Mongolia.  This book contains epics, oral traditions and everything else related to Tengriism, including information about the Khans of Mongolia, shamanic rituals and folklore.
translations: 一本《腾格里信仰：古代蒙古的宗教》（Tengriism: The Religion of Ancient Mongolia）的英文平装书。书中收录了与腾格里信仰相关的史诗、口头传统等所有内容，包括蒙古可汗、萨满仪式和民间传说等信息。

messages.plural: copies of the Classic of Mountains and Seas

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Classic of Mountains and Seas (Shan Hai Jing).  This book primarily focuses on the description of various mythical creatures, gods, goddesses, rituals and geographical features of ancient China.
translations: 一本《山海经》(Shan Hai Jing)的精装英文译本，主要记述了古代中国的各种神话生物、神祇、女神、祭祀仪式，以及地理特征。

messages.msgid: An extremely large, huge English translation of the Tripitaka Koreana, a Korean collection of the Tripitaka that can be considered as the Korean Canon.
translations: 一部非常详细的，巨大的《八万大藏经》的英文译本，一部可以被视作朝韩文化经典的典藏版书籍。

messages.msgid: A grass-cover English edition of the Moʻolelo, a collection of traditional Hawaiian stories, texts and oral traditions, that have been compiled, translated, and documented in written form.  This book also includes information on the deities and entities of the traditional religion of Hawaii, alongside rituals and practices.
translations: 一本草编封面的英文版《Moʻolelo》，其中汇集了传统的夏威夷故事、文献和口头流传的传说，这些内容已被整理、翻译并以文字形式保存。同时介绍了夏威夷传统宗教的神灵和实体，以及相关的仪式和实践活动。
Te Ao Māori：毛利文化世界
messages.plural: copies of the Te Ao Māori

messages.msgid: A collection of written oral traditions of the religion of the Maori people, including the Whakapapa (genealogy and the relationships between the living, the dead, and the natural world), the Tikanga (customs, traditions, and protocols that govern the daily lives of the Maori people), Waiata (songs that play a significant role in the Traditional Maori Religion), Pepeha (a personal statement that outlines one's whakapapa, or genealogy, and connection to the land) and Taonga Tūtahi (sacred treasures and objects that hold spiritual significance for the Maori people), as well as inscriptions regarding the deities, entities and religious traditions of the Maori Religion.
translations: 一本毛利人宗教传统口述记录汇编。书中包含「瓦卡帕帕」，即族谱，和生者、死者与自然世界的关系；「提康加」，即主导毛利人日常生活的习俗、传统和规则；「怀阿塔」，即传统毛利宗教中的重要歌曲；「佩佩哈」，即概括某人「瓦卡帕帕」和其与土地联系的语句；以及「陶加-图塔希」，即对毛利人具有珍贵精神意义的圣物，和关于毛利宗教的神迹、实体和宗教传统的铭文。

messages.msgid: The Native Religion of New England
messages.plural: copies of The Native Religion of New England

messages.msgid: A collection of written oral traditions and written records regarding the religious tradition of the many native groups and tribes of New England (such as the Wampanoag, Narragansett, Mohegan, and Penobscot).  This book also contain information regarding the deities, entities and religious characteristics and hierarchy of these groups, as well as historical, geographical, social, political and cultural information.
translations: 一本关于新英格兰许多土著群体和部落如万帕诺阿格人、纳拉干塞特人、莫希根人和佩诺布斯克人的口头和书面宗教传统的汇编。 这本书还载有关于这些群体的神、实体和宗教特征及等级的信息，以及历史、地理、社会、政治和文化信息。

messages.plural: copies of The Compilation of Divine Messages

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Thanh Ngon Hiep Tuyen (Compilation of Divine Messages), a compilation of divine messages received by Cao Dai mediums during séances in Cao Dai temples.  These messages are believed to be communication from various divine beings, including saints, sages, and deities.  The mediums serve as channels through which these messages are transmitted to the followers.
translations: 这是一本《圣言合选》（Thanh Ngon Hiep Tuyen）的英文精装版译本，收录了高台教乩童在高台寺庙扶乩时接收到的神圣信息。这些信息被认为是来自各种神祇的沟通，包括圣徒、圣贤和神灵。乩童是这些信息传递给信徒的渠道。

messages.msgid: A hardcover, English translation of The Pyramid Texts.  These texts were intended to guide the deceased pharaohs through the Egyptian afterlife, providing them with magical spells, hymns, and instructions for their journey.  The Pyramid Texts contain a wealth of information about ancient Egyptian beliefs in the afterlife, the gods, and the role of the pharaoh as a mediator between the mortal world and the divine.
translations: 《金字塔文本》的英文精装版译本。这些文字旨在引导逝去的法老穿越埃及来世，为他们的旅程提供魔法咒语、赞美诗和指导。金字塔文本包含了关于古埃及人对来世、神祇的信仰以及法老作为凡间与神界中介的作用的丰富信息。

messages.msgid: A hardcover, English translation of The Coffin Texts, a collection of magical spells and texts originally inscribed on the inner surfaces of wooden coffins.  These texts were intended to protect the deceased and ensure their safe passage through the Egyptian afterlife.
