The Coffin Texts provide a insight into the religious beliefs of ancient Egyptians and its contemporary revival, Kemeticism.
translations: 《棺椁文本》的英文精装版译本，收录了最初刻在木制棺椁内壁上的魔法咒语和文本。这些文本旨在保护死者并确保他们安全地穿越埃及来世。《棺椁文本》为了解古埃及人的宗教信仰及其当代复兴运动——凯米特教——提供了深入的见解。

messages.plural: copies of The Book of the Dead

messages.msgid: A hardcover, English translation of the Book of the Dead, a collection of funerary texts dating from the New Kingdom to the Greco-Roman period and contains spells and instructions to help the deceased navigate the Egyptian afterlife.
translations: 《死者之书》的英文精装版译本，收录了从新王国到古希腊-罗马时期的葬礼文本，并包含了引导死者前往埃及来世的咒语和指示。

messages.plural: copies of Orishas and Their Deities

messages.msgid: A paperwork English edition of the Orishas and Their Deities (Orixás e Suas Divindades), written by José Honorato do Rego.  This book provides an extensive overview of the orishas and their associated deities.  It delves into the history, characteristics, and roles of these divine beings within the Umbanda religion, a syncretic Afro-Brazilian religion that combines elements of African, Native Brazilian, and European traditions.
translations: 一本何塞·奥诺拉托·多·雷戈所著的《奥西里斯及其神祇》（Orixás e Suas Divindades）的英文平装译本，书中全面阐述了奥西里斯及其相关的神祇。这本书深入分析了这些神祇在翁班达教（一种融合了非洲、巴西原住民和欧洲传统的非洲裔巴西宗教）的历史、特征和作用。

messages.plural: copies of The Tao Te Ching

messages.msgid: A stylized, hardcover English translation of the Tao Te Ching, also known as the Dao De Jing.  It is a Chinese philosophical and spiritual text believed to have been written by Laozi, a legendary figure in ancient Chinese history, and is considered one of the most important works in Taoism, an ancient Chinese philosophy and religion that emphasizes living in harmony with the Tao.
translations: 一本风格化的精装本英译版道德经。道德经是一部中国哲学作品，传说是由上古时期的老子所作，并且被认为是道家的重要代表作，道家思想强调与道和谐共生。

messages.msgid: The Four Books and Five Classics
messages.plural: copies of The Four Books and Five Classics

messages.msgid: A large hardcover book containing the two collections of ancient Chinese texts that have played a significant role in shaping Chinese culture, education, and philosophy.  These texts are considered foundational works in Confucianism and have been studied by scholars and students for centuries.
translations: 一本精装大册，收录了两种对中国文化、教育和哲学产生深远影响的古代典籍丛书，即四书和五经。这些经典被视为儒家思想的奠基之作，数百年来以来都作为学者和学生的研习对象。

messages.msgid: An English collection of teachings from Raimundo Irineu Serra, the founder of Santo Daime, a syncretic religious movement that combines elements of Christianity, African traditions, and Native Brazilian beliefs.  It is considered a sacred scripture by the movement's followers.
translations: 一本收录了圣达墨(Santo Daime)创始人雷蒙多·伊里内乌·塞拉（Raimundo Irineu Serra）教诲的英文作品集。圣达墨是一个融合了基督教、非洲传统和巴西土著信仰的混合宗教运动，该作品集被该运动的追随者视为神圣经典。

messages.plural: copies of The Ogam and Ipade

messages.msgid: A good-sized book containing the Ogam (Ogã, a collection of sacred hymns that praise the Orishas, sung during rituals and ceremonies, an essential part of the worship and devotion to the deities), and the Ipade (Ipadê, a collection of sacred stories, myths, and legends that explain the origins of the Orishas, the creation of the world, and the history of the religion), directly linked to Afro-Brazilian religions such as Umbanda and Candomble.
translations: 一本大册，收录了欧甘（Ogã，一份在仪式和祭典中吟唱的圣歌合集，旨在赞美奥里沙神，是礼拜和敬神不可或缺的一部分），和伊帕德（Ipadê，一份圣故事、神话和传说的合集，解释了奥里沙神的起源，世界的诞生和宗教的历史），这些合集与巴西非裔宗教如翁班达(Umbanda)和坎东布勒(Candomble)相关。

messages.msgid: This is a lightweight collection of prayers and blessings that are recited by Jews during various parts of their daily lives, religious ceremonies, and festivals.
translations: 一本轻便的合集，记载了犹太人的祈祷和祝福合集，他们在日常生活、宗教仪式和节日的各个环节都会诵读。

messages.msgid: One of the central texts of Rabbinic Judaism, the Talmud expounds upon the Hebrew Bible with teachings and opinions of thousands of rabbis.
translations: 一本拉比犹太教的教义文本，《塔木德》是犹太人的两部法典之一。它是犹太口传律法的集大成，由攸本文米修纳(MISHAN)和注解的戈马拉(GEMARA)两部所构成。类似《圣经》。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 1, Tractate Berakhot (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 1 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Berakhot.  It is concerned with rules relating to the Shema and the Amidah.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第一卷，对应Berakhot第二节的内容。主要讲跟Shema与Amidah相关的规则。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 2, Tractate Berakhot (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 2 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Berakhot.  It discusses rules relating to prayers, primarily those before or after eating but it also touches on prayers that occur on special occasions such as hearing thunder or being unexpectedly delivered from danger.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二卷，对应Berakhot第二节的内容。它讨论有关祷告，主要是在就餐前的祷告，但也讨论其他特殊场景的祷告，比如聆听闪电或意外身处危险时的祷告。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 3, Tractate Pe'ah

messages.msgid: This is volume 3 of 51, containing Tractate Pe'ah.  It discusses agriculture, of harvesting, and providing food for the poor.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第三卷，对应Pe'ah的内容。主要讲述了农业，收获，以及向贫困的人施与食物。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 4, Tractate Demai

messages.msgid: This is volume 4 of 51, containing Tractate Demai.  It discusses rules for dubiously-tithed produce.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第四卷，对应Demai的内容。讨论了产品交税的疑点。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 5, Tractate Kilayim

messages.msgid: This is volume 5 of 51, containing Tractate Kilayim.  It discusses prohibitions on the mixing of different kinds, such as wearing wool and linen clothing or planting anything other than grapes in a vineyard.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第五卷，对应Kilayim的内容。讨论了其他种类的禁忌，如穿着羊毛和亚麻衣服或在葡萄园中种其他作物。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 6, Tractate Shevi'it (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 6a of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Shevi'it.  It discusses the Shemitah year, the seventh year where fields must lie fallow.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第六卷，对应Shevi'it第一部分的内容。它讨论了希米塔年，即必须田地进行休耕的第七年。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 7, Tractate Shevi'it (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 7 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Shevi'it.  It continues the discussion of the Shemitah year, the seventh year where fields must lie fallow.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第七卷，对应Shevi'it第二部分的内容。它继续上卷讨论希米塔年，即必须田地进行休耕的第七年。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 8, Tractate Terumot (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 8 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Terumot.  It discusses terumot, portions of agriculture produce that are given directly to the Kohanim priestly class.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第八卷，对应Terumot第一部分的内容。它讨论特鲁莫特，即部分农产品直接提供给科哈尼姆祭司阶层。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 9, Tractate Terumot (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 9 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Terumot.  It continues the discussion of terumot, portions of agriculture produce that are given directly to the Kohanim priestly class.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第九卷，对应Terumot第二部分的内容。它继续上卷讨论特鲁莫特，即部分农产品直接提供给科哈尼姆祭司阶层。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 10, Tractate Maasrot

messages.msgid: This is volume 10 of 51, containing Tractate Maasrot.  It discusses the separation of the harvest into tithes, and the portions given to the Tribe of Levi, the poor, or the people of Jerusalem.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第十卷，对应Maasrot的内容。它主要讨论将收获分成十份，以及将部分分给Levi部落、穷人或耶路撒冷人。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 11, Tractate Maaser Sheni

messages.msgid: This is volume 11 of 51, containing Tractate Maaser Sheni.  It discusses the practice of consuming a portion of the yearly harvest in Jerusalem, or exchanging it for money used to buy food in Jerusalem to hold a feast.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第十一卷，对应Maaser Sheni的内容。它主要讨论在耶路撒冷吃掉一部分年收成的习俗，或者用这些收成换成钱在耶路撒冷购买食物以举行宴会。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 12, Tractate Challah

messages.msgid: This is volume 12 of 51, containing Tractate Challah.  It discusses the practice of baking bread with the first portion of harvested grain and tithing it as an offering.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第十二卷，对应Challah的内容。它主要讨论用收获的谷物的第一部分烘烤面包并将其作为供品的做法。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 13, Tractates Orlah & Bikkurim

messages.msgid: This is volume 13 of 51, containing Tractates Orlah and Bikkurim.  Both tractates discuss the practice of letting a fruit tree grow for three years before harvesting it.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第三卷，对应Orlah & Bikkurim的内容。这两部分都在讨论让一棵果树在收获前生长三年的做法。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 14, Tractate Shabbat (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 14 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Shabbat.  It discusses the thirty-nine types of prohibited labor.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第十四卷，对应Shabbat第一部分的内容。它主要讨论三十九种禁止的行为。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 15, Tractate Shabbat (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 15 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Shabbat.  It discusses the prohibitions of carrying items or transporting animals on Shabbat.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第十五卷，对应Shabbat第二部分的内容。它主要讨论在安息日禁止携带物品或运送动物。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 16, Tractate Shabbat (Part 3)

messages.msgid: This is volume 16 of 51, containing the third part of Tractate Shabbat.  It discusses the positive commandments of Shabbat, such as lighting candles and eating a festive meal, and continues the discussion of prohibited types of labor.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第十六卷，对应Shabbat第一部分的内容。它主要讨论安息日的允许行为，如点燃蜡烛和吃节日大餐，并继续讨论禁止类型的劳动。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 17, Tractate Eruvin (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 17 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Eruvin.  It discusses the ways to expand the allowable areas in which one may carrying items or transport items on Shabbat.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第十七卷，对应Eruvin第一部分的内容。它主要讨论扩大允许在安息日携带物品或运输物品的区域的方法。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 18, Tractate Eruvin (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 18 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Eruvin.  It continues discussing the ways to expand the allowable areas in which one may carrying items or transport items on Shabbat.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第十八卷，对应Eruvin第二部分的内容。它继续讨论扩大安息日可携带物品或运输物品的容许范围的方法。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 19, Tractate Pesachim (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 19 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Pesachim.  It discusses laws relating to Passover, such as the proper disposal of leaven and the preparation of unleavened bread.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第十九卷，对应Pesachim第一部分的内容。它主要讨论有关逾越节的规定，例如妥善取出酵母准备无酵面包。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 20, Tractate Pesachim (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 20 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Pesachim.  It continues the discussion of laws relating to Passover, such as whether servants are allowed to slaughter the Passover sacrifice or what to do if the Seder occurs on a Friday night.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二十卷，对应Pesachim第二部分的内容。它继续讨论与逾越节有关的法律，例如是否允许仆人宰杀逾越节祭品，或者如果逾越节家宴在星期五晚上举行，该怎么办。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 21, Tractate Shekalim

messages.msgid: This is volume 21 of 51, containing Tractate Shekalim.  It discusses the taxes paid to maintain the Temple and the priesthood.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二十一卷，对应Shekalim的内容。它讨论维持圣殿和祭司职位所缴纳的税款。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 22, Tractate Yoma

messages.msgid: This is volume 22 of 51, containing Tractate Yoma.  It discusses the rituals and laws related to Yom Kippur, primarily concerned with the Temple service.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二十二卷，对应Yoma的内容。它讨论与赎罪日有关的仪式和法律，主要与寺庙服务有关。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 23, Tractate Sukkah

messages.msgid: This is volume 23 of 51, containing Tractate Sukkah.  It discusses the rituals and laws related to Sukkot, such as dwelling in the Sukkah and the four species of plants.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二十三卷，对应Sukkah的内容。它讨论与Sukkot有关的礼法和规定，例如在Sukkot中的住房和四种植物。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 24, Tractate Beitzah

messages.msgid: This is volume 24 of 51, containing Tractate Beitzah.  It discusses laws common to all Torah-derived holidays, such as prohibitions on work and the proper preparation of food.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二十四卷，对应Beitzah的内容。它主要讨论所有摩西五经衍生节日所共有的规定，例如工作的禁忌和准备食物的规定。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 25, Tractate Rosh Hashanah

messages.msgid: This is volume 25 of 51, containing Tractate Rosh Hashanah.  It discusses rituals and laws related to Rosh Hashanah, such as blowing the shofar, as well as the proper way to celebrate the festival of a new month.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二十五卷，对应Rosh Hashanah的内容。它讨论了与犹太新年有关的仪式和法律，比如吹羊角号，以及庆祝新月的正确方式。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 26, Tractate Taanit

messages.msgid: This is volume 26 of 51, containing Tractate Taanit.  It discusses laws related to fasting, as well as proper method of praying for rain to avoid famine.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二十六卷，对应Taanit的内容。它讨论了有关斋戒的规定，以及祈求降雨避免饥荒的正确方法。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 27, Tractate Megillah

messages.msgid: This is volume 27 of 51, containing Tractate Megillah.  It discusses laws of reading the Book of Esther on Purim, as well as commentary on the story of Esther itself.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二十七卷，对应Megillah的内容。它讨论了在普珥节阅读以斯帖书的规定，以及对以斯帖书本身内容的评述。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 28, Tractate Chagigah

messages.msgid: This is volume 28 of 51, containing Tractate Chagigah.  It discusses the practice of offering ritual sacrifices at the Temple on festival days, with frequent interruptions to discuss the Book of Genesis.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二十八卷，对应Chagigah的内容。它讨论了在节日的日子里在寺庙里举行祭祀仪式的做法，经常被打断来讨论《创世记》。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 29, Tractate Moed Katan

messages.msgid: This is volume 29 of 51, containing Tractate Moed Katan.  It discusses Chol HaMoed, the minor holidays in between the first and last days of Sukkot and Passover.  It also has the famous story of the Oven of Akhnai, from which the principle is derived that "The Torah is not in heaven".
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第二十九卷，对应Moed Katan的内容。它讨论了住棚节和逾越节第一天和最后一天之间的小节日Chol HaMoed。它记录了著名的阿赫奈烤炉的故事，从中得出了“托拉不在天堂”的原则。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 30, Tractate Yevamot (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 30 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Yevamot.  It deals with the laws of Yibbum, often translated as "Levirate marriage," the requirement of a man to marry his brother's widow.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第六卷，对应Yevamot第一部分的内容。它涉及到 Yibbum 的法律，通常被翻译成“夫兄弟婚”，一个男人必须和他兄弟的遗孀结婚。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 31, Tractate Yevamot (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 31 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Yevamot.  It continues the discussion of the laws of Yibbum, often translated as "Levirate marriage," and the circumstances in which it does or does not apply.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第三十一卷，对应Yevamot第二部分的内容。它继续讨论Yibbum的法律，通常被翻译为“夫兄弟婚”，以及在什么情况下它适用或不适用。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 32, Tractate Ketubot (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 32 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Ketubot.  It discusses the marriage contract (Ketubah), and the marital obligations between husband and wife.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第三十二卷，对应Ketubot第一部分的内容。它讨论了婚姻契约(Ketubah) ，以及夫妻之间的婚姻义务。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 33, Tractate Ketubot (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 33 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Ketubot.  It continues the discussion of the marriage contract, as well as divorce and giving formal testimony.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第三十三卷，对应Ketubot第二部分的内容。它继续讨论婚姻约定，以及离婚和正式证词。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 34, Tractate Nedarim

messages.msgid: This is volume 34 of 51, containing Tractate Nedarim.  It deals with the making and breaking of vows and the conditions under which vows are automatically void.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第三十四卷，对应Nedarim的内容。它涉及誓言的制定和违背，以及誓言自动失效的条件。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 35, Tractate Nazir (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 35 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Nazir.  It deals with Nazirites, who make vows to abstain from wine, cutting their hair, and avoiding contact with the dead.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第六卷，对应Nazir第一部分的内容。它主要关于拿撒勒人，他们发誓不喝酒，剪头发，避免与死者接触。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 36, Tractate Nazir (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 36 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Nazir.  It continues the discussion of Nazirite vows, as well as the transmission of ritual impurity between objects.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第三十六卷，对应Nazir第二部分的内容。它继续讨论拿撒勒人的誓言，以及在物体之间传递不洁的仪式。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 37, Tractate Sotah (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 37 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Sotah.  It contains a discussion of the sotah, or "bitter water", ritual for a woman suspected of adultery by her husband.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第三十七卷，对应Sotah第一部分的内容。它包含关于sotah，或是“苦水”的讨论，一个被丈夫怀疑通奸的女人的仪式。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 38, Tractate Sotah (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 38 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Sotah.  It continues a discussion of the sotah, as well as a long discussion over the entrance of the Israelites into the land of Israel.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第三十八卷，对应Sotah第二部分的内容。它继续了关于sotah的讨论，并展开了关于以色列人进入以色列地的长长讨论。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 39, Tractate Gittin (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 39 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Gittin.  It discusses the Get, the formal document of divorce, and the specifications for its preparation and writing.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第三十九卷，对应Gittin第一部分的内容。它讨论了Get这个正式离婚的文件，以及其准备和写作的规范。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 40, Tractate Gittin (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 40 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Gittin.  It continues the discussion of the Get, as well the process of  "Tikkun Olam", or repairing the world.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第六卷，对应Gittin第二部分的内容。它继续讨论Get，以及“ Tikkun Olam”，或称作修复世界的过程。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 41, Tractate Kiddushin

messages.msgid: This is volume 41 of 51, containing Tractate Kiddushin.  It discusses the laws of betrothal and the rules governing interactions between unmarried men and women.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第四十一卷，对应Kiddushin的内容。它讨论了订婚法和未婚男女之间互动的规则。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 42, Tractate Bava Kamma

messages.msgid: This is volume 42 of 51, containing Tractate Bava Kamma.  It discusses torts and the proper ways to deal with damages inflicted on people and property.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第四十二卷，对应Bava Kamma的内容。它讨论了侵权行为以及对人身和财产造成损害的正确处理方法。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 43, Tractate Bava Metzia

messages.msgid: This is volume 43 of 51, containing Tractate Bava Metzia.  It discusses interpersonal disputes such as lost property, renting, and obligations of workers and employers, with a digression into how great sages who spend their lives studying Torah are.  It also reiterates the story of the Oven of Akhnai.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第四十三卷，对应Bava Meztia的内容。它讨论了人与人之间的纠纷，比如财产损失、租赁、工人和雇主的义务等等，并且离题了研究摩西五经的圣人们是多么伟大。它还重申了阿克奈烤炉的故事。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 44, Tractate Bava Basra

messages.msgid: This is volume 44 of 51, containing Tractate Bava Basra.  It discusses business relationships and the laws of inheritance.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第四十四卷，对应Bava Basra的内容。它讨论了商业关系和继承法。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 45, Tractate Sanhedrin (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 45 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Sanhedrin.  It discusses the selection of judges and the formation of courts.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第四十五卷，对应Sanhedrin第一部分的内容。它讨论了法官的选任和法院的形成。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 46, Tractate Sanhedrin (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 46 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Sanhedrin.  It continues the discussion of judges, the punishments administered by the courts, and ends with a discussion of who will have a place in Olam Haba, the afterlife.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第四十六卷，对应Sanhedrin第一部分的内容。它继续讨论判决，法院实施的惩罚，并以对谁将在 Olam Haba，即来世拥有一席之地的讨论结尾。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 47, Tractate Shevuot

messages.msgid: This is volume 47 of 51, containing Tractate Shevuot.  It discusses formal oaths, such as those taken by witnesses in court.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第四十七卷，对应Shevuot的内容。它讨论了正式的誓言，例如证人在法庭上的誓言。
塔木德（卷四十八）Avodah Zara（上）
messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 48, Tractate Avodah Zara (Part 1)

messages.msgid: This is volume 48 of 51, containing the first part of Tractate Avodah Zara.  It discusses forbidden idolatry and the laws regulating contact and commerce with idolators.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第四十八卷，对应Avodah Zara第一部分的内容。它讨论了偶像崇拜禁忌以及与偶像崇拜者接触和交易的律令规定。
塔木德（卷四十九）Avodah Zara（下）
messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 49, Tractate Avodah Zara (Part 2)

messages.msgid: This is volume 49 of 51, containing the second part of Tractate Avodah Zara.  It continues the discussion of contact and commerce with idolators, including the prohibition on buying or consuming wine that may have been used in sacrifices to idols.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第四十九卷，对应Avodah Zara第二部分的内容。它继续讨论与偶像崇拜者的接触和贸易的规定，包括禁止购买或消费可能祭祀过偶像的葡萄酒。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 50, Tractates Makkot & Horayot

messages.msgid: This is volume 50 of 51, containing Tractates Makkot and Horayot.  Tractate Makkot discusses punishments administered by a court of law and Tractate Horayot discuss redress for errors committed by the court and how to atone for sins committed by kings, high priests, and other officials.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第五十卷，对应Makkot & Horayot的内容。Makkot 部分讨论由法院实施的惩罚，Horayot 部分讨论对法院所犯错误的补救，以及弥补国王、大祭司和其他官员所犯的罪行。

messages.plural: copies of the Talmud, Vol. 51, Tractate Niddah

messages.msgid: This is volume 51 of 51, containing Tractate Niddah.  It discusses the ritual status of a menstruating woman, the prohibition on marital relations, and different kinds of bloody discharges.
translations: 这是犹太典籍塔木德五十一卷中的第五十一卷，对应Niddah的内容。它讨论了经期妇女的仪式地位，婚姻关系的禁忌，以及各种不同流血的规定。

messages.msgid: A single-volume book containing the complete canon of the Jewish Bible.
translations: 这本单行本包含了犹太教希伯来圣经的所有经典。

messages.msgid: The five books of Moses, written on animal skin by a trained scribe in accordance with the laws and customs of traditional Jewish calligraphy and bound onto wooden rollers.  Once very expensive, it would now be beyond price, if there are any Jewish communities left to use it.
translations: 摩西五经，由训练有素的抄写员按照传统犹太书法抄写在兽皮上，并以木筒装订。它曾经极度昂贵，如今则是无价之宝——如果还有犹太人要用到它。

messages.msgid: A collection of sacred Buddhist writings describing their canons of scriptures.
translations: 大藏经为佛教经典的总集，简称为藏经，又称为一切经，有多个版本。

messages.msgid: A collection of sacred Hindu writings regarding the nature of reality and describing the character and form of human salvation.
translations: 吠陀奥义书是印度婆罗门教的教义总集。是用吠陀梵文写作的一些西北印度文献的汇总，是关于对神的诵歌和祷文的文集。

messages.msgid: A single volume containing all four Vedas, which are the oldest scriptures of Hinduism.
translations: 一部古印度婆罗门教的四部根本圣典的合辑本。又作四韦陀、四围陀，是印度教最古老的经文。主要内容是一大堆赞颂神灵及祈祷祭祀的诗歌。

messages.msgid: A paperback English translation of the Enuma Elish, an ancient collection originally written in seven tablets that contain the Babylonian creation myth and cosmology.  It describes the birth of the gods, the formation of the universe, and the struggle for power among various deities.
translations: 《埃努玛·埃利什》的英文平装译本，这是一部由七块泥板组成的古老文献集，其中包含了巴比伦的创世神话和宇宙观。它描述了诸神的诞生、宇宙的形成，以及众神之间对权力的争夺。

messages.msgid: An English translation of several Old Norse poems.  The poems contain proverbs and stories attributed to the god Odin, many transcribed from oral history.
translations: 一部许多北欧古代史诗的英译本。这些诗中讲述了奥丁之神的箴言和故事，其中很多都是从口述历史中转录出来的。

messages.msgid: A large English translation of the Ginza Rabba, also known as The Book of Adam, a scripture Sacred for the Mandaeans.  It is a compilation of various oral teachings and written texts, including literature on a wide variety of topics such as liturgy, hymns, theological texts, didactic texts, as well as both religious and secular poetry.
translations: 一本《银座拉巴》的大型英文译本，也被称作《亚当之书》，是曼达安教的圣典。这是一本收录了各种口述教义和书面文本的著作，包括礼拜仪式、赞美诗、神学文本、教义文本，还有宗教和世俗的诗歌。

messages.msgid: A English translation of the Qolastā, the canonical prayer book of the Mandaeans.
translations: 一部《科拉斯塔》的英文译本，这本书是是曼达安教派的正统祈祷书。

messages.msgid: A English translation of the Drasa d-Yahya, also known as the Mandaean Book of John.  It contains accounts of John's life and miracles, as well as a number of polemical conversations with Jesus and tractates where Anush Uthra (Enosh) performs miracles in the style of Jesus's deeds in Jerusalem.
translations: 一本《曼达约翰福音》的英文译本。此书记录了约翰的生活和展示的奇迹，以及与耶稣的多次辩论，还收录了安舒乌斯拉在耶路撒冷以耶稣的风格展示奇迹的演说集。

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Kitáb-i-Aqdas, also known as The Most Holy Book.  Written by Baha'u'llah, the founder of the Baha'i Faith, in a poetic and mystical style.  It encompasses a wide range of topics, including the nature of God, the purpose of human existence, the role of religion in society, and the principles governing human conduct.  It also contains laws and regulations that govern various aspects of Baha'i life, such as marriage, family life, and the administration of the Baha'i community.
translations: 一本精装的英文版《亚格达斯经》，也称为《至圣之书》。由巴哈伊信仰的创立者，巴哈欧拉(Baha'u'llah)采用诗意且神秘的风格创作而成。书中涵盖了广泛的主题，包括神的本质、人类存在的目的、宗教在社会中的角色以及人类行为的准则。它还包含了约束巴哈伊教徒生活各个方面的规矩和戒律，例如婚姻、家庭生活以及巴哈伊社区的管理。

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Kitáb-i-Íqán, also known as the Book of Certitude.  It was written by Baha'u'llah, the founder of the Baha'i Faith, and addresses theological and philosophical aspects of religion, provides guidance on understanding spiritual truth and recognizing divine messengers throughout history.  This book also explores themes such as the nature of God, the purpose of religion, the progression of revelation, and the spiritual significance of the Baha'i Faith in relation to other religions.
translations: 《基塔布·伊·伊坎》（又称《确证之书》）的英文精装译本。该书由巴哈伊信仰的创始人巴哈欧拉撰写，探讨了宗教的神学和哲学方面，为理解精神真理和认识历史上的神圣使者提供了指引。此书还探讨了诸如上帝的本质、宗教的目的、启示的进展，以及巴哈伊信仰相对于其他宗教的精神意义等主题。

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Kalimát-i-Maknúnih, also known as the Hidden Words.  It was written by Baha'u'llah, the founder of the Baha'i Faith, during his exile in Baghdad.  This book covers a wide range of themes, including love, detachment, unity, humility, justice, and the recognition of God.  Each passage is concise and poetic, expressing profound spiritual truths in a simple yet profound manner.  One distinctive feature of this book is its universal appeal: while it was revealed within the context of the Bahá'í Faith, its teachings transcend religious boundaries and are applicable to people from all backgrounds.
translations: 《Kalimát-i-Maknúnih》（又称《隐言经》） 的英文精装译本。该书由巴哈伊信仰的创始人巴哈欧拉在巴格达流放期间撰写。本书涵盖了广泛的主题，包括爱情、超脱、团结、谦虚、正义以及对上帝的认识。每段文字简洁而富有诗意，以简单而深刻的方式表达出深刻的精神真理。本书的一个显著特点是其普遍吸引力：虽然它是在巴哈伊信仰的背景下进行启示的，但其教义跨越了宗教的边界，适用于来自任何背景的人们。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, paperback book containing a collection of prayers, meditations, and devotional readings that are used for personal reflection, worship, and spiritual nourishment for followers, adherents or sympathizers of the Baha'i Faith.
translations: 一本轻便的平装书籍，收录了祈祷词、冥想和虔诚读物，供巴哈伊信仰的追随者、拥护者和共鸣者在个人反思、礼拜和精神滋养中诵读。

messages.plural: copies of The Secret of Divine Civilization

messages.msgid: A hardcover English translation of the Risali-yi-madaniyyih, also known as The Secret of Divine Civilization.  It was written by 'Abdu'l-Bahá, the son of Bahá'u'lláh, founder of the Bahá'í Faith.  This book addresses various aspects of social and economic development, advocating for progressive reforms and offering guidance on how societies can advance spiritually, intellectually, and materially.  It explores principles that can contribute to the progress and well-being of individuals and societies, emphasizing the importance of education, justice, equality, and unity.  A perfect book for rebuilding society once again.
translations: 《Risali-yi-madaniyyih》（又称《神圣文明的秘密》）的英文精装译本。由阿博都-巴哈，巴哈伊信仰创始人巴哈欧拉之子所著。本书涉及社会与经济发展的各个方面，主张渐进式的改革，指导社会如何在精神、理智、物质上取得发展。本书探索有助于发展和个人、社会安康的准则，强调教育、公正、平等和团结的重要性。对于重建社会，这是一本完美的书。

messages.msgid: A hardcover book containing a collection of transcriptions of table talks given by 'Abdu'l-Bahá in 'Akká between 1904 and 1906 in response to questions posed by Laura Dreyfus-Barney, an American Bahá'í resident in Paris, and first published in 1908.  This book provides clarity, guidance, and understanding to Baha'is and those seeking to learn more about the religion.
translations: 一本精装书籍，收录了阿博都-巴哈于1904~1906年间在阿卡回答居住在巴黎的美裔巴哈伊信徒劳拉·德雷弗斯·巴尼所提出问题的演讲合集，初次于1908年出版。本书为巴哈伊信徒和那些想深入了解巴哈伊信仰的人提供了明辨、指导与领悟。

messages.msgid: An annual publication about fencing and dueling.  There are many good illustrations which describe proper technique and form.
translations: 一本每年都出版的关于击剑和近距离决斗的杂志，有许多插图以及文章描述里边的各种技巧。

messages.msgid: A beginner's guide to traditional and sport fencing - rules, proper defense and offense, movement, etc.
translations: 一本传统剑术或体育剑术的入门指南，讲解规则，进攻与防守和步伐等知识。

messages.msgid: A childish book about fencing, where the mascot Foily guides the reader through the different nuances of fencing with lots of photos and images.
translations: 一本关于剑术的书，给小孩子看的，吉祥物Foily通过许多照片和图像引导读者区分剑术中的细微差别。

messages.plural: copies of The Complete Guide to Fencing

messages.msgid: A thick book, written by professional fencers, that covers every possible aspect of modern sport fencing.
translations: 一本由专业剑术家写的厚书，包括了现代剑术运动可能的方方面面。

messages.plural: copies of Fencing: Skills, Tactics, Training

messages.msgid: A textbook for fence instructors that fulfills every aspect a fencer must know, from the very basics to a master level, from theory to drill training exercises.
translations: 一本给指导者的击剑教科书，包括了击剑者需要知道的每个方面。从非常基础到大师水平，从理论分析到练习技巧都囊括其中。

messages.msgid: This book highlights the modern technologies used in fencing, with new possible techniques and scientific research that underlies the latest training methods.
translations: 本书重点介绍了击剑中使用的现代技术，以及作为最新训练方法基础的新技术和科学研究。
击剑：文艺复兴时期的论文
messages.plural: copies of Fencing: A Renaissance Treatise

messages.msgid: An ancient treatise explaining the fundamental ideas of fencing that are still used today - distance, time, line, blade opposition, counterattacks, countertime, etc.
translations: 一本古老的论文，解释了今天仍在使用的击剑的基本思想——距离、时间、线、刀锋对立、反击等。

messages.plural: copies of FM 23-25 Army bayonet manual

messages.msgid: A hefty military field manual about bayonet usage and combat theory.
translations: 一本沉重的军用野战手册，讲述了刺刀的使用方法和实战理论。

messages.msgid: The Halberd and Other European Pole Arms, 1300-1650
translations: 戟和其他欧洲变种，1300-1650 年
messages.plural: copies of The Halberd and Other European Pole Arms, 1300-1650

messages.msgid: Small, but comprehensive introduction to the pole arms of medieval Europe: from the simple pike, through the halberd in its many forms, to the roncone, bardiche, and many others.
translations: 一本袖珍但内容全面的中世纪欧洲长柄武器讲解书，从长矛、各种战戟，到镗、月刃斧和许多其他武器都有提及。

messages.msgid: Boarders Away: With Steel-Edged Weapons and Polearms
translations: 无懈可击：钢刃武器与长柄武器
messages.plural: copies of Boarders Away: With Steel-Edged Weapons and Polearms

messages.msgid: An all-encompassing study of naval armament under fighting sail.  This volume covers pikes and fighting blades in use between 1626 and 1826.
translations: 研究战船上军备武器的百科全书。这一部内容关于1626年到1826年间使用的矛和战刃。

messages.plural: copies of Polearms of Paulus Hector Mair

messages.msgid: The summarized and preserved experience of Paulus Hector Mair, an ancient German fencing master, using spears, lances, halberds, poleaxes, and similar weapons.
translations: 由Paulus Hector Mair，一位德国古代的剑术大师，总结和记录的关于矛、枪、戟、长柄斧等一系列武器的经验。

messages.msgid: Hafted Weapons in Medieval and Renaissance Europe
translations: 中世纪及文艺复兴时期欧洲的带柄武器
messages.plural: copies of Hafted Weapons in Medieval and Renaissance Europe

messages.msgid: Research about the long history of a huge variety of weapons in medieval times, with lots of illustrations.
translations: 关于中世纪众多型制各异武器漫长历史的研究，附有很多插图和说明。

messages.msgid: A fully illustrated guide to the use of polearms, ranging from the earliest halberds and spears reaching Japan from the Asian mainland to the sophisticated naginata, nagamaki, and various forms of yari used by the Japanese samurai through the medieval period.
translations: 一本完整的带插图的关于长柄武器的书籍，从由亚洲大陆传到日本的早期戟和矛，到之后中世纪时期日本武士使用的精巧的薙刀、长卷和各种枪都有提及。
雪域特战队的刀具技术

messages.msgid: A classic Soviet text on the art of attacking with a blade.
translations: 一本讲述苏联特战部队刀剑艺术的书。

messages.msgid: Simple, practical and useful martial art techniques to use in a fight.  On the first page the author says they will not be held responsible for any harm caused by using advice from this book.
translations: 简单、实际、好用的作战武术。在第一页作者声明：对本书提供建议造成的任何伤害，我们均不承担任何责任。

messages.msgid: Authored by a state trooper and policeman from Michigan, it contains a lot of experience on real fights with a knife and against a knife.
translations: 由一位密歇根州警所著，包括了许多真实刀战或对抗刀战时有用的经验。

messages.plural: copies of The Ka-Bar Knife Combat Manual

messages.msgid: This manual teaches the reader to use the Ka-Bar, an iconic knife of the U.S. Army that carries the energy and spirit of soldiers.
translations: 这本手册教导读者如何使用卡巴，一把承载美军士兵精神的标志性匕首。
放倒他们，然后赶走他们
messages.plural: copies of Put 'Em Down, Take 'Em Out!

messages.msgid: "Knife Fighting Techniques From Folsom Prison".  This book describe fighting with a shiv in the tight walls of a jail.
translations: "来自Folsom监狱的匕首战斗技巧" 这本书描述了如何在监狱的窄墙之间持刀战斗。

messages.msgid: A small, femme-oriented manual about self-defense with knife.
translations: 一本面向女性的小书，讲解如何用匕首自卫。

messages.plural: copies of Secrets of the Karambit

messages.msgid: This book aspires to describe and explain the history, design, materials, and demonstrate deployment and drills with the unusual Indonesian weapon known as the karambit knife.  The final impression is disappointing.
translations: 一本试图描述并解释一种印度尼西亚的稀有武器——爪刀的历史、设计、材料，并展示其使用和练习方法的书。最后的结论令人失望。

messages.plural: copies of Combat Knives and Knife Combat

messages.msgid: A comprehensive compendium about different types of knives and their usage in various martial arts.
translations: 一本关于在不同武术中，各种匕首及其用法的全面纲要。

messages.msgid: "The Art of Knife Fencing & the Chronicles of the Modern Fighting Knife and their Wielders".  This book teaches the reader how to defend against an aggressor with various weapons.
translations: "匕首剑术与现代战匕及其锻造者的编年史" 这本书告诉犊子如何对付带有不同武器的敌人。

messages.plural: copies of Survival Under Atomic Attack

messages.msgid: A wordy and intricate guide to wilderness and urban survival in a worst-case scenario.  While filled with loads of useful information, the madman who wrote this was a terrible writer, and gleaning knowledge from the rants is a chore.
translations: 一本冗长而复杂的野外生存指南和末日城市求生杂志，虽然充满了很多有用的信息，但从作者十分糟糕的文笔中找出隐藏在各种抱怨中的知识让你十分难熬。

messages.msgid: A colorful digest devoted to backpacking and wilderness photography.  The photos are beautiful, though the terminology in the sections on survivalcraft assume some proficiency.
translations: 一个有关徒步旅行，和荒野摄影的杂志。这些照片非常美丽，但其中章节所使用的术语需要读者对生存学相当熟悉。

messages.msgid: A full-size glossy men's magazine.  There's a brief article about hiking and a list of simple wilderness survival tips somewhere in between the photos of bikini-clad women and the gadget advertisements.
translations: 全尺寸光面男士杂志。有一篇关于徒步旅行的简短文章，以及一份简单的荒野生存技巧清单，介于穿着比基尼的女性照片和小工具广告之间。

messages.msgid: A glossy magazine about surviving and hunting in the wilderness.  There's an exciting article about a bear attack in the back pages.
translations: 一本关于在荒野中生存和狩猎的彩页杂志。在后面的页面有一个关于被熊袭击的刺激文章。

messages.msgid: A guide detailing the basics of woodsmanship and outdoor survival.
translations: 一本详细介绍野外伐木技术及野外求生的基础知识的手册。

messages.msgid: This pocket-sized leather-bound survival guide combines a wealth of concise information with simple to follow instructions and easy to read illustrations.
translations: 一本外观轻薄的袖珍生存指南，蕴含有大量简洁的信息，以及简单容易阅读的插图。

messages.plural: copies of Autobiography of a Mountain Man

messages.msgid: An amusing historical novel filled with detailed descriptions of surviving in the wild, potentially containing great insights for an experienced outdoorsman.
translations: 一本历史题材小说，其中有许多关于野外生存的详细描述，也许能对经验丰富的户外运动者有所帮助。

messages.msgid: A thick soft-cover book filled with vital information about surviving in the wild, aimed at the experienced backpacker.
translations: 一本软皮包装的厚书，里面全是在野外生存所需要掌握的重要信息，面向有经验的背包客读者。

messages.plural: copies of Introduction to Plant Biology

messages.msgid: A college-level textbook about plants of all shapes and sizes.  Covers a wide range of subjects, from horticulture to the identification of tropical plants.  As such, it is of limited practical use in your current situation.
translations: 这是一本关于各式各样不同形状大小的植物的大学教材，涵盖范围十分广泛，从园艺学到热带植物分类学。但它显然对你目前的处境的协助非常有限。

messages.plural: copies of The Wonderful World of Arthropodology

messages.msgid: A three-volume doorstopper introducing the whole breadth of modern arthropodology, beginning with a lengthy section on the comparative anatomy of the described taxa.  The authors somehow manage to maintain a gushingly enthusiastic tone, even as they describe the grisly effects of arthropod venoms or the mating habits of horseshoe crabs.  Given the curious lack of man-sized wasps in the illustrations, you have to wonder how much of the content is still applicable.
translations: 本书一共三卷，介绍了现代节肢动物学的全部内容，开篇就用了很长的篇幅介绍了节肢动物的种群分类和解剖学。作者在描述节肢动物毒液的可怕效果或是马蹄蟹的交配习性时，还不知为何保持着一种滔滔不绝的热情语调。考虑到插图中并未包含如今这种成人大小的奇怪黄蜂，你不得不想知道书里还有多少内容仍然适用。

messages.plural: copies of Natural Remedies of New England

messages.msgid: A leather-bound manuscript, it features native herbal remedies with hand-colored illustrations of each plant.
translations: 一本皮革装订的手稿，描述了多种本地的天然草药并附有手绘插图。

messages.msgid: The world's leading resource about aquatic sports.
translations: 一本关于水上运动的全球权威杂志。

messages.msgid: A shiny magazine about fitness, nutrition, and sports, mostly oriented towards men.
translations: 一本关于健身、营养和运动的闪亮杂志，主要面向男性。

messages.msgid: A quarterly issue about natural bodybuilding, weightlifting, and powerlifting.
translations: 关于自然健美、举重和力量举重的季刊。

messages.msgid: A magazine about mainstream fitness and simple bodybuilding, containing articles about different training techniques, nutrition tips, and doctor recommendations.
translations: 一本关于主流健身和简单健美的杂志，包含有关不同训练技术、营养提示和医生建议的文章。

messages.msgid: A monthly issue which covers mostly fitness and bodybuilding themes.  Lots of muscular men aggressively poke at you from the cover.
translations: 一本主要讲健康与塑身的月刊。封面上的肌肉男直勾勾地盯着你。

messages.msgid: A small magazine about the bicycle scene, tips about the buying and maintenance of bikes, and different types of training you can do with them.
translations: 一本关于自行车的小杂志，包含有购买和维修自行车的指南，以及如何用它们进行的不同类型的训练。

messages.plural: copies of Water Survival Training Field Manual

messages.msgid: A commercially produced survival guide that details swimming and deep water survival techniques tailored to emergency scenarios.
translations: 一本商业生存指南，涉及针对紧急状况的游泳和深水生存技能的细节知识。

messages.msgid: "A Science-Based Guide to Healing Painful Joints, Preventing Injuries, and Rebuilding Your Body".  This book details a way to build your body without painful and exhausting training, with a proper training program and step-by-step instructions.
translations: "一本基于科学研究的指南书，告诉你如何从剧烈的关节疼痛中恢复，如何避免伤害，以及如何重塑你的身体"。这本书详细讲解了如何在避免痛苦且超负荷训练的前途下，强健你的身体。并附有细致到每一步的训练项目。

messages.msgid: This book contains comprehensive information about how anatomy and physiology function in running, training plans, and many new exercises for new runners.
translations: 这本书从生理学和解剖学的角度详解说明了奔跑的运作机制，也为跑步爱好者提供了一些训练计划和锻炼项目。

messages.msgid: "A Systematic Approach to Gymnastics and Bodyweight Strength", this thick book is a gold mine of information about strength-oriented bodyweight workout, including scientific principles, different routines, methods, detail about progression, and a huge variety of exercises and their modifications.
translations: "关于体操和自重力量训练的系统方法"。这本厚书包含了自重力量训练的丰富信息，提供了科学的准则，不同的训练、方法，各个阶段的建议。以及大量的练习项目及其变体。

messages.msgid: A step-by-step guide about fitness and working out using only your body, with a huge variety of difficulties in exercises.
translations: 一本全程只用到你的身体的逐步讲解的健身指南，在练习的过程中你可能会遇到很多困难。

messages.msgid: 200 pages of different squat trainings, with comprehensive info on what each of them is designed to train.
translations: 足足200页关于各种蹲式训练的书，对每一种训练设计训练的目标肌肉都有详细的讲解。

messages.plural: copies of Functional Training and Beyond

messages.msgid: The best book for someone who wants to build a better body - from the start to an advanced level.
translations: 对于任何想从起步到较高层次练出更强健的身体的人，选这本书准没错。

messages.plural: copies of New Functional Training for Sports

messages.msgid: Concepts, methods, exercises and programs for athletes of different sports, with demonstrations, commentary, and analysis of key exercises.
translations: 这本书记载了不同专业体育运动的概念，方法，练习和项目，并对重要的练习附有说明，解释和分析。

messages.plural: copies of The World's Fittest Book

messages.msgid: "How to Train for Anything and Everything, Anywhere and Everywhere", this book contains different types of trainings for everyone.
translations: "如何在几乎任何地方和每处地方，为几乎任何事或每件事进行训练"，如它自称的那样，这本书包含各种不同的训练，非常普适。

messages.msgid: The cutting-edge training program to make you stronger than ever, from zero to superhuman, in a year.
translations: 这套尖端的训练项目许诺让你变得比之前任何时候都强，在一年内让一个弱鸡变成超人。

messages.plural: copies of Hard Work Pays Off

messages.msgid: A training manual for someone ready to spend lot of time and energy on training, with detailed instructions and comments.
translations: 一本为有着充足时间和精力的人所著的训练手册，有着详尽的指导和许多评论。

messages.msgid: A short magazine printed as an advertisement for the now canceled Boston AnimeCon.  A few costume ideas are intermixed with miscellaneous information about the event.
translations: 一本薄薄的插图宣传册，里面介绍了有关一年一度的波士顿漫展（现已取消）的信息。在这本漫展介绍册子的巨大信息量中，或许你能借鉴一下里面所展示的COS服的一些裁剪上的技巧。

messages.msgid: A full-size glossy women's magazine.  There are a few simple patterns and basic sewing tips somewhere in between the fashion photos and the makeup advertisements.
translations: 一本光鲜亮丽的大开本女性杂志。在各类时装图片和化妆品广告之间夹着一些简单的纺织图样和基础缝纫心得。

messages.msgid: A well presented monthly magazine all about knitting, crocheting, and needlepoint.  Filled with ideas and project patterns.
translations: 一本销量很好的缝纫技术月刊，通篇介绍针织、钩织和针绣技巧。其中也包含了很多物品的详细缝制配方。
一本色彩鲜艳的裁缝手册，有着丰富的服装制造配方。

messages.msgid: A leather bound portfolio that once belonged to a clothing designer.  Filled with sketches and notes, a skilled tailor could learn a lot from this volume.
translations: 一本高超的服装设计集，曾属于某个服装设计师。充满了各种草图和笔记，熟练的裁缝师能从中学到不少东西。

messages.msgid: An illustrated textbook on the crafting of Japanese traditional garb.
translations: 一本关于日本传统服装制造的插图教科书。

messages.msgid: An educational book detailing the uses of fake fur, as well as its benefits and disadvantages.  The prose is rather passionate, and a disclaimer on the cover proudly states that the book is printed and distributed by the Gryphon Animal Rights Organization.
translations: 一本有教育意义的书籍，详细介绍了人造毛皮的用途，以及它的优缺点。书中行文饱含热情，封面上的免责声明骄傲地说，这本书是由格里芬动物权利协会印刷出版的。
时装设计师技术指导书
messages.plural: copies of Sewing Techniques for Designers

messages.msgid: A massive, hardbound book full of a wealth of information for the professional clothing designer.
translations: 一本厚重的、精装本的书，里面装满了专业服装设计师的大量信息。

messages.plural: copies of Ye Scots Beuk o Tailorin'

messages.msgid: A translated Gaelic book from Scotland.  While boring to read due to its technical tone, it provides insights into Scottish culture and information about tailoring.
translations: 一本翻译自苏格兰盖尔语的书。虽然书中的术语使其读起来很枯燥，但它能提供对苏格兰文化和缝纫技艺的深入解析。

messages.msgid: A large, leatherbound book containing a number of leather and rubber recipes for the fashionable dieselpunk.
translations: 一本巨大的皮革装订的书籍，书中描写了许多皮革和橡胶制品配方，专为时尚的柴油机朋克准备。

messages.msgid: A simple printed pamphlet with clear illustrations and very few words describing how to make what appears to be a well-designed and comfortable cowl offering protection from the elements and physical injury.  The directions do not offer much guidance beyond the plans themselves; this will take a little skill to interpret.
translations: 一本印刷简单的小册子，带有清晰的插图和很少的文字，描述了如何制作一件设计精良、十分舒适的兜帽，能防护恶劣天气和身体伤害。除了设计本身，没有提供太多额外说明指导；这需要有点技能才能理解其中的文字。

messages.msgid: A simple printed pamphlet with clear illustrations and very few words describing how to make what appears to be a tight-fitting but protective bodysuit, with options to reinforce it with Kevlar threads.  The directions do not offer much guidance beyond the plans themselves; this will take a little skill to interpret.
translations: 一本印刷简单的小册子，带有清晰的插图和很少的文字，描述了如何制作一件紧身但有保护作用的连体衣，可以选择用凯夫拉纤维加固。除了设计本身，没有提供太多额外说明指导；这需要有点技能才能理解其中的文字。

messages.msgid: A simple printed pamphlet with clear illustrations and very few words describing how to make what appears to be a jumpsuit designed to survive the long-term wear and tear of exploring the apocalyptic wasteland, with a lot of storage capacity.  The directions do not offer much guidance beyond the plans themselves; this will take a little skill to interpret.  There seems to be room within the directions to make a simpler, lighter version, or a leather-reinforced version.
translations: 一本印刷简单的小册子，带有清晰的插图和很少的文字，描述了如何制作一件连身衣，看起来像是用来探索这片末日后的荒原时能经受住长期磨损而设计的，有着很大的存储空间。除了设计本身，没有提供太多额外说明指导；这需要有点技能才能理解其中的文字。根据其中的指导可以制造出样式较为简单的轻便版本，或者是皮革强化的版本。

messages.msgid: A biannual magazine devoted to the art and science of discus-throwing.
translations: 一本有关于铁饼投掷的艺术性与科学性的半年刊。

messages.msgid: This book has pretty good information about ways to throw a hatchet, from a World Axe Throwing Championship champion.  You are surprised there was a championship for axe throwing.
translations: 这本书由世界飞斧投掷冠军参与编写，对于短柄斧的投掷讲解得很好。"什么，这玩意也有比赛，还有世界冠军？"

messages.msgid: Sergeant Shenk's Comprehensive Book on Knife Throwing
translations: 申克中士的飞刀技巧详解
messages.plural: copies of Sergeant Shenk's Comprehensive Book on Knife Throwing

messages.msgid: Illustrated booklet, that covers the basics of knife throwing.
translations: 一本带插图的书，包括了飞刀投掷的多数基本技巧。

messages.plural: copies of The Complete Guide to Pitching

messages.msgid: A detailed guide for baseball pitchers that combines time-tested techniques and information mixed with a common sense approach to pitching.
translations: 一本详细的垒球投手指南，包括了久经考验的技术和信息，还混杂了对投掷技能的感悟。

messages.msgid: The Ultimate Guide to Knife Throwing
messages.plural: copies of The Ultimate Guide to Knife Throwing

messages.msgid: A precise handbook for someone who wants to win a throwing tournament.
translations: 一本口袋书，为那些想赢得投掷锦标赛的人所编写。

messages.plural: copies of Guide to Knife & Ax Throwing

messages.msgid: A small, simple guide on how to throw a projectile, with different techniques, guides, and tricks.
translations: 一本袖珍，简单的指南书，告诉你如何通过不同的技巧、手法来抛出你的暗器。

messages.msgid: Knife & Tomahawk Throwing: The Art of the Experts
translations: 飞刀与战斧：投掷的艺术
messages.plural: copies of Knife & Tomahawk Throwing: The Art of the Experts

messages.msgid: A small book on the long history of projectile throwing and the people building the sport.  It serves as a guide for someone who wants to get into it, with useful drills and diagrams.
translations: 一本小书，介绍投掷物的漫长历史，以及人们是如何将它变成一项运动的。它也可以作为学习投掷的指南书，附有实用的练习和丰富的图画说明。

messages.plural: copies of The Science of Baseball

messages.msgid: The author and several experts cover topics like what makes a ball break, bounce, and fly; how material science and physics work together to make the bat function; how hitters use physics, geometry, and force to connect; baseball injuries; and much more.
translations: 作者和一些专家探讨什么使棒球停止、弹起或击飞；材料科学与物理学如何解释球棒的击球效果；击球手如何运用物理学、几何学与连接力；棒球的受伤；以及其他许多话题。

messages.plural: copies of The Complete Knife Throwing Guide

messages.msgid: A tiny, though still comprehensive manual of knife throwing from experienced knifemaker.
translations: 一关于飞刀投掷的手册，很薄但写得很详尽，由有经验的飞刀投掷者编写。

messages.plural: copies of How to Trap Anything

messages.msgid: A worn manual that describes how to set and disarm a wide variety of traps.
translations: 一本已经磨损的手册，上面记载着如何设置和拆除各种陷阱。

messages.msgid: An in-depth magazine about trapping game.  There are lots of articles and diagrams that explain simple trap designs.
translations: 一本深入关于如何生存在野外所必备的制造陷阱的知识，还附带一些陷阱草图的书。

messages.msgid: An extensive volume that details numerous methods of trapping game.
translations: 一本内容详尽的书，说明了各种制造陷阱的方法。
野战手册20-32：地雷与反地雷

messages.msgid: A hefty military field manual about mine-warfare principles, the mechanics of different types of mines/IED's, and countermine operations.
translations: 一本沉重的军用野战手册，讲述了地雷战中的原则、不同类型的地雷和简易爆炸装置的机械原理，以及应对地雷的方法。

messages.msgid: Booby Traps, IEDs, Mines and You: A Primer
translations: 诡雷、地雷、简易爆炸物与你
messages.plural: copies of Booby Traps, IEDs, Mines and You: A Primer

messages.msgid: A light military field manual about booby traps, IEDs, mines and how to avoid being blown up by them.
translations: 一本简明军用野战手册，讲解诱饵陷阱、临时爆炸物(IED)、地雷以及你应该如何安全地与它们相处。

messages.msgid: An in-depth book about trapping game animals, covering methods both modern and ancient.
translations: 一本深入介绍用陷阱捕获动物的书，包含从古至今的各种方法。

messages.msgid: A folksy guide to trapping wild game using time-tested methods.  A bit in-depth for the beginner, it can provide a wealth of information to a knowledgeable trapper.
translations: 一本教你如何捕获野生动物的指南，虽然充满了大量的信息，但是如果是初学者，很容易陷入不知所措的地步。

messages.msgid: An exciting monthly magazine about boxing.  There are lots of large, colorful photos of pugilistic exploits.
translations: 一本令人血脉偾张的拳击月刊，其中刊载了许多描绘拳击手的彩图。

messages.msgid: A brutal book about using dirty tricks to disrupt your enemies, and using this advantage to knockout or even kill them.
translations: 一本野蛮的格斗书，教你如何用下三滥的招数干扰你的对手，进而利用优势击倒、甚至杀掉你的对手。

messages.msgid: "A Street Warrior's Guide To Tactical Combat Stances", this book provides plenty of information about how stance changes your movement, and how to use each of them with maximum effect.
translations: "一本街头格斗的架势指南书"，这本书提供了许多信息，讲解移动与架势的关系，以及怎样才能将架势作用最大发挥。

messages.msgid: First Strike: End a Fight in Ten Seconds or Less!
translations: 一击致胜：10秒内结束战斗
messages.plural: copies of First Strike: End a Fight in Ten Seconds or Less!

messages.msgid: Despite having a pretty odd name, this book provides a lot of information about fighting techniques, and different tactics and skills you need to obtain to use them properly.
translations: 虽然名字挺奇葩，但这本书还算有些关于战斗的干货，以及要想正确用出这些技巧你所需的战术和技能。
致命街头：徒手城市格斗
messages.plural: copies of Street Lethal: Unarmed Urban Combat

messages.msgid: This book contains lot of images showing how to use different attacks in close quarters, but someone has hand-written "lame" on the cover.
translations: 这本书内含许多图片，展示了近身战时可以运用的一系列攻击，但有人在封面上手写了一行"弱爆了"。

messages.msgid: "Turn your fist into a weapon of mass destruction!"  This book details different training programs to train your body overall and to temper your hands and nerves into unstoppable forces.
translations: "把你的拳头练成大规模杀伤性武器！" 本书详细介绍了多种身体训练计划，将你的手和神经锻炼成不可阻挡的力量。

messages.msgid: It seems to be a wrestling manual, poorly photocopied and released on spiral-bound paper.  Still, there are lots of useful tips for unarmed combat.
translations: 一本摔跤手册，印刷质量很差，草草进行装订后就发行了，但即使如此，你仍能从中学会很多空手格斗方面的技巧。

messages.plural: copies of Turn Your Fists Into Sledgehammers!

messages.msgid: A detailed explanation of how to train your hands, arms and fists to crush the heads of your opponents, with lot of photos and instructions.
translations: 用手、臂和拳头打爆对手脑袋的详细教学，附有大量照片和说明。

messages.msgid: A book with a creepy image of death with a scythe on the cover, it guides the user on different attacks that can be combined to overwhelm and destroy your enemy in seconds.
translations: 一本封面有恐怖带大镰刀的死神形象的书，教你各种不同的攻击，可以组合起来发挥出压到行的效果，在几秒钟内打倒敌人。

messages.msgid: Knockout: The Ultimate Guide to Sucker Punching
messages.plural: copies of Knockout: The Ultimate Guide to Sucker Punching

messages.msgid: This book shows how to use sucker punches - fast and unexpected attacks - to take advantage in a street fight.  Not as useful as before, but it still contains solid information about certain skills and trainings.
translations: 这本书介绍街头混混常用的拳法 － 用快速且出人意料的攻击占据优势。可能现在没有街溜子给你打了，但其中关于某些技能训练的内容还挺靠谱的。

messages.msgid: Killer Instinct: Unarmed Combat for Street Survival
translations: 杀手本能：安全经历一场街头徒手格斗
messages.plural: copies of Killer Instinct: Unarmed Combat for Street Survival

messages.msgid: A shabby book about possible street dangers the author met in his long life, ways to deal with them, and the skill set that such situations require.
translations: 这本旧书记录了作者在他一生中经历过的街头威胁，如何进行相应的应对，以及需要你有一些什么能力。

messages.msgid: The Bigger They Are, The Harder They Fall
messages.plural: copies of The Bigger They Are, The Harder They Fall

messages.msgid: This book explains simple rules that you need to rely on to fight an enemy of different constitution, with techniques and tactics.
translations: 这本书解释了你在不同情况下与敌人战斗时需要注意的规则，并提供了技巧和战术。

messages.msgid: An abstract video file, implemented as a book.
translations: 一个虚拟的视频文件，实现方式与书籍相同。

messages.msgid: A little book for little readers.  The colorful cartoon characters and sweet stories contained herein belong to a different time, before the dead walked and the world moved on.
translations: 一本给小读者看的小书。有着丰富的卡通插画角色和甜蜜的故事，显然来自另一个时间的产物，来自那个死人复生之前的世界，但世界还是在往前走。

messages.msgid: An amusing collection of folklore featuring the usual cast of fairies, goblins, and trolls.
translations: 一本有趣的民间传说故事集，里面有着常见的精灵、地精、巨魔等。

messages.msgid: This fairy tale is about a wolf who eats so much salted meat she becomes trapped in the butcher's cellar.
translations: 这个童话故事讲的是一只狼吃了太多咸肉，最终被困在屠夫的地窖里。

messages.msgid: In this traditional story of beastly intrigue, a clever fox convinces an elderly lion to kill a derogatory wolf.
translations: 在这个传统童话故事中，一只狡猾的狐狸说服一只年长的狮子杀死一只恶毒的狼。

messages.msgid: An illustrated fairy tale book about a conversation between a mouse and a cat.
translations: 这是一本有插图的童话书，讲述的是老鼠和猫之间的对话。

messages.msgid: This illustrated fairy tale relates how a city mouse did visit his cousin in the country, and how each regarded the other's quality of life.
translations: 这个童话小说讲述了一只城市老鼠拜访他在乡下的表亲的，以及他们如何看待对方的生活质量的故事。

messages.msgid: A fable in which the jackal wins the day via clever foolishness.
translations: 一个童话寓言故事，讲述了一只豺狼如何用自身聪明的愚蠢赢得了胜利。

messages.msgid: A slave mistakenly wanders into a lion's den - thus begins a fable which demonstrates mutual dependence regardless of size or status.
translations: 一个奴隶误打误撞闯进了狮子的巢穴——由此而展开一段寓言故事，其寓意为不论两者大小或地位如何，都有相互依赖的需要。

messages.msgid: An amusing collection of stories featuring "Goldilocks and The Three Bears" on the cover.
translations: 一本有趣的童话故事集，封面上写着《金姑娘和三只小熊》。

messages.msgid: A well illustrated fairy tale about a war between the birds and the beasts, with particulars on the wartime conduct and eventual fate of the bat.
translations: 这是一本有着不错插图的童话故事书，讲述了鸟类和野兽之间的战争，着重描绘蝙蝠在战争之中的行为和最终命运。

messages.msgid: This book, titled "The Rattlesnake's Vengeance" is a collection of Cherokee myths and legends.  "285D" is hand-written in pencil on the title page.
translations: 这本书名为《响尾蛇的复仇》，是切诺基族神话和传说的故事集。标题页上用铅笔手写了"285D"。

messages.msgid: This fairy tale book is a regional variant of "Jack and the Beanstalk."
translations: 这本童话书中讲述了一个《杰克和豌豆》故事的本地变体。

messages.msgid: This fairy tale book is titled "Little Red Cap."  It details a red-cloaked child's various encounters with talking wolves.
translations: 这本童话书的标题是《小红帽》。它描述了一个穿红斗篷的小女孩与一只会说话的大灰狼的各种遭遇。

messages.msgid: A collection of ghost stories warning about the dangers of stealing from the dead.
translations: 一本关于鬼怪的童话故事集，警告读者从死者身上偷东西的危险。

messages.msgid: An Irish fairy tale in which a Celtic poet marries a princess who has been cursed with the head of a pig.
translations: 一个爱尔兰童话故事，讲述了一个凯尔特诗人娶了一个被诅咒长成猪头的公主。

messages.msgid: A book of Italian fairy tales translated into English.  The cover features an orange fairy juggling a lemon, a lime, and a tangerine.
translations: 一本被翻译成英文的意大利童话书。封面上画着一只橙色的仙子正在用一个柠檬、一个酸橙和一个橘子玩杂耍。

messages.msgid: A book of fables about people who change into birds.
translations: 一本关于变成鸟的人的童话书。

messages.msgid: This compendium of amusing folk tales about the devil is titled "Hell's Kettle: Legends of the Devil."
translations: 一本关于魔鬼的有趣的民间故事集录，标题为《地狱的水壶：魔鬼的传说》。

messages.msgid: This charming book of Swedish fables is titled "The Glass Mountain and the Princess."
translations: 一本迷人的瑞典童话书，标题为《玻璃山和公主》。

messages.msgid: A collection of fairy tale stories warning against the consequences of extreme greed.
translations: 一本童话故事集，警告了读者过度贪婪的下场。

messages.msgid: This fable book is titled "The Rabbit Herd."  Inside are woodcut illustrations of a peasant boy playing his flute for a mob of mischievous hares.
translations: 这本寓言书的题目是《野兔群》。书中画着一幅农家男孩为一群淘气的野兔吹长笛的木版画插图。

messages.msgid: This book is titled "The Thieving Pot: Folktales of the Arab World."
translations: 一本标题为《偷东西的罐子：阿拉伯世界的民间故事》的故事书。

messages.msgid: A book of legends collected by Traveller Johnny Cassidy in the 1960s.
translations: 一本童话故事集，由乔尼·卡西迪于1960年代收集。

messages.msgid: A book by the Brothers Grimm, titled "Eve's Unequal Children."
translations: 一本格林兄弟的童话书，书名为《夏娃的孩子们》。

messages.msgid: This book of fables expands upon the legend of the Seven Sleepers of Ephesus.
translations: 这本童话书基于艾弗所之七圣童的传说改编扩写而成。

messages.msgid: In this fairy tale, a strong man frightens an ogre by squeezing water out of a stone.
translations: 在这个童话故事中，一个强壮的小裁缝把石头里的水挤出来吓唬巨人。

messages.msgid: This book of rustic folk tales bears the title "How to Shout Down the Devil."
translations: 这本乡村民间故事书的标题为《如何大叫来吓跑魔鬼》。

messages.msgid: The title of this book is "Village Folk-tales of Ceylon."  It includes fables about logical errors and foolish misjudgments of the Kadambawa men.
translations: 这本书的标题是《锡兰的乡村民间故事》。它里面包含了关于斯里兰卡的卡达姆巴瓦人的逻辑错误和愚蠢误判的童话故事。

messages.msgid: This book of folk tales is titled "The Girl with the Ugly Name, and Other Stories."
translations: 这本民间故事书的标题是《一个有丑陋名字的女孩，和其他故事》。

messages.msgid: Titled "The Fleeing Pancake", this collection of silly folk tales is suitable for small children.
translations: 标题为《逃走的松饼》的民间童话故事集，适合讲给小孩子听。

messages.msgid: When a therapist's daughter transfers to a new school, she decides to change her personality type.  As her social life begins to blossom, can she maintain a healthy boundary between her home life and her public persona?
translations: 当心理医生的女儿转到新学校时，她决定改变自己的性格类型。当她的社交生活开始蓬勃发展时，她能否继续保持家庭生活和公众形象之间的健康界限呢？

messages.msgid: When Jackson gains the mystical talent to alter his appearance on command, will he be able to recognize himself in his own mirror?
translations: 当杰克逊获得能够改变自身外貌的神秘天赋时，他还能在镜子中继续认出自己吗？

messages.msgid: A teenage influencer becomes fast friends with someone who may or may not be an actual demon.
translations: 一位青年意见领袖交到了一个新密友。这个朋友很可能（是/不是）一只真正的恶魔。

messages.msgid: In this work of adolescent fiction, a young Gemini discovers that the astrology section of his small town newspaper is eerily preminiscent.  His efforts to uncover the oracle reveal more than the stars could have predicted.
translations: 在这本青少年小说中，一位双子座的年轻人发现，他小镇的报纸上的占星学部分充满了可怕的预兆。他努力发掘其中的神启，结果揭开的真相比观星所能预测还要可怕得多。

messages.msgid: Fire When You See My Eyes
translations: 当你看到我眼中的火焰
messages.plural: copies of Fire When You See My Eyes

messages.msgid: In a cataclysmic future, advanced technology gives parents access to video footage of every moment of their teenage children's lives.
translations: 故事发生在翻天覆地的未来，高度发达的科技让父母可以随时随地通过视频监控他们叛逆期孩子的生活。

messages.msgid: In this work of young adult fiction, a woman raised on food stamps falls in love with a young cook.  More importantly, she falls in love with the idea of becoming a professional chef.
translations: 在这部青年小说中，一位靠食品券长大的女人爱上了一位年轻的厨师。更重要的是，她爱上了成为一名专业厨师的想法。

messages.plural: copies of Ready When You Are

messages.msgid: When three teenage girls ditch class to drive cross-country together, they get a strong dose of life lessons on the road.  This work of young adult fiction explores how friendships evolve in early adulthood.
translations: 三个十几岁的少女们一起逃课去开车巡游全国，她们在一路上被生活上了不少课。这份青年小说深入探讨了友谊如何是在青少年时期发生演变的。

messages.plural: copies of Study of a Boy

messages.msgid: A high school sophomore's personal journal is stolen and then leaked on social media.  When it goes viral, he is forced to contend with simultaneous fame and betrayal.
translations: 一个高二学生的个人日记被偷，然后被泄露到社交媒体上。当它走红时，他被迫同时与名声和背叛作斗争。

messages.msgid: In this book written primarily for young adults, a woman's modest summer internship results in an incredible discovery that attracts the attention of unsavory elements.
translations: 在这本主要为年轻人写的书中，一位少女在参加一次不太重要的暑期实习时有了一次令人难以置信的发现，吸引了一些不良分子的注意。

messages.plural: copies of In a Dark Place

messages.msgid: Markia dreams about the future.  Theo longs for the past.  Together can they find a way to live in the now?
translations: 马基亚梦想着未来。西奥渴望着过去。他们能一起找到一种生活在当下的方式吗？

messages.msgid: A hard cover book for older teens.  The two main characters pull a cruel prank on their classmates, and are brought together both by their frantic efforts to avoid being caught and their shared sense of guilt.
translations: 一部专为大一点的青少年编写的精装小说。书中讲述了两个主角对他们的同学做恶作剧，以及为了避免被抓所做出的疯狂闹剧和他们共同的负罪感让他们成为挚友的故事。

messages.msgid: A classic tale about growing up, portraying one young man's funny and poignant experiences with life, love, and sex.
translations: 一本关于成长的经典小说，描绘了一个年轻小伙在生活、爱情、性等方面有趣而辛酸的经历。

messages.msgid: Pantheon: The Story of an Iranian Youth
translations: 万神殿：一个伊朗青年的故事
messages.plural: copies of Pantheon: The Story of an Iranian Youth

messages.msgid: A hard cover graphic novel about a young girl living in Iran during the 1980's, seeing the world change around her as Iraq invaded her country.
translations: 一部精装图画小说，内容是关于1980年代一个生活在伊朗的年轻女孩，在国家受到伊拉克入侵时，对周遭世界变迁的见闻。

messages.msgid: An ammo belt consisting of metal linkages which disintegrate upon firing.
translations: 一条由许多金属链节组成的弹药带，射击后解体。

messages.msgid: Goopy white wine, made of the Mycus fruit.
translations: 滑腻的白色果酒，由马卡斯果实酿成。

messages.msgid: A viscous, soft pink wine, made from the fruit of the Marloss.
translations: 一种粘稠、低度数的粉红色酒品，由马洛斯果实制成。

messages.msgid: Sparkling white wine, made from the world's noblest grape.
translations: 一种清新馥郁、有着多层风味的白葡萄酒，产自德国，葡萄挑选精心而严格。

messages.msgid: America's most popular wine, and for good reason.
translations: 一种酒色呈淡金色的白葡萄酒，又称莎当妮葡萄酒，口感非常柔顺且产量高，成为最流行的葡萄酒之一。

messages.msgid: The heavily disputed king of red wines.  Pairs well with red meats and pasta.
translations: 一种口感柔顺细致，风情万种，有"法国葡萄酒皇后"的美称的红酒。

messages.msgid: Prized by collectors and adored by critics, this is one of the rarer and more elegant wines.
translations: 一种更稀有、更优雅的葡萄酒，受到收藏家的珍视和评论家的喜爱。

messages.msgid: A wine popularly used in dishes served in Italian restaurants.
translations: 这是一种意大利餐厅里很受欢迎的葡萄酒。

messages.msgid: A soft wine with a pleasant herbal flavor and aroma.  It is a common cocktail ingredient, and can be used as a substitute for white wine.
translations: 这种柔和的葡萄酒有着舒适的草药香味。常被用作调制鸡尾酒，也可以用于替代白葡萄酒。

messages.msgid: Despite the name, this is technically a strong beer and not wine, but there's no need to be pedantic about it.
translations: 尽管被称作wine，但严格意义上来说，这是一种烈性啤酒而不是葡萄酒，但没有必要对它吹毛求疵。

messages.msgid: A distilled grain alcohol, made from, by, and for real Southern colonels!
translations: 一种经过蒸馏的谷物酿造的高度酒，由真正的南方邦联上校制造，供真正的南部邦联上校享用！

messages.msgid: A beverage of alcohol, water, and not much else.  In America, men make vodka, but in Soviet Russia, vodka makes the man.
translations: 一种除了酒精和水之外而没有其他添加物的高度酒。在美国，是男人们造的伏特加，而在苏联，是伏特加造的男人。

messages.msgid: An alcoholic beverage flavored with juniper berries.  It smells faintly of berries, but mostly booze.
translations: 一种使用杜松浆果调味的酒类饮料。它闻起来有点浆果的味道，但成分中大部分都还是酒。也被称作琴酒。

messages.msgid: A distilled alcoholic beverage made from fermenting molasses.  Drinking it might make you feel like a pirate.  Or not.
translations: 一种经过蒸馏的由糖浆发酵而成的酒类饮料。喝下它也许会让你觉得自己像个海盗。也许不会。

messages.msgid: A distilled alcoholic beverage made from a succulent plant with spiky leaves.  Don't eat the worm!  Wait, there's no worm in this bottle.
translations: 一种经过蒸馏的使用龙舌兰酿成的酒类饮料，龙舌兰汁液丰富且叶子上长有刺。别吃虫子！等等，这瓶酒里没有虫子。（注：墨西哥药酒常用龙舌兰酒泡虫子）

messages.msgid: An orange-flavored liquor used in many mixed drinks.
translations: 一种具有橙子风味的酒，用于多种混合饮料。

messages.msgid: A Japanese alcoholic beverage made by fermenting rice with the use of yeast and koji mold.  This one is mostly clear, as it has been filtered.
translations: 一种用酵母和曲霉菌大米发酵制成日本酒。这份十分清澈，因为已经经过了过滤。

messages.msgid: A Japanese alcoholic beverage made by fermenting rice with the use of yeast and koji mold.  This one has a cloudy white color because of fine rice particles in it, as it has not been filtered.
translations: 一种用酵母和曲霉菌大米发酵制成日本酒。这份由于未经过滤，其中含有细小的大米颗粒，因此呈浑浊的白色。
一种选择酿造材料并不考究、也不精心进行酿造的廉价红酒，但作为酒精饮品，仍有饮用的价值。

messages.msgid: Strong alcoholic drinks, mixed with no regard for taste.
translations: 一种将各类烈酒，毫无品味的混合在一起的混合液体。

messages.msgid: Weak alcoholic drinks, mixed with no regard for taste.
translations: 一种将各类弱酒精饮料，毫无品味的混合在一起的混合液体。

messages.msgid: Cheap booze made from fermented fruit juice.  Tastes as good as it sounds.
translations: 由发酵果汁制成的廉价酒。味道和听起来一样好。

messages.msgid: Wine that has been distilled to a higher proof.  Great as an after-dinner drink, but packs a punch.
translations: 一种由葡萄发酵后经蒸馏而得到的高度酒精，再经橡木桶贮存而成的蒸馏酒，口感猛烈。

messages.msgid: A cocktail made by mixing beer and grenadine syrup.  It's quite sweet.
translations: 一款由啤酒和石榴糖浆混合而成的鸡尾酒。它很甜。

messages.msgid: Sweetened coffee and whiskey topped with milk.  Start your day the closeted alcoholic way!
translations: 一种以爱尔兰威士忌为基酒，配以咖啡为辅料，调制而成的一款鸡尾酒。

messages.msgid: A cocktail made by mixing coffee and pure alcohol, typically moonshine, originating from Scandinavia.  Sometimes sugar is also added.
translations: 一种由咖啡和纯酒精混合而成的鸡尾酒，通常是用来自斯堪的纳维亚半岛的私酿威士忌。有时还会加点糖。

messages.msgid: A cocktail made by mixing black tea and rum, which has its origins in the British Army.
translations: 一种由红茶和朗姆酒混合而成的鸡尾酒，最初起源于英国陆军。

messages.msgid: A blend of incredibly strong-flavored liquors that somehow tastes like none of them.  It contains no tea, but the inclusion of cola gives it a tea-like color.
translations: 一种使用各种烈酒混合而成的鸡尾酒，具有很浓烈风味，尝起来的却不像它们中的任何一种。它实际上不含茶叶成分，不过加入的可乐让它看上去有茶一样的颜色。

messages.msgid: A mix of orange juice and vodka.  It's the surreptitious drunkard mechanic's drink of choice.  A similar drink may be made by substituting cranberry juice for orange juice.
translations: 一种使用橙汁和伏特加混合而成的鸡尾酒。这是那些偷偷摸摸的酒鬼工程师们的首选饮品。用蔓越莓汁代替橙汁也可以制成类似饮品。

messages.msgid: Like apple cider, only with vodka.
translations: 一种将香甜可口的苹果汁与伏特加混合的鸡尾酒，浓烈的伏特加中蕴藏着苹果的味道。

messages.msgid: Suitable for tropical retreats and Canadian artists alike.  In certain variants, whiskey or sake is substituted for rum.
translations: 适合热带度假胜地和加拿大艺术家。在某些变体中，可以用威士忌或清酒代替朗姆酒。

messages.msgid: An early 17th century drink eventually popularized by sailors as a easy ration that contained alcohol and often a dash of sugar.  Though it barely contains any alcohol, it's probably better tasting than water, probably.
translations: 一种17世纪早期的饮料，最终被水手们作为一种含有酒精和少量糖的简单配给品而推广开来。尽管它几乎不包含任何酒精，可能它可能比水更好的品尝。

messages.msgid: A mixed alcoholic drink consisting of gin and tonic water, created in the 19th century as a way to make tonic water (a malaria prophylactic) more palatable, but still popular to this day.  In certain variants, vodka is substituted for gin.
translations: 一种由杜松子酒和汤力水调成的混合酒精饮料，始于19世纪，作为一种使汤力水（一种疟疾预防剂）更可口的方法，但至今仍很流行。在某些变体中，伏特加取代了杜松子酒。

messages.msgid: A cocktail consisting of pineapple juice, coconut milk, and rum, originating in Puerto Rico.  In certain variants, vodka, whiskey, or tequila are substituted for rum.
translations: 一种由菠萝汁、椰汁和朗姆酒调制成的鸡尾酒，源自波多黎各，又称椰林飘香鸡尾酒。在某些变体中，伏特加、威士忌或龙舌兰酒取代了朗姆酒。

messages.msgid: A cocktail consisting of tequila, orange juice, and grenadine syrup, originating from California.  In certain variants, vodka or rum may be substituted for tequila, and pineapple juice may be substituted for orange juice.
translations: 一种由龙舌兰、橙汁和石榴糖浆调制成的鸡尾酒，源自加利福尼亚州。在某些变体中，伏特加或朗姆酒取代了龙舌兰酒，菠萝汁取代了橙汁。

messages.msgid: A generic-brand grain alcohol flavored with hops.  It's best served cold, in a glass, and with a lime - but you're not that lucky.
translations: 一种使用啤酒花调味的无品牌谷物酒。最好是冰过，装在玻璃杯里，配上些柠檬——但你可没那么幸运吧。

messages.msgid: Well-aged honey wine, spiced with a hint of hops.  Goes down bittersweet.
translations: 一种加入了些许啤酒的蜂蜜酒，又苦又甜。

messages.msgid: Homebrewed honey wine, spiced with a bit of hops.  Goes down bittersweet.
translations: 自制蜂蜜酒，加入啤酒花调味，入口苦后回甘。

messages.msgid: Homebrewed honey wine, a smooth and silky golden beverage.
translations: 自制蜂蜜酒，一种入口柔滑的金色饮料。

messages.msgid: Homebrewed spiced honey wine, a tasty beverage that can be served hot or cold.
translations: 自酿香蜜酒，一种冷热皆宜的美味饮料。

messages.msgid: A light and delicious wine made from dandelion flowers.  Slightly effervescent, it is smooth and crisp.
translations: 一种口感清淡的起泡葡萄酒，以蒲公英的花制成，具有精雅的口感，幼滑而又清凉。

messages.msgid: A light and delicious wine made from burdock roots.  Somewhat sweet.
translations: 一种口感清淡的起泡葡萄酒，用牛蒡根制成。有点甜。

messages.msgid: A potent wine flavored with pine resin.  Bold and pungent, its biting taste and strong aroma takes some getting used to.
translations: 一种味道坚实的松脂酒，风格激烈而又泼辣，它那辛辣的口感和浓烈的香气需要你花一点时间来适应。

messages.msgid: Not the finest drink you've had, but hey, it's alcohol by the gallon.
translations: 虽然比不上你所喝过最好的酒，但这玩意的产出至少是按加仑算的。

messages.msgid: Only the strongest, purest, good ol' fashioned hooch, distilled from corn (or pumpkin) and sugar.  Guaranteed to make you forget about the whole Cataclysm thing, or you get your vision back.
translations: 一种经过蒸馏的使用玉米（或者南瓜）和糖酿成的高度酒，最强、最纯、最好的老式烈酒！保证让你忘掉这一切关于灾难的事情，或给你些梦一般的幻象。

messages.msgid: A lager beer imported from Europe.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.
translations: 一种从欧洲进口的拉格淡啤酒。最好是冰过，装在玻璃杯里——但你可没那么幸运吧。

messages.msgid: A tasty domestic craft beer.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.
translations: 一份美味的本地精酿啤酒。最好是冰过，装在玻璃杯里——但你可没那么幸运吧。

messages.msgid: A very flavorful microbrewed beer.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.
translations: 一份富含独特风味的微酿啤酒。最好是冰过，装在玻璃杯里——但你可没那么幸运吧。

messages.msgid: A tasty craft beer, as dark in color as the days ahead.
translations:
一份美味的精酿啤酒。
"就像未来的日子一样黑暗，嗝。"

messages.msgid: A flavorful and filling beer brewed by monks in Belgium.  Best served in a goblet.
translations: 一种源自比利时修道士的果酒，气味丰富又能填饱肚子。最好是能配长脚玻璃杯来饮用。

messages.msgid: A very flavorful beer that has been aged in bourbon barrels.  It is as black as midnight on a moonless night and has the viscosity of oil.  While very tasty, it also has an alcohol content on par with wine.
translations: 一种已经在木桶中存放了很长时间的美味啤酒，它就像无月的午夜一样黑暗，像石油一样粘稠。虽然很美味，但是酒精含量却和葡萄酒相当。

messages.msgid: Strawberries left to ferment with a few other choice ingredients offer up a surprisingly palatable mixture; you barely even have to force yourself to drink it after the first few gulps.
translations: 草莓发酵后与其他一些配料组合成的惊人混合物，在喝下几口后你再也停不下来了。

messages.msgid: This fermented blueberry mixture is surprisingly hearty, though the soup-like consistency is slightly unsettling no matter how much you drink.
translations: 这种发酵蓝莓混合物极其丰盛，然而汤一样的稠度会让你稍微有些担心是否可以畅饮。

messages.msgid: Only the finest whiskey straight from the bung.
translations:
一些由大麦等谷物酿制，在橡木桶中陈酿多年后，调配成43度左右的烈性蒸馏酒，英国人称之为"生命之水"。
"只有刚从酒瓶直接倒出来的威士忌才是最好的。"
爱尔兰单壶式蒸馏威士忌

messages.msgid: A whiskey made from a mixed mash of malted and unmalted barley.
translations: 一种由含麦芽和不含麦芽的大麦混合酿成的威士忌。
一种廉价的混合威士忌。

messages.msgid: A multi-grain liquor made from a mash of corn and rye.
translations: 一种由玉米和黑麦混合酿成的杂粮威士忌酒。

messages.msgid: East India Solera.  A true drink of a British gentleman.  Sherry, Niles?
translations: 一瓶源自东印度的索莱拉陈酿。英国绅士的真正佳酿。"来杯雪莉吗，奈尔斯？"（注：《欢乐一家亲》，1993）

messages.msgid: A fine sherry that has been aged in American oak casks and bottled in Bristol, England.
translations: 一种高端雪利酒，使用美国橡木桶酿造并熟成，在英国布里斯托尔罐装出品。

messages.msgid: Fortified wine from Madeira.  A true Royal Navy drink.
translations: 一瓶加入了烈酒强化的马德拉葡萄酒。皇家海军的真正佳酿。

messages.msgid: This definitely tastes like a hobo drink.
translations: 尝起来就像是流浪汉才会去喝的酒。

messages.msgid: A mix of equal parts wine and cola, originating in Spain in the 1920s.  Tastes better than it sounds.
translations: 等量葡萄酒与可乐的混合物，起源于1920年代的西班牙。尝起来比听起来要好。

messages.msgid: This cocktail dates from the Prohibition era.  Gin, honey and lemon in a delightful mix.
translations: 蜂膝鸡尾酒起源可追溯至禁酒令时期。由琴酒，蜂蜜，柠檬混合而成，十分美味。

messages.msgid: A mixed drink made of whiskey and lemon juice, with sugar added.  In certain variants, gin is substituted for whiskey.
translations: 一种使用威士忌和柠檬汁混合调成的鸡尾酒，加了些糖。在某些变体中，可以用杜松子酒代替威士忌。

messages.msgid: A mixed drink combining bee and ant honey.  It tastes great, and it's a good source of nourishment.
translations: 一种混合了蜂蜜和蚂蚁蜜的饮料。味道很棒，同时也是很好的营养来源。

messages.msgid: Droplet-shaped ant food.  It's like a thick balloon the size of a baseball, filled with sticky liquid.  Unlike bee honey, this has mostly a sour taste, probably because ants feed upon a variety of things.
translations: 水滴状的蚂蚁食物。看起来像是像是个棒球大小的气球，装满了粘稠的液体。和蜂蜜不同，这玩意是酸的，也许是因为蚂蚁的食谱要宽得多。

messages.msgid: Smooth and rich, this spoon-coating mixture of milk, cream, eggs, and booze is a popular traditional holiday drink.  Having been fortified with alcohol, it will keep for a long time.
translations: 顺滑而浓厚，这一由牛奶、奶油和鸡蛋与酒混合而成的、能在勺子上挂住的香甜饮品是流行的传统节日饮品。经过酒精的催化，能够长期保存。

messages.msgid: A popular cocktail made with gin and dry vermouth, dating from the Prohibition era.  In certain variants, vodka or tequila is substituted for gin.
translations: 一种十分流行的鸡尾酒，由杜松子酒和干苦艾酒调制而成，可以追溯至美国的禁酒令时代。在某些变体中，伏特加或龙舌兰酒取代了杜松子酒。

messages.msgid: Tomato juice mixed with vodka and some spices.  A hangover cure of choice for many.
translations: 番茄汁加伏特加和一些香料混合而成，是许多人宿醉疗法的首选。

messages.msgid: This is definitely not tomato juice.
Alcoholic sparkling water infused with delicious fruit.  Perfect for a hot summer day.
translations: 加入了美味水果的酒精气泡水，非常适合炎热的夏日。

messages.msgid: Alcoholic sparkling water infused with delicious fruit.  Perfect for a hot summer day.  Tastes nearly as good as the one in the market.
translations: 加入了美味水果的酒精气泡水，非常适合炎热的夏日。尝起来和超市卖的一样好。

messages.msgid: A baked pumpkin-apple muffin.  Perfect for a fall feast.
translations: 南瓜和苹果制成的烤松饼，秋季盛宴的完美餐点。

messages.msgid: This traditional hazelnut cake (or Bagȣnizabȣnak cake in Abenaki) is a nice, protein-rich treat for cold days.
translations: 这种传统的榛子蛋糕（或阿本拿基语中的Bagȣnizabȣnak蛋糕）是寒冷日子里一种富含蛋白质的美味食物食物。

messages.msgid: A layered pastry dessert made of filo pastry, filled with chopped nuts, and sweetened with syrup or honey.
translations: 一种分层的糕点，由菲洛酥皮制成，内含切碎的坚果，用糖浆或蜂蜜增甜。

messages.msgid: A a French pastry made of a small choux pastry case stacked on top of a larger one, both filled with crème pâtissière, flavored with chocolate.  Each case is topped with a ganache of chocolate, then attached to each other using piped buttercream icing.  Named the religieuse because when made properly, the pastries look like nuns in habits.
translations: 一款法式糕点，它由一大一小两个泡芙堆叠而成，两者里边都填满了巧克力风味的卡仕达酱。每个泡芙顶部都覆盖着巧克力甘纳许（一种奶油） ，然后用裱花的黄油奶油糖霜将它们粘在一起。之所以取名为“religieuse”（意为“修女”），是因为如果制作得当，这款点心看起来就像穿着传统服饰的修女。

messages.msgid: A gâteau St. Honoré is a French cake that incorporates layers of classic puff pastry, balls of choux pastry, and pastry cream.  This cake originated in nineteenth-century France and was named after Saint Honoré, the French patron saint of bakers and pastry chefs.
translations: 一款经典的法式甜点，它巧妙地结合了酥脆的千层酥皮、小巧的泡芙球以及香滑的奶油馅料。这款蛋糕诞生于19世纪的法国，其命名是为了致敬法国面包师与糕点师的守护神——圣奥诺雷。

messages.msgid: These balls of dough have been cut into shape, covered with sugar, and cooked to a crisp.  A staple of fairgrounds everywhere.
translations:
这些面团已被切成形，撒上糖霜，然后炸得松脆。
"在游乐场里，到处都有它！"

messages.msgid: A floury paste that is slowly going bad.  Someday it will be sourdough.
translations: 一团正在慢慢发酵的面糊。总有一天会变成酸面团的。

messages.msgid: After feeding it and caring for it for a week, your sourdough starter is finally ready for the big leagues.
translations: 在细心喂养并照料一个星期后，你的酸面团终于准备好，能正式使用了。

messages.msgid: You've been caring for your starter for a while, but it's going to need longer before you can do anything tasty with it.
translations: 你已经照料这面团一段时间了，但还需要更长的时间，你才能用它做些美食。

messages.msgid: A floury paste with sourdough starter mixed in.  It needs a day to recover its strength before it can be used again.
translations: 一团加入了酸面团的面糊。它需要经过一天发酵复苏，然后才能再次使用。

messages.msgid: The starter is now stinky and bubbly, and looks ready for cooking.
translations: 面团现在酸酸的还冒着泡泡，看上去已经准备好用于烹饪了。

messages.msgid: The starter isn't quite ready to go.
translations: 酸面团还没发酵好，需要等一会才能用。

messages.msgid: A precious mix of flour, water, molds, and bacteria from the air.  When you add flour and water to it, after a few hours it froths and rises.
translations: 一团珍贵的面糊，由面粉、水、霉菌和空气中的细菌混合而成。当你把它加入面粉和水和成面团，几个小时后，面团就会发酵起泡变大。

messages.msgid: Healthy and filling, with a sharper taste and thicker crust than yeast-only bread.
translations: 健康而又能填饱肚子，和纯用酵母发酵的面包相比，味道更强烈，表皮更厚。
一块由面粉简单制成的无酵面饼，可以直接食用但味道不佳，最好用作其它料理之中。

messages.msgid: Delicious fried flatbread.  While it's not pre-contact food, it's a popular treat in many Native American households, especially as ingredient for Indian tacos at Powwows or for Thanksgiving.
translations: 美味的炸面饼。虽然它不是接触前的食物，但在许多美国原住民家庭中是一种很受欢迎的食物，尤其是在Powwows或感恩节时作为印第安玉米饼的原料。

messages.msgid: A humble piece of bread, one of the single most important staple foods of human civilization since the dawn of agriculture.
translations: 一块不起眼的面包，自农业诞生以来人类文明最重要的主食之一。

messages.msgid: Bread cooked with garlic, oil, and seasonings.
translations: 用大蒜、油和调味料烤制的面包。

messages.msgid: A slice of bread with heat applied to crisp it up.  It's a bit dry and would likely go better with some toppings.
translations: 一片加热过的酥脆面包。它有点干，加上一些佐料可能会更好。

messages.msgid: A slice of toast with butter spread on top to make it taste better.
translations: 一片涂了黄油的烤吐司，味道更好。

messages.msgid: A slice of toast with jam added, to make it less dry and to add more flavor.
translations: 一片加了果酱的吐司，没那么干，而且更有风味。

messages.msgid: A slathering of peanut butter gives more heartiness and calories to a slice of toast.
translations: 抹上花生酱让这片吐司变得更暖心，更高热量。

messages.msgid: A cooked egg served inside a piece of toast, not to be confused with the English recipe of the same name.
translations: 熟蛋夹在一片吐司里。不要把它和同名英国菜搞混。

messages.msgid: A slice of toast with peanut butter and jelly on top, with added butter for flavor.
translations: 一片涂有花生酱和果酱的吐司，上面还加上了黄油调味。

messages.msgid: Healthy and filling cornbread, a Native American recipe that quickly became a staple of U.S. cuisine.
translations: 健康又饱腹的玉米面包，一种美国原住民食谱，很快成为了美国餐的主食。

messages.msgid: A dense and tasty fried bread treat.
translations: 一份可口足量的炸面包。

messages.msgid: A round, thin flatbread made from finely ground corn flour.
translations: 圆形的薄饼，由经过细磨的玉米粉制成。

messages.msgid: A round, thin flatbread made from finely ground wheat flour.
translations: 圆形的薄饼，由经过细磨的小麦粉制成。

messages.msgid: A dry, virtually tasteless bread cracker capable of remaining edible without spoilage for vast lengths of time.  So hard it is inedible by itself.  Usually broken into smaller pieces for consumption.
translations: 一种干燥、几乎无味的饼干，可以长时间储存而不用担心变质。 这种饼干非常坚硬，无法直接食用，通常掰成小块才能吃。

messages.msgid: A dry, virtually tasteless bread product capable of remaining edible without spoilage for vast lengths of time.  So hard it is inedible by itself.
translations: 一种干燥的、几乎无味的面包产品，能够长时间保存而不变质。硬到没法直接食用。

messages.msgid: A soggy, virtually tasteless bread product that has soaked up enough water that it won't hurt your teeth when you chew it.
translations: 湿漉漉、几乎无味的面饼，它吸收了足够多的水分，不再硬得咯牙。

messages.msgid: Hardtack's much more palatable descendant, thanks in large part to the addition of milk in the recipe.  Crumbly on the outside, soft on the inside, and delicious all the way through.
