translations: 压缩饼干的后代，但是更可口，很大程度上要归功于配方中添加了牛奶。外面酥脆，里面软软的，总之就是好吃。

messages.msgid: Flour is a commodity these days and to deal with that, most survivors resort to mixing it with leftovers of other ingredients and baking it all into bread.  It's filling, and that's what matters.
translations: 面粉在这些日子越来越珍贵了，所以幸存者们开始把各种东西混进面粉，然后烤成面包。能填肚子当然是最关键的。

messages.msgid: Sweet bread made with molasses, with a consistency closer to cake.
translations: 用糖蜜制成的甜面包，稠度更接近于蛋糕。

messages.msgid: A type of bread popular in Chile and Bolivia.  Prepared using animal lard or oil, it resembles a large, round scone.  In the pre-Cataclysm world, it would usually be filled with savory ingredients.
translations: 一种在智利和玻利维亚很流行的面包。使用动物板油或植物油制成，像一个大的圆形烤饼。在大灾变前的世界里，通常会在其中填满咸香类食材。

messages.msgid: Unfermented Mycus wine.  A goopy white mess, made from Mycus fruit.  It smells sweetly of mushrooms.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的马卡斯酒，滑腻的白色混合物，由马卡斯果实制成。闻起来有蘑菇的香味。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented Marloss wine.  A soft pinkish mess, made from Marloss berries.  It has a strong aroma, but you're not quite sure if it's a good or bad one.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的马洛斯酒。一种柔软的略带粉红色的果酱，由马洛斯莓制成。它有很浓的香气，但你不确定它是好是坏。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented whiskey.  The base of a fine drink.  Not the traditional preparation, but you don't have the time.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的威士忌。一个好的饮料底子，尽管不是传统的制法，但你没有时间酿造它了。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Fermented, but not distilled whiskey.  No longer tastes sweet.  You may want to distill it before drinking.
translations: 已经过发酵，但尚未经过蒸馏的威士忌。尝起来不再甜蜜。你可能想在喝之前蒸馏它一下。

messages.msgid: Unfermented gin mash.  Fermenting it will produce gin.
translations: 未发酵的杜松子酒原汁。发酵会产生杜松子酒。

messages.msgid: Gin wash, after the junipers have had time to add flavor.  Ready to be distilled or drunk as is.
translations: 杜松子酒淡酒，加入的杜松子经过发酵可为其增添风味，可以被进一步蒸馏提纯或者就这样饮用。

messages.msgid: A fine mix of water, koji rice and yeast, ready to be fermented into sake once set in a fermenting vat.
translations: 水、酒曲和酵母搅合在一起，放在罐中发酵，总有一天会变成清酒。

messages.msgid: Brine with mashed soybeans, wheat flour and koji mold added to it.  If you want to make soy sauce from this, the next step would be to let it ferment.
translations: 一份加入了大豆泥、小麦粉和曲霉菌的盐水。如果你想用它做酱油，下一步就是让它发酵。

messages.msgid: Nearly-finished soy sauce that still has some solid particles floating in it.  Still needs to be strained, and also pasteurized to get rid of harmful bacteria.
translations: 接近成品的酱油，仍有一些固体颗粒在其中漂浮着。需要过滤，也需要巴氏杀菌以去除有害细菌。

messages.msgid: Unfermented vodka.  Water with sugar from the enzymatic breakdown of malted grains, or just added in pure form.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的伏特加。发芽的谷物加入酶而酶解成糖，或直接加入纯糖的糖水。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Fermented, but not distilled vodka.  No longer tastes sweet.  You may want to distill it before drinking.
translations: 已经过发酵，但尚未经过蒸馏的伏特加。尝起来不再甜蜜。你可能想在喝之前蒸馏它一下。

messages.msgid: Unfermented rum.  Sugar caramel or molasses brewed into sweet water.  Basically a saccharine soup.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的朗姆酒。焦糖或糖浆煮成的甜水。基本上就是甜水。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Fermented, but not distilled rum.  No longer tastes sweet.  You may want to distill it before drinking.
translations: 已经过发酵，但尚未经过蒸馏的朗姆酒。尝起来不再甜蜜。你可能想在喝之前蒸馏它一下。

messages.msgid: Unfermented fruit wine.  A sweet, boiled juice made from berries or fruit.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的果酒。一种浆果和水果煮汁制成的饮料，尝起来很甜！你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented plain mead.  Diluted honey and yeast.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的普通蜂蜜酒。其实就是稀释的蜂蜜和酵母。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented hopped mead.  Diluted honey cooked with hops for a bitter note, then cooled down and infused with yeast.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的啤酒花蜜酒。被水稀释的蜂蜜与啤酒花一起煮出苦涩的味道，然后冷却并加入酵母。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented spiced mead.  Diluted honey infused with spices and yeast.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的辣味蜂蜜酒。其实就是稀释的蜂蜜加上辣椒和酵母。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented dandelion wine.  A sticky mixture of water, sugar, yeast, and dandelion petals.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的蒲公英起泡酒。由水、糖、酵母和蒲公英花瓣混合而成的粘稠液体。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented burdock wine.  A sticky mixture of water, sugar, yeast, and burdock roots.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的牛蒡酒。由水、糖、酵母和牛蒡根混合而成的粘稠液体。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented pine wine.  A sticky mixture of water, sugar, yeast, and pine resin.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的松针酒。由水、糖、酵母和松树脂混合而成的粘稠液体。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented homebrew beer.  A boiled and chilled mash of malted barley, spiced with some fine hops.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的家酿啤酒。里面有煮熟并冷却的捣碎的大麦麦芽，并加入了品质不错的啤酒花调味。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented seltzer.  A boiled and chilled mash of refined sugar and fruit.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的苏打水。由精制糖和水果煮沸且冷冻制成的糊状物。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Unfermented moonshine.  Just some water, sugar and corn, like good ol' auntie's recipe.  Using pumpkin instead of corn would reduce the amount of extra sugar you need to add.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.
translations: 未发酵的私酿威士忌。只是一些水、糖和玉米，就像好老姑妈的食谱一样。用南瓜代替玉米会减少你需要额外加糖的量。你需要将其放入发酵桶来酿造。

messages.msgid: Fermented, but not distilled moonshine.  Contains all the contaminants you don't want in your moonshine, so you may want to distill it first.
translations: 已经过发酵，但尚未经过蒸馏的私酿威士忌。包含所有你不想留在你的私酿威士忌里的杂质。你可能想在喝之前蒸馏它一下。

messages.msgid: Milk with vinegar and natural rennet added.  Used for making cheese if left in a fermenting vat for some time.
translations: 加了醋与天然凝乳酶的原奶。若在发酵桶里放一段时间，就可以用来制造奶酪。

messages.msgid: A mixture of water, alcohol and fruit juice that will eventually become vinegar when fermented in a vat.
translations: 水，酒精，果汁搅合在一起，放在罐中发酵，总有一天会变成醋。

messages.msgid: A sugary solution with some naturally occurring yeast.  If placed in a fermenting vat and given time, it will eventually produce a more sizeable yeast culture.
translations: 一份含有天然酵母的含糖溶液。如果将其放入发酵桶中并给一点时间，总有一天会变成能用的酵母。

messages.msgid: Malting grain that can be used for brewing.
translations: 发芽的麦粒，可用于酿酒。

messages.msgid: After soaking the grain and waiting, it has finished malting.
translations: 麦粒经过浸泡和等待，它已经发出了麦芽。

messages.msgid: The grain has not malted yet.
Grainy cereal used for malting.  A staple of brewing everywhere.  It can also be ground into flour.
translations: 一些粒状谷物，非常常用的酿酒和主食原料，可以被磨成面粉。

messages.msgid: Soaked dandelions that can be used for brewing.
translations: 浸透的蒲公英，可用于酿酒。

messages.msgid: After soaking the dandelions in boiling water, the juice can be used for making wine.
translations: 蒲公英在沸水中浸泡后，汁液可以用来酿酒。
蒲公英需要浸泡多些时间。

messages.msgid: Dandelions soaked in hot water, used for making dandelion wine.
translations: 用沸水浸泡过的蒲公英，用于制作蒲公英酒。

messages.msgid: Milk inoculated with lactobacillus.  It requires some time fermenting to hopefully end up as delicious yogurt.
translations: 加了乳酸杆菌的原奶。它需要一些时间发酵，希望能最终成为美味的酸奶。

messages.msgid: The milk has finished fermenting and turned into a slightly clumpy yogurt.
translations: 原奶发酵完毕，变成了略带凝块的酸奶。

messages.msgid: A mixture of water, sugar, yeast and sassafras roots that will eventually become root beer, if brewed in a fermenting vat.
translations: 水，糖，酵母和黄樟根搅合在一起，如果在蒸馏器中蒸馏的话，总有一天会变成根汁汽水。

messages.msgid: A raw pair of frog legs.  Tastes like chicken when cooked or smoked.
translations: 一对生的蛙后腿。烹调或熏制之后尝起来像鸡肉。

messages.msgid: An uncooked fish fillet.  Makes a passable meal raw.
translations: 一份生鱼片，生吃起来味道还过得去，但要当心寄生虫。

messages.msgid: A tiny scrap of edible fish.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.
translations: 一小片可食用的鱼肉。虽然不多，但足以应急。

messages.msgid: A cooked fish fillet.  Very nutritious.
translations: 一份煮熟的鱼片，营养非常丰富。

messages.msgid: A chunk of uncooked lobster meat.
translations: 一大块未煮过的龙虾肉。

messages.msgid: A chunk of delicious cooked lobster meat.
translations: 一大块煮熟的美味龙虾肉。

messages.msgid: The raw flesh of a mollusk.  Must be cleaned and cooked before eating.
translations: 软体动物的生肉。食用前必须清洗和煮熟。

messages.msgid: Cooked mollusk meat.  Devoid of any parasites or bacteria due to heat, the only thing left to do is add sauce.
translations: 新煮熟软体动物肉。高温杀死了寄生虫和细菌，只需要加入些酱汁。

messages.msgid: A handful of lucky gastropods that have been prepared for cooking by repeatedly boiling and washing them to remove their mucus and pathogens.
translations: 一把幸运的腹足类动物，通过反复煮沸和清洗以去除黏液和病原体，已经准备好用于烹饪了。

messages.msgid: Cooked gastropods.  A bit low on calories, but high in protein.
translations: 煮熟的腹足类动物肉。热量有点低，但蛋白质含量高。

messages.msgid: The stomach of a human.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 人的胃囊，令人意外的耐磨。

messages.msgid: The stomach of a large humanoid creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 大型人型生物的胃囊，令人意外的耐磨。

messages.msgid: A chunk of raw fat, harvested from a human body.
translations: 一块从人身上切下来的生肥肉。

messages.msgid: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered human fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
translations: 一块清洗后熬制的白色人类脂肪。可以保存很久并食用，而且在很多食物和物品的制造配方中会用到。

messages.msgid: A smooth white block of dry-rendered human fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
translations: 一块干法炼制的白色人类脂肪。可以保存很久并食用，而且在很多食物和物品的制造配方中会用到。

messages.msgid: A chunk of raw meat, butchered from a human body.
translations: 一块生肉，从人类尸体上切割下来的。

messages.msgid: A cooked slice of 'long pig'.  Tastes vary from person to person.
translations: 一片熟制的人肉，口味因人而异。

messages.msgid: A cooked slice of some person, seasoned with black pepper and salt.  Probably has better taste than they did when alive.
translations: 一片用黑胡椒和盐调味的某人的熟切片。这可能比他们活着的时候更有“品味”。

messages.msgid: A chunk of raw meat.  You could eat it as-is, but cooking it is better.
translations: 一块生肉。你可以就这样吃掉，但煮熟更好。

messages.msgid: Blood extracted from a living creature.
A fatty cut of pork from the belly, popular in some cuisine.  With proper technique, it can be used to create bacon.  Not safe to consume in its current raw form.
translations: 一块来自猪肚腩的肥肉，是用来烹饪某些特定菜肴的原料，在经过特殊腌制处理后，也可以用来熏制成培根。不适合直接生吃，加工一下会更安全。

messages.msgid: Porkbelly that has been preserved and flavored with salt and sugar to draw out the moisture from the first layer.  Still raw, it is ready for smoking into bacon.
translations: 用盐和糖腌制并调味过的五花肉，表皮已经略微脱水。仍然是生的，但可以用来熏制培根了。

messages.msgid: A huge slab of uncut smoked bacon.  You can eat it as is, but it would be more efficient to cut it into smaller portions with a knife.
translations: 一大块未切开的熏培根肉。可以直接吃，但用刀把它切片后食用不会太浪费。

messages.msgid: Porkbelly in the process of becoming fully cured with salt and sugar, capable of becoming bacon.  The flavor is slowly developing at this stage, and is significantly unpleasant due to the residual salt.  Activate it once completed to make use of the final product.
translations: 一块正在用盐和糖腌制的五花肉，腌制后能被熏制成培根。在这个阶段，风味物质正在其中缓慢积累，但仍然残留着多到令人咋舌的盐。腌制完成后使用它以获得成品。

messages.msgid: You pat off a bit of extra brine from the slice; this piece of meat is now fully cured.
translations: 你轻轻拍掉肉块上多余的盐水，这块肉现在已经完全熟成了。

messages.msgid: The meat isn't fully cured yet.
translations: 这块肉还没有完全腌好，再等等。

messages.msgid: A tiny scrap of raw meat.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.
translations: 一小块生的碎肉。虽然量不多，但在紧要关头也是肉。

messages.msgid: A tiny scrap of raw human flesh.
A tiny scrap of raw demihuman flesh.
Raw meat from a heavily mutated animal.
translations: 从严重变异的动物身上切下的一块生肉。

messages.msgid: Blood extracted from a heavily mutated creature.
translations: 从严重变异的生物身上提取的血液。

messages.msgid: A tiny scrap of raw meat from a heavily mutated animal.  It smells unappealing, to say the least.
translations: 从严重变异的生物身上切下的一小块生肉。客气点说，闻起来不太诱人。

messages.msgid: Raw meat butchered from the body of a heavily mutated creature that was unsettlingly humanoid in appearance.  It has odd bits of fur and other tissue lodged in it that clearly don't belong.  You'd have to be crazy or starving to eat this.
translations: 从严重变异的人形生物身上切下的生肉块，内部散布着小块毛皮和其它显然不该长出来的组织。除非你疯了，否则在饿死之前你不会考虑吃这个。

messages.msgid: Blood extracted from a heavily mutated human.
translations: 从严重变异的人类身上提取的血液。

messages.msgid: Cooked meat from a heavily mutated humanoid.  Now that the worst bits have been picked out, it's probably digestible, if not very appetizing.
translations: 一块煮熟的变异人肉。里面不好的部分已经被处理干净，虽然倒人胃口，不过大概是可以食用了。

messages.msgid: Cooked meat from a heavily mutated humanoid.  Now that the worst bits have been picked out, it's probably digestible.  It has also been properly seasoned with black pepper and salt, giving it a better taste.  Still, it is somewhat gross, but hey, it's food!
translations: 严重变异的熟人肉，虽然并不是你的熟人。一看就不能吃的部位已经剔除，可以勉强入口。加入了适量的椒盐调味，但还是有点恶心。强杀的人不香，但是可以吃！

messages.msgid: Rotten mutant meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.
translations: 腐烂的变异熏肉，为了保证质量经过烟熏处理，可以长期保存。

messages.msgid: Eugh.  This is a mess of dirt, excreta, connective tissue, and bits of matter like hair and claws, leftover from the butchering process.  Eating it isn't even worth thinking about.
translations: 呕。一团泥土、粪便、结缔组织、以及诸如毛发爪子之类物质的混合物，屠宰之后留下来的残渣。吃下它连想都不要想。

messages.msgid: A chunk of cooked meat.  It's filling and nutritious, but unseasoned and a bit bland.
translations: 一块经过简单烹饪的肉。能够填饱肚子，营养也还丰富，但没有调过味，吃上去有点枯燥乏味。

messages.msgid: A piece of cooked meat, properly seasoned with black pepper and salt.  It's nutritious, yet basic seasoning adds a welcoming taste to this simple dish.
translations: 椒盐熟肉片，制作简单，暖心暖胃，营养和味道一样丰富。

messages.msgid: A chunk of cooked fatty meat.  Although absent of vitamins, it is very filling and delightfully greasy.
translations: 一块刚煮好的猪肚腩肥肉，虽然缺乏维生素，但很管饱且非常油腻。

messages.msgid: A chunk of cooked fatty meat properly seasoned with black pepper and salt.  Although absent of vitamins, it is very filling, tasty and delightfully greasy.
translations: 椒盐熟五花肉。盐之有物，口感丰富，油腻不过度，美味又饱腹，只是缺乏维生素。

messages.msgid: A cooked scrap of meat that has been properly seasoned with pepper and salt.  Yet small, they have a good taste.
translations: 椒盐调味的熟碎肉，味道真挺好，只是有点少。

messages.msgid: A cooked chunk of meat from a mutated animal.
translations: 一块煮熟的变异动物肉。

messages.msgid: A cooked chunk of meat from a mutated animal which has been properly seasoned with black pepper and salt, will keep your hunger away, but even seasoned, it has a weird taste.
translations: 椒盐调味的变异动物熟肉。顶饿，就是味道不太好，虽然已经努力调过了。

messages.msgid: A tiny scrap of cooked mutant meat.  It is small enough that it's hard to tell how disgusting it is.
translations: 一小块煮熟的变异肉。它小到让你很难分辨出它原来有多恶心。

messages.msgid: cooked pepper scrap of mutant meat
messages.plural: cooked pepper scraps of mutant meat

messages.msgid: A tiny scrap of cooked mutant meat properly seasoned with black pepper and salt.  It is small, and even though it has been seasoned, it has a weird taste.
translations: 椒盐调味的熟变异碎肉。尽管味道不太好，而且数量有点少，如果你要饿死了，还得把它当个宝。

messages.msgid: Bone marrow, fully cooked to eliminate any parasites.  Tasty!
translations: 被完全烤熟以消除任何寄生虫的骨髓。好吃！

messages.msgid: Bone marrow, fully cooked to eliminate any parasites and properly seasoned with black pepper and salt.  Tasty!
translations: 熟骨髓，保证已经杀死了寄生虫。烧熟骨髓加调料，入骨椒盐吃不吃？

messages.msgid: A selection of uncooked internal organs and entrails.  Filled with essential vitamins, but most people consider it a bit gross unless it's very carefully prepared.
translations: 一些屠宰时挑选出来的内脏，还未经烹饪。富含必需的维生素，但大多数人认为它有点恶心，除非它经过精心料理。

messages.msgid: A selection of cooked organs and entrails.  Filled with essential vitamins, but pretty unappetizing in this form.
translations: 一些煮熟的器官和内脏。富含必需的维生素，但就以这种形式吃下，令人有些反感。

messages.msgid: An unidentifiable selection of rotted innards that barely hold their form.  It is revolting and certainly no longer healthy to eat.
translations: 一些无法辨认的腐烂内脏，几乎无法保持原来的形状。它看上去令人作呕，当然也不再健康。

messages.msgid: Raw organs from a giant mutant bug.
translations: 从巨大的变异昆虫身上切下的奇怪器官，还是生的。

messages.msgid: A selection of cooked mutant bug organs.  Looks awful, but if you give it a try, you'll find -- that it's worse than it looks.
translations: 一些煮熟的变异昆虫器官。看起来很糟糕，但如果你尝一尝，你会发现——它比看起来更糟糕。

messages.msgid: A mass of entrails and organ meat, preserved in brine.  Packed with essential vitamins, and although it looks like a lab specimen, it actually tastes pretty palatable.
translations: 一份在盐水中保存的内脏和肠子。富含人体所需的各种维生素，虽然它看起来像一个实验室标本，但其实尝起来味道还行。

messages.msgid: Cooked organ meat and entrails, preserved by canning.  Unappetizing, but filled with essential vitamins.
translations: 一份密封在罐头里保存的熟内脏和肠子。看着很恶心，但富含人体所需的各种维生素。

messages.msgid: The stomach of a woodland creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 一个林地生物的胃囊，十分的耐磨，经过加工后可以用作简单的工具，或有其它用途。

messages.msgid: The stomach of a large woodland creature.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 一个大型林地生物的胃囊，十分的耐磨，经过加工后可以用作简单的工具，或有其它用途。

messages.msgid: Salty dried meat that lasts for a long time, but will make you thirsty.
translations: 一块可以长期保存的咸肉干，会使人越吃越渴。

messages.msgid: Salty dried fish that lasts for a long time, but will make you thirsty.
translations: 一块可以长期保存的咸鱼干，会使人越吃越渴。

messages.msgid: Salty dried mollusk that lasts for a long time, but will make you thirsty.
translations: 一块可以长期保存的咸贝肉，会使人越吃越渴。

messages.msgid: Tasty meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.
translations: 一份经过烟熏处理以长期保存的美味熏肉。可进一步烟熏，使其完全脱水。

messages.msgid: Tasty fish that has been heavily smoked for long term preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.
translations: 一份经过烟熏处理以长期保存的美味熏鱼。可进一步烟熏，使其完全脱水。

messages.msgid: Tasty lobster that has been heavily smoked for long term preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.
translations: 一份经过烟熏处理以长期保存的美味熏龙虾。可进一步烟熏，使其完全脱水。

messages.msgid: Tasty mollusk that has been heavily smoked for long term preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.
translations: 一份经过烟熏处理以长期保存的美味熏贝肉。可进一步烟熏，使其完全脱水。

messages.msgid: A portion of lung from an animal.  It's spongy and pink, and spoils very quickly.  It can be a delicacy if properly prepared - but if improperly prepared, it's a chewy lump of flavorless connective tissue.
translations: 一块来自某种动物的肺脏。看上去像粉红色的海绵状物体，而且很容易腐败。如果料理得当，它也能够变成一道美味；但如果料理不当，它就是一大块枯燥乏味的结缔组织。

messages.msgid: A portion of lung from a human.  It's spongy and pink, and spoils very quickly.  It appears to have been extracted too crudely to ever be useful as a transplant.
translations: 一块人肺的一部分。看上去像粉红色的海绵状物体，而且很容易腐败。割取手法太粗糙了，无法用作器官移植。

messages.msgid: A portion of lung from a demihuman being.  It's spongy and pink, and spoils very quickly.
translations: 一块来自类人生物的肺脏。看上去像粉红色的海绵状物体，而且很容易腐败。

messages.msgid: A chewy, grayish lump of flavorless connective tissue.  It doesn't look any tastier than it did raw, but any parasites are all cooked out.
translations: 一块无味且很难嚼的灰色结缔组织。看起来并不比生的好吃，但起码寄生虫都被煮熟了。

messages.msgid: A portion of an animal's heart.  It's tough but not that chewy, and it spoils very quickly.
translations: 一部分动物的心脏。质地很韧，但嚼起来并不费力，而且非常容易变质。

messages.msgid: A portion of heart from a human.  It's tough but not that chewy, and it spoils very quickly.  It appears to have been extracted too crudely to ever be useful as a transplant.
translations: 一部分人类的心脏。质地很韧，但嚼起来并不费力，而且非常容易变质。由于取出方式过于粗暴，无法用于器官移植。

messages.msgid: A portion of heart from a demihuman being.  It's tough but not that chewy, and it spoils very quickly.
translations: 一部分亚人的心脏。质地很韧，但嚼起来并不费力，而且非常容易变质。

messages.msgid: A roasted piece of heart.  It doesn't look any tastier than it did raw, but any parasites are all cooked out.
translations: 一块烤过的心脏切片，看起来并不比生的好吃，但起码寄生虫都被煮熟了。

messages.msgid: piece of raw mutant humanoid heart
messages.plural: pieces of raw mutant humanoid heart

messages.msgid: You're pretty sure this is lung tissue.
translations: 你很确定这是肺脏组织。

messages.msgid: A piece of liver from an animal.  Although many dislike its texture, it's one of the more vitamin-rich parts of the animal.  It is very good in sausages, but maybe a little less appetizing when cooked on its own.
translations: 一块来自某种动物的肝脏。虽然许多人不喜欢这种口感，但它是动物中维生素含量较高的部位之一。制成香肠会很美味，但如果仅仅是煮熟的话，就不那么可口了。

messages.msgid: A piece of liver from a human, which appears to have been extracted too crudely to ever be useful as a transplant.
translations: 一块人肝的一部分。割取手法太粗糙了，无法用作器官移植。

messages.msgid: A chunk of liver from a demihuman being.
translations: 一份从亚人身上切下来的肝脏。

messages.msgid: Chock-full of A- and B-Vitamins!  Cooked liver isn't all that bad, depending on how you feel about the texture, but this is probably the least fancy way to do it.
translations: 一块来自某种动物的肝脏。富含维生素A和维生素B！煮熟的肝脏可能并不是最糟糕的，这取决于你是否喜欢这种口感，但这肯定是最不花哨的烹饪方式。

messages.msgid: A soft, spongy substance found in bones, rich in fat.  Chock-full of good stuff and doesn't taste too bad even raw, but beware of parasites.
translations: 一种柔软的海绵状物质，存在于骨骼中，富含脂肪。包含各种营养，即使生的味道也不会太差，但要提防寄生虫。

messages.msgid: portion of raw human bone marrow
messages.plural: portions of raw human bone marrow

messages.msgid: Soft, spongy marrow tissue from a human bone.
translations: 柔软、海绵状骨髓组织，从人骨中提取得来。

messages.msgid: portion of raw demihuman bone marrow
messages.plural: portions of raw demihuman bone marrow

messages.msgid: Soft, spongy marrow tissue from a demihuman bone.
translations: 柔软、海绵状骨髓组织，从亚人骨中提取得来。

messages.msgid: portion of raw mutant bone marrow
messages.plural: portions of raw mutant bone marrow

messages.msgid: Soft, spongy and oddly-colored marrow tissue from the bone of a heavily mutated animal.
translations: 柔软、海绵状和颜色奇特的骨髓组织，从某种高度变异动物骨骼中提取得来。

messages.msgid: portion of raw mutant human bone marrow
messages.plural: portions of raw mutant human bone marrow

messages.msgid: Soft, spongy and oddly-colored marrow tissue from the bone of a heavily mutated creature that was unsettlingly humanoid in appearance.
translations: 柔软、海绵状和颜色奇特的骨髓组织，从某种高度变异类人生物骨骼中提取得来。

messages.msgid: A chunk of brain from an animal.  You wouldn't want to eat this raw…
translations: 一块来自某种动物的大脑。你可不想生吃这玩意……

messages.msgid: A chunk of brain from a human.  Eating this may cause kuru, but you probably won't live long enough to care about that anyway.
translations: 一块人类大脑。吃这个可能会导致库鲁病，但不管怎么算你都不太可能活得足够长来担心这个。

messages.msgid: A chunk of brain from a demihuman being.  Don't prion diseases cross species barriers?
translations: 一大块类人生物的大脑。朊病毒疾病不是能够跨物种传播的吗？

messages.msgid: Now you can emulate those zombies you love so much!  Preparing brain for eating is challenging, and this doesn't seem to be the best way to do it.
translations: 一块来自某种动物的大脑。现在煮熟后你可以模仿那些你所深爱的丧尸了！如何烹饪大脑很有挑战，而这看上去并不是最好的烹饪方式。

messages.msgid: A chunk of kidney from an animal.  Preparing it for cooking is a challenge unless you want the kitchen to smell strongly of urine.
translations: 一块来自某种动物的肾脏。如何烹饪它是一个挑战，除非你希望整个厨房充满那种强烈的尿骚味。

messages.msgid: A chunk of kidney from a human, which appears to have been extracted too crudely to ever be useful as a transplant.
translations: 一块人肾的一部分。割取手法太粗糙了，无法用作器官移植。

messages.msgid: This is probably a piece of kidney extracted from a demihuman being.
translations: 这可能是从类人生物身上割下的一块肾脏。
一块来自某种动物的肾脏。不，它们不是豆子。

messages.msgid: A piece of the thymus or pancreas of an animal.  These are a delicacy, if prepared properly.
translations: 一块动物的胸腺或胰腺。如果料理得当，会是美味佳肴。

messages.msgid: A piece of the thymus or pancreas of a human, which appears to have been extracted too crudely to ever be useful as a transplant.
translations: 一块人胸腺或是胰腺的一部分。割取手法太粗糙了，无法用作器官移植。

messages.msgid: The consistency of this chunk of organ suggests possibly a thymus or pancreas equivalent.
translations: 这块器官的粘稠度，表明它可能是类人生物的胸腺或胰腺之类的东西。

messages.msgid: Normally a delicacy, but this style of preparation is missing something.
translations: 大体上味道不错，但这种烹饪方式还是缺了什么东西。

messages.msgid: Blood extracted from a human being.
translations: 从人身体中提取的血液。

messages.msgid: A chunk of raw fat.  You could eat it as-is, but it is better used as an ingredient in other foods or projects.
translations: 一块生肥肉。你可以就这么吃掉，但最好经过加工，与其他食材一同使用。

messages.msgid: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered animal fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
translations: 一块清洗后熬制的白色动物脂肪。可以保存很久并食用，而且在很多食物和物品的制造配方中会用到。

messages.msgid: A smooth white block of dry-rendered animal fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
translations: 一块干法炼制的白色动物脂肪。可以保存很久并食用，而且在很多食物和物品的制造配方中会用到。

messages.msgid: A chunk of raw fat butchered from a heavily-mutated animal.  It smells, if anything, even more disgusting than the rest of the mutant.  There are little puddles of unidentified oils dripping from it.
translations: 一块从严重变异的动物身上切下的生脂肪。它闻起来甚至比其他变异部位更恶心。有些不明油脂从中滴落下来形成小滩。

messages.msgid: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered fat, sourced from a mutant animal.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
translations: 一块清洗后熬制的白色变异动物脂肪。可以保存很久并食用，而且在很多食物和物品的制造配方中会用到。

messages.msgid: A smooth white block of dry-rendered fat, sourced from a mutant animal.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
translations: 一块干法炼制的白色变异动物脂肪。可以保存很久并食用，而且在很多食物和物品的制造配方中会用到。

messages.msgid: Raw fat butchered from a heavily-mutated humanoid.
translations: 从一只严重变异的类人生物身上切下的生肥肉。

messages.msgid: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered fat, sourced from a mutant humanoid.  It won't rot for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
translations: 一块清洗后熬制的白色变异人脂肪。可以保存很久并食用，而且在很多食物和物品的制造配方中会用到。

messages.msgid: A smooth white block of dry-rendered fat, sourced from a mutant humanoid.  It won't rot for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
translations: 一块干法炼制的白色变异人脂肪。可以保存很久并食用，而且在很多食物和物品的制造配方中会用到。

messages.msgid: A piece of meat that's obviously unhealthy.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.
translations: 一块散发着恶心的味道的肉，一看就非常不健康。你可以吃，但是会让你中毒。

messages.msgid: A rotted and then shredded arm.  Not much use unless you want to scrape the meat from the bones.
translations: 一根腐烂且碎裂的手臂。没有多大用处，除非你想把腐肉从骨头上刮下来。

messages.msgid: What's left of some zombie's limb.  Most likely a leg based on the proportions.  Though it's rotted, there is quite a bit of meat still on it.
translations: 丧尸残留下来的肢体。根据比例，很可能是一条腿。虽然它已经腐烂了，但上面还带着些腐肉。

messages.msgid: Blood that's obviously unhealthy.  You could drink it, but it will poison you.
translations: 这份血液显然是不健康的。你可以享用，但是会让你中毒。

messages.msgid: A wet, green chunk of spongy goop extracted from a rotten bone.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.
translations: 潮湿的绿色海绵状黏液，从腐烂的骨头中提取得来。你可以吃下它，但它会让你中毒。

messages.msgid: A watery yellow glob of fat from some unnatural creature or other.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.
translations: 一团黄色的浆糊状脂肪，源自某种非自然生物。你可以吃，但是会让你中毒。

messages.msgid: A smooth grayish block of cleaned and rendered monster fat.  It will remain 'fresh' for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many projects.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.
translations: 一块清洗后熬制的灰色怪物脂肪。它会保持"新鲜"很长一段时间，可以作为原料制造许多东西。虽然可以吃，但它会让你中毒。

messages.msgid: A boiled stomach from an animal, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.
translations: 一个煮熟的动物胃囊，看起来丝毫不能引起食欲。

messages.msgid: A boiled stomach from a large humanoid creature, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.
translations: 一个煮熟的人型动物胃囊，看起来丝毫不能引起食欲。

messages.msgid: A small boiled stomach from an animal, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.
translations: 一个煮熟的某种动物的胃，看起来丝毫不能引起食欲。

messages.msgid: A small boiled stomach from a human, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.
translations: 一个煮熟的人胃，看起来丝毫不能引起食欲。

messages.msgid: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from an animal.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.
translations: 一张小心翼翼从动物身上剥下并折叠起来的生皮，你可以加工它以方便储存和鞣制，如果你饿疯了也可以就这样吃掉。

messages.msgid: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from an unnatural creature.  The smell of rot is overwhelming, and it has an ghastly unnatural feeling with a wide variety of cuts, divots, and malformed lumps covering the sickly green-gray skin.  This can't be used for anything useful.
translations: 一块小心折叠的生皮，来自某种非自然的生物。其腐烂的气味令人难以忍受，这块生皮给人一种恐怖而不自然的感觉，外表布满了各种切口、凹陷和畸形的肿块，呈现出病态的灰绿色。这个不能用于任何目的。

messages.msgid: Shredded scraps of raw skin from an unnatural creature.  It can't have much use.
translations: 从怪物身上剥下来的生皮碎片。它没有什么用。

messages.msgid: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a human.  Despite some dubious historical accounts, the usefulness of human skin is limited, and can't be made into leather.  The skin is still edible, if you're that desperate.
translations: 一块小心折叠的生皮，来源于一个人类。尽管有一些可疑的历史记载，但人皮的用途有限，无法制成皮革。如果你真的陷入绝境，它还是可以食用的。

messages.msgid: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a demihuman.  Despite being from a human-enough body, the leather has this distinct unnatural and alien feeling to it, and would be a very poor substitute for leather.  The skin is still edible, if you're that desperate.
translations: 一块小心折叠的生皮，来源于某种类人生物。尽管它来自一个人类相似的身体，但这种皮肤却显然不太自然，给人一种来自外星的感觉，作为皮革的替代品非常不合适。如果你真的陷入绝境，它还是可以食用的。

messages.msgid: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing animal.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.
translations: 一块从有毛皮的动物上仔细地削下来的生皮。还连着毛。你可以加工它来存储并进一步的鞣制，或者直接吃掉它，如果你的肚子里真的是一根毛都没有了的话。

messages.msgid: A carefully folded raw pelt harvested from an unnatural creature.  The smell of rot is overwhelming, with bits of flesh cling to the mangy, sickly patches of fur still present on the pelt.  This can't be used for anything useful.
translations: 一块小心折叠的生皮，来自某种非自然的生物。其腐烂的气味令人难以忍受，这块生皮上仍残留着一些肉块，脏乱不堪，还呈现出病态的斑点。这个不能用于任何目的。

messages.msgid: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing mutant human.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.
translations: 一块从有毛皮的变异人身上仔细地削下来的生皮。还连着毛。你可以加工它来存储并进一步的鞣制，或者直接吃掉它，如果你的肚子里真的是一根毛都没有了的话。

messages.msgid: A thick mass of flesh superficially resembling a mammalian heart.  It's the size of your fist and covered in dimpled grooves.
translations: 一块厚厚的肉，表面看起来像哺乳动物的心脏。它有你的拳头那么大，上面覆盖着多处凹陷。

messages.msgid: A thick, hulking mass of flesh that's easily the size of your head, superficially resembling a mammalian heart and covered in ribbed grooves.  It's still full of whatever passes for blood in jabberwocks, and is heavy in your hands.  After everything you've seen lately, you can't help but remember old sayings about eating the hearts of your enemies…
translations: 一个巨大而沉重的肉块，无疑比你的头还要大，看上去外形和哺乳动物的心脏一个样，上面布满了凸起的纹路。它仍然充满了伽卜沃克的血液，握起来沉甸甸的。在见识过最近所发生的这一切景象后，你不禁想起了那个吃下敌人心脏的传说……

messages.msgid: A huge strip of muscle - all that remains of a putrid heart that has been sliced open and drained of blood.  It could be eaten if you're hungry, but looks *disgusting*.
translations: 一个巨大的肉块——这是将一颗腐化之心割开放血后所残存的部分。如果你实在是饿得发慌的话可以吃掉它，但是看上去*真的*很恶心。

messages.msgid: A tubular leathery organ of an alien creature, comprised of tough muscle tissue.  Dozens of deep ridges make up the slimy surface, like a disgusting rendition of an accordion.
translations: 外星生物的一根管状皮革器官，由坚韧的肌肉组织构成。表面布满数十道深沟，覆盖着黏液，活像手风琴的恶心变体。

messages.msgid: A segmented chitinous shell with curious markings is sheltering a weird alien larva, squirming and wiggling around.  Theorizing what it could eventually turn into, you're unsure if it is safe to keep around.
translations: 布满奇异纹路的节状甲壳内，包裹着一条不断扭动的怪异幼虫。你揣测着它最终会蜕变成什么形态，却不敢确定留着这玩意儿是否安全。

messages.msgid: The fleshy fronds harvested from an alien plant.  Eating these membranous leaves and gut-like stems is likely a terrible idea, and yet they have a paradoxically pleasant and inviting sweet smell.  Might be non-vegan.
translations: 从异界植物上所收获到的肉质叶片。直接吃下这些膜状的叶和肠状的茎也许是个很糟糕的主意，但它们尝起来却有一种自相矛盾的愉悦而诱人的甜味。这玩意可能不适合素食主义者食用。

messages.msgid: The alien beauty of this indigo flower is betrayed by its disgustingly fleshy composition.  What from afar appear to be petals are but layered membranes of transparent veiny flesh, given color by a covering of blue iridescent ichor.  Even if it is certainly poisonous, it has a pleasant medicinal smell to it.
translations: 这朵靛蓝异界花的异样柔美被其令人作呕的肉质成分所辜负。从远处看上去像是花瓣的部分，其实是由近乎透明的血管状血肉组成的多层膜状结构，外表被一层泛蓝的彩虹色脓液染上颜色。即使看上去肯定会含有毒素，它也散发出一股令人愉悦的草药气息。

messages.msgid: Even a close smell of this alien flower feels deeply intoxicating.
translations: 即使是这种异花的浓香也让人陶醉。

messages.msgid: Dry and tough bark matter harvested from an alien plant.  It is slightly translucent, and if placed against the light you can distinguish glistening blue veins running through it.
translations: 从异界植物上所收获到的干燥而坚硬的树皮状物质。它有点半透明，如果放在光线下，你可以分辨出其中所穿过的闪闪发光的蓝色血管状结构。

messages.msgid: The stomach of an intelligent demihuman.  It is surprisingly durable.
translations: 亚人生物的胃囊，令人意外的耐磨。

messages.msgid: Raw fat harvested from a demihuman body.
translations: 一块从亚人身上切下来的肥肉。

messages.msgid: A smooth white block of cleaned and rendered demihuman fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
translations: 一块清洗后熬制的白色亚人脂肪。可以保存很久并食用，而且在很多食物和物品的制造配方中会用到。

messages.msgid: A smooth white block of dry-rendered demihuman fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.
translations: 一块干法炼制的白色亚人脂肪。可以保存很久并食用，而且在很多食物和物品的制造配方中会用到。

messages.msgid: Raw meat butchered from a demihuman body.
translations: 一块从亚人身上切下来的肉。
从亚人身体中提取的血液。

messages.msgid: A cooked slice of something close to being a real person.  Tastes like long pig.
translations: 一份烹熟的亚人肉片，味道尝起来和"长条猪"一样。

messages.msgid: A boiled stomach from a demihuman, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.
translations: 一个煮熟的亚人胃，看起来丝毫不能引起食欲。

messages.msgid: A small boiled stomach from a demihuman, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.
translations: 一个煮熟的亚人胃，看起来丝毫不能引起食欲。

messages.msgid: A piece of mi-go meat that's obviously alien, given its pink color, odd odor, and strange texture.  It would not be advisable to try to eat it.
translations: 一块米戈肉，从它粉红的颜色、古怪的气味和奇特的质地可以看出它显然来自异界。不要尝试吃掉它，这并不明智。

messages.msgid: Goo from inside a mi-go, perhaps some kind of blood?  It's obviously alien, given its pink color and strange, nostril-stinging odor.  It would not be advisable to try to eat it.
translations: 米戈体内的黏液，也许是某种血液？鉴于其粉红的颜色和刺鼻的怪味，显然是外星生物的体液。不要尝试吃掉它，这并不明智。

messages.msgid: An unrecognized structural element from inside a mi-go.  It's strong and springy, somewhat like cartilage, but a bit stiffer.  It's also a deep green color, and might possibly serve a scaffolding role, like bone.
translations: 米戈体内的一种未知结构。它很结实，有弹性，有点像软骨，但有点硬。其颜色深绿，就像骨头一样，能撑起骨架。

messages.msgid: A chunk of raw meat from a bird.  Dangerous to eat as-is.
translations: 一大块飞禽的生肉。照原样生吃很危险。

messages.msgid: A tiny scrap of raw meat from a bird.  You figure that one of these should be about one fifth of a portion.  Dangerous to eat as-is.
translations: 一小块飞禽的生肉。你估计大约只有五分之一肉块的份量。照原样生吃很危险。

messages.msgid: A chunk of bird meat that has been cooked.  Nutritious and safe to eat, but a bit bland.
translations: 一块经过简单烹饪的禽肉。营养也还丰富，而且能安全食用，但吃上去有点枯燥乏味。

messages.msgid: A cut of bird meat that has been cooked with salt and pepper.  The simple addition of spices has made it much more palatable.
translations: 一块用椒盐调味的熟禽肉。简单地添加香料使它更可口。

messages.msgid: A tiny scrap of cooked meat from a bird.  Not very filling, and a bit bland.
translations: 一块经过简单烹饪的碎禽肉。不是很饱，吃上去有点枯燥乏味。

messages.msgid: A tiny scrap of cooked bird meat, seasoned with simple spices.  Makes for a nice high-protein snack.
translations: 一小块用椒盐调味过的碎禽肉。可以当作不错的高蛋白零食。

messages.msgid: Strip of bird meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.
translations: 一条经过烟熏处理以长期保存的禽肉。可进一步烟熏，使其完全脱水。

messages.msgid: A chunk of raw meat with a weirdly off-green coloration.  You could eat it as-is, but are you sure you want to?
translations: 一块颜色诡异，呈淡灰绿色的生肉。你可以直接生吃，但你确定要这样干吗？

messages.msgid: It's cheesy and indulgent, although the mix of tender kernels of corn, veggies, fresh herbs, and a pop of heat keep it in check so it's not too heavy for the apocalypse.
translations: 它看上去富含奶酪而且不甚健康，虽然其中混合了玉米粒，蔬菜，新鲜香草，经过持续加热让它成形，它能让这个大灾变变得不那么沉重。

messages.msgid: This cheesy spinach casserole is cheesy, packed with hearty spinach, and totally delicious.
translations: 这道芝士焗菠菜煲充满了浓郁的菠菜味，而且非常美味。

messages.msgid: Fish noodle casserole is a casserole primarily made with pasta and canned tuna, with canned peas and corn sometimes added.
translations: 金枪鱼烤面是一种主要由意大利面和罐装金枪鱼制成的砂锅面，有时还会加入罐装豌豆和玉米。

messages.msgid: A classic New England casserole made with butter, lobster, and crackers, in roughly that order.
translations: 新英格兰经典砂锅菜，用黄油、龙虾和饼干制作，大致按上面顺序烹饪。

messages.msgid: A good portion of tasty eggplant parmigiana.
translations: 一份美味的帕玛吉娜茄子奶酪烤。

messages.msgid: Foodplace brand Snicker-Snack cereal.  Each tiny "Snicker-Snack" is shaped like human food!
translations: 美食广场™出品的士力点心牌早餐麦片。每份"士力点心"都看上去和人类食品一样！

messages.msgid: This is Foodplace brand "Carpenter Crunch" cereal with the iconic "Breakfast Beaver" mascot on the box.  It tastes kind of like nails.
translations: 美食广场™出品的木匠嘎嘣脆牌早餐麦片，盒子上印着标志性的"早餐河狸"吉祥物。尝起来有点像钉子。

messages.msgid: Foodplace brand "Brantastic" cereal.  An essential part of a complete Bran breakfast.
translations: 美食广场™出品的奇异米糠牌早餐麦片。全米糠早餐的重要组成部分之一。

messages.msgid: Foodplace brand "Sugar Chomps" cereal.  "Chocolate Frosted Crunchy Sugar Chomps: 8 essential vitamins packed into that rich, fudgy taste!"
translations: 美食广场™出品的方糖嚼嚼牌早餐麦片。"裹满巧克力的方糖嚼嚼：8种必须维生素被塞进那丰富而绵软的口味之中！"

messages.msgid: Foodplace brand "Amorphous Honey Pellet" cereal.  The box promises "Inconceivable sustenance in tiny morsels of yellow honey."
translations: 美食广场™出品的"无定形蜂蜜弹丸"牌早餐麦片。盒子上印着一份承诺："一小口黄色的蜂蜜弹丸中包含了难以想象的营养。"

messages.msgid: Foodplace brand Fructose Flakes cereal.  Fortified with energy enriched FoodSyrup™ that supports life most efficiently.
translations: 美食广场™出品的果糖薄碎牌早餐麦片。经过能量丰富的美食糖浆™增强，高效地支撑起你的每日生活。

messages.msgid: Foodplace brand "Foodios" cereal.  Foodios™ are Foodalicious™!
translations: 美食广场™出品的美食晶磨牌早餐麦片。美食晶磨™超级美食美味™！

messages.msgid: Sugary breakfast cereal with marshmallows.  It takes you back to your childhood.
translations: 一盒甜甜的早餐麦片，里面有棉花糖。看着它，童年时光浮现在你眼前。

messages.msgid: Whole-grain wheat cereal.  It's surprisingly good, and allegedly good for your heart.
translations: 全麦麦片，意外地好吃，据称对心脏有益。

messages.msgid: Plain cornflake cereal.  They're not that good, but it beats nothing.
translations: 一盒早餐玉米片。尝起来不太好，但总比什么都没有强。

messages.msgid: Baby cow food, appropriated for human consumption.  Spoils rapidly.
translations: 一份奶牛宝宝的口粮，同时也是人类最古老的天然饮料之一，被誉为"白色血液"的牛奶，含有丰富的营养物质，香浓纯正，但非常容易腐坏。

messages.msgid: Baby cow food, with chocolate added for human enjoyment.  Spoils rapidly.
translations: 曾经是给奶牛宝宝的口粮，现在加入了巧克力供成年人类食用，非常容易腐坏。

messages.msgid: Baby cow food, appropriated for adult humans.  This milk has been reconstituted from powder.  Spoils rapidly.
translations: 奶牛宝宝的口粮，也适合成年人饮用。这份牛奶是用奶粉重新调制而成的，很快就会腐坏。

messages.msgid: This is raw, unhomogenized and unpasteurized milk from a cow.  It couldn't be any fresher unless you drank it straight from the cow, which might upset it.  Depending on your dietary sensibilities, you might want to pasteurize or even boil this before drinking.
translations: 这是一种生的、未经发酵的、未经高温消毒的原奶。除非你直接从牛身上喝，否则没有比它更新鲜的奶了，但这么做可能会使牛不舒服。根据你对饮食的敏感程度，你可能需要在喝前对其进行巴氏杀菌，甚至煮沸。

messages.msgid: This is milk that has been pasteurized at much higher temperatures than normal.  It tastes slightly different, but, unopened, will last far longer than regular milk.
translations: 这是在比常温更高的温度下进行巴氏杀菌的加工奶。它的味道略有不同，但如果不打开，它的保质期将远远长于原奶。

messages.msgid: Milk that's had about 60% of its water removed prior to canning.
This is cultured milk defatted either due to churning or curdling.  Spoils quickly.
translations: 这是由于搅拌或凝结而脱脂的培养乳。很快就会变质。

messages.msgid: Delicious fermented dairy.  It tastes of vanilla.
translations: 美味的发酵乳品。香草口味。

messages.msgid: A yellow stick of milkfat and milk solids, usually made from cow's milk.
translations: 一种黄色的乳脂和乳固体棒，通常由牛奶制成。

messages.msgid: A white stick of raw milkfat and milk solids, made directly from cow's milk.
translations: 一根白色的生乳脂和乳固体棒，由生乳直接制成。

messages.msgid: Clarified butter, free from milk solids and water.  Will last a very long time.
translations: 澄清黄油，不含乳固体和水。能存放很长时间。

messages.msgid: Sugary, fermented dairy.  A wonderful treat.
translations: 加了糖的发酵乳品。简直是上天的恩赐。

messages.msgid: Milk that has been curdled with vinegar and rennet.  It still needs to be salted and drained of whey.
translations: 一些用醋和凝乳酶凝结的凝乳，尚须加盐和滤掉乳清。

messages.msgid: Hard, dry cheese made to last, unlike modern processed cheese.  Will make you thirsty though.
translations: 一份干硬奶酪，不同于现代加工奶酪而是经过许多手序制成的。

messages.msgid: A block of yellow processed cheese.
translations: 一份发酵的牛奶制品，含有丰富的蛋白质、钙、脂肪、磷和维生素等营养成分。

messages.msgid: Unaged curdled milk and whey, made by draining cheese rather than pressing like cheese curds.  The retained whey keeps the curds loose and soft, giving a somewhat soupy texture to this lower calorie variety of cheese.
translations: 未经长时间发酵的的凝固牛奶和乳清，通过沥干奶酪而不是像奶酪凝块那样挤压制成。保留的乳清使奶酪保持松散和柔软，让这种低热量的奶酪品种具有一定的汤状质地。

messages.msgid: Unaged curdled milk and whey, made by draining cheese rather than pressing like cheese curds.  The retained whey keeps the curds loose and soft, giving a somewhat soupy texture to this lower calorie variety of cheese.  By adding fruits to it you've made what might be a full meal.
translations: 未经长时间发酵的的凝固牛奶和乳清，通过沥干奶酪而不是像奶酪凝块那样挤压制成。保留的乳清使奶酪保持松散和柔软，让这种低热量的奶酪品种具有一定的汤状质地。加上水果后，你已经做出了丰盛的一餐。

messages.msgid: Unaged curdled milk and whey, made by draining cheese rather than pressing like cheese curds.  The retained whey keeps the curds loose and soft, giving a somewhat soupy texture to this lower calorie variety of cheese.  By adding savory vegetables to it you've made what might be a full meal.
translations: 未经长时间发酵的的凝固牛奶和乳清，通过沥干奶酪而不是像奶酪凝块那样挤压制成。保留的乳清使奶酪保持松散和柔软，让这种低热量的奶酪品种具有一定的汤状质地。加上美味的蔬菜后，你已经做出了丰盛的一餐。

messages.msgid: A ball of white mozzarella cheese.
translations: 一块白色的马苏里拉奶酪。

messages.msgid: Fried mozzarella cheese sticks, yum.  They lack sauce though.
translations: 炸马苏里拉奶酪条，好吃。不过他们缺少酱汁。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated cheese powder, the kind found in mac & cheese boxes or bulk foods products.  Will keep for an extremely long time.
translations: 脱水奶酪粉，在通心粉、奶酪盒或散装食品里的那种。可以保存很长时间。

messages.msgid: Goopy cheese sauce made by rehydrating cheese powder.
translations: 向奶酪粉中再次加水，制成的粘稠奶酪酱。

messages.msgid: A tortilla filled with cheese and lightly grilled.
translations: 将玉米饼填满奶酪并稍微烤制而成。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated milk powder.  Mix with water to make drinkable milk.
translations: 一些超高纯度奶粉，加水搅拌后就是牛奶。

messages.msgid: Cow's milk that has been partly dehydrated and sweetened.  A key ingredient in many sweets.
translations: 稍微脱水并甜化的牛奶。许多糖果的关键成分。

messages.msgid: Cream that has been whipped, perfect for frosting cakes and pies.
translations: 搅打过的稀奶油，非常适合做糖霜蛋糕和馅饼。

messages.msgid: Cream that has been skimmed from the top of raw milk left to sit.
translations: 一份从生乳表面撇出来的奶油，经过静置浓缩所得到的浓奶油。

messages.msgid: It is an Italian spoon dessert based on savoiardi soaked in coffee and covered with a cream composed of mascarpone and eggs.
translations: 一种意大利甜点，底料是用咖啡过的手指饼干，上面覆盖着由马斯卡彭干酪和鸡蛋组成的奶油。

messages.msgid: A portion of mascarpone, a dairy product obtained from the processing of cream and citric acid, a typical Italian spreadable cheese.
translations: 一份马斯卡彭干酪。马斯卡彭干酪是一种乳制品，由奶油和柠檬酸加工而成，是一种典型的意大利式涂抹用奶酪。

messages.msgid: A slice of pecorino, famous Italian hard cheese used in pasta carbonara.
translations: 一片佩科里诺干酪，意大利著名的硬奶酪，常用于意大利面中。

messages.msgid: Pressed from fresh apples, tasty and nutritious.  This is a non-alcoholic beverage, which sometimes confuses foreigners.  It's instead called 'hard cider' when alcohol is involved.
translations: 新鲜苹果压榨而成，味道鲜美，营养丰富。有时"apple cider"会让外国人感到困惑，但这其实是一种无酒精饮料。当包含酒精时，它会被称为"hard cider"。

messages.msgid: Wait, you can milk almonds?  Not quite, but you can blend them with water!  A dairy-free alternative high in calcium, and one of the big three.
translations: 等等，杏仁也能“挤奶”？严格来说不算，但你可以把它和水一起打成浆。它是无乳制品的替代品，钙含量高，也是“三大植物奶”之一。(豆奶, 杏仁奶, 燕麦奶)

messages.msgid: Wait, you can milk hazelnuts?  Not quite, but you can blend them with water!  A dairy-free alternative high in calcium, and rival to walnut milk.
translations: 等等，榛子能"挤奶"吗？那倒不是，但你可以用榛子和水混合加工成奶！一种不含乳糖的补钙替代品，可与核桃奶媲美。

messages.msgid: Wait, you can milk walnuts?  Not quite, but you can blend them with water!  A dairy-free alternative high in calcium, and rival to hazelnut milk.
translations: 等等，核桃能"挤奶"吗？那倒不是，但你可以用榛子和水混合加工成奶！一种不含乳糖的补钙替代品，可与榛子奶媲美。

messages.msgid: Wait, you can milk soybeans?  Not quite, but you can blend them with water!  A dairy-free alternative high in protein, and one of the big three.
translations: 等等，大豆能"挤奶"吗？那倒不是，但你可以用燕麦和水混合加工成奶！一种不含乳糖的高蛋白替代品，也是三大植物奶之一。

messages.msgid: Wait, you can milk oats?  Not quite, but you can blend them with water!  A dairy-free alternative high in calcium, and one of the big three.
translations: 等等，燕麦能"挤奶"吗？那倒不是，但你可以用燕麦和水混合加工成奶！一种不含乳糖的补钙替代品，也是三大植物奶之一。

messages.msgid: This serving of coffee has twice as much coffee as black coffee, as well as some caffeine pills and sugar for good measure.  You didn't plan to sleep this week anyway, right?
translations: 这份咖啡中含有黑咖啡的两倍咖啡因，还添加了一些咖啡因片和糖。毕竟你这周不打算睡觉，是吧？

messages.msgid: Some wild sarsaparilla root steeped in boiling water.  Energizing.
translations: 一份草药汤，把洋菝葜根茎放入沸水中煮烂制成。让你充满活力。

messages.msgid: A healthy beverage made from bee balm steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to reduce negative effects of common cold or flu.
translations: 香蜂草煮沸得来的有益软饮料。可以用来治疗流感或者普通感冒的不良反应。

messages.msgid: A dense, sweet, creamy sauce, often used in curries.
translations: 又稠又甜的奶油酱，经常用来做咖喱。

messages.msgid: A traditional south Asian mixed-spice tea with milk.
translations: 传统南亚奶茶，混有许多香料。

messages.msgid: A healthy beverage made from chamomile flowers steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to treat insomnia.
translations: 洋甘菊煮沸得来的有益软饮料。可以用来治疗失眠。

messages.msgid: A chocolate-flavored beverage made of artificial flavoring and milk byproducts.  Shelf stable and vaguely appetizing even when lukewarm.
translations: 含有化学添加剂和乳制品的巧克力味饮料。储存期很长，就算没有加热也挺好喝的。

messages.msgid: The morning ritual of the pre-apocalyptic world, created from coffee cherries through a complex process of seed removal, roasting, grinding, and brewing.  Coffee is substantially richer in caffeine than its rival tea.
translations: 曾经在世界末日前是一种早晨仪式，咖啡果经过一系列复杂的除种、烘焙、研磨和调制最终得到的饮品。咖啡比它的对手，茶含有更多的咖啡因。

messages.msgid: Homemade not-coffee created from the Kentucky coffeetree, just like the Meskwaki tribe!  Doesn't actually have any caffeine, and is very bitter, but it'll pass in a pinch.
translations: 由肯塔基咖啡树果实制成的自制非咖啡饮品，就像梅斯克瓦基部落做的一样！实际上它不含咖啡因，而且很苦，但在紧要关头还能用一用。

messages.msgid: Imitation coffee brewed from Kentucky coffeetree, this drink has no caffeine, no sweetener, and is still unpleasantly bitter even with the added milk.
translations: 由肯塔基咖啡树果实制成的自制代咖啡饮品，它不含咖啡因，也没加甜味剂，即使加了牛奶，仍然苦涩难耐。

messages.msgid: The morning ritual of the post-apocalyptic world.  Brewed from the Kentucky coffeetree, this drink has no actual caffeine, but serves as a replacement for those who dearly miss the aroma of real coffee.  Can also be served cold as iced coffee.
translations: 世界末日后的早晨仪式。这种饮品由肯塔基咖啡树果实酿造而成，不含咖啡因，但可以作为替代品来满足那些非常怀念真正咖啡香气的人。也可以冰镇后饮用。

messages.msgid: Some milk with sugar added.  Tastes slightly better.
translations: 一些加了糖的牛奶。味道比不加糖稍稍好一些。

messages.msgid: Milk enriched with protein powder, it's extra healthy and doesn't taste too bad.  It has sugar added, for those who like it sweeter.
translations: 添加了蛋白粉的牛奶，特别健康，味道也不太差。它还加了糖，适合爱喝甜口的人。

messages.msgid: Toasted, ground chicory root steeped in boiling water.  This bitter brew is used as a coffee substitute, though it tastes nothing like coffee.
translations: 将经过烘烤的菊苣根，浸泡在沸水中。这种苦酿被用作咖啡替代品，尽管它尝起来一点也不像咖啡。

messages.msgid: Things go better with cola.  Sugar water with caffeine added.
translations: 一份加有咖啡因的美味汽水，已流行世界百余年，有缓解疲劳、提神醒脑等功效，过量饮用对健康不利。

messages.msgid: It tastes and looks like windshield wiper fluid, but it's loaded to the brim with sugar and caffeine.
translations: 一罐实际上充满了糖和咖啡因，看起来并且尝起来像挡风玻璃的清洗液，过量饮用对健康不利。

messages.msgid: A caffeinated, carbonated drink, flavored with vanilla.
translations: 一份奶油香草口味的汽水，加入了咖啡因，过量饮用对健康不利。

messages.msgid: Made from real Massachusetts cranberries.  Quite sour, but nutritious.
translations: 一份由马萨诸塞州蔓越莓制成的果汁，原汁原味。非常酸，但是营养丰富。

messages.msgid: Mixing cranberry juice and lemon-lime soda works out quite well.
translations: 一份蔓越莓果汁和柠檬苏打的混合液，味道非常不错。

messages.msgid: A healthy beverage made from dandelion roots steeped in boiling water.
translations: 有助健康的草药汤，把蒲公英根茎放入沸水中煮烂制成。

messages.msgid: A healthy beverage made from dandelion and burdock roots steeped in boiling water.  The addition of burdock makes it more nourishing and slightly tastier.
translations: 有助健康的草药汤，把蒲公英和牛蒡根放入沸水中煮烂制成。牛蒡的加入使它更加更健康和美味。

messages.msgid: Smooth and rich, this spoon-coating mixture of milk, eggs, and cinnamon sugar is a popular traditional holiday drink.  This type isn't spiked with alcohol, but it is still delicious.  Meant to be stored cold, it will spoil rapidly.
translations: 顺滑而浓厚，这份由牛奶、鸡蛋和肉桂混合而成的、能在勺子上挂住的香甜混合物是流行的传统节日饮品。这种版本还没有添加酒精，但也足够美味了。需要冷藏，不然会很快变质。

messages.msgid: A heavily-caffeinated soft drink.  Popular among those who need to stay up late working.
translations: 一种含有大量咖啡因的软饮料。在那些需要熬夜工作的人中很受欢迎。

messages.msgid: According to the label, this loathsome-tasting beverage is called ATOMIC POWER THIRST.  Alongside the lengthy health warning, it promises to make the consumer UNCOMFORTABLY ENERGETIC using ELECTROLYTES and THE POWER OF THE ATOM.
translations:
一罐绿色的液体饮料，根据标签，叫做原子动力渴望，除了冗长的健康警告，它承诺可以通过电解质和原子的力量使顾客变得令人不安的充满活力。
"有着令人作呕的味道，散发着诡异的微弱绿光。"

messages.msgid: A healthy beverage made from herbs steeped in boiling water.
translations: 有助健康的草药汤，把草药放入沸水中煮烂制成。

messages.msgid: Also known as hot cocoa, this heated chocolate beverage is perfect for a cold winter day.
translations: 也叫热可可。把巧克力加热融化，寒冬一杯，暖手暖心。

messages.msgid: A sugary drink from Central America infused with rice, milk, and cinnamon.
translations: 一种来自中美洲的含糖饮料，混入了大米、牛奶和肉桂。

messages.msgid: A sweet liquid with a vaguely fruity taste.  Having been pasteurized, it will last for a long time.
translations: 一份带有淡淡水果甜味的液体。经过巴氏杀菌后，可以保持很长一段时间不过期。

messages.msgid: Freshly-squeezed from real fruit!  Tasty and nutritious.
translations: 一些从水果中榨取的液体，富有营养且美味解渴。

messages.msgid: Freshly-squeezed from real pineapples!  Tasty and nutritious.
translations: 一份由菠萝压榨而成的果汁，美味且营养。

messages.msgid: An alcohol-free variant of the pina colada cocktail, consisting of pineapple juice and coconut milk.
translations: 一种无酒精版本的菠萝可乐达鸡尾酒，由菠萝汁和椰汁调制而成。

messages.msgid: An alcohol-free variant of the Bloody Mary cocktail; basically tomato juice mixed with some spices.
translations: 一种无酒精版本的血腥玛丽鸡尾酒；基本上由番茄汁和一些香料混合调制而成。

messages.msgid: An alcohol-free mixed drink made from grenadine syrup and lemon-lime soda, lemonade or orange juice.
translations: 一种不含酒精的混合饮料，由石榴糖浆和柠檬汽水、柠檬水或橙汁制成。

messages.msgid: An alcohol-free mixed drink made from grenadine syrup and cola.
translations: 一种不含酒精的混合饮料，由石榴糖浆和可乐制成。

messages.msgid: Clear juice obtained by cooking fruit in a large volume of water.
translations: 一份将水果在大量水中煮制后获得的澄清果汁。

messages.msgid: Lemon juice mixed with water and sugar to dull the sourness.  Delicious and refreshing.
translations: 一份柠檬汁、糖、水的混合液体，美味爽口又解渴。

messages.msgid: Cheap orange flavored beverage with limited vitamins.
translations: 便宜的橘子味饮料，含有少量维生素。

messages.msgid: Cheap grape flavored beverage with limited vitamins.
translations: 便宜的葡萄味饮料，含有少量维生素。

messages.msgid: Unlike cola this is caffeine free, however it is still carbonated and has plenty of sugar and a lemon-lime taste.
translations: 一份柠檬清爽口味的汽水，与可乐不同的是，它不含咖啡因，但它仍然是碳酸的，并且含有大量的糖分。

messages.msgid: A healthy beverage made from lotus flowers steeped in boiling water.
translations: 有助健康的草药汤，把荷花放入沸水中煮烂制成。

messages.msgid: This semi-bitter chocolate drink made from cocoa, cinnamon, and chilies traces its history to the Maya and Aztecs.  Perfect for a cold winter day.
translations: 这是一种种半带苦味的巧克力饮料，使用可可豆，肉桂，和辣椒混合沸煮而成。这种饮料的历史可以追溯到玛雅和阿兹特克文明的时代。寒冬一杯，暖手暖心。

messages.msgid: Coffee syrup or black coffee mixed into milk.  It's been the state drink of Rhode Island since 1993.
translations: 一种将咖啡，糖混入牛奶中而成的饮品。自1993年起，它就一直是罗得岛州的州立饮品。
一份热茶，加入了冷牛奶。

messages.msgid: Store-bought orange juice.  Refreshing, tasty, and a great source of Vitamin C.
translations: 商店里贩卖的橙汁。清爽可口，富含维生素C。

messages.msgid: Freshly-squeezed from real oranges!  Tasty and nutritious.
Unlike cola this is caffeine free, however it is still carbonated, sweet, and tastes vaguely orange-like.
translations: 一份橘子甜橙口味的汽水，有许多碳酸和糖，过量饮用对健康不利。

messages.msgid: A fragrant and healthy beverage made from pine needles steeped in boiling water.
translations: 有助健康且芳香无比的草药汤，把松针放入沸水中煮烂制成。

messages.msgid: A mass-produced grape flavored beverage of artificial origin.  Good for when you want something that tastes like fruit, but still don't care about your health.
translations: 一个批量生产的普通葡萄味饮料，可以暂时解决对水果的饥渴，但过量饮用对健康不利。

messages.msgid: Freshly-squeezed from the fruit of the Mycus.
translations: 一些从马卡斯果中榨取的果汁，富有营养且美味解渴。

messages.msgid: Like cola, but without caffeine.  Still not that healthy.
translations: 一罐去除了咖啡因、像是可乐的苏打水，但喝多了仍对健康不利。

messages.msgid: Like cola, but without caffeine.  Still not that healthy, but better than the canned stuff.
translations: 像可乐，但没有咖啡因。虽然依旧不是那么健康，但至少比罐装的东西好。

messages.msgid: A carbonated soft drink which contains quinine, giving it a bitter flavor.  Originally used as a prophylactic against malaria, this modern variant is unsuitable for this purpose as it contains much less quinine and is also sweetened.
translations: 一种碳酸软饮料，其中所含有的奎宁使其具有苦味。最初用作预防疟疾的药物，这款现代变种已经不适合用于此目的了，因为它含有的奎宁要少得多，而且还加了甜味剂。

messages.msgid: Originating in Germany almost a century ago, this mix of cola and orange soda tastes great.
translations: 一份由一百年前于德国发明的汽水。将可乐和橘子汽水混合起来的口味令人着迷。

messages.msgid: A flavored drink consisting of a special blend of electrolytes and simple sugars.  It tastes vaguely like fruit with a slight chemical aftertaste.
translations: 一种由电解质和单糖经过特殊混合制成的调味饮料。它尝起来有点像水果，带有轻微的化学品余味。

messages.msgid: A healthy beverage made from spurge flowers steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to prevent asthma attacks.
translations: 有助健康的草药汤，把大戟花放入沸水中煮烂制成。可以用来预防哮喘发作。

messages.msgid: You no longer need to worry about asthma attacks, at least for a while.
translations: 你不再需要担心哮喘发作了，至少短时间内如此。

messages.msgid: A basic oral rehydration therapy drink.  It will rehydrate you faster than water, but tastes like bottled sweat.
translations: 一种口服补液疗法的基本饮品。补水效果比水更快，但味道有点像是瓶装汗水。

messages.msgid: Water with sugar or honey added.  Tastes okay.
translations: 白水里加了点糖或蜂蜜，尝起来还不赖。

messages.msgid: The beverage of gentlemen everywhere, made from applying hot water to oxidized leaves of the tea plant "Camellia sinensis".
translations: 受世界各地绅士欢迎的饮品，由发酵后的茶树叶加开水冲泡而成。

messages.msgid: A bitter tea made by boiling willow bark in water, used since ancient times as a mild painkiller.
translations: 柳树皮在水中煮制的苦茶，自古以来被人用作温和的止痛药。

messages.msgid: Often regarded as folk medicine in some countries, bark tea tastes awful and tends to dry you out, but can help flush out stomach or other gut bugs.
translations: 许多国家都不停实践的土药方，树皮茶难喝的一塌糊涂还会让你更渴，不过你需要洗洗肠子杀杀虫的时候就看它了。

messages.msgid: Contains up to eight vegetables!  Nutritious and tasty.
translations: 含有共计8种蔬菜的田园蔬菜汁，营养又美味。

messages.msgid: Water, the stuff of life, necessary for all kinds of crafting, cleaning, and avoiding an agonizing death by dehydration.  You should boil or purify it before using it as drinking water.
translations: 水，生命之源，是各种工艺、清洁和避免因脱水而痛苦死亡所必需的材料。在将其用作饮用水之前，你应该先把它煮沸或净化。

messages.msgid: Water, the stuff of life.  This water looks like it has quite a bit of life in it in fact, and not the good kind.  You should filter and sterilize it if you want to drink it.
translations: 水，生命的源泉。这水里看起来确实有着许多小生命，但并非有益的那种。如果你想饮用的话，最好先过滤并消毒。

messages.msgid: Fresh, clean water.  Truly the best thing to quench your thirst.
Natural alpine spring water, bottled at the source.
translations: 天然的高山泉水，直接在源头装瓶。

messages.msgid: Fancy mineral water, so fancy it makes you feel fancy just holding it.
translations: 高档矿泉水，非常高档，你光是握着瓶子就能感到它是那么的上档次。

messages.msgid: Made from applying hot water to leaves of the tea plant "Camellia sinensis".  Green tea has a lighter, fresher taste than black and is traditionally preferred in Asian cultures.
translations: 热水冲泡茶树树叶制成的饮品。绿茶比红茶味道更淡、更新鲜，在亚洲文化中传统上更受欢迎。

messages.msgid: A tasty beverage made with herbs and dried fruit from plants other than the tea plant.  While colloquially called 'tea', technically it's an infusion.
translations: 一种美味的饮料，由草药和干果制成，没有用到茶叶。虽然被称为"茶"，但严格来说它只是一种冲泡饮料。

messages.msgid: The morning ritual of the pre-apocalyptic world, created from coffee cherries through a complex process of seed removal, roasting, grinding, and brewing.  Coffee is substantially richer in caffeine than its rival tea.  With added sweetener for better taste.
translations: 曾经在世界末日前是一种早晨仪式，咖啡果经过一系列复杂的除种、烘焙、研磨和调制最终得到的饮品。咖啡比它的对手，茶含有更多的咖啡因。加了甜味剂，口感更佳。

messages.msgid: The beverage of gentlemen everywhere, made from applying hot water to leaves of the tea plant "Camellia sinensis".  With added sweetener for a better taste.  Can also be served cold as iced tea.
translations: 受世界各地绅士欢迎的饮品，用开水冲泡茶树叶制成。加了甜味剂，口感更佳。也可作为冰茶冷饮。

messages.msgid: Hot tea with cold milk and added sweetener.
translations: 一份热茶，加入了冷牛奶和甜味剂。

messages.msgid: Homemade not-coffee created from the Kentucky coffeetree, just like the Meskwaki tribe!  Doesn't actually have any caffeine, but it'll pass in a pinch.  The added sweetener neutralizes the bitterness somewhat.
translations: 由肯塔基咖啡树果实制成的自制非咖啡饮品，就像梅斯克瓦基部落做的一样！实际上它不含咖啡因，但在紧要关头还能用一用。加入了甜味剂，稍稍缓解了苦涩的口感。

messages.msgid: Coffee syrup mixed into milk.  It's been the state drink of Rhode Island since 1993.  With added sweetener for those who like it even sweeter.  Can also be served cold as iced coffee.
translations: 一种将咖啡，糖混入牛奶中而成的饮品。自1993年起，它就一直是罗得岛州的州立饮品。额外加入了甜味剂，现在甜度更爆表了。也可作为冰咖啡冷饮。

messages.msgid: A thick red liquid, made from tomatoes.  Not to everyone's taste, it is a healthy and refreshing drink when chilled.
translations: 浓郁的红色液体，由番茄制成。并非适合所有人的口味，它冷藏后是一种健康而清新的饮料。

messages.msgid: A cold savory yogurt-based beverage popular across Western Asia, Central Asia, Southeastern Europe, North Asia and Eastern Europe.
translations: 一种以酸奶为基础的冷味饮料，流行于西亚、中亚、东南欧、北亚和东欧。

messages.msgid: Things go lighter with Cola Zero!  No sugar, no caffeine, no worries!
translations: 零度可乐，让一切变得更轻松！无糖，无咖啡因，无忧无虑！

messages.msgid: Trofica brand zero-sugar soda with natural orange flavors.  Now with 99% less calories!
translations: Trofica 牌无糖汽水，加入天然橙子风味。卡路里现已减少 99%！

messages.msgid: Trofica brand zero-sugar soda.  Made with all-natural pineapple, kiwi, and passionfruit flavors that taste just like real fruit with none of the real sugar!
translations: Trofica 牌无糖汽水。使用纯天然菠萝、猕猴桃和百香果风味物质，和真水果味道一模一样，而且没有真的糖分！

messages.msgid: Hill Mist 'Puebla Punch', a popular zero-sugar energy drink with enough caffeine to keep you awake but none of the calories that keep you going.  It looks and tastes like blue automotive coolant.
translations: 雾山“普埃布拉冲击”是一种流行的无糖能量饮料，含有足够的咖啡因让你保持清醒，但不含让你保持活力的卡路里。它的外观和味道都像蓝色的汽车冷却剂。

messages.msgid: A curious entry to the diet soda market by Foodplace, the "Refreshing Drink™" tastes just like real human beverages and contains no additives proven to cause diabetes or heart diseases!
translations: 这款“清爽饮品™”是美食广场公司推出的一款奇特饮料，味道就像真正的人类饮料，不含被证明会导致糖尿病或心脏病的添加剂！

messages.msgid: Plain, naturally carbonated mineral water with a subtle bitterness.
translations: 自然碳酸化的平淡矿物质水，有淡淡的苦味。

messages.msgid: Naturally carbonated mineral water with a hint of peach flavoring.
translations: 自然碳酸化的矿物质水，带有一丝桃子风味。

messages.msgid: Naturally carbonated mineral water with pomegranate flavoring.  Fruity and bitter.
translations: 自然碳酸化的矿物质水，带有石榴风味和微微的苦味。

messages.msgid: You've dissolved tablets of disinfecting chemicals in this water to purify it.  Soon it'll be ready to drink.
translations: 你已经在水里溶解了消毒药片，很快就净化完毕能够饮用了。

messages.msgid: After using the tablets and carefully decanting out the resulting clean water, it's ready to drink
translations: 使用药片处理后，小心地倾倒出干净的水，水就可以安全饮用了。

messages.msgid: The chlorine released by the tablets is still working.  You still need to wait a bit before you can drink it.
translations: 净水药片释放的氯正在消毒。 你还得等一会才能喝。

messages.msgid: A minimally seasoned sauce of cooked tomatoes.
translations: 一种由煮熟的番茄制成的酱汁，除此之外没加入其他调味料。

messages.msgid: A water and sugar solution that has been extracted from a maple tree.
translations: 一种从枫树上提取的水和糖的混合溶液。

messages.msgid: A gloppy mix of egg, oil, and salt that is traditionally used to moisten sandwiches.
translations: 一种由鸡蛋、食用油和盐混合而成的粘稠混合物，传统上用于给三明治调味。

messages.msgid: A viscous paste of tomato, salt, and vinegar.
translations: 一种加入了盐和醋调味的粘稠番茄酱。

messages.msgid: Invented in the American south, barbecue sauce is sweet, dark, and full of spices like garlic, pepper, and cayenne.  It's often used in meat dishes as a marinade or condiment.
translations: 这种烧烤酱最早起源于美国南部，甜味浓郁，富含大蒜、胡椒和辣椒等香料。它常被用作肉制品的腌料或调味品。

messages.msgid: A tangy, sweet, and creamy sauce that perfectly complements salads and fried food.
translations: 一种浓郁、甜美的酱汁，看起来有点像奶油，与沙拉和油炸食品完美搭配。

messages.msgid: A condiment made from the seeds of a mustard plant ("Brassica" or "Sinapis"), vinegar, salt, and spices.
translations: 一种使用芥菜种子（黄芥或白芥）、醋、盐和各种香料制成的调味品。

messages.msgid: Honey, that stuff bees make.  This one is "forest honey", a liquid form.  It never spoils, and is good for your digestion.
translations: 一份由蜜蜂酿造的蜂蜜，也就是"森林蜂蜜"，现在处于液态形式。它有助于消化，并且永远不会变质。

messages.msgid: Shockingly tart white vinegar.  This is what you get when you let your booze ferment too long.
translations: 一种酸得掉牙的白醋。当你的酒发酵过头时，就会得到这样的结果。

messages.msgid: Thin yellow vegetable oil used for cooking.
translations: 一些淡黄色的烹饪用油。

messages.msgid: Thin yellow animal oil used for cooking.
translations: 用于烹饪的淡黄色动物油。

messages.msgid: An extremely sugary tar-like syrup, produced by repeatedly boiling the juice of sugarcane or sugar beets.  It has a slightly bitter aftertaste.
translations: 一种富含糖分的焦油状糖浆，通过反复煮沸甘蔗汁或甜菜汁而产生。回味有点苦。

messages.msgid: Extremely sweet syrup made from sugar and pomegranate juice.  It's meant to be mixed with other drinks, rather than drink it as is.
translations: 由糖和石榴汁制成的极甜的糖浆。用于和其它饮料混合，而不是直接喝。

messages.msgid: A spicy grated root vegetable packed in vinegared brine.
translations: 一些磨碎的、加上醋和盐的辛辣根菜。

messages.msgid: A thick syrup made of water and sugar strained through coffee grounds.  Can be used to flavor many foods and beverages.
translations: 水和糖和浓咖啡调制而成的粘稠糖浆，能用来给各种食物和饮料调味。

messages.msgid: Sweet-tasting cloudy liquid extracted from a coconut.
translations: 从椰子中提取的味道甜美的混浊液体。

messages.msgid: Tomato paste of Turkish origin made from pureed in-season tomatoes reduced over the sun or heat.
translations: 源自土耳其的番茄酱，由当季的番茄泥在阳光下或高温下融化而成。

messages.msgid: A molasses-like syrup obtained after condensing juices of grape must.
translations: 凝结葡萄汁后得到的类似于糖浆的液体。

messages.msgid: A nutritious egg laid by a bird.
translations: 一枚由禽类下的营养丰富的蛋，可以加工后作为其它料理，或许还可以孵化出一些有趣的东西。

messages.msgid: A nutritious egg laid by a bird.  This one is unfertilized and probably from a farm.
translations: 一枚由禽类下的营养丰富的蛋。这枚蛋还未受精，可能来自附近的农场。

messages.msgid: A nutritious egg laid by a robin.  The shell is colored a distinctive light blue.
translations: 一枚由知更鸟下的营养丰富的蛋。外壳呈现独特的浅蓝色。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy ant egg, the size of a softball.  Extremely nutritious, but incredibly gross.
translations: 一枚巨大的蚂蚁的卵，有垒球般大，超级有营养，它的蛋白质是牛肉的6倍。如果你是贝爷的话。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy acid ant egg, the size of a softball.  Extremely nutritious, but incredibly gross.
translations: 一个大而重的酸蚂卵，垒球大小。 营养丰富，令人难以置信。

messages.msgid: A fist-sized egg from a giant roach.  Incredibly gross.
translations: 一只大蟑螂生的拳头大小的蛋。看起来十分恶心。

messages.msgid: A fist-sized egg from a plague vector.  Incredibly gross.
translations: 一只瘟疫传染者生的拳头大小的蛋。看起来十分恶心。

messages.msgid: A fist-sized egg from a locust.
translations: 一只蝗虫等昆虫们产下的拳头大小的蛋。

messages.msgid: The still-wet egg of a mutated dragonfly.  Serves as a disgusting substitute for the real thing, just don't let it hatch in the water.
translations: 一些变异蜻蜓产下的湿乎乎的虫卵。可以当成真蛋使用的恶心替代品，最好别让它在水里孵出来。

messages.msgid: The fist-sized egg of a mutant firefly.  Glows faintly in the dark.
translations: 一些变异萤火虫产下的虫卵，有拳头般大小，在暗处会发出微弱的光。

messages.msgid: A large, soft egg of a mutant centipede.  Inside, you can already see a bundle of spindly legs, twitching in anticipation.
translations: 突变蜈蚣的大而柔软的卵。在里面，你已经可以看到一些细长的腿，在中抽搐。

messages.msgid: A white, flexible wasp egg.  It looks like a pristine grain of rice the size of your palm.
translations: 一个白而柔软的黄蜂卵。它看起来像一粒完美的稻米，但有你拳头那么大。

messages.msgid: A huge, translucent beetle egg.  You can see a larva slowly squirming inside, contorting uncomfortably outside of the soil.
translations: 一个巨大的半透明甲虫卵。你可以看到有只幼虫在其中慢慢蠕动，使得外面的土壤令人不安地扭曲着。

messages.msgid: A large, white antlion egg.  There is something hard inside.
translations: 一颗巨大的白色蚁狮卵。里面有只硬东西。

messages.msgid: A large, sticky, and wet water strider egg.  You should probably put it back in the water.
translations: 一颗又大又粘又湿的水黾卵。你也许该把它放回水里。

messages.msgid: A long, white, pill-shaped grasshopper egg.  Inside you can see two twitching legs.
translations: 一颗长长的白色药丸状的蚱蜢卵。你可以看到它里面有两条抽搐的腿。

messages.msgid: A ladybug egg.  It looks like a huge yellow rice grain.  You can see a translucent, hungry larva inside.
translations: 一颗瓢虫卵。它看起来像一颗巨大的黄色米粒。你可以看到里面有一只半透明的饥饿幼虫。

messages.msgid: A mole cricket egg covered in bits of sand and dirt.  It's brown with a few black dots on it.
translations: 一颗覆盖着沙粒和泥土的蝼蛄卵。它外表棕色，上面有几个黑点。

messages.msgid: Praying mantis eggs glued to each other inside a strange-looking case.  It resembles a trilobite or a woodlouse.
translations: 许多螳螂卵粘在一个奇怪的卵鞘里。看上去像只三叶虫或潮虫。

messages.msgid: The egg of a moth fly.
The egg of a house centipede.
The egg of a cellar spider.
The egg of a jumping spider.
The egg of a trapdoor spider.
The egg of a web spider.
The egg of a black widow.
The egg of a wolf spider.
A clump of razorclaw eggs.  A post-Cataclysm delicacy.
translations:
一团利爪怪的卵，大灾变时代的美味。
"末世小神厨系列。"

messages.msgid: Common roe from an unknown fish.
translations: 一只不知道什么品种的鱼生的鱼卵。

messages.msgid: A large half-translucent glob with a mutant fish fry inside.
translations: 一个巨大的半透明卵块，里面有一条变异鱼苗。

messages.msgid: Whole fresh eggs, dehydrated into an easy to store powder.
translations: 新鲜全蛋完全脱水后的粉末，易于储藏。什么蛋？吃不出来。

messages.msgid: Rehydrated eggs.  You can use them instead of eggs when cooking, provided you don't care that they have lost their complete shape.
translations: 用水重新泡发的蛋。你可以用它来代替鸡蛋做饭，只要你不在乎它已经失去了原来的形状。
一块蓬松而美味的炒蛋。

messages.msgid: Tasty scrambled eggs, with seasoning to taste!
translations: 美味的炒蛋，而且加了调味料！

messages.msgid: A hard-boiled egg, still in its shell.  Portable and nutritious!
translations: 一只白煮蛋，壳都没有剥掉。营养全面又便于携带。

messages.msgid: Hard-boiled eggs, mixed into a salad.  Can be made into a sandwich!
translations: 煮熟的鸡蛋，拌在沙拉里。可以做成三明治！

messages.msgid: Sunny-side up eggs fried with a runny yolk and just a bit of crisp on the edges.
translations: 太阳蛋，火候好，边缘焦，中心娇。

messages.msgid: A tasty fried egg, with seasoning added to taste!
translations: 美味的煎蛋，而且加了调味料！

messages.msgid: Deluxe sunny-side up eggs fried with a runny yolk and just a bit of crisp on the edges with cheese or a vegetable, garnish and condiment.
translations: 做成太阳形状的美味煎蛋，边缘焦脆，蛋黄娇嫩，以奶酪或蔬菜为点缀。

messages.msgid: Sunny-side up eggs fried with a runny yolk and just a bit of crisp on the edges.  Made into a sandwich, just like Sunday morning.
translations: 面包轻小，蛋黄娇而巧，蛋白焦脆口感好，仿佛周末清早。

messages.msgid: Deluxe sunny-side up eggs fried with a runny yolk and just a bit of crisp on the edges.  Made into a sandwich, just like Sunday morning.
translations: 做成太阳形状的美味煎蛋，边缘焦脆，蛋黄娇嫩，缀以奶酪或蔬菜，再夹进面包片里，恍若周日的朝阳。

messages.msgid: A fluffy beaten egg pancaked over with cheese inside.
translations: 摊成饼状的松软煎蛋卷，里面包着奶酪。

messages.msgid: A fluffy beaten egg pancaked over with cheese and vegetables inside.
translations: 摊成饼状的松软煎蛋卷，里面包着蔬菜和奶酪。

messages.msgid: A fluffy beaten egg pancaked over with cheese, vegetables, and meat all stuffed inside.  The mother of all omelets.
translations: 摊成饼状的松软煎蛋卷，里面塞满了着奶酪、蔬菜和肉，简直是卷中至尊。

messages.msgid: A simple sandwich with sliced, hard boiled eggs and mayo to balance out the saltiness of the caviar.  Scandinavian breakfast staple.
translations: 一个简单的三明治，夹了切片的煮鸡蛋和蛋黄酱来平衡鱼子酱的咸味。斯堪的纳维亚风早餐的主菜。

messages.msgid: A pickled egg.  Rather salty, but tastes good and lasts for a long time.
translations: 一个腌蛋。有点咸，但是尝起来还不错，保质期很长。

messages.msgid: Roe in the process of becoming fully cured with salt, capable of becoming homemade caviar.  The flavor is slowly developing at this stage, and is currently significantly unpleasant due to the residual salt.  Activate it once completed to make use of the final product.
translations: 正在盐中进行腌制的鱼子，完全腌制后能够变成自制的鱼子酱。现在腌鱼子的风味正在慢慢积累，由于残留的盐分，吃起来非常难受。完成后激活它以获得最终产物。

messages.msgid: You remove the roe from the brine and now have post apocalypse caviar.
translations: 你从盐水中捞出鱼子，在世界末日后做出了鱼子酱。

messages.msgid: The roe isn't fully cured yet.

Fish eggs that have been cured in a salty brine.  Can be vacuum sealed to preserve freshness.  Technically caviar only came from a specific type of Sturgeon roe but the FDA allows all cured fish to be referred to as caviar.
translations: 在咸盐水中腌制过的鱼子，可以真空密封以保持新鲜。从技术上讲，传统的鱼子酱仅使用特定类型的鲟鱼子制作，但FDA允许将所有腌鱼子称为鱼子酱。

messages.msgid: The egg of a water beetle, usually found near aquatic grass.
translations: 一颗水生甲虫的卵，通常在水草附近发现。

messages.msgid: The egg of a water scorpion, usually found near aquatic grass.
translations: 一颗水蝎子的卵，通常在水草附近发现。

messages.msgid: The egg of a butterfly.  They are usually found clustered on leaves.
translations: 一颗蝴蝶卵。它们通常聚集在树叶上。

messages.msgid: The egg of a moth.  They are usually found clustered on leaves.
translations: 飞蛾的卵，通常在叶子上可以成片找到。

messages.msgid: The egg of a cicada.  They are usually found near trees.
translations: 一颗蝉卵。通常在树木附近发现。

messages.msgid: A popular traditional Turkish dish which includes eggs, tomato, green peppers, and spices such as ground black and red pepper cooked in olive oil.
translations: 这是一道受欢迎的土耳其传统菜肴，包括鸡蛋、番茄、青椒和香料，还有用橄榄油煮过的黑胡椒和红胡椒粉。

messages.msgid: A large clump of frog eggs.  They're gelatinous and transparent.
translations: 一大团青蛙卵，呈透明凝胶状。

messages.msgid: This is a dense cluster of dark frog's eggs, not dissimilar in appearance to caviar.
translations: 这是一簇密集的深色蛙卵，外观与鱼子酱无异。

messages.msgid: A thin film of frog eggs floats together atop the water in a roughly circular mass.
translations: 一层薄薄的蛙卵浮在水面上，形成一个大致呈圆形的蛙卵团。

messages.msgid: These eggs float in long strands, drifting in the still water.
translations: 这些卵成长条状漂浮在静止的水面上。

messages.msgid: A spiral strand of frog eggs adorns a patch of underwater vegetation.
translations: 一串螺旋状的蛙卵附着在一片水下植被上。

messages.msgid: A loose grouping of surprisingly few frog's eggs, anchored to submerged vegetation.
translations: 极少量的蛙卵松散地附着在水下植被上。

messages.msgid: A small patch of frog's eggs rests on the water's surface.
translations: 水面上的一小片青蛙卵。

messages.msgid: A tight, spherical cluster of eggs, often found near submerged vegetation.  This cluster is polar, with dark pigment collected near the tops of the eggs and white left on the underside.
translations: 这是一个紧凑的球状鱼卵团，常发现于水下植被附近。此卵团具有极性特征，卵的顶部聚集着深色色素，而底部则保留白色。

messages.msgid: A globular mass of frog's eggs.  The individual eggs are colored a dark brown on top and a yellow-cream on the bottom.
translations: 一团蛙卵，呈球状。每颗卵的上半部为深棕色，下半部则是黄奶油色。

messages.msgid: A thin sheet of clear, gelatinous eggs with dark embryos peppered throughout.
translations: 一片透明的胶状卵膜，散布着许多带有黑色胚胎的小点。

messages.msgid: This softball-sized mass of gooey eggs clings together like a bunch of soft, transparent grapes.  The "seeds" inside these appear to be growing legs.
translations: 这个垒球大小的粘糊糊的卵团紧贴在一起，宛如一串柔软透明的葡萄。卵内的“籽”似乎正在长出腿来。

messages.msgid: Several short strands of tightly clustered black eggs connected together by their viscous coverings.
translations: 几束短小紧密的黑色卵串连在一起，由其粘稠的外表包裹相连。

messages.msgid: A large clump of very large frog eggs.  They're gelatinous, transparent and larger than even chicken's eggs.
translations: 一大团巨大的牛蛙卵。它们呈透明的胶状，甚至比鸡蛋还要大。

messages.msgid: From a distance you could mistake it for a cluster of gigantic caviar.  It is only on close inspection that you can make out the faint translucence of these softball-sized frog eggs.
translations: 从远处看，这个卵块可能会被看错成一团巨大的鱼籽，只有靠近观察才能看出这些是垒球大小的半透明蛙卵。

messages.msgid: A thick flotilla of enormous frog eggs floats together atop the water in a roughly circular mass.
translations: 一片厚厚的巨型蛙卵浮在水面上，形成一个大致呈圆形的蛙卵团。

messages.msgid: Looking like a submerged buoy-line, this long strand of softball-sized, gelatinous eggs floats gently in the still water.
translations: 这一长串垒球大小的胶状蛙卵轻轻地浮在静止的水中，看起来就像一根被淹没的浮标绳。

messages.msgid: This is a spiral strand of giant frog eggs.  Its increased weight and size nearly smothers the submerged vegetation it clings to.
translations: 这是呈螺旋形的一串巨型蛙卵。它巨大的重量和体积几乎要使它附着的水下植物窒息。

messages.msgid: A patch of giant frog's eggs resembling a very thick, clear sack of oranges.
translations: 一块巨型青蛙的卵，像一袋非常厚实且透明的橙子。

messages.msgid: These golfball-sized frog eggs cling together by their sticky membranes.
translations: 这些高尔夫球大小的青蛙卵通过粘性的膜紧紧粘在一起。

messages.msgid: An all-natural cold beverage made with milk and sweeteners.  Tastes great when frozen.
translations: 一种用牛奶和甜味剂制成的全天然冷饮。冷冻后味道更好。

messages.msgid: A milkshake made by freezing a premade mix.  Incredibly sweet.
translations: 通过冷冻预先混合好的材料制成的奶昔。有点太甜了。

messages.msgid: An all-natural cold beverage made with chocolate milk and sweeteners.  Tastes great when frozen.
translations: 一种用巧克力乳和甜味剂制成的全天然冷饮。冷冻后味道更好。

messages.msgid: This milkshake has been enhanced with the addition of candy or fruit.
translations: 添加了糖果或水果的奶昔，更强，更高端。

messages.msgid: This chocolate milkshake has been enhanced with the addition of candy or fruit.
translations: 添加了糖果或水果的巧克力奶昔，更强，更高端。

messages.msgid: An all-natural cold beverage made with lemonade and sweeteners.  Tastes great when frozen.
translations: 一款全天然的冷饮，由柠檬水和甜味剂制成。冰冻后味道更好。

messages.msgid: A summer treat of chopped ice and sweet flavoring!
translations: 包含刨冰和甜味剂的夏日美食！

messages.msgid: Combining snow cones and alcohol, what could go wrong?
translations: 把搭配刨冰的甜味剂换成酒精——能出什么问题呢？

messages.msgid: A sweet, frozen food made with milk and liberal amounts of sugar.
translations: 一种用牛奶和大量糖制成的冰镇甜品。

messages.msgid: Government regulations dictate that since this isn't *technically* ice cream, it can be called a dairy dessert instead.  You can't really taste the difference.
translations: 根据相关政府法规，这份甜点的成分使其不足以被称为"冰淇淋"，最多只能被称为"含乳甜点"。你实在是尝不出来有什么区别。

messages.msgid: A sweet, frozen food made with chocolate milk and liberal amounts of sugar.
translations: 一种用巧克力乳和大量糖制成的冰镇甜品。

messages.msgid: A small cup of frozen dairy dessert that is half chocolate, half vanilla, and all delicious.
translations: 一小杯冷冻奶制甜点，一半是巧克力，一半是香草，非常美味。

messages.msgid: Ice cream with bits of chocolate, caramel, or other sweet candy mixed in.
translations: 一份混入了一点巧克力、焦糖或是其他糖果的冰淇淋。

messages.msgid: Small bits of sweet fruit have been tossed into this ice cream.
translations: 一份混入了许多水果块的冰淇淋。

messages.msgid: A treat made famous on Coney Island, made like ice cream but with egg yolk added in.  Its storing temperature is warmer, and it lasts a little longer than regular ice cream.
translations: 康尼岛著名的冰镇甜品，与冰淇淋很相似，但除了奶油和糖之外还加入了蛋黄酱。它的储存温度略高，保质期也长一些。

messages.msgid: Tarter than ice cream, this is made with yogurt and other dairy products, and is generally lower-fat compared to ice cream.
translations: 略酸的冰淇淋，由酸奶与其他乳制品制成，与普通冰淇淋相比，脂肪含量更低。

messages.msgid: A simple frozen dessert made from water and fruit juice.
translations: 一种简单的冰镇甜点，由水和果汁制成。

messages.msgid: Italian-style ice cream.  It is denser and less airy, giving it a richer flavor and texture.
translations: 意大利式冰淇淋，与一般冰淇淋相比，它的空气含量更少，这带来了更致密的口感，更浓郁的味道。

messages.msgid: It's like strawberry jam, only without sugar.
translations: 这就像草莓果酱，只是不加糖。

messages.msgid: Dried strips of sugary fruit paste.
translations: 一些甜甜的条状果泥干，由水果碾成泥再做成片状，利于保存，口感独特。

messages.msgid: It's like blueberry jam, only without sugar.
translations: 这就像蓝莓果酱，只是不加糖。

messages.msgid: Yellow cling peach slices packed in light syrup.
translations:
一些切碎的黄桃堆叠在糖水中。
"水果罐头之王正在安静的躺着休息。"

messages.msgid: Canned pineapple rings in water.  Quite tasty.
translations: 糖水菠萝罐头，蛮好吃的。

messages.msgid: Tangy yellow powder that smells strongly of lemons.  Can be mixed with water to make lemonade.
translations: 一些有着浓烈的柠檬气味的深黄色粉末，加水冲调即成柠檬水。

messages.msgid: Can be mixed with water to make orange juice.
translations: 可以加水冲泡制作橙汁。

messages.msgid: Can be mixed with water to make grape juice.
translations: 可以加水冲泡制作葡萄汁。

messages.msgid: It's like fruit jam, only without sugar.
translations: 一些煮熟的水果，看上去就像果酱一样，但还没有加入糖。

messages.msgid: Fresh fruit cooked with sugar to make it last longer.
translations: 一些加糖熬煮后使保质期更长、更利于保存的酱状水果。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated fruit flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.  They are useful for several cooking recipes.
translations: 一些片状脱水水果，如果储存妥善，这种干燥的食物可以保存非常长的时间。

messages.msgid: Reconstituted fruit flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的水果片，泡过水再吃更美味了。

messages.msgid: Fruit slices soaked in a sugar syrup to preserve freshness and appearance.
translations: 水果片浸泡在糖水里，以保持新鲜和美观。

messages.msgid: This sodden mass of preserved fruit was boiled and canned in an earlier life.  Bland, mushy, and losing its color.
translations: 一团被煮的湿漉漉的水果，在刚煮熟的时候就用罐头封装密封。淡而无味，软成糊状而且失去了原有的色泽。

messages.msgid: A festive autumnal bread with a golden color in either rolls or sliced loaves of bread.
translations: 一种金黄色的秋日庆典面包，可以是面包卷或是切片长面包的形状。

messages.msgid: An old recipe from the American Civil War, designed to make hardtack more palatable.  The hardtack is crushed and combined with water and flour to make dough, followed by kneading in pieces of fruit.  The dough is then boiled into bread pudding chunks and topped with sweeteners.  Soldiers would call this a dessert.
translations: 美国内战时期的老菜谱，旨在使压缩饼干更加美味。将压缩饼干碾碎并与水和面粉混合制成面团，与水果丁揉在一起。然后将面团煮成面包布丁块，并在上面撒上甜味剂。士兵们会称之为甜点。

messages.msgid: Chopped Jerusalem artichoke combined with any fruit that is in season or at hand.  Surprisingly tasty.
translations: 切碎的洋姜与当季或者手头刚好有的水果结合在一起。出乎意料地美味。

messages.msgid: Whole fruits preserved in 40 proof or higher alcohol.
translations: 一个完整的水果被保存在40度或更高的酒精中。

messages.msgid: A dry toaster pastry coated with solid frosting.  This one is strawberry flavored, what luck!
translations: 洒满糖霜的干烤面包糕点。这个是草莓味的，运气真不错！

messages.msgid: A dry toaster pastry coated with solid frosting.  This one is blueberry flavored!
translations: 洒满糖霜的干烤面包糕点。这个是蓝莓味的！

messages.msgid: A dry toaster pasty, usually coated with solid frosting.  Sadly, this one is not.
translations: 干烤的面包糕点，通常都会洒满糖霜。可惜的是，这个没有。

messages.msgid: A homemade toaster pastry, filled with fruit but lacking icing.
translations: 自制的面包糕点，里面装满了水果，但没有糖霜。

messages.msgid: A delicious fruit-filled pastry that you can cook in your toaster.  It even comes with frosting!  Cook it to make it tastier.
