translations: 一个可以在烤面包机里烤制的夹心水果面包，上面还带着糖霜！加热后更美味。

messages.msgid: A delicious fruit-filled pastry that you've cooked.  It even comes with frosting!
translations: 一个被你加热过的美味夹心水果面包，上面甚至还有糖霜！

messages.msgid: A delicious homemade fruit-filled pastry that you've cooked.
translations: 一份你自己做的美味自制烤夹心面包。

messages.msgid: A delicious homemade fruit-filled pastry that you've cooked.  It even comes with buttercream!
translations: 一份你自己做的美味自制烤夹心面包，上面甚至还有奶油！

messages.msgid: Smooth, sugary buttercream icing.  Almost good enough to forget the end of everything.
translations: 一份光滑的含糖奶油糖霜。几乎足以让你忘记万物的终结。

messages.msgid: A handful of plain, salted potato chips.
translations: 一把朴素的加盐马铃薯片。

messages.msgid: Oh man, you love these chips!  Score!
translations:
哦，你喜欢这些薯片！
"球进了！"

messages.msgid: A handful of tiny, heavily-salted bread twists.  A tasty treat, but they'll make you thirsty.
translations: 一把小小的咸味饼干。十分美味的小吃，但它们会让你口渴。

messages.msgid: A handful of tiny bread twists covered in chocolate.
translations: 一把小小的咸味饼干，被覆盖了一层巧克力。

messages.msgid: A bar of chocolate from a popular candy brand.  A delicious treat.
translations: 来自流行糖果品牌的巧克力棒。美味的小吃。

messages.msgid: A handful of squishy, fluffy, puffy, delicious marshmallows.
translations: 一小撮的粘糊糊的、毛绒绒的、蓬松的、美味的棉花糖。

messages.msgid: A pair of graham crackers with some chocolate and a marshmallow between them.
translations: 一份巧克力与棉花糖味的全麦夹心饼干。

messages.msgid: A handful of peanut butter cups… your favorite!
translations: 一把花生酱杯巧克力，你的最爱！

messages.msgid: A handful of colorful chocolate-filled candies.
A handful of colorful fruit-flavored chewy candies.
translations: 一把五颜六色的水果味糖果，很有嚼劲。

messages.msgid: A handful of colorful fruit- and soda-flavored gummy candies.
translations: 一把五颜六色的水果味和苏打味的软糖。

messages.msgid: A handful of colorful fruit- and soda-flavored vegan gummy candies made from agar instead of animal gelatin.  They have kind of a strange texture, but they're still tasty.
translations: 一把五颜六色的水果味和苏打味的琼脂软糖，使用植物制成，而不是动物明胶。它们有一种奇怪的质感，但仍然很好吃。

messages.msgid: A handful of colorful fruit-flavored chewy candies shaped in a reptilian fashion.  Made by SugarRush.
translations: 一把五颜六色的果味耐嚼糖果，做成了两牺爬行动物的外形。由SugarRush公司出品。

messages.msgid: A handful of chocolate candies shaped like cows.
translations: 一把奶牛形状的巧克力糖果。

messages.msgid: A swirly confectionary treat in strings of sweet-tasting candy.
translations: 一个由甘甜美味的长条形糖果卷成的漩涡状糖果。

messages.msgid: Thin paper tubes of sweet & sour candy powder.  Who thinks of this stuff?
translations:
一根小纸管里装满了酸酸甜甜的糖粉。
"是谁发明出这玩意的？"

messages.msgid: A candy bracelet made by stringing candies onto a thread.  In theory, you could both wear and eat the bracelet.
translations: 将糖果串在一根线上制成的糖果手链。理论上，你可以一边戴一边吃。

messages.msgid: A handful of golden, translucent leaf candies made with pure maple syrup.  They melt slowly in your mouth as you savor the taste of real maple.
translations: 一把用纯枫树糖浆制成的金色半透明叶状糖果。正宗枫树的味道会随着糖果在你的嘴里慢慢融化。

messages.msgid: These dry, sugary crackers will leave you thirsty, but they go well with some chocolate and marshmallows.
translations: 又干又甜的饼干，会让你口渴，但适合与巧克力和棉花糖搭配。

messages.msgid: These dry, sugary cracker pellets will leave you thirsty, and they're not the right size to make s'mores with.  Made by SugarRush!
translations: 又干又甜的小块饼干，会让你口渴，且尺寸也不适合用来制作巧克力棉花糖饼干。由SugarRush公司出品！

messages.msgid: A sweet, delicious cookie, just like grandma used to bake.
translations: 香甜可口的饼干，就像奶奶烤的一样。

messages.msgid: A sweet, delicious cookie, shaped like an egg.  Made by SugarRush!
translations: 香甜可口的饼干，形状像蛋一样。由SugarRush公司出品！

messages.msgid: Boiling the sap of a maple tree has concentrated it into this sweet, delicious maple syrup.
translations: 通过把枫树的汁液煮沸，浓缩而成的香甜可口的枫糖浆。

messages.msgid: A thick syrup produced from shredded sugar beets.  Useful in cooking as a sweetener.
translations: 切碎的甜菜所熬制生产的糖浆。用于烹饪时作为甜味剂。

messages.msgid: A simple syrup, made of just sugar and water.  Used usually as a sweetener for stuff like cocktails.
translations: 一种简易糖浆，仅由糖和水制成。通常用作鸡尾酒等饮品的甜味剂。
从玉米中提取制得的糖浆。

messages.msgid: Delicious sponge cake with buttercream icing.  Happy Birthday is written on top in frosting.
translations: 一份裹上了香浓糖衣的新鲜蛋糕，里面还有满满的奶油。糖霜顶上还写着"生日快乐"。

messages.msgid: Delicious chocolate cake.  It has all the icing.  All of it.
translations: 一块美味的巧克力蛋糕，糖霜都在，应有尽有。

messages.msgid: A cake coated in the thickest icing you've ever seen.  Someone has written guff in quotation marks on it…
translations: 这个蛋糕上的糖霜厚得让你看一眼就恶心。有人在上面写了些什么，看起来像是在胡说八道……

messages.msgid: This unholy confection of delight does not lie, it packs a heavenly amount of calories in each sinful bite.  For debug use only.
translations: 这份不圣洁的甜美点心绝不虚假，每一口罪恶的享受中都蕴含着天堂般的热量。仅供调试使用。

messages.msgid: Roasted coffee beans coated with dark chocolate, a natural source of concentrated caffeine.
translations: 一些黑巧克力咖啡豆，来自自然的满满的咖啡因享受。

messages.msgid: Salty, deep-fried potatoes from a fast food restaurant.
translations: 来自快餐店的咸味炸土豆。

messages.msgid: Homemade deep-fried potatoes or other tubers, with a touch of salt.  Crunchy and delicious.
translations: 一些加有少许盐的自制油炸马铃薯（或者其它块茎作物），酥脆美味。

messages.msgid: Homemade deep-fried potatoes cut long and thin, with a touch of salt.  These were somewhat of a fad before the world ended.  Crunchy and delicious.
A serving of fries, covered in cheese curds and hot gravy.  While cheese curds are more appropriate and traditional, some other cheeses may be used.  A Canadian staple.
translations: 一份覆盖着奶酪凝乳和热肉汁的薯条。虽然奶酪凝乳更合适也更传统，但也可以使用其他一些奶酪。加拿大主食。

messages.msgid: A handful of soft, chocolate-covered peppermint patties… yum!
translations: 一把被软巧克力包裹着的薄荷馅饼，味道好极了！

messages.msgid: A handful of candy wafers in assorted flavors: orange, lemon, lime, clove, chocolate, wintergreen, cinnamon, and licorice.  Yum!
translations: 一大包糖果，什锦口味：橙，柠檬，青柠，丁香，巧克力，冬青，桂皮，甘草，非常美味。"Yum!"

messages.msgid: Flavored sugar sticks designed to look like cigarettes.  Anti-smoking reports from the Surgeon General have caused a pretty big drop in their popularity since the 1960s.
translations: 设计成香烟形状的风味糖棒。自1960年代以来，外科医生的反吸烟报告导致其流行程度大幅下降。

messages.msgid: Some caramel.  Sticky and sweet, but not very exciting by itself.
translations: 一些焦糖。粘稠而甜美，但它本身并不是很令人兴奋。

messages.msgid: A caramel-covered apple.  Best served on an autumn day, at a harvest fair, on a stick - but those days are long gone.
translations: 焦糖覆盖的苹果。最好是在某个秋日，在丰收博览会上，串在棍子上吃——但那些日子早已一去不复返了。
一份油炸的、一片接着一片的马铃薯片。

messages.msgid: Salted chips made from corn tortillas.  They're not bad on their own, but they could really use some cheese, maybe some meat.
translations: 墨西哥式调味玉米片。单独吃起来也不错，不过再来点奶酪，或者是加点肉就更棒了。

messages.msgid: Salted chips made from corn tortillas, with cheese melted on top.  Could stand to have some meat.
translations: 墨西哥式调味玉米片，一层奶酪熔化在上面。再来点肉就更棒了。

messages.msgid: Salted chips made from corn tortillas, with ground meat on top.  Could probably use some cheese, though.
translations: 墨西哥式调味玉米片，上面有碎肉。再来点奶酪就更棒了。

messages.msgid: Salted chips made from corn tortillas smothered in cheese and ground meat.  Delicious.
translations: 墨西哥式调味玉米片，裹着奶酪和碎肉。十分可口。
尼伯龙根奶酪辣味玉米片
变异肉奶酪辣味玉米片

messages.msgid: Salted chips made from corn tortillas, with beans on top.  Could probably use some cheese, though.
translations: 墨西哥式调味玉米片，上面加有豆子。再来点奶酪就更棒了。

messages.msgid: Salted chips made from corn tortillas, smothered in cheese and beans.  Delicious, even if you're not a vegetarian.
translations: 墨西哥式调味玉米片，裹着奶酪和豆子。即使你不是素食主义者，它也十分美味。

messages.msgid: Salty dried pork.  Tastes good, but it will make you thirsty.
translations: 一份咸猪肉干，略咸，口感不错，可以保存很久。

messages.msgid: A small, microwavable steak & cheese burrito, like those found at gas stations.
translations: 微波食品的一种——小分量的牛排、奶酪与玉米煎饼装在一个盒子里，大多数加油站有售。

messages.msgid: Now with ONE POUND of meat and ONE POUND of carbs!  Not as appetizing as it would be if heated up.
translations: 一磅的肉类加上一磅的碳水化合物，看起来并不是那么可口的样子，如果能加热一下就好了。

messages.msgid: Now with ONE POUND of meat and ONE POUND of carbs!  Now that it's been heated up, it's much tastier but will also spoil more quickly.
translations: 一磅多汁的肉类加上一磅香喷喷的碳水化合物！新鲜出炉，风味更佳，但也会更快变质。

messages.msgid: Fast-food chicken, deep-fried in oil.  It's greasy and delicious.
translations: 将鸡肉完全浸泡在油中炸熟而成的快餐食品。油腻但可口。

messages.msgid: A hot dog with chili con carne on top.  Yum!
translations: 一根盖有辣肉酱的热狗，香辣可口。

messages.msgid: A heavily processed sausage, dipped in batter and deep-fried.  It would taste much better cooked.
translations: 一份经过深加工的香肠，裹在面糊里炸熟的生热狗，可以直接食用，但加热一下会更好。

messages.msgid: A heavily processed sausage, dipped in batter and deep-fried.  Now that it's been cooked, this corn dog tastes much better, but will spoil faster.
translations: 一份经过深加工的香肠，裹在面糊里炸熟的热狗，比起生的尝起来更棒。

messages.msgid: A homemade sausage, dipped in batter and deep fried.
translations: 一根蘸上面糊油炸而成的自制香肠。

messages.msgid: Fluffy and delicious pancakes with real maple syrup, with delicious chocolate baked right in.
translations: 松软的美味烤饼浇上货真价实的枫糖浆，更不用提那饼皮下香气扑鼻的巧克力。

messages.msgid: Crunchy and delicious waffles with real maple syrup, with delicious chocolate baked right in.
translations: 嘎嘣脆的美味华夫饼浇上枫糖浆，配上巧克力使它更甜、更不健康。
一些精制的奶酪酱，可涂抹在饼干上或用作其他料理。

messages.msgid: Fried potatoes with delicious cheese smothered on top.
translations: 一些油炸薯条，上面裹着一层奶酪。

messages.msgid: Battered and fried onions.  Crunchy and delicious.
translations: 一堆裹着面糊油炸过的洋葱圈。香脆可口。

messages.msgid: A heavily processed sausage, commonplace at baseball games before the Cataclysm.  It would taste much better cooked.
translations: 一个高度加工的香肠，常见于各个快餐行业之中或者棒球赛的看台上。加热后口感更佳。

messages.msgid: A simple hot dog, cooked over an open fire.  Would be better on a bun, but it's quite an improvement over eating it uncooked.
translations: 一份经过简单的明火烤熟加工的热狗，味道尝起来显然没有裹上面包与其他调料的更好，但作为充饥品已经非常不错了。

messages.msgid: Surprisingly, not made from dog.  Now that it's been cooked, this hot dog tastes much better, but will spoil faster.
translations: 一份经过加热的热狗，已经做熟了，尝起来更棒，但也更容易变质。

messages.msgid: What's better than a hot dog?  A hot dog smothered in ground meat and chopped onions, of course!
translations: 还能有什么比热狗更美味的呢？当然是铺着厚厚一层碎肉和洋葱的热狗！

messages.msgid: Crunchy sugar in chocolate capsules.  The malt gives them a distinct, yet delicious flavor.
translations: 一份表面被巧克力包裹的松脆糖果。其中所含的麦芽给它们带来一种独特而美味的味道。

messages.msgid: Peanuts coated in a sweet, crunchy candy coating.  A regional delicacy.
translations: 裹着一层香甜酥脆的焦糖的花生。本地特色美食。

messages.msgid: A sealed plastic bag containing a full dehydrated meal.  This one contains a hearty beef and egg breakfast.
translations: 一袋密封塑料袋包装的冻干快餐。这一袋里面是牛排和鸡蛋早餐。

messages.msgid: A rehydrated beef and egg breakfast meal meant for camping or hiking.
translations: 一份用水泡发的牛肉鸡蛋早餐，用于露营远足时食用。

messages.msgid: A thick, dense bar of military chocolate.  While tough to chew and not very appetizing, it provides almost a day's worth of calories in portable form.
translations: 一块厚重的军用巧克力棒。虽然很难咀嚼，味道也不是很好，但便携式的它能为你提供几乎一天的热量。

messages.msgid: A serving of sugary, fruit-flavored gelatin dessert powder.  Just add water and set.
translations: 一份含糖的水果味明胶甜点粉。只需加水并凝固。

messages.msgid: An unflavored jiggly, sugary treat made from gelatin and sugar.  It would taste better with some flavor.
translations: 一种由明胶和糖制成的无风味的含糖甜点。再加点调味，味道会更好。

messages.msgid: A jiggly, sugary, fruit-flavored treat made from boxed mix.  A kid favorite pre-Cataclysm.
translations: 一种由预拌粉制成的零食，摇摇晃晃，富含糖分，还有水果风味。大灾变前孩子们的最爱。

messages.msgid: A homemade jiggly, sugary treat made from gelatin and sugar, flavored with fruit juice.  A kid favorite pre-Cataclysm.
translations: 一种由明胶和糖制成摇摇晃晃的含糖甜点，自制时加入了果汁调味。在大灾变前是孩子们的最爱。

messages.msgid: A jiggly, sugary treat made from gelatin and sugar, flavored with fruit juice and set with fruit.  A kid favorite pre-Cataclysm and a healthy treat.
translations: 一种由明胶和糖制成摇摇晃晃的含糖甜点，加入了果肉和果汁调味。在大灾变前是孩子们的最爱。

messages.msgid: A vegan friendly homemade jiggly, sugary treat made from agar and sugar, flavored with fruit juice.  A kid favorite pre-Cataclysm.  They'll never know the difference.
translations: 一种素食者可食用的由琼脂和糖制成摇摇晃晃的含糖甜点，自制时加入了果汁调味。在大灾变前是孩子们的最爱，他们尝不出来区别的。

messages.msgid: A vegan friendly jiggly, sugary treat made from agar and sugar, flavored with fruit juice and set with fruit.  A kid favorite pre-Cataclysm and a healthy treat.
translations: 一种素食者可食用的由琼脂和糖制成摇摇晃晃的含糖甜点，加入了果肉和果汁调味。在大灾变前是孩子们的最爱。

messages.msgid: A famous Italian pasta dish made with egg, pecorino and bacon.
translations: 一道著名的意大利面食，由鸡蛋、佩科里诺干酪和培根做成。

messages.msgid: A famous Italian pasta dish made with red sauce, pecorino and bacon.
translations: 一道著名的意大利面食，由番茄酱、佩科里诺干酪和培根做成。

messages.msgid: Krampouezh, known worldwide as 'crepe' is a traditional, thin Breton pancake.
translations: 法式薄饼，俗称可丽饼，是法国布列塔尼传统的煎薄饼。

messages.msgid: Delicious and creamy delight, half of the famous Fluffernutter.
translations: 美味且细腻蓬松的小玩意，著名的Fluffernutter甜点其中一半的组成部分。

messages.msgid: A hefty raw sausage, prepared for smoking or cooking.
translations: 一条很大的生香肠，可以用来熏制或烹饪。

messages.msgid: A hefty sausage that has been cured and smoked for long term storage.
translations: 一条很大的美味腊肠，已经经过处理熏制，可以长期存储。

messages.msgid: A hefty cooked sausage.  Better eat it hot and fresh.
translations: 一大根煮熟的香肠。最好趁热趁新鲜吃。

messages.msgid: Salted meat slowly cooked in butter or melted fat, a form of food preservation from the days before canning.  Rich and fatty, it will last for a long time.
translations: 把腌肉慢慢在黄油或融化的脂肪中煮熟，这是在罐装出现前的一种食品保存形式。它肥腻且风味十足，可以保存很长时间。

messages.msgid: A sweet and delicious maple-flavored sausage.  Better eat it hot and fresh.
translations: 一份香甜可口的枫糖浆味香肠，最好趁热趁新鲜吃。

messages.msgid: A type of German sausage made of pre-cooked meat and blood.  Better eat it hot and fresh.
translations: 一种德式香肠，由预先煮熟的肉和血制成。最好是趁热吃新鲜的。

messages.msgid: A type of German sausage made of finely-chopped meat, meant to be pan-fried or roasted.  Better eat it hot and fresh.
translations: 一种德式香肠，由被切细的碎肉制成，需要使用平底锅煎或烤制后食用。最好是趁热吃新鲜的。

messages.msgid: A chunk of meat coated with royal jelly.  It's a lot like a honey-baked ham.
translations: 一块肉排，裹上了蜂王浆。和蜜渍烤火腿很像。

messages.msgid: A thick slab of salty cured bacon.  Shelf stable, precooked and ready-to-eat, it tastes better when reheated.
translations: 一片分量厚实的烟熏猪肉，富含磷，钾，钠等微量元素，非常美味，当然是在加工之后。

messages.msgid: Lean sausage made from heavily salt-cured offal, with natural gut casing.  Waste not, want not.
translations: 用盐腌过的内脏制成的细长条香肠，带着天然肠衣。勤俭节约，吃穿不缺。

messages.msgid: Lean raw sausage made from heavily salt-cured offal, ready to be smoked.
translations: 一条细长的用盐腌过的内脏制成的生香肠，可以用来熏制。

messages.msgid: Also known as pork rinds or chicharrones, these are bits of edible fat and skin that have been fried until they are crispy and delicious.
translations: 也称“猪皮脆片”，这些是可食用的脂肪与猪皮碎块，经过油炸后变得酥脆可口。

messages.msgid: A tender piece of meat, perfectly seasoned with a thin sweet glaze and a vegetable accompaniment.  A gourmet dish that is both healthy and delicious.
translations: 一小块用糖裹起来的里脊肉，伴有蔬菜，营养丰富且十分美味。

messages.msgid: Fresh lobster meat, perfectly seasoned with lemon juice and a vegetable accompaniment.  A gourmet dish that is both healthy and delicious.
translations: 新鲜龙虾肉，用大量柠檬汁调味并加入蔬菜配菜。既健康又美味的菜肴。

messages.msgid: Sausage covered in a curry ketchup sauce.  Spicy and delicious!
translations: 裹着咖喱番茄酱的香肠。香辣可口！

messages.msgid: A dish in which meat or fish is set into a gelatin made from a meat or vegetable stock.
translations: 一份肉和菜汤制成的一种冻状食物。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated fish flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.
translations: 一份脱水的鱼片，这种脱水食物在储存得当的情况下有着极长的保质期。

messages.msgid: Reconstituted fish flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的碎鱼肉，泡过水再吃更美味了。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated lobster meat.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.
translations: 一份脱水的龙虾肉，这种脱水食物在储存得当的情况下有着极长的保质期。

messages.msgid: Reconstituted lobster meat, which is much more enjoyable to eat now that it has been rehydrated.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的龙虾肉，泡过水再吃更美味了。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated mollusk meat.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.
translations: 一份脱水的贝肉，这种脱水食物在储存得当的情况下有着极长的保质期。

messages.msgid: Reconstituted mollusk meat, which is much more enjoyable to eat now that it has been rehydrated.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的贝肉，泡过水再吃更美味了。

messages.msgid: A serving of crisply brined and canned fish.  Tasty and nutritious.
translations: 爽脆的咸鱼罐头，美味又营养。

messages.msgid: Low-sodium boiled and canned fish.  Contains most of the nutrition, but little of the savor of cooked fish.
translations: 低钠水煮罐装鱼。含有大部分的营养，但尝不出来有熟鱼的味道。

messages.msgid: Low-sodium boiled and canned lobster.  Contains most of the nutrition, but little of the savor of cooked lobster.
translations: 低钠水煮罐装龙虾肉。含有大部分的营养，但尝不出来有熟龙虾的味道。

messages.msgid: A delicious pair of golden-brown crispy fried frog legs.
translations: 一对酥脆美味、金黄色的油炸蛙后腿。

messages.msgid: A delicious golden-brown serving of crispy fried fish.
translations: 一份金黄色的酥脆炸鱼，油香中富有鱼肉的鲜美，非常美味。

messages.msgid: A delicious deep-fried biscuit loaded with crab meat.
translations: 一块装满蟹肉的美味油炸糕饼。

messages.msgid: A delicious deep-fried biscuit loaded with lobster meat.
translations: 一块装满龙虾肉的美味油炸糕饼。

messages.msgid: Quahog clams stuffed with bread crumbs and fried.
translations: 装满了面包糠的圆蛤经过油炸，成了这道面拖蛤蜊。

messages.msgid: Meat that has been cooked, preserved, and cut into thin slices for convenient sandwich construction.  It tastes fine cold.
translations: 将煮熟的肉腌制之后，切成薄片，便于夹在三明治中。也能当作冷盘吃。

messages.msgid: Formally known as Bologna sausage, this is a finely-ground preserved meat that comes in circular slices.  Its first name isn't Oscar.  You can eat it cold.
translations: 一份源自博洛尼亚的正宗红肠，经过切碎腌制的细肉末被灌进肠衣后切成圆形薄片。不是奥斯卡牌的，能当作冷盘吃。

messages.msgid: Preserved fish that has been dried in a lye solution.  Vile and soap-like yet highly nutritious, it is reminiscent of the afterbirth of a dog or the world's largest chunk of phlegm.
translations: 一份碱渍鱼——在碱液中腌渍而成并长期保存的鱼肉。味道恶臭而且像肥皂一般，但营养丰富，外形看着就像是刚出生的狗的胎盘或者是世界上最大块的浓痰，除非是有着特殊癖好，否则这玩意难以下咽。

messages.msgid: A canned pork product that is unnaturally pink, oddly rubbery, and not very tasty.  Quite filling, but completely unappetizing cold.
translations: 一个呈不自然的粉色、带着奇怪的橡胶口感的猪肉罐头制品，虽然味道糟糕得完全无法引起食欲，但分量依旧能填饱肚子。

messages.msgid: A mysterious lump of SPAM that contains just enough calories and vitamins to feed you for a day.  For debug use only.
translations: 一块神秘的午餐肉，包含了你一天里需要的所有卡路里和维生素。上面写着：调试专享。

messages.msgid: Salty little fish.  They'll make you thirsty.
translations: 被腌渍的小鱼，越吃越口渴。

messages.msgid: Biscuits, meat, and delicious mushroom soup all crammed together into a wonderfully greasy and tasty mush.
translations: 一份饼干、肉块和美味的蘑菇汤搅在一起的油腻肉汁，香喷喷的，非常好吃。

messages.msgid: A concentrated mixture of fat and protein, first said to have been used as a nutritious high-energy food by the Querecho and Teya people of what is Texas today.  Composed of meat, tallow, and edible berries, it provides excellent nutrition in an easy to carry form.
translations: 一份脂肪和蛋白质的浓缩混合物，据说最早是由今天德克萨斯州的奎雷乔人和泰亚人作为一种营养丰富的高能量食品食用。这份由肉、油脂和可食用的浆果组成，以易于携带的形式提供出色的营养。

messages.msgid: A concentrated mixture of fat and protein, first said to have been used as a nutritious high-energy food by the Querecho and Teya people of what is Texas today.  Composed of meat, tallow, and edible plants or mushrooms, it provides excellent nutrition in an easy to carry form.
translations: 一份脂肪和蛋白质的浓缩混合物，据说最早是由今天德克萨斯州的奎雷乔人和泰亚人作为一种营养丰富的高能量食品食用。这份由肉、油脂和可食用的植物或蘑菇组成，以易于携带的形式提供出色的营养。

messages.msgid: A concentrated mixture of fat and protein, first said to have been used as a nutritious high-energy food by the Querecho and Teya people of what is Texas today.  Composed of meat and tallow, it provides excellent nutrition in an easy to carry form.  Contains no fruits or veggies.
translations: 一份脂肪和蛋白质的浓缩混合物，据说最早是由今天德克萨斯州的奎雷乔人和泰亚人作为一种营养丰富的高能量食品食用。这份由肉和油脂组成，以易于携带的形式提供出色的营养，但是不含水果或蔬菜。

messages.msgid: Some mac and cheese with ground meat added, enhancing the flavor and nutritional value.
translations: 一些芝士通心粉，再加点碎肉，提升了味道和营养价值。

messages.msgid: Meat encased in little dough satchels.  Tastes fine straight from the can.
translations: 两块面皮包着一团肉，罐头里直接拿出来也相当好吃。

messages.msgid: A spicy stew containing chili peppers, meat, tomatoes and beans.
translations: 利用肉类、辣椒、番茄和豆子熬制而成。

messages.msgid: Greasy Prospector brand improved pork and beans with hickory smoked pig fat chunks.
translations: "油腻矿工"品牌开发出的猪肉菜豆罐头。精选山核桃木熏制的肥猪肉丁。
本品海豚肉含量已经降低了95%！

messages.msgid: Bright pink fish-paste from a can.
translations: 从罐头里取出来的粉红色鱼肉酱。
从罐头里取出来的米白色鸡肉酱。

messages.msgid: Fish fillets pickled in some sort of tangy white sauce.
translations: 鱼肉片腌制在某种浓郁白色酱汁的罐头。
切碎的圆蛤浸泡在水里，就这样塞入了罐中。

messages.msgid: Delicious, lumpy, white soup made of meat (traditionally clams) and potatoes in a milk base.  A taste of the lost glory of New England.
translations: 由肉类（传统上是蛤蜊）和马铃薯制成的美味块羹白汤，以牛奶为底料。新英格兰美食的最后余晖。

messages.msgid: Slow-cooked beans with meat.  Tasty and very filling.
translations: 慢火烹制的豆子，配有一些肉类，美味又管饱。

messages.msgid: Delicious fried rice with meat.  Tasty and very filling.
translations: 配有肉块的炒饭，美味又管饱。

messages.msgid: Slow-cooked beans and rice with meat and seasonings.  Tasty and very filling.
translations: 将慢火烹制的豆子与米饭一起烹调，配上肉块和调料。美味又管饱。

messages.msgid: A delicious baked pie with a hearty meat filling.
translations: 一个美味的、满是肉的馅饼，香气四溢。

messages.msgid: A meat pizza, for all the carnivores out there.  Chock-full of minced meat and heavily seasoned.
translations: 一份加肉披萨，肉食者们的最爱，加入了大量切碎的肉并配以浓郁的酱料。

messages.msgid: A supreme pizza with ALL the toppings.
translations: 一款加入了所有配料的至尊披萨。

messages.msgid: Fluffy and delicious scrambled eggs made even better with the addition of tasty meat or fish.
translations: 一块蓬松而美味的炒鸡蛋，加上好吃的肉或鱼，更加香气四溢。

messages.msgid: Low-sodium boiled and canned meat.  Contains most of the nutrition, but little of the savor of cooked meat.
translations: 低钠水煮罐装肉。含有大部分的营养，但尝不出来有熟肉的味道。

messages.msgid: Meat slices cured in brine.  Salty but tasty in a pinch.
translations: 用盐腌制的肉片。很咸，但是作为一道应急配菜仍然非常美味。

messages.msgid: Spaghetti covered with a thick meat sauce.  Yum!
translations: 软糯的口感，美味的肉汁，让你欲罢不能。

messages.msgid: A very old type of pasta made with several layers of lasagne sheets alternated with cheese, sauce and meat.
translations: 非常古老的面食，由数层面饼与奶酪、肉馅、酱汁烹制而成。

messages.msgid: Now that it's been fried, this SPAM is actually pretty tasty.
translations: 这块午餐肉被油煎过了，实际尝起来很美味。

messages.msgid: A sandwich of minced meat and cheese with condiments.  A simple favorite of the people before the Cataclysm.
translations: 这个三明治里塞满了美味的碎肉、奶酪和调料。在大灾变前是人们的最爱。

messages.msgid: A cheeseburger with more vegetables and condiments.  This is the apex of pre-Cataclysm culinary achievement.
translations: 这个奶酪汉堡里又塞进了美味的蔬菜和调料。大灾变前烹饪工艺的巅峰之作。

messages.msgid: A sandwich of minced meat with condiments.
translations: 一个填充肉饼并洒满调料的美味汉堡，食用方便、风味可口、营养全面，曾是畅销世界的方便主食之一。

messages.msgid: A sandwich consisting of ground meat and tomato sauce served on bread.
translations: 一种夹馅三明治：把绞肉与番茄酱夹在面包里。

messages.msgid: A traditional Mexican dish composed of a corn tortilla folded or rolled around a meat filling.
translations: 一份墨西哥传统料理，把肉馅夹在或卷在用玉米面薄饼里制成。

messages.msgid: Frybread topped with beans, meat, and lettuce.  Originally conceived by the Navajo in the 19th century, only having available basic foodstuffs provided by the US-government after forced expulsion from their homelands, this dish became popular with many Native Americans and is often served at Powwows or other festivities.
translations: 油煎玉米饼，上面摆着豆子、肉和生菜。由19世纪的纳瓦霍人发明，他们被驱逐出家园，只能吃美国政府提供的基本食物。这道菜在许多美洲原住民社区中颇受欢迎，经常在帕瓦祈祷仪式上或其他节日时食用。

messages.msgid: A serving of crisply brined and canned meat.  Tasty and nutritious.
translations: 爽口的腌肉罐头，美味又营养。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated meat flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.
translations: 一些片装的脱水肉，如果储存妥善，这种干燥的食物可以保存非常长的时间。

messages.msgid: A pair of dehydrated frog legs.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.
translations: 一对脱水的蛙后腿，这种脱水食物在储存得当的情况下有着极长的保质期。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated flakes of bird meat.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.
translations: 一份脱水的禽肉片，这种脱水食物在储存得当的情况下有着极长的保质期。

messages.msgid: Reconstituted frog legs, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的蛙后腿，泡过水再吃更美味了。

messages.msgid: Reconstituted bird meat, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的禽肉，泡过水再吃更美味了。

messages.msgid: Reconstituted meat flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的碎肉片，泡过水再吃更美味了。

messages.msgid: This traditional Scottish savory pudding is made of meat and offal mixed with oatmeal, sewn into an animal's stomach and boiled.  Surprisingly tasty and quite filling, it is best served with boiled root vegetables and strong whisky.
translations: 这种传统的苏格兰咸味布丁由肉类和内脏与燕麦片混合制成，缝入动物的胃中后再煮熟。出乎意料地美味且很有饱腹感，最好搭配煮熟的根茎类蔬菜和烈性威士忌食用。

messages.msgid: Delicious slivers of thinly-sliced raw fish, wrapped in tasty sushi rice and rolled up in a healthy green vegetable.
translations: 将切成薄片的生鱼片，包裹住美味的米饭上，再用绿色蔬菜包裹起来的食物。

messages.msgid: Delicious slivers of raw meat, wrapped in tasty sushi rice and rolled up in a healthy green vegetable.
translations: 将切成片状的生肉，放在美味的米饭上，再用绿色蔬菜包裹起来的食物。

messages.msgid: Delicious slivers of thinly sliced raw fish, served with tasty vegetables.
translations: 用切成薄片的生鱼肉，与美味的蔬菜所组成的寿司。

messages.msgid: Pieces of poisonous meat that have been dried to prevent them from rotting away.  They're still unsafe to eat.
translations: 脱水保存以避免烂个精光的受感染的肉，但依然无法安全食用。

messages.msgid: Delicious cooked dumplings consisting of a meat filling wrapped in thin dough.
translations: 面团里裹了肉的饺子，煮了之后真好吃。

messages.msgid: A traditional Mexican dish of meat, beans or rice, and vegetables spread on a corn tortilla and rolled into a tube shape.  The fresh ingredients make this one taste way better than those gas station knockoffs.
translations: 一种传统的墨西哥菜，由肉、豆类或大米与蔬菜铺在玉米饼上并卷成条状。新鲜的食材使这种自制卷饼的味道比那些加油站的仿冒品更好。

messages.msgid: A round, seasoned lump of meat, ready to fry.
translations: 一团圆形的、经过调味的肉丸，可以油炸。

messages.msgid: A seasoned and fried round lump of meat.  Just like mom used to make!
translations: 一团圆形的、经过调味和油炸的肉丸。就和妈妈以前做的一样！

messages.msgid: A traditional dish originating from Spain, more specifically from the region of Valencia.  A very tasty and filling dish made traditionally of rabbit, beans, rice, chicken, spices and sometimes snails.
translations: 起源于西班牙的传统菜肴，更具体地说来自巴伦西亚地区。一道非常美味丰盛的菜肴，传统上由兔肉、豆类、米饭、鸡肉、香料制成，时而也会辅以蜗牛肉。

messages.msgid: A traditional dish originating from France, more specifically from the region of Bourgogne.  It consists of prepared snails that have then been cooked in butter and parsley inside their own shells, very low on fat but high on protein.
translations: 一种源自法国的传统菜肴，更具体地说是来自勃艮第地区。将蜗牛洗净，然后在它们自己的壳内用黄油和欧芹烹制，脂肪含量很低，但蛋白质含量很高。

messages.msgid: Turkish flatbread topped with ground lamb or beef mixed with peppers, onions, and tomatoes.
translations: 源于土耳其的扁平面包，铺上碎羊肉或牛肉，并与辣椒、洋葱和番茄混合而成的菜肴。

messages.msgid: Turkish flatbread topped with minced meat, minced vegetables, and herbs including onions, garlic, tomatoes, red peppers, and parsley, flavored with spices such as chili pepper and paprika, then baked.
translations: 源于土耳其的扁平面包，铺上肉末、蔬菜末和洋葱、大蒜、西红柿、红辣椒、欧芹等香料，用辣椒和辣椒粉之类的加辣，然后烤制而成的菜肴。

messages.msgid: A Turkish dish that consists of sliced döner kebab meat topped with hot tomato sauce over pieces of pita bread and generously slathered with melted special sheep's milk butter and yogurt.
translations: 一道土耳其菜肴，由切好土耳其烤肉片撒在皮塔饼上制成，再浇上热番茄酱，并涂抹大量融化的特制羊奶黄油和酸奶。

messages.msgid: Dumplings that typically consist of a spiced meat mixture, usually lamb or ground beef, wrapped in a thin dough sheet which is then boiled or steamed.
translations: 一种饺子，通常以加香料调味的肉馅（多为羊肉或牛绞肉）包入薄面皮中，再煮熟或蒸熟。

messages.msgid: A traditional Turkish dish prepared by rolling rice and minced meat in grape leaves.
translations: 一道传统土耳其菜，用葡萄叶卷着米饭和肉末制成。

messages.msgid: A delicious golden-brown serving of crispy fried chicken.
translations: 一份金黄色的酥脆炸鸡，油香中富有鸡肉的鲜美，非常美味。

messages.msgid: Brined in buttermilk, seasoned and breaded to perfection, and fried until crispy and golden.  This fried chicken is so good you can almost forget about the end of the world.  Vinegar leg is on the right!
translations: 加入了脱脂乳，调味并裹上面包屑，炸至酥脆金黄。这炸鸡太好吃了，几乎可以让你忘记世界末日。下次还可以做些醋腿！

messages.msgid: Originating from Punjabi cuisine, this deep-red and spicy baked chicken is marinated with a yogurt-based sauce and is traditionally baked directly on the walls of a wood-fired clay oven.
translations: 这种深红色、辛辣的烤鸡是一款起源于旁遮普邦的美食，采用酸奶酱汁腌制，传统做法直接贴在烧木柴的粘土烤箱的墙里烤。

messages.msgid: This delicious serving of poached chicken with rice is one of the national dishes of Singapore.
translations: 这道美味的白切鸡配米饭曾经是新加坡的国民菜式之一。

messages.msgid: A classic Italian-American dish of breaded and fried chicken atop a bed of pasta, enrobed with tomato sauce and cheese.
translations: 一道经典的意式美国菜肴，在一层意大利面上裹上面包屑和炸鸡，再撒上番茄酱和奶酪。

messages.msgid: A dry mush of meat scraps and grain, sliced and pan-fried; better than it sounds and looks.  A staple food of the Mid-Atlantic United States.
translations: 由碎肉糜和谷物混合制成的干糊糊，切片后煎熟；味道比听上去或是看上去都要好。美国中大西洋地区的主食。

messages.msgid: An over-the-counter melatonin supplement, commonly prescribed to treat sleep deprivation and to mitigate its effects.  One tablet a day combined with a good night's sleep will help you recover faster.
translations: 非处方褪黑激素补充剂，通常用于治疗睡眠不足并减轻其影响。一天一片，再加上一整晚良好的睡眠，可以帮助你更快地恢复健康。

messages.msgid: Medical-grade amphetamine salts mixed with dextroamphetamine salts, commonly prescribed to treat hyperactive attention deficits.  It suppresses the appetite, and is quite addictive.
translations: 包含医用级苯丙胺盐和右旋苯丙胺盐的混合药物，通常用于治疗注意力缺陷多动障碍。它抑制食欲，而且很容易上瘾。

messages.msgid: A syringe filled with a shot of epinephrine, also called adrenalin.  It serves as a powerful stimulant when you inject yourself with it.  Asthmatics can use it in an emergency to clear an asthma attack.
translations: 一管装满了肾上腺素的自助注射器，可以给自己注射来提供强效兴奋效果。哮喘病人发作时可以用它急救缓解症状。

messages.msgid: You inject yourself with the injector.
translations: 你给自己注射了肾上激素。

messages.msgid: Antibacterial medication designed to prevent or stop the spread of infection.  It's the safest way to cure any infections you might have.  One dose lasts twelve hours.
translations: 用于阻隔感染传播的抗菌药物，可安全治愈任何感染。一剂持续十二小时。

messages.msgid: A powerful chemical tablet designed to eliminate fungal infections in living creatures.  One dose lasts four hours.
translations: 一种强力的化学药片，可以彻底清除生物体内的真菌感染。药效持续四小时。

messages.msgid: A broad-spectrum chemical tablet designed to eliminate parasitic infestations in living creatures.  Though designed for use on pets and livestock, it will likely work on humans as well.
translations: 一种广谱的抗寄生虫药片，用来清除生物体内的寄生虫。

messages.msgid: Acetylsalicylic acid, a mild anti-inflammatory and blood thinner.  Take to relieve pain and swelling.  Careful - it can increase bleeding.
translations: 乙酰水杨酸，一种温和的抗炎药和抗凝血药。服用后可缓解轻微的肿痛。不过要小心，它会让你更易出血。

messages.msgid: Ibuprofen, a mild NSAID-based painkiller.  Take to relieve pain and swelling.
translations: 布洛芬是一种温和的非甾体抗炎药，可用于缓解疼痛和肿胀。

messages.msgid: Naproxen, a mild long-lasting NSAID-based painkiller.  Take to relieve pain and swelling.
translations: 萘普生是一种温和的长效非甾体抗炎药，可用于缓解疼痛和肿胀。

messages.msgid: Acetaminophen, a mild painkiller that works well in conjunction with NSAID-based painkillers like aspirin.  Take to relieve pain and swelling.
translations: 对乙酰氨基酚是一种温和的止痛药，适合与阿司匹林等非甾体抗炎药搭配使用，可用于缓解疼痛和肿胀。

messages.msgid: Metaprolol, a classic beta blocker.  It lowers blood pressure and decouples heart rate from stressful events such as anxiety or pain.
translations: 美托洛尔是一种典型的β-受体阻滞剂，可降低血压并避免焦虑或疼痛等压力导致的心率上升。

messages.msgid: A powdered form of chemical antiseptic, this bismuth formic iodide cleans wounds quickly and painlessly.
translations: 一些粉末形式的化学抗菌剂，这些碘化铋甲酸消毒粉可以轻松无痛的清洁伤口。

messages.msgid: Sugar-free chewing gum with added caffeine.  It's a nice pick-me-up, one stick is equivalent to a strong cup of tea.
translations: 添加了咖啡因的无糖口香糖。不错的提神方式，一条口香糖抵得上一杯浓茶。

messages.msgid: A No-doz brand caffeine pill, maximum strength.  Useful in pulling an all-nighter, one pill is equivalent to a strong cup of coffee.
translations: 一片没有品牌的咖啡因药丸，为保证出色的效果有着最大咖啡因量，熬夜工作时很有用，一颗相当于一大杯咖啡。

messages.msgid: Mint-flavored chewing tobacco.  While absolutely terrible for your health, it was once a favorite among baseball players, cowboys, and other macho types.
translations: 薄荷味的咀嚼烟草。虽然对你的健康十分不利，它曾经是棒球运动员，牛仔，或者其他的男子汉最喜欢的食物之一。

messages.msgid: Dilute hydrogen peroxide, for use as an antiseptic and for bleaching hair or textiles.  Foams a little when in contact with organic matter, but otherwise harmless.
translations: 稀释的过氧化氢，可当抗菌剂，或用来漂白头发与织物。与有机物接触时会轻微起泡，不过基本无害。

messages.msgid: A combination of hydrogen peroxide, baking soda, and dish soap that works together to transform skunk spray thiocetates into odorless acids.
translations: 过氧化氢、小苏打和洗碗皂的组合，共同作用将臭鼬所喷射的液体中的硫乙酸盐转化为无味的酸。

messages.msgid: You cover yourself in the solution everywhere the spray touched your body.
translations: 你用臭鼬中和剂把浑身上下接触过臭鼬的地方都喷了一遍。

messages.msgid: A mixture of dried tobacco leaf, pesticides, and chemical additives, rolled into a filtered paper tube.  Stimulates mental acuity and reduces appetite.  Highly addictive and hazardous to health, but lung cancer is kind of the least of your concerns at this point.
translations: 将制备好的干燥烟草和添加剂香料混合在一起，卷成一个纸卷，用来吸食。刺激感知，并降低食欲。高度容易上瘾并危害健康，至于肺癌之类的问题，起码现在你还不需要担心。

messages.msgid: A cigarette with a menthol flavor, the only type of flavored cigarette permitted for sale in the US.  The FDA had previously proposed a ban on them, but the world ended before it could be implemented.  It feels somewhat nicer to smoke than a regular cigarette.
translations: 薄荷味香烟，美国唯一允许销售的调味香烟品种。FDA曾提议禁售此类产品，但还没等禁令实施，大灾变就发生了。抽起来比普通香烟更带劲。

messages.msgid: A cigarette with reduced tar and nicotine content, designed to appeal to quitters and health-conscious smokers.  While not actually less harmful than regular cigarettes, the amount of nicotine absorbed per cigarette is indeed lower.  Marketing cigarettes as "light" has been illegal since 2007, but the term has persisted as a shorthand.
translations: 低焦油低尼古丁含量的香烟，专为试图戒烟者和健康意识较强的烟民设计。虽然实际危害并不比普通香烟小，但单支摄入的尼古丁含量确实较低。自2007年起法律禁止使用"柔和"作为香烟营销用语，但这个说法仍在私下流传。

messages.msgid: A premium brand cigarette rolled from strong, high-quality tobacco.  While discerning smokers may prefer its flavor to that of average cigarettes, the higher tar and nicotine content won't do you any favors.  Then again, you probably have bigger concerns than lung cancer.
translations: 选用优质烟叶卷制的高档香烟，烟味浓烈醇厚。虽然老烟枪们偏爱它胜过普通香烟，但更高的焦油和尼古丁含量对你可没好处。不过话说回来，在这末世里，肺癌恐怕已经算不上什么大问题了。

messages.msgid: A compact, slim cigar in the form of a cigarette.  It's a popular choice for those who want a taste of luxury without the time commitment of a full-sized cigar.  Addictive and hazardous to health.
translations: 一种外形似香烟的细长小雪茄。对于那些想体验奢华滋味又嫌普通雪茄耗时的人来说，这是热门之选。容易上瘾，危害健康。

messages.msgid: Rolled, cured tobacco leaf, addictive and hazardous to health.
translations: 卷曲的、加工过的烟叶，具有成瘾性且危害健康。“生命已尽，雪茄不熄。”

messages.msgid: A debug item that lets you put NPCs (or yourself) to sleep.
translations: 调试用物品，可让NPC或自己入睡。

messages.msgid: A mild opiate used in the suppression of pain, cough, and other ailments.  While relatively weak for a narcotic, it is still addictive, with a potential for overdose.
translations: 一种用于抑制疼痛温和的阿片制剂，可以治疗咳嗽，和其他疾病。相对温和麻醉剂，过量使用，仍会上瘾。

messages.msgid: Crystalline extract of the coca leaf, or at least, a white powder with some of that in it.  A topical analgesic, it is more commonly used for its stimulatory properties.  Highly addictive.
translations: 古柯叶提取物的结晶，一种白色粉末。可以用来局部镇痛，含有刺激特性。高度上瘾。

messages.msgid: A potent cocktail of amphetamines, caffeine and corn syrup, this stuff puts a spring in your step, a fire in your eye, and a bad case of tachycardia tremors in your somersaulting heart.
translations: 一种强有力的药酒，含有咖啡因和玉米糖浆，这东西使你身体迸发力量，你眼睛里冒火，心跳加速。

messages.msgid: Small plastic case with two extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  They are a great replacement for wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>nearsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.
translations: 小塑料盒内装有两片长戴型软性隐形眼镜，在盐水溶液中缓冲。 它们是佩戴眼镜的绝佳替代品，并且舒适地放置在眼睛表面。 这些镜片旨在帮助任何患有<color_light_blue>近视</color>的人，并且应在使用<color_light_blue>一周</color>后丢弃。

messages.msgid: You can use this to mitigate your nearsightedness.

translations: 变色近视隐形眼镜（周抛）

messages.msgid: Small plastic case with two extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  This high-tech pair darkens in response to light, making it easier to see in bright environments.  They sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>nearsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.
translations: 小塑料盒内装有两片长戴型软性隐形眼镜，在盐水溶液中缓冲。这款高科技隐形眼镜会随着光线的变化而变暗，让你能在强光下看得更清楚。这些镜片旨在帮助任何患有<color_light_blue>近视</color>的人，并且应在使用<color_light_blue>一周</color>后丢弃。

messages.msgid: Small plastic case with two daily-use soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  They are a great replacement for wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>nearsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>16 hours</color> of use.
translations: 小塑料盒内装有两片日抛软性隐形眼镜，在盐水溶液中缓冲。 它们是佩戴眼镜的绝佳替代品，并且舒适地放置在眼睛表面。 这些镜片旨在帮助任何患有<color_light_blue>近视</color>的人，并且应在使用<color_light_blue> 16 小时</color>后丢弃。
变色近视隐形眼镜（日抛）

messages.msgid: Small plastic case with two transition daily-use soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  This high-tech pair darkens in response to light, making it easier to see in bright environments.  They are a great replacement for wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>nearsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>16 hours</color> of use.
translations: 小塑料盒内装有两片一次性软性隐形眼镜，在盐水溶液中缓冲。这款高科技隐形眼镜会随着光线的变化而变暗，让你能在强光下看得更清楚。这些镜片旨在帮助任何患有<color_light_blue>近视</color>的人，并且应在使用<color_light_blue> 16 小时</color>后丢弃。

messages.msgid: Small plastic case with two extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  They are a great replacement for wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>farsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.
translations: 小塑料盒内装有两片长戴型软性隐形眼镜，在盐水溶液中缓冲。 它们是佩戴眼镜的绝佳替代品，并且舒适地放置在眼睛表面。 这些镜片旨在帮助任何患有<color_light_blue>远视</color>的人，并且应在使用<color_light_blue>一周</color>后丢弃。

messages.msgid: You can use this to mitigate your farsightedness.

translations: 变色远视隐形眼镜（周抛）

变色远视隐形眼镜（日抛）

They are a great replacement for wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>both nearsightedness and farsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.
translations: 小塑料盒内装有两片长戴软性隐形眼镜，在盐水溶液中缓冲。 它们是佩戴眼镜的绝佳替代品，并且舒适地放置在眼睛表面。 这些镜片旨在帮助任何患有<color_light_blue>近视和远视</color>的人，并且应在使用<color_light_blue>一周</color>后丢弃。

messages.msgid: You can use this to mitigate your nearsightedness or farsightedness.
translations: 你可以用它减轻近视和远视。
变色双光隐形眼镜（周抛）

messages.msgid: Small plastic case with two transition extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  This high-tech pair darkens in response to light, making it easier to see in bright environments.  They are a great replacement for wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>both nearsightedness and farsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.

变色双光隐形眼镜（日抛）

The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>both nearsightedness and farsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>16 hours</color> of use.
translations: 小塑料盒内装有两片一次性软性隐形眼镜，在盐水溶液中缓冲。这款高科技隐形眼镜会随着光线的变化而变暗，让你能在强光下看得更清楚。这些镜片旨在帮助任何患有<color_light_blue>近视和远视</color>的人，并且应在使用<color_light_blue> 16 小时</color>后丢弃。
变色平光隐形眼镜（周抛）

messages.msgid: Small plastic case with two transition extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  This high-tech pair darkens in response to light, making it easier to see in bright environments, but it doesn't help with any sight issues.  Essentially a pair of temporary sunglasses, this lenses should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.
translations: 小塑料盒内装有两片长戴型软性隐形眼镜，在盐水溶液中缓冲。这款高科技隐形眼镜会随着光线的变化而变暗，让你能在强光下看得更清楚。这些镜片本质上是一副临时的太阳镜，并且应在使用<color_light_blue>一周</color>后丢弃。

messages.msgid: You can use this to mitigate your the bright light discomfort.
translations: 你可以用它减轻强光不适。
变色平光隐形眼镜（日抛）

messages.msgid: Small plastic case with two transition daily-use soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  This high-tech pair darkens in response to light, making it easier to see in bright environments, but it doesn't help with any sight issues.  Essentially a pair of temporary sunglasses, this lenses should be discarded after <color_light_blue>16 hours</color> of use.
translations: 小塑料盒内装有两片一次型软性隐形眼镜，在盐水溶液中缓冲。这款高科技隐形眼镜会随着光线的变化而变暗，让你能在强光下看得更清楚。这些镜片本质上是一副临时的太阳镜，并且应在使用<color_light_blue> 16 小时</color>后丢弃。

messages.msgid: You can use this to mitigate the bright light discomfort.
translations: 你可以用它减轻强光不适。

messages.msgid: Deprotonated cocaine crystals, incredibly addictive and deleterious to brain chemistry.
translations: 高纯度的可卡因结晶，非常容易上瘾，容易伤害大脑。

messages.msgid: You smoke your crack rocks.  Mother would be proud.
translations: 你吸食了快克可卡因，妈妈会为你骄傲的。

messages.msgid: Daytime cold and flu medication, non-drowsy formula.  Will suppress coughing, aching, headaches and runny noses, but you'll still need lots of fluids and rest.
translations: 白天使用的对抗感冒和流感的药物，吃了不瞌睡。可以抑制咳嗽，疼痛，头痛，流鼻涕，但你仍然需要多喝水和休息。

messages.msgid: A powerful antiseptic commonly used to disinfect wounds.
translations: 一份强效的抗菌剂，用于给伤口消毒。

messages.msgid: Makeshift antiseptic made from ethanol.  Can be used to disinfect wounds.
translations: 一份用乙醇制成的简易抗菌剂，可用于伤口消毒。

messages.msgid: A strong benzodiazepine drug used to treat muscle spasms, anxiety, seizures, and panic attacks.
translations: 一种强大的苯二氮䓬类药物，用于治疗肌肉痉挛、焦虑、癫痫和恐慌发作。

messages.msgid: Concentrated cannabis extract, commonly known as dabs.  This particular style of concentrate is in a thin sheet and shatters like glass at room temperature.  Arguably one of the better styles of concentrate compared to wax, crumble, or distillate.  Normal cannabis contains around 20% THC; this shatter should be around 55% THC.
translations: 一份高度浓缩的大麻精油，又被称为大麻脂。这种精油在室温下凝聚成薄片状，像玻璃一样易碎。与大麻蜡，大麻粉或大麻提取液相比，它可以说是一种更好的浓缩方式。普通大麻的THC含量约为20%，而这块大麻脂的THC含量至少在55%左右。

messages.msgid: You take a dab.  Wow, that's got some killer terpenes!
translations: 你服用了一些大麻块。哇哦，里面的大麻萜烯可真够劲！

messages.msgid: Concentrated cannabis extract, commonly known as dabs.  This particular style of concentrate is yellow and waxy at room temperature.  Normal cannabis contains around 20% THC; this wax should be around 45% THC.
translations: 一份高度浓缩的大麻精油，又被称为大麻脂。这种特殊的浓缩液在室温下呈黄色蜡状。普通大麻的THC含量约为20%，而这块大麻蜡的THC含量至少在45%左右。

messages.msgid: You take a dab of wax.  *cough cough* Good stuff!
translations: 你服用了一些大麻蜡。*咳咳*好货色！

messages.msgid: Concentrated cannabis extract.  This style of extract goes through the most processing, eliminating most if not all harmful ingredients.  Normal cannabis contains around 20% THC; this distillate should be around 88% THC.  Can be smoked using a refillable electronic cigarette.
translations: 一份高度浓缩的大麻精油。这种精油经过了最多步骤的加工处理，去除了几乎所有有害成分。普通大麻的THC含量约为20%，而这种大麻提取液的THC含量至少在88%左右。可以用可重新填充的电子烟吸食。

messages.msgid: You take a dab of distillate.  Sooooo smooth…
translations: 你服用了一些大麻精油。真～～～爽……

messages.msgid: This battery-operated device vaporizes a liquid that contains flavorings and nicotine.  A less harmful alternative to traditional cigarettes, but it's still addictive.  It can't be reused once it's empty.
translations: 这个电池驱动的装置将尼古丁和调味剂的混合液蒸腾起来，虽然比燃烧型的卷烟伤害低一点，但是同样上瘾。它是一次性使用的，耗尽后无法复装。

messages.msgid: Sterile saline eye drops.  Can be used to treat dry eyes, or to wash out contaminants.
translations: 无菌的生理盐水滴眼液，可以用来治疗眼部干燥，也可以洗掉进入眼中的污染物。

messages.msgid: A topical corticosteroid in the form of eye drops.  Can be used to treat irritation and inflammation of the eyes.
translations: 一种含有皮质类固醇的眼药水，能有效缓解眼部不适和炎症。

messages.msgid: You put the anti-inflammatory eyedrops into your eyes.
A pharmaceutical flu shot designed for mass vaccinations, still in its packaging.  Purported to provide immunity to influenza, for the flu season for which it was developed.
translations: 一支用于大规模疫苗接种的医用流感疫苗，尚未开封。旨在为出厂时的流感季节中流行的毒株提供免疫。

messages.msgid: A roll-your-own cigarette.  Stimulates mental acuity and reduces appetite.  Despite being hand crafted, it's still highly addictive and hazardous to health.
translations: 一根你自己卷的香烟，刺激感知，并且降低进食欲望。即便自产自销，依旧无法掩盖会导致上瘾且有害健康的事实。

messages.msgid: An extremely strong opioid narcotic derived from morphine.  Incredibly addictive, the risk of overdose is extreme, and the drug is contraindicated for nearly all medical purposes.
translations: 一种提取自吗啡的非常强大的阿片类麻醉药物。非常容易上瘾，过量使用时会有致命危险，它被禁用于几乎所有医疗用途。

messages.msgid: A potassium iodide tablet.  If taken prior to exposure, they help to mitigate injury caused by radiation absorption.
translations: 一片碘化钾。在接触辐射前使用，可减少辐射产生的不良影响。

messages.msgid: Marijuana, cannabis, pot.  Whatever you want to call it, it's rolled up in a piece of paper and ready for smokin'.
translations: 大麻、叶子、草。随你怎么称呼，它已经用纸卷好，随时可以吸。

messages.msgid: A tiny pink tabs resembling a postage stamp, dosed with some sort of drug.  Really only useful for entertainment.  Will cause hallucinations.
translations: 类似邮票的粉红色小纸片，加入了某种药物。只是消遣性毒品，会引起幻觉。

messages.msgid: A profoundly addictive and powerful stimulant.  While extremely effective at enhancing alertness, it is hazardous to health and the risk of an adverse reaction is great.
translations: 一种高度的成瘾性和强大的兴奋剂。而在提高警觉性非常有效，但是对健康和产生不良反应的风险是巨大的。

messages.msgid: A profoundly addictive and powerful stimulant.  While extremely effective at enhancing alertness, it is hazardous to health and the risk of an adverse reaction is great.  This one could have only been made by a great chemist.
translations: 一种高度的成瘾性和强大的兴奋剂。而在提高警觉性非常有效，但是对健康和产生不良反应的风险是巨大的。只有一位伟大的化学家才能做出纯度这么高的。

messages.msgid: A very strong, naturally-occurring narcotic used to treat intense pain in hospital settings.  You'll need a syringe to inject it, and it's very addictive, so be careful.
translations: 一种非常强效的天然麻醉剂，用于抑制医院治疗过程中的剧烈疼痛。你需要一个注射器来注射它，这种药物非常容易上瘾，小心使用。

messages.msgid: An ointment infused with wintergreen oil.  Has mild antiseptic properties, and can ease the pain caused by wounds.
translations: 一份加入了冬青油的软膏。具有微弱的抗菌作用，可以缓解受伤引起的疼痛。

messages.msgid: Some essential oil made from mugwort, which may kill parasites when ingested.  Consume it with water!
translations: 从艾蒿中提取出来的一些精油。可以口服，用以驱除体内的寄生虫。用水送服！

messages.msgid: Mint flavored sugar-free nicotine chewing gum.  For smokers who desire to quit.
translations: 薄荷味的尼古丁口香糖，不含糖。适合准备戒烟的吸烟者。

messages.msgid: Nighttime cold and flu medication.  Useful when trying to sleep with a head full of virions.  Will cause drowsiness.
translations: 晚上使用的对抗感冒和流感的药物，吃了睡得香，特别是在你被满脑子的病毒弄得头疼的时候。药效的发挥会使人感到困倦。

messages.msgid: Over-the-counter allergy medication.  These are meant to be taken once a day and can cause drowsiness.
translations: 非处方抗过敏药，每日一服，会导致嗜睡。

messages.msgid: A strong semi-synthetic narcotic used in the treatment of intense pain.  Highly addictive.
translations: 一些半合成的纯阿片受体激动药片，主要通过激动中枢神经系统内的阿片受体而起镇痛作用，镇痛效力中等。

messages.msgid: A habit-forming tranquilizer with a variety of psychoactive side effects.  Used in the treatment of insomnia.
translations: 用于治疗失眠的镇静剂。有成瘾性和各种精神上的副作用。

messages.msgid: Its generic name is zolpidem tartarate.
translations: 这是一种安眠药，通用名是酒石酸唑吡坦。

messages.msgid: A potent opioid palliative produced by the refining of the mutated poppy.  Notably devoid of euphoric or sedative effects, but as an opiate it can still be addictive.
translations: 一些变异的罂粟提炼所产生的缓解剂。值得注意的是它并没有令人愉悦或镇静的作用，但作为阿片制剂它仍然具备成瘾性。

messages.msgid: A potent sleep aid extracted from mutated poppy seeds.  Effective, but as an opiate it can be addictive.
translations: 由变异的罂粟种子中提取的强力辅助睡眠药物。很有效，但作为阿片制剂它可能会让人上瘾。

messages.msgid: Cough syrup made from mutated poppy.  Will make you sleepy.
translations: 变异罂粟制成的咳嗽糖浆。会让你困倦。

messages.msgid: An experimental, cutting-edge antivenom in the form of a small amber vial, designed to be injected a few hours before venom exposure.  It was developed in top secret by the military in response to increasing biological/chemical warfare.
translations: 一种实验性的尖端抗毒药，装在琥珀色的小型玻璃管内，用于在暴露于毒素下的几小时前注射。军方在不断增加的生化战争威胁下秘密开发了这一药物。

messages.msgid: You inject a vial of prophylactic antivenom into your arm.  You feel a bit queasy.
translations: 你将一支抗毒药注射进你的手臂。你感觉有点反胃。

messages.msgid: A common and popular antidepressant.  It will elevate mood, and can profoundly alter the effects of other drugs.  It is only rarely habit-forming, though adverse reactions are not uncommon.
translations: 一种广泛使用的广谱抗抑郁药物。可以使心情愉快，并强烈的影响其他药物的效果。只有极低的成瘾性，即使如此，不良反应也是挺普遍的。
这是一种抗抑郁药，通用名是氟西汀。

messages.msgid: A tablet containing oxidized ferrous ferrocyanide salts.  Capable of purging nuclear contaminants from the body if taken after radiation exposure.
translations: 含有亚铁氰化铁盐的药片。能够清除体内的核辐射污染，接触辐射后服用。
你服用了一些普鲁士蓝药片。

messages.msgid: A powdered antihemorrhagic compound that reacts with blood to immediately form a gel-like substance that stops bleeding.
translations: 一些接触正在流血的伤口就立即形成一种能止血的凝胶状物质的止血粉。

messages.msgid: A solution of sterilized water and salt for intravenous infusion or washing contaminants from one's eyes.
translations: 一份生理盐水溶液，可以用于静脉注射，或者冲洗眼中的污物。

messages.msgid: Anti-psychotic medication.  Used to stabilize brain chemistry, it can arrest hallucinations and other symptoms of psychosis.  Carries a sedative effect.
translations: 抗精神病药物。用来稳定大脑内化学平衡，可以用于抑制幻觉和精神分裂。有镇静效果。
这是一种抗精神病药，通用名是氯丙嗪。

messages.msgid: Some essential oil made from thyme, which can act as a mildly irritating antiseptic.
translations: 从百里香中提取的精油，可以作为轻度刺激性的抗菌剂。

messages.msgid:
Loose, fine-cut tobacco leaves.  Popular in Europe and among hipsters.  Highly addictive and hazardous to health.
Can either be rolled into a cigarette with some rolling papers or smoked through a pipe.
translations: 松散，细切的烟叶。在欧洲和嬉皮士人群中流行。令人上瘾，对身体有害。可以卷成香烟或者找个大烟管直接开吸。

messages.msgid: A painkiller used to manage moderate pain.  The effects last for several hours, but are relatively subdued for an opioid.
translations: 一种管制的中度止痛药。效果持续几个小时，效果不及阿片类药物。

messages.msgid: Essential dietary nutrients conveniently packaged in pill form.  An option of last resort when a balanced diet is not possible.  Excess use can cause hypervitaminosis.
translations: 身体必需的各种膳食营养成分被方便地包装成丸状。是无法平衡饮食时的最后手段。过量使用可引起维生素过多症。

messages.msgid: A white calcium tablet.  Widely used by elderly people with osteoporosis as a method to supplement calcium before the apocalypse.
translations: 一片白色的钙片。在大灾变之前，它常被患有骨质疏松的老年人用来补充钙质。

messages.msgid: A homemade calcium supplement made out of bone meal.  Tastes horrible and is hard to swallow but it does its job.
translations: 一份用骨粉制成的自制钙补充剂。尝起来口感很糟糕，很难下咽，但它起码管点用。

messages.msgid: A homemade calcium supplement made out of bone meal.  Due to some sweeteners mixed in to counteract the powdery texture and the taste of ash, it's almost as palatable as the pre-Cataclysm tablets.
translations: 一份用骨粉制成的自制钙补充剂。由于添加了甜味剂来抵消原本的粉状口感和骨灰味道，它现在几乎和大灾变前的药片一样可口。

messages.msgid: A small white tablet promising more vitamin C than a human can conceivably absorb.
translations: 一片小小的白色药片，保证提供比人体能够吸收的更多的维生素C。

messages.msgid: a small slice of a vitamin C supplement, providing as much vitamin C as a human can conceivably absorb.
translations: 一小片维生素C补充剂，这里面的维生素C含量已达到人体可吸收的极限。

messages.msgid: Essential dietary nutrients conveniently packaged in a fruit-flavored chewy candy form.  An option of last resort when a balanced diet is not possible.  Excess use can cause hypervitaminosis.
translations: 一些水果口味耐嚼软糖形式的基本膳食营养。当饮食营养不均衡时的最终解决方案，过多使用会导致维生素过多症。

messages.msgid: A homeopathic pill, prepared through the repeated dilution of an active ingredient with water.  The label purports that these pills are able to maintain general wellness.
translations: 一片顺势疗法药丸，通过用水反复稀释活性成分制成。标签上声称这些药片能保持身体总体健康。

messages.msgid: You swallow the %s.  You wait in anticipation of its effects.
translations: 你吞下了 %s。你期待着它所能产生的效果。

messages.msgid: An Oscillococcinum homeopathic pill, prepared through the dilution of one part duck offal with 10^400 parts water.  The label purports that these pills are able to treat flu-like symptoms and maintain general wellness.
translations: 一片"欧斯洛可舒能"牌顺势疗法药丸，用10^400份水稀释一份鸭内脏制成。标签声称这些药片能够治疗类似流感症状并保持身体健康。

messages.msgid: An Arsenicum album homeopathic pill, prepared through the dilution of one part arsenic trioxide with 10^24 parts water.  Purported to treat anxiety, various digestive disorders, and arsenic poisoning.
translations: 一片"白砷"牌顺势疗法药丸，用10^24份水稀释一份三氧化二砷制成。标签声称这些药片能够治疗焦虑、各种消化系统疾病和砷中毒。

messages.msgid: An Allium cepa homeopathic pill, prepared through the dilution of one part onion with 10^30 parts water.  The label states that these pills can ameliorate symptoms of asthma, gastrointestinal disorders, and bronchitis.  You briefly wonder if it can cure fungal infections.
translations: 一片"洋葱"牌顺势疗法药丸，用10^30份水稀释一份洋葱制成。标签声称这些药丸可以改善哮喘，胃肠道疾病和支气管炎的症状。你想知道它们是否可以治愈真菌感染。

messages.msgid: An Arum tryphillum homeopathic pill, prepared through the dilution of the jack-in-the-pulpit plant with 10^30 parts water.  The label claims that the pills are able to treat voice loss.
translations: 一片"阿鲁姆泰菲利姆"牌顺势疗法药丸，用10^30份水稀释一份黄花菖蒲制成。标签声称这些药片能够治疗失音症状。

messages.msgid: An Aesculus hippocastanum homeopathic pill, prepared through the dilution of horse chestnut with 10^30 parts water.  These pills are meant to treat dysentery and hemorrhoids.
translations: 一片"七叶树"牌顺势疗法药丸，用10^30份水稀释一份马栗制成。标签声称这些药片能够治疗痛经和痔疮。

messages.msgid: A Lachesis mutus pill, prepared through the dilution of the venom of the bushmaster snake with 10^1000 parts water.  These pills are claimed to be an effective treatment for sore throat.
translations: 一片"丛林王"牌顺势疗法药丸，用10^1000份水稀释一份棕蛇毒液制成。标签声称这些药片能够治疗咽喉肿痛。

messages.msgid: A small vial of dark yellow liquid containing soluble iron for injection.
translations: 一小瓶暗黄色的液体，含有可溶性铁元素的注射液。
你注射了一些铁补充剂。

messages.msgid: The dried flower buds and leaves harvested from a psychoactive variety of hemp plant.  Used to reduce nausea, stimulate appetite and elevate mood.  It can be habit-forming, and adverse reactions are possible.
translations: 干燥后的花蕾、叶子，采集自各种大麻植物。用来减轻恶心，刺激食欲，提升心情值。它可以致瘾，并可能有不良反应。

messages.msgid: You smoke some weed.  Good stuff, man!
translations: 你吸了一口大麻。好货，兄弟！

messages.msgid: An anti-anxiety agent with a powerful sedative effect.  May cause dissociation and loss of memory.  It is dangerously addictive, and withdrawal from regular use should be gradual.
translations: 一种具有强烈镇静作用的抗焦虑剂。可能造成解离和失忆。极易成瘾，而且需要多疗程的渐进式戒断。

messages.msgid: A narrow-spectrum antibiotic used to suppress infections and prevent them from spreading.  It isn't broad enough to purge most infections outright, but it boosts the body's resistance against them.  One dose lasts twelve hours.
translations: 一种窄谱抗生素，用于预防和抑制感染。功效还不足以彻底治愈感染，但可增强体内免疫力。一剂药持续十二小时。

messages.msgid: Creamy pink heartburn syrup that soothes upset stomachs and quells vomitous urges.
translations: 一罐粘稠的粉红色胃药糖浆，能缓解胃部不适，平息呕吐冲动。

messages.msgid: A common stomach soother in flavored tablet form.  Makes you less likely to vomit.
translations: 一种常见的调味胃药，可以减轻你的呕吐情况。

messages.msgid: An apple-red gel capsule the size of your thumbnail, filled with a thick, oily liquid that shifts from black to purple at unpredictable intervals, flecked with tiny gray dots.  Given the place you got it from, it's either very potent, or highly experimental.  Holding it, all the little aches and pains seem to fade, just for a moment…
translations: 一颗红如苹果的胶囊，和你拇指甲差不多大小，内部充满了一种厚厚的油状液体，这种液体毫无规律地从黑色变成紫色，上面布满了灰色小点。从你获得它的地方看来，它要么有特别的药效，要么就是实验用品。那怕只是将它握在手中一瞬间，你都觉得一切疼痛仿佛消失了一般……

messages.msgid: Clear jelly harvested from cattails.  Can be used to protect a wound from contamination, and works as a painkiller.
translations: 从香蒲秆中获得的透明凝胶，可保护伤口免受污染，并且能当作止痛剂使用。

messages.msgid: A broad-spectrum antibacterial medication designed to prevent or stop the spread of infection.  It contains nearly toxic levels of antibiotics, but can treat any bacterial infections you may encounter.  One dose lasts twelve hours.
translations: 一份广谱抗生素，用于预防和治疗感染。带有一定毒性，但是能够治疗你能遇到的任何感染。一剂药持续十二小时。

messages.msgid: A medical cream that provides both vascular restriction and anesthetic properties.
translations: 一种既能抑制血管又能起到麻醉剂作用的药膏。
一袋尼古丁口含烟，富含尼古丁盐。
你将一片含烟塞入口中。

messages.msgid: A pouch containing cool mint-flavored nicotine salts.
translations: 一袋冰凉薄荷口味的尼古丁口含烟，富含尼古丁盐。

messages.msgid: A pouch containing peppermint-flavored nicotine salts.
translations: 一袋胡椒薄荷口味的尼古丁口含烟，富含尼古丁盐。

messages.msgid: A pouch containing wintergreen-flavored nicotine salts.
translations: 一袋冬青口味的尼古丁口含烟，富含尼古丁盐。

messages.msgid: A pouch containing coffee-flavored nicotine salts.
translations: 一袋咖啡口味的尼古丁口含烟，富含尼古丁盐。

messages.msgid: A pouch containing cinnamon-flavored nicotine salts.
translations: 一袋肉桂口味的尼古丁口含烟，富含尼古丁盐。

messages.msgid: A pouch containing menthol-flavored nicotine salts.
translations: 一袋薄荷醇口味的尼古丁口含烟，富含尼古丁盐。

messages.msgid: A pouch containing spearmint-flavored nicotine salts.
translations: 一袋绿薄荷口味的尼古丁口含烟，富含尼古丁盐。

messages.msgid: A pouch containing citrus-flavored nicotine salts.
translations: 一袋柑橘口味的尼古丁口含烟，富含尼古丁盐。

messages.msgid: The chili & beans entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的辣椒炒豆风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The BBQ beef entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的烤牛肉风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The chicken noodle entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的鸡肉面风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The spaghetti entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的意大利面风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The chicken chunks entree from an MRE, with an included beef stick.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的炸鸡块风味主菜，内含牛肉棒。
MRE 主菜（墨西哥牛肉卷）

messages.msgid: The beef taco entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的墨西哥牛肉卷风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The beef brisket entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的炖牛腩风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The meatballs & marinara entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的番茄酱肉丸风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The beef stew entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的炖牛肉风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The chili & macaroni entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的辣椒通心粉风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（墨西哥素菜卷）

messages.msgid: The vegetarian taco entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的墨西哥素菜卷风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（番茄酱通心粉）

messages.msgid: The macaroni & marinara entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的番茄酱通心粉风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（菠菜意大利宽面）

messages.msgid: The creamy spinach fettuccine entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的菠菜意大利宽面风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The ratatouille entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的蔬菜杂烩风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The cheese tortellini entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的芝士水饺风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（蘑菇意大利宽面）

messages.msgid: The mushroom fettuccine entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的蘑菇意大利宽面风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（墨西哥炖鸡肉）

messages.msgid: The Mexican chicken stew entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的墨西哥炖鸡肉风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（墨西哥鸡肉沙拉）

messages.msgid: The chicken burrito bowl entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的墨西哥鸡肉沙拉风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The maple sausage entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的枫糖香肠风味主菜。

messages.msgid: The ravioli entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的意式方饺风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（胡椒杰克芝士牛肉）

messages.msgid: The pepper jack beef entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的胡椒杰克芝士牛肉风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（洋葱土豆煎饼配培根）

messages.msgid: The hash browns & bacon entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的洋葱土豆煎饼配培根风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（柠檬胡椒金枪鱼）

messages.msgid: The lemon pepper tuna entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的柠檬胡椒金枪鱼风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（龙虾海鲜杂烩）

messages.msgid: The lobster seafood medley entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的龙虾海鲜杂烩风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（亚式牛肉炒菜）

messages.msgid: The Asian beef & vegetables entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的亚式牛肉炒菜风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（鸡肉意大利香蒜沙司通心粉）

messages.msgid: The chicken pesto & pasta entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的鸡肉意大利香蒜沙司通心粉风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（西南牛肉炖豆）

messages.msgid: The southwest beef & beans entree from an MRE.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的西南牛肉炖豆风味主菜。
MRE 主菜（法兰克福香肠炖豆）

messages.msgid: The dreaded four fingers of death.  It seems to be several decades old.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的法兰克福香肠炖豆风味主菜。著名的"死神的四根手指"，看上去香肠已经保存了数十年之久。

messages.msgid: The pizza entree from an MRE, now in vegetarian form.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的素食版披萨主菜。

messages.msgid: The pizza entree from an MRE, featuring pepperoni slices and cheese.
translations: 一份MRE军用口粮的披萨主菜，披萨上含有辣香肠和奶酪。
一份焗烤成金黄色的土豆。

messages.msgid: Fried rice, a simple dish made by stir-frying rice with other ingredients.
translations: 炒饭，一道简单的菜，把米饭和其他材料一起炒制而成。

messages.msgid: Golden, jelly-like food with the flavor of apples.
translations: 金黄色的果冻状食物，有苹果的味道。

messages.msgid: A savory and flavorful combination of black beans and sauce.
translations: 黑豆和酱汁的美味组合。

messages.msgid: Delicious cake with carrots blended seamlessly.
translations: 美味的蛋糕与胡萝卜完美融合。

messages.msgid: Cake filled with the goodness of lemon and poppy seeds.
translations: 蛋糕中充满了柠檬和罂粟籽的美味。
用巧克力做成的布丁。真美味！
带着巧克力碎的夹心面包。
一道美味的炖野生蘑菇餐。

messages.msgid: A savory condiment made from mushrooms.
Prized by chefs and woodsmen alike, morel mushrooms are delicious but must be cooked before they are safe to eat.
translations: 一些珍稀食用菌品种，因其菌盖表面凹凸不平、状如羊肚而得名。美味且健康，但是必须烹饪之后才能安全食用。
一道美味的熟羊肚菌大餐。

messages.msgid: A delicious serving of fried morsels of morel mushroom.
translations: 一道美味的炒羊肚菌大餐。

messages.msgid: Dried mushrooms are a tasty and healthy addition to many meals.
translations: 一根将鲜香菇经烤制等工艺加工而来的常用配菜，美味且健康。

messages.msgid: Mushrooms are tasty, but be careful.  Some can poison you, while others are hallucinogenic.
translations: 蘑菇很美味，但要小心。有些会让你中毒，另一些则具有致幻作用。

messages.msgid: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.
translations: 一种罕见的未知来源物质，会导致你基因变异。
一种经过处理的诱变剂引物。

messages.msgid: A processed, purified, and condensed dose of mutagenic drugs.  When combined with mutagenic primer, this will cause mutations over time.
translations: 经过处理与净化、浓缩过的诱变剂。当与诱变引物配合服用时，将会在一段时间内引起变异。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer strongly resembling blood.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出像鲜血一样颜色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer as red as a matador's cape.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出像斗牛士斗篷一样的红色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer the color of the pre-Cataclysmic skies.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出大灾变前天空的颜色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer the color of grass.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出青草的绿色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer as black as ink.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出像墨水一样的黑色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that churns with iridescence.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出混合在一起的彩虹色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that's a striking sylvan green.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出引人注目的森林绿色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer, yellow and highly reflective.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出反光度相当高的黄色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer the color of the ocean, with white foam at the top.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出大海一般深邃的蓝色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that's a beautiful amber color.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出美丽的琥珀色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that shifts between various shades of green.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，在不同深浅的绿色之间变幻。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer as white as a full moon.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出如满月般的白色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that looks like a mixture of bodily fluids.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，看上去像是各种体液的混合物。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that looks like pureed spinach.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，看上去像是一滩菠菜糊。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that seems to shift slightly whenever you look at it.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，看上去像是一滩菠菜糊。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that's a rather unappealing beige.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出毫无吸引力的米黄色。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer, black as night.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变引物，黑色如夜。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer, oily and viscous.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，又油又黏。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer with pale filaments suspended in it.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，里面隐约悬浮着一些白色的丝状物。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer with the consistency of snot.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，看上去像鼻涕一样浓稠。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that looks like pond water… are the shadows in it moving?
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，看上去像是池水……里面的阴影在动吗？

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that seems to recoil from the light.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，看起来有点畏惧光线。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer that's the color of honey, and is just as thick.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出蜂蜜色，也同蜂蜜一般的浓稠。

messages.msgid: A processed mutagenic primer resembling liquefied metal.
translations: 一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，看上去就像液态金属一样。
一种经过处理的诱变剂引物，呈现出橙色。
一种红色的诱变剂引物。

messages.msgid: A slurry of organic chemicals and compounds, used as the foundation for making primers and mutagenic catalyst.  In this baseline form, it is highly toxic, and dangerous to consume on its own.
translations: 一种充满了有机化合物的浆液，用于制造诱变引物和诱变催化剂。在这种基线形态下，它具有很强的毒性，单独食用很危险。

messages.msgid: A thick, soupy red liquid.  It looks and smells disgusting, and seems to bubble with an intelligence of its own…
translations: 浓稠黏糊的红色液体。看着闻着都恶心，而且仿佛有生命一般地冒着泡……

messages.msgid: You choke down the congealed blood.

translations: 一种极度罕见的混合诱变剂。

messages.msgid: A murky black liquid that smells of blood.
translations: 一种有血腥味的黑色浑浊液体。

messages.msgid: A shadowy mutagen that looks like it might be full of tiny swimming tadpoles.
translations: 内含许多阴影的诱变剂，看起来好像里面满是游来游去的小蝌蚪。

messages.msgid: A mutagen that looks awfully like the slime from an old children's network.
translations: 一种诱变剂，看起来像是来自老旧的儿童电视节目中的史莱姆。

messages.msgid: A white, clear colored mutagen.  You can drink it… if you really want to?
translations: 白而透明的诱变剂。你可以喝下它……如果你真的想喝的话。

messages.msgid: This thick, flesh-hued liquid helps revert the mutated to baseline humanity, but cannot remove mutagen present in the bloodstream.  Not for use on animals.
translations: 这种粘稠的血色液体有助于将变异后的人类恢复到原始状态，但无法去除血液中的诱变剂。不适合用于其他动物。

messages.msgid: This chunky, flesh-hued injection does wonders for returning mutants to humanity, but perhaps counter-intuitively, it requires regular mutagen to function.  Do not use on animals.
translations: 这种浓稠的血肉色注射药剂在让变种人恢复人性方面有奇效，但想让它生效需要反其道而行之——服用一些诱变催化剂。严禁用于其他动物。

messages.msgid: A dangerous treatment that binds to mutagen present in the bloodstream and allows it to be excreted.
translations: 一种与血液中的诱变剂结合并使其排出体外的危险疗法。

messages.msgid: An experimental stem cell treatment, offering limited control over which mutations are purified.  The liquid sloshes strangely inside of this syringe.
translations: 一种实验性干细胞治疗剂，能够有限地指定所要被净化的变异特性。注射器里的液体正奇怪地在针管内晃动。

messages.msgid: A deformed human fetus.  Eating this would be the most vile thing you can think of, and just might cause you to mutate.
translations: 一个原本可以成为人类但畸形了的胚胎，看上去恶心极了。有勇气吃掉它的人，很可能发生某种变化。

messages.msgid: A misshapen human arm.  Eating this would be incredibly disgusting and probably cause you to mutate.
translations: 变异的人类手臂，丧心病狂的人才去吃，吃了后会恶心，并且导致DNA突变。

messages.msgid: A malformed human leg.  This would be gross to eat, and probably cause mutations.
translations: 一条畸形的人类腿。吃起来会很恶心，而且很可能导致突变。

messages.msgid: A handful of tasty, crunchy nuts from a pinecone.
translations: 一把从松果里剥出来的松籽，又香又脆。

messages.msgid: A handful of female juniper cones, for making gin and adding earthy flavors to food.  Spicy, tastes similar to rosemary.
translations: 一把雌杜松球果，用于制作杜松子酒，或者为食物添加泥土芳香。辛辣，味道类似于迷迭香。

messages.msgid: A handful of nuts from a pistachio tree, with the shells removed.
translations: 一把从开心果树摘下来的坚果，已经去掉了壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of roasted nuts from a pistachio tree.
translations: 一把开心果，已经烤熟了。

messages.msgid: A handful of nuts from an almond tree, with the shells removed.
translations: 一把来自杏仁树的果实，已去除外壳。

messages.msgid: Pulp left over after making almond milk.  It's gritty and incredibly bland.
translations: 制作杏仁奶后剩下的渣滓。口感粗糙，味道极其寡淡。

messages.msgid: A handful of roasted nuts from an almond tree.
A handful of pecans, a sub-species of hickory nuts, with the shells removed.
translations: 一把碧根果，山核桃的亚种，已经去壳了。

messages.msgid: A handful of roasted nuts from a pecan tree.
translations: 一把碧根果，已经烤熟了。

messages.msgid: Salty peanuts with the shells removed.
A handful of hard, pointy nuts from a beech tree.
translations: 一把美洲山毛榉树的带刺果实。

messages.msgid: A handful of raw, hard nuts from a walnut tree, with the shells removed.
translations: 一把从栗子树摘下来的生硬坚果，已经去壳了。

messages.msgid: Pulp left over after making walnut milk.  It's gritty and incredibly bland.
translations: 制造核桃乳剩下的残渣。口感像沙子，而且味同嚼蜡。

messages.msgid: A handful of raw nuts from a butternut tree, with the shells removed.
translations: 一把从白胡桃木上摘下来的生硬坚果，已经去壳了。

messages.msgid: A handful of roasted nuts from a walnut tree.
A handful of roasted nuts from a butternut tree.
translations: 一把白胡桃，已经烤熟了。

messages.msgid: A handful of raw, hard nuts from a chestnut tree, with the shells removed.
translations: 一把从栗树摘下来的生硬坚果，已经去掉了壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of roasted nuts from a chestnut tree.
A handful of raw, hard nuts from a hazelnut tree, with the shells removed.
translations: 一把从榛子树摘下来的生硬坚果，已经去掉了壳。

messages.msgid: Roasted edamame, a hearty and healthy snack.
translations: 烤毛豆，有益心脏的健康零食。

messages.msgid: Roasted soybeans, often called soy nuts.
translations: 烤大豆，通常被称为烤豆子。

messages.msgid: A handful of roasted nuts from a hazelnut tree.
Pulp left over after making hazelnut milk.  It's gritty and incredibly bland.
translations: 制造榛子乳剩下的残渣。口感像沙子，而且味同嚼蜡。

messages.msgid: A handful of raw, hard nuts from a hickory tree, with the shells removed.
translations: 一把从山核桃树摘下来的生硬坚果，已经去掉了壳。

messages.msgid: A handful of roasted nuts from a hickory tree.
translations: 一把山核桃，已经烤熟了。

messages.msgid: Delicious hickory nut ambrosia.  A drink worthy of the gods.
translations: 美味的山核桃酿。神的饮品。（原文Ambrosia意为神的食物）

messages.msgid: A brown goo that tastes very little like its namesake.  It's not bad, but it'll stick to the roof of your mouth.
translations: 棕色的粘稠物，尝起来没什么花生味。倒不难吃，不过会粘在上牙上。
一份工厂出品的抹面包用的加工花生酱。

messages.msgid: A handful of acorns, still in their shells.  Squirrels like them, but they taste terribly bitter and can upset your stomach.
translations: 一把仍带壳的橡子。松鼠很喜欢，但味道极其苦涩，且吃了后可能让你胃部不适。

messages.msgid: A serving of acorns that have been hulled, chopped, and boiled in water before being thoroughly toasted until dry.  Filling and nutritious.
translations: 将橡子去壳，剁碎，煮熟，然后彻底烤干制成。美味又顶饱。

messages.msgid: A handful of roasted nuts from an oak tree.
A handful of mushy blanched acorns.  No longer bitter, but not pleasant to eat in this state.
translations: 一把焯了水的糊状橡子。不再苦涩，但在直接这样吃口感可不太好。

messages.msgid: A mix of water and hulled acorns, slowly leaching the tannins.  It'll take about a week before they're palatable.
translations: 水和去壳橡子的混合物，正在慢慢浸出单宁。约需一周才能令其变得适口。

messages.msgid: After a week of changing water and taste-testing, the acorns are no longer bitter and ready to decant.
translations: 经过一周的换水并反复尝味后，橡子已经不再苦涩，可以进行沥干或分装了.

messages.msgid: A light brown butter substitute made from nuts.  Differs from other nut butters in that the fats are removed from the meat and only the fats retained.
translations: 一种浅棕色的坚果制黄油替代品。与其他坚果酱不同，其制作过程中分离了果肉仅保留油脂成分。

messages.msgid: Though this meal is technically not foie gras, you have a feeling neither the French nor animal rights groups are likely to criticize it now.
translations: 虽然不是真正字面上的"鹅"肝酱，但你感觉，无论是法国人还是动保组织，现在都不太可能以任何方式批评它。

messages.msgid: A classic way to serve liver.
translations: 一道经典的食用肝脏的菜式。

messages.msgid: Tasty deep-fried liver, a Southern delicacy.
translations: 美味的炸猪肝，一道南方美食。

messages.msgid: Tasty deep-fried heart, retaining most of its texture and gaining that delicious fried taste.
translations: 美味的油炸心脏，保留了大部分的口感，并增添了油炸的风味。

messages.msgid: Chunks of heart filled with vegetables and spices.
translations: 心脏中塞满了蔬菜和香料。

messages.msgid: Also known as 'Umble' pie, made with chopped organ meats.  Not half bad, and full of vitamins!
translations: 又被称为"卑微者的馅饼"，采用切碎的内脏做馅。虽然在以前只有地位低微的人会吃，但尝起来还不赖，甚至还充满了维生素！

messages.msgid: Stomach lining, cut up and stewed for an hour in broth.  Better than it sounds.
translations: 胃，切碎，放进汤里慢慢煨，吃起来比听起来更美味。

messages.msgid: Some people don't enjoy the taste or texture of organ meat, so deep-frying is a great way to disguise both.
translations: 有些人不喜欢内脏肉的味道或质地，所以油炸是解决这种问题的好方法。

messages.msgid: A traditional Danish pate.  Probably better if you spread it on some bread.
translations: 一种传统丹麦菜肴，采用绞碎的内脏肉制成的肉酱。最好是抹在面包上吃。

messages.msgid: I don't know what you were expecting.  It's brain.  It's deep-fried.  Enjoy!
translations: 你可别对它抱太大期望了。这依然是个脑子，只是被油炸了一遍，好好享受吧！

messages.msgid: A delicious way to prepare kidneys, originating from Victorian England.  You had to make some substitutions in the devilling sauce, but it still came out damn good.
translations: 一种烹饪肾脏的美味方法，起源于维多利亚时代的英国。虽然你只能用别的调料来替代"魔鬼酱"，但最后的味道依然很棒。

messages.msgid: Not sweet like the name would suggest, but delicious all the same!
translations: 吃起来一点也不甜，但仍然美味。（注：杂碎英文被称为sweetbread）

messages.msgid: Livers preserved in a can.  Chock-full of B vitamins!
translations: 在罐子里密封保存的肝脏。富含维生素B！

messages.msgid: Chunks of heart preserved in a can.
A French lung dish, made by poaching the lungs before pan-frying them with onion, tomato, seasonings, and a generous amount of wine.
translations: 一种法式肺脏料理，先将肺煮熟，然后与洋葱、番茄、调味料和大量葡萄酒一起煎。

messages.msgid: A German peasant dish that converts many less-desirable meat cuts and organs into a palatable meal with the liberal application of butter, sugar, and wine.
translations: 一种德国农家菜，将许多不太受欢迎的肉块和器官变为可口的菜肴，主要是靠大量使用黄油、糖和酒。

messages.msgid: Brain and eggs, why didn't you ever think to put these together?
translations: 脑花加蛋，以前怎么就没想到把它们凑一对儿呢？

messages.msgid: Sausage casings made from animal intestines.  Ready to be used for forming meat products.
translations: 用动物的肠子制成的肠衣，可以用来装香肠。

messages.msgid: Sausage casings made from plastic bags.  Ready to be used for forming meat products.
translations: 用塑料制成的肠衣，可以用来装香肠。

messages.msgid: A vegetable from the gourd family, bottle gourds were brought to the Americas by the first Native American settlers crossing the Bering strait.  This one has been dried for processing into a watertight container.
translations: 一种葫芦科的蔬菜，由第一批穿越白令海峡的美洲土著定居者带到美洲。这个葫芦已经烘干，准备加工成一个水密容器。

messages.msgid: The classic of classics, a flavor that provides a fresh and invigorating sensation in the mouth, as well as freshening breath.
translations: 经典中的经典，可以振奋精神，清新口气。

messages.msgid: Spearmint is a slightly sweeter and milder version of peppermint, providing a fresher taste and is also good for freshening breath.
translations: 相比于薄荷，留兰香更为温和，且带有一丝甜味，同样能清新口气。

messages.msgid: Wintergreen has a cool and refreshing taste, similar to mint, but with a slightly sweeter flavor.
translations: 冬青拥有与薄荷相近的冰凉清爽，但略微更甜。

messages.msgid: Bubblegum is a nostalgic flavor that's reminiscent of the classic pink bubblegum flavor that kids love.  It's basically a combination of various flavors.
translations: 怀旧的泡泡糖味，能够让人联想到孩子们喜欢的经典粉色泡泡糖。本质上是多种味道混合的复合口味。

messages.msgid: This strawberry-flavored chewing gum offers a sweet and juicy taste, reminiscent of fresh strawberries.
translations: 这款草莓味口香糖口感甜美，让人想起新鲜的草莓。

messages.msgid: This cherry-flavored chewing gum is both sweet and tart, with a delicious fruity flavor.
translations: 这款樱桃味口香糖酸甜可口，犹如美味的水果。

messages.msgid: This orange-flavored chewing gum provides a fresh and fruity taste, like biting into a juicy orange.
translations: 这款橙子味口香糖味道清新，吃下去后仿佛咬了一口多汁的橙子。

messages.msgid: This watermelon-flavored chewing gum has a sweet and fruity flavor, perfect for summertime.
translations: 这款西瓜味口香糖味道清甜，很适合夏天食用。

messages.msgid: This blueberry-flavored chewing gum has a fruity, tangy flavor with a slightly sweet taste.
translations: 这款蓝莓味口香糖果味浓烈，但并不十分甜。

messages.msgid: This pineapple-flavored chewing gum has a sweet and tangy taste, perfect for those looking for a tropical twist.
translations: 这款菠萝味口香糖味道甜美，很适合那些热衷热带风味的人。

messages.msgid: This green apple-flavored gum is crisp and refreshing, with a slightly sour and sweet taste, more sour and sweet than the regular apple-flavored one.
translations: 这款青苹果味口香糖味道酸甜清爽，比一般的苹果味口香糖要更加酸甜。

messages.msgid: This uncommon mango-flavored chewing gum has a sweet, tropical taste, reminiscent of fresh mangos.
translations: 这款不太常见的芒果味口香糖带有热带水果特有的甜味，让人想起新鲜芒果的味道。

messages.msgid: This lemonade-flavored chewing gum provides a zesty and citrusy burst of flavor.
translations: 这款柠檬味口香糖有着一股活泼而刺激的柠檬味。

messages.msgid: This pomegranate-flavored chewing gum has a blend of tart and sweet taste for a unique, fruity flavor.
translations: 这款石榴味口香糖有着石榴独特的味道，酸酸甜甜。

messages.msgid: This raspberry-flavored chewing gum has a fruity and tart taste with a slightly sweet finish, offering a tangy and refreshing pop of flavor.
translations: 这款木莓味口香糖有着浓烈的酸味，而其后的回甘则带来了些许清爽。

messages.msgid: This kiwi-flavored chewing gum provides a sweet and tangy taste, reminiscent of fresh kiwis.
translations: 这款奇异果味口香糖味道甜美，让人想起新鲜的奇异果。

messages.msgid: This peach-flavored chewing gum offers a sweet, slightly tangy, and earthy taste, reminiscent of fresh peaches.
translations: 这款桃子味口香糖甜味稍重，有着泥土的芳香，就像是新鲜的桃子。

messages.msgid: This blackberry-flavored gum has a sweet taste, combined with a subtle tartness, offering a fruity and refreshing flavor.
translations: 这款黑莓味口香糖酸中带甜，有着清爽的水果味。

messages.msgid: A little hunk of glop that fell off a slime monster.  It doesn't seem hostile, but it does wiggle occasionally.
translations: 一小块从变形怪身上掉下的糊状物，似乎已经没有了敌意，但偶尔会蠕动几下。

messages.msgid: A large chunk of wax filled with honey.  Very tasty.
translations: 一大块涂满了蜂蜜的蜡，超级美味。

messages.msgid: A large chunk of beeswax.  Despite being used in some cooking recipes, beeswax in itself is indigestible to humans.
translations: 一大块蜂蜡。尽管会在一些食谱中使用，但蜂蜡本身对人类而言是难以消化的。

messages.msgid: A translucent hexagonal chunk of wax, filled with dense, milky, bitter and acidic-tasting jelly.  Though some hold it as a panacea, it doesn't have any medical benefit.  Still it is rich with the most beneficial substances the hive can produce.
translations: 一大块涂满了粘稠 、乳白色液体的半透明蜂窝蜡，尝起来有点苦涩和酸味。虽然有些人认为它是灵丹妙药，但它其实没有任何疗效。不过尽管如此它依然富含蜂群能制造的营养物质。

messages.msgid: A sugar-rich sticky substance, produced by aphids from plant sap.  Ants and bees love it.
translations: 一种富含糖的粘性物质，由吸取植物汁液的蚜虫产生。蚂蚁和蜜蜂都喜欢它。

messages.msgid: This looks like a blueberry the size of your fist, but pinkish in color.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.
translations: 这看起来像拳头大小的蓝莓，但却有粉红色的颜色。香气浓郁，芬芳扑鼻，但显然经过了变异，或许是外星产物也说不准。

messages.msgid: This looks like a handful of lemon-colored liquid which has taken a set, much like pre-Cataclysm Jello.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.
translations: 这看起来就像凝固住的柠檬色液体，活像末日前的果冻。香气浓郁，芬芳扑鼻，但显然经过了变异，或许是外星产物也说不准。
