messages.msgid: Humans might call this a Gray Delicious apple: large, gray, and smells even better than the Marloss.  If they didn't reject it for its alien origins.  But we know better.
translations: 人类或许会直接称其为“灰色的蛇果”：大且灰白，香味更甚于马洛斯梅。若那些人类不因其起源于异界而排斥，将会更加美妙。但吾等更清楚。

messages.msgid: A powder-like mix of cultured yeast, good for baking and brewing alike.
translations: 一份人工培育的粉末状酵母，可以用于烘培或者酿造。

messages.msgid: A powder-like mix of cultured yogurt bacteria, good for fermenting yogurt.
translations: 一种由用于发酵酸奶的细菌混合而成的粉末状混合物，用于发酵酸奶。

messages.msgid: Some ground rice covered with a special kind of mold used for saccharification and fermentation in Japanese cuisine.
translations: 一些表面覆盖着一种特殊的霉菌的碎米，在日本料理中用于糖化和发酵。

messages.msgid: Dried and powdered gelatin, used as a gelling agent when mixed with water.
translations: 经过烘干的粉状明胶，当与水混合后变成凝胶。
新鲜的明胶。不适合素食主义者！

messages.msgid: This chitin powder can be used to craft fertilizer and some other things.
translations: 一份甲壳粉，可以用来制造肥料和其他物品。

messages.msgid: A napkin.  Can be used for fires.
translations: 一张纸巾。可以用来生火。

messages.msgid: Canned beans.  A staple among canned goods, these are reputedly good for one's coronary health.
translations: 罐装豆子。罐头食品的标志性产品，据说有利于冠动脉健康。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated great northern beans.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, virtually inedible when dry.
translations: 脱水的大北豆。煮熟以后美味又营养，但是干燥状态几乎不能食用。

messages.msgid: A hearty serving of cooked great northern beans.
translations: 一份丰盛的水煮大北豆。

messages.msgid: Tofu, a soy protein crucial to East Asian cuisine.  It absorbs flavors very well and can be used as a meat alternative in many dishes.
translations: 豆腐，一道在东亚菜系中占据重要地位的菜肴，富含蛋白质。它能很好地吸收风味，在许多菜肴中可作为肉类替代品。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated tofu, sealed and still extra firm to last a long time.
translations: 脱水豆腐，被密封保存。可以保存相当久的时间不腐坏。

messages.msgid: Beige colored beans.  They have many uses, but in their raw form are fairly poisonous to humans.
translations: 米黄色的豆子。它们有很多用途，但生吃对人类来说有剧毒。

messages.msgid: Beige colored beans, dried until rock hard.  They'll need to be cooked or processed before use.
translations: 干燥的米黄色的豆子，坚如磐石。它们在使用前需要经过烹饪或加工。

messages.msgid: Raw soybeans still in their pod.  They can be cooked as-is or shelled for further processing, but in their raw form, they're toxic to humans.
translations: 未去荚的豆子。它们可以直接烹饪，或者去壳进行进一步加工，但生吃对人类来说有毒。

messages.msgid: Blood rice pudding is a pastry made from blood and rice grains.  Best with chopped peanuts, but also good to eat with various seasonings.
translations: 血米布丁是一种用血和大米做成的糕点。最好搭配花生碎，也可以搭配各种调料食用。

messages.msgid: The best-seller from Foodplace, delicious food™, is made with real foodstuff and is guaranteed 100% edible!
translations: 美食广场™最畅销的产品，美食广场美食™，用真正的食物制成，并保证100%可食用！

messages.msgid: Real foodstuff now in a pocket size format!
translations: 真正食品现在被做成能轻松装进你口袋的合适大小！

messages.msgid: Wet, cooked lentils.  Humble and nutrient-rich, but pretty bland.
translations: 水煮熟的扁豆。简单且营养丰富，但味道寡淡。

messages.msgid: Ground coffee beans.  You can boil it into a mediocre stimulant, or something better if you had an atomic coffee pot.
translations: 磨碎的咖啡豆。可以加水煮成普通咖啡当作兴奋剂使用，或者使用原子咖啡机将其制成效果更强的玩意。

messages.msgid: Coffee grounds created through washing, cleaning, and roasting the pods from a Kentucky coffeetree.  They can be used to create coffee.
translations: 通过清洗、清洁和烘烤来自肯塔基州咖啡树的豆荚而形成的咖啡粉。它们可以用来制造类似咖啡的饮品。

messages.msgid: Honey, that stuff the bees make.  This variant is "candied honey", a variant of very thick consistence.  This honey won't spoil and is good for your digestion.
translations: 一份由蜜蜂酿造的蜂蜜。这种蜂蜜又被叫做"结晶蜂蜜"，是一种浓稠的蜂蜜。它不会腐坏变质，而且能帮助消化。

messages.msgid: Canned tomato.  A staple in many pantries, and useful for many recipes.
translations: 罐装番茄。厨房里常见的罐头食品，可以做很多种菜。

messages.msgid: This is a human brain soaked in a solution of highly toxic formaldehyde.  Eating this would be a terrible idea.
translations: 一个浸泡在含有剧毒的福尔马林中的人脑。吃下它会是个十分糟糕的主意。

messages.msgid: What cattle eat.  Mainly made of grass, silage or legumes.  It's perfect for ruminants.
translations: 一些喂养家畜用的饲料，主要由草、青贮饲料或豆类等制成，适合奶牛等牲畜食用。

messages.msgid: A pile of cattle fodder, about enough to feed a goat or a sheep for a day.
translations: 一捆家畜饲料，基本可以让一只山羊或者绵羊吃一天。

messages.msgid: A big heap of cattle fodder, enough to feed a cow for a day.
translations: 一大捆家畜饲料，可以让一头牛吃一天。

messages.msgid: What birds eat.  Mainly made of seeds, silage or legumes.  It's perfect for small birds.
translations: 一些主要由种子、青贮或一些豆类制成的鸟食，小型鸟类非常喜欢吃。

messages.msgid: Minced meat mixed with some greens to be presented to a dog or something with a omnivorous diet.
translations: 剁碎的肉和一些素食混合，用于喂给狗或其他杂食动物。

messages.msgid: This is wet food for dogs, made from canned fresh meats.  It smells strange, but dogs seem to love it.
translations: 半湿犬粮，用罐装鲜肉制成。闻起来很奇怪，但是狗狗喜欢。

messages.msgid: Dry morsels of dog food with a long shelf life.  Made from dried processed meats and grains, and enriched with vitamins and minerals.
translations: 有较长保质期的干犬粮。由加工过的肉类和谷物制成，富含维生素和矿物质。

messages.msgid: Minced meat to be presented to a cat or something with a strict meat diet.
translations: 剁碎的肉，用于喂给猫或其他纯肉食动物。

messages.msgid: This is wet food for cats, made from canned fresh meats.  It has a pungent aroma that cats seem to love.
translations: 湿猫粮，用罐装鲜肉制成。闻起来有点刺鼻，但是猫猫喜欢。

messages.msgid: Dry kibbles of cat food with a long shelf life.  Made from dried processed meats and grains, and enriched with vitamins and minerals.
translations: 有较长保质期的干猫粮。由加工过的肉类和谷物制成，富含维生素和矿物质。

messages.msgid: A paper sachet with tea leaves inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of black tea.
translations: 一个装满了茶叶的小纸袋。把它丢进一杯开水里就能泡出红茶了。

messages.msgid: A paper sachet with tea leaves inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of green tea.
translations: 一个装满了茶叶的小纸袋。把它丢进一杯开水里就能泡出绿茶了。

messages.msgid: A paper sachet with leaves and fruit parts inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of fruit tea.
translations: 一个装满了草叶和干果的小纸袋。把它丢进一杯开水里就能泡出果茶了。

messages.msgid: A paper sachet with dried wild herbs inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of herbal tea.
translations: 一个装满了干草药的小纸袋。把它丢进一杯开水里就能泡出草药茶了。

messages.msgid: A paper sachet with dried dandelion roots inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of dandelion tea.
translations: 一个装满了干蒲公英根茎的小纸袋。把它丢进一杯开水里就能泡出蒲公英茶了。

messages.msgid: A paper sachet with dried chamomile inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of chamomile tea.
translations: 一个装满了干洋甘菊的小纸袋。把它丢进一杯开水里就能泡出甘菊茶了。

messages.msgid: A small packet of commercial instant coffee powder.  No creamer or sweetener added.
translations: 一小包商品化的速溶咖啡粉。未添加奶油或甜味剂。

messages.msgid: A сocoa powder.  No milk or sweetener added.  Bitter, used on baking.
translations: 一份可可粉，未混合甜味剂或奶粉。有点苦，主要用在烘焙。

messages.msgid: A сocoa powder, with some milk powder and sugar added.  Sweet with a bitter aftertaste, water or milk will made it very tasty.
translations: 一份可可粉，掺入了奶粉和糖，后调微苦。用水或牛奶冲泡即可饮用，非常美味。

messages.msgid: Raw hide soaking in a dilute acid solution to extract collagen.  After 24 hours the solution can be strained to extract fresh gelatin.
translations: 一块浸泡在稀酸溶液中提取胶原蛋白的生皮。在24小时后，将溶液过滤就能够提取出新鲜明胶。

messages.msgid: Freshly extracted gelatin in a dilute acid solution.  It needs to be strained to separate the gelatin from the acid.
translations: 在稀酸溶液中新鲜提取出的明胶。它需要过滤以将明胶和酸液分开。

messages.msgid: Dry leftovers that remain after extracting the oil from nuts or seeds.
translations: 一份坚果或种子榨油后留下的干燥残渣。
干的、煮熟的和磨碎的蚯蚓。

messages.msgid: A handful of fried earthworms, cooked in salt.
A handful of common earthworms, boiled to remove impurities.
translations: 一把常见的蚯蚓，煮去杂质。

messages.msgid: A small gastropod harvested from the bushes.  Dangerous to consume raw but can be prepared if you get enough of them.
translations: 一只从灌木丛中找到的小型腹足动物。生吃十分危险，但如果你找到足够多的蜗牛，可以把它们洗净处理。

messages.msgid: A mass of ground seeds that are ready to be pressed into oil.
translations: 一大团磨碎的种子，准备用来榨油。

messages.msgid: A thick mass of ground nuts that are ready to be pressed into oil.
translations: 一大团磨碎的浓稠坚果，准备用来榨油。

messages.msgid: A swarm of honey bees, displaced from the hive.  Without the support and nutrients of an apiary, or taking root somewhere, they will die in a few days.
translations: 从蜂巢或蜂箱里取出来的一群蜜蜂。如果没有蜂房的补给和营养，或者没有在某个地方筑巢，它们将在几天内死亡。

messages.msgid: Instant gravy mix, used for making gravy, instantly.  Not very appetizing in its current form.
translations: 速溶肉汁粉，用于制作肉汁。以目前的形式来看没什么食欲。

messages.msgid: Instant gravy mix, used for making gravy, instantly.  Not very appetizing in its current form.  This one has been made with mushrooms, and as such is vegan friendly.
translations: 速溶肉汁粉，用于制作肉汁。以目前的形式来看没什么食欲。这一份使用蘑菇制成，因此对素食主义者很友好。

messages.msgid: A thin slurry of refined protein mixed with water.  While quite nutritious, it is not particularly tasty.
translations: 少量蛋白质粉与水的混合物，虽然很有营养，但味道并不怎么样。

messages.msgid: Raw, refined protein.  While quite nutritious, it is impossible to enjoy in its pure form, try adding water.
translations: 精制蛋白质原粉。虽然很有营养，但是这种纯净形态让你难以下咽，冲泡后食用。

messages.msgid:
SoyPelusa ran a highly successful crowdfunding campaign for their signature protein bar, dubbed "DaiZoom."

A person can live on one of these bars, three times a day, presumably forever.  After backers received their product, a single flaw was found: most consumers found starvation preferable to the flavor.  Warehouses of the product went unsold as the company went bankrupt, providing the perfect opportunity for FEMA to scoop them up and stock the evac shelters.

Now, you hold a piece of famous crowdfunding history in your hands.  How exciting.
translations:
SoyPelusa公司成功地众筹并生产了这款现象级的"DaiZoom"牌的蛋白质棒。

普通人可以只靠吃这种蛋白棒生存下去，一天三根，大概永远都死不了。在众筹支持者们收到产品后，他们发现了它仅有的一个缺陷：大部分食用者宁愿饿死也受不了这味道。当公司破产之际，存放这些产品的仓库无人问津，这为联邦应急管理局提供了一个绝佳的机会，它接手了这些产品，并用其供应各个紧急避难所。

现在，你手上拿着的就是一段众筹历史的见证。多么令人兴奋！

messages.msgid: A thick and tasty beverage made from pure refined protein and nutritious fruit.
translations: 由蛋白质粉和水果混合而成的营养丰富的美味饮料，口感醇厚。

messages.msgid: A thick and tasty beverage made from pure refined protein and nutritious fruit.  It has been supplemented with extra vitamins and minerals.
translations: 由蛋白质粉和水果混合而成的营养丰富的美味饮料，口感醇厚。特别添加人体所需的维生素和矿物质，均衡膳食营养。
增强型人肉蛋白混合饮料
增强型亚人蛋白混合饮料

messages.msgid: Milk enriched with protein powder, it's extra healthy and doesn't taste too bad.
translations: 添加了蛋白粉的牛奶，特别健康，味道也不太差。

messages.msgid: A thick and tasty smoothie made from pure refined protein and nutritious fruit mixed into milk.
translations: 一份浓稠可口的奶昔，由提纯蛋白粉和营养丰富的水果混合在牛奶中制成。

messages.msgid: An iconic and delicious fruit grown and enjoyed across the world, used for generations in folk medicine as doctor repellant.
translations: 一种标志性且美味的水果，在世界各地广泛种植并食用。数代以来也被用于民间疗法。

messages.msgid: A term used to describe both wild apples native to North America as well as less appetizing feral varieties, these are rather small and far too sour.
translations: 北美本土的野生苹果属植物果实，或者苹果的味道不佳的野化品种。这些野苹果很小，而且太酸了。

messages.msgid: A long, curved yellow fruit in a peel.  Some people like using them in desserts.  Those people are probably dead.
translations:
一种长弧形黄色可剥皮的水果，一些人喜欢拿来当饭后甜点。
"但那些人已经死了。"

messages.msgid: A sweet citrus fruit.  Also comes in juice form.  In case you were wondering, the color is named after the fruit, not the other way around.
translations: 一种甜柑橘类水果。可以榨成果汁。以免你真的会好奇为什么橙子是橙色："橙"色是从水果得来的，而不是反过来。

messages.msgid: A very sour citrus fruit.  Can be eaten if you're desperate, but you should probably look for some other cooking application for this.
translations: 一种非常酸的柑橘类水果。如果你真的很想直接吃，也不是不行，但你或许应该为它寻找一些别的料理用途。

messages.msgid: A handful of tasty sweet-tart berries.  They're blue, but that doesn't mean they're sad.
translations: 一把美味的酸甜浆果。它们是蓝色的，但这并不意味着它们很伤心(blue)。

messages.msgid: Some black hobbleberries.  They are quite sweet.  Before they ripened, they were deceptively red and utterly bitter.
translations: 一些黑色的绊步莓，味道非常甜美。在成熟之前，它们呈欺骗性的红色，且极为苦涩。

messages.msgid: Not tasting anything like olives, this sweet, red and very nutritious fruit can also be used as a tomato-substitute in some cases.
translations: 这种红色，甜美且富有营养的水果，吃起来完全不像橄榄，有时候也可以作为番茄的替代品。

messages.msgid: A handful of tasty, juicy red berries with visible seeds on the outside of the skin.  Often found growing wild in fields.
translations: 一把美味多汁的红色浆果，果皮外面有可见的种子。经常可以在田野中找到野生的。

messages.msgid: A handful of very bitter red berries, probably grown locally in Massachusetts.  Good for urinary tract health.
translations: 一把红色的酸浆果，主要在马萨诸塞州当地生长。有益于泌尿道健康。

messages.msgid: A handful of sweet red berries, each with a hollow core.
translations: 一把红色甜浆果，每颗都有一个空的果核。

messages.msgid: A handful of huckleberries, often times confused for blueberries.
translations: 一把美洲越橘，经常会和蓝莓混淆。

messages.msgid: A bunch of deep red berries with a pleasant bittersweet flavor.  Can have a laxative effect if eaten in large quantities.
translations: 一把深红色的浆果，有股令人愉悦的甘苦回甜的味道。大量食用可以通便。

messages.msgid: A small, edible fruit of an otherwise toxic plant.  You should not eat too many of them.
translations: 一种小型可食用的浆果，来自有毒植物。你不应该吃太多。

messages.msgid: A handful of sweet, brilliant red berries of the wintergreen shrub.
translations: 一把冬青灌木所结出的芬芳而鲜艳的红色浆果。

messages.msgid: This red variety of mulberries is unique to eastern North America, and is said to have the strongest flavor of any variety in the world.
translations: 一把北美桑椹，这种红色品种是北美东部所独有的，据说是世界上所有品种中风味最浓的一个品种。

messages.msgid: A handful of elderberries, toxic when eaten raw but great when cooked.
translations: 一把接骨木果，生吃有毒，但煮熟后很美味。

messages.msgid: Some dark blue nannyberries, tasting like prunes mixed with banana.
translations: 一把深蓝色的保姆莓，尝起来就像是香蕉和梅干的混合味道

messages.msgid: Some dark blue tupelo fruits.  They are tart and feature a hard seed but are still enjoyable.
translations: 一把深蓝色的多花蓝果，它们味道酸涩，有坚硬的种子，但仍然很好吃。

messages.msgid: A handful of black chokeberries.  They look similar to blackcurrant.  Big and juicy but actually exceedingly sour.
translations: 一把野樱莓，它们看起来类似于黑醋栗。果实大而多汁，但实际上非常酸。

messages.msgid: A handful of fruits grown from pollinated rose flowers.  Full of irritating hairs and hard seeds, they'll need to be disassembled before eating.
translations: 一些授粉成功的玫瑰花长成的果实。里面充满了扎人的毛刺和坚硬的种子，食用前需要先拆解。

messages.msgid: Tart little fruits grown from a rose bush, now separated from their inedible seeds and spines.
translations: 玫瑰丛里长出的酸味小果实，已经去掉了不可食用的种子和毛刺。

messages.msgid: A handful of stringy pulp, left-over from juicing some kind of fruit.  It's not very tasty, but contains a lot of healthy fiber.
translations: 一把粘稠的果肉，某种水果榨汁后剩下的。不太好吃，但富含膳食纤维。
一个味美汁多，铃铛外形的梨子。甜中带酸，营养丰富，含有多种维生素和纤维素。

messages.msgid: A sweet, sandy-textured fruit with pink flesh native to the Caribbean, Central America, and South America.  Great for making milkshakes.
translations: 一种甜美的沙质水果，果肉呈粉红色，原产于加勒比海、中美洲和南美洲。非常适合制作奶昔。

messages.msgid: A sweet, acidic fruit originating from South America.  It grows on vines and is filled with seeds like a pomegranate.  Also known as the maracuya.
translations: 一种味道酸甜的水果，原产于南美洲，生长在藤蔓上，果实内长满了种子，像石榴一样。也被称为马拉库亚。

messages.msgid: An acidic fruit found in South America and the Caribbean, it looks like a hairy orange and is used mainly for juice and desserts.  Also known as the naranjilla.
translations: 一种产于南美洲和加勒比海的酸性水果，看起来像多毛的橘子，主要用于果汁和甜点。也被称为纳兰吉拉。

messages.msgid: A hybrid citrus fruit descended from the orange, whose taste ranges from sour to semi-sweet, and a little bitter.
translations: 一种由橙子杂交而来的柑橘类水果，有酸味又有一点甜味，还略带苦味。

messages.msgid: A sweet red fruit that grows on trees.  If you have some time on your hands, maybe you could figure out how to do that trick where you tie a knot in the stem with your tongue.
translations: 一种长在树上的甜红色果实。如果你手头有一些时间，也许可以练习一下那个用舌头给樱桃梗打结的技巧。

messages.msgid: A large purple plum.  Tasty and good for your digestion.
translations: 一把紫色的大李子，饱满圆润，玲珑剔透，形态美艳，口味甘甜，美味又有助于消化。

messages.msgid: A handful of juicy grapes.  Quite calorie-dense compared to most fruit, and you might be able to make them into wine if you're ambitious enough.
translations: 一串多汁的葡萄，与大多数水果相比，它的热量相当高。如果你有雄心壮志——以及耐心，还可以把它们酿成酒。

messages.msgid: A large, spiky tropical fruit.  A tough rind protects the tasty flesh inside, and digging into it as-is would be pretty inefficient and messy.  You should find a knife or something vaguely knife-like to cut it up with.
translations: 一种大型、带刺的热带水果。坚硬的外皮保护着里面可口的果肉，直接徒手剥开既低效又很脏乱。你最好找把刀，或至少找个勉强算刀的东西把它切开。

messages.msgid: A handful of pineapple chunks.  Delicious and a great source of Vitamin C, though a bit sour.
translations: 一捧菠萝果肉，十分美味，而且富含维生素C，就是有点酸。

messages.msgid: A tropical fruit with a hard, hairy shell and a hollow inside full of liquid and edible flesh.  If you want to eat it, you'll have to find something heavy to crack open the shell and something sharp to remove the 'meat'.
translations: 一种热带水果，外壳坚硬且带毛，内部为空腔，充满液体并含有可食用的果肉。若想食用，你需要找个沉重的东西把壳砸开，再用尖锐的工具把“肉”取出来。

messages.msgid: A handful of coconut flesh.  It's surprisingly calorie-dense.
translations: 椰子的果肉，卡路里含量惊人。

messages.msgid: This fruit's large pit is surrounded by its tasty flesh.
translations: 一个近球形带条沟纹的桃子，表面有毛茸，肉质香甜可口，非常美味。

messages.msgid: A deep green melon, bigger than your head.  It is very juicy!  You should be able to take it apart with a knife.
translations: 一个深绿色的比你的头还大的多汁甜瓜！你应该能够用刀把它切开。

messages.msgid: A yummy wedge of watermelon.  A handheld snack that tastes like summer.
translations: 一片美味的西瓜。一种有夏日味道的手持式小吃。

messages.msgid: A large and very sweet orange fruit.  Technically a berry, like all melons are.  You should be able to take it apart with a knife.
translations: 一种大而甜的橙色水果。严格地说是一种浆果，就像所有的甜瓜一样。你应该能够用刀把它切开。

messages.msgid: A handful of cantaloupe melon chunks.  A great snack by itself or in a fruit salad.
translations: 一把哈密瓜块。可以直接吃，也可以用于制作水果沙拉。

messages.msgid: A darker cousin of the raspberry.  The color isn't actually what sets them apart - the identifying characteristic is whether the stem stays connected to the fruit when it's first picked.
translations: 树莓的深色近亲。颜色并不是区分它们的关键——重点特征是首次采摘时，果梗是否与果实相连。

messages.msgid: A fleshy tropical fruit with a large pit.  Better enjoy it soon, you're pretty sure more of these aren't going to be imported for a long time.
translations: 多肉的热带水果，带有一个大果核。最好赶快吃掉，你十分确定，在很长一段时间内，再也不会有人进口这种东西了。

messages.msgid: Under this pomegranate's spongy skin lie hundreds of fleshy seeds.
translations: 一个石榴，海绵一样的果皮下面有着数以百计被果肉包裹的种子，甘甜可口。

messages.msgid: A very sweet and soft tropical fruit.
translations: 一种非常甜、质地柔软的热带水果。

messages.msgid: A large, brown, and fuzzy-skinned berry.  Its delicious insides are green.
translations: 一个大大的，有着棕色毛绒外皮的水果，绿色的果肉有着奇异的味道。

messages.msgid: A handful of smooth-skinned fruits related to the peach.
translations: 一把杏子，表皮很光滑，有着味甜多汁的暗黄色果肉，是桃子的近亲。

messages.msgid: The edible bud of a cholla cactus, with its spines removed; the candy of the Mojave indigenous peoples.  Tastes similar to asparagus.
translations: 可食用的仙人掌花蕾，刺已经去掉了，是莫哈维沙漠土著的最爱。尝起来有点像芦笋。

messages.msgid: A handful of edible pads from a cactus.
translations: 一种仙人掌的肉质茎，可以作为蔬菜食用。

messages.msgid: A corn cob full of delicious golden kernels.  You can eat them on the cob or shell it for cooking.
translations: 一个装满美味的金色果仁的玉米棒子。你可以直接抓住棒子吃，也可以把它剥下来煮。

messages.msgid: An empty corn cob.  No longer contains any edible kernels, but it can be used to make stock or as fuel.
translations: 一个脱粒的玉米芯。不再包含任何可食用的玉米粒，但可以用来制作物品或作为燃料。

messages.msgid: A popcorn cob full of popcorn kernels.  You can eat them on the cob or shell it for cooking.
translations: 一根长满爆米花粒的玉米棒。你可以直接啃着吃，也可以剥下来烹饪。

messages.msgid: A special variety of corn which could be used for making popcorn, after it's dried.  Unlike normal corn, it's not sweet and is more dry.
translations: 一种特殊的玉米，干燥后可以用来做爆米花。不像普通的玉米，它不甜，而且更干。

messages.msgid: Dried kernels from a particular type of corn.  Inedible raw, they can be cooked to make a tasty snack.
translations: 这种干燥过的玉米粒来自于一种特殊种类的玉米。不能生吃，但是加以烹饪就会成为美味的佳肴。

messages.msgid: Plain, unseasoned popcorn.  Not as tasty as other kinds, but healthier as a result.
translations: 一份质朴且毫无味道的"原味"爆米花，味道不如加料的爆米花，但是相比之更加绿色健康无污染。

messages.msgid: Popcorn with salt added for extra flavor.
translations: 加了盐以增添风味的爆米花。

messages.msgid: Popcorn with a light covering of butter for extra flavor.
translations: 裹了一层薄薄黄油以增添风味的爆米花。

messages.msgid: A sheaf of freshly-cut wheat, now ready for drying in a stook or smoker.
translations: 一捆刚刚收割的小麦，现在可以放在炉灶或烟熏架里烘干了。

messages.msgid: A sheaf of dried wheat stalks.  These will require threshing before anything can be done with them.
translations: 一捆干燥的小麦麦穗。在使用它们做任何事情之前，你都需要取下上面的麦子。

messages.msgid: Wheat with the chaff still mixed in.  It will have to be winnowed before it's usable.
translations: 混着谷壳的小麦，它必须经过扬谷才能使用。

messages.msgid: Loose bits of dried straw and seed casings from winnowed grain.  There are a few fragments of seeds still mixed in, a big enough pile of this stuff could be made into bird food or cattle fodder.
translations: 松散的干稻草和筛过的谷壳。里面仍有混着一些种子碎屑，可以收集起来制成鸟食或牛饲料。

messages.msgid: A heap of dried wheatberries, ready for planting.  They're hard as gravel, but could be boiled for food or ground into flour.
translations: 一堆干小麦，可以用于种植。它们像砾石一样坚硬，但可以煮成食物或磨成面粉。

messages.msgid: A sheaf of freshly-cut barley, now ready for drying in a stook or smoker.
translations: 一捆刚刚收割的大麦，现在可以放在炉灶或烟熏架里烘干了。

messages.msgid: A sheaf of dried barley stalks.  These will require threshing before anything can be done with them.
translations: 一捆干燥的大麦麦穗。在使用它们做任何事情之前，你都需要取下上面的麦子。

messages.msgid: Barley with the chaff still mixed in.  It will have to be winnowed before it's usable.
translations: 混着谷壳的大麦，它必须经过扬谷才能使用。

messages.msgid: A pile of dried barleycorn, a staple of brewing everywhere.  It can be planted, boiled, or ground into flour.
translations: 一堆干大麦，世界各地都用它当主食。它可以种植，也可以煮成食物或磨成面粉。

messages.msgid: A sheaf of freshly-cut oats, now ready for drying in a stook or smoker.
translations: 一捆刚刚收割的燕麦，现在可以放在炉灶或烟熏架里烘干了。

messages.msgid: A sheaf of dried oat stalks.  These will require threshing before anything can be done with them.
translations: 一捆干燥的燕麦麦穗。在使用它们做任何事情之前，你都需要取下上面的麦子。

messages.msgid: Oats with the chaff still mixed in.  They will have to be winnowed before they're usable.
translations: 混着谷壳的燕麦，它必须经过扬谷才能使用。

messages.msgid: A sheaf of wild rice stalks, ready for drying.
translations: 一捆野生稻稻穗，可以拿去干燥了。

messages.msgid: A bunch of dry wild rice stalks.  Threshing these would knock the grains loose.
translations: 一捆干燥的野生稻稻穗，需要脱粒后才能使用。

messages.msgid: Raw wild rice, still in its fibrous shell.  It'll need to be milled before it's edible for humans.
translations: 生的野生稻，仍被包裹在其纤维状的外壳中。它需要经过研磨才能供人类食用。

messages.msgid: Dry seeds from a wild buckwheat plant.  Inedible in their present state, they are commonly cooked or ground into flour.
translations: 从野生荞麦里收获的干荞麦，不能生吃，通常要把他们磨成粉或者放在水里煮熟。

messages.msgid: A sheaf of tall grass with slender little seed pods, now ready for drying.
translations: 一捆有着细长的小籽荚的长穗，现在可以拿去烘干了。

messages.msgid: A sheaf of dry grass, it must be threshed to separate out the seeds.
translations: 一捆干草，必须经过脱粒才能从中分出种子。

messages.msgid: Round black seeds mixed in with dry chaff.
translations: 和干谷壳混合在一起的圆形的黑色种子。

messages.msgid: A heap of round black seeds, typically milled and pressed for their oil.
translations: 一堆圆形的黑色种子，通常用于碾磨和压榨以获得油。

messages.msgid: A pile of short stalks with lentils rattling in their pods.  These plants dried in the field and didn't need a tool to harvest, but they'll still need to be threshed and winnowed.
translations: 一捆长着豆荚的短茎，扁豆在豆荚里嘎嘎作响。这些植物可以直接在田里晾干，不需要用工具收割，但仍需要脱粒和扬谷。

messages.msgid: Lentils with chaff mixed in.  These will have to be winnowed before they're usable.
translations: 混着豆荚的燕麦，它必须经过扬谷才能使用。

messages.msgid: A humble but nutrient-rich legume.  They should be cooked prior to consumption, unless you're planning to plant them.
translations: 一种不起眼但富含营养的豆类。食用前应该先煮熟，除非你想拿去种。

messages.msgid: These leafy stalks only get about waist-high and technically aren't a grass, but thanks to their long stems and nutritious seeds, they can still be farmed like any other cereal crop.
translations: 这些多叶的茎秆只有齐腰高，严格意义上讲也不是草，但由于它们的长茎和营养丰富的种子，它们仍然可以像其他谷物作物一样用于种植。

messages.msgid: A heap of dried buckwheat.  It'll need to be threshed before eating, unless you're a cow.
translations: 一堆干燥的荞麦麦穗。除非你是一头牛，否则在吃之前需要把它脱粒。

messages.msgid: A pile of buckwheat seeds with some chaff still mixed in.  Once it's winnowed, it'll be ready for use.
translations: 混着谷壳的荞麦，它必须经过扬谷才能使用。

messages.msgid: A snow-white flower also known as wild bergamot.  Smells faintly of mint.
translations: 一种雪白的花，也被称为野薄荷。散发着淡淡的薄荷气味。

messages.msgid: An almost forgotten staple of the native tribes, called the Indian potato by some.  Very nutritious, but mildly toxic unless cooked.
translations: 几乎被遗忘的土著部落主食，一些人称之为"印第安土豆"。非常有营养，但未煮熟时有轻微毒性。

messages.msgid: This aromatic rhizome can be eaten as is in an emergency, but it is much better used for making beverages.  Its taste is pleasant but it is also tough and stringy.
translations: 这种芳香的根茎可以在紧急情况下食用，但它最好用于制作草药茶。它的味道沁人心脾，但也硬而多筋。

messages.msgid: A slightly sweet tuber.  Contains much inulin which may cause some minor issues with your digestive tract, so it should be cooked.
translations: 一种略带甜味的块茎。含有大量菊糖，可能会导致消化道出现一些小问题，所以应该煮熟后食用。

messages.msgid: Also called ramps, this delicate leafy vegetable is healthy and a tasty ingredient for many dishes.
translations: 这株纤细的多叶蔬菜也被称为北美野韭，是许多菜肴的健康美味配料。

messages.msgid: A big stalk of broccoli.  It's a bit tough, but rich in Vitamin C and quite delicious when properly cooked.
translations: 一大根西兰花茎。它有点偏硬，但富含维生素 C，而且在恰当烹调后相当美味。

messages.msgid: A head of crisp white cabbage.  You should probably prepare it before eating.
translations: 一头脆白的卷心菜。在烹饪前你可能需要先处理一下。

messages.msgid: Edible leaves of the grape vine.  Typically used in salads or as a food wrapping.
translations: 葡萄藤上结出的可食用的叶子。通常用于沙拉或食品包装。

messages.msgid: A handful of crunchy red radish taproots.
translations: 一把松脆的红萝卜主根。

messages.msgid: A bunch of spinach leaves.  Their ability to provide one with superhuman strength has been greatly exaggerated by popular media.
translations: 一束菠菜叶。和大众媒体宣传的不同，吃了并不会拥有超人的力量。

messages.msgid: A healthy root vegetable.  Rich in vitamin A!
translations: 健康的根菜。富含维生素A！

messages.msgid: A stout, branching rhizome from a cattail plant.  Its crisp white flesh is very starchy and fibrous, but you really ought to cook it before you attempt to eat it.
translations: 一根粗壮的香蒲的根茎，新鲜的白色组织富含纤维，毛毛糙糙，你得煮熟它才能吃下肚子。

messages.msgid: The rhizome of the lotus, which has many tubular cavities inside, can be eaten both raw and cooked.
translations: 带有许多管状空腔的莲花根茎，可以生吃也可以烹调后食用。

messages.msgid: A stiff, green stalk from a cattail plant.  It is starchy and fibrous, but it would be much better if you cooked it.
translations: 来自香蒲的绿色硬茎。它富含淀粉和纤维，但如果你把它煮熟会更美味。

messages.msgid: A stiff, green stalk from a plant.  It is starchy and fibrous, but it would be much better if you cooked it.
translations: 来自一株植物的绿色硬茎。它富含淀粉和纤维，烹饪后会更美味。

messages.msgid: A single stalk of celery.  Neither tasty nor very nutritious, but it goes well with salad.
translations: 一根芹菜。既不好吃也不很有营养的蔬菜，但它的口感很适合沙拉。

messages.msgid: A tough protective capsule bulging with densely-packed fibers and seeds, this cotton boll can be processed into usable material with the right tools.
translations: 一个充满了浓密的纤维和种子的坚硬保护荚，可以用适当的工具加工成有用的材料。

messages.msgid: A spicy chili pepper.  Not the best on its own, but adds great flavor when used in cooking.
translations: 一种辣椒。单吃不怎么样，但在烹饪中使用能增添超棒的风味。

messages.msgid: A chili pepper that's been cut into pieces.  The seeds have been removed.
translations: 被切成块的辣椒，里面的种子已被摘除。

messages.msgid: The larger cousin of a pickle.  A vegetable from the gourd family.  Not especially flavorful, but very refreshing.
translations: 泡菜用黄瓜的大个表亲。葫芦科的一种蔬菜。不是特别香，但是很清爽。

messages.msgid: A pickle before it becomes a pickle.  Gherkins are smaller cucumbers that - you guessed it - are used to make pickles.
translations: 变成泡菜黄瓜之前的泡菜用黄瓜。小黄瓜是一种用来做泡菜的黄瓜，你猜对了，它个头比较小。

messages.msgid: The large, tuberous root of a dahlia flower.  It smells spicy, but is too starchy to eat without cooking.
translations: 大丽花的大块根。它闻起来挺辣，但是由于含有太多淀粉，不做熟就不能吃。

messages.msgid: A highly nutritious root, it is tough and bland until cooked, at which point it tastes strangely similar to oysters.
translations: 一种营养丰富的根，在煮熟之前又韧又无味，此时它的味道很奇怪地与牡蛎非常相似。

messages.msgid: A very bitter root, not meant to be eaten raw.
translations: 一种非常苦的根，不适合生吃。

messages.msgid: These are often wild carrots, but beware of poisonous lookalikes.  In any case, the root is tough and is not as tasty as a real raw carrot.
translations: 这些通常是野生胡萝卜，但要当心某些会有毒。无论如何，这些根茎都很硬，不像真正的生胡萝卜那么好吃。

messages.msgid: A stalk of dogbane.  It has very fibrous stems and is mildly poisonous.
translations: 一株罗布麻。有非常厚的植物纤维，并且有点毒性。

messages.msgid: A pungent garlic bulb.  Popular as a seasoning for its strong flavor.  Can be disassembled into cloves.
translations: 一块味道刺鼻的大蒜鳞茎。因其浓郁的气味，是常见的香辛调味料。可以拆解为可种植的蒜瓣。

messages.msgid: Cloves of garlic.  Useful as a seasoning.
translations: 大蒜瓣。可以当作调味料。

messages.msgid: A cluster of small cone-like flowers, indispensable for brewing beer.
translations: 一簇小圆锥状的花，它是啤酒酿造不可缺少的原料。

messages.msgid: A large white tapered root of a horseradish plant.  Way too spicy to eat in this form, but can be used for making condiments.
translations: 一根巨大的白色锥形辣根根茎。这样直接吃太辣了，但可以用来做调味品。

messages.msgid: A crisp head of iceberg lettuce.  You should probably prepare it before eating.
translations: 一颗脆脆的冰山生菜。在烹饪前你可能需要先处理一下。

messages.msgid: A handful of shredded iceberg lettuce.
A stalk of mugwort.  Smells wonderful.
An aromatic onion used in cooking.  Cutting these up can make your eyes sting!
translations: 一种用于烹饪的辛香洋葱。切开时会让眼睛刺痛！

messages.msgid: A fluid bladder from a fungus-based lifeform.  Not very nutritious, but safe to eat.
translations: 一个来自于某种真菌类生物的液体囊包。没什么营养，但吃起来应该是安全的。

messages.msgid: A potato, mildly toxic and not very tasty raw.  Delicious and filling when properly cooked.
translations: 一种马铃薯，微毒，生的不太好吃，但适当烹饪后美味可口又管饱。

messages.msgid: A much less sweet and more starchy relative of the banana; unlike dessert bananas, they usually are eaten cooked rather than raw, and can be processed into flour.  They are a staple food in tropical regions of the world.  Also known as plantains.
translations: 香蕉的近亲，没那么甜，但淀粉含量更高；与水果香蕉不同，芭蕉通常煮熟后食用，而非生吃，也可以加工成面粉。它们是世界热带地区的主食。又名普拉塔恩。

messages.msgid: A large gourd, about the size of a person's head.  It'll require some disassembly before use.
translations: 一个有大约一个人的头那么大的瓜。在使用前需要先切开。

messages.msgid: A quarter section of a pumpkin.  The seeds and stringy inner pulp have been removed.
translations: 南瓜的四分之一块。种子和粘稠的内果肉已被去除。

messages.msgid: Leaves of a horseradish plant with a sharp, bitter and peppery taste.  They're edible, but not commonly eaten.
translations: 辣根的叶子，有一股刺激的苦辣味道。它们虽然可以食用，但并不常见人吃这些叶子。

messages.msgid: A handful of freshly-picked yellow dandelions.  In their current raw state they are quite bitter.
translations: 一把刚采摘的黄色蒲公英。以目前的生食状态而言，它们相当苦。

messages.msgid: Burdock, a bitter thistle-like vegetable.  Can be eaten raw or cooked.
translations: 牛蒡，一种苦涩的蓟类蔬菜。可以生吃或煮熟。

messages.msgid: Raw woody bamboo shoots, they require some preparation before they can be eaten safely.
translations: 生竹笋，在能够被安全食用前，需要先做一些处理。

messages.msgid: A sour stalk of the rhubarb plant, often used in baking pies.
translations: 北美菜用大黄的肉质叶柄，很酸，烤馅饼时常用它。

messages.msgid: This fleshy root is ripe and flowing with sugars; it'll just take some processing to extract them.
translations: 这块新鲜的根茎已经成熟并且充满了糖分。只差最后一些步骤，赶紧把它们都榨出来吧。

messages.msgid: Dried leaves of a tropical plant.  You can boil them into tea, or you can just eat them raw.  They're pretty gross and not too filling that way, though.
translations: 热带植物的晒干的叶子，可以当茶叶泡，还可以直接嚼着吃，只是不饱肚子而且令人恶心。

messages.msgid: These leaves smell strongly medicinal.  When chewed, they first taste sweet but the aftertaste is incredibly bitter.  These leaves contain good amounts of methyl salicylate and merely chewing them may have a similar effect to aspirin.
translations: 这些叶子闻起来有股草药味。咀嚼时，它们最初尝起来有点甜，但回味却极其苦涩。这些叶子中含有大量的水杨酸甲酯，仅仅咀嚼它们可能会产生与阿司匹林相似的效果。
你咀嚼着吃下了冬青叶。

messages.msgid: Dried leaves of a tropical plant.  You can boil them into green tea, or you can just eat them raw.  They're pretty gross and not too filling that way, though.
translations: 热带植物的晒干的叶子，可以泡成绿茶，还可以直接嚼着吃，只是不饱肚子而且令人恶心。

messages.msgid: A juicy red tomato.  It gained popularity in Italy after being brought back from the New World.
translations: 一个鲜美多汁的番茄，从新大陆引入之后就在意大利广泛被食用。

messages.msgid: A cut-up tomato with the seeds removed.
An weird looking chunk of plant matter that's a shade of yellow and green, with oddly thick fibers.  It smells like a mix of rotted wood and dirt, and it leaks a clear fluid.
translations: 一块看起来很奇怪的植物，有着黄色和绿色的阴影和奇怪的粗纤维。它闻起来像腐烂的木头和污垢的混合物，还会泄漏一些清澈的液体。

messages.msgid: A chunk of fungal matter from some sort of alien mushroom creature.  Eating unfamiliar mushrooms is a bad idea.
translations: 一大块外星真菌物质。乱吃陌生蘑菇小心躺板板哦。

messages.msgid: An assortment of edible-looking wild plants.  Most are quite bitter-tasting.  Some are inedible until cooked.
translations: 一些可食用的野菜，据说大部分野菜都含有苦味，一些只有在加工后才可以进行食用。

messages.msgid: A chopped-up summer squash.  The seeds have been removed.
translations: 一种切碎的夏日瓜果。种子已被摘除。

messages.msgid: Raw, uncooked kidney beans.  They are mildly toxic to humans in this form, but you could cook them to make them tasty.
translations: 生的，没有经过烹煮的菜豆。生豆子对人类来说有点毒性，但是熟了就好吃了。

messages.msgid: A handful of immature fern fronds, still curled up like the head of a fiddle.  Delicious when cooked, but consuming them raw can cause food poisoning.
translations: 一把未成熟的蕨菜叶子，仍像小提琴头一样蜷曲着。烹饪后味道鲜美，但生吃会引起食物中毒。

messages.msgid: Some young leaves from miscellaneous plants.  They're tender enough to eat, but not very tasty on their own.
translations: 来自各种植物的嫩叶。很嫩，可以吃，单独食用时味道不怎么样。

messages.msgid: Some chicory greens.  They are quite bitter but high in calcium.
translations: 一些菊苣叶。它们相当苦，但富含钙质。

messages.msgid: Some young Japanese knotweed stems.  They taste a bit like rhubarb and contain good amounts of vitamin A.  Refreshing.
translations: 一些日本虎杖的嫩茎秆。它们尝起来有点像大黄，含有大量的维生素A。十分提神。

messages.msgid: A green bell pepper.  Eating it whole and raw would be kind of a hassle, considering all the seeds.
translations: 一个青椒。考虑到里面有那么多种子，把它整个生吃会有点麻烦。

messages.msgid: A chopped up bell pepper with the seeds removed.
translations: 去掉籽的切好的灯笼椒。

messages.msgid: This wheat-free white flour is useful for baking items for those with grain intolerances.
translations: 不含麸质的白面粉，用于烘烤供麸质不耐的人食用的食物。

messages.msgid: A vegetable from the gourd family, bottle gourds were brought to the Americas by the first Native American settlers crossing the Bering strait.  It can be further prepared to produce a hard, watertight shell, usable as a biodegradable liquid container.  Eating it doesn't look worth it.
translations: 葫芦科的一种蔬菜，由第一批穿越白令海峡的美洲土著定居者带到美洲。它可以进一步制备出坚硬的、不透水的外壳，能制成可降解的液体容器。没必要吃这个。

messages.msgid: A normal and healthy purple eggplant.  Needs to be disassembled before being useful for cooking.
translations: 一个普通且健康的紫色茄子。在烹饪前需要先处理一下。

messages.msgid: A cut-up eggplant with many of the seeds picked out.
translations: 切好的茄子，里面的种子已经被去除。

messages.msgid: A handful of slimy seaweed.  It doesn't look edible, but properly dried, it might make for decent kindling.
translations: 一把滑溜溜的海藻。看上去不适合食用，但如果好好晒干，或许能成为不错的燃料。

messages.msgid: A slimy heap of seaweed.  It doesn't look edible, but properly dried, it might make for decent kindling.
translations: 一把滑溜溜的海藻。看上去不适合食用，但如果好好晒干，或许能成为不错的燃料。

messages.msgid: A handful of edible green seaweed.  It makes a good snack as-is, but can be dried or prepared in a number of ways.
translations: 一把可食用的绿海藻。直接食用就非常可口，也可以晒干或以多种方式烹制。

messages.msgid: A sizable strip of new growth harvested from a sugar kelp.  While these are most often dried, it seems edible enough as is.
translations: 一条相当长的糖海带新芽。虽然通常需要晒干加工，但看起来目前已经可供食用了。

messages.msgid: A leafy bunch of seaweed covered in air bladders.  Many claims are made about its health benefits, but at least as a foodstuff, it's no better or worse than other edible seaweed.
translations: 一束长满气囊的海藻。关于它的健康益处有许多说法，但至少作为食物来说，它与其他可食用海藻无异，既不更好也不更差。

messages.msgid: A delicious grilled cheese sandwich, because everything is better with melted cheese.
translations: 烤过的奶酪三明治，奶酪融化了就是好啊。
一份美味的鸡蛋沙拉三明治。

messages.msgid: A sandwich of meat, vegetables, and cheese with condiments.  Tasty and nutritious!
translations: 这个三明治里塞满了美味的碎肉、奶酪和调料。灾前烹饪工艺的巅峰之作。

messages.msgid: A pre-Cataclysm classic, probably made with significant substitutions.  Key components are the special sauce and sauerkraut, with bread, meat, and cheese fried in a pan.
translations: 一款大灾变前的经典美食，可能含有特别的配方成分。关键成分是特制酱汁和德式酸菜，配上面包、肉和奶酪在锅里煎熟。

messages.msgid: A refreshing cucumber sandwich.  Not very filling, but quite tasty.
translations: 新鲜的黄瓜三明治。不是很填肚子，但很美味。

messages.msgid: A delicious jam and cheese sandwich.
translations: 美味的果酱奶酪三明治。

messages.msgid: A delicious jam and butter sandwich.
translations: 美味的黄油果酱三明治。

messages.msgid: An 'open-faced sandwich' consisting of sliced white bread, a healthy crust-to-crust slathering of butter, and sprinkles.  Supposedly a staple of birthday parties in Australia.
translations: 一个"单面三明治"，由一块切片白面包涂上黄油和彩糖做成。据称是澳大利亚生日宴会的保留项目。

messages.msgid: A simple sauce sandwich.  Not very filling, but it beats eating just the bread.
translations: 单一调味酱的三明治。不是很美味，但比起面包夹面包好得多。
面包夹着蔬菜，就只有这么简单了。

messages.msgid: A vegetarian combination of cheese and vegetable on bread, simple yet satisfying.
translations: 面包配上奶酪和蔬菜的素食组合，简单却美味。

messages.msgid: Some peanut butter smothered between two pieces of bread.  Not very filling, and will stick to the roof of your mouth like glue.
translations: 一份将花生酱夹在两片面包之中的三明治，分量不大，花生酱让口感变得很粘。

messages.msgid: A delicious peanut butter and jelly sandwich.  It reminds you of the times your mother would make you lunch.
translations: 一个美味的花生酱果酱三明治，它让你会想起母亲为你准备午餐的时光。

messages.msgid: Some damned fool put honey on this peanut butter sandwich, who in their right mind- oh wait, this is pretty good.
translations: 一份将蜂蜜涂抹在花生酱三明治，简单的加工却让本身单调的花生酱变得美味起来。

messages.msgid: Who knew you could mix maple syrup and peanut butter to create yet another tasty sandwich?
translations: 一个将枫糖浆和花生黄油混合创造出的全新美味三明治。
一份美味的鱼排三明治。

messages.msgid: A delicious fish bagel with spinach and eggs.
translations: 一份美味的百吉饼，用鱼和菠菜以及蛋类做夹心。

messages.msgid: A bacon, lettuce, and tomato sandwich on toasted bread.
translations: 一个烤面包中夹有培根、生菜和番茄的三明治。

messages.msgid: A sandwich of crispy fried chicken topped with condiments and veggies.  Also called chicken burger, or chicken on a bun.
translations: 一种加了调味品和蔬菜的脆炸鸡三明治。也可以把它叫做炸鸡汉堡，又或是鸡肉面包。

messages.msgid: A delicious peanut butter and marshmallow fluff sandwich.  More commonly referred to as a fluffernutter.
translations: 花生酱和棉花软糖团构成的美味三明治。通常被称为Fluffernutter。

messages.msgid: Roots of a hop plant, for growing your own.
translations: 啤酒花的根茎，你可以用它来种出你自己的啤酒花。

messages.msgid: This pile of dried barley is earmarked for planting.
translations: 这堆大麦是专门用来种植的。

messages.msgid: Some cotton seeds.  Can be processed to produce an edible oil.
translations: 一些棉花种子。经过处理后可以榨出食用油。

messages.msgid: Some cattail seeds.  Must be planted in shallow water.
translations: 一些香蒲种子。必须在浅水中种植。

messages.msgid: Some lotus seeds, which can be used for planting, or cooked and eaten after picking off the bitter internal ingredients.  Must be planted in shallow water.
translations: 一些莲子，可用来种植，也可以摘去里面发苦的莲心后用于烹饪。必须种植在浅水中。

messages.msgid: Boiled lotus seeds, with a soft taste.

translations: 一些蒜叶婆罗门参种子。

messages.msgid: Some seeds from a white flower.
translations: 一些野生根茎的白花上的种子。

messages.msgid: Some small decorative plant seeds, likely grass or flower.  Don't expect them to be useful for anything other than dry plant material.
translations: 一些细小的园艺植物种子，可能是草或花。别指望它提供枯萎植物以外的材料。

messages.msgid: A pile of dried corn, designated for planting.  It could just as easily become food.
translations: 用于种植的一堆干玉米。它可以很容易地变成食物。

messages.msgid: Raw potato cut into pieces, separating each bud for planting.
translations: 一些被切成小块的生马铃薯，带着芽，可用于种植。

messages.msgid: Some poppy seeds.  Could be pressed into oil.
translations: 一些罂粟种子，可以用来榨油。

messages.msgid: Seeds of the cannabis plant.  Filled with vitamins, they can be roasted or eaten raw.
translations: 大麻植物的种子。富含维生素，他们可以烤或生吃。

messages.msgid: This looks like a sunflower seed the size of your palm.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.  You could probably plant it.
translations: 这看起来像拳头大小的葵花籽。香气浓郁，芬芳扑鼻，但显然经过了突变，或许是外星产物也说不准。你可以将它种在地里。
生的菜豆，可以用于种植。

messages.msgid: A pile of dry soybeans.  These are intended for planting, but there's no reason they couldn't be made into food.
translations: 一堆干大豆。这些是用来种植的，但没有理由不能做成食物。
生的扁豆，可以用于种植。

messages.msgid: Some raw pumpkin seeds with the shells on.  Could be fried and eaten.
translations: 一些带壳生南瓜籽。可以油炸食用。

messages.msgid: Some raw sunflower seeds with the shells on.  Could be pressed into oil.
translations: 一些带壳生葵花籽。可以用来榨油。

messages.msgid: A pile of buckwheat, ready to be planted.
translations: 一堆荞麦，可以用于种植。

messages.msgid: Some seeds harvested from wild herbs.
translations: 一些从野生草药中获得的种子。

messages.msgid: Some Japanese knotweed stems, prepared for planting.
translations: 一些日本虎杖的茎秆，可以种植。

messages.msgid: Some wild rice seeds, prepared for planting.
translations: 一些野生稻的种子，可以种植。

messages.msgid: Some starry false Solomon's seal seeds.
Small, dark seeds from the spiny pods of a datura plant.  Full of powerful psychoactive chemicals, these tiny seeds are a potent analgesic and deliriant, and can be deadly in cases of overdose.
translations: 从曼陀罗植株带刺的荚囊中获得的又小又黑的种子。充满了致幻化学物，这些小种子是潜在的止痛剂，亦可以导致谵妄。过量使用会致人死亡。

messages.msgid: A pile of dried whole oats, ready for planting.
translations: 一堆干燕麦，可以用于种植。

messages.msgid: Several cloves of garlic, ready for planting.
translations: 几片蒜瓣，可以用于种植。

messages.msgid: A pile of dry wheatberries, designated for planting.
translations: 一堆干小麦，可以用于种植。

messages.msgid: Some fried seeds of a sunflower, pumpkin or other plant.  Quite nutritious and tasty.
translations: 一些油炸的葵花籽、南瓜籽或其他植物种子。营养丰富，也很美味。

messages.msgid: Coffee pods taken from a Kentucky coffeetree.  If washed thoroughly and roasted, you could use them to make a dark and bitter brew much like coffee.
translations: 从肯塔基州的咖啡树上收获的咖啡豆。如果经过了彻底清洗和烘烤，你可以用它们来酿苦涩的类似黑咖啡的饮品。

messages.msgid: Some coffee beans, can be roasted.
translations: 一些咖啡豆，可以进行烘焙加工。

messages.msgid: Some roasted coffee beans, can be ground into powder.
translations: 一些烘焙后的咖啡豆，可以磨成粉末状。

messages.msgid: A bunch of dry unpopped corn.  It's intended for planting, but could be put to other uses.
translations: 一堆干玉米。它可以用于种植，但也可以用于其他用途。

messages.msgid: Some mustard seeds.  Could be ground into mustard powder.
translations: 一些芥菜种子。可以磨成芥末粉。

messages.msgid: Little, sealed ampule with some white, semi-transparent liquid of unknown origin.  Label on it says "48x-"Locutus"", whatever that means.
translations: 这是一支小巧密封的安瓿瓶，内含些许白色半透明的不明液体。其标签上标有“48x-‘洛库图斯’”，其含义尚不明确。

messages.msgid: Vegetable stock.  Tasty and fairly nutritious.
translations: 一份从植物中获取的成分的汤，十分美味，具有很高的营养价值。

messages.msgid: Meat stock.  Tasty and fairly nutritious.
translations: 肉汤，味道鲜美，营养丰富。

messages.msgid: A tasty and nutritious broth made from bones, with added vinegar to extract more calcium.
translations: 用骨头熬制的肉汤，味道鲜美，营养丰富，醋的加入从骨头中提取出了更多的钙质。

messages.msgid: A nutritious and delicious hearty vegetable soup.
translations: 一份营养丰富且美味的蔬菜汤。

messages.msgid: A hearty stew made of the traditional 'three sisters' plants corn, beans, and pumpkins.  Variations of this dish were a staple of many Native American cultures through the centuries up until current times.  This Abenaki recipe has wild rice added to it.
translations: 由玉米、豆子和南瓜制成的炖菜。美洲土著人发现，将这三种植物混搭种植可以增加收成，称之为"三姐妹"。几个世纪以来，这道菜的演化同样见证着许多美洲土著文化的变迁。在这个来自阿贝内基的食谱中，还在其中加入了野生稻米。

messages.msgid: A nutritious and delicious hearty meat soup.
translations: 一份营养丰富且美味的肉汤。

messages.msgid: A nutritious and delicious hearty fish soup.
translations: 一份营养丰富且美味的鱼汤。

messages.msgid: A spicy South Indian dish filled with vegetables.
translations: 一种充满蔬菜的辛辣菜肴，源自印度南部。

messages.msgid: A spicy South Asian dish filled with chunks of meat and vegetables.
translations: 一种辛辣的南亚菜肴，里面有肉块和蔬菜。

messages.msgid: A nutritious and delicious soup packed with meat and vegetables.
translations: 一份营养丰富的美味炖汤，里面有肉和蔬菜。

messages.msgid: A nutritious and delicious soup packed with eggs and vegetables.
translations: 一份营养丰富的美味炖汤，里面有蛋和蔬菜。

messages.msgid: An old recipe from the American Civil War, designed to make hardtack more palatable.  The hardtack is crushed and combined with water to make it soggy, then fried up with melted chunks of fat until browned, and seasoned with salt and pepper.  Surprisingly edible, considering its ingredients.
translations: 美国内战时期的老菜谱，旨在使压缩饼干更加美味。将压缩饼干碾碎并与水混合使其变湿，然后用融化的脂肪块煎至棕色，并用盐和胡椒调味。尽管成分十分奇怪，但味道意外地不错。

messages.msgid: Chicken chunks and noodles swimming in a salty broth.  Rumored to help cure colds.
translations: 咸汤里泡着鸡肉块和面条。据说能缓解感冒。

messages.msgid: A mushy, gray semi-liquid soup made from mushrooms.
translations: 灰色的半流体，看来放了不少蘑菇。

messages.msgid: A mushy, brown semi-liquid soup made from blood and flour.
translations: 一份糊状的、棕色的粘稠羹汤，由血液和面粉制成。

messages.msgid: Condensed tomato soup.  Not very filling, but it goes well with grilled cheese.
translations: 浓缩番茄汤。不太饱肚子，但加上烤奶酪就能当午餐了。

messages.msgid: A soup with chicken chunks and balls of dough.  Not bad.
translations: 罐装鸡汤，能看到鸡块和小面团。味道不错。

messages.msgid: A rich and tasty fish chowder from Scotland, made with preserved fish and creamy milk.
translations: 一道苏格兰传统美食，由美味的浓鱼汤配以熏鱼及奶油制成。

messages.msgid: A rich and tasty lobster stew from New England, made with fresh lobster, milk, cream, and butter.
translations: 一道来自新英格兰的美味龙虾炖菜，由新鲜龙虾、牛奶、奶油和黄油制成。

messages.msgid: Instant chicken noodle soup made from dehydrated noodles and chicken reconstituted with water.  Not the most exciting meal but better than plain water.
translations: 一份即食鸡汤方便面，由脱水面饼和脱水鸡肉加水调制而成。这算不上让人振奋的一餐，但总比白开水好。

messages.msgid: Instant chicken noodle soup powder made from dehydrated noodles and chicken.  Mix with water to create a mildly improved meal.
translations: 即食鸡肉方便面调料，由脱水面饼和脱水鸡肉制成。与开水混合后，可以制成稍稍改善的一餐。

messages.msgid: Instant spring vegetable soup made from dehydrated noodles and vegetables reconstituted with water.  Not the most exciting meal but better than plain water.
translations: 一份即食春菜汤方便面，由脱水面饼和脱水蔬菜加水调制而成。这算不上让人振奋的一餐，但总比白开水好。

messages.msgid: Instant spring vegetable soup powder made from dehydrated noodles and vegetables.  Mix with water to create a mildly improved meal.
translations: 即食春菜方便面调料，由脱水面饼和脱水蔬菜制成。与开水混合后，可以制成稍稍改善的一餐。

messages.msgid: French chicken stew braised with red wine.
translations: 一道法式红葡萄酒炖鸡肉。

messages.msgid: Chili P, yo!  Not edible on its own, but it could be used to make seasoning.
translations: 一份辣椒粉，没法直接食用，但可以在制造食品时当作调味料使用。

messages.msgid: Garlic that has been dehydrated and ground into a powder.  A must-have seasoning in any pantry.
translations: 经过脱水处理并磨成粉末的大蒜，每家厨房必备的调味品。

messages.msgid: Flamin' hot sauce.  It'd be a bad idea to drink it on its own.  You should probably wash your hands after handling it, too.
translations: 火辣辣的辣酱，不适合直接喝掉。接触后最好洗下手。

messages.msgid: Ground cinnamon bark with a sweet but slightly spicy aroma.
translations: 磨碎的肉桂皮，有点清甜而微辣的芳香。

messages.msgid: A blend of spices meant to be used in some South Asian dishes.  Can't be eaten raw, why would you even try that?
translations: 一份各类香料的混合物，多用于南亚料理中。无法直接食用，但你为啥会想要直接吃这玩意？

messages.msgid: Ground black spice berries with a pungent aroma.
translations: 一些磨碎的黑色香料，带着强烈刺鼻的香气。

messages.msgid: Small, red berries with a pungent aroma.  It is said they are comparable to allspice, but also boasting their own flavor profile.
translations: 小的红色浆果，有强烈的香味。据说它们与百香果相似，但也独具风味。

messages.msgid: These formerly red berries now have a stronger aroma after being dehydrated.
translations: 这曾经的红色小浆果现在经过脱水后气味更强烈。

messages.msgid: Yuck!  You surely wouldn't want to eat this.  It's good for preserving meat and cooking, though.
translations: 呕！你肯定不想吃它。不过它很适合用来腌制肉类和烹饪。

messages.msgid: A fragrant mix of dried oregano, basil, thyme and other spices.
translations: 一份牛至草、罗勒叶、百里香、等香料的混合物。

messages.msgid: Salt mixed with a fragrant blend of secret herbs and spices.
translations: 混合了一些神秘药草和香料的盐。

messages.msgid: Sweet, sweet sugar.  Bad for your teeth and surprisingly not very tasty on its own.
translations: 甜甜的糖，多吃容易蛀牙，直接吃时并不是很美味，更适合用作调味品。

messages.msgid: Known as nonpareils, sprinkles, jimmies, sugar strands or 'hundreds-and-thousands', these colorful balls, rods or flakes of sugar and starch are intended for use decorating soft surfaces of sweets.  Like sugar, they are bad for your teeth and surprisingly not very tasty on their own.
translations: 又名七彩米或巧克力米，这种彩色的糖丸、糖条或者糖片被用于装饰甜品的表面。和白糖一样对牙齿不好，而且单独尝起来也并不怎么好吃。

messages.msgid: A tasty collection of wild herbs including violet, sassafras, mint, clover, purslane, and fireweed.
translations: 一小堆可口的野生草药，包含紫罗兰，黄蟑，薄荷，苜蓿，马齿苋，柳兰草等。
咸味的发酵豆制调味汁.

messages.msgid: A stalk of thyme.  Smells delicious.
translations: 百里香，一种采择自百里香属品种植物、具有烹饪及药用价值的香草。

messages.msgid: A fragrant yellow powder.  Not edible in this form.
translations: 一种有香气的黄色粉末。还不能食用。

messages.msgid: Sweet, sweet sugar?  No, it is bitter-sweet artificial sweetener.  No calories, no worries.
translations: 甜的，是糖吗？不，它是带有苦甜的人工甜味剂。不含任何卡路里，不用担心。

messages.msgid: A cooked stalk from a cattail plant.  Its fibrous outer leaves have been stripped away, and now it is quite delicious.
translations: 一根煮熟的香蒲的草秆，坚韧的外皮和叶子都已经被剥除，非常美味。

messages.msgid: A cooked stalk from a plant.  Its fibrous outer leaves have been stripped away, and now it is quite delicious.
translations: 一份做熟的植物茎杆。它的纤维状外层叶子已被剥去，现在它非常美味。

messages.msgid: A roasted root from a cattail plant.  Its fibrous outer core is charred black, so you can remove it and chew on the dry inside.
translations: 一根烤熟的香蒲根茎，坚韧的外皮已经烧焦。你可以去掉烧焦的外皮后咀嚼内部的可食用部分。

messages.msgid: Sticky, gooey carbohydrate paste extracted from plants.  Spoils rather quickly if not prepared for storage.
translations: 在植物中流出来的胶状粘稠碳水化合物营养物质，如果不好好储藏的话没两下就全坏了。

messages.msgid: Exposed cloves of garlic that have been coated in oil and then roasted.  Much better than eating them raw.
translations: 把大蒜剥瓣，涂上一层油，然后烤熟。比生吃美味多了。

messages.msgid: A chili pepper that has been roasted on high heat, with the skin removed.  This has taken out most of the spice, and it's much better than eating it raw.
translations: 一份经过高温烤制并去皮的辣椒。已经去掉了大部分的辣味，而且比生吃要好得多。

messages.msgid: Cooked leaves from wild dandelions.  Tasty and nutritious.
translations: 一份煮熟的蒲公英叶片，美味且营养丰富，有助于健康。

messages.msgid: Wild dandelion flowers that have been pan fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.
translations: 一份用平底锅煎熟的油煎蒲公英，美味且营养丰富。

messages.msgid: Cooked burdock leaves.  Tasty and nutritious.
translations: 一份煮熟的牛蒡叶片，美味且营养丰富，有助于健康。

messages.msgid: Wild burdocks that have been battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.
translations: 一份将野生牛蒡裹上面粉后炸熟的面拖牛蒡，美味且营养丰富。

messages.msgid: Wild dandelions and burdocks that have been battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.
translations: 一份将野生蒲公英和牛蒡裹上面粉后炸熟的面拖蒲公英配牛蒡，美味且营养丰富。

messages.msgid: Peeled and cooked bamboo shoots.  Tasty and nutritious.
translations: 去皮煮熟的竹笋。美味又营养。

messages.msgid: Raw bamboo shoots that have been peeled, battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.
translations: 把生竹笋去皮、裹上面粉后炸熟。美味且营养丰富。

messages.msgid: A freshly-cooked chunk of plant matter, tasty and nutritious.
translations: 一团新鲜烹饪的美味植物精华，看上去味道不错，营养丰富。

messages.msgid: Cooked wild edible plants.  An interesting mix of flavors.
translations: 一份摘挑后再煮熟的野菜，可以直接食用或用作其他料理之中。

messages.msgid: A dish in which vegetables are set into a gelatin made from a plant stock.
translations: 一份用菜汤制成的一种冻状食物。

messages.msgid: A serving of cooked buckwheat porridge.  Healthy and nutritious but bland.
translations: 一份煮熟的荞麦粥。健康且营养丰富，但味道寡淡。

messages.msgid: Canned corn in water.  Eat up!
An ear of corn cooked in foil.
translations: 用锡纸包着烤熟的玉米棒。

messages.msgid: Corn roasted in a frying pan with herbs and spices.
translations: 在煎锅里用香草和香料烤熟的玉米棒。

messages.msgid: Popcorn kernels which have been cooked in an alkaline solution and then rinsed, making them better suited for eating or cooking.
translations: 一些用碱性溶液煮熟并漂洗干净的爆米花碎粒，使其更适合食用或烹饪菜肴。

messages.msgid: This yellow cornmeal is useful for baking.
translations: 这黄色的玉米面可以用来做成面包。

messages.msgid: Slow-cooked beans with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.
translations: 慢火烹制的豆子，配有一些蔬菜，美味又管饱。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated long-grain rice.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, virtually inedible when dry.
translations: 脱水的长粒米。煮熟以后美味又营养，但是干燥状态几乎不能食用。

messages.msgid: Raw, milled wild rice.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, virtually inedible when dry.
translations: 生的、碾过的野生米。煮熟以后美味又营养，但是干燥状态几乎不能食用。

messages.msgid: A hearty serving of cooked long-grain white rice.
translations: 一份热腾腾香喷喷的米饭。

messages.msgid: A hearty serving of cooked wild rice.
translations: 一份热腾腾香喷喷的野生米饭。

messages.msgid: Delicious fried rice with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.
translations: 配有蔬菜的炒饭，美味又管饱。

messages.msgid: A serving of beans and rice that has been cooked together.  Delicious and healthy!
translations: 将豆子和大米放在一起煮，美味又健康。

messages.msgid: Coming from a word meaning "broken corn kernels" in the language of the Narragansett, it is a popular dish during hard times and Thanksgiving in New England.  Incorporating maize and beans (or a similar legume), it is cheap and made from common ingredients.
translations: 它来自纳拉甘塞特语中的"碎玉米粒"一词，在新英格兰的困难时期和感恩节期间是一道受欢迎的菜。它融合了玉米和黄豆（或类似的豆类），价格低廉，由普通原料制成。

messages.msgid: Succotash, but made more modern and tasty by adding some flavorful ingredients.
translations: 还是煮玉米菜豆，但是加了许多风味调料，使其更好看且美味了。

messages.msgid: Delicious tofu fried rice with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.
translations: 配有蔬菜的豆腐炒饭，美味又管饱。

messages.msgid: A tofu stirfry with rice and a sweet, bold flavor sure to stay on your mind through these dark days.
translations: 爆炒豆腐拌饭的甘美滋味伴随着你度过这些黑暗的日子。

messages.msgid: Slow-cooked beans and rice with vegetables and seasonings.  Tasty and very filling.
translations: 将慢火烹制的豆子与米饭一起烹调，配上蔬菜和调料。美味又管饱。

messages.msgid: A delicious baked potato or other tuber.  Got any sour cream?
translations:
一个香气喷鼻的烤马铃薯（或者其它块茎作物）。
"能淋上点酸奶油就好了。"

messages.msgid: A boiled potato or other tuber, the keystone of comfort food.
translations: 一个煮熟的土豆（或者其它块茎作物），舒适食品的基石。

messages.msgid: A boiled lotus rhizome, with a soft taste.
The much less sweet and more starchy relative of the banana, that has been cooked to make it better suited for eating.
translations: 香蕉的近亲，没那么甜，但淀粉含量更高，经过烹调后更适合食用。
简单而美味的烤胡萝卜。

messages.msgid: A grilled glazed carrot, topped with some aromatic herbs.  Simply divine.
translations: 经过油煎而表面发亮的胡萝卜，点缀有一些芳香的草药。简直是神来之笔。

messages.msgid: A simple dish made by cooking pumpkin pulp and then mashing.
translations: 将南瓜肉煮熟、捣碎，一份简单的菜肴——南瓜泥就完成了。

messages.msgid: A delicious baked pie with a tasty vegetable filling.
translations: 一份填满美味蔬菜的烤馅饼。

messages.msgid: A crispy, savory pastry filled with spicy potatoes and vegetables, popular in Indian cuisine.
translations: 一种酥脆可口、咸香美味的糕点，内馅填充着辛辣的土豆和蔬菜，在印度菜中很受欢迎。

messages.msgid: A vegetarian pizza, with delicious tomato sauce and a fluffy crust.  Its smell brings back great memories.
translations: 一份蔬菜披萨，上面涂有美味的番茄酱和蓬松的面包片。

messages.msgid: Olive oil, basil, garlic, and pine nuts.  Simple and delicious.
translations: 橄榄油，紫苏，大蒜，松子。简单而美味。

messages.msgid: This mushy pile of vegetable matter was boiled and canned in an earlier life.  Better eat it before it oozes through your fingers.
translations: 一团被煮的稀烂的蔬菜，在刚煮熟的时候就用罐头封装密封。最好在它从你指缝渗光前吃掉。

messages.msgid: Vegetable chunks pickled in a salt bath.  Goes well with burgers, if you can find one.
translations: 一份盐浴蔬菜，配合汉堡味道更佳。

messages.msgid: Spaghetti with a generous helping of pesto on top.  Yum!
translations: 上面覆盖着厚厚一层香蒜酱的意大利面。非常好吃！

messages.msgid: A small pickled cucumber.  Rather sour, but tastes good and lasts for a long time.
translations: 一个腌黄瓜，酸酸甜甜，美味可口而且保质期很长。

messages.msgid: A delicious sautee of lovely diced onions and sauerkraut.  The smell alone is enough to make your mouth water.
translations: 美味的酸菜炒洋葱，单是气味就能让人口水直流。

messages.msgid: A serving of crisply brined and canned vegetable matter.  Tasty and nutritious.
translations: 脆爽的腌蔬菜，美味又营养。

messages.msgid: A serving of fried pickled vegetables, tangy with a crunchy golden-brown coating.
translations: 一份油炸咸菜，金色的酥脆外壳中是浓郁的味道。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated vegetable flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.
translations: 一些片状脱水蔬菜，如果储存妥善，这种干燥的食物可以保存非常长的时间。

messages.msgid: A dehydrated chili pepper.  Still not great, but you can easily ground or mill it into powder.
translations: 一颗脱水的辣椒。作为食物而言仍不算好，但你可以将其轻松磨成粉末。

messages.msgid: Dehydrated garlic.  You definitely don't want to eat these like this, but they can be milled or grounded into garlic powder.
translations: 一份脱水的大蒜。你肯定不想直接这样干吃，但可以磨碎或磨成蒜粉。

messages.msgid: A handful of dried corn kernels.
Reconstituted vegetable flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的蔬菜片，泡过水再吃更美味了。

messages.msgid: Reconstituted chili pepper.  It isn't less spicy after dehydrating and rehydrating but it can be used to flavor your dishes again.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的辣椒，脱水再泡水后，它的辣味并没有减少，依然能为你的菜肴调味。

messages.msgid: Reconstituted garlic cloves, much more edible than its dehydrated state, although the flavor and texture has changed in the process.  Can be used for recipes, albeit its shelf life is shortened by a great margin.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的蒜瓣，在加工过程中味道和口感发生了变化，但还是比脱水状态下可口多了。尽管保质期大大缩短，但仍可用于食谱。

messages.msgid: Reconstituted corn kernels, much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.
translations: 一些脱水后再水发的玉米粒，泡过水再吃更美味了。

messages.msgid: A salad made with all kind of vegetables.
translations: 一盘什锦蔬菜沙拉，营养丰富。

messages.msgid: A dried salad packed in a box with mayonnaise and ketchup.  Add water to enjoy.
translations: 包装在小盒子里的干燥沙拉和蛋黄酱、番茄汁，加入净水就能开始享用了。

messages.msgid: A dried salad with water added, not very tasty but still a decent substitution for real salad.
translations: 泡好的方便沙拉，距离真正的沙拉还是有差距的，但是至少能吃。

messages.msgid: Baking this dahlia root has broken down the starch, making it softer and sweeter.
translations: 烤过的大丽花根已经分解了其中的部分淀粉，这使它变得更加柔软和香甜。

messages.msgid: Now that it's been properly cooked, this salsify tastes vaguely like oysters.  Makes a great side dish.
translations: 这份已经烤熟的蒜叶婆罗门参，味道有点像牡蛎，是一道很好的配菜。

messages.msgid: A serving of sticky vinegared rice, commonly used in sushi.
translations: 制造寿司时使用的粘醋饭。

messages.msgid: A triangular block of tasty sushi rice with a healthy green vegetable folded around it.
translations: 一块三角形的美味饭团，用一些绿色蔬菜包裹着。

messages.msgid: Delicious chopped vegetables wrapped in tasty sushi rice and rolled up in a healthy green vegetable.
translations: 将蔬菜切成小条然后用紫菜包起来的寿司卷。

messages.msgid: Pieces of alien mushroom that have been dried to prevent them from rotting away.  They will still poison you if you eat them.
translations: 经过脱水以防止它们腐烂的异界真菌块。依旧有毒不宜食用。

messages.msgid: This crunchy, sour topping made from lettuce or cabbage is perfect for your hot dogs and hamburgers, or, if you're desperate, straight to your stomach.
translations: 这种脆脆、酸酸的泡菜由生菜或是卷心菜制成，配上热狗和汉堡就最完美了。不过紧要关头也可以直接吃下肚。

messages.msgid: A less prickly version of cactus pads.
translations: 一种刺更少的仙人掌茎片。

messages.msgid: Boiled fiddleheads.  Not bad, but would be better sauteed in butter.
translations: 一份煮熟的蕨菜叶。吃起来还不差，但要是用点黄油煎一下就更棒了。

messages.msgid: Fiddleheads sauteed in fat.  Tender and delicious.
translations: 用油煎过的蕨菜。软嫩而美味。

messages.msgid: Most of this artichoke's inulin has been converted into fructose after cooking, and it now tastes pleasantly sweet.
translations: 这种洋姜所含的大部分菊糖在烹饪后都转化为果糖，现在尝起来很甜。

messages.msgid: Still crunchy but much more palatable than raw, with a slight nutty taste.
translations: 煮熟的洋姜仍然很脆，但比生的更可口，还有一点坚果味。

messages.msgid: A cored and cooked bell pepper.  It is far more enjoyable now that the seeds are removed.
translations: 一份去核并煮熟的灯笼椒。去掉籽之后吃起来更美味。

messages.msgid: Ground nuts that have been peeled and then boiled, to destroy the harmful protease inhibitors.  Safe to eat, but need further cooking to become palatable.  Can be used much like potatoes.
translations: 去皮并煮熟的美国豆芋，其中有害的蛋白酶抑制剂已被破坏。可以安全食用，但需要进一步烹饪才能变得可口。烹饪方法和土豆差不多。

messages.msgid: Boiled ground nuts.  They look and taste a little like potatoes, but with a slight nutty taste.
translations: 煮熟的美国豆芋。它们的外观和味道有点像土豆，但带有轻微的坚果味。

messages.msgid: Chopped tomatoes, spices, and any number of other vegetables, used as a condiment in Mexican food.  Not so good on its own, but great in a dish.
translations: 切碎的番茄、香料、以及一些其它的蔬菜，用作墨西哥食物的调味品。单独吃不太好，但配着菜很棒。

messages.msgid: A Greek eggplant dip.  The eggplants are baked until almost falling apart and seasoned with a big help of garlic, then mixed with some oil and acid.
translations: 一道希腊茄子沙拉，将茄子烤到几乎散开，然后用大量大蒜调味，最后混合少许油和柠檬汁。

messages.msgid: Onions cooked up in oil and spices, often used as a topping or side in dishes.
translations: 用油和香料煎过的洋葱，常用作其它菜的浇头或者配菜。

messages.msgid: An essential component of Japanese cuisine, this dried sheet of seaweed has hardened to the point of inedibility.  Boiled in water, it should make an excellent broth.
translations: 这是日本料理中不可或缺的部分，这种干海藻片已经硬到无法食用的地步。但如果用水熬煮，它应能成为极美的高汤。

messages.msgid: Boiled potatoes mashed together with salt & oil.
translations: 将煮熟的土豆与盐和油一起捣成泥。

messages.msgid: Whole wheat or barley kernels that have been boiled in water.  Very bland on their own, but will do if you can't prepare them in a different way.
translations: 用水煮熟的全麦或大麦仁。它们本身毫无滋味，但如果你实在想不出其他的吃法，也能吃饱吧。

messages.msgid: A type of pasta usually used when preparing spaghetti.  It could be eaten raw if you're desperate, but is much better cooked.
translations: 一种用来做意大利面的面条。当你饿的不行时，生吃也不是不可以，但是弄熟了之后会好吃得多。

messages.msgid: A pasta sheet used in making lasagne.  It could be eaten raw if you're desperate, but is much better cooked.
translations: 一片用来做千层面的生面。当你饿的不行时，生吃也不是不可以，但是弄熟了之后会好吃得多。

messages.msgid: Fresh wet noodles.  Fairly bland, but fills you up.
translations: 新鲜的煮面条，虽然乏味，但比啃树根好。

messages.msgid: It could be eaten raw if you're desperate, but is much better cooked.
translations: 当你饿得不行时，生吃也没什么影响，当然，弄熟了再吃最好不过。

messages.msgid: When the cheese starts flowing, Kraft gets your noodle going.
translations: 上面覆盖着奶酪的通心粉，好香啊！

messages.msgid: This enriched white flour is useful for baking.
translations: 这白色的面粉可以用来做成面包。

messages.msgid: This white flour is useful for adding more stretch and chew to bread while baking.
translations: 这种白面粉有助于在烘烤时增加面包的弹性和咀嚼性。

messages.msgid: Dry flakes of flattened grain.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, it also doubles as food for horses while dry.
translations: 扁平的谷物干片。烹饪后美味和营养并存，干的时候也可以作为马的食物。

messages.msgid: A filling and nutritious New England classic that has sustained pioneers and captains of industry alike.
translations: 新英格兰经典食物，饱肚子有营养。

messages.msgid: A filling and nutritious New England classic that has been improved with the addition of extra wholesome ingredients.
translations: 新英格兰经典食物，饱肚子有营养，更加入了新配方。

messages.msgid: Boiled cornmeal, a simple type of porridge.
translations: 煮过的玉米粉，一种简单的粥。

messages.msgid: Pulp left over after making oat milk.  It's gritty and incredibly bland.
translations: 制造燕麦乳剩下的残渣。口感像沙子，而且味同嚼蜡。

messages.msgid: Boiled cornmeal with cheese to add a little more flavor.
translations: 煮过的玉米粉，加入了奶酪以增添些许风味。

messages.msgid: Fluffy and delicious pancakes with real maple syrup.
translations: 用枫糖浆做的松软又美味的煎饼。

messages.msgid: Fluffy and delicious pancakes with real maple syrup, made sweeter and healthier with the addition of wholesome fruit.
translations: 用枫糖浆做的松软又美味的煎饼，加了水果之后更加健康和香甜。

messages.msgid: Blodplättar is not your average pancake.  It does not taste of blood at all and it tastes like a crispier black pudding.
translations: 血煎饼不是一般的煎饼。它一点血的味道也没有，尝起来像一个更脆的黑布丁。

messages.msgid: Slices of bread dipped in a milk and egg mixture then fried.
translations: 切片的面包浸过奶蛋糊之后炸成。

messages.msgid: Hey it's waffle time, it's waffle time.  Won't you have some waffles of mine?
translations: 嗨，华夫饼时间到了，华夫饼时间到了。你不想来一块我的华夫饼吗？

messages.msgid: Crunchy and delicious waffles with real maple syrup, made sweeter and healthier with the addition of wholesome fruit.
translations: 嘎嘣脆的美味华夫饼浇上枫糖浆，配上水果使它更甜、更健康。

messages.msgid: Dry and salty, these crackers will leave you quite thirsty.
translations: 一些又咸又干的饼干，味道不错，但吃完会让你口渴。

messages.msgid: Wheat Snack Bread, a delicious snack made from wheat.
These bite-sized crackers go well with soups, but will make you thirsty on their own.
translations: 这些一口大小的饼干适合用来配汤，但直接吃会让你很口渴。

messages.msgid: A delicious baked pie with a sweet fruit filling.
translations: 一个放满了香甜水果的烤派，非常美味且营养丰富。

messages.msgid: A delicious pizza with molten cheese on top.
translations: 一份铺满融化奶酪的美味披萨。

messages.msgid: A tasty and nutritious mixture of oats, honey, and other ingredients that has been baked until crisp.
translations: 一份由燕麦片、蜂蜜和其他原料制成的燕麦卷，烘烤至香脆可口，美味且营养丰富。

messages.msgid: A sweet and delicious baked pie with pure maple syrup.
translations: 一块香甜可口的馅饼派，加了纯净的枫树糖浆烘烤制成。

messages.msgid: So-called ramen noodles.  Can be eaten raw.
translations: 一份方便面，是种可在短时间之内用热水泡熟食用的面制食物，亦可直接食用。

messages.msgid: This traditional Scottish treat is a sweet and filling little boiled cake studded with dried fruit.
translations: 苏格兰传统美食，嵌入很多果干的水煮小糕点。

messages.msgid: Filling bread buns, taste good with tea on a Sunday morning breakfast.
translations: 夹在面包小圆面包里的馅料，周日早晨配茶当早餐很合适。

messages.msgid: Plain, fluffy cake for the proletariat.

HPBT.

艇尾空尖弹
