messages.msgid: A small brown box without a cover.
translations: 一个无盖的棕色小盒子

messages.msgid: A beige collapsible drum with a water valve and D-Rings.  Text on its top clearly says "POTABLE WATER ONLY".
translations: 一个米色折叠桶，带有阀门和 D 型环扣。上面清楚地写着"仅限饮用水"。

messages.msgid: A black collapsible drum with a valve and D-Rings.  Yellow text on its top clearly says "FLAMMABLE".  Empty and collapsed, it could be moved elsewhere.
translations: 一个黑色大型折叠桶，带有阀门和 D 型环扣。上面写着黄色的"易燃"字样。它已经被清空并折叠起来，可以移动到其他地方。

messages.msgid: A badly mangled human body.  A giant puncture wound is visible on its upper chest, and something has drained most of the moisture from the carcass, leaving it desiccated and making it impossible to determine the body's age.
translations: 一具严重破损的尸体。在他的上胸部可以看到一个巨大的穿刺伤口，有什么东西把尸体上的大部分水分都吸干了，使尸体变得十分干燥，无法确定尸体的年龄。
一具没有生命体征的人类尸体。

messages.msgid: A dead body of a middle-aged man.
A dead body of a young woman.
A dead body of a little boy.
A dead body of a little girl.
The dead body of a small child.  Their corpse bears a calm facial expression, as if they died instantly.
translations: 一具儿童的尸体，其表情十分平静，就像是一瞬间死掉的。

messages.msgid: The dead body of a child, riddled by bullets to the extent that you can no longer tell their gender.
translations: 一具儿童的尸体，已经被子弹打成了筛子，你甚至辨认不出这具尸体的性别。

messages.msgid: The corpse of an infant.  A single small-caliber bullet has been put through its skull.
translations: 婴儿的尸体。一颗小口径子弹穿过了它的头骨。

messages.msgid: A dead body of an old woman.  Both of her earlobes are torn, several of her fingers have been chopped off, and several of her teeth have been knocked out.
translations: 一具老太太的尸体。她两边的耳垂都被撕裂，许多根手指被截断，连嘴里的牙也被打掉了不少。

messages.msgid: A dead body, coated in congealed blood.
translations: 一具沾满了凝固的血液的尸体。

messages.msgid: A dead body with a frightful grimace on its face.  He appears to have been horribly mangled prior to his death.
translations: 一具脸上带着恐怖表情的的尸体，看起来在死前身体就遭受了可怕的损害。

messages.msgid: An awful, almost unidentifiable mass of charred flesh.
translations: 一堆令人作呕的无法辨认的烧焦尸块。

messages.msgid: A dead body with a gaping stab wound in its back.
translations: 一具后颈被刺了个大洞的尸体。

messages.msgid: The bloody corpse of a young man.  He has been stabbed repeatedly in the jugular and throat with a small blade.
translations: 一具年轻人的血淋淋的尸体。他被一把小刀反复刺伤颈静脉和喉咙。

messages.msgid: The dead body of a person.  They look to have been skewered with a large, sharp implement.
translations: 一个人的尸体。它看起来是被一个大而锋利的东西刺穿的。

messages.msgid: The corpse of a tall middle-aged woman.  She appears to have many stab wounds up her legs and thighs.
translations: 一具高大中年妇女的尸体。她的小腿和大腿上似乎有许多刺伤。

messages.msgid: The corpse of a small old lady, her face caked in blood and missing an eye.
translations: 一具身材矮小的老太太的尸体，她的脸上满是血块，少了一只眼睛。

messages.msgid: The dead body of a person.  Their forehead bears a large bullet entrance wound.  An even larger exit wound is present on the back of their head.
translations: 一具尸体，额头上有一个巨大的子弹入射伤口，后脑勺则有另一个更大的伤口。

messages.msgid: The upper half of a dead body, as if it was torn apart with enormous force.  Some organs are hanging out.
translations: 一具尸体的上半截，像是被蛮力撕开的一样。一些器官从里面漏了出来。

messages.msgid: A half-decapitated dead body.  It is unclear what could have caused such a wound.
translations: 一具头没了一半的尸体。造成这种损伤的原因不得而知。

messages.msgid: The corpse of a young blonde woman shot several times in the back with a low-caliber weapon.
translations: 一具年轻金发女子的尸体，它被一把小口径枪械从背后多次射击。

messages.msgid: An androgynous-looking corpse gored by bullet wounds from chest to thighs, leaving the face eerily pristine.
translations: 一具无法分辨性别的尸体，从胸膛到大腿都被子弹打得血肉模糊，但却留下了一副诡异的干净面孔。

messages.msgid: The corpse of a seemingly older man.  He appears to have been shot in the forehead at very close range, leaving you a good view of his brain matter.
translations: 一具年长男性的尸体，似乎是在很近的地方被击中了前额，你可以清晰地看见他的脑子。

messages.msgid: The corpse of a middle-aged woman, her legs and arms covered in blood.  She appears to have been shot in the thigh.
translations: 一具中年妇女的尸体，她的腿和手臂都沾满了鲜血。她似乎大腿中枪。

messages.msgid: The corpse of a young man who appears to have been shot to death.  His right arm is only barely still attached to his shoulder.
translations: 一名年轻男子的尸体，似乎是被枪杀的。他的右臂都快从肩膀上断开了。

messages.msgid: The corpse of a tall woman unblemished but for the bloody hole atop her head, her thick black hair intermixed now with brain, viscera and shotgun pellets.
translations: 一名身材高大的女性尸体，除了头部上的血洞之外没有其他伤痕，她浓密的黑发现在和脑子、内脏和霰弹混合在了一起。

messages.msgid: The dead body of a person.  There is a bloody bite wound on their forearm.  Dry filth surrounds it.
translations: 一具人类尸体。前臂上有一处血迹斑斑的咬伤。周围有一圈已经干燥了的污物。

messages.msgid: The dead body of a person.  There is a bloody bite wound on their forearm.  Dry filth surrounds it but the body seems otherwise unharmed.
translations: 一具人类尸体。前臂上有一处血迹斑斑的咬伤。周围有一圈已经干燥了的污物，但身体其他部位似乎没有受到伤害。

messages.msgid: One of this deceased persons shoulders is disfigured by a deep bite wound with a distinct shape, obviously caused by a human.
translations: 死者的肩膀有一处形状独特的深咬伤，显然是人为造成的。

messages.msgid: This unlucky fellow has a deep, straight cut wound on their hand.  The blackened veins suggest it got infected.
translations: 这个倒霉蛋的手上有一道又深又直的伤口。发黑的静脉表明它已经被感染了。

messages.msgid: This lifeless body is covered in myriads of uneven scratches.  Some of them look pretty swollen.
translations: 这具没有生命体征的尸体上布满了无数凹凸不平的痕迹。有些看起来肿得很厉害。

messages.msgid: Waxen skin drapes the remnants of an unknowable death.
translations: 蜡状皮肤覆盖着这具死因未知的尸体的残余部分。

messages.msgid: A broken Exodii worker.  It's possible it could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的流亡族工兵机器人。可以拆解得到部件。
流亡族四足机器人（损坏）

messages.msgid: A broken Exodii walker.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的流亡族四足机器人。可能因为巨大的体积和质量的缘故，就算已经永久无法继续运作依旧看起来可怕无比。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A broken Exodii turret.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的流亡族炮塔。可能因为巨大的体积和质量的缘故，就算已经永久无法继续运作依旧看起来可怕无比。可以拆解得到部件。
流亡族气球无人机（损坏）

messages.msgid: A broken balloon drone.  The balloon has been shredded, but most of the chassis is still intact.  Could be gutted for parts.
translations: 一台损坏的气球无人机。气球已被撕碎，但大部分底盘仍然完好无损。可以拆解得到部件。

messages.msgid: A split-open facet reveals an interior full of closely-fit geometric primitives among chipped strips of milk-white quartz.  The composition of parts lends you no clues as to how this machine ever functioned.
translations: 一个裂开的琢面揭露出它内部充满了各种紧密结合的几何基元外形的零件，以及无数破裂的奶白色石英结晶长条。这些组合的零件并不能给你带来任何这台机器如何运作的线索。

messages.msgid: Its broken shell reveals an interior made from a single piece of quartz, intricately carved into a series of nested tetrahedra.
translations: 这个破损的外壳显露出了它的内部结构：由一块完整的石英雕琢而成，精细地雕刻成一系列相互嵌套的四面体。

messages.msgid: A large golden monolith.  Carefully carved asymmetric edges betray its artificial origin.
translations: 巨大的黄金碑体。其精密雕刻的不对称棱边暴露了人工造物的本质。

messages.msgid: A small piece of inscrutable alloy shaped like an arrow's broadhead.  It doesn't look like much of a robot once dead.
translations: 一小块不可思议的合金，形状类似于箭矢的宽箭头。这东西停机后就不像个机械装置了。

messages.msgid: A great sickle-shaped leg, slumped and lifeless.  The metal is cold to the touch, and its near invisible joints are locked in place.
translations: 一条巨大的镰刀形腿，耷拉着毫无生气。这种金属摸起来很冷，它几乎看不见的关节被机构锁死。

messages.msgid: A great carved piece of gold and crystal, slumped in the form of an unearthly arachnid.
translations: 一块巨大的黄金和水晶雕刻品，以某种异界蜘蛛的形式瘫软在地上。

messages.msgid: An inactive EMP hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains an EMP grenade and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to reprogram and release the EMP hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.
translations: 一台未激活的 EMP 无人机，一种拳头大小的飞行机器人。这台无人机的内部搭载了一枚 EMP 榴弹，通过飞向敌人并引爆 EMP 榴弹来攻击敌人。使用它以将其激活。电子学和计算机学等级决定了你将其重新编程的成功几率。

messages.msgid: The EMP hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
translations: 这台 EMP 无人机从你手上飞起，在附近区域自动寻找目标中！

messages.msgid: You misprogram the EMP hack; take cover!
translations: 你没设好这台 EMP 无人机的程序，它现在变成敌对的了！快找掩护吧！

messages.msgid: An inactive C-4 hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a C-4 demolition charge and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the C-4 hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.
translations: 一台未激活的 C4 无人机，一种拳头大小的飞行机器人。这台无人机的内部搭载了一发 C4 炸药，通过飞向敌人并引爆 C4 炸药来攻击敌人。使用它以将其激活。电子学和计算机学等级决定了你将其重新编程的成功几率。

messages.msgid: The C-4 hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
translations: 这台 C4 无人机从你手上飞起，在附近区域自动寻找目标中！

messages.msgid: You misprogram the C-4 hack; take cover!
translations: 你没设好这台 C4 无人机的程序，它现在变成敌对的了！快找掩护吧！

messages.msgid: An inactive flashbang hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a flashbang and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the flashbang hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.
translations: 一台未激活的闪光弹无人机，一种拳头大小的飞行机器人。这台无人机的内部搭载了一枚闪光弹，通过飞向敌人并引爆闪光弹来攻击敌人。使用它以将其激活。电子学和计算机学等级决定了你将其重新编程的成功几率。

messages.msgid: The flashbang hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
translations: 这台闪光弹无人机从你手上飞起，在附近区域自动寻找目标中！

messages.msgid: You misprogram the flashbang hack; take cover!
translations: 你没设好这台闪光弹无人机的程序，它现在变成敌对的了！快找掩护吧！

messages.msgid: An inactive tear gas hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a tear gas canister and attacks by flying at its target and releasing the gas.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the tear gas hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.
translations: 一台未激活的催泪弹无人机，一种拳头大小的飞行机器人。这台无人机的内部搭载了一枚催泪弹，会飞向敌人并释放出气体。使用它以将其激活。电子学和计算机学等级决定了你将其重新编程的成功几率。

messages.msgid: The tear gas hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
translations: 这台催泪弹无人机从你手上飞起，在附近区域自动寻找目标中！

messages.msgid: You misprogram the tear gas hack; take cover!
translations: 你没设好这台催泪弹无人机的程序，它现在变成敌对的了！快找掩护吧！

messages.msgid: An inactive grenade hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a grenade and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the grenade hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.
translations: 一台未激活的榴弹无人机，一种拳头大小的飞行机器人。这台无人机的内部搭载了一枚榴弹，通过飞向敌人并引爆榴弹来攻击敌人。使用它以将其激活。电子学和计算机学等级决定了你将其重新编程的成功几率。

messages.msgid: The grenade hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
translations: 榴弹无人机从你手上飞起，在附近区域自动寻找目标中！

messages.msgid: You misprogram the grenade hack; take cover!
translations: 你没设好这台榴弹无人机的程序，它现在变成敌对的了！快找掩护吧！
M2HB CROWS II 自动机枪塔（关）
messages.plural: inactive M2HB autonomous CROWS II turrets

messages.msgid: An inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded .50 BMG rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever .50 BMG rounds you do NOT want to give the turret), turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully, the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its M2HB.
translations: 一座未激活的 .50 口径机枪炮塔。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的原装 .50 BMG 弹药（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，防御塔会将你识别为友方，并采用内置 M2HB 机枪攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: An inactive manhack, a fist-sized robot that flies through the air.  This one is covered with whirring blades and attacks by throwing itself against its target.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the manhack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.
translations: 一台未激活的飞锯无人机，一种拳头大小的飞行机器人。这台无人机的表面布满了嗡嗡作响的刀刃，通过撞击目标来攻击敌人。使用它以将其激活。电子学和计算机学等级决定了你将其重新编程的成功几率。

messages.msgid: The manhack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
translations: 飞锯无人机离开你的掌心，侦察着这片区域！

messages.msgid: You misprogram the manhack; it's hostile!
translations: 你没设好这台飞锯无人机的程序，它现在变成敌对的了！
M249 CROWS II 自动机枪塔（关）
messages.plural: inactive autonomous M249 CROWS II turrets

messages.msgid: An inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56x45mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 5.56x45mm rounds you do NOT want to give the turret), turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully, the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its M249.
translations: 一座未激活的 5.56x45mm 口径机枪炮塔。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的原装 5.56x45mm 弹药（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，防御塔会将你识别为友方，并采用内置 M249 机枪攻击附近的所有敌人。
M240 CROWS II 自动机枪塔（关）
messages.plural: inactive autonomous M240 CROWS II turrets

messages.msgid: An inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 7.62x51mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 7.62x51mm rounds you do NOT want to give the turret), turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully, the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its M240.
translations: 一座未激活的 7.62x51mm 口径机枪炮塔。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的原装 7.62x51mm 弹药（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，防御塔会将你识别为友方，并采用内置 M240 机枪攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: An inactive riot control turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the 40x46mm M1006 sponge rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever beanbag rounds you do NOT want to give the turret), turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully, the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its riot control gun.
translations: 一座未激活的防暴炮塔。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的 40x46mm M1006 海绵弹药（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，防御塔会将你识别为友方，并采用内置防暴枪攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: An inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 9x19mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 9x19mm you do NOT want to give the turret), turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its SMG.
translations: 一座未激活的 9x19mm 口径机枪塔。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的原装 9x19mm 弹药（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，防御塔会将你识别为友方，并采用内置冲锋枪攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: An inactive TALON UGV equipped with an M16A4.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56x45mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 5.56x45mm you do NOT want to give the robot), turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the security bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with its rifle.
translations: 一台未激活的鹰爪型无人车，配有一把 M16A4 步枪。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的原装 5.56x45mm 弹药（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，无人车会将你识别为友方，自主行动或跟随你，并采用内置步枪攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: The security bot beeps affirmatively and begins scanning for hostiles.
translations: 安防无人机发出肯定的哔哔声，开始扫描敌人。

messages.msgid: You misprogram the security bot and it trains its gun on you.  RUN!
translations: 你没设好这台安防机器人的程序，它把枪对准了你。快跑吧！

messages.msgid: An inactive TALON UGV equipped with an M202A1.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the M235 rockets in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever M235 rockets you do NOT want to give the robot), turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the security bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with its M202A1.
translations: 一台未激活的鹰爪型无人车，配有一把 M202A1 火箭筒。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动，并装填你物品栏内的 M235 火箭弹（如果你只想装填部分弹药，请先把不需装填的弹药移出物品栏）。若成功编程放置，无人车会将你识别为友方，自主行动或跟随你，并采用内置 M202A1 火箭筒攻击附近的所有敌人。

messages.msgid: This bot has had tubes welded above the original guns that allow it to shoot fireworks in order to blind and stun attackers.  With fireworks being harder to come by then the ammo for the original weapons, the best option would be to convert it back to it's original guns.  It should be easy enough to give it back the use of the original M16A4.
translations: 这台机器人在其原有的枪械上方焊接了发射管，能够发射“烟花”用以致盲并眩晕攻击者。然而，鉴于“烟花”相较于原武器弹药更为稀缺，最明智的选择是将其恢复成原本的武装配置。重新装配回M16A4步枪应当是足够简单的。

messages.msgid: An inactive nurse bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the nurse bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and assist you in surgeries.
translations: 一台未激活的护士机器人。使用该物品以将它放置在地面上并重新激活其机械体。若成功编程放置，护士机器人会将你识别为友方，自主行动或跟随你，并协助你进行手术。

messages.msgid: The nurse bot beeps affirmatively and awaits orders.
translations: 护士机器人发出肯定的哔哔声，并等待着指令。

messages.msgid: You misprogram the nurse bot.  It's looking at you funny.
translations: 你没设好这台护士机器人的程序。它十分古怪地看着你。

messages.msgid: An inactive grocery bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the grocery bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you.
translations: 一台未激活的食杂店机器人。使用该物品以将它放置在地面上并重新激活其机械体。若成功编程放置，食杂店机器人会将你识别为友方，并自主行动或跟随你。

messages.msgid: The grocery bot beeps affirmatively and awaits orders.
translations: 食杂店机器人发出肯定的哔哔声，并等待着指令。

messages.msgid: You misprogram the grocery bot.  It's looking at you funny.
translations: 你没设好这台食杂店机器人的程序。它十分古怪地看着你。
残缺的食杂店机器人（关）

messages.msgid: A deactivated broken cyborg, the last shreds of its humanity still rotting away.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the cyborg will then follow you and attack enemies.  You monster.
translations: 一台未激活的破损改造人，它最后依然残留着几分人性。使用该物品以将它放置在地面上并重新激活其机械体。若成功编程放置，改造人将跟随你攻击敌人（你这个魔鬼）。

messages.msgid: The broken cyborg rises to the sound of screeching metal and peers around for hostiles.
translations: 破损的改造人在金属的摩擦声中站起，四处寻找敌人。

messages.msgid: The broken cyborg lets out a howl of agony and attacks you!
translations: 破损的改造人发出痛苦的嚎叫并攻击你！

messages.msgid: A deactivated prototype cyborg, glimpses of humanity can still be seen in its empty eyes.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the cyborg will then follow you and attack enemies.  You monster.
translations: 一台未激活的原型改造人，在他空洞的眼中仍能看到残存的人性。使用该物品以将它放置在地面上并重新激活其机械体。若成功编程放置，改造人将跟随你攻击敌人（你这个魔鬼）。

messages.msgid: The prototype cyborg rises to the sound of screeching metal and peers around for hostiles.
translations: 原型改造人在金属的摩擦声中站起，四处寻找敌人。

messages.msgid: The prototype cyborg lets out a howl of agony and attacks you!
translations: 原型改造人发出痛苦的嚎叫并攻击你！

messages.msgid: An inactive cleaner bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the cleaner bot will respond to future commands.
translations: 一台未激活的清洁机器人。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，清洁机器人将会遵守你发出的指令。

messages.msgid: The cleaner bot emits a friendly beep and starts scrubbing.
translations: 清洁机器人发出友好的哔哔声，开始擦洗。

messages.msgid: The cleaner bot plays an error sound, but starts cleaning anyway.
translations: 清洁机器人发出运行错误的提示音，开始到处乱擦。

messages.msgid: An inactive demining robot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.
translations: 一台未激活的排雷机器人。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。

messages.msgid: The demining bot whirs and tunnels into the ground.
translations: 排雷机器人呼啸着钻入地下。

messages.msgid: The demining bot spins out of control and lunges at you.  Make way!
translations: 排雷机器人旋转着钻头——失控了，它向你冲来，快让开！

messages.msgid: An inactive skitterbot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the robot will race towards enemies and shock them.
translations: 一台未激活的掠行无人机。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，掠行无人机将会冲向敌人并电击它们。

messages.msgid: The skitterbot gives a quick bow and scurries away.
translations: 掠行无人机点头致意，迅速离开。

messages.msgid: The skitterbot darts around you and menacingly clicks its tasers.
translations: 掠行无人机在你周围快速游走，电击枪发出威胁性的咔嗒声。

messages.msgid: An inactive Hub 01 exterminatron.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and reloaded successfully, the robot will track you while providing fire-support.
translations: 一台未激活的 Hub 01 根除者无人机。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，根除者无人机将在提供火力支持的同时跟随你。

messages.msgid: The exterminatron gives a quick bow and starts scanning the horizon for threats.
translations: 根除者无人机点头致意，随即开始搜剿传感器中所有被视为威胁的目标。

messages.msgid: You misprogram the exterminatron and it trains its gun on you.  RUN!
translations: 你把机器人编程错了，它把枪口对准了你。快跑！

messages.msgid: An inactive experimental robot plundered from a science lab.  It resembles a human-sized spider and was designed to deploy manhacks.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the robot will race towards enemies and deploy a variety of experimental devices.
translations: 一台未激活的从科学实验室里偷来的实验性机器人。它类似一个人类大小的蜘蛛，被用于部署无人机。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，实验性机器人会冲向敌人并部署各种非常"实验性"的设备。

messages.msgid: The lab defense bot shudders briefly and skitters away.
translations: 实验室原型机器人短暂地颤抖，然后跑开了。

messages.msgid: The lab defense bot raises its front legs and shines a multitude of colored lights in your face!
translations: 实验室原型机器人抬起它的前足，用一束彩色的光照亮了你的脸！

messages.msgid: An inactive military-grade automated searchlight.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the searchlight will then identify you as an ally, survey the area, and illuminate approaching hostiles.  Seems to have an unhealthy fascination with you.
translations: 一台未激活的军用级自动探照灯。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，探照灯会将你识别为友方，调查附近区域，并照亮接近的敌人。它似乎对你有一种不健康的迷恋。

messages.msgid: The searchlight flares up and establishes a perimeter.
translations: 军用探照灯亮了起来，照亮了一片区域。

messages.msgid: A bright light blinds you as the searchlight refuses to turn away from you.
translations: 探照灯拒绝从你的方向转开，明亮的灯光使你失明。

messages.msgid: An inactive Northrop Dispatch, guard model, serving as a mobile assembler and deployer of kamikaze manhacks for defense.  Activate it to place it onto the ground; due to a one-way switch triggered during deactivation, however, it will be nonaggressive, and serves only as a distraction.
translations: 一台未激活的诺斯洛普派遣者，警卫型号。它通过装配和部署飞锯无人机进行防御。使用它可将其放置在地上，但是由于在关闭时触发了单向开关，它将不具有攻击性，并且只能起到分散敌人注意力的作用。

messages.msgid: The dispatch whirs onto its legs and searches for a target.
translations: 派遣者呼啸着移动并开始寻找目标。

messages.msgid: The dispatch turns on you, whacking at you with its arms!
translations: 派遣者转向你，用它的手臂向你猛击过来！

messages.msgid: An inactive Northrop Dispatch, military model, serving as a mobile assembler and deployer of lethal manhacks for combat situations.  Activate it to place it onto the ground; due to a one-way switch triggered during deactivation, however, it will be nonaggressive, and serves only as a distraction.
translations: 一台未激活的诺斯洛普派遣者，军用型号。它通过装配和部署飞锯无人机进行攻击。使用它可将其放置在地上，但是由于在关闭时触发了单向开关，它将不具有攻击性，并且只能起到分散敌人注意力的作用。

messages.msgid: The dispatch turns on you, slashing at you with its arms!
translations: 派遣者转向你，用它的手臂向你猛击过来！

messages.msgid: An inactive automated loudspeaker.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the loudspeaker will continuously shout pre-recorded messages.
translations: 一台未激活的自动扩音器。使用该物品以将它放置在地上启动。若成功编程放置，扩音器将会不停发出提前录制的声音。

messages.msgid: The loudspeaker activates and begins its nonstop shouts.
translations: 扩音器打开了，开始不停发出响亮的喊声。

messages.msgid: An inactive taser hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one has a taser and attacks by flying at its target and delivering an electric shock.  Use this item to reprogram and release the taser hack.  Electronics and computer skills determine if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.
translations: 一台未激活的电击枪无人机，一种拳头大小的飞行机器人。这台无人机的内部搭载了一把电击枪，会飞向敌人并电击目标。使用它以将其激活。电子学和计算机学等级决定了你将其重新编程的成功几率。

messages.msgid: The taser hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
translations: 这台电击枪无人机从你手上飞起，在附近区域自动寻找目标中！

messages.msgid: You misprogram the taser hack; run!
translations: 你错误设置了这台电击枪无人机的程序！快跑！

messages.msgid: A featureless quartz pyramid that, although obviously artificial, shows no real indication of ever having been an advanced robot.  Perhaps you could try reactivating it?
translations: 一个平平无奇的石英金字塔，虽然明显应该是人造产物，但并没有真正的迹象表明它曾经是一只高级的机器人。也许你可以试着重新激活它？

messages.msgid: You know this artfully craved piece of gold hued ceramics to be a robot of some kind, but it seems impossible to interact with it.
translations: 这尊精雕细琢的金黄色陶瓷工艺品看起来像某种机器人，但似乎无法与其互动。

messages.msgid: A small piece of inscrutable alloy shaped like an arrow's broadhead.  It looks like a robot boomerang.
translations: 一小块材质不明的合金，形状类似于箭矢的宽箭头，看起来像一个机器人回力镖。

messages.msgid: An inactive security drone.  They are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  They have a scanner, lens and speaker.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the security drone.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.
translations: 一台未激活的安防无人机，一种拳头大小的飞行机器人。这台无人机的内部搭载了一台读卡器，摄像机及扬声器。使用它以将其激活。电子学和计算机学等级决定了你将其重新编程的成功几率。

messages.msgid: The security drone flies from your hand and surveys the area!
translations: 这台安防无人机从你手上飞起，在附近区域自动寻找目标中！

messages.msgid: You misprogram the drone; it's hostile!
translations: 你没设好无人机的程序，它变成敌对的了！

messages.msgid: An inactive camspy.  Using this item involves turning it on and launching it.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the camspy will then keep watch for intruders.
translations: 一架未激活的侦察无人机。使用该物品以将它启动并释放。若成功编程放置，侦察无人机会持续寻找入侵者。

messages.msgid: The camspy hums and takes to the sky.
translations: 侦察无人机嗡嗡作响，飞向天空。

messages.msgid: The camspy hums and appears to reconnect to whoever was piloting it before.
translations: 侦察无人机嗡嗡作响，似乎重新连接到了之前控制它的人。
橡胶状尤格巨噬虫尸体

messages.msgid: An oversized hollow tube made of black semi-liquid rubbery substance.  It is vaguely shaped like a yugg.
translations: 一个由黑色半液态橡胶状物质构成的超大型中空管状物，形状模糊地勾勒出尤格巨噬虫的样子。

messages.msgid: An oversized tube of faintly green raw flesh of nondescript origin.  It is vaguely shaped like a yugg.
translations: 一根巨大的管状物，由淡绿色的血肉制成，来源不明，形状有点像尤格巨噬虫。

messages.msgid: A statue of a yugg, made entire out of jade.  If jade was still worth anything this could fetch a fortune.  A shame the world ended.
translations: 一座尤格巨噬虫的雕像，完全由玉石制成。如果现在玉还值点钱的话，它能让你大赚一笔。可惜大灾变到来了。

messages.msgid: A full-length mirror mounted in a sleek aluminum frame.  Metal stand is currently folded.
translations: 一面全尺寸的穿衣镜，架设在纤薄的铝制框架上。现在金属支架被收起来以节省空间。

messages.msgid: A simple wooden chair, with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.
translations: 一把简单的木制椅子，有四条腿，一个椅座和一个靠背。能让你的脚好好休息一会，如果再加上一张合适的桌子，你可以好好吃一顿饭，假装一切正常了。

messages.msgid: A simple stool, with four legs and a seat.  While it's a touch more maneuverable to sit on, the lack of back support means it's significantly less comfortable than a normal chair.
translations: 一把简单的凳子，有四条腿和一个座位。虽然坐起来更灵活，但缺乏背部支撑意味着它明显不如普通椅子舒适。

messages.msgid: A short section from a tree trunk with one of the flat ends smoothed down.  Makes for a decent place to sit, but not quite a real chair.
translations: 一小段从树干上取下来的原木，其中一端被磨平。它是块坐下来的好地方，但还算不上一把真正的椅子。

messages.msgid: A bar stool with a leather seat on a steel support.  Not practical for sleeping at all but it does feel nicer than sitting on the ground.
translations: 一个酒吧凳子，钢支架上有一个皮革座椅。用来睡觉一点都不实用，但确实比坐在地上感觉更好。

messages.msgid: A simple chair made of plywood on a steel frame.  Quite uncomfortable but works for sleeping if it's the only option available.
translations: 一把简单的椅子，由胶合板固定在钢制框架上制成。相当不舒服，但确实可以用来睡觉，如果这是唯一选择的话。

messages.msgid: A simple wooden chair, with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.  This particular chair was painted black.
translations: 一把简单的木制椅子，有四条腿，一个椅座和一个靠背。能让你的脚好好休息一会，如果再加上一张合适的桌子，你可以好好吃一顿饭，假装一切正常了。这把椅子被特别漆成黑色。

messages.msgid: A simple wooden chair, with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.  This particular chair was painted white.
translations: 一把简单的木制椅子，有四条腿，一个椅座和一个靠背。能让你的脚好好休息一会，如果再加上一张合适的桌子，你可以好好吃一顿饭，假装一切正常了。这把椅子被特别漆成白色。

messages.msgid: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.
translations: 一个从弹链上脱离下来的小型金属链节。

messages.msgid: A shallow dish for holding a bar of soap.  It has ridges to help drain water away from the dish.  Not the most exciting of items.
translations: 一个用来装肥皂的浅盘，内部有便于排水的凸脊。这并不是什么激动人心的东西。

messages.msgid: A razor blade on a comfortable handle.  Much easier to shave with than a loose razor.
translations: 一把剃须刀，刀片安装在一个舒适的手柄上。用剃须刀刮胡子比起直接用剃须刀片来要容易得多。

messages.msgid: A plastic brush with soft bristles for cleaning your teeth.
translations: 一根顶部有软毛的用来清洁你的牙齿的塑料牙刷。

messages.msgid: A plastic brush with soft bristles for cleaning your teeth.  It has a cheap, blocky handle and is likely meant to be disposable.
translations: 一根顶部有软毛的用来清洁你的牙齿的塑料牙刷。它有着廉价的长条形手柄，很可能是一次性的。

messages.msgid: A combination toothbrush and gum massager.  It has an ergonomic silicone grip.  Luxurious!
translations: 一根带有牙龈按摩器的复合型牙刷。它有一个符合人体工程学的硅橡胶握把。真是豪华！

messages.msgid: A plastic brush with soft bristles for cleaning your teeth.  The blue and white pattern on the handle implies cleanliness.
translations: 一根顶部有软毛的用来清洁你的牙齿的塑料牙刷。手柄上的蓝色和白色图案暗示着干净清洁。

messages.msgid: A short toothbrush designed for children.  It has a wide-eyed cartoon pony on the handle.
translations: 一根专为儿童设计的短牙刷。手柄上有一只大眼睛的卡通小马。

messages.msgid: A short toothbrush designed for children.  It has a grinning red racecar on the handle.
translations: 一根专为儿童设计的短牙刷。手柄上有一辆笑逐颜开的红色赛车。

messages.msgid: A small cotton tampon with a plastic applicator.
translations: 带有塑料涂抹器的小棉条。

messages.msgid: A small cotton tampon with a plastic applicator.  Useless for some, an invaluable commodity for others.
translations: 带有塑料涂抹器的小棉条。 对某些人来说毫无用处，对另一些人来说却是无价的商品。

messages.msgid: A 'light' cotton tampon with a plastic applicator rated for light flows.
translations: 一种"轻型"棉质卫生棉条，带有一个塑料涂抹器，适用于小流量。

messages.msgid: A 'super' cotton tampon with a plastic applicator rated for heavy flows.
translations: 一种"超级"棉质卫生棉条，带有塑料涂抹器，适用于大流量。

messages.msgid: A small, lavender-scented cotton tampon with a plastic applicator.
translations: 带有薰衣草香味的小棉条，带有塑料涂抹器。

messages.msgid: A small cotton tampon with a plastic applicator proudly claiming to be anti-microbial.  Ultra-fine print indicates that this tampon has no noticeable health benefits compared to others.
translations: 一个小小的棉质卫生棉条，上面有一个塑料涂抹器，自豪地宣称它是抗菌作用。超细印花表明，与其他卫生棉条相比，这种卫生棉条对健康没有明显的益处。

messages.msgid: An expensive-looking tampon with a fancy, smooth plastic applicator.  The ultra-soft cotton has the appearance of a fluffy cloud.
translations: 一种看起来很贵的卫生棉条，上面有一个漂亮光滑的塑料涂抹器。这种超柔软的棉花看起来像一团蓬松的云朵。

messages.msgid: A cheap-looking tampon.  The cotton looks rough, the plastic applicator has a few sharp edges, and the string is somehow already knotted.
translations: 一个看起来很便宜的卫生棉条。 棉花看起来很粗糙，塑料涂抹器有一些锋利的边缘，而且绳子不知何故已经打结了。
一种可以吸收液体的垫子。

messages.msgid: An absorbent menstrual pad.  Unfortunately, not as useful as a bandage as you'd think.  The adhesive is on the side opposite of the absorbent part.
translations: 吸收液体的卫生巾。 不幸的是并不像你想象的那么有用。一面用于粘贴，另一面用于吸收。

messages.msgid: A small panty-liner only meant for the lightest flows.
translations: 一款仅适用于最小流量的内裤里衬垫。

messages.msgid: A large menstrual pad meant for use overnight.
translations: 一个大的卫生巾，用于过夜。

messages.msgid: An absorbent menstrual pad with racing stripes, for the fastest flows.  Probably.
translations: 带有赛车条纹的吸收性卫生巾，可能是为最快的经流准备的。

messages.msgid: An absorbent menstrual pad that smells strongly of essential oils.
translations: 一种吸收性卫生巾，闻起来有强烈的精油味。

messages.msgid: A pride-themed menstrual pad in trans flag coloring.  'Men can bleed too!' is proudly written on the packaging.
translations: 以反式旗帜颜色为主题的骄傲主题卫生巾。包装上自豪地写着： 男人也会流血！。

messages.msgid: A cheap menstrual pad.  The cotton somehow looks like sandpaper and is almost see-through thin.
translations: 便宜的卫生巾。 棉花不知何故看起来像砂纸，薄如蝉翼。

messages.msgid: A tiny, washable, flexible plastic cup about the size of a medicine cup for catching menstrual flow.
translations: 一种可清洗的柔性塑料小杯，和药瓶大小差不多，用来收集经血。
一个用来折磨头发的工具。

messages.msgid: An instrument of hair torture.  There are round safety tips on the bristles.
translations: 一个用来折磨头发的工具。刚毛尖端有许多圆形的安全帽。

messages.msgid: An old-fashioned hair-straightening device with a faux-wood handle.
translations: 一根带有人造木柄的老式直排头发梳理工具。

messages.msgid: A soft, cushioned hairbrush.  The shiny chrome design appears modern.
translations: 一根柔软的带有软垫的发梳。闪亮的镀铬设计看起来很现代。

messages.msgid: A tacky kid's hairbrush.  The cartoon whale on the handle seems friendly enough.
translations: 一把十分俗气的儿童发梳。手柄上的卡通鲸鱼似乎很友好。

messages.msgid: A soft plastic cylinder you can wrap a lock of your hair around to curl it.
translations: 一个柔软的塑料圆柱体，可以用它把你的头发卷曲起来。

messages.msgid: Twenty-five yards of finely waxed thread wound up inside a plastic container.  Perfect for picking bits of smoked meat out of your teeth.  Disassemble to use the thread for something else.
translations: 一根长25码的细蜡线缠绕在一个塑料容器上。最适合用来取出塞在牙齿上的熏肉。拆解它可获得细线。

messages.msgid: A grooming tool with teeth for straightening your hair.
translations: 一个带有许多梳齿的梳妆工具，能用来理顺你的头发。

messages.msgid: Somehow, a few teeth have already broken off the end of this otherwise pristine comb.
translations: 不知怎么回事，这把看上去全新的梳子上已经有几个梳齿折断了。

messages.msgid: A grooming tool with teeth for straightening your hair.  This one is narrow, black and austere.
translations: 一个带有许多梳齿的梳妆工具，能用来理顺你的头发。这把又窄又黑又朴实。

messages.msgid: A comb made of soft plastic.  Its tortoiseshell pattern makes it seem antique.
translations: 用软塑料制成的梳子。上面的龟甲式图案使它显得古色古香。

messages.msgid: A comb which folds on a hinge, in case you want to look like a greaser.
translations: 一把带有折叠铰链的梳子，想当油头滑面的时髦少年就带上它吧。

messages.msgid: A rubber-tipped tool for unclogging pipes, or a club for an immature survivor.
translations: 一根用来通管道的带有橡胶头的工具，也是一根新手幸存者所使用的棍子。

messages.msgid: This hollow plastic toilet plunger's bell compresses like an accordion.  It is efficient at its intended purpose, and complete rubbish as a weapon.
translations: 一根内部中空的塑料马桶塞，顶部能像手风琴一样压缩。它用来通马桶当然十分有效，但作为武器使用时完全就是垃圾。
一卷人类文明最后的奢华遗物。

messages.msgid: Imagine the thinnest, most disposable paper you could possibly make.  Now imagine something thinner than that.
translations: 用尽你的想象力想象一下最薄、最一次性的厕纸。然后再想象一下比这更薄的东西。

messages.msgid: This roll of toilet paper is two-ply and quilted, for vandalizing houses more comfortably than ever.
translations: 这卷厕纸为双层绗缝款式，用于在恶作剧中将厕纸抛挂在房屋上时也能保持格外舒适

messages.msgid: This brand of toilet paper is designed to dissolve completely in water!
translations: 这个牌子的厕纸号称完全溶于水！

messages.msgid: Images of your least favorite politician are printed on each individual sheet.
translations: 你最讨厌的政客的照片被印在每一张厕纸上。

messages.msgid: A luxurious remnant of civilization.  The splinters of unprocessed wood visible in this one make it seem less luxurious, though.
translations: 一卷人类文明最后的奢华遗物。不过，其中可见的未经加工的木屑使它看起来不那么奢华了。

messages.msgid: This tool dries your hair by pushing air through a coil of hot wires.  The heat can be toggled on and off.
translations: 这种工具通过一卷热线来加热空气并将其吹出，可以用于吹干头发，也可以关闭加热功能直接吹风。

messages.msgid: A wand made of heat-resistant ceramics.  When plugged into an outlet, it is hot enough to shape your hair into curls.  Too bad the power's out.
translations: 一根采用耐热陶瓷制成的短棒。当插入插座后，它能够加热到使你的头发卷曲的温度。可惜停电了。

messages.msgid: Zombies cannot be intimidated or humiliated, so this stiff brush is only useful for scouring toilet bowls.
translations: 丧尸没法被恐吓或羞辱，所以这把坚硬的刷子只适合用来刷马桶。

messages.msgid: A stainless-steel comb with spiral grooved teeth designed to remove pesky parasites from hair.  Even just thinking about it makes you itch.
translations: 一把带有密集螺旋槽齿的不锈钢排梳，用于去除毛发中讨厌的跳蚤。即使只是想一想也会让你浑身发痒。
一个塑料做的浴缸玩具。

messages.msgid: A yellow rubber duck.  Designed to dropped in the bath.
translations: 一只黄色的橡皮鸭。可以丢进浴缸里。

messages.msgid: A black rubber duck with large white eyes.  Designed to dropped in the bath.
translations: 一只黑色的橡皮鸭，长着一双大大的白眼睛。可以丢进浴缸里。

messages.msgid: A small green dinosaur with a wide grin.  Designed for bath time.
translations: 一只咧嘴笑的绿色小恐龙。专为泡澡时间设计。

messages.msgid: A squeezable bottle used to hold various liquid soaps.
translations: 一个用来装各种液体肥皂的可挤压的瓶子。

messages.msgid: A bottle for special shampoo for dyed hair.
translations: 一个用来装特殊的染发香波的瓶子。

messages.msgid: A plain white bottle made to contain the cheapest shampoo.
translations: 一个用来装最便宜的洗发水的普通的白色瓶子。

messages.msgid: A bottle for body wash.  This one is called 'Afrika'.
translations: 一个装沐浴露的瓶子。上面的牌子叫做"Afrika"。
一个用来装护发素的瓶子。

messages.msgid: A colorful bottle of body and hair wash marketed for children.
translations: 一个用来装儿童沐浴露的五颜六色的瓶子。

messages.msgid: A plain white bottle made to contain the cheapest hair conditioner.
translations: 一个用来装最便宜的护发素的普通的白色瓶子。

messages.msgid: A plain white bottle made to contain the cheapest shower gel.
translations: 一个用来装最便宜的沐浴露凝胶的普通的白色瓶子。

messages.msgid: A standard set of prosthetic teeth.  Pretty useless to anyone aside from its owner.
translations: 一套标准的假牙。除了它的主人之外，对任何人都毫无用处。

messages.msgid: A large sheet of cloth with ropes on two sides.  Could be tied to something and then used as a sleeping place that is comfortable, but lacks warmth.
translations: 一块两头有吊绳的大布，可以系在附近的物体上。睡在里面很舒服，但不保暖。

messages.msgid: A large net with ropes on two sides.  Could be tied to something and then used as a sleeping place that is comfortable, but lacks warmth.
translations: 一块两头有吊绳的大网，可以系在附近的物体上。睡在里面很舒服，但不保暖。

messages.msgid: A 72 by 24 inch two-layer-thick fabric sheet.  It could be used as a curtain or bedsheet, or cut up for a bunch of smaller sheets.
translations: 一张长72x24英寸（约183×61厘米）的双层织物面料，可以用来制造成窗帘或床单，或者裁剪为一堆布条。

messages.msgid: Hiding under here will not protect you from the monsters.
translations:
一个大的棉毯，可以用来当被子，也可以穿上进行保暖。
"在怪物攻击时躲在它底下并不能保护你。"

messages.msgid: A blanket made by you!  Embrace your inner tailor.
translations: 一件你自己制作的毯子！拥抱你内在的裁缝天赋吧。

messages.msgid: This blanket is official sports memorabilia, or so says the tag.  It features the name and mascot of the <sports_teams>!
translations: 这件毯子是官方认证的体育纪念品，至少标签上是这么写的。它印有<sports_teams>的名字和吉祥物！

messages.msgid: This blanket is an alleged collector's piece, featuring the name and mascot of the <sports_teams>!  The tag explains that only 100,000 were made and reads: #<number><number><number><number><number>.
translations: 这条毯子据称是一件收藏佳品，上面展示了<sports_teams>的名称及其吉祥物图案！标签上说明了此款毯子仅限量生产了10,000条，并标注了序号：#<number><number><number><number><number>。

messages.msgid: A standard blanket, except that the stitching across the surface is patterned in <geometric_patterns>s.
translations: 这款毯子较为常规，与众不同之处在于其表面采用了精致的<geometric_patterns>刺绣，

messages.msgid: This blanket's tag lists it as "the fluffiest blanket in the world" and was made in the USA.  Only moderately fluffy.
translations: 这条毯子的标签自称它是“世界上最蓬松的毯子”，并注明为美国制造。但实际上只达到了中等的蓬松度。

messages.msgid: The ever popular floral print blanket.  This one is patterned with <flowers>.  Popular with grandmothers.
translations: 流行的印花毛毯。毯子上印有各种花卉图案，很受老奶奶的欢迎。

messages.msgid: A blanket adorned with a famous animated character!  It depicts <cartoon_blanket>!
translations: 一条装饰着著名动画人物的毯子！上面画着<cartoon_blanket>！

messages.msgid: A thick, layered blanket with glass microbeads added to increase the weight.
translations: 一条厚重的多层毯子，加入了小玻璃珠以增加重量。

messages.msgid: It's been stitched in a <geometric_patterns> pattern.
Hiding under here will not protect you from the monsters, but it'll keep you warm.
translations: 躲在这里并不能保护你免受怪物伤害，但至少能让你暖和些。

messages.msgid: A heavy fur blanket that covers most of your body.
translations: 一条厚重的毛毯，可以用来当被子，也可以穿在身上进行保暖。

messages.msgid: A big, comfy quilt made of thick wool in a triangle pattern.  Extremely cozy!
translations:
一张又大又舒适的被子，用厚羊毛制成，上面有三角形的图案。
"太舒服了！"

messages.msgid: A huge, patchwork wool quilt.  Very, very warm.
translations:
一张巨大的，拼凑而成的羊毛被。
"非常，非常温暖。"

messages.msgid: A blanket made of space-age material that covers your most important body parts.  It folds into a very compact form when not in use.
translations: 这条使用太空时代材料制成的毯子可以覆盖你身上大部分重要部位。不用时，它可以折叠成非常紧凑的形状。

messages.msgid: A large sleeping bag that covers you head to toe, with a strap for carrying it on your back when not in use.  This one is medium weight.  It is currently unrolled; activate it to roll it up for easy storage.
translations: 一个可以把你从头到脚包住的大睡袋，不用时可以用带子扎起来背在背上。这个是中等重量的型号。当前已展开；使用它把它绑好，便于存放。

messages.msgid: You roll up the sleeping bag, preparing it for transport.
translations: 你把睡袋卷起来，便于携带。

messages.msgid: You might think it is bizarre to sleep in a body bag stuffed with dead plants.  However, the thought of sleeping in the cold is far more uncomfortable.
translations: 你可能会觉得睡在装满死植物的运尸袋里很奇怪。然而，一想到在寒风中睡觉就更不舒服了。

messages.msgid: Some grass yarn woven into a crude sheet.
translations: 用一些干草编织成的简易面料。

messages.msgid: Some grass sheets sewn together.  Itchy, but more comfortable than the cold.
translations: 一些干草被缝在一起。让你浑身发痒，但比被寒风吹更舒服。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .223 round.
An empty casing from a .223 round, with its primer removed.
translations: 一枚移除了底火的 .223 空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .22 LR round.  These can't be hand-reloaded.
translations: 一枚 .22 LR 弹的空弹壳。这种弹壳无法手工复装。

messages.msgid: An unfired, like-new .22 round casing, with the primer still intact.
translations: 一枚未使用过的崭新 .22 弹壳，附有完好的底火。

messages.msgid: An unfired, like-new .22 short casing, with the priming compound still intact.
translations: 一枚未使用过的崭新 .22 短弹壳，附有完好的底火。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .30-06 round.
An empty casing from a .30-06 round, with its primer removed.
translations: 一枚移除了底火的 .30-06 空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a 12.3ln round.  It looks deceptively like a .303 British casing, if those were rimless.
translations: 一枚 12.3ln 弹的空弹壳。看上去和 .303 英式弹壳极度相近，只不过没有底缘。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a 12.3ln round.  It looks deceptively like a .303 British casing, if those were rimless.  This one has had its primer removed.
translations: 一枚移除了底火的 12.3ln 空弹壳。看上去和 .303 英式弹壳极度相近，只不过没有底缘。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a 3.3 naval round.  If it wasn't for burns and soot, it could be used as a cup.
translations: 一枚 3.3 海军弹的空弹壳。如果不是因为被弹药灼烧附灰，它甚至可以当杯子用。

messages.msgid: This is a small metallic cube of inscrutable construction.  You think it might feel slightly lighter when compared to the fresh ones.
translations: 一个构造难以理解的小型金属立方体。你觉得与全新的相比，它的重量稍微轻了一些。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .270 Winchester round.
translations: 一枚 .270 温彻斯特弹的空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .270 Winchester round, with its primer removed.
translations: 一枚移除了底火的 .270 温彻斯特空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .303 round.
An empty casing from a .303 round, with its primer removed.
translations: 移除了底火的.303 温彻斯特空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .300 Winchester Magnum round.
translations: 一枚 .300 温彻斯特马格南弹的空弹壳。
.300 温彻斯特马格南弹壳（无底火）

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .300 Winchester Magnum round, with its primer removed.
translations: 一枚移除了底火的 .300 温彻斯特马格南空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .308 round.
An empty casing from a .308 round, with its primer removed.
An empty casing from a 7.62x51mm M80 round.
An empty casing from a 7.62x51mm M80 round, with its primer removed.
translations: 移除了底火的7.62x51mm M80空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .32 ACP round.
translations: 一枚 .32 ACP 弹的空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .32 ACP round, with its primer removed.
translations: 一枚移除了底火的 .32 ACP 空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .38 Special round.
translations: 一枚 .38 特制弹的空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .38 Special round, with its primer removed.
translations: 一枚移除了底火的 .38 特制空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .38 Super round.
translations: 一枚 .38 超级弹的空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .38 Super round, with its primer removed.
translations: 一枚移除了底火的 .38 超级空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .40 S&W round.
translations: 一枚 .40 S&W 弹的空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a .40 S&W round, with its primer removed.
translations: 一枚移除了底火的 .40 S&W 空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a 10mm Auto round.
translations: 一枚 10mm Auto 弹的空弹壳。

messages.msgid: An empty casing from a 10mm Auto round, with its primer removed.

messages.msgid: The Free Merchant Certified Note, also known by names such as a 'c-note' or 'merch', is a currency based on old American bills.  Fifty dollar bills and larger are printed with a promissory note signed by the treasurer of the Free Merchants, along with a complex design.  The note explains that this can be exchanged for food, water, and other services through the Free Merchants in the Refugee Center.
translations: 自由商会认证货币，又被称为"C币"或是"商币"，是一种以旧美金为基础的货币。一张50美元或更大面额的旧美金本票，经过自由商会财务主管亲笔签字后，又加盖了经过精心设计的复杂图章。纸币上解释了可以用它在位于难民中心的自由商会处等价交换食物、水、或其他服务。

messages.msgid: A small but surprisingly heavy gold coin.  One side is etched with circuitry and the other side reads 'Hub 01 exchange currency'.
translations: 一枚虽然很小但是很重的金币。一面刻有电路，另一面写着"Hub 01 兑换币"。

messages.msgid: A coin that has been flattened in a novelty coin flattening machine.  The machine has been somewhat crudely altered so that the design - which appears to once have been Mickey Mouse - is overlaid with a hand-drawn emblem of a book.  There is some text that faintly reads 'Campus Exchange Token'.
translations: 一个被某台独特的压币机压扁了的硬币。那台压币机器像是经过较为粗糙地调试，压出了一个特殊形状：如同米老鼠一样的图案上叠着个像是手绘出来的书形纹章，边缘有着一些勉强可见的文字写着："学院交换用代币"。

messages.msgid: A slip of paper signed by the issuer.
A small picture, about the size of an ID card, symbolizing a religious figure.  On the back, there is text that faintly reads 'New England Church Community'.
translations: 一张和钥匙卡差不多大小的小卡片，上面的图案象征着某个宗教人物。背面隐约写着"新英格兰教会社区"。

messages.msgid: A one-cent coin, featuring a portrait of Abraham Lincoln.  You could flip it.
translations: 一枚一美分硬币，印有亚伯拉罕·林肯的肖像。你可以把它抛起来。

messages.msgid: A ceramic dinner plate, unremarkable in every way.
translations: 陶瓷餐盘，各方面都不起眼。

messages.msgid: A perfectly ordinary ceramic soup bowl.
A light ceramic teacup.  Quite classy.

translations: 一只<color>的小号陶瓷咖啡杯。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads 'World's Greatest Dad'.
translations: 马克杯的测面写着"世界上最伟大的爸爸"。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads 'World's Greatest Mom'.
translations: 马克杯的测面写着"世界上最伟大的妈妈"。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug has a picture of a happy-looking family.
translations: 马克杯的侧面有一张看起来很幸福的家庭照。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug has a comical green face on it and says 'I'm a zombie without my coffee!'.
translations: 马克杯的侧面有个漫画风格的绿脸说："我是个没了咖啡的行尸走肉！"

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads 'I'd rather be playing open source games'.
translations: 马克杯的侧面写着"我宁愿玩开源游戏"。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads 'If you think I'm bad, look in a mirror'.
translations: 马克杯的侧面写着"如果你认为我是坏人，那么请照镜子看看你自己"。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug has a diagram of a caffeine molecule.
translations: 马克杯的侧面有一个咖啡因分子图。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug has a cute picture of a sleeping cat.
translations: 马克杯的侧面有一张可爱的睡猫图片。

messages.msgid: The mug is printed in leopard spots.
translations: 这个马克杯印着豹纹斑点。

messages.msgid: The mug is blue and looks like a TARDIS.
translations: 这个马克杯是蓝色的，外形看起来像是塔迪斯博士的时间机器。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads 'STAR WARS' over a picture of a lightsaber.
translations: 这个马克杯印着写上"STAR WARS"的光剑图片。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads 'House Stark' and depicts a fictional crest.
translations: 马克杯的侧面写着"史塔克家族"，并描绘了一个虚构的家徽。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads 'My fandom could beat up your fandom'.
translations: 马克杯的测面写着"我的粉丝可以海扁你的粉丝"。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads 'Do you even linux, bro?' and has a picture of a muscular penguin.
translations: 马克杯的侧面写着"兄弟，你用过linux吗？"，并有一张肌肉企鹅的照片。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads 'I wish this was wine!'
translations: 马克杯的测面写着"我希望这是酒"。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads 'CasUaL aLcoHoLiSm'
translations: 马克杯的测面写着"肆意纵酒"。

messages.msgid: It says "World's Best Dad!" on the side.
translations: 上面印着"世界上最好的爸爸！"。

messages.msgid: It says "Great Ideas start with Great Coffee." on the side.
translations: 上面印着"好主意始于好咖啡"。

messages.msgid: On the side is a glass of wine and a cup of coffee both saying "She loves me more!"
translations: 上面印着一杯葡萄酒和一杯咖啡，同时都在说："她更爱我！"

messages.msgid: It says "This is a designer mug.  It fuels designers." on the side.
translations: 上面印着"名牌（设计师）马克杯。它为设计师提供燃料"。

messages.msgid: On the side is a winking woman in lingerie.
translations: 上面一个只穿着内衣的女人在眨眼。

messages.msgid: It says "You're my definition of perfect.  <3" on the side.
translations: 上面印着"你是我对完美的定义。<3"。

messages.msgid: It says "You've been poisoned." on the bottom, inside of it.
translations: 杯子内侧底部写着"你中毒了"。

messages.msgid: On the side is a dog wearing a hat, sitting in a burning room, saying "This is fine."
translations: 上面画着一只戴着帽子的狗，坐在一间着火的房间里，说"一切都还好。"

messages.msgid: There's a tiny dinosaur sculpture inside of it.
translations: 里面有个小小的恐龙雕塑。

messages.msgid: It says "I <3 Massachusetts." on the side.
translations: 上面印着"我 <3 马萨诸塞州"。

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads "fuck you, <name_b>!"
translations: 咖啡杯的侧面写着"操你妈，<name_b>！"

messages.msgid: The side of the mug reads "Worlds Worst Dad".
translations: 咖啡杯的侧面写着"世界上最糟糕的爸爸"

messages.msgid: A tin dinner plate, lightweight and clanky.
An enameled tin cup.  Great for camping or for prison use; makes a wonderful sound when clanged along bars.
translations: 搪瓷锡杯。非常适合露营或监狱使用；敲着杯沿叮当作响，发出美妙的声音。

messages.msgid: A small pewter serving bowl without a lid.  Holds 250 mL of liquid.
translations: 一个无盖的小锡碗。可容纳250毫升液体。

messages.msgid: A glass dinner plate, for people who don't have clumsy children.
translations: 玻璃餐盘，适合没有笨拙孩子的人。

messages.msgid: A stemmed drinking glass that makes you feel very fancy when you drink from it.
translations: 高脚玻璃酒杯，让你喝酒时自觉品味非凡。

messages.msgid: A glass bowl for soup or dessert.
translations: 用于汤或甜点的玻璃碗。

messages.msgid: A durable plastic plate, the sort you might use as patio dishware.
translations: 耐用的塑料盘，你可以用这类东西作庭院餐具。

messages.msgid: A durable plastic drinking vessel.  This one is made of clear acrylic and looks almost like glass.
translations: 耐用的塑料饮用容器。这个是透明压克力制成，看起来几乎像玻璃。

messages.msgid: A piece of plastic tupperware with a matching watertight lid.  Holds 750 mL of liquid.
translations: 一个带有匹配水密盖子的塑料水杯，可以储存750毫升液体。

messages.msgid: A plastic bowl designed for use by children.
translations: 设计供儿童使用的塑料碗。

messages.msgid: This bowl is decorated with cartoon bears.
There is a drawing of Yoda at the bottom of this bowl, and the words 'Eaten it all, you have'.
translations: 碗底有一张尤达大师的图画，上面写着"吃光了，你已经"。

messages.msgid: This bowl is covered in cartoon dogs and a logo that reads 'Paw Patrol'.
translations: 这个碗上满是卡通狗和一个标有"狗腿巡逻队"的标志。

messages.msgid: There are orange and blue fish chasing each other around the rim of this bowl.
translations: 有橙色和蓝色的鱼绕着碗沿互相追逐。

messages.msgid: This bowl is shaped like the head of a silly frog with the opening forming the mouth.
translations: 这个碗被塑成一个傻呼呼的青蛙头，碗口做成嘴巴模样。

messages.msgid: There are cute farm animals decorating this bowl.
translations: 这个碗上有着可爱的农场动物做装饰。

messages.msgid: A plastic cup with a spill-proof lid, designed for use by children.
translations: 带防漏盖的塑料杯，专供儿童使用。

messages.msgid: This cup is decorated with cartoon bears.
translations: 这个杯子上装饰着卡通熊。

messages.msgid: This cup has a cartoony picture of the Avengers wrapped around the side.
translations: 这个杯子里有一张复仇者的卡通画。

messages.msgid: This sippy cup is made of plastic in bright clashing colors.
translations: 这个吸管杯是用颜色鲜艳的塑料制成的。

messages.msgid: This is a simple blue sippy cup with tooth marks around the spout.
translations: 这是一个简单的蓝色吸管杯，吸嘴上有牙痕。

messages.msgid: This cup is decorated to look like a pokeball.
translations: 这个杯子装饰得像个小球。

messages.msgid: There are cute anthropomorphic fruits decorating this cup.
translations: 这个杯子上装饰着可爱的人形水果。

messages.msgid: This sippy cup is decorated with crayon-like text that reads 'I love you'.
translations: 这个小杯上装饰着蜡笔字般的文字，上面写着"我爱你"。

messages.msgid: A fork, if you stab something with it, you eat it right away.  Wait… nevermind.
translations: 一把叉子，叉了东西之后就可以送进嘴里。等等……现在这么说好像不太对。

messages.msgid: A plastic disposable fork.  Great for picnic lunches in the post-apocalyptic wasteland.
translations: 塑料一次性叉子。非常适合后世界末日废土的野外午餐。

messages.msgid: Do not try to bend the spoon.  That is impossible.
translations: 不要试图去弯曲这把勺子。那是不可能的。

messages.msgid: A plastic disposable spoon.  Easier to bend than the metal variety.
translations: 塑料一次性勺子。比金属勺子更容易被折弯。

messages.msgid: A plastic spoon designed for use by children.
translations: 专为儿童使用的塑料勺子。

messages.msgid: This spoon is striped in bright primary colors.
translations: 这把勺子上画着明亮的三原色条纹。

messages.msgid: This spoon is styled to look like a bulldozer.
translations: 这把勺子的样式看起来像推土机。

messages.msgid: This spoon is covered in cartoon dogs and a logo that reads 'Paw Patrol'.
translations: 这把勺子上印着卡通狗和"汪汪队"的标志。

messages.msgid: There is a cute cartoon bear on the handle of this spoon.
translations: 这把勺子的手柄上有一个可爱的卡通熊。

messages.msgid: There are cartoon cats all over this spoon.
translations: 这个勺子到处都是卡通猫的图案。

messages.msgid: This spoon has a silhouette of a giraffe going down the handle.
translations: 这把勺子的柄上有长颈鹿的轮廓。

messages.msgid: A dull knife, absolutely worthless in combat.  Excellent for spreading soft things on bread.
translations: 一把钝刀，在战斗中绝对毫无价值。非常适合在面包上涂抹柔软的东西。

messages.msgid: A plastic butter knife.  It's actually a bit sharper than its metal counterpart, but that doesn't make it any more effective as a weapon.
translations: 塑料黄油刀。它的刀刃其实比金属版更锐利，但这并不能让它作为武器使用。

messages.msgid: A plastic straw, for drinking things and littering.
translations: 一根塑料吸管，用来喝东西，也用来乱扔制造垃圾。

messages.msgid: Many a pleasant date has been ruined by forgetting this important tool.
translations: 很多愉快的约会败兴而归，只因为忘了这个重要工具。

messages.msgid: A simple tool for peeling the outer skin off fruits and veggies without stabbing yourself.
translations: 一把简单的工具，可以削掉蔬果外皮而不刺伤自己。

messages.msgid: A simple lever for popping open bottles.
translations: 一个简单的杠杆，用来撬开瓶子。

messages.msgid: This bottle opener is shaped like a zombie head, the mouth pops open the bottle.
translations: 这支开瓶起子被塑得像个丧尸头，嘴巴用来起瓶盖。

messages.msgid: This bottle opener is shaped like a lightsaber.
translations: 这个开瓶器的形状像一把光剑。

messages.msgid: This bottle opener is shaped like a revolver.
translations: 这个开瓶器的形状像一把左轮手枪。

messages.msgid: This bottle opener is engraved with the words 'I'll die before I give you my beer'.
translations: 这把开瓶器上刻着这样一句话：“我宁可死也不会把我的啤酒给你”。

messages.msgid: This bottle opener is emblazoned with a logo for an HVAC contracting company.
translations: 这个开瓶器上印着一家暖通空调系统承包公司的商标。

messages.msgid: This bottle opener reads 'Corporate Team Building Exercise 1999'.
translations: 这个开瓶器写着"1999年公司团建活动留念"。

messages.msgid: This bottle opener reads 'I'd rather be drinking whiskey'.
translations: 这个开瓶器上写着"我宁愿喝威士忌"。

messages.msgid: This bottle opener is shaped like a phaser.
translations: 这个开瓶器的形状像相位枪。

messages.msgid: This novelty bottle opener is designed to look like a hobo clown.
translations: 这把新奇的开瓶器设计得像个流浪汉小丑。

messages.msgid: The bastardized hybrid of a spoon and fork, with all the power and capabilities of both in a more annoying to use package.
translations: 勺子和叉子的怪异混合体，同时有着两者的功能，但是用起来更加烦人。

messages.msgid: Clearly the superior instrument.  Sporks are just imitators.
translations:
一个西方国家之中常见的餐具，叉子一端可手握，另一端有二至四条分支，用来插入或盛住食物。
"贵人用餐叉，穷蛋用叉勺。"

messages.msgid: One of the most popular eating utensils in the world.  Does double duty as a way of dealing with especially fragile vampires.
translations: 世界上最受欢迎的餐具之一。另一个功能是用来对付特别脆弱的吸血鬼。

messages.msgid: When you need to scoop some soup, this is the utensil for you.
translations: 当你需要舀一些汤时，用这个就行了。

messages.msgid: A tool designed for finely mixing ingredients or introducing air into the blend.  Also known as a 'wire whip', but it's a less effective weapon than that name makes it sound.
translations: 一种用于精细混合成分或将空气引入混合物中的工具。也被称为"钢丝鞭"，但如果当武器用起来可不像这个名字那么有效。

messages.msgid: A tool for mashing potatoes and soft root vegetables; it cannot do the twist.
translations: 一把用来捣碎马铃薯和块根类蔬菜的工具；但它不能用来搅拌。

messages.msgid: A tool for squashing a clove or two of garlic into a fine paste.
translations: 一把用来将一两瓣大蒜压成细小糊状物的工具。

messages.msgid: A tool for opening cans that lack pull-tabs.  Now that you think about it, you haven't seen any of those around lately.
translations: 一种用于打开无拉环罐头的工具。不过现在想想，你已经多少年没见过这种罐头了。

messages.msgid: A utensil used to hold meat still while you slice it.  It's like a tiny pitchfork, or a very large dinner fork.
translations: 切肉时用来固定肉的器具。像一个微型干草叉，或者一个非常大的餐叉。

messages.msgid: A rubber scraper for making sure you get every last scrap of cookie dough.
translations: 一把橡胶刮刀，保证你能刮下来每一点面团。

messages.msgid: A stout piece of hardwood, turned and sanded smooth, with rounded handles at the ends.  This timeless kitchen tool also doubles as an effective club.
translations: 一块经过打磨抛光的结实硬木，两侧的末端带有圆形把手。这款永不过时的厨房工具同时也是一根非常有效的棍棒。

messages.msgid: A cooking pot, useful for boiling water and making all kinds of food.
translations: 一个烹饪锅，用于烧水和制作各种食物。

messages.msgid: This hefty black pot is made from cast iron and coated in a sturdy enamel.
translations: 这个沉重的黑色厚锅由铸铁制成，并涂有坚固的珐琅。

messages.msgid: A cooking pot, useful for boiling water and making all kinds of food.  Made from copper, with a lining of tin to prevent metal from leaching into acidic foods.
translations: 一个烹饪锅，用于烧水和制作各种食物。由铜制成，内层镀锡，以防止酸性食物腐蚀。

messages.msgid: A ceramic pot made for both cooking and serving, particularly one-pot dinners.
translations: 一只陶瓷砂锅，能烹饪或者上菜用，特别是当晚餐是一锅烩菜的时候。

messages.msgid: A large pot with 20 gauge walls and a thick aluminum bottom, used for making soup stocks.  You could fit a whole turkey in there, with a bit of shoving.
translations: 一口用来熬汤的大锅，20号锅壁，厚铝锅底。稍微挤挤的话，你可以塞进去一整只火鸡。

messages.msgid: A very large 20 liter pot, primarily meant for canning food in glass jars via the water bath method, though it can cook normal foods just as well.  Canning foods with it will require a lot of water.  If you're only canning a couple of jars at a time, you'd fill it up with rocks or something to displace the water above the lids.
translations: 一个容量20升的非常大的锅，主要是用于水浴法让玻璃瓶罐装食物，当然它同样可以当作厨具烹饪普通食物。罐装食品需要大量的水。如果你只是一次装几个罐子的话，你需要先放些石头或什么东西抬升水位没过罐子的盖子。

messages.msgid: A very large 25 liter earthenware pot, primarily meant for canning food via the water bath method, though it can cook normal foods just as well.  Canning foods with it will require a lot of water.  If you're only canning a couple of jars at a time, you'd fill it up with rocks or something to displace the water above the lids.
translations: 一个容量25升的非常大的陶锅，主要是用于水浴法来罐装食物，当然它同样可以当作厨具烹饪普通食物。罐装食品需要大量的水。如果你只是一次装几个罐子的话，你需要先放些石头或什么东西抬升水位没过罐子的盖子。

messages.msgid: A cast-iron pan.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is used for cooking.
translations: 一只铸铁煎锅。一种不错的近战武器，且能用于烹饪。

messages.msgid: A steel frying pan.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is used for cooking.
translations: 一只钢制煎锅。一种不错的近战武器，且能用于烹饪。

messages.msgid: A copper frying pan, coated in a thin layer of tin.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is used for cooking.
translations: 一只铜制煎锅，外部镀了薄薄一层锡。一种不错的近战武器，且能用于烹饪。

messages.msgid: A sheet of metal crudely hammered into a cooking pot.  Good enough to cook food and boil water, but not as useful as proper cookware.
translations: 粗暴地砸凹金属板造出来的锅子。烹食煮水倒是够用了，但是跟正常的锅子比肯定是不成的。

messages.msgid: A cooking pot crudely hammered out of copper.  Good enough to cook food and boil water, but not as useful as proper cookware.
translations: 粗暴地砸凹铜料造出来的锅子。烹食煮水倒是够用了，但是跟正常的锅子比肯定是不成的。

messages.msgid: A stovetop kettle for boiling water.
translations: 用于烧开水的炉灶水壶。

messages.msgid: A glass pot for making a cup of joe.
translations: 一个用来泡咖啡的玻璃壶。

messages.msgid: A stainless steel mesh colander, for washing rice and vegetables, or straining liquid off from noodles or other foods.
translations: 一个不锈钢滤网，可以用来淘米，洗菜，或者滤掉面条之类东西里的水。

messages.msgid: A stainless steel mesh screen for preventing flying oil from getting all over your nice counters (or you) when frying.
translations: 一个用来在炒菜时防止溅油的不锈钢网，你再也不用担心你的崭新柜台（或者你自己）被油溅到了！

messages.msgid: A large, flat piece of wood for chopping vegetables on without ruining your knife or your countertop.
translations: 一大块扁平的木板，用来切菜，不会磨坏刀子或台面。

messages.msgid: A stainless steel tray used for serving food in cafeterias, mess halls, or similar places.
translations: 不锈钢托盘，用于在自助餐厅，食堂或类似场所中提供食物。

messages.msgid: A utensil used for cutting pizza.  Practically useless in combat.
translations: 切披萨饼的用具，在战斗中几乎没什么用。

messages.msgid: A utensil used for scooping icecream into bowls.  It has a spring powered lever to assist.
translations: 一种用于将冰淇淋捞入碗中的器具，它有一个弹簧驱动的杠杆来助力。

messages.msgid: A stainless steel cheese grater with a plastic grip.  It is used to shred cheese.
translations: 带有塑料手柄的不锈钢奶酪刨丝器，它能用来把奶酪切碎。

messages.msgid: A cast-iron dutch oven, suitable for boiling, broiling, roasting, baking, stewing, frying and any other method of cooking.
translations: 一个铸铁荷兰锅，可用于煮沸、烧烤、烘焙、烘烤、炖煮、油炸和任何其他烹饪方法。

messages.msgid: A large pot converted into an improvised oven, suitable for basic baking on a hot surface.
translations: 一口大锅，被改造成一个简易烤箱，适合在高温表面上进行基本的烘焙。

messages.msgid: A makeshift oven made of a big clay pot with a lid, containing firebricks to hold heat and a smaller pot to bake in.
translations: 一个自制的荷兰锅，由一个带盖子的大陶锅制成，里面有耐火砖来保温，还有一个小锅能用来烘烤。

messages.msgid: An aluminum frying pan.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is used for cooking.
translations: 一只铝制煎锅。一种不错的近战武器，且能用于烹饪。

messages.msgid: A cooking pot, useful for boiling water and making all kinds of food.  Made from aluminum.
translations: 一个烹饪锅，用于烧水和制作各种食物。这个是由铝制成的。

messages.msgid: A flat paper container with a sealable flap, used to enclose a letter or other paper goods.
translations: 一个带有封口的扁平纸制容器，用于封装信件或其他纸制品。

messages.msgid: A written message from one person to another, usually put in an envelope.  Reading it would be rude.
translations: 一个人写给另一个人的书面信息，通常放在信封里。偷读他人信件是很没教养的行为。

messages.msgid: A written message from a soldier to their partner, carefully folded into its envelope.  Their deployment ends soon and they can't wait to see their lover.  Reading the rest of it would be rude.
translations: 一个士兵给他的伴侣的书面信息，小心翼翼地折在信封里。他们的军事部署即将结束，他们迫不及待地想见到他们的爱人。阅读它的其余部分是不礼貌的。

messages.msgid: A written message from a soldier to their partner, stuffed angrily into its envelope.  They know, they know she knows, and don't even pretend you don't know.  This letter is full of expletives you don't dare read aloud.
translations: 一个士兵给他们的伙伴的书面信息，愤怒地塞进信封。他们知道，他们知道她知道，不要假装你不知道。这封信里充满了你不敢大声读出的脏话。

messages.msgid: A written message from a soldier to their parents.  Their deployment has been extended and they won't be home for the holidays.  This sad letter makes you feel homesick.
translations: 一名士兵给他们父母的书面信息。他们的军事部署已被延长，他们不会回家过节。这封悲伤的信让你感到思乡。

messages.msgid: A written message from a woman to her lover, it's sealed with a heart-shaped sticker and smells of perfume.  You start to read it but it quickly becomes embarrassing.
translations: 一个女人写给她的情人的书信，它用心形贴纸密封，有香水味。你开始读它，但它很快就变得很尴尬。

messages.msgid: A written message from a student to their parents scrawled on notebook paper.  They're having a really bad time at college and want to come home, nothing seems to be going well, their grades and heart are in the dumps.
translations: 一个学生写在笔记本纸上给他们父母的书面信息。他们在大学里过得非常糟糕，想回家，似乎没有什么事情是顺利的，他们的成绩和心都很糟糕。

messages.msgid: A written message from a student to their parents scrawled on notebook paper.  They're having a great time at college and can't wait to introduce you to their new lover.  Coincidently they have run out of money for gas again and it sure would be great if you could send some.
translations: 一个学生给他们父母的书信，写在笔记本纸上。他们在大学过得很开心，迫不及待地想把你介绍给他们的新恋人。巧合的是，他们又没钱买汽油了，如果你能打一些钱，肯定会很好。

messages.msgid: A written message home in a foreign tongue, carefully folded into its envelope.
translations: 一封用你不懂的外语写的家书，小心翼翼地折在信封里。

messages.msgid: A folded pink sheet of paper declaring the homeowner fired!  Oh no.
translations: 一张折叠的粉红色纸片，宣布房主被踢出门了！哦，不！

messages.msgid: A notification from a credit card company, the recipient has been preapproved!  Attached in a thick wad of glue is a fake credit card, this could be theirs if they wanted it.
translations: 信用卡公司的通知，收件人已获得预先批准！粘在厚厚一团胶水里的是一张假信用卡，如果他们想要的话，这可能是他们的。

messages.msgid: A letter from the bank stating the homeowners account is overdrawn and they owe quite a bit of money.
translations: 银行的一封信，说明房主账户透支，他们欠了不少钱。

messages.msgid: A letter to recipient notifying them of their overdue rent, they have 30 days to pay or they are going to court!
translations: 给收件人的一封信，通知他们拖欠的租金，他们有 30 天的时间支付，否则他们将上法庭！

messages.msgid: A notice from the local police, there is a tiny picture of a car and a demand of 350 dollars for speeding in a school zone.
translations: 一张当地警方的通知，显示有一张汽车的照片，并因在学区超速行驶而被罚款350美元。

messages.msgid: A piece of thick, rectangular paper intended for writing and mailing without an envelope.
translations: 一张厚厚的长方形纸片，用于书写和邮寄，无需信封。

messages.msgid: A small card that can be exchanged for goods or services from a particular business, usually given as a gift.
translations: 一张小卡片，可以从特定企业兑换商品或服务，通常作为礼物赠送。

messages.msgid: A gift card for a local restaurant, covering the cost for an entire meal.
translations: 一张本地餐厅的礼品卡，可以支付一顿饭的费用。

messages.msgid: A $20 gift card, redeemable for purchases at your local clothing store.
translations: 一张价值20美金的礼品卡，可在本地服装店付款时抵扣。

messages.msgid: This gift card could be exchanged for a free cut at a local barbershop.
translations: 这张礼品卡可以在本地一家理发店兑换一次免费理发。

messages.msgid: A $100 electronic gift card, redeemable for purchases at your local megastore.
translations: 一张价值100美金的电子礼品卡，可在本地购物广场付款时抵扣。

messages.msgid: This gift card gives you a 5% discount for purchases at your local shopping mall.  Can only be redeemed once.
translations: 这张礼品卡可以在本地购物中心购物时打九五折。只能使用一次。

messages.msgid: A $5 gift card, redeemable for purchases at your local bookstore.
translations: 一张价值5美金的礼品卡，可在本地书店付款时抵扣。

messages.msgid: A $10 gift card, redeemable for purchases at your local hardware store.
translations: 一张价值10美金的礼品卡，可在本地五金店付款时抵扣。

messages.msgid: A piece of card stock meant to convey an expression of sentiment.
translations: 一张意在传递情感的卡片。

messages.msgid: A greeting card for expressing best wishes.  Its corners are decorated with paintings of flowers and leaves.
translations: 一张用来表达美好祝愿的贺卡。它的四周装饰着花和叶子的图案。

messages.msgid: A baby blue greeting card with a drawing of a teddy bear holding an umbrella.  Words printed on it read: "It's getting closer by the hour, so let's have a baby shower!"
translations: 一张淡蓝色的贺卡，上面画着一只泰迪熊拿着一把伞。上面印着一行文字："孩子就要出生了，我们来办个party迎接他吧！"

messages.msgid: A greeting card given to a person to celebrate their birthday.  This one has a floral design.
translations: 送给某人庆祝生日的贺卡。这张上印着花卉图案。

messages.msgid: This greeting card displays a picture of a graduate tossing their graduation cap.  Above the cap is the word 'CONGRATULATIONS'.
translations: 这张贺卡上印着一张毕业生投掷毕业帽的照片。在帽子上方是"毕业了"一词。

messages.msgid: A white greeting card with a stylized drawing of an empty road.  Words printed on it read: "You're going places (literally).  Wishing you the best!"
translations: 这是一张白色贺卡，上面画着一条空旷的道路。上面印着这样的文字："你将离我而去（字面上）。祝你一路顺风！"

messages.msgid: A greeting card with a stylized picture of a donut and a coffee cup.  Above the picture, it says 'I am thankful for our friendship' and below are the words 'we are better together'.
translations: 带有风格化的甜甜圈和咖啡杯图片的贺卡。图片上方写着"感谢我们的友谊"，下方写着"我们在一起更好"。

messages.msgid: This greeting card displays a cartoon turtle in a cozy blanket sipping hot tea.  Above the turtle, it says 'Wishing you a SPEEDY recovery!'
translations: 这张贺卡展示了一只卡通海龟在舒适的毯子里啜饮着热茶。海龟上方写着"祝你早日康复！"

messages.msgid: A greeting card wishing the recipient a long and happy retirement.  This one displays a drawing of a rocking chair surrounded with white roses.
translations: 一张贺卡，祝收信人退休愉快。这张上印了一张被白玫瑰环绕的摇椅。

messages.msgid: A black greeting card with a picture of a dimly lit candle.  Words printed on it read: "Please accept our deepest and most heartfelt condolences at this challenging time."
translations: 一张黑色的贺卡，上面画着一支昏暗的蜡烛。上面写着："在这个充满挑战的时刻，请接受我们最深切、最衷心的哀悼。"

messages.msgid: A plain white greeting card featuring an expression of gratitude to the recipient.
translations: 一张素白的贺卡，上面写着对收信人的感激之情。

messages.msgid: A balanced cable used for sending audio signal.  The connectors have three prongs.
translations: 一根用于传输音频信号的平衡电缆。连接器上有三根芯。

messages.msgid: This audio cable connects one speaker to a powered head, or one speaker to another.
translations: 一根能将一个扬声器连接到电源插头，或将一个扬声器连接到另一个扬声器的电缆。

messages.msgid: Known as an instrument cable because it is usually used to connect a guitar to a powered amp, it is an unbalanced cable with 1/4" male connectors on each side.
translations: 一根通常用于将吉他连接到功率放大器的乐器线，属于不平衡电缆，每侧有个1/4寸公头。

messages.msgid: A pair of headphones that cover your ears for improved sound quality and private listening.  This pair is from a well-known brand that is very high quality, with a detachable 1/8" cable.  Comes with a 1/8" to 1/4" adapter.
translations: 一副头戴式耳机，可提高音质并保持声音私密。这副耳机出自某个名牌产品，质量非常好，附带一根可拆卸的1/8寸电缆以及对应的1/8寸到1/4寸的转换头。

messages.msgid: A microphone used to record or amplify sound.  Comes with a clip.  Has a 3-pin XLR connector on the bottom in order to connect to an amp.
translations: 一个用来录音或放大声音的麦克风。有一个夹子。底部有一个3针卡农接头，用于连接调幅放大器。

messages.msgid: A lightweight telescoping boom stand made of aluminum and painted black.  About 6' tall when full extended, or 3' when closed fully.  Has threads for a mic clip on one end.
translations: 一个轻巧的伸缩式臂架，由铝制成，被漆成黑色。完全伸展时约6尺高，完全闭合时约3尺高。一端有麦克风夹的螺纹。

messages.msgid: A small, oddly-shaped piece of aluminum hardware with three legs.  When placed on the ground, this can support one guitar in an upright position.
translations: 一个三条腿的形状奇特的小型铝制五金件。当放在地上时，它能撑起一把吉他。

messages.msgid: A flat piece of plastic with a pointed tip, designed for plucking the strings of an instrument.
translations: 一片两端尖尖的扁平塑料片，用于拨动乐器的琴弦。

messages.msgid: A device with faders, switches, and knobs that mixes input signal and sends it to two output XLR cables, a left one and a right one.
translations: 一台带有各类音量控制器、开关和旋钮的装置，能够混合输入的音频信号并将其输出到两条卡农电缆上，左声道右声道各一条。

messages.msgid: A synthetic rubber V-belt with steel reinforcement fibers.  Commonly fitted to engines or other industrial equipment.
translations: 一根有着钢铁纤维强化的合成橡胶质地的三角皮带，通常用于引擎和其他工业设备中。

messages.msgid: An improvised belt useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.
translations: 当没有更好的选择的时候，这个简易的皮带可堪用于修理引擎或其它工业设备。

messages.msgid: A harness made of five belts meant to be mounted on vehicle to fasten a passenger securely to their seat.
translations: 一种由五条带子组成的安全带，用于安装在载具上，将乘客安全地固定在座位上。

messages.msgid: A plastic box containing creped paper used to filter the air supply for combustion engines or other industrial equipment.
translations: 一个塑料盒，装着叠的和可丽饼（法式薄饼）一样的滤纸，用于内燃机或其他工业设备的空气过滤。

messages.msgid: An improvised air filter useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.
translations: 当没有更好的选择的时候，这个简易的空气过滤器可堪用于修理引擎或其它工业设备。

messages.msgid: A steel can containing filter paper designed for automotive use.
translations: 一个装满了车用级滤纸的钢罐。

messages.msgid: An improvised automotive filter useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.
translations: 当没有更好的选择的时候，这个简易的汽车过滤器可堪用于修理引擎或其它工业设备。

messages.msgid: A cylindrical heating device designed to be screwed in to a diesel engine to aid starting in cold weather.
translations: 类似火花塞的一种圆柱形加热设备，设计有一圈螺纹，以便拧在柴油引擎上，它能帮助引擎在严寒条件下启动。

messages.msgid: A complex mechanical pump capable of achieving high pressures.  Far beyond anything you could reasonably improvise.
translations: 一个能提供很高压力的复杂机械泵，远远超出你手工制造的合理范畴。

messages.msgid: A simple cast iron mechanical impeller pump.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.
translations: 一种简易铸铁机械叶轮泵。单独它自己并没有什么用。

messages.msgid: An electrically-powered device which compresses gas to increase pressure.  Used in fridges, air conditioners and many other appliances.
translations: 一台电力驱动的气体压缩机。用于冰箱、空调和许多其他电器。

messages.msgid: A straight pipe with high-tech membrane filter inside it, designed to separate nitrogen from compressed air that is pumped through it.
translations: 一条笔直的管道，内部装有高科技过滤膜，能将氮气从泵送的压缩空气中分离出来。

messages.msgid: A small but strong permanent magnet made from alnico alloy, which produces a magnetic field that attracts ferromagnetic materials such as steel.  Useful for crafting.
translations: 一块由铝镍钴合金制成的、小而坚固的永磁体，会产生磁场吸引铁磁材料（如钢），可以用来制造物品。

messages.msgid: A section of steel pipe with very thick walls built to contain very high pressure, probably intended to be a part of industrial equipment.
translations: 一段厚壁钢管，可以承受很高的压力，可能是工业设备的一部分。

messages.msgid: set of heavy duty pipe fittings
messages.plural: sets of heavy duty pipe fittings

messages.msgid: A loose assortment of very thick-walled steel pipe fittings - end caps, pipe junctions, and similar items.  Probably intended to be a part of industrial equipment.
translations: 各式各样的厚壁钢制金属管件。管帽、管接头和类似的配件。可能是工业设备的一部分。

messages.msgid: A short section of thick-walled pipe with a valve integrated into it, allowing an operator to regulate the flow of gas or liquid through it.
translations: 一小段厚壁管道，上面有个阀门，可以调节通过它的气体或液体的流量。

messages.msgid: A short section of thick-walled pipe with a device which shows the internal pressure built into it.
translations: 一小段厚壁管道，带有显示管道内部压力的装置。

messages.msgid: A small electronic device used for measuring high temperatures.
translations: 一台用于测量高温的小型电子装置。

messages.msgid: A bulky and very powerful compressor which can produce very high pressure if fitted to a pipe.  Much more powerful than whatever you'd find in common household appliances.
translations: 一台十分笨重、功率强大的压缩机，如果安装在管道上，可以产生很高的压力。比普通家用电器里用的更强大。

messages.msgid: An enormously bulky and heavy steel vessel with thick walls.  Likely meant to be a reaction chamber for industrial processes requiring high pressure.
translations: 一个体型巨大、十分笨重的钢制厚壁容器。可能是需要高压的化工反应的反应室。

messages.msgid: A rather small steel vessel with thick walls designed to contain high pressure.  Quite heavy for its size.
translations: 一个小型钢制厚壁容器，设计用来容纳高压气体或液体。就其尺寸而言，相当重。

messages.msgid: A loose assortment of metal pipe fittings - end caps, pipe junctions, and similar items.  They can be used in a variety of projects.
translations: 各式各样的金属管件。管帽、管接头和类似的配件。它们可以用在各种工程项目中。

messages.msgid: A simple cranking mechanism, consisting of a bent metal arm attached at a right angle to a rotating shaft.  It can be used to convert circular motion into reciprocating motion, or vice versa, by means of muscle power.
translations: 一个简单的曲柄机构，由一个弯曲的金属臂组成，该金属臂以直角连接到一个旋转轴上。它可以通过肌肉力量将圆周运动转换为往复运动，反之亦然。

messages.msgid: A plastic clothes hanger with a metal hook to hang something on a rail.
translations: 一个带金属钩的塑料衣架，能在挂衣杆上挂衣服。

messages.msgid: A four foot long collection of carabiners for hanging items while camping.
translations: 一根露营时用来悬挂物品的四英尺（约1.2米）长的锁链。

messages.msgid: A 6-inch (or about 15 cm) long piece of natural cordage.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper string.
translations: 一根六英寸（约15厘米）长的天然纤维。可用于某些制造配方，但强度和柔韧性不如正规生产的棉线。

messages.msgid: A 3-foot (or about 90 cm) long piece of natural cordage.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper string.
translations: 一根三英尺（约90厘米）长的天然纤维。可用于某些制造配方，但强度和柔韧性不如正规生产的棉线。

messages.msgid: A 6-inch (or about 15 cm) long piece of cotton string.
translations: 一根六英寸（约15厘米）长的棉线。

messages.msgid: A 3-foot (or about 90 cm) long piece of cotton string.
translations: 一根三英尺（约90厘米）长的棉线。

messages.msgid: A 6-inch (or about 15 cm) long piece of leather lace.  Useful for some purposes, but not as flexible as proper string.
translations: 一根六英寸（约15厘米）长的皮革条。可用于某些制造配方，但柔韧性不如正规生产的棉线。

messages.msgid: A 3-foot (or about 90 cm) long piece of leather lace, made from smaller pieces that are tied together.  Useful for some purposes, but not as flexible as proper string.
translations: 一根三英尺（约90厘米）长的皮革条。可用于某些制造配方，但柔韧性不如正规生产的棉线。

messages.msgid: A 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long piece of rope.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.
translations: 一段六英尺（约1.8米）长的绳索。你可以把它挂在肩上用来拴住东西携带。

messages.msgid: You use an elaborate knot to tie your %s to your %s
translations: 你用一个复杂的绳结把%s绑到你的%s上。
选择用绳索捆绑的物品。

messages.msgid: A 30-foot (or about 9 m) long rope.  Useful for keeping yourself safe from falls.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.
translations: 一段三十英尺（约9米）长的绳索。有效保护你从高处落下时的安全。你可以把它挂在肩上用来拴住东西携带。

messages.msgid: A sturdy 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long vine.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.
translations: 一段六英尺（约1.8米）长的坚固藤蔓。你可以把它挂在肩上用来拴住东西携带。

messages.msgid: A sturdy 30-foot (or about 9 m) long vine.  Could easily be used as a rope.  Strong enough to suspend a large corpse for butchering.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.
translations: 一段三十英尺（约9米）长的藤蔓。完全可以替代绳子，但是无法分解。足以吊起大型尸体以便屠宰。你可以把它挂在肩上用来拴住东西携带。

messages.msgid: A 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long piece of rough rope, woven from natural cordage.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper rope.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.
translations: 一根六英尺（约1.8米）长的绳索，采用天然纤维编织而成。可用于某些制造配方，但强度和柔韧性不如正规生产的绳索。你可以把它挂在肩上用来拴住东西携带。

messages.msgid: A 30-foot (or about 9 m) long rough rope, woven from natural cordage.  Not strong enough to hold up to falls, but still useful for some things, such as suspending large corpses for butchering.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.
translations: 一根三十英尺（约9米）长的绳索，采用天然纤维编织而成。可用于某些制造配方，但强度和柔韧性不如正规生产的绳索。强度不足以让你用于攀岩下降。足以吊起大型尸体一边屠宰。你可以把它挂在肩上用来拴住东西携带。

messages.msgid: A length of synthetic fiber weaved into a flat band, usually used to securely fasten passenger inside vehicles.
translations: 一段编织成扁平带状的合成纤维，通常用于将乘客固定在车内。

messages.msgid: A rather green stick.  Very fibrous.
translations: 一根相当绿的植物茎秆，富含纤维。

messages.msgid: An elastic loop of rubber commonly used to hold multiple objects together.
translations: 一根有弹性的橡胶圈，能将许多物体捆在一起。

messages.msgid: This is a talking doll, meant for children.  Fortunately it still works, and you could unload the batteries out of it.
translations: 会说话的娃娃，只有孩子们才会感兴趣。庆幸的它还没坏，你可以把电池取下来。

messages.msgid: A swimming kickboard, would be a great training aid for the beach or the pool, if only they weren't full of zombies and mutant fish.
translations: 一块游泳打腿练习板，在海边或游泳池训练游泳时的绝佳辅助，要是那里没被丧尸和变异的鱼类占满就好了。

messages.msgid: A high-drag projectile used in the sport of badminton.
translations: 一个羽毛球比赛中使用的高阻力羽毛球。
