messages.msgid: A pin-shaped piece of wood meant for holding a golf ball slightly off the ground.
translations: 一根木头制成的大头针形状的杆子，用于将高尔夫球固定托起得略高于地面。

messages.msgid: A small, hard plastic ball with round indentations on it.
translations: 一个表面上有很多圆形凹痕的坚硬塑料小球。

messages.msgid: A colorful, hard plastic ball for playing games on a pool table.  Essentially a rock.
translations: 用于在台球桌上进行游戏的彩色硬塑料小球。其实也可以当作一块石头。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy ball with finger holes for better grip.  Before the apocalypse, its main purpose was to be rolled along waxed floors.
translations: 一个大而重的球，带有指孔便于更好地抓握。在世界末日之前，它最常干的事只是在打蜡的地板上滚动。

messages.msgid: A baseball, good for throwing at enemies.  Getting hit with one of these hurts a lot more than you might think.
translations: 一个普通的棒球，可以将其掷出，如果击中的话威力超乎你的想象。

messages.msgid: An oval-shaped ball made of leather and string, it's easily thrown but does little damage.  You could take it apart into leather if you wanted.
translations: 一个椭圆形的球，由皮革和线制成，很容易扔出去，但威力不大。如果你愿意，你可以把它拆成皮革。
一个高品质的7号室内篮球。
一个符合标准规则的排球。

messages.msgid: A collection of laser guns and targets designed to help you practice shooting.  The spot you 'hit' is displayed on the targets.
translations: 一组激光玩具枪和靶子，用来练习射击。你"击中"的位置会显示在标靶上。

messages.msgid: A brightly colored beach volleyball.  It is slightly larger than a regular white one.
translations: 一个色彩鲜艳的沙滩排球。它比标准规则所使用的白色排球稍微大一些。

messages.msgid: A heavy circular block of solid rubber, normally used for playing hockey.  You can throw it to cause some serious harm.
translations: 用固体橡胶制成的沉重的球状物，通常用于玩曲棍球。投掷它能造成严重的伤害。

messages.msgid: A figure of an adult human, as seen in the display case at the mall.  It might be able to fool some zombies if it could attract their attention.
translations: 一个成人大小的人偶，和商场的展示柜里的一样。它能吸引丧尸的注意，也许能骗过它们。

messages.msgid: A figure of an adult human, as seen in the display case at the mall.  This one is cradling a talking doll.  It can make sound when powered by batteries and can be used to distract some zombies.
translations: 一个成人大小的人偶，和商场的展示柜里的一样。这个人偶抱着一只说话玩偶。在使用电池供电时，它可以发出声音，可以用来分散丧尸的注意力。

messages.msgid: You activate the talking doll on the mannequin.
translations: 你开启了人体模型上的说话玩偶。

messages.msgid: Your mannequin seems to have a mind of its own!  If you see this, an error has occurred.
translations: 你的人体模型似乎有自己的想法！如果你看到了这句话，说明出bug了。

messages.msgid: A classic six-shooter revolver chambered for 10mm and .40 rounds.
translations: 一把经典的 10mm/.40 口径六发左轮手枪。

messages.msgid: The Smith and Wesson 610 is a classic six-shooter revolver chambered for 10mm rounds, or for S&W's own .40 round.
translations: S&W 610 左轮手枪是一把经典的六发左轮手枪，可以选择装入 10mm 弹，或者S&W公司特有的 .40 弹。
格洛克 紧凑型手枪

messages.msgid: A small pistol accepting Glock magazines and chambered in 10mm.  Because of its size, it is easy to carry, but it has rather fierce recoil.
translations: 一把使用格洛克弹匣的 10mm 小型手枪。因为它的小体积，它便于携带，但后坐力也很强。

messages.msgid: A modestly sized version of the highly successful Glock, chambered in hard-hitting 10mm Auto.  It is easy to carry because of its small size, but also recoils fiercely.
translations: 一把出自广受欢迎的格洛克系列的小尺寸手枪，采用威力强大的 10mm Auto 弹。因为它的小体积，它便于携带，但后坐力也很强。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm and accepting Glock magazines.
translations: 一把使用格洛克弹匣的 10mm 半自动手枪。

messages.msgid: A full-sized version of the highly successful Glock, chambered in hard-hitting 10mm Auto.  The third model of Glock designed, all other full-sized, large framed Glocks are adaptations of this one.
translations: 一把出自广受欢迎的格洛克系列的全尺寸手枪，采用威力强大的 10mm Auto 弹。该枪采用格洛克第三代设计（Gen 3），格洛克旗下的其他全尺寸大型手枪皆是基于此设计开发。
格洛克 狩猎型手枪

messages.msgid: A full-sized, long-slide version of the highly successful Glock, chambered in hard-hitting 10mm Auto.  The extra barrel length makes for slightly more accurate and powerful shots, and the extra slide length means the sights are a little easier to use.  It also features Glock's Modular Optic System, making aftermarket optics much easier to mount.
translations: 一把出自广受欢迎的格洛克系列的全尺寸长套筒手枪，采用威力强大的 10mm Auto 弹。额外的枪管长度略微改善了射击精度和子弹威力，而额外的套筒长度使其瞄具更为易用。它还自带格洛克公司出品的模块化光学瞄具系统（MOS），能更容易安装非原厂瞄具。

messages.msgid: A full-sized, long-slide version of the highly successful Glock, chambered in hard-hitting 10mm Auto.  The extra barrel length makes for slightly more accurate and powerful shots, and the extra slide length means the sights are a little easier to use.
translations: 一把出自广受欢迎的格洛克系列的全尺寸长套筒手枪，采用威力强大的 10mm Auto 弹。额外的枪管长度略微改善了射击精度和子弹威力，而额外的套筒长度使其瞄具更为易用。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic carbine chambered in 10mm and accepting BA10 magazines.

The MP5/10 served the FBI briefly alongside their 10mm Auto pistols, adding to the caliber's overall mystique.  Though the gun's usage was short-lived, a handful of clones were made and sold occasionally.  This semi-automatic clone manufactured by Brethren Arms features a welded-on M1913 rail and a collapsible arm brace.
translations: MP5/10冲锋枪曾经与使用 10mm Auto 弹的手枪一同短暂地服役于FBI，增加了该口径的整体神秘感。虽然该型号枪械的服役时间很短，但是它的复制品已经制造了一部分，并且偶尔会在市场上少量出售。这把由 Brethren Arms 公司制造的半自动复制品的特点是焊上了一根M1913导轨和一个可折叠的前臂支架。
柯尔特 "三角精英" 手枪

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm.  It accepts Colt Delta Elite magazines.
translations: 一把使用柯尔特 "三角精英" 手枪弹匣的 10mm 半自动手枪。

messages.msgid: A modernized, match-grade variant of the venerable M1911 chambered in hard-hitting 10mm Auto.  Early variants were known to crack frames; modern 1911s, like this one, are slotted to prevent such crack formation.
translations: 一把基于著名的 M1911 手枪设计，经现代化改造后的竞赛级衍生型手枪，采用威力强大的 10mm Auto 弹。M1911 手枪的早期变体存在枪身容易破裂的通病；现代的 M1911 手枪——比如说手上这把——通过主动在枪身设计开槽，来防止枪身裂开。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm and accepting EAA Witness magazines.
translations: 一把使用 EAA "证人" 手枪弹匣的 10mm 半自动手枪。

messages.msgid: The EAA Witness is a modified variant of the CZ-75, produced in Italy by Tanfoglio.  This is the standard steel framed version chambered in 10mm Auto.
translations: EAA "证人" 手枪是 CZ 75 手枪的改进型号，由意大利Tanfoglio公司制造。这一把是标准的钢制枪身版本，口径为 10mm Auto。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm and accepting SIG magazines.
translations: 一把使用西格手枪弹匣的 10mm 半自动手枪。

messages.msgid: The SIG Sauer P220 was developed for the Swiss military in 1975, and its simplified action was later used in most other SIG Sauer designs, including the P226.  The all-steel construction adds heft to this model, which is chambered in hard-hitting 10mm Auto.
translations: 1975年的西格&绍尔 P220 手枪原为瑞士军队用途而设计开发，而其所使用的简化版枪机后续被包括 P226 手枪在内的大多数西格&绍尔枪械所使用。该型号的全钢结构增加了枪体重量，但也使其能使用威力强大的 10mm Auto 弹。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm and accepting XD-M magazines.
translations: 一把使用 XD-M 弹匣的 10mm 半自动手枪。

messages.msgid: Designed by HS Produkt in Croatia, the HS2000 has become a commercial success for Springfield Armory, who imports and markets it as the eXtreme Duty.  The XD has since been offered in a variety of chamberings and sizes, including this full-sized match grade variant in 10mm Auto.
translations: HS2000 手枪由克罗地亚的HS Produkt公司设计，被春田兵工厂以eXtreme Duty商标进口至北美销售后大获成功。如今，XD系列手枪已经涵盖了多种口径和尺寸，包括这把使用 10mm Auto 弹的全尺寸竞赛型号。

messages.msgid: A submachine gun chambered in 10mm, accepting Glock magazines.
translations: 一把 10mm 口径的冲锋枪，可使用格洛克弹匣。

messages.msgid: The Vector SDP is a delayed blowback "pistol" with a unique, downward reciprocating bolt that helps combat muzzle climb.  This one is chambered in 10mm Auto.
translations: Vector SDP 手枪是一把延迟反冲式"手枪"，有个设计独特的向下往复枪栓，有助于补偿枪口上跳后坐力。这把手枪使用 10mm Auto 弹。

messages.msgid: A highly advanced infantry weapon that magnetically propels a ferromagnetic projectile using an alternating current.  Markings and serials imply it was manufactured by Heckler & Koch, but the maturity of the implemented technologies makes such a claim suspect.  Powered by UPS.
translations: 一把及其先进的步兵武器，通过交变电流发射磁性弹丸。标记和序列皆表明它由H&K公司生产，但这把枪上表现的成熟技术让人很难不怀疑是否真由他们所为。使用UPS供电。

messages.msgid: A venerable .22 caliber lever-action rifle, with a 19-round tube magazine and a classic design that dates back over a century.  Generally used for the hunting of small game like rabbits, the strict taxonomic classification of zombies as 'small game' is debatable, but this decades-old weapon can still be counted upon to help manage the undead population.
translations: 一把久负盛名的 .22 杠杆式步枪，采用19发管式弹仓，以及沿用了一个世纪的经典设计。通常用于兔子之类的小型猎物的狩猎——虽然丧尸能不能被算作是“小型猎物”不太好说，但这并不妨碍你与这位几十岁的老伙计合作，控制不死生物的种群数量。

messages.msgid: The oldest and longest-produced shoulder firearm in the world.  Though it fires the weak .22 round, it is highly accurate and damaging, and has essentially no recoil.
translations: 这是世界上最古老、持续生产时间最长的长枪之一。尽管使用的是较弱的 .22 弹，但其仍精准且致命，而且几乎没有后坐力。

messages.msgid: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.
translations: 一把自制的步枪。其本质上是给钢管装了支架，又在尾部装了个击锤来击发装在钢管里的子弹。

messages.msgid: A lightweight and modular pistol caliber hunting carbine, firing the low power .22 LR cartridge.  Before the Cataclysm, a mix of high customizability, cheap ammunition, and low recoil made this a very popular varmint rifle among civilian shooters.
translations: 一把轻量模块化的手枪弹狩猎卡宾枪，发射 .22 LR 弹。在大灾变前，因其高度可定制性、廉价的弹药，以及低后坐力而成为平民射手间流行的狐鼠步枪。

messages.msgid: A combination of negligible recoil, high customization, and inexpensive ammunition made the Ruger 10/22 a popular choice among enthusiasts and small game hunters.  Even though it fires the weak .22 round, it's perfectly capable of killing.
translations: 可控后坐力、高度定制化、廉价的弹药的结合，使鲁格 10/22 步枪成为枪械或小型动物狩猎爱好者的热门之选。尽管使用较弱的 .22 弹，但仍能胜任杀敌工作。

messages.msgid: A handy and lightweight rifle, modified to fire semi and full auto.
translations: 一把轻便且易于操作的步枪，经过改造后可选择半自动和全自动射击模式。
全自动 鲁格 10/22 步枪

messages.msgid: A Ruger 10/22 modified post-Cataclysm to selective fire.  While the .22 round isn't very powerful, full auto makes it a lot more effective, and still easily controllable in full auto.
translations: 一支大灾变后改装的，可选择射击模式的鲁格 10/22 步枪。单发 .22 弹的威力较弱，全自动射击则与其相辅相成，不仅使武器能造成更有效的伤害，且武器仍能被轻松控制。

messages.msgid: A comparatively dainty revolver, chambered for 8 tiny rounds of .22 LR.
translations: 一把相当精致的左轮手枪，可装填8发小尺寸的 .22 LR 弹。
鲁格 LCR .22 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: A compact, double-action-only revolver designed for easy concealment, with a stainless steel cylinder and aluminum frame.
translations: 一把紧凑的双动式左轮手枪，使用不锈钢转轮弹仓和铝制枪身。设计旨在强化其隐蔽性。

messages.msgid: A medium sized, .22 caliber semi-automatic pistol, for training with a pistol similar to more powerful pistols.  Built from aluminum and polymer components, the weapon is lightweight and concealable, but its chambering is not very powerful.
translations: 一把中等大小，.22 口径的半自动手枪，用于训练以适应威力更大的手枪。整把枪由铝与聚合材料制成，轻便又易携带，但其使用的弹药威力较小。

messages.msgid: The GSG firefly is a .22 semi-automatic handgun.  While the GSG Firefly started off as the SIG Mosquito, after the Mosquito ceased production, German Sport Guns picked it up and renamed it to the Firefly.
translations: GSG "萤火虫" 手枪是一把 .22 半自动手枪。原为西格 "蚊"式手枪，在后者停产后，德国运动枪械（GSG）公司便将该设计收购并更名为"萤火虫"。

messages.msgid: A dainty training pistol offered by the Walther Arms company, making use of the .22 LR cartridge, for training on a pistol very similar to more powerful pistols.
translations: 瓦尔特武器公司所生产的一把训练手枪，发射 .22 LR 弹，用于训练以适应威力更大的手枪。

messages.msgid: The Walther P22 is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol intended for training with a platform very similar to more defensive handguns.  It is about half the size of most Walthers.  It is made mostly with plastic, with the slide and key components (other than the barrel) being made of die-cast zinc alloy.
translations: 瓦尔特 P22 手枪是一把采用反冲式枪机的半自动手枪，作为训练用枪，提供了与防御性手枪相近的武器平台。体积只有其他瓦尔特手枪型号的一半。枪体基本由塑料制造，只有套筒和一些关键部件由锌合金压铸而成。

messages.msgid: A large capacity handgun, chambered in .22 and feeding from quad stack magazines.  Used both recreationally and in competition.
translations: 这是一种大容量手枪，口径为.22，采用四排弹匣供弹。既适用于休闲射击，也常见于竞技比赛之中。

messages.msgid: The Kel-Tec CP33, standing for Competition Pistol 33, is a .22 semi automatic pistol targeted towards competition shooters and recreational shooters alike, with the ability to feed from 33 round quad stack magazines, or even 50 with an extension.  While in a fairly weak cartridge, the capacity makes it quite a formidable weapon in the right hands.
translations: Kel-Tec CP33手枪，全称为“竞赛手枪33”，是一款面向竞赛射手及休闲射击爱好者设计的.22口径半自动手枪。该枪可使用33发四排弹匣供弹，装上扩容弹匣底板后甚至可达50发容量。尽管使用的子弹威力相对较弱，但在合适的使用者手中，凭借其高容量的特点，仍是一款相当有威力的武器。

messages.msgid: A light and handy .22 LR handgun from Ruger, this handgun is one of the most popular .22 handguns ever created.
translations: 一把鲁格公司出品的，轻巧便捷的 .22 LR 手枪，是史上最受欢迎的 .22 口径手枪之一。
鲁格 MK II 手枪

messages.msgid: The 2nd version of the Ruger Standard, which replaced production of the Standard in 1982 and continued until 2005 with the main feature of having adjustable sights.  Features a 5.5 inch barrel and feeds from a 10 round magazine.
translations: 鲁格标准手枪的第二代产品，自1982年起接替了初代标准手枪的生产，直至2005年，其主要特点是配备了可调节瞄准具。该手枪拥有5.5英寸枪管，使用10发弹匣供弹。
鲁格 MK III 手枪

messages.msgid: The 3rd version of the Ruger Standard, which replaced production of the Mark II in 2005 and continued until 2016.  Features a 5.5 inch barrel and feeds from a 10 round magazine.
translations: 鲁格标准手枪的第三代产品，自2005年起接替了第二代标准手枪的生产，直至2016年。该手枪拥有5.5英寸枪管，使用10发弹匣供弹。
鲁格 MK IV 手枪

messages.msgid: The 4th, and most modern version of the Ruger Standard.  Still in production since 2016, and has a simplified disassembly feature.  Has a 5.5 inch barrel and feeds from a 10 round magazine.
translations: 鲁格标准手枪的第四代产品，作为最新的一代，自2016年起接替了第三代标准手枪的生产至今，其主要特点是简化了拆装过程。该手枪拥有5.5英寸枪管，使用10发弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, wood framed pump action rifle, holding 15 rounds of .22 with an 18 inch barrel.  While pump actions tend to be largely shotguns, they can be made in calibers such as .22 LR.
translations: 一把轻便的木制枪身泵动式步枪，使用18英寸枪管，可容纳15发 .22 弹。虽然采用泵动式结构的大多是霰弹枪，但小如 .22 LR 这样的口径也能使用该结构。

messages.msgid: A modern take on the Winchester 1890, the Rossi Gallery is a .22 LR rifle, notably using a pump action.  Much like a pump action shotgun, the magazine tube is below its 18 inch barrel and can hold 15 rounds.  While pump actions are quite often associated with shotguns, the mechanism can be applied to rifles as well, though in practice it's limited to .22 LR.
translations: 罗西 "画廊" 步枪是温彻斯特 1890 步枪的 .22 LR 口径现代改良版，其最显著的特点是使用了泵动式结构。与泵动霰弹枪类似，它的18英寸枪管下方装有一个可容纳15发子弹的管式弹仓。虽然采用泵动式结构的大多是霰弹枪，但步枪其实也能使用该结构——尽管实际会去使用的也只有 .22 LR 口径步枪。

messages.msgid: A revolver chambered in .22 LR, with 6 shots and a 6.5 inch barrel.
translations: 一把 .22 LR 口径的左轮手枪，拥有6.5英寸枪管，可装填6发子弹。
遗产制造 "粗野骑兵" 6.5英寸左轮手枪

messages.msgid: A cheap, single action revolver chambered in .22 LR.  While it makes for a handy plinking gun, the single action mechanism, size of the firearm, combined with the lack of a swing out cylinder makes for a less than ideal zombie fighting handgun.
translations: 一把廉价的单动式左轮手枪，发射 .22 LR 弹。虽是一把不错的打靶练习枪，但单动式击发、枪支体积，以及缺少弹出式弹巢，使得它在对付丧尸时的表现并不理想。
大型 .22 六发左轮手枪

messages.msgid: A revolver chambered in .22 LR, with 6 shots and a 9 inch barrel.
translations: 一把 .22 LR 口径的左轮手枪，拥有9英寸枪管，可装填6发子弹。
遗产制造 "粗野骑兵" 9英寸左轮手枪

messages.msgid: A cheap, single action revolver chambered in .22 LR.  While it makes for a handy plinking gun, the single action mechanism, size of the firearm, combined with the lack of a swing out cylinder makes for a less than ideal zombie fighting handgun, even with the slightly increased performance from the longer barrel.
translations: 一把廉价的单动式左轮手枪，发射 .22 LR 弹。虽是一把不错的打靶练习枪，但单动式击发、枪支体积，以及缺少弹出式弹巢，使得它在对付丧尸时的表现并不理想，即使更长的枪管提升了一点性能。

messages.msgid: A 1911 in .22 LR, with a 4 1/4" barrel, and feeding from 10 round magazines.
translations: 一把 .22 LR 口径的 1911 手枪，拥有4.25英寸的枪管，使用10发弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: A 1911 handgun with "1911-22" stamped on the slide.  While .22 LR 1911s were first devised as a training aid for US soldiers, it found large civilian use from concealed carry to plinking thanks to the readily available ammunition and familiar platform.
translations: .22 LR 1911 手枪，套管上刻有“1911-22”字样。最初是为了美军士兵训练而设计，但由于弹药易购，且采用的是众人熟知的武器平台，很快在民间流行起来，上至携行防身，下至休闲打靶。

messages.msgid: A .22 Long Rifle lever-action rifle, which holds 15 rounds of ammo.  While quite useful against small game, its effectiveness isn't as great against the undead.
translations: 一把 .22 LR 口径的杠杆式步枪，可装载15发子弹。虽然它对小型猎物非常有效，但对丧尸的杀伤力就显得有些不足了。
罗西 "布拉沃河" 杠杆式步枪

messages.msgid: A modern .22 LR lever-action rifle, the Rio Bravo features an 18" barrel with 15 rounds of ammo in its tube magazine, which is loaded from the front of the rifle.  The mechanical origins date back decades, being based off of Rossi's R92 series of rifles which themselves were based off of the Winchester 1892.
translations: 罗西 "布拉沃河" 是一把现代化 .22 LR 杠杆式步枪，拥有18英寸枪管和15发载弹的前装式管状弹仓。该枪使用的机械结构可以追溯到几十年前——其本身基于罗西公司的R92系列步枪设计，而该系列步枪本身又是基于温彻斯特 1892 步枪设计。

messages.msgid: A .22 Long Rifle lever-action rifle, which holds 16 rounds of ammo.  While quite useful against small game, its effectiveness isn't as great against the undead.
translations: 一把 .22 LR 口径的杠杆式步枪，可装载15发子弹。虽然它对小型猎物非常有效，但对丧尸的杀伤力就显得有些不足了。
亨利 "金童" 杠杆式步枪

messages.msgid: A modern .22 LR lever-action rifle, the Henry Golden Boy features an 20" octagonal barrel with 16 rounds of ammo in its tube magazine, which is loaded from the front of the rifle.  It fairly resembles the original Henry Model 1860 with its brass colored receiver, though with wooden furniture at the front, and without a doubt using modern manufacturing.
translations: 亨利 "金童" 是一把现代化 .22 LR 杠杆式步枪，拥有20英寸八边形枪管和16发载弹的前装式管状弹仓。其使用的黄铜色机匣与亨利 M1860 步枪非常相似，但在枪身前部有木制结构，以及毫无疑问地使用了现代工业进行生产。

messages.msgid: The Model 60 is a semi-automatic rifle chambered in .22 LR, and looks awfully familiar to a 10/22.  However, instead of a detachable magazine, it features a tubular magazine below the barrel.  While out of production, a large number of them have been made since the 60s, making it a very commonplace rifle.
translations: 马林 Model 60 是一款 .22 LR 半自动步枪，造型与鲁格 10/22 步枪异常地相似，不过并未采用可拆卸弹匣供弹，而是在枪管下方装有一个管状弹仓。虽然已经停产，但由于60年代的大量生产，使其在如今也十分常见。

messages.msgid: A revolver chambered in .22 LR, with 10 shots and a 6 inch barrel.
translations: 一把 .22 LR 口径的左轮手枪，拥有6英寸枪管，可装填10发子弹。

messages.msgid: The S&W 617 is a fine revolver, chambered in .22 LR.  However, instead of more common 6 rounds revolvers come in, this revolver has a 10 round capacity cylinder.  While still a revolver, and to boot a revolver in .22 LR, 10 is still bigger than 6.
translations: S&W 617 左轮手枪是一把精制的 .22 LR 左轮手枪。与左轮常见的六发弹巢不同，这款左轮的弹巢有十发容量。虽然仍是 .22 LR 口径的左轮，但十发终究比六发来得实在。

messages.msgid: A small handgun with a short barrel.  Feeds from 10 round magazines.
translations: 一把短枪管的小手枪，使用10发弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: A very popular handgun, the SR22 is a more conventional pistol than Ruger's other famous .22 LR handguns, the Ruger Standards.  While .22 LR is still capable of killing, the very short barrel brings that into question.
translations: 作为一把较为普及的 .22 LR 手枪，SR22 手枪相较鲁格公司其他知名枪型的射击更加“传统”。虽然 .22 LR 弹仍具杀伤力，但过短的枪管不禁让人对此产生存疑。

messages.msgid: A Glock chambered in .22LR.  While effective against paper targets and rodents, it will struggle against the walking dead.
translations: 一款发射.22LR口径的格洛克手枪。打打纸靶子和老鼠还行，但拿来打丧尸就有点吃力了。

messages.msgid: Resembling a military rifle, this firearm is made from polymer.  Despite its looks, it only shoots .22 LR in a semi-automatic fashion.
translations: 这把步枪由聚合物制成，外观酷似军用步枪。尽管有此般外观，它仅能以半自动方式发射 .22 LR 弹。

messages.msgid: A .22 LR version of the M&P-15, this rifle resembles an AR-15 in form and function, but does not have the ability for compatible uppers or lowers.
translations: 一把 .22 LR 口径版本的 M&P-15，在外形和结构上与 AR-15 相似，但其上下机匣并不与 AR-15 的上下机匣相兼容。

messages.msgid: This ubiquitous rifle is the forefather of the M16 rifle series.  It is lightweight and accurate, but will malfunction if not properly maintained.  This one is a semi-automatic civilian version.
translations: 普及度极高的步枪，是 M16 步枪系列的前身。它重量轻且精准，但如果不常维护会经常发生故障。这一把是半自动民用版。

messages.msgid: The common AR-15 platform, with its stock removed and buffer tube covered by a thick, padded sleeve that allows the user to brace it like a rifle.  AR pistols lack stocks, or have arm braces due to restrictions on short barreled rifles, and so without a stock, they're legally classified as a pistol.
translations: 使用常见的 AR-15 平台，但移除了枪托，并在缓冲管上包裹了厚实的带衬垫护套，让使用者仍可以像步枪一样进行抵肩射击。由于短管步枪有着更严苛的法律限制，AR 手枪通常会移除枪托，或使用臂箍枪托，使其法律上被归类为无法抵肩射击的手枪。

messages.msgid: Designed to replace the M4 Carbine, the M27 assault rifle features most of the former's strengths, while being considerably more durable.  It is chambered in 5.56x45mm and accepts STANAG magazines.
translations: M27 突击步枪旨在取代 M4 卡宾枪，并在保留后者大部分优点的同时，提升了武器耐用性。这把枪的口径为 5.56x45mm，可使用 STANAG 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: Designed to replace the M4A1, the Heckler and Koch 416A5 features most of the former's strengths, while being considerably more durable.
translations: H&K公司出品的 416A5 步枪旨在取代 M4 卡宾枪，并在保留后者大部分优点的同时，提升了武器耐用性。

messages.msgid: A H&K416 carbine outfitted with a heavier barrel to enable higher amounts of suppressive fire while retaining a good degree of mobility.
translations: 一把配备了更重枪管的 H&K416 卡宾枪，在提供更强大的压制火力的同时仍能维持较好的机动性。

messages.msgid: The M38 Designated Marksman Rifle is an M27 IAR, itself derived from a H&K416, selected for accuracy, and outfitted with a variable power scope and a QDSS suppressor.
translations: M38 精确射手步枪基于由 H&K416 衍生而来的 M27 IAR 步枪，经过专门的精度调校，并配备了可变功率瞄准镜和 QDSS 消音器。

messages.msgid: A highly accurate and modular assault rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  The 'L' in its name stands for light, as it uses the lightweight .223 round.
translations: 一把专门为美军特种作战部队设计的高精度模块化突击步枪。名字中的L代表轻型(Light)，代表其使用的子弹是轻便的 .223 口径。
民用 FN SCAR-L 步枪

messages.msgid: A highly accurate and modular rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command, in semi-auto only to be sold on the civilian market.
translations: 一把专门为美军特种作战部队设计的高精度模块化突击步枪。为在民用市场售卖，这把枪只有半自动射击模式。

messages.msgid: The SCAR 16S is the civilian-legal version of the SCAR-L rifle.  It is still very expensive, not like that matters now anymore.
translations: SCAR 16S 是 SCAR-L 步枪的合法民用版本。虽然价格依旧昂贵，但在这末世里钱早就没意义了。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic clone of an older German assault rifle.  Due to importation bans, it is semi-auto and can only feed from 10 round magazines.
translations: 一把老式德国突击步枪的半自动仿制品，由于进口禁令，只能使用半自动射击和使用10发弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: The SL8 is an importation-legal gun similar to the German G36, made to be semi-auto only, and to only feed from 10 round single stack magazines.  It also features a distinctive thumbhole stock, a polymer handguard, and a top rail for mounting optics.
translations: SL8 是一把造型与德国 G36 步枪相似的进口合规步枪，仅可使用半自动射击模式，且只能装载 10 发单排弹匣。SL8 还配备了标志性的拇指孔枪托、聚合物护木，和可安装瞄准镜的顶部导轨。

messages.msgid: The M249 is a mountable machine gun used by the US military and SWAT teams.  Quite inaccurate and difficult to control, the M249 is designed to fire many rounds very quickly.
translations: M249 机枪是一款广泛应用于美军及特警部队的轻机枪。由于设计目的是快速倾泻大量弹药，因此 M249 的射击精度和操控性并不优秀。

messages.msgid: This is a semi-automatic civilian variant of the M249 machine gun, manufactured for sport shooting and collectors market.  Notably, it retains the ability to be belt fed, an uncommon feature in civilian firearms.
translations: 一把 M249 机枪的半自动民用版本，专供于竞技射击和收藏领域。值得注意的是，该枪保留了用弹链供弹的功能，其在民用枪械中较为少见。

messages.msgid: A popular carbine, long used by the US military.  Though accurate, small, and lightweight, it is infamous for its unreliability when not properly maintained.  It is chambered in 5.56x45mm and accepts STANAG magazines.
translations: 较为流行的卡宾枪，长期服役于美军。虽然精度高、体积小、重量轻，但是可靠性之差臭名昭著，特别是在缺乏正经维护时。这把枪的口径为 5.56x45mm，可使用 STANAG 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: A popular carbine, long used by the US military.  Though accurate, small, and lightweight, it is infamous for its unreliability when not properly maintained.
translations: 较为流行的卡宾枪，长期服役于美军。虽然精度高、体积小、重量轻，但是可靠性之差臭名昭著，特别是在缺乏正经维护时。

messages.msgid: This is a shorter M4 carbine with a 10.3 inch barrel, intended for confined spaces and close quarters battle situations.
translations: 一把使用较短的10.3英寸枪管的 M4 卡宾枪，适用于密闭空间和室内近战环境。

messages.msgid: The M16 is a common assault rifle descended from the AR-15, used by militaries across the world for over 50 years.  It fires in three round bursts, ensuring the rifle is more accurate, but at the cost of being slower than other assault rifles.  It is chambered in 5.56x45mm rounds, and accepts STANAG magazines.
translations: M16 步枪是一把基于 AR-15 步枪的通用突击步枪，在过去的50多年被世界各国军队使用。使用三连发射击模式，提升了步枪的射击精确，但代价是整体射速慢于其他突击步枪。这把枪的口径为 5.56x45mm，可使用 STANAG 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: The M16 is a very common assault rifle descended from the AR-15, used by militaries across the world for over 50 years.  It is a gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle known for its accuracy and controllable recoil.
translations: M16 步枪是一把基于 AR-15 步枪的通用突击步枪，在过去的50多年被世界各国军队使用。该步枪采用气动滚转式枪栓，以其高命中率和易于掌控的后坐力而出名。

messages.msgid: The M16 is a very common assault rifle descended from the AR-15, used by militaries across the world for over 50 years.  Unlike its more common brother, the M16 burst rifle, this one has full-auto capabilities.  It is chambered in 5.56x45mm and accepts STANAG magazines.
translations: M16 步枪是一把基于 AR-15 步枪的通用突击步枪，在过去的50多年被世界各国军队使用。相较其短连发兄弟款，这一把具有全自动射击模式。这把枪的口径为 5.56x45mm，可使用 STANAG 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: The M16 is a very common assault rifle descended from the AR-15, used by militaries across the world for over 50 years.  It is a gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle known for its accuracy and controllable recoil.  This one is a relatively rare M16A3, with full auto capability.
translations: M16 步枪是一把基于 AR-15 步枪的通用突击步枪，在过去的50多年被世界各国军队使用。该步枪采用气动滚转式枪栓，以其高命中率和易于掌控的后坐力而出名。这一把是比较少见的 M16A3，具有全自动射击模式。

messages.msgid: A small, lightweight semi-auto carbine designed for civilian and police use.  Its superb accuracy and low recoil makes it more suitable than full-auto rifles for some situations.
translations: 这是款供民用和警用的小体积的轻型半自动步枪，以其卓越的命中率和低后坐力闻名，主要部件采用高抗拉强度合金钢制成，大大减小了武器质量，快速射击时武器易于控制，在某些场合甚至比全自动步更具杀伤力。

messages.msgid: A civilian variant of an automatic Swiss rifle for military service.  Accepts STANAG magazines.
translations: 一把瑞士军用制式步枪的民用版本，能够兼容 STANAG 标准弹匣。
西格 SG556 突击步枪

messages.msgid: The SG 556 is a civilian model of the Swiss SIG SG 550 series, manufactured in New Hampshire.  It lacks any automatic fire capability and has a 16 inch barrel, but still retains a folding stock, with the feature of feeding from STANAG magazines instead of the SG 550 series magazines.
translations: SG556 是瑞士西格 SG550 系列步枪的民用版本，生产于美国新罕布什尔州。缺少了原版枪械的全自动射击功能，使用16英寸枪管，但保留了可折叠枪托。此外它使用 STANAG 弹匣供弹，而非 SG550 系列原配的弹匣。

messages.msgid: An assault rifle chambered in 5.56x45mm and accepting AUG magazines
translations: 一把 5.56x45mm 口径的突击步枪，使用 AUG 弹匣。

messages.msgid: The Steyr AUG is an Austrian assault rifle that uses a bullpup design.  It is used in the armed forces and police forces of many nations, and enjoys low recoil and high accuracy.
translations: 斯泰尔 AUG 步枪是一把来自奥地利的无托结构步枪，兼顾低后坐和高精度，曾被多个国家用于军队及警察武装。
扎斯塔瓦 ZPAP AK式步枪

messages.msgid: A civilian AK pattern rifle, chambered in 5.56x45 NATO.
translations: 一把民用AK型步枪，使用 5.56x45 NATO 弹。

messages.msgid: A Serbian-made AK pattern rifle made by Zastava in 5.56x45mm NATO.  To avoid import restrictions, Zastava USA has added a number of American-made parts.
translations: 一把由扎斯塔瓦公司于塞尔维亚生产的AK造型步枪，使用 5.56x45mm NATO 弹。为了规避进口限制，扎斯塔瓦美国特地使用了一些美国本地制造的零件。
沙漠科技 无托卡宾枪

messages.msgid: Produced by the Desert Tech gun company, this is a highly modular, semi-automatic rifle of remarkably modest dimensions.  The weapon is notable for the simplicity of converting it to fire a wide number of different cartridges, with retool kits for .223 Remington, .308 Winchester, and .300 AAC Blackout being available.
translations: 由沙漠科技公司生产。作为一把高度模块化的半自动步枪，它的尺寸意外地令人可以接受。该枪的特色是可轻易改装多种枪械口径——分别拥有对应的 .223 雷明顿弹、.308 温彻斯特弹，和 .300 BLK 弹改装套件。
沙漠科技 MDRX 卡宾枪

messages.msgid: Bringing a compact, highly modular, and soft-recoiling weapon system to the table, the Desert Tech Micro Dynamic Rifle Extreme (MDRX) is a gas-operated bullpup carbine originally unveiled in 2014, with this updated model of the weapon having been released in 2019.  One of the rifle's most notable features is the utter simplicity of swapping the carbine's chambering, with an easy change of the barrel, bolt, and a handful of other components being all the steps required to chamber the MDRX for either .223 Remington, .308 Winchester, or .300 AAC Blackout.
translations: 沙漠科技微动力步枪(MDRX)是一把气动式无托步枪，于2014年问世，而这把则是在2019年发布的升级版本。该枪以紧凑、高度模块化、低后坐力的特点进入人们的视野，其最明显的特征是极易改变枪械口径，只需更换枪管、枪栓等组件，就能将 MDRX 改为使用 .223 雷明顿弹、.308 温彻斯特弹，或 .300 BLK 弹。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic clone of the Czech Republic's standard infantry carbine, sold for civilian sport shooting and recreational use, this modular rifle makes use of the standard magazines of the AR-15 platform and a 5.56x45mm cartridge.
translations: 一把捷克共和国生产的制式步兵卡宾枪的半自动仿制品，专供于民用竞技和休闲射击领域。这把模块化步枪使用 AR-15 平台的标准弹匣，5.56x45mm 口径弹药。

messages.msgid: Hailing from the Czech Republic, this modular carbine supplanted the older CZ 805 rifle within Czech military use, improving upon the former's features and bringing fully ambidextrous controls, a streamlined design, and an easily adjustable gas system to the table.  Chambered for the 5.56x45mm NATO cartridge, this particular weapon possesses a 16.5-inch barrel and is a civilian MS, 'modular semi-automatic,' model.  Incorporating a number of US-made parts, the weapon features a removable muzzle break rather than the flash hider that comes standard with military rifles.
translations: 生产于捷克共和国，这把模块化卡宾枪替换了原先捷克军队使用的 CZ 805 步枪，并在前者的基础上增加了左右手持枪以及流线型设计，还加装了易于调整的导气系统。这一把枪为民用MS（Modular Semi-automatic，即“模块化半自动”）型号，拥有16.5英寸枪管，发射 5.56×45mm NATO 弹。因为使用了一系列美产部件，这把枪装载了可拆卸消音器，而不是本国制式步枪上的消焰器。

messages.msgid: Compact, svelte, and lightweight, this Leen bolt-action rifle packs the same features of larger sporting weapons into a backpack-sized package.  Possessing an adjustable buttstock, a detachable magazine-based system, and a quick-swap barrel that can be exchanged to accommodate the firing of .223 Remington or 7.62x39mm Soviet ammunition, the weapon is a commendable backpacker or prepper rifle.
translations: 紧凑、修长且轻便的李恩式栓动步枪，将大号竞技步枪拥有的功能集成进了可以塞进背包的小体积之中。包含可调的枪托、可拆卸弹匣系统，以及可在 .223 雷明顿弹和俄制 7.62×39mm 弹之间切换的快拆枪管，乃极佳的户外或生存用步枪。

messages.msgid: A handy bolt-action offering from CZ, the 600 Trail is a box magazine-fed ranch rifle that utilizes an aluminum chassis to keep its overall heft to a minimum.  Possessing an extendable buttstock, extensive modularity, and a quick-swap barrel assembly switchable to accommodate the firing of either .223 or 7.62x39mm ammunition, the rifle was intended for use by backpackers, trail hikers, and preppers.
translations: 600 Trail 是捷克CZ公司生产的一把弹匣供弹的栓动式牧场步枪，通过使用铝制枪身尽可能减轻其整体重量。该枪包含可调的枪托、可拓展的模块化系统，以及可在 .223 雷明顿弹和俄制 7.62×39mm 弹之间切换的快拆枪管，乃极佳的户外（不论是徒步还是越野携行）或生存用步枪。

messages.msgid: This is a semi-automatic bullpup rifle with a lightened body due to the use of polymers and aluminum, using standard magazines of the AR-15 platform and a 5.56x45mm cartridge.
translations: 一把半自动无托步枪，由于枪身使用聚合物和铝材质，整体十分轻便。使用 AR-15 平台的标准弹匣，5.56×45mm 口径弹药。

messages.msgid: This is a semi-automatic bullpup rifle with a lightened body due to the use of polymers and aluminum, using standard magazines from the AR-15 platform and the 5.56 NATO cartridge.  The name stands for rifle, downward-ejection, bullpup, and its design was intended to incorporate some technical solutions, such as downward case ejection and convenience for left-handers, to solve some problems with bullpup guns.  However, the good idea's execution is not as perfect as the manufacturer (and user) would like.  No good idea from Kel-Tec is immune to Kel-Tec manufacturing issues, sadly.
translations: 一把半自动无托步枪，由于枪身使用聚合物和铝材质，整体十分轻便。使用 AR-15 平台的标准弹匣，5.56×45mm 口径弹药。其名字的三个字母分别代表：步枪(Rifle)、下方抛壳(Downward-ejection)、无托结构(Bullpup)，旨在为部分枪械使用情况提供技术上的解决方式——下方抛壳便于左手持枪使用，同时还解决了一些由无托结构导致的问题。尽管设计很美好，但实际造出来的东西符不符合制造厂商（及用户）的意想就是另一回事了——属于“Kel-Tec的好想法被Kel-Tec生产水平拖后腿”的典型例子。
IWI "塔沃尔" X95 突击步枪

messages.msgid: The Tavor is an Israeli series of bullpup rifles designed and produced by Israel Weapon Industries.  This is the Tavor X95, a civilian-legal rifle lacking any full-auto capability, and sporting a 16.5" barrel.  Chambered in 5.56/.223, this rifle feeds from STANAG magazines.
translations: "塔沃尔"是以色列武器工业(IWI)公司设计和生产的系列无托步枪。这一把是 "塔沃尔" X95，一把缺少全自动功能的民用合法步枪，配备16.5英寸枪管。该步枪的口径为 5.56/.223，通过 STANAG 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: A lightweight AR-15 platform rifle, capable of feeding standard AR magazines.  Unlike the military versions, it has no threaded barrel or collapsing stock.
translations: 轻量化的 AR-15 平台步枪，兼容标准规格的 AR 弹匣。不同于军用版本，它没有螺纹枪管和折叠式枪托。

messages.msgid: S&Ws version of the AR-15, the M&P-15 is a very common rifle.  Despite being very similar to an AR-15 in both form and function, the receivers and uppers are incompatible.
translations: 作为S&W公司自家版本的 AR-15，M&P-15 步枪的普及度极高。尽管在造型和结构上与 AR-15 极为相似，但其上下机匣组件均不相互兼容。

messages.msgid: Featuring a handsome set of wooden furnishings, a classic design, and a no nonsense .270 caliber chambering, this is a powerful hunting rifle.  With a tried and proven pedigree dating back over 60 years, millions of such rugged arms have been made, exported, and used throughout the United States and the world at large.  Where hunting is concerned, this is a highly capable and well proven weapon in all respects.  Fortunate, given that your prey in these dark days may turn out to be a little bit more feisty than typical White-Tailed deer, moose, and black bears.
translations: 经典设计、木制结构、务实的 .270 口径，造就了这把强大的狩猎步枪。经历了60多年考验的坚固耐用，被数以百万计地制造、出口，并在整个美国和世界范围内使用。至少就打猎而言，这把枪在各个细节都做到了符合甚至超过应有表现——这也让获得这把步枪成为一件幸事，现如今黑暗当前，你要面对敌人的会比白尾鹿、驼鹿和黑熊这些常见猎物更加好斗。
雷明顿 700 步枪（.270 温彻斯特弹）

messages.msgid: A classic bolt-action rifle chambered for .270 Winchester, very popular among hunters.  This is a CDL SF model with a forged, fluted, 416 stainless steel barrel threaded into the receiver and a recessed bolt face.  It has checkered walnut furniture and a recoil pad to reduce perceived recoil.
translations: 一把经典的栓动步枪，使用.270温彻斯特弹，在猎人中十分流行。这把CDL SF 型号属于经典奢华版，线膛枪管使用 416 不锈钢锻造，枪管-枪机连续膛线，以及嵌入式枪栓。它的核桃木枪托上装饰着格子图案，还有一个用于减少后坐力的托垫。

messages.msgid: A bolt-action, box-magazine-fed sniper rifle chambered in the powerful .300 Winchester Magnum round.  The M2010 had completely replaced the M24 rifle series by 2017.
translations: 一把使用弹匣供弹的栓动狙击步枪，发射威力强大的 .300 温彻斯特马格南弹。M2010 狙击步枪作为换代枪型，在2017年完全取代了 M24 系列狙击步枪。
韦瑟比 Mark V 步枪

messages.msgid: The Weatherby Mark V is one of the world's finest bolt-action rifles.  Designed in 1955 by Roy Weatherby and Fred Jennie, it has a strong action designed to safely fire high-pressure cartridges.  These rifles were presented to celebrities as part of a marketing campaign.
translations: 韦瑟比 Mark V 步枪是世界上最好的旋转拴动式步枪之一。于1955年由罗伊·韦瑟比和佛莱德·珍妮两人共同设计，这把枪牢靠的机械设计使其可以安全地发射高压弹药。现如今，这把步枪已经成为枪械市场流通的常客。
温彻斯特 M70 步枪

messages.msgid: The Winchester Model 70 is a bolt-action sporting rifle.  It has an iconic place in American sporting culture and has been held in high regard by shooters since it was introduced in 1936.
translations: 温彻斯特 M70 步枪是一把栓动式竞技步枪，自其1936年问世以来，逐渐在美国竞技射击文化中占据标志性的地位，广受射手们的喜爱。

messages.msgid: Originally introduced to the Ruger gun corporation's family of high-end marksman rifles in 2015, the Ruger Precision Rifle is a modern and highly modular long-range bolt-action weapon.  By incorporating a unique in-line recoil path that manages recoil from the rear of the receiver to the buttstock, as opposed to traditional bedding, the rifle offers maximal accuracy potential, while the arm's additional bells and whistles, an incorporated marksman's trigger, muzzle brake, and this particular rifle's powerhouse chambering of .300 Win Mag, help to make the most from any long-range engagement.
translations: 最初于2015年作为鲁格枪族的高端射手步枪问世，鲁格精密步枪是一把现代化、高度模块化的长距离栓动式步枪。与传统枪械不同，该枪独特的直线后坐技术将后坐力从枪机后部转移到枪托上，优化了其潜在精度，此外枪械自带的射手级扳机、制退器、以及专属于该枪的 .300 口径枪膛，使其性能处于长距离步枪的顶尖水平。

messages.msgid: A highly accurate lever-action hunting rifle chambered for the powerful .30-06 round.  Notable for using a detachable magazine instead of a traditional tube.
translations: 高精度的杠杆式狩猎步枪，使用威力强大的 .30-06 弹。因其使用可拆卸的弹匣而不是传统的管式弹仓而闻名。

messages.msgid: The Browning BLR is notable for being a lever-action rifle, chambered in calibers with spitzer bullets.  This is unusual for lever-actions, as a spitzer bullet risks setting off other cartridges in a typical tube magazine.  The BLR gets around this issue by utilizing box magazines instead, making it quite unique among other lever-action rifles.  This one is chambered for 30-06.
translations: 勃朗宁 BLR 是一款著名的杠杆式步枪，采用在杠杆式步枪中并不常见的尖头弹——由于杠杆式步枪通常使用管式弹仓，使用尖头弹容易引爆弹仓内的其他子弹。勃朗宁 BLR 通过使用盒式弹匣，不光解决了前述的问题，还让其在一众杠杆式步枪中显得独树一帜。这把枪发射 30-06 口径弹药。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic .30-06 battle rifle, developed to replace the M1903 Springfield.  It didn't completely supplant the older bolt-action until after World War II.
translations: 一把 .30-06 口径半自动战斗步枪，本意为取代 M1903 春田步枪而设计生产，但直到二战打完，它都未能完全将后者取代。

messages.msgid: The M1 Garand is a widely celebrated battle rifle, being one of the most mass-produced battle rifles in the world.  It saw widespread use in the US military, being used extensively in WW2 and the Korean War.  While its military use has dwindled down, being out of US service for more than 50 years, some of its mechanical influence still remains through rifles such as AKs or M14s.  It still sees widespread use in civilian spaces as an accurate competition or hunting rifle.
translations: M1 加兰德是一款广受赞誉的战斗步枪，同时也是世界上产量最高的战斗步枪之一，曾在二战和朝鲜战争中大规模列装于美国军队。虽然如今其军事列装已经减少——在美国军队中已经退役了超50年，但其部分机械设计仍然存在于 AK 和 M14 等步枪之中。而在民用领域，M1 加兰德仍在竞技射击及狩猎领域被广泛使用。

messages.msgid: A powerful military rifle chambered in .30-06, developed to replace the US Army's older Krag rifle.  It served as the main American rifle in World War I, was used alongside the M1 Garand in World War II, and was used as a sniper rifle as late as the Vietnam War.
translations: 一把威力强大的 .30-06 口径军用步枪，本意为取代当时服役于美军的克拉格-约根森步枪而设计生产。该枪自第一次世界大战时便作为美军的主要制式装备步枪，在第二次世界大战时同本来要取代它的 M1 加兰德步枪平起平坐，在越南战争中则作为狙击步枪使用到最后撤装。

messages.msgid: A powerful military rifle originally chambered in .30-03 Springfield, developed to replace the US Army's older Krag rifle.  It was quickly rechambered into the .30-06 caliber with its spitzer bullet.  While an American rifle produced and developed around WW1, manufacturing couldn't keep up with demand, and saw service alongside the M1917 Enfield, a British rifle rechambered for the American 30-06.  It saw service as a sniper rifle up to the Vietnam War, but nowadays is mainly used by civilians, either as hunting rifles or in collections.
translations: 一把威力强大的军用步枪，本意为取代当时服役于美军的克拉格-约根森步枪而设计生产。最初设计使用 .30-03 春田弹，但随后迅速改为使用 .30-06 被甲空尖弹。虽然诞生并产出于第一次世界大战，但受限于当时的产能，该枪与 M1917 恩菲尔德步枪——使用美制 .30-06 弹的英制步枪——一同被投入使用。该枪一直服役至越南战争，作为狙击步枪使用，而在民用市场，该枪仍在狩猎和收藏领域流通。

messages.msgid: This heavy rifle was designed near the end of World War I, and provided fire support for the US Army from World War II all the way to the Vietnam War.  Too much firepower to serve as a battle rifle, but not enough to be an ideal light machine gun, it still found a niche on the battlefield.
translations: 这把重型步枪诞生于一战末期，并作为火力支援武器，在美军服役参与了二战和越战。该枪的火力作为战斗步枪使用威力过剩，作为轻机枪使用又威力不足，但它最终仍在战场上找到了自己的独特定位。

messages.msgid: Designed near the end of World War I, the BAR provided fire support for the US Army from World War II all the way to the Vietnam War.  Originally developed to fill a now outdated role as an "automatic rifle", it was pushed into service for use as a light machine gun.  Despite being heavy and cumbersome, without filling its designed role, it saw service for over 50 years.  While newer models have a slow and fast fully automatic setting, this one is an older one, with just semi and full auto.
translations: 勃朗宁 BAR 诞生于一战末期，并在美军服役参与了二战和越战。最初基于“自动步枪”——一个已在现代作战中过时的定位——而设计，并作为轻机枪服役。虽然和“自动步枪”（定位上）与轻机器（重量上）都不沾边，但它仍服役了超过50年。新一些的型号有额外的快慢两档全自动射击模式，但这把老型号只有半自动和全自动两种模式。

messages.msgid: A very popular and durable hunting or sniping rifle.  Popular among SWAT and US Marine snipers.  Highly damaging, but perhaps not as accurate as the competing Browning BLR.
translations: 一把非常普及的打猎/狙击两用步枪，深受SWAT特警队和美国海军陆战队狙击手青睐。高杀伤力，但相较勃朗宁 BLR 步枪，在精准度上欠了一些。

messages.msgid: This is a popular and sturdy long-range rifle that has been in production by the Ruger gun company for several decades.  Using a bolt-action feed system, the rifle features a four round capacity of .30-06 cartridges and has the capability to dispatch said rounds with a level of accuracy that would make comparable hunting rifles blush.
translations: 由鲁格枪械公司于数十年前推出，畅销且耐用的长距离步枪。该枪使用栓动式供弹系统，可以容纳四发 .30-06 口径子弹，同时其精度甚至能比过同档次的狩猎步枪。
鲁格 M77 "鹰眼" 步枪

messages.msgid: A popular bolt-action hunting rifle first introduced in 2006, the Ruger M77 was originally intended to be a modernized Mauser 98-style long gun.  To this end, the weapon features a Mauser-type fixed blade extractor and an angled large screw that tightly beds the action into the stock.  This particular rifle is a variant with additional features, a smoother trigger, and a recontoured buttstock.
translations: 作为于2006年问世的狩猎用栓动式步枪，鲁格 M77 最初是作为毛瑟98式步枪的现代化版本而设计。因此它保留了毛瑟的刀片式抛壳装置，以及使用带有倾角的螺栓连接枪膛与枪托。手上的这一款式与原版相比多了一些额外改装，更流畅的扳机组，以及重塑造型的枪托。
西格 MCX "响尾蛇" 短管步枪

messages.msgid: A gas-operated rifle, with a short 5.5 inch barrel, built-in thin folding stock, and full rail mount on the upper receiver.  This particular one is a select-fire military version.
translations: 一把使用5.5英寸短枪管的气动式步枪，包含集成式折叠枪托，以及上机匣之上，全长度的导轨。手上的这一把是可选择射击模式的军用版本。

messages.msgid: An iconic weapon of both the First and Second World Wars, this bolt-action rifle has seen deployment in the hands of Commonwealth troops across Europe and beyond.  Firing the .303-caliber cartridge and making use of 10-round Enfield magazines, the firearm's reputation precedes it.
translations: 作为现身于两次世界大战的标志性武器，这把栓动式步枪被列装于欧洲及周边地区的英联邦军队。发射 .303 弹药，使用李-恩菲尔德10发弹匣供弹，这把枪的名气大过了枪支本身。
李-恩菲尔德 No. 1 Mk III 步枪

messages.msgid: An English darling and icon of the First World War, the Short Magazine Lee-Enfield Mk III was the standard issue battle rifle of the British commonwealth from 1907.  Chambered for .303 ammunition, the rifle makes use of ten-round detachable magazines.  With its full-length wooden handguard, brass buttplate, and smooth action, the Lee-Enfield cuts a recognizable profile in either the trenches of the Great War or the zombie-strewn wastelands.
translations: 是英国的国宝级武器，也是第一次世界大战的标志性武器，李-恩菲尔德弹匣短步枪（SMLE）Mk III 自1907年起便作为英联邦的制式战斗步枪服役。该步枪使用 .303 弹药，具有十发可拆卸弹夹。凭借其全长的木质护手、黄铜枪托板，和丝滑的操作手感，李-恩菲尔德步枪定可在一战的战壕或丧尸横行的荒野中留下深刻的印象。
改进型李-恩菲尔德步枪

messages.msgid: An evolution of Britain's First World War battle rifle, this bolt-action firearm uses the same .303-caliber cartridge as its forerunner.  Much beloved across the globe by collectors, rifles like this served as England's infantry rifle well into the 1950s, with a specialized sniper variant remaining in service until the early nineties.
translations: 作为英国一战时所使用的战斗步枪的改进型，这把栓动式步枪使用与其前身相同的 .303 弹药。这款步枪深受全球收藏家的喜爱，同时作为英国的步兵制式步枪，其一直被使用到20世纪50年代，而专门的狙击型一直服役到90年代初。
李-恩菲尔德 No. 4 Mk I 步枪

messages.msgid: A Second World War progression of the British Commonwealth's Lee-Enfield battle rifle, the No. 4 began its decades-long service life in 1939.  Externally similar to its forefather, the rifle possesses a reinforced receiver, an adjusted nose cap, and a heavier barrel.  Still chambered for the same .303-caliber cartridge, the No. 4 represents one of the most populous firearm imports in U.S. history.
translations: 作为英联邦的李-恩菲尔德战斗步枪的第二次世界大战升级版，No. 4 步枪于1939年开始了其长达几十年的服役生涯。在外观上与其前身相似，该步枪采用了加强型机匣、经过调整的枪托盖，和更重的枪管。No. 4 步枪成为了美国历史上进口数量最多的枪支之一，且仍使用相同的 .303 口径弹药。

messages.msgid: Originally designed during the Cold War, this gun is probably the most successful battle rifle ever designed.  Despite being labeled as obsolete, its tunable gas system ensures both reliability and low recoil, allowing the FAL to keep up even among modern competitors.  This is a semi-automatic clone built by a domestic manufacturer.
translations: 这把枪最初设计于冷战时期，可能是有史以来最成功的战斗步枪。尽管被贴上了过时的标签，但其可调气体系统确保了可靠性和低后坐力，使FAL在现代竞争对手中保持领先。这是由国内制造商制造的半自动复制品。

messages.msgid: Originally designed during the Cold War, the FAL is probably the most successful battle rifle ever designed.  Despite being labeled as obsolete, its tunable gas system ensures both reliability and low recoil, allowing the FAL to keep up even among modern competitors.  This is a semi-automatic clone of the SA-58 pattern built by DSA.
translations: 设计于冷战时期，FAL 步枪可能是有史以来最成功的战斗步枪。尽管被贴上了过时的标签，但 FAL 步枪所使用的可调式气体调节器使该枪兼顾可靠性和低后坐力，使该枪仍能与如今的现代竞品扳一扳手腕。手上这一把是由DSA公司生产的，名为 SA-58 的半自动仿制品。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic, domestically produced clone of an early battle rifle developed after the end of WWII.  Known as the PTR 91, it is a fantastically reliable, cheap to produce rifle that continues to serve in conflict regions.  Though the action is legendary, its handling characteristics and harsher recoil leave something to be desired.
translations: 一把于二战结束后研发的早期战斗步枪的美国制半自动仿制品，名为 PTR 91 步枪。由于可靠且生产成本低廉，该枪得以持续在冲突地区服役。尽管此枪机械结构堪称传奇，但其不易操控和巨大的后坐力仍需改进。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic, domestically produced clone of an early battle rifle developed after the end of WWII.  The PTR 91 is a fantastically reliable, cheap to produce rifle that continues to serve in conflict regions.  Though the action is legendary, its handling characteristics and harsher recoil leave something to be desired.
translations: 一把于二战结束后研发的早期战斗步枪的美国制半自动仿制品。由于可靠且生产成本低廉，PTR 91 步枪得以持续在冲突地区服役。尽管此枪机械结构堪称传奇，但其不易操控和巨大的后坐力仍需改进。
世纪武器 C308 步枪

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic, domestically produced clone of the CETME Model C, the progenitor of the famous H&K G3 battle rifle.  The CETME is a fantastically reliable, cheap to produce rifle that continues to serve in conflict regions.  Though the action is legendary, its handling characteristics and harsher recoil leave something to be desired.
translations: 一把赛特迈C型步枪——著名的 H&K G3 战斗步枪的前身——的美国制半自动仿制品。由于可靠且生产成本低廉，C型步枪得以持续在冲突地区服役。尽管此枪机械结构堪称传奇，但其不易操控和巨大的后坐力仍需改进。

messages.msgid: The M134D-H Minigun is a (relatively) lightweight heavy rotary machine gun.  Its six barrels are rotated by an electric motor, powered by UPS or vehicle.  If you could find enough ammo for it, it would become a devastating weapon.  It must be mounted on a vehicle before use.
translations: M134D-H 速射机枪是一把（相对）轻型的转管式机枪。它由UPS或车辆为其电动马达供电，驱动六只枪管旋转射击。只要你拥有充足的弹药，那它就是一把毁灭性的武器。它需要安装在载具上使用。
M14 EBR-RI 增强型战斗步枪

messages.msgid: A highly modified version of the M14 rifle designed to cover both CQB and designated marksman roles.  A very powerful and versatile rifle, if somewhat heavy.
translations: 一把高度定制的 M14 步枪，以同时兼顾CQB作战以及精确射手职责。威力强大且用途多样，就是重了一些。

messages.msgid: This civilian variant of an American battle rifle is essentially a rifle from World War 2 with a detachable magazine stuck in it that was sold to the military as a cheap, do-all rifle that could replace many other weapon systems.  While it delivered none of those things, it was an acceptable rifle, if marginally inferior to its contemporaries.
translations: 美军战斗步枪的民用版本，本质上是给一把二战时期的老步枪上了个可拆卸弹匣，然后以“能取代其他武器平台的廉价多用途步枪”的唬烂名义卖给了军方。虽然与其宣称的要点一点不沾，但整体来说其实是一把可以接受的步枪，性能上仅是略逊于同时期的步枪一点。

messages.msgid: This civilian variant of the M14 is essentially the M1 Garand from World War 2 with a detachable magazine stuck in it that was sold to the military as a cheap, do-all rifle that could replace many other weapon systems.  While it delivered none of those things, it was an acceptable rifle, if marginally inferior to its contemporaries.
translations: M14 步枪的民用版本，本质上是给二战时期的 M1 加兰德上了个可拆卸弹匣，然后以“能取代其他武器平台的廉价多用途步枪”的唬烂名义卖给了军方。虽然与其宣称的要点一点不沾，但整体来说其实是一把可以接受的步枪，性能上仅是略逊于同时期的步枪一点。

messages.msgid: The M240 is a medium machine gun used by the US military, replacing the older M60.  Quite inaccurate and difficult to control, the M240 is designed to fire many rounds very quickly.
translations: M240 是一款广泛用于美军的中型机枪，用以取代之前的 M60 机枪。由于设计目的是快速倾泻大量弹药，因此 M240 的射击精度和操控性并不优秀。

messages.msgid: The M60 is a general-purpose machine gun developed to replace the .30-caliber M1918 and M1919.  Heavy and difficult to handle fired from the shoulder, as most people aren't action-movie heroes.
translations: M60 是一款通用机枪，开发用以取代 .30 口径的 M1918 和 M1919 机枪。它很沉重，很难拿着它来抵肩站立射击，你如果没有《第一滴血》系列里的兰博的体格的话，还是架起两脚架趴着玩吧。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic civilian variant of the M60 machine gun, retaining the ability to be belt fed, an uncommon feature in civilian firearms.
translations: 一把 M60 机枪的半自动民用版本，保留了用弹链供弹的功能，该功能在民用枪械中较为少见。

messages.msgid: A very accurate rifle chambered for the powerful .308 round.  Its very low ammo capacity is offset by its accuracy and near-complete lack of recoil.
translations: 这是一支采用.308子弹的步枪，十分精准，后坐力很低，就是弹匣容量少了一些。

messages.msgid: A highly accurate and modular battle rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  The 'H' in its name stands for heavy, as it uses the powerful .308 round.
translations: 一把专门为美军特种作战部队设计的高精度模块化突击步枪。名字中的H代表重型(Heavy)，代表其使用的子弹是威力强劲的 .308 口径。

messages.msgid: Sniper Support Rifle, this semi-auto variant of SCAR-H is designed for a long-range precision application, to be used by dedicated marksman.  Includes extended barrel, bipod, and a few additional attachment for greater comfort of a user.
translations: SCAR-H 步枪的半自动狙击支援步枪(SSR)变体，以供精确射手进行长距离下的精确射击。配备加长枪管、两脚架及若干提升操作舒适度的附加配件。
FN SCAR-H MK 20 SSR 狙击支援步枪
民用 FN SCAR-H 步枪

messages.msgid: A highly accurate and modular battle rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  This one is a civilian model, limited to semi-auto.
translations: 一把专门为美军特种作战部队设计的高精度模块化突击步枪。此为民用版本，仅可使用半自动射击模式。

messages.msgid: The SCAR 17S is the semi-auto version of the SCAR-H rifle used in the military.  With how powerful .308 is, maybe having it in semi-auto only is a blessing.
translations: SCAR 17S 步枪是军用 SCAR-H 步枪的半自动民用版本。考虑到 .308 弹药的强大威力，只有半自动或许是件好事。

messages.msgid: The M24 Sniper is the military and police version of the Remington Model 700 rifle, M24 being the model name assigned by the United States Army after adoption as their standard sniper rifle in 1988.  The M24 is referred to as a 'weapon system' because it consists of not only a rifle, but also a detachable telescopic sight and other accessories.
translations: M24 狙击步枪是雷明顿 700 步枪的军警用版本，其型号名称于美军于1988年将其作为标准狙击步枪列装时获得。整把 M24 也被称为"武器系统"，因为其所涵盖的不仅仅是步枪本体，还有可拆卸的望远镜式瞄准镜和其他附属配件。

messages.msgid: A German battle rifle with a 13" barrel and telescopic stock.  It is a gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle with a short-stroke piston design similar to that of the G36.
translations: 一把枪管长13英寸，包含可调试枪托的德制战斗步枪。它是一把气动滚转式步枪，具有与 G36 步枪类似的短冲程活塞设计。

messages.msgid: A gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle accurate to 1.5 MOA with standard ammunition, and featuring an aluminum upper receiver for reduced weight.
translations: 一把气动滚转式步枪，在使用标准弹药射击下，精度可达到1.5角分，同时还使用铝制上机匣以减轻重量。

messages.msgid: A derivative of H&K's G28 with an aluminum upper receiver to meet US Army weight requirements.  It is a gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle accurate to 1.5 MOA with standard ammunition.
translations: H&K G28 狙击步枪的衍生版产物，配备可调节枪托及可拆卸两脚架。它是一种气动、旋转上膛的栓式步枪，使用标准弹药时可精确到 1.5 MOA。

messages.msgid: A civilian AK pattern rifle, chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO.
translations: 一把民用AK型步枪，使用 7.62x51 NATO 弹。

messages.msgid: A Serbian-made AK pattern rifle made by Zastava in 7.62x51mm NATO.  To avoid import restrictions, Zastava USA has added a number of American-made parts.
translations: 一把由扎斯塔瓦公司于塞尔维亚生产的AK造型步枪，使用 7.62x51mm  NATO 弹。为了规避进口限制，扎斯塔瓦美国特地使用了一些美国本地制造的零件。

messages.msgid: Somewhat similar to the later AR-15, the AR-10 is a gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle chambered for 7.62x51mm rounds.
translations: AR-10 步枪是一种气动滚转式步枪，与后来的 AR-15 步枪有点相似，使用 7.62x51mm 口径弹药。

messages.msgid: This is a semi-automatic bullpup rifle with a lightened body due to the use of polymers and aluminum, using standard magazines of the heavy automatic rifle and a 7.62x51mm cartridge.
translations: 这是一款小型半自动步枪，由于使用了聚合物和铝材制造，枪身较轻，使用重型自动步枪的标准弹匣和7.62x51mm口径的子弹。

messages.msgid: This is a semi-automatic bullpup rifle with a lightweight, polymer frame, using magazines from the FN FAL and the .308 Winchester cartridge.  The rifle, forward-ejection, bullpup (abbreviated as RFB) features forward case ejection, ambidextrous controls, and structural use of the barrel, uncommon in modern designs.
translations: 这是一把使用轻质聚合材料框架的半自动无托式步枪，兼容FN FAL步枪的弹匣和 .308 温切斯特子弹。这把前抛壳无托步枪（简称RFB）的特点是前抛壳、高操控性以及现代枪械设计中少见的结构化枪管。

messages.msgid: This is a versatile, all-purpose hunting rifle.  To this end, it is exceedingly lightweight, contains an inbuilt polymer bipod, and fits a spare magazine inside the stock for fast reloading.  While these features made for a hunting rifle too universal for widespread adoption, they might yet fulfill a vital scouting niche for survivors in the post-Cataclysm world.
translations: 这是一支多功能、通用的猎枪。为此，它非常轻，包含一个内置的聚合物两脚架，并在枪托内安装一个备用弹匣，以便快速重新装载。虽然这些功能使猎枪过于普遍，无法广泛采用，但它们可能会为后大灾难世界的幸存者提供重要的侦察位置。

messages.msgid: The Steyr Scout is Steyr's interpretation of Jeff Cooper's concept of a 'scout rifle', a versatile, all-purpose hunting rifle.  To this end, it is exceedingly lightweight, and contains a built-in polymer bipod, and fits a spare magazine inside the stock for fast reloading.  While these features made for a hunting rifle too universal for widespread adoption, they might yet fulfill a vital scouting niche for survivors in the post-Cataclysm world.
translations: 斯太尔侦察步枪是斯太尔公司对杰夫·库珀的“侦察步枪”概念的诠释，这这是一支多功能、通用的猎枪。为此，它非常轻，包含一个内置的聚合物两脚架，并在枪托内安装一个备用弹匣，以便快速重新装载。虽然这些功能使猎枪过于普遍，无法广泛采用，但它们可能会为后大灾难世界的幸存者提供重要的侦察位置。

messages.msgid: A light rifle developed during the Second World War to provide a less cumbersome weapon for soldiers that didn't need the firepower of the M1 Garand.  Firing the .30 Carbine cartridge, it provides more firepower than a pistol and is easier to carry than most other rifles.
translations: 一把于第二次世界大战期间研制的轻型步枪，为不需要 M1 加兰德步枪级别的火力的士兵提供一把比后者轻量的武器。发射 .30 卡宾枪弹药，既能提供比手枪更大的活力，又比大多数步枪更容易携带。

messages.msgid: An improved version of the M1 carbine offering full-auto capability, the M2 carbine was rare and coveted among collectors even before the world ended.  Takes M1 carbine magazines.
translations: M2 卡宾枪是 M1 卡宾枪的改进型号，增加了全自动模式。M2 卡宾枪之稀有，哪怕是放在末日之前，也令收藏家垂涎。可直接使用 M1 卡宾枪弹匣。

messages.msgid: One of the most famous handguns of the 20th century.  Your name is not Bond, but you might find this little gun still useful.
translations: 20世纪最著名的手枪之一。虽然你不是詹姆斯邦德，但这把枪仍能在关键时刻发挥作用。

messages.msgid: One of Kel-Tec's oldest designs, the P-32 is a popular option for deep concealment and backup usage.  Despite its extreme light weight and small size, its .32 ACP chambering makes for good handling and recoil control.
translations: 作为Kel-Tec数控工业公司最古老的设计之一，P-32手枪常常在秘密渗透和火力支援时使用。虽然它的重量非常轻，体积也很小，但是它的 .32ACP 口径使它的后坐力很小，易于控制。
精密国际 栓动狙击步枪

messages.msgid: A high-precision bolt-action sniper rifle, in service with special operations members of the US Navy prior to the Cataclysm.  Firing the powerful .338 Lapua cartridge, the weapon feeds from detachable five round Accuracy International magazines.
translations: 一把高精度栓动式狙击步枪，在“大灾变”之前列装于美国海军特种作战部队。它使用威力强大的 .338 拉普阿弹，通过精密国际5发弹匣进行供弹。
麦克米兰 Tac-338 狙击步枪

messages.msgid: Chambering the .338 Lapua cartridge, the Tac-338 is a high-precision, bolt-action sniper rifle that, before the Cataclysm, complemented the arsenal of the US Navy Special Warfare unit.  Providing Navy SEAL marksmen with the capability to land effective shots on targets at a typical range of 1600 meters, a valuable capability for the long-distance engagements prevalent during the US army's war on terror, the rifle comes kitted with an adjustable cheek pad, butt hook, and muzzle break.
translations: Tac-338 是一把高精度栓动式狙击步枪，使用 .338 拉普阿弹药。在“大灾变”之前，收录在美国海军特种作战部队武器库之中。能让海豹突击队射手在约1600米的射程内有效命中目标，该表现在美军反恐战争时期常见的远距离交战中非常可贵。该步枪配备了可调节的托腮板、枪托尾钩，和枪口制退器。

messages.msgid: A bolt-action precision rifle with the potential for impressive accuracy, this particular weapon makes use of the powerful .338 Lapua cartridge and is decked in a handsome set of wooden furniture, providing the rifle with a classical mystique.  Unfortunately, the weapon's single-round magazine and a lack of factory iron sights, which makes target acquisition an exercise in futility unless a gunsight is installed, make the rifle limited in its post-Cataclysm utility.
translations: 一把精度喜人的栓动式精确步枪，使用强力的 .338 拉普阿弹，且配有漂亮的木制枪身，为步枪增添了一丝经典步枪的气息。 不幸的是，该武器仅有单发载弹，且没有机瞄——除非安装瞄具，否则连瞄准目标都做不到，这使得它在大灾变后的实用性有限。
萨维奇 112 马格南 "靶射" 步枪

messages.msgid: A highly-accurate precision rifle chambered for the powerful .338 Lapua cartridge, the Savage 112 Magnum Target is a classically designed bolt-action rifle in both its fit and finish, with a heavy barrel, a hardwood stock, and an attached muzzle brake.  Unfortunately for the weapon and its users, a traditional veneer, no matter how admittedly swanky, isn't conducive to tactical effectiveness, as demonstrated by the 112 Magnum Target's mighty magazine size of one entire cartridge and lack of any factory-attached sights.
translations: 萨维奇 112 马格南 "靶射" 步枪是一把高精度栓动式精确步枪，使用强力的 .338 拉普阿弹，配有重型枪管、硬木枪托，和加装式枪口制退器，造型与设计接近于经典式步枪。 不幸的是，对于武器及其使用者来说，再好看的饰面，也不提供战术价值——它的一发”大容量“载弹以及出厂没有附装任何瞄具很好的证明了这一点。

messages.msgid: A box magazine-fed bolt-action precision rifle developed by the Barrett Arms Company, firing the .338 Lapua cartridge.  A civilian copy of more versatile military weapons, this rifle is a remarkably well-crafted piece of anti-personnel engineering despite lacking the sheer modularity of its Marshal sister, and is still capable of engaging targets at extreme distances.
translations: 由巴雷特公司研制的盒式弹匣供弹栓动精确步枪，发射 .338 拉普阿弹。作为制式武器的民用版本，尽管它不像制式版本那样模块化，但在人员杀伤方面仍表现出色，且仍能在极远距离打击目标。
巴雷特 MRAD SMR 步枪

messages.msgid: Chambered for the .338 Lapua cartridge, the Barrett MRAD SMR is a civilian variant of the MK22 MRAD sniper rifle, which was in service with elements of the US army and is often regarded as one of the finest bolt-action sniper rifles ever developed.  The primary differences that set this weapon apart from its Marshal sibling are the removal of the MRAD's caliber conversion capabilities and the installation of a fixed buttstock.  These changes have resulted in a lighter and slimmer rifle that, most importantly for the discerning pre-Cataclysmic precision shooter, didn't require a second mortgage to purchase.
translations: 采用 .338 拉普阿弹药的巴雷特 MRAD SMR 是 MK22 MRAD 狙击步枪的民用改型，后者曾在美军服役，常被认为是有史以来最好的栓动式狙击步枪之一。该枪与其姊妹型号的区别主要在于取消了 MRAD 的口径转换功能，并安装了固定枪托。这两项改动使得它更轻更薄，以及对于大灾变前的挑剔精确射手来说最重要的——不需要砸锅卖铁也买得起。

messages.msgid: A weapon platform that prides itself on modularity and customizability, this highly accurate precision rifle may be configured with various caliber conversion kits that can allow it to fire either the .338 Lapua, .300 Win Mag, or .308 Winchester cartridges.  The rifle's size prevents it from being a particularly mobile piece of equipment, but the weapon's folding buttstock aids in portability.
translations: 作为以模块化和定制性而闻名的武器平台，这把高精度的精确步枪可以通过各种口径转换套件，以发射 .338 拉普阿弹、.300 温彻斯特 马格南弹，或 .308 温彻斯特弹。枪体整体尺寸限制了其携行机动性，但武器的折叠式枪托多少缓解了携带难度。
精密国际 AXMC 狙击步枪

messages.msgid: Produced by the British precision rifle company Accuracy International, the AX Modular Caliber Weapon System is a highly-accurate combat sniper rifle offered to military, law enforcement, and civilian precision marksmen.  The rifle is compatible with a wide range of aftermarket components, including caliber conversion kits, and is built upon a base aluminum chassis, into which the weapon's parts may be installed or removed at the user's discretion.
translations: 由英国精确步枪公司"精密国际"生产，AX 多口径模块化（Modular Caliber）武器平台是一把高精度的战斗狙击步枪，适用于军队、执法部门和精确射击爱好者。该步枪兼容大量的第三方零售组件，也能使用口径改装套件，可以在其铝制枪体基座上按用户的需求安装或拆卸。

messages.msgid: A SIG Sauer P226 chambered for .357 SIG.  The P226 is a DA/SA, short-recoil operated semi-automatic pistol.
translations: 发射 .357 西格弹的西格&绍尔 P226 手枪。P226手枪是一把采用单/双动操作扳机的短反冲式半自动手枪。
西格 P320 紧凑型手枪

messages.msgid: The P320 Compact is a semi-automatic, short recoil operated pistol.  This one is chambered for .357 SIG.
translations: 西格&绍尔 P320 紧凑型手枪是一把短反冲式半自动手枪，发射 .357 西格弹。
南北战争 六发左轮手枪

messages.msgid: The Colt Model 1861 Navy cap & ball .36-caliber revolver was a six-shot, single-action percussion weapon produced by Colt's Manufacturing Company from 1861 until 1873.
translations: 柯尔特 M1861 海军型 左轮手枪是一把使用 .36 纸卷弹、六发弹仓的单动击锤式左轮，于1861至1873年期间由柯尔特公司制造。
柯尔特 M1861 海军型 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: The Colt M1861 is a black powder, cap & ball revolver dating back to the Civil War.  While reloading it takes quite a while due to having to put a primer on each chamber manually, instead of having the primer in one unit with the casing, like metallic cartridges.  However, for the time 6 shots in quick succession was a great thing for cavalry and officers to have on the field, though this version was much rarer than the more popular Colt M1860.  Nowadays, this firearm is completely outdated, and only sees use in collections, reenactment, or special shooting competitions.  However, black powder guns such as this are less regulated than more modern firearms, so it is sometimes the first gun a youth may buy.  This one is chambered in .36, weaker than the M1860's .44.
translations: 柯尔特 M1861 是一把火帽-弹丸式左轮手枪，可以追溯到美国内战时期。由于需要手动在每个弹膛上安装火帽（而不是像现代金属弹壳那样将底火集成在一起），它的装填速度很慢，但在当时，能够快速连续射击六发子弹对于战场上的骑兵和军官来说是极大的优势——不过手上这一把 M1861 型要比更受欢迎的 M1860 型稀有得多。如今这支左轮手枪已经完全过时，只在收藏、历史重演活动或特殊的射击比赛中才能见到。然而，像这样的黑火药枪支比现代枪械受到的监管更少，所以有时会成为年轻人购买的第一支枪。这把枪使用的是 .36 口径弹药，威力比 M1860 型的 .44 口径要小。

messages.msgid: A crudely made double barrel pistol firing .38 Special ammo.  Unfortunately, the name is less about the double barrels and more about the number of shots you'll get before it breaks down on you.
translations: 一把做工粗糙的双管手枪，发射 .38 Special 弹药。不幸的是，这个名字与其说是在指双管，不如说是在指它在你手里报废之前，你大概只能打出两发。

messages.msgid: A six-shot revolver, produced since 1899 and known as the most popular handgun of the 20th century.  It has a swing-out cylinder for ease of reloading.
translations: 一把六发左轮手枪，最早于1899年生产，被誉为20世纪最流行的手枪。弹巢能够侧向旋出以便装填，因而得名“左轮”。

messages.msgid: The Model 10 is one of the oldest firearm models still in production, and most produced handguns, with production dating back to 1899.  Starting life as the Model 1899 Hand Ejector, it only picked up the current name of Model 10 in the 1950s.  Despite .38 Special and .357 Magnum being the same caliber, Model 10s were produced to handle blackpowder loads, and while modern smokeless loads of .38 Special work fine, .357 Magnum could cause the Model 10 to catastrophically fail.
translations: Model 10 左轮手枪是迄今为止仍在生产的最古老的枪械之一，也是生产最多的手枪，其生产最早可以追溯到1899年。其最初 M1899 型采用手动退弹，直到20世纪50年代才被改进并更名为 Model 10。尽管 .38 特制弹和 .357 马格南弹的口径相同，但 Model 10 本身是为处理黑火药装药而设计，.38 特制弹由于使用现代无烟火药因此没啥大问题，而 .357 马格南弹所使用的装药对 Model 10 来说就是遭老罪了。
自制钢管步枪（.38特制弹口径）
隐蔽携带 六发左轮手枪
鲁格 LCR 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: The Ruger LCR (Lightweight Compact Revolver) is a modern revolver, starting production in just 2010.  It's a lightweight, aluminum-framed revolver, designed for conceal carry with its double-action-only trigger, lightweight and compact size.  Due to the double-action trigger, it is more possible to carry it in your pocket instead of a holster due to the heavy trigger, but still ill-advised.
translations: 鲁格紧凑型轻型左轮手枪（Lightweight Compact Revolver）是一把于2010年开始生产的现代左轮手枪。该枪为轻量的铝制框架左轮，设计紧凑轻便，专为隐蔽携带而设计，并采用了纯双动扳机。由于双动扳机的扳机较重，因此理论上你可以把它揣在口袋里，而不是非得放在枪套里。——只是这么说说，难误触发不代表不会误触发。

messages.msgid: A six inch revolver chambered in .357 Magnum/.38 Special.  Favorite of sheriffs and post-Cataclysm survivor group leaders.
translations: 一把6英寸枪管的左轮，发射 .357 马格南弹 和 .38 特制弹。治安官和大灾变后幸存者领袖的最爱。
柯尔特 "蟒蛇" 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: Made by Colt, this six inch six-shooter is one of the most lauded revolvers ever produced.  Can fire .38 Special and .357 Magnum.
translations: 由柯尔特公司制造，这把6英寸枪管的左轮是有史以来最受喜爱的左轮手枪之一。可以发射 .38 特制弹 和 .357 马格南弹。

messages.msgid: A revolver chambered in .357, with a 6 inch barrel and 7 shots.
translations: 一把 .357 口径的左轮手枪，使用6英寸枪管，可容纳7发子弹。

messages.msgid: Introduced in the 90's, Smith & Wesson's model 686 'Plus' features a robust stainless steel frame, an adjustable front sight and a seventh shot that's sure to save your life.
translations: S&W 686 “Plus”型左轮诞生于90年代，具有坚固的不锈钢枪身，可调节的前准星，并且多一发弹巢容量——以便在关键时刻救你一命。

messages.msgid: A revolver chambered in .357, with a 6 inch barrel and 6 shots.
translations: 一把 .357 口径的左轮手枪，使用6英寸枪管，可容纳6发子弹。
齐亚帕 "犀牛" 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: An innovative, futuristic looking revolver designed by Emilio Ghisoni after developing the Mateba, its most distinctive feature is its barrel, aligned with the bottom chamber of its hexagonal cylinder to alleviate muzzle flip.
translations: 埃米利奥·吉索尼在设计出马特巴自动左轮之后设计的另一把新颖的、具有未来感的左轮手枪，其最显著的特点是枪管与六角圆柱的底腔对齐，以减轻枪口上跳。

messages.msgid: Short, stout, and compact, this stainless steel revolver is a handy dispenser of .357-magnum, or lower-power .38-caliber, cartridges.  Six rounds fit within the weapon, though its small stature and short barrel ensure that each pull of the trigger is all but a pyrotechnic spectacle: flashy, loud, and jumpy.
translations: 短小精悍，紧凑灵巧。这款不锈钢左轮手枪可以射出 .357 马格南弹或威力低一些的 .38 弹。可容纳六发子弹，但由于其小巧的枪身和短枪管，导致每次扣动扳机都像举行一场烟火表演：火光大作、声响巨大，且枪口跳动巨大无比。
罗西 RP63 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: A small frame, stainless-steel Brazilian wheel gun with rubberized grips, a serrated front sight, and a satin finish, boasting a 6-round cylinder of .357-magnum persuasion.  Affordable, before the world collapsed, and confidently asserted by Rossi themselves to be the ideal carry gun for its rounded butt and 3-inch barrel, you aren't wholly sure that such assertions accounted for zombies.
translations: 一款小型的巴西制不锈钢左轮手枪，配有橡胶握把、锯齿状准星和缎面处理，弹巢可装填六发 .357 马格南弹。在大灾变降临之前，这把枪的价格平易近人，且罗西公司曾自信地宣称，其圆润的握把和3英寸枪管，是理想的随身携带之选，但你不确定对上丧尸时这说法还靠不靠谱。

messages.msgid: This fine lever-action rifle is chambered in the powerful .357 Magnum cartridge, with an 20" barrel with a tube-fed magazine.  Go get 'em cowboy!
translations: 这把精致的杠杆式步枪发射威力巨大的 .357 马格南弹，拥有一根20英寸枪管以及管式弹仓。干翻它们，牛仔！
乌贝蒂 1873 杠杆式步枪

messages.msgid: The 1873 is a rifle platform developed all the way in, unsurprisingly, 1873.  This one is a fairly faithful Uberti reproduction, although the original 1873s pre-dated .357 Magnum, and even .38 Special.  This one has a case-hardened finish, wood furniture, and octagonal barrel.
translations: 1873 杠杆式步枪——毫不意外地——是1873年研发的一把步枪。手上这一把是乌贝蒂公司十分忠于原物的仿制产品，尽管其所发射的 .357 马格南弹，甚至 .38 特制弹的问世皆晚于原版 1873 步枪。这把枪进行了表面硬化处理，拥有木制的枪身结构和八角形枪管。

messages.msgid: This lever-action rifle is chambered in the powerful .357 Magnum cartridge, with an 20" barrel with a tube-fed magazine.  Go get 'em cowboy!
translations: 这把杠杆式步枪发射威力巨大的 .357 马格南弹，拥有一根20英寸枪管以及管式弹仓。干翻它们，牛仔！
罗西 R92 20英寸 杠杆式步枪

messages.msgid: The R92 is a widely successful line of lever-action rifles from Rossi, featuring a wide array of different calibers and barrel lengths.  These aim to be less reproductions of old rifles, but rather modern takes on the lever-action formula.  This particular one features wooden furniture, a 20" barrel, and 10 rounds of .357 Magnum or .38 Special.
translations: R92 是罗西公司大受欢迎的杠杆式步枪系列，涵盖多种不同口径和枪管长度。它们并非旧式步枪的简单复刻，而是旨在以现代工艺与设计重新演绎杠杆式枪械。手上这一把配有木制结构枪身、20英寸枪管，可填装10发 .357 马格南弹或 .38 特制弹。

messages.msgid: This fine lever-action rifle is chambered in the powerful .357 Magnum cartridge, with an 16" barrel with a tube-fed magazine.  Go get 'em cowboy!
translations: 这把精致的杠杆式步枪发射威力巨大的 .357 马格南弹，拥有一根16英寸枪管以及管式弹仓。干翻它们，牛仔！
罗西 R92 16英寸 杠杆式步枪

messages.msgid: The R92 is a widely successful line of lever-action rifles from Rossi, featuring a wide array of different calibers and barrel lengths.  These aim to be less reproductions of old rifles, but rather modern takes on the lever-action formula.  This particular one features wooden furniture, a 16" barrel, and 8 rounds of .357 Magnum or .38 Special.
translations: R92 是罗西公司大受欢迎的杠杆式步枪系列，涵盖多种不同口径和枪管长度。它们并非旧式步枪的简单复刻，而是旨在以现代工艺与设计重新演绎杠杆式枪械。手上这一把配有木制结构枪身、16英寸枪管，可填装8发 .357 马格南弹或 .38 特制弹。

messages.msgid: This .38 revolver is quite small and lightweight, due to its short barrel and aluminum material.
translations: 得益于较短的枪管和铝制材质枪身，这把 .38 左轮手枪相当轻盈小巧。

messages.msgid: A modern version of the Airweight, the 642 is a lightweight .38 caliber revolver, made with an aluminum frame.
translations: S&W 642 是一把采用铝制枪身结构的轻量化 .38 左轮手枪，为基于"Airweight"框架的现代化版本左轮手枪。

messages.msgid: A lesser known variant of the MAC-10, this machine pistol is chambered in .380 ACP for a smaller overall size while remaining inherently subsonic.  Smaller in almost every dimension, this inexpensive automatic weapon was declared 'fit only for combat in a phone booth' due to its low weight and absurd fire rate ranging from 1200 to 1400 rounds per minute.
translations: MAC-10 冲锋枪的一个鲜为人知的衍生型号，使用 .380 ACP 弹药，整体尺寸较小，但子弹初速仍可达到亚音速。作为一把并不昂贵的自动武器，因其整体较小的体积以及较轻的重量，还有高达每分钟1200到1400发的射速，因此被戏称为"仅适用于电话亭中的战斗"。

messages.msgid: One of the best-selling modern day 'pocket pistols', the LCP is an affordable, polymer framed pistol chambered in .380 ACP.  Despite the round's relatively low power, the pistol's low weight and short sight radius make for moderately poor handling.
translations: 作为当今最畅销的袖珍手枪之一，鲁格 LCP 手枪不光价格合理，还具有聚合物枪身，发射 .380 口径弹药。尽管所发射的弹药威力相对较低，但由于该枪重量轻且瞄准基线短，使得整体操控性还是偏差。

messages.msgid: The Hi-Point CF-380 is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.
translations: Hi-Point CF-380 手枪是由Hi-Point公司设计的一把采用反冲式枪机的半自动手枪。该公司以制造廉价枪械而闻名，但为了降低造价，所生产的武器常常造型臃肿且手感较差。Hi-Point公司的枪械普遍使用锌合金制的套筒，相比传统钢制套筒来说比较脆弱。

messages.msgid: A pistol-caliber carbine chambered in .380 ACP.  It is more powerful and accurate than an equivalent pistol but the .380 ACP round is nonetheless fairly weak.  Accepts 10-round magazines, which are not shared with any .380 ACP pistol unlike many other similar pistol-caliber carbines.
translations: 一把发射 .380 ACP 弹药的手枪口径卡宾枪。比手枪更准更强，但上限终究被其发射的 .380 ACP 弹所限制。使用的10发弹匣，但该弹匣不像其他手枪口径卡宾枪那样能被相似的 .380 ACP 手枪使用。

messages.msgid: A pistol-caliber carbine chambered in .380 ACP, designed by Hi-Point Firearms.  Its 16.5" barrel provides extra stopping power over an equivalent pistol, but .380 is still a relatively weak caliber.  Accepts 10-round magazines, which are notably not interchangeable with those of CF380 pistols.
translations: 一把由Hi-Point公司设计，发射 .380 ACP 弹药的手枪口径卡宾枪。使用16.5英寸枪管，提供了比手枪更高的停止力，但其发射的 .380 ACP 弹本身并不算强力。使用10发弹匣，但该弹匣无法被 CF380 手枪使用。

messages.msgid: A very small and lightweight handgun, firing the .380 ACP cartridge.
translations: 一款非常小且轻量的手枪，发射 .380 ACP 弹药。

messages.msgid: A now-discontinued conceal carry gun, the S&W Bodyguard is a small and lightweight conceal carry gun, firing the .380 ACP cartridge.  Despite the short barrel and weak cartridge, it is still enough for self defense.  Even though it's discontinued, it still remains as a very popular firearm.
translations: 作为现已停产的隐蔽携带手枪，S&W "保镖" 手枪非常小且轻量，且发射 .380 ACP 弹药。尽管枪管太短且弹药威力弱，但用于自卫依然足够。即使已经停产，它至今仍是一款非常受欢迎的枪械。

messages.msgid: The smallest gun Glock produces, chambered in .380 ACP.  Even though it is small a small gun that shoots a weak cartridge, it is still effective against small game, paper targets, and zombified children
translations: 格洛克公司生产的最小型号，采用.380 ACP口径。尽管只是一把发射低威力弹的小手枪，但它在对付小型猎物、纸靶和丧尸儿童时依然有效。

messages.msgid: The M1911A1 is an extremely popular pistol known for its reliability.  This one is chambered for .38 Super.
translations: M1911A1 是一把极度流行的手枪，以其可靠性而闻名。这一把发射 .38 超级弹。

messages.msgid: A .40 S&W variant of the popular Glock 17 pistol.  The standard-issue firearm of the FBI from 1997-2016, and of countless other law enforcement agencies worldwide.
translations: 受大众欢迎的格洛克 17 手枪的 .40 S&W 口径变体。曾是1997年至2016年间，FBI的标准配枪，也是全球无数执法机构的标配武器。

messages.msgid: A compact version of the Glock 22, chambered in .40 S&W.  Popular among civilian and law enforcement alike for its capacity, durability, and reliability.
translations: 格洛克 22 手枪的紧凑款，发射 .40 S&W 弹药。凭借其弹匣容量、耐用性和可靠性，在民用和警用领域广受欢迎。

messages.msgid: A diminutive pistol chambered in .40 S&W. Widely popular among concealed carriers, its popularity soared further in the months leading up to the Cataclysm, partly due to its ability to fit the higher cpacity magazines of its older brothers.
translations: 一款紧凑型的.40 S&W口径手枪，因便于隐蔽携带而广受欢迎。尤其是在“大灾变”爆发前的数月间，这款手枪的人气更是高涨，归功于它可以兼容同系列大尺寸格洛克手枪的大容量弹匣。
伯莱塔 Px4 "风暴" .40 S&W 手枪

messages.msgid: Lighter than Beretta's iconic 92 series of guns, the Px4 Storm was built by utilizing light-weight polymer construction with steel inserts.  Its shape was also optimized for concealed carry.  This one is chambered in .40 S&W.
translations: 通过“往轻型聚合物枪身内填入金属加强结构”的方式，伯莱塔 Px4 "风暴" 手枪成功做到了将枪体重量控制在同公司标志性的92系列手枪之下。其枪身造型经过设计，便于隐蔽携带。这一把发射 .40 S&W 弹药。

messages.msgid: Originally marketed as a lightweight and compact alternative to older SIG handguns, the Pro .40 is popular among European police forces.
translations: 原本作为旧版西格手枪更为轻便紧凑的替代品推向市场，Pro .40 手枪受到欧洲各国警方的青睐。

messages.msgid: A Luty pattern makeshift smoothbore SMG crudely constructed out of various steel parts using advanced powered hand tools; likely one of the most complex guns that is feasible to make outside of a machine shop, but still very unreliable.  This one is chambered for .40 S&W cartridges and accepts custom-made makeshift magazines.
translations: 一把粗制的Luty式无膛线冲锋枪，利用各种手持工具将各种金属部件野蛮地拼接到一起——虽说不可靠，但也算是在专业车间之外能造出的最复杂的枪支了。这一把使用 .40 S&W 弹，可通过自制的Luty式冲锋枪弹匣供弹。
勃朗宁大威力 .40 S&W 手枪

messages.msgid: The Browning Hi-Power is a semi-automatic handgun developed shortly before the Second World War.  Widely issued since then, it remains in use by India, Canada, and Australia.  This is a commercial variant produced by Browning Arms in .40 S&W.
translations: 勃朗宁大威力手枪是一把于二战开始前完成研发的半自动手枪。该枪一经面世便被广泛列装于各国军队，且目前在印度、加拿大，和澳大利亚仍有列装。这一把属于勃朗宁武器公司为商业销售而开发的 .40 S&W 弹版本。

messages.msgid: The Hi-Point Model JCP is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.
translations: Hi-Point Model JCP 手枪是由Hi-Point公司设计的一把采用反冲式枪机的半自动手枪。该公司以制造廉价枪械而闻名，但为了降低造价，所生产的武器常常造型臃肿且手感较差。Hi-Point公司的枪械普遍使用锌合金制的套筒，相比传统钢制套筒来说比较脆弱。
M320 独立式榴弹发射器

messages.msgid: Heckler & Koch's M320 grenade launcher offers the functionality of larger launchers in a very small package at the cost of decreased accuracy.  This one is combined with a buttstock for standalone operation.
translations: H&K公司出品的 M320 榴弹发射器，在维持大型发射器上应有功能的前提下，将体积极致压缩，缺点是射击精度相对地降低不少。这把枪包含一个内置枪托，使作为管下配件的模组本体可作为独立武器使用。

messages.msgid: A widely-used grenade launcher that first saw use by American forces in the Vietnam War.  Though mostly replaced by more modern launchers, the M79 still sees use with many units worldwide.
translations: 最早由美国在越南战争中使用，现如今被广泛使用的榴弹发射器。虽然几乎已经被更现代的发射器所取代，但你仍可以看见 M79 被世界上的许多部队所使用。
米尔科姆 MGL 榴弹发射器

messages.msgid: The Milkor Multi-Grenade Launcher is designed to compensate for the drawback of single-shot grenade launchers by allowing sustained heavy firepower.  However, it is still slow to reload and must be used with careful planning.
translations: 米尔科姆公司的多发榴弹发射器（Multi-Grenade Launcher）旨在通过解决单发榴弹发射器只能射一发的缺点，来换取更持久的重型火力输出——不过射击后的装填速度没比射一发换一次要好多少（转轮式弹巢），使用的时候请务必作好提前计划。

messages.msgid: An array of six M203 grenade launchers for use on the TALON UGV platform.
translations: 在鹰爪型无人车平台上使用的六管 M203 榴弹发射器阵列。

messages.msgid: A heavy, tripod-mounted belt-fed grenade launcher used by the US Military since the start of the Cold War all the way to the Cataclysm, and if you can find some 40mm grenades, maybe even beyond.
translations: 一把通过弹链供弹的三脚架式重型榴弹发射器，自冷战起一直被美国军方使用到大灾变发生——如果你能找到一些 40mm 榴弹，它还能被继续使用下去。
温彻斯特 M37 .410 霰弹枪

messages.msgid: A single-shot break-action shotgun, chambered in .410 bore.  Designed as a lower-recoil alternative to 12 gauge shotguns, it is light and easy to manufacture.
translations: 一把单发开膛式霰弹枪，采用.410口径。设计得比12口径霰弹枪有更低的后坐力，它很轻便而且制造起来很简单。

messages.msgid: An icon of popular culture more than a practical weapon, this massive pistol can shoot a variety of magnum handgun rounds depending on the conversion kit and magazine used.
translations: 这把大尺寸手枪更多被作为流行文化象征，而不是实用的武器。它可以根据使用的改装套件和与之对应弹匣，发射多种口径的马格南手枪弹。
沙漠之鹰 Mark XIX 手枪

messages.msgid: Needing little introduction, the Desert Eagle's impact on popular culture is almost as massive as the pistol itself.  The newest Mark XIX model introduced a more modern optics rail.  It was sold in multiple hard-hitting magnum calibers and can swap between them using conversion kits and the appropriate magazine.
translations: 无需多说，沙漠之鹰对流行文化的影响几乎与手枪本身一样巨大。该把最新的 Mark XIX 型带有可安装现代光学瞄具的导轨，包含发射多种口径的马格南的版本销售，或者使用配套的改装套件和对应弹匣进行改装。

messages.msgid: golden Desert Eagle Mark XIX pistol
translations: 黄金沙漠之鹰 Mark XIX 手枪
messages.plural: golden Desert Eagle Mark XIX pistols

messages.msgid: Needing little introduction, the Desert Eagle's impact on popular culture is almost as massive as the pistol itself.  The newest Mark XIX model introduced a more modern optics rail.  It was sold in multiple hard-hitting magnum calibers and can swap between them using conversion kits and the appropriate magazine.  For maximum style points (or tackiness, depending on taste), this one is plated in what appears to be 24-karat gold.
translations: 无需多说，沙漠之鹰对流行文化的影响几乎与手枪本身一样巨大。该把最新的 Mark XIX 型带有可安装现代光学瞄具的导轨，包含发射多种口径的马格南的版本销售，或者使用配套的改装套件和对应弹匣进行改装。这把手枪表面还镀了层24k纯金，取决于你的品味，这真是帅/俗到爆了！

messages.msgid: This fine lever-action rifle is chambered in the powerful .44 Magnum cartridge and features a sleek octagonal barrel with a tube fed magazine.  Go get 'em cowboy!
translations: 这把精致的杠杆式步枪发射威力巨大的 .44 马格南弹，拥有一根八角形枪管以及管式弹仓。干翻它们，牛仔！
.44 马格南 自制钢管步枪

messages.msgid: A stainless steel, six-shot, double-action revolver with a matte black plastic handle manufactured by Smith & Wesson.  Though hardly the most powerful handgun in the world any more, it could still blow a zombie's head clean off.
translations: S&W公司出品、不锈钢制、六发装填，黑色塑料握柄的双动左轮手枪。虽然已经不再是世界上威力最大的左轮，但打爆丧尸的头依旧不成问题。
鲁格 "红鹰" 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: One of the most powerful handguns in the world when it was released in 1979, the Redhawk offers very sturdy construction, with an appearance that is reminiscent of "Wild West" revolvers.
translations: "红鹰" 左轮手枪于1979年问世，曾一度成为世界上威力最大的左轮手枪之一。它工艺精良、选材考究，其外观设计更是颇具狂野西部风格。

messages.msgid: A large-frame revolver with a modern plastic handle.  Too large for law enforcement, it was mostly used by sport shooters and hunters, for the manufacturer deemed it to be the most accurate .44-caliber revolver in their line.  This one has an extended 8-inch barrel.
translations: 一把带有现代塑料握把的大型左轮手枪。由于体积确实过于庞大，因此未被执法机构所使用，但在竞技射击和狩猎领域占据一席之地。制造商声称这把枪是他们所销售的最精确的 .44 口径左轮手枪。手上的这一把左轮配有一根加长的8英寸枪管。
柯尔特 "巨蟒" 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: A large-frame double-action revolver with a modern plastic handle.  Too large for law enforcement, it was mostly used by sport shooters and hunters, for Colt deemed it to be the most accurate .44-caliber revolver in their line.  This one has an extended 8-inch barrel.
translations: 一把带有现代塑料握把的大型左轮手枪。由于体积确实过于庞大，因此未被执法机构所使用，但在竞技射击和狩猎领域占据一席之地。柯尔特公司声称这把枪是他们所销售的最精确的 .44 口径左轮手枪。手上的这一把左轮配有一根加长的8英寸枪管。

messages.msgid: A large-frame revolver with a modern plastic handle.  Too large for law enforcement, it was mostly used by sport shooters and hunters, for the manufacturer deemed it to be the most accurate .44-caliber revolver in their line.  This one has a 6-inch barrel.
translations: 一把带有现代塑料握把的大型左轮手枪。由于体积确实过于庞大，因此未被执法机构所使用，但在竞技射击和狩猎领域占据一席之地。制造商声称这把枪是他们所销售的最精确的 .44 口径左轮手枪。手上的这一把左轮配有一根6英寸枪管。

messages.msgid: A large-frame double-action revolver with a modern plastic handle.  Too large for law enforcement, it was mostly used by sport shooters and hunters, for Colt deemed it to be the most accurate .44-caliber revolver in their line.  This one has a 6-inch barrel.
translations: 一把带有现代塑料握把的大型左轮手枪。由于体积确实过于庞大，因此未被执法机构所使用，但在竞技射击和狩猎领域占据一席之地。柯尔特公司声称这把枪是他们所销售的最精确的 .44 口径左轮手枪。手上的这一把左轮配有一根6英寸枪管。
