messages.msgid: A large-frame revolver with a modern plastic handle.  Too large for law enforcement, it was mostly used by sport shooters and hunters, for the manufacturer deemed it to be the most accurate .44-caliber revolver in their line.  This one has a shortened 4-inch barrel.
translations: 一把带有现代塑料握把的大型左轮手枪。由于体积确实过于庞大，因此未被执法机构所使用，但在竞技射击和狩猎领域占据一席之地。制造商声称这把枪是他们所销售的最精确的 .44 口径左轮手枪。手上的这一把左轮配有一根缩短的4英寸枪管。

messages.msgid: A large-frame double-action revolver with a modern plastic handle.  Too large for law enforcement, it was mostly used by sport shooters and hunters, for Colt deemed it to be the most accurate .44-caliber revolver in their line.  This one has a shortened 4-inch barrel.
translations: 一把带有现代塑料握把的大型左轮手枪。由于体积确实过于庞大，因此未被执法机构所使用，但在竞技射击和狩猎领域占据一席之地。柯尔特公司声称这把枪是他们所销售的最精确的 .44 口径左轮手枪。手上的这一把左轮配有一根缩短的4英寸枪管。

messages.msgid: This lever-action rifle is chambered in the powerful .44 Magnum cartridge, with an 16" barrel with a tube-fed magazine.  Go get 'em cowboy!
translations: 这把杠杆式步枪发射威力巨大的 .44 马格南弹，拥有一根16英寸枪管以及管式弹仓。干翻它们，牛仔！

messages.msgid: The R92 is a widely successful line of lever-action rifles from Rossi, featuring a wide array of different calibers and barrel lengths.  These aim to be less reproductions of old rifles, but rather modern takes on the lever-action formula.  This particular one features all-black furniture, a 16" barrel, and 8 rounds of .44 Magnum, along with a large lever loop.
translations: R92 是罗西公司大受欢迎的杠杆式步枪系列，涵盖多种不同口径和枪管长度。它们并非旧式步枪的简单复刻，而是旨在以现代工艺与设计重新演绎杠杆式枪械。手上这一把配有全黑部件枪身、16英寸枪管，以及大号的杠杆护圈，可填装8发 .44 马格南弹。

messages.msgid: This lever-action rifle is chambered in the powerful .44 Magnum cartridge, with an 20" barrel with a tube-fed magazine.  Go get 'em cowboy!
translations: 这把杠杆式步枪发射威力巨大的 .44 马格南弹，拥有一根20英寸枪管以及管式弹仓。干翻它们，牛仔！

messages.msgid: The R92 is a widely successful line of lever-action rifles from Rossi, featuring a wide array of different calibers and barrel lengths.  These aim to be less reproductions of old rifles, but rather modern takes on the lever-action formula.  This particular one features all-black furniture, a 20" barrel, and 10 rounds of .44 Magnum.
translations: R92 是罗西公司大受欢迎的杠杆式步枪系列，涵盖多种不同口径和枪管长度。它们并非旧式步枪的简单复刻，而是旨在以现代工艺与设计重新演绎杠杆式枪械。手上这一把配有全黑部件枪身、20英寸枪管，以及大号的杠杆护圈，可填装10发 .44 马格南弹。

messages.msgid: The Colt Army Model 1860 is a cap & ball .44-caliber revolver.  It was used during the American Civil War, and made by Colt's Manufacturing Company.
translations: 柯尔特 M1860 陆军型 左轮手枪是一把使用 .44 纸卷弹、六发弹仓的单动击锤式左轮，由柯尔特公司制造，曾在美国南北战争期间被投入使用。
柯尔特 M1860 陆军型 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: The Colt M1860 is a black powder, cap & ball revolver dating back to the Civil War.  While reloading it takes quite a while due to having to put a primer on each chamber manually, instead of having the primer in one unit with the casing, like metallic cartridges.  However, for the time 6 shots in quick succession was a great thing for cavalry and officers to have on the field.  Nowadays, this firearm is completely outdated, and only sees use in collections, reenactment, or special shooting competitions.  However, black powder guns such as this are less regulated than more modern firearms, so it is sometimes the first gun a youth may buy.  This one is chambered in .44, and while the number may remind some of .44 Magnum, it has nowhere near the ballistic effectiveness of .44 Magnum.
translations: 柯尔特 M1860 是一把火帽-弹丸式左轮手枪，可以追溯到美国内战时期。由于需要手动在每个弹膛上安装火帽（而不是像现代金属弹壳那样将底火集成在一起），它的装填速度很慢，但在当时，能够快速连续射击六发子弹对于战场上的骑兵和军官来说是极大的优势。如今这支左轮手枪已经完全过时，只在收藏、历史重演活动或特殊的射击比赛中才能见到。然而，像这样的黑火药枪支比现代枪械受到的监管更少，所以有时会成为年轻人购买的第一支枪。这把枪使用的是 .44 口径弹药，虽然同口径还有 .44 马格南弹，但前者的弹道性能远不如后者。

messages.msgid: A submachine gun chambered in .45 ACP, accepting Glock magazines.
translations: 一把 .45 ACP 口径的冲锋枪，可使用格洛克弹匣。

messages.msgid: The Vector SMG is a delayed blowback submachine gun with a unique, in-line design that places both the shooter's hand and shoulder in line with the bore axis, reducing muzzle climb during bursts.  This one is chambered in .45 ACP.
translations: Vector 冲锋枪是一把延迟反冲式冲锋枪，有着独特的同轴设计，使射手的手和肩与枪膛轴线平齐，有助于减少连发射击时的枪口上跳。这把冲锋枪使用 .45 ACP 弹。

messages.msgid: A modern polymer-body sub-machine gun, once quite popular with police departments until recently.  Can be configured in 9x19mm, .40 S&W, or .45 ACP using conversion kits and the appropriate UMP magazine.
translations: 一把使用现代聚合物枪身的冲锋枪，在近几年被新晋装备所替代之前，在执法机构中被广泛使用。可以使用转换套件与对应的 UMP 弹匣，来发射 9x19mm、.40 S&W，或 .45 ACP 弹药。

messages.msgid: Developed as a lower-cost successor to H&K's own MP5, the Universal Machine Pistol is a closed-bolt, simple blowback sub-machine gun constructed of lightweight polymer.  In order to make it more attractive to American police departments, it was offered in .40 S&W and .45 ACP as well as the ubiquitous 9x19mm, all using the same receiver.  This was meant to simplify manufacturing, but it also means the user can change the caliber with the right parts and magazine.
translations: 作为同为H&K公司的 MP5 的低成本继承者，UMP 通用冲锋枪是一把轻量聚合物结构，具有简单的反冲作用和闭锁式枪机的冲锋枪。为了进一步吸引美国执法部门使用该武器，该枪拥有 .40 S&W、.45 ACP，以及遍地都是的 9x19mm 三种口径，且皆使用相同的机匣。虽本意是简化制造，但这也意味着用户只要有对应的机匣部件和 UMP 弹匣，就可以手动将武器改为其他口径。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in .45 ACP and accepting M1911 magazines.
translations: 一把 .45 ACP 口径的半自动手枪，使用 M1911 弹匣。

messages.msgid: The M1911 was the US Military standard-issue sidearm for most of the 20th Century.  It remains one of the most popular .45 pistols today.
translations: M1911 曾是美国军方在 20 世纪大部分时期的制式随身手枪。直到今天，它仍然是最受欢迎的 .45 口径手枪之一。

messages.msgid: The M45A1 supplanted earlier M45 MEUSOC pistols in use by Force Recon elements of Marine Expeditionary Units.  Where the original M45 pistols were gutted M1911A1s hand-fitted by USMC armorers, the updated M45A1s are hardly different from any other commercial 1911 design, save for their dual recoil springs.  Most were replaced in 2016 with Glock 19s due to logistics issues.
translations: M45A1 手枪为海军陆战队直属侦察连先前使用的 M45 MEUSOC 手枪的迭代版本。由于最初的 M45 手枪是海军陆战队军械士对 M1911A1 手枪改造调整而来，因此更新版的 M45A1 手枪除了使用双反冲弹簧外，与商用版 M1911 手枪的结构设计几乎没有区别。由于后勤问题，它们中的绝大部分在2016年被格洛克 19 手枪替代。

messages.msgid: A submachine gun chambered in .45 ACP and accepting MAC-10 magazines.
translations: 一把 .45 ACP 口径的冲锋枪，使用 MAC-10 弹匣。

messages.msgid: The MAC-10 is a popular machine pistol originally designed for military use.  For many years it was the most inexpensive automatic weapon in the US, and enjoyed great popularity among criminals less concerned with quality firearms.
translations: MAC-10 冲锋枪最初是为军队而设计的，然而经过许多年的更新换代，这款有"美国最便宜的冲锋枪"之称的 MAC-10 已经彻底沦为那些囊中羞涩的犯罪分子心目中的首选。

messages.msgid: A compact, lightweight carbine chambering the .45 ACP pistol round.  Resembling the popular UMP submachine gun in both its blowback operating system and lightweight polymer frame construction, this civilian variant is distinguished by its skeletonized stock and 16 inch barrel, leaving it unable to accommodate standard UMP parts.
translations: 一把发射 .45 ACP 手枪弹的轻量化紧凑型卡宾枪。作为热门的 UMP 冲锋枪的民用版本，其采用了与之类似的反冲操作系统和轻质聚合物框架结构，但在此之外使用镂空枪托和16英寸枪管，导致其无法安装标准的 UMP 配件。

messages.msgid: A Luty pattern makeshift smoothbore SMG crudely constructed out of various steel parts using advanced powered hand tools; likely one of the most complex guns that is feasible to make outside of a machine shop, but still very unreliable.  This one is chambered for .45 ACP cartridges and accepts MAC-10 compatible magazines.
translations: 一把粗制的Luty式无膛线冲锋枪，利用各种手持工具将各种金属部件野蛮地拼接到一起——虽说不可靠，但也算是在专业车间之外能造出的最复杂的枪支了。这一把使用 .45 ACP 弹，可通过 MAC-10 冲锋枪弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: A submachine gun chambered in .45 ACP and accepting Thompson magazines.
translations: 一把 .45 ACP 口径的冲锋枪，使用汤普森冲锋枪弹匣。
汤普森 M1928A1 冲锋枪

messages.msgid: An American-made submachine gun developed during the very end of World War I, too late to see action.  Infamous during the 1920s for its use by gangsters, and used during World War II before being mostly replaced with less-expensive alternatives.
translations: 一把美国制造的冲锋枪，于一战末期研发——末到这枪还没来得及造出来上战场一战就结束了。不过汤普逊冲锋枪在二十世纪20年代，以“汤米枪”、“芝加哥打字机”之名流行于黑帮，也在二战时期，在比其更廉价的替代品被研发之前被美军列装使用过。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in .45 ACP and accepting USP magazines.
translations: 一把 .45 ACP 口径的半自动手枪，使用 USP 弹匣。

messages.msgid: A popular pistol, widely used among law enforcement.  Extensively tested for durability, it has been found to stay accurate even after being subjected to extreme abuse.
translations: 一把被执法机关广泛使用的手枪。即使在被过度摧残后仍能保持其精度，其耐用性毋庸置疑。

messages.msgid: Jokingly referred to as "The World's Only Crew-Served Pistol", this massive pistol was designed as a primary weapon for select "special operators".  Its cumbersome nature, the introduction of the derivative HK USP series, and the logistics of getting .45 ACP ammunition in theater doomed this behemoth to US SOCOM armories.  Like the USP, the MK 23 is a remarkably reliable gun; someone could probably take out a nuclear-equipped walking tank with this in their holster.
translations: 这款大型手枪被戏称为"世界上唯一需要班组操作的手枪"，最初是为特定"特种作战人员"设计的主战武器。其笨重的特性、衍生型号 HK USP 系列的推出，以及在战区获取 .45 ACP 弹药的后勤难题，共同注定了这个庞然大物只能被封存在美国特种作战司令部的军械库中。与 USP 相似，MK 23 是一款具有非凡可靠性的枪械；或许有人能凭着腰间枪套里的它，单枪匹马摧毁装备核武器的步行坦克。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in .45 ACP and accepting PPQ magazines.
translations: 一把 .45 ACP 口径的半自动手枪，使用 PPQ 弹匣。

messages.msgid: The Walther PPQ is a semi-automatic pistol originating from the Walther P99QA, and maintains compatibility with some of its predecessor's accessories.  This model is chambered in .45 ACP.
translations: 瓦尔特 PPQ 手枪是基于瓦尔特 P99QA 手枪研制的半自动手枪，保留了一些对其部件的兼容性。这个型号发射的是 .45 ACP 弹药。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in .45 ACP and accepting Hi-Point magazines.
translations: 一把 .45 ACP 口径的半自动手枪，使用 Hi-Point 弹匣。

messages.msgid: The Hi-Point Model JHP is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.
translations: Hi-Point Model JHP 手枪是由Hi-Point公司设计的一把采用反冲式枪机的半自动手枪。该公司以制造廉价枪械而闻名，但为了降低造价，所生产的武器常常造型臃肿且手感较差。Hi-Point公司的枪械普遍使用锌合金制的套筒，相比传统钢制套筒来说比较脆弱。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in .45 ACP and accepting Glock magazines.
translations: 一把 .45 ACP 口径的半自动手枪，使用格洛克弹匣。

messages.msgid: A full-sized version of the highly successful Glock.  This model is chambered in .45 ACP.
translations: 一把出自广受欢迎的格洛克系列的全尺寸手枪。该型号发射 .45 ACP 口径弹药。

messages.msgid: A Glock compact pistol chambered in .45 ACP.  Accepts the same magazines as its older brothers.
translations: 一把发射 .45 ACP 口径弹药的紧凑型格洛克手枪，可以兼容同系列旧款手枪的弹匣。

messages.msgid: A Glock subcompact pistol chambered in .45 ACP.  Due to its slim construction, it only accepts Glock 36 magazines.
translations: 一把发射 .45 ACP 口径弹药的超紧凑型格洛克手枪。由于其过小的结构，它只能使用专用的格洛克 36 弹匣。

messages.msgid: A WWII submachine gun, lacking semi-auto fire selector and chambered in .45 ACP.
translations: 一把二战时期使用的冲锋枪，没有半自动快慢机，发射 .45 ACP 弹药。

messages.msgid: An American-made submachine gun developed during WWII as an alternative to Thompson M1928A1 and used at least till early 1990s.  Simple, cheap, and somewhat crude, the M3 was still quite an effective weapon, mostly made from sheet metal to reduce costs and speed up production.  In times of active use, it was considered as a disposable weapon, which is more expedient to replace than to repair.  Unfortunately, you cannot afford such wastefulness, unlike this submachine gun, which is devoid of even a fire selector for semi-auto fire.
translations: 一把二战时期美国生产的冲锋枪，用来替代 汤普森 M1928A1 并一直服役到90年代早期。因为价格低廉、结构简单，整枪主要由金属板材制成来降低成本并加快生产，M3 冲锋枪仍是相当实用的武器。在服役期间，它曾被当作可抛弃武器来使用，因为换新比维修更便宜。可惜你做不到像这把枪一样浪费，它甚至没有半自动开火的切换功能。
鲁格 美式牧场步枪

messages.msgid: A compact, magazine-fed, bolt-action hunting rifle designed and manufactured with cost-effectiveness at the peak of concerns, the Ruger American Ranch Rifle series caters to shooters on a budget.  Factory chambered for the powerful, though short-range, .450 Bushmaster cartridge, the weapon was able to stand toe-to-toe with all native North American game despite its minimalist design.
translations: 一把紧凑的弹匣供弹的栓动式狩猎步枪，鲁格美式牧场系列步枪切中要害地考虑了购买者的预算问题，设计与生产都考虑到了成本问题。原厂使用射程较近但威力强劲的 .450大毒蛇 弹药，所以即使有着极简设计也能在北美本土猎枪市场有它的一席之地。
陶鲁斯 "愤怒公牛" 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: The Taurus Raging Bull is a 5-shot revolver chambered in .454 Casull.  It has impressive stopping power.
translations: 陶鲁斯 "愤怒公牛"左轮手枪发射 .454 卡苏尔弹，弹容量5发，这种子弹的停止力很优异。

messages.msgid: A handy but powerful lever-action rifle chambered for .45-70 Government.  Designed for wilderness guides for defense against large predators such as grizzly bears, moose, and dinosaurs.
translations: 一种轻便但威力强大的杠杆式步枪，使用威力极大的 .45-70 口径子弹。专为野外狩猎大型动物，例如灰熊、驼鹿等而设计。

messages.msgid: A handy but powerful lever-action rifle chambered for .45-70 Government, the Marlin 1895 SBL was designed as a guide rifle, a rifle designed to defend against animals such as bears in the wilderness.  While advertised as capable of defending against T-Rex, there has yet been any testing against actual T-Rexes, and hopefully remains that way.
translations: 马林 1895 SBL 是一款实用且强大的杠杆式步枪，使用.45-70 政府弹步枪。这把枪作为向导步枪而设计，用于在野外防御熊等动物。虽然广告宣称它能够抵御霸王龙，但还没有针对真正的霸王龙进行过测试，希望最好不用。

messages.msgid: A massive single-action revolver.  While the .45-70 rifle round loses significant velocity in its short pistol barrel, it still competes with other large magnum handguns in terms of power.
translations: 一款体积巨大的单动左轮手枪。虽然使用较短的手枪枪管发射 .45-70 口径步枪子弹使其枪口初速下降了不少，但它与其他马格南手枪相比威力依旧要大许多。（注：BFR意为Biggest Finest Revolver，最大最优秀的左轮手枪）
马格南研究所 BFR 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: The Magnum Research BFR (Biggest, Finest Revolver) are a series of single action revolvers chambered in calibers from anywhere from .357 Magnum, to rifle calibers such as 45-70.  While rifle caliber chamberings for pistols are no doubt uncomfortable to shoot, they do see some use in the sport of handgun hunting, or rarely as range toys.  Due to its loading gate, it prevents the use of speedloaders and can make for lengthy reload times, so it's best to make every shot count.
translations: 马格南研究所出品的 BFR（意思是最大、最精良的左轮手枪）是一系列单动左轮手枪，其口径涵盖了从 .357 马格南到.45-70 等步枪弹药。手枪发射步枪弹的体验并不舒适，但它们在手枪狩猎运动中仍然有用武之地，偶尔也会作为靶场玩具。由于其装弹口设计，无法使用快速装弹器，导致重新装弹耗时较长，尽量每一颗子弹都消灭一个敌人。

messages.msgid: A reproduction of an antique single-shot .45-70 rifle once used to hunt buffalo and other large game in the late 19th Century.  Highly accurate and powerful for the time, this one is made to handle modern smokeless ammunition.
translations: 一把19世纪单发步枪的仿制品，采用 .45-70 口径，曾在19世纪末用于狩猎野牛和其他大型猎物。在当时高度精确和威力强大，这款型号已被改造为使用现代无烟火药。

messages.msgid: The Sharps rifle series are antique, falling block rifles that saw service far back as the American Civil War.  The 1874 Sharps is one of the first rifles to utilize metallic cartridges, a revolutionary technology back in those days.  While they were chambered in 45-70, modern day smokeless loads would blow up older versions.  Thankfully, this reproduction from Uberti can handle modern day 45-70 loads.
translations: 夏普斯步枪是一系列堪称古董的，使用下落式枪机的步枪，早在美国内战时期就开始服役。1874 年的夏普斯步枪是最早使用金属弹壳的步枪之一，在当时是一项革命性技术。虽然发射的是45-70 弹，但现代的无烟火药会让这堆老枪炸膛。庆幸的是，这把由乌伯蒂生产的复刻品能承受现代的 45-70 弹。

messages.msgid: A bolt-action sporting rifle for hunting dangerous game, chambered in the powerful .458 Winchester Magnum cartridge.
translations: 一种用于危险狩猎游戏的栓动式运动步枪，装有威力强大的.458温彻斯特马格南弹药。
温彻斯特 M70 游猎步枪

messages.msgid: This is a Winchester Model 70 Safari Express chambered in .458 Winchester Magnum, a fine bolt-action rifle for hunting dangerous game.  A fixture of American gun culture, the Model 70 has been held in high regard by shooters since it was introduced in 1936.
translations: 一款由装载.458温彻斯特马格南弹药的温彻斯特 M70 游猎步枪，一种用于危险狩猎游戏的栓动式运动步枪，作为美国枪支文化的一部分，M70自1936年推出后便备受射手们的重视。

messages.msgid: The Bond Arms Derringer is a series of multi-barrel compact pistols.  Most commonly chambered for .45 Colt, with chambers long enough to accept .410 shotgun shells.
translations: 邦德军械厂德林加手枪是该系列的多管轻便型手枪型号。常见型号采用 .45 柯尔特口径，但枪室也足够长，可以发射 .410 口径霰弹。
邦德军械厂德林加手枪

messages.msgid: Derringers are old-fashioned conceal carry weapons, usually sporting one or two barrels.  The Bond Arms Derringer is a modern series of multi-barrel compact pistols.  Most commonly chambered for .45 Colt, with chambers long enough to accept .410 shotgun shells.  Though, with modern handguns, derringers have become less and less practical as a conceal carry option.
translations: 德林加手枪是一款老式的隐蔽携带武器，通常具有一到两个枪管。邦德武器公司的德林加手枪是现代化的多枪管紧凑型手枪系列，通常使用 .45 口径 柯尔特弹，并且弹膛足够长，能够容纳 .410 霰弹。然而，随着现代手枪的普及，德林加手枪在隐蔽携带方面的实用性正在逐渐降低。
牛仔式 六发左轮手枪

messages.msgid: A reproduction of an antique firearm, chambered in .45 Colt.  Due to the lack of a swing-out cylinder, each cartridge must be reloaded and ejected manually.
translations: 一把古董枪械的复制品，发射 .45 柯尔特子弹。由于缺少外摆式转轮，每发弹药必须要手动装填及弹出。
柯尔特 单动陆军型 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: A famous revolver for many westerns, the Colt Single Action Army has seen plenty of military service, production ends, and production restarts.  While originally in a large amount of chamberings, it is mostly found in .45 Colt chamberings today.  While reloading is slow due to the lack of a swing-out cylinder, it was still much faster than earlier revolvers of the time thanks to using metallic cartridges.  It's also sometimes referred to as the Peacemaker, Model P, M1873 or shortened to SAA.
translations: 作为一把深受许多西部牛仔青睐的左轮手枪，柯尔特单动式陆军见证了大量的兵役，生产的结束和生产的重启。虽然起初使用多种规格的机匣，但如今最多的还是 .45 柯尔特机匣。由于缺少外摆式转轮，装填速度缓慢，但由于使用了金属弹药，它仍然比当时早期的左轮手枪快得多。它有时也被称为"和平缔造者"，Model P，M1873或直接被简称为SAA。
乌贝蒂 1873 "牛仔" 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: This 7.5" barreled Uberti Cattleman is a modern reproduction of the legendary Colt Single Action Army, or Colt Peacemaker, one of the first revolvers to use a modern self-contained cartridge.  Made famous by Westerns, it is still in demand for Cowboy Action Shooting, reenactors, and collectors.  Unlike modern revolvers, the cylinder cannot swing out for loading, and spent brass must be ejected one at a time.
translations: 乌贝蒂 "牛仔"左轮手枪枪管长 7.5 英寸，是手枪传奇柯尔特单动式陆军左轮手枪的现代重制版。柯尔特单动式陆军左轮手枪又称柯尔特"和平使者"左轮，是较早采用现代化的定装弹药的左轮手枪。它因西部电影而声名远扬，在牛仔射击运动、历史表演和收藏界也仍有流通。与现代左轮手枪不同，它的转轮在装弹时不能摆出，而发射后的弹壳也必须单个依次退出。

messages.msgid: A stainless steel 5 shot revolver, capable of firing .410 shells or 45 Colt cartridges.
translations: 这是一款不锈钢材质的五发左轮手枪，既能发射.410口径霰弹，也能使用.45柯尔特弹药。
陶鲁斯 “判官” 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: Marketed for home defense, the Taurus Judge is a 5 shot cylinder revolver, capable of firing .410 shotshells or .45 Colt cartridges out of it's 3 inch barrel.  While it doesn't compete ballistically with a proper rifle, or even a full length revolver, it's still a handy handgun against the undead and soon to be.
translations: 陶鲁斯 “判官” 左轮手枪以其在家防领域的适用性而著称，是一款五发转轮的手枪，能从其3英寸枪管中发射.410口径霰弹或.45柯尔特弹药。尽管在弹道性能上无法与标准步枪或是全长转轮手枪相匹敌，但它对抗丧尸或其他即将来临的威胁时，依旧是一款便于操作且实用的手枪。

messages.msgid: Designed as a personal defense weapon, the MP7 fires the high-powered 4.6x30mm round while being lightweight, compact in size, and practically recoil-free.
translations: 作为个人防卫武器而设计的MP7，可发射强力的4.6x30mm子弹，同时轻便紧凑且几乎无后坐力。
.460 S&W 马格南 左轮手枪

messages.msgid: A behemoth of a revolver, with an 8.38" barrel, weighing almost 2 kilograms, and sporting an impressive muzzle break.  With how powerful the .460 S&W Magnum round is, those features won't be taken for granted.  Often used as a hunting handgun, or as a bush gun, this large revolver is a formidable threat.

The S&W 460 XVR is a behemoth of a revolver, with an 8.38" barrel, weighing almost 2 kilograms, and sporting an impressive muzzle break.  With how powerful the .460 S&W Magnum round is, those features won't be taken for granted.  Often used as a hunting handgun, or as a bush gun, this large revolver is a formidable threat.

A mahoosive rifle of military pedigree, fitted with a telescopic gun scope peeking over its giant cocking mechanism and resting upon a bipod to control recoil from the equally big .50-caliber munitions it is designed for.  Originally employed for detonating unexploded ordnance in combat conditions and defeating light vehicular and structural targets, in the post-Cataclysm it serves as an admirable conduit of kinetic energy to the biggest and baddest of the new world's critters.
translations: 一款具有军方背景的巨型步枪，其巨大的上膛机构上安装有伸缩式瞄准镜，并架设在三脚架上，并配备了用于控制 .50 口径巨大后坐力的两脚架。最初设计用于在战斗中引爆未爆弹药，以及摧毁轻型车辆和建筑物。在大灾变后，成为了对抗新世界中最强大和最凶猛的怪物的理想工具，将动能传递到血肉上的不二选择。
巴雷特 M107A1 狙击步枪

messages.msgid: A large, shoulder-fired, .50 caliber anti-materiel rifle.  Its large size, recoil, and noise is offset by its damage and range.
translations: 一把巨型肩扛式 .50 口径反器材步枪。其威力和射程足以可以抵消巨大的尺寸、后坐力以及噪音带来的不便。

messages.msgid: Essentially a giant steel box with a long barrel peering from one end and dual spade grips mounted upon the other, this venerable machine gun design served the United States military since the First World War, mounted on everything from tanks to patrol boats to aircraft, and even tripod-mounted for stand-alone use.  Part and parcel with its size and munition payload of .50-caliber ammo belts, however, is the fact that, to operate it, one must mount it upon suitable furniture, terrain features, or vehicles.
translations: 这款经典的机枪设计本质上是个大钢箱子，一端伸出长枪管，另一端安装了双D形握把。自第一次世界大战以来一直服役于美军，广泛安装在坦克、巡逻艇、飞机上，甚至可以架设在三脚架上独立使用。考虑到它的体积和 .50 弹链的弹药重量，操作者必须将其架设在合适的平台、地形，或车辆上。

messages.msgid: A heavy machine gun used by the US Military from its inception to the Cataclysm, and even rarely by Cataclysm survivors.  Its massive size and design make it impossible to use unless deployed or mounted to a vehicle.
translations: 美国军队在大灾变之初大量使用的重型机枪，在幸存者之中也有少量保有。其巨大的体积和独特结构使它几乎无法使用，除非被安装在载具上。

messages.msgid: Pin-point accurate out to one and a half kilometers and cycling its .50-caliber feed from detachable, 10-round magazines, this combat sniper's weapon provides users with a comfortable window to engage targets at a distance.  Its imposing bullets ensure that it is more than capable of delivering an adequate account of itself at such ranges.
translations: 这款战斗狙击枪的精确射程可达一公里半，使用可拆卸的 10 发弹匣供弹 .50 口径弹药，为使用者提供了一个舒适的远距离射击窗口。其威力强大的弹药确保在如此远的距离上也能充分发挥杀伤力。
精密国际 AS50 反器材步枪

messages.msgid: Developed by Accuracy International, the AI AS50 is a semi-automatic .50 caliber anti-materiel rifle produced for the British armed forces and the United States Navy SEALs.  With a free-floated barrel, titanium frame, and an accessory rail integrated into the weapon's receiver with two others mounted on each side of the barrel shroud, the rifle features commendable ergonomics and a notable level of modularity.  Providing operators with the capability to engage targets at an estimated max range of 1500 meters, the firearm feeds from 10-round box magazines.
translations: 由英国精确步枪公司”精密国际“生产，精密国际 AS50 步枪是为英国武装部队和美国海军海豹突击队设计生产的半自动 .50 口径反器材步枪。采用自由浮动枪管、钛制枪身，且机匣顶部及枪管护木两侧分别有一条导轨，使整枪具有值得称赞的人体工学设计和极高的模块化水平。赋予使用者在最大约1500米的射程打击目标的能力，且使用10发盒式弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: Serving both anti-materiel and high-priority sniping roles in their service with various militaries, bolt-action rifles, such as this one, were known for their long ranges of engagement, recoil, and armor-defeating ordinance.  Essentially a step below light cannonry, as far as shoulder-arms are concerned, this weapon's mix of power and accuracy meet hands to ensure that, before the Cataclysm, one shot was synonymous with one very, very dead target.
translations: 这款栓动步枪在各军队中都承担着反器材和高优先级狙击的任务，以其超远的射程、强大的后坐力以及能够摧毁装甲的弹药而闻名。从肩扛式武器的角度来看，威力几乎可媲美轻型火炮。这款武器集强大的破坏力和精确的射击能力于一身，确保了在大灾难之前，一枪就足以将目标彻底摧毁。
麦克米兰 TAC-50 狙击步枪

messages.msgid: A long-range anti-materiel and anti-personnel sniper rifle made by McMillan Firearms, serving the Canadian Army since 2000 as the C15, and the Navy Seals as the Mk 15 Mod 0.  This .50 caliber bolt-action rifle is capable of defeating light vehicles, radar installations and crew-served weapons at extreme distances.  It notably held the longest-range confirmed sniper kill, as well as the 4th and 5th longest.
translations: 由麦克米兰枪械公司制造的远程反器材和反步兵狙击步枪，自2000年进入加拿大陆军服役，代号为 C15 步枪，在美国海豹突击队代号为 Mk 15 Mod 0 步枪。这款 .50 口径的栓动步枪能够在极远的距离击毁轻型车辆、雷达装置和班组武器。值得注意的是，它保持着世界上射程最远的狙击手确认击杀纪录，以及世界第四和第五远的确认击杀纪录。

messages.msgid: Relatively trim as far as .50-caliber rifles go, this single-shot firearm was a reasonably affordable entry-level gun for civilians wishing to play with some very large, very punchy toys.  Now, at the world's Armageddon, it would be wise to make that singular round-capacity count on some high-priority craniums.
translations: 就.50口径步枪而言，这把单发步枪较为苗条，价格实惠，是那些想玩大狙的平民的入门之选。现在世界末日已经降临，最好保证一发子弹消灭一个高价值目标。
谢尔布 BFG-50 狙击步枪

messages.msgid: A single-shot, bolt-action rifle made by Serbu Firearms, the BFG-50 was a very affordable firearm for those wishing to shoot .50 BMG.
translations: BFG-50 步枪是由谢尔布武器公司生产的单发栓动步枪，对于那些希望射击 .50 BMG 弹药的人来说，这是一款非常便宜的枪械。

messages.msgid: The definition of 'overkill', this behemoth handgun puts large .44 caliber revolvers to shame with its sheer size, power, and immense chambering.  Firing the appropriately named .500 Magnum cartridge, the most powerful handgun round in the world, the weapon has seen work in both sport shooting and hunting roles.  A pistol for those of the 'bigger is better' mentality, a high recoil junky's personal dream, and an all-around useless military sidearm, should the urge to assault the Cataclysm in fine style grip you, this giant provides you with 5 rounds with which to reduce a zombie into an afterthought.
translations: 这把大口径左轮本身便是"威力过剩"的诠释，它的尺寸、威力和巨大的枪膛使.44口径的大型左轮相形见绌。发射的是一种命名为.500 马格南弹的，号称世界上威力最大的手枪弹，该武器已经在射击运动和狩猎中有所应用。这把手枪满足了那些"大就是好"的心态，和每一个后坐力瘾君子的个人梦想，也是把全方位都显得鸡肋的军用手枪。当心中涌起豪迈地向大灾变发起反击的冲动时，这个5发弹巢的大家伙能让丧尸化作你的事后回忆。

messages.msgid: The 5-shot Smith and Wesson 500 revolver fires the comparably-named .500 S&W Magnum.  It's an impressive weapon.
translations: 这把5发的 S&W 500 左轮手枪发射以该公司为名的.500 S&W 马格南子弹，这是把优秀的武器。

messages.msgid: Flaunting classically iconic lines and a profile instantly recognizable to any viewer, this American semi-automatic weapon is a replica of the AK-47 rifle's technological descendant, the AK-74, a weapon with more notable differences from its elder sibling than simply flipping the order of its name's numbers.  Firing the rare, at least for the United States, 5.45x39mm Soviet cartridge, this clone makes use of original 5.45mm banana magazines.  Considering the scarcity of its munitions, you might be obliged to resort to hand-loading your own ammunition.
translations: 这把美国制造的半自动武器，以其经典的标志性线条和任何人都能一眼认出的外观而出名，是AK-47步枪技术后裔AK-74的复制品，这种武器与其前辈的区别不仅仅是名字数字顺序的颠倒。它发射的是美国少见的5.45x39mm苏式弹药，使用原装的5.45mm香蕉（弧形）弹匣。考虑到其弹药的稀缺性，你可能不得不自己动手复装弹药。

messages.msgid: A rifle of the Cold War, or at least a dead ringer for it, this weapon is a semi-automatic clone of the Soviet Union's standard assault rifle following 1974.  Either a locally-built replica or produced from an imported, foreign parts kit, fitted with a fixed wooden buttstock, a side-mounted optics rail, and a barrel threaded for suppressors, the rifle's chambered for the Russian 5.45x39mm cartridge and feeds from AK-74 magazines.  A Communist gun built in Capitalist America; bar hoofing it to eastern Europe, the weapon's likely the closest you'll ever get to laying your palms on a Russian Kalashnikov.
translations: 这是一款冷战时期的半自动步枪，或至少是它的完美复制品。这把武器是苏联1974年后标准突击步枪的克隆品，要么是本地制造的，要么是由进口的外国零件组装而成。它配备了固定木质枪托、侧装光学瞄具导轨和可安装消音器的枪管，并且采用5.45x39mm俄罗斯口径弹药，使用AK-74弹匣。这是一把在资本主义美国制造的共产主义武器；除非你能亲自前往东欧，否则这很可能是你能接触到的最接近俄罗斯卡拉什尼科夫步枪的武器了。

messages.msgid: An American copy of a Soviet assault rifle, a strange piece of ordinance using some weird proprietary Russian ammunition—all these terms and more can describe this rifle: a semi-automatic clone of the Kalashnikov AKS-74, the descendant of the iconic AKM.  Either a locally-built replica or produced from an imported, foreign parts kit, the firearm possesses a triangular, folding buttstock, a side-mounted optics rail, and a threaded barrel for attaching muzzle devices.  The weapon fires the Soviet 5.45x39mm cartridge—a unicorn even in the American gun wilderness—and feeds said unicorn ammunition from AK-74 magazines.
translations: 这款步枪是苏联突击步枪的美国仿制品，使用一种奇怪的、专有的俄罗斯弹药——所有这些术语都可以用来描述它：卡拉什尼科夫 AKS-74 的半自动仿制版，经典 AKM 步枪的后代。这支枪要么是本地制造的仿制品，要么是用进口的外国零件组装而成。配有一个三角形折叠枪托、一个侧装光学瞄准镜导轨，和一个用于安装枪口装置的螺纹枪管。发射苏联 5.45x39mm 弹药——即使在美国枪支领域也相当罕见——并使用 AK-74 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: A special forces Russian rifle chambered in 5.45.  This version uses standard Picatinny rails, has modern lightweight furniture and a unique complex recoil balance system for high fire rate with minimal recoil.  It combines the reliability of the AK series with the high-velocity, lightweight 5.45x39mm cartridge and accepts standard AK-74M magazines.
translations: 一把俄罗斯特种部队使用的 5.45mm 口径步枪。该型号使用标准皮卡汀尼导轨，配备现代化轻型枪托以及独特而复杂的后坐力平衡系统，在提供高射速的同时最大限度控制后坐力。它将AK系列的可靠性与高速、轻便的5.45x39mm 弹药相结合，并能使用AK-74M的制式弹匣。

messages.msgid: Firing the armor-piercing 5.7x28mm round, this lightweight handgun was developed for NATO use as a sidearm capable of penetrating body armor.  Its proprietary and nonprolific ammunition kept it comparatively rare among both civilian and militant use, but the gun's ability to ignore most forms of conventional ballistic armor can't be argued with.  Given that its tiny bullets have next to no stopping power, its armor-penetrating capability comes at a considerable trade-off.
translations: 这把轻便的手枪发射5.7x28mm穿甲弹，是为北约设计的配枪，能够穿透防弹衣。它使用专有且不普及的弹药，所以在民间和军事用途中都比较罕见。但这把枪穿甲能力毋庸置疑。不过，由于它的小型子弹杀伤力很弱，这种穿甲能力是以牺牲停止力为代价的。

messages.msgid: Designed to work with FN's proprietary 5.7x28mm round, the Five-seveN is a lightweight pistol with a very high capacity, best used against armored opponents.
translations:
一款专为 FN 赫斯塔尔公司特有的 5.7x28mm 口径子弹设计的轻型手枪，有着较高的准确度和弹容量，对穿戴护甲的敌人特别有效。细胞分裂中一直伴随山姆费舍尔的手枪原型。
"瞄准，行刑！"
P90 自动单兵防卫武器

messages.msgid: A late 90s manufactured personal defense weapon (PDW), this automatic firearm fires the high-velocity, proprietary 5.7x28mm cartridge.  Making use of top-mounted 50-round custom magazines which lock into the receiver of the weapon behind the grip, this little submachine gun packs quite the nasty payload.  Its small, high-speed caliber makes it excellent at both defeating armored opponents and firing short bursts manageably.
translations: 作为90年代末生产的个人防卫武器(PDW)，这把全自动枪支发射高速的5.7x28mm特制子弹。利用顶部安装的50发定制弹匣锁定在握把后的机匣中，这把小型冲锋枪火力十足。它的小型高速子弹更使其在对抗着甲目标和进行可控短连射方面表现出色。

messages.msgid: The first in a new genre of guns, termed "personal defense weapons."  FN designed the P90 to use their proprietary high-velocity 5.7x28mm ammunition.  Made to fulfill NATO requests for a weapon chambered in a more suitable cartridge for defeating body armor than standard 9x19mm submachine guns, the FN P90 is excellent at firing short and controllable bursts manageably.  The PDW's small and high-speed 5.7mm ammunition, of which 50 rounds fit in the P90's top mounted magazine, packs quite the lethal payload for any armored opponent, whilst the firearm's bullpup design makes it commendably compact to boot.
translations: 世界上第一支使用了全新弹药的"个人防卫武器"。P90使用的是 FN 公司专有的高初速的 5.7x28mm 口径子弹。为了满足北约对一种能够使用比标准 9x19mm 冲锋枪更适合击穿防弹衣的弹药的武器的要求而设计，FN P90冲锋枪在单发和短连发时表现出色。PDW使用小巧而高速的 5.7mm 弹药，50发子弹能轻松放进安装在P90冲锋枪顶部的弹匣之中，能向任何装甲对手倾泻相当致命的火力，而枪械的无托式设计使其具有值得称赞的紧凑性。

messages.msgid: A large and retro-looking semi-automatic pistol firing the high-velocity 5.7x28mm cartridge, mainly constructed out of polymer-based materials.  Making use of standard P90 50-round magazines which are inserted horizontally over the grip, the top of the gun swings forwards and away from the frame to facilitate reloading.  If you were looking to add a touch of retro-futuristic spice to your new life in the ruins of New England, this firearm just might become your best friend.
translations: 一把外观复古的大型半自动手枪，使用高初速的5.7x28mm弹药，枪身主要由聚合物材料制成。标配 5.7x28mm 50发弹匣，将其水平插入握把上方，枪械顶部在装弹时向前展开，与枪身分离，便于重新装弹。如果你想为新英格兰废土上的新生活增添一丝复古未来主义的情趣，这把枪可能会成为你最好的伙伴。

messages.msgid: Unique, adaptable, and extremely retro, the Kel-Tec P50 is a truly bizarre semi-automatic pistol.  Having been regarded as possibly one of the most innovative firearms from Kel-Tec's entire line-up of guns, the P50 makes use of the high velocity 5.7x28mm cartridge, and feeds from standard FN P90 magazines.  Boasting ambidextrous controls, an AR-15-like T-shaped charging handle, and a reload which involves swinging the receiver and barrel assemblies up and away from the frame to insert the magazine horizontally over the grip, this weapon lends a decidedly retro-futuristic touch to almost any situation.
translations: 外观独特，适应性强，非常复古，凯尔科技 P50 冲锋枪是一款造型十分怪异的半自动手枪。P50手枪被认为可能是凯尔科技公司整个系列枪支中最具创新性的枪支之一，它使用高初速的5.7x28mm弹药，并用标准FN P90冲锋枪弹匣供弹。具有双手操控能力、一个类似AR-15步枪的T形上膛拉柄和一个特殊的装填装置，将机匣和枪管组件向上掰开，将弹匣水平插入握柄上方，这把枪几乎在任何情况下都具有绝对复古未来主义风格。

messages.msgid: Produced by the Ruger gun company, this full-sized pistol makes use of the 5.7x28mm cartridge.  One of the first pistols to both make use of the unusual round and achieve market success within the civilian world, it opened the door for accessible 5.7mm shooting due to its low price and reliable design.
translations: 由鲁格枪械公司生产，这把全尺寸手枪使用5.7×28mm 弹药。是第一把既使用了特种弹又得到了民用市场销量的手枪，以低廉的价格和可靠的设计为想接触的人打开了5.7mm 弹药射击的大门。

messages.msgid: A full-sized polymer framed handgun chambered in the unusual 5.7x28mm cartridge, the Ruger-57 was one of the first commercially available 5.7mm pistols on the market, with its main competitor being FN's decades-old, and far pricier, Five-seveN pistol.  Featuring a lightweight ergonomic design, 1911-style thumb-safety, a high visibility green front-sight with adjustable black rear iron-sights, and a price point which hovered a good 500 dollars below its competition, the Ruger-57 made the comparatively niche 5.7x28mm round far more accessible to a wider margin of potential shooters.
translations: 这是一把采用罕见的5.7x28mm弹药的全尺寸聚合物枪框手枪 - 鲁格-57。它是市面上最早的商业5.7mm手枪之一，主要竞争对手是FN公司几十年前推出的、价格高得多的Five-seveN手枪。鲁格-57采用轻量化人体工程学设计，配备1911式手动保险，带有高亮绿色前瞄具和可调节黑色后瞄具，而且售价比竞争对手低500美元左右，使得这种相对小众的5.7x28mm弹药更容易为更广泛的潜在射击爱好者所接受。
半自动 P90 卡宾枪

messages.msgid: The civilian version of the older 5.7mm PDW, this carbine features a 16 inch long barrel, feeds from the same 50-round magazines as its predecessor, and is only capable of semi-automatic fire in order to keep it in line with American firearm restrictions.
translations: 上一代5.7mm PDW的民用版本，特点是16英寸（约41厘米）的长枪管，标志性的50发弹匣。但由于美国枪支管理规定的限制，仅有半自动射击的功能。

messages.msgid: Originally introduced in 2005, the PS90 is the civilian clone of the venerable FN P90, sharing much of the same characteristics and features as its fully-automatic older brother.  Chambering the same 5.7x28mm cartridge as its predecessor, in order to make it a legally distributable carbine in the eyes of the law the PS90 was manufactured to only be capable of semi-automatic fire, with a fitted-on 16-inch long barrel to sidestep NFA regulations on short-barreled rifles.
translations: PS90卡宾枪最初是在2005年推出的，它是广为人知的FN P90冲锋枪的民用版，与它的全自动哥哥有着许多相同的外观和功能。它和它的前辈采用了相同的5.7x28mm口径，为了使其在法律上成为一种可以合法出售的卡宾枪，PS90卡宾枪只能进行半自动射击，并配有一根16英寸（约41厘米）的长枪管，以规避NFA协会对短管步枪的限制。

messages.msgid: Lightweight Company Mortar System is a portable mortar that can be carried and used by a one person, even if much slower than with a full crew of three.  Luckily, someone attached a bunch of firing tables to it.  Whoever will use it should be prepared to spend plenty of time estimating distances and calculating correct elevation and rotation angles.
translations: 轻型连用迫击炮系统是一种便携式迫击炮，一个人就能携带和使用，尽管其发射速度比三人组成的完整炮组要慢得多。幸运的是，有人给它附上了射击诸元表。

messages.msgid: An American rocket launcher designed in the 1970s to replace WWII-era flamethrowers still in use in Vietnam.  It has four barrels sharing the 66mm caliber of the M72 LAW.
translations: 19 世纪 70 年代设计的美制火箭发射器，用于取代越战中仍有使用的二战老式火焰喷射器。这种火箭筒有四个发射管，使用与 M72 LAW 单兵火箭筒相同的 66mm 火箭弹。

messages.msgid: One of the most recognizable assault rifles ever made, the AKM is renowned for its durability even under the worst conditions.
translations: 世界名枪之一，AKM 步枪以其耐用性而闻名，即使在最糟的环境下也能正常射击。

messages.msgid: Arguably the most mass-produced firearm ever made, the AKM has cemented itself in history, and a few country flags.  Designed after WW2, it was meant to replace the PPSh-41's role, but soon became the main infantry rifle.  While many believe it is a copy of the German StG-44, it more resembles an M1 Garand in operation.  Despite it's age, it still sees plenty of use in conflicts today.
translations: AKM 可以说是历史上产量最高的枪支之一，它在历史长河中以及一些国家的国旗上都留下了自己不可磨灭的印记。这款步枪在第二次世界大战后设计，最初是为了取代 PPSh-41 的定位，但很快就成为了各国军队的主要步兵武器。虽然许多人认为它仿制了德国的 StG-44 突击步枪，但其操作原理更接近于美国的 M1 加兰德步枪。尽管问世已久，在现今的各种冲突中仍然可以看到AKM的身影。

messages.msgid: Developed by the Soviets in 1945, this rifle was quickly replaced by the full-auto AK-47.  However, due to its superb accuracy, low recoil, and deployable integrated bayonet, this gun maintains immense popularity.
translations: 苏联在1945年开发了这把步枪，随后它很快被全自动的AK-47取代了。然而，由于其极佳的精准度，低后坐力和集成刺刀，这把步枪仍然极受欢迎。

messages.msgid: A very common 7.62x39 rifle, the SKS was designed to replace the Mosin Nagant bolt action rifle, while the AK-47 was meant to replace the PPSh-41.  Mechanically, it resembles a much scaled down version of USSR's PTRS-41 semi automatic anti-tank rifle.  However, due to the success of the AK-47, the SKS was replaced by it in the USSR's Red Army.  It still saw service in other militaries, mainly other socialist states that got a surplus of SKS carbines from the USSR.  Due to the amount produced, it is a commonplace rifle in many gun owning American households.
translations: SKS 是一款十分常见的 7.62x39 步枪，最初被设计用来取代苏联的莫辛-纳甘步枪，而 AK-47 则是为了取代 PPSh-41 冲锋枪。在机械结构上，它很像苏联 PTRS-41 半自动反坦克步枪的缩小版。然而，由于 AK-47 的巨大成功，SKS 在苏联红军中被 AK-47 所取代。尽管如此，它仍然在其他国家的军队中服役，主要是一些从苏联获得了大量 SKS 卡宾枪的社会主义国家。由于生产数量巨大，它在许多拥有枪支的美国家庭中也很常见的步枪。

messages.msgid: Civilian-legal clones of the AK-47, with no ability to fire full-auto.  Despite lacking that ability, they're still reliable and useful rifles, even if much rarer ammo and magazine wise than the more common AR-15 platform.
translations: AK-47的合法民用版仿制枪，不具备全自动射击功能。尽管如此，这仍然是把可靠且实用的步枪，只是弹药和弹匣比起常见的AR-15系列而言更加少见。
世纪武器 VSKA 步枪

messages.msgid: This one is a VSKA, manufactured in the USA by Century Arms.
translations: 这把枪是 VSKA，由美国的世纪武器公司生产。
世纪武器 WASR-10 步枪

messages.msgid: This one is a WASR-10, imported by Century Arms.
translations: 这是由世纪武器公司进口的WASR -10。
扎斯塔瓦 ZPAP M70 步枪

messages.msgid: This one is a ZPAP M70, imported by Zastava.
translations: 一把由扎斯塔瓦公司进口至国内的 ZPAP M70 步枪。

messages.msgid: The CMMG Mk47 Mutant is an American rifle, natively chambered for 7.62x39mm ammo.  Features a characteristic free-floating handguard, with a similar action mechanism to the AR-15, repurposed for the bigger, more potent ammo.
translations: CMMG公司出品的 Mk47 "突变"步枪是一把美国步枪，本体采用 7.62x39mm 口径弹药。采用标志性的自由浮动式护手，具有与 AR-15 步枪类似的击发机制，但改用口径更大、威力更强的弹药。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic clone of the Czech Republic's standard infantry carbine, sold for civilian sport shooting and recreational use, this modular rifle makes use of the 7.62x39mm Soviet cartridge and uses proprietary magazines.
translations: 捷克共和国军队列装标准半自动卡宾枪的民用复刻版，常用于体育射击运动或是娱乐用途。这把模块化步枪使用苏制弹药及专用的弹匣。

messages.msgid: Hailing from the Czech Republic, this modular carbine supplanted the older CZ 805 rifle within Czech military use, improving upon the former's features and bringing fully ambidextrous controls, a streamlined design, and an easily adjustable gas system to the table.  Chambered for the 7.62x39mm Soviet cartridge, this particular weapon possesses a compact 11-inch barrel and is a civilian MS, 'modular semi-automatic,' model.  Incorporating a number of US-made parts, the weapon features a removable muzzle break rather than the flash hider that comes standard with military rifles.
translations: 这款来自捷克的模块化卡宾枪取代了捷克军队使用的老式CZ 805步枪，在前者的基础上进行了改进，增加了全双手操作控制、简洁流线的设计以及可轻松调节的气动系统。这款特定武器采用7.62x39mm苏联口径弹药，配备了11英寸的短枪管，是民用MS（模块化半自动）型号。它采用了一些美制零件，配备可拆卸的枪口刹车，而不是标准军用步枪上的消焰器。

messages.msgid: Strongly resembling the FN SCAR, with features and ergonomics inspired by the AR-18, this semi-automatic rifle is a civilian clone of the Czech Republic's formerly standard infantry carbine and was produced by the same company.  Discontinued in 2018, the rifle features an included muzzle break and adjustable folding buttstock, with this particular version being chambered in 7.62x39mm.
translations: 这款半自动步枪外观极其类似于FN SCAR，并且在功能和人体工程学设计上受到了AR-18的启发，它是捷克共和国曾经的标准步兵卡宾枪的民用克隆版本，由同一家公司生产。该步枪于2018年停产，其特点包括一个固定的消焰器和可调节的折叠式枪托，这个特定版本采用7.62x39mm口径。

messages.msgid: A later produced and substantially shortened version of Imperial Russia's original service rifle, this variant of the Mosin features a notably more compact barrel and an integral side-folding bayonet.  Produced during the latter days of the Second World War for the Soviet Union, the weapon exhibits less overall stopping power than its full-length older brother thanks to the former's stubbier barrel.  Despite the arm being somewhat weaker than its forefather, the 7.62x54mm round that it chambers still packs a hefty punch, whilst its smaller size helps to make the weapon wieldier.
translations: 这款步枪是沙俄原始制式步枪的后期生产版本，大幅缩短了枪管，并且有一个一体式侧折式刺刀。该型号是在第二次世界大战后期为苏联生产的，由于枪管较短，其整体制止力比原始的全长版本要弱一些。尽管如此，它依然使用7.62x54mm口径弹药，威力依然很大，而较小的尺寸使得这款步枪更容易操控。
莫辛纳甘 M44 卡宾枪

messages.msgid: The Model 44 is the carbine-sized variant of the standard 1891/30.  It has a shorter barrel, making it weaker than the 1891/30, but easier to carry.  This weapon also comes with an integrated side-folding bayonet.
translations: 莫辛-纳甘 M1944是1891/30步枪的卡宾版本。它的枪管更短一些，因此火力比1891/30步枪小，但是易于携带。
莫辛纳甘 M44-EBR 卡宾枪

messages.msgid: This carbine packs the classic Mosin-Nagant Model 44 action in a modern-day stock capable of accepting modifications.
translations: 这把卡宾枪将传统的莫辛纳甘44式步枪和现代可调整枪托结合在一起。
莫辛纳甘 战斗步枪

messages.msgid: Developed by the Russian Empire prior to the onset of the First World War, the Mosin is a bolt-action military battle rifle chambered for 7.62x54mm rounds.  Powerful, unwieldy, and prolific across the world as military surplus, this sizable rifle is a Soviet updated version of the venerable Mosin.
translations: 莫辛纳甘步枪，于第一次世界大战前夕由俄罗斯帝国所研制，是一种口径为7.62x54mm的栓动步枪。这种威力大、不够便携，产量巨大的步枪作为军备剩余品而遍布全球。这款长莫辛是苏联时期的改进型。

messages.msgid: The Mosin-Nagant 1891/30 is a bolt-action, internal magazine-fed military rifle, developed by the Russian Empire and later used and perfected by the Soviet Union.
translations: 莫辛-纳甘 1891/30 是一种旋转后拉式、使用内置弹仓供弹的军用步枪，由俄罗斯帝国研发，后来被苏联采用，并进一步加以完善。

messages.msgid: This Mosin-Nagant has exchanged the classic wooden stock for a modern synthetic model, carefully balanced to the same weight and handling, to allow support for modern accessories.
translations: 这把莫辛纳甘步枪把传统木制枪托替换为现代合成枪托，并且精心调节至相同的重量及控制度，以供安装现代改装配件。

messages.msgid: The Romanian PSL is a designated marksman's rifle developed by Romania after political tensions with Soviet Russia forced them to develop their own alternative to the SVD.
translations: 罗马尼亚 PSL 狙击步枪是在罗马尼亚与苏联关系紧张后，独立研发的一款狙击步枪，用以替代SVD狙击步枪。
世纪武器 PSL 54 狙击步枪

messages.msgid: The PSL is a semi-automatic rifle chambered in 7.62x54mmR, created by Romania due to uneasy tensions arising between the USSR and Romania, which put pressure on Romania to manufacture their own firearms.  While it looks much like a Soviet SVD, mechanically it's akin to a scaled up AK-47.  This one has been imported from Romania by Century Arms.
translations: PSL 是一款发射 7.62x54mmR 弹的半自动步枪，是罗马尼亚在与苏联关系紧张的背景下，为了自行生产武器而研发设计的。虽然看起来很像苏联的 SVD，但在机械结构上，它类似于放大的 AK-47。这把枪由世纪武器公司从罗马尼亚进口。

messages.msgid: A symbol of Soviet pride and favored sidearm of Red Army officers, this is a compact pistol firing the punchy 7.62x25mm cartridge.  featuring an uncomfortable grip angle reminiscent of brandishing an unusually irate capital L at one's opponents, it is nevertheless a commendably accurate and durable handgun.
translations: 这是一把象征苏联骄傲的紧凑型手枪，曾是红军军官的常用配枪。它发射威力强大的7.62x25mm口径弹药，握把角度让人联想到向对手"怒目而视"的大写字母L，但它仍然是一款值得称赞的精准且耐用的手枪。
托卡列夫 TT-33 手枪

messages.msgid: The Tokarev TT-33 is an antique Russian semiautomatic pistol, famous for its durability, accuracy, and uncomfortable grip angle.  It was chambered for the 7.62x25mm due to the popularity of the C96 pistol among Russian revolutionaries.
translations: 托卡列夫ТТ-33型半自动手枪，俄国古董手枪之一，闻名于其耐用与精度，还有无视人体工程学的令人不适的握把角度。它使用的 7.62x25mm 托卡列夫手枪弹，是从俄国在革命时期的"熟人"德国流行的毛瑟C96手枪的 7.63mm 子弹经过"社会主义改造"改良得来的，颇具含义，就是不能够换用。

messages.msgid: A stout and rugged battle rifle that traces its origins to the hands of imperial Japanese forces and saw extensive use in the Pacific theatre of the Second World War, this bolt-action firearm shoots the 7.7x58mm Arisaka cartridge.  Powerful, dependable, and elegantly built, Japan's 20th-century infantry rifle may yet find service guarding the lives of her former enemies.
translations: 这是一款结实耐用的战斗步枪，起源于日本帝国军队，在第二次世界大战太平洋战场广泛使用。它发射7.7x58mm有坂弹。这款日本20世纪栓动步枪威力强大、可靠性高、外观优雅，可能仍然会在保护她昔日敌人的生命中发挥作用。

messages.msgid: The standard service arm of the imperial Japanese army during the Second World War, chambered for the powerful 7.7x58mm cartridge and built to replace the weaker Type 38, the Type 99 is a sturdy and formidable bolt-action rifle with a Mauser-inspired action renowned for its strength.  Though the rifle was historically sneered at in the US due to extensive anti-Japanese propaganda and the lower quality of later-production guns, the weapon is, by most metrics, a finely produced and effective shoulder arm.  This particular Arisaka is an early-war example with anti-aircraft sights and an intact 6-petal chrysanthemum seal.
translations: 这是日本帝国陆军在第二次世界大战期间的标准配枪。它采用威力强大的7.7x58mm口径弹药，是为取代较弱的38式而研制的。Type 99是一款结实可靠的枪机式步枪，其动作机构受到毛瑟步枪的启发，以其坚固著称。尽管由于反日宣传和后期生产质量下降，这种步枪在美国曾遭到贬低，但从大多数指标来看，它仍是一件精心制造、性能出色的肩扛武器。这件有坂步枪是战争初期的型号，带有对空瞄具和完整的6瓣菊花纹章。

messages.msgid: Standing as a clear example of what happens when a country losing a war realizes that it's running out of resources and its rifles are ripe for corner-cutting, this Type 99 Arisaka, the standard service arm of imperial Japan from 1939, is a crewed end-of-war example.  Coated in machining marks, lacking an upper handguard, and with the early production anti-aircraft sights long since done away with, where early production Arisaka rifles are a feat in elegant engineering, this one is a last-ditch bang stick hammered together in a mostly bombed-out factory.  Aesthetics not withstanding, this weapon is still an effective and powerful shoulder arm, just… not the prettiest.
translations: 作为一国在战争中败退、资源告罄时不得不采取偷工减料手段的鲜明例证，这款自1939年起成为日本帝国标准制式步枪的九九式有坂步枪，乃是一款典型的战败前夕产物。其表面布满加工痕迹，缺少上护木，早期型号所配备的对空瞄具早已不复存在。当早期生产的有坂步枪堪称优雅工程典范之时，这款却如同一处大多已被炸毁的工厂中匆忙敲打拼凑而成的应急火器。尽管在美学上难以恭维，但这把武器依然不失为一款有效且威力强大的肩抗武器，只是……外观实在谈不上美观。

messages.msgid: A precision weapon issued to Japanese forces part way through the Second World War and proving to be little more than an off-the-rack 7.7mm battle rifle fitted with a telescopic sight, the rifle, despite being only marginally different from its closer-range cohorts, was a formidable implement upon the battle fields of the Pacific theatre.
translations: 这是一款在二战中期配发给日本军队的精密武器，本质上不过是一支加装了望远式瞄准镜的标准7.7毫米战斗步枪。尽管相较于其近战型同类产品仅略有不同，但这支步枪在太平洋战场上却展现出强大的战斗力。

messages.msgid: The standard sniper's weapon of Imperial Japan, this rifle is essentially an early production Type 99 Arisaka fitted with an offset optical sight and a bent bolt handle to facilitate stripper clip loading and easy manipulation despite the scope's presence.  While its 7.7x58mm chambering resulted in a muzzle flash and report that were significantly greater than those of the Type 97, which it sought to replace, the rifle's man-stopping potential is nothing to be trifled with.
translations: 作为日本帝国时期的标准狙击手武器，这款步枪实质上是早期型号的九九式有坂步枪，加装了偏置式光学瞄准镜，并配有弯曲的拉机柄。这样的设计使得即使在安装瞄准镜的情况下，仍能方便地使用弹夹装填弹药并轻松操作。尽管其采用的7.7x58mm口径导致枪口闪光和声响明显大于其意欲取代的九七式步枪，但其对敌方人员的杀伤力不容小觑。

messages.msgid: Manufactured in Sweden, the Carl Gustaf M3 is a breech-loading 84 millimeter man-portable, reusable, multi-role recoilless rifle commonly used by the US military.  Under normal circumstances, users should refrain from shooting more than 6 rounds per day to avoid undue risk of brain injury…
translations: 卡尔·古斯塔夫M3是一种84毫米后装式单兵便携式、可重复使用、多用途无后坐力炮，通常被美军使用。在正常情况下，使用者应避免每天射击超过6发，以防止过度的脑损伤风险……

messages.msgid: The Carl Gustaf M3E1 is a breech-loading 84 millimeter man-portable, reusable, multi-role recoilless rifle.  This is a shorter, lighter, and more advanced development of the M3.  Under normal circumstances, users should refrain from shooting more than 6 rounds per day to prevent undue risk of brain injury…
translations: 卡尔·古斯塔夫M3E1是一种84毫米后装式单兵便携式、可重复使用、多用途无后坐力炮。这是M3的更短，更轻，更先进的版本。在正常情况下，使用者应避免每天射击超过6发，以防止过度的脑损伤风险……

messages.msgid: A milspec recoilless rifle - an 84mm unguided, portable, single-shot recoilless smoothbore weapon used primarily by the US military.
translations: 一把军用无后坐力炮，84毫米口径、无制导、便携式单发无后坐力炮，主要由美国军方使用。
无壳弹自动马格南手枪

messages.msgid: Designed for style rather than practicality, the Rivtech RM103A is an impressive-looking pistol with less-than-impressive results.  Too short to properly utilize Rivtech's proprietary 8mm caseless ammunition, this status symbol is still a capable sidearm.  Accepts stick magazines.
translations: 作为“外美中干”的体现，Rivtech RM103A 手枪的设计重心更多被放在了造型，而非实用性上。虽然使用Rivtech公司生产的 8mm 无壳弹，但其枪管长度并不足以让子弹完全发挥效能——不过这并不影响其成为合格的副手武器与身份象征。可使用条形弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: Intended to function as a long-range sharpshooter support weapon for the military, the Rivtech RM11B scout rifle was designed for durability and accuracy under less than ideal circumstances.  Its bullpup layout, digital scope, and two round burst mode allow it to deliver precise long-range takedowns, utilizing the proprietary Rivtech 8mm caseless round.  Accepts stick magazines.
translations: 作为军用的长距离精密支援武器设计，Rivtech RM11B 侦察步枪的设计重心放在了非理想环境下的耐用性和射击精度上。使用Rivtech公司生产的 8mm 无壳弹的同时，其无托式设计、数字瞄准镜、双发点射模式，更是让其能轻松应对远距离的精准击杀。可使用条形弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM2000 submachine gun was designed for durability and ease of carrying under less than ideal circumstances.  Accepts stick magazines.
translations: 使用强力但非常规弹药，Rivtech RM2000 冲锋枪的设计重心放在了非理想环境下的耐用性和便携性上。可使用条形弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM51 assault rifle was designed for durability and ease of use under less than ideal circumstances, with its considerable bulk minimized by a compact and ergonomic layout.  Accepts box magazines.
translations: 原为军事用途而设计生产，Rivtech RM51 突击步枪的设计重心放在了非理想环境下的耐用性和易用性上，它的体积也因其紧凑的人体工程学布局设计而大大减小。可使用条形弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: The Calico automatic carbine is a submachine gun with a unique circular magazine that allows for high capacities and reduced recoil.
translations: 卡利科卡宾枪是一种大弹容冲锋枪，有着独特的螺旋式弹匣，提供持久的火力和更低的后座。
卡利科 M960 卡宾枪

messages.msgid: A compact submachine gun designed evidently under the 'spray and pray' mentality, this Calico M960 automatic carbine is not notably powerful, or dependable, or even particularly accurate to shoot.  Intended for military and law enforcement use, it never saw any noteworthy service due to its poor reliability and overall performance, and would be an unremarkable weapon in all respects, save for its enormous magazine capacity.  Making use of uniquely designed 50 or 100 round circular magazines, the Calico might not be a particularly good gun, but will throw an overwhelming amount of lead down range for a long time providing that it doesn't choke, jam, and die.
translations: 这支卡利科M960自动卡宾枪显然是在“倾泻火力，然后祈祷”的心态下设计的紧凑型冲锋枪，威力不大，也不可靠，甚至射击也不是很准确。它本来打算用于军事和执法，但由于其可靠性和整体性能较差，从来没有碰上任何应用场景，除了其巨大的弹匣容量外，在各方面都是一种不起眼的武器。因为其独特的50或100发圆形弹匣，它虽然可能不是一把特别好的枪，但只要它不卡壳、堵塞、不炸膛，就能持续射出大量的子弹。
格洛克 便携式手枪

messages.msgid: A common 9x19mm pistol of modest proportions, produced by the popular Glock gun company and mainly built from plastic polymers.  Making use of aptly-named Glock magazines and being a decades-long popular concealed carry option for civilians due to its small size, it is a tried, tested, and reliable design.
translations: 一把常见的中小体积 9x19mm 手枪，由远近闻名的格洛克枪械公司生产，主体以塑料聚合物构成。得益于较小的提及与兼容格洛克弹匣，它成为了几十年来平民隐蔽携行的流行选择。设计久经考验且十分可靠。

messages.msgid: Possibly the most popular pistol in existence, the Glock 19 can be summed up as being fundamentally a more compact brother to the full-sized Glock 17 pistol.  Sporting a mainly polymer-based design, the Glock 19 is often derided for its plastic construction which lends the handgun a deceptively flimsy feel.  Even so, the Glock 19 remains both a remarkably reliable firearm and a quite shootable gun in its own right.
translations: 格洛克 19 可能是现存最受欢迎的手枪之一，概括而言，它本质上是全尺寸 格洛克 17 手枪更为紧凑的“兄弟型号”。格洛克 19 主要采用聚合物设计，常因其“塑料”结构而受到揶揄，这种结构会让人产生一种“看似不够结实”的错觉。即便如此，格洛克 19 仍然是一把可靠性相当出色的枪械，并且就其自身而言也具有良好的射击操控性。

messages.msgid: A Glock 19 developed specially for the FBI, with all black internals and match grade components.  It was nearly impossible to find on the civilian market before the Cataclysm, now it is completely irreplacable.
translations: 为FBI专门研发的一款格洛克 19 手枪，采用全黑的内部零件和竞赛级部件。大灾变前在民用市场上几乎无处可寻，现在则更是无法替代。

messages.msgid: The Glock 45 is practically identical to the Glock 19, the main difference being that the grip is styled to be closer to that of the Glock 17.
translations: 格洛克 45 手枪与格洛克 19 手枪几乎完全相同，其主要区别在于其握把的样式更接近格洛克 17 手枪。

messages.msgid: A Glock subcompact pistol chambered in 9mm Luger.  Despite its tiny size, it can fit the magazines of its larger brothers.
translations: 一把使用 9mm 鲁格弹的格洛克超紧凑型手枪。尽管尺寸微型，但它能装配其同系大尺寸型号的弹匣。

messages.msgid: A large, stylish Glock chambered in 9mm.  Developed for accuracy, this pistol is used by competition shooters, law enforcement, and even the Baba Yaga.
translations: 一把使用 9mm 弹，大型且时尚的格洛克手枪。该枪为追求精度而设计，被竞赛射手、执法部门，甚至是那位“芭芭雅嘎”所使用。

messages.msgid: A 9x19mm Glock of diminutive proportions.  Unfortunately it is incompatible with other 9mm Glock magazines.
translations: 一把尺寸袖珍的 9x19mm 格洛克手枪。很可惜它无法不兼容其他的 9mm 格洛克弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 9mm compact Glock.  Despite its name, it does not accept the magazines of the Glock 43.
translations: 一把紧凑型 9mm 格洛克手枪。虽然名字里带43，但它其实并不兼容格洛克 43 手枪的弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 9mm, slimline Glock.  Designed for concealed carry, and accepts the magazine from a Glock 43x, but not the base 43.
translations: 一把小巧的 9mm 格洛克手枪。该枪为隐蔽携带而设计，且可使用格洛克 43x 手枪的弹匣，但不兼容基础型格洛克 43 手枪的弹匣。

messages.msgid: The Heckler & Koch MP5 is one of the most widely-used submachine guns in the world, and has been adopted by special police forces and militaries alike.  Its high degree of accuracy and low recoil are universally praised.
translations: H&K MP5 冲锋枪作为在世界范围内广泛使用的冲锋枪之一，被列装于特警和军队之中。它优越的精度与极小的后坐力为之赢得了广泛的赞扬。

messages.msgid: The H&K MP5SD offers subsonic performance in almost the same footprint as the H&K MP5, retaining its handiness.  The large suppressor cuts down on muzzle flash greatly, aiding in night operations.  It has also seen some popularity with SWAT teams, as it lowers the risk of fire and explosions in illegal laboratories.  With body armor in more common use, the MP5SD has waned in popularity among special forces due to its decreased terminal performance.
translations: H&K MP5SD 冲锋枪在维持与H&K MP5 冲锋枪相近性能的前提下，实现了亚音速武器的表现。它附带的大型消音器显著减弱了枪口火焰，降低了其在夜间的可见度。这同时也降低了在诸如非法实验室等地点引发火灾或爆炸的几率，因此其在SWAT部队中也受到一定青睐。考虑到如今防弹护甲变得逐渐普遍，MP5SD 冲锋枪也因其有限的穿透力，在特种部队中的使用率逐渐下滑。

messages.msgid: The Heckler & Koch MP5 is one of the most widely-used submachine guns in the world, and has been adopted by special police forces and militaries alike.  Its high degree of accuracy and low recoil are universally praised.  The MP5K-PDW model features a shorter barrel, a built-in foregrip, and a side folding stock for vehicle or aircraft crew use.
translations: H&K MP5 冲锋枪作为在世界范围内广泛使用的冲锋枪之一，被列装于特警和军队之中。它优越的精度与极小的后坐力为之赢得了广泛的赞扬。其 MP5K-PDW 型号配有更短的枪管，内置前握把和侧折式枪托，为随车或飞机机组人员使用。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic copy of the famous MP5 series, domestically produced for the US market.  Like the MP5, its roller delayed blowback action offers smooth shooting and precision, setting it apart from other submachine guns and pistol caliber carbines.  This model is configured as a pistol to avoid inconvenient and costly NFA regulations.  A welded-on section of M1913 rail offers convenient mounting for aftermarket optics, but precludes the use of claw mounts.
translations: 一把著名的 MP5 冲锋枪的半自动仿制品，面向美国国内市场制造。和 MP5 冲锋枪一样，这把枪采用滚轮延迟反冲式结构，提供了与其它冲锋枪和手枪弹卡宾枪不同的舒适射击体验和高精度。该型号是为规避繁琐又高昂的美国国家枪械法案的特供版本，经过多项调整使其符合法律意义上的“手枪”标准。这把枪还包含一段焊接上的M1913导轨，以便后续安装光学瞄具，但也阻碍了插座式瞄准镜的安装。

messages.msgid: The PTR 9KT is a semi-automatic copy of the famous MP5 series, domestically produced for the US market on original Heckler & Koch tooling by PTR Industries.  Like the MP5, its roller delayed blowback action offers smooth shooting and precision, setting it apart from other submachine guns and pistol caliber carbines.  This model is configured as a pistol to avoid inconvenient and costly NFA regulations.  A welded-on section of M1913 rail offers convenient mounting for aftermarket optics, but precludes the use of claw mounts.
translations: PTR 9KT 手枪是著名的 MP5 冲锋枪的半自动仿制品，由PTR Industries公司生产，以便于在美国国内市场销售原装H&K枪械配件。和 MP5 冲锋枪一样，这把枪采用滚轮延迟反冲式结构，提供了与其它冲锋枪和手枪弹卡宾枪不同的舒适射击体验和高精度。该型号是为规避繁琐又高昂的美国国家枪械法案的特供版本，经过多项调整使其符合法律意义上的“手枪”标准。这把枪还包含一段焊接上的M1913导轨，以便后续安装光学瞄具，但也阻碍了插座式瞄准镜的安装。

messages.msgid: A hard-sided briefcase with a trigger in the handle and a concealed hole in the side.  To fire the internally mounted MP5K-PDW, one braces the briefcase at the waist, ensures the hole is pointed at the enemy, and squeezes the trigger.  Precision and handling are severely hampered by the shape of the briefcase, but if you need to 'hand over the goods' or look low profile while bodyguarding, this is your gun.  When the briefcase is open, the MP5 may be reloaded or dismounted.
translations: 一个硬壳公文包，提手上有一个扳机，侧面开有一个隐秘的枪孔，内部藏有一把 MP5K-PDW 冲锋枪。正确的射击方法如下：将手提箱抵在腰部，确认枪口的一侧朝的是敌人，并扣动扳机。由于本质上是抱着公文包射击，因此命中率和操控性都大打折扣，但如果你是前去"交货"或者执行隐蔽保护任务的话，这就是你的最佳选择。如果你重新装填或取出冲锋枪的话，则需要打开公文包。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic 9x19mm military issued pistol with an unusual toggle-lock action.  Well-known for its use by the Germans during both World Wars, it's a notably accurate handgun even by modern standards, and this example of a P08 was more than likely either brought back state-side as a war trophy by a veteran, or imported.
translations: 一把采用了罕见的肘节闭锁结构的军用制式 9x19mm 半自动手枪。因在两次世界大战皆被列装于德军而闻名。射击精度即使按照现代标准也较为精确，而手上这把 P08 手枪很可能是退伍军人作为战利品带回美国，或是进口而来的。

messages.msgid: A semi-automatic German pistol developed prior to 1900, the firearm features a burned and painted number '9' on its broom handle-shaped grip to signify its chambering, 9x19mm parabellum, and makes use of appropriate stripper clips or single round loading.  Quite possibly the most aesthetically steampunk weapon that one could ever possibly get their hands on, this example likely found its way into the US via early import or as a holdover from the Great War.
translations: 一把于十九世纪后半叶研发的德国制半自动手枪，其扫帚把状握把上烙印并涂绘了一个数字“9”，象征其使用 9x19mm 帕拉贝鲁姆弹，且支持通过相应口径的弹夹或单发进行装填。无疑是最具蒸汽朋克风格的武器之一，任何人有幸获得都会为之倾倒，而手上的这把很可能是通过早期进口，或是作为某位一战士兵的遗物流入美国。

messages.msgid: A late 19th century semi-automatic German pistol with an integral magazine loaded from the top via stripper clips, and quite possibly the most steampunk gun one could ever possibly lay their hands on.  A red number '9' burned and painted into the weapon's broom handle-shaped grip marks it as a variant chambered for 9x19mm rounds.  Both exported for commercial use and produced for the German military during the First World War to make up for production shortages of the standard Luger, this example likely entered the US as a holdover from the Great War.  You suppose that it's only fitting that one of the globe's first produced and oldest semi-automatic handguns gets reinstated into service now that the planet's facing its end.
translations: 一把于十九世纪后半叶研发的德国制半自动手枪，包含内建弹舱，可通过弹夹从上方的退弹口供弹。无疑是最具蒸汽朋克风格的武器之一，任何人有幸获得都会为之倾倒。其扫帚把状握把上烙印并涂绘了一个数字“9”，象征其使用 9x19mm 帕拉贝鲁姆弹。原作为一战期间鲁格手枪产量不足的替代武器，同时用于列装德国军队以及外贸出口，不过手上这把很可能是作为某位一战士兵的遗物流入美国。你觉得在地球即将走向末日之时，是时候让这把世界上第一批被成功量产，也是最古老的半自动手枪再就业了。

messages.msgid: An antique German-issued submachine gun from the Second World War, likely having entered the United States as a personal holdover by a veteran.  Chambered in 9x19mm and utilizing proprietary box magazines, the firearm has an integrated under folding wire stock.
translations: 一把于二战时期列装于德军的老式冲锋枪，很可能是作为某位士兵的遗物流入美国。这款冲锋枪使用 9x19mm 弹和特制的盒式弹匣，同时枪体还包含一个内置的下折叠式铁丝枪托。
沃尔默 MP40 冲锋枪

messages.msgid: A simple and renowned 9x19mm submachine gun developed by Heinrich Vollmer for the German army.  Adopted  in 1940, it saw extensive service on both fronts of the Second World War and was much regarded by soldiers who fielded the weapon in combat, being praised for its reliability and relatively modern design.  Featuring an integral folding wire butt stock, this weapon more than likely entered the United States as a war trophy by a returning veteran.  It was often called "Schmeisser" by the Allies, after Hugo Schmeisser, who designed the MP 18, although he was not involved in the design or production of the MP 40.
translations: 一把结构简单且十分著名的 9x19mm 冲锋枪，由海因里希·沃尔默为德国陆军研发。它于1940年列装德国军队，在第二次世界大战的东西两线上都得到了广泛使用，并受到了在战斗中配发该武器的士兵的重视，因其可靠性和相对现代的设计而受到广泛称赞。这把武器包含一个内置的折叠式铁丝枪托，很可能是某位退伍军人作为战利品带回美国。盟军通常将其称为“施迈瑟”，以纪念设计 MP18 冲锋枪的雨果·施迈瑟——尽管他并没有参与 MP40 的设计或生产工作。
半自动 MP 40 冲锋枪

messages.msgid: A modern semi-automatic replica of the MP 40 submachine gun, which lacks a butt stock to make it legally be considered a pistol.  It actually bears only a visual resemblance to the original, differing substantially from originally manufactured MP 40 submachine guns in its internal operations.
translations: 一把 MP40 冲锋枪的半自动现代仿制品，由于没有枪托，因此在法律层面上被归类为“手枪”。它仅具有与原版相近的外观，内部构造则与原本的 MP40 完全不同。
折叠式 格洛克卡宾枪

messages.msgid: With its claim to fame being its ease of portability when compared to other conventional rifles and carbines, this is a uniquely-designed pistol caliber carbine sporting an integral folding mechanism and chambered for 9x19mm cartridges, making use of regular Glock compatible magazines.  With its mechanism engaged, the barrel assembly swings rearwards and causes the firearm to fold to half its regular length, packing up into a very compact package with ergonomics unfortunately having to take a backseat to allow for the weapon's extreme portability.  With a mainly polymer constructed receiver, the carbine is relatively light and incredibly transportable when fully folded.
translations: 因其与其他常规步枪和卡宾枪相比更高的便携性而闻名，这是一把经过特别设计的手枪口径卡宾枪，包含集成折叠结构，使用常规 9x19mm 弹，且兼容常规格洛克弹匣。其机械结构允许将枪管组件向后折叠，使枪身长度字面意义上的“折中”，不过这也使人体工程学不得不靠后站，以为这极端的便携性让路。得益于聚合物枪身，这把卡宾枪的重量相对较轻，完全折叠时也十分便于携带。

messages.msgid: With its claim to fame being its ease of portability when compared to other conventional rifles and carbines, the Kel-Tec SUB-2000 is a uniquely-designed pistol caliber carbine sporting an integral folding mechanism and chambered for 9x19mm cartridges, making use of regular Glock compatible magazines.  With its mechanism engaged, the barrel assembly swings rearwards and causes the firearm to fold to half its regular length, packing up into a very compact package with ergonomics unfortunately having to take a backseat to allow for the weapon's extreme portability.  With a mainly polymer constructed receiver, the carbine is relatively light and incredibly transportable when fully folded.
translations: 因其与其他常规步枪和卡宾枪相比更高的便携性而闻名，Kel-Tec SUB-2000 卡宾枪是一把经过特别设计的手枪口径卡宾枪，包含集成折叠结构，使用常规 9x19mm 弹，且兼容常规格洛克弹匣。其机械结构允许将枪管组件向后折叠，使枪身长度字面意义上的“折中”，不过这也使人体工程学不得不靠后站，以为这极端的便携性让路。得益于聚合物枪身，这把卡宾枪的重量相对较轻，完全折叠时也十分便于携带。

messages.msgid: A rugged, iconic, and long-serving 9mm handgun, the M9 is a sleek pistol that has enjoyed fame in military, law enforcement, and civilian circles ever since its inception.  Adopted as the primary service sidearm across all United States armed branches from the early eighties until the late two thousand and tens, the weapon has seen a great deal of popular media coverage in both video games and television alike.
translations: 作为极度耐用、极具标志性，且服役长久的 9mm 手枪，M9 手枪在军警以及民用领域皆颇受美誉。于上世纪80年代初到本世纪10年代末，该枪一直作为美国武装部队的制式副手武器，并在游戏和电视剧等大众媒体中得到了广泛的传播。

messages.msgid: An iconic 9x19mm pistol, the M9 was the standard issue sidearm of the US armed forces from 1985 until only recently.  It was formerly popular among law enforcement before the advent of commercially available polymer-framed handguns and the FBI's adoption of .40 S&W.
translations: 一把极具标志性的 9x19mm 手枪，M9 手枪自1985年直至近年，一直作为美国武装部队的制式副手武器。直到商用聚合物框架手枪出现以及联邦调查局改用 .40 S&W 弹之前，它曾在一度在执法部门中十分流行。

messages.msgid: A more modern version of Beretta's popular 92 series of handguns, the 90-two performs largely the same.  The main difference is a sleeker, almost futuristic-looking design owed in large part to the polymer underbarrel rail cover.
translations: 作为伯莱塔公司流行的92系列手枪的现代化改版，90-two 手枪的性能与前者大体相同。两者主要的区别在于后者的聚合物导轨护套以及其他设计细节改动，使其看起来更加圆滑且具有未来感。
伯莱塔 Px4 "风暴" 手枪

messages.msgid: Lighter than Beretta's iconic 92 series of guns, the Px4 Storm was built by utilizing light-weight polymer construction with steel inserts.  Its shape was also optimized for concealed carry, while maintaining the reliability that the 92 series is known for.
translations: 通过“往轻型聚合物枪身内填入金属加强结构”的方式，伯莱塔 Px4 "风暴" 手枪成功做到了将枪体重量控制在同公司标志性的92系列手枪之下，却又有不输于92系列所闻名的可靠性。其枪身造型经过设计，便于隐蔽携带。

messages.msgid: A Luty pattern makeshift smoothbore SMG crudely constructed out of various steel parts using advanced powered hand tools; likely one of the most complex guns that is feasible to make outside of a machine shop, but still very unreliable.  This one is chambered for 9x19mm cartridges and accepts STEN-compatible magazines.
translations: 一把粗制的Luty式无膛线冲锋枪，利用各种手持工具将各种金属部件野蛮地拼接到一起——虽说不可靠，但也算是在专业车间之外能造出的最复杂的枪支了。这一把使用 9x19mm 弹，可通过斯登冲锋枪弹匣供弹。
斯登 Mk II 冲锋枪

messages.msgid: The standard issue 9mm submachine gun of the British military throughout most of the Second World War.  The STEN is aesthetically far from pretty.  Featuring an iconic side mounted magazine well and a design optimized for mass production using unskilled labor, the STEN was developed to make up for drastic supply shortages during the early days of the war.  Likely entering the US prior to the 1960s, either as a war time holdover or a museum purchase; you suppose that if you were to try and defend your nation, whatever the cost may be, and fight the undead 'on the beaches, fight on the landing grounds, fight in the fields and in the streets, fight in the hills; and never surrender', then it might be the time for the STEN to come back into frontline service.
translations: 曾作为英军制式武器，参与了大半个二战的 9mm 冲锋枪。斯登冲锋枪难说有多少美观的造型设计——除开其标志性的侧装式弹匣井，为了弥补战争初期的军资短缺，斯登冲锋枪采用了哪怕是非熟练工人团队也能进行大批量生产的精简化设计。手上这把斯登大概是上世纪60年代流入美国，要么是战争时期的遗留物，要么是被博物馆购买作为馆藏。你觉得既然要不惜一切代价保卫祖国，与不死的敌人鏖战于海滩和登陆点，于田野、街道，和山岭，那么是时候让这把斯登重返前线了。

messages.msgid: The TEC-9 is a semi-automatic 'pistol' made of cheap polymers and machine stamped parts.  Its rise in popularity among criminals is largely due to its intimidating looks, low cost and relative ease of converting to fully automatic.
translations: TEC-9是一种半自动"手枪"，由各种廉价聚合物和机械冲压件制成。它被犯罪分子大量使用，主要是因为外观震慑性强，造价低廉，而且比较容易改造成全自动的。

messages.msgid: The Uzi 9x19mm has enjoyed immense popularity, selling more units than any other submachine gun.  It is widely used as a personal defense weapon, or as a primary weapon by elite frontline forces.
translations: 相较其他冲锋枪，Uzi 9x19mm 冲锋枪可谓是名利双收，拥有更高的知名度和销量。其被广泛用作个人防卫武器，或是作为主战武器列装于精英前线部队。

messages.msgid: Designed for all shooters, this offering from the Glock gun company is a full-sized 9x19mm pistol marketed towards law-enforcement and military users.  Because of the long magazine well, it can't fit magazines shorter than the standard 17-round ones.
translations: 格洛克公司的这款全尺寸 9x19mm 手枪虽主要面向军警用户，但在设计层面仍考虑了不同的射击用途。由于弹仓很长，因此无法装入比标准17发弹匣短的弹匣。

messages.msgid: Commonly seen tucked away in the holsters of police officers, certain military professionals, and civilian shooters, this is a larger, older, service-oriented version of the popular Glock 19.  Similarly firing the 9x19mm cartridge and using higher capacity magazines, it performs largely the same, but due to the longer magazine well, it can't fit magazines shorter than the standard 17-round ones.
translations: 作为比格洛克 19 手枪更大、更早的勤务版本，常被警察、部分军人和平民射手的所携带。和前者一样发射 9x19mm 弹，性能基本相同，但由于弹仓更长，因此无法装入比标准17发弹匣短的弹匣。

messages.msgid: A military, fully automatic capable version of the popular 9x19mm handguns produced by the Glock arms company, this machine pistol makes use of Glock magazines.  The weapon has had its barrel modified to lessen recoil, a useful feature considering its high rate of fire and lack of a default buttstock.
translations: 由格洛克公司生产的知名 9x19mm 手枪的军用全自动版本，使用格洛克弹匣。考虑到其高射速和没有自带的枪托，武器通过枪管改动以抑制后坐力，非常地人性。

messages.msgid: A selective-fire variation on the Glock 17, originally designed for Austria's EKO Cobra unit.  It has compensator cuts along its barrel to make recoil more manageable.
translations: 格洛克 17 手枪的可选射击模式的衍生型号，最为奥地利的 EKO 眼镜蛇部队使用设计。其沿着枪管上方开了数个排气孔，以将其的后坐力抑制在可掌控范围内。

messages.msgid: Made by SIG Sauer, the M11 is a compact semi-automatic, short recoil operated pistol, also known as the P228.
translations: M11 手枪是一把由西格&绍尔公司生产的半自动短反冲式紧凑型手枪，也被称为 P228 手枪。

messages.msgid: The general-issue military handgun of the United States army before the Cataclysm, this is a sizable pistol that fires 9x19mm cartridges.  Based off successful civilian designs and capable of taking magazines of various round capacities, the gun features a plastic polymer frame which helps to reduce overall weight.
translations: 一把体积十足的 9x19mm 手枪，在大灾变之前作为美军的通用制式手枪使用。该枪基于其成功的民用版本，除了能够使用多种容量的弹匣，还采用塑料聚合物框架来减轻枪体重量。

messages.msgid: The M17 is an army issued semi-automatic, short recoil operated pistol derived from the SIG Sauer P320.
translations: M17 手枪是一把由西格&绍尔 P320 手枪衍生而来的半自动短反冲式手枪，作为军队制式武器使用。

messages.msgid: A more petite version of the United States army's general issue sidearm, this is a modestly-sized pistol firing 9x19mm rounds.  Making use of the same magazines as its larger brother, the weapon features a shorter barrel and frame which helps to reduce its overall profile and make it more concealable as a result.
translations: 一把体积适中的 9x19mm 手枪，为美军的通用制式手枪的紧凑版本。相较其更大号的兄弟款，除了能够使用多种容量的弹匣外，更短的抢断和套筒有效减少了枪体尺寸，使其更适合隐蔽携带。

messages.msgid: The M18 is a compact, semi-automatic, short recoil operated pistol derived from the SIG Sauer P320 Carry, used by US Armed Forces.  Practically the same as its big brother, the M17, in every respect, the M18 features a moderately shorter slide and barrel which terminates at the end of the frame rather than extending partway beyond it like the M17.
translations: M18 手枪是一把由西格&绍尔 P320 便携型手枪衍生而来的紧凑型半自动短反冲式手枪，作为军队制式武器使用。性能与其老大哥 M17 手枪无异，M18 手枪有着相对较短的滑套和枪管，使其枪口末端与枪身末端齐平，而不是像 M17 手枪一样延伸到枪身之外。
西格 P226 MK25 手枪

messages.msgid: The P226 MK25 is a full-size semi-automatic DA/SA, short-recoil operated pistol with corrosion-resistant internal coating and an engraved anchor on the side of the slide.
translations: P226 MK25 手枪是一把全尺寸，采用单/双动操作扳机的短反冲式半自动手枪，具有耐腐蚀的内部涂层，且在套筒两侧刻有船锚。
西格 Pro SP2022 9mm 手枪

messages.msgid: A polymer-frame, semi-automatic, DA/SA operated pistol, featuring a Picatinny rail and a Nitron stainless steel slide.
translations: 一把使用塑料聚合物框架，可单/双动操作扳机的半自动手枪，具有卡皮汀尼式轨道和不锈钢套筒。
勃朗宁大威力 9x19mm 手枪

messages.msgid: The Browning Hi-Power is a semi-automatic handgun developed shortly before the Second World War.  Widely issued since then, it remains in use by India, Canada, and Australia.  This is a commercial variant produced by Browning Arms in 9x19mm Parabellum.
translations: 勃朗宁大威力手枪是一把于二战开始前完成研发的半自动手枪。该枪一经面世便被广泛列装于各国军队，且目前在印度、加拿大，和澳大利亚仍有列装。这一把属于勃朗宁武器公司为商业销售而开发的 9x19mm 帕拉贝鲁姆弹版本。

messages.msgid: The Walther P38 is a semi-automatic handgun adopted shortly before the Second World War.  Developed due to the high production costs of its predecessor, the Luger P08, the P38 is also chambered in 9mm Parabellum.  This early DA/SA locked-breech design would introduce features later seen on more modern firearms such as the Beretta 92 series, and served Germany until 2004.
translations: 瓦尔特 P38 手枪是一把在二战开始不久便被投入使用的半自动手枪。由于设计初衷是解决其前辈鲁格 P08 手枪的高生产成本问题，因此瓦尔特 P38 手枪也使用了与前者相同的 9mm 帕拉贝鲁姆弹。该手枪也是早期使用单/双动扳机和闭锁式枪膛的枪械之一——该设计多见于例如伯莱塔92系列手枪的现代手枪——并在德国服役直至2004年。

messages.msgid: The Walther PPQ is a semi-automatic pistol originating from the Walther P99QA, and maintains compatibility with some of its predecessor's accessories.  This model is chambered in 9x19mm Parabellum.
translations: 瓦尔特 PPQ 手枪是基于瓦尔特 P99QA 手枪研发的半自动手枪，并保留了对后者的部分部件的兼容性。这个型号发射的是 9x19mm 帕拉贝鲁姆弹。

messages.msgid: The Hi-Point C-9 is a blowback operated semi-automatic pistol designed by Hi-Point Firearms, which is known for making inexpensive firearms, and for making said firearms bulky and uncomfortable.  Hi-Points have slides made with a zinc pot-metal which is relatively fragile compared to steel slides.
translations: Hi-Point C-9 手枪是一把由Hi-Point公司出品，采用反冲式枪机的半自动手枪。Hi-Point公司以制造价格低廉，但也又大又不好用的武器而知名。公司旗下的枪械套筒皆由锌合金制成，相比钢制套筒来说比较脆弱。

messages.msgid: The CZ 75 B is a semi-automatic pistol developed in Czechoslovakia, and is one of the original wonder nines.  Though designed for export to western countries, it was declared a state secret; lack of international patent protection meant that many clones and variants were produced and distributed around the world, with Česká zbrojovka only joining in the 90's.  This pistol remains wildly popular among competition shooters.
translations:
CZ 75 B 手枪是一把来自捷克斯洛伐克的半自动手枪，为最早的“奇迹九毫米”之一。尽管是为出口至西方国家而设计，该枪却在当时被列为了国家秘密；由于缺乏国际专利保护，全世界都开始了这种型号或衍生型号的生产和销售，而最初设计该型号的乌尔斯基·布罗德兵工厂直到90年代才开始境内的销售。这种手枪仍在射击比赛中被广泛使用。
（译注：“奇迹九毫米”的定义为发射 9x19mm 帕拉贝鲁姆弹，使用双排单进弹匣、双动式扳机的半自动手枪，可作为左轮代替品装备于警队。）

messages.msgid: The Walther CCP is a gas-delayed blowback semi-automatic pistol intended for the concealed carry consumer market.  Internally, it is nearly identical to the cult classic H&K P7.  Its fixed barrel design makes it potentially more accurate than many other pistols, though this may be difficult to realize with its average trigger and short sight radius.
translations: 瓦尔特 CCP 手枪是一把采用气体延迟反冲式枪机的半自动手枪，作为隐藏携带的选择进入民用市场。其内部设计几乎与相对小众的 H&K P7 手枪相同。固定的枪管使其理论上比其它手枪更为精确，但是由于其中庸的扳机和小瞄具半径，可能很难察觉到任何精度提升。
柯尔特 乌兹弹匣冲锋枪

messages.msgid: A 9x19mm submachine gun based on the M16 rifle design, it is a closed bolt, blowback operated firearm.  There is a large plastic brass deflector mounted by the ejection port, and no forward assist.  It looks very similar to an M4 carbine, except for the magazine well that accepts Uzi-style magazines.
translations: 基于 M16 步枪开发，采用封闭式机匣和反冲式枪机的 9x19mm 冲锋枪。抛壳口处有块大型塑料制弹壳挡板，且没有辅助推机柄。造型与 M4 卡宾枪非常相似，但使用的是乌兹冲锋枪的弹匣。
柯尔特 Model 635 冲锋枪

messages.msgid: B&T APC9 PRO K submachine gun
translations: B&T APC9 PRO K 冲锋枪
messages.plural: B&T APC9 PRO K submachine guns

messages.msgid: The Brügger & Thomet APC9 PRO K is a closed bolt blowback submachine gun in 9x19mm Parabellum.  It has a collapsible shoulder stock and a red dot sight.
translations: APC9 PRO K 冲锋枪是由B&T公司出品，采用封闭式机匣和反冲式枪机的 9x19mm 帕拉贝鲁姆弹冲锋枪。包含一个可折叠的肩托和一个红点瞄准镜。

messages.msgid: A lightweight pistol caliber carbine, chambered in 9mm and accepting Glock magazines.
translations: 一款轻量化手枪弹卡宾枪，发射 9mm 弹，使用格洛克弹匣。

messages.msgid: The Ruger PCC is a pistol caliber carbine, made by Ruger.  It's quite commonplace, thanks to its low recoil, reliability, and use of readily available magazines.
translations: 鲁格 PCC 是由鲁格公司制造的一款手枪弹卡宾枪。因其后坐力低、性能可靠，所使用的弹匣随处可得而相当普及。
一把 9mm 隐蔽携带手枪。

messages.msgid: The SIG P365 is a modern compact 9mm pistol made by SIG.  Even though SIG promises to offer a lifetime warranty, you suspect that isn't true anymore.
translations: 西格 P365 是西格&绍尔公司生产的一把现代紧凑型 9mm 手枪。尽管西格&绍尔公司承诺提供终身保修，但你觉得这个承诺现在大概率不再能被兑现。

messages.msgid: The Makarov was developed by the Soviet Union to replace the Red Army's obsolete WWII-era handguns.  It uses the 9x18mm cartridge, which remains in use among various former Soviet countries.
translations: 马卡洛夫手枪由苏联研制，用来取代红军在二战时使用的手枪。它使用 9x18mm 口径弹药，这种子弹仍在许多前苏联国家中广泛使用。
马卡洛夫 PM 手枪

messages.msgid: A svelte, Cold War era handgun of Russian heritage, this former military pistol fires the Soviet 9x18mm cartridge.  Constructed completely out of steel components and experiencing relative popularity throughout eastern European countries, it was a favored backup weapon among USSR security forces, soldiers, and covert units.
translations: 冷战时期的俄国遗产，这把修长的军用手枪发射9x18mm苏制弹药，完全由钢材制成，在欧洲许多国家都很受欢迎，是苏联安全部队、士兵和秘密部队偏爱的备用武器。

messages.msgid: A cut-down, modified Mosin-Nagant.  It has a short barrel and the stock has been cut down and fitted with a mace head, with new low profile front and rear sights added.  The sides of the firearm have been reinforced with metal to withstand a beating.
translations: 一把经过魔改莫辛纳甘步枪。它的枪管被锯断，枪托也被削掉，并安装了一个战锤头，和一组不易察觉的前后瞄准镜。枪械侧面用金属加固，可以经受冲击。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy sledge hammer converted for use as a weapon.  It features a notable safety on the side, and the back of the head has a firing mechanism that can be loaded with rifle blanks.  When the head impacts and the safety is off, the blanks are engaged, sending the moving piston forward and causing massive damage.  Etched into the head are the words 'she's lost control'.
translations: 一把又大又重的大钢锤，被改装成武器。侧面有个显眼的保护装置，锤头后部安装了一个可以装填步枪空包弹的发射机构。当锤头碰撞且保护装置关闭时，空包弹被击发，向前移动活塞，造成巨大伤害。锤头上刻着"她已失控"的字样。

messages.msgid: An oddly-vented mace with an internal fuel reservoir built into the pommel.  Can be engaged to ignite large puffs of gasoline and start fires.
translations: 一把奇怪的喷火钉头锤，在锤柄上安装上了一个内置油箱。可以喷射出大量汽油并点燃。

messages.msgid: Releases a blast of ignited gasoline directly in front of you.
translations: 在你正前方喷射出一股点燃的汽油。

messages.msgid: with a crack a cloud of gasoline ignites!
A compact short-range pistol without a pistol grip.  When in use, the entire gun body is pointed at targets and squeezed.  The body also conceals a switchblade for close quarters use.
translations: 一把没有握把的小型短程手枪。把整个枪身对准目标并挤压来开枪。枪身上还隐藏了一把弹簧刀，以便近身作战使用。

messages.msgid: A launcher for anti-tank guided missiles, capable of being deployed as a crew-served weapon or mounted on vehicles.  While fairly accurate, it isn't fire-and-forget.
translations: 一种反坦克导弹发射器，其能够作为手持武器或车载武器使用。虽然命中率比较高，但发射后需要一直瞄准目标，无法发射后不管。

messages.msgid: Bionic one-shot retracting shotgun integrated with your arm.
translations: 通过生化插件植入你手臂的单发伸缩式霰弹枪。

messages.msgid: A homemade version of a crude precursor to the shotgun.
translations: 一把自制的霰弹枪的原始前身型号。

messages.msgid: A light cannon widely used in the American Civil War, noted for its reliability.
translations: 美国内战中广泛使用的一种轻型火炮，以其可靠性而闻名。

messages.msgid: A bulky, self-made chemical sprayer with an internal conversion mechanism that allows all sorts of chemicals to be dispersed to your surroundings.
translations: 一个笨重的自制化学药剂喷雾头和一个内置化学药品混合分选器的容器，你可以用它来喷洒各种化学药品到邻近地面。

messages.msgid: A break action firearm comprised of a .30-06 barrel over two 12 gauge smooth bore barrels.  Historically used by egomaniac hunters in Africa, now used by their egomaniac descendants in New England.
translations: 一把后装式组合枪械，由一根 .30-06 口径的线膛枪管，及下方两根装填12号霰弹的滑膛枪管组成。这类枪械在历史上曾经在非洲被那些贪心不足的偷猎者们用来射杀大小动物，而现在则被新英格兰的那些同样自大的后人们继续使用。

messages.msgid: Originating from big game express smoothbores and heavy fowling pieces adapted for wallguns, the Brogyeki '23 is an over/under break action 'pistol' that is (unfortunately?) capable of launching its original 27.3 x 110 Diyua express slug and shot loads as well as the wide array of payloads in 27.3 x 44 Diyua.  A simple wire stock collapses neatly along its octagonal barrels, which feature a combination of sighting devices necessary for launching its numerous loads, in addition to the usual Exodii retrofits.  Unless you are a quadrupedal cyborg with this gun in a shock absorbing mount, recoil with the 27.3 x 110 Diyua shells will be *stout*.
translations: Brogyeki '23源自用于狩猎大型动物的大口径滑膛枪，这种重型猎枪又常被用作抬枪。这是一款叠筒中折式“手枪”，（不幸的是？）它既能发射原装的27.3 x 110 Diyua大口径独头弹与霰弹，也能发射27.3 x 44 Diyua口径的一系列弹药。它八角形的枪管上附有一套瞄具，用于发射多种弹药，枪管旁边是折叠整齐的金属线枪托，同时还经过了常规的流亡族改造。除非你是一个带有减震器的四足生化人，否则发射27.3 x 110 Diyua弹的后坐力会*很大*。

messages.msgid: Originating from big game express smoothbores and heavy fowling pieces adapted for wallguns, the Brogyeki '23 is an over/under break action 'pistol' that is (unfortunately?) capable of launching its original 27.3x110 Diyua express slug and shot loads as well as the wide array of payloads in 27.3x44 Diyua.
