messages.msgid: This is a complete upper receiver assembly containing a 16-inch barrel, handguard, and bolt carrier group that, given the right knowledge, is installable upon an AR-15-style rifle's lower frame.  Swappable uppers allow compatible firearms to be retooled for different cartridges and barrel lengths, with this kit bringing to life the dreams of users wishing to feed capitalism's rifle with communist lead.  Necessitating a proprietary magazine to cycle the hefty munitions, you're honestly unsure if this constitutes a brilliant idea, a bastard, or just a paradox.
translations: 一个包含16英寸枪管、护手和枪栓组件的完整上机匣总成，在熟悉相关知识的情况下，可安装至 AR-15 式步枪的下机匣上。可更换的上机匣为对应的兼容枪械提供了根据不同作战情况，更换弹药口径和枪管长度以调整武器定位的可能。该套上机匣完美满足用户“用老美的枪打老毛子的子弹”的幻想，但更大的子弹口径需要使用特质的弹匣才能供弹。是合理强化还是自讨无趣？你说实话难以界定。

messages.msgid: This is a complete upper receiver assembly containing a barrel, handguard, and bolt carrier group that, given the right knowledge, is installable upon an AR-15-style rifle's lower frame.  Swappable uppers enable compatible firearms to be retooled for different cartridges and barrel lengths, with this kit furnishing a weapon with a 16-inch barrel chambered for .22 rounds.
translations: 一个包含枪管、护手和枪栓组件的完整上机匣总成，在熟悉相关知识的情况下，可安装至 AR-15 式步枪的下机匣上。可更换的上机匣为对应的兼容枪械提供了根据不同作战情况，更换弹药口径和枪管长度以调整武器定位的可能。该套上机匣提供16英寸、使用 .22 弹的枪管。

messages.msgid: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  Bored for .223-caliber munitions and requiring STANAG magazines for feeding, the assembly makes the most from the weapon's bullpup design with a 20-inch barrel configuration, coaxing increased terminal performance from fired rounds.
translations: 包含专用补偿器和相应的枪栓组件的快拆枪管套件，可被安装至沙漠科技 MDRX 步枪的框架上。该套件适配 .223 口径弹药，通过 STANAG 弹匣供弹；充分利用了无托式结构，20英寸的枪管很好地提升了子弹射击时的性能。

messages.msgid: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  Bored for .223-caliber munitions, the assembly requires STANAG magazines for feeding.
translations: 包含专用补偿器和相应的枪栓组件的快拆枪管套件，可被安装至沙漠科技 MDRX 步枪的框架上。该套件适配 .223 口径弹药，通过 STANAG 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  Bored for .223-caliber munitions and requiring STANAG magazines for feeding, the assembly renders the MDRX into a compact CQB carbine, with an 11.5-inch barrel recessed into the weapon's bullpup layout.
translations: 包含专用补偿器和相应的枪栓组件的快拆枪管套件，可被安装至沙漠科技 MDRX 步枪的框架上。该套件适配 .223 口径弹药，通过 STANAG 弹匣供弹；通过隐藏在无托式结构内的11.5英寸枪管，将 MDRX 变为了一把紧凑的CQB卡宾枪。

messages.msgid: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  Bored for .300 AAC Blackout munitions, the assembly requires STANAG magazines for feeding.
translations: 包含专用补偿器和相应的枪栓组件的快拆枪管套件，可被安装至沙漠科技 MDRX 步枪的框架上。该套件适配 .300 BLK 弹，通过 STANAG 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach, 20-inch barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  chambered for long-range .308 Winchester munitions and requiring AR-10 magazines for feeding, the assembly essentially retools the weapon into a designated marksman's rifle.
translations: 包含专用补偿器和相应的枪栓组件的快拆枪管套件，可被安装至沙漠科技 MDRX 步枪的框架上。该套件适配 .308 温切斯特弹，通过 AR-10 弹匣供弹；通过20英寸的枪管与长射程弹药，将武器变为一把精确射手步枪。

messages.msgid: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach, 16-inch barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  Chambered for long-range .308 Winchester munitions and requiring AR-10 magazines for feeding, the assembly essentially retools the weapon into a designated marksman's rifle.
translations: 包含专用补偿器和相应的枪栓组件的快拆枪管套件，可被安装至沙漠科技 MDRX 步枪的框架上。该套件适配 .308 温切斯特弹，通过 AR-10 弹匣供弹；通过16英寸的枪管与长射程弹药，将武器变为一把精确射手步枪。

messages.msgid: This is a specialized 27-inch .338-caliber barrel and bolt face that is installable within the main chassis of an Accuracy International AXMC rifle, converting it to fire the .338 Lapua cartridge.
translations: 特制的27英寸 .338 口径枪管与枪栓，可被安装至精密国际 AXMC 模块化狙击步枪的框架上，使其能够发射 .338 拉普阿弹。

messages.msgid: This is a specialized 24-inch .300-caliber barrel and bolt face that is installable within the main chassis of an Accuracy International AXMC rifle, converting it to fire the .300 Winchester Magnum cartridge.
translations: 特制的24英寸 .300 口径枪管与枪栓，可被安装至精密国际 AXMC 模块化狙击步枪的框架上，使其能够发射 .300 温切斯特马格南弹。

messages.msgid: This is a specialized 24-inch .308-caliber barrel and bolt face that is installable within the main chassis of an Accuracy International AXMC rifle, converting it to fire the .308 Winchester cartridge.
translations: 特制的24英寸 .308 口径枪管与枪栓，可被安装至精密国际 AXMC 模块化狙击步枪的框架上，使其能够发射 .308 温切斯特弹。

messages.msgid: This is a quick-detach .223-caliber barrel assembly and bolt-head, installable within the frame of a CZ 600 rifle, and secured with three fasteners.  With this assembly installed, a rifle is capable of feeding ammunition from standard STANAG-style magazines.
translations: 可快拆的.223口径枪管套件与枪栓，可通过三个紧固件被安装至CZ 600栓动式卡宾枪的框架上。换装此套件后，枪械可使用常见的 STANAG 弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: This is a quick-detach 7.62mm barrel assembly and bolt head, installable within the frame of a CZ 600 rifle, and secured with three fasteners.  With this assembly installed, a rifle is rendered compatible with 7.62x39mm CZ Bren 2 magazines.
translations: 可快拆的7.62mm口径枪管套件与枪栓，可通过三个紧固件被安装至CZ 600栓动式卡宾枪的框架上。换装此套件后，枪械可兼容7.62x39mm的CZ Bren 2弹匣。
沙漠之鹰 .357 改装套件

messages.msgid: This is a caliber conversion for a Desert Eagle pistol, allowing it to shoot .357 Magnum ammunition.  It includes the barrel and the reduced-diameter bolt.  Don't forget the .357 magazine!
translations: 沙漠之鹰手枪的口径改装套件，使其能够发射 .357 马格南弹。包含枪管与小尺寸的枪栓。别忘了配备 .357 的弹匣！
沙漠之鹰 .44 改装套件

messages.msgid: This is a caliber conversion for a Desert Eagle pistol, allowing it to shoot .44 Magnum ammunition.  It includes the barrel, sporting an integral muzzle brake, and the standard-diameter bolt.  Don't forget the .44 magazine!
translations: 沙漠之鹰手枪的口径改装套件，使其能够发射 .44 马格南弹。包含集成抑制器的枪管与标准尺寸的枪栓。别忘了配备 .44 的弹匣！
沙漠之鹰 .50 改装套件

messages.msgid: This is a caliber conversion for a Desert Eagle pistol, allowing it to shoot the infamous .50 Action Express round.  It includes the barrel, sporting an integral muzzle brake, and the standard-diameter bolt.  Don't forget the .50 magazine!
translations: 沙漠之鹰手枪的口径改装套件，使其能够发射恶名远扬的 .50 AE 弹。包含集成抑制器的枪管与标准尺寸的枪栓。别忘了配备 .50 的弹匣！

messages.msgid: This is a caliber conversion for a UMP sub-machine gun allowing it to shoot 9x19mm ammo.  It includes the barrel and the bolt.  Don't forget the 9mm UMP magazine!
translations: UMP冲锋枪的口径改装套件，使其能够发射 9x19mm 弹。包含枪管及枪栓。别忘了配备 9mm UMP 弹匣！

messages.msgid: This is a caliber conversion for a UMP sub-machine gun allowing it to shoot .40 S&W ammo.  It includes the barrel and the bolt.  Don't forget the .40 UMP magazine!
translations: UMP冲锋枪的口径改装套件，使其能够发射 .40 S&W 弹。包含枪管及枪栓。别忘了配备 .40 UMP 弹匣！

messages.msgid: This is a caliber conversion for a UMP sub-machine gun allowing it to shoot .45 ACP ammo.  It includes the barrel and the bolt.  Don't forget the .45 UMP magazine!
translations: UMP冲锋枪的口径改装套件，使其能够发射 .45 ACP 弹。包含枪管及枪栓。别忘了配备 .45 UMP 弹匣！

messages.msgid: A larger cradle with a longer sling for fitting to a staff sling to enable it to throw grenades.
translations: 更大的托兜，更长的绳索，安装到投石杖上后使其能够投掷手雷。

messages.msgid: A set of optics made to fit on laser weapons, which will diffract the laser beam into several lower powered beams.  This increases point-blank damage, but greatly reduces range.
translations: 一套用于激光武器的光学器件，可将激光束分解成多条低能激光，增加近身伤害，但大大减少射程。

messages.msgid: A set of optics to concentrate the laser beam on a smaller focus point.  This increases range and damage output, but complicates targeting.
translations: 一套光学透镜，可将激光束聚焦到更小的点上，增加射程和伤害，但延长了瞄准流程。

messages.msgid: A set of high-tech electronics and optics.  Converts a laser pistol into a less-lethal electrolaser capable of stunning targets, at the cost of a decreased damage output and increased power consumption.
translations: 一套高科技电路及光学透镜组合，可将激光手枪改装成发射能够击晕目标的非致命电子激光束，但相应地减少了伤害输出，并增加射击时的能量消耗。

messages.msgid: A set of electronics to optimize emitter workcycle and increase overall energy efficiency.  Decreases power consumption.
translations: 一套用于优化发射器工作循环，增加整体能量效率的电路组合，可降低射击时的能量消耗。

messages.msgid: A capacitor with a higher energy density.  Increases range and damage at the cost of markedly increased power consumption.
translations: 一个由高能量密度材质制成的电容，可增加激光武器的射程和伤害，但也极大的增加了射击时的能量消耗。

messages.msgid: A metal ramp that can be installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  Need modification before attaching.
translations: 一块可以安装在霰弹枪装弹口附近的金属斜坡，用来引导快速装弹器与装弹口对齐。需要根据霰弹枪进行改造后才能安装。
快速装弹器滑槽（4发水禽霰弹枪）

messages.msgid: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 4-round waterfowl shotgun.
translations: 一块可以安装在霰弹枪装弹口附近的金属斜坡，用来引导快速装弹器与装弹口对齐。这个已被适配用于4发水禽霰弹枪。
快速装弹器滑槽（4发破门霰弹枪）

messages.msgid: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 4-round breaching shotgun.
translations: 一块可以安装在霰弹枪装弹口附近的金属斜坡，用来引导快速装弹器与装弹口对齐。这个已被适配用于4发破门霰弹枪。
快速装弹器滑槽（5发狩猎霰弹枪）

messages.msgid: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 5-round hunting shotgun.
translations: 一块可以安装在霰弹枪装弹口附近的金属斜坡，用来引导快速装弹器与装弹口对齐。这个已被适配用于5发狩猎霰弹枪。
快速装弹器滑槽（6发战斗霰弹枪）

messages.msgid: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 6-round combat shotgun.
translations: 一块可以安装在霰弹枪装弹口附近的金属斜坡，用来引导快速装弹器与装弹口对齐。这个已被适配用于6发战斗霰弹枪。
快速装弹器滑槽（8发自动霰弹枪）

messages.msgid: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 8-round auto-loading shotgun.
translations: 一块可以安装在霰弹枪装弹口附近的金属斜坡，用来引导快速装弹器与装弹口对齐。这个已被适配用于8发自动霰弹枪。
快速装弹器滑槽（9发战斗霰弹枪）

messages.msgid: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 9-round combat shotgun.
translations: 一块可以安装在霰弹枪装弹口附近的金属斜坡，用来引导快速装弹器与装弹口对齐。这个已被适配用于9发战斗霰弹枪。

messages.msgid: A precision weighted trigger assembly that slightly improves a firearm's accuracy.
translations: 一个精调过扳机重量的扳机组件，可以略微提升枪械射击时的精度。

messages.msgid: A vaguely 'U'-shaped piece of metal with a vaguely 'T'-shaped flapper on a pin.  Once tucked into an AR-15's lower receiver, the rifle will become selective fire-capable.  The handcrafted-sear surface isn't as good as actual full-auto parts, so precision and reliability suffer slightly.
translations: 一个U形的金属块，后方栓接了一个T形活动块。将它卡进AR-15式步枪的下机匣内，就能恢复武器的射击模式切换功能。由于自制阻铁的工艺品质不如实际的全自动组件，因此安装后的枪械精度与可靠性也略欠于后者。

messages.msgid: Originally designed for the Colt SP-1, this 'reproduction' is intended to convert an AR-15 into a full-auto only rifle.  Once the necessary modifications are made and the link is in place, semi-auto is disabled and full-auto is enabled.  Reliability and precision suffer greatly due to questionable craftsmanship and lack of unobtainium SP-1 parts.
translations: 基于最早用于柯尔特 SP-1 步枪的设计，这个"仿制品"可以将一把AR-15 步枪变为一把仅可全自动射击的步枪。在完成必要的前置改装后，安装快装联片阻铁将使武器的射击模式将从半自动锁死为全自动。由于难以言表的制作工艺，以及无法获取到 SP-1 原装件进行比对，改装后的枪械精度与可靠性将受到很大影响。
格洛克全自动挡板阻铁

messages.msgid: A relatively simple switch or button mechanism that replaces the back plate of a Glock slide, allowing it to function as a select-fire machine pistol.  A highly illegal modification, but the feds are zombie food anyway.  This will fit any standard Glock pistol in 9mm, .40, .45, 10mm, or .357 caliber.
translations: 一个相对简单的开关或按钮结构，将其与格洛克手枪的套筒原装挡板替换，你就得到了一把可选射击模式的全自动手枪。极度非法的改装，不过条子们已经忙着成为丧尸们的大餐了。该模组适用于任何标准格洛克手枪——不论是9mm、.40、.45、10mm，还是.357口径。

messages.msgid: A relatively simple modification of some of a TEC-9's internal fire-control components, converting it to a fully-automatic-only machine pistol.  Calling this hilariously illegal would be an understatement, but anyone who'd care is probably long gone by now.
translations: 这个模组对TEC-9的一些内部扳机结构进行了相对简单的改造，将其改造成为全自动冲锋枪。把这种改装称为"违法行为"甚至都算轻描淡写，但会关心这种事情的人应该都已经与世长辞了。

messages.msgid: A complex set of parts designed to minimize recoil using a reciprocating counterweight.
translations: 一套复杂的部件，旨在通过往复式配重来最大限度地降低后坐力。

messages.msgid: A trigger modification that allows the M249 to switch between semi and full automatic modes.
translations: 一个改造后的快慢机，可以让M249在半自动与全自动射击模式间切换。

messages.msgid: A condenser unit for the Caotel Sr2.2, seemingly in perfect condition.
translations: 考特尔 Sr2.2的冷凝器单元，看起来状态完美。

messages.msgid: A trigger modification that allows the M240 to switch between semi and full automatic modes.
translations: 一个改造后的快慢机，可以让M240在半自动与全自动射击模式间切换。

messages.msgid: A kit consisting of various steel and plastic parts.  When installed, it will permanently modify and partially replace some of the weapon's furniture so that it can be easily changed if needed.  This allows installing any kind of more advanced grips or other furniture.
translations: 一个由各种钢和塑料部件组成的套件；安装后，它将永久性地修改和部分替换枪具握把的一些组件，以便需要时能够很容易地替换。这样使老式枪械可以安装上各种各样更高级的握把。

messages.msgid: A plastic mount for attaching a rail accessory, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.
translations: 一个用于安装导轨模组的塑料底座，只要几个紧固件就能让其与绝大多数武器的枪身紧紧相依、*永不*分离。满足你"把老枪改成晾衣杆"的战术幻想。

messages.msgid: A plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon other than launchers and pistols, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.
translations: 一个用于安装瞄具模组的塑料底座，只要几个紧固件就能让其与除发射器及手枪外，绝大多数武器的枪身紧紧相依、*永不*分离。满足你"把老枪改成晾衣杆"的战术幻想。

messages.msgid: A plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any launcher, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on rocket launchers.
translations: 一个用于安装瞄具模组的塑料底座，只要几个紧固件就能让其与绝大多数发射器的枪身紧紧相依、*永不*分离。满足你"把发射器改成晾衣杆（管？）"的战术幻想。

messages.msgid: A plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any pistol, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on pocket pistols.
translations: 一个用于安装瞄具模组的塑料底座，只要几个紧固件就能让其与，绝大多数手枪的枪身紧紧相依、*永不*分离。满足你"把手枪改成晾衣杆"的战术幻想。

messages.msgid: A kit consisting of various steel parts.  When installed, it will remove the weapon's original fixed stock, install a new stock mount in its place, modify the original stock to fit it and then reattach it to the gun, or simply attach a stock mount if the gun had no stock to start with.  This allows easy installation of any kind of more advanced stocks.
translations: 一套包含多种钢制改装件的套件。安装后，武器的枪托位置将被安装（或替换为）一个枪托底座，而拆下来的原枪托（如果武器改装前存在枪托）将经过改装后重新装回底座。为老式枪械提供了使用现代化枪托的可能。

messages.msgid: A plastic mount for attaching an underbarrel accessory, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.
translations: 一个用于安装下挂式附件的塑料导轨座，设计为可配合一些紧固件永久固定在几乎任何武器上。非常适合让你的老枪也能释放出内心的“战术装逼”

messages.msgid: A one-piece mount for attaching a bayonet to a firearm's accessory rail, in case that was a thing you wanted.  Ideal for making newer guns pointier.
translations: 一个用于将刺刀安装在枪械导轨上的一体式支架——如果你有这样的需求的话。让现代枪械也有机会像老式枪械那样，枪头尖尖的。

messages.msgid: A compensator contains a number of holes or slits to vent some of the exhaust gasses of a gun upwards to reduce muzzle climb, while also increasing noise and bulk slightly.
translations: 一个补偿器，通过上面的数个小孔或缝隙，引导部分枪口气体向上排出，以抑制一定的枪口上跳，缺点是会略微增加枪口噪音和武器体积。

messages.msgid: A muzzle brake redirects exhaust gases to reduce recoil, at the cost of increasing bulk, noise, and reducing accuracy slightly.
translations: 一个枪口制退器，通过改变枪口气体的排出方向来缓和后坐力，但会增加枪口噪音和武器体积，以及略微降低精准度。

messages.msgid: A homemade suppressor made from a pipe and improvised wipe media.  For as long as the wipes hold up, it will reduce the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels, as well as slightly reducing recoil and muzzle velocity.  This simple suppressor is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun.
translations: 一个自制消音器，由一节钢管和作为擦片的简易材料拼凑而成。只要“擦片”还在，就能一定程度地抑制武器发射时所产生的噪音和枪口火焰。枪械击发后会产生极大的噪音，甚至可能伤及听力；消音器不光可以将枪声降低到一个可以接受的范围内，同时还会减少后坐力但是降低枪口初速度。这个自制的消音器不光体型巨大，安装后还会遮挡枪械原本瞄具的视线。

messages.msgid: An automotive filter crudely adapted to mate up with a firearm's barrel, creating an illegal, unregistered suppressor.  Good thing there don't seem to be any ATF agents around to arrest you.  While close in design to a real suppressor, it was not designed for the high pressures involved in gunfire and will eventually lose effectiveness.  The filter is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun.
translations: 一个汽车过滤器，经过改装可被安装到枪口上作为消音器使用。无需登记、完全非法，幸好现在已经没有ATF探员会因此逮捕你。虽然原理和真正的消音器相近，但它并不是为枪械射击产生的高压环境而设计的，并会逐渐失去效果。这个自制的消音器不光体型巨大，安装后还会遮挡枪械原本瞄具的视线。

messages.msgid: A large suppressor designed to work with shotguns.  It's a lot more complex than a suppressor for a pistol or rifle.
translations: 一个霰弹枪消音器。体积巨大，相较手枪和步枪消音器也更复杂。

messages.msgid: A suppressor reduces the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels.
translations: 一个消音器，用于抑制枪械发射时所产生的枪口噪音和火焰。枪械击发后会产生极大的噪音，甚至可能伤及听力；消音器可以将枪声降低到一个可以接受的范围内。

messages.msgid: The integrated suppressor for the H&K MP5SD.  Its large expansion chamber decelerates ammunition via several ports in the barrel, rendering most ammo subsonic at the cost of terminal performance.  It is not as effective as modern designs.
translations: H&K MP5SD 冲锋枪的内置消音器。消音器的大型舱室及枪管周围的多处排气门能够将绝大多数种类的子弹的初速降至亚音速，但同时也降低了其弹道性能。现代消音器的性能已经超越这种消音器。

messages.msgid: A suppressor designed for pistols, submachine guns, and pistol caliber carbines.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels.
translations: 一个用于手枪、冲锋枪，和使用手枪弹的卡宾枪的消音器。枪械击发后会产生极大的噪音，甚至可能伤及听力；消音器可以将枪声降低到一个可以接受的范围内。

messages.msgid: A choke shapes the spread of a shot cloud to give a shotgun better range and accuracy.
translations: 可以改变霰弹弹丸散布的喉缩，使霰弹拥有更好的射程和精度。

messages.msgid: An alternative set of iron sights mounted at 45° for use when a scope or other modification prevents use of the primary sights.
translations: 一套安装在枪械侧面45度角的机械瞄具，方便在主瞄具被其他瞄具或模组占用后仍能使用到机械瞄具。

messages.msgid: An additional rail set at 45° for attaching a secondary optic.
translations: 一套安装在枪械侧面45度角的瞄具导轨，方便安装额外的副瞄具。

messages.msgid: A small visible-light laser that mounts on a firearm's accessory rail to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.
translations: 一个小型可见激光发射器，可被安装到导轨上，提升索敌和瞄准效率。除了增加一点点重量外，完全没有缺点。

messages.msgid: An angled grip set at 45° that attaches to a side rail, allowing for a grip while leaving the underbarrel rail free, or on guns that have integral bipods.
translations: 一套安装在枪械侧面45度角的侧面握把，方便在需要留出管下位置，或武器有内置双脚架的情况下仍能使用到握把。

messages.msgid: A set of adjustable optic fiber aiming pins with a bracket to mount on modern bows.  It takes more time to calibrate but can improve accuracy more effectively.
translations: 一个包含一套可调式光纤针瞄的支架，可被安装到现代弓上。瞄准耗费的时间更多，但相应的也能瞄得更准些。

messages.msgid: A single aluminum pin with a bracket to mount on modern bows.  Quick to use.
translations: 一个带有铝制的单针瞄的支架，可被安装到现代弓上。比起准度，更注重快速瞄准。

messages.msgid: A single magnifying scope mounted on an adjustable bracket, with accompanying clarifier peep sight.  Designed for extra long shots, but easily adjusted for short range.  Spectacularly accurate.
translations: 一个带有一块倍镜，以及成套的澄清器和窥孔的支架。设计用于超远距离射击，但也能调整适应短距离射击。命中率惊人。

messages.msgid: An advanced optic with an adjustable circular hologram reticle superimposed on the field of view.  Used extensively by military forces, it increases accuracy and weight.  This is a step up from a red dot sight.
translations: 一个可在瞄具镜片上投映可调的圆形全息标线的先进光学瞄具。同时提升射击精度和武器重量，在军队中被广泛使用。相较红点瞄准镜有明显改进。

messages.msgid: A basic set of iron sights.
A small scope intended for use on a handgun.  Increases weight but improves accuracy greatly.
translations: 一个为手枪设计的小瞄准镜。同时提升射击精度和武器重量。

messages.msgid: A red dot optic meant to be attached to the top of the weapon, replacing the iron sights.  Increases accuracy and weight.
translations: 一个用于取代机械瞄具的光学红点瞄准镜。同时提升射击精度和武器重量。

messages.msgid: A 3-18x44 rifle scope.  It is adjustable for windage and elevation in 1/10th mrad increments and is remarkably small and light for its magnification.
translations: 一个 3-18x44 规格的步枪瞄准镜。它可以按 1/10 毫弧度增量调节风量和仰角，并且相对其放大倍数而言非常小巧轻便。

messages.msgid: A 3-18x44 rifle scope.  It is adjustable for windage and elevation in 1/10th mrad increments and is remarkably small and light for its magnification.  This one has an additional rail on the top of its ring mounts for an additional backup optic.
translations: 一个 3-18x44 规格的步枪瞄准镜。它可以按 1/10 毫弧度增量调节风量和仰角，并且相对其放大倍数而言非常小巧轻便。这一个还在其环形支架顶部额外附带了导轨，可用以安装额外的备用瞄具。

messages.msgid: A 4x32 TA01 Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight with a tritium illuminated crosshair.
translations: 一个 4x32 TA01 型先进战斗光学瞄准镜（ACOG），带有一个氚发光十字准星。

messages.msgid: A sleek compact 3x magnifier designed to sit behind a modern holographic sight.  Mounted on a lever to quickly flip in and out of the sights picture, the magnifier allows the full functionality of a high end close quarters sight while also allowing you to engage targets at range.
translations: 一个圆滑紧凑的 3 倍变焦器，可被安装在现代全息瞄准镜后方。与其相连的开关方便将其快速切入和切出瞄准视野，让你在享受高端近距离瞄准镜的同时，还能拥有与远距离目标交战的能力。
混合式 ACOG 瞄准镜

messages.msgid: A high end 4x32 military grade ACOG scope.  This one has additional mounting brackets on top for another sight.
translations: 一个高端的 4x32 军规级先进战斗光学瞄准镜(ACOG)。这一个还在其顶部额外附带了导轨，可用以安装额外的备用瞄具。

messages.msgid: An integral component of the RM11B rifle system, the RS1219 Accipiter digital scope provides auto-adjusting focal length, a user-selectable reticle, and an offset reflex sight for close objectives.
translations: 作为 RM11B 步枪系统的其中一个内置组件，RS1219 数码型远距瞄准镜包含了自动调整瞄准焦距与可选择标线样式的功能，其侧面还有一个供快速反应近距离目标的反射式瞄准镜。

messages.msgid: A simple hand-crafted telescopic sight, essentially a small telescope with crosshairs.  Not as good as the ones made before the Cataclysm.  Increases weight but improves accuracy.
translations: 一个自制的望远镜式瞄准镜——其实就是个画上了标线的望远镜。没有大灾变之前制作得那么精良。同时提升射击精度和武器重量。

messages.msgid: A simple telescopic sight intended for use on a handgun.  Increases weight but improves accuracy greatly.
translations: 一个为手枪设计的望远镜式瞄准镜。大幅提升射击精度，并提升武器重量。

messages.msgid: A basic and antique 4x rifle optic: essentially a non-adjustable telescopic sight built by the Nagoya Arsenal during the Second World War and issued for mounting on Type 99 sniper rifles.
translations: 一个简易且古早的4倍步枪光学瞄具——是名古屋兵工厂在第二次世界大战期间制造的一种无法调节的望远镜式瞄准镜，作为制式配件安装在有坂九九式狙击步枪上。

messages.msgid: A shoulder strap allows the rifle to be worn over a shoulder like a piece of clothing.  However, it offers no protection.
translations: 一条肩带，让你可以把武器跨肩穿在身上。虽说是在身上多穿了一件，但别指望它能带来什么保护。

messages.msgid: An adjustable strap that allows the rifle to be worn over your shoulders like a piece of clothing.  However, it offers no protection.
translations: 一条肩带，让你可以把武器跨肩穿在身上。虽说是在身上多穿了一件，但别指望它能带来什么保护。

messages.msgid: You shift the weapon to the front of your body.
A shoulder strap allows the rifle to be worn over your shoulders like a piece of clothing.  Currently adjusted so the weapon hangs off your front.
translations: 一条肩带，让你可以把武器跨肩穿在身上。目前武器被调整到挂在你的胸前。

messages.msgid: You shift the weapon to the back of your body.
An adjustable replacement stock improving both recoil and accuracy.
translations: 一个可以调节枪托长度的可更换枪托，改善枪械后坐力和射击。

messages.msgid: A folding stock which reduces length when folded.  Currently unfolded and ready to shoot.
translations: 一个可以折叠以缩短枪身长度的折叠枪托。目前处于展开状态，以备射击。

messages.msgid: You fold the stock for transport.
A folding stock which reduces length.  Currently folded, making shooting this gun difficult.
translations: 一个可以折叠以缩短枪身长度的折叠枪托。目前处于折叠状态，很难射击。

messages.msgid: You unfold the stock for combat.
A multi position, high-end folding stock which reduces length when folded.  Currently unfolded and ready to shoot.
translations: 一个可以折叠以缩短枪身长度的高端折叠枪托，包含多档可调长度。目前处于展开状态，以备射击。

messages.msgid: A multi position, high-end folding stock which reduces length when folded.  Currently folded, making shooting this gun hard.
translations: 一个可以折叠以缩短枪身长度的高端折叠枪托，包含多档可调长度。目前处于折叠状态，很难射击。

messages.msgid: A collapsing wire stock which folds closely against the body of the weapon, reducing length and volume.
translations: 一个铁丝枪托，可以紧密折叠在枪身上，减少枪身长度和体积。

messages.msgid: You push the stock in for storage.
A collapsing wire stock which folds closely against the body of the weapon, reducing length and volume.  Currently collapsed, making shooting difficult.
translations: 一个铁丝枪托，可以紧密折叠在枪身上，减少枪身长度和体积。目前处于折叠状态，很难射击。

messages.msgid: You pull the stock out for combat.

translations: 毛瑟 C96 木制枪托

messages.msgid: The hollow removable wooden pistol stock of the C96 Mauser pistol, which doubles as a holster.  It fits both the original clip-loaded C96 and later magazine-fed reproductions, but a gun with an extended magazine won't fit without modification.
translations: 毛瑟 C96 手枪配套的中空可拆卸式木质枪托，兼具枪套功能。枪托可装入采用弹夹供弹的原版以及后期采用弹匣供弹的复刻版本；如若武器装载了扩容弹匣，不将枪托经过改造则无法将其容纳。

messages.msgid: A quick saw cut removed the original stock from this weapon.  It is now much harder to handle, but much smaller.
translations: 将武器原始枪托的主体直接锯下。现在武器的后坐力更难控制，但体积变小了很多。

messages.msgid: An add-on stock for handguns, this considerably improves control of recoil.
translations: 一个附加在手枪上的枪托，可以显著提升后坐力控制。

messages.msgid: A replacement stock designed to absorb perceived recoil.
translations: 一个注重于缓解枪械射击时的后坐力的可更换枪托。

messages.msgid: A stock accessory for sniper rifles and DMRs, this considerably improves eye relief efficiency, prevents slipping, and reduces recoil to the neck and cheek.
translations: 一套供狙击步枪和精确射手步枪使用的枪托配件。极大提升眼部舒适度，防止枪托滑动，并降低颈部和脸颊所受到的后坐力。

messages.msgid: An attachment to the butt of the gun that is held under the armpit, improving stability.
translations: 一个安装在枪托后方的枪托配件，通过将枪托卡在肩腋处，提升射击时的稳定性。

messages.msgid: A foldable add-on stock for handguns and submachine guns with a pivoting hook that latches onto the forearm, allowing for greater stability.
translations: 一个可折叠的，用于手枪和冲锋枪的枪托。带有一个可旋转的尾钩，能够钩住前臂，提升射击时的稳定性。

messages.msgid: A light wire-framed stock with a push button release catch on the side  which allows it to fold and be stored away under the weapon's receiver.  The wire construction means that it's less comfortable to shoulder than a regular fixed attachment.  The stock is currently locked in the open position.
translations: 一个轻便的铁丝枪托，侧面有个按钮释放锁扣，可以折叠并存放在枪身的机匣下。它的铁丝结构意味着，与常规固定枪托相比，抵肩射击时自然更不舒服。枪托目前锁定在展开位置。

messages.msgid: You push in the release catch on the side and fold away the stock.
translations: 你按下侧面的释放钮，将枪托折叠收起。

messages.msgid: A light wire-framed stock with a push button release catch on the side  which allows it to fold and be stored away under the weapon's receiver.  It is currently folded underneath the weapon's chassis, making it more difficult to control.
translations: 一个轻便的铁丝枪托，侧面有个按钮释放锁扣，可以折叠并存放在枪身的机匣下。它目前被折叠在枪械机匣下，使得在射击时更难控制武器后坐力。

messages.msgid: The integral series of hinges and pivots which allow the SUB-2000 to fold in half and be stored for transport.  The firearm is currently locked in the unfolded position and is ready for use.
translations: 一系列内置的铰链和枢轴，让 SUB-2000 卡宾枪能够对折起来存放并携带。枪械目前处于展开状态，以备射击。

messages.msgid: You tug down on the trigger guard whilst swinging the barrel assembly up and over onto the receiver, locking it into place by the buttplate.
translations: 你向下拉动扳机护圈，同时将枪管组件向上翻转至机匣处，再用枪托底板将其锁定到位。

messages.msgid: The integral series of hinges and pivots which allow the SUB-2000 to fold in half and be stored for transport.  Shooting this firearm would be particularly tricky given that the barrel assembly is folded and locked backwards for storage, rendering the weapon inoperable.
translations: 一系列内置的铰链和枢轴，让 SUB-2000 卡宾枪能够对折起来存放并携带。鉴于枪管组件正处于“枪口冲着自己”的折叠状态，要想用它射击可能得费点脑子——俗称没法射击。

messages.msgid: You release the barrel and pivot it forwards, locking it in the open firing position.
translations: 你解锁枪管并将其向前转动，锁定在射击位置。

messages.msgid: A specially designed adjustable stock with an integrated grip to convert the M26-MASS to a standalone configuration.
translations: 一个专为 M26-MASS 霰弹系统设计的，包含内置握把的可调枪托，可将 M26-MASS 作为独立武器使用。

messages.msgid: An extremely lightweight stock.  There's a hollow cavity at the bottom where a spare magazine can be stored.
translations: 一个非常轻量的枪托。枪托底部还专门开了个放备用弹匣的中空槽位。

messages.msgid: Bipods are commonly used on rifles and machine guns to provide a forward rest and reduce motion.  Although they greatly improve handling of recoil, they are usable only on certain surfaces (or from the prone position), and are slow to equip.
translations: 两脚架是广泛使用于步枪与机枪的、可提供枪械前端稳定性、减少摆动的泛用部件之一。尽管可以极大地提高后座的可控度，它只能在俯卧姿态，或所处位置存在可用于架设的平台时使用，更别提较长的架设时间了。

messages.msgid: Bipods are commonly used on rifles and machine guns to provide a forward rest and reduce motion.  Although they greatly improve handling of recoil, they are usable only on certain surfaces (or from the prone position).  This one is integrated into a high end hand guard, replacing the factory hand guard of your weapon, allowing for comfortable shooting with or without the bipod deployed.  Currently the bipod legs are stowed.
translations: 两脚架是广泛使用于步枪与机枪的、可提供枪械前端稳定性、减少摆动的泛用部件之一。尽管可以极大地提高后座的可控度，它只能在俯卧姿态，或所处位置存在可用于架设的平台时使用。这个两脚架集成在高端护木中，取代了武器的原厂护木，使武器即便不架设两脚架，也能舒适地射击。目前两脚架腿处于收起状态。
你伸长了两脚架的支腿。

messages.msgid: Bipods are commonly used on rifles and machine guns to provide a forward rest and reduce motion.  Although they greatly improve handling of recoil, they are usable only on certain surfaces (or from the prone position).  This one is integrated into a high end hand guard, replacing the factory hand guard of your weapon, allowing for comfortable shooting with or without the bipod deployed.  Currently the bipod legs are out and are ready for use.
translations: 两脚架是广泛使用于步枪与机枪的、可提供枪械前端稳定性、减少摆动的泛用部件之一。尽管可以极大地提高后座的可控度，它只能在俯卧姿态，或所处位置存在可用于架设的平台时使用。这个两脚架集成在高端护木中，取代了武器的原厂护木，使武器即便不架设两脚架，也能舒适地射击。目前两脚架腿已经展开，可供架设。

messages.msgid: You collapse and fold the bipod legs.
translations: 你收缩并折叠了两脚架。

messages.msgid: A comfortable, high end hand guard with a set of optional mounts for accessories and equipment.  When installed, this replaces the original factory hand guard for the weapon, cutting down on excessive rails and weight.  This allows for comfortable, controlled firing of the weapon while keeping a sleek profile and avoiding bulky foregrips.
translations: 一个舒适的高端护木，包含一组可用于安装额外配件的底座。安装时将取代原厂护木，并移除不必要的导轨和枪身重量；使枪械的护木维持平滑的同时也能提升射击时的操控和舒适度，而不是依赖安装前握把“节外生枝”。

messages.msgid: The integrated underbarrel shotgun of a combination gun which holds two shots.  It's irremovable.
translations: 步霰复合枪下方集成的霰弹枪管，总共能容纳2发霰弹。无法拆除。

messages.msgid: A grip placed forward on the barrel allows for greater control.  Not as effective as a bipod but usable under all conditions.
translations: 一个安装在枪管前端位置的握把，让武器更好操控。效果不如两脚架，但不像两脚架存在地形依赖。

messages.msgid: A grip placed forward on the barrel allows for greater control.  Not as effective as a bipod but usable under all conditions.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon, if you so want.
translations: 一个安装在枪管前端位置的握把，让武器更好操控。效果不如两脚架，但不像两脚架存在地形依赖。这个握把经过改装，能够适配几乎所有的武器种类——如果你真的觉得有必要的话。

messages.msgid: A wooden grip placed forward on the barrel allows for greater control.  Not as effective as a bipod but usable under all conditions.  This one was cleverly handmade by a desperate survivor or miserly enthusiast, it cannot be removed after installation.
translations: 一个安装在枪管前端位置的握把，让武器更好操控。效果不如两脚架，但不像两脚架存在地形依赖。愿意费心将其做出来的，不是绝望的幸存者，就是省钱的手工爱好者。安装后无法被拆除。

messages.msgid: You fold in the bayonet.  It can no longer be used.
translations: 你将刺刀折回。现在刺刀无法使用。

messages.msgid: The weapon's integrated bayonet has been folded for storage.
translations: 该武器的集成刺刀，目前被折叠起来以便携带。

messages.msgid: You fold out the bayonet.  It can be used.
translations: 你将刺刀展开。现在刺刀可以使用。

messages.msgid: A visible-light laser that mounts under a firearm's barrel to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.
translations: 一个小型可见激光发射器，可被安装到枪管下方，提升索敌和瞄准效率。除了增加一点点重量外，完全没有缺点。

messages.msgid: The M203 was originally designed for use with M16 variants but today can be attached to almost any rifle.  It allows a single 40mm grenade to be loaded and fired.
translations: M203 榴弹发射器组件，最初为 M16 步枪设计，如今已迭代到能够适配几乎所有步枪。可装入一发 40mm 榴弹进行射击。
M203 榴弹发射器（适配改装）

messages.msgid: The M203 was originally designed for use with M16 variants but today can be attached to almost any rifle.  It allows a single 40mm grenade to be loaded and fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns, if you so want.
translations: M203 榴弹发射器组件，最初为 M16 步枪设计，如今已迭代到能够适配几乎所有步枪。可装入一发 40mm 榴弹进行射击。这个发射器组件经过改装，能够适配除手枪和泵动式枪械外，几乎所有的武器种类——如果你真的觉得有必要的话。

messages.msgid: The M320 Grenade Launcher Module offers the functionality of larger launchers in a very small package at the cost of decreased accuracy.  It can be either attached to a rifle or combined with a buttstock for standalone use.
translations: M320 榴弹发射器模组，在维持大型发射器上应有功能的前提下，将体积极致压缩，缺点是射击精度相对地降低不少。它既可被安装在步枪的管下，也可安装枪托后独立使用。
M320 榴弹发射器模组（适配改装）

messages.msgid: The M320 Grenade Launcher Module offers the functionality of larger launchers in a very small package at the cost of decreased accuracy.  It can be either attached to a rifle or combined with a buttstock for standalone use.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns, if you so want.
translations: M320 榴弹发射器模组，在维持大型发射器上应有功能的前提下，将体积极致压缩，缺点是射击精度相对地降低不少。它既可被安装在步枪的管下，也可安装枪托后独立使用。这个发射器模组经过改装，能够适配除手枪和泵动式枪械外，几乎所有的武器种类——如果你真的觉得有必要的话。

messages.msgid: The integrated 12 gauge shotgun barrel of the Chiappa M6 Survival Gun.  It's irremovable.
translations: M6 生存步枪集成的12号口径霰弹枪。无法拆除。

messages.msgid: A minimalist pump-action shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows a total of four shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.
translations: 一个极简设计的泵动式霰弹枪，可被安装在多种步枪的管下。可装入四发霰弹进行射击。
"万能钥匙"管下霰弹枪（适配改装）

messages.msgid: A minimalist pump-action shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows a total of four shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns, if you so want.
translations: 一个极简设计的泵动式霰弹枪，可被安装在多种步枪的管下。可装入四发霰弹进行射击。这个霰弹枪经过改装，能够适配除手枪和泵动式枪械外，几乎所有的武器种类——如果你真的觉得有必要的话。

messages.msgid: The Modular Accessory Shotgun System is an underbarrel bolt-action shotgun that was inspired by the "Masterkey" and fixed most of its predecessor's problems.  It can be mounted under the barrel of a rifle, or used as a standalone weapon by attaching a pistol grip or collapsible buttstock module.  It feeds from three- or five-shot detachable magazines.
translations: 模块化配件霰弹枪系统(MASS)，一把受"万能钥匙"启发研发出的管下栓动式霰弹枪，并解决了后者的大部分问题。它既可被安装在步枪的管下，也可安装手枪握把或专门的枪托组件后独立使用。通过三发或五发的可拆卸弹匣供弹。
M26-MASS 霰弹系统（适配改装）

messages.msgid: The Modular Accessory Shotgun System is an underbarrel bolt-action shotgun that was inspired by the "Masterkey" and fixed most of its predecessor's problems.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns.
translations: 模块化配件霰弹枪系统(MASS)，一把受"万能钥匙"启发研发出的管下栓动式霰弹枪，并解决了后者的大部分问题。这个配件系统经过改装，能够适配除手枪和泵动式枪械外，几乎所有的武器种类。

messages.msgid: A pistol bayonet is a stabbing weapon that can be attached to the front of a handgun, allowing a melee attack to deal piercing damage.
translations: 一个手枪用刺刀，可被安装在手枪前端，在手持其近战攻击时造成刺击伤害。

messages.msgid: A short shotgun with 2 barrels, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows two shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.
translations: 一个短管的双管霰弹枪，可被安装在多种步枪的管下。可装入两发霰弹进行射击。

messages.msgid: A folding wire monopod designed to attach to a Type 99 Arisaka's front barrel band, intended to give soldiers a stabler platform from which to shoot while prone.  Less effective than an actual bipod and ungainly long, it was largely cut from active issue relatively soon into the Second World War.  This one is currently stowed in the folded position and cannot aid you while firing.
translations: 一个折叠式铁丝脚架，设计安装于有坂九九式步枪的前枪管箍上，旨在为士兵俯卧射击时提供一个稳定的支点。不如双脚架有效，而且又长又笨重，因此在第二次世界大战前期，产量就被大幅裁减。脚架目前处于折叠状态，无法提供射击支持。

messages.msgid: You flip out the monopod and lock it into position.
translations: 你翻出独脚架并将其锁定到位。

messages.msgid: A folding wire monopod designed to attach to a Type 99 Arisaka's front barrel band, intended to give soldiers a stabler platform from which to shoot while prone.  Less effective than an actual bipod and ungainly long, it was largely cut from active issue relatively soon into the Second World War.  This one is currently locked in the unfolded position and will provide a measure of stability while firing.
translations: 一个折叠式铁丝脚架，设计安装于有坂九九式步枪的前枪管箍上，旨在为士兵俯卧射击时提供一个稳定的支点。不如双脚架有效，而且又长又笨重，因此在第二次世界大战前期，产量就被大幅裁减。脚架目前处于展开状态，可在射击时提供稳定。

messages.msgid: You unlock the monopod and stow it in its folded position.
translations: 你解锁独脚架，并将其折叠收好。

messages.msgid: The Steyr Scout's integral bipod is effectively part of the rifle's housing, causing its added weight to practically be zero.  However, the polymer construction and awkward design prevent it from being as useful as a normal bipod.
translations: 斯太尔侦查步枪的集成两脚架，由于本身就是步枪外壳的一部分，因此可以说它所增加的枪身重量几乎为零。然而，聚合物结构和笨拙的设计使它无法像普通的两脚架那样有效。

messages.msgid: You flip the bipod out from the rifle housing and lock it into position.
translations: 你从枪体中翻出两脚架，并将其锁定到位。
集成聚合物两脚架（展开）

messages.msgid: With an ugly snap, you crack the bipod legs back into the rifle.
translations: 伴随着一声刺耳的“咯啦”声，你将两脚架猛地扳回了枪身。

messages.msgid: A small weight attached below the barrel of a firearm to reduce muzzle climb, increasing bulk but allowing for faster follow-up shots.  Mainly used on competition handguns, but it can be added to combat pistols, too.
translations: 一个安装在枪管下方，用于抑制枪口上跳的小型配重，虽然增加了体积但允许更快的后续连射。主要被用于竞技用手枪，但战术手枪也同样适用。

messages.msgid: Massive tripod, used by Exodii naval rifle so it can be used by lightweight units, providing firearm support.  Allows using naval rifle while prone.
translations: 专为流亡族海军步枪设计的大型三脚架，使轻型作战单位能够使用该武器并提供火力支援。安装后可在俯卧姿势下操作流亡族海军步枪。

messages.msgid: This speedloader can hold 6 rounds of .40 S&W or 10mm Auto and quickly reload a compatible revolver.
translations: 这个快速装弹器可以容纳6发 .40 S&W 弹或 10mm Auto 弹，为兼容的左轮手枪快速装弹。

messages.msgid: A compact light-weight steel and polymer magazine for use with Glock pistols chambered for 10mm Auto.
translations: 一个 10mm Auto 格洛克手枪专用的，紧凑轻量的金属聚合物混合结构弹匣。

messages.msgid: A compact light-weight steel and polymer magazine for use with Glock pistols chambered for 10mm Auto, limited to 10 rounds.
translations: 一个 10mm Auto 格洛克手枪专用的，紧凑轻量的金属聚合物混合结构弹匣，弹容量被限制为 10 发。
格洛克 10mm 10 发便携弹匣

messages.msgid: A stubby steel and polymer magazine for use with the compact Glock pistol.  It is too short to insert into most other 10mm Glock pattern magwells.
translations: 一个格洛克 紧凑型手枪专用的金属聚合物混合结构短弹匣。受长度限制，无法被其他采用 10mm 格洛克样式的弹匣井所使用。

messages.msgid: A stubby steel and polymer magazine for use with the Glock 29.  It is too short to insert into most other 10mm Glock pattern magwells.
translations: 一个格洛克 29 手枪专用的金属聚合物混合结构短弹匣。受长度限制，无法被其他采用 10mm 格洛克样式的弹匣井所使用。
柯尔特 "三角精英"手枪 8发弹匣

messages.msgid: An 8-round single stack steel box magazine for use in the Colt Delta Elite pistol.
translations: 一个柯尔特 "三角精英" 手枪专用的8发单排钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: An 8-round single stack steel box magazine for use with 1911 pattern guns chambered in 10mm Auto.
translations: 一个兼容使用 10mm Auto 弹的 M1911 手枪的8发单排钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A straight 30-round box magazine for the BA10 rifle.
translations: 一个30发条形弹匣，可用于 BA10 步枪。

messages.msgid: A straight 30-round box magazine for use with MP5/10s and similar 10mm MP5 clones such as the Brethren Arms BA10.
translations: 一个30发直排盒式弹匣，可用于MP5/10冲锋枪和类似使用10mm口径MP5系列冲锋枪，如Brethren Arms出品的BA10 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: An 8-round steel box magazine for the SIG pistol.
translations: 一个西格手枪专用的8发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: An 8-round steel box magazine for the SIG Sauer P220 in 10mm Auto.
translations: 一个西格&绍尔 P220 10mm 手枪专用的8发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 30-round plastic and steel box 10mm Auto magazine for use with Glock pistols and submachine guns chambered in 10mm.
translations: 一个 10mm Auto 格洛克手枪及冲锋枪专用的30发金属聚合物混合结构弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 30-round plastic and steel box 10mm Auto magazine for use with Glock pattern magazine wells, namely the Vector SDP.
translations: 一个 10mm Auto 格洛克样式弹匣井专用的30发金属聚合物混合结构弹匣——例如 Vector SDP 10mm 手枪。

messages.msgid: A 15-round steel box magazine for 10mm Auto EAA Witness pistols.
translations: 一个 10mm EAA "证人" 手枪专用的15发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 15-round steel box magazine for 10mm Auto XD-M pistols.
translations: 一个 10mm XD-M 手枪专用的15发钢制弹匣。
H&K G80 磁轨步枪 20发弹匣

messages.msgid: A magazine for the H&K G80 railgun which can hold up to 20 ferromagnetic projectiles.
translations: 一个 H&K G80 磁轨步枪专用的20发磁轨弹弹匣。

messages.msgid: This speedloader can hold 8 rounds of .22 and quickly reload a compatible revolver.
translations: 这个快速装弹器可以容纳8发 .22 弹，为兼容的左轮手枪快速装弹。
小型狩猎步枪 19发管状装弹器

messages.msgid: A tube which holds 19 rounds of .22, designed for quick reloading of a compatible rifle with a tubular magazine.
translations: 这个管状装弹器可容纳19发 .22 弹，为兼容的管式弹仓步枪快速装弹。

messages.msgid: A black, 10-round polymer magazine for AR-platform rifles converted to fire .22 Long Rifle ammunition.
translations: 一个供AR平台步枪使用的，黑色的10发聚合材料弹匣，被改装为装载 .22 LR 弹。

messages.msgid: A black, 28-round polymer magazine for AR-platform rifles converted to fire .22 Long Rifle ammunition.
translations: 一个供AR平台步枪使用的，黑色的28发聚合材料弹匣，被改装为装载 .22 LR 弹。

messages.msgid: A factory specification 10-round magazine for the Firefly pistol.
translations: 一个 GSG "萤火虫" 手枪专用的10发原厂弹匣。

messages.msgid: A factory specification 10-round magazine for the GSG Firefly.
translations: 一个 GSG "萤火虫" 手枪专用的10发原厂弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended capacity 25-round magazine, for use with .22 caliber varmint rifles.
translations: 一个 .22 狐鼠步枪专用的25发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended 25-round stick magazine for the Ruger 10/22, known as the BX-25.
translations: 一个 鲁格 10/22 步枪专用的25发条形弹匣，代号为BX-25。

messages.msgid: A flush fitting 10-round rotary magazine, for use with .22 caliber varmint rifles.
translations: 一个 .22 狐鼠步枪专用的10发螺旋式弹匣。

messages.msgid: A removable 10-round rotary magazine for the Ruger 10/22 which allows the magazine to fit flush with the bottom of the stock.
translations: 一个 鲁格 10/22 步枪专用的10发可拆螺旋式弹匣。弹匣底部能够与枪托底部紧贴齐平。

messages.msgid: An extended capacity 15-round magazine, for use with .22 caliber varmint rifles.
translations: 一个 .22 狐鼠步枪专用的15发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended 15-round stick magazine for the Ruger 10/22, known as the BX-15.
translations: 一个 鲁格 10/22 步枪专用的25发条形弹匣，代号为BX-15。

messages.msgid: A 30-round capacity drum magazine for use in varmint rifles.  While the capacity is nothing to scoff at, it is less reliable than stick magazines.
translations: 一个 .22 狐鼠步枪专用的30发弹鼓。虽然容量不容小觑，但其可靠性不如条形弹匣。

messages.msgid: The ProMag 30 round drum magazine is a high capacity after-market 10/22 magazine.  While a whole lot lighter and handier than larger drum mags, the fact that the capacity isn't much higher than a stick magazine makes this an unpopular choice, as it still comes with all the reliability issues drum magazines have.
translations: 一个ProMag公司生产的 10/22 30发大容量弹鼓。虽然它比更大容量的弹鼓轻便，但其弹容并没有比普通条形弹匣高出多少，而且仍存在普遍于弹鼓的可靠性问题，因此并不太受消费者欢迎。

messages.msgid: An extended capacity 32-round magazine, for use with .22 caliber varmint rifles.
translations: 一个 .22 狐鼠步枪专用的32发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended 32-round stick magazine for the Ruger 10/22 by ProMag.  While more reliable than a drum mag, it's surprisingly not by much.
translations: 一个ProMag公司生产的 10/22 32发扩容条形弹匣。比弹鼓的可靠性高，但只有一点。

messages.msgid: A 55-round capacity drum magazine for use in varmint rifles.  While the capacity is nothing to scoff at, it is less reliable than stick magazines.
translations: 一个 .22 狐鼠步枪专用的55发弹鼓。虽然容量不容小觑，但其可靠性不如条形弹匣。

messages.msgid: The ProMag 55 round drum magazine is a high capacity after-market 10/22 magazine.  While cumbersome, heavy, and unreliable, the capacity is no doubt a selling factor.  While usually range toys, these mags may just make surviving a little bit easier.
translations: 一个ProMag公司生产的 10/22 55发大容量弹鼓。虽然沉重且不可靠，但其容量无疑是一个卖点。虽是靶场时尚小玩具，但也能让你的生存之旅更容易一些。

messages.msgid: A 70-round capacity drum magazine for use in varmint rifles.  While the capacity is nothing to scoff at, it is less reliable than stick magazines.
translations: 一个 .22 狐鼠步枪专用的70发弹鼓。虽然容量不容小觑，但其可靠性不如条形弹匣。

messages.msgid: The ProMag 70 round drum magazine is a high capacity after-market 10/22 magazine.  While cumbersome, heavy, and unreliable, the capacity is no doubt a selling factor.  While usually range toys, these mags may just make surviving a little bit easier.
translations: 一个ProMag公司生产的 10/22 70发大容量弹鼓。虽然沉重且不可靠，但其容量无疑是一个卖点。虽是靶场时尚小玩具，但也能让你的生存之旅更容易一些。

messages.msgid: An 110-round capacity drum magazine for use in varmint rifles.  While the capacity is nothing to scoff at, it is less reliable than stick magazines.
translations: 一个 .22 狐鼠步枪专用的110发弹鼓。虽然容量不容小觑，但其可靠性不如条形弹匣。

messages.msgid: The GSG-16 110 round drum magazine is the highest capacity 10/22 magazine on the (after)-market.  While cumbersome, heavy, and unreliable, the capacity is no doubt a selling factor.  While usually range toys, these mags may just make surviving a little bit easier.
translations: 一个 GSG-16 110发弹鼓，乃市场上能找到的最大容量的 10/22 第三方弹鼓。虽然笨重、沉重，且不可靠，但其容量无疑是一个卖点。虽是靶场时尚大玩具，但也能让你的生存之旅更容易一些。

messages.msgid: A 10-round handgun magazine for use with Walther's .22 caliber pocket pistol.
translations: 一个瓦尔特 .22 口径手枪专用的10发手枪弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 10-round box magazine for the Walther P22.
translations: 一个瓦尔特 P22 手枪专用的10发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 33-round capacity magazine for .22 ammunition, for use in a high capacity handgun.
translations: 适用于大容量手枪的.22口径子弹33发弹匣。

messages.msgid: The CP33's magazine is a polymer body quad stack with 4 rows of .22 rounds, which gives it the ability to cram in 33 rounds into the magazine.
translations: The CP33手枪的弹匣采用聚合物材质，设计为四排堆叠结构，每排可装载.22口径子弹，这样的设计使得单个弹匣能够容纳多达33发子弹。

messages.msgid: A 50-round capacity magazine for .22 ammunition, for use in a high capacity handgun.
translations: 适用于大容量手枪的.22口径子弹50发弹匣。

messages.msgid: CP33 33-round magazine has the ability to accept extensions, and this one has a 17-round extension to bring the total up to a staggering 50 rounds of .22 ammunition.
translations: CP33的33发标准弹匣设计支持扩容，而这一款弹匣则加装了一个17发扩容弹匣底板，使得总弹容量达到了惊人的50发.22口径子弹。
鲁格 "射靶" 手枪弹匣

messages.msgid: A 10-round magazine for a Ruger target pistol.
translations: 一个鲁格 "射靶" 手枪专用的10发弹匣
鲁格 MK IV 弹匣

messages.msgid: A Ruger Mark IV magazine, lightweight and with a magazine follower button to allow easier reloading.  Holds 10 rounds of .22, and is interchangeable with Mark II and Mark III varieties as well.
translations: 一个鲁格 MK IV 弹匣，重量轻，带有弹匣随动按钮，便于重新装填。可容纳10发 .22 子弹，也与鲁格 MK II 和 MK III 型手枪兼容。
一个 .22 1911手枪专用的10发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A magazine for the 1911-22 pistol, holding 10 rounds of .22 LR.  It features a magazine follower button to allow easier reloading, along with a cut-out in the side to see your round count.
translations: 一个 1911-22 手枪专用的弹匣，可容纳10发 .22 LR 弹。带有弹匣随动按钮，便于重新装填；侧面还带有开口，便于检查剩余的弹量。

messages.msgid: A 10-round magazine for the plinking handgun.
translations: 一个休闲练枪用手枪专用的10发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A magazine for the SR22 pistol, holding 10 rounds of .22 LR.
translations: 一个 SR22 手枪专用的弹匣，可容纳10发 .22 LR 弹。

messages.msgid: A compact, light-weight polymer magazine for use with the Glock 44.
translations: 一个格洛克 44 手枪专用的，紧凑且轻便的聚合物弹匣。
.22 现代化狐鼠步枪 10 发弹匣

messages.msgid: A black, 10-round polymer magazine for the modern varmint rifle.  It unfortunately is not compatible with AR-15 .22 conversion magazines.
translations: 一个现代化狐鼠步枪专用的，黑色的10发聚合材料弹匣。可惜它与 AR-15 平台的 .22 改装弹匣并不兼容。

messages.msgid: A black, 10-round polymer magazine for the M&P 15-22 rifle.  It unfortunately is not compatible with AR-15 .22 conversion magazines.
translations: 一个 M&P 15-22 步枪专用的，黑色的10发聚合材料弹匣。可惜它与 AR-15 平台的 .22 改装弹匣并不兼容。

messages.msgid: A 10-round Mini-14 magazine that has been modified to only hold 5 rounds, commonly used to comply with hunting regulations.
translations: 一个鲁格 Mini-14 步枪专用的10发弹匣，为遵循狩猎枪械法规，其弹容量被限制在了5发。

messages.msgid: A compact 10-round box magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的10发紧凑型弹匣。

messages.msgid: STANAG 10-round magazine with attached ranger plate
messages.plural: STANAG 10-round magazines with attached ranger plates

messages.msgid: A compact 10-round box magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.  The bottom has been modified with a ranger plate attachment to allow it to clip to carabiners.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的10发紧凑型弹匣。弹匣底部加装了一块快拔底板，使其能被扣在钩环上。

messages.msgid: A compact 10-round box magazine used with the Ruger Mini-14 rifle.
translations: 一个鲁格 Mini-14 步枪专用的10发紧凑型弹匣。

translations: 一个鲁格 Mini-14 步枪专用的20发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A high-capacity box magazine for use with the Ruger Mini-14 rifle.
translations: 一个鲁格 Mini-14 步枪专用的大容量弹匣。

messages.msgid: A bulky 90-round snail drum magazine for use with the Ruger Mini-14 rifle.
translations: 一个鲁格 Mini-14 步枪专用的，笨重的90发蜗式弹鼓。

messages.msgid: A bulky 100-round double drum magazine for use with the Ruger Mini-14 rifle.
translations: 一个鲁格 Mini-14 步枪专用的，笨重的100发双排弹鼓。

messages.msgid: A 10-round STANAG magazine that has been modified to only hold 5 rounds, commonly used to comply with hunting regulations.

messages.msgid: A 10-round STANAG magazine that has been modified to only hold 5 rounds, commonly used to comply with hunting regulations.  The bottom has been modified with a ranger plate attachment to allow it to clip to carabiners.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的10发紧凑型弹匣，为遵循狩猎枪械法规，其弹容量被限制在了5发。弹匣底部加装了一块快拔底板，使其能被扣在钩环上。

messages.msgid: A compact 20-round box magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的20发紧凑型弹匣。

messages.msgid: A compact 20-round box magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.  The bottom has been modified with a ranger plate attachment to allow it to clip to carabiners.

messages.msgid: A standard capacity 30-round box magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的30发标准容量弹匣。

messages.msgid: A standard capacity 30-round box magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.  The bottom has been modified with a ranger plate attachment to allow it to clip to carabiners.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的30发标准容量的弹匣。弹匣底部加装了一块快拔底板，使其能被扣在钩环上。

messages.msgid: An increased-capacity 40-round box magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的40发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: An increased-capacity 40-round box magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.  The bottom has been modified with a ranger plate attachment to allow it to clip to carabiners.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的40发扩容弹匣。弹匣底部加装了一块快拔底板，使其能被扣在钩环上。

messages.msgid: A bulky 50-round drum magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles, known as the X-15.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的，笨重的50发弹鼓。它的代号为X-15。

messages.msgid: A high-capacity 60-round casket magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.  It is thicker, rather than longer.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的60发扩容弹匣。相较常见的扩容弹匣，选择了增加厚度，而非增加长度。

messages.msgid: A bulky 60-round drum magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles, known as the D-60.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的，笨重的60发弹鼓。它的代号为D-60。

messages.msgid: A bulky 90-round snail drum magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的，笨重的90发蜗式弹鼓。

messages.msgid: A high-capacity 100-round casket magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的100发大容量多排弹匣。

messages.msgid: A bulky 100-round double drum magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles, known as the Beta-C Mag.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的，笨重的100发双排弹鼓。它的代号为Beta-C Mag。

messages.msgid: A bulky 150-round double drum magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles, known as the SAW-MAG.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的，笨重的150发双排弹鼓。它的代号为SAW-MAG。

messages.msgid: A single stack magazine for the SL8 rifle, holding 10 rounds.
translations: 一个 SL8 步枪专用的10发单排弹匣。

messages.msgid: A compact 10-round box magazine for use with the Steyr AUG assault rifle.
translations: 一个斯泰尔 AUG 突击步枪专用的10发紧凑型弹匣。

messages.msgid: A standard capacity 30-round box magazine for use with the Steyr AUG assault rifle.
translations: 一个斯泰尔 AUG 突击步枪专用的30发标准容量弹匣。

messages.msgid: An increased-capacity 42-round box magazine for use with the Steyr AUG assault rifle.
translations: 一个斯泰尔 AUG 突击步枪专用的42发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: A bulky 100-round double drum magazine for use with the Steyr AUG assault rifle.
translations: 一个斯泰尔 AUG 突击步枪专用的，笨重的100发双排弹鼓。

messages.msgid: A 30-round box magazine for use with the ZPAP 85 and ZPAP M90 rifles.
translations: 一个30发盒式弹匣，用于ZPAP 85和ZPAP M90步枪上。

messages.msgid: An improvised 5-round straight single-stack box magazine consisting of little more than a bent sheet of steel held together by duct tape and hope, for use with STANAG compatible rifles.
translations: 一个可被具有 STANAG 兼容性的枪械所使用的5发自制弹匣，通过将几块弯曲的铁片用随缘的方式拿胶带粘贴捆绑制成。

messages.msgid: An improvised 5-round straight single-stack box magazine consisting of little more than a bent sheet of steel held together by duct tape and hope, for use with the Ruger Mini-14 rifle.
translations: 一个鲁格 Mini-14 步枪专用的5发自制弹匣，通过将几块弯曲的铁片用随缘的方式拿胶带粘贴捆绑制成。

messages.msgid: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load ten 5.56x45mm or .300 AAC Blackout rounds into a magazine.
translations: 一块体积小巧中有凹槽的金属片，用来让射手快速为栓动步枪快速装入10发 5.56x45mm 或 .300 BLK 弹。

messages.msgid: A 5-round box magazine used with the M2010 ESR sniper rifle.
translations: 一个 M2010 增强型狙击步枪专用的5发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A single-stack, 5-round, detachable magazine compatible with the Ruger Precision Rifle.  Holding five rounds of.300 Winchester Magnum, the magazine is styled along the lines of Accuracy International's magnum magazines, the latter of which has become the gold standard for precision weapon magazines.
translations: 一个鲁格精密步枪专用的5发单列式弹匣，可装填五发 .300 温彻斯特马格南弹。设计风格与精密国际的马格南弹匣相似，后者的弹匣设计被认为是射手步枪弹匣的黄金标准。

messages.msgid: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load five .30-06 rounds into a compatible firearm.
translations: 一块体积小巧中有凹槽的金属片，用来让射手为兼容枪械快速装填5发 .30-06 弹。

messages.msgid: A compact 4-round box magazine for the Browning BLR.
translations: 一个勃朗宁 BLR 步枪专用的4发紧凑弹匣。

messages.msgid: A light-weight en bloc clip for use with the M1 Garand that will be ejected after the last round is fired.
translations: 一个 M1 加兰德步枪专用的，重量很轻的漏夹式弹夹。最后一发子弹发射后，弹夹会"叮"的一声自动弹出。

messages.msgid: An aftermarket magazine for use with the Browning Automatic Rifle, holds 30 rounds.
translations: 一个勃朗宁 BAR 步枪专用的30发第三方弹匣。

messages.msgid: A standard capacity magazine for use with the Browning Automatic Rifle, holds 20 rounds.
translations: 一个勃朗宁 BAR 步枪专用的20发标准容量弹匣。

messages.msgid: A steel 10-round magazine, for use in .303 caliber Enfield rifles.
translations: 一个 .303 口径的李-恩菲尔德步枪专用的10发金属弹匣。

messages.msgid: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load five .303 British rounds into a magazine.
translations: 一种带凹槽的小金属片，用来让射手快速将5发 .303 英式子弹装入弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended 30-round steel box magazine for the heavy automatic rifle.
translations: 一个重型自动步枪专用的30发的钢制扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended 30-round steel box magazine for the FN FAL rifle.
translations: 一个 FN FAL 步枪专用的30发的钢制扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: A military issue 20-round steel box magazine for the heavy automatic rifle.
translations: 一个重型自动步枪专用的20发的制式钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A military issue 20-round steel box magazine for the FN FAL rifle.
translations: 一个 FN FAL 步枪专用的20发的制式钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: An improvised 5-round straight single-stack box magazine consisting of little more than a bent sheet of steel held together by duct tape and hope, for use with the FN FAL rifle.
translations: 一个 FN FAL 步枪专用的5发自制弹匣，通过将几块弯曲的铁片用随缘的方式拿胶带粘贴捆绑制成。

messages.msgid: A 50-round drum magazine for the H&K G3 rifle.

messages.msgid: A steel box magazine for the H&K G3 rifle.

messages.msgid: An improvised 5-round straight single-stack box magazine consisting of little more than a bent sheet of steel held together by duct tape and hope, for use with G3 rifle.

translations: 一个可用于 M14 步枪及兼容型号的5发第三方弹匣。尽管载弹不高，但存取方便且易于装填。

messages.msgid: An improvised 5-round straight single-stack box magazine consisting of little more than a bent sheet of steel held together by duct tape and hope, for use with M14 pattern rifles.

messages.msgid: A 20-round steel box magazine for the PAP M77 rifle.
translations: 一个 PAP M77 专用的20发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 10-round steel box magazine for the PAP M77 rifle.
translations: 一个 PAP M77 专用的10发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 50-round drum magazine for the FN SCAR-H rifle.

translations: 一个 FN SCAR-H 步枪专用的30发钢制弹匣，看样子像是用 FN FAL 步枪弹匣改的。

messages.msgid: A military issue 20-round steel box magazine for the FN SCAR-H rifle.

messages.msgid: A 10-round magazine for the FN SCAR-H or 17S rifle.

messages.msgid: A 20-round double stack box magazine for the HK417 rifle.

messages.msgid: This 20-round box magazine is compatible with STANAG rifles and has been modified to hold a single-stack, seven round column of .50-caliber Beowulf ammo. translations: 一个20发弹匣，适用于 STANAG 步枪。经过改装后也可容纳7发.50 贝奥武夫弹药。弹匣的前唇已经倾斜，以便能够将贝奥武夫弹药可靠地送入经过适当改装的武器弹膛，好消息是，这并没有影响弹匣容纳标准弹药的能力。

messages.msgid: retooled STANAG 20-round magazine with ranger plate

messages.msgid: This 20-round box magazine is compatible with STANAG rifles and has been modified to hold a single-stack, seven round column of .50-caliber Beowulf ammo. The magazine has been engineered to feed a single-stack column of .50 Beowulf ammunition into the chamber of an appropriately converted AR-style firearm.
translations: 一个可以拆卸的10发弹匣，与标准的30发 STANAG 弹匣外型类似，可以为同样兼容的枪械供弹。这个弹匣被改装来填装.50 贝奥武夫弹药，并且兼容已经过对应改装的AR武器平台。

messages.msgid: A standard magazine made for 5.45x39mm rifles, made mostly of polymer with steel reinforcements.
translations: 一个 5.45x39mm 口径步枪专用的30发标准弹匣，主体为聚合物，并使用金属进行结构加固。

messages.msgid: A 30-round, curved box magazine for Kalashnikov AK-74 pattern firearms chambered in 5.45x39mm Soviet.  Generally made from steel-reinforced polymer, surplus examples found most utility within the contemporary United States in feeding semi-automatic examples of eastern bloc AK-74 rifles.
translations: 一个30发弧形弹匣，可用于卡拉什尼科夫 AK-74 型枪族，使用 5.45x39mm 苏式口径。通常由塑料和钢制加强件制成，在当代美国常见案例主要用于为东欧 AK-74 枪族的半自动步枪供弹。

messages.msgid: A 45-round polymer magazine compatible with 5.45x39mm rifles, though originally designed for use with Soviet light machine guns built upon similar design pattens.
translations: 一个45发塑料弹匣，可用于 5.45x39mm 口径步枪，虽然最初是为采用类似模式的苏联轻机枪设计的。

messages.msgid: Originally built to feed Soviet RPK-74 light machine guns, this curved 45-round box magazine possesses an aggressive waffle texture pattern and also fits other Kalashnikov-based long guns, namely the AK-74 and modern civilian legal variants.
translations: 一个45发弧形弹匣，最初设计用来为苏联 RPK-74 轻机枪供弹，具有侵略性的华夫格纹理图案，也适用于其他卡拉什尼科夫长管枪族，即 AK-74 步枪和现代民用合法改型。

messages.msgid: A 60-round polymer magazine compatible with 5.45x39mm rifles.
translations: 一个60发弹匣，可用于 5.45x39mm 口径步枪。

messages.msgid: A casket magazine that combines four stacks of 5.45x39mm Soviet ammunition into a solid brick of plastic, built for interfacing with the magazine wells of Kalashnikov-pattern firearms, namely the AK-74 assault rifle and subsequent derivatives.
translations: 一个60发弹匣，将四排 5.45x39mm 苏式口径弹药组合成一块实心塑料砖，可与采用卡拉什尼科夫样式弹匣井的枪械对接，例如 AK-74 突击步枪及其衍生型号。

messages.msgid: A 20-round box magazine, for use with handguns chambering the proprietary 5.7x28mm cartridge.
translations: 一个20发弹匣，可用于使用5.7x28mm弹药的手枪。

messages.msgid: A standard-capacity magazine for use with the FN Five-seveN.
translations: 一个标准容量的弹匣，可用于 FN-57 手枪。

messages.msgid: A factory issue translucent polymer box magazine that fits with the frame of the FN P90.
translations: 一个原厂制造的半透明高分子聚合物弹匣，可用于FN-P90冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: A standard capacity 20-round 5.7x28mm magazine for use with the Ruger-57.
translations: 一个标准的20发 5.7x28mm 弹匣，可用于鲁格-57手枪。

messages.msgid: A small capacity 10-round magazine for use with the Ruger-57, developed for use in states in which standard capacity magazines are prohibited.
translations: 一个小容量10发弹匣，可用于鲁格-57手枪，为禁止使用原装弹匣的州开发的。

messages.msgid: A clip for the M202A1 FLASH that can hold 4 M74 incendiary rockets.
translations: 一个用于M202A1 Flash火箭筒的弹夹，可以容纳4发M74燃烧弹。

messages.msgid: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load ten 7.62x39mm rounds into an SKS.
translations: 一小片带凹槽的金属片，旨在让射手能将十发7.62x39mm枪弹快速装填进SKS步枪。

messages.msgid: A compact 10-round magazine for 7.62x39mm AK-pattern rifles, made of sturdy polymer.  Made for restricted civilian use.
translations: 一个紧凑的10发弹匣，可用于7.62x39mm AK型步枪，由耐用塑料制成，为枪械管理严格的州民使用而设计。

messages.msgid: A compact 20-round magazine for 7.62x39mm AK-pattern rifles, made of sturdy polymer.  Originally designed for tank crews.
translations: 一个紧凑的20发弹匣，可用于7.62x39mm AK型步枪，由耐用塑料制成，最初设计为供坦克乘员使用。

messages.msgid: A standard 30-round magazine for 7.62x39mm AK-pattern rifles, made of stamped sheet metal.
translations: 一个标准的30发弹匣，可用于7.62x39mm AK型步枪，由冲压金属板制成。

messages.msgid: An extended 40-round magazine for 7.62x39mm AK-pattern rifles, made of stamped sheet metal.
translations: 一个扩容的40发弹匣，可用于7.62x39mm AK型步枪，由冲压金属板制成。

messages.msgid: A bulky 75-round drum magazine for 7.62x39mm AK-pattern rifles, made of stamped sheet metal.
translations: 笨重的75发弹鼓，可用于7.62x39mm AK型步枪，由冲压金属板制成。

messages.msgid: A proprietary polymer box magazine, capable of containing 30 7.62x39mm rounds and compatible with the Czech Bren 2 carbine.  Unlike conventional 7.62x39mm magazines, this one is inserted straight up into the magazine well rather than rocked in, in order to facilitate a bolt-hold open mechanism.
translations: 一个特制的30发 7.62x39mm聚合物弹匣，适用于捷克Bren 2卡宾枪。 与传统的7.62mm弹匣不同，这个弹匣是直接向上插入弹匣井以便利用机械结构特性。

messages.msgid: A proprietary polymer box magazine, capable of containing 10 7.62x39mm rounds and compatible with the Czech Bren 2 carbine.  Unlike conventional 7.62x39mm magazines, this one is inserted straight up into the magazine well rather than rocked in, in order to facilitate a bolt-hold open mechanism.
translations: 一个特制的10发 7.62x39mm聚合物弹匣，适用于捷克 Bren 2 卡宾枪。 与传统的7.62mm弹匣不同，这个弹匣是直接向上插入弹匣井以便利用机械结构特性。

messages.msgid: Engineered to allow the tapered 7.62x39mm cartridge to reliably cycle into the chamber of an appropriately converted firearm, this compact 5-round steel box magazine is compatible with AR-15-style rifles.
translations: 这个紧凑的5发钢制弹匣设计来让7.62x39mm 锥形弹药可靠地送入改装枪膛，它兼容AR-15系列步枪。

messages.msgid: Engineered to allow the tapered 7.62x39mm cartridge to reliably cycle into the chamber of an appropriately converted firearm, this compact 10-round steel box magazine is compatible with AR-15-style rifles.
translations: 这个紧凑的10发钢制弹匣设计来让7.62x39mm 锥形弹药可靠地送入改装枪膛，它兼容AR-15系列步枪。

messages.msgid: Engineered to allow the tapered 7.62x39mm cartridge to reliably cycle into the chamber of an appropriately converted firearm, this 20-round steel box magazine is compatible with AR-15-style rifles.
translations: 这个20发钢制弹匣设计来让7.62x39mm 锥形弹药可靠地送入改装枪膛，它兼容AR-15系列步枪。

messages.msgid: Engineered to allow the tapered 7.62x39mm cartridge to reliably cycle into the chamber of an appropriately converted firearm and possessing a dramatic curve that looks laughably goofy, this 30-round steel box magazine is compatible with AR-15-style rifles.
translations: 这个30发钢制弹匣设计来让7.62x39mm 锥形弹药可靠地送入改装枪膛，它兼容 AR-15 式步枪。这个弹匣有着夸张的弯曲曲线，看起来甚至有些可笑。

messages.msgid: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load five 7.62x54mmR rounds into a compatible firearm.
translations: 一块体积小巧中有凹槽的金属片，用来让射手为兼容枪械快速装填5发7.62x39mmR弹。

messages.msgid: A compact 5-round magazine for 7.62x54R PSL designated marksman's rifle, made of stamped sheet metal.  Not compatible with a Dragunov despite similar appearances.
translations: 一个紧凑型的 7.62x54R 5发弹匣，由冲压钢板制成，专为精确射手步枪设计。尽管外观很相似，但不是兼容SVD的弹匣。

messages.msgid: A compact 10-round magazine for 7.62x54R PSL designated marksman's rifle, made of stamped sheet metal.  Not compatible with a Dragunov despite similar appearances.
translations: 一个紧凑型的 7.62x54R 10发弹匣，由冲压钢板制成，专为精确射手步枪设计。尽管外观很相似，但不是兼容SVD的弹匣。

messages.msgid: A standard 8-round magazine for the Tokarev handgun.
translations: 一个标准的8发弹匣，可用于托卡列夫手枪。

messages.msgid: A standard 8-round magazine for the Tokarev TT-33.
translations: 一个标准的8发弹匣，可用于托卡列夫 TT-33 手枪。

messages.msgid: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load five 7.7x58mm rounds into a compatible firearm.
translations: 一块体积小巧中有凹槽的金属片，用来让射手为兼容枪械快速装填5发7.7x58mm弹。

messages.msgid: A 100-round box magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.  Designated as RMGB100.
translations: 一个Rivtech 8x40mm 无壳弹枪械专用的100发弹匣。其官方命名为RMGB100。

messages.msgid: A 10-round stick magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.  Designated as RMGP10.
translations: 一个Rivtech 8x40mm 无壳弹枪械专用的10发条形弹匣。其官方命名为RMGP10。

messages.msgid: A 25-round stick magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.  Designated as RMGP25.
translations: 一个Rivtech 8x40mm 无壳弹枪械专用的25发条形弹匣。其官方命名为RMGP25。

messages.msgid: A 50-round box magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.  Designated as RMGB50.
translations: 一个Rivtech 8x40mm 无壳弹枪械专用的50发弹匣。其官方命名为RMGB50。

messages.msgid: A surprisingly compact 50-round helical magazine for use with the Calico M960 SMG.
translations: 一个出奇紧凑的50发螺旋弹匣，可用于卡利科 M960 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: A surprisingly compact 100-round helical magazine for use with the Calico M960 SMG.
translations: 一个出奇紧凑的100发螺旋弹匣，可用于卡利科 M960 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: An extended 33-round polymer magazine for use with Glock compatible firearms.
translations: 一个格洛克系列武器专用的，扩容至33发的聚合物弹匣。

messages.msgid: A compact, light-weight polymer magazine for use with Glock compatible firearms.
translations: 一个格洛克系列武器专用的，紧凑且轻便的聚合物弹匣。

messages.msgid: A small 6-round magazine for the Glock 43.  Incompatible with the Glock 43X.
translations: 一个格洛克 43 手枪专用的小型6发弹匣，与格洛克 43X 手枪并不兼容。

messages.msgid: A 10-round magazine for the Glock 43X and the Glock 48.  Incompatible with the Glock 43.
translations: 一个格洛克 43X/48 手枪专用的10发弹匣，与格洛克 43 手枪并不兼容。

messages.msgid: A compact, light-weight polymer magazine for use with the Glock 19, which has been limited to 10 rounds to comply with firearm regulations.
translations: 一个格洛克 19 手枪专用的，紧凑且轻便的聚合物弹匣。为遵循枪械法规，其弹容量被限制在了10发。

messages.msgid: Made for the Glock 17, this magazine holds 17 rounds.
translations: 一个基于格洛克 17 手枪设计的弹匣，弹容量为17发。

messages.msgid: Made for the Glock 17, this magazine holds 10 rounds to comply with firearm regulations.
translations: 一个基于格洛克 17 手枪设计的弹匣，为遵循枪械法规，其弹容量被限制在了10发。

messages.msgid: Made for the Glock 17, this cheap-looking aftermarket magazine holds 22 rounds.
translations: 一个基于格洛克 17 手枪设计的第三方弹匣，造型廉价，弹容量为22发。

messages.msgid: Made to fit most Glock pistols.  This drum magazine holds 50 rounds.
translations: 一个适配绝大多数格洛克手枪的弹鼓，弹容量为50发。

messages.msgid: Made to fit most Glock pistols.  This double drum magazine holds 100 rounds.
translations: 一个适配绝大多数格洛克手枪的弹鼓，弹容量为100发。

messages.msgid: A 35-round extended magazine compatible with both the M9 handgun and some modern carbines.
translations: 一个 M9 手枪专用的35发扩充弹匣，同时也与部分现代卡宾枪兼容。

messages.msgid: A 32-round extended magazine compatible with both the M9 handgun and some modern carbines.
translations: 一个 M9 手枪专用的32发扩充弹匣，同时也与部分现代卡宾枪兼容。

messages.msgid: A 30-round extended magazine compatible with both the M9 handgun and some modern carbines.
translations: 一个 M9 手枪专用的30发扩充弹匣，同时也与部分现代卡宾枪兼容。

messages.msgid: An extended-capacity 20-round box magazine for use with the Beretta M9 handgun.
translations: 一个伯莱塔 M9 手枪专用的20发盒式扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: An 18-round box magazine for use with the Beretta M9 handgun.
translations: 一个伯莱塔 M9 手枪专用的18发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 17-round box magazine for use with the Beretta M9 handgun.
translations: 一个伯莱塔 M9 手枪专用的17发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A military issue 15-round box magazine originally intended for use with the Beretta M9 handgun.
translations: 一个伯莱塔 M9 手枪专用的15发军用弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 10-round box magazine for use with the Beretta M9 handgun, physically of the same size as a 15-round magazine.  It's made to comply with laws that limit maximum magazine capacity for firearms in some states.
translations: 一个伯莱塔 M9 手枪专用的10发弹匣，不过体积和15发弹匣相同，以遵守一些州限制枪支弹匣容量的法律。

messages.msgid: A bulky 100-round double drum magazine for use with the H&K MP5 SMG.
translations: 一个H&K MP5 冲锋枪专用的，笨重的100发双排弹鼓。

messages.msgid: A drum magazine for use with the H&K MP5 SMG.  Much greater capacity, but less reliable than the factory specification magazine.
translations: 一个H&K MP5 冲锋枪专用的弹鼓。比原厂生产的标准弹匣容量更大，但可靠性更差。

messages.msgid: An extended-capacity 40-round magazine for use with the H&K MP5 SMG.
translations: 一个H&K MP5 冲锋枪专用的40发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended-capacity 38-round magazine for use with the H&K MP5 SMG.
translations: 一个H&K MP5 冲锋枪专用的38发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: A standard capacity curved magazine for use with the H&K MP5 SMG.
translations: 一个H&K MP5 冲锋枪专用的标准弧形弹匣。

messages.msgid: A compact 20-round magazine for use with the H&K MP5 SMG.
translations: 一个H&K MP5 冲锋枪专用的20发紧凑型弹匣。

messages.msgid: A compact 15-round magazine for use with the H&K MP5 SMG.
translations: 一个H&K MP5 冲锋枪专用的15发紧凑型弹匣。

messages.msgid: A compact 10-round magazine for use with the H&K MP5 SMG.
translations: 一个H&K MP5 冲锋枪专用的10发紧凑型弹匣。

messages.msgid: A curved, double-stack plastic box magazine for the UMP sub-machine gun in 9x19mm.  Holds 30 rounds.
translations: 一个 9x19mm UMP 冲锋枪专用的弧形双排塑料弹匣，可容纳30发子弹。

messages.msgid: A standard-capacity angled-feed 8-round steel box magazine for use with the Luger pistol.
translations: 一个鲁格手枪专用的标准8发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: An unreliable and bulky 32-round snail-drum magazine, originally designed for use with the Luger pistol.
translations: 一个鲁格手枪专用的，笨重的32发蜗式弹鼓。

messages.msgid: A tiny piece of grooved metal designed to allow a shooter to quickly load ten rounds of 9x19mm into a Mauser C96.
translations: 一小片带凹槽的金属片，旨在让射手能快速将十发 9x19mm 弹装填进毛瑟 C96 手枪内。

messages.msgid: A double-column, single-feed 32-round box magazine used by the MP 40 SMG.
translations: 一个 MP40 冲锋枪专用的双排单进32发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 10-round box magazine for use with the Beretta Px4 9x19mm handgun, physically of the same size as 15-round and 17-round magazines.  It's made to comply with laws that limit maximum magazine capacity for firearms in some states.
translations: 一个伯莱塔 Px4 9x19mm 手枪专用的10发弹匣，不过体积和15发及17发弹匣相同，以遵守一些州限制枪支弹匣容量的法律。

messages.msgid: A 15-round box magazine for use with the Beretta Px4 9x19mm handgun.
translations: 一个伯莱塔 Px4 9x19mm 手枪专用的15发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A standard magazine for the Beretta Px4 9x19mm.
translations: 一个伯莱塔 Px4 9x19mm 手枪专用的17发弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended-capacity 20-round box magazine for use with the Beretta Px4 9x19mm handgun.
translations: 一个伯莱塔 Px4 9x19mm 手枪专用的20发盒式扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: A double-column, single-feed 9x19mm magazine used by the STEN submachine gun, based off the magazines for the German MP 28 and later MP 40.
translations: 一个斯登冲锋枪专用的双排单进弹 9x19mm 弹匣，设计源于德国 MP28 冲锋枪及后来的 MP40 冲锋枪的弹匣。

messages.msgid: An improvised magazine that is mostly compatible with the STEN submachine gun, with a simplified feed system.
translations: 一个使用简易供弹结构的自制弹匣，与斯登冲锋枪大体上兼容。

messages.msgid: A compact 10-round magazine for use with the TEC-9 SMG.
translations: 一个紧凑的10发弹匣，可用于 TEC-9 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: A compact 20-round magazine for use with the TEC-9 SMG.
translations: 一个紧凑的20发弹匣，可用于 TEC-9 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: A 30-round steel box magazine for use with the TEC-9 SMG, made as a more reliable alternative to 32-round magazines.
translations: 一个30发钢制盒式弹匣，可用于 TEC-9 冲锋枪，作为原本32发弹匣的更加可靠的替代品。

messages.msgid: A cheap and somewhat unreliable 32-round steel box magazine for use with the TEC-9 SMG.
translations: 一个廉价而略不可靠的32发钢制盒式弹匣，可用于 TEC-9 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: An extended 36-round steel box magazine for use with the TEC-9 SMG.
translations: 一个扩容的36发钢制盒式弹匣，可用于 TEC-9 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: An extended 50-round steel box magazine for use with the TEC-9 SMG.
translations: 一个扩容的50发钢制盒式弹匣，可用于 TEC-9 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: A bulky 72-round steel drum magazine for use with the TEC-9 SMG.
translations: 一个笨重的72发钢制弹鼓，可用于 TEC-9 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: A 10-round box magazine for use with the H&K USP 9x19mm pistol, physically of the same size as a 15-round magazine.  It's made to comply with laws that limit maximum magazine capacity for firearms in some states.
translations: 一个H&K USP 9x19mm 手枪专用的10发弹匣，不过体积和15发弹匣相同，以遵守一些州限制枪支弹匣容量的法律。

messages.msgid: A factory specification 15-round box magazine for use with the dependable H&K USP 9x19mm pistol.
translations: 一个H&K USP 9x19mm 手枪专用的15发原厂弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended 18-round box magazine for use with the H&K USP 9x19mm pistol.
translations: 一个H&K USP 9x19mm 手枪专用的18发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended 20-round box magazine for use with the H&K USP 9x19mm pistol.
translations: 一个H&K USP 9x19mm 手枪专用的20发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended 32-round box magazine for use with the H&K USP 9x19mm pistol.
translations: 一个H&K USP 9x19mm 手枪专用的32发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: A compact 20-round box magazine for use with the Uzi SMG.
translations: 一个乌兹冲锋枪专用的20发紧凑弹匣。

messages.msgid: A compact 25-round box magazine for use with the Uzi SMG.
translations: 一个乌兹冲锋枪专用的25发紧凑弹匣。

messages.msgid: A standard 32-round steel box magazine for use with the Uzi SMG.
translations: 一个乌兹冲锋枪专用的32发标准弹匣。

messages.msgid: An extended-capacity 40-round box magazine for use with the Uzi SMG.
translations: 一个乌兹冲锋枪专用的40发扩容弹匣。

messages.msgid: An unwieldy 50-round box magazine seemingly made by welding two of the 25 round magazines together.
translations: 一个乌兹冲锋枪专用的，笨重的50发弹匣，貌似是将两个25发弹匣焊接在一起制成的。

messages.msgid: A bulky 100-round double drum magazine for use with the Uzi SMG.
translations: 一个乌兹冲锋枪专用的，笨重的100发双排弹鼓。

messages.msgid: A 10-round double stack box magazine for the SIG Sauer P226.
translations: 一个西格&绍尔 P226 手枪专用的10发双排弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 15-round double stack box magazine for the SIG Sauer P226.
translations: 一个西格&绍尔 P226 手枪专用的15发双排弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 13-round double stack box magazine for the SIG Sauer P228 (also known as the M11) or P229.
translations: 一个西格&绍尔 P228（又名M11）/P229 手枪专用的13发双排弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 10-round magazine for use with the United States army's general issue 9x19mm handguns.
translations: 一个美军通用制式 9x19mm 手枪专用的10发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 10-round box magazine for the SIG Sauer P320.  Also compatible with its derivative pistols, the M17 and M18.
translations: 一个西格&绍尔 P320 手枪专用的10发弹匣。也兼容其衍生型号，例如 M17 和 M18 手枪。

messages.msgid: A 17-round magazine for use with the United States army's general issue 9x19mm handguns.
translations: 一个美军通用制式 9x19mm 手枪专用的17发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 17-round double stack box magazine for the SIG Sauer P320.  Also compatible with its derivative pistols, the M17 and M18.
translations: 一个西格&绍尔 P320 手枪专用的17发弹匣。也兼容其衍生型号，例如 M17 和 M18 手枪。

messages.msgid: A 21-round magazine for use with the United States army's general issue 9x19mm handguns.
translations: 一个美军通用制式 9x19mm 手枪专用的21发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 21-round double stack box magazine for the SIG Sauer P320.  Also compatible with its derivative pistols, the M17 and M18.
translations: 一个西格&绍尔 P320 手枪专用的21发弹匣。也兼容其衍生型号，例如 M17 和 M18 手枪。

messages.msgid: A 10-round box magazine for the SIG Sauer SP2022, 2340, and 2009.
translations: 一个适用于西格&绍尔 SP2022、2340 和 2009 手枪的10发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 12-round box magazine for the SIG Sauer SP2022, 2340, and 2009.
translations: 一个适用于西格&绍尔 SP2022、2340 和 2009 手枪的12发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 15-round box magazine for the SIG Sauer SP2022, 2340, and 2009.
translations: 一个适用于西格&绍尔 SP2022、2340 和 2009 手枪的15发弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 13-round steel box magazine for the Browning Hi-Power 9x19mm.
translations: 一个勃朗宁大威力 9x19mm 手枪专用的13发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: An aftermarket 15-round steel box magazine for the Browning Hi-Power 9x19mm.
translations: 一个勃朗宁大威力 9x19mm 手枪专用的13发钢制第三方弹匣。

messages.msgid: An 8-round steel box magazine for the Walther P38.
translations: 一个瓦尔特 P38 手枪专用的8发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 10-round steel box magazine for the Walther PPQ 9x19mm.
translations: 一个瓦尔特 PPQ 9x19mm 手枪专用的10发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 15-round steel box magazine for the Walther PPQ 9x19mm.
translations: 一个瓦尔特 PPQ 9x19mm 手枪专用的15发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 15-round steel box magazine with an aftermarket baseplate adding an extra 2 rounds for the Walther PPQ 9x19mm.
translations: 一个瓦尔特 PPQ 9x19mm 手枪专用的15发钢制弹匣，加装了第三方弹匣底板，可以多容纳2发子弹。

messages.msgid: An 8-round steel box magazine for use with the Hi-Point C-9.
translations: 一个 Hi-Point C-9 手枪专用的8发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 10-round steel box magazine for use with the Hi-Point C-9.
translations: 一个 Hi-Point C-9 手枪专用的8发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 15-round steel box magazine for use with the Hi-Point Carbine, it'll fit the C-9 too in a pinch.
translations: 一个 Hi-Point 卡宾枪专用的15发钢制弹匣——勉强能硬塞进 C-9 手枪的弹匣仓内。

messages.msgid: A 16-round steel box magazine for use with the CZ 75.
translations: 一个 CZ 75 手枪专用的16发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 10-round steel box magazine for use with the CZ 75.
translations: 一个 CZ 75 手枪专用的10发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 20-round steel box magazine for use with the CZ 75.
translations: 一个 CZ 75 手枪专用的20发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 26-round steel box magazine for use with the CZ 75.
translations: 一个 CZ 75 手枪专用的26发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: An 8-round steel box magazine for use with the Walther CCP.
translations: 一个瓦尔特 CCP 手枪专用的8发钢制弹匣。

messages.msgid: A standard steel box magazine with magazine extension installed, for use with the Walther CCP.  Holds a total of 9 rounds and provides a better grip for the shooter when loaded.
translations: 一个瓦尔特 CCP 手枪专用的钢制弹匣，安装了扩容底板，不光可容纳9发子弹，还额外为射手提供了更好的抓握力。

messages.msgid: A 10-round translucent polymer magazine for use with the Brügger & Thomet MP9 and compatible guns.
translations: 一个适用于B&T公司 MP9 冲锋枪及其兼容枪械的10发半透明聚合物弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 15-round translucent polymer magazine for use with the Brügger & Thomet MP9 and compatible guns.
translations: 一个适用于B&T公司 MP9 冲锋枪及其兼容枪械的15发半透明聚合物弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 20-round translucent polymer magazine for use with the Brügger & Thomet MP9 and compatible guns.
translations: 一个适用于B&T公司 MP9 冲锋枪及其兼容枪械的20发半透明聚合物弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 25-round translucent polymer magazine for use with the Brügger & Thomet MP9 and compatible guns.
translations: 一个适用于B&T公司 MP9 冲锋枪及其兼容枪械的25发半透明聚合物弹匣。

messages.msgid: A 30-round translucent polymer magazine for use with the Brügger & Thomet MP9 and compatible guns.
translations: 一个适用于B&T公司 MP9 冲锋枪及其兼容枪械的30发半透明聚合物弹匣。

messages.msgid: A bulky 50-round aluminum drum magazine for use with the Brügger & Thomet MP9 and compatible guns.
translations: 一个适用于B&T公司 MP9 冲锋枪及其兼容枪械的，笨重的50发铝制弹鼓。
