messages.msgid: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of faux fur, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.
translations: 一把形状奇特的小块人造毛皮，某次裁剪产生的废料。没什么大用途，通常会被丢弃。

messages.msgid: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of felt, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of, but they can be recycled into some wool fiber if you really want.
translations: 一把形状奇特的小块毛毡，某次裁剪产生的废料。没什么大用途，通常会被丢弃，但如果你实在想的话，可以从其中回收些毛线。

messages.msgid: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of fur, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.
translations: 一把形状奇特的小块毛皮，某次裁剪产生的废料。没什么大用途，通常会被丢弃。

messages.msgid: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of Kevlar fabric, waste material from tailoring projects.  Normally it would be disposed of, but since Kevlar is very difficult to make in a post-apocalyptic world, it might be worth recycling it for Kevlar thread.
translations: 一把形状奇特的小块凯夫拉织物，某次裁剪产生的废料。没什么大用途，通常会被丢弃，但由于凯夫拉材料在末日废土上很罕见，它还是值得你花些时间回收成凯夫拉纤维的。

messages.msgid: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of leather, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.
translations: 一把形状奇特的小块皮革，某次裁剪产生的废料。没什么大用途，通常会被丢弃。

messages.msgid: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of Lycra, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.
translations: 一把形状奇特的小块氨纶面料，某次裁剪产生的废料。没什么大用途，通常会被丢弃。

messages.msgid: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of neoprene, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.
translations: 一把形状奇特的小块氯丁橡胶，某次裁剪产生的废料。没什么大用途，通常会被丢弃。

messages.msgid: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of synthetic fabric, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.
translations: 一把形状奇特的小块化纤面料，某次裁剪产生的废料。没什么大用途，通常会被丢弃。

messages.msgid: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of heat-resistant Nomex fabric, waste material from tailoring projects.  Normally it would be disposed of, but since Nomex is very difficult to make in a post-apocalyptic world, it might be worth recycling it for Nomex thread.
translations: 形状奇特的小块耐热芳纶织物，某次裁剪产生的废料。没什么大用途，通常会被丢弃，但由于芳纶材料在末日废土上很罕见，它还是值得你花些时间回收它来做耐热芳纶线。

messages.msgid: A misshapen section of loose carpet.  Not useful for much on its own and can be discarded.
translations: 一部分已经变形的松松垮垮的地毯。本身用处不大，可以丢弃。

messages.msgid: A natural cluster of wool fibers.  Could be processed into felt patches or yarn.
translations: 一簇天然羊毛纤维。可以加工成毛毡补丁或毛纱。

messages.msgid: A small bolt of fur from an animal, roughly six inches square.  Can be made into patchwork fur sheets or used to repair fur fabric.
translations: 一块约6英寸（约15厘米）见方的动物毛皮。可制成毛皮拼布或用于修补毛皮织物。

messages.msgid: A small bolt of garishly-colored faux fur, roughly six inches square.  Can be made into patchwork faux fur sheets or used to repair faux fur fabric.
translations: 一块约6英寸（约15厘米）见方的色彩艳丽的人造毛皮。可制成人造毛皮拼布或用于修补人造毛皮织物。

messages.msgid: A roughly six-inch square patch of leather, could be used to repair clothing and make smaller leather crafts.
translations: 一块约6英寸（约15厘米）见方的皮革片。可制成小型皮革制品或用于修补皮革物品。

messages.msgid: A small, six-inch square patch of felt.
translations: 一块6英寸（约15厘米）见方的小毛毡片。

messages.msgid: A six-inch square patch of Nomex fire-resistant fabric.
translations: 一块约6英寸（约15厘米）见方的防火芳纶纤维布片。

messages.msgid: A rolled-up animal hide which has been scraped of extraneous hair and flesh and treated to prevent decay.  It still requires tanning to become usable leather.
translations: 一张卷起来的硬皮。相比生皮去除了多余的毛皮和残留肌肉脂肪组织，并且进行了防腐处理。依旧需要鞣制才能变成有用的皮革。

messages.msgid: A folded 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of leather made from carefully tanned animal hide.  Can be cut up or used as is.
translations: 一张折起来的皮革，12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）。由动物的皮小心鞣制得来。可以就这样用，也可以切成小片。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of leather.  Can be cut up or used as is.
translations: 一张折起来的皮革，12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）。可以就这样用，也可以切成小片。

messages.msgid: A folded 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of leather sewn together from patches.  Can be cut up or used as is.
translations: 一张折起来的皮革，12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）。由人造毛皮片采用拼布工艺缝制而成。可以就这样用，也可以切成小片。

messages.msgid: A rolled-up animal hide which has been scraped of extraneous hair and flesh and treated to prevent decay.  It still requires tanning to become usable fur.
translations: 一张卷起来的硬化毛皮皮。相比生皮去除了多余的毛皮和残留肌肉脂肪组织，并且进行了防腐处理。依旧需要鞣制才能变成有用的毛皮。

messages.msgid: A folded sheet of fur made from carefully tanned animal pelt.  Can be cut up or used as is.
translations: 一张折起来的皮革。由动物的皮小心鞣制得来。可以就这样用，也可以切成小片。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of fur sewn together from patches.  Can be cut up or used as is.
translations: 一张折起来的皮革，12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）。由人造毛皮片采用拼布工艺缝制而成。可以就这样用，也可以切成小片。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of cotton fabric, suitable for making clothing.  You can use it to stop bleeding, but it is very wasteful.
translations: 一张12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的棉布，适合制造服装。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of cotton sewn together from patches of various clothing parts.  Suitable for making clothing if you lack proper material sheets.
translations: 一张12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的棉布，由各种衣服部件的补丁缝制而成。 如果你缺乏适当的其它材料片，可以用它来制作服装。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of colorful faux fur, suitable for making clothing.
translations: 一张12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的彩色人造毛皮，适合制作服装。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of faux fur sewn together from mismatched patches.  Suitable for making clothing if you lack proper material sheets, but the bright, clashing colors might end up making you look like a diseased Muppet.
translations: 一张12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的人造毛皮，由不匹配的补丁缝合而成。如果你缺乏适当的其它材料片，可以用它做衣服，但明亮、冲突的颜色最终可能使你看起来像一个生病的布偶。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of felt, suitable for making clothing.
translations: 一张12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的毛毡面料，可以用来制造衣物。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of felt sewn together from patches.  Suitable for making clothing if you lack proper material sheets.
translations: 一张12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的毛毡面料，由各种衣服部件的补丁缝制而成。 如果你缺乏适当的其它材料片，可以用它来制作服装。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of loose-woven Kevlar synthetic fabric, suitable for making durable cut and stab resistant clothing.  While protective, this kind of Kevlar is not suitable for making ballistic gear due to the difference in weave tightness.
translations: 一块12x24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）宽松编织的凯夫拉人造纤维面料，适合制作耐切割、抗穿刺的装备。尽管性能很好，但因为厚度原因，并不适合用于防弹。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of fabric sewn together from Kevlar patches, suitable for making durable cut and stab resistant clothing.  This would be out of the question for ballistic Kevlar but the simpler, looser weave of this variety means it is fine to use if you lack proper material sheets.
translations: 一块12x24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的凯夫拉面料，适合制作耐切割、抗穿刺的装备。虽然是拼接缝成，但也完全可用，注意防弹性能完全比不上防弹凯夫拉。

messages.msgid: A 6-inch square patch of loose-woven Kevlar, suitable for repairing cut and stab resistant clothing or reassembling into a patchwork sheet for sewing.
translations: 一张6英寸（约15厘米）见方的松编凯夫拉，适合修补凯夫拉制成的耐切割、抗穿刺的装备，或者是缝制成凯夫拉拼布面料。

messages.msgid: A sheet of synthetic fabric blended with stretchy Lycra fibers, suitable for making flexible, yet strong clothing.
translations: 一片掺入了弹性氨纶纤维的化纤织物面料。可以用来制造具有弹性且坚韧的衣物。

messages.msgid: A small, 16-layer thick ballistic Kevlar panel.  This kind of Kevlar is precision-made by machine and features an extremely tight weave which cannot be replicated by hand.  Due to this, any damage incurred to your ballistic armor will necessitate complete replacement with a new panel.  It is not as effective as loose-woven Kevlar at stopping stab wounds, but it has no equal against the threat posed by firearms.
translations: 一块凯夫拉防弹板，由16层组成，大小为12x24英寸。编织非常紧密，由精密机器制成故无法手工仿制。防弹装甲受到任何损坏都需要用新的面板完全更换。它的刺击抗性不如松散编织的凯夫拉，但在对抗枪支威胁方面，它是无与伦比的。

messages.msgid: A compressed panel of Kevlar treated with epoxy or other adhesive.  It could be used to repair items made of rigid Kevlar, and makes a decent substitute for damaged carbon fiber and the like even if it isn't exactly the same.
translations: 一块由环氧树脂或其他胶水粘合的压缩凯夫拉片。它可以用于修复硬质凯夫拉制品，还能作为修复受损碳纤维等制品的替代材料，尽管和原材料之间存在一些差异。

messages.msgid: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of fabric sewn together from Lycra patches.  Suitable for making flexible, yet strong clothing if you lack proper material sheets.
translations: 一张12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的化纤织物面料，由氨纶布片缝制而成。如果你缺乏适当的其它材料片，可以用它来制作具有弹性且坚韧的衣物。

messages.msgid: A sheet of neoprene, a synthetic rubber, suitable for making underwater gear.
translations: 一片氯丁橡胶（一种合成橡胶）面料。可以用来制造水下作业的衣物。

messages.msgid: A sheet of neoprene sewn together from patches, with waterproofed seams.  Suitable for making underwater gear if you lack proper material sheets.
translations: 一块由碎片缝合而成的氯丁橡胶片，缝隙经过防水处理。如果你缺乏适当的其它材料片，可以用它来制作潜水装备。

messages.msgid: A sheet of Nomex synthetic fabric, suitable for making heat-resistant clothing.
translations: 一片芳纶化纤织物面料，可以用来制造耐热衣物。

messages.msgid: A sheet of Nomex synthetic fabric, sewn together from patches using Nomex thread.  Suitable for making heat-resistant clothing if you lack proper material sheets.
translations: 一块由碎片缝合而成的芳纶化纤面料。如果你缺乏适当的其它材料片，可以用它来制作耐热衣物。

messages.msgid: A sheet of synthetic fabric, suitable for making clothing.
translations: 一片化纤织物面料，可以用来制造衣物。

messages.msgid: A sheet of fabric, sewn together from synthetic fabric patches in a patchwork fashion.  Suitable for making most clothing, though it's much less time-efficient than if using proper material sheets.
translations: 一些来自各种衣物的化纤布片，用拼布工艺缝合在一起。可以用于制造衣物，但比起使用正规面料要麻烦得多。

messages.msgid: A pile of shredded fabric, dry grass, hair or other cheap materials which could be used to stuff the fabric layers of a gambeson to create armor more cheaply and easily than properly layering and quilting the entire product.
translations: 一块由碎织物、干草、毛发或其他廉价材料组成的布料，可以用来填充软铠的织物层，使用它制作铠甲可以比以如分层和缝合等正常制作流程的速度更快，成本更低。

messages.msgid: Very durable Kevlar thread that would be particularly useful for making ballistic armor, though it's fine to use in place of normal thread too, in most cases.  Making armor-grade Kevlar sheets from this would need a particularly tight weave, and so would require some specialized machinery.
translations: 非常耐用的凯夫拉纤维，在制造防弹装甲时特别有用，不过在大多数情况下也能用来替代普通的缝衣线。盔甲级凯夫拉面料需要特别紧密编织而成，因此需要专门机器才能制造。

messages.msgid: Heat-resistant Nomex thread that would be particularly useful for making heat protection gear, though it's fine to use in place of normal thread too, in most cases.
translations: 防火的芳纶纤维，在制造防火装甲时特别有用，不过在大多数情况下也能用来替代普通的缝衣线。

messages.msgid: A 12 inch by 24 inch sheet of durable blue denim, suitable for making jeans, jorts, or jirts.
translations: 一张12英寸×24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的蓝色牛仔布面料，可以用来制造牛仔裤、牛仔短裤或牛仔短裙。

messages.msgid: Oddly-shaped smallish denim patches, waste material from tailoring projects.
translations: 形状奇特的小块牛仔布，某次裁剪产生的废料。

messages.msgid: A small, 6 inch square patch of blue denim.  It could be used to repair items made of denim or stitched into patchwork sheets for tailoring projects.
translations: 一块6英寸（约15厘米）见方的坚韧的蓝色牛仔布片，可以用来修理牛仔布制品，或缝制成牛仔布拼布面料。

messages.msgid: A selection of various sections of denim, sewn together in a patchwork fashion.  Suitable for tailoring, though it's much less time-efficient than if using proper material sheets.
translations: 一些来自各种衣物的牛仔布，用拼布工艺缝合在一起。可以用于制造衣物，但比起使用正规面料要麻烦得多。

messages.msgid: A 12 inch by 24 inch sheet of durable and waterproof waxed canvas fabric, suitable for making tough bags and clothing.
translations: 一张12英寸x24英寸（约30厘米×61厘米）的打蜡帆布，耐用且防水，适合制作坚韧的袋子和衣物。

messages.msgid: Some tough canvas-weight thread, sturdier than ordinary thread.  You could meticulously weave this into a sheet of canvas cloth.  It would also be useful for stitching such sheets together, though it's fine to use for normal tailoring projects too.
translations: 一些坚韧的帆布用纺织线，比普通的线更结实。你可以把它细致地编织成一张帆布，或者用来缝合帆布面料，不过用于普通的裁缝项目也是可以的。

messages.msgid: Oddly-shaped smallish bits of canvas, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of, but can be recycled into some tough thread.
translations: 形状奇特的小块帆布，某次裁剪产生的废料。没什么大用途，通常会被丢弃，但如果你实在想的话，可以从其中回收些粗线。

messages.msgid: A small, 6 inch square patch of tough canvas.  It could be used to repair items made of canvas or stitched into patchwork sheets for tailoring projects.
translations: 一块6英寸（约15厘米）见方的坚韧帆布片，可以用来修理用帆布制品，或缝制成帆布拼布面料。

messages.msgid: A selection of various sections of canvas, sewn together in a patchwork fashion.  Suitable for tailoring, though it's much less time-efficient than if using proper material sheets.
translations: 一些来自各种衣物的帆布片，用拼布工艺缝合在一起。可以用于制造衣物，但比起使用正规面料要麻烦得多。

messages.msgid: A strip of broad, flat cotton, 42 inches in length, with a metal adjustment buckle threaded in the center.  Normally used as a shoulder strap for bags, its ends are usually sown about a corresponding container's D-rings.
translations: 一条宽而扁平的棉质带子，42英寸长，中间穿有一个金属调节扣。通常用作背包的肩带，两端通常缝在相应容器的 D 形环上。

messages.msgid: A large log of wood, cut from a tree.  (a)ctivate a wood axe or wood saw to cut it into planks.
translations: 一段从树上砍下来的大型原木。使用木斧或木锯对其进行使用可将其切割成木板

messages.msgid: A splintered piece of wood, could be used as a skewer or for kindling.
translations: 一根被劈成细条的木片，可用来串肉或者作为燃火用品。

messages.msgid: A respectable length of wood, just big enough to wrap your hand around.  Makes a decent melee weapon.
translations: 一段还算长的木头，粗细刚好够你用手握住。能算作一把还凑合的近战武器。

messages.msgid: A straight section of wood, about eight feet long and a couple of inches in diameter.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and can be broken into shorter pieces for crafting.
translations: 一段长长的木头，约有8英尺（约2.4米）长，有几英寸粗。能算作一把还凑合的近战武器，而且可以被拆成较短的木棍作为制造材料使用。

messages.msgid: A stout, ten-foot pole.  Could be used similarly to a spear.  It's currently soaked with oil and quite slippery.  Once the oil penetrates the wood it can be wiped down and used for further projects.
translations: 一根结实的十英尺长的杆子，可以像矛一样使用。它目前被油浸透了，很滑。油渗透到木材中之后就可以擦干以用于进一步的项目。

messages.msgid: You wipe down the long pole.
The long pole is still soaking.
A stout, ten-foot pole.  Could be used similarly to a spear.  The Cataclysm gives fresh meaning to walking softly and carrying a big stick.
translations: 一根十英尺（3米）长的粗壮杆子。能当作矛使。大灾变的情况下拿着一根大棍子轻悄悄的走路还算有点新意。

messages.msgid: A long stick carved and sanded into a smooth staff with a slight taper, for use in making spears.  It's currently soaked with oil and quite slippery.  Once the oil penetrates the wood it can be wiped down and used for further projects.
translations: 一根雕刻并打磨成光滑的杆的长棍，有轻微的锥度，用于制作长矛。它目前被油浸透了，很滑。油渗透到木材中之后就可以擦干以用于进一步的项目。

messages.msgid: You wipe down the spear shaft.
The spear shaft is still soaking.

A long stick, sanded and treated with oil for integrity and carved into a smooth staff with a slight taper, for use in making spears.  It can also be used as a makeshift quarterstaff as-is, but is too thin to be very effective for just hitting people.
translations: 一根长木棍，经过打磨和油脂处理，并雕刻成两端带钝锥头的的光滑木杖，用于制作真正的长矛。它也可以作为简易的武术长棍使用，但太细了，用来打人不是很有效。

messages.msgid: A flat, thick plank of wood, like a 2 by 4 or similar piece of dimensional lumber.  Makes a decent melee weapon if you're desperate, and can be used for all kinds of construction projects.
translations: 一块尺寸大概有2x4平方英寸（约5×10平方厘米）的扁平而厚实的木板。如果你走投无路的话，当做近战武器刚好趁手，也可用于各种建造。

messages.msgid: A block of tonally appropriate wood that has been air dried for a year in preparation for being turned into a musical instrument.
translations: 一块音色合适的木材，已经风干了一年，准备好制成乐器。

messages.msgid: Tuning pegs go on stringed instruments to both provide an anchor for the strings and to control the tightness of the wire which in turn controls the tune of the notes produced.
translations: 弦乐器上的调音弦轴既为琴弦提供了锚点，又控制了琴弦的松紧度，而琴弦松紧度又控制了所产生的音调。

messages.msgid: A short 2 by 4 plank of wood.  While less common and smaller than its 4 foot cousin it can still be very useful in carpentry.
translations: 一块2x4平方英寸（约5×10平方厘米）的短木板。虽然不太常见，而且比它的4英尺（约1.2米）表哥小，但它在木工方面仍然非常有用。

messages.msgid: A long 2 by 4 plank of wood.  While not as common as the 4 foot variant, still makes a decent melee weapon, and can be used for all kinds construction.
translations: 一块2x4平方英寸（约5×10平方厘米）的长木板。虽然不太常见，而且比它的4英尺（约1.2米）表弟长，但当做近战武器刚好趁手，也可用于各种建造。

messages.msgid: An enormous beam of solid wood, very heavy and hard to lug around, but also very sturdy for construction.  You could saw or chop it into smaller pieces, like planks or panels.
translations: 巨大的实木梁，很重，很难被拖动，但对于建筑来说也很坚固。你可以把它锯成小块，比如木板或木墙板。

messages.msgid: A wooden post with a 4 by 4 square base.  Posts with a length similar to this are commonly used in mailboxes or as table legs.
translations: 一根横截面是正方形，长4英尺（约1.2米）的木杆。长度与此相似的杆子通常用于邮箱或作为桌腿。

messages.msgid: A wooden post with a 4 by 4 square base.  Posts with a length similar to this are commonly used as chair legs.
translations: 一根横截面是正方形，长24英寸（约61厘米）的木杆。长度与此相似的杆子通常用于椅子腿。

messages.msgid: A wooden post with a 4 by 4 square base.  Posts with a length similar to this are commonly used in the construction of walls and floors.
translations: 一根横截面是正方形，长8英尺（约2.4米）的木杆。长度与此相似的杆子通常用于地板或墙体建设。

messages.msgid: A small 2x2x5 inches block of wood, primarily used for carving out small wooden objects.
translations: 一块2x2x5立方英寸（约5×5×13立方厘米）的木头，主要用于雕刻小型木制物品。

messages.msgid: A wide, thin wooden board - plywood, OSB, MDF, tongue-in-groove boards, or similar, already cut to shape.  Good for all kinds of construction, but for really big projects you'd need a proper sheet of uncut plywood or the like.
translations: 一种宽而薄的胶合板、纤维板或欧松板，已经切割成型并打孔好凹槽。非常适合建造各种建筑。但是对于真正的大型项目来说，你可能需要更合适的未切割的板材。

messages.msgid: A standard 4 by 8 sheet of flat wood - usually plywood, OSB, or MDF.  Heavy and bulky, it is extremely useful for all manner of construction, but you might have to cut it to size before doing smaller projects.
translations: 一块标准的4x8大小的大木板，通常是胶合板、欧松板或纤维板类似材质。又沉又笨重，它能够被用于建造各种建筑，不过也许你需要在建造小型建筑前将它切割成合适的尺寸。

messages.msgid: A giant screw carved out of solid wood, a simple component used to convert rotational energy into a downward movement of greater force.
translations: 一根由实木雕刻而成的巨大螺杆，一个简单的部件，用来将旋转的动力转化为更大力量的向下移动。

messages.msgid: A power cord, like you've seen many times before: it's a short multi-stranded copper cord with a power outlet at the end.
translations: 一根电源线，就像你以前见过的很多充电线一样：它是一根由多股短铜线组成的电线，末端带有电源插头。

messages.msgid: A 3-foot (or about 1 m) jumper cable: a short multi-stranded copper cable with power leads on either end, whose main purpose is to share power between vehicles, but can also link other electrical systems.
translations: 就和你经常见到的一样，一根长3英尺（约1米）的跨接电缆：一小段多用铜线，两端各有一个接头，主要用来在载具间传递电力，但也可以用于连接其它电力系统。

messages.msgid: A long, thick, heavy-duty jumper cable with power leads on either end.  It looks like you could use it to hook up two vehicles to each other, though you expect the power loss would be noticeable.  Can also link other electrical systems.
translations: 一条又粗又长，两端还镀铅的重型跨接电缆。看来你可以用它来连接两部载具，不过线路损耗不可小觑。也可以用来连接其它电力系统。

messages.msgid: A long 30-foot (or about 10 m) orange extension cord for extending cables or connecting appliances.  Could be used on any appliance or other household electrical system.
translations: 一根30英尺（约9米）长橙色延长线，用于连接电器或延长线缆，适用于任何电器或其他家庭电气系统。

messages.msgid: An extra-long 100-foot (or about 30 m) orange extension cord for extending cables or connecting outdoor appliances.  Could be used on any appliance or other household electrical system.
translations: 一根100英尺（约30米）长橙色延长线，用于连接电器或延长线缆，适用于任何电器或其他家庭电气系统。

messages.msgid: An extremely heavy-duty 30-foot (or about 9 m) tow cable made from thick steel wire coated in plastic.  If attached to a vehicle, it could be used to pull another vehicle of any weight.
translations: 一根30英尺（约9米）长的重型牵引索，塑料外皮内是绞成一股的粗钢丝。如果连接到一辆车上，它可以用来拉动任何重量的另一辆车。

messages.msgid: This is the cable of the gods: 100 meters long, no power loss, light as a feather, and fits in a matchbook.  You're sure this wasn't supposed to exist, and the way it shimmers makes you uneasy.
translations: 上帝造出来的电缆：100米长，零线损，轻如羽毛，卷一卷就能放进火柴盒！你确信这种东西不可能存在，但事实就摆在眼前，它还在微微发光。

messages.msgid: A stainless steel water bottle, holds 750 mL of liquid.
translations: 一个不锈钢水瓶，能储存750毫升的液体。

messages.msgid: A non-rigid plastic bottle for easy storage, holds 500 mL of liquid.
translations: 一个水密的可折叠塑料瓶，能储存500毫升的液体。

messages.msgid: This is a Curie-G coffeemaker, by CuppaTech.  It famously uses a radioactive generator to heat water for coffee, reducing the amount of total electricity it consumes.  Consumer safety concerns led to it being banned in the EU as well as many other countries, but don't let that stop you from brewing your morning Joe with the power of the atom™!
translations: 这是茶杯科技制造的"居里-G"型咖啡机。它以使用放射性发电机加热咖啡从而减少了总用电量而闻名。由于可能会对消费者产生安全问题，它在欧盟和许多其他国家被禁止，但不要让这件事阻止你用原子™的力量制造你的早晨咖啡!

messages.msgid: A kit containing all the specialized knives you need to debone, skin, and prepare cuts of meat from an animal.
translations: 一套各式各样的专业刀具，能满足你一切去骨，剥皮等屠宰加工需求。

messages.msgid: A hand-crank-powered cast steel machine designed to automatically seal tin cans.
translations: 手摇驱动的铸铁机器，用于自动封装罐头。

messages.msgid: An electric meat carver powered by cord.  It has two serrated blades that vibrate together to slice just about anything from turkey to ham… even zombies!
translations: 一把使用电源线供电的切肉刀。一副共同振动的锯齿状刀刃从火鸡到火腿都能轻松切开……甚至丧尸！

messages.msgid: The electric carver's serrated blades start buzzing!
translations: 电动切肉刀的齿刃开始滋滋振动！

messages.msgid: You pull the trigger, but nothing happens.
translations: 你按下开关，但什么都没有发生。

messages.msgid: This carver is on and the blades are buzzing.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 这把切肉刀已经启动，刀锋正嗡嗡作响。激活它来关闭。
你的电动切肉刀滋滋作响。

messages.msgid: Using this item on a container full of water will purify the water using layered charcoal.  Once the charcoal has purified enough water, it will become unusable and can be disassembled and recycled.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.
translations: 这个物品专门用来吸取纯净水源，使用三层滤网，和活性木炭过滤，一旦木炭吸取了足够的杂质，将变得无法使用，只能拆解回收。从河流之类的不明水源取得的水有可能被污染。

messages.msgid: A portable charcoal smoker.  Good for weekend barbecuing and preserving meat with smoke.  Cannot be used with coal; the toxic fumes would ruin the meat.
translations: 一台便携式木炭烤架。周末BBQ和制烟熏肉的好帮手。不能使用煤炭，因为有毒烟气会破坏肉的质量。

messages.msgid: A little metal tank for holding coal or charcoal, with a pilot light attached and a pipe to vent toxic coal fumes.  You could use it for cooking food.
translations: 一个小型金属罐，可填充煤炭或是木炭，配有点火装置和排出有害煤炭烟气的管道。你可以用它来烹饪食物。

messages.msgid: A crude clay pot used for cooking.
translations: 一个粗糙的陶锅，可以用来做饭。

messages.msgid: A clay teapot.  Now all you need is tea and water.
translations: 一个陶茶壶，再来点茶叶和水。

messages.msgid: A heating element with a pot and a frame for holding coffee or other powders.  You can use it to make coffee, or other drinks if you so choose.
translations: 一套带有壶和粉末滤网的加热器具。你可以拿它来煮咖啡，或者你想要的其它饮料。

messages.msgid: An electric food dehydrator, invaluable in preserving food.  Can be connected to the electric grid using cord.
translations: 电子食品脱水机，保存食品的无价之宝。 可以用电线连接到电网。

messages.msgid: This jar contains a batch of eggs in a pickling solution.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.
translations: 这个玻璃罐里储存了一批发酵中的醋泡蛋。可在发酵完成后封装以长期储存。

messages.msgid: You examine the batch and see that the pickling solution has done its job, so you seal the jar up for storage.
translations: 你仔细查看了这批醋泡蛋，看起来已经发酵完成了，于是你把罐头封起来用于储存。

messages.msgid: The eggs are not done yet.
A lightweight, folding stove designed to use small hexamine tablets for cooking.  Also known as an Esbit stove.
translations: 一种轻便的折叠炉，使用乌洛托品进行加热。也被称为易斯比特炉。

messages.msgid: A sealed jar holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.
translations: 装满了洗干净的酵母增殖原料的密封罐。当发酵完毕你就可以收获酵母了。

messages.msgid: You open the jar and harvest the culture.
translations: 你打开罐子，收获了培养物。

messages.msgid: The yeast isn't done culturing yet.
A kitchen appliance capable of slicing, chopping, shredding, grinding, pureeing, and mixing.
translations: 一种厨房用具，可用于切片、剁块、绞碎、研磨、打泥和搅拌。

messages.msgid: A simple heater powered by gasoline.  It is designed for cooking food.
translations: 一只被设计成用汽油来加热食物的简单炉子。

messages.msgid: A chemical heat pack, used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  It is usable only once.
translations: 一次性加热贴，可以被用来处理伤口或者加热食物。

messages.msgid: A chemical heat pack, used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  This one has been used up and is chemically inert, rendering it useless.
translations: 一次性加热贴，可以被用来处理伤口或者加热食物，但这个加热贴已经被用过了，现在没用了。

messages.msgid: A small heating element on a stand, powered by your electric grid.  It is indispensable for cooking and chemistry.  Try not to burn yourself.
translations: 一个小小的带插头的加热装置，无论是烹饪还是做化学药剂都必不可少。用的时候可得小心，可别把自己给煮了。

messages.msgid: A high end hotplate that utilizes magnetic induction coils to heat ferrous cookware directly.  It is far more efficient than a standard hotplate.
translations: 一种利用磁感应线圈直接加热铁质炊具的高端加热板。它比标准的火锅效率高得多。

messages.msgid: A homemade heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.
translations: 自制的便携式真空热封口机，用于包装真空食品以延长食物保质期。

messages.msgid: A self-contained camping mess kit, containing everything you might need for wilderness cooking.
translations: 一个独立的露营餐包，里面有你在野外烹饪时可能需要的一切。

messages.msgid: This jar contains raw milk separated into cream.  It is sealed until you are ready to use it.
translations: 这个大罐储存了分离成奶油的生乳。封装后可长期储存直到你再次将其打开使用。

messages.msgid: This jar contains raw milk separating into cream.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.
translations: 这个大罐储存了准备分离奶油的生乳。你可在分离完成后封装以长期储存。

messages.msgid: You examine the batch and see that the cream has risen to the top, so you seal the jar up for storage.
translations: 你仔细查看了这批奶油罐，看起来奶油已经浮至表面了，于是你把罐头封起来用于储存。

messages.msgid: The cream has not risen yet.
A simple combination of a small grindstone and a bowl-shaped stone.  Used for grinding grain, but time-consuming compared to more complex methods.
translations: 一个小磨石和一个碗石的简单组合。用于研磨谷物，但比复杂的方法耗时。

messages.msgid: A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a short electric cord.  Its multitude of settings and features promise to handle any sort of cooking, from parboiling potatoes to cooking curry to popping popcorn.  There's no manual, but you're sure you can work it out.
translations: 一台专业级的多功能电饭锅，配着一根较短的电源线。它提供大量的设置与功能，号称能处理各种烹饪需求，从把土豆焯个半熟，到煮咖喱，再到爆爆米花都不在话下。虽然没有说明书，但你确信自己能摸索出来。

messages.msgid: A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a battery slot for camping trips or tailgating.  There is a dish cooking inside it.
translations: 一种民用级的多功能电饭煲。在旅行野营时使用电池供电。它的许多设置和功能，号称可以处理任何烹饪，从煮马铃薯煮咖哩到做爆米花。虽然没有使用手册，但你确定你会用。这里面有盘菜正在烹饪。

messages.msgid: A simple heater powered by kerosene.  It is designed for cooking food.
translations: 一只被设计成用煤油来加热食物的简单炉子。

messages.msgid: A hand-cranked press for creating vegetable oil.  A hotplate heats the raw material to increase extraction efficiency.
translations: 一台手摇式压榨机，用于制作植物油。有台电炉加热原料以提高萃取效率。

messages.msgid: A barrel with a large screw press for creating vegetable oil.  A kerosene cooker heats the raw material to increase extraction efficiency.
translations: 一台带着大桶的手摇式压榨机，用于制作植物油。有台煤油炉加热原料以提高萃取效率。

messages.msgid: A pasta extruder powered by a hand crank.  Useful in making pasta.  It comes with various heads to make various kinds of pasta.
translations: 一个手摇挤面机。拥有一整套面嘴，能够挤出各种面条。

messages.msgid: This jar contains a batch of pickles set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.
translations: 这个玻璃罐里储存了一批发酵中的腌黄瓜。可在发酵完成后封装以长期储存。

messages.msgid: You test the batch, and it tastes good, so you seal the jar up for storage.
translations: 你尝了下这批酸菜，味道很不错，于是你把罐头封起来用于储存。

messages.msgid: The pickles are not done fermenting yet.
An ultra-light alcohol-burning stove with a simmer ring, crafted by hand from a couple of aluminum soda cans.  It comes with a 500 mL plastic bottle to hold concentrated alcohol fuel.
translations: 一个超轻型酒精燃烧炉，有着用铝罐手工加工而成的火力密封环。它配备了一个500毫升的塑料瓶，以容纳提炼过的酒精燃料。

messages.msgid: A sealable pot, designed to cook food at higher pressures and temperatures.  Useful for all kinds of cooking, and it can also be used for pressure-sensitive chemical reactions.
translations: 一种可密封的锅，用于在更高的压力和温度下烹饪食物。适用于各种烹饪，也可用于压敏化学反应。

messages.msgid: A simple hand-powered stone quern with a wooden handle, for grinding grain.
translations: 一个造型简单，带有木把手的手推石磨，用来磨面粉。

messages.msgid: This jar contains a batch of sauerkraut set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.
translations: 这个玻璃罐里储存了一批发酵中的德式酸菜。可在发酵完成后封装以长期储存。

messages.msgid: The sauerkraut isn't done fermenting yet.
translations: 德式酸菜尚未发酵完成。

messages.msgid: A snow machine, which freezes water and shreds it into "snow", designed to be used from the comfort of your own home!  Useful for making snow cones.
translations: 一台制雪机，可以将水冷冻并粉碎成“雪”，设计用于在自己家中舒适地使用！可用于制作雪糕筒。

messages.msgid: A primitive sieve constructed from woven strips of plant material.  Early sieves like this were used to sift grain, though the openings on this one are too small for that.
translations: 一个用植物编织成的粗糙筛子。这种筛子在人类历史早期被用于筛选谷物，但是这个筛子的网孔太小，没法用来筛谷物。

messages.msgid: This is no mere strainer for noodles; it's a laboratory-grade sieve used to separate particles of certain sizes.  You could use this to do a really good job sifting flour, remove dust and soil from grain, or perhaps conduct gradation tests for any civil engineers you might know.  This one has been constructed from steel mesh.
translations: 这可不是用来捞面的滤网，而是一个用来过滤特定尺寸颗粒的实验室级筛子。用这个东西你可以很好地筛面粉，从谷物中筛除尘土，或者用于土木工程的粒度分级试验。这个筛子是由钢丝网做成的。

messages.msgid: Some fine steel mesh attached to a length of thicker steel wire, forming a rigid frame.  Useful for sieving.
translations: 一张简易筛网，由较粗钢丝制成的硬质边框附着细钢网。适用于筛选或过滤。

messages.msgid: A large still, useful for creating distillations of alcohol and other, more curious substances.  Features a slot for a thermometer.
translations: 一个大型蒸馏器，用来制取酒精和其他更为奇妙物质的蒸馏物。有一个温度计槽。

messages.msgid: A homemade mess kit containing everything you might need for creating post-apocalyptic cuisine.  Powered by a kerosene burner, it is composed of simple yet durable tools and materials.
translations: 一个自制的野炊套装，里面装满了各类用来烹饪后大灾变菜肴的必需工具。以煤油炉供热，全套套装都是由简单而耐用的工具和材料组成。

messages.msgid: A small metal teapot.  Teatime wouldn't be complete without one.
translations: 小金属茶壶，没有它的存在你的下午茶时间就是不完整的。

messages.msgid: A portable heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.
translations: 自制的便携式真空热封口机，用于包装真空食品以延长食物保质期。

messages.msgid: A waffle iron, generally used for making waffles.
translations: 一个华夫饼烤盘，一般用于制作华夫饼。

messages.msgid: A battery-powered device designed to purify drinking water.  Using this item on a container full of water will purify the contents.  It could be useful for water taken from uncertain sources like a river, as it may be non-potable.
translations: 一个由电池供电的净水装置。使用该物品可将任何装水的容器中的水净化使其能够安全饮用。特别是对那些从河流、水池、集雨器甚至是马桶里的弄来的不怎么干净的水来说，再好不过了。

messages.msgid: An improvised water filter made from a plastic bucket filled with a layer of sand and a layer of gravel.  It can be used to remove particulates and some pathogens from water, but it is not 100% effective.
translations: 一个简易的水质过滤器，由一个装满沙子和砾石的塑料桶制成。它可以用于去除水中的大颗粒物和一些病原体，但并非100%有效。

messages.msgid: A simple heater powered by propane.  It is designed for cooking food.
translations: 一只被设计成用丙烷来加热食物的简单炉子。

messages.msgid: A simple heater powered by biogas.  It is designed for cooking food.
translations: 一只被设计成用生物燃气来加热食物的简单炉子。

messages.msgid: A simple heater powered by acetylene welding gas.  It is designed for cooking food.
translations: 用乙炔焊气供能的简单加热器。设计上用来烹饪食物。

messages.msgid: A home microwave, has probably seen its share of baked beans.
translations: 一个家用微波炉，也许有人用它烤过豆子。

messages.msgid: A large pot with 20 gauge walls and a thick aluminum bottom, modified to serve as a bulky but passable pressure cooker.
translations: 一个经过改装的锅壁和锅底有20Ga.（译注：约为0.81mm）厚的大铝锅，可以作为一个笨重但可堪一用的高压锅。

messages.msgid: A small two-slice toaster, can be used to toast toast and few other things.
translations: 一个小巧的两片型烤面包机，可以用来烤面包，或是烤其他东西。

messages.msgid: Sweet, sweet sugar in the process of crystallizing.  It needs two weeks to form solid crystals.
translations: 甜甜的糖正在结晶过程中。形成固体晶体需要两周时间。

messages.msgid: You break up the crystallized sugar into a coarse powder.
translations: 你把结晶的糖碎成粗粉。

messages.msgid: This debug tool will tell you about light.
Deals 1 full bar of damage to an item you wield.
translations: 对你手持的物品造成1整格的伤害。

messages.msgid: <npc_name> have had <context_val:hp_before> hp, now has <context_val:hp_after> hp.
Deals damage to items you pick.
translations: 对你选中的物品造成伤害。

messages.msgid: Causes explosion at overmap you pick.
Applies the fault on item by id.
<npc_name> has random fault from fault_type "<context_val:str>" added, if such group exists.
<npc_name> has "<context_val:str>" fault added, if such id exists.
A large metal stand used to contain a fire.  Fires set in a brazier will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.
translations: 一个巨大的金属支架，用于容纳篝火。火盆内的篝火不会引燃周围的易燃物。

messages.msgid: A portable brazier fashioned from a steel bucket by punching small holes on the sides to improve the air supply.  It is too small to fit any fuel item larger than some splintered wood.  Fires set in this bucket will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.
translations: 一个便携式火盆，由铁桶改造而成，桶壁上凿有小孔以改善通风。它的尺寸过小，装不下比碎木片更大的燃料。桶内点燃的火焰不会蔓延至周围的可燃物。

messages.msgid: A small, improvised wood stove, made from a metal can or similar container of the right size.  It's too small to fit anything much larger than splintered wood.  Activate it to deploy.
translations: 小型的流浪汉火炉，用金属罐或大小合适的类似容器制成。它太小了，装不下任何比碎木体积更大的柴火。激活以作为家具放置。

messages.msgid: A foldable wood stove to safely lit fires while camping in the wilderness.  Activate it to deploy.
translations: 用于野外露营时安全点火的可折叠柴炉。激活以作为家具放置。

messages.msgid: A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.
translations: 用来烧火的大金属桶。它的桶壁上有多个孔以保障空气供应。火桶中的火不会蔓延到周围的易燃物品。

messages.msgid: A folded chair for camping.  Activate it to set it down for a place to sit.
translations: 露营用的折叠椅子。激活以作为家具放置。

messages.msgid: Folded deck chair, deploy to sit down.
translations: 已折叠的日光浴躺椅，展开它来坐下。

messages.msgid: Folded plastic chair on a metal frame, deploy to sit down.
translations: 已折叠的金属框架塑料椅，展开它来坐下。

messages.msgid: A directional antenna and accompanying tripod, folded into a shape vaguely resembling an umbrella.
translations: 一台定向天线和配套的三脚架，折叠成类似雨伞的形状。

messages.msgid: A military-style folding cot.  While it may not be quite as comfortable as a bed, it's better than slumming it on the ground.
translations: 一张折叠起来的行军床，虽然没家里的床舒服，但至少比睡在地上好多了。

messages.msgid: You unfold the cot and place it on the ground.
translations: 你打开床并把它放在地上。

messages.msgid: A metal butchering rack designed to hang a carcass in the air.  It is folded for easy transportation.
translations: 一个金属屠宰架子，可以将清理内脏后的胴体悬挂在半空中。它已经被折叠起来以便携带。

messages.msgid: A metal rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  It is folded for easy transportation.
translations: 设计用于熏制食物的金属架，可以获得更好的保存和口感。它已经被折叠起来以便携带。

messages.msgid: A metal folding table for off-road trips.  It is currently folded for easy transportation.
translations: 用于野外旅行的金属餐桌，目前已被折叠起来方便携带。

messages.msgid: A large sheet of leather.  You could use it as a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a surface for butchering as it does not soak up blood.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.
translations: 一大块缝制的皮革，你可以用它来代替野餐毯子，但用作屠宰工具更有价值，因为它不会渗血。它已经被卷起以便于携带。

messages.msgid: A large mat woven from fibrous material.  You could use it as a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a surface for butchering.  Too thin to be used as a comfortable sleeping mat.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.
translations: 一块由纤维材料编织而成的大垫子。你可以把它当野餐毯使用，但用作屠宰的地方更有价值。因为太薄不能作为舒适的睡眠场所。它已经被卷起以便于携带。

messages.msgid: A large wooden container used to turn raw milk into butter and buttermilk.  This model uses a foot crank and holds three gallons of raw milk.
translations: 一个大木桶，能够将生乳制成黄油和奶油。这个型号有个脚踏曲柄，能够装下三加仑生乳。

messages.msgid: A small water-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Needs to be placed via the construction menu.
translations: 小型水动力磨，可将含淀粉的物品加工成面粉。需要通过建造菜单放置。

messages.msgid: A small wind-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Needs to be placed via the construction menu.
translations: 小型风动力磨，可将含淀粉的物品加工成面粉。需要通过建造菜单放置。

messages.msgid: A large screw press for manually pressing oil out of fruit or seed paste.  Needs to be placed via the construction menu.
translations: 一种大型螺旋压榨机，用于手动从果实或种子糊中榨油。需要通过建造菜单放置。

messages.msgid: A floor-mounted machine containing all the levers, clamps, and mounts required to remove or fit a tire, plus an integrated foot pump to inflate it.
translations: 一台落地式机器，包含拆卸或安装轮胎所需的各类杠杆、夹具和安装件，以及一个内置脚压式充气泵。

messages.msgid: A point-and-shoot digital camera with a digital viewfinder, a backup 'iron-sight', and flash.  You can look at your photos on the digital screen, or transfer them with any standard electronic device.
translations: 一台傻瓜式数码相机，带有数字取景器，辅助的手动取景器以及闪光灯。你可以在液晶屏幕上查看你的照片，或是传输到任何标准电子设备里。

messages.msgid: A 35 mm digital SLR (single-lens reflex) camera with optical and digital viewfinders, a zoom lens with auto-focus and stabilizer, and flash.  You can look at your photos on the digital screen or transfer them with any standard electronic device.  Before the Cataclysm, you could have taken professional-grade photos using this.
translations: 35 mm 的数码单反（单镜头反光）相机，带光学/数字取景器，具有自动对焦的变焦镜头、防抖功能和闪光灯。你可以在液晶屏幕上查看你的照片，或者传输到任何标准电子设备里。在大灾变之前，专业级照片都是使用这种相机拍摄出来的。

messages.msgid: A cellphone, an older cousin of the smartphone that is still popular in certain circles due to its reliability and sturdiness.  Using the phone will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is sufficiently charged.  It also tells the time and has an alarm feature.
translations: 一部手机，现代智能手机的老大哥，由于它的可靠性、坚固性它仍然在某些圈子里很受欢迎。当电量足够时，使用它就能开启并提供照明。它也有一个时钟应用程序，其中包括闹钟功能。

messages.msgid: The cellphone's batteries need more charge.
An antenna designed to pick up signals better when pointed at the source.  You could use this with a radio to receive faint signals.
translations: 天线，可以用来收集信号。当然，你要是把天线对准了信号源，信号强度会更高。

messages.msgid:
A pair of electronic handcuffs, used by police and riot bots to detain captives.  Their continuous siren clearly identifies the wearer as an arrested criminal and alerts human police.  Wait for their arrival, don't try to escape or to remove the cuffs - they will administer an electric shock.
However, since the only police likely to respond are undead, you may have a long wait ahead, unless you get creative…
translations:
一副电子手铐，警察和机器人用来限制嫌疑人行动的常用工具。它会持续的发出警报并且不停的呼叫警官过来将犯人带回警局关押。如果试图挣脱或者逃跑，手铐将主动电击疑犯。
"鉴于目前的治安情况，请在被电击和被吃掉脑子之间选择一个吧，亲。"

messages.msgid: A tablet PC using an efficient color e-ink display.  Before the Cataclysm, these were nifty gadgets; now, they are extremely useful tools.  Runs on conventional batteries.
translations: 一台拥有高清彩色电子墨水屏的平板电脑。大灾变前的俏玩意，现如今倒变得极其有用。它需要电池进行供电。

messages.msgid: A USB thumb drive.  Useful for holding electronic data.
translations: 一个U盘，用于存储电脑软件与数据。

messages.msgid: A USB thumb drive.  Maybe a decade out of date, but still useful for holding electronic data.
translations: 一个U盘，可能有些过时，但仍可用于存储电脑软件与数据。

messages.msgid: A portable external hard drive, the best in affordable mass storage.  Useful for holding lots of electronic data.
translations: 一个移动硬盘，大容量储存设备中的性价比首选，用于储存大量数据。

messages.msgid: A memory card, can be used to store data.
translations: 一张存储卡，可以用来存放数据。

messages.msgid: A memory card.  Maybe a decade out of date, but can still be used to store data.
translations: 一个U盘，可能有些过时，但仍可用于存放数据。

messages.msgid: A memory card, can be used to store data.  This one has a label on which is written 'XEDRA' followed by a long string of numbers.
translations: 一张存储卡，可以用来存放数据。这张存储卡上有一个标签，上面写着“XEDRA”，后面跟着一长串数字。

messages.msgid: This device has many ports attached, allowing it to connect to almost any control panel or other electronic machine (but not computers).  With a little skill, it can be used to crack passwords and more.
translations: 这套仪器由好几个部分构成，当它们连接在一起之后，就可以用来侵入掉绝大多数的电子设备，如果你的技术再高一点的话，甚至可以通过需要身份ID卡的关卡。

messages.msgid: A tool for measuring radiation.  Using it will prompt you to choose whether to scan yourself or the terrain, or to turn on continuous scan, which will provide continuous feedback on ambient radiation.  It is currently off.
translations: 本产品适用于监测辐射，可以用于持续监测周围环境的辐射，也可以扫描一次你的身体或是周围的地形，检测辐射是否超标。

messages.msgid: A tool for measuring radiation.  It is in continuous scan mode, and will produce quiet clicking sounds in the presence of ambient radiation.  Using it allows you to turn it off, or scan yourself or the ground.
translations: 本产品适用于监测辐射。提示：本产品正处于持续扫描模式下，一旦检测到强辐射会发出无声警报。再次使用可以切换模式，转为一次性扫描，或是终止运行。

messages.msgid: The Geiger counter's SCANNING LED turns off.
translations: 盖革计数器的工作状态灯灭了。

messages.msgid: This strange contraption appears to be little more than a laminated box built around a battery, a poorly backlit screen, and a wound spool of cloth netting.  The letters "X E D R A" are emblazoned on the side.  To operate the device, unfurl the netting and place it around the object to analyze.  Despite not appearing to do anything, it consumes an enormous amount of electricity and provides a brief numerical readout.
translations: 这个奇怪的装置似乎不过是个围绕电池、背光不佳的屏幕和缠绕的布网而建的多层盒子。侧面印有“X E D R A”的字样。要操作该装置，展开布网并将其放在要分析的物体周围。虽然看上去似乎什么事情都没做，但它消耗大量电力并输出简短的数字读数。

messages.msgid: A strange apparatus, seemingly consisting of a glass-encased microphone linked to a small thermal printer and digital screen.  The screen remains perpetually blank, save for a battery indicator on its upper right, and on its left side lies a single red button: "PRINT DATA".
translations: 一个奇怪的仪器，似乎由一个玻璃包裹的麦克风连接到一个小型热敏打印机和数字屏幕组成。屏幕始终保持空白，除了右上角的电池指示灯，左侧有一个红色按钮："打印数据"。

messages.msgid: A hand-powered battery charger.  It has an adjustable receptacle designed to accept a wide variety of rechargeable battery cells.
translations: 一个手摇电池充电器。它有一个可调节的插座，可以插入各种型号的可充电电池。

messages.msgid: A portable computer, a ubiquitous tool both before and after the cataclysm.  While you no longer have internet access, you still can load it with books and other useful software.
translations: 便携式电脑，灾难前后无处不在的工具。虽然你不再有互联网接入，但你仍然可以加载书籍和其他有用的软件。

messages.msgid: The laptop's batteries need more charge.
You stop lighting up the screen.
This battery-powered device is loaded up with someone's music collection.  Fortunately, there's lots of songs you like, and listening to it will raise your morale slightly.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 这个耗电池的玩意里存着某人的音乐珍藏，里面恰好有不少你喜欢的歌。听听看吧，你的情绪会随着音乐而高涨。

messages.msgid: This mp3 player is turned on and playing some great tunes, raising your morale steadily while on your person.  It runs through batteries quickly; you can turn it off by using it.  It also obscures your hearing.
translations: 这个MP3播放器正打开着，从中传来优美的曲调，让你的身心都为之放松。回想大灾变之后的日子，你已经经历了太多，然而未来的挑战才刚开始，稍作休整之后，你决定重整行装，再度启程。佩戴MP3的时候你的心情值会持续上升，但是也会持续耗电，所以不用的时候请记得关上它。另外当你戴着MP3时，你对周遭的声响也会失去警觉。

messages.msgid: A device constructed by 'enhancing' a speaker with some amplifier circuits.  It has no other use besides emitting loud crackling static noise that could distract zombies.
translations: 这个装置主要是一个增强的扬声器，这个扬声器连接着一些放大器电路。除了发出刺耳的噪音之外，它没有其他用途。噪音会分散丧尸的注意力。

messages.msgid: You turn the noise emitter on.
A homemade device that is emitting horrible crackles, pops, and other loud static sounds.  Quick, get away from it before it draws zombies to you!
translations: 这个便携装置正在发出可怕的噼啪声、碰撞声和其他嘈杂的声音。快点，在它把丧尸吸引过来之前离开它！

messages.msgid: The infernal racket dies as the noise emitter turns off.
translations: 你关闭了噪音发生器，同时可怕的噪音也随之消失了。

messages.msgid: This device detects and reads out different electromagnetic wave lengths.  It beeps with proximity and is sensitive enough you could use it to get a sense of direction.
translations: 该设备检测并读出不同的电磁波长度。它接近目标时发出嘟嘟声，足够灵敏，你可以用它来获得方向感。

messages.msgid: You turn the EMF detector on.
translations: 你打开了电磁场测试仪。

messages.msgid: This device detects and reads out different wave lengths.  It is currently on, humming and beeping with proximity.  It is sensitive enough you could use it to get a sense of direction.
translations: 该设备检测并读出不同的电磁波长度。它目前正在工作，嗡嗡作响，足够灵敏，你可以用它来获得方向感。

messages.msgid: The noise of your EMF detector slows to a halt.
translations: 电磁场测试仪所发出噪音渐渐停了。

messages.msgid: A portable video game console, with a backlit screen allowing you to play in the dark.  You can use it to play a game, but this requires batteries.  Multiple game systems can be linked together for multiplayer games.
translations: 一个便携式游戏机，它有一个可以在黑暗中使用的背光屏幕，你需要电池才能玩游戏。多台游戏机可以连接在一起进行多人游戏。

messages.msgid: A popular, fancy smartphone.  Capable of taking photos with its integrated camera and illuminating an area with its flashlight app, assuming it has enough charge.  The smartphone also has a clock app that includes an alarm and an app for tracking consumed calories.  Runs on a small, rechargeable power cell compatible with a Unified Power Supply.
translations: 一款广受欢迎的时尚智能手机。当电量足够时，能够使用内置摄像头拍摄照片，或者打开闪光灯当作手电筒照明。手机里还安装了时钟程序，其中包括闹钟功能，以及能记录热量摄入的程序。它使用一个兼容UPS的小型可充电电池供电。

messages.msgid: The smartphone's charge is too low.
This phone is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.
translations: 这款手机正在播放音乐，稳步提升你的士气。你在听音乐的时候，听不到其他的声音。

messages.msgid: A popular, fancy smartphone.  Sadly for you, its previous user used its security features, rendering you unable to use most of its qualities.  You are still able to check the time and use a flashlight.  Runs on a small, rechargeable power cell compatible with a Unified Power Supply.
translations: 一部时髦的流行智能手机。可惜前任机主启用了安全锁，导致你无法使用大部分功能。现在你只能看看时间、当手电筒用。采用小型可充电电池，兼容统一供电系统。

messages.msgid: You can reset the smartphone to be able to use all its functions.
translations: 你可以通过刷机来解锁这部手机的全部功能。

messages.msgid: A unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a device developed jointly by military and scientific interests for use in combat and the field.  The UPS is designed to power tools, smartphones, armor, and some guns, but drains batteries quickly.
translations: 这是一个统一化电源，简称UPS。这种装置由军方和科学界共同研制，用于战斗和野外使用。UPS的设计目的是为工具、手机、装甲和枪械提供通用动力，但电池消耗得很快。

messages.msgid: A unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a device developed jointly by military and scientific interests for use in combat and the field.  The UPS is designed to power tools, smartphones, armor, and some guns, but drains batteries quickly.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 这是一个统一化电源，简称UPS。这种装置由军方和科学界共同研制，用于战斗和野外使用。UPS的设计目的是为工具、手机、装甲和枪械提供通用动力，但电池消耗得很快。使用以打开。

messages.msgid: A direct methanol fuel cell which can provide power to UPS-compatible electronic devices by oxidizing methanol supplied from a specialized fuel tank to produce electricity.
translations: 一种直接使用甲醇作为燃料的电池，通过氧化从特殊燃料罐中提供的甲醇产生电能，并提供给兼容 UPS 接口的电器。

messages.msgid: This battery-devouring device is just the thing to knead the tension out and help you relax.  Use it to take a break and unwind.
translations:
一个具有振动、加热等功能的用于保健按摩的按摩器械，激活它来使用。
"好舒服，要变得奇怪了。"

messages.msgid: A compact thermoelectric generator.  Burns propane gas to charge UPS devices.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 这是一台小型热电发电机。燃烧丙烷为UPS设备充电。使用它以开启。

messages.msgid: A compact thermoelectric generator.  When connected to a propane tank, it will slowly charge UPS-compatible devices.
translations: 一台小型热电发电机。当连接到油罐时，它会慢慢为UPS供电设备充电。

messages.msgid: This is a noisemaker that has been further enhanced with a series of amplifiers.  It's about as loud something can get without making you vomit from sound-induced nausea, and it's as sure to attract every zombie in town as it is to give you permanent hearing damage.
translations: 通过一系列放大器进一步增强的噪音发生器，音量大到几乎能引发因声音导致的晕眩呕吐，并且肯定引来镇上所有的丧尸，还会会对你的听力造成永久性损伤。

messages.msgid: You turn the super noise emitter on.
translations: 你打开了超级噪音发生器。

messages.msgid: This is a noisemaker that has been further enhanced with a series of amplifiers.  It's currently making an extraordinary amount of noise - hopefully you have hearing protection.
translations: 通过一系列放大器进一步增强的噪音发生器。它正在发出极其巨大的噪音——希望你已经戴好降噪用具了。

messages.msgid: The infernal racket dies as the super noise emitter turns off.
translations: 你关闭了超级噪音发生器，可怕的噪音随之消失了。

messages.msgid: Your super noise emitter produces an unholy blast of sonic chaos.
translations: 你的超级噪音发生器发出一阵毛骨悚然的、混沌的声波冲击。

messages.msgid: A hefty prying tool.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them, or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.
translations: 一件沉重的撬具。可用于在不破坏门的情况下撬开上锁的门，或撬起井盖。你也可以把它当作武器，用来砸碎敌人的脑袋。

messages.msgid: A pair of thin pieces of metal, one bent in an 'L' shape to push tumblers and the other acting as a torsion wrench.  These tools are almost totally inadequate for picking locks, but when you've got nothing else, it might work.
translations: 一对金属丝，一个弯曲成"L"形，用来撬动锁栓，另一个更加结实的则用来施加扭力。这对马马虎虎的工具几乎完全不适合撬锁，但当你没有其他工具时，凑合用吧。

messages.msgid: An improvised pick and torsion wrench made from scrap metal.  You'll need MacGyver-like skills to open locks with these as they are brittle, but they lower the chances of alarms being set off.
translations: 简易的撬锁工具，用一块金属碎片做成，用它来撬锁对一般人来说有些强人所难，不过，它确实能降低触发警报的几率。

messages.msgid: An ice axe with a hammer on the other end, a multi-purpose hiking and climbing tool used by mountaineers.  It is sturdy enough to lift manhole covers.
translations: 一把有锤头的冰斧，也称"冰镐"，是最重要、用途最广的登山装备之一。坚固耐用，鹤嘴形的镐尖可以将丧尸的躯体如冰面般凿穿，也可以撬开下水道井盖。

messages.msgid: A pipe with both ends bent and hammered flat to resemble a crowbar.  Use it to open locked crates without destroying them, or to lift manhole covers.  It's not strong enough to pry doors or windows, though.  You could also wield it to fight with, in a pinch.
translations: 一根两端被弯折并锤扁、形状类似撬棍的金属管。可用于在不破坏箱子的情况下撬开上锁的箱子，或撬起井盖。但它不够坚固，无法撬开门窗。在紧急情况下，你也可以把它当作武器来战斗。

messages.msgid: A locksmith's set of sturdy steel lockpicks and torsion wrenches.  It is essential for silently and quickly opening locks, provided you have some lockpicking and mechanical skills.
translations: 一套锁匠用的钢制开锁器和扭力扳手。想安静而迅速地开门就把它带上吧，前提是你的撬锁和机械技能已经点上了。

messages.msgid: A 60-inch-long construction prybar.  Essentially a long, solid steel rod with a hardened chisel tip.
translations: 一根60英寸长的建筑撬杆。基本上是一根长长的带着硬化凿头的实心钢棒。

messages.msgid: A block of military-grade RDX composition explosive.  A label reads: "Highly explosive, use with extreme caution!" It comes with a small timer.
translations: 一块军用级别的RDX复合炸药。标签上标着："严重警告，高爆炸性！"。它由一个小定时器来引爆。

messages.msgid: A block of military-grade RDX composition explosive.  A label reads: "Highly explosive, use with extreme caution!" It comes with a small timer, which is currently ticking down.
translations: 一块军用级别的RDX复合炸药。标签上标着："严重警告，高爆炸性！"。它由一个小定时器来引爆，现在定时器正在嘀嘀作响。

messages.msgid: You've already set the %s's timer, you might want to get away from it.
translations: 你已经设好了%s的定时器，你还打算拿着它多久？

messages.msgid: Several sticks of explosives, bundled together with a fuse attached.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!
translations: 几根炸药棒和一根引信绑在一起。使用物品来点燃引信。当然，你需要在你的库存中放一个打火机或火柴才可以。点燃引信后不久这个东西就会爆炸，所以赶紧离开！

messages.msgid: The fuse on this dynamite is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.
translations: 引信嘶嘶地燃烧着，炸药随时都会爆炸！

messages.msgid: You've already lit the %s, try throwing it instead.
translations: 你已经点着了%s，赶紧丢出去。

messages.msgid: Several sticks of explosives stuffed inside a metal container and surrounded with shrapnel.  The fuse is sticking out through a small hole.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!
translations: 几根炸药棒塞在一个金属容器里，周围是弹片。，引信从一个小孔伸出来。 使用物品来点燃引信。 当然，你需要在库存中放一个打火机或火柴才可以。 点燃引信后不久这件物品就会爆炸，所以赶紧离开！

messages.msgid: The fuse on this dynamite bomb is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.
translations: 引信嘶嘶地燃烧着，炸药炸弹随时都会爆炸！

messages.msgid: This substantial device is a bomb that generates an electromagnetic pulse.  When activated, the plutonium fuel cell is drained into a flux compression generator, the detonation of which creates a strong magnetic field.  When this magnetic field is fed into the antenna, it creates a strong electro-magnetic pulse.
translations: 这个体型巨大的爆炸装置是一个能产生电磁脉冲的炸弹。当激活时，内部钚燃料电池将磁通压缩发生器充能，之后爆炸将产生强磁场。当磁场被导入发射天线之中后，会产生一个很强的电磁脉冲。

messages.msgid: This EMP bomb is active and will shortly detonate, creating a large EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy, as well as a sizeable explosion.  You may not want to be holding it much longer.
translations: 这个EMP炸弹已经被激活了，很快就会引爆并产生电磁脉冲和巨大爆炸，这会破坏附近的机器人并损耗生化能量。你需要做的就是把它用力丢出去，然后就等着瞧吧。

messages.msgid: You've already activated the %s, try throwing it instead.
translations: 你已经激活了%s，赶紧丢出去。

messages.msgid: A solitary firecracker with a short fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse it will explode, so throw it quickly!
translations: 一个鞭炮，引信短而且可以被点燃，当然，你还是要用到打火机。引信燃烧时间很短，点燃后赶紧丢出去！

messages.msgid: A firecracker that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw it quickly before it explodes.
translations: 一个鞭炮，引信已经被点燃，燃烧的同时还在嘶嘶作响。赶紧丢出去，不然就等着被炸伤吧！

messages.msgid: A pack of 25 firecrackers with a starter fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse they will begin to explode, so throw them quickly!
translations: 一包带有引信的鞭炮（共 25 个）。使用此物品可以点燃引信。当然，你需要打火机或火柴来点燃。点燃后不久，鞭炮就会开始爆炸，所以要尽快把它们扔出去！

messages.msgid: A pack of 25 firecrackers that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw them quickly before they start to explode.
translations: 一包已经被点燃的鞭炮（共 25 个）；引信正发出嘶嘶声。在它们开始爆炸之前，赶快将其扔出去。

messages.msgid: A military police-style flashbang.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse.  You will then have five seconds before it detonates with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening, and disorienting anyone nearby.
translations: 一颗军警使用的震撼弹，使用此物品以拔掉插销，之后你有五秒的时间去扔掉它。它会以强光和声波眩晕范围内的所有目标，让他们暂时失明和失聪。

messages.msgid: You pull the pin on the flashbang.
translations: 你拉开了闪光弹的保险插销。

messages.msgid: This flashbang is active, and will soon detonate with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening, and disorienting anyone nearby.  It may be a good idea to throw it!
translations: 这枚闪光弹已被启动，很快就会以强烈的光与巨大的声响爆炸，使附近的任何人失明、失聪并陷入迷惑。最好把它扔出去！

messages.msgid: You've already pulled the %s's pin, try throwing it instead.
translations: 你拉下了%s的拉环，赶紧丢出去。

messages.msgid: A canister grenade filled with fungicidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active fungicidal grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a volatile gas that is highly toxic to fungal life forms.
translations: 一个装满抗真菌溶液的筒状手雷。使用该物品将会拔下插销并点燃引信。五秒后它会开始释放对真菌生物具有高度毒性的挥发性喷雾。

messages.msgid: This fungicidal bomb has had its pin removed and is (or will shortly be) expelling highly toxic gas.
translations: 这个抗真菌手雷的插销已被拔出，并且正在释放有毒气体。

messages.msgid: A makeshift canister grenade filled with fungicidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active fungicidal grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a volatile gas that is highly toxic to fungal life forms.
translations: 一个装满抗真菌溶液的自制筒状手雷。使用该物品将会拔下插销并点燃引信。五秒后它会开始释放对真菌生物具有高度毒性的挥发性喷雾。

messages.msgid: This makeshift fungicidal bomb has had its pin removed and is (or will shortly be) expelling highly toxic gas.
translations: 这个自制抗真菌手雷的插销已被拔出，并且正在释放有毒气体。

messages.msgid: A crude gas bomb made using household chemicals.  Use this item to arm it.  In three seconds it will begin to expel a highly toxic gas for a short time.  This gas poisons those exposed to it, in addition to obscuring vision and scent.
translations: 一个由家用化学药品制成的自制催泪手雷。使用以激活它。在三秒后，它会开始释放有毒气体。这种气体会使吸入的生物中毒，也能遮蔽视野和掩盖气味。

messages.msgid: You arm the makeshift gas canister.
translations: 你激活了自制催泪手雷。

messages.msgid: This homemade canister of poison gas has been unsealed, and is (or will shortly be) expelling highly toxic gas.  You should consider getting rid of it soon.
translations: 这种自制催泪手雷的封口被去掉了，这说明它正在（或将要）释放剧毒气体。你应该赶紧丢掉它。

messages.msgid: You've already armed the %s, try throwing it instead.
translations: 你已经激活了%s，赶紧丢出去。

messages.msgid: A military-grade fragmentation hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.
translations: 一个军用破片手雷，使用此物品以拔掉插销，之后你有五秒的时间去扔掉它。

messages.msgid: You pull the pin on the grenade.
translations: 你拉开了手雷的保险销。

messages.msgid: This fragmentation grenade is active, and will explode any second now.  Better throw it!
translations: 一个拔了插销的手雷，活脱脱的烫手山芋，赶紧扔敌人脸上！

messages.msgid: A grenade that generates an electromagnetic pulse with a low-inductance capacitor bank discharged into a single-loop antenna.  It also produces a mild electric shock cloud.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active EMP grenade.  You will then have three seconds before it detonates, creating an EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.
translations: 一个使用低电感电容连接单环天线放电来产生电磁脉冲的EMP手雷。放电会产生一团会轻微电击敌人的电云。拔下插销来使用EMP手雷，你有三秒时间去扔掉它，它会产生一个EMP电场来破坏机器人和消耗生化能量，以使其周围的电子设备瘫痪。

messages.msgid: You pull the pin on the %s.
translations: 你拉开了 %s 的保险插销。

messages.msgid: This EMP grenade is active and will shortly detonate, creating a large EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy, as well as a mild electric shock cloud.  You may not want to be holding it much longer.
translations: 很好，这个EMP手雷已经被激活了，很快就会引爆并产生电磁脉冲以及一团电云，这会破坏附近的机器人并损耗生化能量。你需要做的就是把它用力丢出去，然后就等着瞧吧。

messages.msgid: A military-grade incendiary hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes into a raging inferno; throwing it would be a good idea.
translations: 一个军用燃烧手雷，使用此物品以拔掉插销。之后五秒它就会把周围烧成火焰地狱，记得扔远点。

messages.msgid: An active incendiary grenade, likely to burst into an inferno any second now.  Better throw it!
translations: 一个拔了插销的燃烧手雷，随时都会变成火焰地狱，赶紧扔敌人脸上！

messages.msgid: A canister grenade filled with noxious irritant.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active tear gas grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a highly toxic gas for some time.  This gas damages and slows those who enter it, as well as obscuring vision and scent.
translations: 一个装满强烈刺激性气体的筒状手雷。使用该物品将会拔下保险销并点燃引信。五秒后它会开始释放具有高度毒性的气体，让所有进入毒气的倒霉蛋受到毒害，速度下降，同时阻碍视线和掩盖气味。

messages.msgid: This tear gas grenade has had its pin removed and is (or will shortly be) expelling highly noxious gas.
translations: 这个催泪手雷的插销已被拔出，并且正在释放有毒气体。

messages.msgid: A canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a volatile gas that is highly toxic to insect life forms.
translations: 一个装满杀虫溶剂的筒状手雷。使用该物品将会拔下插销并点燃引信。五秒后它会开始释放对昆虫具有高度毒性的挥发性喷雾。

messages.msgid: This insecticidal grenade has had its pin removed and is (or will shortly be) expelling highly toxic gas.
translations: 这个杀虫剂手雷的插销已被拔出，并且正在释放有毒气体。

messages.msgid: A makeshift canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a volatile gas that is highly toxic to insect life forms.
translations: 一个装满杀虫溶剂的自制筒状手雷。使用该物品将会拔下插销并点燃引信。五秒后它会开始释放对昆虫具有高度毒性的挥发性喷雾。

messages.msgid: This makeshift insecticidal grenade has had its pin removed and is (or will shortly be) expelling highly toxic gas.
translations: 这个自制杀虫剂手雷的插销已被拔出，并且正在释放有毒气体。
封装好的一次性火箭发射器

messages.msgid: A packed, disposable light anti-tank rocket launcher.  Once fired, it cannot be reloaded and must be disposed of.  Activate it to pop it out and make it ready to fire.
translations: 一种封装成型的一次性轻型反坦克火箭发射器。一旦开火，就不能复装，必须处理。激活它，使其弹出并准备开火。

messages.msgid: You pull the activating lever, readying the LAW to fire.
translations: 你拉开了启动开关，准备好随时发射火箭。

messages.msgid: The M72 LAW (Light Anti-armor Weapon) is a one-time use lightweight rocket launcher, meant to take out tanks and other armored vehicles.  Designed to replace the earlier Bazookas, it features a shaped-charge warhead to pierce armor.  Though weaker than the more modern and heavier AT4, it's still in service to this day.  Due to its design, you must unpack it to use it, and it cannot be reloaded.  Activate to unpack.
translations: M72 LAW是一种一次性轻型火箭筒，用于打击坦克与其它装甲载具。它被设计来取代巴祖卡火箭筒，具有一个锥形装药弹头用来穿透装甲。尽管其威力比更为现代的AT4火箭筒要弱，但它重量更轻，至今仍在服役。由于其设计，你在使用前必须将其展开，并且无法装填。激活以展开。

messages.msgid: The B54 Special Atomic Demolition Munition is an extremely powerful weapon, a portable nuclear bomb, using the smallest nuclear warhead in US inventory.  It is housed inside a extremely sturdy transit container.  Use it to activate the timer.  You guess that the explosion would be large enough to take out a small house.
translations: B54特种原子爆破弹药是一种威力极大的武器，这是一种便携式核弹，使用的是美国存有的最小的核弹头。它装在一个极其坚固的运输容器内。使用它来启动计时器。你觉得其爆炸的威力足以摧毁一座小房子。

messages.msgid: The nuclear bomb looks no different from the outside, yet you know that the device is armed and counting down.  You should probably get far, far away from it.
translations: 这枚核弹的外观看起来并无变化，但你知道这个装置已经激活，正在倒计时。你或许应该离它远远的。

messages.msgid: A bottle of flammable liquid with a rag inserted.  Use this item to light the rag.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  After lighting it, throw it to cause fires.
translations: 一瓶塞着一块破布的易燃液体。使用该物品将点燃它，当然你需要口袋里有打火机或火柴来点燃它。如果渴了也可以喝掉它，难道我骗过你吗？

messages.msgid: A bottle of flammable liquid with a flaming rag stoppered in its neck.  Throwing it will shatter the bottle on impact and ignite a fireball.  Dropping it will set you on fire, so don't do that unless you want to burn to death.
translations: 一瓶塞着一块点燃的破布的易燃液体。投出去就能令火焰漫出，当然不扔可是会火烧眉毛的，随手扔地上不小心乱丢的话就会让你尝到随手扔垃圾的教训。

messages.msgid: A specialized grenade designed to scramble robots' IFF control chips.  This converts the robot to your side for a short time, before the backup systems kick in.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active scrambler grenade.
translations: 这是一个特制的EMP手雷，用来获取机器人芯片的控制权，从而让它们站在你这边。可惜，效果只能维持一会，然后就会被机器人的备用系统取代。使用它来拔出插销。

messages.msgid: This scrambler grenade is active and will soon detonate, releasing a control wave that temporarily converts robots to your side.
translations: 一个拔了插销的扰频手雷，马上就会爆炸并发出一道控制波束，使机器人暂时与你为伍。

messages.msgid: A canister grenade filled with a variety of pyrotechnic chemicals.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active smoke bomb.  Five seconds after you do that, it will begin to expel a thick black smoke.  This smoke will slow those who enter it, as well as obscuring vision and scent.
translations: 一个装满各种发烟物质的筒状手雷。使用该物品将会拔下插销并点燃引信。五秒后它会开始释放浓厚的黑烟，让所有进入其中的倒霉蛋速度下降，同时阻碍视线和掩盖气味。

messages.msgid: This smoke bomb has had its pin removed and is (or will shortly be) expelling thick smoke.
translations: 这个烟雾弹的插销已被拔出，并且正在释放浓烟。

messages.msgid: A pear-shaped chunk of rocket candy obtained by heating saltpeter with sugar and casting the obtained liquid.  Can serve as a rocket fuel, but also as a smokescreen - if you light the narrow end, you should be able to throw it before the flame reaches the broad end.
translations: 梨形的火箭糖。加热硝石与糖的混合物熔融后凝固而成，可以作为火箭燃料，也可以用于制造烟幕——点燃较窄的一端，在烧尽之前把它丢出去。

messages.msgid: You light the rocket candy on fire.  Throw it!
translations: 你点燃了火箭软糖。快扔掉它！

messages.msgid: A chunk of rocket candy that has been lit on fire and burns with a loud hiss, spewing forth large amounts of smoke.
translations: 这是块已经点着了的火箭软糖，在响亮的嘶嘶燃烧声中喷涌出大量的浓烟。

messages.msgid: You've already lit the fuse - get rid of it immediately!
translations: 你已经点燃了引信，赶紧丢掉它！
军用炸药小型自制手雷

messages.msgid: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from parts.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.
translations: 用各种零件拼凑成的自制手雷。使用此物品来点燃导火索，之后你有差不多有5秒钟时间去扔掉它。

messages.msgid: You light the fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows up in your face!
translations: 你点燃了自制手雷的引信。赶紧在你的脸被炸掉之前扔出去！

messages.msgid: active military explosive small homemade grenade
translations: 军用炸药小型自制手雷（激活）
messages.plural: active military explosive small homemade grenades

messages.msgid: The fuse on this improvised grenade is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Better throw it!
translations: 一个已经点燃了的自制手雷，活脱脱的烫手山芋，赶紧扔敌人脸上！

messages.msgid: You've already lit the %s's fuse, try throwing it instead.
translations: 你已经点着了%s的引信……赶紧丢出去。
军用炸药自制手雷（激活）

messages.msgid: A section of steel pipe filled with military explosives.  Use this item to pull the pin, giving you six seconds to get away from it before it detonates.
translations: 一根塞满了军用级炸药的钢管。使用此物品来拔掉插销，之后你差不多有6秒钟逃出它的爆炸范围。

messages.msgid: You pull the pin on the pipebomb.
translations: 你拔掉了自制雷管的插梢。
军用炸药自制雷管（激活）

messages.msgid: This pipebomb's pin is pulled, and it will explode any second now.  Throw it immediately!
translations: 你拔掉了自制雷管的插销，它随时都会爆炸。快点扔掉吧！

messages.msgid: A homemade explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with military explosives and scrap metal, equipped with a delayed fuse.  Use this item to pull the pin.  Once you do, it should explode after about 20 seconds.
translations: 一个自制的爆炸装置，由一个装满了军用级炸药和废金属的大塑料罐制成，有个延时引信。使用此物品来拔出插销，20秒后就炸了。

messages.msgid: You pull the pin on the small bootleg fragmentation device.  Get rid of it quickly!
translations: 你拔出了自制炸弹的保险插销。赶紧扔出去！
军用炸药自制炸弹（激活）

messages.msgid: A homemade explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with military explosives and scrap metal.  Its fuse has been lit, its final countdown starting.
translations: 一个自制炸弹，由一个装满了军用级炸药和废金属的大塑料罐制成，有个延时引信。引信已经被触发，它即将迎来终结。

messages.msgid: You've already pulled the pin - run!
translations: 你已经拔出了保险插销，快跑！
军用炸药自制 50 升油罐炸弹

messages.msgid: A metal keg filled with military explosives.  Once it has been activated, it will explode after 100 seconds, raining fire and steel on everything in sight.
translations: 一个装满了军用级炸药的金属罐。起爆药放置在核心以确保点燃后 100 秒能完全引爆，向视野中的一切泼洒钢铁与烈焰之雨。

messages.msgid: You activate the fuze on the barrel bomb.  Clear the area!
translations: 你激活了自制油罐炸弹的引信。马上离开！

messages.msgid: active military explosive 50 L barrel bomb
translations: 军用炸药自制 50 升油罐炸弹（点燃）
messages.plural: active military explosive 50 L barrel bombs

messages.msgid: A metal keg filled with military explosives.  It has been activated and will soon explode, delivering its entire destructive power to everything in sight.
translations: 一个装满了军用级炸药的金属罐。引信已经激活了，一旦它引燃了中间的起爆药，金属罐就会爆炸，具有毁灭视野内的一切物品的破坏力。

messages.msgid: You've already activated the bomb - clear the area immediately!
translations: 你已经激活了引信，赶紧离开这里！
军用炸药自制 100 升油罐炸弹

messages.msgid: A 100 L metal barrel filled with military explosives.  Once it has been activated it will explode after 100 seconds, raining fire and steel on everything in sight.
translations: 一个装满了军用级炸药的 100 升金属罐。起爆药放置在核心以确保点燃后 100 秒能完全引爆，向视野中的一切泼洒钢铁与烈焰之雨。

messages.msgid: active military explosive 100 L barrel bomb
translations: 军用炸药自制 100 升油罐炸弹（点燃）
messages.plural: active military explosive 100 L barrel bombs

messages.msgid: A 100 L metal barrel filled with military explosives.  It has been activated and will soon explode, delivering its entire destructive power to everything in sight.
translations: 一个装满了军用级炸药的 100 升金属罐。引信已经激活了，一旦它引燃了中间的起爆药，金属罐就会爆炸，具有毁灭视野内的一切物品的破坏力。

messages.msgid: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from spare parts.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have 5 seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.
translations: 用各种零件拼凑成的自制手雷。使用此物品来点燃导火索，之后你有差不多有5秒钟时间去扔掉它。

messages.msgid: A section of steel pipe filled with explosives.  Use this item to light the fuse, giving you six seconds to get away from it before it detonates.  You'll need a lighter or some matches to use it.
translations: 一根塞满了炸药的钢管，带有引信。使用此物品来点燃引信，之后你差不多有6秒钟逃出它的爆炸范围。你需要一个打火机或者火柴来点燃引信。

messages.msgid: You light the fuse on the pipe bomb.
translations: 你点燃自制雷管的引信。

messages.msgid: This pipebomb's fuse is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Throw it immediately!
translations: 引信被点燃的自制雷管，随时都会爆炸。快点扔掉吧！

messages.msgid: A homemade explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with stable explosives and scrap metal, equipped with a long fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Once you do, it should explode after about 20 seconds.
translations: 这是一个自制炸弹，由一个装满了稳定炸药和废金属的大塑料罐制成，有根长长的导火索。使用此物品来点燃引信，20秒后就炸了。

messages.msgid: You light the fuse on the small improvised fragmentation device.  Get rid of it quickly!
translations: 你点燃了自制炸弹的引信。赶紧扔出去！

messages.msgid: A homemade explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with stable explosives and scrap metal.  Its fuse has been lit, its final countdown starting.
translations: 一个自制炸弹，由一个装满了军用级炸药和废金属的大塑料罐制成，有个延时引信。引信已经被触发，它即将迎来终结。

messages.msgid: You've already lit the fuse - run!
translations: 你已经点燃了引信，快跑！

messages.msgid: An improvised demolition charge.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  20 seconds after lighting the fuse, it will explode, so get away!
translations: 一个自制的炸药包。激活此物品可以点燃它，当然，你得有个打火机或火柴。引信燃烧时间有20秒，在爆炸前，快点跑吧！

messages.msgid: The fuse on this primitive demolition charge is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.
translations: 引信嘶嘶地燃烧着，炸药包随时都会爆炸！

messages.msgid: A metal keg filled with stable explosives.  Contains a volatile explosive core, so 100 seconds after the fuse has been lit the charge will detonate completely, delivering its entire destructive power to everything in sight.
translations: 一个装满了许多稳定炸药的金属罐。起爆药放置在核心以确保点燃后 100 秒能完全引爆，并具有毁灭视野内的一切物品的破坏力。

messages.msgid: You activate the fuse on the barrel bomb.  Clear the area!
translations: 你激活了自制油罐炸弹的引信。马上离开！

messages.msgid: A metal keg filled with stable explosives.  The fuse has been lit and once it ignites the primary explosive, the bomb will detonate and rain fire and steel on everything in sight.
translations: 一个装满了许多稳定炸药的金属罐。导火索已经点燃了，一旦它引燃了中间的起爆药，金属罐就会爆炸并向视野中的一切泼洒钢铁与烈焰之雨。

messages.msgid: Small explosive in a form of donut without a piece, this thing is designed to be attached on the mortar shell tail, to increase the projectile velocity and, therefore, its range.  Since the projectile it was connected to was already shot, you can only cut it for its content.
translations: 这种呈无缺口甜甜圈状的小型爆炸物，设计用于安装在迫击炮弹尾部，以提高炮弹速度，从而增加其射程。由于它所连接的炮弹已经发射，所以只能切开它以获取内部物品。

messages.msgid: A crudely-made electric firestarter, which can function as an inefficient lighter.
translations: 一个做工简陋的电子生火工具，也可以当作一只效率不高的打火机。

messages.msgid: A simple item for starting fires with friction between a notched plank and wooden shaft.  The shaft is spun rapidly with a sawing motion by a bowstring wrapped around it.  Very slow to acquire a usable ember.
translations: 简单的生火装置，用木轴在凹槽木板上摩擦以取得火种。将木轴缠绕在弓弦上，像拉锯一样使它快速旋转。以这种方式生火速度非常慢。

messages.msgid: A simple item for starting fires by friction between a notched plank and wooden shaft, with a flywheel attached.  The shaft is spun rapidly with a pumping motion by a cord wrapped around it.  Slow to acquire a usable ember.
translations: 易洛魁族人发明的简单生火装置，用带飞轮的木轴在凹槽木板上摩擦以取得火种。轴上缠有回绕的绳索，泵动此装置即可带动木轴高速旋转。以这种方式生火速度比较慢。

messages.msgid: A piece of flint paired with a hardened high carbon steel striker.  Use it to spark a flame.
translations: 这是一片燧石和一根高碳钢撞针。用它来点燃火焰。

messages.msgid: A disposable plastic lighter, capable of creating a small flame with the flick of a finger.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.
translations: 一个一次性的塑料打火机。打火机可以用来点燃香烟、燃烧瓶之类的东西。还可以用它来生火，从而点燃附近的可燃物。

messages.msgid: A magnifying glass, for closely examining fine details.  It can also be used for starting fires if direct sunlight is available.
translations: 放大镜，用于观察事物的细节。如果有直射的阳光，也可以用来生火。

messages.msgid: A very low-quality focusing lens, made from non-optical-grade glass.  Useless for building most optical devices, but you can start a fire with it if sunlight is available.
translations: 一个质量非常低的聚焦透镜，用非光学玻璃制成。对于制造大多数光学设备来说都是没用的，但如果阳光充足，你可以用它生火。

messages.msgid: A firestarting tool of Southeast Asian origin, consisting of a thin, hollow wooden cylinder sealed at one end and open at the other, and a wooden piston forming an airtight circular seal with it, making use of rapid and adiabatic air compression to ignite a piece of tinder.  It also comes with a tinder container to keep tinder dry.  Use it to start a fire.
translations: 起源于东南亚的生火装置，由一个一端密封另一端敞开的薄壁空心木圆筒、一个与之形成气密的圆形木质活塞组成，利用快速压缩绝热空气来点燃火绒。此外，它还配有一个火绒罐，用来保持火绒干燥。激活它以生火。

messages.msgid: A small book of matches with a coarse strike surface on the outside flap for lighting them.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.  Due to the matches being lightly glued to the matchbook, they can be removed, but not replaced on the book.
translations: 一板火柴，纸板外侧有个能摩擦点燃火柴的粗糙表面。可用来点燃香烟和各类吸食毒品，或是点燃燃烧瓶等简易爆炸物，也可以引燃附近物品。由于火柴只是轻微粘在火柴板上，虽然可以取下使用，但无法再重新将火柴粘回火柴板。

messages.msgid: A solid strike anywhere match.  One and done.
translations: 一根随处可以擦燃的火柴，只要这一个就能生火。

messages.msgid: A small box of matches with a coarse strike surface on the side for lighting them.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.
translations: 一盒火柴，侧面有个能摩擦点燃火柴的粗糙表面。使用许多物品都需要火柴，例如香烟及某些等各种药物，或是点燃燃烧瓶等。你也可以使用火柴来点燃附近的物品。

messages.msgid: A stylish lighter featuring a flip-top cover and a refuelable tank, capable of creating a small flame with the flick of a finger.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.
translations: 一个时髦的可补充燃料的翻盖打火机。可以用来点燃香烟、燃烧瓶之类的东西，或点燃附近的可燃物。

messages.msgid: A stylish lighter featuring a flip-top cover and a refuelable tank.  It is lit.
translations: 一个可补充燃料的翻盖打火机。已经点燃了。

messages.msgid: A large lighter with a trigger and a safety, reloaded by fitting a can of butane inside the base.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.
translations: 一个带有扳机和保险装置的大型打火机，通过在底座内安装一罐丁烷来重新填充。可以点燃香烟、燃烧瓶之类的东西。还可以用它来生火，从而点燃附近的可燃物。

messages.msgid: A small container for holding tinder, with holes punched in it to provide a controlled airflow.  It can nurture a smoldering ember for a long time, to start fires without modern tools.
translations: 带有通气孔，用于保存火种的小型容器。可以让余火保持很长一段时间，缺乏现代工具时可用于生火。

messages.msgid: The ember carrier is out of tinder.
translations: 火种罐中已经没有火绒了。

messages.msgid: You need a lighter or fire to light this.
translations: 你需要一个打火机或火点燃这。

messages.msgid: A small container for holding tinder, with holes punched in it to provide a controlled airflow.  An ember is smoldering inside it, and can be used to start a campfire.
translations: 一个用来装引火物的小盒子，盒子上有个小洞以保持空气流通，里面的引火物里还有些火星在缓缓燃烧。它可以用来点燃篝火。

messages.msgid: A miniature disposable plastic lighter, capable of creating a small flame with the flick of a finger.  Allows you to use various drugs, like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.
translations: 一个一次性的小型塑料打火机。打火机可以用来点燃香烟、燃烧瓶之类的东西。还可以用它来生火，从而点燃附近的可燃物。

messages.msgid: A short, lightweight emergency tool with a quarter-circular blade, a short pick opposite the blade, and an insulated handle.  Used on airplanes to chop down or pry walls or cabinets to gain access in case of a fire.
translations: 一个轻便应急用短斧，由一个扇形的斧刃、与斧刃相对的锄尖和一根绝缘手柄组成。用于在飞机火灾时砍开或撬开墙壁或机舱。

messages.msgid: An emergency fire extinguisher containing five gallons of fire-retardant foam.  Useful for putting out adjacent fires.
translations: 一种大型的灭火器，包含5加仑的灭火剂。用来扑灭附近的火焰。

messages.msgid: A large, two-handed pickhead axe normally used by firefighters.  It makes a powerful melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.  The pickhead is for spiking into doors and glass and is not effective at hooking limbs of opponents.
translations: 一把用于清理着火或易燃材料，切断火势蔓延的大斧，还可以劈开被烧变形的门窗，解救被困的人，如今可以用来解救受困于腐烂身体中的痛苦灵魂。一种强大的近战武器，但在摆动之间恢复有点慢。镐头用于刺入门和玻璃，对钩住对手的四肢无效。

messages.msgid: Marrying strap for a Halligan bar.

A heavy, multiple-use tool commonly carried by firefighters, law enforcement, and military rescue units.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.
translations: 重型多用工具，通常被消防员、执法部门和救灾部队使用。用它来撬开房门和井盖吧！当然，砸丧尸也行。

messages.msgid: A handheld fire extinguisher containing a liter of highly compressed CO2 gas.  Useful for putting out adjacent fires.
translations: 这是一个手提灭火器，内含高压的二氧化碳气体。能够有效的扑灭附近的火势。

messages.msgid: A fire extinguisher in grenade form.  While not as effective as a regular fire extinguisher, you can use it from a farther distance.  It has a plastic plug that can be pulled, but is primarily activated by heat, so just throw it into the flames.
translations: 一个手榴弹式的灭火器。虽然效果不如常规灭火器，但可以从远处使用它。它有个可以拉开的塑料保险销，但主要依靠受热后自动引爆，所以只要把它扔进火中即可。

messages.msgid: You pull the plug on the extinguisher grenade.
translations: 你拉开了投掷型灭火器的保险销。

messages.msgid: An active extinguisher grenade, likely to burst any second now.  Better throw it!
translations: 一个拔了插销的投掷型灭火手雷，随时都会引爆，快点扔掉吧！

messages.msgid: A durable tool consisting of a sturdy fiberglass shaft tipped with a small steel hook.
translations: 一把由坚固牢靠的玻璃纤维手柄和手柄顶端的小号钢制弯钩制成的耐用工具，通常用于救援火灾现场时的破拆吊顶、拉钩电线及清理阻碍工作，也可以用来掀起丧尸的头盖骨。使用时请小心不要把自己的皮磕破了。（注：消防火钩英文名为pike pole）

messages.msgid: A durable tool consisting of a sturdy fiberglass shaft tipped with a set of 3 hooks, one large opposed by two small.  Hot sticks are used to maintain some standoff distance when manual manipulation of explosives is necessary, and robot assistance is unavailable.
translations: 一把结实耐用的工具，由坚固的玻璃纤维主体杆和其顶部三个钩子组成，其中一个大钩子正对着两个小钩子。当需要手动操纵爆炸装置而排爆机器人又无法协助时，操作杆可以用于保持一定的距离。

messages.msgid: A shaft with a pair of hooks on one end and a pry bar on the other, forged from a single piece of steel.
translations: 一根金属杆，一端有个双钩，另一端是一个撬棍，用一整块钢锭锻造而成。

messages.msgid: A makeshift fish trap made from plastic bottles.  It's simple, even primitive, but easy to use.  The principle of action: the fish swims inside to eat the bait, but can't get out.  Not humane and prohibited by law, but there are no cops left to care.
translations: 用塑料瓶做成的简易鱼笼。结构简单，甚至有些原始，但非常容易使用。其工作原理是：鱼游进去吃诱饵，却无法再游出来。并不人道，也违法，不过现在已经没有警察会在意了。

messages.msgid: A long wicker fish trap made from bark, reeds, cordage, or other natural materials.  It's a staple fishing tool in many pre-industrial societies.  The principle of action: the fish swims inside to eat the bait, but can't get out.
translations: 用树皮、芦苇、绳索等天然材料编成的细长柳条鱼笼。是在许多前工业社会中常见的基本捕鱼工具。其工作原理是：鱼游进去吃诱饵，却无法再游出来。

messages.msgid: An improvised fishing hook carved from wood or bone.
translations: 一个由木头或骨头制成的简易鱼钩。

messages.msgid: 'Fishing rod' might be a bit too charitable of a description.  In truth, this is a stick with a piece of string and a hook.
translations: 这货也能叫做"钓鱼竿"？这分明就是一条绳子加一个钩子！

messages.msgid: A professional fishing rod with a matching set of weights.  With this, you should be able to catch 'em all.
translations: 一根配有一整套配重的专业鱼竿。有了它，你应该能把所有猎物都钓上来。

messages.msgid: A commercial two-piece fishing rod that has been disassembled for ease of transport and storage.
translations: 一种商用两节式钓鱼竿，已拆卸，便于运输和储存。

messages.msgid: You put together your two-piece fishing rod.
translations: 你把两节式鱼竿组装在一起。

messages.msgid: A commercial two-piece fishing rod, assembled and ready for use.
