translations: 商业两节式钓鱼竿，已组装好并准备使用。

messages.msgid: You take apart your two-piece fishing rod.
translations: 你把两件式钓鱼竿拆开。

messages.msgid: A commercial telescoping fishing rod that has been retracted for ease of transport and storage.
translations: 一种商用伸缩式钓鱼竿，已缩回，便于运输和储存。

messages.msgid: You extend your telescoping fishing rod.
A commercial telescoping fishing rod, extended and ready for use.
translations: 商用伸缩式钓鱼竿，已展开并随时可用。

messages.msgid: You retract your telescoping fishing rod.
translations: 你收回你的伸缩钓鱼竿。

messages.msgid: A commercial hand fishing reel.  It is a short rod with a section on one end with fishing line wrapped around it, with a rotating guard around that.  It is not as effective as a normal fishing pole, but is much more compact.
translations: 一种商用钓鱼轮。它是一根短杆，一头有个能够缠绕钓鱼线的滑轮，外面有一个能够旋转的护罩。它不像普通的钓竿那么有效，但比它们要紧凑得多。

messages.msgid: A short wooden rod with a section on one end with fishing line wrapped around it, with a notch to put the string though to help pull in fish.  It is not as effective as a normal fishing pole, but is much more compact than them.
translations: 一根短木杆，末端有个用来绕鱼线的凹槽。这玩意没有常规钓竿好用，但比它们要紧凑得多。

messages.msgid: A small hand press for hand loading firearm ammunition.  It comes with everything you need to start hand loading your own munitions.
translations: 小型的手工压弹机，足够你进行各种复装弹药制备。

messages.msgid: A collection of items improvised for field reloading of shotshells.  A plank with a hole cut in the center, a medium-sized nail, and a whittled dowel are used to seat wads, decap primers, and (carefully!) reprime hulls.  Powder and shot are measured with a cut-down shotshell hull.  The opposite side of the plank has been shaped to allow for roll-crimping of the plastic hulls.  There's no provision for resizing, so reloaded hulls will fire best in the firearm they were fired from.
translations: 一套可以用来随时重新装填霰弹的简易装置。它由一根中间开孔的木板、一根中号钉子和一根木销组成，分别用于放置填料、打开并（小心地）装上底火。火药和弹丸通过一颗切短的霰弹壳来称量。木板的另一侧被制成能够碾压卷曲塑料弹壳的形状。这套装置不能改弹药口径，因此复装的霰弹在之前发射的枪里发射效果最好。

messages.msgid: A tool used for properly disassembling firearm ammunition.
translations: 一个用来拆解子弹的装置。

messages.msgid: The internal tank for a gasoline fuel cell bionic.
translations: 用于汽油燃料电池CBM的内置燃料罐。

messages.msgid: The internal ethanol tank for an ethanol burner bionic.
translations: 用于酒精锅炉CBM的内置燃料罐。

messages.msgid: The internal oil tank for an oil generator bionic.
translations: 用于燃油发电机CBM的内置油罐。

messages.msgid: The internal compartment for holding medium sized batteries, for a battery system bionic.
translations: 电池供能CBM的一部分，用于容纳中型电池的内置电池仓。

messages.msgid: Integrated bionic tools implanted in your fingers.
translations: 植入手指的集成仿生工具。

messages.msgid: Integrated bionic miniature welding tool implanted in your fingers.
translations: 内置小型生化焊接工具被植入到了你的手指中。

messages.msgid: Integrated bionic multimeter implanted in your fingers.
translations: 内置小型生化万用表被植入到了你的手指中。

messages.msgid: Integrated soldering iron and screwdriver set.
translations: 内置电烙铁和螺丝刀工具。

messages.msgid: A sharp knife designed for cutting meat.  It makes a poor melee weapon, but is decent at butchering corpses.
translations: 一把较为尖锐、带有小锯齿的西餐餐具，设计用来在餐桌上切牛排。虽然是把很差劲的近战武器，但用来屠宰尸体还行。

messages.msgid: A short-bladed knife with a sharp blade, made for fine controlled cuts to vegetables without using a cutting board.
translations: 一把刀口锋利的短刃刀，可以在不使用砧板的情况下对蔬菜进行精细切割。

messages.msgid: A long-bladed kitchen knife.  The blade is wider than the handle, giving room for the wielder's knuckles, and it has a characteristic curve for a fast rocking action for chopping vegetables.  It makes an acceptable melee weapon, but the wide blade is unwieldy for butchering.
translations: 一把长刃菜刀。刀刃比把手宽，为持刀者的指关节提供了空间，刀刃的特殊曲线使它在切菜时可以快速来回摇动。作为近战武器还行，但宽大的刀身在屠宰时不太方便。

messages.msgid: A long-bladed kitchen knife with a thin, slightly curved blade for deftly slicing meat either in flat sheets or around the bone.  It makes a decent melee weapon, and is excellent for butchery.
translations: 一把长刃菜刀，有一个轻薄、稍微弯曲的刀刃，能够灵巧地将肉切成薄片或剔除骨头。一把不错的近战武器，屠宰时也十分好用。

messages.msgid: This knife has quite a long blade with a scalloped edge for cutting bread.  It's not that sharp, but its length and heft mean it could do a bit of damage and cause some nasty tearing.
translations: 这把刀有着很长的刀刃，刀刃呈扇形，用来切面包。它并不锋利，但它的长度和重量意味着它能够给敌人造成少许伤害，并导致撕裂伤。

messages.msgid: A sharp, heavy knife.  It makes a good melee weapon, and is an ideal item for butchering corpses.
translations: 一把锋利而厚重的刀子。是把不错的近战武器，也是用于屠宰尸体的理想工具。

messages.msgid: A menacing-looking knife with a broad, square-shaped blade.  Its heft and sharpness would make it a very effective melee weapon and an excellent butchering tool.
translations: 一把看起来很凶险的刀，刀身宽大，呈方形。它的重量和锋利度也使它成为一种非常有效的近战武器，也是一种优秀的屠宰工具。

messages.msgid: A menacing-looking knife with a broad, square shaped blade, curved for fast vegetable chopping.  Its heft and sharpness make it a decent weapon as well, although not as good as a meat cleaver.
translations: 一把看起来很凶险的刀，刀身宽大，呈方形，刀刃弯曲，能够快速切开蔬菜。它的分量和锋利度也使它成为一种不错的武器，虽然不如剁肉刀。

messages.msgid: A knife made of crudely-worked copper with a simple handle.  Primitive, but a step above stone-age.
translations: 一把粗糙的自制铜刀，带着一个简单的把手。很原始，但比石器时代更上了一步。

messages.msgid: A cast bronze knife with a full tang, with a handle wrapped in cord and leather, lovingly work-hardened and sharpened to a fine edge.
translations: 一把铸造成型的青铜小刀，刀柄用绳索和皮革包裹，刃口经过精心加工硬化，十分锋利。

messages.msgid: A short, sturdy knife with a serrated edge for cutting lines and straps, and a blunt tip for prying.  Used primarily by divers, this knife has been fitted with cork to slow its descent if dropped underwater, so it takes up more space than usual.
translations: 一个短而结实的匕首，锯齿状的刀刃能够切割绳子和皮带，边缘一个钝头可当做小型撬棍使用。这种刀主要由潜水员使用，它有个软木塞，如果落入水中，可以减缓下降速度，因此它比普通的刀更占空间。

messages.msgid: A sharp, knife-like tool used for harvesting honey from beehives.  Makes a passable melee weapon.
translations: 一把锋利的刀状工具。用来从蜂巢收集蜂蜜。勉强能够拿来当近战武器。

messages.msgid: A small pocket knife.  It isn't great for combat, but it's better than nothing.  It's sharp enough to butcher with.
translations: 一把小巧的折刀，作为武器那是相当糟糕，但总比没有好。不过足够用来切肉了。

messages.msgid: A sharpened stone set into a hollowed handle.  Not nearly as usable as a proper knife, but it's better than nothing.
translations: 一块磨利的石头，插进一个带洞的手柄里。怎么看也不太像匕首，用起来也不那么方便，但总比赤手空拳要好。

messages.msgid: A small knife designed for opening boxes.  It could cause some damage, but it really should be used against inanimate objects.  It is too small to effectively butcher corpses with.
translations: 一把小巧且锋利的刀具，专门用来打开纸箱。它能造成一些伤害，但只能打中不会动的物体。它太小了，不能用来有效地屠宰尸体。

messages.msgid: A rock with sharpened edges, produced by knapping.  Works as a crude cutting and butchering tool, if nothing else is available.
translations: 一块边缘磨尖的大石头，可以用作简易的切割屠宰工具，总比徒手好。

messages.msgid: A large stick with the end carved into a broad blade for digging.  It could be used to dig shallow pits, but not deep ones.
translations: 一根长长的木棍，底端削成了类似锄头的宽刃形状。可以用来挖掘浅坑，但是挖不了多深。

messages.msgid: A small, sharp gardening shovel, perfect for digging up grubs and worms.
translations: 一把小巧的，锋利的园艺铲，非常适合挖掘蛴螬和蠕虫。

messages.msgid: A farming implement.  You can use it to turn tillable land into a slow-to-cross pile of dirt, or dig a shallow pit.
translations: 一件农具。可用于把可耕种土地锄成难以穿行的土堆，或者挖一个浅坑。

messages.msgid: A farming implement made from bronze.  The added heft and durability should let you till soil for farming more easily as well.
translations: 一把用青铜制成的农具，但增加的重量和耐用性应该让你更容易耕作土壤。

messages.msgid: A crude shovel with a shovelhead made from wood, historically used as an alternative to metal shovels when metal was too expensive.  It works passably well, but really can't compare to a metal shovel.
translations: 一把粗糙的铲子，铲头由木头制成，在历史上金属太贵时用作金属铲子的替代品。它功能类似铲子，但比真正的铲子差太多。

messages.msgid: A sturdy metal rake, a must-have during autumn.
translations: 一把结实的金属耙子，秋季收获必备农具。

messages.msgid: A cheap plastic rake.  Will break quite quickly if used for anything other than raking leaves.
translations: 一把廉价的塑料耙子。如果把它用于除了耙树叶以外的任何用途，都会很快损坏它。

messages.msgid: An old-fashioned farming tool used to cut tall grass.  Despite being a giant blade on the end of a stick, it is incredibly awkward to use for anything but its intended purpose.
translations: 老式农业工具，专门用来割杂草。尽管它的棍子末端装上了一片巨大的刀片，但除了本来的用途之外，它非常难以用于任何其他用途。

messages.msgid: A dull, cheaply-made replica of an old-fashioned farming tool used to cut tall grass.
translations: 一把用于割杂草的老式农具的无趣、廉价的复制品。

messages.msgid: A long, crooked tool used to reap souls, with a skull engraved in its blade.  Let the harvest begin.
translations: 一把长而弯曲的镰刀，用来收割灵魂，刀片上刻着骷髅头骨。让收割开始吧。

messages.msgid: A digging tool.  Use it to dig pits adjacent to your location.
translations: 一个挖坑工具，你可以用它在你周围挖坑。

messages.msgid: A sturdy metal shovel used for picking up snow and moving it somewhere else.  It was useful before the Cataclysm, but now it's useless.
translations: 一种结实的金属铲，用来将雪铲除并把它移到其他地方。它在大灾变之前很有用，但现在已经没用了。

messages.msgid: A cheap plastic shovel used for picking up snow and moving it somewhere else.  It was useful before the Cataclysm, but now it's useless.
translations: 一种便宜的塑料铲，用来将雪铲除并把它移到其他地方。它在大灾变之前很有用，但现在已经没用了。

messages.msgid: A primitive tool for cutting grass.  The sharp, crescent-shaped stone at the end of the handle is barely good enough for the job.
translations: 一个用来割草的简易工具。手柄末端是一块磨尖的新月形石头，只能勉强完成这项工作。

messages.msgid: An old-fashioned farming tool for cutting tall grass.  Despite being a massive curved blade on a handle, it is incredibly awkward to use for anything but its intended purpose.
translations: 老式农业工具，专门用来割杂草。尽管它的棍子末端装上了一片巨大的刀片，但除了本来的用途之外，它非常难以用于任何其他用途。

messages.msgid: A handheld grass-cutting tool with a cast bronze blade, fastened to a wood handle wrapped with leather.
translations: 一把手持割草工具，带有铸造而成的青铜刀片，固定在用皮革包裹的木把手上。

messages.msgid: A long, slightly curved and hooked steel blade on the end of a sturdy shaft.  Could be used to thoroughly ruin something's day, or cut branches and small trees.
translations: 一个长长的，稍微弯曲和钩状斧头，结实地安装在柄端上。可以用来彻底弄糟某人的一天，或者用来砍树枝。

messages.msgid: A long, slightly curved and hooked bronze blade on the end of a sturdy shaft.  Could be used to thoroughly ruin something's day, or cut branches and small trees.
translations: 一根结实的长柄末端装着一片略微弯曲的长青铜刃。既能用来狠狠教训目标，也能用来砍削树枝和小树。

messages.msgid: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  A long line of sharp-edged teeth extends from the engine; turning the trimmer on will make them rapidly vibrate.  The poor man's chainsaw as far as the zombies are concerned.
translations: 一把汽油动力的灌木修剪机。马达连着一条长链，上面是锋利的锯齿，如果启动修剪机的话它们会快速振动。如果被丧尸缠上了，就把它当成电锯来用吧……

messages.msgid: With a roar, the hedge trimmer leaps to life!
translations: 随着一声轰鸣，绿篱机猛烈的旋动起来！

messages.msgid: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  It is currently on, ready to do some zombie topiary; use this item to turn it off.
translations: 一把汽油动力的灌木修剪机。现在已经启动，准备"修剪"丧尸们。使用此物品以将其关闭。

messages.msgid: Powered by the magic of nuclear decay and low-energy LEDs, this very expensive lamp will emit a small amount of light for at least a decade.  Before the Cataclysm, it was mostly an expensive way to show off your preparedness.  Now, it's actually really useful.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.
translations: 非常昂贵的灯，由神奇的核衰变能源为低功耗LED供电，能够连续发光至少10年。在大灾变之前，这主要是一种炫耀战备的奢侈玩法。而今，它真的派上了用场。激活它以遮住灯光。

messages.msgid: Powered by the magic of nuclear decay and low-energy LEDs, this very expensive lamp will emit a small amount of light for at least a decade.  Before the Cataclysm, it was mostly an expensive way to show off your preparedness.  Now, it's actually really useful.  The cover is closed.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.
translations: 非常昂贵的灯，由神奇的核衰变能源为低功耗LED供电，能够连续发光至少10年。在大灾变之前，这主要是一种炫耀战备的奢侈玩法。而今，它真的派上了用场。现在灯光已经被遮住了，激活以使它重现光芒。

messages.msgid: Powered by the magic of nuclear decay and low-energy LEDs, this extremely expensive little light will provide just enough light to read by for at least a decade.  It is also available with a cute cartoon bear cover to turn it into a nightlight for a very wealthy child with a fear of the dark.  Use it to close the cover and hide the light.
translations: 利用核衰变产生的能量来驱动二极管发光，这种灯相当昂贵，至少可以保证在十年时间内持续发光。它被设计的非常可爱，可以为喜欢夜读的孩子提供足够的光亮。关上灯罩可以遮住它所发出的光芒。

messages.msgid: Powered by the magic of nuclear decay and low-energy LEDs, this extremely expensive little light will provide just enough light to read by for at least a decade.  It is also available with a cute cartoon bear cover to turn it into a nightlight for a very wealthy child with a fear of the dark.  The cover is closed.  Use it to open the cover and show the light.
translations: 利用核衰变产生的能量来驱动二极管发光，这种灯相当昂贵，至少可以保证在十年时间内持续发光。它被设计的非常可爱，可以为喜欢夜读的孩子提供足够的光亮。灯罩被遮上了，打开灯罩可以让它散发光芒。

messages.msgid: A thick wax candle.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.
translations: 一支粗蜡烛。它提供的光线并不多，但可以燃烧相当长的时间。你需要打火机或火柴才能点燃它。

messages.msgid: A thick wax candle.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  This candle is lit.
translations: 一支粗蜡烛。它提供的光线并不多，但可以燃烧相当长的时间。这支蜡烛已经点燃。

messages.msgid: A battery-powered lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.
translations: 一盏电提灯，灯光虽然不是很亮，但是可以持续亮很久。

messages.msgid: A typical household flashlight with a plastic handle, powered by batteries.
translations: 一种典型的家用手电筒，塑料手柄，电池供电。

messages.msgid: A small waterproof flashlight with an aluminum handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods.
translations: 一个小型的防水手电筒，配有铝制握柄，由电池供电。可以固定在一些潜水面罩和头套上使用。
大功率迷你潜水手电筒（关）

messages.msgid: A small waterproof high-power flashlight with an aluminum handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods.
translations: 一个小型大功率防水手电筒，配有铝制握柄，由电池供电。可以固定在一些潜水面罩和头套上使用。
大功率迷你潜水手电筒（开）

messages.msgid: A waterproof variable power flashlight with a plastic handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods and onto a proprietary wrist mount.
translations: 一个多功率防水手电筒，配有塑料握柄，由电池供电。可以固定在一些潜水面罩和头套上，也可以装在腕带上使用。
可调功率迷你潜水手电筒（开，高）
messages.plural: variable power mini diving flashlights (on, high)

messages.msgid: You decrease power of the flashlight.

translations: 可调功率迷你潜水手电筒（开，中）
messages.plural: variable power mini diving flashlights (on, medium)

translations: 可调功率迷你潜水手电筒（开，低）
messages.plural: variable power mini diving flashlights (on, low)

messages.msgid: A small gasoline-powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 小型汽油燃料灯笼。它的光线较弱，但它的持续时间较长。用的时候请打开它。

messages.msgid: A small gasoline-powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  It is turned on.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 小型汽油燃料灯笼。它的光线较弱，但它的持续时间较长。它正亮着呢，不用时请关掉它。

messages.msgid: A small blue-light glowstick.  Use it to bend the plastic and break the glass cylinder inside to start the reaction.  It will produce a small amount of light.
translations: 小小的蓝色荧光棒，弯曲一下就能产生光，当然，不怎么亮就是了。

messages.msgid: A spent glowstick.  It is essentially trash.
translations: 用过的荧光棒，没什么用了，有兴趣可以留着。

messages.msgid: An active glowstick, currently producing light.  It will last for a few hours before burning out.
translations: 被激活内在化学反应而正在发出微光的荧光棒，只能亮几个小时。

messages.msgid: A slow-burning magnesium flare.  Use it to strike the striker and light it.  It will produce a bright light for about a half hour.
translations: 一个缓慢燃烧的镁制照明弹。激活后，它会持续发出约半个小时的强光。

messages.msgid: You strike your flare and light it.
A burning magnesium flare that is producing light.  It will last for about a half hour before burning out.
translations: 这个镁制照明弹正在不停地燃烧，大约半小时后熄灭。

messages.msgid: A bright burning flare that is producing light.  It will last for about a minute before burning out.
translations: 一个明亮的照明弹，正在燃烧发光，大约一分钟后熄灭。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty LED flashlight with a durable polymer housing.  It's impact-resistant, chemical-resistant, waterproof and certified for use in hazardous environments.  Designed for firefighters, rescue personnel and miners but it can also be used for smacking hooligans.  It has a spring-loaded clip that can be attached to your torso.
translations: 耐用 LED 手电筒，采用耐用的聚合材料外壳。它耐冲击、耐化学腐蚀、防水，并通过了危险环境使用认证。专为消防员、救援人员和矿工设计，当然也可用于殴打小混混。它有一个弹簧夹，可以连接到你的躯干上。

messages.msgid: You turn the heavy-duty flashlight on.
The heavy-duty flashlight's battery is dead.
translations: 耐用手电筒的电池耗尽了。

messages.msgid: You turn the heavy-duty flashlight off.
You turn off the LED strip.
25 feet of colorful LED strip, that are often used as house lights or on some holidays.
translations: 色彩鲜艳的LED灯条，25英尺长，通常用作室内照明或者节日装饰品。

messages.msgid: You turn on the LED strip.
A kerosene-fueled lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 一盏用煤油燃料的油灯，灯光虽然不是很亮，但是可以持续亮很久。使用可以点煤油灯。

messages.msgid: A kerosene-fueled lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  It is turned on.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 一盏用煤油燃料的油灯，灯光虽然不是很亮，但是可以持续亮很久。使用可以熄灭油灯。

messages.msgid: A specialized small clay container with a wick, an ancient form of oil lamp.  Unlike newer designs, it isn't windproof, so the flame is likely to be extinguished if exposed to wind; better use it indoors.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to light it.
translations: 一个带有灯芯的特殊小陶罐，是一种古老的油灯形式。与更新的设计不同，它不防风，因此如果暴露在风中，火焰可能会熄灭；最好在室内使用。它提供的光不多，但能持续很长时间。使用它以点燃。

messages.msgid: A specialized small clay container with a wick, an ancient form of oil lamp.  Unlike newer designs, it isn't windproof, so the flame is likely to be extinguished if exposed to wind; better use it indoors.  It does not provide much light, but lasts a long time.  It is lit, consuming oil and providing light.  Use it to extinguish the flame.
translations: 一个带有灯芯的特殊小陶罐，是一种古老的油灯形式。与更新的设计不同，它不防风，因此如果暴露在风中，火焰可能会熄灭；最好在室内使用。它已经被点燃，消耗灯油并提供光亮。使用它以熄灭火焰。

messages.msgid: An antique brass lamp designed to run from a pressurized cylinder of acetylene.  It is an efficient, if somewhat dangerous, light source.
translations: 一件仿古的黄铜油灯，设计成使用压缩乙炔气罐。是个有效而又有些危险的光源。

messages.msgid: The %s must be attached to a gas cylinder to light.
translations: %s必须装在一个气罐上来点亮。

messages.msgid: A little clip-on LED light, meant for reading books in the dark.
translations: 一个带夹子的小型LED灯，能让你在黑暗中阅读书籍。

messages.msgid: You switch on the reading light.

translations: 阅读灯闪了几下熄灭了。

messages.msgid: A little clip-on LED light, meant for reading books in the dark.  This one is turned on.
translations: 一个带夹子的小型LED灯，能让你在黑暗中阅读书籍。现在开着。

messages.msgid: You switch off the reading light.
A smart lamp that can be activated remotely.
translations: 这是一个遥控灯，它可以遥控激活。

messages.msgid: You turn the smart lamp on.
The smart lamp batteries are dead.
A smart lamp which can be deactivated remotely.  Currently it is turned on.
translations: 一种可以远程遥控的智能灯。目前它已打开。

messages.msgid: A large stick wrapped in rags that are soaked with flammable material.  When lit, it produces a fair amount of light.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.
translations: 浸透了可燃材料的布胡乱地缠在棍子上，点燃了似乎就能照亮四周。找个打火机或者划根火柴点着它。

messages.msgid: A large stick wrapped in rags that are soaked with flammable material.  It is burning, producing plenty of light.
translations: 浸透了可燃材料的布胡乱地缠在棍子上，正在燃烧，光芒四射。

messages.msgid: A small propane-powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.
translations: 小型丙烷燃料灯笼。它的光线较弱，但它的持续时间较长。用的时候请打开它。

messages.msgid: A small propane-powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  It is turned on.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 小型丙烷燃料灯笼。它的光线较弱，但它的持续时间较长。它正亮着呢，不用时请关掉它。

messages.msgid: A thin wax candle.  It doesn't provide very much light and will burn relatively quickly.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.
translations: 一只细长的蜡烛，能发出微弱的光线，但燃烧时间较短。你需要打火机或火柴来点燃。

messages.msgid: A thin wax candle.  It doesn't provide very much light and will burn relatively quickly.  This candle is lit.
translations: 一只细长的蜡烛，能发出微弱的光线，但燃烧时间较短。这只已经点燃了。

messages.msgid: An eight-branched candelabra more properly called a 'hanukkiah', the menorah is used to celebrate the Jewish festival of Hanukkah.
translations: 一种有八个灯座的烛台，更准确的名称是“哈努基亚”，用于庆祝犹太人的光明节。

messages.msgid: A construction tool for cutting through concrete or other surfaces.  It runs on gasoline.  Using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon or a terrible chainsaw.
translations: 一台用于切割混凝土或其他表面的建筑工具。它以汽油为燃料。使用它以将它启动，使其成为非常强大但笨拙的近战武器或是一台糟糕的链锯。

messages.msgid: With a roar, the <npc_name> screams to life!
translations: 随着一声轰鸣，<npc_name>猛烈地转动起来！

messages.msgid: This masonry saw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 石材切割机已经启动，发出可怕的噪声。激活它来关闭。
你的石材切割机吱吱作响。

messages.msgid: A construction tool for cutting through concrete or other surfaces.  It uses electric motor with integrated battery and is compatible with a UPS.  Using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon or a terrible chainsaw.
translations: 一台用于切割混凝土或其他表面的建筑工具。它采用带有集成电池的电动马达，并兼容UPS供电系统。使用它以将它启动，使其成为非常强大但笨拙的近战武器或是一台糟糕的链锯。

messages.msgid: You turn on the masonry saw.
This electric masonry saw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 电动石材切割机已经启动，发出可怕的噪声。激活它来关闭。
你的电动石材切割机吱吱作响。

messages.msgid: A 125 mm angle grinder blade.  You could make a power tool with it, or throw it.  Wielding it without sturdy gloves is a bad idea.
translations: 125 mm 的角磨机刀片。可以用于制作角磨机，也可以用于投掷。没戴结实的手套时最好不要拿在手上。

messages.msgid: A small medical dressing made of a piece of sterile cloth and sticky tape, used for small injuries not serious enough to require a full-size bandage.
translations: 一片小型医用敷料，由一块无菌布和胶带组成，用于治疗那些尚不严重到需要全尺寸绷带的小伤口。

messages.msgid: A wet wipe saturated with alcohol and stored in a sterile package.  Used for personal hygiene or disinfecting small wounds.
translations: 一种用酒精浸透并储存在无菌包装中的湿巾。常用于个人卫生或小伤口消毒。

messages.msgid: A kit for inducing anesthesia for surgery, containing specialized canisters with a variety of powerful hypnotic, analgesic, and stimulative drugs.  It's intended for use in specialized medical equipment, and can't be administered manually.
translations: 一整套用于手术麻醉的工具，内含装有各种强力催眠剂、止痛剂及兴奋剂的瓶子。该工具箱设计主要用于专业医疗设备使用，暂时无法直接使用。

messages.msgid: A sterile cloth bandage.  Used for stopping blood loss and protecting wounds from aggravation to help them heal faster.
translations: 一条无菌布绷带。用于阻止失血和保护伤口免受恶化，以助于更快地愈合。

messages.msgid: A reasonably clean piece of cloth wrapped for use as a simple bandage.  Better than nothing.
translations: 一块相当干净的棉布卷起来做成的简易绷带。有总比没有好。

messages.msgid: A piece of cloth treated with a bleach solution to sterilize it for use as a bandage.
translations: 一块用漂白剂溶液灭菌处理过的棉布，可以用作绷带。

messages.msgid: A piece of cloth boiled in water to sterilize it for use as a bandage.
translations: 一块在水中煮沸灭菌过的棉布，可以用作绷带。

messages.msgid: Fluffy balls of clean, white cotton.  They can serve as makeshift bandages in an emergency.
translations: 毛茸茸的白棉球。紧急情况下可以勉强作为简易绷带使用。

messages.msgid: A rag soaked in antiseptic.  Useful for light wounds, probably won't help with deep bites.
translations: 浸过抗菌剂的布条。对于轻微的伤口很有用，但对于严重的咬伤可能就没用了。

messages.msgid: Fluffy balls of clean white cotton.  Now that they've been soaked with antiseptic, they are somewhat useful to disinfect a wound.
translations: 干净的白色棉球。已经用抗菌剂浸泡过了，对伤口的消毒有一定作用。

messages.msgid: An albuterol inhaler.  Used in the treatment of bronchospasm, it is a lifeline for people with asthma.  A mild stimulant, it may cause anxiety or tremors.
translations: 沙丁胺醇吸入剂。用于治疗支气管痉挛，是哮喘患者救命恩人。一种温和的兴奋剂，它可能导致焦虑或震颤。

messages.msgid: A decent-sized piece of cotton, sterilized and sealed.  It's designed for medical purposes.
translations: 一块大小合适的棉花，经过消毒和密封，可用于医疗目的。

messages.msgid: Liquid bandage for minor cuts and scrapes, packaged in a tiny bottle with an atomizer spray for convenient application.
translations: 用于轻微割伤和擦伤的液体绷带，包装在一个带有喷雾器的小瓶中，便于使用。

messages.msgid: A Rivtech RX12 jet injector, a small pistol-shaped device used to inject advanced fast-healing chemicals through the skin without using a needle.  A label on the side warns against using more than two doses per hour.
translations: Rivtech RX12射流注射器是一种小型的疗伤用无针头注射器，通过皮肤直接将高效的快速治疗药剂注入身体。手枪外形，旁边的标签上印有每小时使用不得超过两次的警告文字。

messages.msgid: A very sharp knife designed for surgical cutting.  Its small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.
translations: 一把小型的，非常锋利的刀具，被广泛应用于各项外科手术中。如果你很擅长近战武器的话，它也会是一件大杀器。

messages.msgid: A small tank of compressed medical oxygen with a folding regulator and mask.  Commonly used in emergency situations, it provides immediate relief for asthma attacks or smoke inhalation, and can provide a brief burst of energy.
translations: 一小罐医用压缩氧，附带调节器和面罩。能够迅速缓解哮喘症状和烟雾吸入损伤，也能让你在短时间内精神满满。

messages.msgid: A medical syringe.  Used for administering intravenous drugs.
translations: 一支医用针筒，可以用来注射海洛因或其他毒品。

messages.msgid: A plastic thermometer that can read the air temperature.
translations: 一个塑料的温度计，可以让你知道当前气温。

messages.msgid: A tank of compressed medical oxygen with a regulator and mask.  Commonly used in emergency situations, it provides immediate relief for asthma attacks or smoke inhalation, and can provide a brief burst of energy.
translations: 一罐医用压缩氧，附带调节器和面罩。能够迅速缓解哮喘症状和烟雾吸入损伤，也能让你在短时间内精神满满。

messages.msgid: A kit for drawing blood, including a test tube for holding the sample.  Use this tool to draw blood, either from yourself or from a corpse you are standing on.
translations: 一套能用来采集血液的工具，附带一根用来保存血样的试管。使用它来抽血，可以是从你自己身上抽血，或者是你当前所站位置的尸体身上抽血。

messages.msgid: A badge that detects radiation dosage, sealed in a radiation-blocking bag.  Use it to remove it from the bag.
translations: 一块用来检测辐射量的徽章，密闭在防辐射的包装袋中。使用它以将其从包装中取出。

messages.msgid: You remove the badge from its wrapper, exposing it to ambient radiation.
translations: 你从包装里取出了辐射侦测徽章，使其暴露于环境辐射中。

messages.msgid: A pair of medical scissors, typically used by nurses or paramedics to cut bandages or fabric.
translations: 一把医用剪刀，通常由护士或护理人员用来剪绷带或织物。

messages.msgid: A small, sealed plastic bag for liquids used in intravenous therapy, with rubber tube and cannula - all you need to perform an infusion.  Holds 250 mL of completely sterile saline, therefore it is safe to put it inside your veins, if you know how.
translations: 一个用于静脉输液的小型密封塑料袋，带有橡胶管和静脉导管，有了它你就可以进行输液。里面装着 250 毫升的无菌生理盐水，可以安全地注射到静脉中，如果你懂得怎么操作的话。

messages.msgid: You can use it to mitigate the consequences of blood loss.  Require health care 3 and some disinfectant.
translations: 你可以用它来减轻失血的症状。需要 3 级医疗技能。

messages.msgid: You don't actually know how to use it properly.
translations: 你其实并不知道如何正确使用它。

messages.msgid: A sealed plastic bag for liquids used in intravenous therapy, with rubber tube and cannula - all you need to perform an infusion.  Holds 500 mL of completely sterile saline, therefore it is safe to put it inside your veins, if you know how.
translations: 一个用于静脉输液的密封塑料袋，带有橡胶管和静脉导管，有了它你就可以进行输液。里面装着 500 毫升的无菌生理盐水，可以安全地注射到静脉中，如果你懂得怎么操作的话。

messages.msgid: You can use it to mitigate the consequences of blood loss.  Require health care 4.
translations: 你可以用它来减轻失血的症状。需要 4 级医疗技能。

messages.msgid: A large, sealed plastic bag for liquids used in intravenous therapy, with rubber tube and cannula - all you need to perform an infusion.  Holds a liter of completely sterile saline, therefore it is safe to put it inside your veins, if you know how.
translations: 一个用于静脉输液的大型密封塑料袋，带有橡胶管和静脉导管，有了它你就可以进行输液。里面装着 1 升的无菌生理盐水，可以安全地注射到静脉中，如果你懂得怎么操作的话。
超大型生理盐水输液袋

messages.msgid: A huge, sealed plastic bag for liquids used in intravenous therapy, with rubber tube and cannula - all you need to perform an infusion.  Holds two liters of completely sterile saline, therefore it is safe to put it inside your veins, if you know how.
translations: 一个用于静脉输液的超大型密封塑料袋，带有橡胶管和静脉导管，有了它你就可以进行输液。里面装着 2 升的无菌生理盐水，可以安全地注射到静脉中，如果你懂得怎么操作的话。

messages.msgid: A set of picks, hooks, and scrapers designed for cleaning teeth.
translations: 一套用于清洁牙齿的镊子、勾针和刮匙工具。

messages.msgid: A crude bronze nail.  Probably not useful for many things due to its size and shape.
translations: 一根粗制铜钉。从大小和形状来看，大概造不了太多东西。

messages.msgid: A heavy block of oddly-shaped steel complete with a pritchel hole and hardy hole.  Once installed, it can be used in most metalworking fabrication recipes.
translations: 一块沉重的、形状奇特的钢，上面有一个冲凿孔和一个插模孔。安装后可在大多数金属加工制作中使用。

messages.msgid: A block of oddly-shaped bronze complete with a pritchel hole and hardy hole.  Once installed, it can be used in most metalworking fabrication recipes.
translations: 一块形状奇特的青铜，上面有一个冲凿孔和一个插模孔。安装后可在大多数金属加工制作中使用。

messages.msgid: An absolutely enormous block of oddly-shaped steel with all the bells and whistles a blacksmith could ask for on an anvil.  Necessary for heavy-duty metalworking or dropping on roadrunners.
translations: 一块庞大的、形状奇特的钢，具有铁匠所需的全部功能与附件。在重型金属加工和Herobrine为谋害Steve所建的陷阱中必不可少。

messages.msgid: A proper, albeit small, anvil.  Pretty handy.
translations: 一个合适的铁砧，很小，但用起来很趁手。

messages.msgid: A portion of heavy steel machinery that has been smoothed and shaped to form a very adequate anvil.
A heavy, thick log to which several flat steel bits have been bolted to serve as an anvil.  Not sufficient for detailed nor heavy work.
translations: 一根粗重的圆木，上面用螺栓固定了几块扁平的钢片充当铁砧。不足以进行精细作业或重活。

messages.msgid: A large pair of bolt cutters.  You could use them to cut padlocks or heavy gauge wire.
translations: 一个用于剪断电线的老虎钳，你还可以用它来剪断铁丝网和锁链。

messages.msgid: A portable, charcoal-fired metalworking forge.  With the right tools, you could use this for metalworking.
translations: 一种便携式烧炭金工锻造工具。搭配合适当的工具，你可以用它来加工金属物品。

messages.msgid: A somewhat portable drum kiln to produce charcoal via pyrolysis: the incomplete burning of organic materials in the absence of oxygen.  Needs to be deployed before use.
translations: 一种通过热解法生产木炭的便携鼓式窑炉：让有机材料在缺氧环境下不完全燃烧以获得炭。使用前需要部署。

messages.msgid: A short, stout metalworking chisel.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.
translations: 一个短而粗的金工凿。在某些金属加工制造时使用。

messages.msgid: A short, stout metalworking chisel made of bronze.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.  Bronze chisels spark less than their steel counterparts, but are less durable.
translations: 一个短而粗的金工凿，采用青铜制成。在某些金属加工制造时使用。青铜凿的火花比钢凿的要小，但不那么耐用。

messages.msgid: A small metalworking crucible.  Looks like a stout drink tumbler.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.
translations: 一个小的金属坩埚。看起来像是一杯烈酒。用于某些金属加工制造的模具。

messages.msgid: A primitive metalworking crucible made of clay.  Looks like a stout drink tumbler.  You could use it for metalworking.
translations: 一个小的金属坩埚。看起来像是一杯烈酒。用于某些金属加工制造的模具。

messages.msgid: An electric metalworking forge, powered by your electric grid.  With the right tools, you could use this for metalworking.
translations: 一个可用于加工金属的电锻炉，带有一个插头。搭配合适当的工具，你可以用它来加工金属物品。

messages.msgid: A sheet of riveted chainmail.  With some skill, several of these sheets could be connected to make effective armor.
translations: 一片铆接而成的锁环网。稍有技巧的人能够将几片锁环网拼接成可用的护甲。

messages.msgid: A set of swages and dies for metalsmithing.  These loops and metal blocks are used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.
translations: 一组用于加工模具的型砧。用于某些金属加工制造的模具。

messages.msgid: A hardened chisel-like object for metalsmithing.  It's used to cut lengths of metal in some metalworking fabrication recipes.
translations: 这是一种用于金属锻造的坚硬凿子。在某些金属加工制造配方中，用来将金属切割成长条。

messages.msgid: A hardened spike-like object for metalsmithing.  It's used to make holes in metal in some metalworking fabrication recipes.
translations: 这是一种用于金属锻造的坚硬锥形冲头。在某些金属加工制造配方中，用来在金属上打孔。

messages.msgid: A pair of long, metal tongs.  They are commonly used for cooking.
translations: 一把长长的金属夹钳。是常用的烹饪工具。

messages.msgid: A pair of flatjaw tongs.  They are commonly used for metalworking, fabrication, or forging recipes.
translations: 一把平口铁钳，通常用于金属加工、制造或锻造配方。

messages.msgid: A sheet of rough paper.  It is commonly used in metalworking and carpentry.
translations: 一张粗糙的纸。常用于金属加工和木工。

messages.msgid: A patch of leather paired with a handful of sand.  Works as a substitute for sandpaper.
translations: 一块沾满了沙子的皮革。用作砂纸的替代品。

messages.msgid: A piece of metal with holes of varying size drilled into it.  Used as part of wire drawing.
translations: 钻有大小不等的孔的金属片。用作拉丝的工具。

messages.msgid: A small mold for casting molten metals into different shapes.
translations: 用于将液态金属铸造成型的小型模具。

messages.msgid: A large mold for casting molten metals into different shapes.
translations: 用于将液态金属铸造成型的大型模具。

messages.msgid: A large, long, mold for casting molten metals into different shapes.
translations: 用于将液态金属铸造成型的大型长条模具。

messages.msgid: A medium mold for casting molten metals into different shapes.
translations: 用于将液态金属铸造成型的中型模具。

messages.msgid: A large natural stone with a flat surface to grind against.
translations: 一块天然的大石头，表面平坦可以用来研磨抛光。

messages.msgid: A round, pedal-powered grindstone, useful for grinding metal.
translations: 一块圆形的脚踏式砂轮，用于磨削金属。

messages.msgid: A hardened steel tool similar to a drawknife, but for metal.
translations: 一把由硬钢制成的工具，类似于刮刀，但用于金属。

messages.msgid: A gas-fueled metalworking forge.  With the right tools, you could use this for metalworking.
translations: 一种便携式燃气金工锻造工具。搭配合适当的工具，你可以用它来加工金属物品。

messages.msgid: A small can of compressed air attached to a plastic horn.  Pressing the button on top causes it to emit a loud honking sound.
translations: 这罐压缩空气被安上了一个塑料的号角，只要轻轻按下罐子上的按钮，就会发出巨大的喇叭声。

messages.msgid: A wind-up alarm clock.  Though the noise it makes is unpleasant to wake up to, it's always good to get an early start to your day.  Can also be disassembled into some useful parts.
translations: 一个发条闹钟。被吵醒实在是不舒服，但起早总没什么坏处。也可以拆成有用的零件。

messages.msgid: A non-refillable can of butane with an adapter for refilling lighters.  It could be useful as a fuel, but also as a solvent or chemical reagent.
translations: 一种不可再填充的丁烷罐，带有用于可填充打火机的适配器。它可以用作燃料，也可以用作溶剂或化学试剂。

messages.msgid: A quarter of a wooden plank with notches cut into it, used with a fire drill to create embers.
translations: 四分之一块木板，刻有火种凹槽，用来配合钻木取火器生火。

messages.msgid: A wooden stick with notches cut into it, used with a fire drill to create embers.
translations: 一根刻有凹槽的木棍，用来配合钻木取火器生火。

messages.msgid: A clay container for storing cremated ashes.
translations: 用于存放骨灰的黏土容器。

messages.msgid: A cow bell.  You feel like you need more of it.
translations: 一个牛铃。你觉得你需要更多。（注：Need more cowbell meme）

messages.msgid: An exquisite, translucent container for cremated ashes, decorated with floral patterns.
translations: 精致的半透明骨灰容器，刻有花卉图案装饰。

messages.msgid: A stout, collapsible spade.  It's commonly used by military forces and favored by hikers for digging.
translations: 一把结实的折叠铁锹。常见于军队装备，也因挖掘方便而深受徒步者的青睐。

messages.msgid: A human skull covered with strange etchings.
translations: 一个布满奇怪蚀刻图案的人类头骨。

messages.msgid: A bedroll made of pelts which can be rolled up for transport.  It insulates you from the floor, making it easier to sleep.  Use it to unroll and place on the ground.
translations: 一床毛皮制成的铺盖，可以卷起来随身携带。垫在地上，让你更容易入睡。

messages.msgid: You unroll the fur mat and lay it on the ground.
translations: 你展开毛皮卷毯，把它平铺在地上。

messages.msgid: A flexible garden hose.  If you cut it into smaller pieces, it could be used for crafting or siphoning fuel from a vehicle.
translations: 一根柔软的花园水管。若将其剪成小段，可用于制作物品，或用来从车辆中虹吸燃料。

messages.msgid: A folding grappling hook attached to a stout, 30-foot long piece of lightweight cord.  Useful for keeping yourself safe from falls.  Can be used in place of a long rope for butchering, in a pinch.
translations: 可折叠的精钢抓钩，系在一根30英尺（约9米）长的尼龙绳上。有效保护你从高处落下时的安全。足以吊起大型尸体以便屠宰。

messages.msgid: A simple steel meat hook with a circular steel handle.
translations: 一个简单的钢制挂肉钩，带有个环形的钢把手。

messages.msgid: A hand-powered pump suitable for pumping air into inflatable objects.
translations: 一台手动驱动的打气泵，适用于给充气物品充入空气。

messages.msgid: A bellow is a device constructed to furnish a strong blast of air.
translations: 一种用来提供强劲气流的装置。

messages.msgid: A simple bulb horn found on many bicycles.  Activate it to honk.  Honk honk.
translations: 一个简单的小铃铛，许多自行车上都可以看到。激活它以发声。

messages.msgid: A very loud horn, usually found on large trucks like semis.
translations: 一个非常响亮的喇叭，通常用在拖车这样的大卡车上。

messages.msgid: A car horn meant to be attached to a car's electrical system.
translations: 需要连接到汽车电气系统的汽车喇叭。

messages.msgid: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees Celsius, and fills a larger volume of air than the smaller version.
translations: 一种便携式电加热器，能稳定地放出温暖的空气。将温度升高约10℃，并比小型版本排气量更大。

messages.msgid: A small personal water filter.  The instructions say to set the lifestraw in suspect water, let sit for one minute then drink.  The two-part filtration system will purify the water you drink up to a certain amount.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.
translations: 一个小型的个人滤水器。将生命饮管放入污水中，静置一分钟之后即可饮用。它内置的双重过滤系统将会将一部分水净化至可饮用状态。从河流之类的不明水源取得的水有可能被污染。
一次性使用的塑料垫片。

messages.msgid: A King Size™ industrial-strength permanent marker, about halfway between a typical marker and a can of spray paint in size.  Activate it to write something down.  However, writing "Elbereth" probably won't help you.
translations: King Size牌的工业级记号笔，大小介于一般的记号笔和喷涂罐之间。可以用它来写东西。但是写下"老天保佑"可能不会有什么用。

messages.msgid: An old-fashioned pocket watch.  Tells the time and looks good doing it.  Can also be disassembled into some useful parts.
translations: 一个经典款怀表，可以让你在查看时间时显得很有派头。可以被拆解成零件。

messages.msgid: A container for holding the remains of a loved one.  Its prior owners must have taken good care of it, as you can see your face reflected clearly upon its surface.
translations: 用来存放亲人骨灰的容器。它的前主人一定把它照顾得很好，因为你可以看到你的脸清楚地反射在它的表面上。

messages.msgid: A sheet of foam which can be rolled tightly for storage.  It insulates you from the floor, making it easier to sleep.  Use it to unroll and place on the ground.
translations: 卷紧便携的泡沫垫。可以垫在地板上，让你更容易进入梦乡。使用它，即可将它展开、铺在地上。

messages.msgid: You unroll the mat and lay it on the ground.
translations: 你展开卷毯，把它平铺在地上。

messages.msgid: A secure combination-lock box.  Sadly, you don't know the combination.  Breaking into it would destroy anything of value.
translations: 一个组合式锁箱，不幸的是，你不知道密码。强行打开的话会破坏里头值钱的东西。

messages.msgid: A printout displaying a string of numbers, the passcode to access the elevator in the hazardous waste sarcophagus.
translations: 一串密码，用来启动通往危险废品储存间的电梯。

messages.msgid: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees Celsius.
translations: 一种便携式电加热器，能稳定地放出温暖的空气。将温度升高约10℃。

messages.msgid: An aerosol spray can filled with paint.  Activate it to make graffiti on the floor.
translations: 一个装满油漆的喷雾器。激活它可以在地板上涂鸦。

messages.msgid: A ten-foot wooden stepladder.  Activate it to set it down.
translations: 这是一把十英尺高（约3米）的木制梯子。使用它来放下梯子。

messages.msgid: A sharpened piece of charcoal used as an improvised pencil.  Almost guaranteed to get your hands all covered in charcoal.  Activate it to write something down.
translations: 只是一块被磨尖的木炭，你为了磨它，弄得整个手都是木炭黑。使用它来写字。

messages.msgid: A homemade collapsible telescope, perfect for a pirate.  Too large and inaccurate to use as a weapon scope, but carrying it in your inventory will double the distance that is mapped around you during your travels.
translations: 一个自制的可折叠式望远镜，非常适合海盗。太大而且精度不高，无法用作武器瞄准镜，但把它带在身上可以让你看到的地图视野距离翻倍。

messages.msgid: A pocket sized plastic canister filled with a pressurized tear gas spray, a step above oleoresin capsicum pepper spray in terms of potency.  Most commonly used by law enforcement and bear-wary hikers, but it became more common in recent months due to anxiety over the riots.  Probably won't do much against a zombie, but should give anything still breathing a rather nasty surprise and give you time to get away.  It contains enough spray for about twenty seconds of continuous application.
translations: 一个口袋大小的塑料罐，里面装满了加压的催泪瓦斯喷雾，在效力方面比辣椒喷雾高出一截。最常见的使用群体是执法人员和防范熊类袭击的徒步旅行者，但近几个月由于社会骚乱引发的恐慌，其普及度显著提升。可能对丧尸没有多大作用，但应该会给任何仍在呼吸的东西一个相当恶心的惊喜，并给你时间逃跑。喷雾能持续约二十秒。

messages.msgid: This is a dummy item used by c4 hacks.  You should never see it outside of debug.
translations: 这是被C-4无人机使用的虚拟物品。除了调试以外你不该在游戏里看到这玩意儿。

messages.msgid: This is a dummy item used by tear gas hacks.  You should never see it outside of debug.
translations: 这是被催泪弹无人机使用的虚拟物品，你不应该在调试模式之外的地方看到它。

messages.msgid: You pull the pin on the payload.
translations: 你拉开了催泪弹载体的拉环。

messages.msgid: This is a dummy item used by tear gas hacks that just so happens to be counting down.  You should never see it outside of debug.
translations: 这是被催泪弹无人机使用的虚拟物品，已激活且正在倒计时。你不应该在调试模式之外的地方看到它。

messages.msgid: A telescoping umbrella which has been collapsed down for easy storage.  May be used to keep dry when extended and wielded.
translations: 伸缩雨伞，已折叠，便于存放。 展开并手持可避免淋雨。

messages.msgid: A telescoping umbrella currently in its extended form, useful for keeping dry when wielded.  May be collapsed down for easy storage.
translations: 一种伸缩雨伞，已经展开，手持时避免淋雨。 可以折叠起来，便于存放。

messages.msgid: A portable plastic toilet, designed to use plastic bags for waste instead of plumbing.
translations: 一个便携塑料坐便器，使用塑料袋而非管道收集排泄物。

messages.msgid: You collapse the toilet for transport.
translations: 你将坐便器折叠起来以便携带。

messages.msgid: A portable plastic toilet.  It has been collapsed for easy transport.
translations: 一个便携塑料坐便器，已经被折叠起来以便携带。

messages.msgid: HOLY SHIT THIS THING IS ON FIRE!
translations: 我 的 天 啊！着 火 啦！！

messages.msgid: An umbrella with a pointy end, useful for keeping dry when wielded.
translations: 一把顶部尖尖的长伞，手持它时可以让你不被雨淋湿。

messages.msgid: A stone with spirals all over it and holes around its perimeter.  Though it is fairly large, it weighs next to nothing.  Air seems to gather around it.
translations: 一块遍布漩涡刻痕的石头，四周遍布着孔洞。虽然看上去不小，但几乎没有重量，似乎有气流聚集在这块石头的周围。

messages.msgid: A plastic bucket holding a small spade and rake, perfect for building sand castles!
translations: 一个装着小铲子和耙子的塑料桶，非常适合建造沙堡！

messages.msgid: A cheap gadget combining a whistle, thermometer, magnifying glass, and compass.
translations: 一个廉价的小玩意儿，结合了口哨，温度计，放大镜，和指南针。

messages.msgid: A ten-foot aluminum stepladder.  Activate it to set it down.
translations: 这是一把十英尺（约3米）高的铝制梯子。使用它来放下梯子。

messages.msgid: A handheld tool used for controlled breaking of glass.  A necessity for any glass cutting projects.
translations: 一把可手持的工具，用于让玻璃可控地裂开。任何玻璃切割项目的必需品。

messages.msgid: A toy that uses compressed air to launch small objects for the amusement of children.  It is very tiring to reload, and completely ineffective as a weapon.  Pump sold separately.
translations: 利用压缩空气发射小物体的玩具，供儿童娱乐。重新装填非常累人，而且作为武器完全没用。气泵单独出售。

messages.msgid: A long, thin and flexible rod that tapers to a point, originally used to stimulate a horse and give them orders.
translations: 一种从尾到头逐渐变长且灵活的细杆，最初用于刺激马并给它们下达命令。

messages.msgid: A rod ending in a leather popper originally used to stimulate a horse and give them orders.
translations: 一种皮制头部的杆子，最初用来刺激马并给它们下达命令。

messages.msgid: Impossibly-sharp teeth extracted from a giant corpse.  You could use them as a weapon, but you might want to wear gloves.
translations: 一根从某个巨怪尸体上拔出来的锋利得出奇的牙齿。可以拿来戳人，不过还是先戴上手套比较好。

messages.msgid: You carefully place the teeth on the ground, ready to be walked on by something passing by.
translations: 你小心地将牙齿放在地上，让它能被经过的东西压碎。

messages.msgid: A standard factory-made banjo.  Looks to be in working condition.
translations: 一把标准的工厂量产班卓琴。看起来还能正常使用。

messages.msgid: A polished bone flute with five finger holes.
translations: 一根经过精心打磨的骨笛，上面有着五个音孔。

messages.msgid: An ornate clarinet made from wood.
A traditional Finnish string instrument.  According to myth the first one was fashioned from a great pike's bone.  This ordinary wooden one doesn't seem quite as special.
translations: 一种芬兰传统的弦乐器。根据神话，第一把琴是用一根巨大的梭鱼骨头做成的。这把普通的木制版本似乎没有那么特别。

messages.msgid: A brass trumpet with only a few dents here and there.
translations: 一只黄铜制成的短号，仅仅有些擦伤。

messages.msgid: A small factory-made ukulele.  Makes you wish you were on a tropical island, or somewhere over the rainbow.
translations: 一家小工厂生产尤克里里。让你希望自己在一个热带岛屿上，或者彩虹之上的某个地方。

messages.msgid: A cheap, factory-made violin with a built-in holder for a bow.  Still produces a nice sound.
translations: 一把廉价的工厂量产小提琴，带有内置的弓架。依然能发出悦耳的声音。

messages.msgid: A shiny golden fiddle, with a strange aura around it.  You feel like it once belonged to the best there's ever been.
translations: 一把闪闪发光的金色小提琴，被某种奇怪的光环环绕着。你有种这玩意曾经属于某个伟人的感觉。

messages.msgid: A shiny golden krar, similar to a harp.
translations: 一把形似竖琴的闪闪发光的金羯啰。

messages.msgid: A wooden krar, similar to a harp.
translations: 一把木制卡拉琴，形似竖琴。

messages.msgid: A standard factory-made percussion drum.  Looks to be in working condition.
translations: 一个标准的工厂制造的打击鼓。看起来还完好能用。

messages.msgid: A handmade primitive percussion drum.  Looks to be in working condition.
translations: 一个手工制作的原始打击鼓。看起来还完好能用。

messages.msgid: A harmonica with a holder, so that you can play it without a free hand.
translations: 一只口琴，配有口琴架，你可以无需手持来演奏它。

messages.msgid: A simple wooden acoustic guitar with a strap so you can wear it around, even when not playing.
translations: 一个简易的民谣吉他，自带一条背带。即使在不弹奏的时候，你也可以穿着它到处走。

messages.msgid: A standard factory-made electric guitar.  It's probably better at smashing heads than melting faces, these days.  Has a strap.
translations: 标准的工厂制造的电吉他。这段日子，砸人头可能比融化脸要好。有一条背带。

messages.msgid: A traditional musical instrument, using enclosed reeds fed from a reservoir of air contained within a leather bag.  It has a strap so you can wear it around, even when not playing.
translations: 传统乐器，使用封闭的簧管发声，由装满空气的皮包提供空气。它有一条背带，即使不在演奏的时候，也能穿着它到处走。

messages.msgid: A big ol' tuba.  Much easier to play when you're wearing it.  Thankfully, this one has a harness attached.
translations: 一个大号的大号，穿在身上时更容易演奏。谢天谢地，这个上面已经安装有一条背带了。

messages.msgid: A brass alto saxophone with a neck strap, so you can wear it while playing.
translations: 一个黄铜制萨克斯管，配了一条背带。你可以把它穿起来演奏。

messages.msgid: A wire container made for transporting chickens, but you can use it to hold any tiny animal.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.
translations: 一个铁丝网制成的笼子，本来是用来抓鸡的，但也可以用来运输体型类似的动物。激活它后选择需要捕获的动物，或者选择空地放出笼中动物。

messages.msgid: A small whistle.  When blown into, it produces a high tone that causes nearby friendly dogs to either follow you closely and stop attacking, or start attacking enemies if they are currently docile.
translations: 一只小型的哨子，吹它的时候会产生一种高频的声波，让附近所有非敌对状态的狗狗都会向你靠拢并为你而战。

messages.msgid: A set of shears designed to obtain wool from sheep.
translations: 这是一把用来剪羊毛的剪刀。

messages.msgid: A set of heavy-duty shears designed to obtain wool from sheep.  Made of two steel blades connected by spring leaf.
translations: 用于剪羊毛的重型剪刀，由两片钢片以弹簧片连接而成。

messages.msgid: A set of forged single-piece bronze shears for cutting fabrics.  Made of two painstakingly sharpened blades connected by a carefully tempered twisted bridge.
translations: 这是一对锻造加工而成的青铜剪刀，用来剪切布料。由两片经过精心磨砺的刀片组成，并由一个经过精心回火的曲柄连接。

messages.msgid: Electric corded shears, used to quickly shear animals.
translations: 有线电动剪，用来快速给动物剪毛。

messages.msgid: A saddle, bridle, and associated tack that can be placed on a tamed animal that is capable of being ridden.
translations: 一个鞍座，一副缰绳，以及配套的各类马钉，能够装在已驯服的动物身上，让它供你骑乘。

messages.msgid: A giant electronic scale with a rubber mat meant for weighing a single horse, cow, or other large animal.  You could also weigh yourself with it.
translations: 一台巨大的电子秤，带有能承载马、牛等大型动物的橡胶板。你也能用它称量自己的重量。

messages.msgid: A plastic container meant to hold pets for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.
translations: 一个塑料笼子，可以用来运输小型宠物。激活它后选择需要捕获的动物，或者选择空地放出笼中动物。

messages.msgid: A wooden container meant to hold pets for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.
translations: 一个木制笼子，可以用来运输小型宠物。激活它后选择需要捕获的动物，或者选择空地放出笼中动物。

messages.msgid: A glass container meant to hold plants and/or insects.  They come in a variety of sizes.
translations: 一个用来盛放植物和/或昆虫的玻璃容器。有各种尺寸。

messages.msgid: Some enterprising survivor has decided to turn this terrarium into a light source, using what appear to be a giant firefly and triffid vegetation.
translations: 某个有进取心的幸存者决定用一只巨型萤火虫和三尖树植物把这个玻璃盆栽变成一个光源。

messages.msgid: A whistle carved out of hardwood.  When blown into, it produces a high tone that causes nearby friendly dogs to either follow you closely and stop attacking, or start attacking enemies if they are currently docile.
translations: 一只硬木雕成的哨子，吹它的时候会产生一种高频的声波，让附近所有非敌对状态的狗狗都会向你靠拢并为你而战。

messages.msgid: A remote control for an RC car, with a joystick to steer the car and colorful buttons that don't seem to do anything.  Perhaps they were for the deluxe model?
translations: 一个用来操纵遥控车的无线控制器，通过摇杆来控制车的移动，还有一堆用不到的按钮，或许是用来控制更高级的型号的。

messages.msgid: A remote-controlled car.  Fun for all ages.
A remote-controlled toy car.  It is turned on and draining its batteries just like a real electric car!  Use a remote control to drive it around.
translations: 这辆玩具遥控车已经开启，它已经被打开了，正跟正儿八经的电动车一样吃着电池！使用无线控制器来驾驶它。

messages.msgid: A small electronic device that can be attached to certain items to activate them with a radio signal from an RC car controller.
translations: 这枚小型电子元件可以被安装到某些物品上，使其可以在接收到无线控制器的信号后开启。

messages.msgid: A portable radio.  Using this radio turns it on.  It will pick up any nearby signals being broadcasted and play them audibly.
translations: 无线电，能够接受信号，并转化为声波。据说要是对准了信号塔，声音会格外响亮。

messages.msgid: A portable radio that is turned on and continually draining its batteries.  It is playing the broadcast being sent from any nearby radio towers.
translations: 这台无线电设备已经被启动，不停消耗着电池的同时不断向你播送着附近电台传出的资讯。

messages.msgid: A radio with a transmitting unit.  You could use it to contact someone who also has one.
translations: 一种带有发射单元的收音机。你可以用它来联系同样拥有它的人。

messages.msgid: A remote controller for a real car.  Can turn onboard devices on and off.  Some cars can be driven remotely.
translations: 一个真车的遥控器。可以打开和关闭机载设备。有些汽车还可以远程驾驶。

messages.msgid: A small birchbark funnel.  Place it above an outdoor container to collect rainwater.
translations: 一个小型桦皮漏斗。放置在室外的容器上来收集雨水。

messages.msgid: You place the birchbark funnel, waiting to collect rain.
translations: 你安置了桦皮漏斗，等待收集雨水。

messages.msgid: A plastic funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.
translations: 一个用来收集雨水的塑料漏斗。在户外激活该物品把它放在地上，然后在它下面放一个容器就可以收集雨水了。

messages.msgid: You place the funnel, waiting to collect rain.
translations: 你安置了漏斗，等待收集雨水。

messages.msgid: A small leather funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.
translations: 一个用来收集雨水的小型皮革漏斗。在户外激活该物品把它放在地上，然后在它下面放一个容器就可以收集雨水了。

messages.msgid: You place the leather funnel, waiting to collect rain.
translations: 你安置了皮革漏斗，等待收集雨水。

messages.msgid: A small makeshift funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.
translations: 一个用来收集雨水的小型自制漏斗。在户外激活该物品把它放在地上，然后在它下面放一个容器就可以收集雨水了。

messages.msgid: You place the makeshift funnel, waiting to collect rain.
translations: 你放置了简易漏斗，万事俱备，只待下雨了。

messages.msgid: A large metal funnel used to collect rainwater.  Less portable than plastic funnels, but collects more water.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.
translations: 一个用来收集雨水的大型金属漏斗。相较于塑料版更难移动，但能收集更多水。在户外激活该物品把它放在地上，然后在它下面放一个容器就可以收集雨水了。

messages.msgid: You place the metal funnel, waiting to collect rain.
translations: 你安置了金属漏斗，等待收集雨水。

messages.msgid: A collection of sticks and string with a tarpaulin to set up as an improvised raincatcher.
translations: 由一些棍子和绳子与防水油布所搭建的一个简易集雨器。

messages.msgid: You set up the raincatcher, waiting to collect water.
translations: 你设置了防水帆布集雨器，等待收集水。

messages.msgid: A plastic barometer that can read atmospheric pressure.
translations: 一个塑料气压计，可以让你知道当前气压。

messages.msgid: A metal canister with a label reading: "Warning: contains highly toxic and corrosive materials.  Contents may be sentient.  Open at your own risk." You think you can feel something moving inside it.
translations: 一个金属罐子，上面贴着个标签："警告：内含剧毒及极强腐蚀性物质！该物质具有自主意识！开启后果自负！"你感觉到里面有什么东西在动。

messages.msgid: A chemistry set stored in a box.  It includes glass containers, hoses, metal wire, a hotplate, and a pair of safety glasses.  It might be used to craft some chemistry projects if you're so inclined.
translations: 这是一整套装在盒子里的化学实验装置，包括一些玻璃器皿、软管、金属导线、加热板以及护目镜。如果你需要的话，它可用来制造化学用品。

messages.msgid: A basic chemistry set including glass containers, hoses, and a pair of safety glasses.  It might be used to craft some chemistry projects if you're so inclined, but you'll need a source of heat.
translations: 这是一整套基本的化学实验装置，包括一些玻璃器皿、软管以及护目镜。如果你需要的话，它可用来制造化学用品。这件物品需要热源。

messages.msgid: A set of wiring and electrodes for applying a direct current, usually to a liquid.  Useful for crafting.  Load with a storage battery or 12 V vehicle battery to use.
translations: 一整套能够进行直流电电解的线缆和电极设备，通常使用在液体上。可以用来制造物品。需要安装一个蓄电池或者 12 V 的载具电池配合使用。

messages.msgid: A section of glass pipe with a bulb in the middle, which contains an electrical heating element.  It is used for producing ketene via pyrolysis of acetone or 1,3-butadiene from cyclohexane, for use in other chemical reactions.  Due to the instability of ketene, it can't be stored and must be used immediately.
translations: 这是一段中间带有灯泡的玻璃管，其中包含一个电热器。它用于通过丙酮或环己烷中的1,3-丁二烯加热分解生产乙烯酮，用于其他化学反应。由于乙烯酮的不稳定性，它无法储存，必须随制随用。

messages.msgid: A kit with hundreds of pieces and dozens of blueprints for small engineering projects designed for beginner learners.  Explore mechanics and hydraulics!
translations: 内含数百个部件，以及数十张蓝图，搭建专为入门者设计的小型工程项目。探索机械和液压的奥秘！

messages.msgid: A complete robotics engineering system, for learning the basics of building and programming robots.  Using sensors, motors, a core controller, and hundreds of snap-together building pieces, you can follow the instructions to assemble 12 different robots.  The versatile parts also allow you to make robots according to your own designs.
translations: 一个完整的机器人工程系统，用于学习构建和编程机器人的基础知识。使用传感器、电机、核心控制器和数百个拼搭部件组合，你可以按照说明书组装12台完全不同的机器人。多功能部件还能让你根据自己的设计制造机器人。
斯特林发动机玩具套装

messages.msgid: A Stirling engine kit that demonstrates the principles behind the generation of electricity through the use of hot air.
translations: 一份斯特林发动机玩具套装，展示了热空气发电背后所蕴含的科学原理。

messages.msgid: A small 0.9 cubic foot vacuum oven used to purge residual solvents out of liquids and solids.  Looks kind of like a microwave.
translations: 一个体积为0.9立方英尺的小型真空炉，能够清除液体和固体中的残留溶剂。看起来有点像微波炉。

messages.msgid: A small closed loop extractor used for extracting essential oils from organic material, producing a high quality-extract.  It consists of a long metal tube clamped onto a steel "honey pot".  Organic material is packed in the tube, flushed with solvent, and essential oils gathered from the pot.  Must be powered up to operate.
translations: 一台小型闭环萃取器，能够从有机原料中提取精油，生产出高品质的提取物。它的主体由一个钢制"蜜罐"和固定在其上方的长金属管组成。将有机原料装入金属管中，用有机溶剂反复冲洗，然后从坩埚中收集精油。需要通电才能正常运行。

messages.msgid: A large machine used for extracting essential oils from large batches of organic material, producing a low-quality crude oil.  It consists of three long metal tubes funneled into a large drum that's set horizontally.  A series of hoses and tubes come out of the machine going to different valves.  It needs to be powered up to operate.
translations: 一台大型闭环萃取器，能够从大量有机原料中提取精油，生产出低品质的提取物。它由三根长金属管组成，这些金属管汇入水平放置的鼓形釜中。一系列软管和玻璃管从机器中伸出，通往不同的阀门。需要通电才能正常运行。

messages.msgid: A makeshift extraction system.  It's pretty much just a 55 gallon drum, a pipe to stir the solution, and a faucet at the bottom to drain the extractor.  Not the most ideal piece of equipment, but it will work.
translations: 一台自制精油萃取器。基本上就是个55加仑大桶，配上一根搅拌溶剂用的钢管以及底部一个用来排水的水龙头组成。不是最理想的设备，但也能勉强用。
催化裂解反应器（未组装）

messages.msgid: A makeshift extraction system, or as makeshift as you can consider something that was purpose-built in a laboratory by a group of experts.  Meticulously disassembled.  You can reassemble and plug it into your own power grid to use it.
translations: 一套临时的催化裂解系统，或者说是那种实验室的研究人员建造的临时制取装置。现在它被仔细地拆解开了，你可以将它装好并接入你的电网使用。

messages.msgid: A piece of filter paper for separating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 2 microns, separating more solids out than quantitative filter paper, but the process takes longer.  It's intended to be disposable, but you could probably use it for some time before it's unusable.
translations: 一片能将固体从液体中分离出来的滤纸。这种滤纸的过滤等级为2微米，比定量滤纸能分离出更多的固体，但这一过程需要更长的时间。它是一次性的，但你也许能够在完全失效前多次使用。

messages.msgid: A piece of filter paper for separating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 20 microns, separating less solids out than qualitative filter paper, but the process is much faster.  It's intended to be disposable, but you could probably use it for some time before it's unusable.
translations: 一片能将固体从液体中分离出来的滤纸。这种滤纸的过滤等级为20微米，不如定性滤纸所能分离出固体多，但这一过程耗时更短。它是一次性的，但你也许能够在完全失效前多次使用。

messages.msgid: A set of three plastic gaskets.  They're intended to be single-use, but you could probably use it for some time before they're too worn out to use.
translations: 一套三个的塑料垫片。它是一次性的，但你也许能够在完全失效前多次使用。

messages.msgid: A small belt-driven mechanical pump capable of achieving a vacuum of -29.99 hg (50 microns).
translations: 一台由小型皮带驱动的机械真空泵，能够达到-29.99汞柱（50微米）的真空。

messages.msgid: A medium-sized vacuum pump designed to recover solvent (hydrocarbons) from extracted essential oils.
translations: 一种从萃取的精油中回收溶剂（碳氢化合物）的中型真空泵。

messages.msgid: A makeshift appliance which decomposes water into oxygen and hydrogen via electrolysis of sodium hydroxide solution.  Much less energy-efficient than actual industrial equipment.
translations: 一台自制的通过碱性溶液电解将水分解成氧气和氢气的设备。能源效率远低于实际工业设备。

messages.msgid: A huge appliance built from salvaged industrial equipment, which produces ammonia via the Haber-Bosch process from hydrogen and nitrogen.  As it uses primitive catalysts for the reaction, energy efficiency is very low.  This one is powered by electricity.
translations: 一台巨大的设备，由回收来的工业设备制成，通过哈伯-博施法用氢气和氮气反应合成氨。由于使用较为原始的催化剂进行反应，能量效率非常低。这台是电力驱动的。

messages.msgid: A rather complicated system of thick-walled pipes, powerful compressors, and wiring, meant to interface with a reactor producing ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen via Haber-Bosch process.  It also acts as a power source for all the low-powered electrical components of the system.
translations: 一个相当复杂的系统，由厚壁管道、强大的压缩机和电线组成，用于连接氨反应器，通过哈伯-博施法用氢气和氮气合成氨。它还可以作为系统中所有低功耗电气组件的供电电源。

messages.msgid: A large makeshift appliance which captures nitrogen from the air for use in chemistry projects.  It includes a standard air filter for filtering out dust and other large particles, a deliquescent dryer to remove water vapor from air, and a nitrogen membrane filter to separate nitrogen from dry air.
translations: 一台自制的从空气中收集氮气用于化学反应的大型设备。它包括一个用于过滤灰尘和其他大颗粒物的标准空气过滤器，一个用于去除空气中水汽的潮解干燥器，以及一个用于从干燥空气中分离氮气的氮气膜过滤器。

messages.msgid: A tank of compressed butane.  Aside from its practicality as fuel, it can also be used to extract essential oils from organic material.
translations: 一个大型压缩丁烷罐。除了可以用作燃料以外，还可以用来从有机物质中提取精油。

messages.msgid: A tank of compressed hydrogen gas.  If you need to make water from scratch, or lift a zeppelin, it could come in handy.
translations: 一个压缩氢气罐。如果你需要从零开始制造水，或者让一架齐柏林飞艇升空，它可能会派上用场。

messages.msgid: A tank designed to hold high pressure gases.
translations: 一个设计用于容纳高压气体的储气罐。

messages.msgid: A plastic hygrometer that can read the relative humidity in the air.
translations: 一个塑料湿度计，可以让你知道当前相对湿度。

messages.msgid: A tank of compressed nitrogen gas.  Nitrogen is useful for its lack of reactivity.  Don't try to breathe it.
translations:
一个压缩氮气罐。氮气化学性质稳定，非常有用。
"警告：禁止口鼻接触。"

messages.msgid: A large steel cylinder used for storing pressurized gas.  It is marked with a faded, but legible O2 symbol.
translations: 一个用于储存高压气体的大型钢罐。上面有着一个依稀可见的 O2 标记。

messages.msgid: A metal grille with a layer of platinum plating, suitable for use as a catalyst for some chemical reactions.
translations: 一个带有一层铂金镀层的金属格栅，可在某些化学反应中当作催化剂使用。

messages.msgid: A rare, bizarre, and arcane device of an otherworldly nature.  It's giving you a headache just looking at it.  It is covered in alien markings.
translations: 一个罕见、奇异、不可思议的来自异界的装置。光是盯着它看上一会就会让你头疼。上面覆盖了各种奇特的陌生符号。

messages.msgid: A kit for a teleporter trap, consisting of a teleporter and a solar cell that is triggered when stepped upon.
translations: 这是一个由传送器和太阳能电池组成的传送陷阱，踩上去会触发它。

messages.msgid: An experimental device that will teleport you a short distance when activated.
translations: 一件实验性装置，激活后会将你传送一小段距离。
涡轮2000型全息多普勒气象分析仪

messages.msgid: A briefcase with a built-in laptop that looks like it's from the 80s.  Its vintage monochrome monitor displays a plethora of meteorological data.  No sign of the FLDSMDFR, however.
translations: 一个内嵌了一台笔记本电脑的公文包，电脑看起来像是80年代老电脑。它古董的单色显示器上显示着大量的气象数据。不过貌似它没法帮你找到什么超级食物制造机。（注：《美食从天降》）
基础实验室分析工具包

messages.msgid: A simple scale that uses a set of steel weights on sliding bars to measure a sample's mass quite accurately.
translations: 一个小型平衡称，使用一套钢制砝码以及滑条，能够精确测量样品的质量。

messages.msgid: A ubiquitous analytical chemistry tool that measures the light absorption of a liquid sample in a special tube called a cuvette.
translations: 一个十分常见的分析化学工具，用于测量液体样品在一种被称作比色皿的特殊试管中吸光率。

messages.msgid: A small box filled with precisely-calibrated square plastic tubes for laboratory spectrometer use.
translations: 一个小盒子，其中装满了精确校准的方形塑料管，供实验室光谱仪使用。

messages.msgid: A pair of glass probes attached to a voltmeter.  By putting one probe into a calibration solution (conveniently included) and the other in a substance, you can calculate the substance's acidity.
translations: 一个带着一对玻璃探针的电压表。通过将探针分别放入标准溶液（仪器已配套）和待测物质中，你可以测量物质的酸碱度。

messages.msgid: A device with two probes that let you measure the electrical potential between two points.
translations: 一个带有两个探针的装置，可以测量两点之间的电位。

messages.msgid: A gadget that is a little bigger than a handheld calculator, with a digital display and two pointed probes connected by wires.  It can measure not just voltage, but current in amps, and resistance in ohms, as well as test for electrical continuity.
translations: 一台比手持式计算器稍大一点的小工具，有个数字屏显和两根通过导线连接的探头。它不仅可以测量电压，还可以测量电流和电阻，还可以测试电气联通性。

messages.msgid: A hot plate with a metal housing attached.  The metal housing has a magnification viewport and a slot into which a capillary tube containing a crystallized sample is inserted.  The device lets you precisely measure the melting point of a crystal, a property very useful in identifying what it is and how pure it is.
translations: 一个电炉，外带一个金属外壳。金属外壳上有个带放大镜的观察口，以及一个能插入装有结晶样品的细试管的插槽。这个仪器可以让你精确测量晶体的熔点，可用于鉴定样品的纯度。

messages.msgid: A small, hefty, boring-looking machine.  Its weighted trapezoidal frame has a single on-off switch and a speed dial, and on top of it sits a rubber receptacle.  Pressing a test tube into the receptacle would, with power, rapidly shake and mix the contents of the test tube.  It's surprisingly fun to use.
translations: 一台小巧、笨重、看起来很无聊的机器。它的加重梯形框架上有一个独立开关和一个快速拨号盘，顶部有一个橡胶容器。将试管压入容器中，通电后会迅速摇晃并混合试管中的内容物。使用起来出人意料的有趣。

messages.msgid: A photodiode on a chip, designed to convert incoming light to electrical energy for quantification.
translations: 一个安装在芯片上的光电二极管，可以用来将入射光转换成电能并进行测量。

messages.msgid: A high-quality crystal glass prism for separating and redirecting light.
translations: 一个质量很好的水晶玻璃棱镜，用于分离并改变不同频率光的光路。

messages.msgid: A small glass tube.  Small, tube-shaped, and made of glass.
translations: 一个小的，管状的，由玻璃制成的，小玻璃管。

messages.msgid: A classic tool for the ages!  This hefty, durable piece of lab equipment makes small things look bigger.  Without electricity the light doesn't work, but the rest of it is surprisingly functional.  Unfortunately it's not useful for very much at the moment.
translations: 一个经典的工具！这件笨重耐用的实验室设备能让你更清晰地看到小东西。由于没有电，它的灯泡不能工作，但其余的功能却非常完好。不幸的是，事到如今它也没有太多用处了。

messages.msgid: This microscope has less magnification than a standard one.  It's also stereoscopic and produces a neat 3-D image of the surface.  It was typically used for performing dissections and other fine-detail work on small creatures.  It still works pretty well with an added light source, but what would you do with it?
translations: 这台显微镜的放大倍数比标准显微镜小。它也有立体视觉功能，可以生成表面清晰的三维图像。它通常用于对小生物进行解剖或其他精细的工作，添加附加光源后非常好用，但你会如何使用它？

messages.msgid: This thing doesn't look much like a funnel.  It's a teardrop-shaped piece of glass with a stopper at the wide end and a valve at the other.  It can be used to wash one liquid with another, like water and an oil, and then draw off whichever of the two liquids contains a higher amount of whatever compound you're trying to isolate.  With a high level of skill, it can also be used to make juvenile farting noises.
translations: 这东西看起来不像漏斗，更像一块泪珠状的玻璃，宽端有一个塞子，另一端有一个阀门。它可以用来分离一种液体和另一种液体，如水和油，然后抽出两种液体中你要离析的化合物。如果你的技术水平够高，它也可以用来制造幼稚的放屁声。

messages.msgid: A tall glass column with a stopcock at the end.  If you're serious about chemistry, you probably have a tattoo of one of these somewhere.
translations: 端部有旋塞的长玻璃柱。如果你是个对化学很认真的人，你可能在某个地方纹了一个这样的纹身。

messages.msgid: Just looking at this thing makes you feel like a proper mad scientist.  It's a series of glass tubes and round flasks, connected to a central motor and a heating element.  The heating element warms one flask, kept rotating by the motor, evaporating the contents.  The vapor is then condensed in the tubes and collected in another flask, in case you wanted to save it for later.
translations: 只要看看这东西，你就会觉得自己是个真正的疯狂科学家。一系列玻璃管和圆烧瓶连接到一个中央电机和一个加热器上。加热器加热一个烧瓶，电机使它保持转动，令内容物蒸发。然后，蒸汽在试管中冷凝，并收集到另一个烧瓶中，以备以后使用。

messages.msgid: One of the classic pieces of mad science glassware, this is a small-volume still that passes vapor through a fractional distillation column and then condenses the distillate in a cooled collection column.  A grad student or a robot (is there really any difference?) collects the distillate in fractions so that specific contents can be analyzed.  Going a few milliliters at a time, it would not be very effective to try to distill whiskey in this thing.
translations: 一件经典的疯狂科学玻璃器皿，基本上是一个小体积的蒸馏器，蒸馏物的蒸汽通过分馏塔，然后在一个冷却的收集塔中冷凝。研究生或机器人（真的有什么区别吗？）将蒸馏液收集起来，以便分析具体的成分。如果你用它来蒸馏威士忌，每次大概只能得到几毫升。

messages.msgid: A set of plastic trays, electrodes, and a power supply designed to create an electric voltage gradient through a liquid solution containing a solid gel.  Stuff like proteins and DNA would then get separated on the gel according to electrical charge and size.  Pretty useless now for anything but salvage.
translations:
一组塑料托盘、电极和电源，用于通过含有固体凝胶的液体溶液产生电压梯度。然后，像蛋白质和DNA之类的物质会根据电荷和大小在凝胶上分离。
"现在这只是可回收垃圾。"

messages.msgid: A smaller, benchtop version of the larger furniture-sized centrifuge.  Don't be fooled by its portable scale; it's still a very powerful piece of equipment that can spin stuff really quickly.  It's not a toy!
translations: 一个台式的大型家具大小的离心机的较小版本。别被它的便携式天平欺骗了，它仍然是一个非常强大的设备，可以快速旋转东西。这不是玩具！

messages.msgid: Stop giggling.  This is a tiny plastic valve, get your mind out of the gutter.
translations: 别笑了。这只是一个小塑料阀门，别往歪处想。

messages.msgid: A plastic box with holes in it.  Not that exciting, unless you're desperate for a place to store a test tube.  Then it's great.
translations: 一个上面有许多孔的塑料盒子。不是那么有用，除非你急着要找个地方存放试管，那它还挺有用。

messages.msgid: A plastic tray riddled with small holes, for storing microcentrifuge tubes.
translations: 布满小孔的塑料托盘，用于摆放微型离心管。

messages.msgid: A heavy metal plate and a sturdy rod, for clamping lab stuff to.
translations: 一个由一块重金属板和一根坚固的杆组成用于夹紧实验器具的工具。

messages.msgid: A small box with a jumbled assortment of clamps for mounting on ring stands.  There seems to be some sort of rule that all of them are missing at least one wing nut for tightening; twist ties, duct tape, and other random stuff has been used to compensate.
translations: 一个小盒子，里面有各种各样的夹具，可以安装在铁架台上。所有夹具的螺栓都至少缺少了一个用于拧紧的蝶形螺母，使用了扎带、强力胶带和其他物品来代替。

messages.msgid: A tool for measuring angles of distant objects.  It can be used for measuring the altitude of the sun.
translations: 一个用于测量远处物体角度的工具。它可以用来测量太阳的高度。

messages.msgid: You have a slight feeling of being watched.
translations: 你有种轻微的被人监视的感觉。

messages.msgid: You have an intense feeling of being watched.
translations: 你有种强烈的被人监视的感觉。

messages.msgid: You feel your aches and pains fade away!
translations: 你感觉你的疼痛消失了！
你立刻感觉自己更清醒了！

messages.msgid: Also called storm glass or 'Goethe barometer', The weather glass barometer consists of a glass container with a sealed body, half filled with water.  A narrow spout connects to the body below the water level and rises above the water level.  The difference between the sealed water level in the body and the narrow open spout determines the atmospheric pressure.  Activate to get current atmospheric pressure.
translations: 天气玻璃气压计，又称作风暴玻璃或歌德气压计，由一个装有一半水的密封玻璃容器组成。一个狭窄的喷嘴连接到容器下方的水线以下，并在水面之上延伸。容器内密封的水位与喷嘴中开放的水位之间的差异决定了大气压力。激活它以查看当前的大气压力。

messages.msgid: A small rectangular box.  Inside is a device that measures humidity by utilizing the hygroscopy of hair.  The hair's length changes with humidity as indicated on a dial.
translations: 一个小方盒子。盒子内部有一个装置，它通过利用头发的吸湿性来测量湿度。头发的长度会随着湿度的变化而在刻度盘上显示出来。

messages.msgid: A device used to measure temperature.  This one is made entirely of glass.  Mercury is used as its temperature sensor.  You could use this to get accurate information on current air temperature.
translations: 一个用于测量温度的设备，完全由玻璃制成，使用水银作为其温度传感器。 你可以使用它来获取有关当前气温的准确信息。

messages.msgid: A disassembled small shelter made of sticks and skins.  It's been damaged and needs to be repaired before you can set it up.
translations: 用树枝和兽皮做成的可拆卸的小棚子。它被损坏了，需要修理一下才能安装。

messages.msgid: A huge shelter made of sticks and skins, very bulky but with plenty of space.  This is broken and cannot be deployed.
translations: 一顶用木棍和毛皮做成的棚屋，很大，空间充裕。可惜它的龙骨已经断裂，不能再次撑开使用。

messages.msgid: A family sized tent in a storage bag.  It provides a large amount of space, but is very bulky.
translations: 一顶装在储存袋里的供全家出行使用的帐篷，可以提供大量的空间，但十分笨重。

messages.msgid: A disassembled small shelter made of sticks and skins.  Activate it to set it up.
translations: 一顶用木棍和皮革做成的破旧的小棚屋。使用它可以把它架设在地面上。

messages.msgid: A large disassembled shelter made of sticks and skins.  Activate it to set it up.
translations: 一顶用木棍和皮革做成的破旧的大棚屋。使用它可以把它架设在地面上。

messages.msgid: A small personal tent in a storage bag.  It's just big enough to fit one person comfortably.
translations: 一顶装在储物袋里的一个小的个人帐篷。它刚好大到可以让一个人舒服地躺在里面。

messages.msgid: A light, collapsible tent pole made from aluminum, perfect for pitching a tent.
translations: 一根由铝制成的轻型可折叠帐篷支架，非常适合用来搭建帐篷。

messages.msgid: An advanced, rechargeable electronic cigarette.  A less harmful way to get your nicotine fix than regular cigarettes, but still addictive.  It needs batteries and nicotine liquid to function.
translations: 电子香烟的高级可充版本。和普通香烟比起来摄取尼古丁的方式要柔和得多，不过照样会让你上瘾。需要电池和尼古丁浓缩液来运作。

messages.msgid: A fine glass tube with a bulb with a bowl on one end.  It's used to partake of certain illicit substances.
translations: 一根精致的玻璃管，一端带有球状膨大部和小碗形管头，用于吸食某些违禁物质。

messages.msgid: A hand-blown glass pipe.  It's commonly used to smoke recreational substances.
translations: 一根手工吹制而成的玻璃管，经常被用来吸食迷幻类植物制品。

messages.msgid: A mass-manufactured water pipe, otherwise known as a 'bong'.  Head shops often insist these are used solely for tobacco, despite their iconic status as cannabis paraphernalia.
translations: 一种批量生产的水烟壶，俗称“水烟斗”。烟具店经常强调这些东西只能用来抽烟草，尽管它早已成为抽大麻的标志性工具。

messages.msgid: A mass-manufactured water pipe, otherwise known as a 'bong'.  This one is made of plain, clear, glass.
translations: 一种批量生产的水烟壶，俗称“水烟斗”。这个是由普通、透明的玻璃制成的。

messages.msgid: A mass-manufactured water pipe, otherwise known as a 'bong'.  It is covered in copyrighted cartoon characters, all smoking marijuana.
translations: 一种批量生产的水烟壶，俗称“水烟斗”。上面印满了受版权保护的卡通角色，全都在抽大麻。

messages.msgid: A mass-manufactured water pipe, otherwise known as a 'bong'.  It is colored with the 'rasta' pattern of red, yellow, and green.
translations: 一种批量生产的水烟壶，俗称“水烟斗”。上面印有红、黄和绿色组成的拉斯塔图案。

messages.msgid: A handblown water pipe, also known as a 'bong'.  Lovingly crafted by an artisan, a true fusion of aesthetic sensibilities and stoner functionalities.
translations: 一款手工吹制的水烟枪，也被称为“水烟斗”。由工匠精心打造，真正融合了审美的情趣和“过瘾”的功能。

messages.msgid: A mass-manufactured water pipe, also known as a 'bong'.  It is covered in stickers depicting 'psychedelic' art.
translations: 一种大规模生产的水烟枪，也称为“水烟斗”。它被描绘“迷幻”艺术的贴纸所覆盖。

messages.msgid: A mass-manufactured water pipe, also known as a 'bong'.  It is made out of frosted glass.
translations: 一种批量生产的水烟壶，俗称“水烟斗”。这个是由磨砂玻璃制成的。

messages.msgid: A mass-manufactured water pipe, also known as a 'bong'.  Though it looks like it's made out of gold it is, in fact, just metallic paint.
translations: 一种批量生产的水烟壶，俗称“水烟斗”。虽然看上去像是黄金打造的，但实际上只是涂了层金属漆。

messages.msgid: A hand-carved wooden smoking pipe.  It's designed to facilitate the consumption of fire-cured tobacco leaves.
translations: 一根手工雕刻而成的烟斗，可以用来吸食烟叶。

messages.msgid: A desk tool for fastening sheets of paper together.
translations: 一种将纸张固定在一起的桌面用具。

messages.msgid: A metal tool that can punch a single hole in a piece of paper.  I mean, you could do more if you wanted, but you'd have to do them one at a time.  Or, if you really wanted more holes with one punch, I suppose you could fold the paper….  This is a one-cylinder hole puncher.
translations: 这个金属工具可以帮你在纸上打一个孔。多打几个也行，只要你肯一个一个来。或者，如果你真的非常想用它一次打好几个孔，也许可以把先纸折起来……总之它是一个单筒打孔器。

messages.msgid: A sterling silver letter opener resembling a small dagger, with a sharp point and no cutting edge.  It's used to open mail envelopes neatly and quickly.
translations: 一把像小匕首的纯银开信刀，有锋利的刀尖，但没有开刃。它能干净利落地拆开信封。

messages.msgid: A long pair of heavy-duty scissors.  You can use them to cut things such as fabric or plastic apart.
translations: 一把耐用的工艺长剪刀。你可以用它把织物或塑料之类的东西剪开。

messages.msgid: A pair of short scissors designed with kids in mind.  You can use them to cut things such as fabric or plastic apart, although they are probably subpar compared to other alternatives.
translations: 一把为孩子设计的短剪刀。你可以用它们来切割织物或塑料等东西，尽管与其他替代品相比，它们可能不太好。

messages.msgid: A pair of wavy artistic scissors.  You can theoretically use them to cut things but you should probably not get your hopes too high.
translations: 一把波浪形的艺术剪刀。理论上你可以用它们来切割东西，但你可能不应该抱有太高的希望。

messages.msgid: A fine metal pen, of much better quality than a disposable model.
translations: 一支很好的圆珠笔，质量比普通的一次性圆珠笔要好得多。

messages.msgid: A sharpened HB Number 2 graphite pencil, equipped with an eraser.
translations: 一支削尖的HB#2石墨铅笔，尾部配有橡皮擦。

messages.msgid: A disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Has the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This one is black.
translations: 一支一次性圆珠笔，提供流畅的书写体验。有着和那些一次性打火机相同的商标。这支笔是黑色的。

messages.msgid: A disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Has the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This one is blue.
translations: 一支一次性圆珠笔，提供流畅的书写体验。有着和那些一次性打火机相同的商标。这支笔是蓝色的。

messages.msgid: A disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Has the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This one is red.
translations: 一支一次性圆珠笔，提供流畅的书写体验。有着和那些一次性打火机相同的商标。这支笔是红色的。

messages.msgid: A disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Has the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This one is green.
translations: 一支一次性圆珠笔，提供流畅的书写体验。有着和那些一次性打火机相同的商标。这支笔是绿色的。

messages.msgid: A leather-back journal for preserving notes and maps, has a strap to keep loose pages contained.
translations: 一本用来保存各类笔记和地图的皮革日记本，有一条带子固定松散的书页。

messages.msgid: A thick, short bone, usually used in flintknapping for soft-hammer percussion.
translations: 一根粗短的骨头，通常用于当作软锤敲击燧石。

messages.msgid: A thick, short wooden stick, usually used in flintknapping for soft-hammer percussion.
translations: 一根粗短的木棍，通常用于当作软锤敲击燧石。

messages.msgid: A thick, blunted wooden stick.  Can be used to drill rough holes in rock, if water and sand are available, but the process is lengthy.
translations: 一根又粗又钝的木棍。如果有水和沙子，可以用来在石器上钻出粗糙的孔，但耗时很长。

messages.msgid: A thick, short bone with a small, pointy tip, usually used in flintknapping for indirect percussion and pressure flaking.
translations: 一根粗短的骨头，一端有个小尖头，常用于打制燧石时辅助敲打和修边。

messages.msgid: Two pieces of wood with a steel nail secured between them with some cordage.  Usually used in flintknapping for indirect percussion and pressure flaking.
translations: 两块木头之间用绳子固定着一根钢钉。通常用于打制燧石时辅助敲打和修边。

messages.msgid: A crude, sharpened bone awl, used for leatherworking before metal was discovered.  It can also serve as an improvised stabbing weapon, but will break quickly.
translations: 一个经过粗糙打磨成型的骨锥；早在人类发现金属之前就被用于制造皮革物品了。它也能够当作一把简易的刺击武器，但会很快损坏。

messages.msgid: A steel awl with a wooden grip, usually used for leatherworking.  It can also serve as an improvised stabbing weapon, but will break quickly.
translations: 一个带着木头手柄的钢锥，能够用于制造皮革物品。它也能够当作一把简易的刺击武器，但会很快损坏。

messages.msgid: A pair of stout wooden needles with round ends, used to turn thread and yarn into cloth.
translations: 一组结实的圆头木针，用来将线织成布。

messages.msgid: A rather bulky and primitive wooden frame which can be used to weave cloth sheets.  The process is very slow, though.
translations: 一个巨大且原始的织布用的木架，织布效率极低。

messages.msgid: A sharp needle made from a bone.  Useful for making rough clothing and items.  Its low quality makes it rather unsuitable for anything requiring speed or precision.
translations: 一根由骨头制成的锐利针头。可用来制造粗糙的简易服装和物品。它低劣的品质使它不适合用来制造任何需要精度或速度的物品。

messages.msgid: A curved, sharp needle made of steel.  Its rounded shape allows it to make stitches that only pierce one side of the material.  While unsuitable for most tailoring projects, it's a necessity for stitching neoprene.
translations: 一种钢制的弯曲的尖针。它的圆形的形状可以使它只穿透的材料的一侧。虽然不适合大多数的裁缝工作，但这是拼接氯丁橡胶的必需品。

messages.msgid: A wooden needle whittled down to a sharp point.  It has a narrow hole carved into the head for threading.  Its low quality makes it rather unsuitable for anything requiring speed or precision, or involving tougher materials like Kevlar.
translations: 一根削尖的木针，上面有个刻出来的穿线孔。它低劣的品质使它不适合用来制造任何需要精度或速度的物品，或者用于类似于凯夫拉的坚硬材质上。

messages.msgid: A stainless steel needle.  It would be useful for making clothing and items.
translations: 一根不锈钢针，可以用来缝制衣物或其它物品。

messages.msgid: A plastic kit with a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, small scissors, and a few other useful textile tools.  Use a sewing kit on an article of clothing to attempt to repair or refit if applicable.  This uses your tailoring skill.
translations: 一个塑料套件，里面有各种针、塑料线轴、小剪刀和其他有用的缝纫工具。在服装类物品上使用，可以尝试修理或定制该衣物。这会用到你的缝纫技能。

messages.msgid: A short, thin, flat wooden stick, used as a tool while weaving cloth with a frame loom.
translations: 一根细短的扁平木棍，和织布架一起用于织布。

messages.msgid: A treated animal hide that is undergoing the chemical processes required to become leather.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.
translations: 一张经过处理的动物皮，正在进行必要的化学变化以变成皮革。当它鞣制完成后你就可以激活它以展开并使用它。

messages.msgid: You carefully unfold the tanning leather hide and shake it clean.
translations: 你煞费苦心地展开鞣制中的皮革，把它抖干净。

messages.msgid: The tanning leather hide isn't done yet.
A treated animal pelt that is undergoing the chemical processes required to become fur.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.
translations: 一张经过处理的动物毛皮，正在进行必要的化学变化以变成毛皮。当它鞣制完成后你就可以激活它以展开并使用它。

messages.msgid: You carefully unfold the tanning fur pelt and shake it clean.
translations: 你煞费苦心地展开鞣制中的毛皮，把它抖干净。

messages.msgid: The tanning fur pelt isn't done yet.
A large set of tailoring patterns made from paper.  They're useful for making any kind of cloth or leather items from scratch, but are necessary for more advanced projects.
translations: 一大套纸制的缝纫用模板，可以用来从头制造布料或者皮革衣物，在更复杂的裁缝工作中更是必不可少。
