messages.msgid: A pair of heavy-duty shears suitable for cutting particularly tough materials, from polyaramid fabrics to tough plastics and thin metals.  The blades feature flat shearing edges and fine serrations.
translations: 一对坚固耐用的剪刀，能切开特别坚韧的材料，从聚胺纤维到硬塑料和薄金属板。刀片既具有平坦的剪切边缘也有细密的锯齿。

messages.msgid: A device for spinning thread or yarn from fibers.  This particular model is electrically-powered and easily portable.
translations: 用于将纤维纺织成纱线的装置。这种特殊型号是电动的，便于携带。

messages.msgid: A high-quality kit consisting of a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, scissors and shears, and an awl.  Use a tailor's kit on an article of clothing to attempt to repair or refit if applicable.  This uses your tailoring skill.
translations: 一个装着各种针、几个塑料绕线轮，各种类型的剪刀，以及一把锥子的高品质缝纫套件。你可以用它修复或定制你的衣服。它主要运用你的裁缝技能。

messages.msgid: A small bathroom scale, meant to weigh a person while naked.
translations: 一个小型的浴室秤，用来称一个人裸体时的体重。

messages.msgid: A simple scrub brush for cleaning hard objects.
translations: 一种简单的刷子，用于清洁坚硬的物体。

messages.msgid: A dish towel, useful for cleaning hard surfaces.
translations: 一条擦碗布，用于清洁坚硬的表面。

messages.msgid: An elegant, monogrammed dish towel.  Unfortunately, they aren't your initials.
translations: 一种优雅的带有花押的擦碗布。不幸的是，上面不是你的姓名缩写。

messages.msgid: An elegant, monogrammed dish towel.  It even has your initials!
translations: 一种优雅的带有花押的擦碗布。上面甚至有你的姓名缩写！

messages.msgid: A well-used dish towel, judging by the stains.
translations: 从污渍来看，一条用得很透的擦碗布。

messages.msgid: A novelty dish towel featuring a popular children's cartoon character.
translations: 一条新颖的擦碗布，上面画着一个受欢迎的儿童卡通人物。

messages.msgid: A novelty dish towel which reads "IT'S WINE O CLOCK".
translations: 一条新颖的擦碗布，上面写着"现在是酒点钟"。

messages.msgid: A dish towel with a floral pattern.
translations: 一条鲜花图案的擦碗布。

messages.msgid: A dish towel with a gingham pattern.
translations: 一条格子图案的擦碗布。

messages.msgid: A dish towel with a cat pattern.
translations: 一条猫咪图案的擦碗布。

messages.msgid: A pocket-sized electric trimmer made for cutting hair.  You can use it to cut your hair if it's supplied with batteries.  It requires 1 unit of charge per use.
translations: 一个小巧的电动理发剪。如果你有电池，你可以用它剪头发。每次使用需要1单位的电量。

messages.msgid: An unwieldy mop.  Good for cleaning up spills.  Use to mop up any 'mess' you may have made.
translations: 一把笨重的拖把。适合清理洒落的液体。使用它可以拖掉你可能制造的任何污渍

messages.msgid: A long, unwieldy mop with a collapsible handle for convenient transportation.  You may use it to clean up any 'mess' you have made.
translations: 一把又长又笨重的拖把，带有可折叠手柄，便于携带运输。使用它可以拖掉你可能制造的任何污渍

messages.msgid: A 6-inch square cotton patch, suitable for repairing and tailoring clothing.
translations: 一块约6英寸（约15厘米）见方的棉布片，可以用来修补或缝制衣物。

messages.msgid: A compact, lightweight shaving kit made for travelers.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.
translations: 一个为旅行者准备的紧凑、轻便的刮胡刀工具包。如果你有肥皂，你可以用它刮胡子。每次使用需要1单位的肥皂

messages.msgid: A cleaning aid made of soft, porous material.  Typically used for cleaning hard objects.
translations: 一块质地柔软多孔的清洁海绵，通常用来清洗硬质物品。

messages.msgid: A rectangular sponge with a green abrasive back.
translations: 一块带有绿色研磨面的矩形海绵。

messages.msgid: A dolphin-shaped sponge.  It looks at home in the water.
translations: 一块海豚形状的海绵。它在水里就像回到家一样。

messages.msgid: A sponge cake-shaped sponge, the abrasive pad looks like frosting.
translations: 一块蛋糕形海绵，看起来像结了霜一样。

messages.msgid: A sponge in the shape of a beloved character from a children's cartoon.
translations: 一块饱受大家喜爱的卡通人物形状的海绵。

messages.msgid: A kit containing various improvised tools for cutting hair.
translations: 一个理发套装，包括各种自制的理发工具。

messages.msgid: A makeshift shaving kit.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.
translations: 一把简易剃须刀。如果你有肥皂，你可以用它刮胡子。每次使用需要1单位的肥皂。

messages.msgid: A wooden washboard.  You can use it to wash filthy clothing if it's supplied with cleansing agent.
translations: 一块木制的洗衣板。如果你有肥皂，你可以用它洗脏衣服。每次使用需要消耗清洗剂。

messages.msgid: A combination of a washboard and a scrubbing tool.  Everything you need to clean items after the apocalypse.
translations: 洗衣板和洗刷工具组成的工具，这就是大灾变后洗涤所需的一切用具。

messages.msgid: A kit featuring all the tools needed to dye hair, including an applicator brush, combs, and plastic gloves.
translations: 一套包括染发所需的所有工具的工具包，包括涂抹刷、梳子和塑料手套。

messages.msgid: A spring-loaded pair of steel jaws connected to a sensitive pressure plate.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will ensnare and damage anything that steps on it.  If you are carrying a shovel, you will have the option of burying it.
translations: 一副弹簧驱动的钢制夹子，连着灵敏的压力板。布置在地面上做成陷阱，可以保证每个失足踩上来的家伙喝上一壶。如果你随身带着铁锹，你还能把它埋在土里。

messages.msgid: A simple loop snare, comprising a carefully wound loop of string, two anchor points, and a tool to hammer them in.  It is suitable for immobilizing only small animals.  It has no means of harming its target, as live meat lasts longer.
translations: 一种简单的套圈陷阱，由一根精心缠绕的绳环，两个锚点组成，并用工具将其敲入地里。它只适合抓捕小型动物，没有伤害能力，防止动物死亡导致肉快速变质。

messages.msgid: A machete attached laterally to a motor, with a tripwire controlling its throttle.  When the tripwire is pulled, the blade is swung around with great force.  The trap forms a 3x3 area of effect.
translations: 一把横向连接在电机上的砍刀，有一根拉绳连接油门。当拉绳被拉下，巨大的力量便会带动刀片形成3x3的杀伤性区域。

messages.msgid: You set the blade trap 2 squares away.
translations: 你在2格外设置了刀片陷阱。

messages.msgid: Several pieces of wood nailed together, with some nails sticking straight up.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on it, they'll get nails through the foot.
translations: 这是一块厚实的木板，其中一端上有几枚长长的钉子。你可以邀请你的敌人享受脚板的"愉悦"。

messages.msgid: You set the board trap on the %s, nails facing up.
translations: 你成功在%s上安装了钉板陷阱，当然钉子朝上。

messages.msgid: A crude explosive device triggered by a piece of string.  Use it to set it up and wait for some poor bastard to trigger it.
translations: 由一小截绊线触发的简易爆炸装置。激活它来安装，并等待某个可怜的小混蛋在经过时触发吧。

messages.msgid: You set the booby trap up and activate the grenade.
translations: 你设置了引信，然后激活了榴弹。

messages.msgid: A sheet of plastic covered with air-filled bubbles.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will warn you with noise when something steps on it.
translations: 一层充满气泡的塑料薄膜，如果有东西踩过它的话，会发出足够的响声以提醒在附近活动的你。

messages.msgid: You set the bubble wrap on the ground, ready to be popped.
translations: 你把泡泡卷铺在了地上，准备充气。

messages.msgid: A handful of small metal objects covered with many sharp points.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get a spine through the foot.
translations: 一些金属小刺猬，如果哪个倒霉蛋踩上去，就得担心破伤风的问题了。

messages.msgid: You scatter the caltrops on the %s.
A handful of glass shards glued together to expose all their sharp edges.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get cut.
translations: 这些碎玻璃片用胶水粘在一起，露出锋利的边缘。如果哪个倒霉蛋踩上去，就会被割伤。

messages.msgid: You scatter the glass caltrops on the %s.
A simple tripwire attached to the trigger of a loaded crossbow.  When the tripwire is pulled, the crossbow fires.  Only a single bolt can be used, after which the trap is disabled.
translations: 一种简易的绊线陷阱，把绊线接在一把已上弦并装填好的弩的扳机上。绊线一被拉动，弩就会射出弩矢。它只能使用一支弩矢，射出之后陷阱就会失效。

messages.msgid: A military anti-personnel fragmentation mine that is triggered when stepped on.
translations: 一个已经埋设好的军用反步兵破片地雷，一旦踩上就会爆炸。

messages.msgid: A simple tripwire attached to the trigger of a loaded double slam-fire shotgun.  When the tripwire is pulled, the shotgun fires.  Two shells are loaded; the first time the trigger is pulled, one or both shells may be discharged.
translations: 一种简易的绊线陷阱，把绊线接在一把已装填的双管撞击式霰弹枪扳机上。绊线一被拉动，霰弹枪就会击发。枪里装了两发霰弹；扳机第一次被触发时，可能会打出一发，也可能两发同时打出。

messages.msgid: A length of thin string with some affixing tools on either end.  It must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage to function.  Its purpose is to trip up trespassers, causing them to stumble and possibly hurt themselves slightly.
translations: 一个绊索陷阱，只能设置在门口或是狭窄的走廊。入侵者将触发它，将其绊倒的同时也可能造成轻微伤害。

messages.msgid: A handful of small impossibly-sharp teeth glued together.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get a tooth through the foot.
translations: 一把小而锋利的牙齿粘在一起。如果一个毫无戒心的受害者踩到了一颗，他们会把一颗牙齿穿过脚。

messages.msgid: You scatter the teeth caltrops on the %s.

translations: 一架被折叠起来的自行车。
一架被折叠起来的轮椅车。

messages.msgid: This rubber rowboat (with oars included) is deflated for storage.  Activate it with an air pump in your inventory to inflate and launch it.
translations: 这艘橡胶皮划艇被放掉气，折叠夹带船桨方便存放。你带着有打气筒时，可以激活将其充气并展开。

messages.msgid: A large, two-handed wood axe.  It makes a good melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.
translations: 巨大的双手木斧。是个优秀的近战武器，至于速度比较慢，请不要在意这些细节。

messages.msgid: A saw that is more at home outdoors than inside.  It's used for trimming trees, pruning, and cutting firewood, but may be used for other rough cuts as well.
translations: 一把弓锯，在户外使用起来比室内相比更施展得开。用于伐木、剪枝和砍柴，但也可用于其他不需要精细切割的场景。

messages.msgid: A treecutting tool moonlighting as a weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with gas, using this item will turn it on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.
translations: 一件便利的伐木工具，偶尔也作为武器使用。装填汽油之后，激活它来开启。威力巨大，不过难以掌控。

messages.msgid: With a roar, the chainsaw screams to life!
translations: 随着一声轰鸣，链锯猛烈的旋动起来！

messages.msgid: This chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 链锯已经启动，发出可怕的噪声。激活它来关闭。

messages.msgid: A lumbering tool intended for trimming hedges and tree branches at a distance.  If loaded with gas, using this item will cause it to turn on, making it into an unwieldy polearm.
translations: 用于远距离修剪树篱和树枝的伐木工具。如果装满汽油，使用此物品会使其开启，使其变成笨重的长柄武器。

messages.msgid: With a roar, the pole saw screams to life!
translations: 随着一声轰鸣，长柄锯猛烈地转动起来！

messages.msgid: This pole saw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 长柄锯已经启动，发出可怕的噪声。激活它来关闭。

messages.msgid: A lightweight, handheld cordless circular saw.  Spins a circular blade fast enough to cut wood, zombies, or in an emergency, pizza.  The blade, while effective in combat, is hard to hit with due to its small size.
translations: 一把轻便的手持无线圆锯，能够用来切木头、丧尸或者……呃，如果你等不及了的话，披萨。虽然刃片看起来能在战斗中起到很大作用，但体积太小，想用它打中敌人可不容易。

messages.msgid: With a loud buzz, the <npc_name> roars to life!
translations: 随着一声轰鸣，<npc_name>猛烈地转动起来！

messages.msgid: A lightweight, handheld cordless circular saw.  It is currently on and the blade is spinning; use this item to turn it off.
translations: 一把轻便的手持无线圆锯。它的刃片正高速旋转。激活它来关闭。

messages.msgid: A primitive axe made from a small wedge of copper affixed to a short haft.
translations: 一把原始的斧，楔形的铜质斧头下方装有较短的手柄。

messages.msgid: A socketed bronze axe with a work-hardened edge, tightly bound to the shaft with cords.
translations: 一把带銎的青铜斧，刃口经过加工硬化，斧头像用绳索紧紧地绑在斧柄上。

messages.msgid: A one-handed hatchet.  Makes a great melee weapon, and is useful both for chopping things and hammering them.
translations: 一柄单手的短斧，是一件不错的近战武器，也可以用于砍柴与捶打。

messages.msgid: A set of luthier tools in several sizes and types.  Guaranteed to have the right tools for creating musical instruments from wood.
translations: 一套有多种尺寸和类型的制琴师工具。保证拥有合适的工具来用木头制作乐器。

messages.msgid: A treecutting tool moonlighting as a weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with batteries, using this item will turn it on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.
translations: 一件便利的伐木工具，偶尔也作为武器使用。装填电池之后，激活它来开启。威力巨大，不过难以掌控。

messages.msgid: With a roar, the electric chainsaw screams to life!
translations: 随着一声轰鸣，电动链锯猛烈地转动起来！

messages.msgid: This electric chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.
translations: 电动链锯已经启动，发出可怕的噪声。激活它来关闭。
你的电动链锯隆隆作响。

messages.msgid: A treecutting tool moonlighting as a weapon of opportunity.  It has a short electric cord, which you can connect to the generator or your home grid.  Extension cord not included.
translations: 一种临时用作武器的砍树工具。它有一根短电线，你可以把它连接到发电机或家里的电网上。不包括延长线。

messages.msgid: With a roar, the corded electric chainsaw screams to life!
translations: 随着一声轰鸣，有线电锯尖轰鸣起来！
你的有线电锯隆隆作响。

messages.msgid: A broad piece of stone with an edge narrow enough to roughly chop wood.
translations: 边缘狭窄的宽阔石头，勉强可以用来砍树。

messages.msgid: A chunk of steel with one edge hammered down to something resembling a cutting edge.  It works passably well, but really can't compare to a proper axe.
translations: 一大块钢材，一边被锤成类似于刀刃的东西。它的使用效果还可以，但完全不能与一把真正的斧子相提并论。

messages.msgid: A stone adze, a primitive tool for smoothing or scraping wood objects.
translations: 石锛，用来削平木头的原始工具。

messages.msgid: A stone with a narrow edge affixed to a stick.  It can chop wood, but requires much more effort than a modern axe.
translations: 一块固定在棍子上的窄边石头。它勉强能砍木头，但比现代斧头要费劲得多。

messages.msgid: A thin saw, useful for cutting through wood objects.  Activate it to turn pre-cut logs into planks.
translations: 一把薄型锯，适用于切割木质物体。使用它可将预先切好的原木加工成木板。

messages.msgid: A short, primitive chisel made from hard stone, usually used for primitive woodworking.
translations: 一把用坚硬的石头做成的简易短凿，通常用于原始的木工制造。

messages.msgid: A pallet full of heavy mud bricks which need to dry slowly to be usable.
translations: 一个装满重泥砖的托盘，需要慢慢干燥才能使用。

messages.msgid: You test the bricks, and they're solid enough to use.
translations: 你试了试，这块砖似乎已足够结实可以使用。

messages.msgid: The bricks are still too damp to bear weight.
translations: 这块砖还太湿，承受不了重量。

messages.msgid: A pallet of humble mud bricks that have dried for a week while you were out risking your life.  Disassemble it to retrieve your frame and building supplies.
translations: 一堆简陋的泥砖，在你出去浴血奋战时，已经在这干燥一个星期了。拆解它来取回你的框架和建造材料。

messages.msgid: A bulky device that turns water and calcium carbide into unpressurized acetylene.
translations: 这个大型设备将水和电石反应，转化生成常压的乙炔气。

messages.msgid: A widespread power tool, often used for removing excess material or polishing surfaces.
translations: 这种广泛的电动工具经常用于去除多余的材料或抛光表面。

messages.msgid: A manufactured disc for an angle grinder, with a thin, abrasive edge designed for cutting metal.
translations: 一个用在角磨机上的量产圆盘，具有用于切割金属的薄研磨刃。

messages.msgid: A manufactured disc for an angle grinder, with a thick, abrasive surface designed for grinding and shaping metal.
translations: 一个用在角磨机上的量产圆盘，具有用于研磨和金属塑形的厚研磨表面。

messages.msgid: A portable coal-or-charcoal-fired kiln.  It is designed for firing bricks, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.
translations: 便携式砖窑，可使用木炭或煤炭作为燃料。专为烧制砖块而设计，但也可用于烧制其他粘土制品。

messages.msgid: A pair of toothy wooden paddles used to clean fibers for use in textile production.
translations: 一只有木齿的拨片，通常用于在纺织品生产中清理纤维。

messages.msgid: A homemade vacuum-forming machine with an air pump.  It's used for creating plastic molds.
translations: 一台带气泵的自制真空吸塑机。它能够用来制作塑料模具。

messages.msgid: A vacuum-forming machine with an air pump.  It's used for creating plastic molds.
translations: 一台带气泵的真空吸塑机。它能够用来制作塑料模具。

messages.msgid: A tool similar to a chisel, designed to remove paint.
translations: 一个类似凿子的工具，用来移除油漆。

messages.msgid: A metal clamp, useful for holding things in place, especially if you have several of them.
translations: 一种金属夹具，用于将物体固定在原位，尤其是在你同时使用多个时会非常有用。

messages.msgid: A small prying tool with a clawed bend at one end for pulling spikes.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.
translations: 一种小型撬棍，一端带有弯曲的爪状结构，用于拔出钉子。可以用它在不破坏门的情况下撬开上锁的门，或掀开下水道井盖。你也可以把它当作武器，用来敲碎僵尸的脑袋。

messages.msgid: A portable concrete mixer.  It is large and heavy, but it can be operated solo.  Unfold to use.
translations: 一台便携式的水泥搅拌机。虽然它又庞大又笨重，但是能够独自运行。展开来使用。

messages.msgid: A cordless battery-powered drill with a selection of drill bits.
translations: 一把使用电池供电的无线电钻，配有一套钻头。

messages.msgid: A black power drill with a selection of bits.  Uses a power cord, so it will have to be plugged into a power grid or vehicle to function.
translations: 一台配有各式钻头的黑色电动钻机。使用电源线供电，所以需要将其插入电网或车辆中才能运作。

messages.msgid: A cordless battery-powered impact wrench, designed to deliver high torque via an internal rotating hammer.  It comes with a standard set of sockets, and makes a loud ratcheting sound when it operates.  You could use it to turn large bolts or change a vehicle wheel.
translations: 电池供电的无绳式电动冲击扳手，内部旋转锤可以产生高扭力。配有一套标准的接头套筒，在运行时会发出响亮的棘轮声。 激活它可以转动更大号的螺栓，或者用于更换轮胎。

messages.msgid: A pair of specialized wooden rods used to spin fibers into thread and yarn.
translations: 一对儿特制的木杆，用来将纤维纺成线。

messages.msgid: A construction tool for drilling through hard rock or other surfaces.  It runs on a cell compatible with a UPS.  Use it to blast a hole in adjacent solid terrain.
translations: 一种能够钻穿坚硬岩石或其他表面的建筑工具。它靠UPS驱动，开启后，可以把附近的地面或者敌人钻出一个大洞来。

messages.msgid: A sturdy saw, useful for cutting through metal objects.
translations: 一把结实的锯子，适合用来切割金属物品。

messages.msgid: A pair of tin snips, resembling a sturdy pair of scissors with beefy blades designed to cut through thin sheets of soft metal.  These cannot cut through thick metals like a hacksaw can, but are better suited to precision work and leave a cleaner edge.
translations: 铁皮剪，看上去就像一把结实的剪刀。它具有坚固的刀片，可用于切割较软的金属薄板。它不能像钢锯那样锯切较厚的金属，但更适合精密加工，留下更干净的切边。

messages.msgid: A demagnetized steel claw hammer with a wooden grip.  With a hammer, nails, and planks in your inventory, you could board up adjacent doors and windows.  It has myriad other uses as well.
translations: 一把消磁的钢制羊角锤，有一个木头手把。使用铁锤、铁钉与木板就能够加固邻近门窗。此外它还有许多其他用途。

messages.msgid: A simple crude bronze hammer.  It is not as sophisticated or useful as its steel alternative but it does get the job of hammering in nails well enough.
translations: 一把简易青铜锤子。它不像钢制锤子那样精致实用，但拿来敲敲钉子够用了。

messages.msgid: A crude nail puller made of bronze.  Not really as good as its steel alternative but it gets job of pulling out nails good enough.
translations: 用青铜制成的简易的拔钉器。虽然没有钢制品那么好，但它可以很好地拔出钉子。

messages.msgid: A simple wood saw made of bronze.  Not as great as its steel equivalent, but it's good enough.
translations: 一把简易青铜木工锯。没钢制木工锯用的那么顺手，但也够用了。

messages.msgid: A primitive manual drill with a single drill bit.  It is slow to use, and will exhaust you quickly.
translations: 一种只有单种钻头的原始手摇钻。用起来相当慢，还会迅速耗尽你的精力。

messages.msgid: A flexible rubber hose.  It could be used for crafting or siphoning fuel from a vehicle.
translations: 一根柔软的橡胶软管。可以用来做东西或从载具中抽油。

messages.msgid: A portable hydraulic bottle jack used for lifting vehicles.
translations: 便携式液压瓶式千斤顶，用于起重车辆。

messages.msgid: A poorly-constructed improvised scissor jack used for lifting vehicles if you're brave enough to use it.
translations: 一个粗制滥造的剪式千斤顶，用于起重车辆，如果你敢用它的话。

messages.msgid: A compact scissor jack used for lifting vehicles.
translations: 紧凑的剪式千斤顶，用于起重车辆。

messages.msgid: A construction tool for drilling through hard rock or other surfaces.  It runs on gasoline.  Use it (if loaded) to blast a hole in adjacent solid terrain.
translations: 一种能够钻穿坚硬岩石或其他表面的建筑工具。它靠汽油驱动，使用它可以把附近的地面钻出一个大洞来。

messages.msgid: An electric kiln, powered by your electric grid.  It is designed for firing bricks, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.  With a little mechanical know-how, you could probably even convert it to run directly off a vehicle's power system.
translations: 一个使用电池供电的电窑，带有一个插头。原本设计用来烧制砖块，但你可以用它来烧制任何用黏土制品。如果会一些机械知识，你甚至可以把它改装为车载电源供电。

messages.msgid: A complete tool kit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires 1 charge of battery power per use.
translations: 一套完整的工具包，用于修复受损的枪支。它由标准电池供电，是长期维护枪支的重要工具。每次使用需要消耗电池电量。

messages.msgid: A crude hammer made from a piece of metal affixed to a stick.  It functions adequately, but really can't compare to a proper hammer.
translations: 一把粗糙的锤子，用一块金属固定在棍子上制成。虽然当锤子是勉强凑合了，但跟正规的还是没得比。

messages.msgid: A set of tools commonly used to remove small amounts of material from the surface of metal objects.
translations: 一把常用于去除金属物体表面少量的材料的工具。

messages.msgid: A tool that is most often used to smooth concrete or mortar in construction projects.
translations: 一把在建筑工程中常用于磨平混凝土或砂浆的工具。

messages.msgid: A portable tool kit consisting of a small craft knife for precise carving of replacement parts from raw materials, a wood saw for more heavy-duty wood cutting, and a patch of soft material for cleaning surfaces.  If supplied with duct tape, it can be used to repair certain items.
translations: 一个便携式工具包，包括用于从原材料中精确替换部件的小型刻刀、用于切割木材的耐用木工锯以及用于清洁表面的柔软布条。配合足够的强力胶带，可用于修复部分材质特殊的物品。

messages.msgid: A cleverly designed all-in-one tool which combines several smaller tools into the handles of a pair of pliers.
translations: 一个将许多小工具整合进钳子握柄造就的多功能工具。

messages.msgid: A 'Hideman' brand multi-tool.  This model includes extra options for outdoors use such as a firestarting rod, awl, rescue whistle and a hammering surface.
translations: 一把“Hideman”品牌的多功能工具。这款多功能工具包括户外使用的多重实用选项，如生火工具、锥子、救援哨子和锤头。

messages.msgid: A compact tool kit intended for welding and cutting metal, this portable oxygen-acetylene torch includes a torch handle and cutting attachment in an easy-to-carry tote.  It needs to be connected to a pressurized cylinder of an appropriate welding gas before use.  In addition to its metalworking uses, you can activate it in order to destroy metal barriers.
translations: 一个用于焊接和切割金属的小型工具包。这个便携式氧乙炔焊炬包含焊炬握柄和割炬附件并装入便携式手提包中。需要先连接到含有焊接气体的加压气罐才能使用。因为它的金工用途，你也可以激活它切割金属栅栏。

messages.msgid: A wide brush, suitable for painting walls.
translations: 一个大刷子，用来给墙刷漆而不是刷牙。

messages.msgid: A large steel pickaxe, suitable for breaking up hard things or (with enough skill) hard targets.  Strike the earth!
translations: 一把钢制大镐头，刨墙砸头两不误。劳动人民一声吼，地球也要抖三抖！

messages.msgid: A heavy-headed cast and worked tool with a pointed wedge on one side for breaking stone and a flat wedge on the other for prying it out.  You could mine with this.
translations: 一把整体铸造加工成型的头部大而沉重的工具，一端尖楔用来砸碎石头，另一端平楔用来撬出碎石。你可以用它挖矿。

messages.msgid: Handheld pin reamers of this kind are used to enlarge existing holes, or remove any burs and such from them.
translations: 这种手持式针铰刀用于扩大现有的孔，或从其中移除任何毛刺之类的东西。

messages.msgid: A basic pair of slip-joint pliers, able to handle basic mechanical work.  Anything more complex will require a wrench.
translations: 一把外形简单的鲤鱼钳，只能用来做一些基本的机械工作，再复杂一点的操作就需要用扳手了。

messages.msgid: A large pair of slip-joint pliers bent at the elbow, able to handle basic mechanical work.  Anything more complex will require a wrench.
translations: 一把弯头处弯曲的大型滑动鲤鱼钳，只能用来做一些基本的机械工作，再复杂一点的操作就需要用扳手了。

messages.msgid: A pair of pliers with extra-hefty jaws and an adjustable mechanism to clamp them in a locked grip on whatever unfortunate object is trapped between them.  They could grip and turn a fairly large bolt head, or clamp two parts together temporarily.
translations: 一把有个特别大的钳口的钳子，还有一个可调节的机构，可以将钳子夹在可锁紧的夹钳中，夹住任何被夹在钳子之间的不幸物体。它可以抓住并转动相当大的螺栓，或者暂时将两个零件夹在一起。

messages.msgid: An electric polisher, used to buff metal surfaces until they are reflective like a mirror.
translations: 一台电动打磨机，用来打磨金属地面，直到它们像镜子一样亮。

messages.msgid: A rock affixed to a stick in the crude facsimile of a hammer.  It functions adequately, but really can't compare to a proper hammer, and can't pull out nails either.
translations: 一个插着棒子的岩石，勉强构成锤子的形状。它功能类似锤子，但比真正的锤子差太多，而且没法用它拔出钉子。

messages.msgid: A battery-powered tool, commonly known by the generic trademark Sawzall, that uses an electric motor to push a straight sawblade back and forth to rapidly cut wood or metal.  It is useful for heavy demolition and construction work, but poorly suited to precision tasks.
translations: 一种以电池为动力的工具，通常也被称为军刀锯，它使用电动机往复驱动一根直锯，以快速切割木材或金属。它适用于大型拆除和建筑作业，但不适合干精细活。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty bag marked with the Hub 01 logo.  It contains space for barrels, adapters, and proprietary tools.  Embossed on the inside is a sketch of the Hybrid Weapons Platform.
translations: 一个印着Hub 01标志的沉甸甸的箱子。它包含用于放置枪管、适配器和专用工具的空间。内部压印出了混合武器平台的缩略图。

messages.msgid: A Philips-head screwdriver.  It is important for almost all electronics crafting, most mechanics crafting, and has many more uses.
translations: 一把十字螺丝刀，对制造电子产品和机械十分重要，而且还有许多其他用途。

messages.msgid: A set of screwdrivers in several sizes and blade types.  Guaranteed to have the right tools for more precise work.
translations: 一把有着多种尺寸和形状接口的螺丝刀。保证有正确的工具来进行更精细的工作

messages.msgid: A ratcheting screwdriver with a collection of hex sockets for turning small bolts or nuts, including a couple standard screwdriver bits.
translations: 一把套筒螺丝刀，带有一系列用于转动螺栓或螺母的六角套筒，包括一对标准螺丝刀头。

messages.msgid: A thick-handled ratchet wrench with an assortment of interchangeable sockets in common hex bolt sizes.  You could loosen or tighten fairly large bolts with this, and the ratchet makes a satisfying clicking sound.
translations: 一把厚柄齿轮扳手，带有各种通用六角螺栓尺寸的可更换套筒。你可以用这个松开或拧紧相当大的螺栓，齿轮能发出令人满意的咔嗒声。

messages.msgid: A portable tool kit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires one charge of battery power per use.
translations: 一套便携式工具包，用于修复受损的枪支。它由标准电池供电，是长期维护枪支的重要工具。每次使用需要消耗电池电量。

messages.msgid: A device with a metal tip that can get very hot.  It is necessary for advanced electronics crafting.  Has a short cable that you can plug to your grid.
translations: 一种金属尖头处可以产生高温的设备，制作高级电子产品的必备工具。带有一个插头。

messages.msgid: A device with a metal tip that can get very hot.  It is necessary for advanced electronics crafting.  This one is a portable version, and contains a slot for a battery.
translations: 一种金属尖头处可以产生高温的设备，制作高级电子产品的必备工具。这个是便携式的，有一个电池仓。

messages.msgid: A steel rod bent 90 degrees with a socket on the shorter end, made to hold the lug nuts of a car's wheels to either fasten or loosen for convenient removal and replacement.  Makes for a decent melee weapon in a pinch.
translations: 一根弯曲90度的钢棍，短端有一个套筒，用来固定车轮的凸缘螺母，以便拆卸和更换。在紧要关头时可以用来当作近战武器。

messages.msgid: A stout metal box for holding tools.  It has a handle on the top and a latch on the front.
translations: 一个结实的金属工具盒。它的顶部有一个把手，正面有一个插销。

messages.msgid: A stout metal box for holding tools.  It is much bigger than a regular toolbox, and can be used to store more tools as a result.
translations: 一个结实的金属工具盒。这一个比一般的工具盒都要大，也就是说里面可以存放更多的工具。

messages.msgid: A cable-powered tool for welding metal pieces together using an electric arc.  It is an indispensable tool for construction or repair.
translations: 一台带插头的焊机，用于金属电弧焊，是建造或修理不可缺少的工具。

messages.msgid: A crude arc welder fashioned from a few small transformers, some wire, an improvised electrode holder, and a complete disregard for personal safety.  While it's not as efficient as a factory-made welder, it will serve in a pinch.
translations: 简陋的电弧焊机，由几台小变压器、一些电线、一个临时制作的电极架组成，完全无视个人安全。它的效率不如工厂出品的标准焊机，但在必要时也不是不能用。

messages.msgid: A welder combined with a fireproof insulating blanket allows for advanced welds and repairs to tempered steels.
translations: 一套焊机与防火绝缘毯，可以对回火碳钢进行高级焊接和修复。

messages.msgid: A large makeshift tool used in smoothing concrete or mortar in construction projects.  You could also use it as an improvised head-basher.
translations: 这个大型自制工具通常用于在建筑时平整混凝土、抹平砂浆。你也可以拿它削别人的脑袋。

messages.msgid: A small, sharp knife, designed for making precise cuts for textiles or crafts.  It could cause decent damage, but is difficult to land a solid hit with.  Its small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.
translations: 小而锋利的刀，用于精确切割纺织品或工艺品。它可以造成相当大的伤害，但很难击中目标。小而锋利的刀刃熟练的人手中可以实现精确打击。

messages.msgid: A compact adjustable crescent wrench, with a short handle that fits in the palm of your hand.  It could be used for turning small hex-head nuts or bolts.
translations: 一把结构紧凑的新月形可调扳手，手柄很短，可放在手掌中。它可用于转动小型六角螺母或螺栓。

messages.msgid: An adjustable crescent wrench.  It is used in many mechanics crafting recipes.
translations: 一把新月形可调扳手。是许多机械制造的必备之物。

messages.msgid: An unusually large adjustable crescent wrench, with a long handle and jaws that widen over two inches.  This could easily turn most bolts, and should even work on wheel lug nuts.
translations: 一把非常大的新月形可调扳手，手柄很长，钳口约两英寸（约5厘米）宽。这样可以很容易地转动大多数螺栓，甚至可以转动车轮凸缘螺母。

messages.msgid: A 48in pipe wrench, normally used in oil fields and in the maintenance of public utilities.  It's much larger and heavier than you have any practical use for.
translations: 一把48英寸的管钳，通常用于油田和公共设施的维护工作。这玩意儿又大又沉，根本找不到任何能用上它的地方。

messages.msgid: A hose made of leather.  Watertight and flexible, it can be used to siphon fuel from a vehicle tank.  However, it's not as elastic as a rubber hose.
translations: 一根用皮革制成的软管。水密而且有弹性，可从车辆油箱中抽取燃油。但是它的弹性不如橡胶软管好。

messages.msgid: A makeshift manual drill made with a pipe and an improvised drill bit.  Using it is very slow, and will exhaust you quickly.
translations: 一个用铁管和原始手工钻头制成的简易手摇钻。转速非常缓慢，而且会迅速耗尽你的精力。

messages.msgid: A machine designed specifically for turning metal rods into wire.
translations: 一台专门用来把金属棒变成金属丝的机器。

messages.msgid: A compact tool kit intended for heating metal, this portable propane torch includes a torch handle and accessories in an easy-to-carry tote.  It needs to be connected to a pressurized propane cylinder before use.
translations: 一个用于加热金属的紧凑型工具包，这套便携式丙烷喷枪包括一个喷枪手柄和配件，都装在一个便于携带的工具包里。在使用前需要连接到一个丙烷加压气瓶上。

messages.msgid: A sturdy metal housing with a number of pulleys that can be used with a thick rope or a chain to gain mechanical advantage on a lift.
translations: 一套滑轮组，由坚固的金属外壳包裹住，可与粗绳或钢链一起使用，以获得起重时的省力优势。

messages.msgid: A wooden housing with a pair of pulleys that can be used with a thick rope or a chain to gain mechanical advantage on a lift.  Not as durable as a metal set.
translations: 一套滑轮组，由木制外壳包裹住，可与粗绳或钢链一起使用，以获得起重时的省力优势。不如钢制的版本坚固。

messages.msgid: A non-flammable mat used to protect surfaces from welding splatter, or to insulate a weld when repairing tempered metal.  This one is made with asbestos.
translations: 阻燃的衬垫，在焊接时可用于保护工作面免遭焊接飞溅的损害，或在修复回火金属时用于隔离焊缝。这一块是用石棉做的。

messages.msgid: A makeshift mostly-non-flammable mat used to protect surfaces from welding splatter or to insulate a weld when repairing tempered metal.  This one is stitched together from oven insulation batts.
translations: 粗制的阻燃垫，用于保护工作面免遭焊接飞溅的损害，或在修复回火金属时保证焊缝绝缘。其实就是缝在一起的烤箱绝缘垫。

messages.msgid: This is a set of a external thread cutting die inserted into a manual grip and an internal thread cutting die used as a drill bit.
translations: 一整套攻螺纹与套螺纹的工具，包括攻螺纹的丝锥，套螺纹的板牙等。

messages.msgid: A machine for separating seed from chaff.  It mechanized the winnowing process, in which the grain was separated from the lighter chaff and straw by blowing a leather bellows.
translations: 从谷壳中分离种子的机器。它机械化了簸扬过程，在这个过程中，通过吹一个皮革风箱将谷物与较轻的谷壳和稻草分开。

messages.msgid: A heavy, metal vise bolted down to a work surface.  With its jaws and screw, it can tightly hold items, useful for a wide array of handiwork such as soldering, woodworking, welding, anything that can be aided by a firm grip.  Also has a small, flat metal surface, useful for light metalworking if needed.
translations: 这是一种固定在工作台面上的重型金属虎钳，通过其钳口和螺丝机构，能紧紧夹持物品，对于需要稳固抓握的多种手工活非常有用，比如焊接、木工、焊接等工作。它还带有一块小而平坦的金属表面，必要时可用于轻型金工操作。

messages.msgid: An electric kiln, powered by your electric grid.  A bit larger than a refridgerator, this Exodii-manufactured kiln is large enough to repair the sheets of ceramic they use for armor.  It is designed for firing sheets of the Exodii's ceramic, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.  A large and power-hungry appliance.
translations: 一台由流亡族制造的巨型电窑，需要接入你的电网才能运作。它的体积比冰箱还大，而且是个十足的“电老虎”。其尺寸之大，足以修复流亡族用作护甲的陶瓷板。虽然其设计初衷是烧制流亡族的特种陶瓷，但你也可以用它来烧制任何黏土制品。

messages.msgid: A standard alternator used to power vehicle electrical systems.
translations: 一个用来给车上的电气系统供能的发电机。

messages.msgid: A compact, lightweight alternator used to power small vehicle electrical systems.
translations: 一个紧凑轻便的用来带动小型汽车电气系统的发电机。

messages.msgid: A very lightweight alternator used to power a bicycle's headlights.
translations: 一个非常轻便的用来给自行车车灯供能的发电机。

messages.msgid: A larger and more powerful alternator used to power vehicle electrical systems.
translations: 一个更强大的用来给车上的电气系统供能的大型发电机。

messages.msgid: A bar and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along.
translations: 一种将足够大的生物固定在轮式车辆上的杆和马具，允许它们拉动载具。

messages.msgid: Heavy steel beams and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along, reinforced to withstand the rigors of the apocalypse and ill-advised off-roading.  You would still need separate armor for said creature to wear.
translations: 加厚钢梁与鞍具，连接体型足够大的生物与有轮载具，利用生物的力量拉动前行。经过强化以应对末世条件下的严酷环境和崎岖的道路。你仍然需要另外的护具为上述的生物加装来提供防护。

messages.msgid: Several interlocked rods of rebar serving as makeshift armor, allowing for light and effective reinforcement of vehicle sections.
translations: 用几根互锁的钢筋棒充当自制装甲板，可以对载具部件进行轻而有效的加固。

messages.msgid: A makeshift combination of springs and scrap that protects a particular section of a vehicle from the shock of impacts.  The springs can absorb a surprising amount of damage.
translations: 由弹簧和废料结合而成的自制减震器，保护车辆的特定部分免受冲击。弹簧可以吸收大量的伤害。

messages.msgid: A 12 V lead-acid battery used to power car electrical systems.  Can also be plugged into a static power grid.
translations: 一个 12 伏铅酸蓄电池，通常用于一般车辆的电力系统。可以接入到家电电网中。

messages.msgid: A 12 V lead-acid battery used to power smaller vehicles' electrical systems.
translations: 一个 12 伏铅酸蓄电池，通常用于小型车辆的电力系统。

messages.msgid: A miniature 12 V lead-acid battery used to power smaller vehicles' electrical systems.
translations: 一个微缩版 12 伏铅酸蓄电池，通常用于小型车辆的电力系统。

messages.msgid: An empty case that can hold a storage battery, complete with a charging controller chip and connecting wires.
translations: 一个用来安装蓄电池的空箱子，包括充电控制芯片和连接线。

messages.msgid: An empty mount that can connect conventional batteries used in most handheld tools to a vehicular power grid.  It has a power converter, a charging controller chip, connecting wires, and a harness for securing a battery.
translations: 一个充电架，可将与常见手持工具兼容的传统充电电池连接到载具电网。配有电源转换器、充电控制芯片、连接线和用于固定电池的带子。

messages.msgid: A huge storage battery containing many lithium-ion cells.  Holds a tremendous amount of energy.  Could be installed into a storage battery case for easy removal from a vehicle, or just welded straight in.  Can also be plugged into a static power grid.
translations: 一个巨型蓄电池，由许多锂离子电池单元拼接而成。可以储存巨大的能量。可被安装到蓄电池箱上，便于快速拆卸，也可以直接焊接在载具上。可以接入到家电电网中。

messages.msgid: A medium storage battery containing multiple lithium-ion cells.  Can be plugged into a static power grid.
translations: 一个中型蓄电池，由数个锂离子电池单元拼接而成。可以接入到家电电网中。

messages.msgid: A small storage battery created with pre-Cataclysm lithium-ion technology.  Useful for crafting.  Can be plugged into a static power grid.
translations: 一个小型蓄电池，由大灾变前的锂离子技术制造而成。可以用来制造物品，或者接入到家电电网中。

messages.msgid: A large storage battery containing many lithium-ion cells.  Could be installed into a storage battery case for easy removal from a vehicle, or just welded straight in.
translations: 一个大型蓄电池，由许多锂离子电池单元拼接而成。可被安装到蓄电池箱上，便于快速拆卸，也可以直接焊接在载具上。

messages.msgid: A wooden board that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.
translations: 一个让船只保持浮力的木板。将其安装在载具上直到它浮在水上。继续添加桨或者引擎来移动船只。

messages.msgid: Logs tied together to make a vehicle float.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.
translations: 一根让船只保持浮力的原木。将其安装在载具上直到它浮在水上。继续添加桨或者引擎来移动船只。

messages.msgid: A rigid plastic sheet that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.
translations: 一个让船只保持浮力的硬质塑料板。将其安装在载具上直到它浮在水上。继续添加桨或者引擎来移动船只。

messages.msgid: A rigid carbon fiber sheet that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.
translations: 一张让船只保持浮力的坚固碳素纤维板。可多层加装到载具上直到浮起。然后可以加上桨或者引擎来为船只提供动力。

messages.msgid: A pair of oars for a boat.
An aluminum hull that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.
translations: 一块让船只保持浮力的铝板。将其安装在载具上直到它浮在水上。继续添加桨或者引擎来移动船只。

messages.msgid: A large wire basket from a shopping cart.
translations: 购物推车上用的大篮筐。

messages.msgid: A collection of pipes, cams, and straps, mounted on the edge of a vehicle and used to support another vehicle for transport.  It must be mounted on a vehicle to be used.
translations: 一套由各式钢管、凸轮和带子组成的装置，安装在载具边缘，可托起并运输一辆摩托车。它需要安装在载具上使用。

messages.msgid: A set of locks designed to be installed on a vehicle.
translations: 一套设计用于安装在载具上的锁。

messages.msgid: A large wire basket from a shopping cart, modified to be foldable.
translations: 购物推车上用的大篮筐，可以折叠。

messages.msgid: A simple bike basket.  It is small and foldable.
translations: 一个造型简单的自行车篮。体积很小而且可以折叠。

messages.msgid: A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo.
translations: 一个有着运载货物用的绳索和附着点的重型框架。

messages.msgid: A section of flooring with a cargo space beneath and a hinged door for access.
translations: 地板的一部分，下面的空间可以存放货物，通过一扇铰链门存取物品。

messages.msgid: A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo, with additional railings to keep a large animal in place.  It is meant to hold large animals for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.
translations: 一个有着运载货物用的绳索和附着点的重型框架，额外安装了用于固定大型动物的围栏，可以用来运输大型动物。激活它后选择需要捕获的动物，或者选择空地放出笼中动物。

messages.msgid: A spare tire mounted on a carrier rig, ready to be attached to the rear bumper of a vehicle.
translations: 备用轮胎已装入托架，可以安装在载具的后保险杠上。

messages.msgid: A locker used to contain animals safely during transportation if installed properly.  There is room for animal food and other animal care goods.  It is meant to hold medium or smaller animals for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.
translations: 一个用于安全运输动物的柜子，需要正确安装在载具上使用。内部有足够的空间供宠物活动和进食，可以用来运输中型和小型动物。激活它后选择需要捕获的动物，或者选择空地放出笼中动物。

messages.msgid: A set of small monitors.  Required to view cameras' output.
translations: 一组小型显示屏，有了这玩意才能看到摄像头拍了些什么玩意。

messages.msgid: A security camera you could connect to a display.  Image quality is quite low, but the field of vision is great.
translations: 一个可以连接显示屏的安防摄像头。视野广阔，但是图像质量很差。

messages.msgid: A security camera with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.
translations: 一个用铁框保护起来的安全摄像头，抗撞击又不降低可用性。

messages.msgid: A set of various vehicle controls.  Useful for crafting.
translations: 一整套用于控制载具的装置设备。可以用来制造物品。

messages.msgid: A set of leather bindings to control a mountable creature.
translations: 用来控制可骑乘生物的全套皮革缰绳和挽具。

messages.msgid: A vehicle instrument panel with various gauges and switches.  Useful for crafting.
translations: 一副具有各种仪表和开关的车辆仪表板。可以用来制造物品。

messages.plural: sets of drive by wire controls

messages.msgid: A fully electronic vehicle control system.  You could control it remotely if you had the proper tools.
translations: 纯电动的车辆控制系统，如果你有合适的工具，就可以远程遥控它。

messages.msgid: A set of servos, microcontrollers, and other devices, together capable of driving an unmanned vehicle.  Its AI is not functional, but it should still have some sort of maintenance mode.
translations: 一套伺服系统、微控制器和其它设备连接在一起可用于驾驶无人载具。里面的AI已经罢工了，但它应该还有一些维护功能。

messages.msgid: A set of motors, cameras, and various electronic modules banded together to allow for tracking targets, friend-or-foe identification, and firing the connected turret in full automatic mode.
translations: 一套由电机、摄像头及各种电子模块组成的炮塔控制模块，能够追踪目标，识别敌我，并以全自动模式发射其连接的炮塔。

messages.msgid: An accessibility tool for the paraplegic or very short, this is a simple pair of metal tubes that clamp to a vehicle's gas and brake pedals, allowing them to be operated by hand with the help of a trigger.
translations: 这是一种便于截瘫患者使用的工具，它是一对简单的金属管，夹在车辆的油门和刹车踏板上，可以在扳机的帮助下用手操作。

messages.msgid: These thick rubber pads can clamp securely onto a vehicle's gas and brake pedals, allowing even very short people to drive a car.
translations: 这些厚厚的橡胶垫可以牢牢地夹在汽车的油门和刹车踏板上，让非常矮的人也能驾驶汽车。

messages.msgid: It is probably not a great idea, but if you wanted to, you could tape these blocks to a vehicle's gas and brake pedals so that a kid or very short adult could drive.
translations: 这可能不是一个好主意，但如果你想，你可以把这些积木绑在汽车的油门和制动踏板上，这样孩子或很矮的成年人就可以开车了。
一个 50 毫升单缸四冲程内燃机。

messages.msgid: A high-compression, 200 cc single-cylinder 4-stroke combustion engine.
translations: 一个 200 毫升高压单缸四冲程内燃机。

messages.msgid: A high-compression, 150 cc single-cylinder 4-stroke combustion engine.
translations: 一个 150 毫升高压单缸四冲程内燃机。

messages.msgid: A high-compression, 200 cc single-cylinder 4-stroke diesel combustion engine.
translations: 一个 200 毫升高压单缸四冲程柴油内燃机。

messages.msgid: A small, 25 cc single-cylinder 2-stroke combustion engine.
translations: 一个 25 毫升单缸双冲程小型内燃机。

messages.msgid: An air-cooled, 4-cylinder, horizontally opposed internal combustion engine, rated for 150 horsepower.  Commonly used on light aircraft.
translations: 一台气冷水平对置四缸内燃引擎，额定功率为150马力。常用于轻型飞机。

messages.msgid: A small, 1600 cc 4-cylinder combustion engine, commonly called a straight-four.
translations: 一个 1600 毫升四缸内燃机，体积较小，也被称为直四。

messages.msgid: A small, yet powerful 4-cylinder diesel engine, commonly called a straight-four.
translations: 一个体积小功率大的四缸柴油内燃机，也被称为直四。

messages.msgid: A small, diesel powered one-cylinder, four-stroke air-cooled engine.
translations: 一款小型柴油发动机，单缸四冲程，采用风冷散热。

messages.msgid: An industrial-sized 6-cylinder diesel engine, commonly called a straight-six.  About as powerful as a V6 engine but significantly larger for use in heavy equipment.
translations: 工业级六缸柴油引擎，通常称为直六。与 V6 引擎一样强大，但体积要大很多，通常用于重型设备。
0.6 升 V 型双缸引擎

messages.msgid: A 600 cc, 2-cylinder 4-stroke combustion engine, commonly called a V-twin.
translations: 一个 600 毫升双缸四冲程内燃机，也被称为 V2。
一个大功率的六缸内燃机。
一个大功率的六缸柴油内燃机。

messages.msgid: A large and very powerful 8-cylinder combustion engine.
translations: 一个体积和功率一样强大的八缸内燃机。

messages.msgid: A large and very powerful 8-cylinder diesel engine.
translations: 一个体积和功率一样强大的八缸内燃柴油机。

messages.msgid: A massive and extremely powerful 12-cylinder combustion engine, usually built into high-end sports cars.
translations: 一台巨大而强劲的十二缸内燃机，一般用于高端跑车。

messages.msgid: A massive and extremely powerful 12-cylinder diesel engine, usually built into heavy trucks.
translations: 一台巨大而强劲的十二缸内燃柴油机，一般用于重型卡车。

messages.msgid: A small, primitive steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed-cycle system.
translations: 一台小型自制蒸汽引擎。一个内置的锅炉燃烧木炭将水加热变成蒸汽，带动一根往复轴。一个冷凝器回收冷却水，构成一个闭环系统。

messages.msgid: A small steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed-cycle system.
translations: 一台小型蒸汽引擎。一个内置的锅炉燃烧木炭将水加热变成蒸汽，带动一根往复轴。一个冷凝器回收冷却水，构成一个闭环系统。

messages.msgid: A medium-sized steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed-cycle system.
translations: 一台中型蒸汽引擎。一个内置的锅炉燃烧木炭将水加热变成蒸汽，带动一根往复轴。一个冷凝器回收冷却水，构成一个闭环系统。

messages.msgid: The beginnings of a massive gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.
translations: 巨型的汽油或柴油引擎设备的框架，不组装起来的话，单独一块并没什么用。

messages.msgid: The beginnings of a large gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.
translations: 大型的汽油或柴油引擎设备的框架，不组装起来的话，单独一块并没什么用。

messages.msgid: The beginnings of a medium gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.
translations: 中型的汽油或柴油引擎设备的框架，不组装起来的话，单独一块并没什么用。

messages.msgid: The beginnings of a small gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.
translations: 小型的汽油或柴油引擎设备的框架，不组装起来的话，单独一块并没什么用。

messages.msgid: The beginnings of a tiny gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.
translations: 微型的汽油或柴油引擎设备的框架，不组装起来的话，单独一块并没什么用。
25 升燃气涡轮发动机（650 马力）

messages.msgid: A gas turbine engine.  Used primarily for small helicopters.
translations: 燃气轮机引擎。主要用于小型直升机。
38 升燃气涡轮发动机（1900 马力）

messages.msgid: A large gas turbine engine, usually used for military helicopters.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption.
translations: 一种大型燃气涡轮发动机，通常用于军用直升机。以耗油率高而闻名。
119.5 升燃气涡轮发动机（6000 马力）

messages.msgid: A massive gas turbine engine, used to power the V-22 Osprey.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption.
translations: 一种大型的燃气涡轮发动机，用于为V-22鱼鹰提供动力。以耗油率高而闻名。

messages.msgid: A large, rigid steel boom.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 20 metric tonnes.
translations: 一个巨大而坚固的钢吊杆。安装到车架上后，可以用于起重不超过20吨的载具。

messages.msgid: A small, telescoping steel cantilever.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 3.5 metric tonnes.
translations: 一个小型钢制伸缩悬臂。安装到车架上后，可以用于起重不超过3.5吨的载具。

messages.msgid: A makeshift pallet lifter.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 0.5 metric tonnes.
translations: 一个自制的托盘升降机。如果固定到一个车架上它就可以用于起重不超过0.5吨的车辆。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy, jagged metal disc for digging trenches.
translations: 一个用于挖掘壕沟的巨大而沉重的锯齿状金属盘。

messages.msgid: An extendable metal pylon used to replace a portable jack.  If mounted to a vehicle, it could be used to lift it up.
translations: 一个可伸缩的带充气气囊的金属支架，能够替代便携式千斤顶使用。当安装在载具上时，可以使载具提升自身。

messages.msgid: A kickstand to keep a bike from falling over.  You could use this to lean a small vehicle forward or backward to change a tire.
translations: 一个用于防止摩托车侧翻的金属支撑脚架。安装后可将车辆前倾或者后倾以更换轮胎。

messages.msgid: An assembly of motors and sheet metal that allows a vehicle to clean the road surface by removing debris and contaminants.
translations: 由引擎和大块金属组装而成，能够允许车辆清除道路上的废墟及各类污染物。

messages.msgid: An assembly of tubes, spikes, and wheels that, when dragged along the ground, allows a vehicle to plant seeds automatically in suitably tilled land.
translations: 由各类管道，尖刺，和轮胎组装而成。当被拖行时，能够允许车辆自动在已经翻耕的土壤中播种。

messages.msgid: An assembly of a blade, wheels, and a small lever for engaging/disengaging, used to cut down crops prior to picking them up.
translations: 由各类刀片，轮胎，及一个小型升降机组成，能够割倒农作物并收集起来。

messages.msgid: An advanced electronic device used to cut down, collect, and store crops.
translations: 高级电子设备，用于割倒、收集并存储农作物。

messages.msgid: An assembly of tubes, spikes, and wheels that, when dragged along the ground, allows a vehicle to plant seeds automatically in suitably tilled land.  This one is equipped with an electronic control system and will avoid damaging itself when used on untilled land.
translations: 由各类管道，尖刺，和轮胎组装而成。当被拖行时，能够允许车辆自动在已经翻耕的土壤中播种。这一台装备了一个电子控制系统，当在未开耕的土地上使用时不会损坏。

messages.msgid: A heavy assembly of wheels and steel blades that turn up the ground.
translations: 一个由轮子及钢刀拼装而成的沉重部件，能够翻鬆泥土。

messages.msgid: A small, foldable lightweight frame made from pipework.
translations: 一个使用钢管制成的小型折叠轻型车架。

messages.msgid: A small, lightweight frame made from pipework.  Useful for crafting.
translations: 一个小型管材制做的车辆框架。可以用来制造物品。

messages.msgid: A small, foldable lightweight frame made from aluminum.
translations: 一个铝制的小型可折叠超轻型车架。

messages.msgid: A large frame made of steel.  Useful for crafting.
translations: 一个大的钢制框架。可以用来制造物品。

messages.msgid: A large, reinforced steel frame, used in military vehicle construction.
translations: 一个大型的钢筋框架，用于军用车辆制造。

messages.msgid: A large frame made of wood.  Useful for crafting.
translations: 一个用木头做的大框架。可以用来制造物品。

messages.msgid: A small, foldable frame made from scrap wood.
translations: 木材边角料制成的小型折叠框架。

messages.msgid: A small frame made of a few pieces of wood, held together by rope.  Useful for crafting.
translations: 一个由木片做的小框架，用绳子绑扎起来。可以用来制造物品。

messages.msgid: A small skateboard frame made of thin layers of wood glued together.
translations: 滑板的主体，由层叠的薄木板粘合制成。

messages.msgid: The chassis of a concrete mixer.
A bin for holding solid fuel.  Contains up to 50 liters of coal or charcoal.
translations: 一个装固体的燃料舱。最多可以装50L的煤炭或者木炭。

messages.msgid: A vehicle headlight to light up the way.
translations: 车载头灯，照亮前方的路。

messages.msgid: A motorcycle headlight to light up the way.
translations: 摩托车头灯，照亮前方的路。

messages.msgid: A wide-angle vehicle headlight to light up the way.
translations: 车载广角头灯，照亮前方的路。

messages.msgid: A vehicle headlight with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.
translations: 一个用铁制框架保护起来的车头灯，抗撞击又不降低可用性。

messages.msgid: A wide-angle vehicle headlight with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.
translations: 一个用铁制框架保护起来的广角车头灯，抗撞击又不降低可用性。

messages.msgid: A red light from the top of an emergency services vehicle.  When turned on, the light rotates to shine in all directions.
translations: 应急服务车辆车顶的红灯，打开后，灯光360度旋转闪烁。

messages.msgid: A blue light from the top of an emergency services vehicle.  When turned on, the light rotates to shine in all directions.
translations: 应急服务车辆车顶的蓝灯，打开后，灯光360度旋转闪烁。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy light designed to illuminate wide areas.
translations: 又大又重的灯，用来照亮大片区域。

messages.msgid: A large, heavy light designed to illuminate a wide area in a half-circular cone.
translations: 又大又重的灯，用来照亮大片半圆形区域。

messages.msgid: A set of hand rims for use on a wheelchair.
translations: 一套轮椅上用的环形铁圈。

messages.msgid: A pedal and gear assembly from a bicycle.
translations: 自行车的踏板和齿轮零件。

messages.msgid: A small turbine that can convert wind into electric power.
translations: 一台能将风能转化为电能的小型涡轮机。

messages.msgid: A large turbine that can convert wind into electric power.
translations: 能把风转化成电能的大型涡轮机。

messages.msgid: A water wheel that will slowly recharge electrical power when built over shallow moving water.
translations: 一个木制水轮机。当建在流动的浅水上时，可以进行缓慢的充电。

messages.msgid: A large water wheel with wooden supports.  It will recharge electrical power when built over shallow moving water.
translations: 一个木结构支撑的大型水轮机。当建在流动的浅水上时，可以进行发电。

messages.msgid: A standard electric motor.  Suitable for use in ultra-light vehicles.
translations: 一台标准的电力引擎。适用于超轻载具。

messages.msgid: A powerful electric motor, as found in those consumer electric sports cars with ridiculous or ludicrous acceleration options.
translations: 一台动力强劲的电力引擎，能用在最大加速度离谱夸张的的电驱运动跑车上。

messages.msgid: An extremely powerful electric motor.  This delivers massive torque and would be well suited to an electric racing car.
translations: 一台体积庞大、功率极强的电动机，以巨大的耗电量为代价提供极高的扭矩，非常适合电动赛车。

messages.msgid: A large electric motor.  Could be used to power a full-size car or SUV.
translations: 一台较大的电力引擎，能用来驱动全尺寸轿车或SUV。

messages.msgid: A light-duty electric motor.  Strong enough for an electric moped or golf cart.
translations: 一个轻量级电动引擎。驱动电动助力车或高尔夫球车那是绰绰有余。

messages.msgid: A small electric motor, suitable for powering a bicycle or a hedge trimmer.
translations: 一个小型电力引擎，能用来驱动自行车或树篱修剪机。

messages.msgid: A 1,300 horsepower 3-phase 60 Hz electric engine.  Normally used in trains.
translations: 一台1300马力三相60Hz交流电引擎。通常用于列车。

messages.msgid: A muffler from a car.  Useful in a few crafting recipes.
translations: 汽车引擎用的消音器。可以用来制造物品。

messages.msgid: A safety device intended to warn passersby of a vehicle moving in reverse.  Usage of it now seems terribly unwise.
translations: 一个倒车时用来警告路人的安全装置，但在目前环境下使用它似乎很不明智。

messages.msgid: A stereo system with speakers.  It is capable of being hooked up to a vehicle.
translations: 附带扬声器的音响系统。可以被连接于载具。

messages.msgid: A stereo system with loudspeakers and a built-in set of simple melodies that it will play.  Commonly used by ice cream trucks to draw the attention of children in the days when children wanted ice cream more than brains.
translations: 演奏内建简单旋律的立体声扬声系统。冰淇淋车常用它吸引孩子们的注意——在他们喜欢冰淇淋更胜于脑浆的时代。

messages.msgid: A bundle of planks prepared to be used as vehicle armor.
translations: 一块由木板拼装成的木制载具装甲板。

messages.msgid: A piece of vehicle armor plating made of steel.
translations: 一块由钢铁制成的载具装甲板。

messages.msgid: A piece of vehicle armor plating made of sturdy superalloy.
translations: 一块采用异常坚固的超合金制成的载具装甲板。

messages.msgid: A sheet of sturdy superalloy; incredibly hard, yet incredibly malleable.
translations: 一块坚固的超合金片，十分坚硬，也很容易锻造。

messages.msgid: A piece of vehicle armor plating made of steel.  It is covered with menacing spikes.
translations: 一块由钢铁制成的载具装甲板，在它上面覆盖着尖尖的钉刺。

messages.msgid: A piece of very thick vehicle armor plating made of tempered steel.  Can be used as a makeshift anvil.
translations: 一块很厚的回火碳钢载具装甲板。可以用作临时铁砧。

messages.msgid: A thick sheet of military-grade armor; the best bullet-stopper you can stick on a vehicle.
translations: 军用级装甲厚板，制造防弹载具的最好选择。

messages.msgid: A piece of light chitin plating made for a vehicle.
translations: 载具用轻型甲壳装甲板。

messages.msgid: A piece of durable silica-coated chitin plating made for a vehicle.
translations: 载具用硅化甲壳装甲板。

messages.msgid: A heavy block of steel used for balancing other heavy things.  Can be used as a makeshift anvil.
translations: 用于平衡其他重物的重钢块。可以用作临时铁砧。

messages.msgid: This menacing-looking attachment is meant to be powered by a vehicle's engine.  Upon doing so, the circular blades of this device will rotate rapidly; anything in front of it is likely to be ripped to shreds.  It is sturdy enough to withstand multiple impacts, and is designed to detach if it would take a hit that would break it.
translations: 这种带有旋转刀片的看起来很锋利的机器可以被连接到车辆的引擎上，然后带动锋利的旋转刀片旋转，切割面前的一切物体，使其变成一堆碎片。这种机器很结实耐用，还有过载分离机制以在承受到剧烈的撞击之前分离以保护机体。

messages.msgid: A forge rig made to run off a vehicle's storage battery, with integrated tool storage for metalworking equipment.
translations: 一种使用车载电源的锻造系统，有着集成的金属加工工具的储存箱。

messages.msgid: An electric kiln made to run off a vehicle's storage battery.
translations: 一个使用车载电源的电动窑炉。

messages.msgid: A welder combined with a fireproof insulating blanket, allowing for advanced welds and repairs to tempered steels.
translations: 一套焊机与防火绝缘毯，可以对回火碳钢进行高级焊接和修复。

messages.msgid: A set of four rotor blades from a military attack helicopter.
translations: 一套军用攻击直升机所使用的四叶旋翼。

messages.plural: sets of small civilian helicopter rotors

messages.msgid: A set of four rotor blades from a civilian light helicopter.
translations: 一套民用轻型直升机所使用的四叶旋翼。

messages.msgid: A soft car seat made from synthetic fabric.
translations: 由化纤织物制成的柔软汽车座椅。

messages.msgid: A soft car seat covered with leather.
translations: 覆盖有真皮的柔软汽车座椅。

messages.msgid: A wide, flat seat like you'd find in the back of a sedan, upholstered with soft nylon.
translations: 一个宽而平的座椅，就像你在轿车后座上看到的一样，垫着软面尼龙。

messages.msgid: A wide, flat seat like you'd find in the back of a sedan, upholstered with leather.
translations: 一个宽而平的座椅，就像你在轿车后座上看到的一样，垫着软面真皮。

messages.msgid: A leather-covered seat designed to be straddled.
translations: 一个由皮革制成的鞍形座椅，需要双腿跨着乘坐。

messages.msgid: An electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  Useful for a vehicle or a static power grid.
translations: 可以将太阳辐射能量转换成电能的电子设备。用于制造载具，或者接入家电电网之中。

messages.msgid: A collection of four solar panels, ready to get to work converting solar radiation into electric power.  Install them to use them in a static power grid.
translations: 一组由四块太阳能电池板组成的装置，随时都能开始将太阳辐射转换成电能。安装它们以便将其接入家电电网。

messages.msgid: This "little" solar panel folds up to carry around, in case you need to charge anything on the go.  Its small size means in might take quite some time to charge, however.
translations: 这个“说小其实也不算小”的太阳能电池板可以被折叠起来携带，以防你在旅途中需要充电。拜“小”所赐，充电可能需要相当长的时间。

messages.msgid: A large, ready-to-deploy set of solar panels, designed for portable off-the-grid use.
translations: 一套即设即用的大型便携式太阳能板，专为户外用电需求设计。

messages.msgid: A solar panel that has been covered with a pane of reinforced glass to protect the delicate solar cells from zombies or errant baseballs.  The glass causes this panel to produce slightly less power than a normal panel.
translations: 一块太阳能电池板，覆盖着一层强化玻璃，以免脆弱的太阳能电池被丧尸或者打歪的棒球破坏。玻璃保护层导致电池功率略有降低。

messages.msgid: An electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  This one is a high-performance type made with monocrystalline silicon cells.
translations: 可以将太阳辐射能量转换成电能的电子设备。这款高性能太阳能板是由单晶硅电池制成的。

messages.msgid: A collection of four smaller solar panels, ready to convert solar radiation into electric power.  These panels are high-performance, made with monocrystalline silicon cells.
translations: 一组由四块较小的太阳能板组成的太阳能板阵列，用于将太阳辐射转化为电能。这些电池板采用单晶硅电池制造，具有高性能。

messages.msgid: An advanced solar panel that has been covered with a pane of reinforced glass to protect the delicate solar cells from zombies or errant baseballs.  The glass causes this panel to produce slightly less power than a normal advanced panel.
translations: 一块高能太阳能电池板，覆盖着一层强化玻璃，以免脆弱的太阳能电池被丧尸或者打歪的棒球破坏。玻璃保护层导致电池功率略有降低。

messages.msgid: A small electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  This one is a common, inexpensive type made of polycrystalline silicon.
translations: 可以将太阳辐射能量转换成电能的小型电子设备。这是一种常见的、廉价的多晶硅电池。

messages.msgid: A small electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  This one is a high-performance type made of monocrystalline silicon.
translations: 可以将太阳辐射能量转换成电能的小型电子设备。这款高性能太阳能板是由单晶硅电池制成的。

messages.msgid: A very fancy table for those with fancy lives.  If times were better, it might be useful for something other than firewood.
translations: 一件为精致生活打造的奢华餐桌。若非时局艰难，它本可用于更体面的用途，而非仅仅作为柴火。

messages.msgid: A sturdy workbench made of metal and wood.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things, when unfolded.
translations: 一个用金属制成的坚固的工作台。当它展开时非常适合用来制造巨大而沉重的物品。

messages.msgid: A sturdy metal workbench, perfect for crafting large and heavy things.  It also has a built-in battery charger for your phone.
translations: 一个用金属制成的坚固的工作台。它非常适合用来制造巨大而沉重的物品。还内置了手机电池的充电器。

messages.msgid: A universal mount for weapons intended to be installed as turrets.
translations: 一个将武器安装为车载炮塔的通用炮塔底座。

messages.msgid: An aircraft's black box, seemingly pulled from some sort of military vehicle wreckage.  If you can find a system to analyze this, you may find something of interest.
translations: 这个黑匣子似乎是从军用载具的残骸里找到的。如果你能找到什么系统来分析一下这里面的东西，或许能找到什么有用的东西吧。

messages.msgid: A vehicle-mounted area cooler.  Install a muffler in another part of the vehicle to direct the exhaust heat to that location.
translations: 车载区域冷却器。在车辆的另一部分安装消声器，将废气的热量引导到该位置。
一个小型车载空间冷却器。
一个小型车载空间加热器。
一个挂有毛巾的毛巾架。

messages.msgid: A universal recharging station designed to operate on vehicle power.  While on, it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.  The system can only be installed onto existing storage compartments, and is controlled from a dashboard or electronics control unit.
translations: 一种使用车载能源的通用充电站。它会稳定地为直接放置在其存储空间内的所有可充电电池（蓄电池，铅酸电池等）充电。该系统只能安装在已有存储空间的位置上，并由仪表板或电子控制单元控制。

messages.msgid: A small device for recharging batteries, given a source of electricity.  It could easily be wired into a vehicle with power.  It will slowly charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.  It can only be installed onto existing storage compartments.
translations: 一个小型电子设备，通电后能够为电池重新充电。它看上去能很容易地接入车载电源系统中。它会稳定地为直接放置在其存储空间内的所有可充电电池（蓄电池，铅酸电池等）充电。该系统只能安装在载具中已有存储空间的位置上。

messages.msgid: A very small washing machine designed for use in vehicles.
translations: 一台非常小型的车载洗衣机。

messages.msgid: A computer system hooked up to the steering and engine of a vehicle to allow it to follow simple paths.
translations: 一套连接到载具的方向控制系统和引擎的计算机系统，能够控制载具进行简单的驾驶。

messages.msgid: This autoclave has been rigged to run off a vehicle power grid.
translations: 这个高压灭菌釜被改装过，可以使用载具上的电力来工作。

messages.msgid: A very small dishwasher designed for use in vehicles.
translations: 一台非常小型的车载洗碗机。

messages.msgid: A 60 L refrigerated tank for keeping liquids cool.  Provides some insulation from outside weather.
translations: 一个容量 60 升的冷藏罐，用于冷藏液体。能够稍微隔热，减少外界气温的影响。

messages.msgid: A 100 L refrigerated tank for keeping liquids cool.  Provides some insulation from outside weather.
translations: 一个容量 100 升的冷藏罐，用于冷藏液体。能够稍微隔热，减少外界气温的影响。

messages.msgid: A 60 L heated tank for keeping liquids from freezing.  Provides some insulation from outside weather.
translations: 一个容量 60 升的加热罐，用于防止液体冻结。能够稍微隔热，减少外界气温的影响。

messages.msgid: A metal faucet that can be attached to a water tank for easy access.
translations: 一个金属的水龙头，可以连接到水箱上，方便随时取水。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty press used to create vegetable oil from nuts or seeds.  It needs to be mounted on a vehicle due to its high power draw.
translations: 一台重型压榨机，用来从坚果或种子中提炼植物油。由于其高功率消耗，需要将其安装在载具上使用。

messages.msgid: A piece of wood with holes suitable for a bike wheel.
translations: 一块打了孔的木板，用于安装车轮。适合自行车轮。

messages.msgid: A piece of metal with holes suitable for a bike or motorbike wheel.
translations: 一块打了孔的金属板，用于安装车轮。适合自行车和摩托车轮。

messages.msgid: A metal assembly that allows bolting a wheel onto a car.  Fit for a car wheel.
translations: 金属制轮毂总成，可以将车轮栓接到汽车上。适合标准尺寸的车轮。

messages.msgid: A heavy metal assembly that allows bolting a wheel onto a car.  Fit for a large car wheel.
translations: 重型金属制轮毂总成，可以将车轮栓接到汽车上。适合大尺寸的车轮。

messages.msgid: A pair metal skateboard trucks, for attaching wheels to.
translations: 一对金属制的滑板轮架，用于安装滑板轮。

messages.msgid: A medium-size steel rim for a car tire.
translations: 一个常见于汽车轮胎的中等尺寸钢制轮毂。

messages.msgid: A steel rim for a motorbike tire.
translations: 一个常见于摩托车轮的钢制轮毂。

messages.msgid: A wide steel rim for a larger tire.
translations: 一个常见于大型轮胎的宽轮辋。

messages.msgid: A large, spoked rim for a bicycle tire.
translations: 一个常见于自行车轮的大号辐条轮毂。

messages.msgid: A standard 17" car tire for fitting to a medium steel rim.
translations: 一个常见的17英寸（约43厘米）汽车轮胎胎皮，可被安装到中型轮辋上。

messages.msgid: A slick 16" racing car tire for fitting to a medium steel rim.
translations: 一个光滑的16英寸（约41厘米）竞赛轮胎胎皮，可被安装到中型轮辋上。

messages.msgid: A 16" motorbike tire for fitting to a steel motorbike rim.
translations: 一个16英寸（约41厘米）摩托车轮胎皮，可被安装到摩托车轮辋上。

messages.msgid: A 20" off-road motorbike tire for fitting to a steel motorbike rim.
translations: 一个20英寸（约50厘米）越野摩托车轮胎皮，可被安装到摩托车轮辋上。

messages.msgid: A wide tire for fitting to a wide steel rim.
translations: 一个24英寸（约61厘米）宽轮胎胎皮，可被安装到宽轮辋上。

messages.msgid: A wide tire for fitting to a wide steel rim.  It's studded to provide better grip off-road at the cost of some performance on pavement.
translations: 一个24英寸（约61厘米）宽轮胎胎皮，可被安装到宽轮辋上。表面布满了钉状花纹，以牺牲部分公路行驶时的性能，换取了越野时更高的抓地力。

messages.msgid: A bicycle tire for fitting to a bicycle rim.
translations: 一个27英寸（约69厘米）自行车轮胎皮，可被安装到自行车轮辋上。

messages.msgid: A wide, studded bicycle tire intended to be fitted to a bicycle rim for off-road biking.
translations: 一个27英寸（约69厘米）自行车轮胎皮，可被安装到自行车轮辋上。更宽的胎面和表面的钉状花纹使它更适合越野环境。

messages.msgid: A car wheel.  It is currently deflated and will need to be inflated to be used on a vehicle.
translations: 一个17英寸（约43厘米）汽车轮胎。目前被放掉了气，需要重新充气后才能安装到载具上。

messages.msgid: A wide, smooth wheel intended for racing.  It is currently deflated and will need to be inflated to be used on a vehicle.
translations: 一个光滑的16英寸（约41厘米）竞赛用宽轮胎。目前被放掉了气，需要重新充气后才能安装到载具上。

messages.msgid: A motorbike wheel.  It is currently deflated and will need to be inflated to be used on a vehicle.
translations: 一个16英寸（约41厘米）的摩托车轮。目前被放掉了气，需要重新充气后才能安装到载具上。

messages.msgid: A motorbike wheel, studded for improved off-road performance.  It is currently deflated and will need to be inflated to be used on a vehicle.
translations: 一个20英寸（约50厘米）的摩托车轮。表面布满了钉状花纹，拥有更好的越野性能。目前被放掉了气，需要重新充气后才能安装到载具上。

messages.msgid: A wide wheel.  \o/ This wide.  It is currently deflated and will need to be inflated to be used on a vehicle.
translations: 一个24英寸（约61厘米）宽轮胎。\o/ 有这么宽。目前被放掉了气，需要重新充气后才能安装到载具上。

messages.msgid: A wide wheel.  \o/ This wide.  It's studded to provide better grip off-road at the cost of some performance on pavement.  It is currently deflated and will need to be inflated to be used on a vehicle.
translations: 一个24英寸（约61厘米）宽轮胎。\o/ 有这么宽。表面布满了钉状花纹，以牺牲部分公路行驶时的性能，换取了越野时更高的抓地力。目前被放掉了气，需要重新充气后才能安装到载具上。

messages.msgid: A bicycle wheel.  It is currently deflated and will need to be inflated to be used on a vehicle.
translations: 一个27英寸（约69厘米）自行车轮。目前被放掉了气，需要重新充气后才能安装到载具上。

messages.msgid: A wide, studded, bicycle wheel intended for off-road biking.  It is currently deflated and will need to be inflated to be used on a vehicle.
translations: 一个27英寸（约69厘米）自行车轮。更宽的胎面和表面的钉状花纹使它更适合越野环境。目前被放掉了气，需要重新充气后才能安装到载具上。

messages.msgid: A wide, smooth wheel intended for racing.  The slick surface provides better speed on pavement but penalizes off-road speed.
translations: 一个光滑的竞赛用宽轮胎。轮胎表面平整光滑，以牺牲部分越野时的速度，换取了更快的公路行驶速度。
一个军用级别的宽轮胎。

messages.msgid: A small wheel from a common garden wheelbarrow.
translations: 一个装在园艺手推车上的小型车轮。

messages.msgid: A wide, studded bicycle wheel intended for off-road biking.
translations: 一个自行车轮。更宽的胎面和表面的钉状花纹使它更适合越野环境。

messages.msgid: A set of small wheels mounted on pivots, like you'd find on a rolling office chair.
translations: 一组安装在枢轴周围的小型脚轮。你可以在滑轮办公椅上找到类似的脚轮组。

messages.msgid: A set of medium wheels mounted on pivots, like you'd find on a shopping cart.
translations: 一组安装在枢轴周围的中型脚轮。你可以在购物车上找到类似的脚轮组。

messages.msgid: A set of large rubber wheels mounted on pivots, like you'd find on small industrial equipment.
translations: 一组安装在转轴上的大型橡胶轮，类似于小型工业设备上使用的那种。

messages.msgid: A strong rail wheel.  A flange helps keep it on a rail, but makes it perform terribly when not on a rail.
translations: 一个坚固的轨道轮。凸出的轮缘有助于车轮卡着轨道行进，但脱离轨道的行进性能就十分糟糕。

messages.msgid: A pair of small rail wheels.  It fits small railroad rails found in places like amusement parks.  Mostly for hobby purposes rather than transportation.
translations: 一对窄轨火车车轮。它适合用在游乐园等地的观光窄轨铁路上。主要是为了观光游乐，而不是运输货物。

messages.msgid: A motorbike wheel, studded for improved off-road performance.
translations: 一个摩托车轮。表面布满了钉状花纹，拥有更好的越野性能。

messages.msgid: A large cylinder fashioned out of thick plates of hardened steel, normally found on road rollers.  Numerous massive spokes, attached to a central axis, reinforce its structure even further, making it an unstoppable force once it starts rolling.
translations: 用淬火后的厚硬钢板做成的大筒，通常用在压路机上。许多又粗又长的辐条连接到中心的长轴上，更进一步的加固了它，使它开始滚动的时候恐怕只有钢铁侠敢站在它前面。

messages.msgid: A pretty small wheel.  Probably from one of those Segway things.  It is not very menacing.
translations: 一个比较小的车轮。大概是从那种体感车上拆下来的，总之不太可靠。

messages.msgid: A very small plastic wheel with a punk attitude.  This wheel was made for skating.
translations: 一个很小的塑料轮子，看上去很有朋克精神。可以在滑冰鞋上找到。

messages.msgid: A set of four small wheels, for a skateboard.
translations: 四个一组的小型滑板轮。

messages.msgid: A set of hard plastic wheels with one larger than the other two.  Proudly made in the USA by Double Dango Productions.
translations: 一套硬塑料轮子，其中一个比另外两个大。由美国双丹戈公司出品。

messages.msgid: A pair of wheels for a wheelchair.

translations: 一只宽车轮。\o/ 有这么宽。

messages.msgid: A wide wheel.  \o/ This wide.  It's studded to provide better grip off-road at the cost of some performance on pavement.
translations: 一个宽车轮。\o/ 有这么宽。表面布满了钉状花纹，以牺牲部分公路行驶时的性能，换取了越野时更高的抓地力。

messages.msgid: A handmade wooden cart wheel with metal bands for durability.
translations: 在手工木制车轮外加上了金属箍圈，使其更加耐用。

messages.msgid: A set of two small wheel mounts from a concrete mixer.
translations: 混凝土搅拌器上，两个一组的小轮架。

messages.msgid: A set of two small wheels from a concrete mixer.
translations: 混凝土搅拌器上，两个一组的小滚轮。

messages.msgid: This item is used to make a hole for a crater.  It should not otherwise appear in game.
translations: 这个物品用来炸出弹坑。它不应该出现在游戏中。

messages.msgid: The severed leg of a void weaver, turned into some macabre ornament.
translations: 虚空编织者的断肢，变成了某种可怕的装饰。

messages.msgid: the drone scans for your ID badge.
translations: 无人机扫描了你的访问授权钥匙卡。

messages.msgid: Your hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: Your black hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的黑色头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: Your blond hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的金色头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: Your blue hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的蓝色头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: Your brown hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的棕褐色头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: Your gray hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的灰色头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: Your green hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的绿色头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: Your pink hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的粉色头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: Your purple hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的紫色头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: Your red hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的红色头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: Your white hair has been shaved close to the head.
translations: 你的白色头发被剪短到紧贴头部。

messages.msgid: You have long hair, swooping over one eye.
translations: 你有一头长发，面前的刘海遮住了一只眼睛。

messages.msgid: You have long black hair, swooping over one eye.
translations: 你有一头黑色长发，面前的刘海遮住了一只眼睛。

messages.msgid: You have long blond hair, swooping over one eye.
translations: 你有一头金色长发，面前的刘海遮住了一只眼睛。

messages.msgid: You have long blue hair, swooping over one eye.

translations: 你蓬蓬的红色头发被绑成两个丸子。

messages.msgid: White hair tied into two puffs.
translations: 你蓬蓬的白色头发被绑成两个丸子。
你的黑色头发由饰珠装点。
你的金色头发由饰珠装点。
你的蓝色头发由饰珠装点。
你的棕色头发由饰珠装点。
你的灰色头发由饰珠装点。
你的绿色头发由饰珠装点。
你的粉色头发由饰珠装点。
你的紫色头发由饰珠装点。
你的红色头发由饰珠装点。
你的白色头发由饰珠装点。
两条非常长的黑色辫子。
两条非常长的金色辫子。
两条非常长的蓝色辫子。
两条非常长的棕色辫子。
两条非常长的灰色辫子。
两条非常长的绿色辫子。
两条非常长的粉色辫子。
两条非常长的紫色辫子。
两条非常长的红色辫子。
两条非常长的白色辫子。

messages.msgid: Black hair for the better princess.
Blond hair for the better princess.
Blue hair for the better princess.
Brown hair for the better princess.
Gray hair for the better princess.
Green hair for the better princess.
Pink hair for the better princess.
Purple hair for the better princess.
Red hair for the better princess.
White hair for the better princess.
Hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型。

messages.msgid: Black hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型，黑发。

messages.msgid: Blond hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型，金发。

messages.msgid: Blue hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型，蓝发。

messages.msgid: Brown hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型，棕发。

messages.msgid: Gray hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型，灰发。

messages.msgid: Green hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型，绿发。

messages.msgid: Pink hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型，粉发。

messages.msgid: Purple hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型，紫发。

messages.msgid: Red hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型，红发。

messages.msgid: White hair for lawyers and crime solvers.
translations: 律师和侦探的经典发型，白发。
你有一头自然的黑色长发。
你有一头自然的金黄色长发。
你有一头自然的棕色长发。
你有一头自然的灰色长发。
你有一头自然的红色长发。
你有一头自然的白色长发。

messages.msgid: Your hair will naturally grow out into various forms, getting longer over time.  Turning this off will prevent it from growing and changing.
translations: 你的头发会自然地长成各种形状，随着时间的推移会变得越来越长。关闭此功能将阻止其生长变化。

messages.msgid: Your beard will naturally grow out into various forms, getting longer over time.  Turning this off will prevent it from growing and changing.
translations: 你的胡须会自然生长成各种形态，并随着时间的推移而变长。关闭此选项将阻止其生长和变化。

messages.msgid: You have a matrix in your central nervous system that acts as a universal control and installation bus for compact bionic modules.
translations: 你的中枢神经系统中被植入了一个矩阵，作为紧凑型生化插件的通用控制和安装总线。

messages.msgid: Your brain and some of your organs are shielded in a nice tough bipedal walker frame.
translations: 你的大脑和一些重要器官被保护在一台结实的双足机器人中。

messages.msgid: Your brain and some of your organs are shielded in a shiny gold bipedal walker frame.
translations: 你的大脑和一些重要器官被保护在一台金光闪烁的双足机器人中。

messages.msgid: Taking this mutation will allow you to talk to the Exodii Merchant Rubik and ask to travel to the early playtest version of the Labyrinthine Structure, an in-development dungeon set inside an alternate dimension.  This version is still very low on content, but your early feedback is highly valued!
translations: 获得此突变后，你将可以与外来者商人鲁比克交谈，并请求前往“迷宫结构”的早期试玩版本。这是一个仍在开发中的、位于另一维度的地下城。该版本的内容还非常少，但我们非常重视你的早期反馈！

messages.msgid: There's a symbol etched into your skin.  Somehow you implicitly understand that it is a type of password, it just looks like a tattoo, though how you know this isn't clear.  The symbol itself is your own face, with a clever smirk.
translations: 你的皮肤上蚀刻着一个符号。不知为何，你下意识地明白这是一种密码，尽管它看起来就像一个纹身，但你并不清楚自己为何会知道这一点。这个符号本身就是你自己的脸，带着一抹狡黠的假笑。

messages.msgid: There's a symbol etched into your skin.  Somehow you implicitly understand that it is a type of password, it just looks like a tattoo, though how you know this isn't clear.  The symbol itself looks like bird wings, circling around themselves in an ouroboros-like shape.
translations: 你的皮肤上蚀刻着一个符号。不知为何，你下意识地明白这是一种密码，尽管它看起来就像一个纹身，但你并不清楚自己为何会知道这一点。这个符号本身看起来像一对鸟翼，以衔尾蛇般的姿态盘绕成环。

messages.msgid: There's a symbol etched into your skin.  Somehow you implicitly understand that it is a type of password, it just looks like a tattoo, though how you know this isn't clear.  The symbol itself is of a stylized hand dragging its fingernails down a piece of sheet metal, leaving five deep gouges.
translations: 你的皮肤上蚀刻着一个符号。不知为何，你下意识地明白这是一种密码，尽管它看起来就像一个纹身，但你并不清楚自己为何会知道这一点。这个符号本身是一只风格化的手，正用指甲划过一块薄钢板，留下了五道深深的刻痕。

messages.msgid: There's a symbol etched into your skin.  Somehow you implicitly understand that it is a password, not a tattoo, though how you know this isn't clear.  The symbol itself is of a handsome man's face, laughing.  At first glance it appears charming and friendly, but the longer you examine it, the more it appears to be inhumanly cold and cruel.  It fills you with a feeling of dread that seems to originate from outside your own mind.
translations: 你的皮肤上蚀刻着一个符号。不知为何，你下意识地明白这是一个密码，而不是纹身，但你并不清楚自己为何会知道这一点。这个符号本身是一张英俊男人的笑脸。乍一看，它显得迷人而友好，但你审视得越久，就越觉得它透着非人的冰冷与残忍。它让你心中充满了一种似乎源自你意识之外的恐惧。
你有一双淡褐色的眼睛。
你有一双琥珀色的眼睛。

messages.msgid: You have a dark brown skin tone.
You have a light peach skin tone.
You have a light brown skin tone.
You have a rosy pink skin tone.
You have a bronze or tan skin tone.
You have no hair on your face, it is shaven or simply untouched by the presence of hair.
translations: 你的脸上没有毛发。它被剃干净了，或者你原本就没有胡子。

messages.msgid: You have a short beard at the tip of your chin.
translations: 你的下巴尖有一把短胡子。

messages.msgid: You have a mustache and a short beard, that both form a circle around your lips.
translations: 你的胡子在你的嘴唇周围长成了一个圆圈。

messages.msgid: You have a mustache and a short beard forming a patch under your lips.
translations: 你的嘴唇下面有一块短胡子。

messages.msgid: You have a mustache and a beard starting with a strip going down from the bottom lip, then tracing the jaw lines.  It looks a bit like an anchor, thus the name.
translations: 你有一个小胡子，胡须从下唇开始，沿着下颚线向下延伸。它看起来有点像一个锚，因此得名。

messages.msgid: You have a mustache and a short beard with trimmed sides.  Thin patches connect them both, forming a 'box' around the lips, thus the name.
translations: 你留着小胡子和短胡须，旁边修剪过。薄胡茬将两者连接起来，在嘴唇周围形成一个"盒子"，因此得名。

messages.msgid: You have a mustache that covers your entire top lip.
translations: 你的整个上唇上都长着小胡子。

messages.msgid: You have a short trimmed mustache and beard imitating a 3-day stubble.
translations: 你有一个修剪得很短的小胡子和模仿胡茬生长三天的长度的胡须。

messages.msgid: You have a mustache with patches going down the chin from both ends, thus the name.
translations: 你的小胡子两头从下巴往下垂，成马蹄铁状，因此得名。

messages.msgid: You have a mustache with shortened ends, that covers only the skin above your upper lip.
translations: 你的胡须末端很短，只覆盖上唇以上的皮肤。

messages.msgid: You have long sideburns that connect to your mustache, with the tip of the chin shaven clean.
translations: 你留着长长的胡子，下巴尖剃得很干净。

messages.msgid: You have a horseshoe mustache and disconnected sideburns.
translations: 你有马蹄形的小胡子，和鬓角不相连。

messages.msgid: You have a short beard in a form of a vertical patch under your bottom lip.
translations: 你的下嘴唇下面有一个直直的小胡子。

messages.msgid: You have a full beard without a mustache, restricted to the chin, sometimes called a 'lion's mane'. Much like Abraham Lincoln's beard.
translations: 你留着浓密的下巴胡须，但没有上唇的胡须，有时被称为“狮子鬃毛”。就像亚伯拉罕·林肯的胡子。

messages.msgid: You have a beard along the jaw lines, circling the chin, and no mustache.
translations: 你的胡须沿着下巴的线条，环绕着下巴，没有小胡子。

messages.msgid: You have a mustache and a long beard, both formed by allowing free growth of hair, with no particular styling.
translations: 你有一个小胡子和一把长胡须，两者都是由头发自由生长形成的，没有特别的造型。

messages.msgid: You have a mustache with long flared out ends.
translations: 你有一把长而展开的胡子。

messages.msgid: You have a beard formed from hair grown on neck below the chin line.  No mustache included.
translations: 你留着下巴到脖子之间的胡须，但是没有小胡子。

messages.msgid: You have a very thin mustache just above the line of the upper lip.
translations: 你的小胡子很薄，刚好在上唇的上方。

messages.msgid: Long full beard with no mustache, popular among Amish community, often with two pointed ends.
translations: 长而覆盖广的胡须，没有胡子。在阿们宗派中很受欢迎，通常有两个尖头。

messages.msgid: You have patches of hair in front of your ears, that normally would connect your hair with the beard, but they are here by themselves.
translations: 你的耳朵前面有些鬓角毛发，一般来说，它会让你的头发和胡须相连，但它们是单独存在的。

messages.msgid: You have a little bit of hair in the dip under your lower lip, and no other facial hair whatsoever.
translations: 你的下唇下面留着一点胡子，其它地方没留胡须。

messages.msgid: Charlie Chaplin used to have this short patch of hair just under the nose, but then that other guy used it as a characteristic, and it became unwelcome.
translations: 查理·卓别林曾经在鼻子下面留的一种短胡形式，但后来另一个名人把它作为一种特征，使得它变得不再受欢迎。

messages.msgid: You have a handlebar mustache with a chin strip or a small goatee.
translations: 你留着八字胡，下巴剃光或留一点小山羊胡。

messages.msgid: You have a long thick mustache, overshadowing your lips, that somewhat resembles the facial hair of a walrus.
translations: 你长着浓密的胡须，遮住了嘴唇，看上去像海象。

messages.msgid: You have a wide soul patch and a full mustache that extends a bit downwards at the corners of your lips.
translations: 你有一个宽宽的下唇胡和一个完整的小胡子，延伸到你的嘴唇的角落再往下一点。

messages.msgid: You have a long beard, that goes down to your chest.  Somewhat reminiscent of Santa's mustache.
translations: 你的胡子很长，一直垂到胸前。有点让人想起圣诞老人的胡子。

messages.msgid: You have a very long beard, that goes down to your waist, like wise old mentors have.
translations: 你的胡子很长，一直垂到腰部，就像睿智的老师傅一样。
你感觉到变异正在消失。

messages.msgid: You feel much closer to nature.  Your breath and thoughts slow.
translations: 你感觉自己更接近自然。你的呼吸和思维变慢了。

messages.msgid: You hear buzzing, and feel your body harden.
translations: 你听到嗡嗡声，感觉你的身体变硬。

messages.msgid: You feel insidious, and your vision fragments for a moment.
translations: 你感觉自己需要潜伏，视野有一阵子碎裂开来。

messages.msgid: Your body loses all rigidity for a moment.
translations: 你的身体失去了一会儿控制。

messages.msgid: You are overcome by an overwhelming longing for the ocean.
Your split lower body starts to come back together.
translations: 你分裂的下半身开始恢复。
你感觉到一阵短暂的恶心。

messages.msgid: Your heart races and you see blood for a moment.
translations: 你看到血感到心跳加速。

messages.msgid: You feel an urge to… patrol?  The forests?
translations: 你突然想去……巡视领地？在森林里？

messages.msgid: Your back arches and the hair stands up on the back of your neck.
translations: 你的背部拱起，头发从脖子后面披散下来。

messages.msgid: You feel an urge to mark your territory.  But then it passes.
translations: 你有一种标记领地的冲动，不过很快就消失了。

messages.msgid: Your mind and body slow down.  You feel peaceful.
translations: 你的思想和身体都慢了下来。你感觉平静祥和。

messages.msgid: Your mind is overcome by images of eldritch horrors… and then they pass.
translations: 各种光怪陆离的影像压向了你，你感到恐惧……但它们很快消失了。

messages.msgid: Your body lightens and you long for the sky.
translations: 你感觉到你的身体变轻，你渴望着蓝天。

messages.msgid: For a heartbeat, your blood cools down.
translations: 有如心跳般的瞬间，你的血液变冷了。

messages.msgid: Like a tadpole you must transform.
translations: 就像蝌蚪一样，你必须改变。

messages.msgid: You yearn for a cool, dark place to hide.
translations: 你渴望隐藏在一个凉爽、黑暗的地方。
你觉得……好多了。不知何故。

messages.msgid: You can feel the blood rushing through your veins and a strange, medicated feeling washes over your senses.
