translations: 你感觉到血液在你的血管中四处奔涌，一股奇特的磕了药的感觉洗涤了你的感官。

messages.msgid: You need to roar, bask, bite, and flap.  NOW.
translations: 你需要歇斯底里的发泄！马上！

messages.msgid: Everything goes green for a second.  Nature is becoming one with you…
translations: 一切都变绿了。大自然正在与你合而为一……

messages.msgid: You're struck by a primordial flashback… and then it passes.
translations: 你被某种原始的闪回片段所震撼……然后它就消散了。

messages.msgid: You feel a desire to curl up in a nice, warm pile of… shredded paper.
translations: 你感到一阵冲动，想要蜷缩在一堆美好而温暖的……碎纸里。

messages.msgid: Walking is overrated.  It's time to start hopping.
translations: 直立行走没那么好，该蹦跶蹦跶了。

messages.msgid: You suddenly want to burrow under some sand or find some nice rocky alcove to hide behind.
translations: 你突然有种卧沙的冲动，想把自己埋在沙子下，或是找一个岩石洞将自己藏起来。

messages.msgid: Your ears ring and you taste iron.
translations: 你的耳朵嗡嗡作响，你尝到了铁锈的味道。

messages.msgid: You are wearing equipment that helps to distribute weight allowing you to carry more.
translations: 你所穿戴的装备有利于分散负重，让你能够携带更多物品。

messages.msgid: Blinds enemy for a short time.
Spray slime onto an enemy to slow them down.
translations: 朝敌人喷射黏液，使他们减速。

messages.msgid: Launches a glob of bioluminescent goo that illuminates the area around it.
translations: 喷射出一团生物发光的黏液，照亮周围区域。

messages.msgid: You squat down, build up tension in your legs and release.  Launching yourself quite a distance.
translations: 你蹲下，增加腿部的张力，然后释放。让自己跳出一段距离。

messages.msgid: You squat down, build up tension in your legs and release.  You have the ability to target and land in the way to do maximum damage to any target in your way.  Death from above.
translations: 你蹲下，增加腿部的张力，然后释放。你能按照自己的意愿瞄准降落地点，对挡路的目标造成极大伤害。死亡从天而降。

messages.msgid: You squat down, build up tension in your legs, waggling your tail, then release.  Launching yourself quite a distance.
translations: 你蹲下，增加腿部的张力，摆动尾巴，然后释放。让自己弹射出一段距离。

messages.msgid: Blinds a random nearby enemy for a short duration and up an ink_gland_ink status charge.
You don't have any tails, whiskers, horns, or miscellaneous extra bits.
translations: 你没有任何尾巴、胡须、角或其他多余的部分。

messages.msgid: You have human ears and hearing.
You heal as fast as most humans do in this new world.
translations: 在这个新世界里，你的治愈速度和大多数人一样快。

messages.msgid: Your digestive system and cardio health are standard for a human.
translations: 你的消化系统和心肺功能是普通人类的标准。

messages.msgid: You have a human mouth with human teeth.
translations: 你有一张长着人牙的人嘴。

messages.msgid: Your voice doesn't sound especially abnormal.
translations: 你的嗓音并没有什么反常的。

messages.msgid: You have human skin and no distinct smell.
translations: 你有人类的皮肤，没有特别的气味。

messages.msgid: You sleep a normal amount for a human.
translations: 对于人类来说，你的睡眠量是正常的。

messages.msgid: Your mind and brain chemistry are not mutated.
translations: 你的思维和脑化学没有发生任何变异。

messages.msgid: Your immune system is more or less normal for a human.
translations: 你的免疫系统能力处于正常人类范围。

messages.msgid: Your temperature tolerance is more or less normal for a human.
translations: 你的耐热与耐寒能力处于正常人类范围。

messages.msgid: You can move more quickly than most, resulting in a 15% speed bonus on sure footing.
translations: 你的腿部肌肉与协调能力更加出色，可以比别人走、跑得更快，俗称"健步如飞"。你步行的速度增加15%。

messages.msgid: A photophore has grown from your head.  You can't consciously control it, and it might start to shine in response to your emotions or your physiological state.
translations: 你的头上长出了一个发光器。你不能自主控制它，它可能会随着你的情绪或生理状态而自行发光。

messages.msgid: A photophore has grown from your head; you can make it glow softly.  This will make you very visible in the dark, ideal for attracting a partner during mating season.
translations: 从你的额头上长出一个发光器官，你可以使它发出微光。这将使你在黑暗中非常明显，很适合在交配季节吸引伴侣。
你额头上的发光器官开始发出微光。
你额头上的发光器官正在发出柔弱的微光。
你额头上的发光器官停止发光。

messages.msgid: You can make your photophore glow brightly.
translations: 你额头上的发光器官现在能发出强光。
你额头上的发光器官正在发出强光。

messages.msgid: You can spit a wad of bioluminescent goo several meters away.  There it will light up its surroundings until it dissipates.
translations: 你可以在几米外吐出一团生物发光的黏液。在那里，它会照亮周围的环境，直到消失。

messages.msgid: You're a normal human; there's nothing wrong with you.  No need to worry.
translations: 你现在是个正常人，没什么问题。不用担心。

messages.msgid: Everything is terrible and this makes you so ANGRY!
translations: 一切都糟透了，这让你很*生*气*！

messages.msgid: Anger clouds your mind; you can't think straight, but you feel strong.
translations: 莫名的愤怒充满了你的头脑，你脑子里一团糟，但你感觉自己很强大。

messages.msgid: As the morning comes, you return back to normal.
translations: 当早晨来临时，你恢复了正常。

messages.msgid: You tend to have bouts of depression during the fall and especially winter.  Taking antidepressants can help.
translations: 到秋季末至冬季，你会出现抑郁症状。服用抗抑郁药会有所帮助。

messages.msgid: Your hearing is better than average, and you can hear distant sounds more easily.
translations: 你的听觉神经更为发达，对于微小的、更远处的声音你可以更容易的听清楚。

messages.msgid: Your broad, pointed ears are like radar dishes.  You can hear even the slightest sounds at great distance, and are less likely to be deafened by loud noises.
translations: 你的耳朵又宽又尖，就像雷达天线。你甚至可以在很远的距离听到最轻微的声音，并且不太可能被噪音致聋。

messages.msgid: You've learned how to hunt without sight.  Activate this mutation to make a quiet chirp that can reveal obstacles and enemies by its echo.
translations: 你已经学会了如何在没有视力的情况下狩猎。激活此变异可发出安静的超声波，通过回声定位发现障碍物和敌人。

messages.msgid: Your nose is upturned, ridged and flared out into a leaf shape that humans will likely find unsightly.  On the plus side, thermoreceptors in your nostrils allow you to smell heat as long as you can breathe.
translations: 你的鼻子向上、隆起并向外张开，形成人类可能会觉得难看的叶子形状。从好的方面来说，只要你还在呼吸，鼻孔中的温感器官就可以让你闻到热量。

messages.msgid: You're not sure the shape of your ears is helping you any; regardless, you have become very sensitive to sounds.
translations: 你不确定是不是耳朵形状的原因，你对声音变得非常敏感。

messages.msgid: You never paid attention to your surroundings and specifically to people around you.  You can't judge the intent of critters you see.
translations: 你从来没有注意过你周围的环境，尤其是你周围的人。你不能判断你看到的动物的意图。

messages.msgid: You are accustomed to being exposed to the elements.  This decreases morale penalties for being wet.
translations: 你相比普通人，更习惯于被雨淋。减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Whether due to exercise and good diet, or due to a natural propensity to physical endurance, you tire due to physical exertion much less readily than others.  Your cardio fitness and maximum stamina are higher than usual.
translations: 或许是由于锻炼和良好的饮食习惯，或许是由于先天体能优势，你更不容易因体力消耗而感到劳累。你的心肺功能和耐力上限比常人高。

messages.msgid: Your body's efficiency is like that of a tiny furnace, greatly increasing your cardio and stamina.
translations: 你的身体效率有如一台微型火炉一般，极大地提升了你的心肺功能和耐力上限。

messages.msgid: You're just generally quick!  You get a 10% bonus to action points.
translations: 你的神经反射能力更加迅速，不论是思考还是动作。你比普通人行动更快10%。

messages.msgid: You know how to fight in cramped tunnels at risk of collapse.  You gain bonuses when fighting underground.
translations: 你知道如何在狭窄的隧道里冒着坍塌的危险战斗。你在地下战斗时获得加成。

messages.msgid: Your body is one with the night.  You make less noise when the moon is up in the sky, even when you cannot see it.
translations: 你的身体与黑夜合一。当月亮升上天空时，即使你看不见它，你也会发出更少的噪音。

messages.msgid: You feel alien in your own body, as if part of you remained behind with the storm.  You will suffer severely when not exposed to portal storms unless you find a way to anchor yourself to the world again.
translations: 你对自己的身体感到陌生，仿佛自己的一部分留在了空间风暴之中。如果你没有暴露在空间风暴中时，你将遭受严重的痛苦，除非你找到一种方法再次将自己锚定到这个世界上。

messages.msgid: You have regained some substance and have stabilized somewhat, if not entirely.  Portal storm withdrawal will not affect you as strongly as before.
translations: 你恢复了部分现实形态，并在某种程度上稳定下来，空间风暴脱瘾症的影响将不会像之前那样地强烈。

messages.msgid: Nothing gets you down!  You savor the joys of life, ignore its hardships, and are generally happier than most people.
translations: 你大脑激素水平更加旺盛，时刻分泌着令你快乐的多巴胺，你一直在享受着生活的乐趣，并无视其中的艰难困苦。你通常比绝大多数人更加乐观。

messages.msgid: Your wounds and broken limbs heal quicker than usual.
translations: 你的伤口与断肢比常人愈合得更快。

messages.msgid: Your metabolism is a little slower, and you require less food than most.
translations: 你的新陈代谢较为缓慢，你所需食物比普通人更少一些。

messages.msgid: You have always been able to fall asleep easily, even when sleeping in less than ideal circumstances.
translations: 你很容易入睡，即便在金属残骸上也照睡不误。

messages.msgid: Your body's demanding energy needs mean you can fall asleep just about anywhere.
translations: 你的身体所需要的极高能量消耗让你能够在任何地方迅速睡着。

messages.msgid: You always sleep better surrounded by earth.
translations: 在大地的包围下，你总是睡得更好。
在水的包围下，你总是睡得更好。

messages.msgid: You have a high tolerance for pain.
translations: 你的神经与精神更加坚韧，对疼痛有着很高的忍耐性。

messages.msgid: You possess natural night vision, and can see further in the dark than most.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.
translations: 你拥有天然的夜视能力，在黑暗中能看得比普通人更远一些。激活以切换显示夜视范围。

messages.msgid: Your system is rather tolerant of poisons and toxins, and most will affect you less.
translations: 你的身体组织对于中和体内有毒物质能力更强，大部分毒素对你效果甚微。

messages.msgid: You're a quick reader, and can get through books a lot faster than most.
translations: 你的大脑对于文字与图片的处理更加有效率，俗称"一目十行"，你阅读书籍的速度比一般人要快。

messages.msgid: The bottoms of your feet are tough, and you are accustomed to going barefoot.  You receive no movement penalty for not wearing shoes.
translations: 你的脚掌厚度与脚底反射区较为坚韧，即便脚掌没有保护，也不会受到移动力惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your flesh has become dense with fat and muscle.  This makes you harder to take down, but also a poor swimmer.
translations: 你的肉变得充满脂肪和肌肉。这会让你更难被击倒，但同时也是一个糟糕的游泳者。

messages.msgid: Your bulk has rendered you a veritable living wall.  Be careful around water though; while you're as sturdy as a rock, you'll sink like one too.
translations: 你的体积使你成为一堵名副其实的活墙。不过要小心水源；当你像岩石一样坚固时，你也会像岩石一样沉没。

messages.msgid: It takes a lot to bring you down!  You get a 20% bonus to all hit points.
translations: 你的肌肉密度更大，对于外界打击有着更强的抵御能力，你的生命值上限增加20%。

messages.msgid: You can shrug off almost anything!  You get a 30% bonus to all hit points.
translations: 你不仅肌肉密度更强大，你的内脏与骨骼也更加坚韧，你的生命值上限增加30%。

messages.msgid: Nothing can break you!  You get a 40% bonus to all hit points.
translations: 你的肌体强度极为强大，对于一切攻击都有着出色的抵御能力，你的生命值上限增加40%。

messages.msgid: Your skin is tough.  Cutting and bashing damage is slightly reduced for you.  There's a small chance you don't cut yourself on sharp terrain.
translations: 你的皮肤组织比普通人更加坚韧。略微减少对你受到的钝击和斩击伤害，同时降低在通过尖锐地形时割伤自己的几率。

messages.msgid: You pack things very efficiently!  You can retrieve things from containers 10% faster.
translations: 你收拾起东西来很有效率！你从包里取东西的速度快10%。

messages.msgid: You are capable of carrying far more than someone with similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is increased by 35%.
translations: 你背部肌肉力量比普通人更大，你的身体最大承载重量上升35%。

messages.msgid: You have a flexible mind, allowing you to learn skills much faster than others.  Note that this only applies to real-world experience, not to skill gain from other sources like books.
translations: 你的大脑的学习能力更加灵活出色，加快你技能的经验获得速度。

messages.msgid: You've been taught proper table manners from your early childhood on; now, you can't even think about eating without being seated at a table and taking your time.  Eating without a table and chair frustrates you, but eating like a civilized person gives you a bigger morale bonus.
translations: 你从小就被教导需要时刻遵守正规餐桌礼仪。即便是现在，你依然无法想象自己不在桌椅吃饭，或是不细嚼慢咽慢慢吃饭的样子。不在桌椅上吃饭会让你沮丧，像文明人一样吃饭会带给你好心情。

messages.msgid: You are less likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.  If you throw up despite this, you won't suffer any residual nausea.
translations: 你的胃与肠道对于酒精与食物中毒等处理能力更强，即便你呕吐了，也不会因此导致后续恶心。

messages.msgid: You have gained the ability to invert your stomach outside your body to quickly eliminate toxins, and are more likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.  If you throw up because of this, you won't suffer any residual nausea.
translations: 你获得了将胃容物呕吐到体外的能力，以快速排除毒素，并且更有可能因食物中毒、酒精等而呕吐。如果你因此呕吐，你不会产生残留的恶心效果。

messages.msgid: You have an exceptional memory, and find it easy to remember things.  However, you don't benefit as much as other people from dropping a subject for a while and will thus end up learning slower.
translations: 你有着非凡的记忆力，记住些东西对你来说轻而易举。然而，你不像其他人那样能暂时放下一些问题，这会导致你的学习速度变慢。

messages.msgid: While you're not any better at melee combat, you are better at recovering from a miss, and will be able to attempt another strike faster.
translations: 虽然你的近战技能并未得到提升，但你能更快的从一次未命中的攻击中恢复过来，并更快的尝试发动新的攻击。

messages.msgid: You've always felt that there is more to the world than we can see.  Whether driven by religious beliefs or philosophical interest, you find great inspiration in studying holy texts and experiencing mystical things.
translations: 你一直觉得世界远比我们能看到的丰富。不知是出于宗教信仰还是哲学观念，总之你能从研习神学或体验神秘事物中得到极大的鼓舞。

messages.msgid: You can handle intoxicants well.  Their effects clear up more quickly for you.
translations: 你可以很好的抵抗麻醉药品。它们的效果在你身上持续时间更短。

messages.msgid: You eat faster, and can eat and drink more, than anyone else!  You also enjoy food more; delicious food is better for your morale, and you don't mind unsavory meals as much.  Activate to skip prompt for overeating.
translations: 你比别人吃得更快，也比别人更能吃！你能从美食中获得更多的好心情，你也不介意残羹剩菜。激活该变异可跳过暴饮暴食的确认对话框。

messages.msgid: Either as the result of a lifesaving surgery, or as a congenital defect, your stomach is much smaller than usual.  You'll have to eat your food in small servings during the day, rather than one or two large daily meals.
translations: 无论是由于挽救生命的手术，还是先天性缺陷，你的胃容量都比普通人要小得多。你每天必须少食多餐，而不是吃一两顿大餐。

messages.msgid: There's nothing quite like the smell of a good book!  Books are more fun (or less boring) for you!
translations: 没有什么能比得上看一本好书的感觉！书籍对你来说更有趣（或不会枯燥）！

messages.msgid: Whether due to a lifetime of exposure or through simple willpower, it's harder for you to become addicted to substances, and easier to rid yourself of these addictions.
translations: 你的机体对于物质与精神的相互作用更加具有自我控制力，你不易上瘾，戒瘾也更加轻松。

messages.msgid: Peaceful animals will not run away from you, and even aggressive animals are less likely to attack.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.
translations: 不攻击人的动物不会从你身边跑开，甚至那些富有攻击性的动物也不太会优先攻击你。该特性只能对诸如林地动物等的自然生物生效。

messages.msgid: Something about your presence is calming to animals, and they will treat you with innate trust.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.
translations: 你能让动物平静下来，他们会以与生俱来的信任对待你。此特性只对野生动物起效。

messages.msgid: There's something about you that creatures find frightening, and they are more likely to try to flee.
translations: 你身上有些让动物们感到恐惧的东西，它们更有可能试图从你身边逃开。

messages.msgid: It's very unlikely that you will catch ambient diseases like the cold or flu.
translations: 你的机体免疫力更强，对感冒等环境疾病有一定的特殊抵抗能力。

messages.msgid: If you are in a very dangerous situation, you may experience a temporary rush which increases your speed and strength significantly.
translations: 你肾上腺髓质分泌的激素在紧急时刻作用更大，当你处于濒死等危险之中时，你可以获得一次短暂的加速以及力量提升。

messages.msgid: When you are in great danger you may flip a chemical switch in your brain and for a cost in hunger, fatigue, and thirst your nervous system will process things around you slightly faster.  Giving you better reaction times that you can pay for later if you survive.
translations: 当你处于极大的危险中时，你可能会在大脑中触发一个化学开关，以饥饿、疲劳和口渴为代价，你的神经系统会稍微加快处理你周围的事情。提升你的反应时间，如果你能活下来，你可以之后再付代价。

messages.msgid: You need less sleep than the average person.
translations: 相比普通人，你不需要充足的睡眠就依旧能够保持活力，你对睡眠时间的要求比普通人要少。

messages.msgid: Although you still suffer the negative effects of pain, it also brings a unique pleasure to you.
translations: 你有受虐癖，疼痛使你感到快乐，虽然你还会承受疼痛的负面效果，但这同时会让你感到一种独特的快感。

messages.msgid: You have a unique history with stimulants (like coffee or amphetamines).  You can tolerate a lot more of them without overdosing, but if you indulge too much, you start seeing things…
translations: 你有着一段关于兴奋剂（如咖啡因或安非他命）的独特经历。你比普通人能够承受更高剂量的兴奋剂而不过量，但如果你摄入过多兴奋剂，你会开始看见奇怪的事情发生……

messages.msgid: You make less noise while walking.  You're also less likely to set off traps.
translations: 你走路时的声音很轻，而且触发陷阱的概率更低。

messages.msgid: Your genome has rapidly adapted to the Cataclysm and can handle the strain of mutation better.  Taking different kinds of mutagen won't result in more defective mutations than normal.
translations: 你的基因已经迅速适应了大灾变，并且可以更好地适应各类变异。服用不同种类的诱变剂不会导致比正常情况更多的负面变异。

messages.msgid: Your body eats up lesser mutagens faster than normal.  Exotic and esoteric mutagens will still affect you normally.
translations: 你的身体分解低等诱变剂的速度比常人更快。奇异和深奥的诱变剂对你的效果则一如往常。

messages.msgid: Your genome has become an impregnable fortress to lesser genetic deviations.  You are no longer able to mutate traits that are outside of the Alpha category or regress to unremarkable humanity.  Any other mutations that you previously developed are safe for now.
translations: 你的基因组已成为一座可以阻挡较小基因偏移的坚不可摧的堡垒。 你再也无法变异出新人类类以外的特性，或者退化回普通的人类。 你以前开发的任何基因现在依然保留。

messages.msgid: You're an excellent navigator and your ability to recognize distant landmarks is unmatched.  Your sight radius on the overmap extends beyond the normal range.
translations: 你是个出色的领航员，你认出远处地标的能力无与伦比。你的大地图视野相比普通人有所扩大。

messages.msgid: Focal brain damage has rendered you incapable of recognizing landmarks and orienting yourself in your surroundings, severely crippling your sight radius on the overmap.
translations: 局部性脑损伤使你无法定位地标和识别你自己所处的周围环境，严重削弱你的大地图视野。

messages.msgid: For your whole life you've been forbidden from indulging in your peculiar tastes.  Now the world's ended, and you'll be damned if anyone is going to tell you that you can't eat people.
translations: 你喜好人肉，但你这一辈子都被禁止从你的特殊嗜好里获得快感，不过现在是世界末日，再没有人可以阻止你享用新鲜人肉了。

messages.msgid: You're convinced that these things that look vaguely human from elsewhere are definitely not people.  Therefore it's okay to eat them, right?
translations: 你坚信，亚人只是长得有点像人而已，其实根本不配称为人，总之——可以吃，对吧？

messages.msgid: You don't feel any strong feelings for your fellow man.
translations: 你对人类同胞并无强烈的情感。

messages.msgid: You have received some martial arts training at a local dojo.  You start with your choice of Karate, Judo, Aikido, Tai Chi, Taekwondo, or Pankration.
translations: 你在道场里接受过一些武术训练。你能够在空手道、柔道、合气道、太极拳、跆拳道及古希腊搏击中选择一项，作为你的起始武术。

messages.msgid: You have taken some self-defense classes at a nearby gym.  You start with your choice of Boxing, Kickboxing, Capoeira, Krav Maga, Muay Thai, Ninjutsu, Wing Chun, or Zui Quan.
translations: 你曾在附近健身房受过一套防身术训练。你可以在开局时从拳击、踢拳、巴西战舞、马伽术、泰拳、忍术、咏春或者醉拳之中选择其一。

messages.msgid: You have studied the arts of the Shaolin monks.  You start with one of the five animal fighting styles: Tiger, Crane, Leopard, Snake, or Dragon.
translations: 你是少林寺的俗家弟子。你在开始的时候可以选择少林虎形拳、少林豹形拳、少林鹤形拳、少林蛇形拳或者少林龙形拳之一。

messages.msgid: You have practiced fighting with weapons.  You start with your choice of Barbaran Montante, Bōjutsu, Eskrima, Fencing, Fior Di Battaglia, Medieval Swordsmanship, Niten Ichi-Ryu, Pencak Silat, or Sōjutsu.
translations: 你曾经接受过一套近身武器训练。你在开始的时候可以选择巴巴兰重剑术、日本棍术、菲律宾剑棍术、击剑术、战斗之花、中世纪剑术、二天一流剑术、班卡苏拉刀术或日本枪术之一。

messages.msgid: You were an avid fencer, starting with foil and moving onto saber, then épée.  You competed nationally and dabbled with some of the historical fencing weapons afforded by HEMA's popularity.
translations: 你是一个狂热的击剑运动员，从花剑开始，然后进入佩剑，最后是重剑。你参加了全国比赛，还接触了欧洲历史武术流行所提供的一些历史上的传统击剑武器。

messages.msgid: Your scent is quite weak.  Animals that track your scent will do so with more difficulty.
translations: 你身上汗腺等处散发的气味很小，依靠气味追踪的怪物不太容易注意到你。

messages.msgid: You have no qualms about bending the truth, and have practically no tells.  Telling lies and otherwise bluffing will be much easier for you.
translations: 你对歪曲事实毫无顾虑，说谎时毫不脸红，而谎话说的就像是真的一样。欺骗别人将变得更加容易。

messages.msgid: You lost an awful lot of weight before the Cataclysm.  Whatever the reason, now that food is not always close at hand, your skeletal figure presents an additional danger.  You need to gain weight or die trying.
translations: 你在大灾变之前失去了不少体重。无论原因如何，你现在骨瘦如柴，在食物难以获得的如今这开始拖你的后腿。你需要在饿死之前增加你的体重。

messages.msgid: You gained an awful lot of weight before the Cataclysm.  Whatever the reason, now that mobility is key to survival, your bloated figure presents an additional danger.  You need to lose weight or die trying.
translations: 你在大灾变之前增加了不少体重。无论原因如何，你肥胖的体型开始拖你的后腿，而移动能力又对你的生存至关重要。你需要在挂掉之前开始减肥。

messages.msgid: You are a sight to behold.  People who care about such things will react more kindly to you.
translations: 你的外貌十分出众，习惯以貌取人的人或许对你会更有好感。

messages.msgid: Whether due to injury or age, your knees aren't particularly strong or flexible.  Moving over rough terrain will slow you down more than normal.
translations: 你的膝盖状态由于旧伤一直欠佳。在比较崎岖的地形上行走会让你耗时更长。

messages.msgid: Your knees never bend.  Period.  Stiff as a metal pole.  Pray that your journey doesn't involve stairs or slightly uneven terrain.
translations: 你的膝盖有时完全无法弯曲，僵硬如金属杆。希望你的旅程不用经过楼梯或者稍微不平整的地形。

messages.msgid: Your knees are strong and capable of angles that you couldn't imagine previously.  Moving over rough terrain will slow you down less than normal.
translations: 你的膝盖很强壮，能够弯曲到你以前无法想象的角度。在崎岖不平的地形上移动时不像普通人那样困难。

messages.msgid: Whether due to lack of exercise and poor diet, or due to a natural disinclination to physical endurance, you tire due to physical exertion much more readily than others.  Your total cardio fitness and stamina are lower than normal.
translations: 或许是由于缺乏运动和常吃垃圾食品，或许是由于先天体能劣势，你的体力消耗比其他人更快。你的心肺功能和耐力上限比常人低。

messages.msgid: Without glasses, your seeing radius is severely reduced!  However, you are guaranteed to start with a pair of glasses.
translations: 当不戴近视眼镜时，你看不清远处，你的视野范围极度受限。幸运的是，你可以一开始就拥有一副近视眼镜。

messages.msgid: Your wounds heal a little slower than most.  Your HP whilst asleep, as well as your broken limbs, heal at 75% of the regular rate.
translations: 你的伤口愈合得比大多数人都慢。伤口在睡眠时恢复速度以及折断的四肢的愈合速度是正常人的75%。

messages.msgid: Your health recovery is severely impaired.  Your HP whilst asleep, as well as your broken limbs, heal at 33% of the regular rate.
translations: 你的机体自愈能力严重受损。伤口在睡眠时恢复速度以及折断的四肢的愈合速度是正常人的33%。

messages.msgid: Wounds are incredibly dangerous to you, as they barely heal at all.  Your HP whilst asleep, as well as your broken limbs, heal at 10% of the regular rate.
translations: 伤口对你来说是非常危险的，因为它们几乎无法愈合。伤口在睡眠时恢复速度以及折断的四肢的愈合速度是正常人的10%。

messages.msgid: Whatever caused the end of the world affected you in a horrible way.  Your wounds will never heal on their own and your broken limbs will never mend.
translations: 无论是什么导致了世界末日，都以某种可怕的方式影响着你。你的伤口永远无法自行愈合，你折断的肢体也永远无法自愈。

messages.msgid: Without reading glasses, you are unable to read anything, and take penalties on melee accuracy and electronics/tailoring crafting.  However, you are guaranteed to start with a pair of reading glasses.
translations: 当不戴远视眼镜时，你无法看清近处的东西，近战精度、电子学和裁缝制造技能都受到惩罚。幸运的是，你可以一开始就拥有一副远视眼镜。

messages.msgid: You're quite the heavy sleeper.  Noises are unlikely to wake you up.
translations: 你很容易进入深度睡眠，而且深度更甚于常人，当你沉睡时，基本对外界没有任何感应，任何声响都无法唤醒你。

messages.msgid: You need sleep more often, but still spend most of your time awake.
translations: 相对于常人，你需要更多的睡眠，不过大多数时候还能保持清醒。

messages.msgid: You will occasionally need to use an inhaler, or else suffer severe physical limitations.  However, you are guaranteed to start with an inhaler.
translations: 你患有哮喘，需要时不时地使用哮喘吸入剂，否则将会受到多种生理方面的制约。幸运的是，你可以一开始就拥有一个哮喘吸入剂。

messages.msgid: You simply cannot carry as much as people with a similar strength could.  Your maximum weight carried is reduced by 35%.
translations: 你的背伤让你无法和其他同等力量的人那样携带那么重的东西。你的最大负重减少了35%。

messages.msgid: Things just keep getting you down.  You tend to be unhappy, and it takes some doing to cheer you up.
translations: 你总是情绪低落。你很容易不高兴，需要多做些能让你振作的事。

messages.msgid: You are terrible at organizing and storing your possessions.  You retrieve things from containers 10% slower.
translations: 你的物品总是放得一团糟。你从包里取东西的速度慢10%。

messages.msgid: You never learned to read!  Books and computers are off-limits to you.
translations: 你幼年时错过了对文字的最佳开发期，所以你不识字，你无法阅读书籍或使用电脑。

messages.msgid: Your hearing is poor, and you may not hear quiet or far-off noises.
translations: 你的听力很弱，可能听不清楚附近小的或远些的声音。

messages.msgid: You're not able to hear anything, and as such you're not able to talk to NPCs.
translations: 你什么都听不到，所以你不能和他人说话。

messages.msgid: You are slow to grasp new ideas, and thus learn things more slowly than others.  Note that this only applies to real-world experience, not to skill gain from other sources like books.
translations: 你认为掌握新思维实在是个难事，你在生活实践中获得的经验较常人少，但并不影响其他来源的经验获取速度，比如阅读。

messages.msgid: You have a hard time falling asleep, even under the best circumstances!
translations: 你患有严重的失眠症，你的大脑睡眠功能非常紊乱，即使最好的情况下依然难以入睡。

messages.msgid: You have problems with eating meat.  It's possible for you to eat it, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from it.
translations: 你坚持素食主义。虽然你还是可以吃肉，但是你会受到心情惩罚并且吸收更少的营养。

messages.msgid: Your skin is fragile.  Cutting and bashing damage is slightly increased for you.
translations: 你的皮肤组织很脆弱。钝击和斩击伤害对你的伤害略有增加。

messages.msgid: You have problems with eating vegetables.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.
translations: 你讨厌蔬菜。虽然你还是可以吃菜，但是你会受到心情惩罚并且吸收更少的营养。

messages.msgid: Reading is for nerds!  Boring books are more boring, and you can't have fun by reading books.
translations: 读书是书呆子才会做的事！枯燥的书籍将更枯燥，而且无法从书中获得乐趣。

messages.msgid: Eating fruits always causes your stomach to ache.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.
translations: 水果总是让你肚子不舒服。虽然你还是可以吃水果，但是你会受到心情惩罚并且吸收更少的营养。

messages.msgid: You, like 75 percent of the world, cannot tolerate milk or milk based products.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.
translations: 你像世界上75%的人一样，你有乳糖不耐症，难以消化奶制品。虽然你还是可以吃，但是你会受到心情惩罚并且吸收更少的营养。

messages.msgid: Something in those heavily processed foods doesn't agree with you.  It's possible for you to eat them, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.
translations: 这些加工过头的食品中含有一些让你不适的成分。虽然你还是可以吃它们，但是你会受到心情惩罚并吸收更少的营养。

messages.msgid: You have a rare allergy that prevents you from eating wheat.  It's possible for you to eat wheat-based products, but you will suffer morale penalties and obtain less nutrition from them.
translations: 你有罕见的过敏症使你难以消化含麸质的麦面制品。虽然你还是可以吃，但是你会受到心情惩罚并吸收更少的营养。

messages.msgid: You have a soft spot for processed foods, and gain a morale bonus from eating them.
translations: 你对加工食品有种特殊偏好，吃下它们能够提升更多心情值。

messages.msgid: You *adore* the taste of junk food, and find it preferable to everything else!
translations: 你*爱极*了垃圾食品的味道，比起其他食物对你的身体更好！

messages.msgid: Your head can't take much abuse.  Its maximum HP is 20% lower than usual.  Your apparent fragility makes you less intimidating.
translations: 你的头骨由于生理缺陷导致很脆弱，经不起太大打击。头部HP上限减少20%，并且这种明显的脆弱感降低了你的威慑力。

messages.msgid: You have a hard time remembering things.  Your skills will erode slightly faster than usual, and you have trouble keeping your story straight when lying.
translations: 你的记忆力很差，记住学到的东西很困难。  你技能遗忘的速度比别人更快，你撒谎时编出的故事前言不搭后语。

messages.msgid: Alcohol and drugs go straight to your head.  You suffer the negative effects of these for longer.
translations: 酒精和毒品很容易影响你的大脑，因此它们所带来的副作用将会更长。

messages.msgid: It's easier for you to become addicted to substances, and harder to rid yourself of these addictions.
translations: 你很容易对其他东西上瘾，烟酒不论，同时，也许是上瘾和戒瘾过于频繁，你想再次戒瘾是很难办到的。

messages.msgid: Your scent is particularly strong.  It's not offensive to humans, but animals that track your scent will do so more easily.
translations: 你的汗腺等处散发的气味比常人要重。人们也许还不怎么在意，但嗅觉灵敏的其他生物会因此轻易的追踪到你。

messages.msgid: You suffer from a minor chemical imbalance, whether mental or physical.  Minor changes to your internal chemistry will manifest themselves on occasion, such as hunger, sleepiness, narcotic effects, etc.
translations: 你的内分泌失调，无论精神还是肉体上。你的内部化学成份改变会造成饥饿、嗜睡、麻醉等作用。

messages.msgid: Most animals don't like you, and aggressive animals are more likely to attack you.  This only applies to natural animals such as woodland creatures.
translations: 你的身体散发着令动物反感的信息素，大多数动物不喜欢你，具有攻击性的动物更会表现出强烈的攻击性。此特性只对野生动物起效。

messages.msgid: Natural animals like dogs and wolves see you as prey, and are liable to attack you on sight.
translations: 野生动物如狗和狼把你当作猎物看待，并且会更有可能一见面就攻击你。

messages.msgid: You're a slow reader, and it takes you longer to get through books than most.
translations: 你大脑对于文字处理能力很差，你阅读速度很慢，你阅读书籍消耗比别人更长的时间。

messages.msgid: Ever since the sky first broke, you have felt unwell, your head split by alien thoughts.  You will periodically suffer from delusions, ranging from minor effects to full visual hallucinations.  Some of these effects may be controlled through the use of antipsychotics.
translations: 自从天空被扭曲之后，你就感到有些异常，你感觉头脑被奇怪的思想撕裂了。你经常受到精神分裂的困扰，会不断产生幻觉，可以通过服用抗精神病药来控制症状。

messages.msgid: You randomly fall asleep without any reason.
translations: 你无缘无故就会倒下睡着。

messages.msgid: You make more noise while walking.  You're also more likely to set off traps.
translations: 你的身体协调能力很差，你的行走噪声更大，也更容易触发陷阱。

messages.msgid: When very hungry or under the effects of stimulants, you may find your hands shaking uncontrollably, severely reducing your Dexterity.
translations: 你在非常饥饿或极度兴奋时，你的手会不自觉地颤抖，降低你的敏捷。

messages.msgid: You don't feel right unless you're carrying as much as you can.  You suffer morale penalties for carrying less than maximum volume (weight is ignored).  Xanax can help control this anxiety.
translations: 你不把你的背包装满就觉得浑身不对劲。当你携带物品的体积小于你可携带的最大体积时，你会受到心情值惩罚。服用赞安诺等抗焦虑药可以控制这种焦虑。

messages.msgid: You tend to specialize in one skill and be poor at all others.  You advance at half speed in all skills except your best one.  Note that combining this with Fast Learner will come out to a slower rate of learning for all skills.
translations: 你在技能实践上严重偏科，除了你当前最高等级的技能的之外都爱搭不理，这将会导致其他的技能升级速度减半。此外，如果你同时拥有快速学习特性时，改为你的所有的技能经验获取速度减慢。

messages.msgid: You don't like thinking about violence.  Your combat skills advance much slower than usual, and you feel more guilt about killing.
translations: 你对暴力行为极为的抵触与反感，连想都不愿意想，你的战斗技能增长更为缓慢，你对杀戮造成的内疚也更为强烈。

messages.msgid: Your morale will shift up and down at random, often dramatically.
translations: 你的心情难以控制，常常毫无预料的开心或难过，而且很强烈。

messages.msgid: You can't move as fast as most, resulting in a 15% speed penalty on flat ground.
translations: 你的腿部肌肉与腿部协调能力很差，相比普通人，你就是跑不快。在平地上移动有15%的速度损失。

messages.msgid: You are more likely to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.
translations: 你患有慢性胃病，在食物中毒或饮酒后有更大的几率呕吐。

messages.msgid: You are badly allergic to wool, and cannot wear any clothing made of the substance.
translations: 你对羊毛过敏，不能穿任何羊毛制品。

messages.msgid: You're very strictly vegan, eating animal products is out of the question, even if it means death.  You also can't bear to wear clothing made of animal products, such as leather or fur.
translations: 你是一个严格意义的素食主义者，吃下动物制品是不可能的，死都不吃。你也坚决抵制穿上动物材质的衣服，如皮革或是毛皮。

messages.msgid: When you try to tell a lie, you blush, stammer, and get all shifty-eyed.  Telling lies and otherwise bluffing will be much more difficult for you.
translations: 你试图说谎时，你会脸红，心跳加速，别人一眼就看得出你在撒谎。

messages.msgid: You're not much to look at.  People who care about such things will react poorly to you.
translations: 你的五官令有着正常审美的人会感到不悦，一些在意你长相的人可能不会信任你，甚至忽视你。

messages.msgid: You lack skin pigmentation due to a genetic problem.  You sunburn extremely easily, and typically use an umbrella and sunglasses when going out in the sun.
translations: 由于基因缺陷，你缺乏皮肤色素沉着。你非常容易被阳光晒伤，外出时最好带上伞和太阳镜。

messages.msgid: Your body can't take much abuse.  Its maximum HP is 25% lower than usual.  Your weakness is apparent and makes you less intimidating.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.
translations: 你的身体经不起太多打击。HP上限减少20%，并且这种明显的脆弱感降低了你的威慑力。

messages.msgid: Your body breaks very easily.  Its maximum HP is 50% lower than usual.  Your weakness is apparent and makes you less intimidating.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.
translations: 你的身体非常容易受损。HP上限减少50%，并且这种明显的脆弱感降低了你的威慑力。

messages.msgid: Your body is extremely fragile.  Its maximum HP is 75% lower than usual.  Your weakness is apparent and makes you less intimidating.  Stacks with Glass Jaw.
translations: 你的身体极其脆弱。HP上限减少75%，并且这种明显的脆弱感降低了你的威慑力。

messages.msgid: The events of the Cataclysm have damaged your DNA beyond repair.  You mutate frequently, all mutations you receive (from any source) are negative, and your instability is rapidly growing out of control.
translations: 一次大灾变中发生的事故已经严重损坏了你的DNA，使其难以恢复。你会经常发生变异，而且你获得的所有变异（无论来源）都是负面的，同时你的基因不稳定性在快速增长。

messages.msgid: It's subtle, but your skin has definitely taken on a sickly yellow-green hue.
translations: 虽然很轻微，但你的皮肤毫无疑问正呈现病态的黄绿色。

messages.msgid: You have goosebumps that never seem to go away.  Are they getting bigger?
translations: 你身上的鸡皮疙瘩似乎用于不会消退。它们会变得更大吗？

messages.msgid: You've developed a persistent skin rash.  Sometimes it's fine, other times it itches like hell.
translations: 你患上了持续性的皮疹。有些还好，有些地方简直痒得难以忍受。

messages.msgid: Your body hair is growing in thicker than it used to.  It's almost like you're going through a second puberty or something.
translations: 你的体毛比以往长得更厚，你又到青春期了还是啥的吗？

messages.msgid: Your skin keeps peeling in big flakes, like you're recovering from a bad sunburn.  Oddly, it doesn't hurt at all.
translations: 你的皮肤出现了大块脱皮的症状，就好像经历过严重的晒伤一样。但很奇怪，这一点也不疼。

messages.msgid: Your skin has lost some of its color and taken on a smooth, papery texture.  This slightly reduces wet effects, but also makes you a little more vulnerable to cuts and scrapes.
translations: 你的皮肤失去了它本应有的颜色，呈现平滑的白纸质感。这稍微减少了湿身的影响，但这也使你面对割伤或砍伤时更加的脆弱。

messages.msgid: You can see incredibly well in the dark!  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.
translations: 你的视觉神经发生了变异，在夜晚的黑暗中，视野出乎意料的好。激活来切换显示夜视可见范围。

messages.msgid: You can see in pitch blackness as if you were wearing night-vision goggles.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.
translations: 你的视觉神经发生了变异，在夜晚的黑暗中可以看得更远，就像戴了夜视镜一样。激活来切换显示夜视可见范围。

messages.msgid: Your eyes still bulge, yet your pupils look different somehow.  Water doesn't seem to cause any trouble at all, though.
translations: 你的眼睛发生了变异，眼珠很突出，瞳孔发生了变化，你可以轻易的在水中视物。

messages.msgid: Man's oldest and most well known friends are all Lupines.  Somehow you've mutated something that reminds other survivors of your more domestic relatives.  A softer edge around the eyes, maybe.
translations: 人类最古老和最著名的同伴都是狼科生物。不知何故，你获得了某种变异，能让其他幸存者联想起与你同族的家养宠物。可能是眼神比较柔软吧。

messages.msgid: Your brain has caught up with your eyes.  You can see much better in the dark, but sunlight seems much brighter now.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.
translations: 你的视觉系统发生了变异，你的大脑神经跟上了你眼睛的速度，在黑暗中你看得更清楚了。不过阳光对你来说却更加刺眼。激活来切换显示夜视可见范围。

messages.msgid: Your eyes have turned… green.  It's tough to tell the exact shade, as it seems to shift.  The effect is… pleasant.
translations: 你的眼睛发生了变异，眼睛颜色变成了莹绿色。瞳孔似乎在不断地转动，你很难描述出它的形状，这效果...真讨喜。

messages.msgid: The shadows don't seem as dark now.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.
translations: 你的眼睛发生了变异，所视的阴影似乎并没有那么暗。激活来切换显示夜视可见范围。

messages.msgid: You have great low-light vision now, but it doesn't allow you to perform fine tasks such as crafting and reading in darkness.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.
translations: 你的眼睛发生了变异，有着很好的夜视能力，但这不能让你在黑暗中执行精细的任务，如阅读和制造物品。激活来切换显示夜视可见范围。

messages.msgid: Your eyes have mutated; now you have slit pupils, and they glitter in the light, much like a cat's.  This is visually striking, but it isn't helping you see at night.
translations: 你的眼睛发生了变异，瞳孔像猫一样眯成一条缝，在夜里闪着光。看起来不错，但并没有夜视功能。

messages.msgid: Your optic nerves and brain caught up with your eyes.  Now you can see pretty well at night.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.
translations: 你的视觉系统发生了变异，视觉神经和大脑终于适应了你的新眼睛。现在你能像猫一样看穿黑夜了。激活来切换显示夜视可见范围。

messages.msgid: Your visual processing has shifted: though you can see better in the dark, you're nearsighted in the light.  Maybe glasses would help.  Activate to toggle NV-visible areas on or off.
translations: 你的视觉系统发生了变异，尽管黑暗里你看得更清楚，亮光底下你却看不了多远了。可能带副眼镜会有帮助。激活来切换显示夜视可见范围。

messages.msgid: You find it difficult to see very far in bright light.  On its own, this doesn't necessarily make you any better in the dark.
translations: 你发现在强光环境下很难看清远处物体。就其本身而言，这并不能让你的暗光视力变得更好。

messages.msgid: Your vision has become particularly acute: you suspect you could pick out zombies much farther away.  Perception +4.
translations: 你的视觉非常敏锐，很远距离就能看见丧尸。感知+4

messages.msgid: Your eyes have mutated to pick up radiation in the infrared spectrum.
translations: 你的眼睛发生了变异，可以看见红外线光线。

messages.msgid: Your eyes have mutated, with a brilliant iris and slitted pupil similar to that of a lizard.  This is visually striking, but doesn't seem to affect your vision.
translations: 你的眼睛发生了变异，有着类似蜥蜴一样闪亮的虹膜和竖瞳，看上去很吓人，不过好像并不影响你的视力。

messages.msgid: Your optic nerves and brain have mutated to catch up with your eyes, allowing you to see in the infrared spectrum.
translations: 你的视觉系统发生了变异，视觉神经与大脑已经随着你眼睛的变异而变异，现在你能使用红外线视觉了。

messages.msgid: Your wounds and broken limbs heal very quickly.
translations: 你的伤口与断肢恢复得非常快。

messages.msgid: Your flesh regenerates and your limbs mend incredibly quickly.
translations: 你的肉体再生与断肢愈合速度快得不可思议。

messages.msgid: Your broken limbs mend themselves without significant difficulty in addition to your already-quick healing.  You do not require splints for broken limbs.
translations: 你断掉的四肢可以轻易的自愈。你折断的四肢不需要夹板就能愈合。

messages.msgid: You don't sleep often.  But when you do, you need very little of it.
translations: 你的大脑发生了变异，细胞活性极其活跃，你无需经常睡觉，仅需小憩便能恢复活力。

messages.msgid: You defend the realm all night and all day.
translations: 你的大脑发生了变异，脑细胞活性较于常人相比基本处于旺盛状态，疲劳下降速度为正常的一半。

messages.msgid: Your big teeth have grown in.  Folks had best show some more respect.
translations: 你的嘴部牙齿发生了变异，长出了很突出的门齿，看起来也许会令人不悦。

messages.msgid: You bite into %s with your ratlike incisors!
translations: 你用你的门齿狠狠的咬进%s！
%1$s 用老鼠般的门齿扎入 %2$s 体内

messages.msgid: You have a set of clear lenses which lower over your eyes while underwater, allowing you to see as though you were wearing goggles.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.
translations: 你的眼睛长出了透明的薄膜，在水下时能够覆盖眼球，让你像戴了潜水镜一样看得很清楚，同时也稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your eyes bulge noticeably out of your face, and you are able to move them much more freely than before.  You can see movement and close objects clearly, but you have trouble picking up distant details in the light.  Instead of eyelids they are covered by a translucent, protective membrane that blocks irritants and water.  It allows you to sleep with your eyes open!  Activate to cause the approach of hostile creatures to wake you up.
translations: 你的眼睛明显从脸上凸出，可以比以前更自由地移动它们。你现在可以清楚地看到运动中和近距离物体，但在明亮环境中难以捕捉远处的细节。眼睑被半透明的保护膜替代，可以阻挡刺激物和水，还可以让你睁着眼睛睡觉！激活以使敌对生物接近时唤醒你。

messages.msgid: You've grown a set of gills in your neck, allowing you to breathe underwater.  Slightly increases wet benefits.
translations: 你的呼吸系统发生了变异，拥有了一对腮，允许你在水下呼吸。稍微增加湿身对你的心情加成。

messages.msgid: You've grown a set of gills, running from your neck up behind your ears.  They allow you to breathe underwater and slightly increase wet benefits.
translations: 你的呼吸系统发生了变异，长了一对腮，从脖子一直开口到耳朵后边。允许你在水下呼吸。略微增加湿身对你的心情奖励。

messages.msgid: We have begun adapting local physiology to Mycus physical structure, greatly reducing wet effects.
translations: 吾等已将本地生物肌体改造为马卡斯结构。大大降低了湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: We have spliced the dense, amphibole fibers from Mycus core towers with the resilient, adaptive flesh of local physiology.  This reduces our speed by a moderate amount, but provides powerful armor across our body, nullifies wet effects, and provides complete protection from fire.
translations: 吾等已将源自马卡斯核心塔中的致密角闪石纤维嫁接至本地生物柔韧而广泛适应的肌体之上。大大降低吾等速度，但为吾等各处躯体提供强大保护，无视湿身心情惩罚，并提供对火焰的完全防护。

messages.msgid: Local physiology has been fully incorporated with that of Mycus silicate fibers.  In addition to benefits conferred by previous developments, we may join with Mycus fibers beneath us - sleeping on top of fungal areas places us into a dormant state, which spreads spores around us as we sleep and revitalizes our body much more quickly than regular sleep.
translations: 本地生物结构已完全与马卡斯硅酸盐纤维融合。先前变异的益处仍然存在，现在吾等可与脚下的马卡斯纤维融合，在马卡斯之地上入眠可使吾等变为休眠状态，在吾等睡眠时朝四周散布孢子，并比普通睡眠更快恢复元气。

messages.msgid: Your skin has toughened and grown thin, flexible scales in some places, acting as natural armor.
translations: 你的皮肤已经变硬，在一些地方长出薄而有弹性的鳞片，作为天然的盔甲。

messages.msgid: Your skin has toughened further and your scales have grown to cover most of your body.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤进一步变硬，你的鳞片生长覆盖了你的大部分体表。在一定程度上减少湿身效果。

messages.msgid: Your skin has grown thick and leathery and a set of heavy green scales has grown to cover most of your body, acting as natural armor.  Further, bony scutes cover your extremities, offering additional protection there.  While difficult to penetrate, it also limits your flexibility.  Greatly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤已经变得坚韧而厚实，一套厚重的绿色鳞片覆盖了你的大部分身体，充当天然的盔甲。此外肢体末端还覆盖有骨甲板，提供更多的防御。尽管难以被穿透，但它也限制了你的灵活性。极大减少湿身惩罚。

messages.msgid: A set of very flexible and slick scales has grown to cover your toughened skin.  These act as decent natural armor, improve your ability to swim, and make you difficult to grab.  Mostly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，柔韧光滑的鳞片长满了你硬化的皮肤，成为了你天然的护甲。这些鳞片有一定保护效果，也增强了你的游泳能力，同时让你滑溜溜难以被抓住。减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your bones are very light.  This enables you to move and attack 10% faster, but also reduces your carrying weight by 20% and makes bashing attacks hurt a little more.
translations: 你的骨骼发生了变异，骨质非常松脆，你的行动速度增加了10%，但你所携带的物品最大重量下降20%，而且你受到的钝击伤害略微提升。

messages.msgid: Iridescent feathers have grown to cover your entire body, providing a marginal protection against attacks and minor protection from cold.  They also provide a natural waterproofing.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，绚丽的羽毛长满了你的身体。羽毛可以抵挡少量伤害并提供很好的保暖。同时，它们也拥有防水能力。

messages.msgid: You shan't need to migrate south with your layer of down.  It's even better with no apes around to kill you for it!
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，羽绒可以为你保持体温。有了它你就没必要向南迁徙。更棒的是，那些觊觎你绒羽的猩猩都已经死光了！

messages.msgid: Light fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing marginal protection against attacks and slight protection from cold.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，整个身体长出了轻薄的毛皮，既可以些许抵挡攻击，又稍稍可以保暖。

messages.msgid: Thick black fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing minor protection against attacks, and considerable protection from cold.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，整个身体长出了厚厚的黑色毛皮，既可以少许抵挡攻击，又相当保暖。

messages.msgid: Your fur has grown out and thickened, providing great protection from attacks as well as considerable insulation.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，体表的毛皮长得又浓又密，既可以很好的抵挡攻击，又相当保暖。

messages.msgid: You've lost your fluffy undercoat for the summer.  This feels a lot better in the heat, but it's less protective and looks a little bedraggled.
translations: 夏天让你失去了自己蓬松的毛发。这在炎热的天气里感觉好多了，但它的防护较差，而且看起来有点脏。

messages.msgid: Dense gray fur has grown to cover your entire body, providing noticeable protection against attacks, and considerable protection from cold.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，整个身体包裹着深灰色的毛皮，既可以明显地抵挡攻击，又相当保暖。

messages.msgid: Your entire body is covered in dense fur, but it's thinned out a bit for the summer, which may provide some relief from the heat at the cost of physical protection.
translations: 你的整个身体被厚实的毛皮覆盖，但它为了适应夏日而稍微变薄了。可能以物理防护为代价，减轻了炎热的负担

messages.msgid: You've grown sleek fur, providing minor protection against attacks, and some protection from cold.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，整个身体长出了光滑的毛皮，既可以少许抵挡攻击，又可以保暖。

messages.msgid: Your fur has grown out significantly around your cheeks and neck, providing excellent protection from attacks.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，脸上和脖子上都长出了猞猁一样的长毛，可以极好地抵挡攻击。

messages.msgid: Your skin has mutated into an amalgamation of fur and scales.
translations: 你的皮肤已经变异，由毛皮和鳞片融合而成。

messages.msgid: Your skin has mutated into an amalgamation of thickened fur, scales, and more.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，由厚厚的毛皮和鳞片等融合而成。

messages.msgid: Your skin has warped into a highly protective but inconsistent medley of chitin, scales, fur, and bone.
translations: 你的皮肤已经变异成一层防御力强大但杂乱无章的混合物，由几丁质、鳞片、毛发和骨骼组成。

messages.msgid: Your epidermis has turned into a thin, flexible layer of chitin.  It provides decent physical protection.  Slightly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，变成了一层轻薄而有弹性的甲壳。可以很好的抵挡攻击。稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your epidermis has turned into a thin, flexible layer of chitin.  Newly molted, it feels a little tender, but it's still tough and leathery.
translations: 你的外表皮变成了一层薄的、可动的几丁质甲壳层。刚刚蜕皮，现在还是软的，但已经像皮革般坚韧了。

messages.msgid: You've grown a chitin exoskeleton, much like that of an insect.  It provides considerable physical protection, and make your punches hit a little harder.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，整个身体被类似昆虫的甲壳外壳所包围。可以很好的抵挡攻击，让你的拳头更有力。稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: You've recently molted, and your chitin exoskeleton is still soft and vulnerable.
translations: 你刚刚才蜕皮，你的几丁质外骨骼还柔软而脆弱。

messages.msgid: You've grown a sclerotin exoskeleton, akin to an organic suit of platemail.  It provides excellent physical protection and makes your punches hit harder, but reduces your Dexterity by 1 and encumbers all body parts but your eyes and mouth.  Greatly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，整个身体被骨质外骨骼所包围，类似一层有机骨板甲。可以极好地抵挡攻击，让拳头打得更重些，但你的敏捷 -1，且身体除了眼睛和嘴的其他部位的累赘都额外增加了。大大减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your exoskeleton bears thick plates of chitin which have not fully sclerotized.  They won't provide good protection until they've had time to harden.
translations: 你的外装甲覆盖有一层厚厚的甲壳板，还没有完全骨骼化。它们现在的防御力不佳，除非彻底等到硬化。

messages.msgid: Your body is covered with a thick, near impenetrable, vividly-colored carapace.  It provides unmatched physical protection and even some protection from corrosive chemicals, but reduces your dexterity by 2 and encumbers all body parts except your eyes.  Greatly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你被厚实的，几乎无法刺穿的彩色甲壳包裹住了身体。为你提供无与伦比的物理防御能力，甚至能阻挡某些腐蚀性化学液体，但会减少你 2点 敏捷，为除了眼部的所有身体部位增加累赘。极大地减少湿身惩罚。

messages.msgid: You're covered in a great chitin carapace which reduces your Dexterity by 1, however it has recently molted and will offer poor protection until it has time to harden.  Greatly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你被巨大的几丁质甲壳给整个包住了，减少你 1点 敏捷。但甲壳才蜕出不久，在完全硬化之前防御力会很差。极大减低湿身惩罚。

messages.msgid: You've developed some sort of hair growing out of your chitin.  It's a bit warmer than not having hair.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，产生了甲壳。几丁质甲壳上进化出了一些毛发。比光溜溜的要暖和点儿。

messages.msgid: Your chitin hair has thickened and spread across your body.  It provides minor warmth and helps you sense nearby vibrations.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，产生了甲壳。甲壳上的几丁质毛发变得浓密并且遍布全身。这为你提供了一点热量，并且有助于你感知附近的振动。

messages.msgid: Your thick exoskeleton boasts a fine coat of hairs that put feline whiskers to shame.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，外骨骼外覆盖着一层可以强化感知的长毛，能让猫须自愧不如。

messages.msgid: Significant amounts of your hairs have loosened.  If some creature tries to attack you, your assailant is quite likely to get fine, bristly chitin in an irritating spot; it doesn't carry your venom but it will be distracting.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，产生了许多毛发。大部分毛发都是松脱地粘在身上的。攻击你的生物很可能会沾上大量恼人的绒毛。这些毛发并未携带你身上的毒液，但会分散攻击者的注意力。

messages.msgid: Instead of your right hand, you now have a giant claw resembling ones found on crabs.  It encumbers you greatly, but you can use it in melee combat to deal massive damage.
translations: 一只巨大的钳子代替了你的右手。它让你非常烦恼，但你可以在近战中使用它来造成巨量伤害。

messages.msgid: Your skin is covered with fine spines.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive moderate damage.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，长出了许多细骨刺。当对手徒手攻击直接命中暴露在外的肢体时，将会受到不小的伤害。

messages.msgid: Your body is covered with large quills.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive significant damage.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，长出了又大又长的硬刺。当对手徒手攻击直接命中暴露在外的肢体时，将会受到较高的伤害。

messages.msgid: Some of the quills on your arms have become quite loose.  By flinging your arms, you can fire off these quills as projectiles.
translations: 你胳膊上的一些羽毛已经松了。你可以甩动手臂，把这些羽毛当作投射物发射出去。

messages.msgid: You fire off some of your quills.
Your skin is light green and has a slightly woody quality to it.  This provides armor and helps you retain moisture, resulting in less thirst.  Greatly decreases wet penalties.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，在变成绿色的同时质地也更像木头。这为你提供了防护加成，并帮助你保持水分，从而使你不容易口渴。大大减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your skin is coated in a light bark, like that of a tree.  This provides powerful armor and makes you nearly waterproof.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，整个身体覆盖着一层薄薄的树皮，就像一棵树一样。这为你提供了强大的防护，也让你几乎完全防水。

messages.msgid: Your warped bark can be shifted in function, and is currently spread evenly.  Activate to better protect your torso, at the cost of other areas.
translations: 你所变异出的树皮可以进行功能转化，目前分布均匀。激活此变异，可以以牺牲其他部位为代价，更好地保护躯干。

messages.msgid: Your bark ripples across your body, repositioning at a cellular level.
translations: 你的树皮在扩散出一道道波纹，在细胞水平上重新调换位置。

messages.msgid: Your warped bark can be shifted in function, and is currently consolidated on your torso.  Activate to shift your bark into a lattice, increasing bulk but providing better protection for the entire body.
translations: 你所变异出的树皮可以进行功能转化，目前固结在躯干上。激活此变异，将树皮变成网格状，增加累赘，同时为整个身体提供更好的保护。

messages.msgid: Your warped bark can be shifted in function, and is currently expanded into a sturdy lattice.  Activate to collapse the lattice, returning to an evenly distributed form.
translations: 你所变异出的树皮可以进行功能转化，已经扩展开成坚固的网格。激活此变异，将网格回缩，变成更加平均分布的形状。

messages.msgid: Your skin is covered in small, woody thorns.  Whenever an unarmed opponent strikes a part of your body that is not covered by clothing, they will receive minor damage.  Your punches may also deal extra damage.
translations: 你的皮肤组织发生了变异，覆盖着许多细小的木质尖刺。当对手徒手攻击直接命中暴露在外的肢体时，将会受到些微的伤害。你的徒手攻击也能造成额外伤害。

messages.msgid: All the hair on your body has turned to long, grass-like leaves.  Apart from being physically striking, these provide you with a minor amount of nutrients while in sunlight when your head is uncovered.  Slightly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的秀发转变成了一蓬绿油油的藤蔓，上面长满了绿叶。除了样子很令人瞩目之外，当你的手臂和头部被暴露在阳光下时，光合作用会产生少许营养。稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your leaves have grown in size and prominence, with additional leaves sprouting along your arms.  While your arms and head are uncovered, you will photosynthesize nutrients while in sunlight.  Reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的叶子已经长大了，而且非常突出，更多的叶子在你的手臂上发芽。当你的手臂和头部被暴露在阳光下时，光合作用会产生营养。减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your leaves are vibrant, large, and green, and have become a major source of nutrients for your body.  Whenever your arms and head are uncovered you will gain a large amount of nutrients by standing in the sunlight.  Reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的叶子生机勃勃，又大又绿，它已经成为你身体营养的主要来源。当你的手臂和头部被暴露在阳光下时，光合作用会产生大量的营养。减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your body has begun moving nutrients via the evaporation of water.  This increases your thirst when it's hot, but reduces it when it's cold.
translations: 你的身体已经开始通过水分的蒸腾作用来运输营养物质。热的时候会让你更容易口渴，但在冷的时候会让你不容易口渴。

messages.msgid: You've started blooming where your scalp used to be.  Your blossoms have a pleasant aroma, are visually striking, and are quite sensitive.
translations: 你的头皮上开出了花朵，香气怡人，看上去也很令人瞩目，而且还特别敏感。

messages.msgid: The top of your head is blooming with rosebuds.  They're eye catching, and have a strong fragrance that makes you pleasant to be around.
translations: 你头顶上开满了花蕾。它们很吸引人，有一种强烈的香味，让你感到身心愉悦。

messages.msgid: We have developed local spore sacs.  The Mycus must grow.
translations: 吾等已在本地生物上培育出了孢子囊。马卡斯必将壮大。

messages.msgid: Local organisms seem to regard overt spore dispersal as a danger, and attack the Mycus.  Accordingly, our local spore sacs remain quiescent, until local guidance determines that it is safe to germinate.  Rapid development taxes local nutrient reserves but ensures swift and effective growth.
translations: 有机生物土著们似乎将公开散播孢子视作危险行为，并攻击马卡斯。为此吾等将使本地孢子囊保持沉寂，直至本地生物的引导者决定何时为安全发芽的时机。孢子增殖会极大地消耗本地养分储备，但能保证快速而有效地繁殖。

messages.msgid: We have developed local blossoms.  The Mycus must grow.
translations: 吾等已在本地生物上培育出了孢子花。马卡斯必将壮大。

messages.msgid: Local organisms seem to regard overt spore dispersal as a danger, and attack the Mycus.  Accordingly, our local blossoms remain quiescent, until local guidance determines that it is safe to germinate.  Rapid development taxes local nutrient reserves but ensures swift and effective growth.
translations: 有机生物土著们似乎将公开散播孢子视作危险行为，并攻击马卡斯。为此吾等将使本地孢子花保持沉寂，直至本地生物的引导者决定何时为安全发芽的时机。孢子增殖会极大地消耗本地养分储备，但能保证快速而有效地繁殖。

messages.msgid: Local spore sacs and blossoms have merged into a single, symbiotic form.  Acting as one, they germinate together to cement rapid growth across a large area according to local guidance.  The Mycus must grow.
translations: 本地的孢子囊和孢子花已融合为单一而共生的形态。合二为一，它们将在本地生物引导者的控制下共同生长，将这广阔的土地融合在马卡斯下。马卡斯必将壮大。

messages.msgid: Your fingernails are long and sharp.  If you aren't wearing gloves, your unarmed attacks deal a minor amount of cutting damage.
translations: 你的指甲变得很长。如果不戴手套，徒手攻击对方时将造成少量斩击伤害。

messages.msgid: You have claws on the ends of your fingers.  If you aren't wearing gloves, your unarmed attacks deal a minor amount of cutting damage.
translations: 你的指甲变得又长又硬，如果不戴手套，徒手攻击对方会造成少量斩击伤害。

messages.msgid: Your claws have grown tougher and slightly gnarled.
translations: 你的爪子变得又粗又硬，还带着倒钩。

messages.msgid: Your paws are bone, muscle, and claw with a thin layer of skin and fur.  They might as well be made of stainless steel.
translations: 你的手爪不外乎骨头，肌肉，利爪外加一层毛皮，如同不锈钢一般锋利。

messages.msgid: You have claws on the ends of your fingers, and can extend or retract them as desired.  Gloves will still get in the way, though.
translations: 你的指甲变得尖锐锋利，并且伸缩自如。如果不戴手套，你的徒手攻击将造成少量斩击伤害。

messages.msgid: Sharp claws are extending from the end of your fingers.
translations: 锋利的爪子从你的手指末端伸出来。

messages.msgid: Your upper tentacles have grown large, hook-barbed rakes on the ends.  They're quite vicious, but really aren't suited for fine manipulation.
translations: 你的上部触手末端已进化成带钩刺的巨大耙状结构。它们攻击性极强，但确实不适合进行精细操作。

messages.msgid: Several ink glands have developed in your gill structure.  When active, they will spray defensive ink and blind an attacker in an emergency.
translations: 鳃的结构中已发育出几个墨腺。激活后，它们会在紧急情况下喷射防御性墨汁并致盲攻击者。

messages.msgid: You exude slime from your pores.  You can spread that slime on an opponent in melee range.
translations: 你的毛孔会渗出黏液。你可以在近战时将黏液喷射到对手身上。

messages.msgid: You develop a reservoir of fluids that bulges out of your abdomen.  Your body has adapted to containing extra liquids in event of shortfalls.
translations: 你的腹部形成了一个隆起的体液储库。你的身体进化得能够容纳额外液体供水分短缺时使用。

messages.msgid: You have an ability to spray boiling water on your enemies at melee distance.  This will drastically increase your thirst.  Without an extra reservoir you would quickly dehydrate yourself.
translations: 你能在近距离向你的敌人喷射灼热液体。这将大大增加你的口渴速度。如果没有额外的储备，你会很快脱水。

messages.msgid: You spray %s with a boiling chemical mixture!
translations: 你朝着 %s 喷出一股灼热的化学液体！

messages.msgid: %1$s sprays %2$s with a boiling chemical mixture!
translations: %1$s朝着 %2$s 喷出一股灼热的化学液体！

messages.msgid: Your index fingers have grown into huge talons.  After a bit of practice, you find that this does not affect your dexterity, but allows for a deadly unarmed attack.  They also prevent wearing gloves.
translations: 你的食指已经变成了一个巨大的猛禽利爪，经过实践后你发现，这并不影响你的敏捷，还可以造成致命一击。但你穿不了手套了。

messages.msgid: Your system has adapted to radiation.  While irradiated, you will actually heal slowly, converting the radiation into hit points.
translations: 你的身体似乎稍微适应了辐射。当你受到辐射时，你将缓慢恢复生命值，将辐射值慢慢转换成生命值。

messages.msgid: Your flesh has developed a unique reaction to radiation that lets you sense when ambient radiation is abnormally high.  Turn off to ignore messages.
translations: 你的血肉能与辐射产生特殊的反应，让你能感觉到超出底噪的辐射量。关闭以忽略监测信息。

messages.msgid: Ever since you ate that Marloss berry, you can't get its scent out of your nose, and you have a strong desire to try some seeds and… sap?
translations: 自从你吃了马洛斯变异莓后，你始终无法忘怀它的气味，你十分想再吃一次，或者去试试种子和……凝胶？

messages.msgid: Ever since you ate that Marloss seed, you can't get its taste off of your tongue, and you have a strong desire to try some berries and… sap?
translations: 自从你吃了马洛斯种子后，你始终无法忘怀它的味道，你十分想再吃一次，或者去试试变异莓和……凝胶？

messages.msgid: Ever since you ate that Marloss jelly, you can't stop thinking of it, and you have a strong desire to eat some seeds and berries.
translations: 自从你吃了马洛斯凝胶后，你永远无法忘怀它的味道，你十分想再吃一次，或者去试试种子和变异莓。

messages.msgid: Ever since you had that life-threatening reaction to that Marloss junk, you can't bear the thought of ever eating it again!
translations: 自从你对那什么马洛斯狗屁玩意有过一次危及生命的排异反应，你一辈子都不想再吃它了，哪怕是一次！

messages.msgid: Ever since you had that life-threatening reaction to those mutagen and purifier things, you can't bear the thought of ever using them again!
translations: 你受够了那些在你身体里面反应来反应去最后差点要你命的诱变剂和净化剂。你再也不想使用这些见鬼的玩意了。

messages.msgid: Your body produces low-level pheromones, identifying you as a friend to many species of insects.  Insects will attack you much less.
translations: 你的身体会生产少量使昆虫安心的信息素，使得昆虫不太可能攻击你。

messages.msgid: Your body produces low-level pheromones, identifying you as a friend to many species of amphibian.  Amphibians will attack you much less.
translations: 你的身体会生产少量使两栖动物安心的信息素，使得两栖动物不太可能攻击你。

messages.msgid: Your body produces low-level pheromones which put mammals at ease.  They will be less likely to attack or flee from you.
translations: 你的身体会生产少量使哺乳动物安心的信息素，使得动物不太可能会攻击或逃离你。

messages.msgid: Your body is simply immune to diseases.  You will never catch an ambient disease.
translations: 你的身体产生了疾病免疫。你将永远不会生病。

messages.msgid: Your immune system is particularly good at resisting infections.  You have an increased chance for bad wounds and infections to heal on their own, and only suffer reduced penalties from them.
translations: 你的免疫系统特别能抵抗感染。你有更高的机率治愈严重的伤口与感染，而且伤势的影响也较轻微。

messages.msgid: Your bloodstream has developed antibiotic properties.  Your wounds will never become infected.
translations: 你的血液里充斥着抗体。你的伤口再也不会被感染了。

messages.msgid: You tend to get hay fever, especially in springtime.  Antihistamines are your friend.
translations: 你容易得花粉热，尤其是春天。抗组胺药是你的朋友。

messages.msgid: We have synchronized our local physiology with that of the Mycus.  Any spores we may encounter will not attempt to germinate inside the local system, and we may traverse Mycus biospheres easily, as native bioforms shift shape to accommodate us.
translations: 吾等已将本地生物结构与马卡斯同步。所遇到的孢子将不会在本地生物体内生长，并且吾等可在马卡斯中畅行无阻，本地生物将改变形态以容纳吾等。

messages.msgid: Your body is unusually inhospitable to parasitic lifeforms.  You will never become infested with internal parasites.
translations: 你的身体对寄生虫类生命形式极度不友好。你永远不会被内部寄生虫感染。

messages.msgid: Your body produces a potent venom.  Cutting or stabbing attacks from mutations have a chance to poison your target.
translations: 你的身体能分泌出一种烈性毒液。任何由于变异导致的斩击和刺击攻击都有机会使目标中毒。

messages.msgid: Your venom has become particularly strong.  You're confident that your bites or other cutting/stabbing natural attacks will take your target down quickly.
translations: 你所分泌的毒液的毒性变得更加猛烈。你相信，被你咬伤或其他变异的斩击/刺击攻击都能够迅速干掉你的目标。

messages.msgid: The skin on your hands is now a mucous membrane that produces a thick, acrid slime.  Attacks using your hand will cause minor acid damage.  Slightly increases wet benefits.
translations: 你双手表皮发生了变异，能够分泌出一层厚厚的、刺鼻气味的黏液膜，当你徒手攻击敌人时将会造成轻微的酸液腐蚀伤害。稍微增加湿身心情加成。

messages.msgid: Your limbs seem to have a little more 'give' to them.  +1 Dexterity.
translations: 你的四肢好像能够再主动"伸远"一点点。敏捷 +1。

messages.msgid: Your limbs are significantly more flexible than any pathetic human arm or leg.  +3 Dexterity, -2 Strength.
translations: 你的四肢明显比可悲的人类肢体要柔韧。敏捷 +3，力量 -2。

messages.msgid: Your pseudopod-like limbs can fit into anything!  You also suffer reduced penalties to attacking while prone.  +4 Dexterity, -4 Strength.
translations: 你伪足一样的四肢能够匹配任何东西！同时减少俯卧时的攻击惩罚。敏捷 +4，力量 -4。

messages.msgid: Your extremities have gained strength but lost fine motor skills.  -1 Dexterity +2 Strength.
translations: 你的四肢力量增强了，但失去了精细运动技能。敏捷-1，力量+2。

messages.msgid: You've developed an extremely long and mobile tongue capped with teeth.  You may use it to attack your enemies and pull them towards you.
translations: 你长出了一根非常长的舌头，上面覆盖着尖刺。你可以用它来攻击或拖拽你的敌人。

messages.msgid: You tear into %s with your rasping tongue!
%1$s tears into %2$s with their rasping tongue!
Your tongue has increased its length and mobility.  You may use it to pull your enemies towards you.
translations: 你的舌头增加了长度和灵活性。你可以用它拖拽你的敌人。

messages.msgid: You stab into %s with your harpoon tongue!
%1$s stabs into %2$s with their harpoon tongue!
Your eyes are compound, like those of an insect.  This increases your Perception by 2 whenever you aren't wearing eyewear.
translations: 你的眼睛变成了像昆虫一样的复眼。只要你不戴任何眼部装备，感知 +2。

messages.msgid: The bottoms of your feet are strongly padded.  You receive no movement penalty for not wearing shoes, and your steps are significantly quieter, as added tissue dampens the noise.
translations: 你的脚底有厚实的肉垫。你不会因为不穿鞋而受到运动惩罚，而且脚步声也变得更安静了，因为额外的肉垫可以减弱噪音。

messages.msgid: Your legs have gained muscle mass to propel you across any terrain.
translations: 你的双腿肌肉发达，可以让你穿越任何地形。

messages.msgid: Your lower limbs have shortened and splayed, slowing your bipedal movement.  As long as you're not wielding anything and you've got both wings, you're able to crawl quickly and quietly when you run or crouch.
translations: 你的下肢已缩短并张开，从而减慢了双足运动速度。只要你不手持物品并且你长着翅膀，你可以在奔跑或俯卧时安静而快速地爬行。

messages.msgid: You hunch forward to crawl quickly on folded wings.
translations: 你弯腰向前，用折起来的翅膀快速爬行。

messages.msgid: You rise up to walk like a human.
translations: 你重新站起像人类一般行走。

messages.msgid: Your feet have grown into strong, curved claws.  They won't fit into normal shoes and are not much help in combat, but they allow you to climb most vertical surfaces with ease.  You can even cling to walls you glide into!
translations: 你的脚已经长成强壮的弯爪。它们穿不下普通的鞋子，对战斗也没有太大帮助，但可以让你轻松攀爬大多数垂直表面。你甚至可以在滑翔时攀墙！

messages.msgid: The heels of your feet have shifted up off the ground in a rather animalistic fashion, reducing your carry weight limit and preventing you from wearing shoes.  These hind feet are a bad match for human arms, but could pair well with matching forepaws.
translations: 你的脚后跟以一种相当动物化的方式向上移动，降低了你的负重，还让你没法穿鞋子。这种脚后跟和人类的手臂无法很好地配合，但可以和前爪相得益彰。

messages.msgid: You drop down on all fours.
You assume a less bestial posture.
translations: 你摆出了一个不那么野蛮的姿势。

messages.msgid: You've gained a strong ability to leap a short distance from a standing position with little preparation time.
translations: 你获得了一种强大的能力，能以很短的准备时间从立定姿态跳跃出一小段距离。

messages.msgid: You've gained a strong ability to leap from a standing position.
translations: 你获得了站立时跳跃的强大能力。

messages.msgid: You've gained a strong ability to leap a significant distance from a standing position and crush whatever you land on.
translations: 你获得了从站立的位置跳跃一段很长的距离，然后压碎你落点处的任何东西的强大能力。

messages.msgid: You have grown large, curved, and wickedly sharp talons in place of your big toes.  Fortunately, they don't get in the way of your movement.  Unfortunately, they do prevent wearing footgear.
translations: 你的大脚趾上长出了巨大、弯曲且看上去十分锋利的爪子。幸运的是，它们不会影响你的移动。不幸的是，这爪子让你无法穿戴鞋袜。

messages.msgid: You slash %s with one of your talons!
%1$s slashes %2$s with one of their talons!
Your legs and feet have become bird-like, with long talons arranged three ahead and one behind.  They probably won't fit in human shoes, but they're perfect for gripping onto precarious perches.
translations: 你的腿和脚变得像鸟一样，形成前三后一排列的长爪。它们可能穿不上普通的鞋子，但非常适合用来抓住摇晃的栖枝。

messages.msgid: Your feet have fused into hooves.  This allows you to perform a powerful kicking attack, provides natural armor, and removes the need to wear shoes; however, you cannot wear normal shoes.  Reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的脚已经融合成马蹄形状。这使你能够进行强大的踢击攻击，提供天然的护甲，并且不需要穿鞋子；然而，你无法穿普通的鞋子。这还可以减少在潮湿环境下的不利影响。

messages.msgid: So it's fermented?  Whatever, it's still good drinking.  You've developed the ability to metabolize alcohol as a food source.
translations: 所以说这玩意发酵过吗？管它呢，反正挺好喝。"酒是粮食精"，现在你消化酒精就像消化粮食一样能解饿。

messages.msgid: The aches and pains of living underground don't bother you as much.
translations: 你习惯于长年生活在地下，对你来说并不痛苦。

messages.msgid: Your frame has adapted for life in confined spaces.  You seem a little shorter and bulkier, trading mobility for muscle mass.  (+2 Strength, -2 Dexterity)
translations: 为了适应在狭小地方的生活，你变得矮小精干，牺牲灵活性来获得力量。力量 +2，敏捷 -2。

messages.msgid: Your digestive system is specialized to allow you to consume decaying material.  You can eat rotten food, albeit for less nutrition than usual.
translations: 你的消化系统已经变异得能够消化已经腐坏的食物，但是仅能从中获得较正常食物少的营养。

messages.msgid: You prefer to sustain your nutritional needs using your roots and direct nutrient extraction/synthesis.  Your human parts still need the raw caloric bulk of 'food' to keep them going, though, and you handle it a lot easier if it's had time to… age a little.
translations: 你更喜欢用你的根和或其他直接的营养萃取合成过程来维持你的营养需求。不过，你的人体成分仍然需要大量的"食物"来维持它们的健康，而且吸收食物养分时，你更希望它们能……"熟成"一段时间。

messages.msgid: You seem to get full faster now, and food goes through you more rapidly as well.
translations: 你更容易吃饱了，同时你现在是个直肠子。（物理意义上）

messages.msgid: We have streamlined our nutritional requirements.  We rely on the Mycus for sustenance, as it relies on us.  We may locate sources of sustenance in close proximity to Mycus core towers, and in forested areas that the Mycus has grown into.
translations: 吾等已精简了营养需求。吾等依赖马卡斯维生，正如其依赖吾等。在马卡斯核心塔及马卡斯繁盛之地四周，吾等将可寻获营养之源。

messages.msgid: Your digestive system is capable of digesting cellulose and other rough plant material.  You can eat underbrush and shrubs by activating this, standing over your target, and pressing E.
translations: 你能消化纤维素等植物原料了。激活后站在灌木丛上按"E"键，吃掉它。

messages.msgid: You're accustomed to eating plants directly, and can get nutrition from grass as well as underbrush and shrubs.  Eat either one by activating this, standing over your target, and pressing E.
translations: 你习惯直接吃植物，可以从草地以及灌木丛中得到营养。激活后站在目标上按"E"键，吃掉它。

messages.msgid: Your guts have developed the ability to handle the toxic elements of mutated flesh.  Mostly.
translations: 你的五脏六腑已经进化出处理变异肉中有毒成分的能力。大部分吧。

messages.msgid: Your digestion has evolved further.  In addition to mutated meat, you can also stomach the tainted and long-dead flesh of zombies… if you can stand the taste, of course.
translations: 你的消化能力进一步发展。除了变异肉，你还可以吃被污染的、早已死去的丧尸肉……当然，如果你能忍受这种味道的话。

messages.msgid: Your dextrous paws and long teeth allow you to dig through dirt and rubble with ease.
translations: 你灵活的爪子和长牙可以让你轻松地挖开泥土和瓦砾。

messages.msgid: Your tough paws allow you to dig through dirt and rubble with ease.
translations: 你坚硬的爪子可以让你轻松地挖开泥土和瓦砾。

messages.msgid: Your fangs have grown extremely large and incredibly sharp.  They make it impossible to wear mouthgear and difficult to eat… but leave nasty wounds when you bite.
translations: 你的牙又长又尖，以至于你不能带口罩，吃东西也很不方便……不过你的尖牙在咬人会留下可怕的伤口。

messages.msgid: You tear into %s with your saber teeth!
%1$s tears into %2$s with their saber teeth!
Your particular metabolism allows you to burn calories at a prodigious rate to regenerate tissues in a matter of minutes; this is, however, a very wasteful process.  Activate to start healing.
translations: 你特殊的新陈代谢让你以惊人的速度燃烧卡路里，在几分钟内使组织再生，然而这是一个非常耗能的过程。激活以开始治疗。

messages.msgid: Your hyper-metabolism starts burning up calories.
translations: 你的超级代谢开始极速消耗卡路里。

messages.msgid: You're burning calories like crazy to heal your wounds.
translations: 你疯狂地燃烧卡路里来治愈你的伤口。
你的超级代谢渐渐减弱了。

messages.msgid: You have a pair of small horns on your head.  They allow you to make a weak piercing headbutt attack, but prevent the use of most rigid headwear.
translations: 你头上有一对角，它们能让你施展较弱的头刺击，但也阻止了大多数硬质头部装备的佩戴。

messages.msgid: You have a pair of large curled horns, like those of a ram.  They allow you to make a strong bashing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing any headwear.
translations: 你有一对像公羊一样的羊角。你可以用你的头撞击对方造成钝击伤害，但也让你没法戴上不是织物的帽子。

messages.msgid: You headbutt %s with your curled horns!
You have a pair of long, pointed horns, like those of an antelope.  They allow you to make a strong piercing headbutt attack, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.
translations: 你头上有一对像羚羊般的犄角。你可以用你的头撞击对方造成刺击伤害，但也让你没法戴上不是织物做的帽子。

messages.msgid: You stab %s with your pointed horns!
You have a huge rack of antlers, like those of a moose.  They allow you to make a weak headbutt attack, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.
translations: 你头上有个像麋鹿一样的鹿角。你可以用你的头撞击对方造成轻微的钝击伤害，但也让你没法戴上不是织物做的帽子。

messages.msgid: You have a pair of antennae.  They allow you to detect the presence of monsters up to a few tiles away, even if you can't see or hear them, but prevent wearing headwear that is not made of fabric.
translations: 你有一对触角，可以发现周围你看不见的怪物，但也让你没法戴上不是织物做的帽子。
你在此地感知到了什么。

messages.msgid: Your legs are extremely limber and fast-moving.  You move 30% faster on flat surfaces.
translations: 你的腿非常柔软有弹性。在平地上，你移动能快30%。

messages.msgid: You have a short, stubby tail, like a rabbit's.  It serves no purpose.
translations: 你有一个毛茸茸的兔子尾巴。但是没有任何作用。

messages.msgid: You have a fin-like tail.  It allows you to swim more quickly, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.  Slightly increases wet benefits.
translations: 你有一个鳍状的尾巴。它让你游得更快，但也让你没法穿上不是织物的裤子。略微增加湿身心情加成。

messages.msgid: You have a long, graceful tail, like that of a big cat.  It improves your balance, making your ability to dodge higher, but prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
translations: 你有一条像猫一样的尾巴，它可以提高你的平衡能力，使你的闪避能力提高，但也让你没法穿上不是织物的裤子。

messages.msgid: You have a long tail with a tuft on the end.  You find yourself instinctively swatting away flies with it, though it's not as effective at balancing you as you'd like.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
translations: 你长出了一条长尾巴，末端有一簇毛。你发现你本能地用它驱赶苍蝇，以至于当你想要用它保持平衡时，它却打向了后背。让你没法穿上不是织物的裤子。

messages.msgid: You have a long but hairless tail.  It's a pretty effective balancing aid, but does look, uh, ratty.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
translations: 你长出了一条长而无毛的尾巴。它提供了优秀的平衡辅助，你没法穿上不是织物的裤子。

messages.msgid: You have a long, thick, lizardlike tail.  It helps you balance a bit but also makes a serviceable whip.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
translations: 你现在有了一根长长的、粗粗的蜥蜴尾巴。它能够帮你维持平衡，同时还能当做一根很犀利的鞭子。让你没法穿上不是织物的裤子。

messages.msgid: Your face has drastically mutated, with the bones of your jaws having extended forth into a long, tapered snout.  The palate of your mouth is considerably vaulted, with curved, serrated teeth lining your saurian maw and reptilian scales covering your muzzle's exterior.  While paleobiology has evidently not evolved with mouth gear in mind (making such items unwearable), the bite wounds you can now inflict promise the ferocity of long-dead beasts.
translations: 你的脸发生了巨大的变异，下颌骨向前延伸，变成了一个长长的、锥形的鼻子。你的嘴巴呈拱形，蜥蜴形状的大嘴里排列着弯曲的锯齿状牙齿，而爬行动物的鳞片覆盖着你的口吻外侧。虽然古生物学显然没有考虑到嘴部装备的出现（这使得你无法再佩戴这些物品），但你现在所能造成的咬伤展现出早已死去古代巨兽的凶猛。

messages.msgid: You dart your head and snap at %s!
translations: 你猛扑上去用大嘴撕咬%s！

messages.msgid: %1$s darts their head and snaps at %2$s!

Formed from a network of interlocking bones, a long tail has mutated from the base of your spine, with ossified tendons assisting in keeping the limb stiff and rigid.  A plume of lengthy feathers sprouts from the reptilian flesh along your new tail, drawing the eye.  While it is useless in combat and prevents you from wearing non-fabric pants, you find it's pretty handy for maintaining your balance.
translations: 一条由相互互锁的骨骼网络构成的长尾巴，从你脊柱的根部突变出来，骨化的肌腱有助于保持肢体坚固强健。一缕长长的羽毛沿着你的新尾巴从爬行动物的肉体中长出来，十分吸引眼球。虽然它在战斗时毫无用处，也让你没法穿上不是织物的裤子，但你发现它有助于你保持平衡。

messages.msgid: You have a long, fluffy-furred tail.  It greatly improves your balance, making your ability to dodge much higher.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
translations: 你有一根长长的毛茸茸的尾巴，它极大地提高你的平衡，使你的闪避能力提高。让你没法穿上不是织物的裤子。

messages.msgid: You have a long tail that ends in a vicious stinger.  It does not improve your balance at all, but allows for a powerful piercing attack.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
translations: 你有一条长着毒刺的尾巴，它并不能使你保持平衡，但提供刺击伤害。让你没法穿上不是织物的裤子。

messages.msgid: You have a long tail that ends in a heavy, bony club.  It does not improve your balance at all, but allows for a powerful bashing attack.  Prevents wearing non-fabric pants.
translations: 你有一条骨感十足的长长的尾巴，它并不能使你保持平衡，但提供钝击伤害。让你没法穿上不是织物的裤子。

messages.msgid: You've developed the ability to stockpile calories and then sleep for extended periods of time.
translations: 你拥有了储存大量卡路里后进入冬眠状态的能力。

messages.msgid: You can survive injuries that would incapacitate humans: you get a 20% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.
translations: 你能从严酷的环境中存活下来，生命值上限额外加成20%。可以和强壮等特性叠加。

messages.msgid: Not much scares you.  You get a 30% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.
translations: 基本没什么东西可以吓到你了。生命值上限额外加成30%。可以和强壮等特性叠加。

messages.msgid: You can simply take the punishment from lesser beings and keep going.  You get a 40% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.
translations: 弱者无法阻止你前进的道路，碾压！生命值上限额外加成40%。可以和强壮等特性叠加。

messages.msgid: You recover from pain slightly faster than normal.
translations: 你从疼痛中恢复的速度要比一般人快一些。

messages.msgid: You recover from pain faster than normal.
translations: 你从疼痛中恢复的速度要比一般人要快很多。

messages.msgid: You recover from pain much faster than normal.
translations: 你从疼痛中恢复的速度远远超过一般人。

messages.msgid: You've developed a serious appetite for pain, and take pride in your scars.
translations: 你对疼痛上瘾了，而且你对自己满身的伤疤非常自豪。

messages.msgid: You positively adore pain, in all its varied forms.
translations: 你沉迷于疼痛带来的快感，无论何种形式。

messages.msgid: Nothing hurts anymore.  Those bites tickle and the wounds itch a bit, but that's it.
translations: 再也没什么让你感到疼痛了，那些撕咬撞击枪凿斧砍仅仅让你感到有点痒。

messages.msgid: For some reason, things always seem to hurt you more.  Pain dealt to you is increased by 25%.
translations: 不知道为什么，你总是容易受伤。你受到的疼痛增加25%。

messages.msgid: Your body experiences pain out of proportion to the physical causes.  Pain dealt to you is increased by 50%.
translations: 你所感受到的疼痛要比实际情况高出很多。你受到的疼痛增加50%。

messages.msgid: Your body reacts cripplingly to any source of pain.  Pain dealt to you is doubled.
translations: 你的身体会对任何疼痛来源产生极度反应。对你造成双倍疼痛。

messages.msgid: You've had a revelation: by killing the weaker creatures, who would only die anyway, you preserve resources for those better able to survive.  You are less bothered by the deaths of others: their own weakness invited these fates upon them.
translations: 你从杀戮之中领悟到，通过杀掉终将死去的弱者，你为那些能够活下去的强者保留了更多资源。你不会太被其他人的死亡所困扰，因为他们自身的懦弱导致了他们的结局。

messages.msgid: Your brain has a lot more in common with a predatory animal than a human, making it easier to control misplaced reactions to the death of your prey.  Additionally, combat skills, which you use to hunt, are easier to learn and maintain.
translations: 你的大脑较人类而言更像是只猛兽，让你更容易控制自己在面对猎物死亡时所造成的负面情绪。此外，你能够更容易提升及保持你所用来进行狩猎的战斗技能。

messages.msgid: You consider yourself something other than human and no longer empathize with them.  Combat skills are easy to learn and maintain, but your critical thinking, so characteristic to these creatures, suffers.
translations: 你认为自己不再归属于人类，也不再同情他们。战斗技能很容易提升及保持，但你的批判性思维能力，那类生物的突出特点，变差了。

messages.msgid: Your mind and brain have adapted to your new place in the world: as one on top of the food chain.  You can effortlessly master and maintain combat skills, but your critical thinking has atrophied further.
translations: 你是顶级掠食者，你的意识和大脑已经适应了你在世界上的新地位：食物链的巅峰。你可以毫不费力地提升及保持战斗技能，但你的批判性思维能力已进一步萎缩。

messages.msgid: The hairless apes make as good eating as any other meat.
translations: 你认为那些没毛的猴子们比任何肉都要更好吃，你对美味的人肉充满着渴望。

messages.msgid: Puny as they may seem, a hunter needs a pack, and some of those hairless bipeds may yet prove some worth.  You continue to gain combat skills at an elevated rate, and maintain a level of critical thinking that supports cooperation.
translations: 尽管它们看起来很弱小，但猎手需要群体行动，而那些没毛的双足动物中的一部分可能还能证明自身有些价值。你继续以更高的速度获得战斗技能，并保持了进行合作所需要的批判思维。

messages.msgid: From time to time the Mycus requires protection from non-Mycus that, for whatever reason, wish it ill.  We have adapted to better carry out this task - our fibers will grow strong and resilient when such threats present themselves to us.
translations: 马卡斯时而需要吾等之保护，以免受那些，不知何故，总想伤害它的非马卡斯们的攻击。吾等已适应并进化出了执行该项任务之能力，吾等之纤维在遇到此类威胁时能够生长，并变得足够强大且有弹性。

messages.msgid: You have a pair of large, feathered wings.  Your body is too heavy to be able to fly, but if you're not too weighed down, you might be able to glide from a ledge or lessen the impact of a fall.
translations: 你的背后有双天使般的翅膀，但你太重了飞不起来。如果身上的负重不多，你可以从高处滑翔或减轻坠落时的冲击伤害。

messages.msgid: A large pair of translucent wings grow from your back.  They are too small to lift you, but if you're not weighed down, they can help a bit if you fall.  You can flutter them quickly to improve your move speed, but this is noisy and tires you out.
translations: 你的背上长出一对半透明的大翅膀。它们太小了，抬不起你，但如果你在没有负重时摔倒了，它们可以帮你一点忙。你可以快速摆动它们来提高你的移动速度，但这很吵，还会让你疲惫。

messages.msgid: You're fluttering your wings as fast as you can.  This doesn't generate enough lift to move you, but it does increase your movement speed.  If you're not burdened, you can fall short distances without harm.
translations: 你在尽可能快地扇动翅膀。这不足以产生的升力让你飞行，但它确实提高了你的移动速度。如果你没有负重，你可以在短距离内免疫跌落伤害。

messages.msgid: A set of tentacles surrounds your mouth.  They allow you to eat twice as fast.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.
translations: 你嘴上长了很多触须。吃东西快了一倍。稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: A set of insect-like mandibles have grown around your mouth.  They allow you to eat faster and provide a slicing unarmed attack.  Slightly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的嘴上长出了类似昆虫一样的下颚，你吃东西更快，并且让你在徒手攻击时能够用它狠狠地咬敌人一口。稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: You have developed deadly extensible fangs, allowing you to bite quickly or ensure your venom goes home, as desired.
translations: 你的牙齿发生了变异，你长出了可以伸缩的毒牙，让你能够快速撕咬敌人，也能让你的毒液如预期一样到达目的地。

messages.msgid: You have four prong-tipped legs, splayed out and articulated like a crab's.  They're a little quieter than human feet.
translations: 你张开四条关节像螃蟹一样的尖头腿。它们比人腿要安静一点。

messages.msgid: Your legs have consolidated into a single muscular 'foot' that goes up into your belly.  You move about a fourth of your previous speed and can no longer wear pants or shoes, on the other hand you make significantly less noise.  In addition to being harder to knock down, you can move through sludge-covered surfaces easily.
translations: 你的双腿被整合成一只肌肉发达的"脚"，伸入你的腹部。你的移动速度约为先前速度的四分之一，并且不能再穿裤子或鞋子，另一方面，你移动时的噪音明显降低。除了更难击倒外，你还可以轻松地穿过泥泞地面。

messages.msgid: By pushing your whole 'foot' against the ground you are able to move across rough terrain without losing your 'footing'.  You're also able to cling to the ground underwater, allowing you to move along the bottom more easily.
translations: 通过将整个"腹足"推到地面上，你可以在崎岖的地形上移动而不会失去"立足点"。 你还可以紧贴水下的地面，让你更轻松地沿着底部移动。

messages.msgid: You once had a significant other call you slimy, now you exemplify that.  It covers everything you come into contact with but now you can move through slime you didn't create with ease.
translations: 你曾经有个重要的另一半说你滑头，现在你就是个活生生的例子。黏液覆盖了所有你接触到的东西，但现在你可以不受阻碍的穿过任何黏液。

messages.msgid: Your mucus has developed an acidic component that seems to soften your prey up.
translations: 你分泌出的黏液中含有一种酸性成分，似乎能软化你的猎物。

messages.msgid: You've developed some ability to control your slime emissions.  As a result of this you can leave trails of slime anywhere you walk.
translations: 你进化出了部分控制你的黏液排放的能力。因此，无论你走到哪里，你都可以留下黏液的痕迹。

messages.msgid: Your ears have extended into long, pointed ones, like those of a canine.  They enhance your hearing, allowing you to hear at greater distances.
translations: 你的耳朵发生了变异，变得又长又尖，和狗耳朵差不多。它们能够增强你的听觉，让你听得更远。

messages.msgid: Your hearing has evolved further and is now on par with that of wolves.  You can hear things significantly farther away.
translations: 你的耳朵已经进一步变异，现在和狼耳朵差不多了。你能够听到远得多的地方所发出的声音。

messages.msgid: Your ears have extended into long, pointed, velvety ones, like those of a feline.  You find it easier to tune in on sounds from afar.
