translations: 你的耳朵发生了变异，变得又长又尖又软，和猫耳朵差不多。你发现自己能比较容易的收到远处发出的声音，听力得到了增强。

messages.msgid: Your ears have grown longer and rounder, much like those of a bear.  You can hear things a little farther away.
translations: 你的耳朵发生了变异，变得又圆又大，和熊耳朵差不多。你的听力稍微提升了。

messages.msgid: Your upper earlobes have grown noticeably higher.  Fortunately, they don't get in the way of your headgear, much.  Unfortunately, they also don't seem to help your hearing any.
translations: 你的耳朵发生了变异，和精灵一般，幸运的是，长长的耳垂并不影响你穿戴头饰。不幸的是，这仅仅是外观上的改变，并不能增强你的听力。

messages.msgid: Your ears are huge, round, and gray!  They're rather fascinating, and help you hear from a much greater distance.
translations: 你的耳朵发生了变异，变得又大又圆还有点灰！它们看上去很迷人，而且能够帮助你听见远处的动静。

messages.msgid: Your body excretes very fine amounts of a chemical which prevents you from sticking to webs.  Walking through webs does not affect you at all.
translations: 你的皮肤分泌出非常精细的化学物质以阻止粘在网上。你可以尽情地穿梭于网中了

messages.msgid: Your body produces and anchors webbing.  Too bad you can't seem to control the process.  There is a chance that you will leave webs in your wake.
translations: 你的身体能够自动生成并射出蛛网，不过不受控制。没准儿一觉醒来，你就被粘在床上了。

messages.msgid: You've developed the necessary anatomy and techniques to control your web-generation.  Activate this to start or stop weaving webs.
translations: 你已经变异出了生成蛛网的必要结构并掌握了相关控制技巧。激活该变异来开始或停止编织蛛网。

messages.msgid: Your webbing is strong enough to support your weight.  Activate to rappel down any drop you encounter, at the cost of nutrition.
translations: 你的蛛网很结实，足以支撑你的体重。激活时，通过消耗营养值，让你快速索降至悬崖之下。

messages.msgid: With spinnerets like THESE, who needs rope?!  Activate to produce rope.
translations: 有了次世代纺织器，谁还需要绳子？激活该变异以制造绳索。

messages.msgid: You spin a rope from your silk.
translations: 你用自己的丝编了一条绳索。

messages.msgid: You have a handsome set of whiskers around your mouth.  These make you more aware of vibrations in the air, and improve your ability to dodge very slightly.
translations: 你的嘴部周围长出了漂亮的胡须。它可以在空气中震动从而提高你的感知，略微提升你的闪避能力。

messages.msgid: You have a set of prominent rodent-like whiskers around your mouth.  These make you more aware of vibrations in the air, and improve your ability to dodge slightly.
translations: 你的嘴部周围出现了像啮齿动物般的显眼胡须。它可以在空气中震动从而提高你的感知，并轻微提升你的闪避力。

messages.msgid: You've put on some additional weight around your body.  It slows you down a little, but helps your swimming and warmth.
translations: 你身上有不少脂肪，或许这会使你变得迟钝一点，不过这对游泳和保暖都有帮助。

messages.msgid: You have grown noticeably taller and broader.  Much of it is useful muscle mass (Strength +2), but you find it throws off your balance and you get in your own way (+10 torso and arm encumbrance).
translations: 你明显地长高长壮了。你变得更强壮（力量+2），但是你发现你的平衡感被破坏了，甚至会自己绊到自己（+10躯干和手臂累赘）。

messages.msgid: You carry your rugged body with the dignity you deserve.  Strength +2.
translations: 虽然你的身材高大，但是你也拥有与之相匹配的力量和敏捷。力量+2。

messages.msgid: You have grown even more massive, to the point where you cannot usefully fit into human-sized clothing or vehicles.  Much of it is powerful muscle mass (Strength +4), but it's a real pain to haul around.
translations: 你的巨型身材很难找到匹配的衣服，连钻进汽车都困难。尽管你的力量惊人（力量+4）但是与之相随的迟缓笨重令你相当头痛。

messages.msgid: Your cardiovascular system has caught up with your muscular physique, so who needs pathetic human cars?  Strength +4.
translations: 你的生理系统已经足够驱动你巨大的身形，惊人的力量在你身上得到了完美的平衡。你堪称人形汽车。力量+4。

messages.msgid: Your muscles are a little stronger.  +1 Strength.
translations: 你比以前强壮了少许。力量+1。
你的肌肉更强壮了。力量+2。

messages.msgid: Your muscles are much stronger.  +4 Strength.
translations: 你的肌肉变得强壮多了。力量+4。

messages.msgid: Your muscles are noticeably bulging.  +7 Strength.
translations: 你的肌肉明显鼓起。力量+7。
你的肌肉已经生长完美。

messages.msgid: You are a little nimbler.  +1 Dexterity.
translations: 你比以前灵活了少许。敏捷+1。
你比以前更灵活了。敏捷+2。

messages.msgid: You are nimble and quick.  +4 Dexterity.
translations: 你变得既灵活又敏捷。敏捷+4。

messages.msgid: You are much nimbler than before.  +7 Dexterity.
translations: 你掌握了灵活行动的身法。敏捷+7。
你的肢体协调性已经完美。

messages.msgid: You are a little smarter.  +1 Intelligence.
translations: 你比以前聪明了少许。智力+1。
你比以前更聪明了。智力+2。

messages.msgid: You are much smarter, and your skull bulges slightly.  +4 Intelligence.
translations: 你变得聪明多了，而且你的头骨略微隆起。智力+4。

messages.msgid: Your skull bulges noticeably due to your impressive brain.  +7 Intelligence.
translations: 你令人印象深刻的大头显示了你的过人才智。智力+7。

messages.msgid: You understand almost everything about which you think, with minimal effort.
translations: 你的智力发展已经完美。

messages.msgid: Your brain has evolved beyond human imagination.  You'll show them the REAL meaning of 'gray goo'!
translations: 你的大脑已经进化到人类无法想象的地步。现在让他们见识一下什么才是"变形怪"真正的力量。

messages.msgid: Your senses are a little keener.  +1 Perception.
translations: 你的感官敏锐了少许。感知+1。
你的感官更敏锐了。感知+2。

messages.msgid: Your senses are much keener.  +4 Perception.
translations: 你的感官比以前敏锐得多了。感知+4。

messages.msgid: You can sense things you never imagined.  +7 Perception.
translations: 你能感觉到你从未想象过的东西。感知+7。
你的感官敏锐度已经完美。

messages.msgid: Your sense organs are all over the place: eyes extending and retracting, 'ears' of various shapes migrating about, and taste & smell are uncontrollable.  The world is a horrible mixup.  Ugh!
translations: 你的感知器官非常淘气：眼睛非凸即凹，各种形状的耳朵长的到处都是，假如它们还算是耳朵的话，更别提嗅觉和味觉了，根本不听使唤。这世界变成了一团恐怖的浆糊。呃啊~！

messages.msgid: You can now extend and reabsorb sensory organs at will, and can therefore ignore most shocks that would overwhelm lesser beings.
translations: 你的感知器官能够随意伸展收回，这让你能够忽略那些会对大部分低等生物造成巨大感知伤害的打击。

messages.msgid: You can communicate with your extant mass without physical contact, absorbing knowledge from nearby friendly slime.
translations: 你可以在没有身体接触的情况下与你现存的同类交流，从附近友好的变形怪中获取知识。

messages.msgid: You are significantly shorter than the general population.  You can't carry quite as much as a person of average height and you need special accommodations to drive a car, but otherwise being little isn't too much of a bother.
translations: 你比常人矮很多。你无法像常人一样携带那么多东西，还需要使用特殊设备才能开车，但除此之外，个子小也不是什么大麻烦。

messages.msgid: You are significantly taller than the general population.  This leaves you with high blood pressure, a big appetite, and some minor health concerns, but you can carry a bit more than normal.
translations: 你比常人高很多。这会导致你有高血压，并且胃口变大，以及其他的健康问题，但你可以比常人多携带一点东西。

messages.msgid: You've noticeably shrunk in size.  You're able to move with increased litheness, but your smaller stature prevents you from carrying as much.
translations: 你的体型明显缩小了。你移动时更加敏捷，但你的小个子让你无法携带很多东西。

messages.msgid: You're only half as tall as you used to be!  The weight of things you once found easy to carry is now unbearable, clothes are now twice as encumbering for you unless you refit them (since you're half their size), and your hit points are heavily reduced.  However, your movement is silent, and your dodge skill is a little higher.
translations: 你的身高只有以前的一半！你发现曾经轻易携带的物品重量现在已经让你难以忍受，从前所穿着的衣物在重新裁剪前对你而言增加了两倍累赘（因为你只有原来的一半大），你的生命值也大大降低了。然而，你移动时很安静，闪避技能也会更高一点。

messages.msgid: You've mastered your tiny form!  Item encumbrance and carry weight penalties are reduced, and you've learned to use your increased nimbleness to offset your reduced capacity to absorb damage.
translations: 你已经完全掌握了你细小的体型！累赘度和携带重量的惩罚略微减少了，而且你学会了用你所增加的灵活性来稍微补偿你所降低的吸收伤害的能力。

messages.msgid: By making the most of your small stature, you can avoid the notice of all but the most perceptive creatures, and your speed is greatly increased.
translations: 通过充分利用你的细小身材，除了少数高感知的生物，你可以避开大部分生物的注意，你的速度也大大提高了。

messages.msgid: Just thinking of mutagen (such a lovely word!  'Mutagen'.  Perfect!) makes you thirsty.  And you so love your new parts.  You simply must have more mutagen!
translations: 只要一想到"诱变剂"你就会饥渴难耐，你是如此的迷恋你的变异……再来点诱变剂就好了……

messages.msgid: You have a pair of bumps on your skull.
You have a flattened nose and thin slits for nostrils, giving you a lizard-like appearance.  This makes breathing slightly difficult and increases mouth encumbrance by 10.
translations: 你有一个扁平的鼻子和窄窄的鼻孔，就像蜥蜴一样。使你产生轻微的呼吸困难，嘴部累赘+10。

messages.msgid: Your tongue is forked, like that of a reptile.  This has no effect.
translations: 你的舌头像蛇一样分叉，除了吓人以外没什么用。

messages.msgid: Your tongue has lengthened and often extends far beyond your mouth.  This has no effect.
translations: 你的舌头拉长了，而且经常伸到嘴以外。这没有效果。

messages.msgid: You've developed an extremely long and mobile tongue.  You may use it to attack your enemies and pull them towards you.
translations: 你长出了一根非常长的舌头。你可以用它来攻击或拖拽你的敌人。

messages.msgid: Your eyes bulge out several inches from your skull.  This does not affect your vision in any way.
translations: 你的眼睛从头颅突出来几英寸，但这并不影响你的视觉。

messages.msgid: Your eyes barely protrude from your head on tentacles, preventing the use of any rigid eyewear.  On the plus side, you can have additional awareness, but sometimes your vision goes wonky as your brain tries to process the new angles.  Perception +1
translations: 你的眼睛变成触柄稍稍从你的头上凸出，这让你无法使用任何硬质眼镜。从好的方面来说，你可以获得额外的环境感知力，但有时当你的大脑试图处理新的视角时，你的视野会变得不稳定。感知+1

messages.msgid: Your eyes protrude from your head on flexible tentacles, preventing the use of any eyewear.  On the plus side, you can see in two directions at once, and they automatically retract to reduce damage.  Perception +2
translations: 你的眼睛从你的头上伸出，变成灵活的触柄，这让你无法使用任何眼镜。但另一方面，你可以同时看向两个方向，它们会自动缩回以减少伤害。感知+2

messages.msgid: You have compound eyes on rigid stalks that can fold back against your head to protect them from danger.  This gives you better all-around vision and allows you to see underwater, but interferes with eyewear.  Perception +1
translations: 你有一对坚硬的眼柄，可以向后折叠靠在你的头上，保护它们免受危险。这可以给你更好的全方位视野，让你在水下看看得更清楚，但会让你无法戴上眼镜。感知+1。

messages.msgid: Skin tabs and odd flaps of skin surround your mouth.  They don't affect your eating, but are unpleasant to look at.
translations: 你的嘴部环绕着褶皱和奇怪的皮瓣，它们并不影响你的进食，但看上去让人很不舒服。

messages.msgid: You have a pair of stubby little wings projecting from your shoulderblades.  They can be wiggled at will, but are useless.
translations: 你肩胛骨外有一对又粗又短的小翅膀，你可以拍打它们，但它们没什么用。

messages.msgid: Most of your fingers have grown to tremendous length, becoming a broad pair of leathery wings.  This allows you to arrest a fall or glide from a ledge if you aren't too weighed down, but naturally impedes your fine motor skills.  They even keep you warm when you sleep.
translations: 你的大部分手指已经长得非常长，变成了一对宽阔的皮革翅膀。 这可以防止你不慎跌倒或者在崖壁间滑行，只要别太重，但自然也会妨碍精细运动技能。它们甚至可以在睡觉时为你保暖。

messages.msgid: You have a very large pair of brightly-colored, very beautiful wings.  They can't lift you, and they make balancing tricky, but they certainly catch air and attention!
translations: 你拥有一对又大又漂亮的色彩斑斓的蝶翼。靠这玩意飞不起来，也让平衡变得更难。不过至少很拉风！

messages.msgid: Your skin is covered in a pattern of red spots.
translations: 你的皮肤长了很多红色的疹子。

messages.msgid: You smell awful.  Monsters that track scent will find you very easily, and humans will react poorly.
translations: 你的臭味十里外都能闻得到，怪物很容易追到你，人类都离你远远的。

messages.msgid: You're slightly deformed.  Some people will react badly to your appearance.
translations: 你长得像个畸形怪胎，某些人看你可能不顺眼。

messages.msgid: You're hideously deformed.  Some people will have a strong negative reaction to your appearance.
translations: 你的面部结构严重变形，有些人可能会对你的外表产生强烈的反感。

messages.msgid: Your visage is disgusting and liable to induce vomiting.  People will not want to interact with you unless they have a very good reason to.
translations: 你恶心的畸形外表让人看到就有想吐的冲动，除非有非常重要的缘由，人们压根就不愿搭理你。

messages.msgid: You're a real head-turner.  Some people will react well to your appearance, and most people have an easier time trusting you.
translations: 你的相貌十分英俊，大家很容易接近你并且信任你。

messages.msgid: You are a vision of beauty.  Some people will react very well to your looks, and most people will trust you immediately.
translations: 你有一个看起来美丽的外表，一些人会被你外表所吸引，大多数人会信任你。

messages.msgid: You are incredibly beautiful.  People cannot help themselves due to your charms, and will do whatever they can to please you.
translations: 你有着超凡脱俗般的灿丽容貌，正如天使下凡一般，无论是谁都完全在你身上挑不出任何缺点；人们情不自禁被你所折服，将尽一切可能来的取悦你。

messages.msgid: Your face and jaw have begun… changing.  Masks and such fit OK, but you're noticeably mutated.
translations: 你的脸和下巴发生了……变化。你仍然可以戴上面具一类的东西，但是你的变异已经十分明显。

messages.msgid: Your face resembles that of a bull, with a significant snout.  It looks fearsome but makes it difficult to find gear that covers your face.
translations: 你的脸就像是一头公牛，长着明显的牛鼻子。它看起来很吓人，但也让你很难找到合适的脸部装备。

messages.msgid: Your jaw and nose have extended into a wolfish muzzle.  It lends itself to biting in combat and looks impressive, but prevents wearing mouthgear.
translations: 你的下巴和鼻子都发生了变异，变得和狼一样。这让你能在战斗中狠狠地咬敌人一口，而且看着也很"引入注目"，但供人类使用的口罩等嘴部装备对你来说已经戴不上了。

messages.msgid: Your jaw and nose have extended into a bearish muzzle.  You could bite with it, and it looks impressive, but it prevents wearing mouthgear.
translations: 你的下巴和鼻子都发生了变异，变得和熊一样。咬人威力大多了，貌若熊罴，令人印象深刻，但供人类使用的口罩等嘴部装备对你来说已经戴不上了。

messages.msgid: Your face and jaw have extended, giving you an alert and attentive appearance.
translations: 你的脸颊凸出来了，让你看起来充满着警觉与细心。

messages.msgid: Your face and jaws are a shorter version of those found on alligators.  They look NASTY--as do the bite wounds they can inflict--but prevent wearing mouthgear.
translations: 你的脸和鼻子都发生了变异，呃，看上去是缩短版的鳄鱼吻。它看起来巨凶——咬起来也巨凶，但供人类使用的口罩等嘴部装备对你来说已经戴不上了。

messages.msgid: You bite a chunk out of %s!
translations: 你咬掉了 %s 的一部分！

messages.msgid: You have an unsettlingly wide mouth, like a frog.  This looks hideous, but allows you to swallow your food whole.
translations: 你长着一张令人不安的大嘴，就像青蛙一样。这看起来很丑，但它可以让你把食物整个吞下。

messages.msgid: You've gotten rid of that terribly imprecise mouth and now imbibe your food like a proper person.  Chewing was tiresome anyway.
translations: 你终于摆脱那张糟糕而又含糊的嘴啦，现在你现在能用长长的喙像个真正的"人"一样吸取植物精华。咀嚼多累啊！

messages.msgid: You have Avian Bone Syndrome--your bones are nearly hollow.  Your body is very light as a result, enabling you to move and attack 20% faster, but also frail; you can carry 40% less, and bashing attacks injure you more.
translations: 你有禽骨综合症 - 你的骨头几乎是空心的。由于你的身体很轻，你的行动速度增加20%，但你的体质也弱，你的最大载重量减少40%，而且你受到的钝击伤害有所提升。

messages.msgid: Your bones are particularly dense and durable.  Your tougher frame grants 5% more HP and 15% more carry capacity plus bashing attacks injure you less, but your higher weight makes attacking and moving 5% slower.  Also, dodging and swimming are harder.
translations: 你的骨骼特别致密耐用。更硬的身体为你增加了5%的生命值和15%的负重能力，钝击对你的伤害也变得更小了，但你较高的体重会使攻击和移动速度变慢5%。此外，你更难进行闪避和游泳。

messages.msgid: You feel nauseated almost constantly, and are more liable to throw up from food poisoning, alcohol, etc.  You can, if desired, think yourself into vomiting, too.
translations: 你经常感到恶心，更容易从变质食物和酒精中获得这种状态。

messages.msgid: You have a major digestive disorder.  Though it causes you to vomit frequently, you have found that you can trigger your vomit reflex on demand, too.
translations: 你有严重的消化系统紊乱，虽然它会导致你频繁呕吐，但你也可以根据需求触发呕吐反射。

messages.msgid: You can pursue prey for miles and miles at a variety of paces until they stop from exhaustion.
translations: 你可以按照自己的节奏连续追踪猎物数英里，直到它们停止呼吸。

messages.msgid: You can pursue prey for days until they literally die from exhaustion.  It's too bad zombies don't fatigue either.
translations: 你可以追捕猎物几天，直到它们精疲力竭而死。可惜的是，丧尸也不知疲倦。

messages.msgid: You require more food than most people, but recover stamina slightly faster.
translations: 你消耗的食物比大部分人都多，同样，你耐力的恢复速度略微加快。

messages.msgid: You require more resources than most, but heal more rapidly as well.  Provides weak regeneration even when not asleep.
translations: 你会消耗比众人更多的资源，但是也会自我愈合得非常快。不在睡眠时也能恢复相当一部分HP。

messages.msgid: You need about twice as much food as the average human to maintain your expanded cardiovascular and respiratory systems.  On the plus side, it doesn't take you much time to recover from any strenuous activity.
translations: 你消耗的食物相当于普通人食量的两倍多，这才能够支撑被变异扩充的心肺系统。同时，你的耐力能在经过激烈运动后更加快速的恢复。

messages.msgid: You consume three times as much food as the average human to maintain your truly superhuman endurance.
translations: 你的全身系统发生了变异，你消耗的食物相当于普通人食量的三倍多，但以此来维持你超人一般的耐力。

messages.msgid: Your body dries out easily; you need to drink more water.
translations: 你的身体容易脱水。你需要喝更多的水。

messages.msgid: Ugh, out of water already?  You need about twice the fluids of an average human.
translations: 呃，已经没水了么？你差不多需要两人份的水来维持生命。

messages.msgid: You dry out seriously quickly, requiring three times as much liquid to stay hydrated.
translations: 如果没有三人份的水的话，你就要变成人干了。

messages.msgid: Your body gets everything it needs from the food that you eat!  You no longer need hydration from fluids.
translations: 你的身体能够从食物中得到所有需要的所有营养！你不再需要通过液体补水了。

messages.msgid: You could probably sleep through a firefight.
translations: 大火和消防水枪都叫不醒你。

messages.msgid: You find yourself needing to sleep quite often.  You'll spend about half of your time in or around a bed.
translations: 你发现自己更加渴望睡眠，整天都迷迷糊糊，睡眠占去了你的一半生命。

messages.msgid: You feel as though you are slowly weakening and your body heals slower.
translations: 你好像觉得你的身体正在慢慢变得虚弱，而且自愈得更慢了。

messages.msgid: Your body is very slowly wasting away.
translations: 你的身体正在非常缓慢地萎缩！

messages.msgid: Your body is slowly wasting away!
translations: 你的身体正在缓慢地萎缩！

messages.msgid: Your skin simply cannot handle ultraviolet radiation, such as sunlight.  It will seriously burn you.
translations: 你的皮肤无法承受阳光中的紫外线辐射，暴露在阳光下会严重灼伤你的皮肤。

messages.msgid: Your extremities are covered in painful sores.  The pain is worse when they are covered in clothing.
translations: 你的四肢覆盖满了疼痛的溃疡。当你穿着衣服时更是会痛不欲生。

messages.msgid: Sunlight makes you uncomfortable.  If you are outdoors and the weather is Sunny, you suffer -1 to all stats.
translations: 阳光使你不舒服。如果你在晴朗的户外，你所有属性值-1。

messages.msgid: Sunlight makes you very uncomfortable.  If you are outdoors during the day, you suffer -1 to all stats; -2 if the weather is Sunny.
translations: 阳光让你很不舒服。如果你在户外，你所有属性值-1，如果天气晴朗，则-2。

messages.msgid: Sunlight makes you extremely uncomfortable, resulting in large penalties to all stats.
translations: 阳光让你极端不舒服，暴露在阳光下会使你各项属性值大幅下降。

messages.msgid: Your hands are heavily webbed, reducing your Dexterity by 1 and causing problems with gloves.  However, you can swim much faster.  Slightly decreases wet penalties.
translations: 你的手上长出了蹼，敏捷-1，而且没法戴手套，但是你可以游得更快。稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your feet are heavily webbed, allowing you to swim faster if you aren't wearing footwear.
translations: 你的脚上长有厚厚的蹼，如果你不穿鞋，可以游得更快。

messages.msgid: Your hands have fused into quasi-paws.  Fine manipulation is a challenge: permanent hand encumbrance of 10, difficulty with delicate craftwork, and your gloves don't fit.  But they handle water better and bear weight well, allowing you to move on all fours when crouching and unarmed.
translations: 你的双手变成了爪子。精细操作对你来说是个挑战：手部累赘永久+10，精细制造时间延长，手套也不再合身。但也更适应于游泳，可以更好地负重，也能让你在没穿装备时用四肢匍匐行进。

messages.msgid: You come out of your quadrupedal posture.

Your paws are much larger now.  Manual dexterity is difficult: permanent hand encumbrance of 20, serious problems crafting, and no gloves.  In return, though, you can swim better and move on all fours when crouching and unarmed.
translations: 你的爪子现在更加粗壮了。手部灵活性更差：手部累赘永久+20，制造物品有严重困难，不能戴手套。这也让你能更好地游泳，且可以在空手时靠四肢行动。

messages.msgid: You have a beak for a mouth.  You can occasionally use it to peck at your enemies, but it is impossible for you to wear mouth gear.  Slightly reduces wet effects.
translations: 你有一个嘴喙。你可以偶尔用它来啄你的敌人，但你不能带口罩类物品。稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Pecking at prey is part of your daily routine now.  Slightly reduces wet effects.
translations: 啄你的猎物已经是你日常生活的一部分了。稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: You jackhammer into %s with your beak!
Though your beak's not suitable for pecking, those flowers out there are a good source of energy.  Examine them to feed.
translations: 虽然你的喙不适合啄东西，那些开在外边的花却成了不错的能量来源。按"E"查看来食用。

messages.msgid: Your DNA has been damaged in a way that causes you to continually develop more mutations.
translations: 你体内的基因已被严重损害，这会导致你会不断产生更多的变异。

messages.msgid: Exposure to portal storms and related phenomena causes you to mutate in a mostly predictable fashion.
translations: 暴露在空间风暴及其带来的异象下，让你开始向难以预测的方向变异。

messages.msgid: Your body alters itself rapidly, and without your intervention or conscious control.
translations: 你的身体快速的发生各种变异，而且根本不管你愿不愿意。

messages.msgid: Your body has become radioactive!  You continuously emit low levels of radiation, which slowly contaminates the world around you.
translations: 你的身体拥有了放射性！你不断向周围辐射少量的射线，缓慢地污染着你周围的世界。

messages.msgid: Your body has become radioactive!  You continuously emit moderate levels of radiation, which contaminates the world around you.
translations: 你的身体拥有了放射性！你不断向周围辐射中量的射线，污染着你周围的世界。

messages.msgid: Your body has become radioactive!  You continuously emit heavy levels of radiation, making your surroundings unlivable.
translations: 你的身体拥有了放射性！你不断向周围辐射大量的射线，你周围的世界寸草不生。

messages.msgid: Your body is coated with a fine slime which makes uncovered skin harder to grab and protects from long-term effects of acid, though not short-term ones.  Greatly increases wet benefits.
translations: 你的身上覆盖着一层细腻的黏液，使你裸露的皮肤难以抓握，并且使你能免受酸液腐蚀的长期效果影响，但不能防止短期腐蚀。大大增加湿身心情加成。

messages.msgid: Your body's slime output has become sticky and gel-like, making uncovered skin harder to grab and offering some protection from acid.  Greatly increases wet benefits.
translations: 你身上的黏液变得粘稠且呈凝胶状，使你裸露的皮肤难以抓握，并且使你能部分免受酸液的腐蚀。大大增加湿身心情加成。

messages.msgid: Your flesh is a pleasing gel-like consistency.  Your bodily functions seem to be moving around, and your leg-equivalents flow comfortably - if a little slower than your old meat-legs.
translations: 你的血肉就好像一整块舒爽的凝胶。你的身体结构似乎正在到处跑偏，而你的"腿"流动的相当舒适，不过比起你原先的肉腿稍微慢了些。

messages.msgid: Your body is more or less one consistent whole: a single, giant, omni-cell that alters itself as needed.
translations: 你的身体基本上就是一个整体：一个单一巨大可以随意变换形状的大细胞。

messages.msgid: Your body's ability to digest meat is severely hampered.  Eating meat has a good chance of making you vomit it back up; even if you manage to keep it down, its nutritional value is greatly reduced.
translations: 你的身体丧失了对肉类的消化以及吸收能力，你将不能从鸡鸭等肉类中获得营养，你只能吃素了。

messages.msgid: Your body's ability to digest fruits, vegetables, grains and nuts is severely hampered.  You cannot eat anything besides meat.  While your vitamin C needs are lowered, it's still needed and can be found often in organ meat.
translations: 你的身体消化水果，蔬菜，谷物和坚果的能力受到严重阻碍。除了肉，你什么都不能吃。虽然对维生素 C 的需求量有所降低，但它仍然是必需的，而且经常存在于动物内脏中。

messages.msgid: You can still eat other food, but you crave the taste of blood over everything else.  Without a steady supply or some kind of iron supplement, you're prone to developing anemia.
translations: 你仍然可以吃其他食物，但你对鲜血的渴望胜过其他一切。如果没有稳定的铁来源或某种补铁剂，你很容易患上贫血。

messages.msgid: Your craving for blood borders on obsession.  You need the stuff too much to care about whether it came from a human, and your body can filter out most of the toxins in mutant blood.
translations: 你对血液的渴望近乎痴迷。你太需要这些东西了，以至于不在乎它是否来自人类，而你的身体可以过滤掉变异血液中的大部分毒素。

messages.msgid: Your muscles are generally slow to move.  You move 10% slower.
translations: 你的肌肉总体来说不适合运动，你移动速度下降10%。

messages.msgid: Your muscles are quite slow to move.  You move 20% slower.
translations: 你的肌肉十分不适合运动，你移动速度下降20%。

messages.msgid: Your muscles are very slow to move.  You move 30% slower.
translations: 你的肌肉非常不适合运动，你移动速度下降30%。

messages.msgid: You feel very sluggish when not in direct sunlight.  You suffer a 5% drop in speed when in shade, and a 10% drop in speed when in the dark.
translations: 当你不在阳光下时，你的行动会变得非常迟钝。你在阴暗处速度下降5%，在黑暗中下降10%。

messages.msgid: You have developed several vines sprouting from your shoulder area.  They're bulky, and get in the way.
translations: 你的肩膀上长出了许多藤蔓。又笨重又麻烦。

messages.msgid: You've developed the ability to control your vines; they make good lashes.  You can even rappel down sheer drops using them, but disconnecting HURTS.
translations: 你已经可以控制你身上的藤蔓了。这些藤蔓可以猛抽你的敌人。你甚至可以用这些藤蔓从陡坡上爬下去，不过藤蔓断开时可真疼。

messages.msgid: You lash %s with one of your vines!
%1$s lashes %2$s with one of their vines!
You have full control of your vines, and can grow new ones and detach old ones more or less at will.
translations: 你已经完全掌握了你的藤蔓。并且可以随时生长出新的藤蔓或者扯下旧的藤蔓。

messages.msgid: You detach a vine from your body.
translations: 你从身上扯下一条藤蔓。

messages.msgid: Roots have started growing from your leaf-like hair.  They don't seem to do much.
translations: 根已经开始从你的头发上生长出来，它们似乎没有什么作用。

messages.msgid: Your toes have grown wriggly, and you can't imagine why you wear that stuff on your feet.  Take it off.  It's in the way.
translations: 你的脚趾奇葩的蜿蜒着，而你根本想不通你为何会在脚上穿东西。脱下来，它挡到你了。

messages.msgid: It's about time you started developing a root system.  When reading, fishing, waiting, or otherwise being stationary for a while on diggable terrain, you'll extract nutrients and water from the soil.
translations: 是时候发展你的根系了。在阅读，钓鱼，等待，或者站在可挖掘地形上时，你将从土壤中提取营养素。

messages.msgid: You find it difficult not to sink roots when able.  You extract nutrients and water whenever on diggable terrain, but move more slowly.
translations: 你发现一有机会自己就想要扎根进土里。你可以从任何可挖掘地形上或者水中汲取营养，但你的行动更加缓慢了。

messages.msgid: Every inch of your skin is packed with chlorophyll and you have strong roots.  Sleeping on diggable soil will satisfy any hunger or thirst you might have.
translations: 你的每寸肌肤富含叶绿素，你还有强大的根系。只要睡在可挖掘的土壤上你就不会饥渴。

messages.msgid: You have gained the ability to commune with trees and comprehend their ancient wisdom.  Activate next to a tree to gradually gain overmap vision through connected forests.
translations: 你获得了与树木交流的能力，能够理解它们的古老智慧。在树木附近激活，可借助相连的森林获得大地图视野。

messages.msgid: Your muscle response is dependent on ambient temperatures.  You lose 1% of your speed for every 5 (2.8) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C).  This sluggishness helps you conserve energy, however.
translations: 你的肌肉反应速度受环境温度影响。在18.3℃(65F)以下，温度每降低2.8℃(5F)，你的速度将下降1%。但行动迟缓能够帮助你减少略微食物消耗。

messages.msgid: Your muscle response is highly dependent on ambient temperatures.  You lose 1% of your speed for every 3 (1.7) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C), but your slow metabolism requires much less energy.
translations: 你的肌肉反应速度严重受环境温度影响。在18.3℃(65F)以下，温度每降低1.7℃(3F)，你的速度将下降1%。但你缓慢的新陈代谢能够帮助你减少能量消耗。

messages.msgid: You are cold-blooded and rely on heat to keep moving.  Your lose 1% of your speed for every 2 (1.1) degrees below 65 F (18.3 C), resulting in less calorie usage.
translations: 你是冷血动物，依靠热量来移动.你在气温为18℃以下(65F)时气温每下降1.1℃(2F)速度降低1%。但缓慢的新陈代谢能够减少卡路里消耗。

messages.msgid: Your body has become permanently cold-blooded.  Your speed lowers or raises 1% for every 2 (1.1) degrees below or above 65 F (18.3 C).  You eat much less than you otherwise would.
translations: 你已经完全变异为冷血动物。在温度低于/高于18.3℃(65F)时，每 1.1℃(2F)的变化会使你的速度降低/提高 1%。你的食量也因此减少了不少。

messages.msgid: You have a growling, rough voice.  Persuading NPCs will be more difficult, but threatening them will be easier.
translations: 你有着一个粗鲁的声音，说服他人将更加困难，但威胁他们变得十分容易。

messages.msgid: You have a low, croaking voice, like an aged grandparent.  Persuading NPCs will be easier, but threatening them will be more difficult.
translations: 你的声音变成低沉的呱呱叫声，像一个年老的祖父母。说服他人会更容易，但威胁他们会更难。

messages.msgid: You have a threatening snarl in your voice.  Persuading NPCs will be near impossible, but threatening them will be much easier.
translations: 你的嗓门很大且经常发出咆哮音，从而几乎不可能说服他人，但威胁他们要容易得多。

messages.msgid: You hiss when speaking.  Persuading NPCs will be more difficult, but threatening them will be easier.
translations: 正常说话的时候会伴随嘶嘶声，虽然说服他人会更为困难，但是威胁他们却轻而易举。

messages.msgid: Your voice sounds like a bird trying to imitate a human.  Persuading NPCs will be more difficult, but threatening them will be easier.
translations: 你的声音听起来像是一只鸟在模仿人类。说服他人将会更加困难，但恐吓他们会更简单。
你偶尔会无法控制的大喊大叫。

messages.msgid: You frequently let out a piercing howl.
translations: 你经常发出刺耳的惨嚎声。

messages.msgid: Your arms have sprouted feathers, and you find you can no longer fully extend your elbows.  This gets in the way a bit, but the feathers offer minor protection from damage and the elements.
translations: 你的手臂长出了羽毛，这让你的肘部无法完全伸展。这有点碍事，但羽毛提供了轻微的保护，抵消伤害和环境影响。

messages.msgid: You've *finally* sprouted a pair of arms from your midsection.  They flail more or less uncontrollably, making you feel rather larval.
translations: 你"终于"从身体中部长出了一对臂膀。他们来回摆动基本不受控制，让你感觉自己就是个幼虫。

messages.msgid: It's good having all your arms.  Though they're too thin to block or punch, you can fold them inside human-shaped gear if need be.
translations: 有这么多臂膀真是好。尽管它们太纤细没办法格挡或者击拳，但需要时你能够把它们藏进你披的这身人皮里边。

messages.msgid: There's the last two limbs you were expecting.  Unfortunately, you still can't coordinate them, so you're getting in your own way.  A lot.
translations: 你期待的最后那两条肢体就在这。不幸的是你还无法协调他们，所以你还有很长的路要走，很长的路。

messages.msgid: You have four handsome limbs, and then those mutant 'hand' and 'foot' things.  They probably aren't worth concealing.
translations: 你另外有四条漂亮的肢体，在加上那些变异了的手和脚。或许根本没必要藏起来。

messages.msgid: Your arms have transformed into tentacles, resulting in a +1 bonus to Dexterity, permanent hand encumbrance of 30, and an inability to wear gloves.  Reduces penalties for attacking while prone and somewhat decreases wet penalties.
translations: 你的手臂变成了触须，敏捷+1，手部累赘永久+30，不能戴手套。减少俯卧时的攻击惩罚，并稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: You slap %s with one of your tentacles!
%1$s slaps %2$s with one of their tentacles!
You rake %s with one of your tentacles!
%1$s rakes %2$s with one of their tentacles!

Your arms have transformed into four tentacles, resulting in a +1 bonus to Dexterity, permanent hand encumbrance of 30, and an inability to wear gloves.  You can make up to 3 extra attacks with them, and you suffer reduced penalties to attacking while prone.  Somewhat decreases wet penalties.
translations: 你的手臂变成了四条触须，敏捷+1，手部累赘永久+30，不能戴手套。随机增加最多3次额外攻击。减少俯卧时的攻击惩罚，并稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your arms have transformed into eight tentacles, resulting in a +1 bonus to Dexterity, permanent hand encumbrance of 30, and an inability to wear gloves.  You can make up to 7 extra attacks with them, and suffer reduced penalties to attacking while prone.  Somewhat decreases wet penalties.
translations: 你的手臂变成了八条触须，敏捷+1，手部累赘永久+30，不能戴手套。随机增加最多7次额外攻击。减少俯卧时的攻击惩罚，并稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: You have grown a thick shell over your torso, providing excellent armor, but you cannot wear anything on your torso.  Somewhat reduces wet effects.
translations: 你的躯干外长出了一层厚厚的外壳，为你提供了优秀的防护。但不能穿衣服了。稍微减少湿身心情惩罚。

messages.msgid: Your protective shell has grown large enough to accommodate--if need be--your whole body.  Activate to pull your head and limbs into your shell, trading mobility and vision for warmth and shelter.
translations: 你可以随时、把自己整个缩进你宽敞的甲壳里，充分享受它的温暖和保护。激活它将头和四肢缩入壳里，以移动力和视野为代价，换取保暖和防护。

messages.msgid: Your protective shell has developed increased strength and hardness and a mother of pearl sheen.
translations: 你的保护外壳变得具有更高的强度和硬度，散发出珍珠母般的光泽。

messages.msgid: Your legs have transformed into six tentacles.  This decreases your speed on land by 20%, makes your movement silent, increases your swimming speed and reduces wet penalties, but you can't use footwear any more.
translations: 你的腿变成了六条触须。这会降低你20%左右的陆地移动速度，但让你走路悄无声息。然而，也增加你的游泳速度，减少湿身心情惩罚，同时你也无法再穿上鞋子了。

messages.msgid: Your lower tentacles have developed suckers, perfect for walking along lake beds and ocean floors.  They make land movement marginally more tiring, do a good job of keeping you set in place.
translations: 你的下肢的触手长出了吸盘，非常适合在湖底或海床上移动。在陆地上行动时会带来一定的不便，不过可以保证你稳稳站着。

messages.msgid: Your hook-shaped feet curl inward to grip the ground, allowing you to easily walk along the bottom when you're underwater.  They're also a bit quicker at climbing over obstacles, even on dry land.
translations: 你的钩形脚向内弯曲以抓住地面，让你可以轻松地沿着水底行走。即使在陆地上，它们也能帮你更快地越过障碍。

messages.msgid: You sometimes look back on your days before your tail came in.  But you're better now.
translations: 你偶尔还会回想起长尾巴前的日子，但你觉得现在快活多了。

messages.msgid: You feel bad for all the creatures that don't carry their home on their backs.
translations: 你为所有不背着家的生物感到难过。

messages.msgid: You're sure you'll fly someday.  In the meantime, there are still nests to build.
translations: 你确信你有一天会飞起来的，但在此之前还是先把窝做好再说。

messages.msgid: Ninety percent of the planet, and it's yours to explore.  And colonize.  And enjoy.  What was that about a surface?
translations: 行星上百分之九十的区域等待着你去探索征服。你还想什么陆地上的事？

messages.msgid: It's about time you grew out.  Now that you've matured, it is time to make something of yourself.
translations: 漫长的时间终于让你成熟，是时候让你拥有自己的东西了。

messages.msgid: Stalking prey, eating well, and lying in the sun.  Mmm, all you could ever desire.
translations: 跟踪猎物，吃顿好的，躺在阳光下晒太阳。嗯，这些就是你全部的渴望。

messages.msgid: You're the perfect candidate to lead a pack.
translations: 你是狼群最合适的领头人选。

messages.msgid: So the humans died; what's the worry?  Now they won't ruin the woods.
translations: 人类灭绝又如何？反正它们不再会来毁灭我的森林了。

messages.msgid: Civilization collapsed?  Great!  You and your kin will never have to worry about a slaughterhouse again.
translations: 文明崩溃？太棒了！你和你的亲属将永远不用再担心屠宰场了。

messages.msgid: It would be good to be a queen, having workers constantly servicing your every need… but how would you keep them in line?
translations: 要是你能够成为王虫，让其它虫子每时每刻服侍着你，不是很好吗……但是怎样才能让虫群顺从呢？

messages.msgid: Well, you still have those other walking flowers--and the mushrooms, too--to deal with.  But you'll manage.
translations: 好吧，你还要处理一些会走路的花草或者蘑菇，但你会搞定的。

messages.msgid: What was that old advertisement?  'Paint the planet'?  That might be a good long-term goal, but for now…
translations: 以前有个宣传是怎么说的，"绿色地球"？听起来是个不错的远大目标，不过现在嘛……

messages.msgid: Not much point to rebuilding up in that horribly bright, roofless wasteland.  Now that you've become accustomed to your new digs, there's the beginning of a great empire right here, underground.
translations: 在那个亮的可怕的废土上重建并没有多大意义。你现在习惯于你的新住所，这将是一个伟大帝国的开端，地下的帝国。

messages.msgid: Strange aeons, true, but Death seems to be slacking, and you are doing just fine.
translations: 现在是个奇怪的时代，是啊，古神还在打盹儿，没空儿理你。

messages.msgid: Well, maybe you'll just have to make your own worldwide web.
translations: 你已经变异为蜘蛛人，你也许可以自己搞个万维网。

messages.msgid: Hey.  Civilization fell.  You're still around.  'Rat' just isn't respectful.
translations: 嘿，文明毁灭，但你毫发无伤。"老鼠"这个称呼太不尊重，但你拥有着不亚于老鼠的顽强生命力。

messages.msgid: After all those experiments, what's a few more, hmm?
translations: 所有这些实验之后，再来几个，怎么样？

messages.msgid: You're the perfect candidate to tidy this mess.
You are the tree under which humankind will shelter during these dark times.
translations: 你是一颗大树。你是人类在黑暗岁月的避难所。

messages.msgid: You can't tell what you are anymore.  Everything and yet nothing, like you weren't meant to exist.  But you do, and you're a force, no matter what happens.  Unlocks gaining post-threshold traits from most other mutation categories.
translations: 你再也不知道自己是什么怪物了。像各种生物又不是任何一种生物，就像你本不该在这个世界上存在一般。但你又是确实存在的，你代表了某种力量，无论发生了些什么。你现在可以获得大多数其他变异类别中突破阈值后的特性。

messages.msgid: The chance to undo not one but TWO extinction events.  You're confident you'll do fine.
translations: 接连化解两次灭绝危机的挑战，你相信你会做得很好。

messages.msgid: A perfect ambush predator, if only there were less competition.
translations: 一个完美的伏击捕食者，要是少一点竞争就好了。

messages.msgid: So much food, everywhere!  And nobody's even guarding it anymore!  These are good times.
translations: 到处都是这么多的食物！而且连一个看守的人都没有！现在是个好时代。

messages.msgid: You get the feeling that you're on the cusp of becoming something greater than yourself.
translations: 你觉得你将马上成为某种比你自己更伟大的存在。

messages.msgid: Who needs skin when you can have a hard carapace?
translations: 当你有着坚硬的甲壳，谁还会需要皮肤？

messages.msgid: You long for a colony, the cover of darkness, and a meal on the wing.
translations: 你渴望着族群、黑暗的掩护和双翼下的一顿美餐。

messages.msgid: Your mutated flesh is immune to the damaging effects of acid.
translations: 你变异后的血肉对酸液的腐蚀伤害免疫了。

messages.msgid: Your body has developed a wonderful defense mechanism.  Instead of normal blood, you bleed a strong molecular acid which will damage any creature foolish enough to harm you.
translations: 你的身体产生了一种神奇的防御机制。你流出的血含有强酸，会伤害任何蠢到弄破你皮肤的家伙。

messages.msgid: You have an unhealthy obsession with fire, and you get anxious if you don't light them every now and then or stand near them often.  However, you gain a mood bonus from doing so.
translations: 你对火焰有种病态的渴望，每当你不点燃火焰或靠近火焰，你就感到自己无比焦虑。反之，你的心情会得到很大提升。

messages.msgid: You're as comfortable in water as on land, and your body has adapted around that fact.  Your base swimming speed is greatly increased, and weight will hinder you much less while swimming.
translations: 你感到自己在水里和在陆地上一样舒服，你的身体已经据此进化了。你的基础游泳速度大大提高，游泳时负重对你的阻碍会更少。

messages.msgid: Like a true fish, your eyes lack eyelids, and are instead covered by a translucent, protective membrane that blocks irritants and water, and provides minor armor.  It also allows you to sleep with your eyes open!  Activate to cause the approach of hostile creatures to wake you up.
translations: 就像一条真正的鱼一样，你的眼睛缺少眼睑，而是被一层半透明的保护膜所覆盖，它能够阻挡刺激物和水，并提供少量护甲。它也让你能够睁着眼睛睡觉！激活后，敌对生物的接近会将你唤醒。

messages.msgid: Falling asleep underwater is easy for you, and you spend less time asleep when you rest there.  You can also eat underwater, though you can't drink.
translations: 在水下入睡对你来说很容易，当你在水下睡眠时，你花费的时间会更少。你也可以在水下吃东西，然而你还是不能直接汲取周围水分。

messages.msgid: Your flesh is highly poisonous, and creatures that bite you will receive a nasty surprise.
translations: 你的肉含有剧毒，任何咬你的生物会得到一个麻烦的惊喜。

messages.msgid: Your gills and skin are highly permeable to moisture, and you can hydrate your body through osmosis.  While submerged in fresh water, any thirst you might have will be slaked.
translations: 你的鳃和皮肤能够渗透并吸收水汽，你可以通过渗透补充你的身体的水分。当你被淡水淹没时，你所有的任何口渴度将得到满足。

messages.msgid: A network of jelly-filled electroreceptors, like that of a shark, have grown throughout your face and nose.  They are very sensitive to magnetic fields, allowing you to see robots and creatures charged with electricity through walls, but being shocked will seriously mess you up.
translations: 你的脸部和鼻子内长出了一个像鲨鱼一样的充满胶质的电感受器网络。它们对磁场非常敏感，可以让你透过墙壁看到带电的机器人和生物，但是一旦被电击你会更惨。

messages.msgid: Your teeth have grown incredibly sharp, and have calcified even further.  In addition to letting you eat much faster, you can use them as a lethal natural weapon, as long as your anatomy favors it.  They also grow very fast, and you harmlessly shed them more or less at random.
translations: 你的牙齿变得非常锋利，并且进一步钙化。除了让你更快进食，你还可以将它们作为一种致命的天然武器使用，只要你的身体允许。它们也生长得非常快，会时不时随机地脱落。

messages.msgid: You tear into %s with your teeth!
You are a duly sworn law enforcement officer, with jurisdiction throughout the New England region thanks to interstate agreements.  Whether that means anything now is another question.
translations: 你是一名誓言捍卫法律的执法警察。感谢州际协议，你拥有在全新英格兰的执法权。当然，这还有没有意义是另外一回事了。

messages.msgid: Thou art a lewede man, a lowly cowherd, though where thi catel been thou hast not ynn certain.
translations: 草民生于中世纪，仅仅是个放牛的下人。

messages.msgid: You are a duly sworn law enforcement investigator, with jurisdiction throughout the New England region thanks to interstate agreements.  Whether your shield means anything now is another question.
translations: 你是一名誓言守卫法律的警探。感谢州际协议，你拥有在全新英格兰的执法权。当然，这还有没有意义是另外一回事了。

messages.msgid: You are a duly sworn Federal marshal, with nationwide jurisdiction and the authority of the United States of America.
translations: 你是一名誓言守卫法律的联邦法警，拥有在美国全国的执法权。

messages.msgid: You are known to be a capable and resourceful mercenary at the employ of Hub 01.
translations: 众所周知，你是Hub 01雇佣的一名有足够能力且足智多谋的雇佣兵。

messages.msgid: You are the true Foodperson, some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  You are Foodperson, the mask has become your face; you are real, and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.
translations: 你是真正的美食侠™，有些人可能认为那只是吉祥物而已，但你知道不仅仅如此：美食侠™面具已成为你的面孔，你真实存在，绝世而独立。

messages.msgid: You trained as a medical professional in a clinic or hospital.  You can put "Dr." in front of your name and everything.
translations: 你曾在诊所或医院接受过专业医疗培训。你可以在名字后加上“博士”的头衔，名副其实。

messages.msgid: You are skilled in maneuvering on skates.  You suffer lower penalties to dodging and are less likely to fall down if hit in melee combat while you're wearing rollerskates or rollerblades.
translations: 你擅长滑冰。当你穿着滚轴溜冰鞋或者直排轮滑鞋时，你受到的闪避惩罚更少，在近战中被击中时摔倒的几率也更小。

messages.msgid: You were shaping up to be a pretty decent student of the martial arts before the Cataclysm struck.  Time to see just how good you really are.
translations: 在大灾变前你中规中矩的探索武学的道路，是时候检验你的水平了。

messages.msgid: You were competitive at national levels, and had considered teaching your art.  Defending against the entire town may still be a challenge, though.
translations: 国宝级的空手道大师，但是在你招收开门弟子时，所有人都来踢你的馆了。

messages.msgid: You are experienced in the Sweet Science of boxing.  You could've had a shot at a local boxing tournament, if the Cataclysm hadn't screwed that up.
translations: 你专精于甜蜜的拳击科学。如果不是大灾变搞砸了一切，你很有机会在当地的拳击比赛中获奖。

messages.msgid: You have some training in the art of kickboxing.  It's just boxing with kicks, right?
translations: 你接受过一些踢拳的训练，就只是拳击加上踢击，对吧？

messages.msgid: Weeks spent picking through manuals and researching topics you aren't versed in has taught you to find what you need to know more quickly.  You read slightly faster, and suffer no reading time penalty for books too complex for you to easily understand.
translations: 你经常会花费了数周的时间钻研各类游戏手册，了解各类陌生领域的设定，这让你更快找到你所需要学习的信息。你阅读速度略有提升，同时免受书籍难度超出智力时的阅读时间惩罚。

messages.msgid: They said college costs an arm and a leg, they sure weren't kidding!
translations: 他们说上大学要抵上你的手和脚，他们肯定不是在开玩笑！

messages.msgid: They said college what make me smart, this is a lot to lug around!
translations: 他们说上大学让我有一个聪明的大头，这实在是太拖累了。

messages.msgid: You just can't wait to turn into a bug!  Triggers a mutation using the normal mutation rules (requiring primer but no catalyst) every five seconds.
translations: 你迫不及待地想变成一只虫子！ 每隔五秒按正常变异规则（需要引物但无需催化剂）触发一次变异。

messages.msgid: Grants flawless night vision and the ability to see all of the overmaps without having to reveal them manually.  As such, you can clearly see that this is for dev purposes only.
translations: 赋予完美的夜视能力，并无需手动探索即可查看所有大地图。因此，你心知肚明这仅用于调试用途。

messages.msgid: Being able to see through walls and the floor is clearly for dev purposes only.
translations: 能够透视墙壁和地板的功能，显然仅用于调试用途。

messages.msgid: Much bigger range than the other Debug Clairvoyance trait.  Unsure which one to use?  Use them both!  You can see all the bugs with this one.
translations: 比其他调试用透视特性的范围大得多。不确定用哪个？两个都用吧！用这个你能看到所有bug漏洞。

messages.msgid: If you see this, you'd best be debugging something.
translations: 如果你能看到这个，你最好正在debug某些东西，否则就是作弊。

messages.msgid: Holds hunger, thirst, and sleepiness stable.  You can debug all year long with this one!
translations: 让饥饿，口渴，睡意这些指数定住不动。然后你可以一辈子废寝忘食的debug下去了。

messages.msgid: You can run, but you'll never run out of breath.
translations: 你可以跑，但你永远不会喘不过气来。

messages.msgid: If you need to survive the deadliest bug attacks.
translations: 如果你需要抗住致命的bug攻击的话。

messages.msgid: Heal yourself from this stupid bug attacks.
translations: 让你在抗住愚蠢的bug攻击后自愈。

messages.msgid: Smell that bug?  Smell's certainly not coming from you!
translations: 完全消除你的体味，生物无法从嗅觉上感知到你的存在。

messages.msgid: Be vewwy vewwy quiet.  We're hunting bugs.
translations: 幽灵一般的消除你的脚步声音。我们正在除错。

messages.msgid: To cast bug killing spells.  Also increase the cast speed of spells.
translations: 用来施放杀手级bug法术。也会增加施法速度。

messages.msgid: Using mana to incinerate all bugs, activate to start burning.
You start using mana to burning bugs.
You're burning mana like crazy to burn of all bugs, also making you glow softly.
translations: 你正疯狂地燃烧魔力以焚尽所有bug，这也让你浑身散发着柔光。

messages.msgid: You stop incinerate bugs with mana.
Temperature and weather won't bug you.
translations: 气候和温度再也无法干扰你了。

messages.msgid: You start to emit a light, so you can debug in the darkest nights.
translations: 你开始发光，即使在最黑暗的夜晚也能进行调试。

messages.msgid: Crafting and construction requirements bugger off with this one.  Apply with care.
translations: 制造和建设的要求统统不再需要了，小心应用。

messages.msgid: Crafting failures won't bug you any more.
translations: 制造失败不会再困扰你了。

messages.msgid: Craft the bug out 50 times faster.
translations: 以50倍的速度制作物品，以及bug。

messages.msgid: Mind the bugs, would you kindly?
Lets you instantly install torsion ratchets for your eight legs.
translations: 让你能立刻为自己安装上各类生化插件。

messages.msgid: With this, you'll be fixing those bugs faster than ever!
translations: 有了这个，你将比以往更快地修复bug !

messages.msgid: Your energy to squash bugs is endless!
translations: 你消灭BUG的精力是无穷的！

messages.msgid: You can't even think about putting filthy clothes on yourself, especially from zombies' corpses.
translations: 你根本无法容忍把脏衣服穿在身上，尤其是那些从丧尸上扒下来的。

messages.msgid: Trait that makes it impossible to say anything.

Your mouth and larynx have changed dramatically, rendering you incapable of human speech.  With enough practice you could relearn imitating their weird ape chirps, but it will take time.  <color_red>Look for a new practice recipe to lose this setback.</color>
translations: 你的嘴和喉部发生了巨大变化，使你无法发出人类的语言。通过足够的练习，你可以重新学会模仿他们奇怪的猿类叫声，但这需要时间。<color_red>查看新的练习配方来消除这一缺陷。</color>

messages.msgid: Your throat cramps, your beak twitches, but you can speak human again if you want.
translations: 你的喉咙抽搐，喙部颤动，但如果你愿意，你可以再次说出人类的语言。

messages.msgid: Your beak and new lungs have diverged too much from your human form to be capable of human speech.  <color_red>Look for a new practice recipe to lose this setback.</color>
translations: 你的喙部和新肺与人类形态差异太大，无法发出人类的语言。<color_red>查看新的练习配方来消除这一缺陷。</color>

messages.msgid: Contorting your voice to match your surroundings is just as necessary as changing your color, even if learning it was a pain.
translations: 扭曲你的声音以匹配周围环境，就像改变肤色一样必要，即使学习过程艰巨无比。

messages.msgid: Just losing your teeth would have been an adjustment, but with your new tongue human speech is straight-up impossible.  <color_red>Look for a new practice recipe to lose this setback.</color>
translations: 仅仅是失去牙齿或许还能适应，但如今长出新舌头后，发出人类的语言堪比奢望。<color_red>查看新的练习配方来消除这一缺陷。</color>

messages.msgid: Fine control of your radula was hard to learn, but now that you mapped out which calcified not-tooth on there makes what pitch you can open your mouth and…speak.  Yes, let's call it speaking.
translations: 精准控制齿舌并非易事，但既然你已经摸清了上面哪颗钙化“非牙齿”能发出什么音调，现在你可以张嘴……说话了。没错，我们就称之为说话吧。

messages.msgid: Your mandibles already made speech hard, but now that you don't even have a tongue…<color_red>Look for a new practice recipe to lose this setback.</color>
translations: 你的上颚本就让说话变得困难，而现在你连舌头都没有了……<color_red>查看新的练习配方来消除这一缺陷。</color>

messages.msgid: Using all this new anatomy cramps you up, and there's spittle flying everywhere, but you can manage short sentences of whistling almost-words.
translations: 使用这些新器官会让你全身紧绷，口水四溅，但你还是能勉强发出一些类似口哨声的简短句子。

messages.msgid: Your mouth is gone.  Oh, wait, there's one, isn't there?  If only it stopped moving around you might start to relearn something like human speech.  <color_red>Look for a new practice recipe to lose this setback.</color>
translations: 你的嘴不见了。哦，等等，好像这边还有一个，对吧？要是它能别再乱动，你说不定还能重新学会人类的语言。<color_red>查看新的练习配方来消除这一缺陷。</color>

messages.msgid: Each word its own custom bubble under your membrane, waiting for its turn to pop.  It sounds like something small and furry drowning in sourdough, but if you manage to convince somebody to listen to you they will probably understand.
translations: 每个词都在你的膜下形成独立的气泡，等待轮到它破裂。听起来像是什么毛茸茸的小东西在酸面团里溺水了，但如果你能说服别人听你说话，他们大概还是能听懂的。

messages.msgid: You're too adventurous for your own good.  The more time you spend somewhere, the unhappier it makes you to be there.
translations: 你过于爱好冒险。在同一地点待得越久，你就越是坐立难安。

messages.msgid: You can't bear to stay still for long.  Your morale will suffer unless you constantly explore new territory.
translations: 你不能在同一个地方待太久。去探索未知的地方，不然你就会感到难受。

messages.msgid: Spending any amount of time in familiar places makes you miserable.  Must.  Keep.  Moving.
translations: 在熟悉的地方待一秒钟都让你感到痛苦不堪。必须！保持！移动！

messages.msgid: Whether from personal choice or childhood trauma, traveling with vehicles is off-limits to you, even if your life depended on it.
translations: 无论是出于个人选择还是童年阴影，你不愿驾驶载具，就算事关生死也不能接受。

messages.msgid: Whether from personal choice or childhood trauma, using ranged weapons is off-limits to you, even if your life depended on it.
translations: 无论是出于个人选择还是童年阴影，你不愿意使用远程武器，就算事关生死也不能接受。

messages.msgid: Using a firearm is off limits, due to personal philosophy or a traumatic event.  You can still use bows and slings.
translations: 由于个人理念或创伤事件，你禁止自己使用枪械。你仍然可以使用弓和弹弓。

messages.msgid: You have fast reflexes, allowing you to dodge attacks more easily.
translations: 你反应很快，让你更容易闪避敌人的攻击。

messages.msgid: You really want to eat some carrots.  Welcome to the Lagomorpha family.
translations: 你十分想吃胡萝卜。欢迎加入兔兔大家族。

messages.msgid: Your ears have grown into tall and flexible rabbit ears.  They're are slender and enhance your hearing beyond the normal range.
translations: 你的耳朵已经长成了长长的、灵活的兔耳朵。它们又细又长，使你的听力超越凡人。

messages.msgid: Your stubby tail has become fuzzy and more round, but doesn't seem to serve any purpose.
translations: 你短粗的尾巴变得毛茸茸、圆滚滚，但似乎没有什么实际用途。

messages.msgid: Your fur keeps you covered in winter, maintaining heat and allowing you to better tolerate cold temperatures.
translations: 在冬天，你的毛皮能更好地保持体温，让你更加耐寒。

messages.msgid: Your feet have grown into strong and large rabbit feet.  This makes your kicks pack a little more oomph.  Emphasis on little.  It also offers some warmth, and the lucky part is but superstition.  The downside is you are unable to wear shoes.
translations:
你的脚长成了又大又结实的兔子脚。这让你在蹬腿时更有力了。虽然只有那么一点点。此外，这双脚更加保暖。缺点是你不能穿鞋了。
"兔子脚带来幸运什么的都是迷信啦~"

messages.msgid: You kick %s with your large feet!
Your nose has morphed into a cute bunny nose, along with the snout.  It's extremely twitchy too.
translations: 你的鼻子变成了可爱的兔鼻子，像兔鼻子一样抽动。

messages.msgid: Your hands have elongated and look a bit more like paws.  It makes fine manipulation a little more difficult, but you can still probably manage.  Plus, they allow you to move on all fours when crouching and unarmed.
translations: 你的手变得更加修长，看上去更像爪子。精细操作变得困难了一点，但还勉强接受。此外在空手蹲伏时，可以适用四肢爬动行进。

messages.msgid: Something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it, but it always seems to find you eventually.
translations: 有只怪物一直在永不停歇地追杀着你。你可以跑得比它快，但它似乎总能最终找到你。

messages.msgid: Your ability to feel or express emotion has been greatly hampered.
translations: 你的感官及表达情感的能力受到了极大的妨碍。

messages.msgid: You know how to project your voice.  You are able to shout much louder than the average person.
translations: 你知道如何发声才能广为人知。你能比一般人喊得更大声。

messages.msgid: Your muscles, joints, and the movement center of your brain have changed internally somewhat, allowing you to traverse obstacles with ease.
translations: 你的肌肉、关节和大脑运动中枢发生了一些内部变化，让你可以轻松穿越障碍。

messages.msgid: You really hate getting your fur all wet.  This increases morale penalties for being wet, and you will get them even when wearing appropriate clothing.
translations: 你真的很讨厌把你的毛皮弄湿。增加湿身时的心情惩罚，就算穿着合适的衣服也会遭受影响。

messages.msgid: Your body is well-adapted to resist trauma.  20% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.
translations: 你的身体能够很好地抵抗创伤。生命值上限额外加成20%。可以和强壮等特性叠加。

messages.msgid: Your body is extremely well-adapted to resist trauma.  30% bonus to all hit points.  Stacks with Tough, etc.
translations: 你的身体能够极好地抵抗创伤。生命值上限额外加成30%。可以和强壮等特性叠加。

messages.msgid: You are terribly afraid of the dark.  You refuse to enter very dark areas.  If you somehow still happen to stay in dark areas, you suffer from various detrimental mental and physical effects.
translations: 你非常害怕黑暗。你拒绝进入非常黑暗的区域。如果你强行或仍然以某种方式碰巧停留在黑暗区域，那么你将遭受各种有害的心理和身体影响，可以服用速效镇静剂来缓解。

messages.msgid: You fare worse than most in colder climates and are more bothered by lower temperatures.  Note that while it will take less cold and exposure for you to suffer the effects of frostbite, you aren't any worse at dealing with the symptoms.
translations: 在寒冷气候中，你比大多数人更难受，也更容易受到低温的困扰。请注意：虽然你只需要更少的寒冷和暴露时间就会遭受冻伤，但你在处理其症状方面并不会更差。

messages.msgid: You are now even more bothered by the cold and it is easier for you to freeze or to even get chilly.  When you do though, it'll hit just as hard as it did before.
translations: 你现在更加畏惧寒冷，也更容易冻僵或感到寒意。不过，一旦你真的受寒，其影响程度将和其他人一样。

messages.msgid: You fare better than most in colder climates and are less bothered by lower temperatures.  Note that while it will take more cold and exposure for you to suffer the effects of frostbite, you aren't any better at dealing with the symptoms.
translations: 你比大多数人更能适应寒冷的气候，受到低温的影响更少。请注意，虽然你遭受冻伤的影响需要更低的温度和更长时间的暴露，但你应对冻伤症状的能力并未提高。

messages.msgid: You are now even less bothered by the cold and it is harder for you to freeze or to even get chilly.  When you do though, it'll hit just as hard as it did before.
translations: 你现在更加不受寒冷的困扰了，你更难被冻僵，甚至更难变冷。不过当你冻僵的时候，它一样会让你受到沉重的打击。

messages.msgid: You fare worse than most in warmer climates and are more bothered by hotter temperatures.  Note that while it will take less heat and exposure for you to suffer the effects of sunstroke, you aren't any worse at dealing with the symptoms.
translations: 在炎热气候中，你比大多数人更难受，也更容易受到高温的困扰。请注意：虽然你只需要更少的热量和暴露时间就会遭受中暑，但你在处理其症状方面并不会更差。

messages.msgid: You are now even more bothered by the heat and it is easier for you to overheat or even sweat.  When you do though, it'll hit just as hard as it did before.
translations: 你现在更加畏惧炎热，也更容易身体过热甚至只是出汗。不过，一旦你真的中暑，其影响程度将和其他人一样。

messages.msgid: You fare better than most in warmer climates and are less bothered by hotter temperatures.  Note that while it will take more heat and exposure for you to suffer the effects of sunstroke, you aren't any better at dealing with the symptoms.
translations: 你比大多数人更能适应炎热的气候，受到高温的影响更少。请注意，虽然你遭受中暑的影响需要更高的温度和更长时间的暴露，但你应对中暑症状的能力并未提高。

messages.msgid: You are now even less bothered by the heat and it is harder for you to overheat or even sweat.  When you do though, it'll hit just as hard as it did before.
translations: 你现在更加不受炎热的困扰了，你更难过热，甚至更难发热。不过当你过热的时候，它一样会让你受到沉重的打击。

messages.msgid: Your skin is covered in shifting patterns of dots, lines, and swirls.  This is outside of your control and does not help your stealth.  In fact, it makes you more noticeable.
translations: 你的皮肤上布满了变化的斑点、线条和漩涡。你无法操控它，而且对你的隐身没有帮助。事实上，它会让你更引人注目。

messages.msgid: Your can change your skin patterns to match your environment, somewhat increasing your stealthiness.
translations: 你可以改变你的皮肤以适应你周围的环境，在一定程度上增加你的隐蔽性。

messages.msgid: Your mind has been altered in such a way that you now find it very difficult to understand humans.  Your capability to persuade and lie to them suffers slightly, even if it is mitigated by your intelligence.  In addition, while you find it much easier to learn by doing now, the plasticity of your psyche means you forget skills much faster.
translations: 你的思维已经被改变了，以至于你现在发现你很难理解人类。你说服他们和对他们撒谎的能力会受到轻微的影响，不过你的智慧会减轻这种影响。此外，虽然你发现现在通过实践学习变得更容易了，但你心智的可塑性也意味着你遗忘技能的速度要快得多。

messages.msgid: You are now not at all bothered by the heat and it is harder for you to overheat or freeze at all.  When you do though, it'll hit just as hard as it did before.
translations: 你现在更加不受温度的困扰了，你更难过热，也更难冻僵。不过当你过热或冻僵的时候，它一样会让你受到沉重的打击。

messages.msgid: You know you're beautiful, and the world deserves to know it too.  You prefer to show off your stunningly good looks to the world and will be unhappy if you cover up your face.
translations: 你知道自己很美，全世界都应该知道。你更喜欢向世界炫耀你惊人的美貌，你会因为面部被遮掩而感到不快。

messages.msgid: You're a very picky eater.  You refuse to eat any food that tastes bad unless you're starving.
translations: 你是个很挑食的人。除非你感到极度饥饿，否则你拒绝吃任何难吃的食物。

messages.msgid: You don't mind being alone, but you get a slight mood boost from being around friends.
translations: 你不介意独处，但和朋友在一起会让你的心情稍微好一些。

messages.msgid: You are a social creature.  Spending time with friends will improve your mood, but if you're alone too long, you'll start to feel unhappy.
translations: 你是一个社会生物。 与朋友共度时光会改善你的心情，但如果你独处时间太长，你就会开始感到不快乐。

messages.msgid: You are the natural leader of any group.  It's just part of who you are, groups naturally form around you and you need these groups to energize you.  Sometimes however, you give in to your worst impulses and this trait will flip.
translations: 你是天生的团队核心，领导力是你与生俱来的特质，群体会自然地以你为中心形成，而你也需要这些群体来获取力量。但有时候，你会屈服于内心深处最糟糕的冲动，导致这一特质发生反转。

messages.msgid: You give in to your worst instincts.
translations: 你屈服于内心深处最糟糕的冲动。

messages.msgid: You are a god among mortals and they are all so very disappointing.  Why should you even bother to hide your disappointment in their failures?
translations: 你是凡人中的神祇，而他们是如此令人失望。你又何必隐藏自己对他们失败的失望之情？

messages.msgid: Maybe you can make better decisions this time.
translations: 或许这次你能做出更明智的选择。

messages.msgid: You can tolerate others, but you prefer to be alone.  Spending time by yourself will boost your mood slightly.
translations: 你可以容忍别人在旁边，但你更喜欢独处。 独处会稍微改善你的心情。

messages.msgid: You'd really rather be by yourself.  Being alone will improve your mood, but spending too much time around other people can grate on your nerves.
translations: 你十分宁愿只有自己一个人。 独处会改善你的情绪，但花太多时间和其他人在一起会刺激你的神经。

messages.msgid: You can't stand to prostrate yourself before your lessers and hate it when they don't immediately do what you say.  Persuasion is much more difficult, but you're better at lying and intimidating.
translations: 你不能忍受在一些次要之人面前卑躬屈膝，讨厌他们不立刻按你说的去做。说服他人会变得更加困难，但你会更擅长说谎和威胁。

messages.msgid: You can hear your heartbeat in your ears, feel the blood sloshing around in your veins.  The uneven hitches in your breath, the aches in your joints, the rumbling of your stomach.  It's nasty and messy and ugly.  And you are extremely grateful for that.
translations: 你可以在耳朵里听到你的心跳，感觉到血液在你的静脉里流动。你的呼吸不均匀，关节疼痛，胃部隆隆作响。它又脏又乱又丑。你对此非常感激。

messages.msgid: While it doesn't cause you any problems in daily life, your immune system and body chemistry are overly sensitive to foreign implants.  You cannot have any CBMs installed.
translations: 你的免疫系统和人体化学对外部植入物极度敏感，这不会对你的日常生活造成影响，但你不能安装任何CBM。

messages.msgid: Your saliva contains powerful anticoagulants.  If you have a bite attack, it will prolong the bleeding of most animals, including humans and the undead.  It may be less effective against insects and stranger creatures.
translations: 你的唾液含有强大的抗凝血剂。一旦被你咬伤，会延长多数生物的流血时间，无论是人类还是丧尸。但这对昆虫和异界生物可能就不起作用了。

messages.msgid: Your teeth have grown into long, sharp fangs.  If your mouth is uncovered, you'll sometimes bite your enemies.
translations: 你的牙齿长得又长又尖。当嘴部无遮挡时，你有时会用牙咬人。

messages.msgid: Your teeth are so sharp, you can use them to shave the fur from your victims before you feed.  What's more, anticoagulants in your saliva will keep their blood flowing long after it should have clotted.
translations: 你的牙齿非常锋利，你可以用它们剃掉受害者的皮毛，然后进食。更重要的是，唾液中的抗凝剂可以让血液长时间保持流动不凝结。

messages.msgid: <npc_name> is certainly a survivor.  You can only wonder how many they've abandoned to save themself.
translations: <npc_name>肯定是幸存者。你不禁好奇为了拯救自己而付出了多少代价。

messages.msgid: <npc_name> tries to avoid conflict, even when they have good reason not to.
translations: <npc_name> 总是试图避免冲突，即便他们本有充分的理由去面对

messages.msgid: <npc_name> loves to fight a good fight, but only for themself.
translations: <npc_name>想要好好干一架，但只为了自己。

messages.msgid: <npc_name> believes in fighting… mostly for others, even at risk to their own wellbeing.
translations: <npc_name>执着于为他人而战斗，甚至冒着损害自身利益的风险。

messages.msgid: <npc_name> is just looking for an excuse.
<npc_name> flinches at the thought of fighting, whether it be other people or the undead.
translations: <npc_name>一想到战斗就会退缩，无论是与其他人还是不死生物。

messages.msgid: <npc_name> is afraid of the dark, spiders, and unexplained sounds.  So are you, but only because you've lived through the apocalypse.  <npc_name> has always been like this.
translations: <npc_name>害怕黑暗、蜘蛛和无法解释的声音。你也是，但只是因为你经历过世界末日。<npc_name>一直都是这样。

messages.msgid: <npc_name> knows the name of fear, but only as a long-defeated foe.  Little can shake them.
translations: <npc_name>知道什么叫害怕，但那不过是早已击败过的敌人。没有什么可以使其动摇。

messages.msgid: <npc_name> is an ideal ally to those they call friend, always willing to help others.
translations: <npc_name>对于被其称作朋友的人来说，是个完美的盟友，总是愿意帮助他人。

messages.msgid: <npc_name> loves their trinkets, and hates giving them away.
translations: <npc_name>异常爱惜自己的小玩意，并拒绝把它们交出去。

messages.msgid: <npc_name> collects trash like a RPG protagonist collects potions.

messages.msgid: A strange occult symbol carved into your hand by Brigitte LaCroix.
translations: 一个由布丽吉特·拉克鲁瓦雕刻在你手心中的奇怪的神秘符号。
鲁比克的流亡族战斗步枪

messages.msgid:
The most popular gun to use the 12.3ln cartridge was, of course, the PA md. 71.  Its predecessor, the md. 68, was viewed by many as a sort of failure: although it was reliable and powerful, it was too heavy to be used as a good infantry weapon, and not really heavy enough to be a good support gun.  Enough were made, though, that during the zombie apocalypse, it gained a great deal of resurgent popularity as a light emplacement gun that used readily available ammunition.  It perfectly served the purposes of the Exodii, who had far less concern about its unwieldiness.

This particular rifle has been painted a dusty pink color and has a picture of a smiling eel twisting along the barrel.
translations:
在所有使用 12.3ln 弹的枪械中，最受欢迎的的枪当然是PA Md. 71 步枪。作为它的前身，PA Md. 68 战斗步枪被许多人认为是某种程度上的失败品：虽然它非常可靠而且威力强大，但它太重了，不是一把好的步兵武器，但又不足以成为一把好的支援武器。尽管如此，它仍然被大量制造，在随后到来的丧尸末日之中，作为一种弹药很容易获得的轻型炮塔枪，受到了人们的再次青睐。而且它完全符合流亡族的需求，它们对这把枪械不灵活的使用条件不太在意。

这把特殊的步枪被漆成暗粉色，枪管上画着一条盘在枪管上微笑的鳗鱼。
鲁比克的 PA Md. 68 战斗步枪

messages.msgid: A small, shiny brass coin with a picture of a stern-looking older man on one side and the words 'For all of Angland and her children' in an arc beneath him.  On the other side is a large number '1' wreathed in what appear to be nettle leaves.
translations: 一枚闪闪发光的小铜币，一面是面容严肃的老人头像，他的下方围了一圈弧形铭文："献给全安格兰王国及其子民"。而另一面印着一个巨大的数字"1"，数字上缠绕着的似乎是荨麻叶。

messages.msgid: Your entire body is covered by a rectangular frame, that has numerous supporting arms and manipulators, with decent stability.  The price of this is that the weight of the entire frame is enormous, which causes the user to either use dedicated tracked treads to move around, or stay immobile for a large amount of time.
translations: 你的整个身体被一个矩形框架所覆盖，框架上伸出许多支撑臂和机械手，稳定性相当不错。但代价是，整个框架的重量极为惊人，导致使用者要么依靠专用的履带移动，要么就得长时间保持静止。

messages.msgid: You decided to take responsibility for your actions.
translations: 你决定为自己的行为负责。

messages.msgid: You finally got the weight off your chest.
translations: 你终于卸下了心中的重担。

messages.msgid: A collection of sketches and CAD designs marked up with pencil.  There are two peoples handwriting.
translations: 一堆用铅笔做了标记的草图和CAD设计图纸。上面有两个人的笔迹。

messages.msgid: This beggar in the refugee center has had something to eat recently.
translations: 这个难民中心的乞丐最近吃了点东西。

messages.msgid: You spent some pleasant time relaxing with someone.
translations: 你和某人一同度过了一段愉快的时光。

messages.msgid: A small, somewhat worn-out laptop computer.  The flip-top is decorated with various stickers.
translations: 一台有些旧的笔记本电脑，后盖上装饰着各种贴纸。

messages.msgid: This crusty old jar has a glow-in-the-dark Millennium Falcon decal on the side, and a label that reads, "Landough Calrisean.  Dana's.  Do not touch on pain of death".  It's been abandoned for some time and doesn't look like it could be readily salvaged as a sourdough culture, but maybe an experienced sourdough baker could manage it.
translations: 这个硬壳旧罐头上，有个千年隼号的夜光贴纸粘在侧面，上面还写着"蓝多‧卡瑞辛，达娜之物，触摸者格杀勿论。"它已被弃置了一段时间，不再具有普通酸面头那样的活性，不过也许经验丰富的面包师还能重新激发它的活性。（注：《星球大战》）

messages.msgid: This round loaf of bread has a thick, dark crust, and smells very enticing.
translations: 这圆面包有厚厚的黑皮，闻起来很诱人。

messages.msgid: The Soviet-made PPSh-41 is a mass-produced selective-fire submachine gun.  It has a relatively high rate of fire.
translations: 苏联造的ppsh-41冲锋枪是一种大规模量产的射击模式可调的冲锋枪，射速相对较高。

messages.msgid: A bulky and simple Second World War submachine gun of Russian manufacture, composed from a basic wooden buttstock, steel barrel shroud, and the hopes and prayers of Soviet soldiers under threat of German invasion.  Designed for mass production with limited materials, the weapon is notable for its high-capacity drum magazines, capability of rapidly depleting said magazines, and vicious 7.62x25mm chambering.
translations: 俄罗斯在二战期间制造的一款笨重但简单冲锋枪，由基本的木制枪托、钢制枪管护木，以及受到德国入侵威胁的苏联士兵的希望和祈祷组成。 该武器设计之初就确定了造价低廉、大规模列装的路线，以其弹鼓容量管饱、泼水能力强大以及致命的 7.62x25mm子弹而闻名。

messages.msgid: The Portable Plasma Accelerator Model Five, developed by Lockheed Martin Corporation.  This device uses highly advanced capacitor banks to create a torus of superheated hydrogen plasma and accelerate it to incredible speed.  It was designed to take down heavy vehicles, and was expected to fully enter US Army service not long before the Cataclysm.
translations: 便携式等离子加速器5型(PPA-5)，由洛克希德·马丁公司研发。这种设备通过高度先进的电容器组产生一个环状的过热氢等离子体，并且将其加速到难以置信的速度。它被设计用于破坏重型载具，本来预计在大灾变前不久开始在美军中大规模部署。
波音 XM-P 等离子步枪

messages.msgid: Boeing developed this focused plasma weaponry together with DARPA.  It heats solid hydrogen to create plasma, and envelops it with polymers to reduce blooming.  While powerful, it suffers from short range.  Powered by UPS.
translations: 波音公司和美国国防部高级研究计划局一起研发了这种等离子武器。它通过加热固态氢来产生等离子态物质，用特制的聚合材料束缚使之不会在枪管里爆炸。威力惊人，可惜射程偏短。这种武器从你携带的UPS电源中获取能量。

messages.msgid: A high-capacity drum magazine for the PPSh-41.
translations: 一个71发弹鼓，可用于PPSh-41冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: A 35-round box magazine for the PPSh-41.
translations: 一个35发弹匣，可用于PPSh-41冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: An unusually-shaped pan magazine for use with .22 caliber submachine guns.
translations: 一个外形怪异的盘式弹匣，可用于 .22 口径冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: An unusually-shaped pan magazine for the American-180.
translations: 一个外形怪异的盘式弹匣，可用于 American-180 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: An unusually-shaped polymer constructed pan magazine for use with .22 caliber submachine guns.
translations: 一个外形怪异的聚合材料盘式弹匣，可用于 .22 口径冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: An unusually-shaped, polymer pan magazine for the American-180.
translations: 一个外形怪异的聚合材料盘式弹匣，可用于American-180 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: An unusually-shaped polymer pan magazine for use with .22 caliber submachine guns.
translations: 一个外形怪异的聚合材料盘式弹匣，可用于 .22 口径冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: An unusually-shaped polymer pan magazine for the American-180.
translations: 一个外形怪异的聚合材料盘式弹匣，可用于American-180 冲锋枪。

messages.msgid: A dramatically uncommon automatic weapon, making use of high-capacity pan magazines and firing the low power .22 caliber cartridge: an unusual ammunition choice for a submachine gun.  With negligible recoil on account of its modest cartridge and a suppressively high rate of fire, a burst of .22 LR rounds from this little machine gun can be best likened with a swarm of hornets… an incredibly angry swarm of hornets.
translations: 一把非常不寻常的自动武器，使用大容量的盘型弹匣供弹，发射低威力的.22子弹，这不是冲锋枪子弹的常用口径。由于弹药口径较小，枪口上跳几乎可以忽略，再加上极高的射速，这挺小机枪射出的.22 LR子弹就像一群破巢而出的黄蜂…当然，一群极端愤怒的黄蜂。

messages.msgid: The American-180 is a submachine gun developed in the 1960s that fires .22 LR, unusual for an SMG.  Though the round is low-powered, the high rate of fire and large magazine makes the 180 a formidable weapon.
translations: American-180是一款于1960问世的冲锋枪，使用的是在冲锋枪中很罕见的.22口径。尽管子弹本身的威力比较弱，这把枪的高射速和超大弹容量仍使它成为一把强力武器。
陶鲁斯 "暴怒裁决"马格南手枪

messages.msgid: The Taurus Raging Judge Magnum is a 6-shot revolver chambered in .454 Casull.  It can fire .410 shotshells and .45 Colt cartridges as well.
translations: 陶鲁斯 "暴怒裁决"马格南手枪发射 .454 卡苏尔弹，弹容量6发。该型号同时也能够发射 .410 口径霰弹或 .45 柯尔特弹。

messages.msgid: This pump-action shotgun uses a system of twin magazines to carry 24 total rounds of 12-gauge shotgun shells.  Each tube must be loaded separately, but this offers the option of loading different ammunition for different situations.  As the weapon's trigger is situated forwards of the chamber in what is termed as a 'bullpup' design, the firearm's still only as long as conventional shotguns despite having a comparatively far higher capacity.
translations: 这把泵动式霰弹枪使用一个由两个管形弹匣组成的系统来携带总共24发12号口径霰弹。每根管子都必须单独装填，但这提供了为不同情况装填不同弹药的选项。由于该武器的扳机位于膛室前方，被称为"无托式"设计，虽然与其他霰弹枪相比其容量相对较高，但长度仍然和传统的霰弹枪一样。

messages.msgid: A bullpup pump-action shotgun, the Kel-Tec KSG-25 uses a pair of magazine tubes to increase its capacity.  Each tube has to be loaded separately, but this offers the option of loading different ammunition for different situations.  The big brother of the KSG, it has a longer barrel and longer magazine tubes.
translations: 一支无托式泵动霰弹枪，Kel-Tec KSG-25 霰弹枪有两个单独的管仓供弹机构，以增加其载弹量。每条供弹管仓都要单独装填，射击时也只能选择其中一个管仓供弹，这样也提供了在不同情境下快速切换不同弹药的便利。作为 KSG 霰弹枪的老大哥，它有根更长的枪管和更长的弹匣。

messages.msgid: The integrated second tube magazine of the Kel-Tec KSG-25, which holds 12 shots.  It's irremovable.
translations: Kel-TecKSG-25霰弹枪集成的第二弹管，能容纳12发霰弹。无法拆除。
柯尔特 "闪电" .45 卡宾枪

messages.msgid: A modern reproduction of a Colt pump-action rifle.  Originally chambered in .44-40, modern versions most commonly use .45 Colt, complementing the Single Action Army as a Cowboy Action Shooting firearm.
translations: 柯尔特泵动式步枪的现代重制版本。原本采用 .44-40 口径，现代重制品常常采用 .45 柯尔特口径，在牛仔射击运动中可作为单动式手枪的替代品。

messages.msgid: Two .38 Super 8-round box magazines attached to a single base plate, holding up to 16 rounds in total, used by the AF2011A1 double-barrel pistol.
translations: 两个 .38 超级弹8发弹匣被连接在同一个基座上，总共可容纳16发子弹，AF2011A1 双管手枪专用。

messages.msgid: A double-barrel semi-automatic pistol of Italian origin, firing two bullets per shot, a derivative of the M1911 pistol.
translations: 一把源自意大利的双管半自动手枪，每次发射两发子弹，是 M1911 手枪的衍生型号。

messages.msgid: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM614 light machine gun was designed for durability and extreme volume of sustained fire under the worst possible circumstances.  Accepts RMXB500 box and RMGD250 drum magazines.
translations: 采用了威力巨大的特殊口径，Rivtech RM614轻机枪设计设计来在极端情况提供长时间的持续火力，并且具有良好耐久。能使用RMXB500弹匣及RMGD250弹鼓。

messages.msgid: A 250-round drum magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.  Designated as RMGD250.
translations: 250发弹鼓，可用于使用Rivtech 8x40mm无壳弹的武器。其官方命名为RMGD250。

messages.msgid: A 500-round drum magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.  Designated as RMGD500.
translations: 500发弹鼓，可用于使用Rivtech 8x40mm无壳弹的武器。其官方命名为RMGD500。

messages.msgid: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM88 battle rifle was designed for durability and extreme firepower under less than ideal circumstances, with a heavy ported barrel for maximum controllability.  Accepts box and RMGD250 drum magazines.
translations: 原为军用，Rivtech RM88战斗步枪设计时考虑了耐用性、强大火力、及非理想环境下的易用性，其重型装有气门的枪管提供了最大限度的可控性。可使用弹匣及RMGD250弹鼓。

messages.msgid: Designed by Rivtech and utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, this caseless pump-action shotgun was designed for hunting big game, with durability and ease of use as priorities.
translations: 由Rivtech公司设计，采用了一种强大而非常规的口径，这款无壳泵动式狩猎霰弹枪专为狩猎大型猎物而打造，其设计重点在于耐用性和易用性。

messages.msgid: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM120c caseless pump-action shotgun was designed for hunting big game, with durability and ease of use as priorities.
translations: 采用了强力而又特殊的口径，Rivtech RM120c泵动式霰弹枪被设计用来猎杀大型动物，操作简单，火力强劲。

messages.msgid: Designed by Rivtech and utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, this caseless automatic combat shotgun was designed with durability and overwhelming power in mind.
translations: 由Rivtech公司设计并采用了一种强大而独特的无壳弹药，这款自动战斗霰弹枪旨在实现高度耐用与压倒性的火力。

messages.msgid: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM20 caseless automatic combat shotgun was designed with durability and overwhelming power in mind.
translations: 采用了强力而又特殊的口径，Rivtech RM20 自动战斗霰弹枪的设计思路是持续性和压倒性的火力。

messages.msgid: Designed by Rivtech and designated the RM228 PDW, chambering the powerful 20x66mm caseless shotgun cartridge, this gun was designed for the civilian personal defense market with durability and ease of use as priorities.  While lauded for its small size and light weight, its hefty price tag kept it out of the reach of casual collectors.
translations: Rivtech公司设计的RM228 PDW（个人防卫武器），采用强大的20x66毫米无壳霰弹药筒，专为民用个人防卫市场打造，其设计重点在于耐用性和易用性。该枪因其小巧的尺寸和轻便的重量而受到赞誉，但由于其高昂的价格，让那些普通的收藏家望而却步。

messages.msgid: Chambering the powerful 20x66mm caseless shotgun cartridge, the Rivtech RM228 PDW was designed for the civilian personal defense market with durability and ease of use as priorities.  While lauded for its small size and light weight, its hefty price tag kept it out of the reach of casual collectors.
translations: 定位公民个人防卫用武器市场，以耐用与易用为首要目标来设计，Rivtech公司荣誉出品，RM228 PDW（个人防卫武器）。装填大威力的20x66mm无壳霰弹，这把武器主要卖点是其轻小便携，然而其价格标签上那堆长到唬人的0让那些普通的收藏家望而却步。
紧凑无壳霰弹枪10发弹匣

messages.msgid: A 10-round box magazine for use with the RM228 PDW and RM121 auxiliary shotgun.  Designated as RMSA10.
translations: 一个10发弹匣，可用于 RM228 单兵自卫武器及 RM121 附挂霰弹枪。其官方命名为RMSA10。

messages.msgid: A 20-round box magazine for use with the RM20 caseless shotgun.  Designated as RMSB20.
translations: 一个20发弹匣，可用于 RM20 自动无壳霰弹枪。其官方命名为RMSB20。

messages.msgid: A 40-round box magazine for use with the RM20 caseless shotgun.  Designated as RMSB40.
translations: 一个40发弹匣，可用于 RM20 自动无壳霰弹枪。其官方命名为RMSB40。

messages.msgid: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, sublethal beanbag type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.
translations: 20x66mm 无壳霰弹，非致死沙包弹型，Rivtech霰弹枪专用。

messages.msgid: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, explosive projectile type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.
translations: 20x66mm 无壳霰弹，爆裂弹型，Rivtech霰弹枪专用。

messages.msgid: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, signal flare type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.
translations: 20x66mm 无壳霰弹，信号弹型，Rivtech霰弹枪专用。

messages.msgid: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, explosive fragmentation type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.
translations: 20x66mm 无壳霰弹，破片榴弹型，Rivtech霰弹枪专用。

messages.msgid: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, loaded with 18 buffered pellets of premium plated 00 buck.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.
translations: 20x66mm 无壳霰弹，装有18枚带缓冲剂的球形优质镀铜 00 鹿弹，Rivtech霰弹枪专用。

messages.msgid: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, solid projectile type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.
translations: 20x66mm 无壳霰弹，独头弹型，Rivtech霰弹枪专用。

messages.msgid: Designated the Rivtech RM121 auxiliary weapon system, this is a magazine-fed semi-automatic caseless shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  Accepts RMSA10 box magazines.
translations: Rivtech RM121 辅助武器系统是一把弹匣供弹的半自动无壳弹霰弹枪，可以被安装在许多枪械的导轨上。使用RMSA10弹匣。

messages.msgid: The Rivtech RM121 auxiliary weapon system is a magazine-fed semi-automatic caseless shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  Accepts RMSA10 box magazines.
translations: Rivtech RM121 辅助武器系统是一把弹匣供弹的半自动无壳弹霰弹枪，可以被安装在许多枪械的导轨上。使用RMSA10弹匣。
改装 RM121 管下霰弹枪

messages.msgid: The Rivtech RM121 auxiliary weapon system is a magazine-fed semi-automatic caseless shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  Accepts RMSA10 box magazines.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.
translations: Rivtech RM121 辅助武器系统是一把弹匣供弹的半自动无壳弹霰弹枪，可以被安装在许多枪械的导轨上。使用RMSA10弹匣。这把霰弹枪经过了改装，可以装在除手枪外的几乎任何武器上。

messages.msgid: The Saiga-410 is a semi-automatic shotgun designed on the same Kalashnikov pattern as the AK-47 rifle.  It reloads with a magazine, rather than one shell at a time like most shotguns.
translations: Saiga-410 霰弹枪是一把半自动霰弹枪，采用了与 AK-47 步枪相同的卡拉什尼科夫布局。与其他霰弹枪不同，它用弹匣供弹。

messages.msgid: A removable plastic box magazine for the Saiga-410 shotgun.  Holds 10 shells.
translations: 一个可拆卸塑料弹匣，可用于 Saiga-410 霰弹枪。容量为10发。

messages.msgid: A removable plastic drum magazine for the Saiga-410 shotgun.  Holds 30 shells.
translations: 一个可拆卸塑料弹鼓，可用于 Saiga-410 霰弹枪。容量为30发。

messages.msgid: A set of seals and gaskets that will allow a firearm to operate reliably while submerged in water.
translations: 一套防水胶布和垫圈，让枪械在水中也能正常使用。

messages.msgid: A kit to attach a pair of crossbow arms and a firing rail to the barrel of a long firearm.  It allows crossbow bolts to be fired.
translations: 一套包括弩臂和导轨的组件，可安装在长枪的枪管上，发射弩矢。

messages.msgid: A makeshift version of a bayonet that consists of a mere spike with some string.
translations: 简单地用一条尖刺物和一些线绑成的手工制步枪刺刀。

messages.msgid: A full size .357 SIG Glock pistol.  It is extremely similar to the Glock 22, and could be converted to fire .40 S&W by switching the barrel.
translations: 一把全尺寸的格洛克手枪，使用 .357 西格弹。它与格洛克 22 手枪极为相似，可以通过切换枪管转换为使用 .40 S&W弹。

messages.msgid: Mutation has left you with a persistent mild discomfort.  It seems harmless for now, but you can't predict if it'll get worse.
translations: 变异给你留下了持续的轻微不适。目前看来并无大碍，但你不知道是否会变得更糟。

messages.msgid: There's an enervating sense of dysmorphia throughout your whole body.  It waxes and wanes, but never quite goes away.  Mutating this much can't be good for you…
translations: 你的整个身体有一种令人窒息的畸形感。这种感觉时好时坏，但从未完全消失。这么多的变异对你没有好处……

messages.msgid: You're haunted by phantom pains across your entire body now.  Everything aches from an exhaustion that never seems to fade.  Any further mutation right now is very unlikely to have a happy ending.
translations: 你现在被贯穿整个身体的幻痛所困扰，一切都因某种似乎永不消退的疲惫而疼痛。现在继续任何变异都不太可能有一个好结果。

messages.msgid: Commonly known as pinkeye, this minor infection can be treated with antihistamines.  If it's bacterial, antibiotics may help, but you can't tell without a lab analysis.
translations: 结膜炎，俗称红眼病。轻度的感染，可以通过抗组胺药物缓解，如果是细菌感染的话最好用抗生素治疗。可是没有专业的检测手段你难以做出判断。

messages.msgid: Your itchy eye leaks a filmy discharge.
translations: 你的眼睛感到瘙痒，流出浑浊的分泌物。

messages.msgid: There's a slippery surface here, running may be a bad idea.
translations: 这里的地面非常滑，最好不要在此跑步。

messages.msgid: It's quite slippery, it may not be safe to stand here.
translations: 这里的地面太滑了，你甚至有些站不稳。
这片区域的地面非常滑。

messages.msgid: The monster is greedily drinking your blood!
translations: 怪物正在贪婪地吸食你的血液！

messages.msgid: The monster is sucking up your blood!
translations: 怪物正在大口吸食你的血液！

messages.msgid: You're using a prosthetic right leg.
You're using a prosthetic left leg.
You smash the %s with your prosthetic fist.
translations: 你用仿生手部假肢猛击了 %s 一拳。

messages.msgid: You smash the %s with your neuroprosthetic fist.
translations: 你用智能手部假肢猛击了 %s 一拳。

messages.msgid: Dummy mutation that keeps you from wearing prosthetics.
Whether by a serious accident, birth defect, or other means, you have lost your right leg.  You can hobble around, but will likely need a wheelchair or other means of locomotion to get somewhere far.
translations: 无论是由于严重事故、先天残疾还是其他原因，你失去了右腿。你可以一瘸一拐地走来走去，但可能需要轮椅或其他移动工具才能到达较远的地方。

messages.msgid: Whether by a serious accident, birth defect, or other means, you have lost your left leg.  You can hobble around, but will likely need a wheelchair or other means of locomotion to get somewhere far.
translations: 无论是由于严重事故、先天残疾还是其他原因，你失去了左腿。你可以一瘸一拐地走来走去，但可能需要轮椅或其他移动工具才能到达较远的地方。

messages.msgid: Whether by a serious accident, birth defect, or other means, you have lost your left arm.  As such, you cannot use anything you normally could with it, like lifting with two hands.
translations: 无论是由于严重事故、先天残疾还是其他原因，你失去了左臂。受此影响，你不能进行需要左臂的活动，比如使用双臂抬起物体。

messages.msgid: Whether by a serious accident, birth defect, or other means, you have lost your right arm.  As such, you cannot use anything you normally could with it, like lifting with two hands.
translations: 无论是由于严重事故、先天残疾还是其他原因，你失去了右臂。受此影响，你不能进行需要右臂的活动，比如使用双臂抬起物体。

messages.msgid: You have a prosthetic on your right leg.
You have a prosthetic on your left leg.
You have a prosthetic on your left arm.
You have a prosthetic on your right arm.
You're skilled at clearing obstacles; terrain like railings or counters are as easy for you to move on as solid ground.
translations: 你的运动神经与肌体协调能力更加出色，能够在运动中清楚的观察到脚下的障碍物，并且能够轻松穿梭于栏杆和柜台之间。

messages.msgid: You've spent some time developing your general fitness.  When operating muscle-powered vehicles, you know how to get more power out of each stroke.
translations: 你经常锻炼身体。你知道如何更好地利用你的肌肉去驱动人力载具。

messages.msgid: With considerable practice, you've honed your athletic fitness and form.  You know how to get the most out of your effort, when manually powering a muscle-driven vehicle.
translations: 大量的练习锤炼了你的体能与技巧。你掌握了在驱动人力载具时获得最大效益的技巧。
