messages.msgid: You've honed your athletics to at least a professional level.  When it comes to making vehicles move under your own power, your body is a well-oiled machine.
translations: 你持续的进行锻炼，现在你拥有运动员级别的身体能力。当你为使用人力的载具供能时，你的身体就像一台运作良好的发动机，稳定且强力。

messages.msgid: You know how to pick up most of the meat from the animal body.
translations: 你知道如何获取动物身体上的大部分肉。

messages.msgid: There is very little meat left after your skillful knife movements.
translations: 在你熟练的刀工下肉已所剩无几。

messages.msgid: You stopped making holes in the skin of animals you butcher.
translations: 你不再会弄破被屠宰动物的毛皮

messages.msgid: You really know how to skin the animal.
You are beginning to grasp a general idea of how elements and compounds react with each other.
translations: 你开始掌握元素和化合物如何相互作用的基础概念。

messages.msgid: You've identified the key organs within several creatures and their locations with the goal of attacking them in combat.
translations: 你已能辨别几种生物的要害器官和所处身体位置，在战斗中能以其作为目标攻击

messages.msgid: You are beginning to gain a general idea of how various living beings function.
translations: 你开始掌握各种各样的生物如何运作的基础概念。

messages.msgid: Knowledge of the branch of chemistry that studies and uses carbon-containing compounds.
translations: 研究和使用含碳化合物的化学分支知识。

messages.msgid: Knowledge of the branch of chemistry that studies and uses compounds not containing carbon.
translations: 研究和使用不含碳化合物的化学分支知识。

messages.msgid: Knowledge of the esoteric biology of fungi.
translations: 研究真菌生物的各种深奥知识。

messages.msgid: Extensive and detailed knowledge of the esoteric biology of fungi, to an extremely nerdy degree.
translations: 广泛而详尽的有关真菌生物的深奥知识，早已经进入了极度枯燥乏味的领域。

messages.msgid: The understanding of the chemistry of living things.
translations: 对生物体内化学反应的了解。

messages.msgid: An in-depth understanding of how humans and animals operate.
translations: 对人类和动物如何运作的深入理解。

messages.msgid: You are beginning to grasp a general idea of how alien and post-Cataclysm mutated creatures function and operate.
translations: 你开始掌握异界生物和大灾难后变异生物如何运作的基础概念。

messages.msgid: You're beginning to grasp the basics of chemical production.
translations: 你开始掌握化工生产的基础知识。

messages.msgid: The proper understanding of safe chemical synthesization and how to clean your tools used for the next batch.
translations: 对化学合成安全以及如何批量生产时清洗工具的正确理解。

messages.msgid: The process of separating two mixed liquids by their different boiling points.
translations: 通过加热将将两种不同沸点的混合液体分离的技艺。

messages.msgid: An understanding of the chemistry of metalworking and alloys.
translations: 对金属加工和合金学的了解。

messages.msgid: An understanding of how to produce various natural and chemical substances pure enough for human consumption.
translations: 了解如何生产出可供人类食用的足够纯净的各种天然和化学物质。

messages.msgid: You've done enough cooking to know the basics about how to quickly and efficiently sort your ingredients.
translations: 你已经有足够的烹饪经验，知道如何快速有效地处理食材的基本知识。

messages.msgid: You're quite skilled at culinary knife work, making you noticeably faster at preparing meals that involve a lot of chopping.
translations: 你很擅长各类厨刀的操作，这让你在制作需要大量切菜的菜肴时明显地快了很多。

messages.msgid: You know the basics of baking - proportions, leavening, and things - and are less likely to make a dramatic mistake when working from memory.
translations: 你知道烘焙的基本知识——比例、发酵和其他东西——而且在只凭记忆时，不太可能犯严重错误。

messages.msgid: You've baked enough bread to consider yourself an expert.  May your yeast be ever frothy.
translations: 你烤了足够多的面包，可以把自己当作专家了。愿你的酵母永远起泡。

messages.msgid: Anyone can make a cookie, but you can make it look amazing.  Cakes and other fluffies are also no longer a barrier.
translations: 任何人都可以做饼干，但你可以让它看起来完美。蛋糕和其他松软甜点再也不是障碍。

messages.msgid: You could have been a professional baker before the Cataclysm.  Your profiteroles are the envy of the wastelands.
translations: 你本可以在灾难发生前成为一名专业面包师。你的甜饼是废土上令人羡慕的东西。

messages.msgid: Anyone can toss stuff into deep fryer oil.  You know more about selecting oil, keeping the food from burning, and the like.
translations: 任何人都可以把东西扔进油里炸。但你更了解如何选择油，防止食物烧焦等等。

messages.msgid: You know enough about deep frying breads and batters to do it easily without thinking about it.
translations: 你对煎炸面包和面糊有足够的了解，不用想就可以轻松地做。

messages.msgid: You know the vaunted secrets of creating delicious deep fried sweets.
translations: 你知道制作美味的油炸甜点的秘密。

messages.msgid: The basics of fermenting for human consumption, including sanitary technique, avoiding harmful molds, and identifying common problems.
translations: 将食材发酵成可供人食用的基础知识，包括卫生消毒技巧、避免有害霉菌和识别常见问题。

messages.msgid: Applying the science of distillation to alcoholic beverages to get something tasty.
translations: 将蒸馏学应用于酒精饮料以获得更美味的酒。

messages.msgid: The fine art of brewing grains into beers.
translations: 把谷物酿造成啤酒的技艺。

messages.msgid: The knowledge of how to turn sugary fruits, and occasionally vegetables, into fermented beverages.
translations: 如何把含糖的水果，偶尔还有蔬菜变成发酵饮料的知识。

messages.msgid: The microbiology of most non-alcoholic fermented edibles, from sauerkraut to sourdough.
translations: 从酸菜到酸面团等大多数不含酒精的发酵食品的微生物学。

messages.msgid: The basics of curdling and coagulating milk and similar things without the wrong kinds of bacteria and mold winning out.
translations: 制造酸奶和凝乳以及类似的东西，并避免有害细菌和霉菌滋生的基础知识。

messages.msgid: Taking the basics of curdled milk and making it delicious.
translations: 把简单的凝乳做成美食。

messages.msgid: The basic knowledge of ways to keep food safe for long periods of time in a post-refrigeration world.
translations: 在无冰箱的世界里如何长时间保持食品安全的基本知识。

messages.msgid: Using salt, smoke, and similar agents to cure or dehydrate food.
translations: 用盐、烟熏和类似的添加剂将食物脱水。

messages.msgid: Using pressure canning or tinning to safely store food in sealed containers.
translations: 使用压力罐或马口铁罐头将食物安全地储存在密封容器中。

messages.msgid: You know the secrets of cooking tasty food using strange substitutions and weird things you found in a cabinet in an abandoned house.
translations: 你知道利用奇怪的替代品和在废弃房屋里找到的古怪东西来制作美味食物的秘诀。

messages.msgid: Cooking with foraged ingredients that you wouldn't find in most cookbooks.
translations: 用你在大多数食谱中找不到的野外食材烹饪。

messages.msgid: An understanding of the skills and tools needed to create durable, effective soldered electrical connections.
translations: 用于在电子元器件之间通过焊锡建立有效且牢固的连接的技术。

messages.msgid: Practical experience building electrical circuits, and a grasp of the principles of electrical continuity, current, voltage, and resistance.
translations: 构建电路的实际经验，并掌握电气联通、电流、电压和电阻的原理。

messages.msgid: Basic working knowledge of using semiconductors such as diodes and transistors in electrical circuits, for switching or amplifying electrical signals.
translations: 在电路中使用半导体（如二极管和晶体管）来切换或放大电信号的基础知识。

messages.msgid: Familiarity with the role of IC chips in circuit design, and ability to identify many common pre-Cataclysm ICs and understand how to use them in functional circuits.
translations: 熟悉IC芯片在电路设计中的作用，能够识别许多常见的大灾变前生产的芯片，并理解如何在电路中使用它们。

messages.msgid: A practical working knowledge of electromagnetic fields and their creation and application.
translations: 电磁学知识和产生及应用电磁场的实战经验。

messages.msgid: An understanding of how to use high voltage, low-current devices to cause debilitating muscle spasms.  Includes some theoretical knowledge of how to protect yourself from these.
translations: 了解如何通过高电压低电流设备造成肌肉痉挛使目标失去行动能力，以及如何保护自己免受这些伤害的知识。

messages.msgid: A basic understanding of how guns are put together and what tools and materials are needed for the job.
translations: 关于枪械制造及相关材料和工具的基础知识。

messages.msgid: You've become an expert at putting together guns and launchers from makeshift parts.
translations: 你已成为通过自制元件制造枪械和发射器的专家。

messages.msgid: You're specifically skilled at building and repairing antique guns.
translations: 你对如何制造和修理老式枪械有着专门的知识。

messages.msgid: Similar to bowyery, the art of making guns that are powered by elastic mechanisms.
translations: 制造通过弹性装置驱动的枪械的技术，与制弓类似。

messages.msgid: You've got the know-how to make a classic Western revolver, and its many variants.
translations: 你了解如何制造各种经典的西部左轮手枪和类似枪械。

messages.msgid: You know how to quickly disassemble guns, clean them, and reassemble them in the field.
translations: 你知道如何在野外快速拆卸，清洁，并重新组装枪支。

messages.msgid: You know how to bandage wounds and understand basic principles of wound care.
translations: 你知道如何包扎伤口，了解伤口护理的基本原则。

messages.msgid: Your extensive field experience in bandaging and wound care is on par with that of a paramedic.
translations: 你在包扎伤口和伤口护理方面的经验与专业急救医士相当。

messages.msgid: You have some basic understanding of how burns work and (potentially) how they could be treated.
translations: 你已经掌握了烧伤的基本原理和（可能的）治疗方法。

messages.msgid: You have been trained such that you are desensitized to the sight of a human's innards, and can dissect human corpses without penalty.
translations: 你已经被训练得对人类的内脏不再敏感，可以不受惩罚地解剖人类尸体。
维护和建造结构简单的引擎。

messages.msgid: You know how to safely and efficiently build, repair, maintain and use various appliances that make use of high pressure.
translations: 你知道如何安全高效地建造、维修、维护和使用各种高压设备。

messages.msgid: You know how to safely and efficiently build, repair, maintain and use various complex machinery that makes use of chemical processes.
translations: 你知道如何安全高效地建造、维修、维护和使用各种化工工业的复杂机械。

messages.msgid: Maintaining and building compressed-air powered machines.
translations: 维护和建造压缩空气驱动的机器。

messages.msgid: You've been trained and certified to repair aircraft.  You're not really sure how that could help you survive now.
translations: 你受过航空器的修理培训并获维修技师认证，通常被称为机身和动力装置（A＆P）机械师。但你不确定这是否能帮你活过这个末日。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with how to grip a long gun correctly while striking someone with it.
translations: 你熟知如何正确握持长管枪械并用它攻击敌人。

messages.msgid: You're proficient in striking with your rifle, both with and without a bayonet.
translations: 你精通使用长管枪械与敌人进行格斗，无论有没有加装刺刀。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the art of the bayonet charge and know how to handle the gun itself as a weapon.
translations: 你是真正掌握了长管枪械近身战斗技能的大师。无论是刺刀攻击，还是长管枪械格斗本身，都能在你手中发挥出完全的威力。

messages.msgid: You're able to use your handgun effectively as a melee weapon without shooting yourself.
translations: 你现在能够有效地将手枪作为近身武器进行攻击，而不会失手走火。

messages.msgid: You're proficient in striking with your handgun and can do so precisely.
translations: 你精通如何握住手枪并精准的敲打敌人。

messages.msgid: You're able to precisely strike your opponent with your handgun where it hurts the most.
translations: 你可以精确地用手枪射中敌人的弱点。

messages.msgid: You've got a handling on gripping knives so they don't slip out of your hand.
translations: 你已经掌握了刀的握法，不会再脱手了。

messages.msgid: You handle your knife like a butcher, and are ready to prove it.
translations: 你握匕首的动作十分专业，似乎能轻易让生物开膛破肚，而你随时准备证明这一点。

messages.msgid: Your knife is like an extension of yourself, you wield it effortlessly.
translations: 你的匕首简直就是你身体的一部分，匕首在你的手中上下翻飞，优雅而流畅，就像没有重量一样。

messages.msgid: You know how to stab someone with something not typically intended to stab them with.
translations: 你知道怎样用不该用来捅人的东西刺人。

messages.msgid: You're pretty good at shanking your enemy, if you do say so yourself.
translations: 按你自己的话说，你很擅长用刀子捅人。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the ancient and ignoble art of sticking someone with something small and pointy.
translations: 你已经掌握了一门古老而卑鄙的技巧，用细小的尖锐物捅人。

messages.msgid: You've learned to swing a baton without spraining your wrists.
translations: 你掌握了怎么挥动短棍不会扭伤手腕。

messages.msgid: You know how to strike with your baton so you get the most out of every blow.
translations: 你知道如何用你的短棍击打，在每次击打中取得最大效果。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the use of all kinds of batons, and the fine art of beating someone with a stick.
translations: 你已经可以熟练运用各种短棍类武器了，只要手上有一根棍子，你就可以把敌人打得落花流水。

messages.msgid: You have enough practice not to cut yourself with your own blade.
translations: 你经过足够的练习，不会被自己的刀刃割伤了。

messages.msgid: The weight of your weapon feels as natural to you as if it were your own limb.
translations: 长剑在手，举重若轻，如臂指使。

messages.msgid: Your body has grown accustomed to the rigors of sword fighting, and can handle it for longer.
translations: 经过严酷的剑术训练，你可以的身体可以战斗更久。

messages.msgid: You understand how to swing a short blade around.  In theory, at least.
translations: 你知道怎么挥舞短刀。至少在理论上知道。

messages.msgid: You've trained your body against the strain of fighting with a short sword.
translations: 经过短刀训练，你的身体已经准备好承受战斗带来的压力。

messages.msgid: You're able to cut through zombies with the same ease you cut through foliage.
translations: 你可以如砍瓜切菜般的砍丧尸。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with how to handle your staff and can use it without knocking yourself out.
translations: 你已经能熟练使用棍棒，不会再敲到自己了。

messages.msgid: You're used to the balance of a staff and know how to handle it.
translations: 你熟悉了棍棒的平衡，知道如何处理它。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the use of quarterstaves.  Donatello would be proud.
translations: 你现在精通长棍类武器的使用，哈，棍扫一大片。

messages.msgid: You've got the basics of lunging and parrying your opponent.
translations: 你已经掌握了进攻和招架的基本技巧。

messages.msgid: You strike forth with ease after many hours of training.
translations: 历经许多小时的训练，你可以轻松出击。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, you could have been an Olympic fencer.
translations: 在大灾变之前，你本可以成为奥运击剑运动员。

messages.msgid: You've learned how to use claw weapons in combat.
translations: 你已经学会了如何在战斗中使用爪形武器。

messages.msgid: You're quite experienced with your claws by now.
translations: 你使用爪子已经经验老到了。

messages.msgid: You feel as dangerous as a tiger with your claws.
translations: 你感觉自己挥爪似虎，异常凶险。

messages.msgid: You're getting a hang of hooking your opponents with your weapon.
translations: 你已经掌握了用武器勾住对手的技巧。

messages.msgid: You could probably unhorse someone with your weapon with your skills.
translations: 以你的技巧驱使下，能用武器打的敌人人仰马翻。

messages.msgid: You've mastered the art of knocking someone to the ground with your weapon.
translations: 你已完全掌握如何将人迅速击倒。

messages.msgid: Dominant hand on the grip, the other on the haft, you're familiar with how to hold most polearms.
translations: 主手握握把，另一只手握柄，你对大多数长柄武器的握法都很熟悉。

messages.msgid: You know how to keep your enemies at a distance with a polearm, and are able to defend yourself with one.
translations: 你知道如何用长柄武器与敌人保持距离，也能够用长柄武器保护自己。

messages.msgid: You can handle the awkward balance of a polearm well, like it's an extension of your body.
translations: 你可以很好地掌握长柄武器的平衡，就像它是你身体的延伸一般。

messages.msgid: Your body is getting used to the stress your bionic weapons put on it.
translations: 你的身体正在适应你的仿生武器带来的应力。

messages.msgid: You've become accustomed to the motions of your bionic weapons in combat.
translations: 你已经习惯使用仿生武器来战斗。

messages.msgid: Your bionic weapon feels as natural to you as your heartbeat.
translations: 你使用仿生武器就像心跳一般自然。

messages.msgid: Non-dominant leg forward, you know the basics of impaling someone on a spear.
translations: 非惯用腿向前，你知道用矛刺人的基本动作。

messages.msgid: Whether you're hunting boar or hunting zombies, you know how to stab with your spear.
translations: 无论你是在猎杀野猪还是丧尸，你都知道怎么用长矛刺杀它们。

messages.msgid: You're in touch with your inner hunter-gatherer, able to keep up the hunt for longer.
translations: 你对着内心深处的猎人冥想，让自己的狩猎更加漫长。

messages.msgid: You're no stranger to thrusting your sword through zombies.
translations: 你对用剑刺杀丧尸并不陌生。

messages.msgid: You're able to gore someone on your sword like a pro.
translations: 你可以像专业人士一样用剑杀人。

messages.msgid: You're a virtuoso with your sword, ready to deliver a swift and deadly thrust.
translations: 你是剑术大师，随时准备迅速而致命的一击。

messages.msgid: You know how to swing a longsword without chopping off your own foot.
translations: 你知道怎么挥舞长剑，不会把自己的腿削下来。

messages.msgid: You're proficient with the use of long swords, and are deadly with one in your hands.
translations: 你精通长剑，手握利器便能杀人。

messages.msgid: You are a blade master of unparalleled skill.  And they said anime wasn't real.
translations: 你是一位身手不凡的剑术大师。

messages.msgid: You are able to operate your bionic sword without incident.
translations: 你可以安全地使用你的仿生剑。

messages.msgid: Your bionic sword proficiency is satisfactory.  You are able to use it without discomfort.
translations: 你对仿生剑的熟练程度令人满意。你可以毫无不适地使用它。

messages.msgid: Your capabilities with your bionic sword is the epitome of combat efficiency.
translations: 你使用仿生剑的能力是战斗效率的典范。

messages.msgid: You've learned how to hit your opponent instead of yourself with your flail.
translations: 你已经学会了如何用连枷击打对手而不是自己。

messages.msgid: You're able to swing your flail with deadly precision, crushing through ribs and skulls alike.
translations: 你能以致命的精准挥动连枷，粉碎肋骨和头骨。

messages.msgid: You can make your flail dance like a ballerina, and hit like a truck.
translations: 你能让连枷像芭蕾舞演员一样跳舞，也能让连枷像卡车一样撞击。

messages.msgid: You've got the gist of bludgeoning your enemies.
translations: 你已经掌握了用重武击打敌人的要领。

messages.msgid: You swing your mace with dead efficiency.
translations: 经年累月的练习与实战，让你手中的钉头锤成了冷酷而高效的杀敌工具 。

messages.msgid: Your strikes with a mace shatter skulls and pulp brains.
translations: 你是真正的钉头锤大师，谈笑间就能让敌人的头颅灰飞烟灭。

messages.msgid: You're not afraid to lift a heavy sword nor bring it down on someone's head.
translations: 你不怕举起沉重的剑，也不怕把它砍到别人的头上。

messages.msgid: You are not afraid to swing big with a heavy sword.
translations: 你不怕拿着一把重剑挥舞。

messages.msgid: You wield your blade like it was a modern day Caliburn.
translations: 你持刀的姿势就像现代的卡利伯恩。

messages.msgid: You can handle a big ol' hammer without dropping it on your toes.
translations: 你能够挥舞这种巨锤，而不至于失手伤到自己。

messages.msgid: You're not afraid to put some muscle into it when you're swinging a hammer.
translations: 你能够很好的控制挥舞巨锤的力度，暴力而不失优雅。

messages.msgid: You're a hammering juggernaut, ready to smash it all.
translations: 挥动巨锤的你简直就像是战争机器，势要粉碎所有的阻碍。

messages.msgid: You're not quite a professional lumberjack, but you can handle an axe.
translations: 你不是一个专业的伐木工，但你会用斧头。

messages.msgid: You chop through bodies as easily as you chop through trees.
translations: 你砍倒尸体就像砍倒树木一样容易。

messages.msgid: You're a post-apocalyptic Paul Bunyan, but it's not just wood you're chopping.
translations: 你是就是这末日废土中的保罗·班扬，但你砍的不仅仅是木头。

messages.msgid: You know the proper technique to use with a hand axe.
translations: 你知道使用手斧的正确技巧。

messages.msgid: You know how to use a hatchet safely and effectively.
translations: 你知道如何安全有效地使用短斧。

messages.msgid: You're more than capable of using a hand axe to protect yourself.
translations: 你完全有能力用手斧来保护自己。

messages.msgid: You know how to punch someone without hurting your wrists.
translations: 你知道如何揍人不伤手腕。

messages.msgid: You're able to pace yourself when you've got nothing else to fight with.
translations: 你在搏斗时可以熟练控制自己的速度和节奏，无人/僵能敌。

messages.msgid: You're used to fighting with nothing and can fight unarmed for longer.
translations: 你习惯了徒手格斗，可以徒手格斗更长时间。

messages.msgid: You can crack a whip without hurting yourself.
translations: 你可以甩动鞭子而不伤到自己。

messages.msgid: You can use a whip to snuff out a candle from across the room without touching the wax.
translations: 你可以从房间另一头用鞭子熄灭蜡烛，而不触碰蜡烛本身。

messages.msgid: Your skill at hunting the living dead with a whip is unparalleled.  Make the Belmonts proud.
translations: 你用鞭子猎杀亡灵的技巧无人能及。定能让贝尔蒙特家族为你骄傲。

messages.msgid: A basic understanding of the properties of metal as a material, and the concepts behind smithing, die casting, and other metalworking techniques.
translations: 基本了解金属材料的特性，以及锻造、压铸和其他金属加工技术背后的概念。

messages.msgid: A basic understanding of the different types of welding, welding tools and fuels, how to weld different materials, and more.
translations: 基本了解不同类型材料的焊接，焊接工具和燃料使用等方面的技术。

messages.msgid: The craft of working metal into tools and other items of use.
translations: 把金属加工成工具和其他物品的技艺。

messages.msgid: How to make jewelry from precious metals like gold and silver.
translations: 用金银等贵金属制作珠宝首饰的技能。

messages.msgid: How to make articulated armor from pieces of metal.
translations: 将金属制成铰接式盔甲的技艺。

messages.msgid: How to fabricate sharp and reliable blades from scratch.
translations: 从头开始制造锋利可靠的刀剑的技艺。

messages.msgid: How to make high-quality tools and parts by hand.  Includes techniques like threading, durable articulation points, and using appropriate metals for appropriate tasks.  Also applies to making blunt instruments that can withstand a severe beating without distortion.
translations: 如何手工制作高质量的工具和零件，包括一些技巧，比如缝制，耐久恢复，以及在适当的任务中使用合适的金属的技术。也可以用于制造在猛烈撞击下保持不变形的打击工具。

messages.msgid: How to turn raw ingots and metals into usable wire.  Includes both drawing and extruding.
translations: 如何把原锭和金属变成可用的金属线。包括拉丝和冷挤压工艺。

messages.msgid: Heating steel packed in charcoal at high temperatures to cause a hard case of higher carbon steel around the lower carbon core.
translations: 在高温下加热用木炭包裹着的钢锭，在低碳核心周围形成高碳钢硬壳。

messages.msgid: Quenching involves heating the steel, quenching it in water, then tempering it to create extremely tough metal.
translations: 淬火包括加热钢，在水中淬火，然后回火以制造出非常坚硬的金属。

messages.msgid: You know the basic principles of turning stones into more useful tools.
translations: 你知道把石头变成有用工具的基本原理。

messages.msgid: You've banged rocks together so much and for so long, you've become extremely fast at it.
translations: 你通过多次长时间的练习已经能够很快地敲制石器。

messages.msgid: Working with glass and heat without poisoning or perforating yourself.
translations: 将玻璃加热并制成物品而不让自己中毒或被烧穿孔的技艺。

messages.msgid: Working with pipes and pipe fittings to transport fluids without leakage.
translations: 通过管道和管件来无泄漏地运输液体的技术。

messages.msgid: Basic pottery, from shaping to working with slip to fuse pieces.
translations: 将黏土成型到打磨，再拼接成片的基础制陶工艺。

messages.msgid: The ability to make durable, effective bows.
translations: 能够制造耐用且有效的弓的技能。

messages.msgid: The skill involved in making arrows that fly true.
translations: 能制作出真正在空中平稳飞行的箭支的技能。
将粗大的纤维编织成形的技艺。

messages.msgid: Adding glazes to pottery to make them waterproof.
translations: 在陶器上添加釉料使其防水的技艺。

messages.msgid: Working with plastic using your hands, including carving, molding, and gluing it.  You know how to identify thermoplastics that are suitable for mold casting, and how to identify the right plastic for the right job.
translations: 用双手加工塑料的技艺，包括雕刻、模塑和粘合。你知道如何辩别能用来铸造模具的热塑性塑料，以及如何为不同配方挑选合适的塑料原料。

messages.msgid: Shaping wood, bone, and similar materials with a cutting implement.
translations: 用工具雕琢木头、骨头和类似材料的技术。

messages.msgid: How to add gemstones to jewelry.
translations: 如何在首饰上添加珠宝的技能。

messages.msgid: You know how to accurately measure powder and projectile weights for reloading firearm cartridges.
translations: 精确测量火药和弹丸重量来复装弹药的技艺。

messages.msgid: A base knowledge of how to put together and take apart common appliances, diagnose problems, and replace parts.
translations: 关于如何组装和拆卸常用电器、诊断问题和更换零件的基本知识。

messages.msgid: Making flexible items out of hard materials is tricky.  You've done enough of it to understand how to make smoothly articulated joints out of rigid or semi-rigid materials.
translations: 将坚硬的材料制作成灵活的物品是非常棘手的。你已经制造了足够多的盔甲，知道如何使用刚性或半刚性材料来制造能够灵活转动的铰接关节。

messages.msgid: You are familiar with the adjustments and tricks needed to make properly functional buttons, zippers, and other closures on garments.
translations: 你熟悉制造合适的纽扣、拉链与其他服装收口相关的技艺。

messages.msgid: You know how to make garments and fabric containers sealed against water.
translations: 你知道如何制造各种防水服装和织物容器。

messages.msgid: Making elastic bands is easy enough, but making a whole garment from stretchy cloth takes a bit of finesse.  You're good at it.
translations: 做橡皮筋很容易，但是用弹力面料制造整件衣服需要一些特殊技巧。你对此很在行。

messages.msgid: Like a magical elf, you've learned how to construct footwear by hand.
translations: 能像童话里的小精灵一样徒手制造鞋类装备的技艺。

messages.msgid: The art of spinning fiber into thread.
translations: 把纤维纺成缝线的技艺。

messages.msgid: You've learned how to use a loom to produce sheets of fabric from thread.
translations: 你学会了用纺车把丝线编织成织物面料。

messages.msgid: Like a solitary mouse, you've learned how to construct hats by hand.
translations: 你就像一只孤独的老鼠，已经学会了徒手制造帽子的技艺。

messages.msgid: Knitting, one of the oldest ways of making loops in fiber until it is fabric.
translations: 针织，将纤维节编织成织物的古老技艺。

messages.msgid: You have knitted and knitted and knitted some more, and have the consistent string tension to show for it.  When you get going, the clicking of your needles is like a metronome.
translations: 你已经不停地针织、针织、再针织，这使得你能够持续稳定地快速将线团变成织物。当你针织时，针头的敲击有如节拍器一般。

messages.msgid: You've got a basic familiarity with how to work with leather, furs, hides, and similar materials.
translations: 你对如何使用皮革、毛皮、生皮和类似材料有基本的了解。

messages.msgid: Working with leather requires a specific set of skills and tools… a set you are familiar with.
translations: 制造皮革需要特定的技能和工具……你早已谙熟此道。

messages.msgid: Working with fur and faux fur is a skill all its own.
translations: 如何处理毛皮和人造毛皮自身就是一项技能。

messages.msgid: It seems unlikely that anyone prior to the Cataclysm knew how to work with the shells of giant bugs as well as you do now.
translations: 任何大灾变之前的人都不太可能像你现在一样，知道如何处理巨型虫子的甲壳。

messages.msgid: Turning sheets of chain links into effective, wearable clothing that doesn't bind up.
translations: 将链环制成有防护力可穿戴的装备，而非粘合在一起的技艺。

messages.msgid: You know the tricks for working with Kevlar, Nomex, and other advanced polymer cloth.
translations: 使用凯夫拉，芳纶和其他先进聚合物织物的技艺。

messages.msgid: You know how to sew stacks of sheets together efficiently to create sturdier armor.  It's also a nice way to sew something pretty!
translations: 你知道如何有效地将成堆的面料缝合在一起，以制作更坚固的盔甲。这也是一种缝制漂亮东西的好方法！。

messages.msgid: You know how to pick a lock, at least in theory.
translations: 你知道怎么开锁，至少理论上是这样。

messages.msgid: You can pick a lock in the dark, blindfolded.  Although that doesn't make it all that much harder.  You're good at locks, OK?
translations: 你可以在蒙着眼睛开锁，这对你来说根本不算什么。你擅长开锁，明白吗？

messages.msgid: Opening safes is an exacting skill, one that you are proficient at.
translations: 打开保险箱是一项困难的技能，幸好你很精通。

messages.msgid: You know the basics of setting and taking down traps safely.
translations: 你知道安全设置和拆除陷阱的基本知识。

messages.msgid: You're specifically quite skilled at setting effective traps.
translations: 你特别擅长设置精巧的陷阱。

messages.msgid: You know how to take down a trap safely.
translations: 你知道如何安全地拆除陷阱。

messages.msgid: You are skilled at spotting things out of the ordinary, like traps or ambushes.
translations: 你善于发现异常情况，例如陷阱或埋伏。

messages.msgid: Before the Cataclysm, you were a helicopter pilot.  Now, you just hope you can fly again.
translations: 大灾变前，你是一名直升机驾驶员。现在，你只希望自己能再飞一次。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with the control and operation of marine vehicles, like boats.
translations: 你现在熟知控制与操作水上载具，比如船。

messages.msgid: You're comfortable with the basic controls of cars, and land vehicles in general.
translations: 你对汽车和一般陆地交通工具的基本控制都很熟悉。

messages.msgid: Basic improvement on the chance of hitting the Weakpoint Monster's weak points.
translations: 部分提高命中弱点怪物弱点的几率。

messages.msgid: Expert improvement on the chance of hitting the Weakpoint Monster's weak points.
translations: 极大提高命中弱点怪物弱点的几率。

messages.msgid: Very basic familiarity with various types of undead creatures.
translations: 对于各类不死生物的基础了解。

messages.msgid: Very basic familiarity with various types of demihuman creatures.
translations: 对于各类亚人的基础了解。

messages.msgid: You are familiar with the common anatomy of these purpose-built abominations, as far as they have one.
translations: 你对这种"人"造怪物的常见解剖学结构很熟悉，只要碰到一个就能知道其身体结构。

messages.msgid: Understanding of man-made armors and ways to exploit them.  You're able to find openings in certain kinds of body armor.
translations: 对各类人造护甲的了解，以及如何利用它们的缺点。你可以找到某些护甲的弱点。

messages.msgid: You're somewhat familiar with naturally armored creatures.  You're able to find openings in certain kinds of hardened shells and thick hides.
translations: 你对那些长着天然护甲的生物有所了解。你能够找到某些坚固甲壳和硬化兽皮中的弱点。

messages.msgid: You're somewhat familiar with cybernetic creatures.  You're able to find openings and gaps that aren't as hardened.
translations: 你对那些生化改造过的生物有所了解。你能够找到某些坚固装甲上的弱点。

messages.msgid: Basic familiarity with various types of frogs and salamanders.
translations: 对于各类青蛙、蝾螈等两栖生物的基础了解。

messages.msgid: Basic familiarity with various types of birds.
translations: 对于各种鸟类的基础了解。

messages.msgid: Basic familiarity with the anatomy of various canines.
translations: 对各种犬科生物构造的基本熟悉

messages.msgid: Basic familiarity with the anatomy of various ungulates.
translations: 对各种有蹄目生物构造的基本熟悉

messages.msgid: Basic familiarity with various types of insects, arachnids, and worms.
translations: 对于各类昆虫、蜘蛛和蠕虫生物的基础了解。

messages.msgid: You are familiar with the anatomy of mutated beetles - bypassing their thick armor should be easier.
translations: 你对那些变异甲虫有所了解。你能够绕开它们厚重的甲壳。

messages.msgid: You are familiar with the anatomy of mutated centipedes, letting you target their less-deadly parts with ease.
translations: 你对那些变异蜈蚣有所了解。你能够瞄准它们不太危险的部位。

messages.msgid: Familiarity with the comparative anatomy of mutant Hymenopterans - ants, bees, and wasps of all kinds.  You find it easier to exploit their weak points, and possibly disable their natural weaponry.
translations: 你对各种膜翅昆虫有所了解，蚂蚁、蜜蜂、黄蜂之类。你能够找到它们的弱点，并瘫痪它们天生的武器。

messages.msgid: You are familiar with the anatomy of mutated spiders of all shapes and sizes.
translations: 你对各种形状大小的蜘蛛有所了解。

messages.msgid: Basic understanding of what's needed for certain creatures to fly, as well as ways of preventing it.
translations: 对于各类生物如何飞行以及如何阻止它们飞行的基础了解。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with creatures presenting unsettling bones on their outer structure.
translations: 你对那些在外部结构上长着可怕骨头的生物十分熟悉。

messages.msgid: You have some practice in fighting small humanoids like children.  You don't necessarily feel good about it.
translations: 你有着对抗诸如儿童之类的小型人型生物的经验。虽然你觉得未必能用得上。

messages.msgid: You have some practice in fighting large, hulking humanoids.  You're better at reaching certain weak points.
translations: 你有着对抗巨型人型生物的经验。你更容易利用某些弱点。

messages.msgid: You have extensive experience with netherium abominations which provides you with a vague sense of where more vulnerable spots might be.
translations: 你对付虚质畸变体的经验丰富，因此能隐约察觉到它们身上可能存在的弱点。

messages.msgid: You have studied mi-go sufficiently to get a sense for where some sensitive points might be.  However, its biology remains too different from life originating on Earth to be understood to any extent.
translations: 你已经对米戈进行了充分的研究，了解了其弱点所在。然而，它的生理结构与地球上的生命有巨大差别，使你完全无法理解其构造。

messages.msgid: Your understanding of the mi-go body is advanced enough to have a decent idea of where it is more sensitive to harm.  This does not mean you have any significant understanding of how it works internally; if anything, your dissections have just left you more confused.
translations: 你对米戈的构造已经了解的足够深入，可以大致了解它的哪些部位更容易受到伤害。但这并不意味着你对它的内部运作有任何重大的认识；相反，你的解剖只是让你更加困惑。

messages.msgid: You have studied fungaloids sufficiently to get an idea of which parts are the more sensitive ones.  While seeming to be a weird mixture of fungus and animal, it at least has a structure with commonalities between different types of fungaloids.
translations: 你已经对真菌进行了充分的研究，了解其弱点所在。虽然看起来是真菌和动物的奇怪混合物，但它至少和地球上一些不同类型的真菌之间有着共同的结构。

messages.msgid: You have advanced your understanding of the fungaloid body sufficiently to have a pretty good idea of where you can harm it and where it's better protected.  You don't really understand it's biological functions, although it seems it would be possible for someone with much more time than you have to glean some insight into it, but you've gotten an understanding of how to hurt it, and that's what's important here.
translations: 你对真菌体的研究已相当深入，基本能确定哪些部位更容易造成伤害，哪些部位保护得更好。尽管你并没有真正理解它的生物学机能，但如果有人投入比你更多的时间，也许能从中获得一些了解，但重要的是你已经掌握了如何有效地对其造成伤害。

messages.msgid: Your observations of the power leech anatomy is starting to pay off.  You now have a basic idea of where their more sensitive structures are located.  These creatures exhibit traits that seem to be a mix between animal and plant ones.
translations: 你对水蛭花的解剖观察正在取得成果。你现在对它们较敏感的结构位置有了基本的了解。这些生物表现出似乎介于动物和植物之间的特性。

messages.msgid: The extensive experience with power leeches have given you a good understanding of their weaknesses and strengths.  A rather different set of skills would be needed to actually understand their biology, though, and you probably don't have the time to study that anyway.
translations: 丰富的与水蛭花打交道的经验让你很好地了解了它们的弱点和长处。不过，要真正理解它们的生物学原理，需要另一套完全不同的技能，而且你可能也没有时间去钻研那些。

messages.msgid: After having engaged slimes to a significant extent you have started to get better at exploiting weaknesses in their behavior and, for lack of better terms, "physiology".
translations: 在与变形怪进行大量交战后，你开始更好地利用它们行为上的弱点，以及更恰当地说，它们的“生理学”上的弱点。

messages.msgid: You've probably reached the pinnacle of slime weakness exploitation, but it has taken an enormous amount of combat to acquire it.
translations: 你可能已经掌握了利用变形怪弱点的最高技巧，但这需要经过大量的战斗才能获得。

messages.msgid: Study of triffids has given you insights into their anatomy that allows you to aim for some weak spots.
translations: 对三尖树的研究让你对其解剖学有了深入了解，这使得你能够瞄准它们的一些弱点。

messages.msgid: Extensive study of triffids has provided you with a good understanding of their strengths and weaknesses when it comes to combat.  A scientific study of them might yield further biological insights, but you don't have the time to spend years cooped up in a lab.
translations: 对三尖树的广泛研究使你在战斗中对其优势和劣势有了很好的理解。对它们进行科学研究可能会带来更多的生物学了解，但你没有时间在实验室里耗费数年。

messages.msgid: You've got a basic grasp of the theory of how to twist and arrange fibers into a more durable cord.
translations: 把纤维缠绕编织成更耐用的线材的技艺。

messages.msgid: Making twisted fibers into durable and useful rope.
translations: 把编织线制成更加耐用且有用的绳索的技艺。

messages.msgid: You're familiar with the theory behind turning raw hides into leather.
translations: 你熟悉把生皮鞣制成皮革的理论。

messages.msgid: You have a lot of practice and experience with processing hides to leather, as well as related techniques like making boiled leather.
translations: 你有很多将生皮加工成皮革的实践经验，并掌握了各种鞣制皮革的技巧，比如煮制皮革。

messages.msgid: You have grasped some basic understanding on archery, and find handling bows easier.
translations: 你已经掌握了射箭的一些基本知识，这让操作弓箭变得更容易。

messages.msgid: After significant practice, you have become experienced in the movements used in drawing and firing a bow, and have strengthened those muscles considerably.
translations: 经过大量的练习，你已经成为拉弓射箭的专家，并且大大锻炼了相关肌肉群。

messages.msgid: You have drawn and fired a bow so many times, you probably have a bit of a twist in your spine from it.  You've developed at least a professional-level understanding of the pose and motion of effective archery.
translations: 你已经拉了无数次弓，射了无数次箭，多到脊椎可能因动作长期重复而有点形变了。你对有效射箭的姿势和动作至少有了专业水平的理解。

messages.msgid: Simple projects involving holding planks and panels of wood together with nails or similar fasteners.
translations: 你会用钉子或类似的扣件把木板和木板固定在一起的简单技术。

messages.msgid: Simple projects involving creating musical instruments out of wood.
translations: 涉及使用木材制作乐器的简单项目。

messages.msgid: mild steel brigandines with shoulder guards
translations: 布面甲背心（低碳钢 带护肩）

messages.msgid: medium steel brigandines with shoulder guards
translations: 布面甲背心（中碳钢 带护肩）

messages.msgid: high steel brigandines with shoulder guards
translations: 布面甲背心（高碳钢 带护肩）

messages.msgid: mild steel brigandine coats with shoulder guards
translations: 布面甲大衣（低碳钢 带护肩）

messages.msgid: medium steel brigandine coats with shoulder guards
translations: 布面甲大衣（中碳钢 带护肩）

messages.msgid: high steel brigandine coats with shoulder guards
translations: 布面甲大衣（高碳钢 带护肩）

messages.msgid: A system of springs and pads, intended to cushion the effects of collisions on the interior of your vehicle.
translations: 一套弹簧和垫片组合而成的缓冲系统，用于吸收碰撞对载具内部造成的冲击。

messages.msgid: A battery for storing electrical power, and discharging it to power electrical devices built into the vehicle.
translations: 一块能够储存电能的电池，并能够为车上的各类电子设备提供电力。

messages.msgid: A battery for storing electrical power, and discharging it to power electrical devices built into the vehicle.  This one is mounted on a quick release framework to allow it to be easily swapped, though it still weighs so much that a lifting tool of some kind is necessary for most people.
translations: 一块能够存储电力的电池，能够为车上其他电子设备提供所需电力。这块电池安装在一个能够快速插拔的框架上，可以方便地替换。但对普通人来说还是需要一些起重工具才能提起这么重的东西。

messages.msgid: A battery for storing electrical power, and discharging it to power electrical devices built into the vehicle.  This one is mounted on a quick release framework to allow it to be easily swapped, though it still weighs so much that a lifting tool of some kind is necessary for some people.
translations: 一块能够存储电力的电池，能够为车上其他电子设备提供所需电力。这块电池安装在一个能够快速插拔的框架上，可以方便地替换。但对普通人来说还是需要一些起重工具才能提起这么重的东西。

messages.msgid: A metal wall.  Keeps zombies outside the vehicle and prevents people from seeing through it.
translations: 一块金属隔板。能够阻挡丧尸和其他人的视线。

messages.msgid: A half-height metal wall.  Keeps zombies outside the vehicle but allows people to see over it.
translations: 一块半高金属隔板。能够阻挡丧尸但是无法阻挡其他人的视线。

messages.msgid: A cloth wall.  Keeps zombies outside the vehicle and prevents people from seeing through it.
translations: 一块布制隔板。能够阻挡丧尸和其他人的视线。

messages.msgid: A half-height cloth wall.  Keeps zombies outside the vehicle but allows people to see over it.
translations: 一块半高布制隔板。能够阻挡丧尸但是无法阻挡其他人的视线。

messages.msgid: A metal wall with a storage locker.  Keeps zombies outside the vehicle and prevents people from seeing through it.
translations: 一块有着储藏箱的金属隔板。能够阻挡丧尸和其他人的视线。

messages.msgid: A strong metal wall.  Keeps zombies outside the vehicle and prevents people from seeing through it.
translations: 一块厚金属隔板。能够阻挡丧尸和其他人的视线。

messages.msgid: A half-height strong metal wall.  Keeps zombies outside the vehicle but allows people to see over it.
translations: 一块半高厚金属隔板。能够阻挡丧尸但是无法阻挡其他人的视线。

messages.msgid: A wooden wall.  Keeps zombies outside the vehicle and prevents people from seeing through it.
translations: 一块木制隔板。能够阻挡丧尸和其他人的视线。

messages.msgid: A half-height wooden wall.  Keeps zombies outside the vehicle but allows people to see over it.
translations: 一块半高木制隔板。能够阻挡丧尸但是无法阻挡其他人的视线。

messages.msgid: A half-height thin metal wall.  Keeps zombies outside the vehicle but allows people to see over it.
translations: 一块半高薄金属隔板。能够阻挡丧尸但是无法阻挡其他人的视线。

messages.msgid: A half-height heavy metal wall.  Commonly used in forklifts to balance them when lifting heavy things.
translations: 半高的沉重金属墙。常用于叉车起重物时平衡重量。

messages.msgid: Storage space, mounted outside your vehicle's armor and vulnerable to damage.
translations: 安装在载具外部的储物空间，不受装甲防护，而且很容易损坏。

messages.msgid: A collection of pipes and frames for supporting a bike or other small vehicle and carrying it on your vehicle.  Move a single tile wide vehicle so that all of that vehicle's tiles are next to bike racks, and then 'e'xamine any bike rack to mount that vehicle onto the bike rack.  'e'xamine the bike rack to unmount the carried vehicle.
translations: 一套由各式钢管、凸轮和带子组成的装置，安装在载具边缘，可托起并运输一辆摩托车。将待装载的单格宽的载具停放于摩托车托架旁，按"e"查看任意一处摩托车托架可装载载具。再次按"e"查看摩托车托架，可卸下所装载的载具。

messages.msgid: Spare tire stored on an external carrier rig.
translations: 一个安装在载具外挂架上的备用轮胎。

messages.msgid: A combustion engine.  Burns fuel from a tank in the vehicle.
translations: 一个内燃引擎。燃烧消耗载具油箱内的燃料。

messages.msgid: A combustion engine for use on aircraft.  Burns gasoline or avgas fuel from a tank in the vehicle.
translations: 一个飞机上使用的内燃引擎。燃烧消耗载具油箱内的汽油或航空燃油。

messages.msgid: A combustion engine.  Burns diesel fuel from a tank in the vehicle.  Can also burn biodiesel or kerosene, though somewhat less efficiently.
translations: 一个内燃引擎。燃烧消耗载具油箱内的柴油。同时也能使用乙醇或煤油作为燃料，但效率会较低。

messages.msgid: A combustion engine.  Burns gasoline fuel from a tank in the vehicle.
translations: 一个内燃引擎。燃烧消耗载具油箱内的汽油。

messages.msgid: An advanced combustion engine.  Burns gasoline or diesel or aviation fuel from a tank in the vehicle.  Can also burn kerosene, though somewhat less efficiently.  Better power-to-weight ratio than a traditional engine, but consumes more fuel.
translations: 一个先进内燃引擎。燃烧消耗载具油箱内的汽油、柴油或航空燃料。同时也能使用煤油作为燃料，但效率会较低。拥有比传统引擎更好的推重比，但会消耗更多燃料。

messages.msgid: An inline 6-cylinder diesel engine.  Somewhat more powerful but much larger than a V6, you might see an engine like this in a road roller or excavator.
translations: 一台直排6缸柴油发动机。通常用在压路机或挖掘机上，性能比六缸引擎更强大，但也更笨重。

messages.msgid: A four-cylinder diesel engine, commonly found in small passenger cars and light trucks.
translations: 一台四缸柴油发动机，通常用于小轿车和轻型卡车中。

messages.msgid: A powerful 6-cylinder diesel engine, typical of a bus, RV, large van, or armored personnel carrier.
translations: 一台动力强劲的6缸柴油发动机，通常用于公共汽车、房车、大型货车或装甲运兵车。

messages.msgid: A large 8-cylinder diesel engine, powerful enough for a semi truck, armored car, or Humvee.
translations: 一台大型8缸柴油发动机，功率足以驱动半挂卡车、装甲车或悍马。

messages.msgid: A 50 cc gasoline engine, suitable for a lawnmower, golf cart or moped.
translations: 一个 50 毫升的汽油引擎，适用于锄草机、高尔夫球车、或是助力车。

messages.msgid: A 200 cc engine, suitable for a dirt bike or scooter.
translations: 一个 200 毫升的汽油引擎，适用于小型摩托或越野摩托。

messages.msgid: A 150 cc engine, suitable for a dirt bike, scooter or generator.
A 200 cc engine, suitable for a dirt bike, scooter, or generator.
translations: 一个 200 毫升的柴油引擎，适用于小型摩托、越野摩托或发电机。

messages.msgid: A small 25 cc gasoline engine, suitable for a hedge trimmer or installing on a bicycle.
translations: 一个轻量的 25 毫升汽油引擎，适用于修枝机或是助力单车。

messages.msgid: A 1600 cc four-cylinder gasoline engine, commonly found in small passenger cars.
translations: 一个 1600 毫升的四缸汽油引擎，常常能在小轿车里看到。

messages.msgid: A massive 12-cylinder gasoline engine, with the kind of power you might need in a sports car.
translations: 一台巨大的12缸汽油发动机，具备有跑车才可能需要的强劲动力。

messages.msgid: A massive 12-cylinder diesel engine, typical of a heavy cargo truck.
translations: 一台大型12缸柴油发动机，通常用于重型载货卡车。

messages.msgid: A powerful 6-cylinder gasoline engine strong enough for a pickup truck, SUV, or full-size van.
translations: 一台动力强大的6缸汽油发动机，足以驱动皮卡、SUV或全尺寸面包车。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty 8-cylinder gasoline engine, like you might find in a fire truck, ambulance, or tow truck.
translations: 一台重型8缸汽油发动机，通常用于消防车、救护车或拖车。

messages.msgid: A 600 cc, two-cylinder, gas engine for a fast motorcycle or very small car.
translations: 一个 600 毫升的两缸汽油引擎，适用于高速摩托车或袖珍型轿车。

messages.msgid: A closed cycle, external combustion steam engine.  Burns coal or charcoal from a bunker in the vehicle to produce steam.
translations: 一个闭环外燃蒸汽引擎。燃烧消耗载具燃料舱内的煤炭或木炭并产生蒸汽。

messages.msgid: A small gas turbine engine, suitable for powering a small one or two-seat helicopter.
translations: 一台小型燃气涡轮引擎，足以为单座或双座小型直升机提供动力。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty gas turbine engine, like those typically found in a Medevac, Apache, or Blackhawk helicopter.
translations: 一台重型燃气涡轮发动机，是救援直升机、阿帕奇或黑鹰直升机上的典型发动机。

messages.msgid: A huge gas turbine engine, used to lift large military helicopters such as the V-22 Osprey.
translations: 一台巨大的燃气涡轮发动机，通常用于驱动类似V-22鱼鹰的大型军用直升机。

messages.msgid: A door.  Has a window so you can see out of it, even when closed.
translations: 一扇车门。即使关上门你也可以透过其上的窗来观察。

messages.msgid: A cloth sheet that can be fastened into a closed position to act as a door.
translations: 一块可以系紧关闭的布门帘。

messages.msgid: A cloth sheet that can be slid into a closed position to act as a door.
translations: 一块可以拉起关闭的布门帘。

messages.msgid: A door.  Solid construction means you can't see through it when closed.
translations: 一扇车门。它是实心的，所以关上门时你不能透过它来观察。

messages.msgid: A strong door.  Has a window so you can see out of it, even when closed.
translations: 一扇坚固的车门。即使关上门你也可以透过其上的窗来观察。

messages.msgid: A strong door.  Solid construction means you can't see through it when closed.
translations: 一扇坚固的车门。它是实心的，所以关上门时你不能透过它来观察。

messages.msgid: An interior door.  Solid construction means you can't see through it when closed.
translations: 一扇内部车门。它是实心的，所以关上门时你不能透过它来观察。

messages.msgid: A strong door.  A window lets you see through it when closed.
translations: 一扇坚固的车门。即使关上门你也可以透过其上的窗来观察。

messages.msgid: A very strong door.  A window lets you see through it when closed.
translations: 一扇非常坚固的车门。即使关上门你也可以透过其上的窗来观察。

messages.msgid: A very strong door.  Solid construction means you can't see through it when closed.
translations: 一扇非常坚固的车门。它是实心的，所以关上门时你不能透过它来观察。

messages.msgid: A short door.  You can always see over it, open or closed.
translations: 一扇低矮的车门。无论开关，你总能从这里看见外面。

messages.msgid: A strong, short door.  You can always see over it, open or closed.
translations: 一扇坚固而低矮的车门。无论开关，你总能从这里看见外面。

messages.msgid: A door.  A window lets you see through it when closed.
translations: 一扇车门，即使关上门你也可以透过其上的窗来观察。

messages.msgid: A rigid steel boom crane.  If it is in your line of sight and within two tiles of another vehicle, you will automatically use it when you want to jack up the other vehicle to change its wheels.  To use it to lift a heavy component like an engine that you are installing or removing, the crane must have line of sight to where it is going and it must be within four tiles of it.
translations: 一台坚固的钢制吊臂起重机。当它安装在你视野内的载具上且距离目标载具两格内时，能够当作千斤顶使用，将其他载具抬起来更换轮胎。当它安装在你视野内的载具上且距离目标四格内时，能够当作起重机使用，更换沉重的载具部件，例如引擎。

messages.msgid: An extendable cantilever crane.  If it is in your line of sight and within two tiles of another vehicle, you will automatically use it when you want to jack up the other vehicle to change its wheels.  To use it to lift a heavy component like an engine that you are installing or removing, the crane must have line of sight to where it is going and it must be within four tiles of it.
translations: 一台可伸缩吊臂起重机。当它安装在你视野内的载具上且距离目标载具两格内时，能够当作千斤顶使用，将其他载具抬起来更换轮胎。当它安装在你视野内的载具上且距离目标四格内时，能够当作起重机使用，更换沉重的载具部件，例如引擎。

messages.msgid: A small pallet lifter.  If it is in your line of sight and within two tiles of another vehicle, you will automatically use it when you want to jack up the other vehicle to change its wheels.  To use it to lift a heavy component like an engine that you are installing or removing, the crane must have line of sight to where it is going and it must be within four tiles of it.
translations: 一台小型托盘升降机。当它安装在你视野内的载具上且距离目标载具两格内时，能够当作千斤顶使用，将其他载具抬起来更换轮胎。当它安装在你视野内的载具上且距离目标四格内时，能够当作起重机使用，更换沉重的载具部件，例如引擎。

messages.msgid: A pair of forklift arms.  If it is in your line of sight and within two tiles of another vehicle, you will automatically use it when you want to jack up the other vehicle to change its wheels.  To use it to lift a heavy component like an engine that you are installing or removing, the crane must have line of sight to where it is going and it must be within four tiles of it.
translations: 一对叉车升降臂。当它安装在你视野内的载具上且距离目标载具两格内时，能够当作千斤顶使用，将其他载具抬起来更换轮胎。当它安装在你视野内的载具上且距离目标四格内时，能够当作起重机使用，更换沉重的载具部件，例如引擎。

messages.msgid: A large metal disc, powered by the vehicle's engines.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  When turned on, it will stop the vehicle unless it has a strong engine.  When turned on, it will dig a shallow pit in dirt.  Mount it on the edge of your vehicle.
translations: 一个由车辆引擎带动的大型金属圆盘。在载具控制菜单中控制开关。开启时会在其所经过的泥土地上挖出浅坑。需要将其安装在车辆侧面。

messages.msgid: A kickstand to keep the bike from falling over.  You could use this to lean it forward or backward to change a tire.
translations: 一个用于防止摩托车侧翻的金属支撑脚架。安装后可将摩托车前倾或者后倾以更换轮胎。

messages.msgid: A metal framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.
translations: 一个金属车辆框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面，在它四周增加新的车辆框架，就可以增加车辆大小。

messages.msgid: A light metal framework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.
translations: 一个可折叠的轻型金属车辆框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面。如果构成载具的所有框架和部件都可折叠，那么这辆载具能够被打包折叠并可像普通物品一样被拾取带走。

messages.msgid: A light wooden framework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.
translations: 一个可折叠的轻型木制车辆框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面。如果构成载具的所有框架和部件都可折叠，那么这辆载具能够被打包折叠并可像普通物品一样被拾取带走。

messages.msgid: A wooden framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Wood and nail construction means it can be constructed and added to the vehicle without welding tools.
translations: 一个木制车辆框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面，在它四周增加新的车辆框架，就可以增加车辆大小。木制车架采用钉子固定，因此不需要焊接工具就能够制造和连接。

messages.msgid: A light wooden skateboard deck.  Other skateboard components can be mounted on it.
translations: 轻便结实的木制板材，可以让其他的滑板部件恰当地安装在上边。

messages.msgid: A light wooden framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Wood and rope constructions means it can be constructed and added to the vehicle without welding tools or nails.
translations: 一个轻型木制车辆框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面，在它四周增加新的车辆框架，就可以增加车辆大小。木制轻车架采用绳子固定，因此不需要焊接工具和钉子就能够制造和连接。

messages.msgid: A heavy metal framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Increased mass makes it more resistant to damage in collisions.
translations: 一个重型金属车辆框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面，在它四周增加新的车辆框架，就可以增加车辆大小。增加质量的同时也让它更难被撞坏。

messages.msgid: A light metal framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.
translations: 一个轻型金属车辆框架。其他载具部件能够安装在它上面，在它四周增加新的车辆框架，就可以增加车辆大小。

messages.msgid: A bright light, self-powered by an atomic decay reaction that never stops.  When turned on, it illuminates several squares inside the vehicle.
translations: 一盏明亮的原子灯，采用内部核能供电，开启时照亮车内数格空间。

messages.msgid: A very dim light, self-powered by an atomic decay reaction that never stops.  When turned on, it illuminates a single square inside the vehicle that isn't suitable for crafting.
translations: 一盏十分昏暗的原子灯，采用内部核能供电，开启时照亮车内一格空间。你无法在这么昏暗的灯光下制造物品。

messages.msgid: A very bright, circular light that illuminates the area outside the vehicle when turned on.
translations: 一盏十分明亮的泛光灯，开启时照亮车外大片圆形区域。

messages.msgid: A very bright, directed light that illuminates a half-circular area outside the vehicle when turned on.  During installation, you can choose what direction to point the light.
translations: 一盏十分明亮的定向泛光灯，开启时照亮车外大片半圆形区域。安装时可以选择车灯的方向。

messages.msgid: A bright light that illuminates a narrow cone outside the vehicle when turned on.  During installation, you can choose what direction to point the light, so multiple headlights can illuminate the sides or rear, as well as the front.
translations: 一盏明亮的探照灯，开启时照亮车外一片锥形区域。安装时可以选择车灯方向，多盏方向不同的车灯能照亮载具四周。

messages.msgid: A small, lightweight, bright light that illuminates a narrow cone outside the vehicle when turned on.  During installation, you can choose what direction to point the light, so multiple headlights can illuminate the sides or rear, as well as the front.
translations: 一盏小巧轻便明亮的探照灯，开启时照亮车外一片锥形区域。安装时可以选择车灯方向，多盏方向不同的车灯能照亮载具四周。

messages.msgid: A bright light that illuminates a wide cone outside the vehicle when turned on.  During installation, you can choose what direction to point the light, so multiple headlights can illuminate the sides or rear, as well as the front.
translations: 一盏明亮的探照灯，开启时照亮车外一片广角锥形区域。安装时可以选择车灯方向，多盏方向不同的车灯能照亮载具四周。

messages.msgid: Emergency lights, like a police car's or ambulance's, mounted on the vehicle's roof.  Flashes between red and blue when turned on, attracting attention without illuminating the area.
translations: 一盏安装在车顶上的警灯，和警车和救护车顶上的一样。开启时发出红蓝相间的光，照亮不了很大范围但能够吸引附近人的注意。

messages.msgid: A set of bicycle-style foot pedals attached to a crank.  If mounted on the same tile as a seat, they allow you to use your stamina to produce engine power, using your legs.  Provides more power the stronger you are.
translations: 一组连接到曲轴的自行车式脚踏板。 如果与座椅安装在同一块格上，它们可以让你利用你的腿部耐力来产生引擎动力。 你越强壮，提供的动力就越多。

messages.msgid: A set of wheelchair-style hoop hand rims, often attached directly to the wheels.  If mounted on the same tile as seat, they allow you to use your stamina to produce engine power, using your arms.  Provides more power the stronger you are.
translations: 一组轮椅式的环形手圈，通常直接连接到轮子上。 如果与座椅安装在同一块格上，它们可以让你用你的手臂，通过你的耐力来产生引擎动力。 你越强壮，提供的动力就越多。

messages.msgid: A set of leather bindings to control a creature pulling a vehicle, such as a cart.
translations: 用来控制可骑乘生物的全套皮革缰绳和挽具，让它能拉动载具，就和马车一样。

messages.msgid: A small mirror, mounted outside the vehicle.  If you see the mirror, your vision is expanded as though you were standing where the mirror is.
translations: 一面小镜子，安装在车辆外部。当你能看见反光镜时，你的视野将依据反光镜所在位置进行扩充。

messages.msgid: A small mirror, mounted inside the vehicle.  If you see the mirror, your vision is expanded as though you were standing where the mirror is.
translations: 一面小镜子，安装在车辆内部。当你能看见反光镜时，你的视野将依据反光镜所在位置进行扩充。

messages.msgid: A table rig with a faucet for water tank access, fume hood, drawers and fixtures for storing tools, low power electric connectors and valves for fuel tank connections.
translations: 一套集成了水龙头（连接水箱）、通风橱、抽屉、工具固定架、低功率电连接器和燃料箱阀门的工作台设备。

messages.msgid: A table rig with drawers and fixtures for storing tools, wiring for high power electric connectors and valves for fuel tank connections.
translations: 一套配有抽屉、工具固定架、高功率电连接器接线和燃料箱阀门的工作台设备。

messages.msgid: A tiny electric motor just the right size for powering a bicycle or a hedge trimmer.
translations: 一台微型电动机，尺寸刚好适合驱动自行车或树篱机。

messages.msgid: A light-duty electrical motor, strong enough for an electric moped or golf cart.
translations: 一台小型电动机，足以为电动摩托车或高尔夫球车提供动力。

messages.msgid: A medium-duty electrical motor, suitable for powering ultra-light vehicles, or as part of a hybrid gas-electric drivetrain.
translations: 一台中型电动机，适用于为超轻型车辆提供动力，或作为油电混动系统的一部分。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty electrical motor, capable of propelling a full-size car or SUV through electric power alone, provided you have the battery capacity.
translations: 一台重型电动机，只要你有足够的电池容量，就能单独驱动全尺寸汽车或SUV。

messages.msgid: A powerful high-performance electric motor, as found in those consumer electric sports cars with ridiculous, ludicrous, or similarly hyperbolic acceleration options.  It needs a lot of battery power.
translations: 一台动力强劲的高性能电动机，能用在那些具有荒谬可笑或令人匪夷所思加速选项的消费类电动跑车上。它需要消耗巨量电能。

messages.msgid: A massive and extremely powerful electric motor, delivering high torque at the cost of significant power drain, this would be well suited to an electric racing car.
translations: 一台体积庞大、功率极强的电动机，以巨大的耗电量为代价提供极高的扭矩，非常适合电动赛车。

messages.msgid: An enormous and heavy electric traction motor, powerful enough to pull a train.
translations: 一台巨大而沉重的电动机，其功率足以拉动火车。

messages.msgid: A reinforced ram.  Place at the edge of vehicle to reduce damage taken in collisions, and to increase damaged delivered in collisions, if the ram is the first vehicle part to collide.
translations: 一个强化撞锤。将它安装在载具的边沿能减少碰撞对载具的损伤。而且能够让被撞上的家伙伤得更惨。

messages.msgid: A mattress, strapped onto the vehicle.  It could serve to blunt any impact.
translations: 一个绑到载具上的床垫，可以用来吸收冲击。

messages.msgid: A circular blade, powered by the vehicle's engine.  It will dramatically increase the damage the vehicle delivers in collisions.  Mount on the edges of the vehicle, preferably the front.
translations: 一个圆形刀片，采用载具引擎牵引其旋转。会大大提升载具碰撞时所造成的伤害。安装在车辆外侧，最好是正前方。

messages.msgid: A blade, welded to the vehicle, for cutting up zombies.
translations: 一片焊接在车上的大刀片，看上去能够轻易切碎挡在路上的丧尸。

messages.msgid: A metal spike, welded to the vehicle, to increase injury when crashing into things.
translations: 一根焊接在车上的尖刺，被撞上的家伙一定会伤得更惨。

messages.msgid: A wooden spike, attached to the vehicle, to increase injury when crashing into things.
translations: 一根安在车上的木制尖刺，被撞上的家伙一定会伤得更惨。

messages.msgid: A set of aerofoil helicopter rotors, when spun at high speed, they generate thrust via lift.
translations: 一套旋翼型直升机旋翼桨叶，通过高速旋转，提供升力和推力。

messages.msgid: A set of four military-grade helicopter rotor blades, used to provide lift by rotation.
translations: 一套四翼军用级直升机旋翼桨叶，通过高速旋转，提供升力和推力。
重型军用黑鹰直升机旋翼
重型军用鱼鹰直升机旋翼

messages.msgid: A set of three military-grade helicopter rotor blades, used to provide lift by rotation.
translations: 一套三翼军用级直升机旋翼桨叶，通过高速旋转，提供升力和推力。

messages.msgid: A soft upholstered car seat, contoured to hold one person.
translations: 带软垫的汽车车座，可坐一人。

messages.msgid: A leather car seat for one.
A soft seat with an adjustable backrest, making it a reasonably comfortable place to sleep.
translations: 带有可调节靠背的柔软座椅，是个相当舒适的睡觉地方。

messages.msgid: A soft, wide seat with a high back, the kind often used in back seats or older cars.  It might be a decent place to sleep.
translations: 柔软、宽阔、高靠背的座椅，通常用于后座或老式汽车。 这大概是个像样的睡觉地方。

messages.msgid: A padded wedge that you straddle, like a bicycle or motorcycle.
translations: 一个自行车或摩托车上常见的鞍座。

messages.msgid: A simple fabric seat, suspended from the frame itself.
translations: 一个悬挂在车体框架上的简易布质座位。

messages.msgid: A steel bench with ankle and wrist restraints built in.  It looks very uncomfortable.
translations: 一条自带脚踝和手腕锁链的钢制长凳。看起来很不舒服。

messages.msgid: A fridge, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的冰箱，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A minifridge, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的迷你冰箱，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A food truck fridge, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的冷藏车冰箱，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A single glass door fridge, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.  Careful with the glass!
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的单玻璃门冰箱，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。小心玻璃易碎！

messages.msgid: A double glass door fridge, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.  Careful with the glass!
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的双玻璃门冰箱，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。小心玻璃易碎！

messages.msgid: A heavy duty fridge, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的展示冰箱，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A display fridge, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的展示冰箱，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A household freezer, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的家用冰柜，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A minifreezer, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的迷你冰柜，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A chest minifreezer, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的卧式迷你冰柜，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A food truck freezer, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的冷藏车冰柜，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A chest freezer, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的冰柜，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty freezer, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的重型冰柜，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: An oven, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个烤箱，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，但总比你亲手搬运要省力。

messages.msgid: An arcade machine, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一台街机，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，但总比你亲手搬运要省力。

messages.msgid: A drill press, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一台钻床，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，但总比你亲手搬运要省力。

messages.msgid: A table saw, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的台锯，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A mitre, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一台斜切锯，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，但总比你亲手搬运要省力。

messages.msgid: A band saw, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一个用绳索固定在车顶上以便运输的带锯，目前没法使用，但比你徒手扛着要轻松。

messages.msgid: A router, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一台雕刻机，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，但总比你亲手搬运要省力。

messages.msgid: A planer, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一台刨床，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，但总比你亲手搬运要省力。

messages.msgid: A jointer, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一台平刨机，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，但总比你亲手搬运要省力。

messages.msgid: A hydraulic press, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一台液压机，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，但总比你亲手搬运要省力。

messages.msgid: An air compressor, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一台空气压缩机，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，但总比你亲手搬运要省力。

messages.msgid: An oxygen concentrator, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, but easier than carrying it with your hands.
translations: 一台制氧机，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，但总比你亲手搬运要省力。
捆好的战构体足节残骸

messages.msgid: A broken quadraphract leg, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, and hopefully never be.
translations: 一条四足甲兽的断腿，固定在车顶以便运输。无法使用，希望永远也用不上。
捆好的四足战构体残骸

messages.msgid: A broken quadraphract, secured to the roof for transportation.  Not functional, and hopefully never be.
translations: 一个损坏的四足战构体，被固定在车顶以便运输。它一动也不动，希望永远如此。

messages.msgid: More than a ton of gold tied to roof for easier transportation.  Probably the only way to move this without breaking your back.
translations: 超过一吨的黄金被绑在车顶，以便运输。这恐怕是唯一能不闪到腰就搬动它的方法了。

messages.msgid: An alien construct, secured to the roof for transportation.  Hopefully it won't reanimate on next road bump.
translations: 一个外星造物，固定在车顶以便运输。希望它不会在下一个颠簸路段上复活。

messages.msgid: A storage space for holding liquids.  If filled with the appropriate fuel for the vehicle's engine, the engine will automatically draw fuel from the tank when the engine is on.  If filled with water, you can access the water from a water faucet, if one is installed in the vehicle.  You can also use a rubber hose to siphon liquids out of a tank.
translations: 一个能够装载液体的车载容器。装入车辆引擎所对应消耗的燃料后，引擎启动时将会自动从对应的油箱内抽取燃料。装入水或其他液体后，可以在车辆水龙头处获取对应液体。你也可以使用一根橡胶软管从油箱中抽取液体。

messages.msgid: A 60 L refrigerated tank.  When turned on, it will cool the liquid inside, extending the time until the food spoils.
translations: 一个 60 升容量的冷藏罐，开启时可以冷却里面的液体，延长其保质期。

messages.msgid: A 100 L refrigerated tank.  When turned on, it will cool the liquid inside, extending the time until the food spoils.
translations: 一个 100 升容量的冷藏罐，开启时可以冷却里面的液体，延长其保质期。

messages.msgid: A 60 L heated tank.  When turned on, it will prevent the contents from freezing.
translations: 一个容量 60 升的加热罐，开启后能防止液体冻结。

messages.msgid: A storage space for holding liquids, mounted outside the vehicle's walls and armor.  If filled with the appropriate fuel for the vehicle's engine, the engine will automatically draw fuel from the tank when the engine is on.  If filled with water, you can access the water from a water faucet, if one is installed in the vehicle.  You can also use a rubber hose to siphon liquids out of a tank.
translations: 一个能够装载液体的车载容器，安装在载具外侧装甲上。装入车辆引擎所对应消耗的燃料后，引擎启动时将会自动从对应的油箱内抽取燃料。装入水或其他液体后，可以在车辆水龙头处获取对应液体。你也可以使用一根橡胶软管从油箱中抽取液体。

messages.msgid: A storage space for holding liquids, mounted inside the cargo or passenger space.  If filled with the appropriate fuel for the vehicle's engine, the engine will automatically draw fuel from the tank when the engine is on.  If filled with water, you can access the water from a water faucet, if one is installed in the vehicle.  You can also use a rubber hose to siphon liquids out of a tank.
translations: 一个能够装载液体的车载容器，安装在车内货舱或者客舱中。装入车辆引擎所对应消耗的燃料后，引擎启动时将会自动从对应的油箱内抽取燃料。装入水或其他液体后，可以在车辆水龙头处获取对应液体。你也可以使用一根橡胶软管从油箱中抽取液体。

messages.msgid: A bin for holding solid fuel.
translations: 一个用来储存固态燃料的箱子。

messages.msgid: A medium tank for pressurized gasses.
translations: 装加压气体的中型容器。

messages.msgid: A large tank for pressurized gasses.
translations: 装加压气体的大型容器。
车顶外挂铝油罐（100 升）
车顶外挂铝油罐（200 升）

messages.msgid: An electric forge for metalworking, powered by the vehicle's batteries.  With a hammer and other tools, you could use this for metalworking.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs a forge, you will be given the option of selecting it as a tool.
translations: 一台用于金属加工的电锻炉，使用车载电源供电。附带一个锤子和其他工具。你可以使用这个进行金属加工。如果你尝试制作需要锻炉的物品，你可以选择将其作为工具。

messages.msgid: A electric kiln for baking brick or clay, powered by the vehicle's batteries.  You could use this to harden bricks or clay.  If you attempt to craft an item that needs a kiln, you will be given the option of selecting it as a tool.
translations: 一台可以烧制砖块和陶器的电力窑炉，使用车载电源供电。砖块和陶器需要烧制变硬后才能使用。如果你在制造物品时需要使用到它的功能时，该部件会出现在可选项中。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty press used to create vegetable oil from nuts or seeds.
translations: 一台重型压榨机，用来从坚果或种子中提炼植物油。

messages.msgid: Some wires and gears for connecting door handles and an unlocking knob to a latching mechanism, and a sturdy lock to go on the outer surface.  It is meant to be installed in a vehicle door or hatch.
translations: 一些用于将门把手和解锁旋钮连接到闭锁结构的电线和齿轮，以及一把用于装在外面的结实锁。它应该安装在车门或舱门上。
固定在座位旁边的双筒望远镜。

messages.msgid: A plastic 100-liter drum of a portable concrete mixer.
translations: 便携式混凝土搅拌机的100升塑料滚筒。

messages.msgid: Attach this part to a beast of burden to allow it to pull your vehicle.
translations: 将这个载具部件和一头套有缰绳的拉车动物连接在一起就可让它拉动载具。

messages.msgid: Attach this part to a beast of burden to allow it to pull your vehicle.  This one is reinforced with heavy chains and steel.
translations: 将这个载具部件和一头套有缰绳的拉车动物连接在一起就可让它拉动载具。这个被重型锁链和钢铁加固过。

messages.msgid: A metal handle, a creature with hands could use it to push a vehicle.
translations: 一个金属把手，任何有手的生物都能用它来推动载具。

messages.msgid: A pair of handles.  You can mount other items on top of it.
translations: 一对把手。你可以在上面安装其他部件。

messages.msgid: An aisle.  A hatch lets you access a cargo space beneath it, keeping items stored here out of the way.
translations: 一条过道。通过舱口你可以进入下方的货舱，使存放在这里的物品不会挡道。

messages.msgid: A computer system hooked up to the steering and engine of the vehicle to allow it to follow simple paths.
translations: 一套连接到载具的方向控制系统和引擎的计算机系统，能够控制载具进行简单的驾驶。

messages.msgid: A battery case for storage batteries.  Allows quick removal or addition of a storage battery, if you can lift the battery.
translations: 一块装电池的电池箱。可以快速安装或卸载电池，前提是你能提得起来。

messages.msgid: A mount for batteries usually used in handheld tools.  Allows quick removal or addition of such batteries into vehicular power grid.
translations: 一个电池充电架，为通常用于手持工具的电池充电。能让你将此类电池快速插拔连接至载具电网中。

messages.msgid: An armored black box, a device meant to record and preserve data of a military vehicle in the field in case it gets destroyed.
translations: 一个带装甲的黑匣子，用于在战场上记录并保存军用载具数据，以保证载具损毁后仍能还原事故过程。

messages.msgid: A small washing machine.  With detergent, water, and some electrical power, you could clean a lot of clothes.  'e'xamine the tile with the washing machine to use it.
translations: 一台小型车载洗衣机。只要你有洗涤剂、水和一些电，你可以洗干净许多衣服。按"e"查看该部件所在位置来使用它。

messages.msgid: A small dishwasher.  With detergent, water, and some electrical power, you could clean your dishes… or something more useful like a CBM dripping with zombie gore.  'e'xamine the tile with the dishwasher to use it.
translations: 一台小型车载洗衣机。只要你有洗涤剂、水和一些电，你可以洗干净许多盘子……或者洗掉CBM上面的丧尸血肉。按"e"后选择该部件所在位置来使用它。

messages.msgid: This is an autoclave.  It's useful for sterilizing things like CBMs.  'e'xamine the tile with the autoclave to use it.
translations: 这是一个高压灭菌釜，用于对 CBM 之类的物品进行灭菌。按"e"后选择该部件所在位置来使用它。

messages.msgid: A wooden board that keeps the water out of your boat.
translations: 木板，可以把水挡在船外。

messages.msgid: Logs tied together that will keep your boat out of the water.
translations: 绑在一起的原木，可以把水挡在船外。

messages.msgid: A rigid plastic sheet that keeps water out of your boat.
translations: 坚硬的塑料板，可以把水挡在船外。

messages.msgid: A metal sheet that keeps the water out of your boat.
translations: 金属板，可以把水挡在船外。

messages.msgid: A light weight, advanced carbon fiber rigid sheet that keeps the water out of your boat.
translations: 一块轻便而先进的碳素纤维板，可以把水挡在船外。

messages.msgid: A steering wheel and accelerator and brake pedals.
translations: 一套方向盘、油门踏板和刹车踏板。

messages.msgid: A pair of adjustable rods with a simple trigger.  They easily can be easily installed on top of vehicle controls and will allow a car or similar vehicle to be driven by those who can't use their legs to do so, whether due to disability or small stature.  These are designed for automobiles and will not work on bicycle style foot pedals.
translations: 这是一对带有简易扳机的可调节杆。它们可以轻松安装在车辆控制装置上方，使那些因残疾或身材矮小而无法用腿驾驶的人能够操作。这些装置专为汽车设计，不适用于自行车式的脚踏板。

messages.msgid: Thick rubber pads which can be easily clamped onto gas and brake pedals to allow vehicle controls to be used even by people who are very short.
translations: 厚橡胶垫，可方便地夹在油门和刹车踏板上，方便个子很矮的人也能操作车辆控制装置。

messages.msgid: Blocks of wood, taped to the pedals to allow vehicle controls to be used even by people who are very short.
translations: 一个用胶带固定在踏板上的木板，使个子很矮的人也能操作车辆控制装置。

messages.msgid: A frame containing some lights and controls.
translations: 一块含有一些指示灯和开关的面板。

messages.msgid: Set of tubes, that move heat from the engine into the vehicle cabin, heating it up.
translations: 一套管道，将发动机的热量传送到车厢内，加热车内。

messages.msgid: Small set of mechanisms, that cool the vehicle out when turned on.
translations: 一小套机械装置，在启动时可使车辆冷却下来。

messages.msgid: Some switches and knobs to control the vehicle's electrical systems.
translations: 一些用来控制车内各类电子设备的开关和按钮。

messages.msgid: A metal pipe that somewhat reduces engine noise.  Also vents heat from an installed vehicle cooler.
translations: 该金属管可以在一定程度上降低引擎噪音，并从安装的载具冷却器中排出热量。

messages.msgid: A belt, attached to a seat.
translations: 一根安装在座椅上的安全带。

messages.msgid: A bunch of electronics that make it difficult to start the vehicle without the proper key, and that will sound an alarm if you try.  The alarm can be disabled.
translations: 一套安全设备，使你在没钥匙的情况下很难启动车辆，并且如果你尝试强行打火，它会响起警报。可以关闭警报。

messages.msgid: Electronic module that automatically switches combustion and electric engines on and off minimizing fuel consumption and optimizing power output and battery charge rate.  Must be turned on to work.  Simplified ruleset: 1. When throttling, maximize acceleration.  2. Keep battery at 90%.  3. Minimize fuel consumption.
translations: 一个复杂的电子模块，可根据情况自动打开或关闭内燃引擎和电动引擎，最大限度地降低油耗，优化输出功率和电池充电功率。必须开启后才能工作。简化规则如下：1. 踩下油门时，尽可能加速。2. 尽可能保持电池电量为90%。3. 尽可能减少油耗。

messages.msgid: A series of straps attached to the seat, intended to fasten together after going over your shoulders and hips and between your legs.
translations: 一套安全带，从肩膀、髋关节和腿部全方位地把你绑在座位上。

messages.msgid: A large water wheel with wooden supports.
translations: 一个木质支撑的大型水轮机。

messages.msgid: A large wind turbine with stabilizing legs.  Will cause extra drag on the vehicle.
translations: 一个大型风力发电机。会额外增加载具的阻力。

messages.msgid: A solar panel.  Reinforced with armored glass to make it more resistant to damage.
translations: 一块太阳能电池板。装有强化玻璃保护外壳，使其不那么易于受到伤害。
一块高性能太阳能电池板。

messages.msgid: A high-performance solar panel.  Reinforced with armored glass to make it more resistant to damage.
translations: 一块高性能太阳能电池板。装有强化玻璃保护外壳，使其不那么易于受到伤害。

messages.msgid: A military ASRG covered in heavy plating.  Provides constant albeit low power to your car.
translations: 一台军用级ASRG发电机，覆盖着厚厚的装甲板。为你的载具提供恒定的低功率电力。

messages.msgid: A spiked plate that will increase the damage delivered to someone else in collisions.
translations: 一块钉刺装甲板，能让被撞上的家伙伤得更惨。

messages.msgid: A small horn.  Use the vehicle controls and select the honk option to make noise.
translations: 一个小型自行车铃。在载具控制菜单中可以按下它制造噪音。

messages.msgid: A horn.  Use the vehicle controls and select the honk option to make noise.
translations: 一个汽车喇叭。在载具控制菜单中可以按下它制造噪音。

messages.msgid: A powerful truck horn.  Use the vehicle controls and select the honk option to make noise.
translations: 一个威力强大的卡车喇叭。在载具控制菜单中可以按下它制造噪音。

messages.msgid: An electronic noise maker.  It will automatically make noise when you drive in reverse, alerting things behind you to move out of the way.
translations: 一个电子噪声制造器。在你倒车时自动发出警报声，提醒车后的行人让出道路。

messages.msgid: A cargo space for carrying livestock.  'e'xamine it to capture an animal next to you, or to release the animal currently contained.  When selecting an animal to capture, choose its tile relative to you, not the part.
translations: 一个运输牲畜的围栏货舱。按"e"查看该部件选择需要捕获的动物，或者释放笼中动物。当选择捕获动物时，动物需要紧挨着你。

messages.msgid: A large locker for transporting smaller animals.  'e'xamine it to capture an animal next to you, or to release the animal currently contained.  When selecting an animal to capture, choose its tile relative to you, not the part.
translations: 一个运输小型动物的大柜子。按"e"查看该部件选择需要捕获的动物，或者释放笼中动物。当选择捕获动物时，动物需要紧挨着你。

messages.msgid: A device for recharging batteries.  When turned on, it charges any rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly in the attached storage space, drawing power from the vehicle's batteries.
translations: 一套车载充电装置。开启后，会使用载具蓄电池中储存的电力为放置在同一位置的存储空间内的所有可充电电池及蓄电池充电。

messages.msgid: A small, low-power consumer device for recharging batteries.  It slowly charges any rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly in the attached storage space, drawing power from the vehicle's batteries.
translations: 一套小型低压车载电池充电装置。会缓慢地使用载具蓄电池中储存的电力为为放置在同一位置的存储空间内的所有可充电电池及蓄电池充电。

messages.msgid: A stereo system.  When turned on, it plays music, improving your mood.
translations: 一套车载音响系统。开启时会播放音乐，提升你的心情。

messages.msgid: A collection of electronic bells.  Use the vehicle's controls to turn it on or off.  When turned on, it makes noise, attracting neighborhood children.
translations: 一套电子音乐铃。在载具控制菜单中可以开关。开启时播放音乐，吸引整个社区的小孩。

messages.msgid: Thick copper cable with leads on either end.  Attach one end to one vehicle and the other to another, and you can transfer electrical power between the two.
translations: 一条粗壮的铜缆，两端有着接头。将两个不同车辆部件用它连接起来，能够在它们之间传输电力。

messages.msgid: A long orange extension cord for connecting appliances.  Currently plugged in.
translations: 一根用于连接电器的橙色延长线。目前已接入载具电力系统。

messages.msgid: An extra long 30 m orange extension cord for connecting outdoor appliances.  Currently plugged in.
translations: 一根用于连接户外电器的三十米长的橙色延长线。目前已接入供电系统。

messages.msgid: Very thick copper cable with leads on either end.  Attach one end to one vehicle and the other to another, and you can transfer electrical power between the two.
translations: 一条十分粗壮的铜缆，两端有着接头。将两个不同车辆部件用它连接起来，能够在它们之间传输电力。

messages.msgid: A heavy-duty tow cable, if the other end was attached to another vehicle, it could pull it.
translations: 一种重型牵引索。当一头连接至另一辆车后，可以拉动其他车辆。
也算个能坐的地方吧，大概。

messages.msgid: A small electric motor.  Installed on the same frame as a door or curtain, it will allow you to remotely open the door or curtain from the vehicle controls.
translations: 一个小型电动马达。安装在车门或者车窗帘上时，可以让你在控制面板远程操控。

messages.msgid: A sophisticated set of electronic controls that allow you to control the vehicle from a vehicle remote while you are not in it.  You can 'e'xamine the tile to access the controls, or use the vehicle control key (default '^').
translations: 一套十分复杂的电子控制系统，能够让你不乘坐时也能使用载具远程遥控器遥控载具。你可以按"e"查看或在此按载具控制键"^"以控制载具。

messages.msgid: An LCD attached to one or more cameras.  When turned on, it lets you see from the cameras, but drains power from the vehicle's batteries.  You can 'e'xamine the tile to access the controls, or use the vehicle control key (default '^').
translations: 一套连接到车载摄像头的液晶显示屏。开启时，使用车载电源并让你通过摄像头观察四周。你可以按"e"查看或在此按载具控制键"^"以控制载具。

messages.msgid: A small camera.  Will relay what it can see to a camera control station.
translations: 一个小型车载摄像头。能够将拍摄的图像传输给监控控制系统。

messages.msgid: A small camera encased in a protective metal cage.  Will relay what it can see to a camera control station.
translations: 一个装在金属保护笼中的小型车载摄像头。能够将拍摄的图像传输给监控控制系统。

messages.msgid: A set of controls to allow a vehicle to drive itself, or you to drive it remotely using a controller.
translations: 一套安装在载具控制器上让车辆自动驾驶或者接受远程遥控的控制装置。

messages.msgid: A clock, so you know what time it is.
translations: 一个时钟，让你知道现在的时间。

messages.msgid: A funnel that will collect rainwater into the tank beneath it.
translations: 一个能够为底下水箱收集雨水的车载集雨器。

messages.msgid: A scoop.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  When turned on, it will scoop up loose items that it travels over until it's full.
translations: 一台车铲。在载具控制菜单中控制开关。开启时，将收集其所经过位置的散落物品，直到装满为止。

messages.msgid: A water purifier, powered by the vehicle's batteries.  You can use it to purify water in a container or in the vehicle's tanks.  'e'xamine the tile with the purifier to use it.
translations: 一台车载净水器，使用车载电源供电。你可以用它净化容器或者车辆水箱内的水。按"e"查看该部件所在位置可以使用它净化水源。

messages.msgid: A plow.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  When turned on, it will create a furrow in any dirt it travels over, making it suitable for planting seeds.  It should be placed in front of any seed drills on the vehicle.
translations: 一台犁具。在载具控制菜单中控制开关。开启时会在其所经过的泥土地上犁出可供播种的土堆。需要将其安放在播种机之前。

messages.msgid: A seed drill.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  You can load it with seeds by examining it.  When turned on, it will drop seeds as the vehicle moves, or plant them in furrowed dirt.  It should be placed behind any plows on the vehicle, and any wheels should be placed so they won't run over the plants.
translations: 一台播种机。在载具控制菜单中控制开关。你可以通过查看它来将其装满种子。开启时会在其所经过的位置洒落种子，或者播种进犁好的地里。需要将其安放在犁具之后，同时车轮需要安放在不会碾压种子的位置。

messages.msgid: An automatic reaper.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  When on, it will cut down plants that it travels over.  It should be placed in front of any plows in the vehicle for efficient operation.  It does not include cargo space, so harvested plants will end up on the ground.
translations: 自动收割机。在载具控制菜单中控制开关。开启时会收割途经位置的植物。应将其放在犁具之前以保证农场作业高效运行。不包含货物空间，收获的植物将掉落在地上。

messages.msgid: An automatic reaper.  Use the vehicle controls to turn it on or off.  When on, it will cut down plants and store them in the vehicle's cargo.  It should be placed in front of any plows in the vehicle for efficient operation.  It has internal cargo space for collecting the harvest.
translations: 一台自动收割机。在载具控制菜单中控制开关。开启时会收割所经过位置的任何植物，并将其存放于货舱内。需要将其安放在犁具之前来保证农场作业能够高效运行。内置可存放收获作物的货舱。

messages.msgid: A set of locks.  Attached to a suitable cargo space, it will prevent other people from accessing the cargo and taking your stuff.
translations: 一套锁具。能够被安装在合适的货舱部件上，可以避免其他人使用货舱并拿走你的物品。

messages.msgid: A rotating, universal mount for a weapon.  If your hands are empty, you can stand on the same tile as a turret mount and 'f'ire the weapon.
translations: 一个能够自由旋转的通用武器炮塔底座。你空着双手站在炮塔底座所在位置时，按射击键操作它上面所安装的武器开火。

messages.msgid: A lock and latching mechanism.  If installed on a door, this can be used to lock it.
translations: 一套闭锁装置。如果安装在门上，可用于锁门。

messages.msgid: A set of motor, camera, and an AI unit which allows for tracking targets, friend-or-foe identification, and firing the connected turret in full automatic mode.  When installed over the turret, it will enable auto targeting mode for said turret.
translations: 一套由电机、摄像头及一个AI模块组成的炮塔控制模块，能够追踪目标、识别敌我，并以全自动模式发射其连接的炮塔。可以安装在炮塔上来开启炮塔的自动瞄准模式。

messages.msgid: An aluminum hull that keeps the water out of your boat.
translations: 一块铝制船壳，可以把水挡在船外。

messages.msgid: Unfortunately, some responsible killjoy poured concrete in the barrel of this historic cannon to make it safe for display.
translations: 不幸的是，一些大煞风景的人在这门历史悠久的大炮的炮管里灌了混凝土，以保证它在展示时足够安全。
