translations: 在野外历经长年的自我流放式的生活，你已经和大自然母亲达成了谅解。这个原属于被抛弃的人类的世界可能已经完蛋了，但是对你而言却依如昨日。

messages.msgid: You spent most of your days fishing in the swamp, getting by quietly on your catch.  You found the buzzing of insects enjoyable, but recently they've gotten bigger and meaner.  Now their horrible noises have you spooked - you just hope the fish aren't as nasty.
translations: 你大半辈子都在沼泽里钓鱼，靠着渔获安静度日。嗡嗡作响的虫鸣你原本还挺享受，可最近它们不仅变大了，还变得更凶。如今，那些可怕的噪音把你吓得不轻——你只希望水里的鱼别也这么糟糕。

messages.msgid: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world permanently derailed your plans.
translations: 你正赶着前往一年一度的新英格兰革命战争“活历史”展演活动，准备亲身再现那段峥嵘岁月——结果大灾变横插一脚，把你的计划彻底、而且是永久性地打乱了。

messages.msgid: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world made traditional gender roles obsolete.
translations: 你正赶着前往一年一度的新英格兰革命战争“活历史”展演活动，结果世界末日一来，所谓“传统性别分工”直接成了过时概念。

messages.msgid: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a pair of blades than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.
translations: 你超爱轮滑！你穿着滑冰鞋的时间比脱下它还要多的多。一切都变得一团糟，但至少现在那些烦人的大人们不会再告诉你哪里不准滑了。

messages.msgid: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a skateboard than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.
translations: 你超爱轮滑！你踩着滑板的时间比下地走路要多的多。一切都变得一团糟，但至少现在那些烦人的大人们不会再告诉你哪里不准滑了。

messages.msgid: You never cared for grown-ups telling you what to do, so you ended up spending quite a few days in the principal's office.  Now, not needing grown-ups to tell you what to do is the only reason you're alive.  Man, you really should've played hooky today.
translations: 你从来就不爱听大人指手画脚，所以没少在校长办公室里耗日子。如今，正是不需要大人告诉你该做什么，才成了你还能活着的唯一原因。天哪，你今天真该翘课的。

messages.msgid: Your parents were crazy preppers who thought some "Cataclysm" was coming, and insisted on preparing you for it.  Turns out they were right.  You didn't get a chance to thank them.  The only thing you can do for them now is what they always hoped you would do in the dark days ahead: survive.
translations: 你的父母都是认为在不远的未来就会末日降临的生存狂们，同时也坚持教你各种应对末世的技巧。现在看来，他们是正确的，但是你没有得到一个对他们表达感谢的机会。现在你唯一要做的事情就是他们曾经教导你的，在末世来临时要做的事：生存。

messages.msgid: In dodgeball, failing to dodge meant taking a ball to the head and being out of the game.  In the Cataclysm, it means getting eaten by monsters.  Don't slip up.
translations: 在躲避球比赛中，没能躲开球意味着被球砸到头，退出比赛。而在大灾变中，这意味着你会被怪物吃掉。别出错。

messages.msgid: The school never let your club play with the really fun chemicals, the kind that make things go boom, but there aren't any teachers around to enforce the rules anymore.
translations: 学校从来不让你的俱乐部玩真正有趣的化学物质，那些会爆炸的玩意，但是现在没有老师来执行这些规则了。

messages.msgid: You were a member of the school A/V club.  You're sure there's some way you can use your technical skills to help you stay alive.  You just haven't figured out how to make an awesome death ray yet.
translations: 你是学校电影俱乐部的成员之一。你相信你能从电影中学到能够保命的技能，但是你仍然搞不懂如何才能发射死亡射线。

messages.msgid: You've been teaching kids all your life, experiencing the joy and aggravation of imparting knowledge to young minds.  If zombies have any interest in education, they're not showing it.
translations: 你一生都在教导孩子们，体验向年轻人传授知识的喜悦和痛苦。即使丧尸对教育有兴趣，它们也没能表现出来。

messages.msgid: Covering the apocalypse up close could make your career, though finding a publisher seems more difficult a prospect than usual.  You managed to hold onto your camera - hopefully you can get some fantastic shots.
translations: 近距离报道大灾变可以让你的事业蒸蒸日上，不过现在想找到一家出版商似乎比往常要困难。你成功将你的相机保留了下来，祝你能抓拍到一些美妙时刻。分享此刻，分享生活。

messages.msgid: It was hard enough getting kids to run laps without having to worry about them trying to eat your brains.  Zombies won't even line up when you blow your whistle.
translations: 要让孩子跑几圈就已经够难的了，那会儿你还不必担心他们想吃掉你的大脑。而这些丧尸甚至在你吹完哨子后还学不会排队。

messages.msgid: You're a miner, not a minor!  Your canteen is dry, your jackhammer is out of gas, and you're on your last pair of batteries for your mining helmet…
translations: 虽然你是矿工，但你不是无名之辈！（英语双关）你的水壶早已经干透，你的打桩机也耗光了燃料，而你的矿工帽只剩下最后一对电池了……

messages.msgid: Before this all began, you were having the time of your life at your dream job: blowing stuff up.  The Cataclysm means you're finally allowed to do it full time.
translations: 在这一切开始之前，你有份梦想中的工作，把各种东西炸上天。大灾变意味着你终于可以全职工作了。

messages.msgid: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running FOR your life.
translations: 你已经练了很多年的跑酷，世界就是你的游乐场。当你说跑步是你的生命时并没有撒谎。这很好，因为现在世界已经终结了，你正在为逃命而奔跑。

messages.msgid: This seemed like a great place for a vacation, but you're starting to regret ever leaving home.  You came here to get a taste of New England, but New England keeps trying to get a taste of you!
translations: 这里曾经是一个度假的好地方，但你开始有些后悔离家了。你本来来着是为了体验下新英格兰的风味，现在你只希望别让新英格兰尝尝你的风味了！

messages.msgid: The apocalypse has caught you completely naked!  Maybe you were robbed, maybe you were at a nudist beach, or maybe you just enjoy the feeling of liberation brought by the wind touching your skin.  Whatever the reason, you lack clothes in a time when everyone wants a piece of you.
translations: 末日降临时，你却一丝不挂。也许你被人洗劫了，也许你原本就在天体海滩，又或者你只是单纯享受微风拂过皮肤时那种“自由解放”的感觉。不管原因是什么，在这个人人都想从你身上撕下一块的时代，你却连件衣服都没有。

messages.msgid: You were called in on your day off to feed the animals at the zoo.  For some reason, none of your coworkers bothered showing up for work today.
translations: 你在自己原本的休息日被一通电话叫回去喂养动物园的动物。因为各种各样的原因，你的同事们都没能够来上班。

messages.msgid: You were always an inexplicable sight in town, with your funny hair and odd Japanese clothes.  Little of this concerned you, but last week the grocery service stopped coming and now the TV no longer turns on.  This displeases you.
translations: 你一直都是镇上那道难以解释的风景线：发型离谱，日式衣服也穿得古里古怪。你对此向来不太在意，可上周送杂货的服务突然不来了，而现在连电视也打不开了。这就让你你很不高兴。

messages.msgid: Years of training prepared you for the competitive fencing circuit, but your latest tournament was cut short when zombies invaded the piste.  The referee was eaten, so you're not sure if the rules are still in play.
translations: 经过多年的训练，你已经准备好参加击剑比赛了，但随着丧尸入侵赛场，你的最后一场比赛就被迫中断了。裁判被吃掉了，所以你不确定规则是否仍然有效。

messages.msgid: You've spent your life appealing to the people, persuading many and promising much throughout your time in office.  Now that your voting base wants to eat you alive, winning hearts and minds just got that much harder.
translations: 你的一生都在吸引人们，说服更多人，并做出了很多承诺。既然你的选民想活活地吃掉你，想再去争取人心，显然难上加难了。

messages.msgid: Taking care of cows, horses, and other animals is your passion, but the ways things are going, this isn't going to be just another day at the ranch.
translations: 照顾牛、马和其他动物是你的爱好，但按照目前事态的发展方式，这可能并不仅仅是牧场的例行一日了。

messages.msgid: You've always worked just outside of the limelight, carrying and fixing the equipment and ensuring that the performers got what they needed.  The show must go on.
translations: 你总是在聚光灯下工作，搬运和修理设备，确保演员们能获得他们所需要的灯光，保证演出顺利进行。现在责任更重了，但演出还得继续。

messages.msgid: You nailed your solo, but the audience erupted into screams instead of applause.  You weren't able to grab much during the panic, but at least you have your loaded six string on your back.
translations: 你完成了你的独奏，但观众爆发出尖叫，而不是掌声。慌乱之中你没能带走多少东西，但是至少背上的六弦琴还在。

messages.msgid: You saw a sign at the local mall advertising a discount on survival kits.  You bought one, more for show than for actual use.  Now it's all you have.
translations: 你在当地商场看到一张告示：生存套装正在打折。你买了一套，说是为了实用，不如说更像是图个样子。现在——这就是你仅剩的一切。

messages.msgid: You made your living on Wild West exhibitions and shows, impressing tourists with your displays of marksmanship.  But that world has ended, so you took your trusty six-shooter and wandered into a world where it's always high noon.
translations: 你通过进行狂野西部展览和表演维持生计，为参观者表演你的枪法，但是这种生活已经结束了。你带上了你可靠的六发左轮手枪，走向了一个永远充满危机的世界。

messages.msgid: You were living the high life, spending your parents' money without a care in the world.  At one of your usual crazy parties, the guests became hungry for more than drugs and booze, but you still have a chance to use the last symbol of your luxurious life - your sports car - and get far away.
translations: 你曾经纸醉金迷，肆意挥霍父母的钱，完全不把任何事放在心上。可在你一场又一场的疯狂派对上，宾客们开始渴望的不再只是毒品与酒精。所幸你仍有机会利用奢华人生最后的象征——你的跑车——尽快逃离这里，远远离开。

messages.msgid: You like to think of yourself as a sniper, but really you're just infantry with a bigger gun.  That said, a big gun is a definite advantage now.
translations: 你喜欢把自己当作狙击手，但其实你不过是拿着更大口径枪械的步兵。即便如此，在如今这种局势下，火力更强的武器确实是明确的优势。

messages.msgid: You were trusted with a big-ass, belt-fed machine gun and plenty of ammo to lay down suppressing fire for your team.  Now that it's going to be much harder to resupply, you should probably be more selective with the ol' spray-and-pray.
translations: 你曾被信任配发一挺大口径的弹链供弹机枪，以及充足的弹药，用于为小队提供压制火力。如今补给将变得困难得多，你大概应该对那套老式的“扫射祈祷”打法更谨慎一些。

messages.msgid: There's no kill like overkill, and not many people in this world can boast that they have a grenade launcher and know how to use it.  Just try not to blow yourself up, that would be really embarrassing.
translations: 没有什么击杀方式比“过度火力”更可靠，而在这个世界上，真正能夸口自己既拥有榴弹发射器、又懂得如何使用它的人并不多。只要记得别把自己炸上天——那可就太丢人了。

messages.msgid: Doors and windows everywhere dare not speak your name.  You're going to be breaking into buildings for supplies rather than combat operations now, but the principle is about the same.
translations: 门窗都畏惧你的名字。如今你要闯入建筑物是为了搜集补给，而非执行作战任务，但其基本原理并无二致。

messages.msgid: You're a crack shot with a rifle, and the farther you can stay away from zombies, the better.  The only thing stopping you is limited ammo, so you should try to find a place to restock sooner or later.
translations: 你是步枪射击的神枪手，而你与僵尸保持的距离越远越好。唯一限制你的是弹药有限，因此你迟早应设法找到地方补充弹药。

messages.msgid: 'Hacker' is a silly pop-culture name, popularized by Hollywood and people with little to no knowledge of what your job entails.  You prefer 'Electronic Warfare Specialist,' though nobody's really left to make the distinction.
translations: "黑客"是一个愚蠢的流行文化名称，由好莱坞和那些对你的工作知之甚少或根本不了解的人流行起来。你更喜欢"电子战专家"，尽管没人能真正区分这两者。

messages.msgid: You've been tailing your target for months, and now he's a zombie.  So much for that lead.  Command isn't responding to your calls for an evac, so you'll have to make do with what you have on you.
translations: 你跟踪目标好几个月了，现在他成了丧尸。这条线索到此为止。指挥部没有回应你的撤离请求，所以你只能用身上的东西凑合着用了。

messages.msgid: You got to see things fall apart from the sky, transporting soldiers and survivors from one holdout to the next.  You knew it was only a matter of time before the horrors patrolling the skies shot you down.
translations: 你曾在空中目睹世界分崩离析，将士兵与幸存者从一个据点运送到下一个据点。你很清楚，那些在天空中巡弋的恐怖存在将你击落，只是时间问题。

messages.msgid: You were responding to a call with your partner before you got separated.  Now all you have is your trusty ambulance, ready to transport patients through the apocalypse.
translations: 你和你的搭档在出急救现场时被分开了。现在你只有你那辆可靠的救护车陪着你，准备好把病人运过大灾变。

messages.msgid: You were separated from your partner while out on a call.  You managed to hang onto some medical supplies, but it's looking like the only life that needs saving now is yours.
translations: 你和你的搭档在出急救现场时被分开了。你设法保存了一些医疗用品，但看起来现在唯一需要拯救的是你的生命。

messages.msgid: You were on the front lines when everything happened, patching up the wounded and providing support.  But they wouldn't stop coming.  Now you're on your own.
translations: 在这一切发生时你正好在前线，为伤员包扎并提供支援。但它们源源不断向你涌来。现在你只能靠自己了。

messages.msgid: You were a member of a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping out where help was needed.  When the riots happened, you were eager to lend a hand.  But you had to cut your plans short when everyone was less interested in handouts, and more interested in eating you.
translations: 你是个非营利组织的成员，致力于帮助那些需要帮助的人。暴动开始的时候，你热切地伸出援手。但现在你不得不改变计划了，因为人们现在不想要救济品，更想要吃掉你。

messages.msgid: You used to rule the roads before they were filled with wrecks, undead, and unspeakable horrors.  At least there's no speed limits in the apocalypse!
translations: 在道路被残骸、亡者与难以名状的恐怖填满之前，你曾称霸公路。至少在末日里，再也没有限速可言。

messages.msgid: You were deployed to autopsy one of the rioters showing feral behavior before being put down.  When they got back up, you knew this was out of your pay grade.
translations: 你被派去解剖一名在被击毙前表现出野蛮的行为的暴徒的尸体。而当它们复活的时候，你知道这不在你的职责范围之内。

messages.msgid: You were about to make your biggest sale yet, but when you met the buyer he tried to bite you.  To top it off, it seems that this wasn't some sort of bad trip, as the whole town tried going for your throat too.
translations: 你原本正要完成迄今为止最大的一笔交易，但当你见到买家时，他竟试图咬你。更糟的是，这似乎并非某种嗑药后的幻觉——整座城镇的人也都开始冲着你的喉咙来。

messages.msgid: Born into poverty, you joined one of the organized crime families to make a living.  There, you quickly made it to the top and became the boss.  The government was building a RICO case against you, but doomsday arrived first.  Your crew is gone, but your past life has prepared you for a world where violence is common currency.
translations: 你出生于贫困之家，为了谋生加入了一个有组织的犯罪家族。在那里，你迅速爬升至权力顶端，成为老大。政府正依据《反黑手党及腐败组织法》对你审查，但末日先一步降临。你的手下都没了，但你过去的生活让你准备好面对一个暴力为王的世界。

messages.msgid: You were dismissed from your position as a parapsychology professor at the local university and started your own business as a paranormal investigator.  Your former colleagues didn't approve of your research, but it looks like it's paying off now.
translations: 你曾任职于当地大学的超心理学教授，却被解雇，随后自立门户，成为一名超自然现象调查员。你过去的同事并不认可你的研究方向，但如今看来，这些研究终于开始显现其价值。

messages.msgid: You were at your favorite park looking at the robins when the Cataclysm struck.  Now all you have are your binoculars and a lot of trivia about local birds to share with any survivors you may find.
translations: 大灾变发生时，你正在你最喜欢的公园里看知更鸟。现在你所拥有的只有你的双筒望远镜和许多关于当地鸟类的趣闻，可以与你所能找到的幸存者分享。

messages.msgid: You were abducted from your home, taken hostage, and used as a test subject in a lab.  For the last test, you were dressed in strange clothes and put in a room where you started to feel… different.  You lost consciousness and woke up somewhere unfamiliar.
translations: 你在家里被绑架为人质，送进实验室里被当作实验对象。在最后的测试中，你穿着奇怪的衣服，被送进一个房间，在那里你感觉……不一样了，你失去了意识，并在一个陌生的地方醒来。

messages.msgid: You are obsessed with the techniques and aesthetics of the ninja, so you practiced your movements, dressed all in black, and spent big bucks to acquire some tools of the trade.  Some may question your historical authenticity, but you're perfectly happy living out your fantasy regardless.
translations: 你痴迷于忍者的技法与美学，因此苦练身法，身着一袭黑衣，并花了大价钱购置了一些“行头”。也许有人会质疑你的历史考据是否可靠，但无论如何，你都乐于沉浸在自己的幻想之中。

messages.msgid: Your last cheerleader routine ended abruptly after your partners switched sides to the undead team.  Let's hope your quick reflexes and flexibility help you to find new members for the squad.
translations: 你最后一次的啦啦队员训练突然被打断，而你的同伴们开始改为不死队加油。希望你的快速反应和灵活敏捷能帮你找到新的啦啦队员。

messages.msgid: You are a true American patriot, dressed with star-spangled clothing from head to toe.  The government has fallen, but the nation lives on with its people.
translations: 你是一个真正的美国爱国者，从头到脚都穿着星条旗的衣服。政府垮台了，但国家依然存活在它曾经的人民心中。

messages.msgid: Does the American dream still exist?  Well, recent events have put that to the test.  Does it still proudly live in your beating heart?  Yes.  Yes, it does.  A patriot to the bitter end, you've readied yourself to go toe to toe with the Cataclysm that would seek to do harm to your darling USA.  That is to say, you grabbed your gun… and nothing more.  God bless America, soldier.
translations: 美国梦还存在吗？嗯，最近的事件对这一点进行了考验。它是否仍然自豪地活在你跳动的心脏里？是的。是的，它确实存在。作为一个爱国者，你已经准备好与试图伤害你亲爱美国的大灾变交手了。所以说，你拿起了你的枪……仅此而已。大兵加把劲，上帝保佑美国。

messages.msgid: You liked to spend your days taking care of the horses and cows, searching the perimeter of the ranch on your steed and looking out for anything suspicious, that's why you managed to escape in time when shit hit the fan.
translations: 你喜欢整天照顾马和牛，骑着你的坐骑在牧场周边搜索，并注意任何可疑的东西，这就是为什么你能在事情发生时及时逃脱。

messages.msgid: You were looking forward to a nice, relaxing day at the beach.  You had to run when some lunatics tried to rip your head off and play beach volleyball with it, but at least you managed to grab your bag on the way out.
translations: 你期待着在海滩上度过美好放松的一天。当一群疯子想扯下你的头，拿着它打沙滩排球时，你不得不逃跑，但至少你在出去的时候带走了你的包。

messages.msgid: After much practice you were sure the next competition would be your big break, but your rivals started killing each other and you had to escape with only your competition gear on you.  Will your athleticism alone be enough to keep you alive?
translations: 经过常年练习，你确信下次比赛将会大获成功，但你的对手开始互相残杀，你只能带着你的比赛装备逃跑。你多年的训练让你活下来吗？

messages.msgid: You went to ride the waves, but the waves ended up riding you instead when a putrid hand appeared from underwater and grabbed you by the ankle.  You had to ditch your surfboard in favor of a kickboard, and now you'll fight every day to stay ahead of the wave of the undead.
translations: 你本来是想乘风破浪的，但当一只腐烂的手从水下出现并抓住你的脚踝时，海浪最终还是把你冲了过去。你不得不放弃冲浪板而选择打腿板，现在你每天都要战斗，以保证冲在不死人浪潮的前面。

messages.msgid: Your job was to safeguard the lives of everyone at the beach, but when the swimmers started drowning each other, you knew the situation was out of your hands.
translations: 你的工作是保护海滩上每个人的生命，但当游泳的人开始互相试图把对方淹死时，你知道局面已经超出你的掌控了。

messages.msgid: You were exploring below the waves close to shore when you noticed something weird on the nearby beach, you decided to swim away when you heard the screams.
translations: 当你在靠近海岸的海浪下探险时，注意到附近海滩上有些奇怪的家伙，当你听到尖叫声时，你决定赶紧游走。

messages.msgid: You were the captain of your small ship, making a living by ferrying divers and tourists across the waves.  The last excursion went bad after your passengers tried to mutiny, but you managed to escape.  Will you ever sail the open ocean again?
translations: 你曾是自己那艘小船的船长，以载运潜水员与游客穿行于浪涛之间为生。最后一次出航出了岔子：乘客试图哗变夺船，但你设法逃了出来。你还能再一次驶向开阔海域吗？

messages.msgid: You did the wet work for a gang, mafia, or whatever person had enough money.  You were no trained assassin, but you know how to shoot a gun and get out of dodge quickly.
translations: 你曾为帮派、黑手党，或任何出得起钱的人干那些见不得光的脏活。你并非受过系统训练的刺客，但你知道如何开枪，以及如何在事成之后迅速脱身。

messages.msgid: You were the best undercover agent they had, with a mission so vital that you had to take it even with the riots going on.  Your target seems to have turned feral as well as your contact, you are all alone now.
translations: 你曾是他们手下最好的卧底探员，任务如此重要，即使暴乱仍在继续，你也不得不接受。你的目标似乎已经疯了，你的联系人也是如此，你现在孤身一人。

messages.msgid: You've been through hell once before.  Hopefully those weekend range trips have kept your skills sharp.
translations: 你曾经从地狱回来过。希望退伍后的那些周末远足让你还没忘掉你的技能。

messages.msgid: You've always admired the beauty of urban desolation, and were ready for your next excursion when the end of the world hit.  You suppose that pretty much every building could be considered abandoned now.
translations: 你一直沉醉于都市荒废所呈现的独特美感，而当世界末日降临时，你正准备开始下一次探索之旅。现在看来，几乎每一栋建筑都可以被视为“废弃建筑”了。

messages.msgid: You felt years of your life being sapped away, slaving at your computer as you subsisted on a daily pot of coffee, microwave burritos and an endless supply of crumpled paper to toss.  Perhaps the Cataclysm is a refreshing change of pace…
translations: 你觉得自己多年的生活被抽干了，在电脑前苦苦挣扎，每天靠一壶咖啡、微波炉卷饼和无穷无尽的皱巴巴的纸来生活。 也许大灾变是节奏的一次令人耳目一新的变化……

messages.msgid: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting and traveling; so when you scraped enough money, you bought yourself an old RV, a gun, and hit the road.  You've been all over the country, hunting for good game.  Unfortunately the country is all over this time, and even more unfortunately you've lost your ol' reliable in the chaos.  Now you gotta find a new reliable.
translations: 自小时候起你就喜欢打猎和旅行，所以你凑够钱后就给自己买了一辆旧房车和一把枪，踏上了旅途。 你已游历全国山水，狩猎至尽兴。 不幸的是，这个国家也已经走到头了，更不幸的是，你在混乱中丢掉了你的爱车。 现在，你得找一辆新的。

messages.msgid: For as long as you can remember, you have lived a double life: a normal driver by the day and a heist driver in the night.  Now there are no cops and no law, but even after the Cataclysm, you drive.
translations: 在你记忆中已经你已经在这样的双重生活中度过了很久：白天是普通司机，晚上是抢劫司机。 现在已经没有警察和法律了，但即使在大灾变后，你还是当司机。

messages.msgid: Ever since you were a child you were fascinated with explosives and all things that go boom.  As soon as you turned 18 you joined the army to become an EOD technician.  While out on a call about a potential explosive in the neighboring county, your team was overrun by hordes of the undead.  You are alone, with nothing but your precious training, gear and love of explosives.
translations: 当你还是孩子时，便已沉迷于炸药和所有爆炸物。你一满十八岁就加入了军队，成为一名排爆技术员。当你为一份邻郡可能存在爆炸物的通报出勤时，你的团队被成群的不死生物淹没了。你孤身一人，身无长物，仅剩下优异的训练、装备和对炸药的热爱

messages.msgid: You've spent plenty of time training to become the next big thing.  But now it looks like you will be fighting your life from now on.  At least that training won't go to waste!
translations: 为了成为下一个冠军，你花费了大量时间进行训练。但现在看来，从现在起你将为了自己的生存而抗争。至少那些训练不会白费！

messages.msgid: As a member of the FBI, you dealt with crime that crossed state lines.  You had gotten the go-ahead to make the biggest bust of your career; before you kicked down the door, you yelled "FBI, open up!" and then the sky broke open.
translations: 作为联邦调查局的一员，你负责处理跨州犯罪。你拿到了许可，准备进行你职业生涯中最大的一次突袭行动；在你踹开门之前，你大喊“FBI, open up！”，这时天空突然破裂开来。

messages.msgid: The cataclysm may have caught you off guard, but you're not going down without a fight!
translations: 大灾变或许让你措手不及，但你绝不会轻易认输！

messages.msgid: You've trained in how to pilot marine craft, as well as general boating and swimming safety.
translations: 你接受过驾驶船舶以及一般划艇和游泳安全方面的培训。

messages.msgid: You got your driving license and know how to drive a car, change the oil and tires, and other basics.
translations: 你合法持有驾照，熟悉诸如驾驶、更换机油、装卸轮胎等基本操作。

messages.msgid: You've been living on your own long enough that you know how to cook basic dishes and feed yourself.
translations: 你独自生活了一段时间，会做基本菜式喂饱自己。

messages.msgid: Either through school, your job, or from your family, you've learned the basics of how to use a computer.
translations: 你懂得基本的电脑使用方法。

messages.msgid: You've spent a significant portion of your life living among other people and are familiar with social norms.  You know how to talk with other people, and how to convey your emotions and understand those of others.
translations: 你一生中有相当多的时间与他人生活在一起，熟悉社会规范。你知道如何与他人交谈，如何传达自己的情感并理解他人的情感。

messages.msgid: You've graduated from high school and thus know a little bit about applied science and electronics.
translations: 你已经高中毕业，懂得基本的应用科学和电子学。

messages.msgid: You've managed to survive modern life in a first world country.  Through your ordeals you've learned how to treat scrapes and bruises, and how to assemble basic furniture.
translations: 你经历过第一世界国家的现代生活。在磨难中，你学会了如何处理擦伤和瘀伤，以及组装基本家具。

messages.msgid: The last thing you remember was meeting God behind the local Foodplace.  Then people started eating each other.  This doesn't feel like a fever dream.
translations: 你所记得的最后一件事是在当地美食广场™后面和上帝谈心。然后人们开始互相吃。这感觉不像是一场狂热之梦。

messages.msgid: Your coworkers always muttered when you had to duck outside every hour for a smoke, but it ended up saving your life when things got bad.  You'll need to find a steady supply of nicotine if you want to keep the cravings at bay.
translations: 当你不得不每隔一小时躲在户外抽烟时，你的同事总是在背后嘀嘀咕咕，但当事情变得糟糕时，这救了你一命。如果你想缓解烟瘾，得找到一个稳定的尼古丁来源。

messages.msgid: Cocaine.  It is, indeed, a helluva drug.  You blew your money on some rocks, and before you knew it you were turning tricks behind the local pharmacy just to score a little more.  Where are you going to get your fix now?
translations: 可卡因。这，这玩意儿，可真攒劲。你挥金如土只为了这白粉玩意儿，当你回过神来时，你发现自己正在本地社区药店偷鸡摸狗，只为了再吸一口这玩意儿。现在你又该去哪里找你的下一次呢？

messages.msgid: You're not entirely sure what happened last night, but you woke up on the floor and everything has completely gone to shit.  The only thing running through your head, though, is where you're gonna find your next hit.
translations: 你不完全确定昨晚发生了什么，但你在地板上醒来，一切都变得一团糟。不过，唯一能贯穿你脑海的想法是去哪里找你下一次药。

messages.msgid: After a bad accident, you became hooked on the opiates prescribed to you for the pain.  With the pharmacies shut down and your dealers turned undead, satisfying those cravings just got a lot more difficult.
translations: 在一次严重的事故后，你开始对你用来镇痛的阿片制剂成瘾了。现在药店关门，毒贩也变成了丧尸，要想爽一把可就更难了。

messages.msgid: One drink became two, two became too many, and before long you were only able to find solace at the bottom of a bottle.  God-damn, you need a drink.
translations: 一杯变成了两杯，两杯变成了无数杯，不久后只能在酒瓶底中寻求慰藉。该死，你需要喝一杯了。

messages.msgid: You'd been having trouble falling asleep, so you started taking prescription sleep meds.  Now you can hardly seem to fall asleep at all without them, and you'll need plenty of rest to face the days ahead.
translations: 你一直难以入睡，所以你开始服用处方安眠药。现在，如果没有它们，你几乎无法入睡，而你需要充足睡眠来面对未来的挑战。

messages.msgid: Caffeine gave you life and without it you are nothing.  Your dependence upon it was so extreme that you can barely function in its absence and you've done lasting psychological harm to yourself.  You'd better find a steady supply, and fast.
translations: 咖啡因就是你的生命，你现在根本离不开它了！你是如此依赖咖啡因，没有它你甚至无法开始工作，同时你也一直遭受着精神折磨。你最好找到持续的咖啡因供给，要快！

messages.msgid: Coffee was your faithful companion every morning, and without it you feel like a zombie.  Thanks to all the actual zombies shambling about, getting your caffeine fix will be much harder now.
translations: 咖啡是你每个早上的忠实伴侣，没有它让你觉得自己像只丧尸。多亏了那些真正蹒跚而行的丧尸，现在再想得到你的咖啡解药要难得多了。

messages.msgid: You liked to make your own costumes and wear them to various conventions.  Now that everyone is dead or dying, maybe this will be useful for something else.
translations: 你喜欢自己制作服装，穿着它们参加各种展会。现在每个人都已经死了或者快要死了，但也许这对其他事有些帮助。

messages.msgid: Whether it was for fun, innocent utility, or criminal intent, you learned the basics of how to silently pick locks.  Now, being able to get into secured places just got a lot more useful.
translations: 无论是出于好玩无害的动机还是出于犯罪目的，你学会了无声撬锁所需要的基本知识。而现在，能够进入防护严密地点的能力变得更有用了。

messages.msgid: Maybe you're a certified locksmith, a career burglar, or an intense hobbyist.  Regardless, you've spent so long picking locks you could pop most open in under a minute easy, with the right tools.
translations: 你可能是专业锁匠，或者是个职业窃贼，也可能是业余爱好者。 无论如何，你已经花了很长时间撬锁，只要有合适的工具，大多数锁都能在一分钟内轻松打开。

messages.msgid: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running for your life.
translations: 你已经练了很多年的跑酷，世界就是你的游乐场。当你说跑步是你的生命时并没有撒谎。这很好，因为现在世界已经终结了，你正在为你的生存而奔跑。

messages.msgid: You enjoyed camping in the vast wilderness as a means of escaping the pace of modern life.  The wilderness isn't filled with people, so it must be safe.  Right?  It must be.
translations: 你喜欢在广阔的荒野宿营，以此逃避现代生活的节奏。荒野里没有人，所以一定很安全。对吧？一定是这样。

messages.msgid: You take camping to a whole new level.  You have spent nights and weekends surviving in the wild with just a knife to aid you.  Maybe this skill for self-sufficiency can keep you safe.
translations: 你将露营提升到了一个全新的水平。你花了无数夜晚和周末在野外生存，而只需要一把小刀来帮助你。也许这份自给自足的能力能够护你周全。

messages.msgid: You're probably one of the last people alive who knows how to safely operate a flying vehicle.  It remains to be seen whether you'll live long enough to make use of that skill.
translations: 你可能是最后一个知道如何安全驾驶飞行器的人了。但你是否能活到使用这种技能还有待观察。

messages.msgid: You love reading, but you never seemed to have enough time.  Maybe the Cataclysm is a blessing in disguise.
translations: 你喜欢读书，只是你似乎从来没有足够的时间。也许大灾变是因祸得福。

messages.msgid: Perhaps you produced illicit chemicals for your own consumption, or to sell to others.  Or maybe you're just a real nerd about chemistry.  In any case, you know your way around a Periodic Table.
translations: 也许你所调配出的非法化学品只是为了自己消遣，或者是为了卖给别人。也许你不过是个化学书读太多的书呆子。总之，你知道化学周期表中隐藏的窍门。

messages.msgid: You've used a bow before and maybe taken a class or two.  You won't be pulling off any trick shots but at least you can usually get an arrow to fly forward instead of spinning off to the side.
translations: 你以前用过弓，也许上过一两次课。 虽然你不会耍什么花招，但至少你通常能让箭向前飞，而不是向旁边打转。

messages.msgid: You enjoy nocking back an arrow and hearing it whistle through the air.  If you can get the proper gear together and stay on-target, you'll have a good, quiet alternative to using guns.
translations: 你喜欢搭上一支箭，听它们在空中鸣笛的声音。只要你能找到一套正规装备并瞄准好目标，你就有了一只又好又安静的枪械替代品。

messages.msgid: You're a modern day Robin Hood and probably have hella back muscles.  Perhaps you're an Olympic archer in training or maybe you're descended from the longbowmen of old.  In either case, sniping zombie heads should be as easy as pinning apples to trees for you.
translations: 你是现代的罗宾汉，大概率背肌强壮。你可能是训练中的奥林匹克射箭选手，也可能是有个长弓手祖宗。无论原因如何，以你百步穿杨的箭法，射穿丧尸头简单如探囊取物。

messages.msgid: You can swim.  Probably not very well, and you won't break any speed records, but, you CAN swim.
translations: 你会游泳。 可能游得不是很好，也不会打破任何速度记录，但是，你会游泳。

messages.msgid: You're a strong swimmer, and you're pretty sure zombies aren't.  You can't swim forever, but it's certainly an advantage over the undead.
translations: 你是个游泳健将，你很确定丧尸们并不是。你不可能永远游下去，但这肯定是你对不死生物的优势。

messages.msgid: You're an excellent swimmer and may be part fish.  Plus, all that swimming has left you in great shape.  There aren't any zombie sharks in the water, right?
translations: 你是个出色的游泳健将，可能还有鱼的血统。另外，经常游泳让你体型健美。 水里不会有丧尸鲨鱼吧？

messages.msgid: You used to play baseball, occasionally.  Maybe you were on your school team growing up, but it was never a focus of yours.  Hopefully you can still remember how to use a bat when your life depends on it.
translations: 你以前偶尔打过棒球。也许你是学校棒球队的一员，但这从来不是你的兴趣所在。希望你还能记得如何使用球棒，当你的生命取决于它的时候。

messages.msgid: You got the stance, you got the grip, you got the game.  Swinging at a zombie's head is close enough to swinging at a baseball… right?
translations: 你摆好姿式，你握紧球棒，你赢得比赛。朝丧尸的头上挥舞球棒和在棒球上挥棒差不多，对吧？

messages.msgid: You're accustomed to striking out poor batters at the plate and can probably throw a mean knuckleball.  Now you get to practice your fastball, but perhaps with rocks or grenades this time.
translations: 你已经习惯了在本垒上三振可怜的击球手，也许还能投出一个漂亮的小球。现在，你可以练习你的快速球了，不过这次可能要用石头或手榴弹。

messages.msgid: You didn't quite make it into the big leagues, but you were close.  Now it's time to go for the grand slam or you'll be dealing with worse than a strike out.
translations: 你虽然没能进入大联盟，但已经很接近了。现在是时候实现大满贯了，否则你将面对比三振出局更糟糕的结果。

messages.msgid: Maybe you've taken a few classes at a gym somewhere, or used to be on the youth team, or maybe you just liked to rough-house with your friends or family growing up.  You're not entirely unused to grappling, but you're hardly an expert.
translations: 也许你在健身房上过几节课，或者曾经参加过青年队，又或者你从小就喜欢和朋友或家人打打闹闹。你并不是完全不懂擒拿格斗，但也算不上专家。

messages.msgid: While not the type of wrestler to use folding chairs as weapons, you have experience wrasslin' and tusslin' with others out on the mat.  There's no referees around to see, but hopefully your skills will help you avoid getting pinned by the undead.
translations: 虽然不是那种使用折叠椅作为武器的摔跤手，但你可以在垫子上体验过与其他人的争吵和斗争，周围没有裁判，但希望你的技能能帮助你避免被不死生物钉住。

messages.msgid: You were likely on the 100+ wins list back in school and maybe you're a collegiate wrestler or you're using it as part of something like MMA.  Considering how grabby those zombies are, you should get plenty of use out of your skills.
translations: 在学校时，你很可能是百战百胜的选手，你可能是大学摔跤队选手，或者把它作为综合格斗的一部分。考虑到这些丧尸的擒拿能力，你应该能从你的技能中得到很多帮助。

messages.msgid: You loved immersing yourself in virtual worlds through video games.  Now you're faced with real survival horror, and no extra lives.
translations: 你喜欢用电子游戏让自己沉浸在虚拟世界中。现在你面临着真正的生存难题，没有多条命。

messages.msgid: You liked to trap little wild animals such as mice and other rodents.  This skill could be useful for working with more deadly devices, if you're creative enough.
translations: 你喜欢捕捉小型野生动物，如老鼠和其他啮齿动物。如果你有足够的创造力，这项技能在处理更致命的陷阱时可能很有用。

messages.msgid: Dodging fast-moving balls as though your life depended on it was fun.  Dodging zombies isn't as fun, but your life certainly depends on it.
translations: 想逃命一样躲开快速移动的球很好玩。躲开丧尸也许不好玩，但现在躲不开你就真没命了。

messages.msgid: You found unexpected solace while soldering components to circuit boards.
translations: 在将元件焊接到电路板时，你总能获得意想不到的安慰。

messages.msgid: You spent much of your time making useful things out of bits and bobbles.
translations: 你花了很多时间将零碎的东西做成有用的东西。

messages.msgid: Whether due to circumstances forcing ingenuity or just an unhealthy fascination with tinkering you're a certified MacGyver with a very wide range of fabrication knowledge.  You could probably make a functioning cannon out of a paper clip and some bubble gum.
translations:
无论是因为环境迫使你发挥聪明才智，还是因为你对修修补补有一种不健康的迷恋，你都是一个合格的马盖先，拥有非常广泛的制作知识。 你也许能用回形针和泡泡糖做出一门能用的大炮。
译注：马盖先，《百战天龙》主角，擅长用生活用品组装工具化险为夷。

messages.msgid: You can cook well enough that you didn't have to live on instant noodles and takeout, but you've only really learned the bare minimum.
translations: 你的厨艺足以让你不用靠方便面和外卖度日，但你只真正学会了最基本的东西。

messages.msgid: You enjoyed cooking for yourself and others.  The grocery stores are closed for good, so you might need to start getting creative with your recipes.
translations: 你喜欢为自己和他人做饭。杂货店再也不开张了，所以你可能需要想些新菜式了。

messages.msgid: You're an excellent chef capable of making delicious meals out of almost anything and have a wide array of culinary knowledge.  Sadly, the undead would rather eat you than your meals.
translations: 你是一名出色的厨师，几乎能用任何东西做出美味佳肴，并拥有丰富的烹饪知识。遗憾的是，不死人宁愿吃你，也不愿吃你做的饭菜。

messages.msgid: The art of producing the finest quality cheeses has been passed down through your family for generations.  How useful these skills will be in the apocalypse remains to *brie* seen.
translations: 生产最优质奶酪的艺术已经通过你的家族代代相传。这些技能在启示录中有多大用处还有待观察。

messages.msgid: Whether it was something practiced in your family or something you took it up to extend the shelf life of your groceries, you know how to preserve produce and meat in cans or mason jars.  With the electricity down and refrigerators dead, saying your skills could come in handy is an understatement.
translations: 无论这是你家里的传统，还是你为了延长食品保质期而学会的，你知道如何将蔬菜和肉类保存到罐头或梅森罐中。在如今电力中断，冰箱失效的情况下，不言而喻，你的技能绝对会派上用场的。

messages.msgid: Pretending to shoot at your friends has always been fun.  Now you can do it for real.
translations: 和朋友一起玩射击一直都很有趣。现在你可以玩真的了。

messages.msgid: You enjoyed target plinking with your airsoft pistol.  You're a good shot, but you'll need a real gun for it to matter.
translations: 你喜欢用你的软弹手枪射击目标。你是一个好射手，但你需要把真正有威力的枪。

messages.msgid: Where the skeet go, your shot follows.  Throw enough pellets downrange, and you'll at least hit something.
translations: 飞碟飞到哪里，你的子弹就跟到哪里。朝射程内的目标洒下足够多的弹丸，至少会击中一些东西。

messages.msgid: You are an incredibly social individual, with the projection and vocabulary to make people listen.
translations: 你是个非常善于社交的人，懂得各种心理投射和语言技巧让人群听你演讲。

messages.msgid: You've been in quite a few fights in the street.  You can throw and dodge a punch better than most.
translations: 你在街上打过不少架。你比大多数人都能更好地挥拳和躲避。

messages.msgid: Maybe you're the muscle of some criminal gang, maybe you're a bouncer at a club, or maybe you're just a huge asshole.  You've constantly been getting into fights with strangers on the streets for most of your life, and somehow you ain't dead yet, so you must be doing something right.
translations: 也许你是某个犯罪团伙的打手，也许你是俱乐部的保镖，也许你就是个大混蛋。你大半辈子都在街上和陌生人打架，却还没死，肯定是做对了什么事。

messages.msgid: You learned how to throw knives before the world ended, a skill that can be deadly in the right situation.
translations: 你在大灾变之前学会了如何扔飞刀，一种在合适的条件下可以致命的技能。

messages.msgid: You are quite good at sewing torn clothes back together, and have even made your own clothes a few times.
translations: 你过去常常把破衣服缝好，甚至为自己缝了几件。

messages.msgid: Despite modern technology making career tailors obsolete you've spent much of your life hand-making clothing of all sorts, whether for historical purposes or to sell as artisanal goods.  Too bad you can't stitch the holes in reality closed.
translations: 尽管现代技术让职业裁缝变得过时，但你一生中的大部分时间都在手工制作各种服装，无论是用于历史目的还是作为艺术品出售。可惜的是，你无法缝合现实中的破洞。

messages.msgid: You were in a fencing club, and you weren't too shabby with a saber.  If you can get your hands on a real sword, you'll be a formidable fighter.
translations: 你加入了击剑俱乐部，而且你对剑术略知一二。如果你能得到一把真正的剑，你将变身成强大的战士。

messages.msgid: You've spent so long practicing your fencing you wouldn't look out of place in the Renaissance dueling with ne'er-do-wells and rapscallions.  En Garde!
translations: 你花了这么长时间练习剑术，在文艺复兴时期与新手和奸商决斗也不会显得突兀。 En Garde（就位）！

messages.msgid: You're a big fan of cars and other things that go vroom, whether it's fixing them or driving them.  You may not be a professional, but you know your way around an engine.
translations: 你是汽车和其他能轰隆隆响的东西的超级粉丝，不管是修车还是开车。你可能不是一个专业人士，但你知道应该如何对待引擎。

messages.msgid: You're a real speed demon in anything with an engine!  Pulling off hairpin turns at high speeds is a difficult skill to master but you can drift with the best of them.
translations: 驾驶任何带发动机的汽车，你都是真正的速度狂魔！在高速行驶中完成发夹弯是一项很难掌握的技能，但你可以和他们中的佼佼者一起漂移。

messages.msgid: You've trained in non-combat kickboxing at a gym as a way to exercise.  While you were taught the moves, you've never sparred or fought anything more dangerous than a falling punching bag.  Whether you can remember your training when push kick comes to jab is up to you.
translations: 你在健身房里学过一些用来锻炼身体的非实战踢拳。你练这些招式时，遇过最危险的对手是甩回来的沙袋。当你前蹬转刺拳时，能否记住之前训练的玩意儿，就得看你自己了。

messages.msgid: You have received some martial arts training at a local dojo.  You start with your choice of Karate, Judo, Aikido, Tai Chi, Taekwondo, or Pankration.
translations: 你在道场里接受过一些武术训练。你能够在空手道、柔道、合气道、太极拳、跆拳道及古希腊搏击中选择一项，作为你的起始武术。

messages.msgid: You have taken some self-defense classes at a local gym.  You start with your choice of Boxing, Kickboxing, Capoeira, Krav Maga, Muay Thai, Ninjutsu, Wing Chun, or Zui Quan.
translations: 你曾在附近健身房受过一套防身术训练。你可以在开局时从拳击、踢拳、巴西战舞、马伽术、泰拳、忍术、咏春或者醉拳之中选择其一。

messages.msgid: You have studied the arts of the Shaolin monks.  You start with one of the five animal fighting styles: Tiger, Crane, Leopard, Snake, or Dragon.
translations: 你是少林寺的俗家弟子。你在开始的时候可以选择少林虎形拳、少林豹形拳、少林鹤形拳、少林蛇形拳或者少林龙形拳之一。

messages.msgid: You've been doing martial arts for years and have earned the coveted black belt in a martial art of your choice.
translations: 你已经习武多年，并在一项武术获得了梦寐以求的黑带。

messages.msgid: You have practiced fighting with weapons.  You start with your choice of Barbaran Montante, Bōjutsu, Eskrima, Fencing, Fior Di Battaglia, Medieval Swordsmanship, Niten Ichi-Ryu, Pencak Silat, or Sōjutsu.
translations: 你曾经接受过一套近身武器训练。你在开始的时候可以选择巴巴兰重剑术、日本棍术、菲律宾剑棍术、击剑术、战斗之花、中世纪剑术、二天一流剑术、班卡苏拉刀术或日本枪术之一。

messages.msgid: Despite firearms making traditional melee weapons largely obsolete, you have extensive experience fighting in hand-to-hand combat with tools of war.  Maybe it was full-contact HEMA or SCA sparring, or maybe you're just a badass commando with a machete.  You start with your choice of Barbaran Montante, Bōjutsu, Eskrima, Fencing, Fior Di Battaglia, Medieval Swordsmanship, Niten Ichi-Ryu, Pencak Silat, or Sōjutsu.
translations: 尽管枪支使传统的近战武器基本上过时了，但你在进行肉搏战方面有着丰富的经验。也许是全接触的HEMA或SCA拳击，也许你只是一个拿着大砍刀的突击队员。你可以从 巴巴兰重剑术、日本棍术、菲律宾剑棍术、击剑、战斗之花、中世纪剑术、二天一流、班卡苏拉刀术 和 日本枪术 之中选择一种来开始游戏。

messages.msgid: You loved going to all kinds of restaurants and experiencing everything the world of culinary arts had to offer.  Nowadays, those chefs are all dead, so it'll be up to you to recreate the joys of your past.
translations: 你喜欢去各种餐馆，体验厨艺世界所提供的一切。如今，那些厨师都已经死光了，只能靠你自己来重现往昔欢愉。

messages.msgid: You were a professional eater before the Cataclysm and frequently participated in eating contests.  Thanks to your training, you can eat huge amounts of food without getting sick, and while eating forty hot dogs in ten minutes might not be too useful in the apocalypse, your fortitude might help you survive off food other survivors would pass over.
translations: 在大灾变之前，你是一名经常参加大胃王比赛的专业食客。多亏了你的训练，你可以吃大量食物而不生病，虽然在丧尸世界中，十分钟内吃掉四十个热狗可能没有太大用处，但你的毅力可能会帮助你在面对其它幸存者不爱吃的食物时生存下来。

messages.msgid: You ran the Boston Marathon every year.  That conditioning should make you better equipped than most in avoiding the dead.
translations: 你每年都跑波士顿马拉松。这使你比其他大多数人更容易躲开那些不死人。

messages.msgid: Reading is for nerds!  You've managed to make hatred of the written word a central part of your identity.  Or, perhaps, you have a barrier that makes books additionally challenging and frustrating for you.  Whatever the reason, boring books are more boring, and you can't have fun by reading books.
translations: 读书是给书呆子的！你已经成功地将对文字的仇恨作为你认知身份的核心。或者，也许你有阅读障碍，读书对你来说更具挑战且让人沮丧。不管是什么原因，枯燥的书变得更枯燥，而且你不能从读书中获得乐趣。

messages.msgid: You absolutely love meat, and dislike eating fruits and vegetables.  Your particular tastes have turned you into a decent amateur butcher.
translations: 你超级喜欢吃肉，讨厌水果和蔬菜。你的特殊品味使你成为一个不错的业余屠夫。

messages.msgid: You have been a vegetarian for so long that eating meat makes you feel sick.  You like to supplement your diet with wild plants and mushrooms foraged in the woods.
translations: 你吃素这么久了，吃肉会让你恶心。你喜欢用森林里的野菜蘑菇作为你的饮食补充。

messages.msgid: You are skilled in maneuvering on skates.  You suffer lower penalties to dodging and are less likely to fall down if hit in melee combat while you're wearing rollerskates or rollerblades.
translations: 你擅长滑冰。当你穿着滚轴溜冰鞋或者直排轮滑鞋时，你受到的闪避惩罚更少，在近战中被击中时摔倒的几率也更小。

messages.msgid: You loved doing crafts at home.  Now, you might want to channel those skills into making more practical things.
translations: 你喜欢在家做些手工艺品。现在，你可能会想要把手艺用于制作更实用的东西。

messages.msgid: Spending time every weekend in your garage working on an old classic car was your favorite pastime.  You never finished the car, but at least you learned a little over the years.
translations: 每个周末，花些时间在你的车库里修车是你最喜欢的消遣。你从来没有造完一辆车，但这些年来你至少学到了些东西。

messages.msgid: Pranks and physical jokes are a passion of yours, from the setup right through to playing innocent at the end.
translations: 恶作剧和捉弄人是你的爱好，从场景设置到最后装无辜。

messages.msgid: You were deep into the fashion scene, keeping up on the latest trends and even modeling clothes yourself.  Having style and good looks is just as, if not more, important to you than practicality.
translations: 你深谙时尚界，紧跟最新潮流，甚至亲自为服装走秀。  对你来说，时尚与美观就算不比实用性更重要，那也至少跟它一样重要。

messages.msgid: You're a master of throwing on the potter's wheel, able to shape clay into whatever shape you need.
translations: 你是一个熟练的制陶师，能够将黏土塑造成你所需要的任何形状。

messages.msgid: You figured you could save money on ammo by learning to make your own.  Now that the factories are shut down, your abilities just went from handy to lifesaving.
translations: 你觉得自己可以通过学习复装弹药来省子弹钱。现在工厂都关了，这从一种手艺变成了救命的能力。

messages.msgid: As the Game Master, you've guided players' journeys through dungeons and fortresses.  Now, you're the last member of your party.
translations: 作为游戏城主，你引导玩家们穿越各类地牢和城堡。现在，你是你们派对中的最后一名成员了。

messages.msgid: You whiled your nights away using, building, and repairing old ham radios.  Now you have no one to talk to. But you won't give up hope, and maybe your electronics knowledge can help you somehow.
translations: 你整夜都在使用、搭建和修理老式无线电收发机。现在你无人倾诉。但你不会放弃希望，也许你的电子知识会对你有所帮助。

messages.msgid: The backswing's a breeze, and your drive could get skulls into the green if you tried.
translations: 挥杆是一件轻而易举的事，如果你努力尝试的话，你的用力一击可能会把头骨打进果岭里。

messages.msgid: Whether through regular commuting, or just riding for the joy of it, you're no stranger to bicycles.
translations: 无论是定期通勤，还是单纯为了享受骑行的乐趣，你对自行车都不陌生。

messages.msgid: You've shed gallons of sweat, and more than a little blood, riding the streets and trails as a cyclist.
translations: 你是一名自行车骑手，在街道与小径的骑行途中免不了流血流汗，但对你来说都已经是家常便饭。

messages.msgid: You've honed the fitness and form of a professional bicycle racer.  When you're riding, your wheels are like an extension of your body.
translations: 你在骑行的过程中磨炼你的体魄，成为了一名专业的自行车手。你骑乘着自行车闪转腾挪，车子就像你身体的一部分。

messages.msgid: You used to shoot some b-ball outside of the school… at least, until a couple of corpses who were up to no good started making trouble in your neighborhood.
translations: 你过去一直在学校外面打球……直到几具尸体开始在你的社区里闹事。

messages.msgid: Your ability to play point or post will beat the undead in overtime.
translations: 你控球和背身单打能力让你能在这场加时赛中打赢丧尸。

messages.msgid: You can sink 3-pointers all day, and dribble around the most determined defenders.
translations: 你可以整天投进三分球，运球绕过最坚定的防守者。

messages.msgid: You'd occasionally play touch or flag football at the park, but never got too serious about it.
translations: 你偶尔会在公园里踢简单版橄榄球，但从未认真对待过。

messages.msgid: You're no stranger to throwing the ol' pigskin and taking a few tackles.  Hopefully your skills in dodging defenders will help you charge through the hordes of undead.
translations: 你对投掷橄榄球和被擒抱并不陌生。 希望你躲避防守的技巧能帮助你冲过成群的丧尸。

messages.msgid: You played college ball, ya know.  You could have gone pro if the world hadn't ended.
translations: 你在大学打过球，如果不是世界末日，你还有机会去当职业球员。

messages.msgid: You used to kick a ball around with your friends, having fun together.  Though it may not be the case anymore.
translations: 你过去常和朋友一起踢球，并且一起玩得很开心。尽管情况可能不再如此。

messages.msgid: Your fondness for the beautiful game shows with your flairs, skills and tackles.  Whether you can go past the backline of the undead is a question yet to be answered.
translations: 你对美丽足球的钟爱在你的天赋、技巧和铲球中显露无遗。至于能否突破不死者的后防线，这仍是个悬而未决的问题。

messages.msgid: You were on trial at a professional club, ready to get a contract.  What a great opportunity for you, if only your coaches were still alive.
translations: 你在一家职业俱乐部试训并准备拿到合同。如果你的教练还活着，那对你来说是一个多么好的机会啊。

messages.msgid: You've been to a gun range once or twice and maybe took a firearm safety class.  At the very least, you're confident you can point the gun in the correct direction.
translations: 你去过一两次射击场，也许还上过枪支安全课。至少，你有信心将枪指向正确的方向。

messages.msgid: You liked going to the local gun range and shooting at some targets or blasting cans off of fence posts with a variety of firearms.  Maybe if you just imagine targets on those undead, this could help.
translations: 你喜欢去当地的射击场打靶，或者用各种枪支把罐子从栅栏柱上打下来。如果你能想象那些丧尸是靶子，也许会有帮助。

messages.msgid: You've got training and some experience in dealing with urgent injuries.  In the absence of any medical professionals, that'll have to do.
translations: 你受过训练，有急救经验。在没有专业医疗人员的情况下，这也能凑活。

messages.msgid: You loved the smell of gunsmoke and blowing ceramic discs out of the sky.  Your future will likely involve shooting things a little fleshier than clay pigeons.
translations: 没什么能比得上硝烟味和射爆橙色陶碟了。是时候向那些比陶瓷鸽子更带肉的玩意儿射几发了。

messages.msgid: You enjoyed inviting the neighborhood to a backyard cookout on the weekends.  You, of course, were the grill master.
translations: 你喜欢在周末邀请邻居来你的后院野餐。当然，你是烧烤师傅。

messages.msgid: With enough time and materials, you could make a boat from scratch.  These undead can't swim, right?
translations: 如果有足够的时间和材料，你可以从头开始造一艘船。这些不死生物不会游泳，对吗？

messages.msgid: You've learned woodworking in the field of making musical instruments.  You'll be able to create musical instruments in the Cataclysm.
translations: 你在乐器制作领域学过木工活儿。你可以在大灾变中创造乐器。

messages.msgid: You'd fix up any holes and appliances in your own home with nothing but your two hands and some elbow grease.  You did it to save money on repairmen, but now it seems you'll do it to save your life.
translations: 你会用你的两只手和一些肘部油脂来修理你自己家里的任何洞和电器。 你这样做是为了节省修理工的钱，但现在看来你会这样做来挽救你的生命。

messages.msgid: A quiet day at the lake would be a welcome break from the hordes.  Though, now that you think about it, the fish have been acting strangely vicious lately too.
translations: 在湖边安静的待上一天比应付尸潮要舒服得多。不过，现在你想想，这些鱼最近也表现得异常凶恶。

messages.msgid: You could have been the next Browning, if not for the those pesky corpses walking around.  It's time to test for accuracy.
translations: 如果不是因为这些讨厌的尸体到处走动，你可能会成为下一个勃朗宁。现在是测试准头的时候了。

messages.msgid: Being able to body your way through the pack is always useful, whether your opponent is living or rotting.
translations: 无论你的对手是活的还是腐烂的，能够用你的方式穿过一大群人总是很有用的。

messages.msgid: Your time in the rink has taught you that sometimes the best way forward is straight through whoever's trying to block you.
translations: 你在溜冰场的经验告诉你，有时候最好的前进方式是直接穿过那些试图阻挡你的人。

messages.msgid: You'd have been a hit at the county fair, but you're cooking for one now.
translations: 你本来会在乡村集市上大受欢迎的，但现在你只为自己一个人做饭。

messages.msgid: Your white lightning could knock out an elephant, but you're drinking alone now.
translations: 你酿造出的"白色闪电"可以醉倒一头大象，但现在你只能一个人独酌了。

messages.msgid: They tore apart your team, but you're determined to keep the team spirit alive.
translations: 他们撕碎了你的球队，但你决心保持团队精神。

messages.msgid: Your green thumb will come in handy when the grocery stores are overrun.
translations: 当杂货店沦陷之后，你在花园中辛劳获得的绿拇指能派上大用场。

messages.msgid: Your knots are strong, whether they're made from cloth or natural cordage.
translations: 无论是布料还是天然绳索，你打的结都很结实。

messages.msgid: You enjoyed trekking on long trails in nature with all your necessities strapped to your back.
translations: 你喜欢在大自然中长途跋涉，把所有必需品都绑在背上。

messages.msgid: You loved learning and sharing interesting facts about many different topics.  None of them are useful anymore, but your strong memory certainly is.
translations: 你喜欢学习和分享各种主题的趣事。这些都没什么用了，但你的记忆力确实很强。

messages.msgid: You spent hours welding discarded scrap into large and intricate designs.  Some said you were just welding junk into bigger junk.  You call it art.
translations: 你会花上几个小时把被丢弃的废料焊接成大而复杂的设计。有人说你只是把垃圾焊接成更大的垃圾。但你称之为艺术。

messages.msgid: You went to loud concerts and spent your time in the mosh pits.  Now that everything's gone to hell, the whole world is your mosh pit.
translations: 你喜欢去听吵闹的音乐会，在舞池里消磨时间。现在世界都下地狱了，整个世界都是你的地狱舞池。

messages.msgid: Whether you twirled, spun, juggled, or ate it, your manipulation of flaming objects was impressive and terrifying to behold.
translations: 无论你是旋转、缠绕、杂耍还是吞吃，你对燃烧物体的掌控令人印象深刻，看起来也很可怕。

messages.msgid: You loved meeting new people on the dance floor.  These zombies aren't terribly friendly, but they're ready to tango!
translations: 你喜欢在舞池里结识新朋友。丧尸并不十分友好，但已经准备好跳探戈了！

messages.msgid: You make a habit of clearing your thoughts and finding your center, even amidst the chaos of the world.
translations: 即使在这个混乱的世界中，你也养成了清除杂念、找回本心的习惯。

messages.msgid: Circumstance left you wandering the world, alone.  Now there is nothing to go back to, even if you wanted to.  Perhaps your experience in fending for yourself will prove useful in this new world.
translations: 命运的捉弄导致你在世界上独自流浪，但在现在这种情况下，哪怕你想“回到过去的生活”也回不去了。至少你自食其力的经历多少能应用在这个新世界。

messages.msgid: Some would say that there's nothing particularly notable about you, but you've survived, and that's more than most could say right now.
translations: 有些人会说，你身上并没有什么可圈可点之处。不过，"你活下来了"——这一句话胜过千言万语。

messages.msgid: You made a career out of creating and commentating video content and posting it on various platforms.  Now most of your fans are dead, alongside your equipment.  Maybe you didn't cultivate the most practical skillset through your career, but you have learned a thing or two about troubleshooting software and getting people to listen to you.
translations: 你以创作与评论视频内容，并将其发布在各种平台上为生。现在你的大部分粉丝都成了死粉，也别提设备了。虽然你的职业生涯没有让你培养出实际有用的技能，但你多少懂得些电脑软件排障和让人们倾听于你的技巧。

messages.msgid: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter.  You've spent the past months eating canned food, reading books, and tinkering.  Now it is winter - time to face the world above.
translations: 在大灾变初起之时，你躲进了一处防空掩体。过去的数月里，你靠着罐头食品度日，读书消磨时间，并摆弄各种小玩意。如今寒冬已至——是时候走出地表，直面外面的世界了。

messages.msgid: At the start of the Cataclysm, you hunkered down in a bomb shelter with your collection of guns.  You've spent the past months eating canned food and practicing your aim.  Now it is winter - time to face the world above.
translations: 你在大灾变开始时躲进了一个防空洞——连带着你的枪械收藏。在过去的几个月里，你一直在吃罐头食品，以及锻炼自己的枪法。冬日已至，是时候出来面对这个世界了。

messages.msgid: Tailoring may not seem like the most useful skill when the world has ended.  Most people wouldn't expect a simple tailor to live very long.  This is your opportunity to prove them wrong.
translations: 在世界末日来临后，裁缝手艺或许看起来并不是最有用的技能。大多数人也不会指望一个普通裁缝能活多久。而这，就是你证明他们错了的机会。

messages.msgid: Bork bork!  Years in the kitchen have left you carrying a prodigious bulk, but you managed to escape the carnage with your trusty butcher knife and only a small collection of stains on your uniform.
translations: 哇哇！多年在厨房里的岁月让你养出了一身惊人的肥膘，不过你还是带着你那把可靠的屠夫刀从血腥屠戮中逃了出来，制服上也只留下了少量污渍。

messages.msgid: You spent most of your adult life in a butcher shop.  Your trusty knife has seen many different creatures and you know how to butcher them.
translations: 作为一个屠户，你的大多数时光都在屠宰桌前度过。你手上的屠刀对如何解剖各种生物颇有一番见解。

messages.msgid: What the deuyl?  Ye ne wist noo thing of this straunge plaas nor what wycked enchauntment brought ye hidder.  Wyth this accoustrement ye must needs underfongen to find newe lyflode in the most hidous Cataclysm man hath witnessed sithen that deluge Noe rood out in his greet schippe.
translations: 这是什么鬼？你对这处诡异之地一无所知，也不知是哪般邪恶的魔咒将你引到这儿。唯有凭这身行头，你才不得不着手谋求新的生计，在这人世自挪亚驾其巨舟渡过那场洪水以来所目睹的最骇人之大灾变之中求得活路。

messages.msgid: Thanks to years of study and hard work in the lab, you're familiar with the basics of scientific inquiry.  Only one question remains: can you undo the very Cataclysm your colleagues helped create?
translations: 多年来在实验室中的钻研与辛勤付出，使你对科学研究的基本方法了然于胸。如今只剩下一个问题：你是否能够逆转那场由你的同事们亲手促成的“大灾变”？

messages.msgid: You know your way around the periodic table and can name ten different industrial processes that involve any given chemical, but that did not prevent the prospect of employment from looking bleak for you.  Fortunately, the Cataclysm might just be the thing to save you from a dead end job.
translations: 你对元素周期表了如指掌，能够列举出涉及任何化学物的十种不同的工业流程，但这并没有阻止你面临失业的困境。  幸运的是，大灾变可能正是拯救你免于失业的契机。

messages.msgid: You've always loved cars, and there's nothing like getting under the hood and fixing it yourself.  You've kept ahold of some handy tools for the job, and at least now you'll never want for parts.
translations: 你一直都很喜欢汽车，没有什么比躲在引擎盖下自己修车更好的了。你已经为这项工作准备了一些趁手工具，至少现在你再也不需要到处找零件了。

messages.msgid: You've always loved machines, and have extensively incorporated them into your career.  Not long after receiving your degree, you seem to be the one being subjected to a stress test, and it remains unclear if you will retain your structural integrity.
translations: 你一直钟情于机械，并在职业生涯中大量地将它们融入其中。然而，在你取得学位不久之后，接受“应力测试”的似乎反倒成了你自己，而你是否还能保持自身的“结构完整性”，仍然是个未知数。

messages.msgid: Your flexible outlook on the law, the scuffles you've been in (and avoided) at the bar, and your impressive ability to weasel your way out of the consequences of your actions - all these skills have helped ensure your survival.  How much longer will they hold out?
translations: 你对所谓"法律"的那套东西一向很有“弹性准则”，在酒吧里既打过也躲过不少架，再加上你那从麻烦里脱身的过人本事——这些技能都在很大程度上确保了你能活到现在。可它们还能保你多久呢？

messages.msgid: You used to be a professional apiarist, building and maintaining beehives.  You had to abandon your precious bees when the Cataclysm struck, but at least you managed to grab some utensils and honey.
translations: 你曾经是一名养蜂人，搭建并精心照料你的蜂巢。大灾变来袭，你不得不抛下你珍贵的蜜蜂，不过好歹你记得拿上一些工具和蜂蜜。

messages.msgid: You played with the local team.  You're the only one left, but now you can use your trusty bat for another purpose.  Home run!
translations: 你曾效力于当地的球队。如今只剩下你一人，但你仍然可以让那根可靠的球棒发挥新的用途——打爆那些僵尸。

messages.msgid: Your first major game was abruptly canceled when zombies stormed the court.  Quick feet and good reflexes meant you were among the lucky few to escape the stadium alive.
translations: 你的第一场重要比赛突然被取消，丧尸们不断涌进球场。多亏了你的飞毛腿和快速反应，你是少数几个幸运地活着逃出体育场的人之一。

messages.msgid: Your epic touchdown was ruined when your coach's guts were torn out by undead fans.  Now you're first pick in the apocalypse draft.
translations: 随着你的教练被不死球迷们扯出肠子，你这次惊人的达阵算是毁了。如今，你成了大灾变选秀中的头号种子选手。

messages.msgid: You are the true Foodperson.  Some might think Foodperson is just a mascot, but you know better.  The mask has become your face, you are real, and the only thing standing between this world and oblivion is you.
translations: 你是真正的美食侠™，有些人可能认为那只是吉祥物而已，但你知道不仅仅如此：美食侠™面具已成为你的面孔，你真实存在，绝世而独立。

messages.msgid: You were a promising cyclist with a bright career in front of you before this all happened.  Perhaps you'll never get to participate in the grand tours now, but as the saying goes, life is like riding a bicycle: you've got to keep moving.
translations: 在这一切发生之前，你是个前途一片光明的自行车选手，但是现在都泡汤了。好在俗话说：生活就像骑自行车，你必须不停前进。

messages.msgid: You worked your way up through the ranks from a no-name private to a big shot Major General, respected and decorated.  On the downside, years of desk duty have left your shooting skills rusty, and all the medals in the world won't protect you now.
translations: 你从一个无名的二等兵一路晋升到一个受人尊敬的少将。不幸的是，多年的案头工作让你的射击技能变得生疏，现在世界上所有的勋章都无法保护你。

messages.msgid: You are one of the few and the proud: a member of the US Marine Corps.  Now that military command has collapsed in on itself as far as you can tell, you suppose that it falls to you to carry the memory of the Corps forward into the future.  Semper fi.
translations: 你是少数的精英：美国海军陆战队的一员。据你所知，军事指挥现已崩溃，你认为你有责任把部队的记忆带到未来。永远忠诚。

messages.msgid: You're a sailor of the US Navy, and spent the last few years working shipside aboard an aircraft carrier.  Though you're trained in combat, maintenance of the vessel has been your primary duty.  After some event beyond your understanding, the carrier has become a floating graveyard in the middle of nowhere.  This is going to take more than a cup of coffee and a monkey wrench to fix.
translations: 你是美国海军的一名水手，过去几年一直在航空母舰上工作。虽然你们接受了实战训练，但维护这艘船是你们的主要职责。在一些超出你理解的事件之后，航母已经在这荒无人烟的地方变成了座漂浮墓地。这可不是一杯咖啡和一把扳手就能搞定的。

messages.msgid: You were a member of a Naval Special Warfare diving group, a skilled soldier adept at underwater infiltration and marine combat.  You were suiting up for a practice dive when the aircraft carrier you were stationed on was somehow flung from the Yellow Sea to who knows where.  You seem to be the only one who survived with your sanity intact, but it's not safe to stay here.  At least you're already dressed to abandon ship.
translations: 你是海军特种作战潜水小组的一员，是一名擅长水下渗透和海上作战的士兵。你在准备潜水练习的时候，你所在的航空母舰不知怎的从黄海被抛到了个天知道的地方。你似乎是唯一一个心智完整的幸存者，但待在这里不安全。至少你已经准备好弃船了。

messages.msgid: After being discharged from the armed forces, you were sent to a veterans' hospital for treatment.  Just when you thought you'd overcome your traumas and readjusted to civilian life, the world has come to an end and your worst nightmare has become a reality: life in an endless battlefield.
translations: 从武装部队退役后，你被送往一所退伍军人医院接受治疗。正当你以为自己已经克服了创伤、重新适应了平民生活时，世界却迎来了终结，而你最可怕的噩梦也化为了现实——在一片永无止境的战场中生存。

messages.msgid: Joining the military has been your dream for years.  You finally got in, just in time for your training to get interrupted by some sort of national emergency.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.
translations: 参军一直是你多年来的梦想。你终于如愿入伍，却恰逢某种国家紧急事态爆发，训练被迫中断。就你所知，由于你错过了紧急撤离，上级把你丢在了这处地狱般的地方。

messages.msgid: Early in your military career, you were hand-picked for extra training in the mechanic's trade, keeping the armor running.  It's been years since you last touched a rifle, and the dead men are marching again…
translations: 在军旅生涯开始时，你被选中参加军械相关的额外训练，保持装甲车正常运转。你已经好几年没碰过步枪了，而死人们却开始行军了……

messages.msgid: Your job was simple: Keep the army moving.  You built bridges, you built roads, you destroyed fortifications, and you cleared mines.  It has been years since you last handled a rifle in basic training; now might be the time to dust off those skills.
translations: 你的工作很简单：让军队继续前进。你负责修桥修路，摧毁工事，清除地雷。距离你上次在基础作战训练中使用步枪已经有好些年了，现在也许是时候磨练一下这些技能了。

messages.msgid: You're a veteran of several peacekeeping missions.  You led your squad as a sort of parental figure, and they relied on you to give orders and keep them alive.  You failed them.  And now you're alone.
translations: 你是参加过数次维和任务的老兵。你像一个家长一样带领你的连队，他们指望你下达正确的命令，让他们活下去。你让他们失望了。现在只剩你一个人了。

messages.msgid: When you were young, you dreamed of being a soldier.  War is hell and hell is war, but you never thought it would be this bad.
translations: 你年轻的时候梦想着成为一名军人。战争就是地狱，地狱就是战争，但你从没想过会这么糟糕。

messages.msgid: Recruited into the ranks of the US Navy's Special Warfare forces as a designated sniper, your training in precision marksmanship and maritime operations was extensive.  As a proficient soldier and combative in all respects, you provided overwatch and long-range elimination services in the line of duty.  Now, with naval command imploding and your spotter MIA, your skills with a rifle and covert operations are the only things standing between you and the Cataclysm.
translations: 你以指定狙击手的身份被招募进美国海军特种作战部队，在精确射击与海上作战方面接受了系统而严苛的训练。作为一名在各个层面都具备作战能力的优秀士兵，你在执行任务时承担着掩护观察与远程清除目标的职责。如今，随着海军指挥体系的崩溃、你的观察手下落不明，你手中的步枪与隐秘行动的本领，成了你与“大灾变”之间仅存的屏障。

messages.msgid: You were a member of the SEALs; a key component of the US Navy's special forces and a proficient combatant in both maritime and ground operations.  'The only easy day was yesterday', and with the chain of command in ruins, you may fulfill your final mission in any way you see fit.
translations: 你曾是海豹突击队的成员；美国海军特种部队的重要组成部分，也是海、陆作战专家。"美好时光只在昨日"，随着指挥系统的崩溃，你可以以任何你认为合适的方式完成你的最后任务。

messages.msgid: You were the best of the best, the military's finest.  That's why you're still alive, even after all your comrades fell to the undead.  As far as you can tell, military command abandoned you in this hellhole when you missed the emergency evac.
translations: 你是精英中的精英，是军队的神话。这也就是为什么你的战友基本都挂了，而你还活着的原因。目前你所知道的就是在错过紧急撤离之后你已经被长官放弃了。

messages.msgid: You were hired to take care of the housekeeping for a wealthy family.  Naturally, when things got bad, they all took off on a family vacation to somewhere unknown, leaving you to your fate.
translations: 你受雇为一户富裕人家打理家务。事态恶化之时，他们自然是举家外出，前往某个不知名的地方度假，把你独自留下，任由命运摆布。

messages.msgid: You were following a road at night, trying to get away from the horrors of the city, when you heard a voice calling out in the dark.  You followed, hoping they were friendly, but suddenly felt a searing pain in your head and blacked out.  You just woke up in this strange place… are you even on Earth anymore?
translations: 夜色之中，你沿着一条道路前行，试图逃离城市里的种种恐怖。这时，你听到黑暗中有人呼喊你的声音。你循声而去，期望对方是友善之人，却突然感到头部一阵灼痛，随即失去了意识。等你再次醒来，已身处这片陌生之地……你还真的身在地球吗？

messages.msgid: You were ready.  You went in determined to find and rescue your friends.  Now the atmosphere in these twisting corridors grows heavy, and you don't feel quite so confident anymore.  You might be the one in need of a rescue soon.
translations: 你已做好准备。你怀着必救出朋友们的决心闯了进去。可如今，这些蜿蜒曲折的走廊里气氛愈发沉重，你也不再那么自信了。用不了多久，或许就轮到你需要别人来救了。

messages.msgid: Fresh out of med school, you've got little in the way of practical experience and just a handful of first-aid supplies.  You just hope it will be enough if 'physician, heal thyself' turns out to be more literal than you expected.
translations: 刚从医学院毕业的你几乎没有什么临床经验，手头只有一些急救用品。现在你只希望那句谚语是假的："医者不能自医啊！"

messages.msgid: You were a patient-facing doctor practicing general or specialized medicine.  While your bedside manner might not get you far in this new world, your medical skills will certainly help.
translations: 你是一位临床医生，从事普通医学或专科医学的工作。虽然你的诊疗礼仪在新世界中没有什么用处，但你的医疗技能却会实打实地有所帮助。

messages.msgid: You were a pharmacist working in a community pharmacy.  No simple pill-pusher, you have a plethora of knowledge of drug preparation, biochemistry, and biology.  With your trusty mortar and pestle, you hope to grind the undead to a pulp.
translations: 你是在社区药店中工作的一名药师。你有大量关于药品制备、化学和生物学的知识。现在你有可靠的研钵和杵，希望它们能把丧尸们也捣碎成浆吧。

messages.msgid: The boss always said he could rely on you to pull through on the tough jobs.  Shame he got himself smoked.  No problem; the world's always got a place for someone with your kind of talents.
translations: 老大总是说他能靠你做掉任何扎手的活。可惜他嗝屁了。不过没关系，世界上总有一个地方能容下你这样有才能的人。

messages.msgid: You had a boring, underpaid job watching cameras and patrolling hallways, but things have suddenly gotten a lot more dangerous.  You have some useful equipment, but you've never had any call to use it until now.
translations: 你有份工资又低又无聊的工作，整天看监控巡逻走廊，但情况突然变得更危险了。你有一些趁手的装备，但直到现在你才有真正使用它们的机会。

messages.msgid: You used to mow lawns and trim hedges for the wealthy.  Contract work was getting scarce even before the zombies came, but now you've got nothing left except your tools and expertise.
translations: 你过去替富人修剪草坪、打理树篱。即便在丧尸出现之前，零工合同就已越来越难找；而如今，你所剩下的只有手中的工具与多年积累的手艺。

messages.msgid: You went on providing in-home care for the elderly even as the whole world fell apart around you.  You can only pray that you don't see your former clients among the walking dead…
translations: 你过去为老人提供家庭护理，现在整个世界都崩塌了。你只能祈祷，不要在尸潮中看到你之前的客户……

messages.msgid: Living off the land, far from civilization, is nothing new to you.  The only difference is all the monsters that suddenly want you dead.  Your equipment is basic, but versatile… except that your canteen's run out!
translations: 依靠自然、远离文明的生活对你来说并不新鲜。唯一的区别是那些突然出现的想要取你性命的怪物。你的装备很简单，但功能齐全……不过你的水壶空了！

messages.msgid: Society drove you to the fringes and left you with no home, no family, no friends.  But for all the crap thrown your way, you're still breathing.  For now.
translations: 社会把你逼到了边缘，让你失去了住所、家庭与朋友。可无论命运向你砸下多少污秽与不公，你依然还在呼吸——至少，现在还是如此。

messages.msgid: You got your pilot's license and earned a living ferrying businessmen and tourists around.  The Cataclysm has grounded you for now, but the sky still calls to you…
translations: 你终于考到了你的飞行员驾照，靠将商人和游客从一个直升机停机坪送到另一个直升机停机坪为生，大灾变暂时让你失业了，但天空仍然召唤着你……

messages.msgid: You spent your career busting drug smugglers with your faithful canine companion.  Now the world has ended, and none of that matters anymore.  Your loyal dog is still at your side, though, ready to face the Cataclysm with you.
translations: 你在职业生涯中与忠实的警犬搭档并肩作战，专门缉捕毒品走私犯。如今世界已然终结，这一切都不再重要。不过，你那条忠诚的狗依旧在你身旁，准备与你一同直面“大灾变”。

messages.msgid: You have spent many long years forging a bond with your equine companion, from running down common thugs, to entertaining kids when you ride on by.  The Cataclysm is upon you, but at least you have each other.
translations: 你花了很长的岁月与你的爱马建立联系，从冲撞普通的暴徒，到一边骑行一边和孩子们玩耍。大灾变正在向你袭来，但至少你们有彼此。

messages.msgid: You spent your days running around with your faithful dogs by your side.  When the world ended, you grabbed your companions along with some of their things to protect them.  The zombies could be nearby, but at least your canine friends won't have to worry about the rain.
translations: 你终日带着忠实的狗儿们四处奔走，身旁总有它们相伴。世界终结之际，你带上这些伙伴，也顺手带走了它们的一些用品，好保护它们。丧尸也许就在附近，但至少，你的犬类朋友们不必再为雨淋发愁。

messages.msgid: Everyone is dead?  Oh well, it doesn't matter; it's not like you got along with people much anyway.  Your beloved cats are all the friends you need!
translations: 所有人都死了？哦，随便吧，反正你本来就不怎么与人相处得来。只需要有你心爱的猫猫当朋友就够了！

messages.msgid: Just a small-town deputy, you got the call and were ready to come to the rescue.  Soon it was you who needed rescuing, and you were lucky to escape with your life.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents might not even exist anymore?
translations: 你只是一名小镇的副警长，你接到了求救电话，准备前往现场。但很快你发现自己才是需要救援的那个人，你很幸运地逃了出来。当这个徽章所代表的政府已经不复存在时，谁还会尊重你的权威呢？

messages.msgid: You were on the brink of a major breakthrough in your latest homicide case when the Cataclysm struck.  Now your prime suspect is dead.  Everyone's dead.  You could really use a smoke.
translations: 就在你处在凶案侦破的关键点之时，大灾变降临了。嫌疑人死了，大家都死了。你现在真的很想抽根烟。

messages.msgid: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you are more than adequately trained and equipped to survive the brutal onslaught of the apocalypse.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.
translations: 作为警察队伍中最精锐部门的一员，你接受的训练和配备的装备让你存活过大灾变开头的残酷攻击绰绰有余。不幸的是，整个指挥系统已经分崩离析，现在你唯一的任务就是活下去。

messages.msgid: As a member of the police force's most elite division, you were given special training and became an expert in close-quarters combat.  Unfortunately, the chain of command has broken down; your only mission now is to stay alive.
translations: 作为警队中最精锐部门的一员，你接受了特殊训练，并成为近距离战斗方面的专家。不幸的是，指挥链已经完蛋了；如今，你唯一的任务，就是活下去。

messages.msgid: Your skill as a sharpshooter served you well in the line of duty, protecting the innocent with a single, well-placed bullet.  Now your own life is on the line, and you can't afford to miss if you don't want to end up as something's dinner.
translations: 你作为神射手的本领在执勤时大有用处，只需一发精准的子弹，便能保护无辜之人。如今轮到你自己的性命悬于一线；若不想沦为其他东西的盘中餐的话，就绝不能失手。

messages.msgid: The riots were brutal, even before the dead rose and started to devour the living.  The line you were holding broke.  It was only through a bit of luck and a lot of head-bashing that you got away in one piece, and the worst is yet to come.
translations: 暴乱相当残酷，甚至在死人复活吞噬活人之前。你们的防线很快被突破了。你依靠无敌的幸运以及敲碎不少脑袋才勉强全身而退，但最糟糕的日子还在后头。

messages.msgid: Just a small-town deputy, you got the call and were ready to ride to the rescue.  Soon it was you who needed rescuing, and you had to abandon your motorcycle to escape.  Who's going to respect your authority when the government this badge represents doesn't exist anymore?
translations: 你只是一名小镇的副警长，你接到了求救电话，准备驶向现场。但很快你发现自己才是需要救援的那个人，你不得不弃车逃跑。当这个徽章所代表的政府已经不复存在时，谁还会尊重你的权威呢？

messages.msgid: They said you'd sell your own mother for a dollar.  How dare they!  You've been around the block a few times, and you'd charge way more than a dollar - and get it, too!
translations: 他们说你会为了区区一美元把亲妈都卖了。简直岂有此理！你在世道里摸爬滚打多年，真要卖，也绝不止这个价——而且你还真能把钱拿到手。

messages.msgid: A great fan of the archers of old, but at the same time a follower of the latest trends in archery.  You always tried to keep up with the times, acquiring a takedown bow as well as several accessories to complement it.  You can only hope all the training you did with them can help you survive in this trying times.
translations: 你既是古代弓手的忠实粉丝，同时也追随当代射箭的最新潮流。你一向努力与时俱进，入手了一把可拆卸反曲弓，并配齐了多种配件与之相辅相成。你只能寄望于自己用这些装备刻苦训练的成果，能在这艰难的时世里助你活下去。

messages.msgid: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and quickly developed a talent for archery.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty bow.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.
translations: 你从小就爱打猎，很快你就发现自己有射箭的天赋。如果世界末日到来，你最希望你所信赖的弓箭能在你身边。所以，当末日真的来临时，你确保自己带上了它。

messages.msgid: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and crossbow hunting was always your favorite.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty crossbow.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along, though most of your bolts were lost during the escape.
translations: 你从小就爱打猎，而用弩矢狩猎则是你的最爱。如果世界末日到来，你最希望你所信赖的弩能在你身边。所以，当末日真的来临时，你确保自己带上了它，不过你的大部分弩矢在逃跑时丢失了。

messages.msgid: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and one year you got a shotgun for your birthday.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty shotgun.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.
translations: 你从小就爱打猎，有一年生日你得到了一把霰弹枪当礼物。如果世界末日到来，你最希望你所信赖的霰弹枪能在你身边。所以，当末日真的来临时，你确保自己带上了它。

messages.msgid: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting, and you fancy yourself a crack shot.  Why, if the world ended, there's nothing you'd want at your side more than your trusty rifle.  So, when it did, you made sure to bring it along.
translations: 你从小就爱打猎，一直梦想着自己能成为一名神枪手。如果世界末日到来，你最希望你所信赖的步枪能在你身边。所以，当末日真的来临时，你确保自己带上了它。

messages.msgid: You always harbored a passion for hunting and a particular fondness for big-bore rifle calibers and affordable conversion kits.  Whether it was their cost-effective nature or the simple, testosterone-amplifying notion that you could retool your rifle to belt out .50-caliber bullets, you preferred them for your hunting trips.  Now, with your converted rifle in hand, you fancy that there isn't any game too large for you to take down.
translations: 你总是对打猎怀有热情，特别喜欢超大口径步枪和价格美丽的改装套件。无论是因为它们实惠，还是因为"你可以改造步枪然后射出.50口径的子弹"这种令人睾酮激增的事情，你都喜欢带着它们进行狩猎旅行。现在，只要你的改装步枪在手，就没有拿不下的猎物。

messages.msgid: You n' yer kin always figured shit would hit the fan some day, but never like this!  When they turned on you, you grabbed yer gun and a six pack, and hauled ass in the family truck.
translations: 你和你那帮亲戚一直觉得总有一天会出大事，但绝没想到会是这种程度！他们对你翻脸的时候，你抄起枪和一提六罐装啤酒，开着家里的皮卡就一路狂飙逃了出来。

messages.msgid: You used to work at a local hardware store, and you did plenty of home renovations yourself.  Now you look out at the horizon of a ruined world, and wonder - are your meager skills, and the few supplies you grabbed on the way out, sufficient to help rebuild?
translations: 你曾在当地一家建材商店打工，没事儿也替邻居们修修房子。现在旧世界已经毁灭，新世界尚未诞生——你能凭借着自己的技术以及几件随身工具，让曙光重临黑暗大地吗？

messages.msgid: You once ruled the road in your big rig.  When the riots hit, you hopped in and drove it to safety.  Now it's just you and your truck against the world.
translations: 你曾经开的大货是马路上的王者。暴乱发生时，你跳进大货，把它开到了安全的地方。现在只剩下你和你所信赖的大货车陪你面对这个世界了。

messages.msgid: You love driving, and decided to start making some money doing it.  On your way to pick up a customer, a riot broke out around you.  You took a long detour to safety, only to find yourself somewhere unfamiliar.
translations: 你热爱驾驶，并决定靠此赚点钱。就在你前去接送一名乘客的途中，周围突然爆发了骚乱。你为了安全绕了一个大圈，结果却发现自己身处一片完全陌生的地方。

messages.msgid: On your way to respond to an emergency call, you nearly drove straight into a riot in the city.  Turning off of the burning, debris-covered streets, you took a long detour only to find yourself lost.  That call will have to wait - you're in an emergency of your own now.
translations: 你正赶往处理一通紧急呼叫时，几乎一头扎进城里的暴乱之中。你驶离那燃烧着、满是瓦砾与残骸的街道，绕行许久，最终却发现自己迷了路。那通呼叫只能先放一放——你自己也需要急救了。

messages.msgid: Employed by a large company, you performed installation and troubleshooting services at the homes of ungrateful luddites.  Driving back from your last call, you were suddenly swarmed by what you believed to be angry rioters.  You veered off onto an old, neglected side road to escape, only to find yourself lost and low on gas.
translations: 你受雇于一家大型公司，上门为那些抗拒新技术的老登们安装设备并排查故障。结束最后一单返程途中，你突然被一群你以为是愤怒暴徒的人围了上来。你为求脱身猛打方向盘，拐上了一条陈旧失修的岔路，结果却发现自己迷了路，油也快见底了。

messages.msgid: You made a living driving kids to and from school, a career choice you regretted almost every day.  None of the brats were at their normal stops, and the noise of your bus quickly attracted hordes of zombies.  You escaped, but now you've gotten lost.  At least you're getting a break from the hellish screams of children, though you're starting to hear new ones…
translations: 你以接送孩子上下学为生，这一职业选择几乎每天都让你后悔不已。那些小鬼一个也没出现在平日的站点上，而你校车的噪音很快就引来了成群的丧尸。你成功逃了出来，却也因此迷失了方向。至少，你暂时不用再忍受孩子们地狱般的尖叫声了——尽管你开始听到另一种新的叫喊声……

messages.msgid: An on-duty officer, you received the call and were ready to respond to the robbery.  It all went to shit, your backup got eaten, and you were lucky to escape with your life and patrol car.
translations: 你当时正在执勤，接到报警后立刻准备前往处置这起抢劫案。然而事态彻底失控，你的支援被活活吃掉，而你能带着性命和巡逻车逃出来，已属万幸。

messages.msgid: You and a group of like-minded individuals built a hideout in the woods from which to launch looting raids in a jury-rigged pickup.  The last run went bad, and now all your comrades are dead.  Every breath you take now is an act of rebellion against the cruelty of this doomed world.  Do not let that flame of hope perish inside you.
translations: 你和一群志同道合的人在树林里建了一个藏身处，用一辆临时拼凑的皮卡发动抢劫袭击。上次次行动不是很顺利，现在你所有的同志都死了。你现在每一次呼吸都是对这个注定要毁灭的残酷世界的反抗。不要让你心中的希望之火熄灭。

messages.msgid: Your days of patrolling the park and protecting people and wildlife from each other have taught you many useful skills.  After finding a gruesome scene at a campsite and getting no response when you radioed for help, you stockpiled as many supplies as possible and set out in your pickup looking for answers.
translations: 你在公园里巡逻、保护人们和野生动物的日子教会了你许多有用的技能。你到达营地时发现了可怕的场景，而你用无线电求救时却没有任何反应，你储存了尽可能多的物资，然后开着皮卡出发寻找答案。

messages.msgid: You have your trusty wood axe, and you're okay.  You felled trees before the world ended, and you suspect the undead aren't nearly as tough.
translations: 你还活着，身上还带着你那可靠的斧头。世界末日前你砍倒了不少树，想必现在再砍翻几个丧尸应该也不是什么难题。

messages.msgid: The diners at the fancy burger joint where you worked were even more irritable and unreasonable than usual today.  You showed them the meaning of fast food… by running for your life!
translations: 你工作的高级汉堡店的食客们今天看起来比平时更加易怒和不讲理。是时候展示快餐的奥义了……为了逃命而奔跑！

messages.msgid: Small businesses often hired you for electrical work.  You were halfway through your latest job when the whole power grid went dead.
translations: 小企业主们经常雇佣你做电气工作。你刚刚做完一单，结果整个电网都瘫痪了。

messages.msgid: Fresh out of college, you were quite eager to get some practical engineering experience and leave your mark on the world, one solder joint at a time.  Now, you are not even sure if the complete failure of the power grid makes your field obsolete or all the more necessary.
translations: 大学毕业后，你迫不及待想积累一些工程实践经验，想用自己的双手改变世界。现在，电力系统彻底崩溃了，你甚至不知道自己的专业是变得毫无用处了，还是变得更加重要了。

messages.msgid: Caffeine pills and all-nighters in front of a computer screen made you an expert at writing and cracking code.  The power's gone out, and suddenly your elite skills seem significantly less useful.  At least there's no one stopping you from your dream of breaking into a military mainframe now.
translations: 咖啡因药片和在电脑屏幕前通宵达旦的日子，让你成了编写与破解代码的高手。可如今电力中断，你那一身“精英技能”忽然显得没那么有用了。至少，现在再也没有人能阻止你去实现那个梦想——闯入军方主机系统。

messages.msgid: For the past few years you've been traveling the world, sightseeing and living off your parents' trust fund.  You came home to find the world in ruins, and the only thing between you and death is the open road and your backpack.
translations: 在过去的几年里，你环游世界观光旅游，靠父母的信托基金生活。你回家后发现世界已成废墟，而你和死亡之间的距离只有眼前的大路和你身后的背包。

messages.msgid: Just an average student, you find yourself facing a test you never studied for, and the stakes are a bit higher than geometry.  Maybe there'll be something useful in one of these books you've been lugging around all year.
translations: 你只是个普通学生，却发现自己正面对一场从未为之复习过的考试，而这次的考试比高考还要可怕。也许，你这一整年背来背去的那些书里，能找到点派得上用场的东西。

messages.msgid: You just stepped out of a nice, hot shower to find the world had ended.  You've got some soap, along with the most massively useful thing ever… a towel.
translations: 你刚刚舒舒服服地洗着热水澡，一脚踏出来发现世界末日到了。你勉强逃出生天，但是身上仅带着几块肥皂，和有史以来最最有用的玩意儿……一条毛巾。

messages.msgid: You spent most of your life on a motorcycle, out on the open road with your club.  Now they're all dead.  Time to ride or die.
translations: 你把大部分时间都耗费在了改装你心爱的摩托上，在户外公路上和你俱乐部的朋友们一起炸街。可现在他们都死了。——要么骑行，要么等死。

messages.msgid: Things got a little weird on your way to your weekly dance class.  Zombies don't seem to know how to dance, but you're not about to let them step on your toes.
translations: 你正在去每周舞蹈班的路上，发觉四周有些奇怪。丧尸似乎不知道怎么跳舞，但你不会让它们踩到你的脚趾。

messages.msgid: When the diagnosis came back positive, you made a vow: to fight for your life, and to never give in to despair.  Now is the time to renew that vow.
translations: 当诊断结果呈阳性时，你发誓：为你的生命而战，永不屈服于绝望。现在是重申誓言的时候了。

messages.msgid: You were a human guinea pig, used by laboratory technicians to understand the immense power of mutation.  You are determined to live on, if only to spite them for what they did to you.
translations: 你是一只人形小白鼠，实验室技术人员用你来了解变异的巨大力量。你下定决心要活下去，哪怕只是为了用活着来回敬他们对你所做的一切。

messages.msgid: Your dreams of becoming a mutant superhero through genetic alteration may have fallen a bit short, but the scientists say you're ready.  It's time for a field test.
translations: 你通过基因改造突变成为变种超级英雄的梦想可能有点落空，但是科学家说你已经准备好了。是时候实地测试一下你的新身体了。

messages.msgid: Your house has been demolished and your planet destroyed, but at least you still have your towel.
translations: 你的家园和世界都被摧毁了，但至少——你的毛巾还在。

messages.msgid: You spent most of your life trapping with your father.  Both of you made a decent living selling your catches and running trapping tutorials.  Hopefully, your skills will come in useful against less conventional game.
translations: 父亲安放陷阱的背影充斥着你的前半生——你们靠出售猎物和提供陷阱教程度日。如今，在这场不大平常的"狩猎"中，你的技能将大放光芒。

messages.msgid: You ran into trouble coming out of class at your community college's metalsmithing program, but despite the havoc you've managed to keep ahold of some of the equipment you were carrying.
translations: 你从社区学院的金工课程下课出来时遭遇了麻烦，但即便一片混乱，你仍设法保住了随身携带的一部分器材。

messages.msgid: You were an independent artisan, who made gorgeous rings and pendants for the people who afforded your services.  You doubt the market for your work has fared well after the end of the world, but perhaps your proficiency with fine tools and metals will come in handy somehow.
