translations: 你曾是一名独立工匠，为那些付得起你服务费用的人制作精美的戒指与吊坠。你怀疑在世界终结之后，你的手艺恐怕已无甚市场；但也许，你对精密工具与金属加工的娴熟掌握，终究会在某种场合派上用场。

messages.msgid: All you ever wanted was to make people laugh.  Dropping out of school and performing at kids' parties was a dream come true until the world ended.  There are precious few balloon animals in your future now.
translations: 你最大的能力就是让人发笑，你早早的退了学然后在小孩子们的生日派对上表演，直到末日来临。如今，你的未来里恐怕再也没多少“气球小动物”了。

messages.msgid: In the rush to safety, you were separated from your master by cruel fate.  Now you are on your own, with nothing to your name but a suit of really kinky black leather.  Unfortunately, there are no safewords in the apocalypse.
translations: 在一早的玩命大逃亡中，你和你的主人失散了。你没有名字，只有一身SM皮装。让你迷茫的是，你又可以完全掌控你自己了，你不得不一遍遍提醒自己：大灾变之后可没有安全词了！

messages.msgid: You haven't seen this much blood since the war.  The whole world's gone crazy!  They ate your grandkids!  But dagnabbit, you'll make them all pay for what they've done.
translations: 自战争结束后，你再没见过这么多的血……全世界陷入疯狂！而"他们"吃掉了你的孙子！但是……该死的！你会让他们为所做的一切付出代价！

messages.msgid: After many late nights with friends watching anime and eating snacks, you decided to make the trip to the premier anime convention in the Northeast.  Now zombies are eating everyone, and even worse, the convention is canceled!  At least you were ready in case your costume tore.
translations: 在许多次深夜与朋友吃着零食看动画之后，你准备参与在东北地区首屈一指的动漫大会。现在到处有丧尸吃人，更糟糕的是，大会停办了！至少万一你的cosplay装破了，你早就备好了应急工具。

messages.msgid: The Cataclysm struck on the big day and you escaped with nothing but your wedding attire.  Cold feet?  You'd just like to keep your feet attached!
translations: 这原本是你一生中最重要的日子，但大灾变来了。你穿着盛装从婚礼现场逃了出来。双脚冰凉吗？但是好歹你的脚还和身子连在一起。

messages.msgid: All those wicked songs about the apocalypse have come to life.  Brutal!  Now that the system is dead, it's time to party among the bones of the world!
translations: 所有那些关于世界末日的可怕歌曲都变成了现实。真残酷！现在旧世已经彻底完蛋，一起来参加这个充斥着妖魔鬼怪的派对吧！

messages.msgid: As a first responder, you were a direct witness to the gut-wrenching horrors of the apocalypse.  Separated from most of your equipment and your unit while on call, you were forced to fight your way to safety with little more than your trusty iron and your bunker gear to protect you.
translations: 作为第一目击者，你无助地看着这场撕心裂肺的灾难。联系不上小队成员，大多数装备都在车上，你只能靠着手头仅有的家什杀出一条血路了。

messages.msgid: Your ska band broke up after the drummer became a zombie.  Now you're alone in the Cataclysm with some cigarettes and your mp3 player.
translations: 你的乐队在鼓手变成丧尸之后就散伙了。如今“大灾变”里只剩你一个人，身边只有几支烟和你的 MP3 播放器。

messages.msgid: Neither snow nor rain nor heat nor gloom of night stays you from the swift completion of your appointed rounds, but nobody said anything about zombies.
translations: 无论风霜雨雪、酷热暗夜，都无法阻止你投递邮件，但是没人和你说过还有丧尸的事。

messages.msgid: Your trial was contentious, but ultimately you found yourself behind bars.  The Cataclysm has offered you a chance to escape, but freedom may come with a steep price.
translations: 你的判决很有争议，但最终你还是被关进了监狱。大灾变给了你逃跑的机会，但是自由的代价似乎有点偏高。

messages.msgid: Most of your adult life has been spent in prison doing hard time.  It's been rough but you've learned a few tricks to keep them on their toes.  Time to see how tough these zombies are.
translations: 你成年后大部分时间都是在牢里度过的。日子很不好过，但你也学到了几招，让其他人都不敢惹你。是时候看看这些丧尸有多厉害了。

messages.msgid: You were a serial killer, ready to walk the green mile, but in a twist of fate you're one of the few still alive.  True death comes only from your hands, so you're in for a job.
translations: 你曾是名连环杀手，正准备踏上那条通往死刑的“绿里奇迹”，却因命运的戏弄成了少数还活着的人之一。真正的死亡如今只会经由你的双手降临——看来，你又有活儿干了。

messages.msgid: You were given a target, a mission, but killing your mark seems to have become much more difficult now.  Your employer cut contact with you and now you have to make do with what you have.
translations: 你曾接到过明确的目标与任务，可如今要干掉那个指定对象，却变得困难得多。你的雇主已经与你断了联系，现在，你只能靠手头现有的一切将就着办了。

messages.msgid: You had a genius plan to skim fractions of cents out of your company's accounts.  This plan immediately failed and got you arrested.  They said you were too soft for prison, but guess what?  They're dead, and you're not.
translations: 你有一个天才的计划，从你公司的账目中扣除零头。这个计划很快暴露，你被逮捕了。他们说你太弱了，活不到出狱。但猜猜怎么着，现在他们都死了而你没有。

messages.msgid: You clawed your way out of poverty by selling products everyone wanted, and they had the nerve to put you in jail for it.  Too bad you can't sell drugs to zombies.
translations: 你只不过是把*每个人都想要的好东西*卖给他们，借此摆脱贫困而已，条子们竟然把你关进了监狱！可惜，丧尸不愿意买毒品。

messages.msgid: You did your best to expose what was going on in those labs, but they caught you and threw you in prison on trumped-up charges to silence you.  Clearly, they should have listened.
translations: 你尽了最大努力揭露那些实验室里发生的事情，但他们把你抓了起来，并捏造了个罪名把你关进了监狱，让你闭嘴。很明显，他们早应该听你一言的。

messages.msgid: You probably needed psychiatric help instead of a prison sentence.  At least your loyal subjects have agreed to hold the line as you make your daring escape.
translations: 你大概更需要的是精神科治疗，而不是一纸刑期。至少，你那群忠诚的“臣民”已经答应在你大胆越狱时替你顶住阵线。

messages.msgid: This could be your lucky break.  Plenty of loot to be pilfered, and no cops to be seen.  Does it count as breaking and entering if everyone in town is undead?
translations: 这可能是你的幸运休息日。到处都是可以偷的东西，而且没有警察看管。如果城里每个人都成不死族了，闯空门还算是偷吗？

messages.msgid: The jury were in the palm of your hand, but after the defendant tried to eat your brain, you were forced to flee the courtroom in disgrace.  Now nobody seems to care about your objections.
translations: 陪审团被你玩弄于股掌之间，但在被告试图吃了你的大脑后，你也只能狼狈地逃离法庭。如今，似乎再也没有人会在意你的反对意见了。

messages.msgid: Armageddon has come!  You did everything you could to protect your community, but it appears that prayers were not enough.  Now that they are all dead, you should probably find something more tangible to protect you.
translations: 末日审判来了！你尽可能地试图保护你的社区。但他们都死了，显然光做祷告还不够。既然他们都死了，是时候找些更切实的手段保护你自己了。

messages.msgid: For your entire time as a servant of God, you helped, protected and listened to your parish faithful.  But the Rapture has come, and your parish turned against you.  Now all you can do is pray to the Holy Virgin, and prepare to maintain your wellbeing.
translations: 身为上帝的仆人，你一直帮助、保护和倾听教区信徒的心声。 但如今“被提”已经降临，你的教区背叛了你。 现在，你能做的只有向圣母祈祷，为保护自己的安康而做足准备。

messages.msgid: You were one of the maintainers of a Shinto shrine, performing rituals and sacred tasks.  You preferred it when only the spirits of the dead inhabited your shrine, and not their rotting corpses.
translations: 你曾是一个神社的巫女，每天清扫着它，守护着它的宁静。你更喜欢只有逝者的灵魂居住在你的神社，而不是他们腐烂的尸体。

messages.msgid: Your life was simple at the Vihara, doing household chores and meditating.  Your Sangha wanted to attain liberation from suffering, now their rotting corpses will suffer forever.
translations: 你在精舍的日子原本很简单：做些杂务，打坐禅修。你的僧团一心求得离苦解脱；而现在，他们只剩下腐烂的躯壳——并且看起来要“永远”受苦下去了。

messages.msgid: You spent much of your time prior to the apocalypse at the local mosque, studying the words of the Prophet and the Quran and guiding your community in prayer.  Back then they came from far and wide to listen to you; now they come to eat your brains.
translations: 在末日来临之前，你的大部分时间都待在当地清真寺里，研习先知的教诲与《古兰经》，并引导社群进行礼拜。那时，人们从四面八方赶来聆听你的讲解；而现在，他们同样蜂拥而至——只是为了啃你的脑子。

messages.msgid: You were davening Shacharit in shul when the Cataclysm struck.  You had always taught that God will restore life to the dead after Moshiach has come, but not like this!
translations: 大灾变爆发前，你正在犹太教堂里做早祷。你以前一直都被教导，当弥赛亚出现的时候，上帝会让死人复活，但是绝不是以此种方式复活！

messages.msgid: You spent many years traveling through the world, becoming wise and learned.  Normally you can answer any question, but even you are not quite sure what to do about the ravenous undead.
translations: 你用了很多年来游历世界，以增长见识变得聪慧。通常，你可以给出任何的问题的答案，但是即便是你也不知道该如何面对这些饥饿的不死生物。

messages.msgid: You devoted your life to spreading the good word, always on the road, traveling from town to town.  Now everything has gone to hell, you can't host your daily podcast, and the undead don't seem particularly moved by your sermons.
translations: 你把一生都奉献给传播福音，常年奔走在路上，从一个城镇讲到另一个城镇。如今一切都彻底完了：你的每日播客也没法再更新，而那些不死之徒显然并没有被你的布道打动分毫。

messages.msgid: You've decided today is the day to take your first lesson at the local dojo.  You'll be great at it, you're sure of it.
translations: 你决定今天就去当地道场上第一堂课。你坚信自己一定会表现得很出色——毫无疑问。

messages.msgid: 'Drop the martial arts!', they said.  'Learn a skill for the REAL world!', they said.  Well, you're about to show them!  SHOW THEM ALL!
translations: "放弃武术吧！"有人曾这么说。"学些*现实*玩意儿！"好吧，现在你让他们瞧瞧！狠狠打他们的脸！

messages.msgid: As the world ends, you alone stand against the coming darkness with your fists of steel.
translations: 当世界走向终结之际，唯有你一人以钢铁般的双拳，迎面对抗那席卷而来的黑暗。

messages.msgid: You were delivering the last pizza of the night to one of your common patrons when hungry zombies attempted to make a meal out of you.  Fleeing for safety, you find yourself with only your wits and some leftover pizza.  And they didn't even leave a tip!
translations: 你正把当晚最后一份披萨送往一位老熟客家中时，一群饥肠辘辘的丧尸却打算拿你当夜宵。你仓皇逃命，最终只剩下自己的机灵脑袋和几片剩余的披萨。更过分的是——他们连小费都没给！

messages.msgid: Following a clue from your dead grandfather's journal, you made your way to a long-lost temple, but then the ground started to shake uncontrollably.  You had a bad feeling about that, so you got out of there quickly.
translations: 根据你早已去世的爷爷的日记中的线索，你来到了一座沉寂已久的庙宇遗迹前，但随后地面开始无法控制地震动。你有股不祥的预感，所以你迅速离开了。

messages.msgid: You set out this morning to deliver the news of the apocalypse.  The undead hordes don't seem to value the latest news, but at least your trusty bicycle is still in working order.
translations: 当大灾变来袭的时候你正沿着熟悉的路线送早报。显然尸群对最新消息完全不感兴趣，但不管咋样你值得信赖的自行车还能用。

messages.msgid: A patch of soil, some water, and sunlight were all you ever needed; why should things be any different now?  With a handful of seeds and your trusty hoe, it's time to rebuild the Earth, one plant at a time.
translations: 一小块肥沃的土壤，一些水和阳光就是你所需要的全部，即便是现在，情况又会有什么不同呢？带上一小撮种子和你那把值得信赖的锄头，现在是时候重建地球了，从种下一棵植物开始。

messages.msgid: The government activated your National Guard unit to deal with the growing epidemics.  Despite your best efforts, you were unable to form up before all communications ceased and you found yourself alone among the dead.
translations: 政府启动了你所在的国民警卫队部队，命令你们应对不断扩散的疫情。尽管你竭尽全力试图集结队伍，但在所有通讯中断之前仍未能完成整编，最终只剩下你一人，孤身置身于亡者之间。

messages.msgid: One of the lucky few who escaped the Cataclysm, you made a life for yourself amidst the ruins of civilization.  Whether through force, guile, or luck, you've obtained the best gear you could find.
translations: 作为逃离大灾变的幸运儿之一，你在文明的废墟中为自己找到了一条生路。无论是通过武力、诡计还是运气，你收集了一些你所能找到的最好的装备。

messages.msgid: You must have paid attention to your survival training in boot camp; otherwise, you would never have lived long enough to outlast the chain of command and find yourself in this predicament.  The only mission now is to survive.
translations: 你在新兵训练营里多半确实认真听过生存训练；否则，你不可能活得足够久，撑到指挥链彻底崩溃，并落到如今这般境地。现在唯一的任务，就是活下去。

messages.msgid: You spent dull nights guarding the local mall against teen hooligans and petty thieves.  Your job training didn't provide any terribly useful skills, but you do have your trusty stun gun, baton, and pocket knife.
translations: 你在无聊的夜晚中守卫着当地的购物中心，对付青少年流氓和可怜的小偷。你的工作培训并没有为你提供任何有用的技能，但你手头确实还配着你那把可靠的电击枪、警棍和折叠刀。

messages.msgid: Over long years of self-imposed exile in the wilderness, you have come to an understanding with Mother Nature.  The world as they knew it might have ended for your forsaken species, but you can hardly tell the difference.
translations: 在野外历经长年的自我流放式的生活，你已经和大自然母亲达成了谅解。这个原属于被抛弃的人类的世界可能已经完蛋了，但是对你而言却依如昨日。

messages.msgid: You spent most of your days fishing in the swamp, getting by quietly on your catch.  You found the buzzing of insects enjoyable, but recently they've gotten bigger and meaner.  Now their horrible noises have you spooked - you just hope the fish aren't as nasty.
translations: 你大半辈子都在沼泽里钓鱼，靠着渔获安静度日。嗡嗡作响的虫鸣你原本还挺享受，可最近它们不仅变大了，还变得更凶。如今，那些可怕的噪音把你吓得不轻——你只希望水里的鱼别也这么糟糕。

messages.msgid: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world made traditional gender roles obsolete.
translations: 你正赶着前往一年一度的新英格兰革命战争“活历史”展演活动，准备亲身再现那段峥嵘岁月——结果大灾变横插一脚，把你的计划彻底、而且是永久性地打乱了。

messages.msgid: You were on your way to the Annual All New England Revolutionary War Living History exhibition when the end of the world permanently derailed your plans.
translations: 你正赶着前往一年一度的新英格兰革命战争“活历史”展演活动，结果世界末日一来，所谓“传统性别分工”直接成了过时概念。

messages.msgid: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a pair of blades than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.
translations: 你超爱轮滑！你穿着滑冰鞋的时间比脱下它还要多的多。一切都变得一团糟，但至少现在那些烦人的大人们不会再告诉你哪里不准滑了。

messages.msgid: You love to skate!  You've probably spent more time on a skateboard than off.  Things have gotten pretty bad, but at least the grown-ups aren't telling you where you can't roll.
translations: 你超爱轮滑！你踩着滑板的时间比下地走路要多的多。一切都变得一团糟，但至少现在那些烦人的大人们不会再告诉你哪里不准滑了。

messages.msgid: You never cared for grown-ups telling you what to do, so you ended up spending quite a few days in the principal's office.  Now, not needing grown-ups to tell you what to do is the only reason you're alive.  Man, you really should've played hooky today.
translations: 你从来就不爱听大人指手画脚，所以没少在校长办公室里耗日子。如今，正是不需要大人告诉你该做什么，才成了你还能活着的唯一原因。天哪，你今天真该翘课的。

messages.msgid: Your parents were crazy preppers who thought some "Cataclysm" was coming, and insisted on preparing you for it.  Turns out they were right.  You didn't get a chance to thank them.  The only thing you can do for them now is what they always hoped you would do in the dark days ahead: survive.
translations: 你的父母都是认为在不远的未来就会末日降临的生存狂们，同时也坚持教你各种应对末世的技巧。现在看来，他们是正确的，但是你没有得到一个对他们表达感谢的机会。现在你唯一要做的事情就是他们曾经教导你的，在末世来临时要做的事：生存。

messages.msgid: In dodgeball, failing to dodge meant taking a ball to the head and being out of the game.  In the Cataclysm, it means getting eaten by monsters.  Don't slip up.
translations: 在躲避球比赛中，没能躲开球意味着被球砸到头，退出比赛。而在大灾变中，这意味着你会被怪物吃掉。别出错。

messages.msgid: The school never let your club play with the really fun chemicals, the kind that make things go boom, but there aren't any teachers around to enforce the rules anymore.
translations: 学校从来不让你的俱乐部玩真正有趣的化学物质，那些会爆炸的玩意，但是现在没有老师来执行这些规则了。

messages.msgid: You were a member of the school A/V club.  You're sure there's some way you can use your technical skills to help you stay alive.  You just haven't figured out how to make an awesome death ray yet.
translations: 你是学校电影俱乐部的成员之一。你相信你能从电影中学到能够保命的技能，但是你仍然搞不懂如何才能发射死亡射线。

messages.msgid: You've been teaching kids all your life, experiencing the joy and aggravation of imparting knowledge to young minds.  If zombies have any interest in education, they're not showing it.
translations: 你一生都在教导孩子们，体验向年轻人传授知识的喜悦和痛苦。即使丧尸对教育有兴趣，它们也没能表现出来。

messages.msgid: Covering the apocalypse up close could make your career, though finding a publisher seems more difficult a prospect than usual.  You managed to hold onto your camera - hopefully you can get some fantastic shots.
translations: 近距离报道大灾变可以让你的事业蒸蒸日上，不过现在想找到一家出版商似乎比往常要困难。你成功将你的相机保留了下来，祝你能抓拍到一些美妙时刻。分享此刻，分享生活。

messages.msgid: It was hard enough getting kids to run laps without having to worry about them trying to eat your brains.  Zombies won't even line up when you blow your whistle.
translations: 要让孩子跑几圈就已经够难的了，那会儿你还不必担心他们想吃掉你的大脑。而这些丧尸甚至在你吹完哨子后还学不会排队。

messages.msgid: You're a miner, not a minor!  Your canteen is dry, your jackhammer is out of gas, and you're on your last pair of batteries for your mining helmet…
translations: 虽然你是矿工，但你不是无名之辈！（英语双关）你的水壶早已经干透，你的打桩机也耗光了燃料，而你的矿工帽只剩下最后一对电池了……

messages.msgid: Before this all began, you were having the time of your life at your dream job: blowing stuff up.  The Cataclysm means you're finally allowed to do it full time.
translations: 在这一切开始之前，你有份梦想中的工作，把各种东西炸上天。大灾变意味着你终于可以全职工作了。

messages.msgid: You've practiced parkour for many years, and made the world your playground.  It wouldn't be a lie to say that running is your life.  Which is good, because now that the end has come, you're running FOR your life.
translations: 你已经练了很多年的跑酷，世界就是你的游乐场。当你说跑步是你的生命时并没有撒谎。这很好，因为现在世界已经终结了，你正在为逃命而奔跑。

messages.msgid: This seemed like a great place for a vacation, but you're starting to regret ever leaving home.  You came here to get a taste of New England, but New England keeps trying to get a taste of you!
translations: 这里曾经是一个度假的好地方，但你开始有些后悔离家了。你本来来着是为了体验下新英格兰的风味，现在你只希望别让新英格兰尝尝你的风味了！

messages.msgid: The apocalypse has caught you completely naked!  Maybe you were robbed, maybe you were at a nudist beach, or maybe you just enjoy the feeling of liberation brought by the wind touching your skin.  Whatever the reason, you lack clothes in a time when everyone wants a piece of you.
translations: 末日降临时，你却一丝不挂。也许你被人洗劫了，也许你原本就在天体海滩，又或者你只是单纯享受微风拂过皮肤时那种“自由解放”的感觉。不管原因是什么，在这个人人都想从你身上撕下一块的时代，你却连件衣服都没有。

messages.msgid: You were called in on your day off to feed the animals at the zoo.  For some reason, none of your coworkers bothered showing up for work today.
translations: 你在自己原本的休息日被一通电话叫回去喂养动物园的动物。因为各种各样的原因，你的同事们都没能够来上班。

messages.msgid: You were always an inexplicable sight in town, with your funny hair and odd Japanese clothes.  Little of this concerned you, but last week the grocery service stopped coming and now the TV no longer turns on.  This displeases you.
translations: 你一直都是镇上那道难以解释的风景线：发型离谱，日式衣服也穿得古里古怪。你对此向来不太在意，可上周送杂货的服务突然不来了，而现在连电视也打不开了。这就让你你很不高兴。

messages.msgid: Years of training prepared you for the competitive fencing circuit, but your latest tournament was cut short when zombies invaded the piste.  The referee was eaten, so you're not sure if the rules are still in play.
translations: 经过多年的训练，你已经准备好参加击剑比赛了，但随着丧尸入侵赛场，你的最后一场比赛就被迫中断了。裁判被吃掉了，所以你不确定规则是否仍然有效。

messages.msgid: You've spent your life appealing to the people, persuading many and promising much throughout your time in office.  Now that your voting base wants to eat you alive, winning hearts and minds just got that much harder.
translations: 你的一生都在吸引人们，说服更多人，并做出了很多承诺。既然你的选民想活活地吃掉你，想再去争取人心，显然难上加难了。

messages.msgid: Taking care of cows, horses, and other animals is your passion, but the ways things are going, this isn't going to be just another day at the ranch.
translations: 照顾牛、马和其他动物是你的爱好，但按照目前事态的发展方式，这可能并不仅仅是牧场的例行一日了。

messages.msgid: You've always worked just outside of the limelight, carrying and fixing the equipment and ensuring that the performers got what they needed.  The show must go on.
translations: 你总是在聚光灯下工作，搬运和修理设备，确保演员们能获得他们所需要的灯光，保证演出顺利进行。现在责任更重了，但演出还得继续。

messages.msgid: You nailed your solo, but the audience erupted into screams instead of applause.  You weren't able to grab much during the panic, but at least you have your loaded six string on your back.
translations: 你完成了你的独奏，但观众爆发出尖叫，而不是掌声。慌乱之中你没能带走多少东西，但是至少背上的六弦琴还在。

messages.msgid: You saw a sign at the local mall advertising a discount on survival kits.  You bought one, more for show than for actual use.  Now it's all you have.
translations: 你在当地商场看到一张告示：生存套装正在打折。你买了一套，说是为了实用，不如说更像是图个样子。现在——这就是你仅剩的一切。

messages.msgid: You made your living on Wild West exhibitions and shows, impressing tourists with your displays of marksmanship.  But that world has ended, so you took your trusty six-shooter and wandered into a world where it's always high noon.
translations: 你通过进行狂野西部展览和表演维持生计，为参观者表演你的枪法，但是这种生活已经结束了。你带上了你可靠的六发左轮手枪，走向了一个永远充满危机的世界。

messages.msgid: You were living the high life, spending your parents' money without a care in the world.  At one of your usual crazy parties, the guests became hungry for more than drugs and booze, but you still have a chance to use the last symbol of your luxurious life - your sports car - and get far away.
translations: 你曾经纸醉金迷，肆意挥霍父母的钱，完全不把任何事放在心上。可在你一场又一场的疯狂派对上，宾客们开始渴望的不再只是毒品与酒精。所幸你仍有机会利用奢华人生最后的象征——你的跑车——尽快逃离这里，远远离开。

messages.msgid: You like to think of yourself as a sniper, but really you're just infantry with a bigger gun.  That said, a big gun is a definite advantage now.
translations: 你喜欢把自己当作狙击手，但其实你不过是拿着更大口径枪械的步兵。即便如此，在如今这种局势下，火力更强的武器确实是明确的优势。

messages.msgid: You were trusted with a big-ass, belt-fed machine gun and plenty of ammo to lay down suppressing fire for your team.  Now that it's going to be much harder to resupply, you should probably be more selective with the ol' spray-and-pray.
translations: 你曾被信任配发一挺大口径的弹链供弹机枪，以及充足的弹药，用于为小队提供压制火力。如今补给将变得困难得多，你大概应该对那套老式的“扫射祈祷”打法更谨慎一些。

messages.msgid: There's no kill like overkill, and not many people in this world can boast that they have a grenade launcher and know how to use it.  Just try not to blow yourself up, that would be really embarrassing.
translations: 没有什么击杀方式比“过度火力”更可靠，而在这个世界上，真正能夸口自己既拥有榴弹发射器、又懂得如何使用它的人并不多。只要记得别把自己炸上天——那可就太丢人了。

messages.msgid: Doors and windows everywhere dare not speak your name.  You're going to be breaking into buildings for supplies rather than combat operations now, but the principle is about the same.
translations: 门窗都畏惧你的名字。如今你要闯入建筑物是为了搜集补给，而非执行作战任务，但其基本原理并无二致。

messages.msgid: You're a crack shot with a rifle, and the farther you can stay away from zombies, the better.  The only thing stopping you is limited ammo, so you should try to find a place to restock sooner or later.
translations: 你是步枪射击的神枪手，而你与僵尸保持的距离越远越好。唯一限制你的是弹药有限，因此你迟早应设法找到地方补充弹药。

messages.msgid: 'Hacker' is a silly pop-culture name, popularized by Hollywood and people with little to no knowledge of what your job entails.  You prefer 'Electronic Warfare Specialist,' though nobody's really left to make the distinction.
translations: "黑客"是一个愚蠢的流行文化名称，由好莱坞和那些对你的工作知之甚少或根本不了解的人流行起来。你更喜欢"电子战专家"，尽管没人能真正区分这两者。

messages.msgid: You've been tailing your target for months, and now he's a zombie.  So much for that lead.  Command isn't responding to your calls for an evac, so you'll have to make do with what you have on you.
translations: 你跟踪目标好几个月了，现在他成了丧尸。这条线索到此为止。指挥部没有回应你的撤离请求，所以你只能用身上的东西凑合着用了。

messages.msgid: You got to see things fall apart from the sky, transporting soldiers and survivors from one holdout to the next.  You knew it was only a matter of time before the horrors patrolling the skies shot you down.
translations: 你曾在空中目睹世界分崩离析，将士兵与幸存者从一个据点运送到下一个据点。你很清楚，那些在天空中巡弋的恐怖存在将你击落，只是时间问题。

messages.msgid: You were responding to a call with your partner before you got separated.  Now all you have is your trusty ambulance, ready to transport patients through the apocalypse.
translations: 你和你的搭档在出急救现场时被分开了。现在你只有你那辆可靠的救护车陪着你，准备好把病人运过大灾变。

messages.msgid: You were separated from your partner while out on a call.  You managed to hang onto some medical supplies, but it's looking like the only life that needs saving now is yours.
translations: 你和你的搭档在出急救现场时被分开了。你设法保存了一些医疗用品，但看起来现在唯一需要拯救的是你的生命。

messages.msgid: You were on the front lines when everything happened, patching up the wounded and providing support.  But they wouldn't stop coming.  Now you're on your own.
translations: 在这一切发生时你正好在前线，为伤员包扎并提供支援。但它们源源不断向你涌来。现在你只能靠自己了。

messages.msgid: You were a member of a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping out where help was needed.  When the riots happened, you were eager to lend a hand.  But you had to cut your plans short when everyone was less interested in handouts, and more interested in eating you.
translations: 你是个非营利组织的成员，致力于帮助那些需要帮助的人。暴动开始的时候，你热切地伸出援手。但现在你不得不改变计划了，因为人们现在不想要救济品，更想要吃掉你。

messages.msgid: You used to rule the roads before they were filled with wrecks, undead, and unspeakable horrors.  At least there's no speed limits in the apocalypse!
translations: 在道路被残骸、亡者与难以名状的恐怖填满之前，你曾称霸公路。至少在末日里，再也没有限速可言。

messages.msgid: You were deployed to autopsy one of the rioters showing feral behavior before being put down.  When they got back up, you knew this was out of your pay grade.
translations: 你被派去解剖一名在被击毙前表现出野蛮的行为的暴徒的尸体。而当它们复活的时候，你知道这不在你的职责范围之内。

messages.msgid: You were about to make your biggest sale yet, but when you met the buyer he tried to bite you.  To top it off, it seems that this wasn't some sort of bad trip, as the whole town tried going for your throat too.
translations: 你原本正要完成迄今为止最大的一笔交易，但当你见到买家时，他竟试图咬你。更糟的是，这似乎并非某种嗑药后的幻觉——整座城镇的人也都开始冲着你的喉咙来。

messages.msgid: Born into poverty, you joined one of the organized crime families to make a living.  There, you quickly made it to the top and became the boss.  The government was building a RICO case against you, but doomsday arrived first.  Your crew is gone, but your past life has prepared you for a world where violence is common currency.
translations: 你出生于贫困之家，为了谋生加入了一个有组织的犯罪家族。在那里，你迅速爬升至权力顶端，成为老大。政府正依据《反黑手党及腐败组织法》对你审查，但末日先一步降临。你的手下都没了，但你过去的生活让你准备好面对一个暴力为王的世界。

messages.msgid: You were dismissed from your position as a parapsychology professor at the local university and started your own business as a paranormal investigator.  Your former colleagues didn't approve of your research, but it looks like it's paying off now.
translations: 你曾任职于当地大学的超心理学教授，却被解雇，随后自立门户，成为一名超自然现象调查员。你过去的同事并不认可你的研究方向，但如今看来，这些研究终于开始显现其价值。

messages.msgid: You were at your favorite park looking at the robins when the Cataclysm struck.  Now all you have are your binoculars and a lot of trivia about local birds to share with any survivors you may find.
translations: 大灾变发生时，你正在你最喜欢的公园里看知更鸟。现在你所拥有的只有你的双筒望远镜和许多关于当地鸟类的趣闻，可以与你所能找到的幸存者分享。

messages.msgid: You were abducted from your home, taken hostage, and used as a test subject in a lab.  For the last test, you were dressed in strange clothes and put in a room where you started to feel… different.  You lost consciousness and woke up somewhere unfamiliar.
translations: 你在家里被绑架为人质，送进实验室里被当作实验对象。在最后的测试中，你穿着奇怪的衣服，被送进一个房间，在那里你感觉……不一样了，你失去了意识，并在一个陌生的地方醒来。

messages.msgid: You are obsessed with the techniques and aesthetics of the ninja, so you practiced your movements, dressed all in black, and spent big bucks to acquire some tools of the trade.  Some may question your historical authenticity, but you're perfectly happy living out your fantasy regardless.
translations: 你痴迷于忍者的技法与美学，因此苦练身法，身着一袭黑衣，并花了大价钱购置了一些“行头”。也许有人会质疑你的历史考据是否可靠，但无论如何，你都乐于沉浸在自己的幻想之中。

messages.msgid: Your last cheerleader routine ended abruptly after your partners switched sides to the undead team.  Let's hope your quick reflexes and flexibility help you to find new members for the squad.
translations: 你最后一次的啦啦队员训练突然被打断，而你的同伴们开始改为不死队加油。希望你的快速反应和灵活敏捷能帮你找到新的啦啦队员。

messages.msgid: You are a true American patriot, dressed with star-spangled clothing from head to toe.  The government has fallen, but the nation lives on with its people.
translations: 你是一个真正的美国爱国者，从头到脚都穿着星条旗的衣服。政府垮台了，但国家依然存活在它曾经的人民心中。

messages.msgid: Does the American dream still exist?  Well, recent events have put that to the test.  Does it still proudly live in your beating heart?  Yes.  Yes, it does.  A patriot to the bitter end, you've readied yourself to go toe to toe with the Cataclysm that would seek to do harm to your darling USA.  That is to say, you grabbed your gun… and nothing more.  God bless America, soldier.
translations: 美国梦还存在吗？嗯，最近的事件对这一点进行了考验。它是否仍然自豪地活在你跳动的心脏里？是的。是的，它确实存在。作为一个爱国者，你已经准备好与试图伤害你亲爱美国的大灾变交手了。所以说，你拿起了你的枪……仅此而已。大兵加把劲，上帝保佑美国。

messages.msgid: You liked to spend your days taking care of the horses and cows, searching the perimeter of the ranch on your steed and looking out for anything suspicious, that's why you managed to escape in time when shit hit the fan.
translations: 你喜欢整天照顾马和牛，骑着你的骏马在牧场周边搜索，并注意任何可疑的东西，这就是为什么你能在事情发生时及时逃脱。

messages.msgid: You were looking forward to a nice, relaxing day at the beach.  You had to run when some lunatics tried to rip your head off and play beach volleyball with it, but at least you managed to grab your bag on the way out.
translations: 你期待着在海滩上度过美好放松的一天。当一群疯子想扯下你的头，拿着它打沙滩排球时，你不得不逃跑，但至少你在出去的时候带走了你的包。

messages.msgid: After much practice you were sure the next competition would be your big break, but your rivals started killing each other and you had to escape with only your competition gear on you.  Will your athleticism alone be enough to keep you alive?
translations: 经过常年练习，你确信下次比赛将会大获成功，但你的对手开始互相残杀，你只能带着你的比赛装备逃跑。你多年的训练让你活下来吗？

messages.msgid: You went to ride the waves, but the waves ended up riding you instead when a putrid hand appeared from underwater and grabbed you by the ankle.  You had to ditch your surfboard in favor of a kickboard, and now you'll fight every day to stay ahead of the wave of the undead.
translations: 你本来是想乘风破浪的，但当一只腐烂的手从水下出现并抓住你的脚踝时，海浪最终还是把你冲了过去。你不得不放弃冲浪板而选择打腿板，现在你每天都要战斗，以保证冲在不死人浪潮的前面。

messages.msgid: Your job was to safeguard the lives of everyone at the beach, but when the swimmers started drowning each other, you knew the situation was out of your hands.
translations: 你的工作是保护海滩上每个人的生命，但当游泳的人开始互相试图把对方淹死时，你知道局面已经超出你的掌控了。

messages.msgid: You were exploring below the waves close to shore when you noticed something weird on the nearby beach, you decided to swim away when you heard the screams.
translations: 当你在靠近海岸的海浪下探险时，注意到附近海滩上有些奇怪的家伙，当你听到尖叫声时，你决定赶紧游走。

messages.msgid: You were the captain of your small ship, making a living by ferrying divers and tourists across the waves.  The last excursion went bad after your passengers tried to mutiny, but you managed to escape.  Will you ever sail the open ocean again?
translations: 你曾是自己那艘小船的船长，以载运潜水员与游客穿行于浪涛之间为生。最后一次出航出了岔子：乘客试图哗变夺船，但你设法逃了出来。你还能再一次驶向开阔海域吗？

messages.msgid: You did the wet work for a gang, mafia, or whatever person had enough money.  You were no trained assassin, but you know how to shoot a gun and get out of dodge quickly.
translations: 你曾为帮派、黑手党，或任何出得起钱的人干那些见不得光的脏活。你并非受过系统训练的刺客，但你知道如何开枪，以及如何在事成之后迅速脱身。

messages.msgid: You were the best undercover agent they had, with a mission so vital that you had to take it even with the riots going on.  Your target seems to have turned feral as well as your contact, you are all alone now.
translations: 你曾是他们手下最好的卧底探员，任务如此重要，即使暴乱仍在继续，你也不得不接受。你的目标似乎已经疯了，你的联系人也是如此，你现在孤身一人。

messages.msgid: You've been through hell once before.  Hopefully those weekend range trips have kept your skills sharp.
translations: 你曾经从地狱回来过。希望退伍后的那些周末远足让你还没忘掉你的技能。

messages.msgid: You've always admired the beauty of urban desolation, and were ready for your next excursion when the end of the world hit.  You suppose that pretty much every building could be considered abandoned now.
translations: 你一直沉醉于都市荒废所呈现的独特美感，而当世界末日降临时，你正准备开始下一次探索之旅。现在看来，几乎每一栋建筑都可以被视为“废弃建筑”了。

messages.msgid: You felt years of your life being sapped away, slaving at your computer as you subsisted on a daily pot of coffee, microwave burritos and an endless supply of crumpled paper to toss.  Perhaps the Cataclysm is a refreshing change of pace…
translations: 你觉得自己多年的生活被抽干了，在电脑前苦苦挣扎，每天靠一壶咖啡、微波炉卷饼和无穷无尽的皱巴巴的纸来生活。 也许大灾变是节奏的一次令人耳目一新的变化……

messages.msgid: Ever since you were a child you loved hunting and traveling; so when you scraped enough money, you bought yourself an old RV, a gun, and hit the road.  You've been all over the country, hunting for good game.  Unfortunately the country is all over this time, and even more unfortunately you've lost your ol' reliable in the chaos.  Now you gotta find a new reliable.
translations: 自小时候起你就喜欢打猎和旅行，所以你凑够钱后就给自己买了一辆旧房车和一把枪，踏上了旅途。 你已游历全国山水，狩猎至尽兴。 不幸的是，这个国家也已经走到头了，更不幸的是，你在混乱中丢掉了你的爱车。 现在，你得找一辆新的。

messages.msgid: For as long as you can remember, you have lived a double life: a normal driver by the day and a heist driver in the night.  Now there are no cops and no law, but even after the Cataclysm, you drive.
translations: 在你记忆中已经你已经在这样的双重生活中度过了很久：白天是普通司机，晚上是抢劫司机。 现在已经没有警察和法律了，但即使在大灾变后，你还是当司机。

messages.msgid: Ever since you were a child you were fascinated with explosives and all things that go boom.  As soon as you turned 18 you joined the army to become an EOD technician.  While out on a call about a potential explosive in the neighboring county, your team was overrun by hordes of the undead.  You are alone, with nothing but your precious training, gear and love of explosives.
translations: 当你还是孩子时，便已沉迷于炸药和所有爆炸物。你一满十八岁就加入了军队，成为一名排爆技术员。当你为一份邻郡可能存在爆炸物的通报出勤时，你的团队被成群的不死生物淹没了。你孤身一人，身无长物，仅剩下优异的训练、装备和对炸药的热爱

messages.msgid: You've spent plenty of time training to become the next big thing.  But now it looks like you will be fighting your life from now on.  At least that training won't go to waste!
translations: 为了成为下一个冠军，你花费了大量时间进行训练。但现在看来，从现在起你将为了自己的生存而抗争。至少那些训练不会白费！

messages.msgid: As a member of the FBI, you dealt with crime that crossed state lines.  You had gotten the go-ahead to make the biggest bust of your career; before you kicked down the door, you yelled "FBI, open up!" and then the sky broke open.
translations: 作为联邦调查局的一员，你负责处理跨州犯罪。你拿到了许可，准备进行你职业生涯中最大的一次突袭行动；在你踹开门之前，你大喊“FBI, open up！”，这时天空突然破裂开来。

messages.msgid: The cataclysm may have caught you off guard, but you're not going down without a fight!
translations: 大灾变或许让你措手不及，但你绝不会轻易认输！
挑战-更频繁的空间风暴

messages.msgid: Challenge - Between a Rock and a Hard Place

translations: 挑战-更频繁的空间风暴

messages.msgid: Challenge - Between a Rock and a Hard Place
You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.
translations: 你在大灾变的初次冲击中幸存了下来。现在你滞留在一个貌似相对安全的官方疏散点。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have made your way to a refugee center.
translations: 你在大灾变的初次冲击中幸存了下来，并且历尽艰险到达了一个难民中心。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and made your way to the wilderness.  You were expecting this area to be uninhabited, but instead you see a large castle guarded by strange robots.  At the entrance stands a sign, it reads "Traders Come Well Avaunt"
translations: 你挺过了初期的灾变来到了荒野。你原本以为这个地区无人居住，但看到的却是一座由奇怪的机器人守卫的大城堡。入口处立着一块牌子，上面写着“贸易者的来的多而好的”

messages.msgid: You and your friends always talked about what you'd do when the world ended… now it's come true, and you've made your way to a remote cabin your friend Liam always said to head for.  It's been a hell of a journey.  You hope Liam and the others made it in one piece.
translations: 你和你的朋友们总是谈论当世界末日来临时你们会做什么...现在这成为了现实，你来到了一个利亚姆一直想去的偏远小屋。这是一段艰难的旅程，你希望利亚姆和其他人都能平安到达。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in an abandoned building.  Unfortunately, while you're the only one here now, you are definitely not the first person to be here, and in its current state this building no longer seems nearly as secure as one might have hoped.
translations: 你在大灾变的初次冲击中幸存了下来。现在你滞留在一个貌似相对安全的废弃建筑。不幸的是，虽然现在你是建筑里唯一一个人，但你绝对不是第一个来的。以这座建筑目前的状态来看，它似乎也不再像你希望的那么安全了。

messages.msgid: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation and are stuck in a city full of the risen dead.
translations: 无论是由于固执，无知，或者仅仅是运气不好，反正你错过了撤离疏散，并被困在一个充满丧尸的城市里。

messages.msgid: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation and are stuck in a large building full of the risen dead.
translations: 无论是由于固执，无知，或者仅仅是运气不好，反正你错过了撤离疏散，并被困在一个充满丧尸的大型建筑里。

messages.msgid: You've attracted the attention of living dead in some way, now they're all around you and you'll likely have to fight through them if you want to escape.
translations: 你不知为何吸引了一大波丧尸的注意，现在它们已经围在你的周围，而你可能需要一路杀出重围了。

messages.msgid: You've found a safe place away from the cities and devoid of the living dead.  Looks like you're on your own…
translations: 你找到了一个远离城市，安全且没有丧尸的地方。但是看起来你只能靠自己了……

messages.msgid: In the chaos and panic of the evacuation, you got bitten by something!  You didn't get proper medical care, and now the wound has started turning green.
translations: 在混乱和恐慌的撤离行动中，你被什么东西给咬了！由于没有得到及时的医治，现在伤口都开始变绿了。

messages.msgid: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it, but it always seems to find you eventually.  The only escape is for one of you to die.
translations: 自从大灾变开始以来，有只怪物一直在永不停歇地追杀着你。你可以跑得比它快，但它似乎总能最终找到你。唯一解脱的方式就是你们当中死一个。

messages.msgid: Since the start of the Cataclysm, they have been hunting you relentlessly.  You can try to fight them, but each time one falls another takes its place.  The only escape is for you to die.
translations: 自从大灾变开始以来，那些怪物一直永不停歇地追杀着你。你可以尝试将它们击杀，但每干掉一只，另一只就会接替它的位置。唯一的解脱就是你的死亡。

messages.msgid: You feel spores crawling beneath your skin.  It's only a matter of time.
translations: 你感觉到孢子在你皮肤下爬行。死亡不过是个时间问题。

messages.msgid: The building you had chosen to reside in has suddenly caught fire!  You might want to leave.
translations: 你选择歇脚的房子突然失火了！你还是快逃吧。

messages.msgid: New England is dotted with old forts from the Revolutionary War, and many of them are still standing.  When things started getting really bad, it seemed like a natural place to hole up for a while, and it turns out that many, many other people had the same idea.  The peace didn't last long.  Now everyone else is undead, and you're trapped inside the walls with them.  The single entrance being a tight choke point is looking a lot less useful now…
translations: 新英格兰地区遍布革命战争时期的旧堡垒，其中许多堡垒仍然存在。当事情开始变得非常糟糕时，这似乎是一个自然平静的地方，可以供人躲避一段时间。事实证明，许多，许多的其他人有同样的想法。和平并没有持续很久。现在其他人都成了不死者，而你和他们一起被困在墙里。唯一的入口是一个狭小的阻塞点，现在看起来也不那么有用了……

messages.msgid: You start drunk to the point of incapacitation, depressed, infected, surrounded by fire, and sick with the flu.  This day went downhill really fast.
translations: 大灾变来临的时候你正巧心情非常差，而且又喝到几乎不省人事。更别提现在伤口不但严重感染还得了流感。抬头一看，啊，运气真好，你现在待的屋子正在熊熊燃烧……今儿个真是走背字。

messages.msgid: Som nigromancie hath brought yow hidder!  Ye have only the hoose on youre legges and the knyf at youre syde and youre prayeres to Marie moder of God.
translations: 某种糟糕的通灵术把你弄到了这里，除了一把小刀和一身破烂外你一无所有。哦，不要忘记圣母玛利亚的光环照耀着你。

messages.msgid: The scientists stopped their experiments on you abruptly, leaving you behind while they evacuated before lockdown.  Find a way to escape or starve to death.
translations: 对你进行的人体实验突然中止，研究员们在实验室封锁前撤离了，把你扔在这，在饿死之前必须想办法逃出去。

messages.msgid: You were deemed an essential employee and required to stay behind during the lab's evacuation.  Find a way to escape or starve to death.
translations: 你被认为是一名基本员工，并被要求在实验室撤离期间留守工作。现在，必须想办法逃离，或者饿死在这里。

messages.msgid: You were deemed an essential employee and required to stay behind during the facility's evacuation.  You'd better find your lanyard with your badge before the automated defenses notice that you don't have one.
translations: 你被认为是一名基本员工，并被要求在设施撤离期间留守工作。你最好在自动防御系统发现你没有佩戴之前，找到你带有钥匙卡的挂绳。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  While evacuating, you noticed a mysterious sky-high wall in the distance, seemingly cutting off travel in every direction around you.
translations: 你在大灾变的初次冲击中幸存了下来。现在你滞留在一个貌似相对安全的官方疏散点。在疏散时。在撤离时，你注意到远处有一堵神秘的高墙，似乎阻断了你周围的所有方向的路。

messages.msgid: It is the winter after zero hour.  As you were scavenging for food and a warm place to stay, you heard the sound of lots of movement nearby.
translations: 现在是大灾变之后的第一个冬天。正当你在搜寻食物和一处温暖的庇护所时，你听见附近传来无数移动的声音。

messages.msgid: A little over a year has passed since the apocalypse started, and you're about to face your second summer in Hell.
translations: 距离大灾变开始已经过去了快一年多了，你现在准备好面对地狱中的第二个夏天吧。

messages.msgid: It's been a year since the apocalypse, and winter is fast approaching.  You and your company have managed to gather up enough supplies to finally settle down somewhere, away from the death and destruction.  Life has been hard for you, but in your heart you still hold a vision of a bright future lying ahead.
translations: 大灾变已经过去一年了，冬天即将来临，你和你的营地已经成功地收集了足够的物资，最终在某个地方安定下来，远离死亡和毁灭，生活对你来说是艰难的，但在心中仍憧憬着光明的未来。

messages.msgid: When the apocalypse broke out, you were evacuated to a small underground bunker.  Here you have lived, never leaving, lest the dangers of the unknown find you.  Supplies are running low, and for the first time since the Cataclysm, you will be forced to face the outside world.
translations: 当世界末日来临的时候，你被疏散到一个小型地下掩体。你一直生活在这里，从未离开，以免未知的危险伤到你。你赖以维生的物资将要耗竭，你将第一次被迫面对大灾变后的外部世界。

messages.msgid: Sickly and frail, you have spent most of your life in the patient's ward of various hospitals.  When your current one was evacuated, you were considered a lost cause and left behind.  You awaken to the sound of movement around the hospital.
translations: 天生的药罐子和病秧子，你在各家医院的病房中度过了大部分的生命。在医院集体疏散时，你因为他们认为你注定活不了多久而被遗弃。但你被医院周围的动静惊醒。

messages.msgid: When the Cataclysm happened, you were convicted or working in a prison.  Now the inmates and guards alike have turned into mindless horrors and joined forces… you might need to expedite your escape plans.
translations: 当大灾变发生时，你因判有罪或工作而待在一所监狱里。现在囚犯和狱警都变成了没头没脑的怪物……你或许要加快你的越狱计划了。

messages.msgid: You were convicted or working in a high-security prison before the Cataclysm.  Unfortunately, you're still in it, so you need to figure out how to escape.  It's located on a remote island to boot; you'll eventually need to escape that also.
translations: 在大灾变发生前，你曾因判有罪或工作而待在一所戒备森严的监狱里。不幸的是，你现在仍被困在里面，所以你需要想办法越狱。偏偏这座监狱坐落在一个偏远的岛上，所以最后逃出这个岛也是必需的。

messages.msgid: You have found yourself in the most alien place you've ever seen.  The hot, humid air and the organic appearance of the structure make you feel like you're trapped inside a giant creature.  Whatever it is, you need to get out of here before They find you.
translations: 你发现自己身处你所见过的最陌生的地方。四周炎热潮湿的空气和有机结构的外观让你觉得自己被困在一个巨大生物的体内。不管它是什么，你得在它们找到你之前离开这里。

messages.msgid: You have been heavily experimented upon for the advancement of genetic science, willingly or not.  Once the Cataclysm struck, you escaped the lab and wandered aimlessly, ending up in a forest.
translations: 为了促进基因科学的发展，你遭受了多次实验，无论你是否愿意。大灾变发生后，你离开了实验室，漫无目的地游荡到了森林里。

messages.msgid: Business had been bad — for some reason, weeks of rioting, an evacuation order, and the sky breaking with alien shadows prompted a downturn in foot traffic, even among Foodplace's chain restaurants.  As an employee, upon evacuation being declared, you disregarded company orders to lock up your outlet and, along with another survivor, opted to close yourselves within the breakroom to recuperate and plan your next move.  Will Foodplace's delicious food™ be enough to placate the horde of hungry customers banging at the door?
translations: 最近的生意一直不太好——原因种种，持续数周的骚乱，紧急疏散令，以及天空被奇怪的阴影撕裂，导致客流量下降，甚至连美食广场™连锁餐厅也是如此。作为一位光荣的美食广场™员工，在公司宣布撤离时，你无视公司闭店要求，并与另一名幸存者一起，选择将自己锁在休息室内，休养生息并计划下一步行动。美食广场美食™足以安抚成群结队在门外敲门的饥饿顾客吗？

messages.msgid: As the world was falling apart around you, something shook you out of your stupor: a phone call on Foodplace's excellent delivery service line.  It was the most incoherent babbling you've ever heard, but it was undeniably the biggest order you've seen in your years working at Foodplace, and that merits respect.  While you can't fix the tears in reality, this you can do!  You're not sure of much anymore, but one thing is certain: that delicious food™ is going to get delivered if it's the last thing you do!
translations: 当你周围的世界开始分崩离析时，某个东西把你从昏睡之中震醒：美食广场™卓越外卖服务热线打来的一个电话。这是你听过的最语无伦次的喋喋不休，但不可否认，这是你在美食广场™工作多年来遇到过的最大订单，这显然值得重视。虽然你不能修复时空裂隙，但你得做完这单！虽然你不确定到底发生了什么，但有一点是肯定的：美食广场美食™使命必达，即便这是你现在最不想做的事！

messages.msgid: Once it became clear that the world was ending you took to the skies, hoping that your flying skills could lead you to safety.  You found no standing safe zones, and when your fuel ran out, were forced to land in open field.
translations: 当世界末日的到来变得十分明朗之后，你就飞上了天，希望你的飞行技能能让你找到安全的庇护所。你没有发现任何安全区，当你的燃料用完后，你迫降在空地上。

messages.msgid: You find yourself among trees.  The screaming and moaning is fainter this far from civilization, but you'd better know what you're doing out here.
translations: 你发现你置身树林之中。在这远离文明的偏远之地。一切尖叫和呻吟都已变得微弱，不过你最好搞明白你到这儿来是要干什么。

messages.msgid: While being transported to a different military base, the pilot lost control of the helicopter and crashed in the middle of nowhere.  You seem to be the only survivor.
translations: 当你正乘坐直升机转移基地时，驾驶员失去了对直升机的控制，你们坠毁到了荒野之中。你看起来是唯一的幸存者。

messages.msgid: You were participating in a mining operation when you found… something.  You're not sure what, but it sure is dark down here.
translations: 当你在进行采矿作业的时候，你发现了……某种东西。你不知道那是什么，但有一点肯定的是，这底下真的很黑。

messages.msgid: You'd been unsurprised when your vacation — a hastily arranged holiday to a remote resort to maintain distance from the riots — had been put out of its misery when state-wide evacuation was ordered after weeks of worsening violence, and the complex had been placed on a shortlist for civilian gathering sites.  After days of waiting for a non-existent rescue and refugees bringing tales of monsters and the dead, the remaining staff had taken steps to keep spirits up, and last evening, they did that in the best way they knew — hosting a party.  Considering that it lured scores of zombies, you could probably classify that decision as a 'road to literal hell paved with good intentions.'
translations: 当你为了远离骚乱而匆忙安排的前往某处偏远度假胜地的假期突然结束时，你并不感到惊讶，在持续数周不断恶化的暴力事件之后，政府下达了全州范围内的紧急疏散令，而你所在位置被列入平民集合点的候选名单。在经历了连续几天等待根本不存在的救援，并听过难民们所带来的怪物和死者的故事后，幸存的工作人员想要采取一些措施来提振精神，昨晚，他们用他们所想到的最好方式——举办了一场派对。考虑到它吸引来了大量丧尸，你也许会把这个主意总结为“通往地狱之路是由善意铺就的”。

messages.msgid: You decided the open road would be a better prospect than the zombie-filled cities.  While en route to your destination, you were involved in a crash that totaled your vehicle.  Injured and alone, you'll need to think fast if you want to survive.
translations: 你认为郊外道路比充满丧尸的城市更有前景。在前往目的地的途中，你卷入了一场车祸，导致你的车完全报废。受伤又孤独，你得动动脑才能活下来。

messages.msgid: You found yourself alone in an open field when reality began to heave and crack all around you.  You need to find shelter, and fast.
translations: 当现实开始在你周围波动破裂时，你发现自己独自一人身处旷野之中。你需要立刻寻找一处避难所。

messages.msgid: You've managed to get to a shelter, but reality has grown weaker than normal, and portal storms will be quite strong.
translations: 你设法找到了一处避难所，但现实已经变得比平常更弱，空间风暴马上会变得更加强烈。

messages.msgid: You've managed to get to a shelter, but reality has grown weaker than normal, and portal storms will be more frequent.
translations: 你设法找到了一处避难所，但现实已经变得比平常更弱，空间风暴马上会变得更加频繁。

messages.msgid: You were caught in a huge and unstable portal storm, and were utterly unprotected from the full force of its effects.  You're on the tail end of the storm now, and while you've survived, you feel… different.
translations: 你遭遇了一场巨大而不稳定的空间风暴，毫无防护地正面承受了它的影响。你现在正处于风暴尾声，虽然你活了下来，但你感觉……一切都不同了。

messages.msgid: You were living the high life when the world ended, surrounded by riches and eating well every day.  Now you've woken up, alone and drugged, in a room of your mansion that you don't recognize.  As you fight to remain conscious, you hear heavy footsteps nearby.  Time to get the hell out of here.
translations: 世界末日时，你过着奢靡的生活，每天都被财富和奢侈的食物所包围。 现在你在一个不认识的豪宅房间里醒来了，独自一人，还磕了药。当你努力保持清醒时，听到附近有沉重的脚步声。 是时候离开这里了。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  However, the people you came with started to turn and now they're out for your flesh!  You've holed up in the basement for now, but sooner or later you have to make for the door… and fast!
translations: 你在大灾变最初的恐慌中活了下来，并到达了一个相对安全的官方疏散点。然而和你一起到达的人们忽然转向了你，并开始渴望你的血肉！你现在已经躲进地下室了，但你迟早必须向门口走去……而且要快！

messages.msgid: You were on a mission off the coast of North Korea when the aircraft carrier you were stationed on suddenly and inexplicably found itself in the middle of a lake.  You have no idea where you are or what's happened, but you have more important things to worry about: everyone else aboard seems to have become violently insane.  It might be time to abandon ship.
translations: 你在朝鲜外海执行任务时，你所在的航空母舰突然莫名其妙地出现在一个湖的中央。你不知道你在哪里，也不知道发生了什么，但你有更重要的事情要担心：船上的其他人似乎都变得疯狂了。也许是时候弃船逃生了。

messages.msgid: After a lifetime of hard work, you managed to settle down in a posh retirement community.  You saw the riots on the news but assumed they would have no reason to attack some harmless old folks.  That assumption was proven wrong by a group of lunatics breaking in, leaving you no choice but to deal with them personally.  Welcome to your golden years.
translations: 经过一生的辛勤工作，你终于在一个豪华的退休社区安定下来。你在新闻上看到了骚乱，但认为他们没有理由去袭击一些无害的老人。这一假设被一群闯入的疯子证明是错误的，你别无选择，只能亲自对付他们。欢迎来到你的黄金岁月。

messages.msgid: When the Cataclysm happened, you were working in a nuclear power plant.  Now you're trapped inside, surrounded by the shambling bodies of what used to be your coworkers.  The reactor's shut down, but you don't know if there's been a radiation leak and you need to get away from here fast before you find out the hard way.
translations: 大灾变发生时，你正在核电站工作。现在你被困在里面，周围都是曾经的同事们摇摇欲坠的尸体。反应堆已经关闭，但你不知道是否有辐射泄漏，你需要在亲身测出辐射值之前迅速离开这里。

messages.msgid: You don't know what it was but you managed to lose it for the time being.  Now you are injured, surrounded and the building is on fire.  You hope you have some time before it returns to finish the job.
translations: 你不知那究竟是什么，但设法暂时逃离了它。现在你负了伤，身陷重围，大楼正燃起熊熊大火。你希望在那东西回来完成它的任务前，自己还能有些时间。

messages.msgid: You were camping in the wild to let things back home cool off.  One night strange noises closed in on you and you were attacked.  You managed to get away but can feel things moving in the dark.
translations: 你为了让家里的那些事儿消停消停而外出露营。 一天晚上，一阵怪异的声音向你步步逼近，并且对你发动了攻击。 虽然你勉强脱身，但仍能感觉到一片漆黑之中有什么东西在动。

messages.msgid: You are the only one that made it.  Everyone else died nearby.  You have to get out of here!
translations: 你是唯一一个成功的人。 其他人都死在附近。 你必须离开这里！

messages.msgid: You were trying to scavenge for supplies, and now some rough group of bandits has dragged monsters in with them where you were hiding!
translations: 你本来是想搜刮补给品的，现在一群粗暴的土匪把怪物拖到了你藏身的地方！

messages.msgid: From up here, you watched it all fall apart.  The sky cracked and indescribable alien shapes writhed in the clouds.  The horizon has returned to normal, but you still see shadows moving in the corner of your eye and feel them calling you.
translations: 从这里，你看着这一切分崩离析。天空裂开，难以形容的外星形状在云层中扭动。地平线已经恢复正常，但你仍然看到阴影在你的眼角移动，感觉到它们在呼唤你。

messages.msgid: You heard the global, worsening news and saw the nightmare in the cities firsthand — a situation that prompted you to jump from low-rent motel to cheap trailer, trying to outrun the madness.  While only you know where you'd planned to go, when you heard the government's last broadcast and realized 'no help was coming,' you resolved to raise a dejected toast and sink to the bottom of a bottle for as long as you could.  What happened in the following days of drunken stupor is an enigma.  What you do know, is that it's time to see how much of the world there's left to return to.
translations: 你听到了遍及全球不断恶化的新闻，亲眼看到了城市中的梦魇——这一切促使你走出廉价汽车旅馆，跳上廉价拖车，试图摆脱疯狂。虽然只有你知道你打算去哪里，但当你听到政府最后一次广播，意识到“没有帮助”时，你沮丧地举起酒杯畅饮，让自己沉溺在酒瓶底部。在接下来的那段醉酒昏迷的日子里发生了什么是一个谜。你知道的是，是时候看看还剩下多少可以回归的世界。

messages.msgid: When FEMA camps ran out of space the authorities used what was left of their manpower to round up people at gunpoint.  The stadiums they forced everyone into did nothing to slow down the madness and it spread like wildfire.  You managed to slip away from the worst violence but you are now surrounded and need to escape quickly!
translations: 当FEMA营地空间不足时，当局利用剩余的人力在枪口下围捕人们。 他们强迫每个人进入的体育场没有减缓疯狂，它像野火一样蔓延。 你设法从最严重的暴力中溜走，但你现在被包围了，需要迅速逃脱！

messages.msgid: During your escape you got lost and ended up at the wrong location.  Get your bearings and make a plan.  You'll need it.
translations: 在逃跑过程中，你迷路了，最终到了错误的位置。了解你的方位并制定计划。你将需要它。

messages.msgid: When the riots came to your home, you ran underground and hid.  Now days later you are lost and hear movement echoing in the dark.
translations: 当骚乱来到你家时，你跑到地下躲起来。几天后的今天，你迷路了，听到在黑暗中回荡的动静。

messages.msgid: Together with some others you decided to take up arms against the horde.  Now you are reconsidering whether that was a wise choice.
translations: 你和其他一些人一起决定拿起武器对抗尸潮，现在你正在重新考虑这是否是一个明智的选择。

messages.msgid: You've been holed up in your basement ever since the Cataclysm happened a little over a week ago, but now you've run out of food and have been forced to go on a supply run on this fateful moonlit night.  You see zombies all around you, but thankfully, most of them can't seem to see as well in moonlight as you do.
translations: 自从一周多前大灾变发生以来，你一直躲在地下室里，但现在你已经没有食物了，被迫在这个决定性的月夜进行补给。你周围到处都是丧尸，但幸运的是，他们中的大多数人在月光下的视力似乎不如你。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.
translations: 你在大灾变的初次冲击中幸存了下来。现在你滞留在一个貌似相对安全的官方疏散点。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have made your way to a refugee center.
translations: 你在大灾变的初次冲击中幸存了下来，并且历尽艰险到达了一个难民中心。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and made your way to the wilderness.  You were expecting this area to be uninhabited, but instead you see a large castle guarded by strange robots.  At the entrance stands a sign, it reads "Traders Come Well Avaunt"
translations: 你挺过了初期的灾变来到了荒野。你原本以为这个地区无人居住，但看到的却是一座由奇怪的机器人守卫的大城堡。入口处立着一块牌子，上面写着“贸易者的来的多而好的”

messages.msgid: You and your friends always talked about what you'd do when the world ended… now it's come true, and you've made your way to a remote cabin your friend Liam always said to head for.  It's been a hell of a journey.  You hope Liam and the others made it in one piece.
translations: 你和你的朋友们总是谈论当世界末日来临时你们会做什么...现在这成为了现实，你来到了一个利亚姆一直想去的偏远小屋。这是一段艰难的旅程，你希望利亚姆和其他人都能平安到达。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in an abandoned building.  Unfortunately, while you're the only one here now, you are definitely not the first person to be here, and in its current state this building no longer seems nearly as secure as one might have hoped.
translations: 你在大灾变的初次冲击中幸存了下来。现在你滞留在一个貌似相对安全的废弃建筑。不幸的是，虽然现在你是建筑里唯一一个人，但你绝对不是第一个来的。以这座建筑目前的状态来看，它似乎也不再像你希望的那么安全了。

messages.msgid: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation and are stuck in a city full of the risen dead.
translations: 无论是由于固执，无知，或者仅仅是运气不好，反正你错过了撤离疏散，并被困在一个充满丧尸的城市里。

messages.msgid: Whether due to stubbornness, ignorance, or just plain bad luck, you missed the evacuation and are stuck in a large building full of the risen dead.
translations: 无论是由于固执，无知，或者仅仅是运气不好，反正你错过了撤离疏散，并被困在一个充满丧尸的大型建筑里。

messages.msgid: You've attracted the attention of living dead in some way, now they're all around you and you'll likely have to fight through them if you want to escape.
translations: 你不知为何吸引了一大波丧尸的注意，现在它们已经围在你的周围，而你可能需要一路杀出重围了。

messages.msgid: You've found a safe place away from the cities and devoid of the living dead.  Looks like you're on your own…
translations: 你找到了一个远离城市，安全且没有丧尸的地方。但是看起来你只能靠自己了……

messages.msgid: In the chaos and panic of the evacuation, you got bitten by something!  You didn't get proper medical care, and now the wound has started turning green.
translations: 在混乱和恐慌的撤离行动中，你被什么东西给咬了！由于没有得到及时的医治，现在伤口都开始变绿了。

messages.msgid: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it, but it always seems to find you eventually.  The only escape is for one of you to die.
translations: 自从大灾变开始以来，有只怪物一直在永不停歇地追杀着你。你可以跑得比它快，但它似乎总能最终找到你。唯一解脱的方式就是你们当中死一个。

messages.msgid: Since the start of the Cataclysm, they have been hunting you relentlessly.  You can try to fight them, but each time one falls another takes its place.  The only escape is for you to die.
translations: 自从大灾变开始以来，那些怪物一直永不停歇地追杀着你。你可以尝试将它们击杀，但每干掉一只，另一只就会接替它的位置。唯一的解脱就是你的死亡。

messages.msgid: You feel spores crawling beneath your skin.  It's only a matter of time.
translations: 你感觉到孢子在你皮肤下爬行。死亡不过是个时间问题。

messages.msgid: The building you had chosen to reside in has suddenly caught fire!  You might want to leave.
translations: 你选择歇脚的房子突然失火了！你还是快逃吧。

messages.msgid: New England is dotted with old forts from the Revolutionary War, and many of them are still standing.  When things started getting really bad, it seemed like a natural place to hole up for a while, and it turns out that many, many other people had the same idea.  The peace didn't last long.  Now everyone else is undead, and you're trapped inside the walls with them.  The single entrance being a tight choke point is looking a lot less useful now…
translations: 新英格兰地区遍布革命战争时期的旧堡垒，其中许多堡垒仍然存在。当事情开始变得非常糟糕时，这似乎是一个自然平静的地方，可以供人躲避一段时间。事实证明，许多，许多的其他人有同样的想法。和平并没有持续很久。现在其他人都成了不死者，而你和他们一起被困在墙里。唯一的入口是一个狭小的阻塞点，现在看起来也不那么有用了……

messages.msgid: You start drunk to the point of incapacitation, depressed, infected, surrounded by fire, and sick with the flu.  This day went downhill really fast.
translations: 大灾变来临的时候你正巧心情非常差，而且又喝到几乎不省人事。更别提现在伤口不但严重感染还得了流感。抬头一看，啊，运气真好，你现在待的屋子正在熊熊燃烧……今儿个真是走背字。

messages.msgid: Som nigromancie hath brought yow hidder!  Ye have only the hoose on youre legges and the knyf at youre syde and youre prayeres to Marie moder of God.
translations: 某种糟糕的通灵术把你弄到了这里，除了一把小刀和一身破烂外你一无所有。哦，不要忘记圣母玛利亚的光环照耀着你。

messages.msgid: The scientists stopped their experiments on you abruptly, leaving you behind while they evacuated before lockdown.  Find a way to escape or starve to death.
translations: 对你进行的人体实验突然中止，研究员们在实验室封锁前撤离了，把你扔在这，在饿死之前必须想办法逃出去。

messages.msgid: You were deemed an essential employee and required to stay behind during the lab's evacuation.  Find a way to escape or starve to death.
translations: 你被认为是一名基本员工，并被要求在实验室撤离期间留守工作。现在，必须想办法逃离，或者饿死在这里。

messages.msgid: You were deemed an essential employee and required to stay behind during the facility's evacuation.  You'd better find your lanyard with your badge before the automated defenses notice that you don't have one.
translations: 你被认为是一名基本员工，并被要求在设施撤离期间留守工作。你最好在自动防御系统发现你没有佩戴之前，找到你带有钥匙卡的挂绳。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  While evacuating, you noticed a mysterious sky-high wall in the distance, seemingly cutting off travel in every direction around you.
translations: 你在大灾变的初次冲击中幸存了下来。现在你滞留在一个貌似相对安全的官方疏散点。在疏散时。在撤离时，你注意到远处有一堵神秘的高墙，似乎阻断了你周围的所有方向的路。

messages.msgid: It is the winter after zero hour.  As you were scavenging for food and a warm place to stay, you heard the sound of lots of movement nearby.
translations: 现在是大灾变之后的第一个冬天。正当你在搜寻食物和一处温暖的庇护所时，你听见附近传来无数移动的声音。

messages.msgid: A little over a year has passed since the apocalypse started, and you're about to face your second summer in Hell.
translations: 距离大灾变开始已经过去了快一年多了，你现在准备好面对地狱中的第二个夏天吧。

messages.msgid: It's been a year since the apocalypse, and winter is fast approaching.  You and your company have managed to gather up enough supplies to finally settle down somewhere, away from the death and destruction.  Life has been hard for you, but in your heart you still hold a vision of a bright future lying ahead.
translations: 大灾变已经过去一年了，冬天即将来临，你和你的营地已经成功地收集了足够的物资，最终在某个地方安定下来，远离死亡和毁灭，生活对你来说是艰难的，但在心中仍憧憬着光明的未来。

messages.msgid: When the apocalypse broke out, you were evacuated to a small underground bunker.  Here you have lived, never leaving, lest the dangers of the unknown find you.  Supplies are running low, and for the first time since the Cataclysm, you will be forced to face the outside world.
translations: 当世界末日来临的时候，你被疏散到一个小型地下掩体。你一直生活在这里，从未离开，以免未知的危险伤到你。你赖以维生的物资将要耗竭，你将第一次被迫面对大灾变后的外部世界。

messages.msgid: Sickly and frail, you have spent most of your life in the patient's ward of various hospitals.  When your current one was evacuated, you were considered a lost cause and left behind.  You awaken to the sound of movement around the hospital.
translations: 天生的药罐子和病秧子，你在各家医院的病房中度过了大部分的生命。在医院集体疏散时，你因为他们认为你注定活不了多久而被遗弃。但你被医院周围的动静惊醒。

messages.msgid: When the Cataclysm happened, you were convicted or working in a prison.  Now the inmates and guards alike have turned into mindless horrors and joined forces… you might need to expedite your escape plans.
translations: 当大灾变发生时，你因判有罪或工作而待在一所监狱里。现在囚犯和狱警都变成了没头没脑的怪物……你或许要加快你的越狱计划了。

messages.msgid: You were convicted or working in a high-security prison before the Cataclysm.  Unfortunately, you're still in it, so you need to figure out how to escape.  It's located on a remote island to boot; you'll eventually need to escape that also.
translations: 在大灾变发生前，你曾因判有罪或工作而待在一所戒备森严的监狱里。不幸的是，你现在仍被困在里面，所以你需要想办法越狱。偏偏这座监狱坐落在一个偏远的岛上，所以最后逃出这个岛也是必需的。

messages.msgid: You have found yourself in the most alien place you've ever seen.  The hot, humid air and the organic appearance of the structure make you feel like you're trapped inside a giant creature.  Whatever it is, you need to get out of here before They find you.
translations: 你发现自己身处你所见过的最陌生的地方。四周炎热潮湿的空气和有机结构的外观让你觉得自己被困在一个巨大生物的体内。不管它是什么，你得在它们找到你之前离开这里。

messages.msgid: You have been heavily experimented upon for the advancement of genetic science, willingly or not.  Once the Cataclysm struck, you escaped the lab and wandered aimlessly, ending up in a forest.
translations: 为了促进基因科学的发展，你遭受了多次实验，无论你是否愿意。大灾变发生后，你离开了实验室，漫无目的地游荡到了森林里。

messages.msgid: Business had been bad — for some reason, weeks of rioting, an evacuation order, and the sky breaking with alien shadows prompted a downturn in foot traffic, even among Foodplace's chain restaurants.  As an employee, upon evacuation being declared, you disregarded company orders to lock up your outlet and, along with another survivor, opted to close yourselves within the breakroom to recuperate and plan your next move.  Will Foodplace's delicious food™ be enough to placate the horde of hungry customers banging at the door?
translations: 最近的生意一直不太好——原因种种，持续数周的骚乱，紧急疏散令，以及天空被奇怪的阴影撕裂，导致客流量下降，甚至连美食广场™连锁餐厅也是如此。作为一位光荣的美食广场™员工，在公司宣布撤离时，你无视公司闭店要求，并与另一名幸存者一起，选择将自己锁在休息室内，休养生息并计划下一步行动。美食广场美食™足以安抚成群结队在门外敲门的饥饿顾客吗？

messages.msgid: As the world was falling apart around you, something shook you out of your stupor: a phone call on Foodplace's excellent delivery service line.  It was the most incoherent babbling you've ever heard, but it was undeniably the biggest order you've seen in your years working at Foodplace, and that merits respect.  While you can't fix the tears in reality, this you can do!  You're not sure of much anymore, but one thing is certain: that delicious food™ is going to get delivered if it's the last thing you do!
translations: 当你周围的世界开始分崩离析时，某个东西把你从昏睡之中震醒：美食广场™卓越外卖服务热线打来的一个电话。这是你听过的最语无伦次的喋喋不休，但不可否认，这是你在美食广场™工作多年来遇到过的最大订单，这显然值得重视。虽然你不能修复时空裂隙，但你得做完这单！虽然你不确定到底发生了什么，但有一点是肯定的：美食广场美食™使命必达，即便这是你现在最不想做的事！

messages.msgid: Once it became clear that the world was ending you took to the skies, hoping that your flying skills could lead you to safety.  You found no standing safe zones, and when your fuel ran out, were forced to land in open field.
translations: 当世界末日的到来变得十分明朗之后，你就飞上了天，希望你的飞行技能能让你找到安全的庇护所。你没有发现任何安全区，当你的燃料用完后，你迫降在空地上。

messages.msgid: You find yourself among trees.  The screaming and moaning is fainter this far from civilization, but you'd better know what you're doing out here.
translations: 你发现你置身树林之中。在这远离文明的偏远之地。一切尖叫和呻吟都已变得微弱，不过你最好搞明白你到这儿来是要干什么。

messages.msgid: While being transported to a different military base, the pilot lost control of the helicopter and crashed in the middle of nowhere.  You seem to be the only survivor.
translations: 当你正乘坐直升机转移基地时，驾驶员失去了对直升机的控制，你们坠毁到了荒野之中。你看起来是唯一的幸存者。

messages.msgid: You were participating in a mining operation when you found… something.  You're not sure what, but it sure is dark down here.
translations: 当你在进行采矿作业的时候，你发现了……某种东西。你不知道那是什么，但有一点肯定的是，这底下真的很黑。

messages.msgid: You'd been unsurprised when your vacation — a hastily arranged holiday to a remote resort to maintain distance from the riots — had been put out of its misery when state-wide evacuation was ordered after weeks of worsening violence, and the complex had been placed on a shortlist for civilian gathering sites.  After days of waiting for a non-existent rescue and refugees bringing tales of monsters and the dead, the remaining staff had taken steps to keep spirits up, and last evening, they did that in the best way they knew — hosting a party.  Considering that it lured scores of zombies, you could probably classify that decision as a 'road to literal hell paved with good intentions.'
translations: 当你为了远离骚乱而匆忙安排的前往某处偏远度假胜地的假期突然结束时，你并不感到惊讶，在持续数周不断恶化的暴力事件之后，政府下达了全州范围内的紧急疏散令，而你所在位置被列入平民集合点的候选名单。在经历了连续几天等待根本不存在的救援，并听过难民们所带来的怪物和死者的故事后，幸存的工作人员想要采取一些措施来提振精神，昨晚，他们用他们所想到的最好方式——举办了一场派对。考虑到它吸引来了大量丧尸，你也许会把这个主意总结为“通往地狱之路是由善意铺就的”。

messages.msgid: You decided the open road would be a better prospect than the zombie-filled cities.  While en route to your destination, you were involved in a crash that totaled your vehicle.  Injured and alone, you'll need to think fast if you want to survive.
translations: 你认为郊外道路比充满丧尸的城市更有前景。在前往目的地的途中，你卷入了一场车祸，导致你的车完全报废。受伤又孤独，你得动动脑才能活下来。

messages.msgid: You found yourself alone in an open field when reality began to heave and crack all around you.  You need to find shelter, and fast.
translations: 当现实开始在你周围波动破裂时，你发现自己独自一人身处旷野之中。你需要立刻寻找一处避难所。

messages.msgid: You've managed to get to a shelter, but reality has grown weaker than normal, and portal storms will be quite strong.
translations: 你设法找到了一处避难所，但现实已经变得比平常更弱，空间风暴马上会变得更加强烈。

messages.msgid: You've managed to get to a shelter, but reality has grown weaker than normal, and portal storms will be more frequent.
translations: 你设法找到了一处避难所，但现实已经变得比平常更弱，空间风暴马上会变得更加频繁。

messages.msgid: You were caught in a huge and unstable portal storm, and were utterly unprotected from the full force of its effects.  You're on the tail end of the storm now, and while you've survived, you feel… different.
translations: 你遭遇了一场巨大而不稳定的空间风暴，毫无防护地正面承受了它的影响。你现在正处于风暴尾声，虽然你活了下来，但你感觉……一切都不同了。

messages.msgid: You were living the high life when the world ended, surrounded by riches and eating well every day.  Now you've woken up, alone and drugged, in a room of your mansion that you don't recognize.  As you fight to remain conscious, you hear heavy footsteps nearby.  Time to get the hell out of here.
translations: 世界末日时，你过着奢靡的生活，每天都被财富和奢侈的食物所包围。 现在你在一个不认识的豪宅房间里醒来了，独自一人，还磕了药。当你努力保持清醒时，听到附近有沉重的脚步声。 是时候离开这里了。

messages.msgid: You have survived the initial wave of panic, and have achieved (relative) safety in one of the many government evac shelters.  However, the people you came with started to turn and now they're out for your flesh!  You've holed up in the basement for now, but sooner or later you have to make for the door… and fast!
translations: 你在大灾变最初的恐慌中活了下来，并到达了一个相对安全的官方疏散点。然而和你一起到达的人们忽然转向了你，并开始渴望你的血肉！你现在已经躲进地下室了，但你迟早必须向门口走去……而且要快！

messages.msgid: You were on a mission off the coast of North Korea when the aircraft carrier you were stationed on suddenly and inexplicably found itself in the middle of a lake.  You have no idea where you are or what's happened, but you have more important things to worry about: everyone else aboard seems to have become violently insane.  It might be time to abandon ship.
translations: 你在朝鲜外海执行任务时，你所在的航空母舰突然莫名其妙地出现在一个湖的中央。你不知道你在哪里，也不知道发生了什么，但你有更重要的事情要担心：船上的其他人似乎都变得疯狂了。也许是时候弃船逃生了。

messages.msgid: After a lifetime of hard work, you managed to settle down in a posh retirement community.  You saw the riots on the news but assumed they would have no reason to attack some harmless old folks.  That assumption was proven wrong by a group of lunatics breaking in, leaving you no choice but to deal with them personally.  Welcome to your golden years.
translations: 经过一生的辛勤工作，你终于在一个豪华的退休社区安定下来。你在新闻上看到了骚乱，但认为他们没有理由去袭击一些无害的老人。这一假设被一群闯入的疯子证明是错误的，你别无选择，只能亲自对付他们。欢迎来到你的黄金岁月。

messages.msgid: When the Cataclysm happened, you were working in a nuclear power plant.  Now you're trapped inside, surrounded by the shambling bodies of what used to be your coworkers.  The reactor's shut down, but you don't know if there's been a radiation leak and you need to get away from here fast before you find out the hard way.
translations: 大灾变发生时，你正在核电站工作。现在你被困在里面，周围都是曾经的同事们摇摇欲坠的尸体。反应堆已经关闭，但你不知道是否有辐射泄漏，你需要亲身测出辐射值之前迅速离开这里。

messages.msgid: You don't know what it was but you managed to lose it for the time being.  Now you are injured, surrounded and the building is on fire.  You hope you have some time before it returns to finish the job.
translations: 你不知那究竟是什么，但设法暂时逃离了它。现在你负了伤，身陷重围，大楼正燃起熊熊大火。你希望在那东西回来完成它的任务前，自己还能有些时间。

messages.msgid: You were camping in the wild to let things back home cool off.  One night strange noises closed in on you and you were attacked.  You managed to get away but can feel things moving in the dark.
translations: 你为了让家里的那些事儿消停消停而外出露营。 一天晚上，一阵怪异的声音向你步步逼近，并且对你发动了攻击。 虽然你勉强脱身，但仍能感觉到一片漆黑之中有什么东西在动。

messages.msgid: You are the only one that made it.  Everyone else died nearby.  You have to get out of here!
translations: 你是唯一一个成功的人。 其他人都死在附近。 你必须离开这里！

messages.msgid: You were trying to scavenge for supplies, and now some rough group of bandits has dragged monsters in with them where you were hiding!
translations: 你本来是想搜刮补给品的，现在一群粗暴的土匪把怪物拖到了你藏身的地方！

messages.msgid: From up here, you watched it all fall apart.  The sky cracked and indescribable alien shapes writhed in the clouds.  The horizon has returned to normal, but you still see shadows moving in the corner of your eye and feel them calling you.
translations: 从这里，你看着这一切分崩离析。天空裂开，难以形容的外星形状在云层中扭动。地平线已经恢复正常，但你仍然看到阴影在你的眼角移动，感觉到它们在呼唤你。

messages.msgid: You heard the global, worsening news and saw the nightmare in the cities firsthand — a situation that prompted you to jump from low-rent motel to cheap trailer, trying to outrun the madness.  While only you know where you'd planned to go, when you heard the government's last broadcast and realized 'no help was coming,' you resolved to raise a dejected toast and sink to the bottom of a bottle for as long as you could.  What happened in the following days of drunken stupor is an enigma.  What you do know, is that it's time to see how much of the world there's left to return to.
translations: 你听到了遍及全球不断恶化的新闻，亲眼看到了城市中的梦魇——这一切促使你走出廉价汽车旅馆，跳上廉价拖车，试图摆脱疯狂。虽然只有你知道你打算去哪里，但当你听到政府最后一次广播，意识到“没有帮助”时，你沮丧地举起酒杯畅饮，让自己沉溺在酒瓶底部。在接下来的那段醉酒昏迷的日子里发生了什么是一个谜。你知道的是，是时候看看还剩下多少可以回归的世界。

messages.msgid: When FEMA camps ran out of space the authorities used what was left of their manpower to round up people at gunpoint.  The stadiums they forced everyone into did nothing to slow down the madness and it spread like wildfire.  You managed to slip away from the worst violence but you are now surrounded and need to escape quickly!
translations: 当FEMA营地空间不足时，当局利用剩余的人力在枪口下围捕人们。 他们强迫每个人进入的体育场没有减缓疯狂，它像野火一样蔓延。 你设法从最严重的暴力中溜走，但你现在被包围了，需要迅速逃脱！

messages.msgid: During your escape you got lost and ended up at the wrong location.  Get your bearings and make a plan.  You'll need it.
translations: 在逃跑过程中，你迷路了，最终到了错误的位置。了解你的方位并制定计划。你将需要它。

messages.msgid: When the riots came to your home, you ran underground and hid.  Now days later you are lost and hear movement echoing in the dark.
translations: 当骚乱来到你家时，你跑到地下躲起来。几天后的今天，你迷路了，听到在黑暗中回荡的动静。

messages.msgid: Together with some others you decided to take up arms against the horde.  Now you are reconsidering whether that was a wise choice.
translations: 你和其他一些人一起决定拿起武器对抗尸潮，现在你正在重新考虑这是否是一个明智的选择。

messages.msgid: You've been holed up in your basement ever since the Cataclysm happened a little over a week ago, but now you've run out of food and have been forced to go on a supply run on this fateful moonlit night.  You see zombies all around you, but thankfully, most of them can't seem to see as well in moonlight as you do.
translations: 自从一周多前大灾变发生以来，你一直躲在地下室里，但现在你已经没有食物了，被迫在这个决定性的月夜进行补给。你周围到处都是丧尸，但幸运的是，他们中的大多数人在月光下的视力似乎不如你。

messages.context: `Ree` in this case is butchered `Roe`, to carry some sort of nautical vibe
